Title: The Shawshank Redemption
Hint: A quiet banker wrongly jailed for murder spends two decades behind bars, holding on to hope and a secret plan.
Description: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the ___ prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.

Title: The Godfather
Hint: An aging Mafia patriarch hands his crime empire to his reluctant youngest son, who turns out colder than anyone imagined.
Description: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.

Title: Ramayana: The Legend of Prince Rama
Hint: An animated retelling of an ancient Indian epic: an exiled royal heir battles a demon king to rescue his kidnapped wife.
Description: In Ayodhya, the royal palace of Kosala Kingdom in Ancient India, four princes were born to three queens, each of whom grew to great stature. Banished for 14 years due to court intrigue, Prince ___ retreated to the forest with his beautiful wife Sita. When ___ vanquishes the demons of the forest, he invites the wrath of the demon king Ravana, who kidnaps Sita. Based on the Indian epic the ___.

Title: The Chaos Class
Hint: A gang of rich, lazy prankster students at a private Turkish school meet their match in a tough new teacher.
Description: A group of affluent private school slackers enjoy a prankster lifestyle until a tough new disciplinarian headmaster arrives.

Title: The Dark Knight
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A masked vigilante faces a chaotic, scarred criminal mastermind who wants to watch his city burn.
Description: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

Title: Schindler's List
Hint: A German businessman and Nazi party member saves over a thousand Jewish workers during the Holocaust.
Description: The true story of how businessman Oskar ___ saved over a thousand Jewish lives from the Nazis while they worked as slaves in his factory during World War II.

Title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
Country: New Zealand, United States of America
Hint: The final battle for Middle-earth rages as two small heroes struggle toward a volcano to destroy a cursed ring.
Description: As armies mass for a final battle that will decide the fate of the world--and powerful, ancient forces of Light and Dark compete to determine the outcome--one member of the Fellowship of the Ring is revealed as the noble heir to the throne of the Kings of Men.

Title: 12 Angry Men
Hint: In a sweltering jury room, one lone holdout slowly convinces eleven other men to reconsider a murder verdict.
Description: The defense and the prosecution have rested and the jury is filing into the jury room to decide if a young Spanish-American is guilty or innocent of murdering his father. What begins as an open and shut case soon becomes a mini-drama of each of the jurors' prejudices and preconceptions about the trial, the accused, and each other.

Title: The Godfather Part II
Hint: A son expands his family's crime empire in 1950s America, intercut with his father's rise in early 1900s New York.
Description: In the continuing saga of the Corleone crime family, a young Vito Corleone grows up in Sicily and in 1910s New York. In the 1950s, Michael Corleone attempts to expand the family business into Las Vegas, Hollywood and Cuba.

Title: Mirror Game
Hint: A struggling professor is offered a deadly deal by a stranger who knows far too much.
Description: Professor Jay Verma finds himself in a precarious situation amidst his failing career and crumbling marital relationship. Struggling to make his way out, he seeks help from Ronnie, a student in lieu of his help to complete Ronnie's thesis. The two strike a deal, however, soon things go awry and the professor begins to question his own sanity.

Title: Daman
Hint: A young doctor posted to a remote, Maoist-controlled village in Odisha fights superstition to treat the sick.
Description: The film is set in 2015. Sid, is a young doctor who completed his MBBS has been posted to the cut-off of area of Malkangiri district Odisha having 151 villages & infamous for Naxals dominance & no basic facilities. It's journey of a doctor.

Title: Pulp Fiction
Hint: Hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife and a briefcase collide in interlocking, darkly funny LA crime stories.
Description: A burger-loving hit man, his philosophical partner, a drug-addled gangster's moll and a washed-up boxer converge in this sprawling, comedic crime caper. Their adventures unfurl in three stories that ingeniously trip back and forth in time.

Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Tsuzumi Mansion Arc
Hint: A young swordsman and his friends investigate a haunted house whose rooms shift with the beat of a drum.
Description: Tanjiro ventures to the south-southeast where he encounters a cowardly young man named Zenitsu Agatsuma, a fellow survivor from Final Selection. His sparrow asks Tanjiro to help keep him in line. A recap of ___ no ___ episodes 11–14, with new footage and special end credits.

Title: The Message
Country: Libyan Arab Jamahiriya, United Kingdom, Lebanon, Kuwait, Morocco
Hint: An epic about the birth of Islam, as a prophet's followers face persecution in Mecca.
Description: In sixth-century Mecca, Prophet Muhammad receives his first revelation from God as a messenger. Three years later, he's not alone in his quest and publicly declares his prophecy. Muhammad is fought by Abu Sufian and his wife Hind, rulers of Mecca. Muhammad's followers are hunted and tortured but he continues his calling.

Title: Tosun Paşa
Hint: Two rival families in 19th-century Alexandria feud over a piece of land, in a Turkish comedy classic.
Description: Late 19th century in Alexandria. Two traditionally rival Turkish families, "Seferoglu"s and "Tellioglu"s are competing for the "Green Valley". The winner will be determined by Daver Bey, who has a beautiful young daughter, Leyla. Both families try to arrange a marriage between a man from their family and Leyla, so that Daver Bey will be inclined to give the green valley to his "relatives".

Title: The Chaos Class Failed the Class
Hint: A pretty new teacher walks into a classroom of rowdy boys who never stop scheming.
Description: A young and beautiful female teacher starts working in an all boys high school.

Title: Fight Club
Hint: An insomniac office worker and a reckless soap salesman start an underground bare-knuckle brawling society.
Description: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground "fight clubs" forming in every town, until an eccentric gets in the way and ignites an out-of-control spiral toward oblivion.

Title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
Country: New Zealand, United States of America
Hint: A humble young hobbit inherits a powerful, cursed band of gold and sets off with eight companions to destroy it.
Description: Young hobbit Frodo Baggins, after inheriting a mysterious ___ from his uncle Bilbo, must leave his home in order to keep it from falling into the hands of its evil creator. Along the way, a ___ is formed to protect the ringbearer and make sure that the ___ arrives at its final destination: Mt. Doom, the only place where it can be destroyed.

Title: Inception
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A thief who steals secrets from people's dreams is hired to plant an idea instead, in layers of collapsing dreamscapes.
Description: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "___", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.

Title: Forrest Gump
Hint: A kind-hearted Alabama man with a low IQ stumbles through decades of American history while pining for his childhood love.
Description: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events—in each case, far exceeding what anyone imagined he could do. But despite all he has achieved, his one true love eludes him.

Title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
Country: New Zealand, United States of America
Hint: The fellowship is broken: two hobbits head for Mordor while their friends defend a kingdom against an orc army.
Description: Frodo Baggins and the other members of the Fellowship continue on their sacred quest to destroy the One Ring--but on separate paths. Their destinies lie at ___--Orthanc Tower in Isengard, where the corrupt wizard Saruman awaits, and Sauron's fortress at Barad-dur, deep within the dark lands of Mordor.

Title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
Country: United States of America, Italy, Spain, Germany
Hint: Three gunslingers race across a war-torn desert to dig up buried Confederate gold.
Description: While the Civil War rages on between the Union and the Confederacy, three men – a quiet loner, a ruthless hitman, and a Mexican bandit – comb the American Southwest in search of a strongbox containing $200,000 in stolen gold.

Title: Jai Bhim
Hint: A tribal woman's husband vanishes in police custody, and one lawyer refuses to let it go.
Description: A pregnant woman from a primitive tribal community, searches desperately for her husband, who is missing from police custody. So as to find her husband and seek justice for them, as their voice, a High Court advocate rises in support. Will their battle for justice succeed?

Title: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
Hint: A former assassin wakes from a coma and works through a list of killers who betrayed her, in a single epic cut.
Description: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride, wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover ___ attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life.

Title: 777 Charlie
Hint: A lonely, grumpy factory worker's life is turned upside down by a mischievous stray Labrador who moves in.
Description: Dharma is stuck in a rut with his negative and lonely lifestyle and spends each day in the comfort of his loneliness. A pup named ___ who is naughty and energetic which is a complete contrast with the Dharma’s character enters his life and gives him a new perspective towards it.

Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Mt. Natagumo Arc
Hint: A young swordsman and his companions face a terrifying family of spider monsters on a dark, haunted mountain.
Description: Tanjiro, now a registered ___, teams up with fellow slayers Zenitsu and Inosuke to investigate missing person cases on the mountain ___. After the group is split up during a battle with possessed swordfighters, they slowly begin to realize the entire mountain is being controlled by a clan of ___ spider creatures. A recap of ___ no ___ episodes 15–21, with new footage and special end credits.

Title: Manichithrathazhu
Hint: A psychiatrist investigates strange events in an ancestral Kerala mansion, where a woman may be possessed.
Description: A young couple, Ganga and Nakulan, arrives at the ancestral home called Madampalli of the latter. Hailing from a family that follows tradition and superstitions, Nakulan's uncle Thampi objects to the couple's idea of moving into the allegedly haunted mansion, which Nakulan ignores. The couple moves in anyway following which seemingly supernatural events begin to happen.

Title: Balkan Spy
Hint: A paranoid, retired communist becomes convinced his tenant is a foreign agent and starts his own investigation.
Description: Convinced that his subtenant is a spy and an enemy of the state, Ilija Čvorović falls into deep paranoia which leads to an absurd and destructive chain of events.

Title: Maratonci trče počasni krug
Hint: A family of undertakers in pre-war Serbia fight over money as five generations live under one roof.
Description: The Topalović family has been in the burial business for generations. When the 150-year-old Pantelija dies, five generations of his heirs start to fight for the inheritance.

Title: Süt Kardeşler
Hint: Three hapless Ottoman sailors and their commander get mixed up in a comic misadventure in old Istanbul.
Description: Saban, Ramazan and Bayram are sailors in an Ottoman Navy and Hüsamettin is their commander. Hüsamettin's aide Ramazan, Saban who is foster son of Hüsamettin's sister and Bayram who is married to Hüsamettin's niece stays at Hüsamettin's family residence.

Title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
Hint: A teen web-slinger leaps between realities and finds his own kind hunting him.
Description: After reuniting with Gwen Stacy, Brooklyn’s full-time, friendly neighborhood ___ is catapulted across the Multiverse, where he encounters the ___ Society, a team of ___-People charged with protecting the Multiverse's very existence. But when the heroes clash on how to handle a new threat, Miles finds himself pitted against the other Spiders and must set out on his own to save those he loves most.

Title: Interstellar
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A farmer and former pilot leads a mission through a wormhole to find a new home for dying humanity.
Description: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an ___ voyage.

Title: Goodfellas
Hint: A Brooklyn kid grows up idolising the local mobsters and spends three decades inside the Mafia.
Description: The true story of Henry Hill, a half-Irish, half-Sicilian Brooklyn kid who is adopted by neighbourhood gangsters at an early age and climbs the ranks of a Mafia family under the guidance of Jimmy Conway.

Title: The Matrix
Hint: A computer hacker discovers that the world is a simulation and joins a rebellion against the machines.
Description: Set in the 22nd century, The ___ tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.

Title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
Hint: A rebel fakes madness to dodge prison and ends up fighting a cold, iron-willed nurse.
Description: A petty criminal fakes insanity to serve his sentence in a mental ward rather than prison. He soon finds himself as a leader to the other patients—and an enemy to the cruel, domineering nurse who runs the ward.

Title: Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back
Hint: Rebels flee across an ice planet and a cloud city while a young pilot trains with an old master, and a dark revelation awaits.
Description: The epic saga continues as Luke Skywalker, in hopes of defeating the evil Galactic Empire, learns the ways of the Jedi from aging master Yoda. But Darth Vader is more determined than ever to capture Luke. Meanwhile, rebel leader Princess Leia, cocky Han Solo, Chewbacca, and droids C-3PO and R2-D2 are thrown into various stages of capture, betrayal and despair.

Title: Toma
Hint: The life of a beloved, self-destructive Serbian folk singer whose songs were as wild as his lifestyle.
Description: Biopic about Serbian folk singer ___ Zdravković, the man who is remembered not only for his songs and unique way he was singing them, but also as a bohemian, both in his behavior and his soul.

Title: Rocketry: The Nambi Effect
Hint: The true story of an Indian rocket scientist who was falsely accused of espionage and fought to clear his name.
Description: The story of the great Indian rocket scientist, Shri ___ Narayanan's life, a true patriot, who was turned into a villain in the blink of an eye after being falsely accused of treason.

Title: The Legend of Maula Jatt
Hint: A legendary Punjabi fighter with a tortured past seeks vengeance against his arch-rival's ruthless clan.
Description: ___, a fierce prizefighter with a tortured past seeks vengeance against his arch nemesis Noori Natt, the most feared warrior in the land of Punjab.

Title: Soorarai Pottru
Hint: A man from a poor village fights the aviation industry to launch a low-cost airline for ordinary people.
Description: Nedumaaran Rajangam "Maara" sets out to make the common man fly and in the process takes on the world's most capital intensive industry and several enemies who stand in his way.

Title: Who's Singin' Over There?
Hint: A rickety bus full of eccentric passengers travels to Belgrade on the day before a WWII invasion.
Description: On Saturday, 5 April 1941, one day before the Invasion of Yugoslavia of the Kingdom of Yugoslavia, a colourful group of random passengers on a country road deep in the heart of Serbia board a dilapidated bus, headed for the capital Belgrade. The group includes two gypsy musicians, a World War I veteran, a Germanophile, a budding singer, a sickly looking man, and a hunter with a shotgun.

Title: Pariyerum Perumal
Hint: A lower-caste law student falls for a classmate and faces the violent rage of her family.
Description: A law student from a lower caste begins a friendship with his classmate, a girl who belongs to a higher caste, and the men in her family start giving him trouble over this.

Title: Saban, Son of Saban
Hint: Two clumsy soldiers fall for a dancer and blunder into chasing real smugglers.
Description: Clumsy soldiers Şaban and Ramazan fall for a singer-dancer and accidentally become secret policemen tracking down a missing diamond.

Title: Peranbu
Hint: A quiet single father learns to care for his disabled daughter as she grows up.
Description: A single father tries to raise his daughter, who has cerebral palsy, even as she is beginning to wake up to her sexuality.

Title: Kibar Feyzo
Hint: A poor Kurdish villager must raise an impossible dowry to marry his beloved, in a satirical comedy.
Description: To bid for his beloved's hand in marriage, poor villager ___ must come up with an enormous dowry to appease her father.

Title: Zügürt Aga
Hint: A broke landowner loses his village and fortune and must try his luck in the big city of Istanbul.
Description: The landowner (Agha) of the Haraptar village marries off his old father with the young and beautiful Kiraz. But on the nuptial night, his father dies and everything starts to go bad for the Agha. Due to the long drought and provocations of Kekec Salman (big brother of Kiraz), the peasants steal the crops and run away to Istanbul.

Title: Neşeli Günler
Hint: Years after their parents' divorce, six siblings unexpectedly run into each other in a heartwarming Turkish comedy.
Description: Years after a divorce divides their family in half, six siblings encounter each other by chance and try to get their parents back together.

Title: The Chaos Class Is Waking Up
Hint: A sincere, hardworking student joins a group of lazy pranksters, who make him their target.
Description: A sincere and hardworking student joins the Chaos Class, but acceptance seems unlikely when he becomes the target of their pranks.

Title: Oppenheimer
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A brilliant physicist builds the bomb that ends a war and haunts him forever.
Description: The story of J. Robert ___ role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.

Title: Se7en
Hint: Two detectives, a rookie and a veteran, hunt a serial killer staging murders based on the seven deadly sins.
Description: Two homicide detectives are on a desperate hunt for a serial killer whose crimes are based on the "seven deadly sins" in this dark and haunting film that takes viewers from the tortured remains of one victim to the next. The seasoned Det. Somerset researches each sin in an effort to get inside the killer's mind, while his novice partner, Mills, scoffs at his efforts to unravel the case.

Title: The Silence of the Lambs
Hint: A young FBI trainee seeks help from an imprisoned cannibal psychiatrist to catch a serial killer who skins women.
Description: Clarice Starling is a top student at the FBI's training academy. Jack Crawford wants Clarice to interview Dr. Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant psychiatrist who is also a violent psychopath, serving life behind bars for various acts of murder and cannibalism. Crawford believes that Lecter may have insight into a case and that Starling, as an attractive young woman, may be just the bait to draw him out.

Title: Saving Private Ryan
Hint: A squad crosses a bloody French countryside to bring one soldier home to his mother.
Description: As U.S. troops storm the beaches of Normandy, three brothers lie dead on the battlefield, with a fourth trapped behind enemy lines. Ranger captain John Miller and seven men are tasked with penetrating German-held territory and bringing the boy home.

Title: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
Hint: A farm boy joins a smuggler, an old knight and a princess to destroy a planet-killing battle station.
Description: Princess Leia is captured and held hostage by the evil Imperial forces in their effort to take over the galactic Empire. Venturesome Luke Skywalker and dashing captain Han Solo team together with the loveable robot duo R2-D2 and C-3PO to rescue the beautiful princess and restore peace and justice in the Empire.

Title: The Green Mile
Hint: A death row guard in 1930s Louisiana discovers one gentle giant on his block has a miraculous gift.
Description: A supernatural tale set on death row in a Southern prison, where gentle giant John Coffey possesses the mysterious power to heal people's ailments. When the cell block's head guard, Paul Edgecomb, recognizes Coffey's miraculous gift, he tries desperately to help stave off the condemned man's execution.

Title: Spirited Away
Hint: A girl trapped in a bathhouse for gods must work to save her parents, now pigs.
Description: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family.

Title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
Hint: A reprogrammed cyborg is sent back in time to protect a boy from a shape-shifting liquid-metal assassin.
Description: Ten years after the events of the original, a reprogrammed T-800 is sent back in time to protect young John Connor from the shape-shifting T-1000. Together with his mother Sarah, he fights to stop Skynet from triggering a nuclear apocalypse.

Title: City of God
Hint: Two boys in the favelas of Rio take different paths, one into photography and one into gang warfare.
Description: In the poverty-stricken favelas of Rio de Janeiro in the 1970s, two young men choose different paths. Rocket is a budding photographer who documents the increasing drug-related violence of his neighborhood, while José “Zé” Pequeno is an ambitious drug dealer diving into a dangerous life of crime.

Title: Life Is Beautiful
Studio: Mario e Vittorio Cecchi Gori - C.E.I.A.D.
Hint: A playful Jewish-Italian waiter uses humour and imagination to shield his young son inside a Nazi camp.
Description: A touching story of an Italian book seller of Jewish ancestry who lives in his own little fairy tale. His creative and happy life would come to an abrupt halt when his entire family is deported to a concentration camp during World War II. While locked up he tries to convince his son that the whole thing is just a game.

Title: It's a Wonderful Life
Hint: A despairing small-town man is shown by an angel what his community would have become without him.
Description: George Bailey has spent his entire life giving to the people of Bedford Falls. All that prevents rich skinflint Mr. Potter from taking over the entire town is George's modest building and loan company. But on Christmas Eve the business's $8,000 is lost and George's troubles begin.

Title: Seven Samurai
Hint: A band of unemployed swordsmen are hired by poor farmers to defend their village against bandits in feudal Japan.
Description: A ___ answers a village's request for protection after he falls on hard times. The town needs protection from bandits, so the ___ gathers six others to help him teach the people how to defend themselves, and the villagers provide the soldiers with food.

Title: Harakiri
Hint: An impoverished ronin asks to commit ritual suicide at a powerful clan's house, but has a different purpose.
Description: Down-on-his-luck veteran Tsugumo Hanshirō enters the courtyard of the prosperous House of Iyi. Unemployed, and with no family, he hopes to find a place to commit seppuku—and a worthy second to deliver the coup de grâce in his suicide ritual. The senior counselor for the Iyi clan questions the ronin’s resolve and integrity, suspecting Hanshirō of seeking charity rather than an honorable end.

Title: The Kashmir Files
Hint: A young man learns the painful truth about his parents' deaths during the exodus of Hindus from the valley.
Description: Based on a true tragedy, the emotionally triggering film sheds light on the plight of Kashmiri Pandits (Hindus), a religious minority in the 1990s ___ valley, who were compelled to flee their homes by the Islamic militants.

Title: Sita Ramam
Hint: An orphaned army officer receives letters from a mysterious woman, and decades later a student delivers his last one.
Description: Afreen, a rebellious Pakistani student sets ablaze the car of an Indian in London. Angered Afreen returns to Pakistan to ask for money from her grandfather that she has to pay in a month's time as damages. However, she gets to know that he is no more and the only thing he has left for her is a letter-delivering task, written by Ram to ___.

Title: A Dog's Will
Hint: Two poor, wily friends in north-eastern Brazil trick their way around a village, its priest and the devil himself.
Description: The lively João Grilo and the sly Chicó are poor guys living in the hinterland who cheat a bunch of people in a small town in Northeastern Brazil. When they die, they have to be judged by Christ, the Devil and the Virgin Mary before they are admitted to paradise.

Title: Pretty Village, Pretty Flame
Hint: A small group of Serbian soldiers is trapped in a tunnel during the Bosnian War.
Description: In the opening stages of the Bosnian War, a small group of Serbian soldiers are trapped in a tunnel by a Muslim force.

Title: Nayakan
Hint: A boy who kills a corrupt policeman flees to Bombay and grows up to be a revered slum godfather.
Description: Velu Naicker, who witnesses the brutal murder of his father, kills a corrupt policeman and escapes to Mumbai, only to become a gangster.

Title: Anbe Sivam
Hint: An arrogant young man and a scarred, kind stranger share a long, rainy road trip.
Description: Anbarasu, young and arrogant, and Nallasivam, damaged - physically but not spiritually - by life, are thrown together by circumstances, and find that they are in some ways bound together by fate.

Title: The Chaos Class Is on Vacation
Hint: The lazy, wealthy prankster schoolboys are sent on a summer trip where a strict new teacher awaits.
Description: Lazy, uneducated male students mostly coming from money, share a very close band. They live together in the dormitory of this private highschool, where they daily plan their latest pranks on teachers or the other classes. Because of the financial crisis, the headmaster agrees to enroll female students. As the new students try to fit in, a struggle between both parties start, trying to prank the other part away.

Title: Gladiator
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A betrayed Roman general is sold into slavery and fights his way through the arena to take revenge on a corrupt emperor.
Description: After the death of Emperor Marcus Aurelius, his devious son takes power and demotes Maximus, one of Rome's most capable generals who Marcus preferred. Eventually, Maximus is forced to become a ___ and battle to the death against other men for the amusement of paying audiences.

Title: The Departed
Country: Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: An undercover cop and a mob mole hunt each other inside the Boston police.
Description: To take down South Boston's Irish Mafia, the police send in one of their own to infiltrate the underworld, not realizing the syndicate has done likewise. While an undercover cop curries favor with the mob kingpin, a career criminal rises through the police ranks. But both sides soon discover there's a mole among them.

Title: Alien
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: The crew of a commercial towing spaceship answers a distress call and brings back a deadly stowaway.
Description: During its return to the earth, commercial spaceship Nostromo intercepts a distress signal from a distant planet. When a three-member team of the crew discovers a chamber containing thousands of eggs on the planet, a creature inside one of the eggs attacks an explorer. The entire crew is unaware of the impending nightmare set to descend upon them when the ___ parasite planted inside its unfortunate host is birthed.

Title: Parasite
Hint: A poor family schemes their way into working for a wealthy household, until a secret in the basement emerges.
Description: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident.

Title: The Prestige
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two rival Victorian stage magicians become obsessed with outdoing each other's ultimate trick.
Description: A mysterious story of two magicians whose intense rivalry leads them on a life-long battle for supremacy -- full of obsession, deceit and jealousy with dangerous and deadly consequences.

Title: Back to the Future
Hint: A teenager is accidentally sent to 1955 in a time-travelling sports car and must make his parents fall in love.
Description: Eighties teenager Marty McFly is accidentally sent back in time to 1955, inadvertently disrupting his parents' first meeting and attracting his mother's romantic interest. Marty must repair the damage to history by rekindling his parents' romance and - with the help of his eccentric inventor friend Doc Brown - return to 1985.

Title: Whiplash
Hint: A young drummer bleeds for perfection under a teacher who never says good job.
Description: Under the direction of a ruthless instructor, a talented young drummer begins to pursue perfection at any cost, even his humanity.

Title: Psycho
Hint: A woman on the run with stolen cash checks into a remote motel run by a shy young man and his mother.
Description: When larcenous real estate clerk Marion Crane goes on the lam with a wad of cash and hopes of starting a new life, she ends up at the notorious Bates Motel, where manager Norman Bates cares for his housebound mother.

Title: Léon: The Professional
Hint: A lonely hitman in New York reluctantly takes in a 12-year-old girl whose family was murdered by a crooked cop.
Description: ___, the top hit man in New York, has earned a rep as an effective "cleaner". But when his next-door neighbors are wiped out by a loose-cannon DEA agent, he becomes the unwilling custodian of 12-year-old Mathilda. Before long, Mathilda's thoughts turn to revenge, and she considers following in ___ footsteps.

Title: Django Unchained
Hint: A freed slave teams up with a German bounty hunter to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.
Description: With the help of a German bounty hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.

Title: The Usual Suspects
Hint: A small-time con man tells investigators how five criminals were brought together by a mythical crime lord.
Description: Held in an L.A. interrogation room, Verbal Kint attempts to convince the feds that a mythic crime lord, Keyser Soze, not only exists, but was also responsible for drawing him and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro harbor – leaving few survivors. Verbal lures his interrogators with an incredible story of the crime lord's almost supernatural prowess.

Title: The Lion King
Hint: A young cub flees his kingdom after his father's death and must return to reclaim his place on the throne.
Description: Young ___ prince Simba, eager to one day become king of the Pride Lands, grows up under the watchful eye of his father Mufasa; all the while his villainous uncle Scar conspires to take the throne for himself. Amid betrayal and tragedy, Simba must confront his past and find his rightful place in the Circle of Life.

Title: The Pianist
Hint: A Polish-Jewish musician struggles to survive the destruction of the Warsaw Ghetto in WWII.
Description: The true story of ___ Władysław Szpilman's experiences in Warsaw during the Nazi occupation. When the Jews of the city find themselves forced into a ghetto, Szpilman finds work playing in a café; and when his family is deported in 1942, he stays behind, works for a while as a laborer, and eventually goes into hiding in the ruins of the war-torn city.

Title: American History X
Hint: A reformed neo-Nazi tries to stop his younger brother from following the same violent path.
Description: Derek Vineyard is paroled after serving 3 years in prison for killing two African-American men. Through his brother, Danny Vineyard's narration, we learn that before going to prison, Derek was a skinhead and the leader of a violent white supremacist gang that committed acts of racial crime throughout L.A. and his actions greatly influenced Danny.

Title: Casablanca
Hint: In a wartime nightclub, a bitter owner must choose between an old flame and doing right.
Description: In ___, Morocco in December 1941, a cynical American expatriate meets a former lover, with unforeseen complications.

Title: Cinema Paradiso
Hint: A filmmaker recalls his childhood friendship with the projectionist of his Sicilian village's movie theatre.
Description: A filmmaker recalls his childhood, when he fell in love with the movies at his village's theater and formed a deep friendship with the theater's projectionist.

Title: The Intouchables
Hint: A wealthy quadriplegic aristocrat hires a young man from the Paris projects as his caregiver.
Description: A true story of two men who should never have met – a quadriplegic aristocrat who was injured in a paragliding accident and a young man from the projects.

Title: Grave of the Fireflies
Hint: Two young siblings struggle to survive in Japan in the final months of World War II.
Description: In the final months of World War II, 14-year-old Seita and his sister Setsuko are orphaned when their mother is killed during an air raid in Kobe, Japan. After a falling out with their aunt, they move into an abandoned bomb shelter. With no surviving relatives and their emergency rations depleted, Seita and Setsuko struggle to survive.

Title: Rear Window
Hint: A wheelchair-bound photographer spies on his neighbours and becomes convinced one of them is a murderer.
Description: A wheelchair-bound photographer spies on his neighbors from his apartment ___ and becomes convinced one of them has committed murder.

Title: Once Upon a Time in the West
Hint: A mysterious harmonica-playing gunslinger seeks revenge in a frontier town being reshaped by the railroad.
Description: As the railroad builders advance unstoppably through the Arizona desert on their way to the sea, Jill arrives in the small town of Flagstone with the intention of starting a new life.

Title: Modern Times
Hint: A bumbling tramp struggles to survive in the industrialised world of factories and machines, in a silent comedy classic.
Description: A bumbling tramp desires to build a home with a young woman, yet is thwarted time and time again by his lack of experience and habit of being in the wrong place at the wrong time...

Title: City Lights
Hint: A tramp falls for a blind flower girl and schemes to pay for her sight.
Description: A tramp falls in love with a beautiful blind flower girl. His on-and-off friendship with a wealthy man allows him to be the girl's benefactor and suitor.

Title: Woman in the Dunes
Hint: An entomologist is trapped in a sand pit with a widow in a remote Japanese village.
Description: A vacationing entomologist suffers extreme physical and psychological trauma after being taken captive by the residents of a poor seaside village and made to live with a woman whose life task is shoveling sand for them.

Hint: Two former classmates meet at a school reunion after 22 years and relive their unfinished romance.
Description: Ram is a photographer and nature lover who travels all around India capturing moments. On a chance visit to his hometown Tanjavur, he goes into his school and begins to walk down memory lane to 1994 when he was a student harboring feelings for his classmate Janu.

Title: The Best of Youth
Hint: The lives of two Italian brothers from the 1960s to the 2000s, through politics, love and tragedy.
Description: After a fateful encounter in the summer of 1966, the lifepaths of two brothers from a middle-class Roman family diverge, intersecting with some of the most significant events of postwar Italian history in the following decades.

Title: The World of Apu
Hint: A jobless young writer marries a stranger on a whim and finds love, then loss.
Description: ___, now a jobless ex-student dreaming vaguely of a future as a writer, is invited to join an old college friend on a trip up-country to a village wedding.

Title: Le Trou
Hint: Four prison inmates plan an ambitious escape, but a new cellmate arrives.
Description: Four prison inmates have been hatching a plan to literally dig out of jail when another prisoner, Claude Gaspard, is moved into their cell. They take a risk and share their plan with the newcomer. Over the course of three days, the prisoners and friends break through the concrete floor using a bed post and begin to make their way through the sewer system – yet their escape is anything but assured.

Title: Kumbalangi Nights
Studio: Fahadh Faasil and Friends Private Limited
Hint: Four brothers living in a Kerala fishing village share a love-hate relationship, until a stranger arrives.
Description: Four brothers living in the fishing hamlet of ___ share a love-hate relationship with each other. Their relationship progresses when Saji, Boney and Franky decide to help Bobby stand by his love.

Title: Sarpatta Parambarai
Hint: A young labourer is challenged to a do-or-die boxing match in 1970s Chennai.
Description: When ___ is challenged to a do-or-die match, Kabilan, a young labourer, must choose whether to put on the gloves himself and lead his clan to victory, or be dissuaded by his disapproving mother and dangerous politics.

Title: Jersey
Hint: A gifted, failed cricketer in his mid-thirties decides to make a comeback to win his son's respect.
Description: After his career fails to take off, a gifted cricketer in his mid-thirties decides that he’s not ready to give up quite yet.

Title: Thalapathi
Hint: A slum-raised man befriends a powerful gangster and fights for the rights of the poor.
Description: Surya, a courageous man who was raised in the slums, fights for the rights of the poor and befriends Deva, who hires him as his commander and changes his life completely.

Title: Selvi Boylum Al Yazmalim
Hint: A truck driver from Istanbul falls for a young woman in a remote village, in a Turkish love story.
Description: İlyas, a truck driver from Istanbul, arrives in a remote village to work on a dam construction project and meets a young village woman named Asya. They fall madly in love and get married. However, their life together is fraught with conflict.

Title: Operation 'Y' & Other Shurik's Adventures
Hint: A clumsy student stumbles through three comic misadventures, including a heist gone silly.
Description: The film consists of three independent parts: "Workmate", "Déjà vu" and "Operation Y". The plot follows the adventures of ___, the naive and nerdy Soviet student who often gets into ludicrous situations but always finds a way out very neatly.

Title: Gol Maal
Hint: A man's simple lie to secure his job escalates when he must pretend to have a twin brother.
Description: A man's simple lie to secure his job escalates into more complex lies when his orthodox boss becomes suspicious.

Title: Çöpçüler Kralı
Hint: A street cleaner in an old Istanbul neighbourhood falls in love with a housemaid.
Description: Going through his daily routine in a stereotypical neighborhood, a street cleaner falls in love with a charwoman. Unfortunately for him, so does his superior officer.

Title: Zübük
Hint: A cunning politician manipulates his small town to rise to power, in a Turkish satire.
Description: This is the story of the politician named ___. He gets expelled from the political party that he is a member of, due to corruption. The journalist Yaşar wants to make a news story about his case and investigates ___ doings. Yaşar gets baffled at the sly tricks ___ played on his village people.

Title: The Shining
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A struggling writer becomes winter caretaker of an isolated mountain hotel and slowly goes mad.
Description: Jack Torrance accepts a caretaker job at the Overlook Hotel, where he, along with his wife Wendy and their son Danny, must live isolated from the rest of the world for the winter. But they aren't prepared for the madness that lurks within.

Title: Joker
Hint: A failed stand-up comedian in a crumbling city descends into madness and violence.
Description: During the 1980s, a failed stand-up comedian is driven insane and turns to a life of crime and chaos in Gotham City while becoming an infamous psychopathic crime figure.

Title: The Dark Knight Rises
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Eight years after his last appearance, a caped vigilante returns to face a masked terrorist who takes over the city.
Description: Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes to protect the late attorney's reputation and is subsequently hunted by the Gotham City Police Department. Eight years later, Batman encounters the mysterious Selina Kyle and the villainous Bane, a new terrorist leader who overwhelms Gotham's finest.

Title: Aliens
Hint: The sole survivor of an alien attack returns with a team of marines to a colony overrun by monsters.
Description: Ripley, the sole survivor of the Nostromo's deadly encounter with the monstrous Alien, returns to Earth after drifting through space in hypersleep for 57 years. Although her story is initially met with skepticism, she agrees to accompany a team of Colonial Marines back to LV-426.

Title: Avengers: Endgame
Hint: After half of all life vanishes, the remaining superheroes attempt a time heist to undo the damage.
Description: After the devastating events of ___: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the ___ must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.

Title: Oldboy
Hint: A man who has been imprisoned in a room for 15 years without explanation is released and seeks revenge.
Description: With no clue how he came to be imprisoned, drugged and tortured for 15 years, a desperate man seeks revenge on his captors.

Title: Amadeus
Hint: A jealous, mediocre court composer becomes obsessed with destroying a young musical genius.
Description: Disciplined Italian composer Antonio Salieri becomes consumed by jealousy and resentment towards the hedonistic and remarkably talented young Salzburger composer Wolfgang ___ Mozart.

Title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
Hint: A Brooklyn teen gets bitten, gets powers, and meets heroes from other worlds.
Description: Struggling to find his place in the world while juggling school and family, Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales is unexpectedly bitten by a radioactive ___ and develops unfathomable powers just like the one and only ___.

Title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
Hint: A professor and archaeologist races the Nazis to find a powerful biblical artefact.
Description: When Dr. Indiana Jones – the tweed-suited professor who just happens to be a celebrated archaeologist – is hired by the government to locate the legendary ___ of the Covenant, he finds himself up against the entire Nazi regime.

Title: Come and See
Hint: A Belarusian village boy joins the partisans during WWII and witnesses unimaginable horror as his face ages before our eyes.
Description: The invasion of a village in Belarus by German forces sends young Florya into the forest to join the weary Resistance fighters, against his family's wishes. There he meets a girl, Glasha, who accompanies him back to his village. On returning home, Florya finds his family and fellow peasants massacred.

Title: Memento
Hint: A man with short-term memory loss uses tattoos and photos to hunt his wife's killer.
Description: Leonard Shelby is tracking down the man who raped and murdered his wife. The difficulty of locating his wife's killer, however, is compounded by the fact that he suffers from a rare, untreatable form of short-term memory loss. Although he can recall details of life before his accident, Leonard cannot remember what happened fifteen minutes ago, where he's going, or why.

Title: Apocalypse Now
Hint: A US Army captain travels up a river into Cambodia to assassinate a renegade colonel during the Vietnam War.
Description: At the height of the Vietnam war, Captain Benjamin Willard is sent on a dangerous mission that, officially, "does not exist, nor will it ever exist." His goal is to locate - and eliminate - a mysterious Green Beret Colonel named Walter Kurtz, who has been leading his personal army on illegal guerrilla missions into enemy territory.

Title: Coco
Hint: A boy who dreams of being a musician enters the colourful Land of the Dead to find his great-great-grandfather.
Description: Despite his family’s baffling generations-old ban on music, Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning and colorful Land of the Dead following a mysterious chain of events.

Title: Avengers: Infinity War
Hint: A team of superheroes and their allies battle a powerful titan who seeks to wipe out half of all life.
Description: As the ___ and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six ___ Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality.

Title: WALL·E
Hint: A lonely trash-compacting robot on an abandoned Earth falls in love and follows her into space.
Description: After hundreds of years doing what he was built for, ___•E— a robot designed to clean up the earth—discovers a new purpose in life when he meets a sleek search robot named EVE. EVE comes to realize that ___•E has inadvertently stumbled upon the key to the planet's future, and races back to space to report to the humans.

Title: 3 Idiots
Hint: Two friends search for the free-spirited classmate who rewrote their college rules.
Description: Rascal. Joker. Dreamer. Genius... You've never met a college student quite like "Rancho." From the moment he arrives at India's most prestigious university, Rancho's outlandish schemes turn the campus upside down—along with the lives of his two newfound best friends. Together, they make life miserable for "Virus," the school’s uptight and heartless dean.

Title: Your Name.
Hint: Two teenagers who have never met start magically swapping bodies, and a comet is coming.
Description: High schoolers Mitsuha and Taki are complete strangers living separate lives. But one night, they suddenly switch places. Mitsuha wakes up in Taki’s body, and he in hers. This bizarre occurrence continues to happen randomly, and the two must adjust their lives around each other.

Title: The Lives of Others
Hint: An East German secret police officer spies on a playwright and becomes absorbed in his life.
Description: In 1984 East Berlin, dedicated Stasi officer Gerd Wiesler begins spying on a famous playwright and his actress-lover Christa-Maria. Wiesler becomes unexpectedly sympathetic to the couple, and faces conflicting loyalties when his superior takes a liking to Christa-Maria.

Title: Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A deranged general launches a nuclear attack, and the US war room scrambles to call it off in a dark satire.
Description: After the insane General Jack D. Ripper initiates a nuclear strike on the Soviet Union, a war room full of politicians, generals and a Russian diplomat all frantically try to stop it.

Title: Capernaum
Country: France, Lebanon, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A 12-year-old boy in Beirut sues his parents for bringing him into a world of poverty.
Description: After running away from his negligent parents, committing a violent crime and being sentenced to five years in jail, a hardened, streetwise 12-year-old Lebanese boy sues his parents in protest of the life they have given him.

Title: Das Boot
Hint: A German submarine hunts Allied ships in WWII and soon becomes the hunted.
Description: A German submarine hunts allied ships during the Second World War, but it soon becomes the hunted. The crew tries to survive below the surface, while stretching both the boat and themselves to their limits.

Title: Sunset Blvd.
Hint: A struggling screenwriter becomes entangled with a former silent film star who dreams of a comeback.
Description: A hack screenwriter writes a screenplay for a former silent film star who has faded into Hollywood obscurity.

Title: Paths of Glory
Hint: A WWI French colonel defends three soldiers on trial for cowardice after a failed attack.
Description: A commanding officer defends three scapegoats on trial for a failed offensive that occurred within the French Army in 1916.

Title: Witness for the Prosecution
Hint: An ailing barrister defends a man accused of murdering a wealthy widow, in a twisty courtroom drama.
Description: An ailing barrister is thrust back into the courtroom in what becomes one of the most unusual and eventful murder cases of the lawyer's career when he finds himself defending a man being tried for the murder of a socialite.

Title: High and Low
Hint: A shoe executive faces a choice when kidnappers mistakenly seize his chauffeur's son instead of his own.
Description: A Yokohama shoe executive faces a wrenching choice when kidnappers mistakenly seize his chauffeur’s son but demand the ransom anyway.

Title: The Great Dictator
Hint: A Jewish barber is mistaken for a ruthless fascist leader in this satire of the Nazi era.
Description: ___ Adenoid Hynkel tries to expand his empire while a poor Jewish barber tries to avoid persecution from Hynkel's regime.

Title: Kaithi
Hint: A paroled prisoner on his way to meet his daughter is forced to drive a truckload of cops.
Description: Dilli, a convicted criminal, is out on parole to meet his daughter. However, a drug bust sets him off on a mission to save the life of police officers.

Title: Sardar Udham
Hint: A young man scarred by a colonial massacre spends 21 years seeking revenge on the official responsible.
Description: A young ___ Singh left deeply scarred by the Jallianwala Bagh massacre, escaped into the mountains of Afghanistan, reaching London in 1933-34. Carrying an unhealed wound for 21 years, the revolutionary assassinated Michael O’Dwyer on 13th March, 1940, the man at the helm of affairs in Punjab, April 1919 to avenge the lost lives of his beloved brethren.

Title: Dil Bechara
Hint: A young woman with terminal cancer falls for a charming man, in a bittersweet romance.
Description: Kizie and Manny, two ordinary people brought together by a tragic twist, embark on a bittersweet and extraordinary journey into the heart of that crazy little thing called 'life'.

Title: Drishyam 2
Hint: Seven years after covering up a crime, a family man must outwit the police once again.
Description: Seven years after the events of the first film, the family lives with the trauma from that fateful night. A gripping tale of an investigation and a family threatened by it. Will Georgekutty be able to protect his family this time?

Title: Asuran
Hint: A peaceful farmer must protect his family after his teenage son kills a rich landlord.
Description: A family from the underprivileged class is on the run after the teenaged son kills a rich man from the upper caste. Can the pacifist father be able to save his hot-blooded son?

Title: Sansho the Bailiff
Hint: An exiled governor's children are kidnapped and sold into slavery in feudal Japan.
Description: In 11th-century feudal Japan, following the exile of an idealistic governor, his wife and children are separated by slave traders; the children, Zushio and Anju, are sold into brutal servitude under the cruel ___.

Title: Black Friday
Hint: A group of toy store employees must protect each other from a horde of infected shoppers.
Description: A group of toy store employees must protect each other from a horde of parasite infected shoppers.

Title: The Pinchcliffe Grand Prix
Hint: A bicycle repairman and his animal friends build a super racing car in a Norwegian stop-motion classic.
Description: 100 miles north, a bit east and up, is ___, the home of bicycle repairman Reodor Felgen and his two assistants, Solan Gundersen and Ludvig. Sponsored by oil sheik Ben Redic Fy Fazan, they build the car "Il Tempo Gigante" to race against Reodor's former assistant Rudolf Blodstrupmoen, who has stolen one of Reodor's inventions to become a world racing champion.

Title: The Lizard
Hint: A petty thief escapes prison disguised as a cleric, and becomes a popular preacher.
Description: The satirical commentary on clergymen in post-revolutionary Iran. While in prison, petty criminal Reza (Parviz Parastui) comes across a clergyman, sparking a plan for escape. Reza dons his new acquaintance's clerical robes and makes a bid for freedom. He soon learns that being a clergyman brings little respect from the public. Reza travels to the outlying villages, from where he plots to escape the country.

Title: Vada Chennai
Hint: A young carrom player in a gritty Tamil port city becomes caught up in a long-running gang war.
Description: Anbu, a young carrom player in North ___ becomes inadvertently involved in an ongoing conflict between two local gangsters.

Title: When I Grow Up, I'll Be a Kangaroo
Hint: Three intertwined, tragicomic stories of hapless young men chasing love and dreams on a Belgrade rooftop.
Description: A young student Braca is trying to seduce a beautiful model Iris. Although they are from two different worlds, they both try not to show it. In another story, Šomi and Duje anxiously follow the football match between Manchester and Eastwich. They bet on Eastwich, because their childhood friend Kengur is their goalkeeper.

Title: Mahanati
Hint: The rise and tragic fall of one of the greatest and most beloved actresses of Telugu cinema.
Description: ___ depicts the life and career of one of Telugu cinema's greatest and most iconic starlets, the first Indian female super star, Savitri.

Title: Thani Oruvan
Hint: An idealistic cop sets out to take down a genius businessman behind every crime.
Description: An idealistic cop and an ambitious scientist-businessman indulge in a high-stake battle of wits.

Title: Visaaranai
Hint: Immigrant workers are picked up by cops and brutally tortured into confessing to a crime they didn't commit.
Description: Pandi and his friends, immigrant workers in Andhra Pradesh, are picked up by cops for a crime they never committed. And thus begins their nightmare, where they become pawns in a vicious game where the voiceless are strangled by those with power.

Title: Attack on Titan: Chronicle
Hint: A recap of the anime saga about humanity's desperate fight against giant man-eating creatures beyond the walls.
Description: In the fourth recap movie, episodes 1 to 59 of the anime are retold, compiling the first Three seasons of ___ into a two-hour event.

Title: Filantropica
Hint: A Bucharest teacher joins a ring of professional beggars who use emotional sob stories to swindle money.
Description: In 21st century Bucharest, to go out in the city on Saturday evening on the arm of a beautiful woman is a risky financial investment. Ovidiu, an unassuming high school teacher, never could afford it. Looking for a source of income more substantial than a teacher's salary, Ovidiu plunges into a fabulous world – the beggar mob.

Title: Muhsin Bey
Hint: A naive countryman travels to Istanbul hoping to become a folk singer, and meets a struggling, scheming producer.
Description: An ingenuous countryman Ali Nazik migrates to Istanbul and meets producer Mr. ___ to have his first album.

Title: Gentlemen of Fortune
Hint: A kindergarten teacher is sent undercover to impersonate his lookalike, a notorious criminal.
Description: Kindergarten teacher Evgeniy Ivanovich Troshkin is reluctantly sent undercover to take the place of an imprisoned thief who stole Alexander the Great's helmet. Evgeniy uses his striking resemblance to the thief to infiltrate his gang and learn the location of the stolen artifact. He finds the gangsters are unexpectedly similar to his students- they also need love and care.

Title: Aruvi
Hint: A gentle girl from a loving family finds her life turned upside down and takes a TV talk show hostage.
Description: A gentle girl born and brought up amidst the ever growing eco-social-consumeristic environment finds it difficult to fit in the society. She decides to take it hard on the people.

Title: King of the Doormen
Hint: A resourceful doorman of an Istanbul apartment building schemes to keep his job and his little empire.
Description: Seyit, a resourceful doorman of a middle class apartment in Istanbul, finds himself in a struggle for power when the new superintendent decides to crack down on his slack attitude.

Title: Inglourious Basterds
Hint: A band of Jewish-American soldiers and a young cinema owner plot to kill Nazi leaders in occupied France.
Description: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a group of Jewish-American soldiers known as "The ___" are chosen specifically to spread fear throughout the Third Reich by scalping and brutally killing Nazis. The ___, lead by Lt. Aldo Raine soon cross paths with a French-Jewish teenage girl who runs a movie theater in Paris which is targeted by the soldiers.

Title: Top Gun: Maverick
Hint: A veteran Navy aviator returns to train young pilots for a near-impossible mission.
Description: After more than thirty years of service as one of the Navy’s top aviators, and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him, Pete “___” Mitchell finds himself training a detachment of ___ graduates for a specialized mission the likes of which no living pilot has ever seen.

Title: Fukrey 3
Hint: The loveable losers return, now running for city elections with dumb luck on their side.
Description: In the third installment, the Fukras plan to take over Delhi, and run for city elections. However, they have no money and so they take on an international job to make a quick buck, which changes their lives forever. In the first two films, we saw them using dreams, then premonitions to make money but now they’ve been gifted with a new & unique talent which is going to make them millionaires.

Title: Heat
Hint: A master thief and an obsessed detective circle each other across Los Angeles.
Description: Obsessive master thief Neil McCauley leads a top-notch crew on various daring heists throughout Los Angeles while determined detective Vincent Hanna pursues him without rest. Each man recognizes and respects the ability and the dedication of the other even though they are aware their cat-and-mouse game may end in violence.

Title: Requiem for a Dream
Hint: Four Coney Island residents spiral into addiction in a devastating drug drama.
Description: The drug-induced utopias of four Coney Island residents are shattered when their addictions run deep.

Title: American Beauty
Hint: A depressed suburban father has a mid-life crisis and becomes infatuated with his daughter's friend.
Description: Lester Burnham, a depressed suburban father in a mid-life crisis, decides to turn his hectic life around after developing an infatuation with his daughter's attractive friend.

Title: Good Will Hunting
Hint: A troubled janitor at MIT is a mathematical genius, and a therapist helps him find his way.
Description: Will ___ is a headstrong, working-class genius who is failing the lessons of life. After one too many run-ins with the law, Will's last chance is a psychology professor, who might be the only man who can reach him.

Title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Humanity finds a mysterious object on the Moon and sets off to Jupiter with a sentient computer.
Description: Humanity finds a mysterious object buried beneath the lunar surface and sets off to find its origins with the help of HAL 9000, the world's most advanced super computer.

Title: Scarface
Hint: A Cuban refugee claws his way to the top of Miami's cocaine trade, then falls.
Description: After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami.

Title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
Hint: A heartbroken man undergoes a procedure to erase his ex-girlfriend from his memory.
Description: Joel Barish, heartbroken that his girlfriend underwent a procedure to erase him from her memory, decides to do the same. However, as he watches his memories of her fade away, he realises that he still loves her, and may be too late to correct his mistake.

Title: Full Metal Jacket
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A group of Marine recruits face a brutal drill sergeant before being sent to Vietnam.
Description: A pragmatic U.S. Marine observes the dehumanizing effects the U.S.-Vietnam War has on his fellow recruits from their brutal boot camp training to the bloody street fighting in Hue.

Title: A Clockwork Orange
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A violent young delinquent in a near-future Britain undergoes an experimental behaviour modification.
Description: In a near-future Britain, young Alexander DeLarge and his pals get their kicks beating and raping anyone they please. When not destroying the lives of others, Alex swoons to the music of Beethoven. The state, eager to crack down on juvenile crime, gives an incarcerated Alex the option to undergo an invasive procedure that'll rob him of all personal agency.

Title: Braveheart
Hint: A Scottish warrior leads a rebellion against the English king after his wife is murdered.
Description: Enraged at the slaughter of Murron, his new bride and childhood love, Scottish warrior William Wallace slays a platoon of the local English lord's soldiers. This leads the village to revolt and, eventually, the entire country to rise up against English rule.

Title: The Hunt
Hint: Rich elites track kidnapped strangers for sport, until one target bites back.
Description: Twelve strangers wake up in a clearing. They don't know where they are—or how they got there. In the shadow of a dark internet conspiracy theory, ruthless elitists gather at a remote location to ___ humans for sport. But their master plan is about to be derailed when one of the hunted turns the tables on her pursuers.

Title: Hamilton
Hint: A filmed stage musical about an American founding father, told through hip-hop.
Description: Presenting the tale of American founding father Alexander ___, this filmed version of the original Broadway smash hit is the story of America then, told by America now.

Title: Once Upon a Time in America
Hint: A former Prohibition-era gangster returns to New York and reflects on his life.
Description: A former Prohibition-era Jewish gangster returns to the Lower East Side of Manhattan over thirty years later, where he once again must confront the ghosts and regrets of his old life.

Title: Reservoir Dogs
Hint: A botched jewellery heist leaves the surviving robbers suspecting there is a police informant among them.
Description: A botched robbery indicates a police informant, and the pressure mounts in the aftermath at a warehouse. Crime begets violence as the survivors -- veteran Mr. White, newcomer Mr. Orange, psychopathic parolee Mr. Blonde, bickering weasel Mr. Pink and Nice Guy Eddie -- unravel.

Title: Toy Story
Hint: A pull-string cowboy doll gets jealous when a flashy space-ranger action figure becomes his kid's new favourite.
Description: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Andy's birthday brings Buzz Lightyear onto the scene. Afraid of losing his place in Andy's heart, Woody plots against Buzz. But when circumstances separate Buzz and Woody from their owner, the duo eventually learns to put aside their differences.

Title: Up
Hint: A grumpy widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and floats to South America, with a stowaway Scout.
Description: Carl Fredricksen spent his entire life dreaming of exploring the globe and experiencing life to its fullest. But at age 78, life seems to have passed him by, until a twist of fate (and a persistent 8-year old Wilderness Explorer named Russell) gives him a new lease on life.

Title: Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi
Hint: Rebels rescue a smuggler from a crime lord, then attack a second battle station guarded by furry forest allies.
Description: Luke Skywalker leads a mission to rescue his friend Han Solo from the clutches of Jabba the Hutt, the Emperor prepares to crush the Rebellion with a more powerful Death Star, and the Rebel fleet mounts a massive attack on the space station. Luke Skywalker confronts Darth Vader in a final climactic duel before the evil Emperor.

Title: Incendies
Hint: A mother's last wishes send her twin children to the Middle East to uncover a shocking family history.
Description: A mother's last wishes send twins Jeanne and Simon on a journey to Middle East in search of their tangled roots. Adapted from Wajdi Mouawad's acclaimed play, ___ tells the powerful and moving tale of two young adults' voyage to the core of deep-rooted hatred, never-ending wars and enduring love.

Title: Amélie
Hint: A shy Parisian waitress secretly fixes the lives of everyone around her.
Description: At a tiny Parisian café, the adorable yet painfully shy ___ accidentally discovers a gift for helping others. Soon Amelie is spending her days as a matchmaker, guardian angel, and all-around do-gooder. But when she bumps into a handsome stranger, will she find the courage to become the star of her very own love story?

Title: Princess Mononoke
Hint: A cursed prince is caught in a war between forest gods and an iron-making town, alongside a girl raised by wolves.
Description: Ashitaka, a prince of the disappearing Emishi people, is cursed by a demonized boar god and must journey to the west to find a cure. Along the way, he encounters San, a young human woman fighting to protect the forest, and Lady Eboshi, who is trying to destroy it. Ashitaka must find a way to bring balance to this conflict.

Title: Vertigo
Hint: A detective with a fear of heights becomes obsessed with a mysterious blonde.
Description: A retired San Francisco detective suffering from acrophobia investigates the strange activities of an old friend's wife, all the while becoming dangerously obsessed with her.

Title: Judgment at Nuremberg
Hint: In 1948, an American judge presides over the trial of four German judges who served the Nazi regime.
Description: In 1947, four German judges who served on the bench during the Nazi regime face a military tribunal to answer charges of crimes against humanity. Chief Justice Haywood hears evidence and testimony not only from lead defendant Ernst Janning and his defense attorney Hans Rolfe, but also from the widow of a Nazi general, an idealistic U.S. Army captain and reluctant witness Irene Wallner.

Title: Toy Story 3
Hint: A college-bound teen's playthings are accidentally donated to a daycare centre ruled by a bitter, strawberry-scented bear.
Description: Woody, Buzz, and the rest of Andy's toys haven't been played with in years. With Andy about to go to college, the gang find themselves accidentally left at a nefarious day care center. The toys must band together to escape and return home to Andy.

Title: Citizen Kane
Hint: A reporter investigates the dying word of a newspaper tycoon, piecing together his rise and lonely fall.
Description: Newspaper magnate Charles Foster ___ is taken from his mother as a boy and made the ward of a rich industrialist. As a result, every well-meaning, tyrannical or self-destructive move he makes for the rest of his life appears in some way to be a reaction to that deeply wounding event.

Title: Vikram
Hint: A special agent investigates a series of masked killings tied to a vast drug cartel, in an explosive Tamil thriller.
Description: Amar is assigned to investigate a case of serial killings. When Amar investigates the case, he realizes it is not what it seems to be and following down this path will lead to nothing but war between everyone involved.

Title: Lawrence of Arabia
Hint: A British officer unites rival Arab tribes to fight the Ottoman Empire in an epic desert war.
Description: During World War I, English officer Thomas Edward 'T.E.' ___ sets out to unite and lead the diverse, often warring, Arab tribes to fight the Turks.

Title: To Kill a Mockingbird
Hint: A principled small-town lawyer defends a Black man accused of rape in 1930s Alabama, seen through his daughter's eyes.
Description: Scout Finch, 6, and her older brother Jem live in sleepy Maycomb, Alabama, spending much of their time with their friend Dill and spying on their reclusive and mysterious neighbor, Boo Radley. When Atticus, their widowed father and a respected lawyer, defends a black man named Tom Robinson against fabricated rape charges, the trial and tangent events expose the children to evils of racism and stereotyping.

Title: The Apartment
Hint: An ambitious insurance clerk lends his flat to executives for their affairs and falls for the lift operator.
Description: Bud Baxter is a minor clerk in a huge New York insurance company, until he discovers a quick way to climb the corporate ladder. He lends out his ___ to the executives as a place to take their mistresses. Although he often has to deal with the aftermath of their visits, one night he's left with a major problem to solve.

Title: Metropolis
Hint: In a futuristic city divided between rich and poor, an inventor creates a robot double of a workers' saint.
Description: In a futuristic city sharply divided between the rich and the poor, the son of the city's mastermind meets a prophet who predicts the coming of a savior to mediate their differences.

Title: Singin' in the Rain
Hint: A silent film star and his singing chorus-girl love interest struggle with the switch to talking pictures.
Description: In 1927 Hollywood, a silent film star falls for a chorus girl just as he and his paranoid screen partner struggle to make the difficult transition to talking pictures.

Title: The Sting
Hint: Two charming grifters pull an elaborate con to avenge a murdered friend.
Description: A novice con man teams up with an acknowledged master to avenge the murder of a mutual friend by pulling off the ultimate big con and swindling a fortune from a big-time mobster.

Title: Dangal
Hint: A former wrestler trains his two daughters to become world-class champions against village prejudice.
Description: ___ is an extraordinary true story based on the life of Mahavir Singh and his two daughters, Geeta and Babita Phogat. The film traces the inspirational journey of a father who trains his daughters to become world class wrestlers.

Title: North by Northwest
Hint: An ad man mistaken for a spy is chased across America by crop dusters and killers.
Description: Advertising man Roger Thornhill is mistaken for a spy, triggering a deadly cross-country chase.

Title: A Separation
Hint: A couple's divorce in Tehran pulls their families into a tangle of lies and guilt.
Description: A married couple are faced with a difficult decision - to improve the life of their child by moving to another country or to stay in Iran and look after a deteriorating parent who has Alzheimer's disease.

Title: Double Indemnity
Hint: An insurance salesman and a scheming wife plot the perfect murder.
Description: An insurance representative is seduced by a dissatisfied housewife into a scheme of insurance fraud and murder that arouses the suspicion of his colleague, a claims investigator.

Title: Ikiru
Hint: A dying bureaucrat in Tokyo searches for meaning in his final months and fights to build a playground.
Description: Kanji Watanabe is a middle-aged man who has worked in the same monotonous bureaucratic position for decades. Learning he has cancer, he starts to look for the meaning of his life.

Title: Like Stars on Earth
Hint: An eight-year-old who struggles at school is misunderstood until an art teacher discovers he has dyslexia.
Description: Ishaan Awasthi is an eight-year-old whose world is filled with wonders that no one else seems to appreciate. Colours, fish, dogs, and kites don't seem important to the adults, who are much more interested in things like homework, marks, and neatness. Ishaan cannot seem to get anything right in class; he is then sent to boarding school, where his life changes forever.

Title: Bicycle Thieves
Hint: An unemployed man in post-war Rome searches the city with his young son for the stolen bike he needs for work.
Description: Unemployed Antonio is elated when he finally finds work hanging posters around war-torn Rome. However on his first day, his ___—essential to his work—gets stolen. His job is doomed unless he can find the thief. With the help of his son, Antonio combs the city, becoming desperate for justice.

Title: K.G.F: Chapter 2
Hint: A fierce rebel who rules a blood-soaked gold mine faces new enemies and the government.
Description: The blood-soaked land of Kolar Gold Fields (KGF) has a new overlord now - Rocky, whose name strikes fear in the heart of his foes. His allies look up to Rocky as their Savior, the government sees him as a threat to law and order; enemies are clamoring for revenge and conspiring for his downfall. Bloodier battles and darker days await as Rocky continues on his quest for unchallenged supremacy.

Title: Chhichhore
Hint: A father tells his son stories of his college days with his misfit friends to help him through a crisis.
Description: Following a group of friends from university as they progress into middle-age life and go their own separate ways.

Title: Kantara
Hint: A tribal man clashes with a forest officer as ancient deities and land disputes collide in a coastal village.
Description: Shiva, a tribal vagabond lives with his mother in hamlet, stays away from the traditional Daivaradhane and Bhoota Kola legacy due to an unforgettable childhood incident. He is happy loafing around with his friends and doing petty jobs for his landlord. When Forest officer Murali enters the scene, it gives a fresh dimension to the man-vs-nature fight. Can Shiva save the forest from Murali?

Title: The Young and the Damned
Hint: A gang of teenage delinquents live a violent, hopeless life in the slums of Mexico City.
Description: A group of juvenile delinquents live a violent life in the infamous slums of Mexico City; among them Pedro, whose morality is gradually corrupted and destroyed by the others.

Title: To Live
Hint: A Chinese couple endure decades of political upheaval, from civil war to the Cultural Revolution.
Description: Married couple Fugui and Jiazhen endure tumultuous events in mid-20th century mainland China as their personal fortunes move from wealthy landownership to peasantry.

Title: Shershaah
Hint: The true story of a young Indian Army captain and his bravery in the Kargil War.
Description: Inspired by the life of Captain Vikram Batra (PVC), the film celebrates his bravery, valiant spirit and honors his invaluable sacrifice during the Kargil War of 1999, at the age of 24.

Title: Satya
Hint: A newcomer to Mumbai is wrongly jailed and falls into the city's gang wars.
Description: A young man named ___ comes to Mumbai from South India in search of a job. Jailed for something he did not do, the once-honest young man meets an underworld boss, Bhiku Mhatre in jail and joins his gang.

Title: Maanaadu
Hint: A Muslim man stuck in a time loop must stop the assassination of a chief minister.
Description: A Muslim man, who is stuck in a time loop, has to stop a political rally from taking place in order to save the state's chief minister and prevent religious violence.

Title: The Cranes Are Flying
Hint: Two young lovers are torn apart by WWII when he volunteers for the front.
Description: Veronika and Boris come together in Moscow shortly before World War II. Walking along the river, they watch ___ fly overhead, and promise to rendezvous before Boris leaves to fight. Boris misses the meeting and is off to the front lines, while Veronika waits patiently, sending letters faithfully. After her house is bombed, Veronika moves in with Boris' family, into the company of a cousin with his own intentions.

Title: Red Beard
Hint: A young doctor is assigned to a rural clinic under a gruff, compassionate senior physician.
Description: Aspiring to an easy job as personal physician to a wealthy family, Noboru Yasumoto is disappointed when his first post after medical school takes him to a small country clinic under the gruff doctor ___. Yasumoto rebels in numerous ways, but ___ proves a wise and patient teacher.

Title: Ayla: The Daughter of War
Hint: A Turkish sergeant in the Korean conflict finds a little orphan girl and raises her amid the fighting.
Description: In 1950, amidst the ravages of the Korean War, Sergeant Süleyman stumbles upon a a half-frozen little girl, with no parents and no help in sight and he risks his own life to save her, smuggling her into his army base and out of harm’s way.

Title: Children of Paradise
Hint: An actress in 19th-century Paris is loved by four very different men.
