Description: In a chaotic 19th-century Paris teeming with aristocrats, thieves, psychics, and courtesans, theater mime Baptiste is in love with the mysterious actress Garance. But Garance, in turn, is loved by three other men: pretentious actor Frederick, conniving thief Lacenaire, and Count Edouard of Montray.

Title: Raatchasan
Hint: A newbie cop and aspiring filmmaker must track a sadistic serial killer of schoolgirls.
Description: A serial killer is murdering school girls, and a newbie cop has to track him down before the victim count increases.

Title: Jana Gana Mana
Hint: A professor's death sparks nationwide protests, and a cop investigates corruption in the system.
Description: After the mysterious death of a college professor triggers nationwide protests, a police officer’s pursuit of justice unravels layers of political manipulation and moral conflict, exposing how truth and power collide in the pursuit of justice.

Title: Super Deluxe
Hint: A cheating wife, a returning father, a desperate boy and a bag of trouble collide in one day.
Description: An unfaithful newly-wed wife, an estranged parent, a priest and an angry son suddenly find themselves in the most unexpected predicaments, each poised to experience their destiny, all on one fateful day.

Title: Ordet
Hint: A devout Danish farmer's three sons have widely different beliefs, and a miracle may be at hand.
Description: The three sons of devout Danish farmer Morten have widely disparate religious beliefs. Youngest son Anders shares his father's religion, but eldest son Mikkel has lost his faith, while middle child Johannes has become delusional and proclaims that he is Jesus Christ himself. When Mikkel's wife, Inger goes into a difficult childbirth, everyone's beliefs are put to the test.

Title: Jaane Bhi Do Yaaro
Studio: National Film Development Corporation of India
Hint: Two naive photographers stumble upon a murder and a corrupt builders' scheme, in a Bollywood satire.
Description: Two zanies open a photography studio. They score a partnership with a gossip magazine that suddenly thrusts them into a world of corruption, murder, and hijinks.

Title: Samurai Rebellion
Hint: A loyal swordsman defies his feudal lord when ordered to give back his son's wife.
Description: The mother of a feudal lord's only heir is kidnapped by the lord. Her husband and his ___ father must decide whether to accept the unjust decision, or risk death to rescue her.

Title: Chupke Chupke
Hint: A newlywed professor pretends to be a chauffeur to fool his wife's family, in a Bollywood comedy.
Description: Sulekha is in awe of her brother-in-law Raghavendra for his intelligence. Parimal, her husband, decides to take up the challenge of fooling Raghavendra and goes to work for him as a driver.

Title: Bangalore Days
Hint: Three cousins from Kerala move to a big city and chase their very different dreams in a feel-good drama.
Description: A fun roller coaster ride about three young people, Aju, Divya and Kuttan who are cousins, reach ___ to dream, discover & explore!

Title: The Diamond Arm
Hint: An ordinary Soviet citizen on a cruise is unwittingly caught up in a jewel smuggling operation hidden in a plaster cast.
Description: A ___ smuggling operation goes wrong when an ordinary Soviet citizen becomes unwittingly involved, and the criminals are forced to court him to retrieve their diamonds.

Title: Agent Sai Srinivasa Athreya
Hint: An eccentric, broke small-town detective stumbles onto a sinister racket involving unclaimed bodies and becomes a murder suspect.
Description: ___ is a brilliant, underrated detective from Nellore who runs an agency called FBI which sees no business. He gets more than what he asked for when a case happens to fall right into his lap out of nowhere.

Title: Drishyam
Hint: A cable TV operator obsessed with movies uses film tricks to protect his family after a crime.
Description: Georgekutty lives a happy life with his wife and daughters. Things take a turn when his daughter gets indecently filmed using a hidden camera, by the son of a police inspector.

Title: Kidnapping, Caucasian Style
Hint: A naïve student folklorist falls for a girl who is about to be kidnapped as a bride in the Caucasus.
Description: Shurik, a kind but naïve ethnography student, falls in love with the intelligent, athletic and beautiful All-Union Leninist Young Communist League member Nina. He has a rival in the wealthy comrade Saakhov, who concocts a ___ scheme to force Nina to marry him.

Title: Khosla Ka Ghosla!
Hint: A middle-class family conned out of their land plots a clever con of their own.
Description: Kamal ___ land is grabbed by a land shark named Khurana. In a bid to retrieve their land, ___ elder son hatches a clever plan to con the crook and enlists the help of his friends and his dysfunctional family.

Title: Baasha
Hint: A mild-mannered auto rickshaw driver hides a violent past as a feared Mumbai don.
Description: Auto rickshaw driver Manickam avoids violence at all costs. When some thugs begin to intimidate Manickam's family, it triggers the revival of Manickam's old self.

Title: Anniyan
Hint: A meek, rule-obsessed lawyer with multiple personalities secretly becomes a masked vigilante punishing corruption.
Description: Unable to tolerate society's injustices and devastated by rejection from the woman he loves, a meek lawyer develops a split personality: one side a vengeful vigilante killer punishing evildoers, the other a dashing playboy capable of winning her heart. Complications arise when the three sides begin to collide.

Title: Cat City
Hint: A secret agent mouse must stop a gang of felines who have developed a weapon of mass destruction.
Description: In the year 80 AMM (After Mickey Mouse) on the anthropomorphic animal-controlled Planet X, a party of mafioso cats plot to enact a genocide against the mouse population of the world.

Title: Premam
Hint: A young man's life told through three loves across school, college and adulthood.
Description: Three stages in George's life, and three girls he encounters in each stage.

Title: Kaun Pravin Tambe?
Hint: The true story of a man who debuted as a professional cricketer at the age of 41.
Description: Mumbai-born leg-spinner ___ made his debut in professional cricket at the age of 41 in the IPL for Rajasthan Royals in 2013 not having played any international or even first-class cricket before that.

Title: Lucia
Hint: An insomniac usher takes a pill that lets him live his dream life every night.
Description: A man suffering from insomnia is tricked into buying a drug, ___, that makes his desires come true in his dreams, blurring the line between fantasy and reality.

Title: Soodhu Kavvum
Hint: A small-time kidnapper and his gang get involved in a political kidnapping.
Description: Dass specialises in small time kidnapping and has his own set of rules. The primary and most important among them is not to get involved with influential people. Three jobless youngsters meet Dass and the four take up an assignment for a hefty sum that throws away this primary rule and end up being chased by a dreaded policeman.

Title: Sairat
Hint: A politician's daughter and a fisherman's son fall in love and face caste violence.
Description: Archi, a local politician’s daughter, and Parshya, a fisherman’s son, fall in love resulting in violence between the families due to the stringent casteism in the village.

Title: From the Village to the City
Hint: Four country bumpkins strike it rich and learn the bright lights cost more than money.
Description: After they find buried treasure, four hapless brothers from the countryside discover that changing their fortunes will take more than gold.

Title: The Wolf of Wall Street
Hint: A New York stockbroker builds an empire of excess and fraud in the 1990s.
Description: A New York stockbroker refuses to cooperate in a large securities fraud case involving corruption on ___ Street, corporate banking world and mob infiltration. Based on Jordan Belfort's autobiography.

Title: The Great Escape
Hint: Allied prisoners of war plan a daring mass breakout from a German camp, in a WWII classic.
Description: The Nazis, exasperated at the number of escapes from their prison camps by a relatively small number of Allied prisoners, relocate them to a high-security 'escape-proof' camp to sit out the remainder of the war. Undaunted, the prisoners plan one of the most ambitious escape attempts of World War II. Based on a true story.

Title: The Vaccine War
Hint: Scientists race the clock and the doubters to protect a billion people from a pandemic.
Description: Faced with the catastrophic challenge of fighting a global crisis like no other, Indian scientists take on the mantle of producing ___ despite not having enough resources and infrastructure to save the nation's sixteen million citizens.

Title: No Country for Old Men
Hint: A hunter stumbles on a drug deal gone wrong and takes the money, pursued by a relentless killer.
Description: Llewelyn Moss stumbles upon dead bodies, $2 million and a hoard of heroin in a Texas desert, but methodical killer Anton Chigurh comes looking for it, with local sheriff Ed Tom Bell hot on his trail. The roles of prey and predator blur as the violent pursuit of money and justice collide.

Title: Taxi Driver
Hint: An insomniac Vietnam vet takes a job driving cabs in New York and descends into violence.
Description: Suffering from insomnia, disturbed loner Travis Bickle takes a job as a New York City cabbie, haunting the streets nightly, growing increasingly detached from reality as he dreams of cleaning up the filthy city.

Title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
Hint: A teen superhero's secret identity is revealed, and a spell to fix it unleashes villains from other universes.
Description: Peter Parker is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high-stakes of being a super-hero. When he asks for help from Doctor Strange the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be ___.

Title: Shutter Island
Hint: A US Marshal investigates the disappearance of a patient from an asylum for the criminally insane, but nothing is as it seems.
Description: World War II soldier-turned-U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels investigates the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane, but his efforts are compromised by troubling visions and a mysterious doctor.

Title: Jurassic Park
Hint: A billionaire's theme attraction full of cloned dinosaurs goes horribly wrong during a preview tour.
Description: A wealthy entrepreneur secretly creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening day, he invites a team of experts and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park and help calm anxious investors. However, the park is anything but amusing as the security systems go off-line and the dinosaurs escape.

Title: Howl's Moving Castle
Hint: A young hat-maker cursed into an old woman finds refuge in a vain wizard's walking home.
Description: Sophie, a young milliner, is turned into an elderly woman by a witch who enters her shop and curses her. She encounters a wizard named ___ and gets caught up in his resistance to fighting for the king.

Title: There Will Be Blood
Hint: A ruthless oil man rises to power in early 20th-century California, battling a preacher.
Description: Ruthless silver miner, turned oil prospector, Daniel Plainview, moves to oil-rich California. Using his son to project a trustworthy, family-man image, Plainview cons local landowners into selling him their valuable properties for a pittance. However, local preacher Eli Sunday suspects Plainview's motives and intentions, starting a slow-burning feud that threatens both their lives.

Title: Batman Begins
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A billionaire trains with a secret society before returning home to become a masked vigilante.
Description: Driven by tragedy, billionaire Bruce Wayne dedicates his life to uncovering and defeating the corruption that plagues his home, Gotham City. Unable to work within the system, he instead creates a new identity, a symbol of fear for the criminal underworld - The ___.

Title: The Thing
Hint: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the form of its victims.
Description: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

Title: The Truman Show
Hint: A cheerful insurance salesman begins to suspect his entire life is being broadcast to the world.
Description: In a picture-perfect seaside town, an insurance salesman begins to realize that his entire existence may be staged and observed by a vast unseen audience as part of a long-running real-time reality TV show.

Title: Snatch
Hint: A boxing promoter, gangsters and bumbling thieves chase a stolen diamond in London.
Description: Unscrupulous boxing promoters, violent bookies, a Russian gangster, incompetent amateur robbers, and supposedly Jewish jewellers fight to track down a priceless stolen diamond.

Title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
Hint: An assassin shot on her wedding day wakes from a coma and seeks bloody revenge on her former team.
Description: An assassin is shot by her ruthless employer, ___, and other members of their assassination circle – but she lives to plot her vengeance.

Title: Casino
Hint: A gambling executive and a Mafia enforcer fight for control of a Las Vegas empire in the 1970s.
Description: In Las Vegas, two best friends--a ___ executive and a Mafia enforcer--compete for a gambling empire and a fast-living, fast-loving socialite.

Title: The Sixth Sense
Hint: A troubled boy sees dead people and only one child psychologist believes him.
Description: Following an unexpected tragedy, child psychologist Malcolm Crowe meets a nine year old boy named Cole Sear, who is hiding a dark secret.

Title: V for Vendetta
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A masked rebel with a love of explosions fights a fascist government in Britain.
Description: In a world in which Great Britain has become a fascist state, a masked vigilante known only as “V” conducts guerrilla warfare against the oppressive British government. When V rescues a young woman from the secret police, he finds in her an ally with whom he can continue his fight to free the people of Britain.

Title: Green Book
Hint: A tough Bronx bouncer drives a refined pianist on a tour of the segregated South.
Description: Tony Lip, a bouncer in 1962, is hired to drive pianist Don Shirley on a tour through the Deep South in the days when African Americans, forced to find alternate accommodations and services due to segregation laws below the Mason-Dixon Line, relied on a guide called The Negro Motorist ___.

Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Spain, India
Hint: Two young British soldiers must cross enemy territory to deliver a message that will save 1,600 men.
Description: At the height of the First World War, two young British soldiers must cross enemy territory and deliver a message that will stop a deadly attack on hundreds of soldiers.

Title: Die Hard
Hint: One barefoot cop takes on terrorists in a Los Angeles skyscraper on Christmas Eve.
Description: High above the city of L.A. a team of terrorists has seized a building, taken hostages, and declared war. One man has manages to escape... An off-duty cop hiding somewhere inside. He's alone, tired... and the only chance anyone has got.

Title: Finding Nemo
Hint: An overprotective clownfish father searches the ocean for his son, with a forgetful blue tang.
Description: ___, an adventurous young clownfish, is unexpectedly taken from his Great Barrier Reef home to a dentist's office aquarium. It's up to his worrisome father Marlin and a friendly but forgetful fish Dory to bring ___ home -- meeting vegetarian sharks, surfer dude turtles, hypnotic jellyfish, hungry seagulls, and more along the way.

Title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
Hint: An archaeologist and his father race Nazis to find the cup of Christ.
Description: In 1938, an art collector appeals to eminent archaeologist Dr. ___ to embark on a search for the Holy Grail. Indy learns that a medieval historian has vanished while searching for it, and the missing man is his own father, Dr. Henry ___ Sr.. He sets out to rescue his father by following clues in the old man's notebook, which his father had mailed to him before he went missing.

Title: Gone with the Wind
Hint: The spoiled daughter of a Georgia plantation owner survives the Civil War and its aftermath.
Description: The spoiled daughter of a Georgia plantation owner conducts a tumultuous romance with a cynical profiteer during the American Civil War and Reconstruction Era.

Title: A Beautiful Mind
Hint: A brilliant Princeton mathematician's groundbreaking career is threatened by schizophrenia, as his wife stands by him.
Description: From the heights of notoriety to the depths of depravity, John Forbes Nash Jr. experiences it all. As a brilliant but socially awkward mathematician, he made a groundbreaking discovery early in his career and stands on the brink of international acclaim. But as the handsome and arrogant Nash accepts secret work in cryptography, he becomes entangled in a mysterious conspiracy.

Title: Pan's Labyrinth
Country: Mexico, Spain, United States of America
Hint: A girl in post-civil war Spain escapes into a dark fantasy world as her stepfather wages war on rebels.
Description: In post–civil war Spain, 10-year-old Ofelia moves with her pregnant mother to live under the control of her cruel stepfather. Drawn into a mysterious ___, she meets a faun who reveals that she may be a lost princess from an underground kingdom. To return to her true father, she must complete a series of surreal and perilous tasks that blur the line between reality and fantasy.

Title: L.A. Confidential
Hint: Three detectives in the corrupt 1950s LAPD investigate a coffee shop massacre.
Description: Three detectives in the corrupt and brutal L.A. police force of the 1950s use differing methods to uncover a conspiracy behind the shotgun slayings of the patrons at an all-night diner.

Title: Downfall
Hint: The final days of the Nazi regime, inside the Berlin bunker in April 1945.
Description: In April of 1945, Germany stands at the brink of defeat with the Russian Army closing in from the east and the Allied Expeditionary Force attacking from the west. In Berlin, capital of the Third Reich, Adolf Hitler proclaims that Germany will still achieve victory and orders his generals and advisers to fight to the last man.

Title: The Father
Hint: An elderly man with dementia refuses help from his daughter as his reality unravels.
Description: A man refuses all assistance from his daughter as he ages and, as he tries to make sense of his changing circumstances, he begins to doubt his loved ones, his own mind and even the fabric of his reality.

Title: Unforgiven
Hint: A retired killer turned widowed pig farmer takes on one last bounty job in Wyoming.
Description: William Munny is a retired, once-ruthless killer turned gentle widower and hog farmer. To help support his two motherless children, he accepts one last bounty-hunter mission to find the men who brutalized a prostitute. Joined by his former partner and a cocky greenhorn, he takes on a corrupt sheriff.

Title: Chinatown
Hint: A 1930s LA private eye investigating adultery uncovers a web of murder and water corruption.
Description: Private eye Jake Gittes lives off of the murky moral climate of sunbaked, pre-World War II Southern California. Hired by a beautiful socialite to investigate her husband's extra-marital affair, Gittes is swept into a maelstrom of double dealings and deadly deceits, uncovering a web of personal and political scandals that come crashing together.

Title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
Hint: A medieval king and his knights embark on a ridiculous quest, in a classic British comedy.
Description: King Arthur, accompanied by his squire, recruits his Knights of the Round Table, including Sir Bedevere the Wise, Sir Lancelot the Brave, Sir Robin the Not-Quite-So-Brave-As-Sir-Lancelot and Sir Galahad the Pure. On the way, Arthur battles the Black Knight who, despite having had all his limbs chopped off, insists he can still fight. They reach Camelot, but Arthur decides not to enter, as "it is a silly place".

Title: The Secret in Their Eyes
Hint: A retired legal counsellor writes a novel about an unsolved murder case from 25 years ago.
Description: Hoping to put to rest years of unease concerning a past case, retired criminal investigator Benjamín begins writing a novel based on the unsolved mystery of a newlywed’s rape and murder. With the help of a former colleague, judge Irene, he attempts to make sense of the past.

Title: Some Like It Hot
Hint: Two jazz musicians who witness a mob hit flee Chicago disguised as women in an all-girl band.
Description: In Prohibition-era Chicago, musicians Joe and Jerry witness a mob hit, and flee the state in an all-female band disguised as Josephine and Daphne, but further complications set in.

Title: The Elephant Man
Hint: A Victorian surgeon rescues a severely disfigured man from a circus freak show.
Description: A Victorian surgeon rescues a heavily disfigured man being mistreated by his "owner" as a side-show freak. Behind his monstrous façade, there is revealed a person of great intelligence and sensitivity. Based on the true story of Joseph Merrick (called John Merrick in the film), a severely deformed man in 19th century London.

Title: Ran
Hint: An aging Japanese warlord divides his kingdom among his three sons, with tragic results.
Description: Shakespeare's King Lear is reimagined as a singular historical epic set in sixteenth-century Japan where an aging warlord divides his kingdom between his three sons.

Title: Tumbbad
Hint: A man in a cursed village in 1918 India discovers a secret treasure guarded by a fallen god.
Description: India, 1918. On the outskirts of ___, a cursed village where it always rains, Vinayak, along with his mother and his brother, care of a mysterious old woman who keeps the secret of an ancestral treasure that Vinayak gets obsessed with.

Title: For a Few Dollars More
Hint: Two rival bounty hunters, a colonel and a drifter, team up to catch a sadistic, drug-addled bandit in the Old West.
Description: Two bounty hunters both pursue the brutal and sadistic bandit, El Indio, who has a large bounty on his head.

Title: Gangs of Wasseypur
Hint: A bloody family feud over coal and power stretches across generations.
Description: In 1970s India, Sardar Khan vows to take revenge on the man who killed his father decades earlier.

Title: Klaus
Hint: A selfish postman and a reclusive toymaker form an unlikely friendship that gives birth to a legend.
Description: A selfish postman and a reclusive toymaker form an unlikely friendship, delivering joy to a cold, dark town that desperately needs it.

Title: All About Eve
Hint: A scheming young actress manipulates her way into the life of an aging Broadway star.
Description: From the moment she glimpses her idol at the stage door, Eve Harrington is determined to take the reins of power away from the great actress Margo Channing. Eve maneuvers her way into Margo's Broadway role, becomes a sensation and even causes turmoil in the lives of Margo's director boyfriend, her playwright and his wife.

Title: Dial M for Murder
Hint: A jealous ex-tennis player plots to have his wealthy wife murdered for her money.
Description: When her American lover visits London, a wealthy woman’s jealous husband hatches a plan to murder her and inherit her fortune.

Title: Rashomon
Hint: One crime in a forest, four witnesses, and four completely different truths.
Description: Four people recount different versions of the story of a man's murder and the rape of his wife.

Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Movie: Mugen Train
Hint: Young swordsmen board a locomotive where passengers are vanishing in their dreams, facing a powerful enemy.
Description: Tanjiro Kamado, joined with Inosuke Hashibira, a boy raised by boars who wears a boar's head, and Zenitsu Agatsuma, a scared boy who reveals his true power when he sleeps, boards the Infinity Train on a new mission with the Fire Hashira, Kyojuro Rengoku, to defeat a ___ who has been tormenting the people and killing the ___ slayers who oppose it!

Title: Yojimbo
Hint: A wandering swordsman plays two rival gangs against each other in a small town.
Description: A nameless ronin, or samurai with no master, enters a small village in feudal Japan where two rival businessmen are struggling for control of the local gambling trade. Taking the name Sanjuro Kuwabatake, the ronin convinces both silk merchant Tazaemon and sake merchant Tokuemon to hire him as a personal bodyguard, then artfully sets in motion a full-scale gang war between the two ambitious and unscrupulous men.

Title: Andhadhun
Hint: A pianist pretending to be blind witnesses a murder and is drawn into a deadly web.
Description: A series of mysterious events changes the life of a blind pianist who now must report a crime that was actually never witnessed by him.

Title: Miracle in Cell No. 7
Hint: A gentle man with a mental disability is jailed for a crime and kept close by his daughter.
Description: A story about a mentally ill man wrongfully imprisoned for murder and his relationship with his 6 year old daughter.

Title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
Hint: Two drifters and an old prospector search for gold in Mexico, but greed tears them apart.
Description: Two jobless Americans convince a prospector to travel to the mountains of Mexico with them in search of gold. But the hostile wilderness, local bandits, and greed all get in the way of their journey.

Title: Swades
Hint: An Indian NASA scientist returns home to his village and is transformed by its problems.
Description: A successful Indian scientist returns home to his village to take his nanny back to America with him, and in the process rediscovers his roots.

Title: The Wages of Fear
Hint: Four desperate men are paid to drive trucks loaded with nitroglycerin across rough terrain.
Description: In a run-down South American town, four men are paid to drive trucks loaded with nitroglycerin into the jungle through to the oil field. Friendships are tested and rivalries develop as they embark upon the perilous journey.

Title: Children of Heaven
Hint: A poor boy loses his sister's only pair of shoes, and they share his to get to school.
Description: Zohre's shoes are gone; her older brother Ali lost them. They are poor, there are no shoes for Zohre until they come up with an idea: they will share one pair of shoes. School awaits.

Title: Pather Panchali
Hint: A poor Bengali family struggles in a rural village, seen through the eyes of a young boy.
Description: Impoverished priest Harihar Ray, dreaming of a better life for himself and his family, leaves his rural Bengal village in search of work. Alone, his wife, Sarbojaya, looks after her rebellious daughter, Durga, and her young son, Apu, as well as Harihar's elderly aunt Indir. The children enjoy the small pleasures of their difficult life, while their parents suffer the daily indignities heaped upon them.

Title: A Face in the Crowd
Hint: A drifter is turned into a TV star and becomes a power-hungry demagogue.
Description: The rise of a raucous hayseed named Lonesome Rhodes from itinerant Ozark guitar picker to local media rabble-rouser to TV superstar and political king-maker. Marcia Jeffries is the innocent Sarah Lawrence girl who discovers the great man in a back-country jail and is the first to fall under his spell.

Title: Satantango
Hint: Villagers in a Hungarian collective farm deal with the effects of a con man's return.
Description: Inhabitants of a small village in Hungary deal with the effects of the fall of Communism. The town's source of revenue, a factory, has closed, and the locals, who include a doctor and three couples, await a cash payment offered in the wake of the shuttering. Irimias, a villager thought to be dead, returns and, unbeknownst to the locals, is a police informant.

Title: To Be or Not to Be
Hint: A Polish acting troupe becomes embroiled in a plot to trick the Nazis.
Description: During the Nazi occupation of Poland, an acting troupe becomes embroiled in a Polish soldier's efforts to track down a German spy.

Title: Vikram Vedha
Hint: A gangster surrenders to the cop hunting him and tells him stories that make him question right and wrong.
Description: A notorious gangster ___ surrenders himself to encounter specialist ___ whom he challenges every step of the way by narrating his life events in the form of riddles that needs to be solved in order to capture him.

Title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
Hint: A fierce orphan rises from the streets of Bombay to enslaving gold mines to become a rebel.
Description: A period drama set in the 1970s, KGF follows the story of a fierce rebel who rises against the brutal oppression in Kolar Gold Fields and becomes the symbol of hope to legions of downtrodden people.

Title: The Kid
Hint: A tramp cares for an abandoned boy, but the authorities try to take him away.
Description: A tramp cares for a boy after he's abandoned as a newborn by his mother. Later the mother has a change of heart and aches to be reunited with her son.

Title: Sherlock Jr.
Hint: A film projectionist dreams of being a detective and enters the movie he's showing.
Description: A film projectionist longs to be a detective, and puts his meager skills to work when he is framed by a rival for stealing his girlfriend's father's pocketwatch.

Title: Close-Up
Hint: A man who pretended to be a famous filmmaker plays himself in his own trial story.
Description: This fiction-documentary hybrid uses a sensational real-life event—the arrest of a young man on charges that he fraudulently impersonated the well-known filmmaker Mohsen Makhmalbaf—as the basis for a stunning, multilayered investigation into movies, identity, artistic creation, and existence, in which the real people from the case play themselves.

Title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
Hint: The son of a legendary warrior learns about his heritage and battles a tyrant king.
Description: When Mahendra, the son of Bāhubali, learns about his heritage, he begins to look for answers. His story is juxtaposed with past events that unfolded in the Mahishmati Kingdom.

Title: Ugetsu
Hint: Two peasants in 16th-century Japan seek fortune during war, and one is seduced by a ghost.
Description: In 16th century Japan, peasants Genjuro and Tobei sell their earthenware pots to a group of soldiers in a nearby village, in defiance of a local sage's warning against seeking to profit from warfare. Genjuro's pursuit of both riches and the mysterious Lady Wakasa, as well as Tobei's desire to become a samurai, run the risk of destroying both themselves and their wives, Miyagi and Ohama.

Title: A Brighter Summer Day
Hint: A teenage boy experiences first love, friendship and gang violence in 1960s Taipei, leading to a shocking crime.
Description: A boy experiences first love, friendships and injustices growing up in 1960s Taiwan.

Title: Lion of the Desert
Country: Libyan Arab Jamahiriya, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An elderly Bedouin teacher leads a 20-year guerrilla resistance against the Italian colonial army in Libya.
Description: Resistance leader Omar Mukhtar opposes Italian colonization before World War II. The brutal guerrilla war against Italian General Rodolfo Graziani and the Fascist forces of Benito Mussolini highlights the struggle for Libyan independence and the harsh tactics utilised by the colonisers.

Title: My Father and My Son
Hint: A left-wing journalist returns with his young boy to his estranged family's village after the 1980 Turkish coup.
Description: A left-wing journalist whose wife died while giving birth to his son during a military coup returns to his family's farm. Estranged from his father for turning his back on the family and wasting his life with political activism instead, he tries to reconnect with him so that his son will have a place to live as his health is deteriorating due to the extensive torture he had to endure.

Title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
Hint: Three childhood friends go on a road trip through Spain before one gets married.
Description: Three friends who were inseparable in childhood decide to go on a three-week-long bachelor road trip to Spain, in order to re-establish their bond and explore thrilling adventures, before one of them gets married. What will they learn of themselves and each other during the adventure?

Title: Rocco and His Brothers
Hint: A poor widow's five sons move to Milan, and two of them fall for the same woman.
Description: When a impoverished widow’s family moves to the big city, two of her five sons become romantic rivals with deadly results.

Title: It's Such a Beautiful Day
Hint: A lonely stick figure struggles to hold his crumbling mind together.
Description: Bill struggles to put together his shattered psyche.

Title: Late Spring
Hint: A widowed father persuades his devoted daughter to marry, in a quiet Japanese drama.
Description: Noriko is perfectly happy living at home with her widowed father, Shukichi, and has no plans to marry -- that is, until her aunt Masa convinces Shukichi that unless he marries off his 27-year-old daughter soon, she will likely remain alone for the rest of her life. When Noriko resists Masa's matchmaking, Shukichi is forced to deceive his daughter and sacrifice his own happiness to do what he believes is right.

Title: Dersu Uzala
Hint: A Russian military surveyor befriends a wise, elderly native hunter in Siberia's vast, unmapped wilderness.
Description: A military explorer meets and befriends a Goldi man in Russia’s unmapped forests. A deep and abiding bond evolves between the two men, one civilized in the usual sense, the other at home in the glacial Siberian woods.

Title: A Man Escaped
Hint: A French Resistance fighter captured by the Nazis engineers a daunting escape.
Description: A captured French Resistance fighter during World War II engineers a daunting escape from prison.

Title: Uri: The Surgical Strike
Hint: After a terrorist attack on an army base, Indian forces plan a covert retaliation.
Description: Following the roguish terrorist attacks at ___ Army Base camp in Kashmir, India takes the fight to the enemy, in its most successful covert operation till date with one and only one objective of avenging their fallen heroes.

Title: The Mountain II
Hint: A Turkish special forces unit is trapped on a hillside in Syria and must survive enemy fire.
Description: In a desolate war zone where screams of the innocent echo, on the very line between disaster and valor, 7 Maroon Berets will dance with death.

Title: I Am Cuba
Hint: A sweeping, dazzling portrait of the 1959 Caribbean revolution, told through four stories.
Description: A study in contrasts set in and around Havana that explores ___ 1959 revolution: a young woman's fascination with the excess of an American-owned casino leads to her downfall in the eyes of her street vendor boyfriend; a tenant farmer revolts the only way he knows how, attacking the land he works; university students gain first-hand knowledge of political upheaval; and, in the hills outside the city, the members…

Title: Life and a Day
Hint: A poor family's youngest daughter is getting married, and the family struggles to keep it together.
Description: Somaieh, the youngest daughter of an indigent family, is getting married and fear is overwhelming each and every member of the family regarding how to overcome their difficulties after she's gone.

Title: Umberto D.
Hint: A proud old pensioner and his little dog fight to avoid eviction.
Description: When elderly pensioner ___ Domenico Ferrari returns to his boarding house from a protest calling for a hike in old-age pensions, his landlady demands her 15,000-lire rent by the end of the month or he and his small dog will be turned out onto the street.

Title: Aparajito
Hint: A boy moves with his family to the holy city of Varanasi and struggles between study and his mother.
Description: Apu and his family have moved away from the country to live in the bustling holy city of Benares. As he progresses from wide-eyed child to intellectually curious teenager, eventually studying in Kolkata, we witness his academic and moral education, as well as the growing complexity of his relationship with his mother.

Title: Il Sorpasso
Hint: A shy law student in Rome is taken on a reckless road trip by an exuberant stranger.
Description: Roberto, a shy law student in Rome, meets Bruno, a forty-year-old exuberant, capricious man, who takes him for a drive through the Roman and Tuscany countries in the summer. When their journey starts to blend into their daily lives though, the pair’s newfound friendship is tested.

Title: Rangasthalam
Hint: A man begins to suspect his brother's life is in danger in a corrupt village.
Description: Chitti Babu begins to suspect his elder brother's life is in danger after they team up to lock horns with their village president and overthrow his unlawful 30 year old regime.

Title: I Am a Fugitive from a Chain Gang
Hint: A WWI veteran is wrongly sentenced to a brutal prison labour camp and escapes.
Description: A World War I veteran’s dreams of becoming a master architect evaporate in the cold light of economic realities. Things get even worse when he’s falsely convicted of a crime and sent to work on a ___ gang.

Title: Ivan Vasilyevich Changes His Profession
Hint: A scientist's time machine swaps a fearful apartment manager with a medieval tsar.
Description: A scientist builds a time machine and accidentally sends his apartment complex manager and a petty burglar to 16th century Moscow, while Tsar ___ the Terrible travels to 1973.

Title: Bhaag Milkha Bhaag
Hint: The true story of a world champion runner from India and his tragic past.
Description: The true story of the "Flying Sikh" world champion runner and Olympian ___ Singh who overcame the massacre of his family, civil war during the India-Pakistan partition, and homelessness to become one of India's most iconic athletes.

Title: Champion
Hint: An unscrupulous boxer fights his way to the top, but alienates everyone who loves him.
Description: An unscrupulous boxer fights his way to the top, but eventually alienates all of the people who helped him on the way up.

Title: Paan Singh Tomar
Hint: A celebrated Indian Army steeplechase champion is driven by injustice to become a feared rebel bandit in the ravines.
Description: ___ goes from celebrated runner to star brigand and rebel when life after sports fails to unfold as planned.

Title: Shahid
Hint: A former militant becomes a human-rights lawyer defending people wrongly accused of terrorism in Mumbai.
Description: A story based on real-life human-rights and criminal lawyer, ___ Azmi, who was slain while defending the wrongly accused by the law in terrorist activities.

Title: Theeran Adhigaram Ondru
Hint: A determined cop spends years hunting a ruthless highway gang.
Description: A hardnosed cop goes after a gang of ruthless dacoits who have been terrorising residents along the highway for a decade.

Title: Pocket Hercules: Naim Süleymanoglu
Hint: A tiny but immensely strong weightlifter defects from communist Bulgaria to Turkey and wins Olympic glory.
Description: From defecting to the Olympics, an underdog weightlifter powers through adversity to raise up his community in this biopic of ___ Süleymanoğlu.

Title: Dhuruvangal Pathinaaru
Hint: A former cop looks back on a case that left him disabled.
Description: A former cop looks back on the case which left him disabled and forced him to quit the force.

Title: Ustad Hotel
Hint: An aspiring chef learns from his grandfather, who runs a small restaurant.
Description: When his father refuses to support his choice of a career, an aspiring chef tries to fulfil his dream by helping his grandfather run his small eatery.

Title: Jigarthanda
Hint: A filmmaker studying a feared gangster for his movie gets far too close.
Description: A budding director endeavors to research a merciless gangster for making a film on gangsterism. But his secret attempts to conduct the research fail when he gets caught for snooping.

Title: Vaaranam Aayiram
Hint: A son remembers his loving father and how he shaped every chapter of his life.
Description: A son deals with the death of his father and examines how their relationship influences him through growing up, romance, tragedy and adventure.

Title: Athadu
Hint: A hitman hired to stage an assassination is framed when the politician is killed.
Description: A hitman, Nandu, is hired to stage the assassination of a politician. However, when the politician is actually killed and Nandu is framed for the murder, he assumes a dead man's identity to evade the law.

Title: RangiTaranga
Hint: A reclusive novelist and his wife move to his ancestral village, where mysterious events unfold.
Description: Mysterious events begin to unfold after a reclusive novelist and his wife move back to her ancestral village, followed by a journalist.

Title: Ballad of a Soldier
Hint: A young Russian private is given a few days' leave to visit his mother during WWII.
Description: During World War II, earnest young Russian soldier Alyosha Skvortsov is rewarded with a short leave of absence for performing a heroic deed on the battlefield. Feeling homesick, he decides to visit his mother. Due to his kindhearted nature, however, Alyosha is repeatedly sidetracked by his efforts to help those he encounters, including a lovely girl named Shura.

Title: The Exorcist
Hint: A mother seeks the help of two priests when her daughter is possessed by a demon.
Description: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.

Title: Prisoners
Hint: A desperate father takes the law into his own hands when his daughter goes missing.
Description: Keller Dover is facing every parent’s worst nightmare. His six-year-old daughter, Anna, is missing, together with her young friend, Joy, and as minutes turn to hours, panic sets in. The only lead is a dilapidated RV that had earlier been parked on their street.

Title: Stand by Me
Hint: Four boys go on a journey to find the body of a missing teenager in 1959 Oregon.
Description: After learning that a boy their age has been accidentally killed near their rural homes, four boys decide to go see the body. Gordie, Vern, Chris, and Teddy encounter a mean junk man and a marsh full of leeches, but they also learn more about one another and their very different home lives. Just a lark at first, the boys' adventure evolves into a defining event in their lives.

Title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The final battle between a young wizard and the dark lord at a castle school.
Description: Harry, Ron and Hermione continue their quest to vanquish the evil Voldemort once and for all. Just as things begin to look hopeless for the young wizards, Harry discovers a trio of magical objects that endow him with powers to rival Voldemort's formidable skills.

Title: Mad Max: Fury Road
Hint: A woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in a post-apocalyptic desert, with a drifter.
Description: An apocalyptic story set in the furthest reaches of our planet, in a stark desert landscape where humanity is broken, and most everyone is crazed fighting for the necessities of life. Within this world exist two rebels on the run who just might be able to restore order.

Title: Gone Girl
Hint: A man becomes the prime suspect when his wife disappears on their anniversary.
Description: With his wife's disappearance having become the focus of an intense media circus, a man sees the spotlight turned on him when it's suspected that he may not be innocent.

Title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
Hint: A blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate to rescue a governor's daughter from a cursed crew.
Description: When wily pirate Captain Barbossa seizes Jack Sparrow’s beloved ship, the Black ___, and kidnaps the governor’s daughter, Elizabeth Swann, blacksmith Will Turner reluctantly teams up with the unpredictable pirate Jack to rescue her—only to uncover a terrifying ___ that turns Barbossa’s crew into the undead.

Title: The Deer Hunter
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Three Pennsylvania steelworkers go to Vietnam, and the war, and a game of Russian roulette, shatter their lives.
Description: Three steelworkers enlist in the army and are sent to Vietnam, one leaving behind a rushed marriage, the others a shared love. What they encounter during the war changes their lives forever.

Title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
Hint: A legendary concierge at an elegant European resort and his loyal lobby boy are caught up in a murder and a stolen painting.
Description: The ___ tells of a legendary concierge at a famous European hotel between the wars and his friendship with a young employee who becomes his trusted protégé. The story involves the theft and recovery of a priceless Renaissance painting, the battle for an enormous family fortune and the slow and then sudden upheavals that transformed Europe during the first half of the 20th century.

Title: Hacksaw Ridge
Country: Australia, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A conscientious objector who refuses to carry a gun saves dozens of soldiers as a medic in the Battle of Okinawa.
Description: WWII American Army Medic Desmond T. Doss, who served during the Battle of Okinawa, refuses to kill people and becomes the first Conscientious Objector in American history to receive the Congressional Medal of Honor.

Title: Jaws
Hint: A police chief, a marine biologist and a grizzled fisherman hunt a giant great white shark terrorising a beach town.
Description: When the seaside community of Amity finds itself under attack by a dangerous great white shark, the town's chief of police, a young marine biologist, and a grizzled shark hunter embark on a desperate quest to kill the beast before it strikes again.

Title: Blade Runner
Country: United States of America, Hong Kong, United Kingdom
Hint: In a smog-choked future LA, a detective hunts down rogue artificial humans and begins to question his own nature.
Description: In the smog-choked dystopian Los Angeles of 2019, ___ Rick Deckard is called out of retirement to terminate a quartet of replicants who have escaped to Earth seeking their creator for a way to extend their short life spans.

Title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A grieving mother rents roadside advertising signs to shame the local police over her daughter's unsolved murder.
Description: After seven months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at Bill Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police.

Title: The Big Lebowski
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A laid-back bowling slacker is mistaken for a millionaire, and his ruined rug drags him into a kidnapping plot.
Description: Jeffrey 'The Dude' ___, a Los Angeles slacker who only wants to bowl and drink White Russians, is mistaken for another Jeffrey ___, a wheelchair-bound millionaire, and finds himself dragged into a strange series of events involving nihilists, adult film producers, ferrets, errant toes, and large sums of money.

Title: Fargo
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A desperate Minnesota car salesman hires two criminals to kidnap his wife, and a pregnant police chief investigates.
Description: Jerry, a small-town Minnesota car salesman is bursting at the seams with debt... but he's got a plan. He's going to hire two thugs to kidnap his wife in a scheme to collect a hefty ransom from his wealthy father-in-law. It's going to be a snap and nobody's going to get hurt... until people start dying.

Title: Ratatouille
Hint: A rat with a gift for cooking secretly runs a Paris kitchen from under a chef's hat.
Description: Remy, a rat, possesses a palate far more refined than that of his fellow comrades. He dreams of becoming a chef, one who creates rather than scavenges. When fate deposits him in the sewers beneath one of Paris’s most famous restaurants, he finds himself ideally placed to fulfill his dream. Forming an unusual alliance with a hapless young kitchen worker, Remy begins a daring culinary double life.

Title: The Terminator
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A cyborg assassin is sent back in time to kill a waitress whose unborn son will lead humanity against the machines.
Description: In the post-apocalyptic future, reigning tyrannical supercomputers teleport a cyborg assassin known as the "___" back to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor, whose unborn son is destined to lead insurgents against 21st century mechanical hegemony. Meanwhile, the human-resistance movement dispatches a lone warrior to safeguard Sarah. Can he stop the virtually indestructible killing machine?

Title: Dead Poets Society
Hint: An unconventional English teacher at a strict boarding school inspires his students to seize the day.
Description: At an elite, old-fashioned boarding school in New England, a passionate English teacher inspires his students to rebel against convention and seize the potential of every day, courting the disdain of the stern headmaster.

Title: Ford v Ferrari
Hint: An American car designer and a hot-headed British driver build a racer to beat the Italians at Le Mans.
Description: American car designer Carroll Shelby and the British-born driver Ken Miles work together to battle corporate interference, the laws of physics, and their own personal demons to build a revolutionary race car for ___ Motor Company and take on the dominating race cars of Enzo ___ at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in France in 1966.

Title: The Wizard of Oz
Hint: A Kansas girl swept away by a twister follows a yellow road to find a way home.
Description: Young Dorothy finds herself in a magical world where she makes friends with a lion, a scarecrow and a tin man as they make their way along the yellow brick road to talk with the ___ and ask for the things they miss most in their lives. The Wicked Witch of the West is the only thing that could stop them.

Title: Catch Me If You Can
Hint: A teenage con artist poses as a pilot, doctor and lawyer while forging millions, pursued by an FBI agent.
Description: A true story about Frank Abagnale Jr. who, before his 19th birthday, successfully conned millions of dollars worth of checks as a Pan Am pilot, doctor, and legal prosecutor. An FBI agent makes it his mission to put him behind bars. But Frank not only eludes capture, he revels in the pursuit.

Title: The Handmaiden
Hint: A pickpocket is hired as a maid to a Japanese heiress in 1930s Korea, as part of a con man's elaborate scheme.
Description: 1930s Korea, in the period of Japanese occupation, a new girl, Sook-hee, is hired as a ___ to a Japanese heiress, Hideko, who lives a secluded life on a large countryside estate with her domineering Uncle Kouzuki. But the maid has a secret. She is a pickpocket recruited by a swindler posing as a Japanese Count to help him seduce the Lady to steal her fortune.

Title: The Help
Hint: Black maids in 1960s Mississippi share their stories with a young writer.
Description: Aibileen Clark is a middle-aged African-American maid who has spent her life raising white children and has recently lost her only son; Minny Jackson is an African-American maid who has often offended her employers despite her family's struggles with money and her desperate need for jobs; and Eugenia "Skeeter" Phelan is a young white woman who has recently moved back home after graduating college to find out her…

Title: Inside Out
Hint: An 11-year-old girl moves to a new city, and her personified emotions struggle to guide her through it.
Description: When 11-year-old Riley moves to a new city, her Emotions team up to help her through the transition. Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust and Sadness work together, but when Joy and Sadness get lost, they must journey through unfamiliar places to get back home.

Title: Into the Wild
Hint: A top student gives away his savings and hitchhikes into the Alaskan wilderness to live off the land.
Description: After graduating from Emory University in 1992, top student and athlete Christopher McCandless abandons his possessions, gives his entire $24,000 savings account to charity, and hitchhikes to Alaska to live in the wilderness.

Title: Trainspotting
Hint: A group of Edinburgh heroin addicts choose life, or don't.
Description: Heroin addict Mark Renton stumbles through bad ideas and sobriety attempts with his unreliable friends --Sick Boy, Begbie, Spud and Tommy. He also has an underage girlfriend, Diane, along for the ride. After cleaning up and moving from Edinburgh to London, Mark finds he can't escape the life he left behind as Begbie and Sick Boy come knocking.

Title: Logan
Hint: In the near future, a weary, aging mutant cares for his ailing mentor and must protect a young girl with powers.
Description: In the near future, a weary ___ cares for an ailing Professor X in a hideout on the Mexican border. But ___ attempts to hide from the world and his legacy are upended when a young mutant arrives, pursued by dark forces.

Title: Rush
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two rival Formula One drivers, a methodical Austrian and a playboy Brit, battle for the 1976 championship.
Description: In the 1970s, a rivalry propels race car drivers Niki Lauda and James Hunt to fame and glory — until a horrible accident threatens to end it all.

Title: Memories of Murder
Hint: Two detectives in rural South Korea hunt the country's first serial killer in the 1980s.
Description: A sadistic serial rapist and murderer of young women terrorizes a small province in 1980s South Korea. To prevent further crimes, three increasingly desperate detectives with conflicting methods race against time to unravel the violent mind of the killer in a futile effort to solve the case.

Title: Rocky
Hint: A small-time Philadelphia club fighter gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot at the heavyweight title.
Description: ___ Balboa is a Philadelphia club fighter who seems to be going nowhere. But when a stroke of fate puts him in the ring with a world heavyweight champion, ___ knows that it's his one shot at the big time — a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to go the distance and come out a winner!

Title: The Sound of Music
Hint: A free-spirited nun becomes governess to the seven children of an Austrian naval captain before WWII.
Description: In the years before World War II, a tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey is hired as a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children and brings a new love of life and music into the home.

Title: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A card shark and his mates owe a fortune to a gangster and plan to rob their drug-dealing neighbours.
Description: A card shark and his unwillingly-enlisted friends need to make a lot of cash quick after losing a sketchy poker match. To do this they decide to pull a heist on a small-time gang who happen to be operating out of the flat next door.

Title: Monsters, Inc.
Hint: Two creatures who work at a scream-powered factory discover a human girl has followed them home.
Description: Lovable Sulley and his wisecracking sidekick Mike Wazowski are the top scare team at ___, the scream-processing factory in Monstropolis. When a little girl named Boo wanders into their world, it's the ___ who are scared silly, and it's up to Sulley and Mike to keep her out of sight and get her back home.

Title: Spotlight
Hint: Boston reporters uncover a cover-up of child abuse in the Catholic Church.
Description: The true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered the massive scandal of child molestation and cover-up within the local Catholic Archdiocese, shaking the entire Catholic Church to its core.

Title: Platoon
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young recruit in Vietnam is caught between two sergeants with very different morals.
Description: As a young and naive recruit in Vietnam, Chris Taylor faces a moral crisis when confronted with the horrors of war and the duality of man.

Title: 12 Years a Slave
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A free Black man is kidnapped and sold into slavery in the American South.
Description: In the pre-Civil War United States, Solomon Northup, a free black man from upstate New York, is abducted and sold into slavery. Facing cruelty as well as unexpected kindnesses Solomon struggles not only to stay alive, but to retain his dignity. In the twelfth year of his unforgettable odyssey, Solomon’s chance meeting with a Canadian abolitionist will forever alter his life.

Title: Room
Country: Canada, Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A woman held captive for seven years in a shed raises her son, who has never seen the outside world.
Description: Held captive for 7 years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time.

Title: How to Train Your Dragon
Hint: The scrawny son of a Viking chief secretly befriends an injured winged beast, changing his tribe's view of the creatures.
Description: As the son of a Viking leader on the cusp of manhood, shy Hiccup Horrendous Haddock III faces a rite of passage: he must kill a ___ to prove his warrior mettle. But after downing a feared ___, he realizes that he no longer wants to destroy it, and instead befriends the beast – which he names Toothless – much to the chagrin of his warrior father.

Title: Warrior
Hint: Two estranged brothers enter the same mixed martial arts tournament, with their alcoholic father as coach.
Description: The youngest son of an alcoholic former boxer returns home, where he's trained by his father for competition in a mixed martial arts tournament – a path that puts the fighter on a collision course with his estranged, older brother.

Title: In the Mood for Love
Hint: Two neighbours in 1960s Hong Kong discover their spouses are having an affair, and grow close.
Description: In 1960s Hong Kong, two neighbors form an intimate bond after making a discovery about their spouses in this visually stunning tale of unrequited love.

Title: Before Sunrise
Hint: Two strangers meet on a train and spend one night wandering through Vienna together.
Description: An unexpected meeting on a train leads two travelers to spend an evening wandering through Vienna. As the night unfolds, they share stories and conversations about life and love, exploring new ideas while a quiet intimacy grows between them, knowing it may be their only night together.

Title: Barry Lyndon
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An Irish rogue charms and cons his way into 18th-century high society.
Description: An Irish rogue uses his cunning and wit to work his way up the social classes of 18th century England, transforming himself from the humble Redmond ___ into the noble ___.

Title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
Hint: A painter is commissioned to secretly paint a reluctant bride on an isolated island in 18th-century Brittany.
Description: On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding ___ of a young woman.

Title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
Hint: A senator returns to a Western town and tells the truth about a famous killing.
Description: Questions arise when Senator Stoddard attends the funeral of a local man named Tom Doniphon in a small Western town. Flashing back, we learn Doniphon saved Stoddard, then a lawyer, when he was roughed up by a crew of outlaws terrorizing the town, led by ___.

Title: Raging Bull
Hint: A self-destructive, jealous middle-weight boxer fights his way to the top in the ring.
Description: The life of boxer Jake LaMotta, whose violence and temper that led him to the top in the ring destroyed his life outside of it.

Title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington
Hint: A naive idealist appointed to the Senate fights corruption with an epic filibuster.
Description: After the death of a United States Senator, idealistic Jefferson ___ is appointed as his replacement in ___. Soon, the naive and earnest new senator has to battle political corruption.

Title: La Haine
Hint: Three young friends from a Paris suburb spend 24 hours wandering the city after a riot.
Description: After a chaotic night of rioting in a marginal suburb of Paris, three young friends, Vinz, Hubert and Saïd, wander around unoccupied waiting for news about the state of health of a mutual friend who has been seriously injured when confronting the police.

Title: My Neighbor Totoro
Hint: Two sisters moving to the country discover friendly forest spirits, including a giant furry one.
Description: Two sisters move to the country with their father in order to be closer to their hospitalized mother, and discover the surrounding trees are inhabited by Totoros, magical spirits of the forest. When the youngest runs away from home, the older sister seeks help from the spirits to find her.

Title: Gran Torino
Hint: A grumpy Korean War veteran forms an unlikely friendship with his Hmong teenage neighbour.
Description: Disgruntled Korean War veteran Walt Kowalski sets out to reform his neighbor, Thao Lor, a Hmong teenager who tried to steal Kowalski's prized possession: a 1972 ___.

Title: The Iron Giant
Hint: A boy befriends a huge metal robot that fell from space in 1957 Maine, while a paranoid government agent hunts it.
Description: In the small town of Rockwell, Maine in October 1957, a ___ metal machine befriends a nine-year-old boy and ultimately finds its humanity by unselfishly saving people from their own fears and prejudices.

Title: Ben-Hur
Hint: A Jewish prince is betrayed into slavery by his Roman friend and seeks revenge in a chariot race.
Description: In ancient Judea, a Jewish aristocrat opposing Roman occupation of his homeland reunites with his childhood friend, now a Roman commander — setting in motion a saga of betrayal, adventure, tragedy, revenge, and faith.

Title: Million Dollar Baby
Hint: A gruff boxing trainer reluctantly takes on a determined waitress who wants to fight.
Description: Despondent over a painful estrangement from his daughter, trainer Frankie Dunn isn't prepared for boxer Maggie Fitzgerald to enter his life. But Maggie's determined to go pro and to convince Dunn and his cohort to help her.

Title: Stalker
Hint: A guide leads two men into a forbidden Zone to find a room that grants wishes.
Description: Near a gray and unnamed city is the Zone, a place guarded by barbed wire and soldiers, and where the normal laws of physics are victim to frequent anomalies. A ___ guides two men into the Zone, specifically to an area in which deep-seated desires are granted.

Title: Paris, Texas
Hint: A mute, amnesiac man wanders out of the desert and tries to reunite with his young son and estranged wife.
Description: A man wanders out of the desert not knowing who he is. His brother finds him, and helps to pull his memory back of the life he led before he walked out on his family and disappeared four years earlier.

Title: Wild Tales
Hint: Six darkly comic stories of revenge and people pushed to their breaking point in Argentina.
Description: Injustice and the demands of the world can cause stress for many people. Some of them, however, explode. This includes a waitress serving a grouchy loan shark, an altercation between two motorists, an ill-fated wedding reception, and a wealthy businessman who tries to buy his family out of trouble.

Title: Network
Hint: A TV broadcaster exploits a veteran anchorman's on-air breakdown for ratings, in a savage media satire.
Description: When veteran anchorman Howard Beale is forced to retire his 25-year post because of his age, he announces to viewers that he will kill himself during his farewell broadcast. ___ executives rethink their decision when his fanatical tirade results in a spike in ratings.

Title: The Seventh Seal
Hint: A disillusioned knight returning from the Crusades plays a game of chess with Death.
Description: When disillusioned Swedish knight Antonius Block returns home from the Crusades to find his country in the grips of the Black Death, he challenges Death to a chess match for his life. Tormented by the belief that God does not exist, Block sets off on a journey, meeting up with traveling players Jof and his wife, Mia, and becoming determined to evade Death long enough to commit one redemptive act while he still lives.

Title: Before Sunset
Hint: Nine years after one magical night in Vienna, two former lovers meet again in Paris.
Description: Nine years later, Jesse travels across Europe giving readings from a book he wrote about the night he spent in Vienna with Celine. After his reading in Paris, Celine finds him, and they spend part of the day together before Jesse has to again leave for a flight. They are both in relationships now, and Jesse has a son, but as their strong feelings for each other start to return, both confess a longing for more.

Title: The Third Man
Hint: A pulp writer in postwar Vienna investigates the mysterious death of his friend, a black-market racketeer.
Description: In postwar Vienna, Austria, Holly Martins, a writer of pulp Westerns, arrives penniless as a guest of his childhood chum Harry Lime, only to learn he has died. Martins develops a conspiracy theory after learning of a "___" present at the time of Harry's death, running into interference from British officer Major Calloway, and falling head-over-heels for Harry's grief-stricken lover, Anna.

Title: Amores Perros
Hint: A car crash in Mexico City ties together three stories of love and dogs.
Description: A fatalistic car crash in Mexico city sets off a chain of events in the lives of three people: a supermodel, a young man wanting to run off with his sister-in-law, and a homeless man.

Title: Hachi: A Dog's Tale
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A loyal pup waits at a train station every evening for a master who never returns.
Description: Professor Wilson discovers a lost Akita puppy on his way home. Despite objections from his wife, ___ endears himself to the family and grows to be Parker's loyal companion. As their bond grows deeper, a beautiful relationship unfolds.

Title: On the Waterfront
Hint: A former prizefighter turned dockworker stands up against a corrupt union boss.
Description: A prizefighter-turned-longshoreman with a conscience goes up against labor leaders to expose corruption, extortion, and murder among the union ranks.

Title: A Silent Voice: The Movie
Hint: A boy who cruelly bullied a deaf classmate in primary school seeks redemption years later.
Description: Shouya Ishida starts bullying the new girl in class, Shouko Nishimiya, because she is deaf. But as the teasing continues, the rest of the class starts to turn on Shouya for his lack of compassion. When they leave elementary school, Shouko and Shouya do not speak to each other again... until an older, wiser Shouya, tormented by his past behaviour, decides he must see Shouko once more.

Title: In the Name of the Father
Hint: A Belfast petty thief is wrongly convicted of an IRA pub bombing, and his dad is jailed too.
Description: A small-time Belfast thief, Gerry Conlon, is wrongly convicted of an IRA bombing in London, along with his father and friends, and spends 15 years in prison fighting to prove his innocence.

Title: Cool Hand Luke
Hint: A rebellious prisoner on a brutal Florida road gang refuses to conform, no matter how hard the guards push.
Description: When petty criminal ___ Jackson is sentenced to two years in a Florida prison farm, he doesn't play by the rules of either the sadistic warden or the yard's resident heavy, Dragline, who ends up admiring the new guy's unbreakable will.

Title: Persona
Hint: A nurse is put in charge of an actress who has stopped speaking, and their identities merge.
Description: A young nurse, Alma, is put in charge of Elisabeth Vogler: an actress who is seemingly healthy in all respects, but will not talk. As they spend time together, Alma speaks to Elisabeth constantly, never receiving any answer.

Title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
Hint: British POWs in Burma are forced to build a railway crossing for their Japanese captors, and their colonel takes pride in it.
Description: The classic story of English POWs in Burma forced to build a ___ to aid the war effort of their Japanese captors. British and American intelligence officers conspire to blow up the structure, but Col. Nicholson, the commander who supervised the ___ construction, has acquired a sense of pride in his creation and tries to foil their plans.

Title: Rebecca
Hint: A young woman marries a widower and is haunted by the memory of his first wife in his grand estate.
Description: Story of a young woman who marries a fascinating widower only to find out that she must live in the shadow of his former wife, ___, who died mysteriously several years earlier. The young wife must come to grips with the terrible secret of her handsome, cold husband, Max De Winter. She must also deal with the jealous, obsessed Mrs. Danvers, the housekeeper, who will not accept her as the mistress of the house.

Title: Hotel Rwanda
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Italy, South Africa
Hint: A luxury resort's manager in Kigali shelters over a thousand refugees in his building during the 1994 genocide.
Description: Inspired by true events, this film takes place in ___ in the 1990s when more than a million Tutsis were killed in a genocide that went mostly unnoticed by the rest of the world. Hotel owner Paul Rusesabagina houses over a thousand refuges in his hotel in attempt to save their lives.

Title: Farewell My Concubine
Hint: Two Beijing opera actors' lifelong friendship spans 50 years of Chinese history.
Description: In an epic tale of theater, gender, love and class, two Beijing opera actors navigate political turmoil as their friendship evolves over decades.

Title: PK
Hint: An alien stranded on Earth asks innocent questions about religion that cause a stir.
Description: A stranger in the city asks questions no one has asked before. Known only by his initials, the man's innocent questions and childlike curiosity take him on a journey of love, laughter and letting go.

Title: Paper Moon
Hint: A con man drives across Depression-era America with a sharp-tongued girl in tow.
Description: During the Great Depression, a con man finds himself saddled with a young girl who may or may not be his daughter, and the two forge an unlikely partnership.

Title: It Happened One Night
Hint: A runaway heiress and a cynical reporter take a road trip, in a classic screwball comedy.
Description: A runaway heiress makes a deal with the rogue reporter trailing her but the mismatched pair end up stuck with each other when their bus leaves them behind.

Title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The End of Evangelion
Hint: A secret organisation launches an all-out attack as traumatised teen pilots face the apocalypse, in an anime finale.
Description: SEELE orders an all-out attack on NERV, aiming to destroy the Evas before Gendo can advance his own plans for the Human Instrumentality Project. Shinji is pushed to the limits of his sanity as he is forced to decide the fate of humanity.

Title: Tokyo Story
Hint: An elderly couple travel to visit their busy adult children in the capital, who have little time for them.
Description: The elderly Shukishi and his wife, Tomi, take the long journey from their small seaside village to visit their adult children in ___. Their elder son, Koichi, a doctor, and their daughter, Shige, a hairdresser, don't have much time to spend with their aged parents, and so it falls to Noriko, the widow of their younger son who was killed in the war, to keep her in-laws company.

Title: The Grapes of Wrath
Hint: A family of Oklahoma farmers are evicted during the Dust Bowl and head west to California.
Description: Tom Joad returns to his home after a jail sentence to find his family kicked out of their farm due to foreclosure. He catches up with them on his Uncle’s farm, and joins them the next day as they head for California and a new life... Hopefully.

Title: The Celebration
Hint: A family gathers for a patriarch's 60th birthday, and his son reveals a dark secret.
Description: The family of a wealthy businessman gather to celebrate his 60th birthday. During the course of the party, his eldest son presents a speech that reveals a devastating secret that turns the night into a battle of truth and denial.

Title: The Best Years of Our Lives
Hint: Three WWII veterans return home and struggle to adjust to civilian life.
Description: It's the hope that sustains the spirit of every GI: the dream of the day when he will finally return home. For three WWII veterans, the day has arrived. But for each man, the dream is about to become a nightmare.

Title: A Woman Under the Influence
Hint: A loving housewife's breakdown strains her marriage to a hot-tempered husband.
Description: Mabel Longhetti, desperate and lonely, is married to a Los Angeles municipal construction worker, Nick. Increasingly unstable, especially in the company of others, she craves happiness, but her extremely volatile behavior convinces Nick that she poses a danger to their family and decides to commit her to an institution for six months.

Title: All Quiet on the Western Front
Hint: A young German soldier's enthusiasm dies in the trenches of World War I.
Description: Paul Baumer and his friends Albert and Muller, egged on by romantic dreams of heroism, voluntarily enlist in the German army. Full of excitement and patriotic fervour, the boys enthusiastically march into a war they believe in. But once on the ___, they discover the soul-destroying horror of World War I.

Title: Safety Last!
Hint: A store clerk climbs the outside of a tall building and hangs from a clock.
Description: When a store clerk organizes a contest to climb the outside of a tall building, circumstances force him to make the perilous climb himself.

Title: Mary and Max
Hint: A lonely Australian girl and an obese, autistic New Yorker become pen pals.
Description: A tale of friendship between two unlikely pen pals: ___, a lonely, eight-year-old girl living in the suburbs of Melbourne, and ___, a forty-four-year old, severely obese man living in New York.

Title: The Red Shoes
Hint: A ballerina is torn between her love for a composer and her devotion to dance.
Description: A fledgling ballerina falls in love with a brilliant composer, but the jealous head of the ballet company plots to drive them apart.

Title: Underground
Country: Yugoslavia, Czech Republic, France, Germany, Hungary
Hint: Two black marketeers keep refugees in a cellar for decades, telling them WWII never ended.
Description: Black marketeers Marko and Blacky manufacture and sell weapons to the Communist resistance in WWII Belgrade, living the good life along the way. Marko's surreal duplicity propels him up the ranks of the Communist Party, and he eventually abandons Blacky and steals his girlfriend.

Title: The 400 Blows
Hint: A troubled young Parisian boy turns to petty crime and is sent to an observation centre.
Description: For young Parisian boy Antoine Doinel, life is one difficult situation after another. Surrounded by inconsiderate adults, including his neglectful parents, Antoine spends his days with his best friend, Rene, trying to plan for a better life. When one of their schemes goes awry, Antoine ends up in trouble with the law, leading to even more conflicts with unsympathetic authority figures.

Title: OMG: Oh My God!
Hint: A shopkeeper takes the Almighty to court when his shop is destroyed by an earthquake and insurers refuse to pay.
Description: A shopkeeper takes God to court when his shop is destroyed by an earthquake.

Title: Three Colors: Red
Hint: A model in Geneva befriends a retired judge who secretly listens to his neighbours' phone calls.
Description: Part-time model Valentine unexpectedly befriends a retired judge after she runs over his dog. At first, the grumpy man shows no concern about the dog, and Valentine decides to keep it. But the two form a bond when she returns to his house and catches him listening to his neighbors’ phone calls.

Title: Wild Strawberries
Hint: An old professor's road trip becomes a journey through memories and regrets.
Description: Crotchety retired doctor Isak Borg travels from Stockholm to Lund, Sweden, with his pregnant and unhappy daughter-in-law, Marianne, in order to receive an honorary degree from his alma mater. Along the way, they encounter a series of hitchhikers, each of whom causes the elderly doctor to muse upon the pleasures and failures of his own life.

Title: The Battle of Algiers
Hint: French paratroopers wage a brutal fight against the independence movement in North Africa, in a newsreel-style drama.
Description: Paratrooper commander Colonel Mathieu, a former French Resistance fighter during World War II, is sent to Algeria to reinforce efforts to squelch the uprisings of the Algerian War. There he faces Ali la Pointe, a former petty criminal who, as the leader of the Algerian Front de Liberation Nationale, directs terror strategies against the colonial French government occupation.

Title: Fanny and Alexander
Hint: Two children's lives are transformed when their mother marries a strict bishop.
Description: As children in the loving Ekdahl family, ___ enjoy a happy life with their parents, who run a theater company. After their father dies unexpectedly, however, the siblings end up in a joyless home when their mother, Emilie, marries a stern bishop.

Title: Winter Sleep
Hint: A former actor who runs a cave hotel in Cappadocia clashes with his young wife and sister during the snowy season.
Description: Aydın is a hotel owner and a retired actor in rural Turkey. As ___ emerges he begins navigating the conflicts within the relationships with his wife, sister and existence.

Title: Kahaani
Hint: A pregnant woman searches Kolkata for her missing husband, and no one admits he existed.
Description: Pregnant and alone in the city of Kolkata, a woman begins a relentless search for her missing husband, only to find that nothing is what it seems.

Title: Andrei Rublev
Hint: A medieval icon painter wanders a brutal Russia, questioning faith and art.
Description: An expansive Russian drama, this film focuses on the life of revered religious icon painter ___. Drifting from place to place in a tumultuous era, the peace-seeking monk eventually gains a reputation for his art. But after ___ witnesses a brutal battle and unintentionally becomes involved, he takes a vow of silence and spends time away from his work.

Title: The Miracle Worker
Hint: The teacher of a deaf, blind girl struggles to break through her world of silence.
