Description: The true story of the frightening, lonely world of silence and darkness of 7-year-old Helen Keller who, since infancy, has never seen the sky, heard her mother's voice or expressed her innermost feelings. Then Annie Sullivan, a 20-year-old teacher from Boston, arrives.

Title: Sholay
Hint: A retired police officer hires two small-time crooks to capture a ruthless bandit.
Description: After his family is slain by notorious bandit Gabbar Singh, former Inspector Thakur Baldev Singh enlists low-level outlaws Jai and Veeru to capture Gabbar and seek revenge.

Title: Diabolique
Hint: A headmaster's wife and his mistress conspire to murder him, but the body disappears.
Description: The cruel and abusive headmaster of a boarding school, Michel Delassalle, is murdered by an unlikely duo -- his meek wife and the mistress he brazenly flaunts. The women become increasingly unhinged by a series of odd occurrences after Delassalle's corpse mysteriously disappears.

Title: Chak De! India
Hint: A disgraced former hockey player coaches the Indian women's national hockey team.
Description: A team of rag-tag girls with their own agenda form Team India competing for international fame in field hockey. Their coach, the ex-men's Indian National team captain, returns from a life of shame after being unjustly accused of match fixing in his last match. Can he give the girls the motivation required to win, while dealing with the shadows of his own past?

Title: Yi Yi
Hint: A Taipei family faces a wedding, a coma and a midlife crisis all at once.
Description: Each member of a family in Taipei asks hard questions about life's meaning as they live through everyday quandaries. NJ is morose: his brother owes him money, his mother is in a coma, his wife suffers a spiritual crisis when she finds her life a blank and his business partners make bad decisions.

Title: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India
Hint: Indian villagers under British rule challenge the British to a game of cricket to cancel their taxes.
Description: The year is 1893 and India is under British occupation. In a small village, the tyrannical Captain Russell has imposed an unprecedented land tax on its citizens. Outraged, Bhuvan, a rebellious farmer, rallies the villagers to publicly oppose the tax. Russell offers a novel way to settle the dispute: he challenges Bhuvan and his men to a game of cricket, a sport completely foreign to India.

Title: The Hidden Fortress
Hint: Two greedy peasants escort a general and a princess across enemy territory.
Description: In feudal Japan, during a bloody war between clans, two cowardly and greedy peasants, soldiers of a defeated army, stumble upon a mysterious man who guides them to a ___ hidden in the mountains.

Title: Throne of Blood
Hint: A samurai warrior meets a witch who prophesies he will become lord, in a Japanese adaptation of a Shakespeare play.
Description: Returning to their lord's castle, samurai warriors Washizu and Miki are waylaid by a spirit who predicts their futures. When the first part of the spirit's prophecy comes true, Washizu's scheming wife, Asaji, presses him to speed up the rest of the spirit's prophecy by murdering his lord and usurping his place.

Title: Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans
Hint: A married farmer falls under the spell of a city woman who urges him to drown his wife.
Description: A married farmer falls under the spell of a slatternly woman from the city, who tries to convince him to drown his wife.

Title: Inherit the Wind
Hint: A small-town schoolteacher is arrested for teaching evolution, sparking a famous courtroom showdown.
Description: Schoolteacher Bertram Cates is arrested for teaching his students Darwin's theory of evolution. The case receives national attention and one of the newspaper reporters, E.K. Hornbeck, arranges to bring in renowned defense attorney and atheist Henry Drummond to defend Cates. The prosecutor, Matthew Brady is a former presidential candidate, famous evangelist, and old adversary of Drummond.

Title: Time of the Gypsies
Hint: A Romani teenager with telekinetic powers is lured into a life of crime in Italy.
Description: Perhan is a gypsy teenager with telekinetic powers. A wealthy gypsy, Ahmed, visits the village and promises to get Perhan's sister the medical treatment she needs if they join him to Italy. Perhan soon discovers that Ahmed's business activities are in fact quite shady and he is soon lured into the elder's corrupt surroundings.

Title: The General
Hint: A Confederate train engineer pursues Union spies who stole his beloved locomotive.
Description: During America’s Civil War, Union spies steal engineer Johnnie Gray's beloved locomotive, 'The ___'—with Johnnie's lady love aboard an attached boxcar—and he single-handedly must do all in his power to both get The ___ back and to rescue Annabelle.

Title: The Passion of Joan of Arc
Hint: The trial and execution of a young French saint, in a silent classic.
Description: A classic of the silent age, this film tells the story of the doomed but ultimately canonized 15th-century teenage warrior. On trial for claiming she'd spoken to God, Jeanne d'___ is subjected to inhumane treatment and scare tactics at the hands of church court officials. Initially bullied into changing her story, Jeanne eventually opts for what she sees as the truth.

Title: Wolf Children
Hint: A young woman raises two little ones who can turn into wolves in the countryside after their father dies.
Description: After her werewolf lover unexpectedly dies in an accident, a woman must find a way to raise the son and daughter that she had with him. However, their inheritance of their father's traits prove to be a challenge for her.

Title: Nights of Cabiria
Hint: A Roman prostitute looks for true love despite being betrayed again and again.
Description: Rome, 1957. A woman, ___, is robbed and left to drown by her boyfriend, Giorgio. Rescued, she resumes her life and tries her best to find happiness in a cynical world. Even when she thinks her struggles are over and she has found happiness and contentment, things may not be what they seem.

Title: Dil Chahta Hai
Hint: Three inseparable friends go their own ways after college and fall in love.
Description: Three inseparable childhood friends are just out of college. Nothing comes between them - until they each fall in love, and their wildly different approaches to relationships creates tension.

Title: The Gold Rush
Hint: A prospector in Alaska struggles to survive the cold and win the heart of a dance hall girl.
Description: A gold prospector in Alaska struggles to survive the elements and win the heart of a dance hall girl.

Title: Autumn Sonata
Hint: A famous concert pianist reunites with her resentful daughter after seven years.
Description: After a seven-year absence, Charlotte Andergast travels to Sweden to reunite with her daughter Eva. The pair have a troubled relationship: Charlotte sacrificed the responsibilities of motherhood for a career as a classical pianist. Over an emotional night, the pair reopen the wounds of the past.

Title: The Virgin Spring
Hint: A father avenges the rape and murder of his daughter in medieval Sweden.
Description: Devout Christians Töre and Märeta send their only daughter, the virginal Karin, and their foster daughter, the unrepentant Ingeri, to deliver candles to a distant church. On their way through the woods, the girls encounter a group of savage goat herders who brutally rape and murder Karin as Ingeri remains hidden.

Title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
Hint: A devotee of Hanuman takes a mute Pakistani girl lost in India back to her homeland.
Description: A young mute girl from Pakistan loses herself in India with no way to head back. A devoted man with a magnanimous spirit undertakes the task to get her back to her motherland and unite her with her family.

Title: Where Is the Friend's House?
Hint: A small boy crosses villages to return his classmate's notebook before school.
Description: An 8-year-old boy must return his friend's notebook he took by mistake, lest his friend be punished by expulsion from school.

Title: A Special Day
Hint: Two neighbours, a persecuted journalist and a housewife, spend a day together in fascist Rome.
Description: Two neighbours — a persecuted journalist and a resigned housewife — forge a strong bond on the day of Adolf Hitler's historic 1938 visit to Rome.

Title: Rang De Basanti
Hint: A group of college friends are cast in a film about Indian freedom fighters and become inspired.
Description: After a group of friends graduate from Delhi University, they listlessly haunt their old campus, until a British filmmaker casts them in a film she's making about freedom fighters under British rule. Although the group is largely apolitical, the tragic death of a friend owing to local government corruption awakens their patriotism.

Title: Raise the Red Lantern
Hint: A young concubine competes with the other wives of a rich lord for favor.
Description: In 1920s China, 19-year-old Songlian becomes a concubine of a powerful lord and is forced to compete with his three wives for the privileges gained.

Title: Army of Shadows
Hint: A French Resistance leader is betrayed and must navigate the dangerous underground.
Description: Betrayed by an informant, Philippe Gerbier finds himself trapped in a torturous Nazi prison camp. Though Gerbier escapes to rejoin the Resistance in occupied Marseilles, France, and exacts his revenge on the informant, he must continue a quiet, seemingly endless battle against the Nazis in an atmosphere of tension, paranoia and distrust.

Title: A Moment to Remember
Hint: A young couple's love is tested when she is diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's.
Description: A young couple's love is tested when Sun-jin is diagnosed with a rare form of Alzheimer's disease.

Title: Talvar
Hint: Investigators clash over who really killed a teenage girl and the family servant.
Description: A hardened cop deals with three conflicting perspectives involving a brutal double murder. The case is complicated as the prime suspects are the parents who supposedly killed their teenage daughter.

Title: Rififi
Hint: A jewel thief fresh out of prison plans an elaborate heist on a Paris jewellery store.
Description: Out of prison after a five-year stretch, jewel thief Tony turns down a quick job his friend Jo offers him, until he discovers that his old girlfriend Mado has become the lover of local gangster Pierre Grutter during Tony's absence.

Title: The Twilight Samurai
Hint: A low-ranking swordsman struggles to care for his two daughters and his senile mother in 19th-century Japan.
Description: Seibei Iguchi leads a difficult life as a low ranking ___ at the turn of the nineteenth century. A widower with a meager income, Seibei struggles to take care of his two daughters and senile mother.

Title: Omkara
Hint: A bandit falls in love with a woman, but jealousy is stoked by his right-hand man.
Description: Half-caste bandit ___ Shukla abducts his lady love, Dolly Mishra, from her family. Thanks to his cleverness, he gets away with the kidnapping. A conspiracy, however, forms against him when he denies his right-hand man, Langda Tyagi, a promotion. Ultimately, this plot threatens not only his relationship with Dolly, but their lives and those of their associates as well.

Title: White Heat
Hint: A psychopathic gangster with a mother fixation breaks out of prison and plans one last big payroll heist.
Description: A psychopathic criminal with a mother complex makes a daring break from prison and then leads his old gang in a chemical plant payroll heist. After the heist, events take a crazy turn.

Title: The Grand Illusion
Hint: French prisoners of war of different classes plan an escape from a German castle in WWI.
Description: A group of French soldiers, including the patrician Captain de Boeldieu and the working-class Lieutenant Maréchal, grapple with their own class differences after being captured and held in a World War I German prison camp.

Title: Ace in the Hole
Hint: An arrogant reporter exploits a man trapped in a cave to revive his career.
Description: An arrogant reporter exploits a story about a man trapped in a cave to revitalize his career.

Title: Pink
Hint: Three women file a police complaint against a politician's nephew, and a lawyer defends them.
Description: After being molested, Minal and her friends try to file an FIR against a politician's nephew. When the subsequent case gets rigged, a retired lawyer helps them to fight the case.

Title: Faust
Hint: God and Satan wager on the soul of an alchemist, in a silent classic.
Description: God and Satan wager on the soul of a learned and prayerful alchemist as part of their eternal war over Earth.

Title: The Heiress
Hint: A shy, plain rich girl is courted by a charming man her cold father suspects is a fortune hunter.
Description: In 1840s New York, the uneventful and boring days of the daughter of a wealthy doctor come to an end when she meets a dashing poorer man — who may or may not be after her inheritance.

Title: A Short Film About Love
Hint: A lonely 19-year-old post office clerk spies on an older woman across the courtyard through a telescope.
Description: 19-year-old Tomek whiles away his lonely life by spying on his opposite neighbour Magda through binoculars. She's an artist in her mid-thirties, and appears to have everything - not least a constant stream of men at her beck and call. But when the two finally meet, they discover that they have a lot more in common than appeared at first sight...

Title: Article 15
Hint: A young police officer confronts caste violence in a rural Indian village.
Description: A young IPS officer’s new posting in rural India has him confronting caste disparities and uncomfortable truths in the face of a gruesome crime. When three girls go missing in the fictional village of Lalgaon, two of them are found dead and there is no trace of the third one. Where is she and who is responsible for this heinous act?

Title: Tangerines
Hint: An Estonian man stays behind to harvest his crops during the war in Abkhazia and shelters two soldiers.
Description: War in Abkhazia, 1992. An Estonian man Ivo has stayed behind to harvest his crops of ___. In a bloody conflict at his door, a wounded man is left behind, and Ivo is forced to take him in.

Title: Innocence
Hint: At a strange girls' boarding school, new arrivals are delivered in coffins.
Description: At a peculiar all-girls academy, new arrivals, including Iris, are delivered in coffins. Guided by enigmatic teachers, the students dance through enchanted woods by day, while the night unveils sinister lessons that blur ___ and awakening.

Title: A Christmas Carol
Hint: A miserly old man is visited by three spirits on December 24th, in a motion-capture adaptation.
Description: Miser Ebenezer Scrooge is awakened on Christmas Eve by spirits who reveal to him his own miserable existence, what opportunities he wasted in his youth, his current cruelties, and the dire fate that awaits him if he does not change his ways. Scrooge is faced with his own story of growing bitterness and meanness, and must decide what his own future will hold: death or redemption.

Title: Viridiana
Hint: A young novice is sent to visit her uncle before taking her vows.
Description: ___ is preparing to start her life as a nun when she is sent, somewhat unwillingly, to visit her aging uncle, Don Jaime. He supports her; but the two have met only once. Jaime thinks ___ resembles his dead wife. ___ has secretly despised this man all her life and finds her worst fears proven when Jaime grows determined to seduce his pure niece.

Title: Munna Bhai M.B.B.S.
Hint: A gangster sets out to fulfil his father's dream of him becoming a doctor.
Description: A gangster sets out to fulfill his father's dream of becoming a doctor.

Title: Jean de Florette
Hint: Greedy farmers plot to ruin a newcomer by hiding a spring on his land.
Description: In a rural French village, an old man and his only remaining relative cast their covetous eyes on an adjoining vacant property. They need its spring water for growing their flowers, and are dismayed to hear that the man who has inherited it is moving in. They block up the spring and watch as their new neighbour tries to keep his crops watered from wells far afield through the hot summer.

Title: Farha
Hint: A Palestinian girl hides in a storage room during the 1948 conflict.
Description: Palestine, 1948. After the withdrawal of the British occupiers, tensions rise between Arabs and Jews. Meanwhile, ___, the smart daughter of the mayor of a small village, unaware of the coming tragedy, dreams of going to study in the big city.

Title: The Tashkent Files
Hint: A journalist investigates the mysterious death of a former Indian prime minister.
Description: The ___ is a thriller that revolves around the mysterious death of India's 2nd Prime Minister Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri and attempts to uncover if he had actually died a natural death, or, as alleged, was assassinated.

Title: Barfi!
Hint: A charming deaf-mute man finds love with two very different women.
Description: The heartwarming tale of ___, a charming deaf-mute young man from 1970s Darjeeling, and two unalike women who can't help but fall for him.

Title: Hridayam
Hint: Two engineering students fall in love, and the young man's life takes many turns.
Description: Arun and Darshana are first-year engineering students and they fall in love soon after their college begins. And just as how things work generally in teenage, the road ahead isn't too easy for them. Life offers many twists and turns that they least expect.

Title: A Wednesday
Hint: A retired police commissioner recounts the most memorable case of his career.
Description: Prakash Rathod, a retired police commissioner recounts the most memorable case of his career wherein he was informed about a bomb scare in Mumbai by an ordinary commoner.

Title: Masaan
Hint: Four lives intersect along the Ganges in Varanasi, from a cremation worker's son to a grieving daughter.
Description: Four lives intersect along the Ganges: a low caste boy in hopeless love, a daughter ridden with guilt of a sexual encounter ending in a tragedy, a hapless father with fading morality, and a spirited child yearning for a family, long to escape the moral constructs of a small-town.

Title: The Circus
Hint: A wandering tramp becomes a big-top handyman and accidentally becomes the star of the show.
Description: Charlie, a wandering tramp, becomes a ___ handyman - soon the star of the show - and falls in love with the ___ owner's stepdaughter.

Title: The Bandit
Hint: An outlaw released from prison after 35 years seeks revenge in Istanbul, in a Turkish classic.
Description: The film tells the story of a group of bandits captured in the Cudi Mountains 35 years ago. All of them have died, either from illness or vendettas; only Baran (Şener Şen) survives. After serving his 35-year sentence, Baran is released from Viranşehir Prison and learns that his birthplace is now submerged under the waters of a dam. Ceren Ana (Zübeyde Erden) tells him about the past.

Title: Moscow Does Not Believe in Tears
Hint: Three young women from the provinces struggle in the Soviet capital in the 1950s, and one finds success.
Description: Living together in a workers' dorm, Katerina and her friends are determined to make it in ___. But when a boorish cameraman forces himself on her, Katerina finds herself pregnant and alone as her friends move on. Twenty years later, Katerina is a factory director, outpacing her old roommates career-wise, yet still alone but for her daughter. Love seems possible again when she meets a genial mechanic.

Title: Love Today
Hint: A young couple are made to exchange their phones for a day before their wedding.
Description: A young couple is made to exchange their phones for a day. What follows is a hilarious and emotional sequence of events that puts their lives in misery.

Title: Queen
Hint: A young woman goes on her honeymoon alone after her fiancé calls off the wedding.
Description: Rani, a 24-year-old homely girl, decides to go on her honeymoon alone when her fiancé calls off the wedding. Traveling around Europe, she finds joy, makes friends, and gains new-found independence.

Title: Hera Pheri
Hint: Two tenants and a landlord in desperate need of money stumble upon a ransom call.
Description: Two tenants and a landlord, in desperate need of money, chance upon a ransom call via a cross connection. They hatch a plan to claim the ransom for themselves.

Title: Major
Hint: A biopic of an Indian Army officer who died in the Mumbai terror attacks.
Description: This biopic follows the life of Indian Army officer ___ Sandeep Unnikrishnan, from his childhood to his heroic actions during the 2008 Mumbai attacks.

Title: Section 375
Hint: A filmmaker stands trial when a costume assistant accuses him of rape.
Description: A filmmaker stands trial when a costume assistant on his movie accuses him of rape.

Title: The Color of Paradise
Hint: A blind boy returns to his village for the summer, but his father wants to get rid of him.
Description: Mohammad joyfully returns to his tiny village on summer vacation from the Institute for the Blind, unaware of his widowed father's intentions to disown him in order to win the hand—and dowry—of a local woman. With the wedding swiftly approaching, Mohammad's future hangs precariously in the balance as his father struggles against his destiny, unable to see the wonder of life and love that's so clear to his son.

Title: Udaan
Hint: A young man must decide whether to follow his dreams or his father's demands.
Description: Upon returning to his industrial hometown, a young man must decide whether to follow his own dreams or acquiesce to his father's plans for his future.

Title: Checkmate
Hint: Six people are thrown together during an elaborate bank heist in Istanbul.
Description: Six people are thrown together during an elaborate bank heist where any move can alter the outcome. Is it coincidence, or are they merely pawns in a much bigger game.

Title: Her Şey Çok Güzel Olacak
Hint: A man and his estranged brother go on a road trip with stolen drugs.
Description: When Altan swipes prescription drugs from his brother Nuri's pharmacy, they soon find themselves on a dangerous but funny road trip to get rid of the stuff and escape the mafiosi Altan tried to double-cross. Along the way, the brother who are compete opposites finally bond.

Title: Kaththi
Hint: A criminal on the run takes on the identity of an activist fighting for farmers.
Description: Kathiresan aka ___, a criminal, escapes from the Kolkata prison and comes to Chennai, where he comes across his doppelganger Jeevanandham, fighting for his life after being shot at by unknown men. Kathir decides to pass off as Jeeva and make away with a lump sum amount but once he realizes who Jeeva really is, Kathir turns a crusader.

Title: Thuppakki
Hint: An army officer on leave in Mumbai uncovers a sleeper cell of terrorists.
Description: Captain Jagadish, an intelligence officer in the Indian Army, returns to Mumbai for a vacation but soon finds himself in a deadly mission. After witnessing a bus bombing, he uncovers a network of sleeper cells planning multiple attacks across the city.

Title: Dara of Jasenovac
Hint: A young girl survives the horrors of a World War II concentration camp.
Description: During the Nazi-occupied Ustasha regime "NDH" in former Yugoslavia during WWII, little girl ___ is sent to the concentration camp complex ___ in Croatia also known as "Balkan's Auschwitz".

Title: Day of the Wacko
Hint: A misanthropic middle-aged man hates his life and everyone around him in Warsaw.
Description: It is a bitter story about a middle-aged man, who hates his life and other people, including himself. Adam Miauczynski, the character known from director Marek Koterski's previous films, is a 44 year-old teacher, who reads poetry during school lessons and later goes home swearing and calling his neighbours' names. The worst pain for him is the next 5 minutes of living.

Title: Sarfarosh
Hint: A Mumbai cop fights back against cross-border terrorists who killed his brother and crippled his father.
Description: When terrorists kill a cop's brother and disable his father, he fights back against the smuggling of guns and drugs which plagues his country.

Title: Black
Hint: A blind and deaf girl grows up with the help of an alcoholic teacher.
Description: Unable to see, hear, or speak after a childhood illness, a young woman grows up prone to violent outbursts until an eccentric tutor changes her life.

Title: Anand
Hint: A doctor treats a dying cancer patient whose zest for life inspires him.
Description: Dr. Bhaskar Bannerjee struggles with his patients' suffering and the darkness and poverty he confronts daily. He treats cancer patient ___ who upon learning of his impending death determines to use the time he has left to the absolute fullest.

Title: Jo Jeeta Wohi Sikandar
Hint: A carefree young man transforms himself to win an inter-college bicycle race against a rich rival school.
Description: Sanjay, a carefree young man, experiences mental and physical transformation to compete in an inter-collegiate bicycle race after his elder brother is unable to participate due to an injury.

Title: Day of Wrath
Hint: A young woman whose mother was accused of witchcraft marries an older pastor in 17th-century Denmark.
Description: In a Danish village in the early 1600s, a young woman named Anne, whose mother was thought to be a witch, develops sympathy toward an old woman, Marte, who is accused of witchcraft. The intervention of Anne's older but kindly husband, Pastor Absalon saved her mother -- but now, urged on by his overbearing mother, he refuses to help Marte.

Title: Pardon
Hint: Three friends wrongly jailed as terrorists try to survive behind bars.
Description: Based on a true event, ___ tells the tragicomic story of three friends who end up in prison when they are mistaken as members of a terrorist organization. Ibrahim's fear of uniforms makes him runaway whenever he sees one. Because of this, police mistakes him with a terrorist and takes him and his friend Muzo into custody.

Title: Ghilli
Hint: A village kabaddi player rescues a girl from a powerful thug who is forcing her into marriage, then must hide her from him.
Description: Muthu Pandi, a village strongman, decides to marry Dhanalakshmi, and begins his quest by eliminating everyone who opposes their union - starting with both her brothers. In desperation, Dhanalakshmi decides to escape from the village, and in the process is unwittingly assisted by a university Kabaddi player Velu.

Title: Montevideo: Taste of a Dream
Hint: A ragtag Yugoslav football team chases an unlikely shot at playing at the first World Cup in Uruguay in 1930.
Description: A story about one team that decides to follow a dream that takes them on a journey to the First World Football Championship in ___, Uruguay in 1930. A dream that allows them to become true stars and living legends.

Title: Indian
Hint: An elderly former freedom fighter becomes a knife-wielding vigilante against corruption, even targeting his own son.
Description: Senapathy, an ex-freedom fighter, is angry. He is angry against the rampant corruption at every level of the bureaucracy. He will clean it up at any cost.

Title: Roja
Hint: A young bride from a Tamil village fights to free her husband, kidnapped by militants in Kashmir.
Description: ___, a simple girl from a village in Tamil Nadu, makes desperate efforts to find her husband, Rishi, after he is kidnapped by militants during a secret undercover mission in Kashmir.

Title: Bombay
Hint: A Hindu man and a Muslim woman marry against their families' wishes and are caught up in the 1990s Mumbai riots.
Description: A Hindu man and a Muslim woman fall in love in a small village and move to Mumbai, where they have two children. However, growing religious tensions and erupting riots threaten to tear the family apart.

Title: The Legend of Bhagat Singh
Hint: A young revolutionary witnesses British atrocities and becomes a martyr in India's independence struggle.
Description: Born in British India, ___ witnesses numerous atrocities during his childhood and grows up to become one of the most fearless freedom fighters in the country.

Title: Iqbal
Hint: A deaf and mute village boy dreams of bowling for the Indian cricket team and trains with a drunken ex-player.
Description: This is all about chasing your dreams, no matter what the obstacles. The story involves a young deaf and dumb boy who is crazy about cricket.

Title: Past Lives
Country: United States of America, South Korea
Hint: Two childhood friends from Seoul, separated when one emigrates, reunite in New York decades later.
Description: After decades apart, childhood friends Nora and Hae Sung are reunited in New York for one fateful weekend as they confront notions of destiny, love, and the choices that make a life.

Title: Dune
Hint: A young noble's family takes control of a desert planet everyone wants to own.
Description: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people.

Title: Blade Runner 2049
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A replicant hunter uncovers a long-buried secret that leads him to a missing former detective.
Description: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new ___, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. K's discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former LAPD ___ who has been missing for 30 years.

Title: Black Swan
Hint: A committed ballerina struggles to keep her sanity after winning the lead role in a dark production.
Description: A committed dancer struggles to maintain her sanity after winning the lead role in a production of Tchaikovsky's "___ Lake."

Title: The Princess Bride
Hint: A grandfather reads his sick grandson a fairy tale full of pirates, giants, swordfights and true love.
Description: In this enchantingly cracked fairy tale, the beautiful Princess Buttercup and the dashing Westley must overcome staggering odds to find happiness amid six-fingered swordsmen, murderous princes, Sicilians and rodents of unusual size. But even death can't stop these true lovebirds from triumphing.

Title: La La Land
Hint: A jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love while chasing their dreams in Los Angeles, in a modern musical.
Description: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dingy bars, but as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.

Title: Sin City
Hint: Three stories of revenge and corruption unfold in a stylised, black-and-white neo-noir town.
Description: Welcome to ___. This town beckons to the tough, the corrupt, the brokenhearted. Some call it dark… Hard-boiled. Then there are those who call it home — Crooked cops, sexy dames, desperate vigilantes. Some are seeking revenge, others lust after redemption, and then there are those hoping for a little of both.

Title: Guardians of the Galaxy
Hint: A cocky interstellar outlaw teams up with a gang of misfits, including a talking raccoon and a tree.
Description: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.

Title: Donnie Darko
Hint: A troubled teenager is visited by a sinister man in a rabbit suit who tells him the world will end in 28 days.
Description: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a large bunny rabbit that manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

Title: OMG 2
Hint: A father takes his son's school to court after he is expelled over a sex education controversy.
Description: Life is bliss until one day Kanti Sharan Mudgal’s son Vivek is blamed for immoral conduct and expelled from school. Overwhelmed, Kanti plans to leave town until a divine intervention leads him to seek justice by taking those responsible to court.

Title: The Revenant
Country: Canada, Hong Kong, Taiwan, United States of America
Hint: A frontiersman mauled by a bear and left for dead by his companions crawls back to take revenge.
Description: In the 1820s, a frontiersman, Hugh Glass, sets out on a path of vengeance against those who left him for dead after a bear mauling.

Title: Her
Hint: A lonely writer falls in love with his computer's artificial intelligence operating system.
Description: In the not so distant future, Theodore, a lonely writer, purchases a newly developed operating system designed to meet the user's every need. To Theodore's surprise, a romantic relationship develops between him and his operating system. This unconventional love story blends science fiction and romance in a sweet tale that explores the nature of love and the ways that technology isolates and connects us all.

Title: The Incredibles
Hint: A family of undercover superheroes are forced back into action when a vengeful villain targets them.
Description: Bob Parr has given up his superhero days to log in time as an insurance adjuster and raise his three children with his formerly heroic wife in suburbia. But when he receives a mysterious assignment, it's time to get back into costume.

Title: CODA
Hint: The only hearing member of a deaf fishing family dreams of becoming a singer.
Description: As a ___ (Child of Deaf Adults), Ruby is the only hearing person in her deaf family. When the family's fishing business is threatened, Ruby finds herself torn between pursuing her love of music and her fear of abandoning her parents.

Title: The Martian
Hint: An astronaut stranded on Mars after a storm must use his wits and botany to survive until rescue.
Description: During a manned mission to Mars, Astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind by his crew. But Watney has survived and finds himself stranded and alone on the hostile planet. With only meager supplies, he must draw upon his ingenuity, wit and spirit to subsist and find a way to signal to Earth that he is alive.

Title: Deadpool
Hint: A wisecracking mercenary is disfigured in an experiment and becomes an indestructible antihero with a filthy mouth.
Description: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego ___. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, ___ hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.

Title: The Imitation Game
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A brilliant mathematician and his team race to crack the German Enigma code during WWII.
Description: Based on the real life story of legendary cryptanalyst Alan Turing, the film portrays the nail-biting race against time by Turing and his brilliant team of code-breakers at Britain's top-secret Government Code and Cypher School at Bletchley Park, during the darkest days of World War II.

Title: The Avengers
Hint: Earth's mightiest heroes unite to stop an alien invasion in New York.
Description: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!

Title: The Last Picture Show
Hint: Two best friends come of age in a dying Texas town in the early 1950s.
Description: High school seniors and best friends, Sonny and Duane, live in a dying Texas town. The handsome Duane is dating a local beauty, while Sonny is having an affair with the coach's wife. As graduation nears and both boys contemplate their futures, Duane eyes the army and Sonny takes over a local business. Each struggles to figure out if he can escape this dead-end town and build a better life somewhere else.

Title: Young Frankenstein
Hint: A neurosurgeon inherits his notorious grandfather's castle in Transylvania and tries to reanimate a corpse, in a black-and-white spoof.
Description: A young neurosurgeon inherits the castle of his grandfather, the famous Dr. Victor von ___. In the castle he finds a funny hunchback, a pretty lab assistant and the elderly housekeeper. ___ believes that the work of his grandfather was delusional, but when he discovers the book where the mad doctor described his reanimation experiment, he suddenly changes his mind.

Title: The King's Speech
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A British monarch with a crippling stammer works with an unorthodox Australian therapist before a vital WWII broadcast.
Description: The ___ tells the story of the man who became King George VI, the father of Queen Elizabeth II. After his brother abdicates, George ('Bertie') reluctantly assumes the throne. Plagued by a dreaded stutter and considered unfit to be king, Bertie engages the help of an unorthodox ___ therapist named Lionel Logue.

Title: Zootopia
Hint: A bunny cop and a con-artist fox uncover a conspiracy in a city of animals.
Description: Determined to prove herself, Officer Judy Hopps, the first bunny on ___ police force, jumps at the chance to crack her first case - even if it means partnering with scam-artist fox Nick Wilde to solve the mystery.

Title: Casino Royale
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A newly promoted British secret agent must beat a terrorist banker in a high-stakes poker game.
Description: Le Chiffre, a banker to the world's terrorists, is scheduled to participate in a high-stakes poker game in Montenegro, where he intends to use his winnings to establish his financial grip on the terrorist market. M sends Bond—on his maiden mission as a 00 Agent—to attend this game and prevent Le Chiffre from winning.

Title: Rosemary's Baby
Hint: A young wife in a New York apartment building suspects her neighbours have sinister plans for her unborn child.
Description: A young couple, ___ and Guy, moves into an infamous New York apartment building, known by frightening legends and mysterious events, with the purpose of starting a family.

Title: Magnolia
Hint: One rainy day in the San Fernando Valley links many lives together.
Description: On one random day in the San Fernando Valley, a dying father, a young wife, a male caretaker, a famous lost son, a police officer in love, a boy genius, an ex-boy genius, a game show host and an estranged daughter will each become part of a dazzling multiplicity of plots, but one story.

Title: Blood Diamond
Hint: A smuggler and a fisherman search for a rare pink gem during the Sierra Leone civil war.
Description: An ex-mercenary turned smuggler. A Mende fisherman. Amid the explosive civil war overtaking 1999 Sierra Leone, these men join for two desperate missions: recovering a rare pink ___ of immense value and rescuing the fisherman's son, conscripted as a child soldier into the brutal rebel forces ripping a swath of torture and bloodshed countrywide.

Title: 12 Monkeys
Hint: A convict is sent back in time to stop a virus that wiped out humanity.
Description: In the year 2035, convict James Cole reluctantly volunteers to be sent back in time to discover the origin of a deadly virus that wiped out nearly all of the earth's population and forced the survivors into underground communities. But when Cole is mistakenly sent to 1990 instead of 1996, he's arrested and locked up in a mental hospital. There he meets psychiatrist Dr.

Title: The Invisible Guest
Hint: A businessman accused of murdering his lover hires a prestigious lawyer to prepare his defence.
Description: Barcelona, Spain. Adrián Doria, a young and successful businessman accused of murder, meets one night with Virginia Goodman, an expert interrogation lawyer, in order to devise a defense strategy.

Title: Beauty and the Beast
Hint: A bright young woman is held captive in an enchanted castle by a cursed prince.
Description: Follow the adventures of Belle, a bright young woman who finds herself in the castle of a prince who's been turned into a mysterious ___. With the help of the castle's enchanted staff, Belle soon learns the most important lesson of all -- that true beauty comes from within.

Title: Soul
Hint: A jazz-loving music teacher's spirit is separated from his body just before his big break, and lands in a pre-life realm.
Description: Joe Gardner is a middle school teacher with a love for jazz music. After a successful audition at the Half Note Club, he suddenly gets into an accident that separates his ___ from his body and is transported to the You Seminar, a center in which souls develop and gain passions before being transported to a newborn child.

Title: Groundhog Day
Hint: A cynical TV weatherman relives the same day over and over in a small Pennsylvania town.
Description: A cynical TV weatherman, along with his idealistic producer and his sardonic cameraman, is sent to report on ___ in the small town of Punxsutawney, where he finds himself repeating the same day over and over.

Title: Scent of a Woman
Hint: A prep school student takes a job looking after a blind, bad-tempered retired army officer.
Description: Charlie Simms is a student at a private preparatory school who comes from a poor family. To earn the money for his flight home to Gresham, Oregon for Christmas, Charlie takes a job over Thanksgiving looking after retired U.S. Army officer Lieutenant Colonel Frank Slade, a cantankerous middle-aged man who lives with his niece and her family.

Title: Dances with Wolves
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A wounded Civil War soldier is sent to a remote frontier post and befriends a Sioux tribe.
Description: Wounded Civil War soldier John Dunbar tries to commit suicide—and becomes a hero instead. As a reward, he's assigned to his dream post, a remote junction on the Western frontier, and soon makes unlikely friends with the local Sioux tribe.

Title: Aladdin
Hint: A street thief finds a magic lamp and wishes to win a princess.
Description: In the boorish city of Agrabah, kind-hearted street urchin ___ and Princess Jasmine fall in love, although she can only marry a prince. He and power-hungry Grand Vizier Jafar vie for a magic lamp that can fulfill their wishes.

Title: Rain Man
Hint: A selfish car dealer discovers he has an autistic savant brother who inherited his father's fortune.
Description: When car dealer Charlie Babbitt learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has a savant older brother named Raymond and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles.

Title: The Graduate
Hint: A disillusioned young man fresh out of college is torn between his older lover and her daughter.
Description: A disillusioned college ___ finds himself torn between his older lover and her daughter.

Title: The Pursuit of Happyness
Hint: A struggling salesman and his young son fight homelessness to chase a better life.
Description: A struggling salesman takes custody of his son as he's poised to begin a life-changing professional career.

Title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
Hint: A former assassin continues her quest for revenge against the last members of her old team and their leader.
Description: The Bride unwaveringly continues on her roaring rampage of revenge against the band of assassins who had tried to kill her and her unborn child. She visits each of her former associates one-by-one, checking off the victims on her Death List Five until there's nothing left to do … but ___.

Title: Planet of the Apes
Hint: An astronaut crash-lands on a world where simians rule and humans are mute beasts.
Description: Astronaut Taylor crash lands on a distant planet ruled by ___ who use a primitive race of humans for experimentation and sport. Soon Taylor finds himself among the hunted, his life in the hands of a benevolent chimpanzee scientist.

Title: Perfect Blue
Hint: A rising pop idol quits singing to become an actress, and a stalker blurs her sense of reality.
Description: Rising pop star Mima quits singing to pursue a career as an actress. After she takes up a role on a popular detective show, her handlers and collaborators begin turning up murdered. Harboring feelings of guilt and haunted by visions of her former self, Mima's reality and fantasy meld into a frenzied paranoia.

Title: Big Fish
Hint: A dying man's son tries to separate fact from fiction in his father's tall tales.
Description: Throughout his life Edward Bloom has always been a man of big appetites, enormous passions and tall tales. In his later years, he remains a huge mystery to his son, William. Now, to get to know the real man, Will begins piecing together a true picture of his father from flashbacks of his amazing adventures.

Title: JFK
Hint: A New Orleans district attorney investigates the assassination of a US president.
Description: Follows the investigation into the assassination of President John F. Kennedy led by New Orleans district attorney Jim Garrison.

Title: Dogville
Country: Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Netherlands, Sweden, United Kingdom
Hint: A woman on the run from the mob is taken in by a small Colorado community, which then exploits her.
Description: A woman on the run from the mob is reluctantly accepted in a small Colorado community in exchange for labor, but when a search visits the town, she learns that their support has a price.

Title: The Bourne Ultimatum
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A former assassin with no memory goes after the people who made him, as the CIA hunts him.
Description: ___ is brought out of hiding once again by reporter Simon Ross who is trying to unveil Operation Blackbriar, an upgrade to Project Treadstone, in a series of newspaper columns. Information from the reporter stirs a new set of memories, and ___ must finally uncover his dark past while dodging The Company's best efforts to eradicate him.

Title: Akira
Hint: A secret military project turns a biker gang member into a psychic monster in Neo-Tokyo.
Description: A secret military project endangers Neo-Tokyo when it turns a biker gang member into a rampaging psychic psychopath that only two teenagers and a group of psychics can stop.

Title: Lion
Country: Australia, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A five-year-old boy gets lost in Calcutta and, 25 years later, uses Google Earth to find his family.
Description: A five-year-old Indian boy gets lost on the streets of Calcutta, thousands of kilometers from home. He survives many challenges before being adopted by a couple in Australia; 25 years later, he sets out to find his lost family.

Title: Slumdog Millionaire
Hint: A poor teen from Mumbai's slums is one question away from winning millions.
Description: A teenager reflects on his life after being accused of cheating on the Indian version of "Who Wants to be a ___?".

Title: Chungking Express
Hint: Two lovesick Hong Kong cops cross paths with two mysterious women.
Description: Two melancholic Hong Kong policemen fall in love: one with a mysterious underworld figure, the other with a beautiful and ethereal server at a late-night restaurant.

Title: The Shop Around the Corner
Hint: Two employees at a Budapest gift store can barely stand each other, unaware they are secret pen pals.
Description: Two employees at a gift shop can barely stand one another, without realising that they are falling in love through the post as each other's anonymous pen pal.

Title: Dog Day Afternoon
Hint: Two would-be robbers hold up a Brooklyn bank on a sweltering day, and it turns into a media circus.
Description: Based on the true story of would-be Brooklyn bank robbers John Wojtowicz and Salvatore Naturile. Sonny and Sal attempt a bank heist which quickly turns sour and escalates into a hostage situation and stand-off with the police. As Sonny's motives for the robbery are slowly revealed and things become more complicated, the heist turns into a media circus.

Title: Do the Right Thing
Hint: Racial tensions boil over on the hottest day of the year in a Brooklyn neighbourhood.
Description: Sal is the Italian owner of a pizzeria in Brooklyn. A neighborhood local, Buggin' Out, becomes upset when he sees that the pizzeria's Wall of Fame exhibits only Italian actors. Buggin' Out believes a pizzeria in a black neighborhood should showcase black actors, but Sal disagrees. The wall becomes a symbol of racism and hate to Buggin' Out and to other people in the neighborhood, and tensions rise.

Title: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
Hint: Two charming outlaws flee to Bolivia when a posse chases them across the West.
Description: As the west rapidly becomes civilized, a pair of outlaws in 1890s Wyoming find themselves pursued by a posse and decide to flee to South America in hopes of evading the law.

Title: Sling Blade
Hint: A mentally disabled man released from a hospital befriends a boy and his mother.
Description: Karl Childers, a mentally disabled man, has been in the custody of the state mental hospital since the age of 12 for killing his mother and her lover. Although thoroughly institutionalized, he is deemed fit to be released into the outside world.

Title: Annie Hall
Studio: Jack Rollins & Charles H. Joffe Productions
Hint: A neurotic New York comedian falls in love with a ditzy aspiring singer.
Description: New York comedian Alvy Singer falls in love with the ditsy ___.

Title: The Night of the Hunter
Hint: A serial-killing preacher hunts two children who know where their father hid stolen money.
Description: In Depression-era West Virginia, a serial-killing preacher hunts two young children who know the whereabouts of a stash of money.

Title: What Ever Happened to Baby Jane?
Hint: A former child star torments her paraplegic sister in their decaying Hollywood mansion.
Description: A former vaudeville child star viciously torments her paraplegic sister in their decaying Hollywood mansion.

Title: Monty Python's Life of Brian
Hint: A Judean man born next door to Jesus is mistaken for the Messiah.
Description: ___ Cohen is an average young Jewish man, but through a series of ridiculous events, he gains a reputation as the Messiah. When he's not dodging his followers or being scolded by his shrill mother, the hapless ___ has to contend with the pompous Pontius Pilate and acronym-obsessed members of a separatist movement.

Title: Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf?
Hint: A history professor and his wife entertain a young couple during a long, drunken night of cruel games.
Description: A history professor and his wife entertain a young couple who are new to the university's faculty. As the drinks flow, secrets come to light, and the middle-aged couple unload onto their guests the full force of the bitterness, dysfunction, and animosity that defines their marriage.

Title: Mommy
Hint: A widowed mother struggles to raise her violent, ADHD teenage son with the help of a neighbour.
Description: A peculiar neighbor offers hope to a recent widow who is struggling to raise a teenager who is unpredictable and, sometimes, violent.

Title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
Hint: A princess in a toxic world tries to make peace with giant insects.
Description: After a global war, the seaside kingdom known as the ___ of the ___ remains one of the last strongholds on Earth untouched by a poisonous jungle and the powerful insects that guard it. Led by the courageous Princess ___, the people of the ___ engage in an epic struggle to restore the bond between humanity and Earth.

Title: Papillon
Hint: A safecracker befriends a forger in a brutal French Guiana penal colony and plots escape.
Description: A man befriends a fellow criminal as the two of them begin serving their sentence on a dreadful prison island, which inspires the man to plot his escape.

Title: Solaris
Hint: A psychologist is sent to a space station orbiting a mysterious planet that creates manifestations of memories.
Description: A psychologist is sent to a space station orbiting a planet called ___ to investigate the death of a doctor and the mental problems of cosmonauts on the station. He soon discovers that the water on the planet is a type of brain which brings out repressed memories and obsessions.

Title: Ip Man
Hint: A wing chun master in Foshan is forced to fight Japanese occupiers.
Description: A semi-biographical account of Yip Man, the first martial arts master to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun. The film focuses on events surrounding Ip that took place in the city of Foshan between the 1930s to 1940s during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.

Title: Cinderella Man
Hint: A washed-up Depression-era boxer makes an unlikely comeback to feed his family and becomes a folk hero.
Description: The true story of boxer Jim Braddock who, following his retirement in the 1930s, makes a surprise comeback in order to lift his family out of poverty.

Title: Gandhi
Hint: The life of an Indian lawyer who leads a nonviolent independence movement against British rule.
Description: In the early years of the 20th century, Mohandas K. ___, a British-trained lawyer, forsakes all worldly possessions to take up the cause of Indian independence. Faced with armed resistance from the British government, ___ adopts a policy of 'passive resistance', endeavouring to win freedom for his people without resorting to bloodshed.

Title: The Exterminating Angel
Hint: After a lavish dinner party, the guests find themselves inexplicably unable to leave the room.
Description: After a lavish dinner party, the guests find themselves unable to depart... and, over the next few days, all of their elaborate societal pretenses and façades deteriorate as they are reduced to living like animals.

Title: The Hustler
Hint: A cocky small-time pool shark challenges a legendary champion in a marathon high-stakes game.
Description: Fast Eddie Felson is a small-time pool ___ with a lot of talent but a self-destructive attitude. His bravado causes him to challenge the legendary Minnesota Fats to a high-stakes match.

Title: 8½
Hint: A film director suffering from creative block retreats into his memories and fantasies.
Description: Guido Anselmi, a film director, finds himself creatively barren at the peak of his career. Urged by his doctors to rest, Anselmi heads for a luxurious resort, but a sorry group gathers—his producer, staff, actors, wife, mistress, and relatives—each one begging him to get on with the show. In retreat from their dependency, he fantasizes about past women and dreams of his childhood.

Title: Rio Bravo
Hint: A small-town sheriff enlists a drunk and a cripple to hold a killer in jail.
Description: A small-town sheriff in the American West enlists the help of a disabled man, a drunk, and a young gunfighter in his efforts to hold in jail the brother of the local bad guy.

Title: Castle in the Sky
Hint: A boy and a girl with a magic crystal race against pirates to find a legendary floating city.
Description: A young boy and a girl with a magic crystal must race against pirates and foreign agents in a search for a legendary floating ___.

Title: Roman Holiday
Hint: A sheltered princess escapes her royal duties for a day in Rome with an American reporter.
Description: Overwhelmed by her suffocating schedule, touring European princess Ann takes off for a night while in Rome. When a sedative she took from her doctor kicks in, however, she falls asleep on a park bench and is found by an American reporter, Joe Bradley, who takes her back to his apartment for safety.

Title: La Dolce Vita
Hint: A journalist drifts through the decadent high society of Rome in search of love and happiness.
Description: Episodic journey of journalist Marcello who struggles to find his place in the world, torn between the allure of Rome's elite social scene and the stifling domesticity offered by his girlfriend, all the while searching for a way to become a serious writer.

Title: High Noon
Hint: A town marshal must face a gang of killers alone when the townspeople refuse to help him.
Description: Will Kane, the sheriff of a small town in New Mexico, learns a notorious outlaw he put in jail has been freed, and will be arriving on the ___ train. Knowing the outlaw and his gang are coming to kill him, Kane is determined to stand his ground, so he attempts to gather a posse from among the local townspeople.

Title: Fiddler on the Roof
Hint: A poor Jewish milkman in pre-revolutionary Russia struggles with his daughters' choices of husbands.
Description: In a pre-revolutionary Russia, a poor Jewish milkman struggles with the challenges of a changing world as his daughters fall in love and antisemitism grows.

Title: Wolfwalkers
Country: France, Ireland, Luxembourg, United States of America, China
Hint: A young apprentice hunter befriends a wild girl who can turn into a wolf in 1650s Ireland.
Description: In a time of superstition and magic, when wolves are seen as demonic and nature an evil to be tamed, a young apprentice hunter comes to Ireland with her father to wipe out the last pack. But when she saves a wild native girl, their friendship leads her to discover the world of the ___ and transform her into the very thing her father is tasked to destroy.

Title: Pink Floyd: The Wall
Hint: A troubled rock star descends into madness and isolation, in a surreal rock opera.
Description: A troubled rock star descends into madness in the midst of his physical and social isolation from everyone.

Title: Infernal Affairs
Hint: A cop undercover in the triads and a triad mole in the police hunt each other.
Description: Chan Wing Yan, a young police officer, has been sent undercover as a mole in the local mafia. Lau Kin Ming, a young mafia member, infiltrates the police force. Years later, their older counterparts, Chen Wing Yan and Inspector Lau Kin Ming, respectively, race against time to expose the mole within their midst.

Title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
Hint: A sleepwalker under the control of a hypnotist commits murders, in a German expressionist classic.
Description: Francis, a young man, recalls in his memory the horrible experiences he and his fiancée Jane recently went through. Francis and his friend Alan visit The ___, an exhibit where the mysterious doctor shows the somnambulist Cesare, and awakens him for some moments from his death-like sleep.

Title: Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter... and Spring
Hint: A monk raises a boy in a floating temple through the seasons of his life.
Description: An isolated lake, where an old monk lives in a small floating temple. The monk has a young boy living with him, learning to become a monk. We watch as seasons and years pass by.

Title: Touch of Evil
Hint: A border-town bombing draws a Mexican investigator into a corrupt police captain's web.
Description: A border-town bombing draws Mexican investigator Miguel Vargas into a corruption-ridden police investigation led by crooked captain Hank Quinlan, setting off a deadly struggle over power, justice, and truth.

Title: The Maltese Falcon
Hint: A private eye is drawn into a deadly hunt for a priceless black bird.
Description: A private detective takes on a case that involves him with three eccentric criminals, a beautiful liar, and their quest for a priceless statuette.

Title: Silenced
Hint: A new teacher at a school for deaf children discovers the students are being abused.
Description: Based on actual events that took place at Gwangju Inhwa School for the hearing-impaired, where young deaf students were the victims of repeated sexual assaults by faculty members over a period of five years in the early 2000s.

Title: Anatomy of a Murder
Hint: A small-town lawyer defends an army lieutenant accused of murdering a bartender.
Description: Semi-retired Michigan lawyer Paul Biegler takes the case of Army Lt. Manion, who murdered a local innkeeper after his wife claimed that he raped her. Over the course of an extensive trial, Biegler parries with District Attorney Lodwick and out-of-town prosecutor Claude Dancer to set his client free, but his case rests on the victim's mysterious business partner, who's hiding a dark secret.

Title: The Straight Story
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, France
Hint: An elderly man drives a lawn mower 240 miles to visit his estranged, ailing brother.
Description: Retired farmer and widower Alvin ___ learns one day that his distant brother Lyle has suffered a stroke and may not recover. Alvin is determined to make things right with Lyle while he still can, but his brother lives in Wisconsin, while Alvin is stuck in Iowa with no car and no driver's license.

Title: Mirror
Hint: A dying man recalls his childhood, his mother and the war, in a dreamlike Soviet film.
Description: A dying man in his forties recalls his childhood, his mother, the war and personal moments that tell of and juxtapose pivotal moments in Soviet history with daily life.

Title: Fitzcarraldo
Hint: A dreamer plans to haul a steamship over a mountain to build an opera house in the Amazon.
Description: ___ is a dreamer who plans to build an opera house in Iquitos, in the Peruvian Amazon, so, in order to finance his project, he embarks on an epic adventure to collect rubber, a very profitable product, in a remote and unexplored region of the rainforest.

Title: Secrets & Lies
Hint: A woman searching for her birth mother uncovers a family full of things left unsaid.
Description: After her adoptive mother dies, Hortense, a successful black optometrist, seeks out her birth mother. She's shocked when her research leads her to Cynthia, a working class white woman.

Title: My Sassy Girl
Hint: A mild-mannered student rescues a drunk, feisty young woman on a subway, and she dominates his life.
Description: A dweeby, mild-mannered man comes to the aid of a drunk young woman on a subway platform. Little does he know how much trouble he’s in for.

Title: The Leopard
Hint: An aristocratic Sicilian prince struggles to preserve his family's status during the unification of Italy.
Description: As Garibaldi's troops begin the unification of Italy in the 1860s, an aristocratic Sicilian family grudgingly adapts to the sweeping social changes undermining their way of life.

Title: The Legend of 1900
Hint: A piano prodigy born on an ocean liner never sets foot on land.
Description: Musician Max Tooney goes to sell his prized Conn trumpet to a music shop, where he plays the instrument one last time. The shopkeeper recognises the song as one on a record matrix he found and asks who the piece is by. Tooney tells the story of an infant found abandoned in the first class dining room of the four-stacker ocean-liner SS Virginian on 1 January ___.

Title: Brief Encounter
Hint: Two married strangers meet at a railway station and fall into a short, aching love.
Description: Returning home from a shopping trip to a nearby town, bored suburban housewife Laura Jesson is thrown by happenstance into an acquaintance with virtuous doctor Alec Harvey.

Title: The Tale of The Princess Kaguya
Hint: A tiny girl found inside a glowing bamboo stalk grows into a beautiful young woman courted by noblemen.
Description: Found inside a shining stalk of bamboo by an old bamboo cutter and his wife, a tiny girl grows rapidly into an exquisite young lady. The mysterious young princess enthrals all who encounter her. But, ultimately, she must confront her fate.

Title: Song of the Sea
Hint: A boy and his little sister, the last of the seal-folk, journey home through Irish myths.
Description: The story of the last Seal Child’s journey home. After their mother’s disappearance, Ben and Saoirse are sent to live with Granny in the city. When they resolve to return to their home by the sea, their journey becomes a race against time as they are drawn into a world Ben knows only from his mother’s folktales. But this is no bedtime story; these fairy folk have been in our world far too long.

Title: Baahubali: The Beginning
Hint: A young man raised in a village discovers his royal heritage in an epic Indian fantasy.
Description: The young Shivudu is left as a foundling in a small village by his mother. By the time he’s grown up, it has become apparent that he possesses exceptional gifts. He meets the beautiful warrior princess Avanthika and learns that her queen has been held captive for the last 25 years. Shividu sets off to rescue her, discovering his own origins in the process.

Title: The Sea Inside
Hint: A quadriplegic Spanish man fights for the right to end his life.
Description: Ramón Sampedro is a ship mechanic and part-time poet left a quadriplegic following a diving accident. Ramón fought for 30 years for the legal right to end his own life. He develops close relationships with his long-term lawyer Julia and his friend Rosa, who tries to convince him that his life is worth living. Despite his situation, Ramón manages to inspire those around him to live life to the fullest.

Title: Sleuth
Hint: A wealthy mystery writer invites his wife's lover to his mansion for a game of cat and mouse.
Description: A man who loves games and theatre invites his wife's lover to meet, setting up a battle of wits with potentially deadly results.

Title: Elite Squad
Hint: A captain in Rio's brutal special police unit looks for a replacement before the Pope's visit to the favelas.
Description: In 1997, before the visit of the pope to Rio de Janeiro, Captain Nascimento from BOPE (Special Police Operations Battalion) is assigned to eliminate the risks of the drug dealers in a dangerous slum nearby where the pope intends to be lodged.

Title: Out of the Past
Hint: A gas station owner's former life as a private eye catches up with him through a femme fatale.
Description: The peaceful life of a gas station owner is disrupted when a man from his past arrives in town and forces him to return to the dark world he had tried to escape.

Title: Nobody Knows
Hint: Four children are left alone in a Tokyo apartment after their mother disappears.
Description: In a small Tokyo apartment, twelve-year-old Akira must care for his younger siblings after their mother leaves them and shows no sign of returning.

Title: Le Samouraï
Hint: A silent hitman with a strict code is double-crossed after a job.
Description: After carrying out a flawlessly planned hit, Jef Costello, a contract killer with samurai instincts, finds himself caught between a persistent police investigator and a ruthless employer, and not even his armor of fedora and trench coat can protect him.

Title: The Diving Bell and the Butterfly
Hint: A French magazine editor paralysed by a stroke writes his memoir by blinking his eyelid.
Description: Jean-Dominique Bauby, editor-in-chief of French fashion bible Elle magazine, has a devastating stroke at age 43. The damage to his brain stem results in locked-in syndrome, with which he is almost completely paralyzed and only able to communicate by blinking an eye. Bauby painstakingly dictates his memoir via the only means of expression left to him.

Title: Stalag 17
Hint: American POWs in a German camp suspect a cynical sergeant is a spy.
Description: After two American prisoners are killed by guards in the act of escaping from a German POW camp in World War II, barracks black marketeer J.J. Sefton is suspected of being an informer.

Title: Sweet Smell of Success
Hint: A powerful newspaper columnist uses a desperate press agent to break up his sister's romance.
Description: New York City newspaper writer J.J. Hunsecker holds considerable sway over public opinion with his Broadway column, but one thing that he can't control is his younger sister, Susan, who is in a relationship with aspiring jazz guitarist Steve Dallas. Hunsecker strongly disapproves of the romance and recruits publicist Sidney Falco to find a way to split the couple, no matter how ruthless the method.

Title: Evangelion: 3.0+1.01 Thrice Upon a Time
Hint: Teen pilots and survivors face the final battle against a mysterious force, in an anime finale.
Description: In the aftermath of the Fourth Impact, stranded without their Evangelions, Shinji, Asuka and Rei find refuge in one of the rare pockets of humanity that still exist on the ruined planet Earth. There, each lives a life far different from their days as an ___ pilot. However, the danger to the world is far from over. A new impact is looming on the horizon—one that will prove to be the true end of ___.

Title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
Hint: A carefree young man follows the woman he loves to India and wins over her strict father.
Description: Raj is a rich, carefree, happy-go-lucky second generation NRI. Simran is the daughter of Chaudhary Baldev Singh, who in spite of being an NRI is very strict about adherence to Indian values. Simran has left for India to be married to her childhood fiancé. Raj leaves for India with a mission at his hands, to claim his lady love under the noses of her whole family. Thus begins a saga.

Title: The Wild Pear Tree
Country: Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, France, Germany, Macedonia, Qatar, Sweden, Turkey
Hint: A young Turkish graduate returns to his village and struggles to publish his book.
Description: Fresh out of university, a Turkish young man with literary aspirations returns to his home village and starts scraping together money to publish his book. While trying to reconnect with his old friends and environment; his uncertainty, existential struggle and his father’s gambling addiction bring him grave difficulties.

Title: Black Cat, White Cat
Country: France, Germany, Yugoslavia, Serbia and Montenegro
Hint: A small-time Romani hustler makes a deal with a gangster, in a madcap comedy.
Description: A small-time hustler makes a deal with a notorious gangster to whom he owes money: marry his teenage son to the latter's daughter. However, the young lovers are not as agreeable.

Title: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
Hint: A young man learns his classmate has a terminal illness and they form a close bond.
Description: After his classmate and crush is diagnosed with a pancreatic disease, an average high schooler sets out to make the most of her final days.

Title: Haider
Hint: A young man returns to Kashmir after his father's disappearance, in an adaptation of a Shakespeare tragedy.
Description: A young man returns to Kashmir after his father's disappearance to confront his uncle - the man he suspects to have a role in his father's fate.

Title: Persepolis
Hint: A rebellious girl grows up during Iran's revolution and wars.
Description: In 1970s Iran, Marjane 'Marji' Satrapi watches events through her young eyes and her idealistic family of a long dream being fulfilled of the hated Shah's defeat in the Iranian Revolution of 1979. However as Marji grows up, she witnesses first hand how the new Iran, now ruled by Islamic fundamentalists, has become a repressive tyranny on its own.

Title: Quo Vadis, Aida?
Country: Austria, Bosnia and Herzegovina, France, Germany, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Romania, Turkey
Hint: A UN translator tries to save her family during the 1995 Srebrenica massacre.
Description: Bosnia, July 1995. ___ is a translator for the UN in the small town of Srebrenica. When the Serbian army takes over the town, her family is among the thousands of citizens looking for shelter in the UN camp. As an insider to the negotiations ___ has access to crucial information that she needs to interpret. What is at the horizon for her family and people – rescue or death? Which move should she take?

Title: Cries & Whispers
Hint: Two sisters care for a third who is dying of cancer, in a lush, crimson manor.
Description: As Agnes slowly dies of cancer, her sisters are so immersed in their own psychic pains that they are unable to offer her the support she needs.

Title: Fail Safe
Hint: An American bomber is mistakenly ordered to attack Moscow, and the president must prevent nuclear war.
Description: Because of a technical defect an American bomber team mistakenly orders the destruction of Moscow. The President of the United States has but little time to prevent an atomic catastrophe from occurring.

Title: Day for Night
Hint: A film director struggles to complete his project amid his cast and crew's personal problems.
Description: A committed filmmaker struggles to complete his latest project while coping with a myriad of crises, personal and professional, among the cast and crew.

Title: Love Exposure
Hint: A Catholic teenager becomes a skilled upskirt photographer and falls for a girl dressed as his idol.
Description: The story of a teenage boy called Yu, who falls for Yoko, a girl he runs into while working as an upskirt photographer in an offshoot of the porn industry. His attempts to woo her are complicated by a spot of cross-dressing – which convinces Yoko that she is lesbian – dalliances with kung-fu and crime, and a constant struggle with Catholic guilt.

Title: Stairway to Heaven
Hint: A British airman who cheated death must argue for his life before a heavenly court.
Description: A British wartime aviator who cheats death must argue for his life before a celestial court, hoping to prolong his fledgling romance with an American girl.

Title: Goodbye, Children
Hint: A boy at a French boarding school befriends a new student who is secretly Jewish during WWII.
Description: Au revoir les enfants tells a heartbreaking story of friendship and devastating loss concerning two boys living in Nazi-occupied France. At a provincial Catholic boarding school, the precocious youths enjoy true camaraderie—until a secret is revealed. Based on events from writer-director Malle’s own childhood, the film is a subtle, precisely observed tale of courage, cowardice, and tragic awakening.

Title: La Notte
Hint: A day in the life of an unfaithful married couple in Milan.
Description: A day in the life of an unfaithful married couple and their steadily deteriorating relationship in Milan.

Title: Ivan's Childhood
Hint: A 12-year-old orphan works as a scout behind enemy lines in World War II.
Description: In WW2, twelve year old Soviet orphan ___ Bondarev works for the Soviet army as a scout behind the German lines and strikes a friendship with three sympathetic Soviet officers.

Title: La strada
Hint: A naive young woman is sold to a brutish strongman travelling performer.
Description: When Gelsomina, a naïve young woman, is purchased from her impoverished mother by brutish circus strongman Zampanò to be his wife and partner, she loyally endures her husband's coldness and abuse as they travel the Italian countryside performing together.

Title: Departures
Hint: A laid-off cellist returns to his hometown and takes a job preparing the dead for funerals.
Description: Daigo, a cellist, is laid off from his orchestra and moves with his wife back to his small hometown where the living is cheaper. Thinking he’s applying for a job at a travel agency he finds he’s being interviewed for work with ___ of a more permanent nature – as an undertaker’s assistant.

Title: Kind Hearts and Coronets
Hint: A distant heir plots to murder eight family members in line before him to inherit a dukedom.
Description: When his mother eloped with an Italian opera singer, Louis Mazzini was cut off from her aristocratic family. After the family refuses to let her be buried in the family mausoleum, Louis avenges his mother's death by attempting to murder every family member who stands between himself and the family fortune. But when he finds himself torn between his longtime love and the widow of one of his victims, his plans go awry.

Title: The Cremator
Hint: A cremation worker in 1930s Prague is swept up in Nazi ideology.
Description: In 1930s Prague, a Czech ___ who firmly believes cremation relieves one from earthly suffering is drawn inexorably to Nazism.

Title: Manon of the Spring
Hint: A young shepherdess takes revenge on the villagers who ruined her father.
Description: In this, the sequel to Jean de Florette, ___ has grown into a beautiful young shepherdess living in the idyllic Provencal countryside. She plots vengeance on the men who greedily conspired to acquire her father's land years earlier.

Title: Ali: Fear Eats the Soul
Hint: A lonely, elderly cleaning woman in Munich marries a young Moroccan immigrant.
Description: Emmi Kurowski, a cleaning lady, is lonely in her old age. Her husband died years ago, and her grown children offer little companionship. One night she goes to a bar frequented by Arab immigrants and strikes up a friendship with middle-aged mechanic ___. Their relationship soon develops into something more, and Emmi's family and neighbors criticize their spontaneous marriage.

Title: G.O.R.A.
Hint: A carpet seller who fakes UFO photos gets abducted by real aliens.
Description: Carpet dealer and UFO photo forger Arif is abducted by aliens and must outwit the evil commander-in-chief of ___, the planet where he is being held.

Title: Limelight
Hint: A fading music hall comedian helps a young ballerina recover from despair.
Description: A fading music hall comedian tries to help a despondent ballet dancer learn to walk and to again feel confident about life.

Title: Rome, Open City
Hint: A Resistance leader hides from the Nazis in the occupied Italian capital with a priest's help.
Description: During the Nazi occupation of 1944 ___, Resistance leader Giorgio Manfredi is pursued by the Nazis as he seeks refuge and a means of escape.

Title: Elite Squad 2: The Enemy Within
Hint: After a prison riot, a police captain fights corrupt politicians in Rio.
Description: After a bloody invasion of the BOPE in the High-Security Penitentiary Bangu 1 in Rio de Janeiro to control a rebellion of interns, the Lieutenant-Colonel Roberto Nascimento and the second in command Captain André Matias are accused by the Human Right Aids member Diogo Fraga of execution of prisoners. Matias is transferred to the corrupted Military Police and Nascimento is exonerated from the BOPE by the Governor.

Title: The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp
Hint: A British officer's life over 40 years, from the Boer War to WWII.
Description: General Candy, who's overseeing an English squad in 1943, is a veteran leader who doesn't have the respect of the men he's training and is considered out-of-touch with what's needed to win the war. But it wasn't always this way.

Title: Maqbool
Hint: A gangster's right-hand man plots to kill him, in an adaptation of a Shakespeare play.
Description: The Scottish tragedy 'Macbeth' set in the contemporary underworld of India's commercial capital; two corrupt, fortune telling policemen take the roles of the weird sisters, and "Duncan" is Abbaji, the head of a crime family.

Title: Sanjuro
Hint: A jaded swordsman helps a group of young samurai root out corruption.
