Description: In this companion piece and sequel to "Yojimbo," jaded samurai ___ helps an idealistic group of young warriors weed out their clan's evil influences, and in the process turns their image of a proper samurai on its ear.

Title: Central Station

Hint: An aging, washed-up pro grappler with a failing heart tries to reconnect with his estranged daughter.
Description: Aging ___ Randy "The Ram" Robinson is long past his prime but still ready and rarin' to go on the pro-wrestling circuit. After a particularly brutal beating, however, Randy hangs up his tights, pursues a serious relationship with a long-in-the-tooth stripper, and tries to reconnect with his estranged daughter. But he can't resist the lure of the ring and readies himself for a comeback.

Title: Sirf Ek Bandaa Kaafi Hai
Hint: A lawyer fights a five-year case against a powerful godman accused of sexual abuse.
Description: An ordinary lawyer is out to fight an extraordinary case! But can he win against a powerful godman accused of assaulting a minor and deliver justice to the victim?

Title: The Raid 2
Hint: An undercover cop infiltrates the Jakarta mob to expose corrupt police, leading to brutal, bone-crunching fights.
Description: After fighting his way through an apartment building populated by an army of dangerous criminals and escaping with his life, SWAT team member Rama goes undercover, joining a powerful Indonesian crime syndicate to protect his family and uncover corrupt members of his own force.

Title: Doctor Zhivago
Country: Italy, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A married physician and poet falls for another woman as revolution tears Russia apart.
Description: The life of a Russian physician and poet who, although married to another, falls in love with a political activist's wife and experiences hardship during World War I and then the October Revolution.

Title: Short Term 12
Hint: A young supervisor at a foster home helps troubled teens while hiding her own pain.
Description: Grace, a compassionate young supervisor at a foster care facility, helps at-risk teens. But when a new charge dredges up memories of her own troubled past, Grace's tough exterior begins eroding.

Title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
Country: Hong Kong, Taiwan, United States of America, China
Hint: Two warriors pursue a stolen sword and a thief in a wuxia epic.
Description: Two warriors in pursuit of a stolen sword and a notorious fugitive are led to an impetuous, physically-skilled, teenage nobleman's daughter, who is at a crossroads in her life.

Title: A Night to Remember
Hint: The sinking of a famous ocean liner, told in a highly realistic fashion.
Description: The sinking of the Titanic is presented in a highly realistic fashion in this tense British drama. The disaster is portrayed largely from the perspective of the ocean liner's second officer, Charles Lightoller. Despite numerous warnings about ice, the ship sails on, with Capt. Edward John Smith keeping it going at a steady clip.

Title: The Killing
Hint: A career criminal plans a meticulous racetrack heist with a team of misfits, and everything starts to go wrong.
Description: Career criminal Johnny Clay recruits a sharpshooter, a crooked police officer, a bartender and a betting teller named George, among others, for one last job before he goes straight and gets married. But when George tells his restless wife about the scheme to steal millions from the racetrack where he works, she hatches a plot of her own.

Title: 3-Iron
Hint: A drifter lives in people's homes while they're away, until he meets a battered wife.
Description: A drifter lives in people's houses while they are away and repays them by doing chores for them. His life changes when he meets a beautiful woman who wants to escape her unhappy marriage.

Title: Shoplifters
Hint: A poor family of petty thieves in Tokyo takes in a little girl.
Description: In the outskirts of Tokyo, a poor but close-knit group living on the fringes of society survives through shoplifting and odd jobs. When Osamu and his son take in a neglected young girl, their already fragile existence begins to unravel. As the family grows attached to her, buried secrets surface, forcing them to confront the true meaning of love, belonging, and what makes a family.

Title: Hero
Studio: Beijing New Picture Film Co. Ltd.
Hint: An assassin tells a king how he defeated three legendary warriors, in a colourful martial arts epic.
Description: During China's Warring States period, a district prefect arrives at the palace of Qin Shi Huang, claiming to have killed the three assassins who had made an attempt on the king's life three years ago.

Title: A Streetcar Named Desire
Hint: A fading Southern belle moves in with her sister and clashes with her brutish husband.
Description: A disturbed, aging Southern belle moves in with her sister for solace — but being face-to-face with her brutish brother-in-law accelerates her downward spiral.

Title: Before Midnight
Hint: Nine years after their reunion in Paris, a couple vacations in Greece and confronts their problems.
Description: It has been nine years since we last met Jesse and Celine, the French-American couple who once met on a train in Vienna. They now live in Paris with twin daughters but have spent a summer in Greece at the invitation of an author colleague of Jesse's. When the vacation is over and Jesse must send his teenage son off to the States, he begins to question his life decisions, and his relationship with Celine is at risk.

Title: Wings of Desire
Hint: An angel in Berlin longs to become human after falling in love with a trapeze artist.
Description: Two angels, Damiel and Cassiel, glide through the streets of Berlin, observing the bustling population, providing invisible rays of hope to the distressed but never interacting with them.

Title: Dancer in the Dark
Country: Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Iceland, Netherlands, Norway, Sweden
Hint: A nearly blind factory worker escapes into musical daydreams as her life collapses.
Description: Selma, a Czech immigrant on the verge of blindness, struggles to make ends meet for herself and her son, who has inherited the same genetic disorder and will suffer the same fate without an expensive operation. When life gets too difficult, Selma learns to cope through her love of musicals, dreaming up little numbers to the rhythmic beats of her surroundings.

Title: Bound by Honor
Hint: Three Chicano friends in East LA take different paths in life, in a 1970s gang drama.
Description: Based on the true life experiences of poet Jimmy Santiago Baca, the film focuses on half-brothers Paco and Cruz, and their bi-racial cousin Miklo. It opens in 1972, as the three are members of an East L.A. gang known as the "Vatos Locos", and the story focuses on how a violent crime and the influence of narcotics alter their lives. Miklo is incarcerated and sent to San Quentin, where he makes a "home" for himself.

Title: All the President's Men
Hint: Two Washington Post reporters investigate a burglary that leads all the way to the White House.
Description: During the 1972 elections, two reporters' investigation sheds light on the controversial Watergate scandal that compels President Nixon to resign from his post.

Title: Charade
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A widow is chased in Paris by crooks after her late husband's missing fortune.
Description: After Regina Lampert falls for the dashing Peter Joshua on a skiing holiday in the French Alps, she discovers upon her return to Paris that her husband has been murdered. Soon, she and Peter are giving chase to three of her late husband's World War II cronies, Tex, Scobie and Gideon, who are after a quarter of a million dollars the quartet stole while behind enemy lines.

Title: Harold and Maude
Hint: A wealthy young man obsessed with death befriends a free-spirited 79-year-old woman, and they fall in love.
Description: A deadpan young man obsessed with death meets an eccentric septuagenarian who teaches him to live life to the fullest.

Title: The Big Country
Hint: A sea captain arrives in the Old West and is caught in a feud between two ranching families.
Description: Retired wealthy sea captain Jim McKay arrives in the Old West, where he becomes embroiled in a feud between his future father-in-law, Major Terrill, and the rough and lawless Hannasseys over a valuable patch of land.

Title: The Wild Bunch
Hint: An aging gang of outlaws looks for one last score as the Old West disappears.
Description: An aging group of outlaws look for one last big score as the "traditional" American West is disappearing around them.

Title: Being There
Hint: A simple-minded gardener who has never left his house is mistaken for a wise political advisor.
Description: A simple-minded gardener named Chance has spent all his life in the Washington D.C. house of an old man. When the man dies, Chance is put out on the street with no knowledge of the world except what he has learned from television.

Title: Notorious
Hint: A government agent recruits a woman to spy on Nazis in Rio, and they fall in love.
Description: In order to help bring Nazis to justice, U.S. government agent T.R. Devlin recruits Alicia Huberman, the American daughter of a convicted German war criminal, as a spy. As they begin to fall for one another, Alicia is instructed to win the affections of Alexander Sebastian, a Nazi hiding out in Brazil.

Title: Once Were Warriors
Hint: A Maori mother struggles to protect her children from her violent husband.
Description: In a violent relationship, it takes a mother’s strength to save herself and her children from the man she loved. ___ is a violent love story set against a contemporary urban backdrop.

Title: The Manchurian Candidate
Hint: A Korean War veteran discovers his platoon was brainwashed to assassinate a politician.
Description: Near the end of the Korean War, a platoon of U.S. soldiers is captured by communists and brainwashed. Following the war, the platoon is returned home, and Sergeant Raymond Shaw is lauded as a hero by the rest of his platoon. However, the platoon commander, Captain Bennett Marco, finds himself plagued by strange nightmares and soon races to uncover a terrible plot.

Title: Three Colors: Blue
Hint: A woman who survived the car crash that killed her husband and daughter retreats from life in Paris.
Description: The wife of a famous composer survives a car accident that kills her husband and daughter. Now alone, she shakes off her old identity and explores her newfound freedom but finds that she is unbreakably bound to other humans, including her husband’s mistress, whose existence she never suspected.

Title: Togo
Hint: A sled dog leads a team across Alaska to deliver serum during a diphtheria outbreak.
Description: The untold true story set in the winter of 1925 that takes you across the treacherous terrain of the Alaskan tundra for an exhilarating and uplifting adventure that will test the strength, courage and determination of one man, Leonhard Seppala, and his lead sled dog, ___.

Title: King Kong
Country: United States of America, New Zealand, Germany
Hint: A film crew travels to a mysterious island and captures a giant gorilla.
Description: In 1933 New York, an overly ambitious movie producer coerces his cast and hired ship crew to travel to mysterious Skull Island, where they encounter ___, a giant ape who is immediately smitten with the leading lady.

Title: Rope
Hint: Two young men strangle a friend and host a dinner party over his hidden body.
Description: Two young men attempt to prove they committed the perfect murder by hosting a dinner party for the family of a classmate they just strangled to death.

Title: The Artist
Hint: A silent movie star's career collapses with the arrival of talking pictures.
Description: Hollywood, 1927: As silent movie star George Valentin wonders if the arrival of talking pictures will cause him to fade into oblivion, he sparks with Peppy Miller, a young dancer set for a big break.

Title: The Philadelphia Story
Hint: A rich woman's wedding plans are disrupted by her ex-husband and a reporter.
Description: When a rich woman's ex-husband and a tabloid-type reporter turn up just before her planned remarriage, she begins to learn the truth about herself.

Title: Kes
Hint: A bullied working-class boy in Yorkshire finds purpose in training a kestrel.
Description: Bullied at school and ignored and abused at home by his indifferent mother and older brother, Billy Casper, a 15-year-old working-class Yorkshire boy, tames and trains his pet kestrel falcon whom he names ___. Helped and encouraged by his English teacher and his fellow students, Billy finally finds a positive purpose to his unhappy existence.

Title: Talk to Her
Hint: Two men form a friendship while caring for two women in comas.
Description: Two men share an odd friendship while they care for two women who are both in deep comas.

Title: Leila's Brothers
Hint: A woman holds her poor family together while the men around her chase bad ideas.
Description: At the age of 40, ___ has spent her entire life caring for her parents and four brothers. A family that is constantly arguing and under pressure from various debts in the face of sanctions against Iran. While her brothers are struggling to make ends meet, ___ makes a plan.

Title: Arsenic and Old Lace
Hint: A drama critic discovers his sweet old aunts have been poisoning lonely men.
Description: Mortimer Brewster, a newspaper drama critic, playwright, and author known for his diatribes against marriage, suddenly falls in love and gets married; but when he makes a quick trip home to tell his two maiden aunts, he finds out his aunts' hobby - killing lonely old men and burying them in the cellar!

Title: Patton
Hint: The story of a brilliant, controversial and slap-happy American tank commander in WWII.
Description: "___" tells the tale of General George S. ___, famous tank commander of World War II. The film begins with ___ career in North Africa and progresses through the invasion of Germany and the fall of the Third Reich. Side plots also speak of ___ numerous faults such his temper and habit towards insubordination.

Title: Strangers on a Train
Hint: A charming psychopath tries to coerce a tennis star into swapping murders after a chance meeting.
Description: A charming psychopath tries to coerce a tennis star into his theory that two strangers can commit the perfect crime by exchanging murders—each killing the other’s most-hated person.

Title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
Hint: A legendary outlaw fights for justice against the evil Sheriff of Nottingham.
Description: ___ fights nobly for justice against the evil Sir Guy of Gisbourne while striving to win the hand of the beautiful Maid Marian.

Title: My Name Is Khan
Country: China, India, United Arab Emirates, United States of America
Hint: A Muslim man with Asperger's travels across America to meet the president after 9/11.
Description: Rizwan ___, a Muslim from the Borivali section of Mumbai, has Asperger's syndrome. He marries a Hindu single mother, Mandira, in San Francisco. After 9/11, Rizwan is detained by authorities at LAX who treat him as a terrorist because of his condition and his race.

Title: The Big Sleep
Hint: A private eye is hired by a wealthy general to deal with his daughter's blackmail.
Description: Private Investigator Philip Marlowe is hired by wealthy General Sternwood regarding a matter involving his youngest daughter Carmen. Before the complex case is over, Marlowe sees murder, blackmail, deception, and what might be love.

Title: Amour
Hint: An elderly couple's love is tested when the wife suffers a stroke.
Description: Georges and Anne are in their eighties. They are cultivated, retired music teachers. Their daughter, who is also a musician, lives abroad with her family. One day, Anne has a stroke, and the couple's bond of love is severely tested.

Title: The Sacrifice
Hint: A man vows to give up everything he loves to God if a nuclear war can be prevented.
Description: Alexander, a journalist, philosopher and retired actor, celebrates a birthday with friends and family when it is announced that nuclear war has begun.

Title: Cat on a Hot Tin Roof
Hint: An alcoholic ex-football player and his wife clash at his father's birthday.
Description: An alcoholic ex-football player drinks his days away, having failed to come to terms with his sexuality and his real feelings for his football buddy who died after an ambiguous accident. His wife is crucified by her desperation to make him desire her: but he resists the affections of his wife. His reunion with his father—who is dying of cancer—jogs a host of memories and revelations for both father and son.

Title: The Lion in Winter
Hint: A medieval king and his queen battle over which son will inherit the throne.
Description: Henry II and his estranged queen, Eleanor of Aquitaine, battle over the choice of an heir.

Title: The Conformist
Hint: A weak-willed Italian man becomes a fascist agent ordered to assassinate his former professor.
Description: A weak-willed Italian man becomes a fascist flunky who goes abroad to arrange the assassination of his old teacher, now a political dissident.

Title: Head-On
Hint: A suicidal Turkish-German woman marries an alcoholic man to escape her family.
Description: With the intention to break free from the strict familial restrictions, a suicidal young woman sets up a marriage of convenience with a forty-year-old addict, an act that will lead to an outburst of envious love.

Title: In Cold Blood
Hint: Two ex-cons murder a Kansas farm family in a botched robbery, in a chilling true-crime drama.
Description: After a botched robbery results in the brutal murder of a rural family, two drifters elude police, in the end coming to terms with their own mortality and the repercussions of their vile atrocity.

Title: A Taxi Driver
Hint: A cash-strapped Seoul cabbie drives a German reporter into a city under brutal martial law in 1980.
Description: May, 1980. Man-seob is a ___ in Seoul who lives from hand to mouth, raising his young daughter alone. One day, he hears that there is a foreigner who will pay big money for a drive down to Gwangju city. Not knowing that he’s a German journalist with a hidden agenda, Man-seob takes the job.

Title: In a Lonely Place
Hint: A violent screenwriter and his neighbour fall in love while he's suspected of murder.
Description: A violent screenwriter and a female neighbor fall in love after she clears him of murder, but she begins to have second thoughts.

Title: Laura
Hint: A police detective falls in love with the woman whose murder he's investigating.
Description: A police detective falls in love with the woman whose murder he's investigating.

Title: Mildred Pierce
Hint: A hard-working mother divorces her husband and opens a restaurant to please her ungrateful daughter.
Description: A hard-working mother inches towards disaster as she divorces her husband and starts a successful restaurant business to support her spoiled daughter.

Title: Onibaba
Hint: A woman and her daughter-in-law survive by murdering samurai in a field.
Description: While her son, Kichi, is away at war, a woman and her daughter-in-law survive by killing samurai who stray into their swamp, then selling whatever valuables they find. Both are devastated when they learn that Kichi has died, but his wife soon begins an affair with a neighbor who survived the war, Hachi.

Title: Tampopo
Hint: Two truck drivers help a widow turn her noodle shop into the best in town.
Description: In this humorous paean to the joys of food, a pair of truck drivers happen onto a decrepit roadside shop selling ramen noodles. The widowed owner, ___, begs them to help her turn her establishment into a paragon of the "art of noodle-soup making". Interspersed are satirical vignettes about the importance of food to different aspects of human life.

Title: Harvey
Hint: A gentle, eccentric drinker befriends an invisible six-foot rabbit, to his family's despair.
Description: The story of Elwood P. Dowd who makes friends with a spirit taking the form of a human-sized rabbit named ___ that only he sees (and a few privileged others on occasion also.) After his sister tries to commit him to a mental institution, a comedy of errors ensues. Elwood and ___ become the catalysts for a family mending its wounds and for romance blossoming in unexpected places.

Title: Cléo from 5 to 7
Hint: A singer wanders Paris for two hours while waiting for medical test results.
Description: Agnès Varda eloquently captures Paris in the sixties with this real-time portrait of a singer set adrift in the city as she awaits test results of a biopsy. A chronicle of the minutes of one woman’s life, ___ is a spirited mix of vivid vérité and melodrama, featuring a score by Michel Legrand and cameos by Jean-Luc Godard and Anna Karina.

Title: Nostalghia
Hint: A Russian poet travels through Italy and is haunted by memories of home.
Description: Russian poet Andrei Gorchakov journeys through Italy with his interpreter Eugenia to research the life of an 18th-century Russian composer who once lived abroad. Isolated and consumed by an unrelenting longing for his homeland, Andrei becomes drawn to Domenico, a radical mystic obsessed with spiritual redemption.

Title: My Man Godfrey
Hint: A ditzy socialite hires a homeless man she found on a scavenger hunt to be her family butler.
Description: Fifth Avenue socialite Irene Bullock needs a "forgotten man" to win a scavenger hunt, and no one is more forgotten than ___ Park, who resides in a dump by the East River. Irene hires ___ as a servant for her riotously unhinged family, to the chagrin of her spoiled sister, Cornelia, who tries her best to get ___ fired.

Title: Miracle on 34th Street
Hint: A man who claims to be Santa is put on trial in New York.
Description: Kris Kringle, seemingly the embodiment of Santa Claus, is asked to portray the jolly old fellow at Macy's following his performance in the Thanksgiving Day parade. His portrayal is so complete that many begin to question if he truly is Santa Claus, while others question his sanity.

Title: I Remember
Hint: An average, unexciting IT worker meets a new girl in the office and falls in love in a Turkish romance.
Description: When an average and unexciting IT worker meets the new girl in the office, the beautiful Zhao Ximan, he finds a reason to change his life. But Ximan hides a secret, she suffers from Global Transient Amnesia, meaning she won't ___ anything tomorrow. How can he win her over?

Title: The Thin Man
Hint: A witty husband-and-wife detective team with a lot of cocktails searches for a missing inventor.
Description: A husband and wife detective team takes on the search for a missing inventor and almost get killed for their efforts.

Title: Elevator to the Gallows
Hint: A businessman murders his lover's husband but gets stuck in a lift, while his car is stolen by joyriders.
Description: A self-assured businessman murders his employer, husband of his mistress, which unintentionally provokes an ill-fated chain of events.

Title: Mishima: A Life in Four Chapters
Hint: A stylised, fictional account of the life and ritual suicide of a famous Japanese author.
Description: A fictional account of the life of Japanese author Yukio ___, combining dramatizations of three of his novels and a depiction of the events of November 25th, 1970.

Title: Kagemusha
Hint: A petty thief is recruited to impersonate a dying warlord to keep his clan united.
Description: Akira Kurosawa's lauded feudal epic presents the tale of a petty thief who is recruited to impersonate Shingen, an aging warlord, in order to avoid attacks by competing clans. When Shingen dies, his generals reluctantly agree to have the impostor take over as the powerful ruler.

Title: Kwaidan
Hint: An anthology of four eerie Japanese ghost stories, from a vengeful wife to a snow woman.
Description: Taking its title from an archaic Japanese word meaning "ghost story," this anthology adapts four folk tales. A penniless samurai marries for money with tragic results. A man stranded in a blizzard is saved by Yuki the Snow Maiden, but his rescue comes at a cost. Blind musician Hoichi is forced to perform for an audience of ghosts.

Title: The Big Heat
Hint: A tough detective takes on the mob after his wife is murdered.
Description: After the suspicious suicide of a fellow cop, tough homicide detective Dave Bannion takes the law into his own hands when he sets out to smash a vicious crime syndicate.

Title: Battleship Potemkin
Hint: A dramatised account of a Russian naval mutiny and a massacre on the Odessa steps.
Description: A dramatized account of a great Russian naval mutiny and a resultant public demonstration, showing support, which brought on a police massacre.

Title: 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days
Hint: Two college roommates have 24 hours to arrange an illegal abortion in communist Romania.
Description: Two college roommates have 24 hours to make the ultimate choice as they finalize arrangements for a black market abortion.

Title: The Way He Looks
Hint: A blind teenager in São Paulo falls for the new boy at school.
Description: Leonardo is a blind teenager dealing with an overprotective mother while trying to live a more independent life. To the disappointment of his best friend, Giovana, he plans to go on an exchange program abroad. When Gabriel, a new student in town, arrives at their classroom, new feelings blossom in Leonardo making him question his plans.

Title: Gully Boy
Hint: A young man from the Mumbai slums dreams of becoming a rapper.
Description: Murad, an underdog, struggles to convey his views on social issues and life in Dharavi through rapping. His life changes drastically when he meets a local rapper, Shrikant alias MC Sher.

Title: Kal Ho Naa Ho
Hint: An uptight student falls for her cheerful neighbor, who is hiding a sad secret.
Description: An uptight MBA student falls for the charismatic new neighbor who charms her troubled family – but he has a secret that forces him to push her away.

Title: About Elly
Hint: A kindergarten teacher mysteriously disappears during a group vacation by the Caspian Sea.
Description: The mysterious disappearance of a kindergarten teacher during a picnic in the north of Iran is followed by a series of misadventures for her fellow travelers.

Title: Super 30
Hint: A brilliant mathematician coaches 30 underprivileged students in Bihar for India's toughest university entrance exams.
Description: Based on life of Patna-based mathematician Anand Kumar who runs the famed ___ program for financially weak IIT aspirants in Patna.

Title: Nine Queens
Hint: Two con men try to sell fake rare stamps in a single wild day in Buenos Aires.
Description: Two con artists try to swindle a stamp collector by selling him a sheet of counterfeit rare stamps, the "___".

Title: The Lost Weekend
Hint: An alcoholic writer goes on a desperate four-day binge in New York City.
Description: Longtime alcoholic Don Birnam has been sober for ten days and appears to be over the worst... but his craving has just become more insidious. Evading a country weekend planned by his brother and girlfriend, he begins a four-day bender that just might be his last – one way or another.

Title: The Stoning of Soraya M.
Hint: A journalist hears the story of a woman stoned to death in a remote Iranian village.
Description: In 1986 Iran, Sahebjam, whose car breaks down in a remote village, enters into a conversation with Zahra, who relays to him the story about her niece, ___, whose arranged marriage to an abusive tyrant ended in tragedy.

Title: Hiroshima Mon Amour
Hint: A Japanese architect and a French actress have a brief, haunted affair in a city scarred by the atomic bomb.
Description: The deep conversation between a Japanese architect and a French actress forms the basis of this celebrated French film, considered one of the vanguard productions of the French New Wave. Set in ___ after the end of World War II, the couple -- lovers turned friends -- recount, over many hours, previous romances and life experiences.

Title: Captains Courageous
Hint: A spoiled rich boy falls overboard and is rescued by a fishing crew.
Description: Harvey, the arrogant and spoiled son of an indulgent absentee-father, falls overboard from a transatlantic steamship and is rescued by a fishing vessel on the Grand Banks. Harvey fails to persuade them to take him ashore, nor convince the crew of his wealth. The captain offers him a low-paid job, until they return to port, as part of the crew that turns him into a mature, considerate young man.

Title: Opening Night
Hint: A famous actress spirals into crisis during the previews of her new play.
Description: Actress Myrtle Gordon is a functioning alcoholic who is a few days from the ___ of her latest play, concerning a woman distraught about aging. One night a car kills one of Myrtle's fans who is chasing her limousine in an attempt to get the star's attention. Myrtle internalizes the accident and goes on a spiritual quest, but fails to finds the answers she is after.

Title: Jab We Met
Hint: A depressed businessman and a spunky young woman meet on a train.
Description: A depressed wealthy businessman and a spunky carefree young woman embark on an unexpected journey that changes their lives.

Title: The Red Circle
Hint: A freed thief, an escaped prisoner and a drunk ex-cop plan a jewelry heist.
Description: When French criminal Corey gets released from prison, he resolves to never return. He is quickly pulled back into the underworld, however, after a chance encounter with escaped murderer Vogel. Along with former policeman and current alcoholic Jansen, they plot an intricate jewel heist. All the while, quirky Police Commissioner Mattei, who was the one to lose custody of Vogel, is determined to find him.

Title: Now, Voyager
Hint: A repressed woman suffers a nervous breakdown and blossoms after therapy and a cruise romance.
Description: A woman suffers a nervous breakdown and from an oppressive mother before being freed by the love of a man she meets on a cruise.

Title: Angels with Dirty Faces
Hint: Two childhood friends grow up on opposite sides of the law, one a gangster and one a priest.
Description: Childhood chums Rocky Sullivan and Jerry Connelly grow up on opposite sides of the fence: Rocky matures into a prominent gangster, while Jerry becomes a priest, tending to the needs of his old tenement neighborhood.

Title: Through a Glass Darkly
Hint: A young woman recovering from a mental breakdown spends a summer on a Swedish island with her family, and her grip on reality slips.
Description: Karin hopes to recover from her recent stay at a mental hospital by spending the summer at her family's cottage on a tiny island. Her husband, Martin, cares for her but is frustrated by her physical withdrawal. Her younger brother, Minus, is confused by Karin's vulnerability and his own budding sexuality. Their father, David, cannot overcome his haughty remoteness.

Title: Cría Cuervos
Hint: An eight-year-old girl in Madrid, recently orphaned, believes she has the power of life and death over the adults around her.
Description: Ana, an eight-year-old girl living in Madrid with her grandmother and two sisters, mourns the death of her mother.

Title: Auntie Mame
Hint: An orphaned boy is raised by his flamboyant, freethinking aunt, who shows him that life is a banquet.
Description: ___ Dennis, a progressive and independent woman of the 1920s, is left to care for her nephew Patrick after his wealthy father dies. Conflict ensues when the executor of the father's estate objects to the aunt's lifestyle and tries to force her to send Patrick to prep school.

Title: Eternity and a Day
Hint: A dying Greek writer on his last day befriends an Albanian refugee boy on the streets of Thessaloniki.
Description: Famous writer Alexander contracts a terminal illness. He receives a letter from his wife describing a summer day 30 years ago, and leaves his seaside home to remember his past. This journey will allow him to wander between the past and the present, and encounter unexpected people, allowing him to collect unforgettable memories in the final moments of his life.

Title: No Man's Land
Country: France, Italy, Belgium, United Kingdom, Slovenia, Switzerland, Bosnia and Herzegovina
Hint: A Bosnian and a Serb soldier are trapped together in a trench between the front lines, with a third man lying on a mine.
Description: Two soldiers from opposite sides get stuck between the front lines in the same trench. The UN is asked to free them and both sides agree on a ceasefire, but will they stick to it?

Title: Ugly
Hint: A ten-year-old girl vanishes from a car in Mumbai, and the investigation exposes the ugliness of everyone involved.
Description: When a 10-year old girl goes missing, her stepfather races against time to investigate the kidnapping.

Title: One, Two, Three
Hint: A Coca-Cola executive in Berlin must babysit his boss's wild daughter.
Description: In Cold War-era West Berlin, American Coca-Cola executive C.R. 'Mac' MacNamara is tasked with playing babysitter to his boss' spoiled 17-year-old daughter Scarlett, who proves more difficult than anticipated when she reveals that she is pregnant by a Communist.

Title: Who Killed Captain Alex?
Hint: A no-budget Ugandan action blockbuster, with a hype-man narrator, in which commandos battle a gang after their leader dies.
Description: Recognized as Uganda’s first action film, ___ is about the aftermath of a police raid in Kampala in which a police captain is killed.

Title: Still Walking
Hint: A family gathers each summer to commemorate the eldest son who drowned saving a boy years earlier.
Description: A family gathers together for a commemorative ritual whose nature only gradually becomes clear.

Title: Sullivan's Travels
Hint: A successful Hollywood comedy director goes undercover as a hobo to research a serious film about poverty.
Description: Successful movie director John L. ___, convinced he won't be able to film his ambitious masterpiece until he has suffered, dons a hobo disguise and sets off on a journey, aiming to "know trouble" first-hand.

Title: Goodbye, Mr. Chips
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A shy schoolmaster at an English boarding school recalls his long career and his beloved late wife.
Description: Throughout the late 19th-century and early 20th-century, Mr Arthur Chipping rises from a shy, nervous teacher to the beloved, revered headmaster of Brookfield School, with his life and career shaped by his love for his wife and his unwavering dedication to his students.

Title: Alice in the Cities
Hint: A German journalist with writer's block ends up looking after a nine-year-old girl abandoned by her mother.
Description: German journalist Philip Winter has a case of writer’s block when trying to write an article about the United States. He decides to return to Germany, and while trying to book a flight, encounters a German woman and her nine year old daughter ___ doing the same.

Title: The Rules of the Game
Hint: Aristocrats and servants mix at a country house where love and lies collide.
Description: The Marquis de la Chesnaye and his wife host a weekend gala where a variety of complicated romantic and social entanglements between guests and servants lead to tragedy, all against the backdrop of a looming war.

Title: Night and the City
Hint: A small-time London hustler tries to make it big as a wrestling promoter, with deadly results.
Description: Londoner Harry Fabian is a second-rate con man looking for an angle. After years of putting up with Harry's schemes, his girlfriend, Mary, becomes fed up when he taps her for yet another loan.

Title: Letter from an Unknown Woman
Hint: A pianist about to flee a duel receives a message from a woman he can't remember, who loved him all her life.
Description: A pianist about to flee from a duel receives a ___ from a woman he cannot remember. As she tells the story of her lifelong love for him, he is forced to reinterpret his own past.

Title: C.R.A.Z.Y.
Hint: A young French-Canadian boy in a conservative family struggles with his sexuality through the 1960s and 70s.
Description: A young French Canadian, one of five boys in a conservative family in the 1960s and 1970s, struggles to reconcile his emerging identity with his father's values.

Title: Evangelion: 2.0 You Can (Not) Advance
Hint: Teen pilots of giant bio-machines battle monstrous creatures attacking Tokyo-3, in an anime remake.
Description: Under constant attack by monstrous creatures called Angels that seek to eradicate humankind, U.N. Special Agency NERV introduces two new EVA pilots to help defend the city of Tokyo-3: the mysterious Makinami Mari Illustrous and the intense Asuka Langley Shikinami. Meanwhile, Gendo Ikari and SEELE proceed with a secret project that involves both Rei and Shinji.

Title: The Fire Within
Hint: A depressed alcoholic leaves a clinic and spends his last two days visiting old friends in Paris.
Description: Depressed Alain Leroy leaves the clinic where he was detoxified. He meets friends, acquaintances and women, trying to find a reason to continue living.

Title: Badhaai Ho
Hint: A 25-year-old man is embarrassed when his middle-aged mother announces she's pregnant.
Description: A 25-year-old man tries to suppress his embarrassment when his mother announces that she is pregnant.

Title: The Little Foxes
Hint: A greedy Southern woman schemes against her own family to get rich.
Description: In 1900, a clan attempts to strike a deal with a Chicago industrialist to get him to build cotton mills in their Deep South town.

Title: Hey Ram
Hint: A man whose wife was killed in riots sets out to assassinate the leader he blames for the partition.
Description: Saketh ___ wife is raped and killed during direct action day riots in Calcutta. He is convinced that Mahatma Gandhi is responsible for all the problems happening in the country. He sets out to kill him.

Title: La Grande Vadrouille
Hint: Two French civilians help British airmen escape across Nazi-occupied France, in a classic comedy.
Description: During World War II, two French civilians and a downed British Bomber Crew set out from Paris to cross the demarcation line between Nazi-occupied Northern France and the South. From there they will be able to escape to England. First, they must avoid German troops – and the consequences of their own blunders.

Title: Thiruchitrambalam
Hint: A delivery boy with bad luck in love finally looks at the friend beside him.
Description: A guy-next-door tries to find romance in his life while also dealing with his personal problems. How long will it be before he realises what he is looking for is right next to him?

Title: Airlift
Hint: A businessman organizes the evacuation of thousands of Indians from Kuwait.
Description: When Iraq invades Kuwait in August, 1990, a callous Indian businessman becomes the spokesperson for more than 170,000 stranded countrymen.

Title: The Roaring Twenties
Hint: A WWI veteran returns home to find no work and becomes a powerful bootlegger during Prohibition.
Description: After World War I, Armistice Lloyd Hart goes back to practice law, former saloon keeper George Hally turns to bootlegging, and out-of-work Eddie Bartlett becomes a cab driver. Eddie builds a fleet of cabs through delivery of bootleg liquor and hires Lloyd as his lawyer. George becomes Eddie's partner and the rackets flourish until love and rivalry interfere.

Title: Ghost in the Shell 2.0
Hint: A cyborg agent hunts a hacker in a remastered cyberpunk classic.
Description: In the year 2029, Section 9, a group of cybernetically enhanced cops, are called in to investigate and stop a highly-wanted hacker known as 'The Puppetmaster'.

Title: Trouble in Paradise
Hint: A gentleman thief and a pickpocket set out to rob a wealthy perfume company owner, and fall for each other.
Description: Thief Gaston Monescu and pickpocket Lily are partners in crime and love. Working for perfume company executive Mariette Colet, the two crooks decide to combine their criminal talents to rob their employer. Under the alias of Monsieur Laval, Gaston uses his position as Mariette's personal secretary to become closer to her.

Title: Before the Rain
Hint: Three interconnected stories of love and ethnic violence in Macedonia and London.
Description: The circularity of violence seen in a story that circles on itself. In Macedonia, during the war in Bosnia, Christians hunt an ethnic Albanian girl who may have murdered one of their own. A young monk who's taken a vow of silence offers her protection. In London, a photographic editor who's pregnant needs to talk it out with her estranged husband and chooses a toney restaurant.

Title: The Testament of Dr. Mabuse
Hint: An asylum inmate who was once a criminal genius seems to direct a crime wave from his cell.
Description: After a detective is assaulted by thugs and placed in an asylum run by Professor Baum, he observes the professor's preoccupation with another patient, the criminal genius Dr. ___ the hypnotist.

Title: The Earrings of Madame de...
Hint: A countess secretly sells her husband's wedding gift of jewellery, and it keeps returning to her through her lover.
Description: In late 19th century France, the Countess Louise, wife of a wealthy general, sells the ___ her husband gave her on their wedding day to pay off her secret debts, then claims to have lost them. Her husband quickly learns of the deceit, which is the beginning of many tragic misunderstandings, all involving the ___, the general, the countess, and her new lover, the Italian Baron Donati.

Title: The Sword of Doom
Hint: A cruel and gifted swordsman cuts down anyone in his path.
Description: Ryunosuke, a gifted swordsman plying his trade during the turbulent final days of Shogunate rule, has no moral code and kills without remorse. It’s a way of life that leads to madness.

Title: Sonchiriya
Hint: A gang of outlaws in the Chambal Valley in 1975 face a crisis of conscience while hunted by police.
Description: In the more or less lawless Chambal Valley in 1975, a gang of bandits led by Maan Singh are up to mischief. The lawless men, who call themselves Bhaagis (rebels), live by robbery and attack the villages in the area. Since they have previously committed a more than shameful crime, they are hunted mercilessly by the police.

Title: Love Letter
Hint: A grieving woman writes to her dead fiancé's old address in Otaru and, impossibly, receives a reply.
Description: Hiroko attends the memorial service of her fiancé, Itsuki Fujii, who died in a mountain-climbing incident. Although Itsuki's mother says that their old house is gone, Hiroko records the address listed under his name in his yearbook and sends him a ___. Surprisingly, she receives a reply, and discovers it came from his old classmate, a girl who also happens to be called Itsuki Fujii.

Title: Orpheus
Hint: A famous poet in postwar Paris falls in love with Death, who appears as a princess.
Description: A famous poet in postwar Paris, scorned by the Left Bank youth, is in love with both his wife Eurydice and a mysterious princess. Seeking inspiration, the poet becomes obsessed and follows the princess from the world of the living to the land of the dead.

Title: The Book of Sun
Hint: A Saudi high school senior and his teacher shoot an amateur horror film in 2010.
Description: In 2010, at the peak of the Saudi YouTube movement, high school senior Husam finds himself drawn into the world of video production. He’s joined in his pursuit by his best friend Maan, their one-time foe Ibrahim, and Orabi a teacher with a passion for filmmaking. In the middle of their senior year, they set out to produce a no-budget horror movie – a wild adventure that will put their futures at risk.

Title: Dev.D
Hint: A wealthy man's son spirals into drugs and alcohol after breaking up with his childhood love.
Description: The son of a wealthy businessman finds solace in drugs and alcohol when he breaks up with his childhood love.

Title: Johnny Gaddaar
Hint: Five men get involved in a drug deal set up by a corrupt cop, and one plans to betray the rest.
Description: Five men get involved in a drug deal set up by a corrupt police officer, but the plan goes awry when the youngest member decides to steal the money.

Title: Ivy
Hint: The crew of a bankrupt cargo ship is stranded on board for months, and isolation breeds madness.
Description: When the crew of a bankrupt cargo ship gets stuck on board for months, isolation breeds pressures that sink the men into a sea of madness and terror.

Title: The Other Me
Hint: A young architect is diagnosed with a rare disease, and his life is thrown into turmoil.
Description: The life of a young architect is thrown into turmoil when he's diagnosed with a rare eye disease. As his condition worsens, he questions his life and career choices, and his relationship to his frustrated wife becomes more strained.

Title: Big Deal on Madonna Street
Hint: A gang of hapless Roman thieves plan a heist on a pawnshop, in a classic Italian comedy.
Description: Best friends Peppe and Mario are thieves, but they're not very good at it. Still, Peppe thinks that he's finally devised a master heist that will make them rich. With the help of some fellow criminals, he plans to dig a tunnel from a rented apartment to the pawnshop next door, where they can rob the safe.

Title: Border
Hint: A Swedish customs officer with a sixth sense for smugglers meets a strange man who seems like her.
Description: When a ___ guard with a sixth sense for identifying smugglers encounters the first person she cannot prove is guilty, she is forced to confront terrifying revelations about herself and humankind.

Title: Gemide
Hint: Sailors want to stay on their small boat in Istanbul, but the world outside intrudes.
Description: Sailors want to remain in their small world, which is warm and cozy and full of lies, but their routine life turns upside down when one of them gets mugged and badly beaten.

Title: Baby
Hint: Two high school friends turned sugar babies sacrifice everything for each other in Seoul.
Description: A coming-of-age romantic drama exploring the complexities of first love and the evolution of relationships amidst societal pressures and modern technology.

Title: South Wind
Hint: A Belgrade criminal's reckless move triggers an avalanche of trouble.
Description: A story about Petar Maraš, a Belgrade criminal in his late twenties, whose one reckless move causes an avalanche of events that will greatly affect the lives of those around him.

Hint: A scientist's time travel watch becomes the prize in a battle with his evil twin.
Description: Scientist turned Entrepreneur Dr. Sethuraman tries to safeguard his newly invented time travel device from falling into the hands of his Evil Twin Brother Aathreya.

Title: Pad Man
Country: India, United States of America, Hong Kong
Hint: A man in a small village invents a machine to make cheap sanitary napkins after seeing how women struggle.
Description: Upon realizing the extent to which women are affected by their menses, a man sets out to create a sanitary ___ machine and to provide inexpensive sanitary pads to the women of rural India.

Title: Vishwaroopam
Hint: A Kathak dance teacher in New York is secretly a counterterrorism agent.
Description: Vishwanathan, a Kathak dance teacher in New York, is happy in his marriage with Nirupama, a nuclear oncologist who married him to pursue higher studies in the USA. Deciding to cut ties with her husband, Nirupama hires a private detective to monitor his activities.

Title: Ankhon Dekhi
Hint: An old man decides to believe only what he sees with his own eyes, upsetting his family.
Description: Bauji resists his daughter's request to let her marry the man she loves as the neighbours incessantly shame him. However, his opinion changes after he meets him and he decides to change his viewpoint.

Title: The Song of Sparrows
Hint: An ostrich farmer goes to the city to fix his daughter's hearing aid.
Description: When an ostrich-rancher focuses on replacing his daughter's hearing aid, which breaks right before crucial exams, everything changes for a struggling rural family in Iran. Karim motorbikes into a world alien to him - incredibly hectic Tehran, where sudden opportunities for independence, thrill and challenge him.

Title: Kin-dza-dza!
Hint: Two Soviet men are transported to a desert planet where everything depends on a matchstick.
Description: Two Soviet humans previously unknown to each other are transported to the planet Pluke in the ___ galaxy due to a chance encounter with an alien teleportation device. They must come to grips with a language barrier and Plukian social norms (not to mention the laws of space and time) if they ever hope to return to Earth.

Title: Trap
Hint: A father and teenage daughter attend a pop concert where police have set a sting for a serial killer.
Description: A father and teen daughter attend a pop concert, where they realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event.

Title: The Class
Hint: A boy with Tourette's syndrome overcomes discrimination to become a teacher, in a Turkish drama.
Description: A boy with Tourette's syndrome overcomes criticism and discrimination to achieve his dream of becoming a teacher.

Title: Manam
Hint: Three generations of a family are reincarnated, in a heartwarming Telugu fantasy.
Description: A married couple die in an accident, leaving behind a son. As he grows up and becomes successful, he comes across reincarnations of his father and mother as youngsters, and vows to bring them back together.

Title: John Wick: Chapter 4
Hint: A retired hitman fights his way across the world to win his freedom.
Description: With the price on his head ever increasing, ___ uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, ___ must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.

Title: Sound of Freedom
Hint: A former US government agent quits his job to rescue children from sex traffickers in Colombia.
Description: The story of Tim Ballard, a former US government agent, who quits his job in order to devote his life to rescuing children from global sex traffickers.

Title: The Batman
Hint: A brooding young vigilante investigates a sadistic serial killer who leaves riddles for the police.
Description: In his second year of fighting crime, ___ uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.

Title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
Hint: A laundromat owner jumps across universes to save her family.
Description: An aging Chinese immigrant is swept up in an insane adventure, where she alone can save what's important to her by connecting with the lives she could have led in other universes.

Title: The Gentlemen
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An American expat who built a marijuana empire in England tries to sell it, sparking chaos.
Description: American expat Mickey Pearson has built a highly profitable marijuana empire in London. When word gets out that he’s looking to cash out of the business forever it triggers plots, schemes, bribery and blackmail in an attempt to steal his domain out from under him.

Title: The Big Short
Hint: A handful of financial outsiders predict the 2008 housing crash and bet against the banks.
Description: The men who made millions from a global economic meltdown.

Title: Pride & Prejudice
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A spirited young woman spars with a proud wealthy man in Georgian England.
Description: A story of love and life among the landed English gentry during the Georgian era. Mr. Bennet is a gentleman living in Hertfordshire with his overbearing wife and five daughters, but if he dies their house will be inherited by a distant cousin whom they have never met, so the family's future happiness and security is dependent on the daughters making good marriages.

Title: Get Out
Hint: A Black man visits his white girlfriend's family for the weekend and uncovers a disturbing secret.
Description: Chris and his girlfriend Rose go upstate to visit her parents for the weekend. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behavior as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries lead him to a truth that he never could have imagined.

Title: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
Hint: A band of rebels unite to steal the plans for the Empire's planet-destroying battle station.
Description: A ___ band of resistance fighters unite for a mission to steal the Death Star plans and bring a new hope to the galaxy.

Title: Ghostbusters
Hint: Three eccentric parapsychologists start a ghost-catching business in New York, just as an ancient god arrives.
Description: After losing their university jobs, three parapsychologists start a ghost-catching business in New York City and uncover a supernatural threat that could destroy the world.

Title: Tombstone
Hint: A lawman and his ailing friend face down outlaws in an Old West town.
Description: Legendary marshal Wyatt Earp, now a weary gunfighter, joins his brothers Morgan and Virgil to pursue their collective fortune in the thriving mining town of ___. But Earp is forced to don a badge again and get help from his notorious pal Doc Holliday when a gang of renegade brigands and rustlers begins terrorizing the town.

Title: Drive
Hint: A quiet stunt driver moonlights as a getaway man and protects his neighbor.
Description: Driver is a skilled Hollywood stuntman who moonlights as a getaway driver for criminals. Though he projects an icy exterior, lately he's been warming up to a pretty neighbor named Irene and her young son, Benicio. When Irene's husband gets out of jail, he enlists Driver's help in a million-dollar heist.

Title: The Notebook
Hint: An older man reads aloud to a woman with dementia the love story of two young people in the 1940s.
Description: An epic love story centered around an older man who reads aloud to a woman with Alzheimer's. From a faded ___, the old man's words bring to life the story about a couple who is separated by World War II, and is then passionately reunited, seven years later, after they have taken different paths.

Title: Little Women
Hint: Four very different sisters come of age in Massachusetts after the Civil War.
Description: Four sisters come of age in America in the aftermath of the Civil War.

Title: The Breakfast Club
Hint: Five very different teens spend a Saturday in detention and find common ground.
Description: Five high school students from different walks of life endure a Saturday detention under a power-hungry principal. The disparate group includes rebel John, princess Claire, outcast Allison, brainy Brian and Andrew, the jock. Each has a chance to tell his or her story, making the others see them a little differently -- and when the day ends, they question whether school will ever be the same.

Title: About Time
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young man discovers he can travel back in time and uses it to win the woman he loves.
Description: The night after another unsatisfactory New Year's party, Tim's father reveals to him that the men in their family have the ability to travel through time. They can't change history, but they can change what happens and has happened in their own lives. Thus begins the start of a lesson in learning to appreciate life itself as it is, as it comes, and most importantly, the people living alongside us.

Title: The Irishman
Hint: A hitman recalls his years in the mob and his role in the disappearance of a famous union boss.
Description: Pennsylvania, 1956. Frank Sheeran, a war veteran of Irish origin who works as a truck driver, accidentally meets mobster Russell Bufalino. Once Frank becomes his trusted man, Bufalino sends him to Chicago with the task of helping Jimmy Hoffa, a powerful union leader related to organized crime, with whom Frank will maintain a close friendship for nearly twenty years.

Title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
Hint: A swashbuckling cat discovers he's on his last life and sets out to find a magical wishing star.
Description: ___ discovers that his passion for adventure has taken its toll: He has burned through eight of his nine lives, leaving him with only one life left. ___ sets out on an epic journey to find the mythical ___ and restore his nine lives.

Title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
Hint: A high school slacker fakes being sick and has the best day ever in Chicago.
Description: After high school slacker ___ successfully fakes an illness in order to skip school for the day, he goes on a series of adventures throughout Chicago with his girlfriend Sloane and best friend Cameron, all the while trying to outwit his wily school principal and fed-up sister.

Title: Apocalypto
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Mayan villager is captured for sacrifice and must escape to save his family.
Description: Set in the Mayan civilization, when a man's idyllic presence is brutally disrupted by a violent invading force, he is taken on a perilous journey to a world ruled by fear and oppression where a harrowing end awaits him. Through a twist of fate and spurred by the power of his love for his woman and his family he will make a desperate break to return home and to ultimately save his way of life.

Title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
Country: New Zealand, United States of America
Hint: A homebody halfling joins a wizard and thirteen dwarves on a quest to reclaim their mountain home from a dragon.
Description: Bilbo Baggins, a ___ enjoying his quiet life, is swept into an epic quest by Gandalf the Grey and thirteen dwarves who seek to reclaim their mountain home from Smaug, the dragon.

Title: Dunkirk
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Allied soldiers are surrounded on a French beach in 1940, awaiting rescue by sea and air.
Description: The story of the miraculous evacuation of Allied soldiers from Belgium, Britain, Canada and France, who were cut off and surrounded by the German army from the beaches and harbour of ___ between May 26th and June 4th 1940 during World War II.

Title: Remember the Titans
Hint: A coach unites a racially divided high school football team.
Description: After leading his football team to 15 winning seasons, coach Bill Yoast is demoted and replaced by Herman Boone – tough, opinionated and as different from the beloved Yoast as he could be. The two men learn to overcome their differences and turn a group of hostile young men into champions.

Title: A Bronx Tale
Hint: A boy in 1960s New York is torn between his hardworking bus-driver father and a charismatic mob boss.
Description: Set in the ___ during the tumultuous 1960s, an adolescent boy is torn between his honest, working-class father and a violent yet charismatic crime boss. Complicating matters is the youngster's growing attraction - forbidden in his neighborhood - for a beautiful black girl.

Title: RRR
Hint: Two Indian revolutionaries form a friendship while fighting the British Raj in the 1920s.
Description: A fictional history of two legendary revolutionaries' journey away from home before they began fighting for their country in the 1920s.

Title: The Hateful Eight
Hint: Bounty hunters and strangers seek shelter from a blizzard in a Wyoming lodge.
Description: Bounty hunters seek shelter from a raging blizzard and get caught up in a plot of betrayal and deception.

Title: Call Me by Your Name
Country: Brazil, France, Italy, United States of America
Hint: A 17-year-old in 1980s Italy falls for a graduate student staying with his family for the summer.
Description: In the summer of 1983, a 17-year-old Elio spends his days in his family's villa in Italy. One day Oliver, a graduate student, arrives to assist Elio's father, a professor of Greco-Roman culture. Soon, Elio and Oliver discover a summer that will alter their lives forever.

Title: Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory
Hint: Five lucky kids win a tour of a magical candy works run by a very strange host.
Description: When eccentric candy man ___ promises a lifetime supply of sweets and a tour of his ___ to five lucky kids, penniless Charlie Bucket seeks the golden ticket that will make him a winner.

Title: Predator
Hint: Commandos in a jungle are hunted by an invisible alien trophy collector.
Description: A team of elite commandos on a secret mission in a Central American jungle come to find themselves hunted by an extraterrestrial warrior.

Title: The Social Network
Hint: A Harvard student creates a hugely successful website and is sued by his former friends.
Description: In 2003, Harvard undergrad and computer programmer Mark Zuckerberg begins work on a new concept that eventually turns into the global ___ known as Facebook. Six years later, Mark is one of the youngest billionaires ever, but his unprecedented success leads to both personal and legal complications when he ends up on the receiving end of two lawsuits, one involving his former friend.

Title: Atonement
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young girl's false accusation changes the course of her sister's and her lover's lives.
Description: A young girl irrevocably changes the course of several lives when she accuses her older sister's lover of a crime he did not commit.

Title: Star Wars: Episode VII - The Force Awakens
Hint: A young scavenger, a defecting stormtrooper and old heroes face a new threat thirty years after the Empire fell.
Description: Thirty years after defeating the Galactic Empire, Han Solo and his allies face a new threat from the evil Kylo Ren and his army of Stormtroopers.

Title: The Worst Person in the World
Hint: Four years in the life of a young woman in Oslo who struggles with love and career.
Description: The chronicles of four years in the life of Julie, a young woman who navigates the troubled waters of her love life and struggles to find her career path, leading her to take a realistic look at who she really is.

Title: Hot Fuzz
Hint: A top London cop is transferred to a quiet village where suspicious accidents keep happening.
Description: Former London constable Nicholas Angel finds it difficult to adapt to his new assignment in the sleepy British village of Sandford. Not only does he miss the excitement of the big city, but he also has a well-meaning oaf for a partner. However, when a series of grisly accidents rocks Sandford, Angel smells something rotten in the idyllic village.

Title: Hidden Figures
Hint: Three Black female mathematicians at NASA help launch America into space in the 1960s.
Description: The untold story of Katherine G. Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson – brilliant African-American women working at NASA and serving as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in history – the launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit. The visionary trio crossed all gender and race lines to inspire generations to dream big.

Title: Manchester by the Sea
Hint: A janitor returns home to care for his nephew and faces a painful past.
Description: After his older brother passes away, Lee Chandler is forced to return home to care for his 16-year-old nephew. There he is compelled to deal with a tragic past that separated him from his family and the community where he was born and raised.

Title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
Hint: A disgraced journalist and a tattooed hacker investigate a decades-old disappearance in Sweden.
Description: Disgraced journalist Mikael Blomkvist investigates the disappearance of a weary patriarch's niece from 40 years ago. He is aided by the pierced, tattooed, punk computer hacker named Lisbeth Salander. As they work together in the investigation, Blomkvist and Salander uncover immense corruption beyond anything they have ever imagined.

Title: Isle of Dogs
Hint: A boy travels to a trash island where all the canines of a Japanese city have been exiled during a flu outbreak.
Description: In the future, an outbreak of canine flu leads the mayor of a Japanese city to banish all ___ to an island used as a garbage dump. The outcasts must soon embark on an epic journey when a 12-year-old boy arrives on the island to find his beloved pet.

Title: Nightcrawler
Hint: A desperate man becomes a freelance crime cameraman in LA and goes too far.
Description: When Lou Bloom, desperate for work, muscles into the world of L.A. crime journalism, he blurs the line between observer and participant to become the star of his own story. Aiding him in his effort is Nina, a TV-news veteran.

Title: American Gangster
Hint: A Harlem drug lord rises to power in the 1970s while a detective hunts him.
Description: Loosely based on the criminal career of Frank Lucas, a gangster from La Grange, North Carolina, who smuggled heroin into the United States on American service planes returning from the Vietnam War, before being detained by a task force led by Newark Detective Richie Roberts.

Title: Taken
Country: France, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A retired agent has a particular set of skills to save his kidnapped daughter.
Description: Bryan Mills, a former government operative, is trying to reconnect with his teenage daughter Kim. After reluctantly agreeing with his ex-wife to let Kim go to Paris on vacation with a friend, his worst nightmare comes true. While on the phone with his daughter shortly after she arrives in Paris, she and her friend are abducted by a gang of human traffickers.

Title: Little Miss Sunshine
Hint: A quirky family drives across the country in a VW bus to get their daughter to a beauty pageant.
Description: A family loaded with quirky, colorful characters piles into an old van and road trips to California for little Olive to compete in a beauty pageant.

Title: The Last Samurai
Hint: An American officer hired to train Japan's modern army is captured by traditional warriors and embraces their ways.
Description: Nathan Algren is an American hired to instruct the Japanese army in the ways of modern warfare, which finds him learning to respect the ___ and the honorable principles that rule them. Pressed to destroy the ___ way of life in the name of modernization and open trade, Algren decides to become an ultimate warrior himself and to fight for their right to exist.

Title: The Bourne Identity
Country: United States of America, Germany, Czech Republic
Hint: A man with amnesia discovers he is a highly trained assassin.
Description: Wounded to the brink of death and suffering from amnesia, Jason ___ is rescued at sea by a fisherman. With nothing to go on but a Swiss bank account number, he starts to reconstruct his life, but finds that many people he encounters want him dead. However, ___ realizes that he has the combat and mental skills of a world-class spy—but who does he work for?

Title: The Untouchables
Hint: A Prohibition agent assembles a small team of incorruptibles to take down the most notorious gangster in Chicago.
Description: Elliot Ness, an ambitious prohibition agent, is determined to take down Al Capone. In order to achieve this goal, he forms a group given the nickname “The ___”.

Title: Misery
Hint: A famous novelist is rescued after a car crash by a nurse who claims to be his biggest fan.
Description: After an accident, acclaimed novelist Paul Sheldon is rescued by a nurse who claims to be his biggest fan. Her obsession takes a dark turn when she holds him captive in her remote Colorado home and forces him to write back to life the popular literary character he killed off.

Title: Mary Poppins
Hint: A magical nanny brings music and adventure to a troubled London family.
Description: In turn of the century London, a magical nanny employs music and adventure to help two neglected children become closer to their father.

Title: Moonrise Kingdom
Hint: Two 12-year-olds fall in love and run away together on a New England island in 1965.
Description: Set on an island off the coast of New England in the summer of 1965, ___ tells the story of two twelve-year-olds who fall in love, make a secret pact, and run away together into the wilderness. As various authorities try to hunt them down, a violent storm is brewing off-shore – and the peaceful island community is turned upside down in more ways than anyone can handle.

Title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
Country: New Zealand, United States of America
Hint: The dwarves and their halfling burglar journey through a dark forest and a lake town to face a dragon guarding gold.
Description: The Dwarves, Bilbo and Gandalf have successfully escaped the Misty Mountains, and Bilbo has gained the One Ring. They all continue their journey to get their gold back from the Dragon, ___.

Title: Captain America: Civil War
Hint: A disagreement over government oversight splits the superhero team into two factions.
Description: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or ___, which causes an epic battle between former allies.

Title: Boyz n the Hood
Hint: Three young friends come of age in a violent South Central LA.
Description: In the middle of the Los Angeles ghetto, drugs, robberies and shootings dominate everyday life. During these times, Furious tries to raise his son Tre to be a decent person. Tre's friends, on the other hand, have little regard for the law and drag the entire neighborhood into a street war...

Title: I Saw the Devil
Hint: A secret agent goes too far hunting down the serial killer who murdered his fiancée.
Description: Kyung-chul is a dangerous psychopath who kills for pleasure. Soo-hyeon, a top-secret agent, decides to track down the murderer himself. He promises himself that he will do everything in his power to take vengeance against the killer, even if it means that he must become a monster himself.

Title: The Fugitive
Hint: A doctor wrongly convicted of murdering his wife escapes and searches for the one-armed killer.
Description: Wrongfully convicted of murdering his wife and sentenced to death, Richard Kimble escapes from the law in an attempt to find the real killer and clear his name.

Title: Skyfall
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A secret agent's loyalty to his boss is tested when her past comes back to haunt her.
Description: When Bond's latest assignment goes gravely wrong, agents around the world are exposed and MI6 headquarters is attacked. While M faces challenges to her authority and position from Gareth Mallory, the new Chairman of the Intelligence and Security Committee, it's up to Bond, aided only by field agent Eve, to locate the mastermind behind the attack.

Title: The Sandlot
Hint: A new kid joins a group of boys playing baseball in a summer of friendship and adventure.
Description: During a summer of friendship and adventure, one boy becomes a part of the gang, nine boys become a team and their leader becomes a legend by confronting the terrifying mystery beyond the right field wall.

Title: Cast Away
Hint: A FedEx executive is stranded on a deserted island and befriends a volleyball.
Description: Chuck Noland, a top international manager for FedEx, and Kelly, a Ph.D. student, are in love and heading towards marriage. Then Chuck's plane to Malaysia crashes at sea during a terrible storm. He's the only survivor, and finds himself marooned on a desolate island. With no way to escape, Chuck must find ways to survive in his new home.

Title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
Hint: A man born old ages backwards, and falls in love through the decades.
Description: Born under unusual circumstances, ___ springs into being as an elderly man in a New Orleans nursing home and ages in reverse. Twelve years after his birth, he meets Daisy, a child who flits in and out of his life as she grows up to be a dancer.

Title: Back to the Future Part II
Hint: A teen and an eccentric inventor zip ahead to 2015, then must fix the mess they made.
Description: Marty and Doc are at it again as the time-traveling duo head to 2015 to nip some McFly family woes in the bud. But things go awry thanks to bully Biff Tannen and a pesky sports almanac. In a last-ditch attempt to set things straight, Marty finds himself bound for 1955 and face to face with his teenage parents -- again.

Title: Freaks
Hint: A seven-year-old girl kept locked inside by her father discovers she has powers.
Description: Kept locked inside the house by her father, 7-year-old Chloe lives in fear and fascination of the outside world, where Abnormals create a constant threat—or so she believes. When a mysterious stranger offers her a glimpse of what's really happening outside, Chloe soon finds that while the truth isn't so simple, the danger is very real.

Title: Moon
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An astronaut nearing the end of a three-year solo stint on a lunar mining base discovers a disturbing secret.
Description: With only three weeks left in his three-year contract, Sam Bell is eager to return to Earth. Stationed alone at a ___-based facility with his computer assistant GERTY, an unexpected accident sets off a series of unsettling events that shake his isolation.

Title: Mississippi Burning
Hint: Two FBI agents dig into the disappearance of civil rights workers in the Deep South.
Description: Two FBI agents investigating the murder of civil rights workers during the 60s seek to breach the conspiracy of silence in a small Southern town where segregation divides black and white. The younger agent trained in FBI school runs up against the small town ways of his partner, a former sheriff.

Title: Close
Hint: Two 13-year-old boys' intimate friendship is tested when they start secondary school.
Description: Two 13-year-old boys spend an idyllic summer together, but their connection is put to the test when they become the subject of speculation at school.

Title: Captain Fantastic
Hint: A father raising his six kids in the wilderness must take them back into society.
Description: Deep in the forests of the Pacific Northwest, a father devoted to raising his six kids with a rigorous physical and intellectual education is forced to leave his paradise and enter the world, beginning a journey that challenges his idea of what it means to be a parent.

Title: Big Hero 6
Hint: A boy genius and his huggable inflatable healthcare robot form a superhero team to catch a masked villain.
Description: A special bond develops between plus-sized inflatable robot Baymax, and prodigy Hiro Hamada, who team up with a group of friends to form a band of high-tech heroes.

Title: Captain Phillips
Hint: Somali pirates seize a cargo ship and take its commander hostage.
Description: The true story of Captain Richard ___ and the 2009 hijacking by Somali pirates of the US-flagged MV Maersk Alabama, the first American cargo ship to be hijacked in two hundred years.

Title: The Fall
Country: United States of America, India, United Kingdom
Hint: An injured stuntman tells a little girl an epic tale in a 1920s LA hospital.
Description: In a hospital on the outskirts of 1920s Los Angeles, an injured stuntman begins to tell a fellow patient, a little girl with a broken arm, a fantastic story about 5 mythical heroes. Thanks to his fractured state of mind and her vivid imagination, the line between fiction and reality starts to blur as the tale advances.

Title: The Holy Mountain
Hint: A mystical alchemist leads a group of seekers on a strange quest for immortality.
Description: The Alchemist assembles together a group of people from all walks of life to represent the planets in the solar system. The occult adept's intention is to put his recruits through strange mystical rites and divest them of their worldly baggage before embarking on a trip to Lotus Island. There they ascend the ___ to displace the immortal gods who secretly rule the universe.

Title: Jujutsu Kaisen 0
Hint: A teen is cursed by the spirit of his childhood friend and joins a school for sorcerers.
Description: Yuta Okkotsu is a nervous high school student who is suffering from a serious problem—his childhood friend Rika has turned into a curse and won't leave him alone. Since Rika is no ordinary curse, his plight is noticed by Satoru Gojo, a teacher at ___ High, a school where fledgling exorcists learn how to combat curses.

Title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
Hint: A super-powered patriot uncovers a conspiracy within the spy agency and faces a mysterious masked assassin from his past.
Description: After the cataclysmic events in New York with The Avengers, Steve Rogers, aka ___ is living quietly in Washington, D.C. and trying to adjust to the modern world. But when a S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague comes under attack, Steve becomes embroiled in a web of intrigue that threatens to put the world at risk.

Title: Let the Right One In
Hint: A bullied 12-year-old boy in snowy Stockholm befriends his strange new neighbour, a centuries-old vampire.
Description: When Oskar, a sensitive, bullied 12-year-old boy, meets his new neighbor, the mysterious and moody Eli, they strike up a friendship. Initially reserved with each other, Oskar and Eli slowly form a close bond, but it soon becomes apparent that she is no ordinary young girl.

Title: A Night at the Opera
Hint: Three anarchic siblings turn high-society music upside down to unite two lovers.
Description: The Marx Brothers take on high society and the ___ world to bring two lovers together. A sly business manager and two wacky friends of two ___ singers help them achieve success while humiliating their stuffy and snobbish enemies.

Title: The Best Offer
Hint: A renowned auctioneer becomes obsessed with an elusive heiress who never leaves her house.
Description: Virgil Oldman is a world renowned antiques expert and auctioneer. An eccentric genius, he leads a solitary life, going to extreme lengths to keep his distance from the messiness of human relationships.

Title: Night of the Living Dead
Hint: A group of strangers barricade themselves in a Pennsylvania farmhouse as flesh-eating ghouls surround them.
Description: A ragtag group barricade themselves in an old Pennsylvania farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls ravaging the Northeast.

Title: Midnight Cowboy
Hint: A naive Texas hustler moves to New York and befriends a sickly con man.
Description: Joe Buck is a wide-eyed hustler from Texas hoping to score big with wealthy New York City women; he finds a companion in Enrico "Ratso" Rizzo, an ailing swindler with a bum leg and a quixotic fantasy of escaping to Florida.

Title: Walk the Line
Hint: The life of a country music legend and his love for a singer.
Description: A chronicle of country music legend Johnny Cash's life, from his early days on an Arkansas cotton farm to his rise to fame with Sun Records in Memphis, where he recorded alongside Elvis Presley, Jerry Lee Lewis and Carl Perkins.

Title: Serenity
Hint: The renegade crew of a spaceship hide a fugitive girl and are hunted by a ruthless operative.
