Description: When the renegade crew of ___ agrees to hide a fugitive on their ship, they find themselves in an action-packed battle between the relentless military might of a totalitarian regime who will destroy anything – or anyone – to get the girl back and the bloodthirsty creatures who roam the uncharted areas of space. But... the greatest danger of all may be on their ship.

Title: The Man from Earth
Hint: A departing professor tells his colleagues he is a 14,000-year-old caveman who has never died.
Description: A departing professor gathers his closest colleagues for an intimate farewell, but the night takes an unexpected turn when he shares a stunning secret about his past. As the conversation unfolds, skepticism and curiosity collide, challenging everything they thought they knew about history, science, and belief.

Title: October Sky
Hint: A West Virginia coal miner's son is inspired by Sputnik to build rockets and escape the mines.
Description: The true story of Homer Hickam, a coal miner's son who was inspired by the first Sputnik launch to take up rocketry against his father's wishes.

Title: The Fighter
Hint: A boxer gets his shot at the title with the help of his troubled half-brother.
Description: Boxer "Irish" Micky Ward's unlikely road to the world light welterweight title. His Rocky-like rise was shepherded by half-brother Dicky, a boxer-turned-trainer who rebounded in life after nearly being KO'd by drugs and crime.

Title: Awakenings
Hint: A shy research doctor uses an experimental drug to awaken patients who have been catatonic for decades.
Description: Dr. Malcolm Sayer, a shy research physician, uses an experimental drug to "awaken" the catatonic victims of a rare disease. Leonard is the first patient to receive the controversial treatment. His awakening, filled with awe and enthusiasm, proves a rebirth for Sayer too, as the exuberant patient reveals life's simple but unutterably sweet pleasures to the introverted doctor.

Title: The Searchers
Hint: A Civil War veteran spends years searching for his niece, captured by Comanches.
Description: As a Civil War veteran spends years searching for a young niece captured by Indians, his motivation becomes increasingly questionable.

Title: Frankenstein
Hint: A scientist assembles a creature from body parts and brings it to life.
Description: Henry ___ pieces together body parts in the hope of bringing a human-like creature to life. The mad scientist’s dreams are shattered by his monstrous creation awakening with rage to a world that hates and fears him.

Title: The Insider
Hint: A tobacco company chemist becomes a whistleblower, and a TV producer fights to air his story.
Description: A research chemist comes under personal and professional attack when he decides to appear in a 60 Minutes exposé on Big Tobacco.

Title: The King of Comedy
Hint: An aspiring comic kidnaps a talk show host to get his big break.
Description: Aspiring comic Rupert Pupkin attempts to achieve success in show business by stalking his idol, a late night talk-show host who craves his own privacy.

Title: Straight Outta Compton
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Five young men from a rough LA suburb use brutally honest rhymes to start a hip-hop revolution.
Description: In 1987, five young men, using brutally honest rhymes and hardcore beats, put their frustration and anger about life in the most dangerous place in America into the most powerful weapon they had: their music.

Title: Changeling
Hint: A single mother's son disappears in 1928 LA, and the police return a different boy.
Description: Los Angeles, 1928. When single mother Christine Collins leaves for work, her son vanishes without a trace. Five months later, the police reunite mother and son. But when Christine suspects that the boy returned to her isn't her child, her quest for truth exposes a world of corruption.

Title: Dawn of the Dead
Hint: Survivors of a zombie epidemic barricade themselves inside a shopping mall in Pennsylvania.
Description: During an ever-growing epidemic of zombies that have risen from the dead, two Philadelphia SWAT team members, a traffic reporter, and his television-executive girlfriend seek refuge in a secluded shopping mall.

Title: The Day of the Jackal
Hint: A professional assassin plots to kill the President of France.
Description: An international assassin known as ‘The ___’ is employed by disgruntled French generals to kill President Charles de Gaulle, with a dedicated gendarme on the assassin’s trail.

Title: Paddington 2
Hint: A polite bear is framed for stealing a pop-up book and sent to prison.
Description: ___, now happily settled with the Browns, picks up a series of odd jobs to buy the perfect present for his Aunt Lucy, but it is stolen.

Title: Kiki's Delivery Service
Hint: A young witch moves to a seaside town and starts a flying courier business on her broomstick.
Description: A young witch, on her mandatory year of independent life, finds fitting into a new community difficult while she supports herself by running an air courier service.

Title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
Hint: A defiant city kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush.
Description: Ricky is a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive.

Title: The Remains of the Day
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A rule-bound English butler reflects on his decades of service and his lost love.
Description: A rule-bound head butler's world of manners and decorum in the household he maintains is tested by the arrival of a housekeeper who falls in love with him in post-WWI Britain. The possibility of romance and his master's cultivation of ties with the Nazi cause challenge his carefully maintained veneer of servitude.

Title: The Conversation
Hint: A paranoid surveillance expert fears that a couple he's recording will be murdered.
Description: A paranoid, secretive surveillance expert has a crisis of conscience when he suspects that the couple he is spying on will be murdered.

Title: The Devils
Hint: A charismatic 17th-century French priest is accused of witchcraft by a sexually obsessed nun.
Description: A charismatic 17th-century French priest becomes the target of a sexually obsessed nun’s witchcraft accusations, which corrupt church and state officials are all too happy to exploit.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

Title: Thirteen Lives
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The true story of the rescue of 12 boys and their football coach from a flooded cave in Thailand.
Description: Based on the true nail-biting mission that captivated the world. Twelve boys and the coach of a Thai soccer team explore the Tham Luang cave when an unexpected rainstorm traps them in a chamber inside the mountain. Entombed behind a maze of flooded cave tunnels, they face impossible odds.

Title: Ed Wood
Hint: The life of a legendary bad film director and his friendship with a fading horror star.
Description: The mostly true story of the legendary "worst director of all time", who, with the help of his strange friends, filmed countless B-movies without ever becoming famous or successful.

Title: Kramer vs. Kramer
Hint: A workaholic father must learn to raise his son when his wife leaves.
Description: Ted ___ is a career man for whom his work comes before his family. His wife Joanna cannot take this anymore, so she decides to leave him. Ted is now faced with the tasks of housekeeping and taking care of himself and their young son Billy.

Title: Glory
Hint: A young officer leads the US Civil War's first all-Black volunteer company.
Description: Robert Gould Shaw leads the US Civil War's first all-black volunteer company, fighting prejudices of both his own Union army and the Confederates.

Title: Lilya 4-ever
Hint: A teenage girl abandoned in a post-Soviet town is lured into sex trafficking.
Description: In a struggling post-Soviet community, ___ a teenage girl is abandoned when her mother moves to the United States with her boyfriend. Facing neglect and poverty, she meets Andrei, who offers her a job in Sweden, giving her hope for a better life — and a journey that will change everything.

Title: Once
Hint: A street musician in Dublin and a Czech immigrant write and record songs together.
Description: A vacuum repairman moonlights as a street musician and hopes for his big break. One day a Czech immigrant, who earns a living selling flowers, approaches him with the news that she is also an aspiring singer-songwriter. The pair decide to collaborate, and the songs that they compose reflect the story of their blossoming love.

Title: My Fair Lady
Hint: A snobbish phonetics professor bets he can make a flower girl pass as a duchess.
Description: A snobbish phonetics professor agrees to a wager that he can take a flower girl and make her presentable in high society.

Title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
Hint: A young Viking rider and his beast discover a hidden ice cave and a mysterious masked rider who protects winged creatures.
Description: Five years after uniting the dragons and Vikings of Berk, Hiccup and Toothless soar beyond their homeland, charting the vast unknown. During one of their adventures, the pair discover a secret cave that houses hundreds of wild dragons -- and a mysterious ___ rider with a startling connection to Hiccup.

Title: Great Expectations
Hint: An orphan comes into a fortune from a mysterious benefactor and becomes a gentleman.
Description: In this Dickens adaptation, orphan Pip discovers through lawyer Mr. Jaggers that a mysterious benefactor wishes to ensure that he becomes a gentleman.

Title: The Outlaw Josey Wales
Hint: A Missouri farmer whose family was murdered becomes a wanted man and is hunted by Union soldiers.
Description: After avenging his family's brutal murder, ___ is pursued by a pack of soldiers. He prefers to travel alone, but ragtag outcasts are drawn to him - and ___ can't bring himself to leave them unprotected.

Title: The Bride of Frankenstein
Hint: A scientist and his monster survive, and a mad doctor plans to create a mate.
Description: Dr. ___ and his monster both turn out to be alive after being attacked by an angry mob. The now-chastened scientist attempts to escape his past, but a former mentor forces him to assist with the creation of a new creature.

Title: Cabaret
Hint: An American singer at a decadent Berlin club falls for a British writer as Nazis rise.
Description: Inside the Kit Kat Club of 1931 Berlin, starry-eyed singer Sally Bowles and an impish emcee sound the clarion call to decadent fun, while outside a certain political party grows into a brutal force.

Title: Gaslight
Hint: A newlywed fears she's going mad as strange things happen in her London home.
Description: A newlywed fears she's going mad when strange things start happening at the family mansion.

Title: The Right Stuff
Hint: Seven test pilots become the first American astronauts in the Space Race.
Description: At the dawn of the Space Race, seven test pilots set out to become the first American astronauts to enter space. However, the road to making history brings momentous challenges.

Title: Days of Heaven
Hint: A Chicago labourer, his girlfriend and his sister flee to the Texas Panhandle.
Description: In 1916, a Chicago steel worker accidentally kills his supervisor and flees to the Texas panhandle with his girlfriend and little sister to work harvesting wheat in the fields of a stoic farmer.

Title: The Train
Country: France, Italy, United States of America
Hint: A French railway inspector tries to stop a Nazi colonel stealing priceless paintings by rail.
Description: As the Allied forces approach Paris in August 1944, German Colonel Von Waldheim is desperate to take all of France's greatest paintings to Germany. He manages to secure a ___ to transport the valuable art works even as the chaos of retreat descends upon them.

Title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
Hint: A young woman tricked and sold to a Mumbai brothel rises to become a powerful madam and champion of sex workers' rights.
Description: Duped and sold to a brothel, a young woman fearlessly reclaims her power, using underworld connections to preside over the world she was once a pawn in.

Title: All That Jazz
Hint: A chain-smoking, womanising Broadway choreographer drives himself toward death while staging a show and editing a film.
Description: Joe Gideon is at the top of the heap, one of the most successful directors and choreographers in musical theater. But he can feel his world slowly collapsing around him - his obsession with work has almost destroyed his personal life, and only his bottles of pills keep him going.

Title: Whisper of the Heart
Hint: A bookish Tokyo schoolgirl discovers that the same boy has borrowed every library book she's read, and finds her calling.
Description: Shizuku lives a simple life, dominated by her love for stories and writing. One day she notices that all the library books she has have been previously checked out by the same person: "Seiji Amasawa."

Title: Letters from Iwo Jima
Hint: Japanese soldiers dig into the volcanic rock of a small island to defend it against a massive American invasion.
Description: The story of the battle of ___ between the United States and Imperial Japan during World War II, as told from the perspective of the Japanese who fought it.

Title: Hannah and Her Sisters
Hint: Three siblings' lives tangle over two Thanksgivings in New York.
Description: Between two Thanksgivings, ___ husband falls in love with her sister Lee, while her hypochondriac ex-husband rekindles his relationship with her sister Holly.

Title: All About My Mother
Hint: A grieving nurse travels to Barcelona to find her late son's father, a transgender woman, and builds a new family of women.
Description: Following the tragic death of her teenage son, Manuela travels from Madrid to Barcelona in an attempt to contact the long-estranged father the boy never knew. She reunites with an old friend, an outspoken transgender sex worker, and befriends a troubled actress and a pregnant, HIV-positive nun.

Title: The Killing Fields
Hint: A New York Times reporter and his Cambodian assistant are separated when the Khmer Rouge take over.
Description: New York Times reporter Sydney Schanberg is on assignment covering the Cambodian Civil War, with the help of local interpreter Dith Pran and American photojournalist Al Rockoff. When the U.S. Army pulls out amid escalating violence, Schanberg makes exit arrangements for Pran and his family.

Title: Oliver Twist
Country: Czech Republic, France, Italy, United Kingdom
Hint: A nine-year-old orphan escapes a workhouse and falls in with a gang of child pickpockets in Victorian London.
Description: When 9-year-old orphan ___ dares to ask his cruel taskmaster, Mr. Bumble, for a second serving of gruel, he's hired out as an apprentice. Escaping that dismal fate, young ___ falls in with the street urchin known as the Artful Dodger and his criminal mentor, Fagin. When kindly Mr. Brownlow takes ___ in, Fagin's evil henchman Bill Sikes plots to kidnap the boy.

Title: The Day the Earth Stood Still
Hint: An alien and his towering robot land in Washington with a warning for humanity.
Description: An alien and a robot land on Earth after World War II and tell mankind to be peaceful or face destruction.

Title: Manhattan
Hint: A neurotic writer falls for his friend's mistress in a black-and-white New York.
Description: ___ explores how the life of a middle-aged television writer dating a teenage girl is further complicated when he falls in love with his best friend's mistress.

Title: Breaking the Waves
Hint: A devout, naive young woman in the Scottish Highlands makes a terrible sacrifice for her paralysed husband.
Description: In a small, conservative Scottish village, an oilman is paralyzed in an accident. His wife, who prayed for his return, feels guilty; even more, when he urges her to have sex with another.

Title: My Left Foot
Hint: An Irish man with cerebral palsy learns to paint and write using only one limb.
Description: No one expects much from Christy Brown, a boy with cerebral palsy born into a working-class Irish family. Though Christy is a spastic quadriplegic and essentially paralyzed, a miraculous event occurs when, at the age of 5, he demonstrates control of his left ___ by using chalk to scrawl a word on the floor.

Title: The Chaser
Hint: A disgraced detective turned pimp hunts a serial killer who has been kidnapping his girls in Seoul.
Description: Joong-ho is a dirty detective turned pimp, who's in financial trouble as several of his girls have recently disappeared without clearing their debts. While trying to track them down, he finds a clue that the vanished girls were all called up by the same client, whom one of his girls is meeting with right now.

Title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
Hint: A white liberal couple's beliefs are tested when their daughter brings home her Black fiancé.
Description: A couple's attitudes are challenged when their daughter brings home a fiancé who is black.

Title: Stagecoach
Hint: A drunk doctor, an outlaw and other strangers share a dangerous ride through Apache land.
Description: A group of people traveling on a ___ find their journey complicated by the threat of Geronimo, and learn something about each other in the process.

Title: Aguirre, the Wrath of God
Hint: A mad conquistador leads a doomed expedition down the Amazon in search of El Dorado.
Description: A few decades after the destruction of the Inca Empire, a Spanish expedition led by the infamous ___ leaves the mountains of Peru and goes down the Amazon River in search of the lost city of El Dorado. When great difficulties arise, ___ men start to wonder whether their quest will lead them to prosperity or certain death.

Title: Loving Vincent
Country: Poland, United Kingdom, Netherlands, Switzerland, Qatar
Hint: A young man investigates the last days of a famous painter, in a film painted entirely in oil.
Description: A young man arrives at the last hometown of painter ___ van Gogh to deliver the troubled artist's final letter and ends up investigating his final days there.

Title: I, Daniel Blake
Hint: A middle-aged carpenter who needs state welfare after a heart attack fights a cruel bureaucratic system.
Description: A middle aged carpenter, who requires state welfare after injuring himself, is joined by a single mother in a similar scenario.

Title: Batman: Mask of the Phantasm
Hint: A caped crusader faces a mysterious new vigilante killing gangsters, as an old flame returns.
Description: Andrea Beaumont leaves her father to return to Gotham, rekindling an old romance with Bruce Wayne. At the same time, a mysterious figure begins to hunt down Gotham's criminals, wrongly implicating ___ in the murders. Now on the run from the law, ___ must find and stop the culprit, while also navigating his relationship with Andrea.

Title: Pride
Hint: In 1984, a group of London LGBT activists raise money to support striking Welsh miners.
Description: In 1984, a group of LGBT activists decide to raise money to support the National Union of Mineworkers during their lengthy strike. There is only one problem: the Union seems embarrassed to receive their support.

Title: The Innocents
Hint: A governess for two children in a country house becomes convinced they are possessed by ghosts.
Description: In a mid-19th century Essex country house, a young governess for two children becomes convinced that the house and grounds are haunted by ghosts and that the children are being possessed.

Title: East of Eden
Hint: A troubled young man competes with his brother for their stern father's love in WWI-era California.
Description: In the Salinas Valley in and around World War I, Cal Trask feels he must compete against overwhelming odds with his brother for the love of their father. Cal is frustrated at every turn, from his reaction to the war, how to get ahead in business and in life, and how to relate to his estranged mother.

Title: Ninja Scroll
Hint: A masterless swordsman battles eight demons who serve the Shogun of the Dark, in a violent anime.
Description: Jubei is a masterless ___ who travels the land alone, lending his services to those with gold—or a worthy cause. His fearsome abilities have served him well, but a plot to overthrow the government threatens to end his wandering ways—and possibly his life.

Title: Shadow of a Doubt
Hint: A young woman suspects her charming uncle, visiting their sleepy town, is a serial killer.
Description: In sleepy Santa Rosa, restless young Charlie’s world brightens when her sophisticated Uncle Charlie arrives for a long visit. But as his behavior grows increasingly strange, she begins to suspect that her beloved uncle may be hiding a terrible secret—and that danger has quietly entered her home.

Title: The Umbrellas of Cherbourg
Hint: A young woman and a mechanic are separated when he goes to war in Algeria, in a musical sung throughout.
Description: This simple romantic tragedy begins in 1957. Guy Foucher, a 20-year-old French auto mechanic, has fallen in love with 17-year-old Geneviève Emery, an employee in her widowed mother's chic but financially embattled umbrella shop. On the evening before Guy is to leave for a two-year tour of combat in Algeria, he and Geneviève make love.

Title: The Man Who Would Be King
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two roguish British ex-soldiers in 19th-century India set off to conquer a remote land, where one is mistaken for a god.
Description: Tired of life as soldiers, Peachy Carnehan and Danny Dravot travel to the isolated land of Kafiristan, where they are ultimately embraced by the people and revered as rulers. After a series of misunderstandings, the natives come to believe that Dravot is a god, but he and Carnehan can't keep up their deception forever.

Title: Badla
Hint: A young entrepreneur accused of murdering her lover hires a top defence lawyer to rebuild her story.
Description: A dynamic young entrepreneur finds herself locked in a hotel room with the corpse of her dead lover. She hires a prestigious lawyer to defend her and they work together to figure out what actually happened.

Title: Imitation of Life
Hint: A white widow and an African-American widow raise their daughters together in 1940s New York.
Description: In 1940s New York, a white widow who dreams of being on Broadway has a chance encounter with a black single mother, who becomes her maid.

Title: The Spirit of the Beehive
Hint: A young girl in 1940s Spain becomes obsessed with a monster after seeing a film.
Description: In 1940, in the immediate aftermath of the Spanish Civil War, a young girl living on the Castilian plain is haunted after attending a screening of James Whale's 1931 film Frankenstein and hearing from her sister that the monster is not dead, instead existing as a spirit inhabiting a nearby barn.

Title: The White Ribbon
Hint: Strange accidents in a German village in 1913 reveal the dark side of its children.
Description: An aged tailor recalls his life as the schoolteacher of a small village in Northern Germany that was struck by a series of strange events in the year leading up to WWI.

Title: To Have and Have Not
Hint: A charter boat skipper in Martinique gets mixed up with the French Resistance and a sultry singer.
Description: A Martinique charter boat skipper gets mixed up with the underground French resistance operatives during WWII.

Title: L'Atalante
Hint: A newly married couple struggle through life on a river barge in France.
Description: Newly married couple Juliette and ship captain Jean struggle through marriage as they travel on the ___ along with the captain's first mate and a cabin boy.

Title: Red River
Hint: A headstrong rancher leads a cattle drive and clashes with his adopted son.
Description: Following the Civil War, headstrong rancher Thomas Dunson decides to lead a perilous cattle drive from Texas to Missouri. During the exhausting journey, his persistence becomes tyrannical in the eyes of Matthew Garth, his adopted son and protégé.

Title: The World's Fastest Indian
Country: New Zealand, Switzerland, Japan, United States of America
Hint: An elderly New Zealander takes his vintage motorcycle to Bonneville to set a speed record.
Description: The life story of New Zealander Burt Munro, who spent years building a 1920 Indian motorcycle—a bike which helped him set the land-speed world record at Utah's Bonneville Salt Flats in 1967.

Title: Land of Mine
Hint: Young German prisoners are forced to clear landmines from Danish beaches after the war.
Description: In the days following the surrender of Germany in May 1945, a group of young German prisoners of war is handed over to the Danish authorities and subsequently sent to the West Coast, where they are ordered to remove the more than two million mines that the Germans had placed in the sand along the coast.

Title: A Prophet
Hint: A young Arab man rises to power inside a brutal French prison.
Description: Sentenced to six years in prison, Malik El Djebena is alone in the world and can neither read nor write. On his arrival at the prison, he seems younger and more brittle than the others detained there. At once he falls under the sway of a group of Corsicans who enforce their rule in the prison. As the 'missions' go by, he toughens himself and wins the confidence of the Corsican group.

Title: Hud
Hint: A ruthless, charming young Texas rancher clashes with his principled father over a diseased herd.
Description: ___ Bannon is a ruthless young man who tarnishes everything and everyone he touches. ___ represents the perfect embodiment of alienated youth, out for kicks with no regard for the consequences. There is bitter conflict between the callous ___ and his stern and highly principled father, Homer.

Title: The Music Man
Hint: A con man selling band instruments to a small Iowa town falls for the librarian.
Description: Traveling con artist Harold Hill targets the naïve residents of a small town in 1910s Iowa by posing as a boys' bandleader to raise money before he can skip town.

Title: The Lunchbox
Country: France, Germany, India, United States of America
Hint: A mistaken delivery in Mumbai's famous tiffin service connects a lonely widower and a neglected housewife through notes.
Description: A mistaken delivery in Mumbai's famously efficient ___ delivery system (Mumbai's Dabbawallahs) connects a young housewife to a stranger in the dusk of his life. They build a fantasy world together through notes in the ___. Gradually, this fantasy threatens to overwhelm their reality.

Title: Johnny Got His Gun
Hint: A young American soldier is left without arms, legs or face after a WWI shell.
Description: A young American soldier, rendered in pseudocoma from an artillery shell from WWI, recalls his life leading up to that point.

Title: Cowboy Bebop: The Movie
Hint: A bounty hunter crew in 2071 must stop a terrorist planning to unleash a deadly virus on Mars.
Description: The year is 2071. Following a terrorist bombing, a deadly virus is released on the populace of Mars and the government has issued the largest bounty in history, for the capture of whoever is behind it. The bounty hunter crew of the spaceship ___; Spike, Faye, Jet and Ed, take the case with hopes of cashing in the bounty.

Title: The Silence
Country: Canada, Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A teenage girl and her family must stay silent to survive as flying creatures hunt by sound.
Description: With the world under attack by deadly creatures who hunt by sound, a teen and her family seek refuge outside the city and encounter a mysterious cult.

Title: They Shoot Horses, Don't They?
Hint: Desperate contestants in a Depression-era dance marathon compete for prize money until their bodies give out.
Description: In the midst of the Great Depression, manipulative emcee Rocky enlists contestants for a dance marathon offering a $1,500 cash prize. Among them are a failed actress, a middle-aged sailor, a delusional blonde and a pregnant girl.

Title: Bringing Up Baby
Hint: A shy scientist's life is turned upside down by a free-spirited heiress and her leopard.
Description: David Huxley is waiting to get a bone he needs for his museum collection. Through a series of strange circumstances, he meets Susan Vance, and the duo have a series of misadventures which include a leopard called Baby.

Title: Babette's Feast
Hint: A French housekeeper with a mysterious past cooks a lavish banquet for a pious, austere Danish village.
Description: A French housekeeper with a mysterious past brings quiet revolution in the form of one exquisite meal to a circle of starkly pious villagers in late 19th century Denmark.

Title: His Girl Friday
Hint: A newspaper editor schemes to keep his ex-wife, his best reporter, from remarrying.
Description: Walter Burns is an irresistibly conniving newspaper publisher desperate to woo back his paper’s star reporter, who also happens to be his estranged wife. She’s threatening to quit and settle down with a new beau, but, as Walter knows, she has a weakness: she can’t resist a juicy scoop.

Title: The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie
Hint: A group of upper-class friends try to have dinner but keep being interrupted, in a surreal satire.
Description: In Luis Buñuel’s deliciously satiric masterpiece, an upper-class sextet sits down to dinner but never eats, their attempts continually thwarted by a vaudevillian mixture of events both actual and imagined.

Title: Duck Soup
Hint: A wisecracking leader drags his bankrupt country into war with its neighbour, in a madcap comedy from four comedian brothers.
Description: Rufus T. Firefly is named president/dictator of bankrupt Freedonia and declares war on neighboring Sylvania over the love of wealthy Mrs. Teasdale.

Title: Once Upon a Time in Anatolia
Hint: A doctor, police and prosecutor search the Anatolian steppe at night for a murder victim's body.
Description: A group of men lead a search for a victim of a murder to whom a suspect named Kenan and his mentally challenged brother confessed. However, the search is proving more difficult than expected as Kenan is fuzzy as to the body's location.

Title: The Chorus
Hint: A new teacher at a school for disruptive boys in 1940s France gives them hope through music.
Description: In 1940s France, a new teacher at a school for disruptive boys gives hope and inspiration.

Title: Embrace of the Serpent
Hint: A shaman guides two scientists through the Amazon in search of a sacred healing plant.
Description: The epic story of the first contact, encounter, approach, betrayal and, eventually, life-transcending friendship, between Karamakate, an Amazonian shaman, last survivor of his people, and two scientists that, over the course of 40 years, travel through the Amazon in search of a sacred plant that can heal them.

Title: Vivre Sa Vie
Hint: Twelve episodes in the life of a young Parisian woman who turns to prostitution.
Description: Twelve episodic tales in the life of a Parisian woman and her slow descent into prostitution.

Title: Playtime
Hint: A clumsy man wanders through a hyper-modern Paris of glass and steel.
Description: Clumsy Monsieur Hulot finds himself perplexed by the intimidating complexity of a gadget-filled Paris. He attempts to meet with a business contact but soon becomes lost. His roundabout journey parallels that of an American tourist, and as they weave through the inventive urban environment, they intermittently meet, developing an interest in one another.

Title: The Postman
Hint: A drifter in a post-apocalyptic America becomes a hero by delivering letters.
Description: In 2013, there are no highways, no I-ways, no dreams of a better tomorrow, only scattered survivors across what was once the United States. Into this apocalyptic wasteland comes an enigmatic drifter with a mule, a knack for Shakespeare, and something yet undiscovered: the power to inspire hope.

Title: Law of Tehran
Hint: A relentless narcotics cop catches a drug kingpin in Iran's capital, but the battle has only begun.
Description: Samad is nobody’s fool. The narcotics officer has seen his share of a drug dealer’s lies and games, and his patience has come to run thin. While searching for the infamous drug baron Nasser Khakzad, he and his colleague Hamid scour the streets of ___, turning an overcrowded prison on its head.

Title: The Servant
Hint: A manservant slowly takes control of his master's life and home.
Description: Indolent aristocrat Tony employs competent Barrett as his manservant and all seems to be going well until Barrett persuades Tony to hire his sister as a live-in maid.

Title: Crimes and Misdemeanors
Hint: A renowned ophthalmologist is desperate to end his affair, while a filmmaker struggles with his career.
Description: A renowned ophthalmologist is desperate to cut off an adulterous relationship…which ends up in murder; and a frustrated documentary filmmaker woos an attractive television producer while making a film about her insufferably self-centered boss.

Title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
Hint: A deformed bell-ringer longs to leave the cathedral and falls for a Romani dancer.
Description: Isolated bell-ringer Quasimodo wishes to leave ___ tower against the wishes of Judge Claude Frollo, his stern guardian and Paris' strait-laced Minister of Justice. His first venture to the outside world finds him Esmeralda, a kind-hearted and fearless Romani woman who openly stands up to Frollo's tyranny.

Title: You Can't Take It with You
Hint: A young woman from an eccentric family gets engaged to the son of a stuffy banker.
Description: Alice, the only relatively normal member of the eccentric Sycamore family, falls in love with Tony Kirby, but his wealthy banker father and snobbish mother strongly disapprove of the match. When the Kirbys are invited to dinner to become better acquainted with their future in-laws, things don't turn out the way Alice had hoped.

Title: The Asphalt Jungle
Hint: A paroled burglar assembles a team for a jewel heist, but things go wrong.
Description: Recently paroled from prison, legendary burglar "Doc" Riedenschneider, with funding from Alonzo Emmerich, a crooked lawyer, gathers a small group of veteran criminals together in the Midwest for a big jewel heist.

Title: The Killer
Hint: A meticulous, philosophising assassin battles his employers after a mission in Paris goes wrong.
Description: After a fateful miss, an assassin battles his employers, and himself, on an international manhunt he insists isn't personal.

Title: The Court Jester
Hint: A hapless carnival performer masquerades as a royal fool to help overthrow a usurper, in a musical comedy.
Description: A hapless carnival performer masquerades as the ___ as part of a plot against a usurper who has overthrown the rightful king of England.

Title: Seven Days in May
Hint: A Marine colonel discovers a planned military coup against the US president.
Description: A U.S. Marine Corps colonel alerts the president of a planned military coup against him.

Title: Berserk: The Golden Age Arc III - The Advent
Hint: A mercenary returns to his old band and faces their leader's transformation into a demon.
Description: One year has passed since Guts left the Band of the Hawk and Griffith was imprisoned by the Kingdom of Midland for treason. In the dead of night, at a camping site where they hide, the Band of the Hawk is attacked by Bakiraka assassins led by Silat. When all seems lost, Guts returns from his journey.

Title: Like Father, Like Son
Hint: A successful businessman learns the boy he raised was switched at birth.
Description: Ryota Nonomiya is a successful businessman driven by money. He learns that his biological son was switched with another child after birth. He must make a life-changing decision and choose his true son or the boy he raised as his own.

Title: The Children's Hour
Hint: Two teachers' lives are ruined when a spiteful student accuses them of a lesbian affair.
Description: An unruly student at a private all-girls boarding school scandalously accuses the two women who run it of having a romantic relationship.

Title: Millennium Actress
Hint: A filmmaker interviews a retired star whose memories blur into her movies.
Description: Documentary filmmaker Genya Tachibana has tracked down the legendary actress Chiyoko Fujiwara, who mysteriously vanished at the height of her career. When he presents her with a key she had lost and thought was gone forever, the filmmaker could not have imagined that it would not only unlock the long-held secrets of Chiyoko’s life... but also his own.

Title: Eat Drink Man Woman
Hint: A widowed master chef in Taipei cooks a lavish Sunday dinner for his three grown daughters.
Description: Retired and widowed Chinese master chef Chu lives in modern day Taipei, with his three attractive daughters, all of whom are unattached. Soon, each daughter encounters a new man in their lives. When these new relationships blossom, stereotypes are broken and the living situation within the family changes.

Title: The Ghost and Mrs. Muir
Hint: A young widow's seaside cottage is haunted by the gruff spirit of its former owner, a sea captain.
Description: In 1900, young widow Lucy ___ learns that her seaside cottage is haunted and forms a unique relationship with the ___.

Title: Au hasard Balthazar
Hint: A donkey passes through the hands of several owners in rural France.
Description: The story of a donkey ___ as he is passed from owner to owner, some kind and some cruel but all with motivations beyond his understanding. ___, whose life parallels that of his first keeper, Marie, is truly a beast of burden, suffering the sins of humankind. But despite his powerlessness, he accepts his fate nobly.

Title: That Obscure Object of Desire
Hint: A rich older Frenchman is endlessly toyed with by the young woman he can't have.
Description: After dumping a bucket of water on a beautiful young woman from the window of a train car, wealthy Frenchman Mathieu, regales his fellow passengers with the story of the dysfunctional relationship between himself and the young woman in question, a fiery 19-year-old flamenco dancer named Conchita. What follows is a tale of cruelty, depravity and lies -- the very building blocks of love.

Title: Days of Wine and Roses
Hint: A heavy-drinking PR man falls in love and drags his wife into alcoholism.
Description: An alcoholic falls in love with and gets married to a young woman, whom he systematically addicts to booze so they can share his "passion" together.

Title: Mimi
Hint: A young woman in Rajasthan agrees to be a surrogate mother for an American couple.
Description: An aspiring actress in a small town in Rajasthan agrees to bear a child for a visiting couple seeking a surrogate mother, but her experience takes an unexpected turn when they refuse to have the child anymore.

Title: Tokyo Godfathers
Hint: Three homeless people in the Japanese capital find an abandoned baby on Christmas Eve and set out to find her mother.
Description: On Christmas Eve, three homeless people living on the streets of ___ discover a newborn baby among the trash and set out to find its parents.

Title: Veer-Zaara
Hint: An Indian Air Force pilot falls in love with a Pakistani woman.
Description: Squadron Leader ___ Pratap Singh, a pilot in the Indian Air Force, rescues the stranded ___, a woman from Pakistan, following a bus accident, and their lives are forever bound.

Title: Pandora's Box
Hint: A seductive young woman leaves a trail of ruined men behind her.
Description: The rise and inevitable fall of an amoral but naive young woman whose insouciant eroticism inspires lust and violence in those around her.

Title: The Phantom of Liberty
Hint: A string of surreal, absurd scenes that mock society and its rules.
Description: This Surrealist film, with a title referencing the Communist Manifesto, strings together short incidents based on the life of director Luis Buñuel. Presented as chance encounters, these loosely related, intersecting situations, all without a consistent protagonist, reach from the 19th century to the 1970s.

Title: Becket
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The friendship between an English king and his advisor ends when he becomes Archbishop of Canterbury.
Description: Thomas ___, Henry II's longtime advisor, finds his friendship with the debauched king corroding when he is unwillingly appointed as Archbishop of Canterbury in an attempt to gain absolute loyalty from the Church.

Title: Minnal Murali
Hint: A tailor gains superpowers after being struck by lightning in a small Kerala village.
Description: A tailor gains special powers after being struck by lightning but must take down an unexpected foe if he is to become the superhero his hometown in Kerala needs.

Title: Brother
Hint: A yakuza enforcer exiled to Los Angeles builds a brutal criminal empire with his younger half-sibling's gang.
Description: A Japanese Yakuza gangster's deadly existence in his homeland gets him exiled to Los Angeles, where he is taken in by his little ___ and his ___ gang.

Title: My Life as a Zucchini
Hint: A boy goes to a foster home after his mother's death and makes new friends, in stop-motion.
Description: After his mother’s death, ___ is befriended by a kind police officer, Raymond, who accompanies him to his new foster home filled with other orphans his age. There, with the help of his newfound friends, ___ eventually learns to trust and love as he searches for a new family of his own.

Title: Destiny
Hint: A young woman makes a deal with Death to save her lover, in a German silent classic.
Description: As a young couple stops and rests in a small village inn, the man is abducted by Death and is sequestered behind a huge doorless, windowless wall. The woman finds a mystic entrance and is met by Death, who tells her three separate stories set in exotic locales, all involving circumstances similar to hers.

Title: Ninotchka
Hint: A stern Soviet official sent to Paris falls for a charming count.
Description: A stern Russian woman sent to Paris on official business finds herself attracted to a man who represents everything she is supposed to detest.

Title: Burnt by the Sun
Hint: A Soviet colonel's summer at his dacha is disrupted by a visitor in 1936.
Description: Russia, 1936: revolutionary hero Colonel Kotov is spending an idyllic summer in his dacha with his young wife and six-year-old daughter Nadia and other assorted family and friends. Things change dramatically with the unheralded arrival of Cousin Dmitri from Moscow, who charms the women and little Nadia with his games and pianistic bravura.

Title: The Bad and the Beautiful
Hint: A ruthless film producer's career is traced through three people he betrayed on the way up.
Description: Told in flashback form, the film traces the rise and fall of a tough, ambitious Hollywood producer, Jonathan Shields, as seen through the eyes of various acquaintances, including a writer, James Lee Bartlow; a star, Georgia Lorrison; and a director, Fred Amiel. He is a hard-driving, ambitious man who ruthlessly uses everyone on the way to becoming one of Hollywood's top movie makers.

Title: Knockin' on Heaven's Door
Hint: Two terminally ill young men escape a hospital to see the sea for the first time.
Description: Two young men, Martin and Rudi, both suffering from terminal cancer, get to know each other in a hospital room. They drown their desperation in tequila and decide to take one last trip to the sea. Drunk and still in pajamas they steal the first fancy car they find, a 60's Mercedes convertible.

Title: Pelle the Conqueror
Hint: A Swedish boy and his father emigrate to Denmark and work on a farm.
Description: In the late 19th century, two Swedish emigrants, Lasse Karlsson and his son ___, arrive on the Danish island of Bornholm hoping to find work on a farm and save enough money to travel to the United States of America.

Title: System Crasher
Hint: A wild 9-year-old girl is expelled from everywhere, and only one man can reach her.
Description: Wherever 9-year-old Benni ends up, she is expelled. She has become what child protection services call a “___.” But she is not looking to change her ways, and has one goal: go back home to her mother. When anger management trainer Micha is hired to help, suddenly there is hope.

Title: English Vinglish
Hint: An Indian housewife secretly takes a language course in New York to earn her family's respect.
Description: In the United States for the first time, an Indian housewife with a limited command of English turns Manhattan into her personal language school.

Title: Ernest & Celestine
Hint: A little mouse and a big bear become friends, in a watercolour animation.
Description: ___ is a little mouse trying to avoid a dental career while ___ is a big bear craving an artistic outlet. When ___ meets ___, they overcome their natural enmity by forging a life of crime together.

Title: Sword of the Stranger
Hint: A boy and his dog are protected by a nameless ronin with a deadly blade.
Description: Pursued by formidable Chinese assassins, young Kotaro and his dog run into No Name, a mysterious stranger who gets pulled into the chase. The unlikely companions form a bond over saving the dog from a poison attack, but chaos erupts when the assassins find Kotaro, and No Name must face his past before a horrible fate is met again.

Title: Ashes and Diamonds
Hint: A young soldier is ordered to assassinate a communist commissar at the end of WWII.
Description: A young academy soldier, Maciek Chelmicki, is ordered to shoot the secretary of the KW PPR. A coincidence causes him to kill someone else. Meeting face to face with his victim, he gets a shock. He faces the necessity of repeating the assassination. He meets Krystyna, a girl working as a barmaid in the restaurant of the "Monopol" hotel.

Title: Birdman of Alcatraz
Hint: A convict serving life in solitary confinement becomes an expert on birds.
Description: After killing a prison guard, convict Robert Stroud faces life imprisonment in solitary confinement. Driven nearly mad by loneliness and despair, Stroud's life gains new meaning when he happens upon a helpless baby sparrow in the exercise yard and nurses it back to health.

Title: I Vitelloni
Hint: Five young men drift lazily through life in a small Italian seaside town.
Description: Five young men dream of success as they drift lazily through life in a small Italian village. Fausto, the group's leader, is a womanizer; Riccardo craves fame; Alberto is a hopeless dreamer; Moraldo fantasizes about life in the city; and Leopoldo is an aspiring playwright.

Title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town
Hint: A naive greeting-card poet from Vermont inherits a fortune and is taken advantage of by cynical New Yorkers.
Description: Longfellow ___ lives in a small town, leading a small town kind of life. When a relative dies and leaves ___ a fortune, Longfellow moves to the big city where he becomes an instant target for everyone. ___ outwits them all until Babe Bennett comes along. When small-town boy meets big-city girl anything can, and does, happen.

Title: Seven Chances
Hint: A stockbroker must marry by 7pm to inherit a fortune, and is chased by hundreds of brides.
Description: Struggling stockbroker Jimmie Shannon learns that, if he gets married by 7 p.m. on his 27th birthday -- which is today -- he'll inherit $7 million from an eccentric relative.

Title: Breaker Morant
Hint: Three Australian lieutenants are court-martialled for shooting prisoners in the Boer War.
Description: During the Boer War, three Australian lieutenants are on trial for shooting Boer prisoners. Though they acted under orders, they are being used as scapegoats by the General Staff, who hopes to distance themselves from the irregular practices of the war. The trial does not progress as smoothly as expected by the General Staff, as the defence puts up a strong fight in the courtroom.

Title: To the Forest of Firefly Lights
Hint: A girl lost in an enchanted woodland meets a mysterious masked boy she can never touch.
Description: One hot summer day a little girl gets lost in an enchanted forest of the mountain god where spirits reside. A young boy appears before her, but she cannot touch him for fear of making him disappear. And so a wondrous adventure awaits...

Title: Poetry
Hint: A grandmother in her sixties enrols in a verse-writing class as she struggles with dementia and a dark secret.
Description: A South Korean woman in her sixties enrolls in a ___ class as she grapples with her faltering memory and her grandson's appalling wrongdoing.

Title: Oasis
Hint: A young man released from prison falls for the disabled daughter of the man he killed.
Description: A young man released from prison visits the widow of the man he killed drunk-driving and becomes infatuated with his cerebral palsy-stricken daughter.

Title: Mamma Roma
Hint: A former prostitute tries to build a respectable life for her son in Rome.
Description: After years spent working as a prostitute in her Italian village, middle-aged ___ has saved enough money to buy herself a fruit stand so that she can have a respectable middle-class life and reestablish contact with the 16-year-old son she abandoned when he was an infant. But her former pimp threatens to expose her sordid past, and her troubled son seems destined to fall into a life of crime and violence.

Title: The Death of Mr. Lazarescu
Hint: An elderly man is shuttled between hospitals in Bucharest for one long night.
Description: After suffering terrible headaches and stomach cramps, Mr. Lăzărescu, a lonely 63 year-old man, calls for an ambulance, beginning one man’s hellish journey through Bucharest hospitals in search of proper medical care. As the night unfolds, his health starts to deteriorate fast.

Title: Diary of a Country Priest
Hint: An inexperienced, sickly young curate struggles to win over a hostile rural French parish.
Description: An inexperienced, sickly ___ shows up in the rural French community of Ambricourt, where he joins the community's clergy. But the locals don't take kindly to the ___, and his ascetic ways and unsociable demeanor make him an outcast. During Bible studies at the nearby girls school, he is continually mocked by his students. Then his attempt to intervene in a family feud backfires into a scandal.

Title: Good Morning
Hint: Two boys go on a silence strike to get their parents to buy a TV.
Description: A lighthearted take on director Yasujiro Ozu’s perennial theme of the challenges of inter­generational relationships, ___ tells the story of two young boys who stop speaking in protest after their parents refuse to buy a television set.

Title: My Night at Maud's
Hint: A devout Catholic engineer spends a long evening talking with a divorced woman in a snowy French town.
Description: The Catholic Jean-Louis runs into an old friend, the Marxist Vidal, in Clermont-Ferrand around Christmas. Vidal introduces Jean-Louis to the modestly libertine, recently divorced ___ and the three engage in conversation on religion, atheism, love, morality and Blaise Pascal's life and writings on philosophy, faith and mathematics. Jean-Louis ends up spending a night at ___.

Title: Stray Dog
Hint: A young Tokyo detective searches the city's sweltering underworld for his stolen gun.
Description: A bad day gets worse for young detective Murakami when a pickpocket steals his gun on a hot, crowded bus. Desperate to right the wrong, he goes undercover, scavenging Tokyo’s sweltering streets for the ___ whose desperation has led him to a life of crime. With each step, cop and criminal’s lives become more intertwined and the investigation becomes an examination of Murakami’s own dark side.

Title: Monsieur Verdoux
Hint: A charming banker marries and murders rich widows to support his family.
Description: The film is about an unemployed banker, Henri ___, and his sociopathic methods of attaining income. While being both loyal and competent in his work, ___ has been laid-off. To make money for his wife and child, he marries wealthy widows and then murders them. His crime spree eventually works against him when two particular widows break his normal routine.

Title: Germany Year Zero
Hint: A twelve-year-old boy is left to fend for his family in the ruins of post-war Berlin.
Description: In the ruins of post-WWII Berlin, a twelve-year-old boy is left to his own devices in order to help provide for his family.

Title: Interstella 5555: The 5tory of the 5ecret 5tar 5ystem
Hint: Four alien musicians are kidnapped and brought to Earth, in an anime set to a French house album.
Description: Four talented alien musicians are kidnapped by a record producer who disguises them as humans. Shep, a space pilot in love with bass player Stella, follows them to Earth. Reprogrammed to forget their real identities and renamed The Crescendolls, the group quickly becomes a huge success playing soulless corporate pop.

Title: Vicky Donor
Hint: A man is recruited by a fertility doctor to donate his sperm.
Description: A man is brought in by an infertility doctor to supply him with his sperm, where he becomes the biggest sperm ___ for his clinic.

Title: Boruto: Naruto the Movie
Hint: The son of a legendary ninja leader joins an exam to prove himself.
Description: The spirited ___ Uzumaki, son of Seventh Hokage ___, is a skilled ninja who possesses the same brashness and passion his father once had. However, the constant absence of his father, who is busy with his Hokage duties, puts a damper on ___ fire. He ends up meeting his father's friend Sasuke, and requests to become... his apprentice!? The curtain on the story of the new generation rises!

Title: In This Corner (and Other Corners) of the World
Hint: A young bride in wartime Japan draws her way through daily life near Hiroshima.
Description: Japan, 1943, during World War II. Young Suzu leaves her village near Hiroshima to marry and live with her in-laws in Kure, a military harbor. Her creativity to overcome deprivation quickly makes her indispensable at home. Inhabited by an ancestral wisdom, Suzu impregnates the simple gestures of everyday life with poetry and beauty.

Title: Secret Superstar
Hint: A teenage singer in an abusive home becomes a YouTube star wearing a burqa.
Description: A talented teenage singer-songwriter living amid domestic abuse becomes a YouTube sensation after a video in which she hides her identity goes viral.

Title: Our Hospitality
Hint: A young man falls in love with a girl whose family has a long feud with his, in a silent comedy.
Description: A young man falls for a young woman on his trip home; unbeknownst to him, her family has vowed to kill every member of his family.

Title: Fury
Hint: A battle-hardened sergeant commands a tank crew deep in Nazi Germany in April 1945.
Description: April, 1945. As the Allies make their final push in the European Theatre, a battle-hardened army sergeant named Wardaddy commands a Sherman tank and her five-man crew on a deadly mission behind enemy lines. Outnumbered and outgunned, and with a rookie soldier thrust into their platoon, Wardaddy and his men face overwhelming odds in their heroic attempts to strike at the heart of Nazi Germany.

Title: The Island
Hint: A man discovers he is a clone being raised for spare parts.
Description: In 2019, Lincoln Six-Echo is a resident of a seemingly "Utopian" but contained facility. Like all of the inhabitants of this carefully-controlled environment, Lincoln hopes to be chosen to go to The ___ — reportedly the last uncontaminated location on the planet. But Lincoln soon discovers that everything about his existence is a lie.

Title: Nayak: The Real Hero
Hint: A TV reporter gets the chance to be chief minister for a day.
Description: Shivajirao, a TV reporter, gets a chance to be the Chief Minister of Maharashtra for a day after being challenged by incumbent Chief Minister Balraj Chauhan. After his one-day stint turns out to be a huge success, his life spirals out of control and he is embroiled in political intrigue.

Title: Le Corbeau
Hint: A doctor is the target of poison-pen letters in a French town.
Description: Remy Germain is a doctor in a French town who becomes the focus of a vicious smear campaign, as letters accusing him of having an affair and performing unlawful abortions are mailed to village leaders. The mysterious writer, who signs each letter as "___" (The Raven) soon targets the whole town, exposing everyone's dark secrets.

Title: Lovelorn
Hint: A man questions his relationship with his partner as he begins to act differently.
Description: A poignant exploration of the aftermath of a shattered relationship and the internal struggle to move forward.

Title: Kabadayi
Hint: A retired Istanbul tough guy returns to his old ways to protect his long-lost daughter.
Description: Ali Osman is a former bully of city of Istanbul. But lately he gives up bully and starts to operate a synthetic pitch. He often meets his old friends, former bullies, too. One day Ali Osman receives a news which is related with his previous passionate life. Then the whole action stats as a chain of events.

Title: Son of the Bride
Hint: A 42-year-old restaurant owner has a crisis while his father wants to marry his mother in church.
Description: At age 42, Rafael Belvedere is having a crisis. He lives in the shadow of his father, he feels guilty about rarely visiting his aging mother, his ex-wife says he doesn't spend enough time with their daughter and he has yet to make a commitment to his girlfriend. At his lowest point, a minor heart attack reunites him with Juan Carlos, a childhood friend, who helps Rafael to reconstruct his past.

Title: Hindi Medium

Description: Mita and Raj Batra, an affluent couple from Delhi’s Chandni Chowk, are grappling with getting their daughter admission into an English ___ school. But there is one big problem. Their zubaan is ___, and the elitist snobs won’t let the ___ speaking hoi-polloi fit in.

Title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.

Title: Lakshya

Description: An aimless, jobless, irresponsible grown man joins the army and matures into a battlefield hero.

Title: Kai Po Che!

Title: Joji

Description: ___, an engineering dropout and the youngest son of a rich family lives with his aspirations of becoming super wealthy. Driven by greed and blind ambition, he decides to execute his plans following an unexpected event in the family.

Title: The Road Home
Country: China, Hong Kong, United States of America

Description: Prompted by the death of his father and the grief of his mother, a man recalls the story of how they met in flashback.

Title: Gangaajal

Description: An honest Superintendent of Police, IPS Amit Kumar, is assigned to a crime infested town to reduce its crime rates. There, he soon learns that cleaning up the town also means confronting the corruption among police and politicians.

Title: Goodachari
Hint: The son of a former spy joins a secret agency to fight terrorists.
Description: Gopi, is the son of an ex-RAW agent Raghuveer. Brought up by his uncle Sathya, he wants to be an agent just like his father and uncle. But Satya wants him to lead a normal life and not be killed like his father was. What happens in Gopi’s life that turns everything upside down?

Title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young wizard is mysteriously entered into a dangerous magical tournament with older students.
Description: When his name emerges from the ___, Harry ___ becomes a competitor in a grueling battle for glory among three wizarding schools. Signs of Voldemort's return emerge as Harry's friends help him prepare for the Triwizard Tournament.

Title: The Whale
Hint: A reclusive, obese English teacher attempts to reconnect with his estranged teenage daughter.
Description: A reclusive English teacher suffering from severe obesity attempts to reconnect with his estranged teenage daughter for one last chance at redemption.

Title: The Goonies
Hint: A group of kids find a treasure map and set off to find a pirate's lost fortune.
Description: Young teen Mikey Walsh and his friends set off on a quest to find Pirate One-Eyed Willie's treasure in hopes of saving their homes from demolition. However, on their quest to find the treasure, they run into a family of recently escaped criminals, determined to capture the kids and reach the treasure first.

Title: Wind River

Title: Kingsman: The Secret Service

Description: The story of a super-secret spy organization that recruits an unrefined but promising street kid into the agency's ultra-competitive training program just as a global threat emerges from a twisted tech genius.

Title: The Banshees of Inisherin
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: Two lifelong friends find themselves at an impasse when one abruptly ends their relationship, with alarming consequences for both of them.

Title: Aftersun

Description: Sophie reflects on the shared joy and private melancholy of a holiday she took with her father twenty years earlier. Memories fill the gaps between camcorder footages as she tries to reconcile the father she knew with the troubled man she didn't.

Title: Halloween

Description: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on ___ Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.

Title: Ocean's Eleven
Hint: A suave ex-con gathers a crew of specialists to rob three Las Vegas casinos at once.
Description: Less than 24 hours into his parole, charismatic thief Danny ___ is already rolling out his next plan: In one night, Danny's hand-picked crew of specialists will attempt to steal more than $150 million from three Las Vegas casinos. But to score the cash, Danny risks his chances of reconciling with ex-wife, Tess.

Title: The Hangover
Hint: Three friends wake up after a bachelor party in Las Vegas with no memory and a missing groom.
Description: When three friends finally come to after a raucous night of bachelor-party revelry, they find a baby in the closet and a tiger in the bathroom. But they can't seem to locate their best friend, Doug – who's supposed to be tying the knot. Launching a frantic search for Doug, the trio perseveres through a nasty ___ to try to make it to the church on time.

Title: Sicario

Description: An idealistic FBI agent is enlisted by a government task force to aid in the escalating war against drugs at the border area between the U.S. and Mexico.

Title: Coraline
Hint: An 11-year-old girl discovers a parallel world with a sinister "Other Mother".
Description: Wandering her rambling old house in her boring new town, 11-year-old ___ discovers a hidden door to a strangely idealized version of her life. In order to stay in the fantasy, she must make a frighteningly real sacrifice.

Title: The Game
Hint: A wealthy banker receives a mysterious birthday gift: a live-action experience that takes over his life.
Description: In honor of his birthday, San Francisco banker Nicholas Van Orton, a financial genius and a cold-hearted loner, receives an unusual present from his younger brother, Conrad: a gift certificate to play a unique kind of ___. In nary a nanosecond, Nicholas finds himself consumed by a dangerous set of ever-changing rules, unable to distinguish where the charade ends and reality begins.

Title: Zodiac
Hint: A cartoonist becomes obsessed with identifying a serial killer who taunts the police.
Description: Over the course of a decade, editors of the San Francisco Chronicle entice themselves in the murders of the ___ Killer. However, as time runs its course, interest in the case dwindles in the eyes of the professionals. The Killer stops interacting with the public. However, believing he has the answers, an amateur cartoonist from the initial sightings races against time to prevent what he believes is another murder.

Title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Three young wizards go on the run, hunting the dark lord's hidden fragments of soul.
Description: Harry, Ron and Hermione walk away from their last year at Hogwarts to find and destroy the remaining Horcruxes, putting an end to Voldemort's bid for immortality. But with Harry's beloved Dumbledore dead and Voldemort's unscrupulous Death Eaters on the loose, the world is more dangerous than ever.

Title: When Harry Met Sally...
Hint: Two friends spend years debating whether men and women can be just friends.
Description: Sex always gets in the way of friendships between men and women. At least, that's what Harry Burns believes. So when Harry meets ___ Albright and a deep friendship blossoms between them, Harry's determined not to let his attraction to ___ destroy it.

Title: Man on Fire
Country: Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States of America, Mexico

Description: Jaded ex-CIA operative John Creasy reluctantly accepts a job as the bodyguard for a 10-year-old girl in Mexico City. They clash at first, but eventually bond, and when she's kidnapped he's consumed by fury and will stop at nothing to save her life.

Title: Lost in Translation
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An aging movie star and a young neglected wife form a bond in a Tokyo hotel.
Description: Two lost souls visiting Tokyo -- the young, neglected wife of a photographer and a washed-up movie star shooting a TV commercial -- find an odd solace and pensive freedom to be real in each other's company, away from their lives in America.

Title: Ex Machina
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A coder is invited to evaluate the human qualities of a female humanoid AI.
Description: Caleb, a coder at the world's largest internet company, wins a competition to spend a week at a private mountain retreat belonging to Nathan, the reclusive CEO of the company.

Title: Blue Is the Warmest Colour
Hint: A teenage girl in France falls in love with an older, azure-haired art student.
Description: Adèle's life is changed when she meets Emma, a young woman with ___ hair, who will allow her to discover desire, to assert herself as a woman and as an adult. In front of others, Adele grows, seeks herself, loses herself, finds herself.

Title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
Hint: A secret agent and his team race against time after a plutonium deal goes wrong.
Description: When an IMF ___ ends badly, the world is faced with dire consequences. As Ethan Hunt takes it upon himself to fulfill his original briefing, the CIA begin to question his loyalty and his motives. The IMF team find themselves in a race against time, hunted by assassins while trying to prevent a global catastrophe.

Title: Airplane!
Hint: An ex-fighter pilot must take control of an airliner when the crew falls ill, in a parody.
Description: An ex-fighter pilot forced to take over the controls of an airliner when the flight crew succumbs to food poisoning.

Title: Home Alone
Hint: An 8-year-old left behind on Christmas defends his house from two burglars.
Description: Eight-year-old Kevin McCallister makes the most of the situation after his family unwittingly leaves him behind when they go on Christmas vacation. When thieves try to break into his home, he puts up a fight like no other.

Title: Black Hawk Down
Hint: US Rangers and Delta Force are trapped in Mogadishu after their helicopters are shot from the sky.
Description: When U.S. Rangers and an elite Delta Force team attempt to kidnap two underlings of a Somali warlord, their Black ___ helicopters are shot down, and the Americans suffer heavy casualties, facing intense fighting from the militia on the ground.

Title: Brokeback Mountain
Hint: Two cowboys who meet herding sheep in 1960s Wyoming develop a lifelong secret romance.
Description: In 1960s Wyoming, two men develop a strong emotional and sexual relationship that endures as a lifelong connection complicating their lives as they get married and start families of their own.

Title: 500 Days of Summer
Hint: A hopeless romantic greeting card writer looks back on his failed relationship.
Description: Tom, greeting-card writer and hopeless romantic, is caught completely off-guard when his girlfriend, Summer, suddenly dumps him. He reflects on their ___ days together to try to figure out where their love affair went sour, and in doing so, Tom rediscovers his true passions in life.

Title: Primal Fear
Hint: A defence attorney takes the case of an altar boy accused of murdering a bishop.
Description: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.

Title: The Boy in the Striped Pajamas
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The son of a Nazi commandant befriends a Jewish boy behind the fence of a concentration camp.
Description: When his family moves from their home in Berlin to a strange new house in Poland, young Bruno befriends Shmuel, a boy who lives on the other side of the fence where everyone seems to be wearing ___. Unaware of Shmuel's fate as a Jewish prisoner or the role his own Nazi father plays in his imprisonment, Bruno embarks on a dangerous journey inside the camp's walls.

Title: Training Day

Description: On his first day on the job as a narcotics officer, a rookie cop works with a rogue detective who isn't what he appears.

Title: Tangled
Hint: A girl with magical long hair escapes her tower with a charming thief.
Description: Feisty teenager Rapunzel, who has long and magical hair, wants to go and see sky lanterns on her eighteenth birthday, but she's bound to a tower by her overprotective mother. She strikes a deal with Flynn Rider, a charming wanted thief, and the duo set off on an action-packed escapade.

Title: And Your Mother Too
Hint: Two teenage boys and an older woman go on a road trip to find a secret beach in Mexico.
Description: In Mexico, two teenage boys and an attractive older woman embark on a road trip and learn a thing or two about life, friendship, sex, and each other.

Title: The Last of the Mohicans

Description: In war-torn colonial America, in the midst of a bloody battle between British, the French and Native American allies, the aristocratic daughter of a British Colonel and her party are captured by a group of Huron warriors. Fortunately, a group of three Mohican trappers comes to their rescue.

Title: The Name of the Rose
Hint: A Franciscan friar and his young apprentice investigate a string of murders in a medieval abbey's labyrinthine library.
Description: 14th-century Franciscan monk William of Baskerville and his young novice arrive at a conference to find that several monks have been murdered under mysterious circumstances. To solve the crimes, William must rise up against the Church's authority and fight the shadowy conspiracy of monastery monks using only his intelligence; which is considerable.

Title: A Few Good Men
Hint: A cocky Navy lawyer defends two Marines accused of killing a fellow soldier at Guantanamo Bay, and confronts a colonel.
Description: When cocky military lawyer Lt. Daniel Kaffee and his co-counsel, Lt. Cmdr. JoAnne Galloway, are assigned to a murder case, they uncover a hazing ritual that could implicate high-ranking officials such as shady Col. Nathan Jessep.

Title: Blue Velvet
Hint: A college student finds a severed ear in a field and is drawn into a small town's dark, twisted underworld.
Description: The discovery of a severed human ear found in a field leads a young man on an investigation related to a beautiful, mysterious nightclub singer and a group of psychopathic criminals who have kidnapped her child.

Title: The Boondock Saints
Hint: Two devout Irish-Catholic brothers in Boston become vigilantes, killing mobsters on what they believe is God's mission.
Description: Tired of the crime overrunning the streets of Boston, Irish Catholic twin brothers Conner and Murphy are inspired by their faith to cleanse their hometown of evil with their own brand of zealous vigilante justice. As they hunt down and kill one notorious gangster after another, they become controversial folk heroes in the community.

Title: Deliverance
Hint: Four city men on a canoe trip down a Georgia river are terrorised by hostile mountain men.
Description: Intent on seeing the Cahulawassee River before it's turned into one huge lake, outdoor fanatic Lewis Medlock takes his friends on a river-rafting trip they'll never forget into the dangerous American back-country.

Title: Blazing Saddles
Hint: A Black sheriff is appointed to a racist frontier town to sabotage a railroad, in a raucous Western spoof.
Description: A town—where everyone seems to be named Johnson—stands in the way of the railroad. In order to grab their land, robber baron Hedley Lamarr sends his henchmen to make life in the town unbearable. After the sheriff is killed, the town demands a new sheriff from the Governor, so Hedley convinces him to send the town the first black sheriff in the west.

Title: First Blood
Country: United States of America, Netherlands Antilles
Hint: A Vietnam veteran harassed by a small-town sheriff unleashes his guerrilla skills in the Pacific Northwest woods.
Description: When former Green Beret John Rambo is harassed by local law enforcement and arrested for vagrancy, he is forced to flee into the mountains and wage an escalating one-man war against his pursuers.

Title: Silver Linings Playbook
Hint: A man fresh out of a mental hospital forms a dance partnership with a grieving widow.
Description: After losing his job and wife, and spending time in an institution, a former teacher winds up living with his parents. He wants to rebuild his life and reconcile with his wife, but his father would be happy if he shared his obsession with the Philadelphia Eagles.

Title: Suzume

Description: ___, 17, lost her mother as a little girl. On her way to school, she meets a mysterious young man. But her curiosity unleashes a calamity that endangers the entire population of Japan, and so ___ embarks on a journey to set things right.

Title: X-Men: First Class

Description: Before Charles Xavier and Erik Lensherr took the names Professor X and Magneto, they were two young men discovering their powers for the first time. Before they were arch-enemies, they were closest of friends, working together with other mutants (some familiar, some new), to stop the greatest threat the world has ever known.

Title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
Hint: A fading actor once famous for playing a superhero tries to revive his career with a Broadway play.
Description: A fading actor best known for his portrayal of a popular superhero attempts to mount a comeback by appearing in a Broadway play. As opening night approaches, his attempts to become more altruistic, rebuild his career, and reconnect with friends and family prove more difficult than expected.

Title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
Hint: A young man in a small Iowa town cares for his obese mother and his mentally disabled younger brother.
Description: ___ is a small-town young man with a lot of responsibility. Chief among his concerns are his mother, who is so overweight that she can't leave the house, and his mentally impaired younger brother, Arnie, who has a knack for finding trouble. Settled into a job at a grocery store and an ongoing affair with local woman Betty Carver, ___ finally has his life shaken up by the free-spirited Becky.

Title: Crash
Hint: The lives of several Angelenos collide in a series of racially charged incidents over 36 hours.
Description: In post-Sept. 11 Los Angeles, tensions erupt when the lives of a Brentwood housewife, her district attorney husband, a Persian shopkeeper, two cops, a pair of carjackers and a Korean couple converge during a 36-hour period.

Title: Marcel the Shell with Shoes On
Hint: A one-inch-tall talking seashell with a single googly eye searches for his lost family, in a stop-motion mockumentary.
Description: ___ is an adorable one-inch-tall ___ who ekes out a colorful existence with his grandmother Connie and their pet lint, Alan. Once part of a sprawling community of shells, they now live alone as the sole survivors of a mysterious tragedy.

Title: The Dirty Dozen
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Twelve convicted soldiers are trained for a suicide mission behind enemy lines in WWII.
Description: 12 American military prisoners in World War II are ordered to infiltrate a well-guarded enemy château and kill the Nazi officers vacationing there. The soldiers, most of whom are facing death sentences for a variety of violent crimes, agree to the mission and the possible commuting of their sentences.

Title: The Lego Movie
Country: United States of America, Denmark, Australia
Hint: An ordinary construction-worker toy is mistaken for the chosen one who must save the universe.
Description: An ordinary ___ mini-figure, mistakenly thought to be the extraordinary MasterBuilder, is recruited to join a quest to stop an evil ___ tyrant from conquering the universe.

Title: Another Round
Hint: Four stagnant Danish teachers test the theory that a constant level of alcohol improves life.
Description: Four stagnant high school teachers decide to test out a theory that maintaining a constant level of intoxication will improve their overall lives.

Title: Gravity

Hint: Two astronauts are left stranded and spinning in orbit after debris destroys their shuttle.
Description: Dr Ryan Stone, an engineer on her first space mission, and Matt Kowalski, an astronaut on his final expedition, have to survive in space after they are hit by debris while spacewalking.

Title: Happiness
Hint: The lives of several dysfunctional New Jersey people intertwine in a dark comedy.
Description: The lives of several individuals intertwine as they go about their lives in their own unique ways, engaging in acts which society as a whole might find disturbing in a desperate search for human connection.

Title: O Brother, Where Art Thou?
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Three escaped convicts search for buried treasure in the 1930s Deep South, in a musical odyssey.
Description: In the deep south during the 1930s, three escaped convicts search for hidden treasure while a relentless lawman pursues them.

Title: Fried Green Tomatoes
Hint: A Southern housewife hears the story of two women's friendship from an elderly nursing home resident.
Description: Amidst her own personality crisis, a southern housewife meets an outgoing old woman who tells her the story of Idgie Threadgoode and Ruth Jamison, two young women who experienced hardships and love in 1920s Whistle Stop, Alabama.

Title: Donnie Brasco

Description: An FBI undercover agent infiltrates the mob and identifies more with the mafia life at the expense of his regular one.

Description: Woody has always been confident about his place in the world, devoted to taking care of his kid—whether that's Andy or Bonnie. But after Bonnie creates a reluctant new ___ called "Forky", a road trip adventure alongside old and new friends challenges everything Woody believes about loyalty, purpose, and what it truly means to be a ___.

Title: Argo
