Title: Who Framed Roger Rabbit

Title: Mr. Nobody

Title: As Good as It Gets

Description: A misanthropic author, a single mother and waitress, and a gay artist form an unlikely friendship after the artist is assaulted in a robbery.

Title: The Quiet Girl
Hint: A shy, neglected girl is sent to live with distant relatives on a farm in rural Ireland one summer and blossoms.
Description: A quiet, neglected girl is sent away from her dysfunctional family to live with relatives for the summer. She blossoms in their care, but in this house where there are meant to be no secrets, she discovers one.

Title: Gattaca
Hint: A man born with flawed genes poses as an elite to travel into space.
Description: Vincent is an all-too-human man who dares to defy a system obsessed with genetic perfection. He is an "In-Valid" who assumes the identity of a member of the genetic elite to pursue his goal of traveling into space with the ___ Aerospace Corporation.

Title: The Fault in Our Stars

Description: Despite the tumor-shrinking medical miracle that has bought her a few years, Hazel has never been anything but terminal, her final chapter inscribed upon diagnosis. But when a patient named Augustus Waters suddenly appears at Cancer Kid Support Group, Hazel's story is about to be completely rewritten.

Title: Evil Dead II
Hint: A man and his girlfriend find an ancient book in a remote cabin that unleashes demonic spirits, in a splatter-comedy sequel.
Description: Ash Williams and his girlfriend Linda find a log cabin in the woods with a voice recording from an archeologist who had recorded himself reciting ancient chants from "The Book of the Dead." As they play the recording an evil power is unleashed taking over Linda's body.

Title: Sense and Sensibility
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Two sisters with very different temperaments search for love after their father's death leaves them poor.
Description: The Dashwood sisters, sensible Elinor and passionate Marianne, learn that their prospects of marriage seem doomed by their family's sudden loss of fortune. After Henry Dashwood dies unexpectedly, his estate must pass on by law to his son. These circumstances leave Mr. Dashwood's wife and daughters without a home and with barely enough money to live on.

Title: Road to Perdition
Hint: A hitman and his son go on the run after the boy witnesses a murder in 1930s Illinois.
Description: Mike Sullivan works as a hit man for crime boss John Rooney. Sullivan views Rooney as a father figure, however after his son is witness to a killing, Mike Sullivan finds himself on the run in attempt to save the life of his son and at the same time looking for revenge on those who wronged him.

Title: Star Trek Into Darkness
Hint: A starship crew hunts a terrorist from within their own organisation who has a dark secret.
Description: When the crew of the Enterprise is called back home, they find an unstoppable force of terror from within their own organization has detonated the fleet and everything it stands for, leaving our world in a state of crisis. With a personal score to settle, Captain Kirk leads a manhunt to a war-zone world to capture a one man weapon of mass destruction.

Title: Naked
Hint: An unemployed, articulate drifter vents his rage on strangers as he wanders London at night.
Description: An unemployed Brit vents his rage on unsuspecting strangers as he embarks on a nocturnal London odyssey.

Title: Black Book

Description: Israel, 1956: Jewish teacher Rachel Stein rather unexpectedly meets an old friend at the kibbutz. In September 1944, Rachel's hiding place is bombed by Allied troops; she makes contact with a resistance member and joins a group of Jews to be smuggled across the Biesbosch to the freed South Netherlands.

Title: Sound of Metal

Description: ___ drummer Ruben begins to lose his hearing. When a doctor tells him his condition will worsen, he thinks his career and life is over. After being welcomed and accepted just as he is, Ruben must choose between his new normal and the life he once knew.

Title: The Bourne Supremacy

Description: A CIA operation to purchase classified Russian documents is blown by a rival agent, who then shows up in the sleepy seaside village where ___ and Marie have been living. The pair run for their lives and ___, who promised retaliation should anyone from his former life attempt contact, is forced to once again take up his life as a trained assassin to survive.

Title: The Eight Mountains

Description: An epic journey of friendship and self-discovery set in the breathtaking Italian Alps, The ___ follows over four decades the profound, complex relationship between Pietro and Bruno.

Title: The Magnificent Seven

Description: An oppressed Mexican peasant village hires seven gunfighters to help defend their homes.

Title: The French Connection

Description: Tough narcotics detective 'Popeye' Doyle is in hot pursuit of a suave French drug dealer who may be the key to a huge heroin-smuggling operation.

Title: My Dinner with Andre

Description: Two old friends meet for ___; as one tells anecdotes detailing his experiences, the other notices their differing worldviews.

Title: Bonnie and Clyde

Description: In the 1930s, bored European-American waitress ___ Parker falls in love with a European-American ex-con named ___ Barrow and together they start a violent crime spree through the country, stealing cars and robbing banks.

Title: The Color Purple
Hint: A Black woman in the American South endures decades of abuse but finds strength in a musical.
Description: A decades-spanning tale of love and resilience and of one woman's journey to independence. Celie faces many hardships in her life, but ultimately finds extraordinary strength and hope in the unbreakable bonds of sisterhood.

Title: Wreck-It Ralph
Hint: A video game villain wants to be a hero and leaves his game to win a medal.
Description: ___ is the 9-foot-tall, 643-pound villain of an arcade video game named Fix-It Felix Jr., in which the game's titular hero fixes buildings that ___ destroys. Wanting to prove he can be a good guy and not just a villain, ___ escapes his game and lands in Hero's Duty, a first-person shooter where he helps the game's hero battle against alien invaders.

Title: A Man Called Ove

Description: Despite being deposed as president of his condominium association, grumpy 59-year-old ___ continues to watch over his neighbourhood with an iron fist. Title: Dirty Harry
Hint: A tough San Francisco cop with a .44 Magnum hunts a sniper serial killer.
Description: When a madman dubbed 'Scorpio' terrorizes San Francisco, hard-nosed cop, Harry Callahan – famous for his take-no-prisoners approach to law enforcement – is tasked with hunting down the psychopath.

Title: Glengarry Glen Ross
Hint: A group of desperate real estate salesmen compete to keep their jobs.
Description: Times are tough at Premiere Properties. Shelley "the machine" Levene and Dave Moss are veteran salesmen, but only Ricky Roma is on a hot streak. The new ___ sales leads could turn everything around, but the front office is holding them back until these "losers" prove themselves. Then someone decides to take matters into his own hands, stealing the ___ leads and leaving everyone wondering who did it.

Title: Roma
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A housekeeper's quiet life with a middle-class family in 1970s Mexico City.
Description: In 1970s Mexico City, two domestic workers help a mother of four while her husband is away for an extended period of time.

Title: Sorcerer
Hint: Four desperate men drive trucks full of nitroglycerin through a jungle.
Description: Four men from different parts of the globe, all hiding from their pasts in the same remote South American town, agree to risk their lives transporting several cases of dynamite (which is so old that it is dripping unstable nitroglycerin) across dangerous jungle terrain.

Title: Philadelphia
Hint: A lawyer with AIDS is fired from his firm and sues with the help of a homophobic attorney.
Description: Two competing lawyers join forces to sue a prestigious law firm for AIDS discrimination. As their unlikely friendship develops, their courage overcomes the prejudice and corruption of their powerful adversaries.

Title: Apollo 13
Hint: Three astronauts must survive after an explosion cripples their spacecraft on the way to the Moon.
Description: The true story of technical troubles that scuttle the ___ lunar mission in 1970, risking the lives of astronaut Jim Lovell and his crew, with the failed journey turning into a thrilling saga of heroism. Drifting more than 200,000 miles from Earth, the astronauts work furiously with the ground crew to avert tragedy.

Title: Ray
Hint: The life of a blind soul music legend, from Florida poverty to stardom and addiction.
Description: Born on a sharecropping plantation in Northern Florida, ___ Charles went blind at seven. Inspired by a fiercely independent mom who insisted he make his own way, He found his calling and his gift behind a piano keyboard. Touring across the Southern musical circuit, the soulful singer gained a reputation and then exploded with worldwide fame when he pioneered coupling gospel and country together.

Title: Empire of the Sun
Hint: A British boy is separated from his parents and held in a Japanese prison camp.
Description: Jamie Graham, a privileged English boy, is living in Shanghai when the Japanese invade and force all foreigners into prison camps. Jamie is captured with an American sailor, who looks out for him while they are in the camp together.

Title: 3:10 to Yuma
Hint: A struggling rancher escorts a notorious outlaw to a train bound for prison.
Description: In Arizona in the late 1800s, infamous outlaw Ben Wade and his vicious gang of thieves and murderers have plagued the Southern Railroad. When Wade is captured, Civil War veteran Dan Evans, struggling to survive on his drought-plagued ranch, volunteers to deliver him alive to the "___", a train that will take the killer to trial.

Title: Flipped
Hint: A girl falls for a boy in second grade, and the story is told from both their perspectives.
Description: When Juli meets Bryce in the second grade, she knows it's true love. After spending six years trying to convince Bryce the same, she's ready to give up - until he starts to reconsider.

Title: Kung Fu Hustle
Hint: A wannabe gangster in 1940s Shanghai stumbles into a slum full of secret martial arts masters, in a cartoonish action comedy.
Description: It's the 1940s, and the notorious Axe Gang terrorizes Shanghai. Small-time criminals Sing and Bone hope to join, but they only manage to make lots of very dangerous enemies. Fortunately for them, ___ fu masters and hidden strength can be found in unlikely places. Now they just have to take on the entire Axe Gang.

Title: The Theory of Everything
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The story of a brilliant physicist with motor neurone disease and his first wife.
Description: The ___ is the extraordinary story of one of the world’s greatest living minds, the renowned astrophysicist Stephen Hawking, who falls deeply in love with fellow Cambridge student Jane Wilde.

Title: Being John Malkovich
Hint: A puppeteer finds a portal into a famous actor's mind.
Description: One day at work, unsuccessful puppeteer Craig finds a portal into the head of actor John ___. The portal soon becomes a passion for anybody who enters its mad and controlling world of overtaking another human body.

Title: Adaptation.
Hint: A screenwriter struggling to adapt a book about orchids writes himself into the script.
Description: Charlie Kaufman is a confused L.A. screenwriter overwhelmed by feelings of inadequacy, sexual frustration, self-loathing, and by the screenwriting ambitions of his freeloading twin brother Donald. While struggling to adapt "The Orchid Thief," by Susan Orlean, Kaufman's life spins from pathetic to bizarre.

Title: This Is England
Hint: A lonely boy finds a family among skinheads in 1980s Britain.
Description: A story about a troubled boy growing up in England, set in 1983. He comes across a few skinheads on his way home from school, after a fight. They become his new best friends, even like family. Based on experiences of director Shane Meadows.

Title: The Trial of the Chicago 7
Hint: Anti-war protesters face a politically charged conspiracy prosecution after the riots at the 1968 Democratic Convention.
Description: What was supposed to be a peaceful protest turned into a violent clash with the police. What followed was one of the most notorious trials in history.

Title: Never Look Away
Country: Germany, Italy, United States of America
Hint: A German artist who escaped East Germany is haunted by his past under the Nazis and the GDR.
Description: German artist Kurt Barnert has escaped East Germany and now lives in West Germany, but is tormented by his childhood under the Nazis and the GDR regime.

Title: Detachment
Hint: A substitute teacher works in a failing high school and with lost students.
Description: A chronicle of three weeks in the lives of several high school teachers, administrators and students through the eyes of substitute teacher, Henry Barthes. Henry roams from school to school, imparting modes of knowledge, but never staying long enough to form any semblance of sentient attachment.

Title: Serpico
Hint: An honest New York cop blows the whistle on rampant corruption in the force.
Description: New York cop Frank ___ blows the whistle on the rampant corruption in the force only to have his comrades turn against him.

Title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
Hint: A starship admiral faces a genetically engineered superman he exiled years ago, who wants revenge.
Description: The starship Enterprise and its crew is pulled back into action when old nemesis, ___, steals a top secret device called Project Genesis.

Title: Lucky Number Slevin
Country: Canada, Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A case of mistaken identity drags a man into a war between two crime bosses.
Description: ___ is mistakenly put in the middle of a personal war between the city’s biggest criminal bosses. Under constant watch, ___ must try not to get killed by an infamous assassin and come up with an idea of how to get out of his current dilemma.

Title: Paprika
Hint: A machine that lets therapists enter patients' dreams is stolen, unleashing chaos.
Description: When a machine that allows therapists to enter their patient's dreams is stolen, all hell breaks loose. Only a young female therapist can stop it and recover it before damage is done: ___.

Title: Belle de Jour
Hint: A beautiful bored housewife secretly works as a prostitute in the afternoons.
Description: Beautiful young housewife Séverine Serizy cannot reconcile her masochistic fantasies with her everyday life alongside dutiful husband Pierre. When her lovestruck friend Henri mentions a secretive high-class brothel run by Madame Anais, Séverine begins to work there during the day under the name ___. But when one of her clients grows possessive, she must try to go back to her normal life.

Title: Goldfinger
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A British secret agent investigates a gold-obsessed tycoon's plan to raid Fort Knox.
Description: Special agent 007 comes face to face with one of the most notorious villains of all time, and now he must outwit and outgun the powerful tycoon to prevent him from cashing in on a devious scheme to raid Fort Knox -- and obliterate the world's economy.

Title: The Wind Rises
Hint: A Japanese aviation engineer dreams of designing beautiful planes as war approaches.
Description: A lifelong love of flight inspires Japanese aviation engineer Jiro Horikoshi, whose storied career includes the creation of the A-6M World War II fighter plane.

Title: Billy Elliot
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A coal miner's son in 1984 County Durham secretly takes up ballet.
Description: County Durham, England, 1984. The miners' strike has started and the police have started coming up from Bethnal Green, starting a class war with the lower classes suffering. Caught in the middle of the conflict is 11-year old ___, who, after leaving his boxing club for the day, stumbles upon a ballet class and finds out that he's naturally talented. He practices with his teacher Mrs.

Title: Clerks
Hint: Two sharp-witted, slacker convenience store workers deal with bizarre customers during one long day in New Jersey.
Description: Convenience and video store ___ Dante and Randal are sharp-witted, potty-mouthed and bored out of their minds. So in between needling customers, the counter jockeys play hockey on the roof, visit a funeral home and deal with their love lives.

Title: The Great Beauty
Hint: An aging writer and socialite wanders the decadent nightlife of Rome, searching for the meaning he lost in his youth.
Description: Jep Gambardella has seduced his way through the lavish nightlife of Rome for decades, but after his 65th birthday and a shock from the past, Jep looks past the nightclubs and parties to find a timeless landscape of absurd, exquisite beauty.

Hint: The friendship between a landowner's son and a peasant across 20th-century Italy.
Description: The epic tale of a class struggle in twentieth century Italy, as seen through the eyes of two childhood friends on opposing sides.

Title: Hamlet
Hint: A Danish prince returns home to find his father murdered and his mother remarried.
Description: ___, Prince of Denmark, returns home to find his father murdered and his mother now marrying the murderer... his uncle. Meanwhile, war is brewing.

Title: Ordinary People
Hint: A family struggles to cope after the death of their eldest son.
Description: Beth, Calvin, and their son Conrad are living in the aftermath of the death of the other son. Conrad is overcome by grief and misplaced guilt to the extent of a suicide attempt. He is in therapy. Beth had always preferred his brother and is having difficulty being supportive to Conrad. Calvin is trapped between the two trying to hold the family together.

Title: Finding Neverland
Hint: A playwright meets a widow and her sons, who inspire his famous story.
Description: During a writing slump, playwright J.M. Barrie meets a widow and her four children, all young boys—who soon become an important part of Barrie’s life and the inspiration that lead him to create his masterpiece. Peter Pan.

Title: The Longest Day
Hint: The massive D-Day landings told from both Allied and German perspectives, in an all-star WWII epic.
Description: The retelling of June 6, 1944, from the perspectives of the Germans, US, British, Canadians, and the Free French. Marshall Erwin Rommel, touring the defenses being established as part of the Reich's Atlantic Wall, notes to his officers that when the Allied invasion comes they must be stopped on the beach. "For the Allies as well as the Germans, it will be the ___"

Title: The Vanishing
Hint: A man searches for his girlfriend who vanished at a petrol station three years earlier.
Description: Rex and Saskia, a young couple in love, are on vacation when they stop at a busy service station. Saskia is abducted in broad daylight and three years pass with no answers or closure surrounding her disappearance. Rex has nearly given up all hope when he suddenly begins receiving letters from her abductor.

Title: Malcolm X
Country: United States of America, Netherlands Antilles
Hint: The life of a controversial Black activist, from criminal to Nation of Islam leader.
Description: A tribute to the controversial black activist and leader of the struggle for black liberation. He hit bottom during his imprisonment in the '50s, he became a Black Muslim and then a leader in the Nation of Islam. His assassination in 1965 left a legacy of self-determination and racial pride.

Title: mother!
Hint: A couple's relationship is tested when uninvited guests arrive at their country house.
Description: A couple's relationship is tested when uninvited guests arrive at their home, disrupting their tranquil existence.

Title: Miller's Crossing
Hint: A cool-headed adviser plays two rival gangs against each other in a Prohibition city.
Description: Set in 1929, a political boss and his advisor have a parting of the ways when they both fall for the same woman.

Title: Fantasia
Hint: Classical music is set to imaginative animation, including a mouse who loses control of a sorcerer's magic.
Description: Walt Disney's timeless masterpiece is an extravaganza of sight and sound! See the music come to life, hear the pictures burst into song and experience the excitement that is ___ over and over again.

Title: Me and Earl and the Dying Girl
Hint: A high school senior who makes parody films befriends a classmate with leukaemia.
Description: Greg is coasting through senior year of high school as anonymously as possible, avoiding social interactions like the plague while secretly making spirited, bizarre films with ___, his only friend. But both his anonymity and friendship threaten to unravel when his mother forces him to befriend a classmate with leukemia.

Title: The Last Emperor
Hint: The life of China's final imperial ruler, from childhood to his time as a gardener.
Description: A dramatic history of Pu Yi, the last of the Emperors of China, from his lofty birth and brief reign in the Forbidden City, the object of worship by half a billion people; through his abdication, his decline and dissolute lifestyle; his exploitation by the invading Japanese, and finally to his obscure existence as just another peasant worker in the People's Republic.

Title: Run Lola Run
Hint: A young woman has 20 minutes to find 100,000 marks to save her boyfriend's life.
Description: ___ receives a phone call from her boyfriend Manni. He lost 100,000 DM in a subway train that belongs to a very bad guy. She has 20 minutes to raise this amount and meet Manni. Otherwise, he will rob a store to get the money. Three different alternatives may happen depending on some minor event along ___ run.

Title: The Quiet Man
Hint: An American boxer returns to his Irish birthplace and falls for a fiery woman.
Description: An American man returns to the village of his birth in Ireland, where he finds love and conflict.

Title: Open Your Eyes
Hint: A handsome man is disfigured in a car crash, and his life begins to blur with dreams.
Description: Handsome 25-year-old Cesar had it all -- a successful career, expensive cars, a swank bachelor's pad, and an endless string of beautiful and willing women -- until he is thrown into a strange psychological mystery after a car accident scars his face and lands him in prison.

Title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
Hint: Four foul-mouthed kids sneak into an R-rated movie, sparking a war between the US and Canada.
Description: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third graders of ___ sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance and Phillip, and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized.

Title: The Verdict
Hint: A washed-up lawyer takes on a medical malpractice case and finds redemption.
Description: Frank Galvin is a down-on-his-luck lawyer and reduced to drinking and ambulance chasing, when a former associate reminds him of his obligations in a medical malpractice suit by serving it to Galvin on a silver platter—all parties are willing to settle out of court.

Title: Badlands
Hint: A teenage girl and her older greaser boyfriend go on a killing spree across the 1950s American plains.
Description: An impressionable teenage girl from a dead-end town and her older greaser boyfriend embark on a killing spree in the South Dakota ___.

Title: Breathless
Hint: A small-time thief kills a policeman and hides out with an American girlfriend in Paris.
Description: A small-time thief steals a car and impulsively murders a motorcycle policeman. Wanted by the authorities, he attempts to persuade a girl to run away to Italy with him.

Title: The Man from Nowhere
Hint: A reclusive pawnshop owner goes on a rampage to rescue a young girl from organ traffickers.
Description: A reclusive pawnshop owner goes on a brutal rampage to rescue a young girl kidnapped by a criminal organization.

Title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
Hint: The residents of San Francisco are being replaced by emotionless alien duplicates.
Description: The residents of San Francisco are becoming drone-like shadows of their former selves, and as the phenomenon spreads, two Department of Health workers uncover the horrifying truth.

Title: Hedwig and the Angry Inch
Hint: A genderqueer East German rock singer tours with her band, telling her life story.
Description: Raised a boy in East Berlin, ___ undergoes a personal transformation in order to emigrate to the U.S., where she reinvents herself as an 'internationally ignored' but divinely talented rock diva, inhabiting a 'beautiful gender of one'.

Title: Short Cuts
Hint: Many loosely connected people cross paths in Los Angeles over a few days, ending in an earthquake.
Description: Many loosely connected characters cross paths in this film, based on the stories of Raymond Carver. Waitress Doreen Piggot accidentally runs into a boy with her car. Soon after walking away, the child lapses into a coma. While at the hospital, the boy's grandfather tells his son, Howard, about his past affairs. Meanwhile, a baker starts harassing the family when they fail to pick up the boy's birthday cake.

Title: Beasts of No Nation
Hint: A child soldier in a West African civil war is trained by a ruthless commandant.
Description: Based on the experiences of Agu, a child fighting in the civil war of a West African country. Follows Agu's journey as he's forced to join a group of soldiers. While he fears his commander and many of the men around him, his fledgling childhood has been brutally shattered by the war raging through his country, and he is at first torn between conflicting revulsion and fascination.

Title: Kubo and the Two Strings
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A boy with a magical shamisen must defeat the spirits of his past.
Description: ___ mesmerizes the people in his village with his magical gift for spinning wild tales with origami. When he accidentally summons an evil spirit seeking vengeance, ___ is forced to go on a quest to solve the mystery of his fallen samurai father and his mystical weaponry, as well as discover his own magical powers.

Title: Porco Rosso
Hint: A First World War flying ace cursed to look like a pig hunts sky pirates.
Description: In Italy in the 1930s, sky pirates in biplanes terrorize wealthy cruise ships as they sail the Adriatic Sea. The only pilot brave enough to stop the scourge is the mysterious ___, a former World War I flying ace who was somehow turned into a pig during the war.

Title: Breaking Away
Hint: Four working-class friends in Indiana enter a bicycle race against rich college kids.
Description: Dave, nineteen, has just graduated high school, with his three friends: the comical Cyril, the warm hearted but short-tempered Moocher, and the athletic, spiteful but good-hearted Mike. Now, Dave enjoys racing bikes and hopes to race the Italians one day, and even takes up the Italian culture, much to his friends' and parents' annoyance.

Title: Zulu
Hint: A small British garrison defends a mission station against thousands of warriors in 1879.
Description: In 1879, during the Anglo-___ War, man-of-the-people Lt. Chard and snooty Lt. Bromhead are in charge of defending the isolated and vastly outnumbered Natal outpost of Rorke's Drift from tribal hordes.

Title: Fantastic Planet
Hint: On an alien world, giant blue humanoids keep tiny humans as pets, until the humans rebel, in a surreal French animation.
Description: On the planet Ygam, the Draags, extremely technologically and spiritually advanced blue humanoids, consider the tiny Oms, human beings descendants of Terra's inhabitants, as ignorant animals. Those who live in slavery are treated as simple pets and used to entertain Draag children; those who live hidden in the hostile wilderness of the planet are periodically hunted and ruthlessly slaughtered as if they were vermin.

Title: Two Women
Hint: A widow and her teenage daughter flee wartime Rome to the countryside, where tragedy finds them.
Description: A young widow flees from Rome during WWII and takes her lonely twelve-year-old-daughter to her rural hometown but the horrors of war soon catch up with them.

Title: The Cure
Hint: A lonely boy befriends his neighbour, who has AIDS, and they set off down the Mississippi in search of a remedy.
Description: Erik, a loner, finds a friend in Dexter, an eleven-year-old boy with AIDS. They vow to find a ___ for AIDS together and save Dexter's life in an eventful summer.

Title: Waking Life
Hint: A young man drifts through a series of lucid dreams, in rotoscoped animation.
Description: ___ is about a young man in a persistent lucid dream-like state. The film follows its protagonist as he initially observes and later participates in philosophical discussions that weave together issues like reality, free will, our relationships with others, and the meaning of life.

Title: The Motorcycle Diaries
Country: Argentina, France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young Argentine medical student who will become a famous revolutionary travels across South America on a motorbike.
Description: Based on the journals of Che Guevara, leader of the Cuban Revolution. In his memoirs, Guevara recounts adventures he and best friend Alberto Granado had while crossing South America by ___ in the early 1950s.

Title: The African Queen
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A gin-drinking riverboat captain and a prim missionary sail down a dangerous river in WWI-era Africa to attack a German gunboat.
Description: At the start of the First World War, in the middle of Africa’s nowhere, a gin soaked riverboat captain is persuaded by a strong-willed missionary to go down river and face-off a German warship.

Title: The Magdalene Sisters
Hint: Three young Irish women are imprisoned in a laundry run by nuns.
Description: Three young Irish women struggle to maintain their spirits while they endure dehumanizing abuse as inmates of a ___ Asylum.

Title: Perfect Strangers
Hint: Friends at a dinner party agree to share all their phone messages.
Description: During a dinner, a group of friends decide to share whatever message or phone call they will receive during the evening, with unforeseen consequences.

Title: Happy Together
Hint: A gay couple from Hong Kong travels to Argentina to rekindle their relationship.
Description: A couple travels from Hong Kong to Argentina to revive their relationship but experience turbulence when both men's lives drift in separate directions.

Title: Hard Boiled
Hint: A gun-crazy cop and an undercover agent battle smugglers in a hospital.
Description: A cop who loses his partner in a shoot-out with gun smugglers goes on a mission to catch them. In order to get closer to the leaders of the ring he joins forces with an undercover cop who's working as a gangster hitman. They use all means of excessive force to find them.

Title: Taste of Cherry
Hint: A man drives around Tehran looking for someone to bury him after his suicide.
Description: A middle-aged Tehranian man, Mr. Badii is intent on killing himself and seeks someone to bury him after his demise. Driving around the city, the seemingly well-to-do Badii meets with numerous people, including a Muslim student, asking them to take on the job, but initially he has little luck.

Title: Purple Noon
Hint: A charming con man kills a rich friend and takes over his life.
Description: Tom Ripley is a talented mimic, moocher, forger and all-around criminal improviser; but there's more to Tom Ripley than even he can guess.

Title: The Lady Vanishes
Hint: A young woman on a train discovers that a kindly elderly governess has disappeared, and everyone denies she existed.
Description: On a train headed for England a group of travelers is delayed by an avalanche. Holed up in a hotel in a fictional European country, young Iris befriends elderly Miss Froy. When the train resumes, Iris suffers a bout of unconsciousness and wakes to find the old woman has disappeared.

Title: Frost/Nixon
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A British TV host interviews a disgraced former US president in a high-stakes battle of wits.
Description: For three years after being forced from office, ___ remained silent. But in summer 1977, the steely, cunning former commander-in-chief agreed to sit for one all-inclusive interview to confront the questions of his time in office and the Watergate scandal that ended his presidency.

Title: Night on Earth
Country: United States of America, Japan, France, Germany, United Kingdom
Hint: Five cab drivers pick up remarkable passengers in five cities around the world on the same evening.
Description: A quintet of cabbies in five cities and their remarkable fares on the same eventful night.

Title: Nebraska
Hint: An aging, confused father travels from Montana with his son to collect a sweepstakes prize he believes he's won.
Description: An aging, booze-addled father takes a trip from Montana to ___ with his estranged son in order to claim what he believes to be a million-dollar sweepstakes prize.

Title: The Caine Mutiny
Hint: A US Navy captain shows signs of mental instability during a storm.
Description: When a US Naval captain shows signs of mental instability that jeopardize his ship, the first officer relieves him of command and faces court martial for ___.

Title: When the Wind Blows
Hint: An elderly British couple prepare for a nuclear attack, in a devastating animated film.
Description: With the help of government-issued pamphlets, an elderly British couple build a shelter and prepare for an impending nuclear attack, unaware that times and the nature of war have changed from their romantic memories of World War II.

Title: Good Bye Lenin!
Hint: A son tries to hide the fall of the Berlin Wall from his mother, who has just come out of a coma.
Description: Alex Kerner's mother was in a coma while the Berlin wall fell. When she wakes up he must try to keep her from learning what happened (as she was an avid communist supporter) to avoid shocking her which could lead to another heart attack.

Title: Wait Until Dark
Hint: A blind woman is terrorised by con men looking for a doll stuffed with heroin.
Description: After a flight back home, Sam Hendrix returns with a doll he innocently acquired along the way. As it turns out, the doll is actually stuffed with heroin, and a group of criminals led by the ruthless Roat has followed Hendrix back to his place to retrieve it. When Hendrix leaves for business, the crooks make their move -- and find his blind wife, Susy, alone in the apartment.

Title: Black Narcissus
Hint: A group of nuns are sent to a remote Himalayan convent and are overcome by desire.
Description: A group of Anglican nuns, led by Sister Clodagh, are sent to a mountain in the Himalayas. The climate in the region is hostile and the nuns are housed in an odd old palace. They work to establish a school and a hospital, but slowly their focus shifts. Sister Ruth falls for a government worker, Mr. Dean, and begins to question her vow of celibacy. As Sister Ruth obsesses over Mr.

Title: The Double Life of Véronique
Hint: Two identical women, one in Poland and one in France, share a mysterious connection.
Description: ___ is a beautiful young French woman who aspires to be a renowned singer; Weronika lives in Poland, has a similar career goal and looks identical to ___, though the two are not related.

Title: Scarlet Street
Hint: A meek cashier and amateur painter falls for a con woman who sells his paintings under her name.
Description: Cashier and part-time starving artist Christopher Cross is absolutely smitten with the beautiful Kitty March. Kitty plays along, but she's really only interested in Johnny, a two-bit crook. When Kitty and Johnny find out that art dealers are interested in Chris's work, they con him into letting Kitty take credit for the paintings.

Title: The Joy Luck Club
Hint: Four Chinese-American women and their daughters share stories of their past in China and America.
Description: Through a series of flashbacks, four Chinese women born in America and their respective mothers born in feudal China explore their pasts.

Title: Cape Fear
Hint: A tattooed ex-con terrorises the family of the lawyer who defended him.
Description: Sam Bowden is a small-town corporate attorney. Max Cady is a tattooed, cigar-smoking, Bible-quoting, psychotic rapist. What do they have in common? 14 years ago, Sam was a public defender assigned to Max Cady's rape trial, and he made a serious error: he hid a document from his illiterate client that could have gotten him acquitted.

Title: Marty
Hint: A lonely Bronx butcher who lives with his mother falls for a plain, shy schoolteacher.
Description: ___, a butcher who lives in the Bronx with his mother is unmarried at 34. Good-natured but socially awkward he faces constant badgering from family and friends to get married but has reluctantly resigned himself to bachelorhood. ___ meets Clara, an unattractive school teacher, realising their emotional connection, he promises to call but family and friends try to convince him not to.

Title: When Marnie Was There
Hint: A lonely girl sent to the countryside befriends a mysterious girl in a marsh house.
Description: Upon being sent to live with relatives in the countryside due to an illness, an emotionally distant adolescent girl becomes obsessed with an abandoned mansion and infatuated with a girl who lives there - a girl who may or may not be real.

Title: The Broken Circle Breakdown
Hint: A banjo player and a tattoo artist's love is tested by their daughter's illness.
Description: The loss of their young daughter threatens to destroy the love and faith of two married musicians.

Title: A Man for All Seasons
Hint: A man of principle refuses to compromise with a king who wants a divorce.
Description: A depiction of the conflict between King Henry VIII of England and his Lord Chancellor, Sir Thomas More, who refuses to swear the Oath of Supremacy declaring Henry Supreme Head of the Church in England.

Title: Hell
Hint: In a future scorched by the sun, a group of survivors search for water.
Description: In 2016 the sun has turned the entire world into a scorched and barren wasteland. The humans who have survived are either resourceful or violent, and sometimes both. Marie, her little sister Leonie, and best friend Phillip, are in a car headed to the mountains - rumor has it there is water there. Along the way they meet Tom, a first-rate mechanic. But can they trust him?

Title: Dreams
Hint: Eight surreal vignettes based on the nightly visions of a legendary Japanese director.
Description: Eight visually rich vignettes drawn from Kurosawa’s own ___—fox weddings and vanished orchards, a soldier’s ghosts, a walk through Van Gogh’s canvases, nuclear nightmares, and a water-mill utopia—meditate on childhood, art, mortality, and humanity’s uneasy bond with nature.

Title: The Killers
Hint: An insurance investigator digs into the past of a boxer killed by two hitmen.
Description: Two hit men walk into a diner asking for a man called "the Swede". When the ___ find the Swede, he's expecting them and doesn't put up a fight. Since the Swede had a life insurance policy, an investigator, on a hunch, decides to look into the murder.

Title: The Little Prince
Hint: A girl's neighbour, an old aviator, tells her the story of a young royal from a tiny asteroid.
Description: Based on the best-seller book 'The ___', the movie tells the story of a little girl that lives with resignation in a world where efficiency and work are the only dogmas. Everything will change when accidentally she discovers her neighbor that will tell her about the story of the ___ that he once met.

Title: What's Up, Doc?
Hint: Four identical overnight bags get mixed up in a hotel in San Francisco.
Description: The accidental mix-up of four identical plaid overnight bags leads to a series of increasingly wild and wacky situations.

Title: Down by Law
Hint: A DJ, a pimp and an Italian tourist escape from jail in New Orleans.
Description: A disc jockey, a pimp and an Italian tourist escape from jail in New Orleans.

Title: The Experiment
Hint: Twenty men are chosen to play guards and inmates in a psychological study that quickly turns violent.
Description: 20 men are chosen to participate in the roles of guards and prisoners in a psychological study that ultimately spirals out of control.

Title: Key Largo
Hint: A hurricane traps a war veteran and a gangster in a Florida hotel.
Description: A hurricane swells outside, but it's nothing compared to the storm within the hotel at ___. There, sadistic mobster Johnny Rocco holes up - and holds at gunpoint hotel owner James Temple, his widowed daughter-in-law Nora, and ex-GI Frank McCloud.

Title: Raazi
Hint: An Indian spy is married to a Pakistani military officer during the 1971 war.
Description: An Indian spy is married to a Pakistani military officer during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971.

Title: The Purple Rose of Cairo
Studio: Jack Rollins & Charles H. Joffe Productions
Hint: A waitress escapes her dreary life by watching movies, until a character walks off the screen.
Description: Cecilia is a waitress in New Jersey, living a dreary life during the Great Depression. Her only escape from her mundane reality is the movie theatre. After losing her job, Cecilia goes to see 'The ___' in hopes of raising her spirits, where she watches dashing archaeologist Tom Baxter time and again.

Title: A Place in the Sun
Hint: A young social climber falls for an heiress but has a pregnant girlfriend.
Description: A young social climber wins the heart of a beautiful heiress but his former girlfriend's pregnancy stands in the way of his ambition.

Title: Adam's Apples
Hint: A neo-Nazi doing community service clashes with an endlessly optimistic priest.
Description: A neo-nazi sentenced to community service at a church clashes with the blindly devotional priest.

Title: 3 Women
Hint: A strange bond forms between two coworkers who share an apartment and a mind.
Description: Two co-workers, one a vain woman and the other an awkward teenager, share an increasingly bizarre relationship after becoming roommates.

Title: The Salesman
Hint: A couple forced out of their apartment move into a new one, where she is attacked.
Description: Forced out of their apartment due to dangerous works on a neighboring building, Emad and Rana move into a new flat in the center of Tehran. An incident linked to the previous tenant will dramatically change the young couple’s life.

Title: The Triplets of Belleville
Hint: An old woman and her dog search for her kidnapped grandson with a trio of old singers.
Description: When her grandson is kidnapped during the Tour de France, Madame Souza and her beloved pooch Bruno team up with the ___ Sisters—an aged song-and-dance team from the days of Fred Astaire—to rescue him.

Title: Splendor in the Grass
Hint: A fragile Kansas girl's love for a boy drives her to a breakdown.
Description: A fragile Kansas girl's unrequited and forbidden love for a handsome young man from the town's most powerful family drives her to heartbreak and madness.

Title: Missing
Hint: A teen uses technology to search for her mother who disappeared abroad.
Description: When her mother disappears while on vacation in Colombia with her new boyfriend, June’s search for answers is hindered by international red tape. Stuck thousands of miles away in Los Angeles, June creatively uses all the latest technology at her fingertips to try and find her before it’s too late. But as she digs deeper, her digital sleuthing raises more questions than answers...

Title: Evil
Hint: A teenage boy is sent to a brutal boarding school in 1950s Sweden.
Description: Stockholm, in the 1950s. Erik is expelled from the local school for getting into one brawl too many. To protect Erik from his violent stepfather’s reaction to his expulsion, Erik's mother arranges for Erik to spend a year at Stjärnsberg Boarding School, the only school willing to accept him.

Title: L'Avventura
Hint: A woman disappears on a boat trip to a remote island, and her lover and friend search.
Description: Claudia and Anna join Anna's lover, Sandro, on a boat trip to a remote volcanic island. When Anna goes missing, a search is launched. In the meantime, Sandro and Claudia become involved in a romance despite Anna's disappearance, though the relationship suffers from guilt and tension.

Title: Confessions
Hint: A grieving teacher seeks revenge on the students she believes killed her daughter.
Description: Devastated at the death of her four-year-old daughter, a grieving middle school teacher is horrified to discover that her students aren't as innocent as she thinks.

Title: L'Eclisse
Hint: A young translator in Rome ends one affair and drifts into another with a restless stockbroker, as their romance quietly fades.
Description: Vittoria is a beautiful literary translator living in Rome. After splitting from her writer boyfriend, Riccardo, Vittoria meets Piero, a lively stockbroker, on the hectic floor of the Roman stock exchange. Though Vittoria and Piero begin a relationship, it is not one without difficulties, and their commitment to one another is tested during an eclipse.

Title: My Darling Clementine
Hint: A lawman and his brothers stop in a frontier town and end up in a famous showdown at a corral.
Description: Three brothers stop off for a night in the town of Tombstone. The next morning they find one of their brothers dead and their cattle stolen. They decide to take revenge on the culprits.

Title: The Bear
Hint: An orphaned cub teams up with a huge male grizzly to dodge two hunters in the Canadian Rockies.
Description: An orphan ___ cub hooks up with an adult male as they try to dodge human hunters.

Title: Joint Security Area
Hint: Two North Korean soldiers are killed at the border, and a Swiss investigator uncovers a secret friendship across the line.
Description: Two North Korean soldiers are killed in the border ___ between North and South Korea, prompting an investigation by a neutral body. The sergeant is the shooter, but the lead investigator, a Swiss-Korean woman, receives differing accounts from the two sides.

Title: Fireworks
Hint: Two boys argue over whether exploding sky rockets look round or flat, as a magical orb lets one boy rewind a summer day.
Description: Moshimo, Japan. The annual ___ festival is about to take place and a group of schoolboys, arguing over whether they are round or flat when viewed from different angles, set out to find it out.

Title: How Green Was My Valley
Hint: The youngest son of a Welsh coal-mining family recalls his childhood as the community falls apart.
Description: Huw Morgan, the academically inclined youngest son in a proud family of Welsh coal miners, witnesses the tumultuous events of his young life during a period of rapid social change. At the dawn of the 20th-century, a miners' strike divides the Morgans: the sons demand improvements, and the father doesn't want to rock the boat.

Title: The Pawnbroker
Hint: A Holocaust survivor running a pawnshop in Harlem has lost all faith in humanity.
Description: A Jewish ___, a victim of Nazi persecution, loses all faith in his fellow man until he realizes too late the tragedy of his actions.

Title: Jules and Jim
Hint: Two friends love the same free-spirited woman across many years.
Description: In the carefree days before World War I, introverted Austrian author ___ strikes up a friendship with the exuberant Frenchman ___ and both men fall for the impulsive and beautiful Catherine.

Title: After the Wedding
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A woman who runs an orphanage in India travels to New York for funding and discovers a family secret.
Description: Seeking funds for her orphanage in India, Isabelle travels to New York to meet Theresa, a wealthy benefactor. An invitation to attend a wedding ignites a series of events in which the past collides with the present while mysteries unravel.

Title: The Young Girls of Rochefort
Hint: Twin sisters in a seaside French town dream of finding love, in a colourful musical.
Description: In the seaside town of ___, twin sisters Delphine and Solange dream of love and artistic fulfillment beyond their quiet lives. As sailors, artists, musicians, and chance visitors pass through town during a weekend fair, a web of near-misses and romantic longing brings ideal partners tantalizingly close—without their realizing it.

Title: The Women
Hint: A happily married woman is talked into divorce by her catty friends when her husband has an affair, with an all-female cast.
Description: A happily married woman lets her catty friends talk her into divorce when her husband strays.

Title: Holiday
Hint: A freethinking man falls for a wealthy girl, but prefers her rebellious sister's outlook on life.
Description: Johnny Case, a freethinking financier, has finally found the girl of his dreams — Julia Seton, the spoiled daughter of a socially prominent millionaire — and she's agreed to marry him. But when Johnny plans a ___ for the two to enjoy life while they are still young, his fiancée has other plans & that is for Johnny to work in her father's bank!

Title: Love and Death
Hint: A cowardly Russian intellectual stumbles through the Napoleonic Wars and a plot to kill the emperor, in a philosophical spoof.
Description: In czarist Russia, a neurotic soldier and his distant cousin formulate a plot to assassinate Napoleon.

Title: The Muppet Christmas Carol
Hint: Kermit and friends tell the classic Dickens tale of a miser visited by three ghosts.
Description: A retelling of the classic Dickens tale of Ebenezer Scrooge, miser extraordinaire. He is held accountable for his dastardly ways during night-time visitations by the Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present and Future.

Title: The Unknown Soldier
Hint: An intimate portrait of a 92-year-old Soviet WWII veteran remembering his experiences of war and loss.
Description: An intimate investigation of World War II soviet veteran, 92-year-old Newsak Weis or as he prefers, just Uncle Nusya. The mission is to discover a real person under the armor of medals and the role model of a hero.

Title: Eega
Hint: A murdered man is reborn as a housefly and takes revenge on his killer.
Description: Nani is a flower decorator, madly in love with his neighbor Bindhu. He gets killed by the baddie, Sudeep, a powerful businessman. Nani comes back as a housefly to get his revenge.

Title: The Great Silence
Hint: A mute gunslinger defends outlaws against ruthless bounty hunters in a snowbound Western.
Description: A mute gunslinger fights in the defense of a group of outlaws and a vengeful young widow, against a group of ruthless bounty hunters.

Title: Dragon Ball Super: Broly
Hint: A powerful exiled warrior from a destroyed race arrives on Earth, and two heroes face his limitless rage.
Description: Earth is peaceful following the Tournament of Power. Realizing that the universes still hold many more strong people yet to see, Goku spends all his days training to reach even greater heights. Then one day, Goku and Vegeta are faced by a Saiyan called '___' who they've never seen before.

Title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
Hint: A teenage girl discovers she can leap back in time and uses it for trivial things.
Description: When 17-year-old Makoto Konno gains the ability to 'leap' backwards through time, she immediately sets about improving her grades and preventing personal mishaps. However, she soon realises that changing the past isn't as simple as it seems, and eventually, will have to rely on her new powers to shape the future of herself and her friends.

Title: In America
Country: Ireland, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An Irish immigrant family adjusts to life in Hell's Kitchen while grieving a lost son.
Description: A family of Irish immigrants adjusts to life on the mean streets of Hell's Kitchen while also grieving the death of a child.

Title: Twelve O'Clock High
Hint: An American general takes over a demoralised bomber unit in WWII England.
Description: In the early days of daylight bombing raids over Germany, General Frank Savage must take command of a 'hard luck' bomber group. Much of the story deals with his struggle to whip his group into a disciplined fighting unit in spite of heavy losses, and withering attacks by German fighters over their targets.

Title: The Turin Horse
Studio: Motion Picture Public Foundation of Hungary
Hint: A father and daughter's daily struggle in a remote farmhouse as a windstorm rages.
Description: A look at the monotonous daily struggle of a father and daughter in a windswept, desolate landscape. Over six days, their routine of eating boiled potatoes and tending a failing ___ crumbles, symbolizing a slow descent into darkness, emptiness, and the end of existence.

Title: Nightmare Alley
Hint: An ambitious carnival worker teams up with a psychiatrist to con wealthy people.
Description: An ambitious carnival man with a talent for manipulating people with a few well-chosen words hooks up with a female psychologist who is even more dangerous than he is.

Title: Always
Hint: The spirit of a dead pilot mentors a young flier who falls for his grieving girlfriend.
Description: The spirit of a recently deceased expert pilot mentors a newer pilot while watching him fall in love with the girlfriend that he left behind.

Title: The Breadwinner
Country: Canada, Ireland, Luxembourg, United States of America
Hint: A young girl in Taliban-ruled Afghanistan disguises herself as a boy to support her family.
Description: A headstrong young girl in Afghanistan, ruled by the Taliban, disguises herself as a boy in order to provide for her family.

Title: Bad Day at Black Rock
Hint: A one-armed war veteran arrives in a small desert town hiding a dark secret.
Description: One-armed war veteran John J. Macreedy steps off a train at the sleepy little town of Black Rock. Once there, he begins to unravel a web of lies, secrecy, and murder.

Title: Captain Blood
Hint: An Irish doctor wrongly convicted of treason is sold into slavery and becomes a swashbuckling pirate in the Caribbean.
Description: Dr. Peter Blood, unjustly convicted of treason and exiled from England, becomes a notorious pirate.

Title: Der blaue Engel
Hint: A prim professor falls for a nightclub singer and is ruined by his obsession.
Description: Prim professor Immanuel Rath finds some of his students ogling racy photos of cabaret performer Lola Lola and visits a local club, The Blue Angel, in an attempt to catch them there. Seeing Lola perform, the teacher is filled with lust, eventually resigning his position at the school to marry the young woman.

Title: Top Hat
Hint: A dancer pursues a model who thinks he is her friend's husband.
Description: Showman Jerry Travers is working for producer Horace Hardwick in London. Jerry demonstrates his new dance steps late one night in Horace's hotel room, much to the annoyance of sleeping Dale Tremont below. She goes upstairs to complain and the two are immediately attracted to each other. Complications arise when Dale mistakes Jerry for Horace.

Title: Zelig
Hint: A fake documentary about a man who can transform himself to resemble anyone around him.
Description: Fictional documentary about the life of human chameleon Leonard ___, a man who becomes a celebrity in the 1920s due to his ability to look and act like whoever is around him. Clever editing places ___ in real newsreel footage of Woodrow Wilson, Babe Ruth, and others.

Title: The Marriage of Maria Braun
Hint: A woman marries a soldier in the last days of WWII and becomes a successful businesswoman.
Description: ___ marries a young soldier in the last days of World War II, only for him to go missing in the war. She must rely on her beauty and ambition to navigate the difficult post-war years alone.

Title: The Past
Hint: A man returns to Paris to finalise his divorce and discovers his ex-wife's new life.
Description: After four years apart, Ahmad returns to his wife Marie in Paris in order to progress their divorce. During his brief stay, he cannot help noticing the strained relationship between Marie and her daughter Lucie. As he attempts to improve matters between mother and daughter Ahmad unwittingly lifts the lid on a long buried secret...

Title: Joyeux Noel
Country: Belgium, France, Germany, Romania, United Kingdom
Hint: On Christmas Eve 1914, soldiers from opposing sides call a truce in the trenches.
Description: France, 1914, during World War I. On Christmas Eve, an extraordinary event takes place in the bloody no man's land that the French and the Scots dispute with the Germans…

Title: Elmer Gantry
Hint: A charismatic con man joins a female evangelist on her revival tour.
Description: A charismatic charlatan begins a business — and eventually romantic — relationship with a roadside evangelist to sell religion to 1920s America. Based on Sinclair Lewis' novel of the same name.

Title: Sergeant York
Hint: A backwoods sharpshooter becomes a WWI hero despite being a conscientious objector.
Description: Alvin York a hillbilly sharpshooter transforms himself from ruffian to religious pacifist. He is then called to serve his country and despite deep religious and moral objections to fighting becomes one of the most celebrated American heroes of WWI.

Title: Last Year at Marienbad
Hint: At a lavish hotel, a man insists to a woman that they met the previous year.
Description: At a weekend gathering, a man tells a woman that they had spent time there together a year prior. But, the woman has no recollection whatsoever and is convinced that he is simply fabricating the encounter. The more he speaks about their activities the previous year however, the more compelling he becomes. The question remains however – did they meet previously or not?

Title: Vagabond
Hint: A young drifter's frozen body is found in a ditch, and her last weeks are reconstructed.
Description: Mona Bergeron is dead, her frozen body found in a ditch in the French countryside. From this, the film flashes back to the weeks leading up to her death. Through these flashbacks, Mona gradually declines as she travels from place to place, taking odd jobs and staying with whomever will offer her a place to sleep.

Title: A Thursday
Hint: A kindergarten teacher takes her 16 pupils hostage and makes shocking demands to the police and media.
Description: When a kindergarten teacher takes her 16 students hostage and makes a set of demands, it not only rattles the Mumbai police and the city but also sends shockwaves through the country and its leaders as the motive behind the hostage situation is unearthed.

Title: The Lady Eve
Hint: A con artist sets her sights on a naive millionaire snake expert on an ocean liner.
Description: It's no accident when wealthy Charles falls for Jean. Jean is a con artist with her sights set on Charles' fortune. Matters complicate when Jean starts falling for her mark. When Charles suspects Jean is a gold digger, he dumps her. Jean, fixated on revenge and still pining for the millionaire, devises a plan to get back in Charles' life.

Title: Corpus Christi
Hint: A juvenile delinquent poses as a priest in a small Polish town.
Description: A pious 20-year-old juvenile delinquent is sent to work at a sawmill in a small town; on arrival, he dresses up as a priest and accidentally takes over the local parish. The arrival of this young, charismatic preacher is an opportunity for the local community to begin the healing process after a tragedy that happened a year prior.

Title: Mon Oncle
Hint: A charming man prefers his messy old neighborhood to his sister's modern house.
Description: Genial, bumbling Monsieur Hulot loves his top-floor apartment in a grimy corner of the city, and cannot fathom why his sister's family has moved to the suburbs. Their house is an ultra-modern nightmare, which Hulot only visits for the sake of stealing away his rambunctious young nephew. Hulot's sister, however, wants to win him over to her new way of life, and conspires to set him up with a wife and job.

Title: The Edge of Heaven
Hint: Six German-Turkish lives cross paths across borders and grief.
Description: The lives of six German-Turkish immigrants are drawn together by circumstance: An old man and a prostitute forging a partnership, a young scholar reconciling his past, two young women falling in love, and a mother putting the shattered pieces of her life back together.

Title: Udta Punjab
Hint: A rock star, a migrant worker, a doctor and a cop are caught up in the drug epidemic sweeping a north Indian state.
Description: Drug abuse and the darker side of ___ rear their heads in the intense, interwoven tales of a policeman, a doctor, a migrant worker, and a rockstar.

Title: Ball of Fire
Hint: A group of professors writing an encyclopaedia take in a nightclub singer hiding from gangsters.
Description: A group of academics have spent years shut up in a house working on the definitive encyclopedia. When one of them discovers that his entry on slang is hopelessly outdated, he ventures into the wide world to learn about the evolving language. Here he meets Sugarpuss O’Shea, a nightclub singer, who’s on top of all the slang—and, it just so happens, needs a place to stay.

Title: Kapoor & Sons
Hint: Two estranged brothers return home to visit their ailing grandfather, and old family secrets surface.
Description: Returning home to visit their ill grandfather, two estranged brothers must confront their unresolved rivalry while their parents’ marriage frays.

Title: The Gunfighter
Hint: The fastest gun in the West tries to escape his reputation, but young challengers keep coming.
Description: The fastest gun in the West tries to escape his reputation.

Title: Intolerance
Hint: Four tales across history show how hatred and prejudice repeat themselves.
Description: The story of a poor young woman, separated by prejudice from her husband and baby, is interwoven with tales of ___ from throughout history.

Title: Mouchette
Hint: A young girl in rural France suffers constant humiliation from her family and neighbours.
Description: A young girl living in the French countryside suffers constant indignities at the hand of alcoholism and her fellow man.

Title: The Awful Truth
Hint: A divorcing couple tries to sabotage each other's new romances.
Description: Unfounded suspicions lead a married couple to begin divorce proceedings, whereupon they start undermining each other's attempts to find new romance.

Title: Mind Game
Genres: Animation, Romance, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Adventure
Hint: A loser with a crush on his childhood sweetheart has a bizarre afterlife experience, in an anime.
Description: Nishi is a loser who has a crush on his childhood girlfriend. After an encounter with the Japanese mafia, he journeys to heaven and back, and ends up trapped in an even more unlikely place.

Title: The Gospel According to St. Matthew
Hint: The life of Jesus told in a raw, documentary style.
Description: Along a rocky, barren coastline, Jesus begins teaching, primarily using parables. He attracts disciples; he's stern, brusque, and demanding. His parables often take on the powers that be, so he and his teachings come to the attention of the Pharisees, the chief priests, and elders. They conspire to have him arrested, beaten, tried, and crucified, just as he prophesied to his followers.

Title: Stroszek
Hint: A street musician, a prostitute and an old man emigrate from Berlin to Wisconsin.
Description: Bruno ___ is released from prison and warned to stop drinking. He has few skills and fewer expectations: with a glockenspiel and an accordion, he ekes out a living as a street musician. He befriends Eva, a prostitute down on her luck and they join his neighbor, Scheitz, an elderly eccentric, when he leaves Germany to live in Wisconsin.

Title: Rockstar
Hint: A college student seeks inspiration to become a rock star and finds heartbreak.
Description: College student Janardhan is a simpleton who desperately seeks inspiration for the musician inside him. Although heartbreak helps him reach his goal, it also leads him to self-destruction.

Title: Berserk: The Golden Age Arc II - The Battle for Doldrey
Hint: A mercenary band and its ambitious leader fight a decisive siege that will make or break his dream, in a dark anime.
Description: The Band of the Hawk and their enigmatic leader Griffith continue winning battle after battle as their prestige throughout the kingdom of Midland grows. But their latest task is one that has seen failure from everyone who has attempted it: the subjugation of the impenetrable fortress of ___.

Title: The Enigma of Kaspar Hauser
Hint: A man who spent his first 17 years locked in a cellar suddenly appears in a town.
Description: The film follows ___, who lived the first seventeen years of his life chained in a tiny cellar with only a toy horse to occupy his time, devoid of all human contact except for a man who wears a black overcoat and top hat who feeds him.

Title: Machuca
Hint: Two boys from opposite social classes become friends in Santiago in the months before the 1973 coup.
Description: Santiago, capital of Chile during the Marxist government of elected, highly controversial president Salvador Allende. Father McEnroe supports his leftist views by introducing a program at the prestigious "collegio" (Catholic prep school) St. Patrick to allow free admission of some proletarian kids. One of them is Pedro ___, slum-raised son of the cleaning lady in Gonzalo Infante's liberal-bourgeois home.

Title: The Official Story
Hint: A history teacher in Buenos Aires suspects her adopted daughter was taken from a political prisoner.
Description: Buenos Aires, Argentina, 1983. In the last and turbulent days of the military dictatorship, Alicia, a high school history teacher, begins to ask uncomfortable questions about the dark origins of Gaby, her adopted daughter.

Title: Kikujiro
Hint: A boy searches for his mother with the help of a grumpy man, in a Japanese road movie.
Description: Brash, loudmouthed and opportunistic, ___ is the unlikely companion for Masao who is determined to see the mother he has never met. The two begin a series of adventures which soon turns out to be a whimsical journey of laughter and tears with a wide array of surprises and unique characters along the way.

Title: Mephisto
Hint: A German stage actor sells his soul to the Nazis for success.
Description: A German stage actor finds unexpected success and mixed blessings in the popularity of his performance in a Faustian play as the Nazis take power in pre-WWII Germany. As his associates and friends flee or are ground under by the Nazi terror, the popularity of his character supercedes his own existence until he finds that his best performance is keeping up appearances for his Nazi patrons.

Title: Water
Hint: A child widow in 1930s India is sent to live in an ashram for widows.
Description: The year is 1938, and Mahatma Gandhi's groundbreaking philosophies are sweeping across India, but 8-year-old Chuyia, newly widowed, must go to live with other outcast widows on an ashram. Her presence transforms the ashram as she befriends two of her compatriots.

Title: Waterloo Bridge
Hint: A British officer and a ballerina meet during an air raid in WWI London and fall in love.
Description: On the eve of World War II, a British officer revisits ___ and recalls the young man he was at the beginning of World War I and the young ballerina he met just before he left for the front.

Title: Smiles of a Summer Night
Hint: A middle-aged lawyer, his young wife and their friends swap partners during a sultry weekend at a Swedish country estate.
Description: Early in the 20th century, middle-aged lawyer Fredrik Egerman and his young wife, Anne, have still not consummated their marriage, while Fredrik's son finds himself increasingly attracted to his new stepmother. To make matters worse, Fredrik's old flame Desiree makes a public bet that she can seduce him at a romantic weekend retreat where four couples convene, swapping partners and pairing off in unexpected ways.

Title: Three Wishes for Cinderella
Hint: A resourceful orphan receives a trio of enchanted hazelnuts that help her win a prince, in a snowy Norwegian fairy tale.
Description: ___, a resourceful and independent young girl, is a servant in her stepmother's house and confides in her closest friend the owl. When she comes across three magical acorns, she's granted a single wish for each one of them.

Title: The Second Mother
Hint: A housekeeper's daughter arrives and upsets her rich employers' world.
Description: After leaving her daughter Jessica in a small town in Pernambuco to be raised by relatives, Val spends the next 13 years working as a nanny to Fabinho in São Paulo. She has financial stability but has to live with the guilt of having not raised Jessica herself. As Fabinho’s university entrance exams approach, Jessica reappears in her life and seems to want to give her mother a second chance.

Title: A Letter to Three Wives
Hint: A note tells a trio of spouses that one of their husbands has run off with its author.
Description: A ___ is addressed to three ___ from their 'best friend', announcing that she's running away with one of their husbands – but she doesn't specify which one.

Title: City of Life and Death
Hint: The horrors of the fall of Nanjing in 1937 seen through many eyes.
Description: In 1937, during the height of the Second Sino-Japanese War, the Imperial Japanese Army has just captured Nanjing, then-capital of the Republic of China. What followed was known as the Nanking Massacre, or the Rape of Nanking, a six week period wherein tens of thousands of Chinese soldiers and civilians were killed.

Title: Ivan the Terrible, Part I
Hint: A young tsar faces betrayal as he consolidates power in medieval Russia.
Description: Set during the early part of his reign, ___ faces betrayal from the aristocracy and even his closest friends as he seeks to unite the Russian people.

Title: Blind Chance
Hint: A young man runs after a train, and three variations follow on how his life changes.
Description: Witek runs after a train. Three variations follow on how such a seemingly banal incident could influence the rest of Witek's life.

Title: Magadheera
Hint: A biker discovers he was a warrior in a past life and must save his love.
Description: A street-bike racer chances upon a woman and is struck by visions of a past life where they were both star-crossed lovers in a war-ridden kingdom 400 years ago, while the reincarnation of his romantic rival emerges with murderous intent.

Title: Rory O'Shea Was Here
Hint: A young man with cerebral palsy befriends a rebellious new resident at his care home.
Description: Michael is a 24-year-old who has cerebral palsy and long-term resident of the Carrigmore Residential Home for the Disabled, run by the formidable Eileen. His life is transformed when the maverick ___ O'___ moves in.

Title: Kolya
Hint: A Czech cellist marries a Russian woman for money and ends up caring for her son.
Description: After a fictitious marriage with a Russian emigrant, Cellisten Louka, a Czech man, must suddenly take responsibility for her son. However, it’s not long before the communication barrier is broken between the two new family members.

Title: Snitch
Country: United Arab Emirates, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A father goes undercover for the DEA to get his son out of prison.
Description: Construction company owner John Matthews learns that his estranged son, Jason, has been arrested for drug trafficking. Facing an unjust prison sentence for a first time offender courtesy of mandatory minimum sentence laws, Jason has nothing to offer for leniency in good conscience.

Title: Dear Frankie
Hint: A mother hires a stranger to pose as the father of her deaf son.
Description: Nine-year-old ___ and his single mum Lizzie have been on the move ever since ___ can remember, most recently arriving in a seaside Scottish town. Wanting to protect her deaf son from the truth that they've run away from his father, Lizzie has invented a story that he is away at sea on the HMS Accra.

Title: The Barber of Siberia
Hint: An American inventor seeks financing in Russia and falls for a mysterious woman.
Description: Douglas is a foreign entrepreneur, who ventures to Russia in 1885 with dreams of selling a new, experimental steam-driven timber harvester in the wilds of ___. Jane is his assistant.

Title: Nanban
Hint: Two college friends search for their brilliant, unconventional classmate who vanished after graduation.
Description: The plot of the film illustrates the embankment of two friends on a quest for a lost buddy, who was once an optimistic and successful student. On their journey, they recount their college life and special moments that the three shared up until their lost friend secretly parted ways after convocation.

Title: Bang Bang You're Dead
Hint: A troubled high school student fights back against bullies in a school play.
Description: A troubled and bullied high school student fights against judgement from his community after threatening to bomb the football team.

Title: Character
Hint: A kind man aspires to be a manga artist and witnesses a murder.
Description: A kind man aspires to become a manga writer, but villains and evil deeds do not come easily to him, for he has little experience or natural inclination for them. Things take a surprise turn when he comes across a family who were described as idealized that are no more. He uses the real-life situation for his work.

Title: The Butterfly's Dream
Hint: Two young poets with tuberculosis try to survive in a small Turkish town.
Description: In a small Turkish town, two young tuberculous poets try to survive while publishing their poems. As they both fall in love, their life would never be the same.

Title: Shall We Dance?
Hint: A bored, overworked estate lawyer secretly takes ballroom lessons after spotting a beautiful instructor in a studio window.
Description: A bored estate lawyer spots a beautiful woman in the window of a ballroom ___ studio. He secretly starts taking dancing lessons to be near her, and then over time discovers how much he loves dancing. His wife, meanwhile, has hired a private detective to find out why he has started coming home late smelling of perfume.

Title: Don
Hint: A lookalike replaces a captured crime boss to bring down his gang.
Description: DCP DeSilva sees a way to bring to justice the feared head of a criminal empire by recruiting a man named Vijay, who looks exactly like the crime boss. The ruse works too well, and soon Vijay finds his life in danger when DeSilva, the only one who knows his true identity, dies.

Title: Nerkonda Paarvai
Hint: Three young women are harassed and accused of a crime, and a lawyer defends them.
Description: When three young women are harassed and implicated in a crime they didn't commit, a bipolar lawyer sets out to help them clear their names and prove it to everyone that a woman's consent matters.

Title: Mr. India
Hint: A poor man who takes care of orphans discovers a device that makes him invisible.
Description: A poor but big-hearted man takes orphans into his home. After discovering his scientist father's invisibility device, he rises to the occasion and fights to save his children and all of India from the clutches of a megalomaniac.

Title: Guru
Hint: A villager rises from Bombay's streets to become a business tycoon.
Description: A villager, Gurukant Desai, arrives in Bombay in 1958, and rises from its streets to become the biggest tycoon in India.

Title: Rock On!!
Hint: Four college friends form a band, break up after failing to make it, and reunite years later in Mumbai.
Description: Aditya, Joe, Kedar and Rob form a rock band, but break up after they fail to make a success of it. They establish regular lives until they decide to reunite and take another shot at fulfilling their dreams.

Title: Geetha Govindam
Hint: A young college lecturer falls for a woman who misunderstands him after an accidental kiss on a bus.
Description: Vijay Govind, a young college lecturer who dreams of marriage falls for ___, a level-headed woman who's wary of strangers and isn't easy to convince. While things seem to go smoothly, Vijay makes a terrible mistake which not only derails any hope for his love story, but also potential repercussions with his family.

Title: Tabutta Rövasata
Hint: An unemployed homeless man steals cars and sleeps in them in Istanbul.
Description: Mahsun Supertitiz is an unemployed homeless man who steals cars at night so that he can sleep in a heated place during the winter. Mahsun lives in Rumelihisar, an old section of Istanbul, and makes ends meet by getting the local fishermen to help him. Mahsun loves the cars he robs, cleans and polishes them, and drives them through the streets of Rumelihisar during the daytime.

Title: Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!
Hint: A charming thief in custody reflects on his life of crime and the deprived childhood that led to it.
Description: Lovinder Singh, a thief now in custody and facing trial, reflects on his life of crime while the press reflect on how he managed to get away with so much before being arrested.

Title: Let's Sin
Hint: A former boxer turned imam gets caught up in neighborhood drama.
Description: Selman is a former boxer who once was interested in anthropology, an extraordinary imam who now works in a mosque. One day, while praying in the mosque, gunshots are echoed. One of the people inside collapses and dies. The police come to the scene and collect the first evidence and start the investigation process.

Title: Thou Gild'st the Even
Hint: In a small Anatolian town, villagers with various magical powers live their lives.
Description: In a small town in Anatolia, whose inhabitants possess various supernatural powers but still have to deal with ordinary problems, Cemal helps out in his father’s barbershop and, in his free time, acts as a football referee.

Title: Mankatha
Hint: A suspended cop helps four men steal a fortune in betting money.
Description: Vinayak, a suspended cop, helps a group of four men rob cricket betting money amounting to 500 crores INR. When it comes to splitting the amount, betrayal hits the team hard and a chase ensues.

Title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An orphan boy discovers he is a wizard and attends a school of witchcraft.
Description: Harry ___ has lived under the stairs at his aunt and uncle's house his whole life. But on his 11th birthday, he learns he's a powerful wizard—with a place waiting for him at the Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. As he learns to harness his newfound powers with the help of the school's kindly headmaster, Harry uncovers the truth about his parents' deaths—and about the villain who's to blame.

Title: Saw
Hint: Two men wake up shackled in a grimy bathroom with a dead body between them.
Description: Two men wake up to find themselves shackled in a grimy, abandoned bathroom.
