McAdam wins the prize, a one-in-a-thousand ___ rifle, but Dutch steals it and leaves town. McAdam follows, intent on settling his old quarrel, while the rifle keeps changing hands and touching a number of lives.

Title: Le Dîner de Cons
Hint: A publisher and his friends invite an idiot to dinner every week.
Description: For Pierre Brochant and his friends, Wednesday is “Idiots' Day”. The idea is simple: each person has to bring along an idiot. The one who brings the most spectacular idiot wins the prize. Tonight, Brochant is ecstatic. He has found a gem. The ultimate idiot, “A world champion idiot!”. What Brochant doesn’t know is that Pignon is a real jinx, a past master in the art of bringing on catastrophes...

Title: Laurence Anyways
Hint: A woman and her transgender partner's impossible love spans ten years in Montreal.
Description: The story of an impossible love between a woman named Fred and a transgender woman named ___ who reveals her inner desire to become her true self.

Title: Baazigar
Hint: A young man with a vendetta against a tycoon seduces and kills his daughter.
Description: A young man with a vendetta against a business tycoon seduces and kills his eldest daughter and then proceeds to his younger daughter but she begins to suspect her new lover's ulterior motive.

Title: Mutiny on the Bounty
Hint: A first mate leads a revolt against a tyrannical captain on a British ship sailing to Tahiti.
Description: Fletcher Christian successfully leads a revolt against the ruthless Captain Bligh on the HMS ___. However, Bligh returns one year later, hell bent on revenge.

Title: Band of Outsiders
Hint: Two slackers and a shy girl plan a robbery in Paris and dance the Madison in a café.
Description: Cinephile slackers Franz and Arthur spend their days mimicking the antiheroes of Hollywood noirs and Westerns while pursuing the lovely Odile. The misfit trio upends convention at every turn, be it through choreographed dances in cafés or frolicsome romps through the Louvre.

Title: The Man Without a Past
Hint: A man is beaten and loses his memory in Helsinki and builds a new life among the homeless.
Description: Arriving in Helsinki, a nameless man is beaten within an inch of his life by thugs, miraculously recovering only to find that he has completely lost his memory. Back on the streets, he attempts to begin again from zero, befriending a moody dog and becoming besotted with a Salvation Army volunteer.

Title: Mister Roberts
Hint: A restless officer on a WWII Navy cargo ship longs for combat while protecting his crew from a petty, tyrannical captain.
Description: Mr. ___ is a Navy officer who's yearning for battle but is stuck in the backwaters of World War II on a non-commissioned ship run by the bullying Captain Morton.

Title: Boy A
Hint: A young man released after years in juvenile detention for a childhood crime starts a new life under a new name.
Description: Freed after a lengthy term in a juvenile detention center, convicted child killer Jack Burridge finds work as a deliveryman and begins dating co-worker Michelle. While out on the road one day, Jack notices a distressed child, and, after reuniting the girl with her family, becomes a local celebrity.

Title: Ponniyin Selvan: Part I
Hint: The Chola kingdom is threatened by enemies within and without, as a prince and his friends fight to save it.
Description: The Chola kingdom is under threat from forces both internal and external, and with crown prince Aaditha Karikalan, his younger brother Arunmozhi Varman and the emperor, Sundara Cholar separated by situations, it is up to a messenger to ensure the safety of the kingdom. Can he succeed in his mission, especially with Karikalan's former girlfriend, Nandhini, plotting to bring down the entire Chola empire?

Title: Bad Genius
Hint: A brilliant Thai student starts a lucrative exam-cheating business that goes international.
Description: Lynn, a brilliant student, after helping her friends to get the grades they need, develops the idea of starting a much bigger exam-cheating business.

Title: Johnny Guitar
Hint: A tough saloon owner on the frontier faces a jealous, vengeful rival and a lynch mob.
Description: On the outskirts of town, the hard-nosed Vienna owns a saloon frequented by the undesirables of the region, including Dancin' Kid and his gang. Another patron of Vienna's establishment is ___, a former gunslinger and her lover.

Title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
Hint: A man exposed to a mysterious radioactive mist slowly dwindles in size and must battle a house cat and a spider.
Description: A dangerous combination of radiation and insecticide causes the unfortunate Scott Carey to shrink, slowly but surely, until he is only a few inches tall. His home becomes a wilderness where he must survive everything from spiders living in the cellar to his beloved cat.

Title: Superman II: The Richard Donner Cut
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A superhero gives up his powers for love just as three Kryptonian criminals arrive on Earth.
Description: ___ agrees to sacrifice his powers to start a relationship with Lois Lane, unaware that three Kryptonian criminals he inadvertently released are conquering Earth.

Title: My Way
Hint: A Korean marathon runner is forced to fight for Japan, the Soviet Union and Germany in WWII.
Description: During the invasion of Normandy the photograph of a slim Korean man in German uniform was found. It transpired that the man had served as a soldier in the Japanese, Russian and German armies. His incredible story inspired director Kang Je-Gyu to create this epic war drama.

Title: Lovers of the Arctic Circle
Hint: Two children who fall in love are linked by chance their whole lives.
Description: As young children, Otto and Ana become best friends, leading to the marriage of Ana's mother to Otto's father. When Otto and Ana become teenagers, they begin a sexual relationship, which they hide from their parents. The two fall deeply in love and seem destined to spend the rest of their lives together. However, their relationship is tested when Otto's mother dies and the two are separated.

Title: The Bitter Tears of Petra von Kant
Hint: A successful fashion designer falls obsessively in love with a young model, in a one-room drama.
Description: ___ is a successful fashion designer -- arrogant, caustic, and self-satisfied. She mistreats Marlene (her secretary, maid, and co-designer). Enter Karin, a 23-year-old beauty who wants to be a model. ___ falls in love with Karin and invites her to move in.

Title: Karwaan
Hint: Two strangers and a teenage girl take a road trip across southern India after a body mix-up.
Description: Avinash, a dejected soul stuck in a dead-end job shares a strange relationship with his father. He holds him responsible for crushing his dreams. However, he is left pondering upon this longstanding hatred when he hears of his father’s untimely demise.

Title: The Boy and the Beast
Genres: Action, Adventure, Animation, Drama, Family, Fantasy
Hint: A runaway boy in Tokyo stumbles into a hidden world of animal creatures and becomes the apprentice of a gruff bear warrior.
Description: Kyuta, a boy living in Shibuya, and Kumatetsu, a lonesome ___ from Jutengai, an imaginary world. One day, Kyuta forays into the imaginary world and, as he's looking for his way back, meets Kumatetsu who becomes his spirit guide. That encounter leads them to many adventures.

Title: The Bishop's Wife
Hint: An angel comes to help a stressed clergyman raise money for a cathedral and charms his neglected spouse.
Description: An Episcopal ___, Henry Brougham, has been working for months on the plans for an elaborate new cathedral which he hopes will be paid for primarily by a wealthy, stubborn widow. He is losing sight of his family and of why he became a churchman in the first place. Enter Dudley, an angel sent to help him. Dudley does help everyone he meets, but not necessarily in the way they would have preferred.

Title: The Woman in the Window
Hint: An agoraphobic woman in New York believes she witnessed a crime in the house across the street.
Description: An agoraphobic woman living alone in New York begins spying on her new neighbors only to witness a disturbing act of violence.

Title: After Life
Hint: Newly deceased people have a week to choose one memory to take with them into eternity.
Description: On a cold Monday morning, a group of counselors clock in at an old-fashioned social services office. Their task is to interview the recently deceased, record their personal details, then, over the course of the week, assist them in choosing a single memory to keep for eternity.

Title: Vera Drake
Hint: A kind housewife in 1950s London secretly performs illegal abortions for poor women.
Description: Abortionist ___ finds her beliefs and practices clash with the mores of 1950s Britain – a conflict that leads to tragedy for her family.

Title: Brute Force
Hint: Prisoners plot a violent escape from a brutal prison run by a sadistic guard.
Description: Timeworn Joe Collins and his fellow inmates live under the heavy thumb of the sadistic, power-tripping guard Captain Munsey. Only Collins' dreams of escape keep him going, but how can he possibly bust out of Munsey's chains?

Title: Piku
Hint: A taxi driver gets caught between a cranky old man and his short-tempered daughter on a road trip.
Description: A taxi driver is caught between a dysfunctional relationship between a woman and her father as he drives them to Kolkata.

Title: Yankee Doodle Dandy
Hint: The life of a Broadway song-and-dance man who wrote patriotic hits through two world wars.
Description: A film of the life of the renowned musical composer, playwright, actor, dancer and singer George M. Cohan.

Title: Darr
Hint: A woman is caught between her naval officer fiancé and an obsessive stalker who will stop at nothing.
Description: A woman is caught between one man's love and another man's obsession. She fears one and fears for the other. One stands for love and the other for life. Who will she choose?

Title: Le rayon vert
Hint: A lonely Parisian woman searches for love during a summer holiday, hoping to see a rare sunset flash.
Description: A lonely Parisian woman comes to terms with her isolation and anxieties during a long summer vacation.

Title: Soldier of Orange
Hint: Six Dutch students' lives take very different paths during the German occupation of the Netherlands.
Description: The lives of Erik Lanshof and five of his closest friends take different paths when the German army invades the Netherlands in 1940: fight and resistance, fear and resignation, collaboration and high treason.

Title: Bilal: A New Breed of Hero
Hint: A boy born into slavery dreams of becoming a great warrior in ancient Arabia, in an animated epic.
Description: A thousand years ago, one boy with a dream of becoming a great warrior is abducted with his sister and taken to a land far away from home. Thrown into a world where greed and injustice rule all, ___ finds the courage to raise his voice and make a change. Inspired by true events, this is a story of a real hero who earned his remembrance in time and history.

Title: The Miracle
Hint: A nun leaves her convent to follow a British soldier she loves.
Description: A novice leaves a Spanish convent to follow a 19th-century British soldier she loves.

Title: Only Angels Have Wings
Hint: A showgirl stranded in a South American port falls for the leader of a group of daredevil pilots.
Description: A traveling performer arrives at a remote South American port town where the head of an air freight service must risk his pilots' lives to earn a major contract.

Title: The Sea Hawk
Hint: A privateer raids Spanish ships for the Queen of England.
Description: Dashing pirate Geoffrey Thorpe plunders Spanish ships for Queen Elizabeth I and falls in love with Dona Maria, a beautiful Spanish royal he captures.

Title: Odd Man Out
Hint: A wounded IRA gunman tries to evade the police during one night in Belfast.
Description: Belfast police conduct a door-to-door manhunt for an IRA gunman wounded in a daring robbery.

Title: Pickup on South Street
Hint: A New York pickpocket unknowingly steals microfilm meant for communist spies and is hunted by both sides.
Description: In New York City, an insolent pickpocket, Skip McCoy, inadvertently sets off a chain of events when he targets ex-prostitute Candy and steals her wallet.

Title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
Hint: A young student endures brutal training at a legendary Buddhist temple to take revenge on the Manchus.
Description: During the Qing Dynasty, a fishmonger is killed by the reigning Manchu government for supporting the anti-government movement; his son manages to escape to ___ Temple, where he plans to learn its secretive brand of martial arts to seek revenge.

Title: The Wedding Banquet
Hint: A gay Taiwanese-American man stages a fake marriage to a tenant to please his traditional parents.
Description: A Taiwanese-American man is happily settled in New York with his American boyfriend. He plans a marriage of convenience to a Chinese woman in order to keep his parents off his back and to get the woman a green card. Chaos follows when his parents arrive in New York for the wedding.

Title: Bloody Sunday
Hint: A dramatised account of the 1972 civil rights march in Derry when British soldiers opened fire.
Description: The dramatised story of the Irish civil rights protest march on January 30 1972 which ended in a massacre by British troops.

Title: Pickpocket
Hint: A young Parisian man takes up pickpocketing and becomes addicted to the thrill.
Description: Michel takes up pickpocketing on a lark and is arrested soon after. His mother dies shortly after his release, and despite the objections of his only friend, Jacques, and his mother's neighbor Jeanne, Michel teams up with a couple of petty thieves in order to improve his craft. With a police inspector keeping an eye on him, Michel also tries to get a straight job, but the temptation to steal is hard to resist.

Title: Madras Cafe
Hint: An Indian agent travels to war-torn Sri Lanka to stop a rebel leader.
Description: An Indian intelligence agent journeys to a war-torn coastal island to break a resolute rebel group and meets a passionate journalist.

Title: Peppermint Candy
Hint: A man's life is told backwards from his suicide to his youth in South Korea.
Description: In the spring of 1999, a group of old friends gather to celebrate their 20 year reunion. Among the group is Yeong-ho, a cold, unhappy man, whose demeanor puts a damper on the festivities. The seriousness of Yeong-ho's depression becomes apparent when he climbs a railroad bridge and looks like he might jump. At this crucial moment, memories of seven crucial episodes from Yeong-ho's past flood his mind.

Title: Wake Up Sid
Hint: A lazy, spoiled Mumbai college student grows up when he befriends an independent writer.
Description: ___! is the story of a lazy Mumbai college student who does absolutely nothing, with a turn of events will ___ realize his potential in this world and become a success in the fast-paced life of Mumbai.

Title: Gun Crazy
Hint: A man obsessed with firearms falls for a sharpshooting carnival performer, and they go on a crime spree.
Description: Bart Tare is an ex-Army man who has a lifelong fixation with guns, he meets a kindred spirit in sharpshooter Annie Starr and goes to work at a carnival. After upsetting the carnival owner who lusts after Starr, they both get fired. Soon, on Starr's behest, they embark on a crime spree for cash.

Title: Destry Rides Again
Hint: A gentle deputy who refuses to carry a gun cleans up a lawless Western town.
Description: Tom ___, son of a legendary frontier peacekeeper, doesn’t believe in gunplay. Thus he becomes the object of widespread ridicule when he ___ into the wide-open town of Bottleneck, the personal fiefdom of the crooked Kent.

Title: Meet John Doe
Hint: A fired reporter prints a fake letter from an unemployed man, and a drifter is hired to play him.
Description: As a parting shot, fired reporter Ann Mitchell prints a fake letter from unemployed "John ___," who threatens suicide in protest of social ills. The paper is forced to rehire Ann and hires John Willoughby to impersonate "___." Ann and her bosses cynically milk the story for all it's worth, until the made-up "John ___" philosophy starts a whole political movement.

Title: The Last: Naruto the Movie
Hint: A young ninja must save his friend from an ancient threat as the moon falls toward Earth.
Description: Two years after the events of the Fourth Great Ninja War, the moon that Hagoromo Otsutsuki created long ago to seal away the Gedo Statue begins to descend towards the world, threatening to become a meteor that would destroy everything on impact. Amidst this crisis, a direct descendant of Kaguya Otsutsuki named Toneri Otsutsuki attempts to kidnap Hinata Hyuga but ends up abducting her younger sister Hanabi.

Title: A Heart in Winter
Hint: A violin virtuoso becomes obsessed with an emotionally detached violin maker in Paris.
Description: Beautiful violin virtuoso Camille has two obsessions: the music of Ravel, and a friend of her husband's who crafts violins. But his heart seems to be as cold as her playing is passionate.

Title: Stolen Kisses
Hint: A young man drifts through odd jobs and love in Paris.
Description: The third in a series of films featuring François Truffaut's alter-ego, Antoine Doinel, the story resumes with Antoine being discharged from military service. His sweetheart Christine's father lands Antoine a job as a security guard, which he promptly loses.

Title: After the Thin Man
Hint: A married detective couple investigate the disappearance of a cousin's husband in San Francisco.
Description: Nick and Nora Charles investigate when Nora's cousin reports her disreputable husband is missing, and find themselves in a mystery involving the shady owners of a popular nightclub, a singer and her dark brother, the cousin's forsaken true love, and Nora's bombastic and controlling aunt.

Title: And Then We Danced
Hint: A young Georgian dancer falls for a rival male dancer in a conservative dance troupe.
Description: Merab, a devoted dancer, has been training for years with his partner Mary for a spot in the National Georgian Ensemble. The arrival of another male dancer, Irakli, sparks both an intense rivalry and romantic desire that may cause Merab to risk his future in dance as well as his relationships.

Title: Mortal World
Hint: A family running a restaurant in a train station is targeted by killers.
Description: Mermer family, who has been managing a restaurant called “Anatolian flavors” in Haydarpasa train station for generations, consist of 8 members. Even though this family leads a quiet simple life, they will end up finding themselves in complicated situations. Moreover, this family has been keeping a secret for a long time and it just can’t come out at any cost..

Title: Sanam Teri Kasam
Hint: A tough ex-convict and a shy librarian fall in love despite her disapproving family.
Description: Tough ex-convict Inder and traditional mousy Saraswati fall in love and get married, but a tragedy changes their lives forever. The film is a modern rendition of the legends of Shiva-Sati and the novel "Love Story" by Eric Segal.

Title: The Pride of the Yankees
Hint: The life of a legendary baseball player who was struck down by a fatal disease.
Description: The story of the life and career of the baseball hall of famer, Lou Gehrig.

Hint: Twelve jurors in Moscow debate the fate of a Chechen teen accused of murder.
Description: A loose remake of “___ Angry Men”, “___” is set in contemporary Moscow where ___ very different men must unanimously decide the fate of a young Chechen accused of murdering his step-father, a Russian army officer.

Title: Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa
Hint: A struggling musician pursues the woman he loves, who is in love with someone else.
Description: A man belongs to a middle-class family and is intent on pursuing his career with a music group, despite his dad's disapproval. He is also in love with the lead singer, but she sees him mainly as a friend.

Title: Newton
Hint: A government clerk on election duty in a conflict-ridden jungle tries to hold a fair vote.
Description: A government clerk on election duty in a conflict-ridden jungle of Central India tries his best to conduct free and fair voting despite the apathy of security forces and the looming fear of guerrilla attacks by communist rebels.

Title: Closely Watched Trains
Hint: A shy railway apprentice in occupied Czechoslovakia longs for love.
Description: At a village railway station in occupied Czechoslovakia, a bumbling dispatcher’s apprentice longs to liberate himself from his virginity. Oblivious to the war and the resistance that surrounds him, this young man embarks on a journey of sexual awakening and self-discovery, encountering a universe of frustration, eroticism, and adventure within his sleepy backwater depot.

Title: The Passion of Anna
Hint: A divorced man and a grieving widow begin an affair on a remote Swedish island.
Description: A recently divorced man and an emotionally devastated widow begin a love affair.

Title: Neerja
Hint: A young flight attendant saves passengers during the 1986 hijacking of Pan Am Flight 73.
Description: ___ is a portrayal on the life of the courageous ___ Bhanot, who sacrificed her life while protecting the lives of 359 passengers on the Pan Am flight 73 in 1986. The flight was hijacked by a terrorist organization.

Title: The Insult
Hint: An argument between a Lebanese Christian and a Palestinian refugee escalates into a national court case.
Description: After an emotional exchange between a Lebanese Christian and a Palestinian refugee escalates, the men end up in a court case that gets national attention.

Title: Hungama
Hint: A web of mistaken identities leads to comic chaos.
Description: A case of mistaken identities featuring a young woman, an electronics business owner and an aspiring musician which leads to chaotic yet hilarious situations.

Title: Highway
Hint: A young woman is abducted right before her wedding and finds freedom on the road with her kidnapper.
Description: Right before her wedding, a young woman finds herself abducted and held for ransom. As the initial days pass, she begins to develop a strange bond with her kidnapper.

Title: A Pure Formality
Hint: A famous writer who has become a recluse is interrogated in a remote police station.
Description: Famous writer Onoff is now a recluse. The Inspector is suspicious when Onoff is brought into the station one night, disoriented and suffering a kind of amnesia. In an isolated, rural police station, the Inspector tries to establish the events surrounding a killing, to reach a startling resolution.

Title: Raanjhanaa
Hint: A small-town boy in Varanasi is obsessed with a girl who loves someone else.
Description: A small-town boy needs to break through the class divide to gain acceptance from his childhood sweetheart who is in love with big city ideals.

Title: Müslüm
Hint: The life of a beloved Turkish arabesque singer, from poverty to stardom.
Description: A biopic about the Turkish vocal artist ___ Gürses. Born into a poor household, Muslum found his redemption in music from the initial trauma that lingered over his musical and personal life as internalizing the grief. He rose through his ashes of shattered dreams like a phoenix. He walked in darkness, sang songs filled with sorrow which stirred people's souls and created a cult following.

Title: The Magician
Hint: A travelling illusionist and his troupe arrive in a 19th-century Swedish town and are challenged by sceptics.
Description: A traveling ___ and his troupe arrive in a Swedish town in the 1840s, where their act is scrutinized by local authorities and a skeptical medical official. Their stay leads to a series of confrontations that test the boundaries between performance, belief, and deception.

Title: The Navigator
Hint: A rich couple are stranded on a drifting ocean liner.
Description: The wealthy and impulsive Rollo Treadway decides to propose to his beautiful socialite neighbor, Betsy O'Brien. Although Betsy turns Rollo down, he still opts to go on the cruise that he intended as their honeymoon. When circumstances find both Rollo and Betsy on the wrong ship, they end up having adventures on the high seas.

Title: Fireworks Wednesday
Hint: A young maid stumbles into a couple's marital troubles on New Year's Eve in Tehran.
Description: Rouhi, a young bride-to-be, is hired as a maid for an affluent family in Tehran. Upon arriving, she is suddenly thrust into an explosive domestic conflict. The wife is convinced her husband is having an affair and enlists Rouhi as a spy, to follow her husband, and confirm her suspicions. What Rouhi discovers, however, threatens not only their marriage but her own future.

Title: In July
Hint: A physics teacher falls in love on a road trip across Europe to Istanbul.
Description: Daniel’s drab existence as a physics teacher takes an adventurous turn when he falls in love with a Turkish girl named Melek. He spontaneously decides to follow her to Instanbul by car. On the road across Europe, he picks up his free-spirited friend Juli, who is secretly in love with him.

Title: Drunken Angel
Hint: A blunt alcoholic doctor in postwar Tokyo diagnoses a young gangster with tuberculosis.
Description: In postwar Tokyo, a blunt, alcohol-soaked doctor diagnoses a swaggering young yakuza with tuberculosis, forging an uneasy bond that’s tested when the gangster’s ruthless former boss returns and drags him back toward the swampy underworld he can’t escape.

Title: Bob the Gambler
Hint: An aging, charming card player in Montmartre plans one last big casino heist in Deauville.
Description: In Paris, ___ Montagne is practically synonymous with gambling -- and winning. He is kind, classy and well-liked by virtually everyone in town, including police inspector Ledru. However, when ___ luck turns sour, he begins to lose friends and makes the most desperate gamble of his life: to rob the Deauville casino during Grand Prix weekend, when the vaults are full.

Title: Shooting Dogs
Hint: A priest and a teacher are caught up in the Rwandan genocide at a school.
Description: Two westerners, a priest and a teacher find themselves in the middle of the Rwandan genocide and face a moral dilemna. Do they place themselves in danger and protect the refugees, or escape the country with their lives? Based on a true story.

Title: Detective Byomkesh Bakshy!
Hint: A young sleuth fresh out of college investigates the disappearance of a chemist in wartime 1940s Calcutta.
Description: ___, fresh out of college, agrees to investigate the disappearance of Bhuvan, a chemist. Assisted by Bhuvan's son Ajit, ___ links the case to a larger conspiracy that will unsettle Calcutta.

Title: I've Loved You So Long
Hint: A woman released after fifteen years in prison moves in with her younger sister and slowly reveals the secret of her crime.
Description: A woman struggles to interact with her family and find her place in society after spending fifteen years in prison.

Title: Mahaan
Hint: A man's family leaves him when he strays from his ideological path.
Description: A man's family leaves him when he strays from the path of ideological living in his search for personal freedom. However, as he realizes his ambitions, he also misses the presence of his son in his life. Having fulfilled his dream of becoming a billionaire, does life give him a second chance to be a father?

Title: Shyam Singha Roy
Hint: A young filmmaker discovers that he might be the reincarnation of a Bengali social reformer.
Description: A young filmmaker is in a soup right when he’s about to find his footing in the film industry. When he sets out to find an answer, turns out it’s in the past.

Title: The Twelve Tasks of Asterix
Hint: Two Gaulish warriors must complete a series of impossible labours set by the Roman emperor, in an animated comedy.
Description: ___ and Obelix depart on an adventure to complete ___ impossible ___ to prove to Caesar that they are as strong as the Gods. You'll roar with laughter as they outwit, outrun, and generally outrage the very people who are trying to prove them "only human".

Title: Between Family
Hint: A man in the middle of a marriage crisis must pretend to be a father.
Description: In the midst of a marital crisis, Fikret befriends the singer Solmaz and has to step in as a father figure for her daughter, who is about to get married.

Title: Sarkar
Hint: A powerful, revered leader runs a parallel government in Mumbai, until his sons are drawn into a war.
Description: Subhash Nagre runs a parallel government in the city where he has a cult following. When his enemies plot to murder him, his son takes charge and stands up against them.

Title: Bheeshma Parvam
Hint: In the 1980s, a man helms his influential family in a Kerala town.
Description: Set in the backdrop of 1980s, Micheal helms his influential family in Kochi, inspiring fear and respect through his unnerving past. When a few younger members in the household feel his power over their lives too are aggravating, they join hands with foes to clamp down on him. And the story follows what’s in store for them.

Title: Pyaar Ka Punchnama
Hint: Three young Delhi roommates suffer through their disastrous, manipulative relationships in a sharp comedy.
Description: Nishant starts dating Charu while his roommates Rajat and Vikrant already have girlfriends in Neha and Rhea respectively. Trouble starts when the guys feel that their girlfriends are dominating them.

Title: Miss Lovely
Hint: Two brothers make sleazy movies in Bombay's seedy underworld.
Description: A Hindi feature film set in the lower depths of Bombay's "C" grade film industry. ___ follows the devastating story of two brothers who produce sleazy horror films in the mid-1980s.

Title: Brat 2
Hint: A Chechen War veteran travels to America to help a friend's brother.
Description: Arriving in Moscow, Chechen War veteran Danila meets Konstantin, an old friend who tells him that his twin brother has been forced into signing a crooked contract with a US ice hockey team. Soon after this meeting, Danila discovers Konstantin dead and he sets out to avenge his death; a journey that leads him to Chicago and a whole new experience.

Title: Ağır Roman
Hint: A mechanic falls in love with a dancer in an Istanbul neighbourhood.
Description: Salih is a mechanic and the son of a respected barber named Ali. A woman named Tina arrives at Cholera Street, where she takes up residence and works as a prostitute.

Title: Aamir
Hint: A doctor is forced into a terrorist plot by kidnappers.
Description: A doctor of Indian origin returning to Mumbai from London is forced to participate in a terrorist plot.

Title: Dragon Ball Z: Fusion Reborn
Hint: A demon accidentally opens a gate between the world of the living and the dead.
Description: Not paying attention to his job, a young demon allows the evil cleansing machine to overflow and explode, turning the young demon into the infamous monster Janemba. Goku and Vegeta make solo attempts to defeat the monster, but realize their only option is ___.

Title: The Man Who Copied
Studio: Casa de Cinema de Porto Alegre
Hint: A young photocopy operator becomes obsessively infatuated with the woman across the street.
Description: A young photocopier operator becomes infatuated with his neighbor and, unable to afford anything from her shop, turns to shady schemes to make money.

Title: Madaari
Hint: A common man kidnaps the son of a minister to get answers.
Description: A common man kidnaps the son of the Home Minister of India to get answers about the loss of his own son, caused by the illegal acts committed by corrupt government officials.

Title: You Are the Apple of My Eye
Hint: A group of friends all crush on the star student of their school.
Description: A group of close friends who attend a private school all have a debilitating crush on the sunny star pupil, Shen Chia-yi. The only member of the group who claims not to is Ko Ching-teng, but he ends up loving her as well.

Title: Tanu Weds Manu Returns
Hint: After a couple's marriage breaks apart, the husband falls for her lookalike.
Description: After ___ marriage breaks apart, the latter finds himself smitten by Datto, a lookalike of his ex-wife. But the estranged couple's feelings begin to spark again.

Title: Irudhi Suttru
Hint: A grumpy, disgraced boxing coach takes on a young, rebellious fisherwoman from Chennai.
Description: A grumpy boxing coach takes on a young, rebellious woman under his wings and starts training her for the world championship. But their biggest battle has to be fought outside the ring.

Title: Bheja Fry
Hint: A bored music producer and his friends invite a fool to dinner.
Description: Ranjeet Thadani is a bored and arrogant music producer who along with his friends hosts a party every Friday where they invite an 'idiot' to ridicule them and have fun at their expense. One day, he invites Bharat Bhushan, a kind hearted yet annoying Income Tax inspector, who ends up messing things for people when he tries to help them who makes Ranjeet regret inviting him.

Title: Parmanu: The Story of Pokhran
Hint: An officer leads a secret mission to conduct nuclear tests in India.
Description: A look at India's second confidential nuclear test series at ___ lead by Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam, during the time of PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee's tenure.

Title: Ayan
Hint: A smuggler who works for the criminal who raised him uncovers a dangerous betrayal.
Description: Deva works for Arumugam, a smuggler, who has taken care of him for many years. However, when his best friend gets killed, Deva decides to help the police to nab a dangerous drug lord.

Title: Jawan
Hint: A man fights corruption with a group of women while carrying out a vendetta.
Description: An emotional journey of a prison warden, driven by a personal vendetta while keeping up to a promise made years ago, recruits inmates to commit outrageous crimes that shed light on corruption and injustice, in an attempt to get even with his past, and that leads him to an unexpected reunion.

Title: Guy Ritchie's The Covenant
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An Afghan interpreter risks everything to carry an injured American sergeant across hostile terrain.
Description: After an ambush, Afghan interpreter Ahmed goes to Herculean lengths to save US Army Sergeant John Kinley's life. When Kinley learns that Ahmed and his family were not given safe passage to America as promised, he must return to the war zone and repay his debt.

Title: A Man Called Otto
Hint: A grumpy widower finds his life changed when a lively young family moves next door.
Description: When a lively young family moves in next door, grumpy widower ___ Anderson meets his match in a quick-witted, pregnant woman named Marisol, leading to an unlikely friendship that turns his world upside down.

Title: Beetlejuice
Hint: A dead couple hire a bio-exorcist to scare away the family who moves into their house.
Description: A newly dead New England couple seeks help from a deranged demon exorcist to scare an affluent New York family out of their home.

Title: The Conjuring
Hint: Paranormal investigators help a family terrorised by a dark presence in their farmhouse.
Description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse. Forced to confront a powerful entity, the Warrens find themselves caught in the most terrifying case of their lives.

Title: Promising Young Woman
Hint: A medical school dropout traumatised by her friend's assault takes revenge on predatory men.
Description: A young woman, traumatized by a tragic event in her past, seeks out vengeance against those who crossed her path.

Title: The Fabelmans
Hint: A boy discovers a shattering family secret and the power of movies.
Description: Growing up in post-World War II era Arizona, young Sammy Fabelman aspires to become a filmmaker as he reaches adolescence, but soon discovers a shattering family secret and explores how the power of films can help him see the truth.

Title: Rudy
Hint: A small, working-class boy dreams against all odds of playing football for Notre Dame.
Description: ___ grew up in a steel mill town where most people ended up working, but wanted to play football at Notre Dame instead. There were only a couple of problems. His grades were a little low, his athletic skills were poor, and he was only half the size of the other players. But he had the drive and the spirit of 5 people and has set his sights upon joining the team.

Title: The Cook, the Thief, His Wife & Her Lover
Hint: A brutish gangster's long-suffering spouse has an affair with a quiet diner in his lavish restaurant.
Description: When churlish mobster Albert Spica acquires an upscale French restaurant in London, he dines there nightly, effectively scaring off the clientele with his bad manners. His wife, Georgina, is especially disgusted by him, and soon begins an affair with regular guest Michael. Despite their best efforts to keep it secret, Spica learns about their trysts, and he plots a terrible revenge.

Title: Eyes Wide Shut
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A doctor wanders into a secret masked party and a dangerous world.
Description: After Dr. Bill Harford's wife, Alice, admits to having sexual fantasies about a man she met, Bill becomes obsessed with having a sexual encounter. He discovers an underground sexual group and attends one of their meetings -- and quickly discovers that he is in over his head.

Title: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
Country: Japan, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A slacker must defeat his new girlfriend's seven evil exes.
Description: As bass guitarist for a garage-rock band, ___ has never had trouble getting a girlfriend; usually, the problem is getting rid of them. But when Ramona Flowers skates into his heart, he finds she has the most troublesome baggage of all: an army of ex-boyfriends who will stop at nothing to eliminate him from her list of suitors.

Title: Gangs of New York
Hint: An Irish immigrant seeks revenge against the brutal gang leader who killed his father in 1860s Manhattan.
Description: In early 1860s New York, Irish immigrant Amsterdam Vallon is released from prison and returns to the Five Points, seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting, a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Vallon's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people.

Title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young wizard forms a secret army of students as a new teacher takes over the school.
Description: When a new professor's methods leave Hogwarts unprepared to fight the rising tide of evil, Harry teaches students how to defend against the dark arts.

Title: Boiling Point
Hint: A head chef juggles a failed health inspection, a demanding critic and his own collapsing life on the busiest night of the year, in one take.
Description: A head chef balances multiple personal and professional crises at a popular restaurant in London.

Title: Interview with the Vampire: The Vampire Chronicles
Hint: A centuries-old bloodsucker tells his epic life story to a reporter in San Francisco.
Description: A ___ relates his epic life story of love, betrayal, loneliness, and dark hunger to an over-curious reporter.

Title: The Greatest Showman
Hint: The story of a dreamer who founded a famous travelling circus with a troupe of misfits, in a musical.
Description: The story of American ___ P.T. Barnum, founder of the circus that became the famous traveling Ringling Bros. and Barnum & Bailey Circus.

Title: Batman
Hint: A caped vigilante faces a criminal who has been disfigured and turned into a grinning maniac.
Description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne fights crime in Gotham City disguised as ___, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains.

Title: A Quiet Place
Hint: A family must live in silence to hide from creatures that hunt by sound.
Description: A family is forced to live in silence while hiding from creatures that hunt by sound.

Title: The Crow
Hint: A murdered rock guitarist returns from the dead to avenge his fiancée.
Description: Exactly one year after young rock guitarist Eric Draven and his fiancée are brutally killed by a ruthless gang of criminals, Draven, watched over by a hypnotic ___, returns from the grave to exact revenge.

Title: The Devil's Advocate
Hint: A hotshot Florida defence lawyer joins a powerful New York firm run by Satan himself.
Description: Aspiring Florida defense lawyer Kevin Lomax accepts a job at a New York law firm. With the stakes getting higher every case, Kevin quickly learns that his boss has something far more evil planned.

Title: A Time to Kill
Hint: A young lawyer defends a Black man who killed his daughter's attackers.
Description: A young lawyer defends a black man accused of murdering two white men who raped his 10-year-old daughter, sparking a rebirth of the KKK.

Title: 28 Days Later
Hint: A man wakes from a coma to find London deserted after a virus turned people into rage-filled creatures.
Description: Twenty-eight days after a killer virus was accidentally unleashed from a British research facility, a small group of London survivors are caught in a desperate struggle to protect themselves from the infected. Carried by animals and humans, the virus turns those it infects into homicidal maniacs -- and it's absolutely impossible to contain.

Title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
Hint: An archaeologist and his companions rescue enslaved children from a cult in an Indian palace.
Description: After arriving in India, ___ is asked by a desperate village to find a mystical stone. He agrees – and stumbles upon a secret cult plotting a terrible plan in the catacombs of an ancient palace.

Title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
Hint: Two survivors of a deadly televised tournament are forced to compete again.
Description: After surviving the ___, Katniss and Peeta struggle with the consequences of their victory as unrest spreads across Panem. Forced back into the spotlight, they become symbols of hope and resistance while the Capitol prepares a new and deadly challenge that will change the future of the nation forever.

Title: The Impossible
Hint: A family's holiday in Thailand becomes a nightmare when the 2004 tsunami hits.
Description: In December 2004, close-knit family Maria, Henry and their three sons begin their winter vacation in Thailand. But the day after Christmas, the idyllic holiday turns into an incomprehensible nightmare when a terrifying roar rises from the depths of the sea, followed by a wall of black water that devours everything in its path.

Title: Hugo
Hint: An orphan living in a train station uncovers a secret about an old filmmaker.
Description: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, ___ Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in 1930s Paris. ___ job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father.

Title: Sleepers
Hint: Two gangsters take revenge on the guard who abused them in juvenile detention.
Description: Two gangsters seek revenge on the state jail worker who during their stay at a youth prison sexually abused them. A sensational court hearing takes place to charge him for the crimes.

Title: Nocturnal Animals
Country: United States of America, China, United Kingdom
Hint: A woman reads a violent novel by her ex-husband and sees their past in it.
Description: Susan Morrow receives a book manuscript from her ex-husband – a man she left 20 years earlier – asking for her opinion of his writing. As she reads, she is drawn into the fictional life of Tony Hastings, a mathematics professor whose family vacation turns violent.

Title: Legends of the Fall
Hint: Three brothers and their father live in the wilds of Montana in the early 20th century.
Description: In early 20th-century Montana, Col. William Ludlow lives on a ranch in the wilderness with his sons, Alfred, Tristan, and Samuel. Eventually, the unconventional but close-knit family are bound by loyalty, tested by war, and torn apart by love, as told over the course of several decades in this epic saga.

Title: Little Children
Hint: Two married neighbors start an affair while a sex offender lives nearby.
Description: The lives of two lovelorn spouses from separate marriages, a registered sex offender, and a disgraced ex-police officer intersect as they struggle to resist their vulnerabilities and temptations.

Title: The Favourite
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two scheming cousins compete for the affections of an eccentric, ailing 18th-century English queen.
Description: England, early 18th century. The close relationship between Queen Anne and Sarah Churchill is threatened by the arrival of Sarah's cousin, Abigail Hill, resulting in a bitter rivalry between the two cousins to be the Queen's ___.

Title: The Wicker Man
Hint: A policeman goes to a remote island to find a missing girl and finds pagans.
Description: Police sergeant Neil Howie is called to an island village in search of a missing girl whom the locals claim never existed. The investigation is further complicated as Howie’s religious views clash with those of the island’s residents.

Title: The Town
Hint: A Boston bank robber falls for a bank manager his crew took hostage.
Description: Doug MacRay is a longtime thief, who, smarter than the rest of his crew, is looking for his chance to exit the game. When a bank job leads to the group kidnapping an attractive branch manager, he takes on the role of monitoring her – but their burgeoning relationship threatens to unveil the identities of Doug and his crew to the FBI Agent who is on their case.

Title: Collateral
Hint: A cab driver picks up a hitman for a night of murders in Los Angeles.
Description: Cab driver Max picks up a man who offers him $600 to drive him around. But the promise of easy money sours when Max realizes his fare is an assassin.

Title: I, Tonya
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Qatar
Hint: The rise and scandalous fall of an Olympic figure skater, told in a darkly comic mockumentary style.
Description: Competitive ice skater ___ Harding rises amongst the ranks at the U.S. Figure Skating Championships, but her future in the sport is thrown into doubt when her ex-husband intervenes.

Title: Source Code
Hint: A soldier relives the last eight minutes of a man's life to find a bomber on a train.
Description: When decorated soldier Captain Colter Stevens wakes up in the body of an unknown man, he discovers he's part of a mission to find the bomber of a Chicago commuter train.

Title: The Aviator
Hint: The life of a billionaire filmmaker and aviation pioneer struggling with obsessive-compulsive disorder.
Description: A biopic depicting the life of filmmaker and aviation pioneer Howard Hughes from 1927 to 1947, during which time he became a successful film producer and an aviation magnate, while simultaneously growing more unstable due to severe obsessive-compulsive disorder.

Title: The Warriors
Hint: A New York gang is framed for a murder and must fight their way home.
Description: Prominent gang leader Cyrus calls a meeting of New York's gangs to set aside their turf wars and take over the city. At the meeting, a rival leader kills Cyrus, but a Coney Island gang called the ___ is wrongly blamed for Cyrus' death. Before you know it, the cops and every gangbanger in town is hot on the ___' trail.

Title: Tucker and Dale vs Evil
Hint: Two hillbillies are suspected of being killers by a group of college kids.
Description: Two hillbillies are suspected of being killers by a group of paranoid college kids camping near the duo's West Virginian cabin. As the body count climbs, so does the fear and confusion as the college kids try to seek revenge against the pair.

Title: Total Recall
Hint: A construction worker discovers his memories may be fake and his life is on Mars.
Description: Construction worker Douglas Quaid's obsession with the planet Mars leads him to visit Rekall, a virtual vacation company that manufactures memories. When something goes wrong during Quaid's memory implant procedure, his life turns upside down, leading him to question what is reality and what isn't.

Title: The Hunt for Red October
Hint: A Soviet submarine captain plans to defect to the US with his technologically superior sub.
Description: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub, the Red ___, is heading for the U.S. coast under the command of Captain Marko Ramius. The American government thinks Ramius is planning to attack.

Title: Juno
Hint: A witty teen gets pregnant and finds adoptive parents for her baby.
Description: Faced with an unplanned pregnancy, sixteen year old high-schooler, ___ MacGuff, makes an unusual decision regarding her unborn child.

Title: BlacKkKlansman
Hint: A Black detective infiltrates the Ku Klux Klan with the help of a Jewish colleague.
Description: Colorado Springs, late 1970s. Ron Stallworth, an African American police officer, and Flip Zimmerman, his Jewish colleague, run an undercover operation to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan.

Title: Leaving Las Vegas
Hint: An alcoholic screenwriter moves to the Nevada strip to drink himself to death and falls for a sex worker.
Description: Ben Sanderson, an alcoholic Hollywood screenwriter who lost everything because of his drinking, arrives in ___ to drink himself to death. There, he meets and forms an uneasy friendship and non-interference pact with prostitute Sera.

Title: Contact
Hint: A radio astronomer receives the first extraterrestrial radio signal and is chosen to travel through a mysterious machine.
Description: A radio astronomer receives the first extraterrestrial radio signal ever picked up on Earth. As the world powers scramble to decipher the message and decide upon a course of action, she must make some difficult decisions between her beliefs, the truth, and reality.

Title: Spider-Man 2
Hint: A web-slinging superhero gives up his powers, as a mad scientist threatens New York.
Description: Peter Parker is going through a major identity crisis. Burned out from being ___-Man, he decides to shelve his superhero alter ego, which leaves the city suffering in the wake of carnage left by the evil Doc Ock. In the meantime, Parker still can't act on his feelings for Mary Jane Watson, a girl he's loved since childhood. A certain anger begins to brew in his best friend Harry Osborn as well...

Title: The Piano Teacher
Hint: A sexually repressed music instructor in Vienna begins a twisted affair with her young student.
Description: Erika Kohut, a sexually repressed ___ living with her domineering mother, meets a young man who starts romantically pursuing her.

Title: King Richard
Hint: A determined father coaches his two daughters to become world tennis champions.
Description: The story of how ___ Williams served as a coach to his daughters Venus and Serena, who will soon become two of the most legendary tennis players in history.

Title: Field of Dreams
Hint: An Iowa farmer hears a voice and builds a ballpark in his cornfield.
Description: Ray Kinsella is an Iowa farmer who hears a mysterious voice telling him to turn his cornfield into a baseball diamond. He does, but the voice's directions don't stop -- even after the spirits of deceased ballplayers turn up to play.

Title: An American Werewolf in London
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two backpacking tourists are attacked by a wolf-like beast on the Yorkshire moors, and one begins to change.
Description: American tourists David and Jack are savagely attacked by an unidentified animal while hiking on the Yorkshire Moors. After retiring to the home of a beautiful nurse to recuperate, David soon begins experiencing disturbing changes to his body and mind.

Title: The Tin Drum
Hint: A boy refuses to grow up in Nazi-era Danzig, banging his toy percussion instrument and shattering glass with his scream.
Description: In 1924, Oskar Matzerath is born in the Free City of Danzig. At age three, he falls down a flight of stairs and stops growing. In 1939, World War II breaks out.

Title: The Abyss
Hint: An oil rig crew searches for a lost submarine and encounters an alien race.
Description: A civilian oil rig crew is recruited to conduct a search and rescue effort when a nuclear submarine mysteriously sinks. One diver soon finds himself on a spectacular odyssey 25,000 feet below the ocean's surface where he confronts a mysterious force that has the power to change the world or destroy it.

Title: Midnight Run
Hint: A bounty hunter must bring a mob accountant across the country while the FBI and the mob chase them.
Description: A bounty hunter pursues a former Mafia accountant who is also being chased by a rival bounty hunter, the F.B.I., and his old mob boss after jumping bail.

Title: Doctor Strange
Hint: An arrogant surgeon whose hands are ruined in a car accident learns the mystic arts in Nepal.
Description: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.

Title: Lone Survivor
Hint: Four Navy SEALs on a mission are trapped by the Taliban in the Afghan mountains.
Description: Four Navy SEALs on a covert mission to neutralize a high-level Taliban operative must make an impossible moral decision in the mountains of Afghanistan that leads them into an enemy ambush. As they confront unthinkable odds, the SEALs must find reserves of strength and resilience to fight to the finish.

Title: Dead Man Walking
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A nun becomes the spiritual adviser to a convicted murderer on death row in Louisiana.
Description: A death row inmate turns for spiritual guidance to a local nun in the days leading up to his scheduled execution for the murders of a young couple.

Title: Upgrade
Hint: A paralysed man is implanted with a chip that helps him take revenge.
Description: A brutal mugging leaves Grey Trace paralyzed in the hospital and his beloved wife dead. A billionaire inventor soon offers Trace a cure — an artificial intelligence implant called STEM that will enhance his body. Now able to walk, Grey finds that he also has superhuman strength and agility — skills he uses to seek revenge against the thugs who destroyed his life.

Title: Riders of Justice
Hint: A soldier returns home after his wife dies in a train accident and seeks revenge with three nerds.
Description: Markus returns home to care for his daughter when his wife dies in a tragic train accident. However, when a survivor of the wreck surfaces and claims foul play, Markus suspects his wife was murdered and embarks on a mission to find those responsible.

Title: The Illusionist
Hint: A magician in Vienna uses his illusions to win back his childhood love.
Description: With his eye on a lovely aristocrat, a gifted ___ named Eisenheim uses his powers to win her away from her betrothed, a crown prince. But Eisenheim's scheme creates tumult within the monarchy and ignites the suspicion of a dogged inspector.

Title: Trading Places
Hint: A snobbish investor and a street hustler swap lives as part of a bet.
Description: A snobbish investor and a wily street con-artist find their positions reversed as part of a bet by two callous millionaires.

Title: Ice Age
Hint: A mammoth, a sloth and a tiger try to return a human baby to its tribe.
Description: Manny the mammoth, Sid the loquacious sloth, and Diego the sabre-toothed tiger go on a comical quest to return a human baby back to his father, across a world on the brink of an ___.

Title: Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World
Hint: A British naval captain pursues a superior French warship around South America during the Napoleonic Wars.
Description: After an abrupt and violent encounter with a French warship inflicts severe damage upon his ship, a captain of the British Royal Navy begins a chase over two oceans to capture or destroy the enemy, though he must weigh his commitment to duty and ferocious pursuit of glory against the safety of his devoted crew, including the ship's thoughtful surgeon, his best friend.

Title: Jackie Brown
Hint: A flight attendant smuggling money plays cops and crooks against each other.
Description: ___ is a flight attendant who gets caught in the middle of smuggling cash into the country for her gunrunner boss. When the cops try to use ___ to get to her boss, she hatches a plan — with help from a bail bondsman — to keep the money for herself.

Title: Perfume: The Story of a Murderer
Country: Germany, France, Spain, United States of America, Belgium
Hint: A man with a superhuman sense of smell kills women to create the perfect scent.
Description: Jean-Baptiste Grenouille, born in the stench of 18th century Paris, develops a superior olfactory sense, which he uses to create the world's finest perfumes. However, his work takes a dark turn as he tries to preserve scents in the search for the ultimate ___.

Title: Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas
Hint: A journalist and his attorney drive to the gambling capital on a drug-fuelled binge, in a psychedelic odyssey.
Description: Raoul Duke and his attorney Dr. Gonzo drive a red convertible across the Mojave desert to ___ with a suitcase full of drugs to cover a motorcycle race. As their consumption of drugs increases at an alarming rate, the stoned duo trash their hotel room and fear legal repercussions. Duke begins to drive back to L.A., but after an odd run-in with a cop, he returns to Sin City and continues his wild drug binge.

Title: M
Hint: A city's police and criminals hunt a child killer in Berlin.
Description: In this classic German thriller, Hans Beckert, a serial killer who preys on children, becomes the focus of a massive Berlin police manhunt. Beckert's heinous crimes are so repellant and disruptive to city life that he is even targeted by others in the seedy underworld network.

Title: Z
Hint: A politician's murder exposes a corrupt government in Greece.
Description: A prominent politician is murdered during a demonstration. The government and army are trying to suppress the truth, but a tenacious magistrate is determined to not to let them get away with it.

Title: The Trap
Hint: A fur trapper takes a mute woman to his remote cabin.
Description: A French-Canadian fur trapper takes a mute girl as his unwilling wife to live with him in his remote cabin in the woods.

Title: Mother
Hint: A devoted widow searches for the real killer after her intellectually disabled son is accused of murdering a schoolgirl.
Description: A ___ lives quietly with her son. One day, a girl is brutally killed, and the boy is charged with the murder. Now, it's his ___ mission to prove him innocent.

Title: Lolita
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A middle-aged British professor becomes obsessed with the teenage daughter of his landlady.
Description: Humbert Humbert is a middle-aged British novelist who is both appalled by and attracted to the vulgarity of American culture. When he comes to stay at the boarding house run by Charlotte Haze, he soon becomes obsessed with ___, the woman's teenaged daughter.

Title: Blow
Hint: A small-town kid rises to become America's biggest cocaine smuggler in the 1970s and 80s, then loses it all.
Description: A boy named George Jung grows up in a struggling family in the 1950's. His mother nags at her husband as he is trying to make a living for the family. It is finally revealed that George's father cannot make a living and the family goes bankrupt. George does not want the same thing to happen to him, and his friend Tuna, in the 1960's, suggests that he deal marijuana.

Title: The Hurt Locker
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An army bomb disposal sergeant in Iraq takes dangerous risks as his unit counts down its tour.
Description: During the Iraq War, a Sergeant recently assigned to an army bomb squad is put at odds with his squad mates due to his maverick way of handling his work.

Title: We Need to Talk About Kevin
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A mother struggles with her role in her son's terrible act.
Description: After her son ___ commits a horrific act, troubled mother Eva reflects on her complicated relationship with her disturbed son as he grew from a toddler into a teenager.

Title: The Omen
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An American diplomat in London slowly realises his adopted young son may be the Antichrist.
Description: Immediately after their miscarriage, the US diplomat Robert Thorn adopts the newborn Damien without the knowledge of his wife. Yet what he doesn’t know is that their new son is the son of the devil.

Title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
Hint: A dad's dream family holiday spirals into total chaos.
Description: It's Christmastime, and the Griswolds are preparing for a family seasonal celebration. But things never run smoothly for Clark, his wife Ellen, and their two kids. Clark's continual bad luck is worsened by his obnoxious family guests, but he manages to keep going, knowing that his Christmas bonus is due soon.

Title: Babel
Country: France, Mexico, United States of America
Hint: Four stories linked by a single gunshot in Morocco.
Description: Tragedy strikes a married couple vacationing in the Moroccan desert, which jumpstarts an interlocking story involving four different families.

Title: The Beasts
Hint: A French couple farming in rural Spain clash violently with their neighbors.
Description: Antoine and Olga, a French couple, have been living in a small village in Galicia for a long time. They practice eco-responsible agriculture and restore abandoned houses to facilitate repopulation. Everything should be idyllic except for their opposition to a wind turbine project that creates a serious conflict with their neighbors.

Title: Milk
Hint: The first openly gay man elected to public office in California fights for gay rights.
Description: The true story of Harvey ___, the first openly gay man ever elected to public office. In San Francisco in the late 1970s, Harvey ___ becomes an activist for gay rights and inspires others to join him in his fight for equal rights that should be available to all Americans.

Title: Munich
Hint: Israeli agents hunt the men behind the 1972 Olympic massacre.
Description: During the 1972 Olympic Games in ___, eleven Israeli athletes are taken hostage and murdered by a Palestinian terrorist group known as Black September. In retaliation, the Israeli government recruits a group of Mossad agents to track down and execute those responsible for the attack.

Title: Enemy at the Gates
Country: United States of America, France, Germany, Ireland, United Kingdom
Hint: A Soviet shepherd-turned-marksman and a German sharpshooter stalk each other through the ruins of a besieged WWII city.
Description: A Russian and a German sniper play a game of cat-and-mouse during the Battle of Stalingrad in WWII.

Title: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert
Hint: Two drag performers and a transgender woman travel across the Australian outback in a bus.
Description: Two drag performers and a transgender woman travel across the desert to perform their unique style of cabaret.

Title: Sideways
Hint: Two friends go wine tasting in California before one gets married.
Description: Two middle-aged men embark on a spiritual journey through Californian wine country. One is an unpublished novelist suffering from depression, and the other is only days away from walking down the aisle.

Title: Battle Royale
Hint: A class of students is forced to fight to the death on an island.
Description: In the future, the Japanese government captures a class of ninth-grade students and forces them to kill each other under the revolutionary "___" act.

Hint: The first Black player in modern Major League Baseball endures relentless abuse as he breaks the colour barrier.
Description: In 1947, Jackie Robinson becomes the first Black man to play in Major League Baseball facing unabashed racism from the public, the press and other players.

Title: Braindead
Hint: A shy man's mother is bitten by a rat monkey, leading to gory chaos.
Description: When a Sumatran rat-monkey bites Lionel Cosgrove's mother, she's transformed into a zombie and begins killing (and transforming) the entire town while Lionel races to keep things under control.

Title: The Art of Racing in the Rain
Hint: A dog narrates his life with a race car driver.
Description: A family dog – with a near-human soul and a philosopher's mind – evaluates his life through the lessons learned by his human owner, a race-car driver.

Title: Grindhouse
Country: United States of America, Canada, United Kingdom
Hint: A double feature of trashy horror and car chases, complete with fake trailers.
Description: ___ combines Robert Rodriguez's Planet Terror, a horror comedy about a group of survivors who battle zombie-like creatures, and Quentin Tarantino's Death Proof, an action thriller about a murderous stuntman who kills young women with modified vehicles. It is presented as a double feature with fictitious exploitation trailers preceding each segment.

Title: Sophie's Choice
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young writer befriends a Polish survivor haunted by a terrible secret.
Description: Stingo, a young writer, moves to Brooklyn in 1947 to begin work on his first novel. As he becomes friendly with ___ and her lover Nathan, he learns that she is a Holocaust survivor. Flashbacks reveal her harrowing story, from pre-war prosperity to Auschwitz.

Title: Burning
Hint: A young man becomes obsessed with a woman and her mysterious friend.
Description: Deliveryman Jong-su is out on a job when he runs into Hae-mi, a girl who once lived in his neighborhood. She asks if he'd mind looking after her cat while she's away on a trip to Africa. On her return, she introduces to Jong-su an enigmatic young man named Ben, who she met during her trip. One day Ben tells Jong-su about his most unusual hobby.

Title: tick, tick... BOOM!
Hint: A struggling composer races against time before turning thirty.
Description: On the brink of turning 30, a promising theater composer navigates love, friendship and the pressure to create something great before time runs out.

Title: The Piano
Hint: A mute woman and her daughter arrive in colonial New Zealand with a prized instrument.
Description: When an arranged marriage brings Ada and her spirited daughter to the wilderness of nineteenth-century New Zealand, she finds herself locked in a battle of wills with both her controlling husband and a rugged frontiersman to whom she develops a forbidden attraction.

Title: Funny Games
Hint: Two polite young men take a family hostage at their vacation home.
Description: Two psychotic young men take a mother, father, and son hostage in their vacation cabin and force them to play sadistic "___" with one another for their own amusement.

Title: The Hours
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Three women in different eras are connected by a novel.
Description: The story of three women searching for more potent, meaningful lives. Each is alive at a different time and place, all are linked by their yearnings and their fears. Their stories intertwine, and finally come together in a surprising, transcendent moment of shared recognition.

Title: Lust, Caution
Country: China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, United States of America
Hint: A young woman seduces a collaborator to assassinate him in wartime Shanghai.
Description: During World War II, a secret agent must seduce and assassinate an official who works for the Japanese puppet government in Shanghai.

Title: 127 Hours
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A climber is trapped by a boulder in a canyon for days.
Description: The true story of mountain climber Aron Ralston's remarkable adventure to save himself after a fallen boulder crashes on his arm and traps him in an isolated canyon in Utah.

Title: Pain and Glory
Hint: An aging film director reflects on his life and loves.
Description: Salvador Mallo, a filmmaker in the twilight of his career, remembers his life: his mother, his lovers, the actors he worked with. The sixties in a small village in Valencia, the eighties in Madrid, the present, when he feels an immeasurable emptiness, facing his mortality, the incapability of continuing filming, the impossibility of separating creation from his own life.

Title: Miss Sloane
Hint: An ambitious, ruthless lobbyist faces off against the powerful gun lobby in Washington.
Description: An ambitious lobbyist faces off against the powerful gun lobby in an attempt to pass gun control legislation.

Title: A Fish Called Wanda
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A con artist and her gang steal diamonds, then turn on each other.
Description: While a diamond advocate attempts to steal a collection of diamonds, troubles arise when he realises he’s not the only one after the collection.

Title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A cheese-loving inventor and his silent dog hunt a giant beast ruining the town's vegetables.
Description: Cheese-loving eccentric ___ and his cunning canine pal ___ run a business ridding the town of garden pests. Using only humane methods, which turns their home into a halfway house for evicted vermin, the pair stumble upon a mystery involving a voracious vegetarian monster that threatens to ruin the annual veggie-growing contest.

Title: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
Hint: A petty thief poses as an actor and gets mixed up in a murder.
Description: A petty thief posing as an actor is brought to Los Angeles for an unlikely audition and finds himself in the middle of a murder investigation along with his high school dream girl and a detective who's been training him for his upcoming role...

Title: El Dorado
Hint: A gunfighter helps a drunk sheriff defend a town.
Description: Cole Thornton, a gunfighter for hire, joins forces with an old friend, Sheriff J.P. Harrah. Together with a fighter and a gambler, they help a rancher and his family fight a rival rancher that is trying to steal their water.

Title: Secondhand Lions
Hint: A boy spends the summer with two eccentric great-uncles with wild stories.
Description: The comedic adventures of an introverted boy left on the doorstep of a pair of reluctant, eccentric great-uncles, whose exotic remembrances stir the boy's spirit and re-ignite the men's lives.

Title: It's a Mad Mad Mad Mad World
Hint: A crowd of strangers race to find a buried fortune.
Description: A group of strangers come across a man dying after a car crash who proceeds to tell them about the $350,000 he buried in California. What follows is the madcap adventures of those strangers as each attempts to claim the prize for himself.

Title: Brooklyn
Hint: A young Irish immigrant falls in love in 1950s New York.
Description: In 1950s Ireland and New York, young Eilis Lacey has to choose between two men and two countries.

Title: Midnight Express
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An American is thrown into a brutal Turkish prison for smuggling hash.
Description: Billy Hayes is caught attempting to smuggle drugs out of a country. The courts decide to make an example of him, sentencing him to more than 30 years in prison. Hayes has two opportunities for release: the appeals made by his lawyer, his family, and the American government, or the "___".

Title: Boys Don't Cry
Hint: A young transgender man searches for love in rural Nebraska.
Description: A young transgender man explores his gender identity and searches for love in rural Nebraska.

Title: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young admirer joins a famous outlaw's gang and plans to kill him.
Description: Outlaw ___ James is rumored to be the 'fastest gun in the West'. An eager recruit into James' notorious gang, ___ eventually grows jealous of the famed outlaw and, when ___ and his brother sense an opportunity to kill James, their murderous action elevates their target to near mythical status.

Title: The Last Temptation of Christ
Hint: Jesus wrestles with doubt and desire on the road to the cross.
Description: Jesus, a humble Judean carpenter beginning to see that he is the son of God, is drawn into revolutionary action against the Roman occupiers by Judas -- despite his protestations that love, not violence, is the path to salvation. The burden of being the savior of mankind torments Jesus throughout his life, leading him to doubt.

Title: Chaplin
Country: France, Italy, United Kingdom, United States of America, Japan
Hint: An aging silent film comedian narrates his life story to his autobiography's editor.
Description: An aged Charlie ___ narrates his life to his autobiography's editor, including his rise to wealth and comedic fame from poverty, his turbulent personal life and his run-ins with the FBI.

Title: Pleasantville
Hint: Two 1990s teens are transported into a 1950s black-and-white sitcom and bring it colour.
Description: Geeky teenager David and his popular twin sister, Jennifer, get sucked into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom called "___," and find a world where everything is peachy keen all the time. But when Jennifer's modern attitude disrupts ___ peaceful but boring routine, she literally brings color into its life.

Title: Richard Jewell
Hint: A security guard who found a bomb becomes the prime suspect.
Description: ___ thinks quick, works fast, and saves hundreds, perhaps thousands, of lives after a domestic terrorist plants several pipe bombs and they explode during a concert, only to be falsely suspected of the crime by sloppy FBI work and sensational media coverage.

Title: The Big Sick
Hint: A Pakistani comic's girlfriend falls into a coma and he gets to know her parents.
Description: Pakistan-born comedian Kumail Nanjiani and grad student Emily Gardner fall in love but struggle as their cultures clash. When Emily contracts a mysterious illness, Kumail finds himself forced to face her feisty parents, his family's expectations, and his true feelings.

Title: Menace II Society
Hint: A young hustler in Watts tries to escape a life of violence.
Description: A young street hustler attempts to escape the rigors and temptations of the ghetto in a quest for a better life.

Title: Contempt
Hint: A writer's marriage falls apart while working on a film in Capri.
Description: Art film producer Jeremy Prokosch, unhappy with the work of his director, hires Fritz Lang (as himself) to direct an adaptation of The Odyssey, but when it seems that the legendary filmmaker is making a picture destined to bomb, he brings in a screenwriter to energise the script. The professional intersects with the personal when a rift develops between the writer and his wife.

Title: The Guns of Navarone
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Allied saboteurs must destroy two massive German cannons on a fortified Greek island.
Description: A team of allied saboteurs are assigned an impossible mission: infiltrate an impregnable Nazi-held island and destroy the two enormous long-range field ___ that prevent the rescue of 2,000 trapped British soldiers.

Title: Instructions Not Included
Hint: A playboy is left with a baby and raises her in Los Angeles.
Description: Valentin is Acapulco's resident playboy, until a former fling leaves a baby on his doorstep and him heading with her out of Mexico.

Title: Synecdoche, New York
Hint: A theater director builds a life-size replica of his city inside a warehouse.
Description: A theater director struggles with his work, and the women in his life, as he attempts to create a life-size replica of New York inside a warehouse as part of his new play.

Title: Of Mice and Men
Hint: Two drifters, one a gentle giant, work the fields during the Depression.
Description: Two drifters, one a gentle but slow giant, try to make money working the fields during the Depression so they can fulfill their dreams.

Title: The Book Thief
Hint: A girl in Nazi Germany swipes novels and shares them with the Jewish man hiding in her basement.
Description: While subjected to the horrors of WWII Germany, young Liesel finds solace by stealing books and sharing them with others. Under the stairs in her home, a Jewish refugee is being sheltered by her adoptive parents.

Title: Blow-Up
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Italy
Hint: A bored fashion photographer in swinging 60s London believes he accidentally captured a murder on film.
Description: A successful mod photographer in London whose world is bounded by fashion, pop music, marijuana, and easy sex, feels his life is boring and despairing. But in the course of a single day he unknowingly captures a death on film.

Title: Forbidden Planet
Hint: A starship crew investigates a distant world where a scientist lives with his daughter and a robot.
Description: Starship C57D travels to planet Altair 4 in search of the crew of spaceship "Bellerophon," a scientific expedition that has been missing for twenty years. They find themselves unwelcome by the expedition's lone survivor and warned of destruction by an invisible force if they don't turn back immediately.

Title: Following
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An unemployed writer follows strangers and gets drawn into a burglar's world.
Description: Bill, an idle, unemployed aspiring writer, walks the crowded streets of London ___ randomly chosen strangers, a seemingly innocent entertainment that becomes dangerous when he crosses paths with a mysterious character.

Title: The Time Machine
Genres: Thriller, Adventure, Fantasy, Science Fiction, Romance
Hint: A Victorian inventor travels to a distant future divided into two species.
Description: A Victorian Englishman travels to the far future and finds that humanity has divided into two hostile species.

Title: The Player
Hint: A studio executive is threatened by a writer he rejected.
Description: A Hollywood studio executive is being sent death threats by a writer whose script he rejected - but which one?

Title: The Producers
Hint: A producer and his accountant plan to make money with a sure-fire flop.
Description: A conniving Broadway producer and his meek accountant plan to profit from charming wealthy old biddies to invest in an overbudget production, and then put on a sure-fire disaster, so nobody will ask for their money back — and what's more disastrous than a tasteless musical celebrating Adolf Hitler.

Title: Hair
Hint: A young man meets hippies in New York before going to Vietnam.
Description: Upon receiving his draft notice and leaving his family ranch in Oklahoma, Claude heads to New York and befriends a tribe of long-haired hippies on his way to boot camp.

Title: Love, Simon
Hint: A closeted teen falls for an anonymous classmate online.
