Description: Everyone deserves a great love story, but for 17-year-old ___ Spier, it's a little more complicated. He hasn't told his family or friends that he's gay, and he doesn't know the identity of the anonymous classmate that he's fallen for online.

Title: Chor Nikal Ke Bhaga
Hint: A flight attendant and her boyfriend plan to steal a cache of diamonds during a flight, until the plane is hijacked.
Description: A flight attendant and her boyfriend must steal a cache of diamonds to clear an old debt — but the plan spins into a mayhem when the plane gets hijacked.

Title: Cure
Hint: A detective investigates murders committed by people who don't remember them.
Description: A frustrated detective deals with the case of several gruesome murders committed by people who have no recollection of what they've done.

Title: The Secret of NIMH
Genres: Adventure, Animation, Drama, Family, Fantasy, Mystery, Science Fiction
Hint: A widowed field mouse seeks help from a colony of super-intelligent lab rats to save her sick son and their home.
Description: A widowed field mouse must move her family -- including an ailing son -- to escape a farmer's plow. Aided by a crow and a pack of superintelligent, escaped lab rats, the brave mother struggles to transplant her home to firmer ground.

Title: Waves
Hint: A family's life is torn apart by a tragedy during high school.
Description: A controlling father’s attempts to ensure that his two children succeed in high school backfire after his son experiences a career-ending sports injury. Their familial bonds are eventually placed under severe strain by an unexpected tragedy.

Title: A Single Man
Hint: A grieving professor plans his last day in 1960s Los Angeles.
Description: Set in Los Angeles in 1962, at the height of the Cuban missile crisis, is the story of a British college professor who dwells on the past and cannot see his future. We follow him through a single day, where a series of events and encounters ultimately lead him to decide if there is a meaning to life after the death of his long time partner, Jim.

Title: The Big Blue
Hint: Two rival free divers compete to go deeper than anyone.
Description: Childhood friends Jacques and Enzo share a passion for the danger of free diving. Jacques, following in the footsteps of his father, who died at sea when Jacques was a boy, harbors a remarkable ability to adjust his heart rate and breathing patterns in the water, with his vital signs more closely resembling those of dolphins than men.

Title: Stranger Than Fiction
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A lonely tax auditor begins hearing a voice narrating his life and discovers he is a character in a novel who's about to die.
Description: Harold Crick is a lonely IRS agent whose mundane existence is transformed when he hears a mysterious voice narrating his life.

Title: Weathering with You
Hint: A runaway boy meets a girl who can control the weather.
Description: The summer of his high school freshman year, Hodaka runs away from his remote island home to Tokyo, and quickly finds himself pushed to his financial and personal limits. The weather is unusually gloomy and rainy every day, as if taking its cue from his life. After many days of solitude, he finally finds work as a freelance writer for a mysterious occult magazine.

Title: Pinocchio
Hint: A wooden puppet longs to become a real boy.
Description: When the gentle woodcarver Geppetto builds a marionette to be his substitute son, a benevolent fairy brings the toy to life. The puppet, named ___, is not yet a human boy. He must earn the right to be real by proving that he is brave, truthful, and unselfish.

Title: A Simple Plan
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, France, Japan, Germany
Hint: Two brothers find a bag of money in a crashed plane.
Description: Captivated by the lure of sudden wealth, the quiet rural lives of two brothers erupt into conflicts of greed, paranoia and distrust when over $4 million in cash is discovered at the remote site of a downed small airplane. Their ___ to retain the money while avoiding detection opens a Pandora's box when the fear of getting caught triggers panicked behavior and leads to virulent consequences.

Title: Lady Vengeance
Hint: A woman wrongly imprisoned for 13 years for a child's murder executes a meticulous plan for revenge.
Description: Released after being wrongfully convicted and imprisoned for 13 years, a woman begins executing her elaborate plan of retribution.

Title: The Fisher King
Hint: A radio host and a homeless man search for the Holy Grail in New York.
Description: Two troubled men face their terrible destinies and events of their past as they join together on a mission to find the Holy Grail and thus to save themselves.

Title: Saving Mr. Banks
Country: Australia, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A prickly author recalls her troubled childhood as a Hollywood mogul tries to buy the rights to her magical nanny books.
Description: Author P.L. Travers looks back on her childhood while reluctantly meeting with Walt Disney, who seeks to adapt her Mary Poppins books for the big screen.

Title: The Wind that Shakes the Barley
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, Germany, Italy, Spain
Hint: Two Irish brothers fight for independence in the 1920s.
Description: In 1920s Ireland young doctor Damien O'Donovan prepares to depart for a new job in a London hospital. As he says his goodbyes at a friend's farm, British Black and Tans arrive, and a young man is killed. Damien joins his brother Teddy in the Irish Republican Army, but political events are soon set in motion that tear the brothers apart.

Title: The Great Debaters
Hint: A professor turns his debate team into champions in the 1930s South.
Description: The true story of a brilliant but politically radical debate team coach who uses the power of words to transform a group of underdog African-American college students into a historical powerhouse that took on the Harvard elite.

Title: The Farewell
Hint: A Chinese-American woman returns to China, where her family hides the grandmother's terminal diagnosis with a fake wedding.
Description: A headstrong Chinese-American woman returns to China when her beloved grandmother is given a terminal diagnosis. Billi struggles with her family's decision to keep grandma in the dark about her own illness as they all stage an impromptu wedding to see grandma one last time.

Title: Christiane F. – Wir Kinder vom Bahnhof Zoo
Hint: A teen girl in 1970s Berlin becomes addicted to heroin.
Description: A teen girl in 1970s Berlin becomes addicted to heroin. Everything in her life slowly begins to distort and disappear as she befriends a small crew of junkies and falls in love with a drug-abusing male prostitute.

Title: The Hate U Give
Hint: A teen girl finds her voice after her friend is shot by a police officer.
Description: Raised in a poverty-stricken slum, a 16-year-old girl named Starr now attends a suburban prep school. After she witnesses a police officer shoot her unarmed best friend, she's torn between her two very different worlds as she tries to speak her truth.

Title: Withnail & I
Hint: Two unemployed, hard-drinking actors in 1969 London take a disastrous holiday at a cottage in the Lake District.
Description: Two out-of-work actors -- the anxious, luckless Marwood and his acerbic, alcoholic friend, ___ -- spend their days drifting between their squalid flat, the unemployment office and the pub. When they take a holiday "by mistake" at the country house of ___ flamboyantly gay uncle, Monty, they encounter the unpleasant side of the English countryside: tedium, terrifying locals and torrential rain.

Title: Headhunters
Hint: A Norwegian headhunter who moonlights as an art thief steals from the wrong man and becomes the hunted.
Description: An accomplished headhunter risks everything to obtain a valuable painting owned by a former mercenary.

Title: Still Alice
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A respected linguistics professor is diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's and slowly loses her words and memories.
Description: ___ Howland, happily married with three grown children, is a renowned linguistics professor who starts to forget words. When she receives a devastating diagnosis, ___ and her family find their bonds tested.

Title: Deep Red
Hint: A pianist investigates a series of grisly murders in Rome.
Description: An English pianist living in Rome witnesses the brutal murder of his psychic neighbor. With the help of a tenacious young reporter, he tries to discover the killer using very unconventional methods. The two are soon drawn into a shocking web of dementia and violence.

Title: The Life of David Gale
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An anti-death-penalty professor ends up on death row for murder, and a journalist investigates his final days.
Description: A man against capital punishment is accused of murdering a fellow activist and is sent to death row.

Title: Doubt
Hint: A nun suspects a priest of misconduct in a Bronx Catholic school.
Description: In 1964 Bronx, two Catholic school nuns question the new priest's ambiguous relationship with a troubled African-American student.

Title: The Man Who Wasn't There
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A quiet, chain-smoking barber's blackmail scheme spirals into murder in 1940s small-town California.
Description: A tale of murder, crime and punishment set in the summer of 1949. Ed Crane, a barber in a small California town, is dissatisfied with his life, but his wife Doris' infidelity and a mysterious opportunity presents him with a chance to change it.

Title: Thank You for Smoking
Hint: A tobacco spokesman spins the truth while trying to be a good dad.
Description: Nick Naylor is a charismatic spin-doctor for Big Tobacco who'll fight to protect America's right to smoke -- even if it kills him -- while still remaining a role model for his 12-year old son. When he incurs the wrath of a senator bent on snuffing out cigarettes, Nick's powers of "filtering the truth" will be put to the test.

Title: The Last Detail
Hint: Two sailors escort a young prisoner to jail and show him one final good time.
Description: Two Navy men are ordered to bring a young offender to prison, but decide to show him one last good time along the way.

Title: Tell No One
Hint: A doctor receives an email that suggests his murdered wife is alive.
Description: A man receives a mysterious email appearing to be from his wife, who was murdered years earlier. As he frantically tries to find out whether she's alive, he finds himself being implicated in her death.

Title: Dead Man
Country: United States of America, Germany, Japan
Hint: A meek accountant on the run after a killing is guided through the frontier by a Native American who believes he's a famous poet.
Description: On the run after committing murder, an accountant encounters a strange Native American man who prepares him for his journey into the spiritual world.

Title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
Country: France, Germany, Japan, United States of America
Hint: A hitman who lives by an ancient warrior code is targeted by the mob.
Description: A Black hitman who models after the ___ of old finds himself targeted for death by the mob.

Title: The Long Goodbye
Hint: A private eye helps a friend accused of murder in 1970s Los Angeles.
Description: In 1970s Hollywood, Detective Philip Marlowe tries to help a friend who is accused of murdering his wife.

Title: Godzilla
Hint: Japan is thrown into panic as a giant prehistoric monster awakened by nuclear testing attacks Tokyo.
Description: Japan is thrown into a panic after several ships are sunk near Odo Island. An expedition to the island led by Dr. Kyohei Yamane soon discover something far more devastating than imagined in the form of a 50 meter tall monster whom the natives call Gojira. Now the monster begins a rampage that threatens to destroy not only Japan, but the rest of the world as well.

Title: Life as a House
Hint: A dying man rebuilds his home with his troubled teenage son.
Description: When a man is diagnosed with terminal cancer, he takes custody of his misanthropic teenage son, for whom quality time means getting high, engaging in small-time prostitution, and avoiding his father.

Title: Delicatessen
Hint: A former clown moves into a post-apocalyptic building above a butcher's shop.
Description: In a post-apocalyptic world, the residents of an apartment above the butcher shop receive an occasional delicacy of meat, something that is in low supply. A young man new in town falls in love with the butcher's daughter, which causes conflicts in her family, who need the young man for other business-related purposes.

Title: Sympathy for Mr. Vengeance
Hint: A deaf man kidnaps a girl to pay for his sister's surgery.
Description: A deaf man and his girlfriend resort to desperate measures in order to fund a kidney transplant for his sister. Things go horribly wrong, and the situation spirals rapidly into a cycle of violence and revenge.

Title: Henry V
Hint: A young English king leads his army against France.
Description: In 1415, in the midst of the Hundred Years' War, the young King ___ of England embarks on the conquest of France.

Title: The City of Lost Children
Hint: A mad scientist kidnaps kids to steal their dreams and slow his aging.
Description: A scientist in a surrealist society kidnaps children to steal their dreams, hoping that they slow his aging process.

Title: A Perfect World
Hint: An escaped convict kidnaps a boy and they bond on the road.
Description: A kidnapped boy strikes up a friendship with his captor: an escaped convict on the run from the law, headed by an honorable U.S. Marshal.

Title: How to Steal a Million
Hint: A woman plots a heist at a Paris museum to hide her father's forgeries.
Description: A woman must steal a statue from a Paris museum to help conceal her father's art forgeries.

Title: A Royal Affair
Hint: A young Danish queen falls in love with her king's physician, and together they spark a revolution.
Description: A young queen falls in love with her physician, and they start a revolution that changes their nation forever.

Title: Boy
Hint: An 11-year-old in 1980s New Zealand dreams that his absent father is a hero.
Description: ___, an 11-year-old child and devout Michael Jackson fan who lives on the east coast of New Zealand in 1984, gets a chance to know his absentee criminal father, who has returned to find a bag of money he buried years ago.

Title: Show Me Love
Hint: Two teen girls in a small Swedish town fall in love.
Description: Two teenage girls in small-town Sweden. Elin is beautiful, popular, and bored with life. Agnes is friendless, sad, and secretly in love with Elin.

Title: White Christmas
Hint: Two singers stage a show to save their old general's inn.
Description: Two talented song-and-dance men team up after the war to become one of the hottest acts in show business. In time they befriend and become romantically involved with the beautiful Haynes sisters who comprise a sister act.

Title: The Flowers of War
Hint: A Westerner hides in a church during the Nanjing Massacre.
Description: A Westerner finds refuge with a group of women in a church during Japan's rape of Nanking in 1937. Posing as a priest, he attempts to lead the women to safety.

Title: Who Am I
Hint: A young German hacker joins a subversive group seeking fame, and becomes wanted by Europol.
Description: Benjamin, a young German computer whiz, is invited to join a subversive hacker group that wants to be noticed on the world's stage.

Title: Cold War
Hint: A tempestuous love affair between a musician and a singer stretches across the Iron Curtain over fifteen years.
Description: A man and a woman meet in the ruins of post-war Poland. With vastly different backgrounds and temperaments, they are fatally mismatched and yet drawn to each other.

Title: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown
Hint: A woman tries to reach her ex-lover as everything spirals out of control.
Description: After being dumped by her lover, Pepa finds her life and the lives of those around her spiraling out of control in a deliciously chaotic series of events.

Title: Selma
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Martin Luther King Jr. leads a historic march for voting rights.
Description: "___," as in Alabama, the place where segregation in the South was at its worst, leading to a march that ended in violence, forcing a famous statement by President Lyndon B. Johnson that ultimately led to the signing of the Voting Rights Act.

Title: Quiz Show
Hint: A congressional lawyer investigates rigged TV trivia contests in the 1950s.
Description: Herbert Stempel's transformation into an unexpected television personality unfolds as he secures victory on the cherished American game show, 'Twenty-One.' However, when the show introduces the highly skilled contestant Charles Van Doren to replace Stempel, it compels Stempel to let out his frustrations and call out the show as rigged.

Title: Devdas
Hint: A heartbroken man drinks himself to death after losing his childhood love.
Description: In 1900s India, Calcuttan zamindar ___ Mukherjee — unable to marry his lover — takes up alcohol and the company of a courtesan to alleviate the pain.

Title: Mersal
Hint: A doctor and a magician are suspected of a series of crimes.
Description: A few individuals in the medical profession are murdered or kidnapped, and the cop investigating the case suspects a doctor and arrests him. But is he the one who is behind these crimes? And why are they being committed?

Title: Hunger
Hint: An IRA prisoner refuses food in a fatal protest inside the Maze prison.
Description: The story of Bobby Sands, the IRA member who led the 1981 ___ strike during The Troubles in which Irish Republican prisoners tried to win political status.

Title: Little Big Man
Hint: A 121-year-old man tells of his life among the Cheyenne.
Description: Jack Crabb, looking back from extreme old age, tells of his life being raised by Indians and fighting with General Custer.

Title: Kuch Kuch Hota Hai
Hint: A young girl sets out to reunite her widowed father with his college friend.
Description: Per her mother's last wish, an 8 year old girl sets out to reunite her father with his college best friend who was in love with him.

Title: Santa Sangre
Hint: A circus performer escapes an asylum and is controlled by his armless mother.
Description: A former circus artist escapes from a mental hospital to rejoin his armless, cult leader mother, and is forced to enact brutal murders in her name.

Title: Police Story
Hint: A Hong Kong cop protects a key witness from a drug lord.
Description: Officer Chan Ka Kui manages to put a major Hong Kong drug dealer behind the bars practically alone, after a shooting and an impressive chase inside a slum. Now, he must protect the boss' secretary, Selina, who will testify against the gangster in court.

Title: House of Sand and Fog
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An Iranian immigrant buys a bungalow that a troubled woman insists is still hers.
Description: Behrani, an Iranian immigrant buys a California bungalow, thinking he can fix it up, sell it again, and make enough money to send his son to college. However, the house is the legal property of former drug addict Kathy. After losing the house in an unfair legal dispute with the county, she is left with nowhere to go. Wanting her house back, she hires a lawyer and befriends a police officer.

Title: Happy as Lazzaro
Hint: A pure-hearted young man in rural Italy befriends a rich boy.
Description: Purehearted teen ___ is content living as a sharecropper in rural Italy, but an unlikely friendship with the marquise’s son will change his world.

Title: Support Your Local Sheriff!
Hint: A drifter becomes a lawman just for the pay and figures he can always run.
Description: In the old west, a man becomes a Sheriff just for the pay, figuring he can decamp if things get tough.

Title: A Hard Day's Night
Hint: A band of four mop-tops tries to escape screaming fans.
Description: Capturing John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison and Ringo Starr in their electrifying element, 'A ___' is a wildly irreverent journey through this pastiche of a day in the life of The Beatles during 1964. The band have to use all their guile and wit to avoid the pursuing fans and press to reach their scheduled television performance, in spite of Paul's troublemaking grandfather and Ringo's arrest.

Title: High Sierra
Hint: A paroled gangster plans one last heist in California and falls for a disabled young woman.
Description: Given a pardon from jail, Roy Earle gets back into the swing of things as he robs a swanky resort.

Title: The Sweet Hereafter
Hint: A lawyer investigates a school bus accident in a small town.
Description: A small mountain community in Canada is devastated when a school bus accident leaves more than a dozen of its children dead. A big-city lawyer arrives to help the survivors' and victims' families prepare a class-action suit, but his efforts only seem to push the townspeople further apart.

Title: The Collector
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A man kidnaps a woman and keeps her in his basement.
Description: A man kidnaps a woman and holds her hostage just for the pleasure of having her there.

Title: Spellbound
Hint: A psychiatrist falls for a new doctor who may be a killer.
Description: When Dr. Anthony Edwardes arrives at a Vermont mental hospital to replace the outgoing hospital director, Dr. Constance Peterson, a psychoanalyst, discovers Edwardes is actually an impostor. The man confesses that the real Dr. Edwardes is dead and fears he may have killed him, but cannot recall anything. Dr.

Title: The Legend of Drunken Master
Hint: A young martial arts prodigy uses a booze-fuelled fighting style to stop foreigners smuggling Chinese artefacts.
Description: Returning home with his father after a shopping expedition, Wong Fei-Hong is unwittingly caught up in the battle between foreigners who wish to export ancient Chinese artifacts and loyalists who don't want the pieces to leave the country. Fei-Hong must fight against the foreigners using his ___ Boxing style, and overcome his father's antagonism as well.

Title: The Phantom of the Opera
Hint: A young soprano at a grand Paris theatre becomes the obsession of a masked, disfigured musical genius living in its catacombs.
Description: A young soprano becomes the obsession of a disfigured and murderous musical genius who lives beneath the Paris ___ House.

Title: Memories
Hint: Three short anime science-fiction stories, including a derelict space station haunted by an opera singer's past.
Description: Three back-to-back anime films by three different directors make up this sci-fi trilogy three years in the making.

Title: Free Fall
Hint: A promising cop with a baby on the way is drawn to a male colleague.
Description: A promising career with the police, a baby on the way... Marc's life seems to be right on track. Then he meets fellow policeman Kay and during their regular jogs Marc experiences a never-before-felt sense of ease and effortlessness – and what it means to fall in love with another man.

Title: House of Flying Daggers
Hint: A police captain and a blind dancer are caught in a rebellion.
Description: In 9th century China, a corrupt government wages war against a rebel army called the ___. A romantic warrior breaks a beautiful rebel out of prison to help her rejoin her fellows, but things are not what they seem.

Title: Suddenly, Last Summer
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A wealthy New Orleans widow tries to have her niece lobotomised to hide the truth about her son's death.
Description: The only son of wealthy widow Violet Venable dies while on vacation with his cousin Catherine. What the girl saw was so horrible that she went insane; now Mrs. Venable wants Catherine lobotomized to cover up the truth.

Title: The Guilty
Hint: A demoted LA police officer working an emergency call desk tries to save a caller in danger.
Description: A demoted police officer assigned to a call dispatch desk is conflicted when he receives an emergency phone call from a kidnapped woman.

Title: The Sand Pebbles
Country: United States of America, Taiwan, Hong Kong
Hint: An engineer on a gunboat in 1920s China faces war.
Description: Engineer Jake Holman arrives aboard the gunboat USS San Pablo, assigned to patrol a tributary of the Yangtze in the middle of exploited and revolution-torn 1926 China. His iconoclasm and cynical nature soon clash with the 'rice-bowl' system which runs the ship and the uneasy symbiosis between Chinese and foreigner on the river.

Title: Death Note
Hint: A student finds a notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it.
Description: Light Yagami finds the "___," a notebook with the power to kill, and decides to create a Utopia by killing the world's criminals, and soon the world's greatest detective, "L," is hired to find the mysterious murderer. An all out battle between the two greatest minds on earth begins and the winner will control the world.

Title: The Passenger
Hint: A burnt-out journalist in the Sahara swaps identities with a dead man and finds himself mixed up in gunrunning.
Description: David Locke is a world-weary American journalist who has been sent to cover a conflict in northern Africa, but he makes little progress with the story. When he discovers the body of a stranger who looks similar to him, Locke assumes the dead man's identity. However, he soon finds out that the man was an arms dealer, leading Locke into dangerous situations.

Title: 13 Assassins
Hint: A group of samurai are hired to kill a cruel lord.
Description: A bravado period action film set at the end of Japan's feudal era in which a group of unemployed samurai are enlisted to bring down a sadistic lord and prevent him from ascending to the throne and plunging the country into a war-torn future.

Title: Stalingrad
Hint: A German platoon fights through the brutal winter battle in a Soviet city in WWII.
Description: A German Platoon is explored through the brutal fighting of the Battle of ___. After half of their number is wiped out and they're placed under the command of a sadistic captain, the platoon lieutenant leads his men to desert. The platoon members attempt escape from the city, now surrounded by the Soviet Army.

Title: Tora! Tora! Tora!
Hint: The attack on Pearl Harbor from both American and Japanese perspectives.
Description: In the summer of 1941, the United States and Japan seem on the brink of war after constant embargos and failed diplomacy come to no end. "___", named after the code words used by the lead Japanese pilot to indicate they had surprised the Americans, covers the days leading up to the attack on Pearl Harbor, which plunged America into the Second World War.

Title: Remember
Hint: An elderly man with dementia seeks revenge on a Nazi guard.
Description: With the aid of a fellow Auschwitz survivor and a hand-written letter, an elderly man with dementia goes in search of the person responsible for the death of his family.

Title: Meet Me in St. Louis
Hint: A family looks forward to the 1904 World's Fair over one eventful year.
Description: A year in the life of a turn-of-the-century middle class family, leading up to the opening of the 1904 St. ___ World's Fair.

Title: The Petrified Forest
Hint: A waitress dreams of a better life at a desert diner.
Description: Gabby, the waitress in an isolated Arizona diner, dreams of a bigger and better life. One day penniless intellectual Alan drifts into the joint and the two strike up a rapport. Soon enough, notorious killer Duke Mantee takes the diner's inhabitants hostage. Surrounded by miles of desert, the patrons and staff are forced to sit tight with Mantee and his gang overnight.

Title: Tyrannosaur
Hint: A widower drowning in rage finds an unlikely friend in a charity-shop worker hiding her own bruises.
Description: The story of Joseph, a man plagued by violence and a rage that is driving him to self-destruction. As Joseph's life spirals into turmoil a chance of redemption appears in the form of Hannah, a Christian charity shop worker. Their relationship develops to reveal that Hannah is hiding a secret of her own with devastating results on both of their lives.

Title: The Meaning of Life
Hint: Six comic sketches walk from birth to death, with a very large dinner in between.
Description: Life's questions are 'answered' in a series of outrageous vignettes, beginning with a staid London insurance company which transforms before our eyes into a pirate ship. Then there's the National Health doctors who try to claim a healthy liver from a still-living donor. The world's most voracious glutton brings the art of vomiting to new heights before his spectacular demise.

Title: Dil Se..
Hint: A radio journalist falls hard for a silent stranger whose secret could blow up everything.
Description: Journalist Amar falls for a mysterious woman on an assignment, but she does not reciprocate his feelings. However, when Amar is about to get married, the woman shows up at his doorstep asking for help.

Title: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
Hint: A honey-loving bear and his stuffed-animal friends bumble through gentle mishaps in a storybook wood.
Description: Whether we’re young or forever young at heart, the Hundred Acre Wood calls to that place in each of us that still believes in magic. Join pals ___, Piglet, Kanga, Roo, Owl, Rabbit, Tigger and Christopher Robin as they enjoy their days together and sing their way through adventures.

Title: Fruitvale Station
Hint: The last day in the life of a young Oakland father, ending on a train platform at New Year.
Description: Oakland, California. Young Afro-American Oscar Grant crosses paths with family members, friends, enemies and strangers before facing his fate on the platform at ___, in the early morning hours of New Year's Day 2009.

Title: 5 Centimeters per Second
Hint: Two childhood friends drift apart, measured in falling cherry blossoms and missed trains.
Description: Three moments in Takaki's life: his relationship with Akari and their forced separation; his friendship with Kanae, who is secretly in love with him; the demands and disappointments of adulthood, an unhappy life in a cold city.

Title: Redline
Hint: A daredevil driver competes in the most dangerous and popular race in the galaxy.
Description: A daredevil driver is determined to compete in ___, the most popular race in the galaxy. The race only occurs every five years, but in order to participate he must overcome the mafia, the government and even love.

Title: Whale Rider
Hint: A young Maori girl fights her grandfather's tradition to become the tribe's chief.
Description: A contemporary story of love, rejection, and triumph as a young Māori girl fights to fulfill a destiny her grandfather refuses to recognize.

Title: Flickering Lights
Hint: Four small-time Danish crooks steal from their boss and hide out in a ramshackle country restaurant.
Description: Four small gangsters from Copenhagen trick a gangster boss: they take over 4,000,000 kroner which they were supposed to bring him. Trying to escape to Barcelona they are forced to stop in the countryside, in an old, wrecked house, hiding there for several weeks. Slowly, one after another, they realize, that they would like to stay there, start a new life.

Title: The Spy Who Came in from the Cold
Hint: A burnt-out British agent poses as a defector to infiltrate East German intelligence, in a bleak espionage thriller.
Description: British agent Alec Leamas refuses to come in from the Cold War during the 1960s, choosing to face another mission, which may prove to be his final one.

Title: A Bittersweet Life
Hint: A hotel enforcer for a crime boss is ordered to spy on the boss's young mistress, and spares her.
Description: Kim Sun-woo is an enforcer and manager for a hotel owned by a cold, calculative crime boss, Kang who assigns Sun-woo to a simple errand while he is away on a business trip; to shadow his young mistress, Hee-soo, for fear that she may be cheating on him with a younger man with the mandate that he must kill them both if he discovers their affair.

Title: Ip Man 2
Hint: A humble kung fu master opens a school in Hong Kong and takes on a British boxer.
Description: Having defeated the best fighters of the Imperial Japanese army in occupied Shanghai, Ip Man and his family settle in post-war Hong Kong. Struggling to make a living, Master Ip opens a kung fu school to bring his celebrated art of Wing Chun to the troubled youth of Hong Kong. His growing reputation soon brings challenges from powerful enemies, including pre-eminent Hung Gar master, Hung Quan.

Title: Hush...Hush, Sweet Charlotte
Hint: An aging Southern belle, haunted by a decades-old murder, is pushed toward madness.
Description: An aging, reclusive Southern belle plagued by a horrifying family secret descends into madness after the arrival of a lost relative.

Title: You Can Count on Me
Hint: A single mother's life is thrown into turmoil when her troubled younger brother returns to their hometown.
Description: A single mother's life is thrown into turmoil after her struggling, rarely-seen younger brother returns to town.

Title: Fresh
Hint: A dating-app romance leads a young woman to a doctor with very particular tastes in meat.
Description: Frustrated by scrolling dating apps only to end up on lame, tedious dates, Noa takes a chance by giving her number to the awkwardly charming Steve after a produce-section meet-cute at the grocery store.

Title: The Secret of Kells
Hint: A monastery boy sneaks into an enchanted forest to help finish a glowing illuminated book.
Description: Adventure awaits 12 year old Brendan who must fight Vikings and a serpent god to find a crystal and complete the legendary Book of ___. In order to finish Brother Aiden's book, Brendan must overcome his deepest fears on a secret quest that will take him beyond the abbey walls and into the enchanted forest where dangerous mythical creatures hide. Will Brendan succeed in his quest?

Title: Sin Nombre
Hint: A Honduran girl and a fleeing gang member ride the roofs of trains toward the US border.
Description: Sayra, a Native Honduran teenager, hungers for a better life. Her chance for one comes when she is reunited with her long-estranged father, who intends to emigrate to Mexico and then enter the United States. Sayra's life collides with a pair of Indigenous Mexican and Mestizo-Mexican gangmembers who have boarded the same USA-bound train.

Title: Coal Miner's Daughter
Hint: A teenage bride from a Kentucky mining town rises to become a country music queen.
Description: Biography of Loretta Lynn, a country and western singer that came from poverty to fame.

Title: Love Me If You Dare
Hint: Two childhood friends turn a lifelong game of challenges into a wild, reckless romance.
Description: As adults, best friends Julien and Sophie continue the odd game they started as children -- a fearless competition to outdo one another with daring and outrageous stunts. While they often act out to relieve one another's pain, their game might be a way to avoid the fact that they are truly meant for one another.

Title: Berserk: The Golden Age Arc I - The Egg of the King
Genres: Animation, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Drama, Horror
Hint: A lone mercenary with a huge sword joins a band led by an ambitious young commander.
Description: Guts, an immensely strong sword-for-hire, has little direction in his life, simply fighting one battle after the next. However, this all changes suddenly when he meets and is bested by Griffith, a beautiful and charismatic young man who leads the Band of the Hawk mercenary army.

Title: The Lady from Shanghai
Hint: A sailor is pulled into a murder plot by a tycoon's wife, ending in a hall of mirrors.
Description: A romantic drifter gets caught between a corrupt tycoon and his voluptuous wife.

Title: Distant
Hint: A country cousin crashes with an Istanbul photographer, and their silent loneliness fills the flat.
Description: A young man from rural Turkey arrives in Istanbul with dreams of working on a ship and stays with a cousin while he searches for work. Over time, the former’s struggles to find employment and the latter’s troubles and disappointments strain their relationship and living situation.

Title: New World
Hint: An undercover cop deep inside a Korean crime syndicate is caught in a brutal succession war.
Description: An undercover cop has his loyalties tested when the boss of the corporate gang he's spent years infiltrating dies.

Title: Kiss Me Deadly
Hint: A tough LA private eye picks up a terrified hitchhiker and is drawn into a lethal hunt for a mysterious glowing box.
Description: One evening, Hammer gives a ride to Christina, an attractive hitchhiker on a lonely country road, who has escaped from the nearby lunatic asylum. Thugs waylay them and force his car to crash. When Hammer returns to semi-consciousness, he hears Christina being tortured until she dies. Hammer, both for vengeance and in hopes that "something big" is behind it all, decides to pursue the case.

Title: All About Lily Chou-Chou
Hint: A group of Japanese teens deal with bullying and violence, finding escape in a mysterious singer's music.
Description: Charts the troubled teenage years of students Yūichi Hasumi and Shūsuke Hoshino, exploring the shifting and complex power dynamics of their relationship against the backdrop of Yūichi's love for the dreamy and abstract music of pop star ___.

Title: The Damned United
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A brash football manager's 44 disastrous days in charge of his bitter rival's old team.
Description: Taking over Leeds United, Brian Clough's abrasive approach and his clear dislike of the players' dirty style of play make it certain there is going to be friction. Glimpses of his earlier career help explain both his hostility to previous manager Don Revie and how much he is missing right-hand man Peter Taylor.

Title: Disconnect
Hint: Three stories show how online lies, scams and bullying can wreck real lives.
Description: A hard-working lawyer, attached to his cell phone, can't find the time to communicate with his family. An estranged couple uses the internet as a means to escape from their lifeless marriage. A widowed ex-cop struggles to raise a mischievous son who cyber-bullies a classmate. An ambitious journalist sees a career-making story in a teen that performs on an adult-only site.

Title: Mystery Train
Hint: A Japanese couple, an Italian widow and an English drifter share one night in a Memphis hotel.
Description: In Memphis, Tennessee, over the course of a single night, the Arcade Hotel, run by an eccentric night clerk and a clueless bellboy, is visited by a young Japanese couple traveling in search of the roots of rock; an Italian woman in mourning who stumbles upon a fleeing charlatan girl; and a comical trio of accidental thieves looking for a place to hide.

Title: Cyrano de Bergerac
Hint: A poet and swordsman with a huge nose helps a handsome young man woo the woman he secretly loves.
Description: Famed swordsman and poet ___ is in love with his cousin Roxane. He has never expressed his love for her as he his large nose undermines his self-confidence. Then he finds a way to express his love to her, indirectly.

Title: Clouds
Hint: A teenage musician with only months to live writes a song that goes viral.
Description: Young musician Zach Sobiech discovers his cancer has spread, leaving him just a few months to live. With limited time, he follows his dream and makes an album, unaware that it will soon be a viral music phenomenon.

Title: On Body and Soul
Hint: Two shy slaughterhouse workers discover they share the same dream every night, as deer.
Description: Two introverted people find out by pure chance that they share the same dream every night. They are puzzled, incredulous, a bit frightened. As they hesitantly accept this strange coincidence, they try to recreate in broad daylight what happens in their dream.

Title: Mesrine: Killer Instinct
Hint: A French soldier comes home from Algeria and becomes the country's most notorious gangster.
Description: Jacques ___, a loyal son and dedicated soldier, is back home and living with his parents after serving in the Algerian War. Soon he is seduced by the neon glamour of sixties Paris and the easy money it presents. Mentored by Guido, ___ turns his back on middle class law-abiding and soon moves swiftly up the criminal ladder.

Title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
Hint: A handsome young man stays forever young while his hidden portrait grows hideous.
Description: A corrupt young man somehow keeps his youthful beauty, but a special painting gradually reveals his inner ugliness to all.

Title: Ratcatcher
Hint: A Glasgow boy carries a terrible secret through a summer of garbage strikes and canals.
Description: James Gillespie is 12 years old. The world he knew is changing. Haunted by a secret, he has become a stranger in his own family. He is drawn to the canal where he creates a world of his own. He finds an awkward tenderness with Margaret Anne, a vulnerable 14 year old expressing a need for love in all the wrong ways, and befriends Kenny, who possesses an unusual innocence in spite of the harsh surroundings.

Title: A Day at the Races
Hint: Three zany brothers try to save a sanitarium by winning a big horse race.
Description: Doctor Hugo Hackenbush, Tony, and Stuffy try and save Judy's sanitarium by winning a big race with a finicky horse owned by Judy's boyfriend Gil. There are a few problems. Hackenbush, who was recently put in charge of the sanitarium, isn't really a doctor, he's a veterinarian.

Title: Living in Oblivion
Hint: One day on a low-budget film set where everything that can go wrong does.
Description: Low-budget independent filmmaker Nick Reve tries to keep everything together as his production is plagued with an insecure actress, a megalomaniac star, a pretentious beret-wearing director of photography, and lousy catering.

Title: Wuthering Heights
Hint: A wild orphan and a headstrong girl share a love that turns to vengeance on the Yorkshire moors.
Description: Young orphan Heathcliff is adopted by the wealthy Earnshaw family and moves into their estate, ___. Soon, the new resident falls for his compassionate foster sister, Cathy. The two share a remarkable bond that seems unbreakable until Cathy, feeling the pressure of social convention, suppresses her feelings and marries Edgar Linton, a man of means who befits her stature. Heathcliff vows to win her back.

Hint: The story of India's underdog cricket team and their historic 1983 World Cup win.
Description: On the 25th of June 1983, the Lord’s Cricket Ground witnessed one of the biggest underdog stories in the history of sports. Fourteen inspired players - led by a man's self-belief and conviction - fought against all odds and orchestrated India’s greatest sporting triumph by beating the two-time World Champions West Indies.

Title: A Hero
Hint: A prisoner on leave becomes a local celebrity for returning a lost bag of gold, then doubt creeps in.
Description: Rahim is in prison because of a debt he was unable to repay. During a two-day leave, he tries to convince his creditor to withdraw his complaint against the payment of part of the sum. But things don't go as planned. Is he truly a ___?

Title: Lenny
Hint: A filthy-mouthed stand-up comic fights the law for the right to say what he wants.
Description: The story of acerbic 1960s comic ___ Bruce, whose groundbreaking, no-holds-barred style and social commentary was often deemed by the establishment as too obscene for the public.

Title: Carandiru
Hint: A doctor listens to the stories of inmates inside Brazil's most overcrowded prison before a massacre.
Description: When a doctor decides to carry out an AIDS prevention program inside Latin America’s largest prison: the Casa de Detenção de São Paulo - ___, he meets the future victims of one of the darkest days in Brazilian History when the State of São Paulo’s Military Police, with the excuse for law enforcement, shot to death 111 people. Based on real facts and on the book written by Dráuzio Varella.

Title: Away from Her
Country: Canada, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A loving husband watches his wife of fifty years forget him and fall for another man in a care home.
Description: Fiona and Grant have been married for nearly 50 years. They have to face the fact that Fiona’s absent-mindedness is a symptom of Alzheimer’s disease. She must go to a specialized nursing home, where she slowly forgets Grant and turns her affection to Aubrey, another patient in the home.

Title: Evangelion: 1.0 You Are (Not) Alone
Hint: A reluctant teen is forced by his father to pilot a giant robot against monstrous invaders.
Description: After the Second Impact, Tokyo-3 is being attacked by giant monsters called Angels that seek to eradicate humankind. The child Shinji’s objective is to fight the Angels by piloting one of the mysterious ___ mecha units. A remake of the first six episodes of GAINAX’s famous 1996 anime series.

Title: The Red Turtle
Hint: A shipwrecked man on a desert island encounters a mysterious giant sea creature, in a dialogue-free animation.
Description: The dialogue-less film follows the major life stages of a castaway on a deserted tropical island populated by turtles, crabs and birds.

Title: Rurouni Kenshin: The Legend Ends
Hint: A wandering swordsman faces a vengeful villain who plans to burn down Kyoto.
Description: Shishio sets sail in his ironclad ship to bring down the government. In order to stop him, ___ trains with his old master to learn his final technique.

Title: Red Desert
Hint: A fragile woman drifts through a smoky, poisoned industrial landscape after an accident.
Description: In an industrializing Italian town, a married woman, rendered mentally unstable after a traffic accident, drifts into an affair with a friend of her husband.

Title: Jodhaa Akbar
Hint: A Mughal emperor and a Rajput princess find love inside an arranged political marriage.
Description: A sixteenth century love story about a marriage of alliance that gave birth to true love between a Mughal emperor and a Rajput princess.

Title: Summer with Monika
Hint: Two working-class teens in Stockholm begin a reckless affair and run away to the archipelago for the season.
Description: One summer day, two teens begin a reckless affair and abandon their families to be with one another.

Title: The Nun's Story
Hint: A Belgian woman takes her vows and struggles with obedience in the Congo and wartime Europe.
Description: After leaving a wealthy Belgian family to become a ___, Sister Luke struggles with her devotion to her vows during crisis, disappointment, and World War II.

Title: The Flight of the Phoenix
Hint: A cargo plane crashes in the Sahara, and the survivors attempt to build a new aircraft from the wreckage.
Description: A cargo aircraft crashes in a sandstorm in the Sahara with less than a dozen men on board. One of the passengers is an airplane designer who comes up with the idea of ripping off the undamaged wing and using it as the basis for a replacement aircraft they need to build before their food and water run out.

Title: Lilies of the Field
Hint: An unemployed construction worker helps a group of East German nuns build a chapel in Arizona.
Description: An unemployed construction worker heading out west stops at a remote farm in the desert to get water when his car overheats. The farm is being worked by a group of East European Catholic nuns, headed by the strict mother superior, who believes the man has been sent by God to build a much needed church in the desert.

Title: Sonatine
Hint: An aging Tokyo yakuza is sent to Okinawa to end a gang war and waits on a beach.
Description: Murakawa, an aging Tokyo yakuza tiring of gangster life, is sent by his boss to Okinawa along with a few of his henchmen to help end a gang war, supposedly as mediators between two warring clans. He finds that the dispute between the clans is insignificant and whilst wondering why he was sent to Okinawa at all, his group is attacked in an ambush.

Title: Our Little Sister
Hint: Three adult siblings take in their teenage half-sibling after their estranged father dies, in a seaside town.
Description: After the death of their estranged father, 3 adult sisters invite their teenaged half-sister to live with them.

Title: Revanche
Hint: An ex-con plans revenge on a village cop after a robbery goes tragically wrong.
Description: Alex, an ex-con working as muscle in a Vienna brothel, dreams of escaping with his girlfriend Tamara, who also works there. Their attempt to break free sets off a chain of events that links their fate with a rural police officer and his troubled marriage. As their lives intersect, a quiet struggle unfolds between guilt, grief, and the desire for redemption.

Title: Lucifer
Hint: A fallen angel passes through a Mexican village and stirs up its people.
Description: On his downfall from Heaven to Hell, ___ passes through the earthly paradise, a village in Mexico, where elderly Lupita and her granddaughter Maria live. Lupita's brother Emanuel pretends he's paralyzed so he can drink and gamble while the two women tend to the sheep. ___ senses an opportunity and plays the miraculous healer.

Title: Stree
Hint: A small town lives in fear of a ghostly woman who abducts men at night during festivals.
Description: Set in the town of Chanderi, ___ is based on the urban legend of Nale Ba that went viral in Karnataka in the 1990s, and features Shraddha Kapoor and Rajkummar Rao in pivotal roles.

Title: The Blind Swordsman: Zatoichi
Hint: A sightless masseur who gambles on dice is secretly the deadliest blade in the village.
Description: ___ traveler ___ is a master ___ and a masseur with a fondness for gambling on dice games. When he arrives in a village torn apart by warring gangs, he sets out to protect the townspeople.

Title: I Lost My Body
Hint: A severed hand escapes a lab and crawls across Paris searching for its owner.
Description: A story of Naoufel, a young man who is in love with Gabrielle. In another part of town, a severed hand escapes from a dissection lab, determined to find its body again.

Title: Balloon
Hint: Two East German families attempt a daring escape to the West in a homemade hot-air craft.
Description: Two families attempt a daredevil plan to escape the GDR with a homemade hot air ___, but it crashes just before the border. The Stasi finds traces of this attempt to escape and immediately starts investigations, while the two families are forced to build a new escape ___. With each passing day the Stasi is closer on their heels – a nerve-wracking race against time begins.

Title: Husbands and Wives
Hint: When their friends split up, a professor and his wife find cracks in their own marriage.
Description: When their best friends announce that they're separating, a professor and his wife discover the faults in their own marriage.

Title: Dead of Night
Hint: An architect at an English country house realises he's met the other guests in a recurring nightmare.
Description: An architect, visiting an English country house, realizes the other guests are familiar from his recurring nightmare. When they share their tales of the supernatural, he is filled with a growing dread.

Title: Dark Passage
Hint: An escaped convict gets plastic surgery to hunt down his wife's real killer.
Description: A man convicted of murdering his wife escapes from prison and works with a woman to try and prove his innocence.

Title: Hour of the Wolf
Hint: A painter on a remote island with his wife is haunted by demons, in a Bergman horror.
Description: While vacationing on a remote German island with his younger pregnant wife, an artist has an emotional breakdown while confronting his repressed desires.

Title: Delhi Belly
Hint: Three roommates end up on a gangster's hit list after a package gets mixed up with a stool sample.
Description: Three unsuspecting, average guys find themselves on the hit list of one of India's most-powerful crime syndicates.

Title: A Man and a Woman
Hint: A widow and a widower meet at their children's boarding school and fall slowly in love.
Description: A ___ meet by accident on a Sunday evening at their childrens' boarding school. Slowly, they reveal themselves to each other, finding that they have something deeply in common.

Title: Frantz
Hint: A young French soldier visits the grave of a German he knew after WWI, and grows close to his fiancée.
Description: In the aftermath of WWI, a young German who grieves the death of her fiancé in France meets a mysterious French man who visits the fiance’s grave to lay flowers.

Title: Juliet of the Spirits
Hint: A suspicious wife turns to mediums and seances to find out if her husband is cheating.
Description: Middle-aged Giulietta grows suspicious of her husband, Giorgio, when his behavior grows increasingly questionable. One night when Giorgio initiates a seance amongst his friends, Giulietta gets in touch with ___ and learns more about herself and her painful past.

Title: Blue Collar
Hint: Three broke Detroit auto workers rob their own union and find something far more dangerous.
Description: Fed up with mistreatment at the hands of both management and union brass, and coupled with financial hardships on each man's end, three auto assembly line workers hatch a plan to rob a safe at union headquarters.

Title: The Namesake
Country: India, Japan, United States of America
Hint: The son of Bengali immigrants struggles with the odd name his father gave him.
Description: The American-born son of Indian immigrants strives to fit in among his fellow New Yorkers despite his family's unwillingness to let go of their traditional ways.

Title: Sunshine
Hint: A crew flies a bomb toward the dying Sun to reignite it and save humanity.
Description: Fifty years into the future, the sun is dying, and Earth is threatened by arctic temperatures. A team of astronauts is sent to revive the Sun — but the mission fails. Seven years later, a new team is sent to finish the mission as mankind’s last hope.

Title: Charley Varrick
Hint: A small-time bank robber accidentally steals the Mafia's money and must outsmart a hitman.
Description: ___ robs a bank in a small town with his friends, but instead of obtaining a small amount of money, they discover they stole a very large amount of money belonging to the mob. ___ must now come up with a plan to not only evade the police but the mob as well.

Title: Claire's Knee
Hint: A diplomat on vacation becomes fixated on touching one small part of a teenage girl's leg.
Description: On the eve of his wedding, on holiday on the Lake Annecy shore, a career diplomat visits an old acquaintance, perhaps a former girlfriend. Through her he meets an intense teenager, Laura, and then lusts after her sister, ___. Whilst Laura attempts to flirt with him, his fantasy becomes focused on wanting to caress ___.

Title: La Cérémonie
Hint: A shy illiterate maid befriends a nosy postmistress, with deadly results for a rich family.
Description: Sophie, a quiet and shy maid working for an upper-class French family, finds a friend in the energetic and uncompromising postmaster Jeanne, who encourages her to stand up against her bourgeois employers.

Title: All or Nothing
Hint: A taxi driver's family in London's suburbs has lost all love, until a crisis hits.
Description: Penny works at a supermarket and Phil is a gentle taxi-driver. Penny’s love for Phil has run dry and they lead joyless lives with their two children, Rachel, a cleaner, and Rory, who is unemployed and aggressive.

Title: Land and Freedom
Hint: An unemployed British communist joins the fight against fascism in the Spanish Civil War.
Description: David Carr is a British Communist who is unemployed. In 1936, when the Spanish Civil War begins, he decides to fight for the Republican side, a coalition of liberals, communists and anarchists, so he joins the POUM militia and witnesses firsthand the betrayal of the Spanish revolution by Stalin's followers and Moscow's orders.

Title: As It Is in Heaven
Hint: A burned-out conductor returns to his Swedish village and transforms the church choir.
Description: A musical romantic tragedy about a famous composer who moves back to his small hometown after having had heart troubles. His search for a simple everyday life leads him into teaching the local church choir, which is not easily accepted by the town yet the choir builds a great love for their teacher.

Title: Rurouni Kenshin Part II: Kyoto Inferno
Hint: A wandering ronin with a reverse blade must stop a scarred killer from burning the old capital.
Description: ___ has settled into his new life with Kaoru and his other friends when he is approached with a request from the Meiji government. Makoto Shishio, a former assassin like ___, was betrayed, set on fire and left for dead. He survived, and is now in ___, plotting with his gathered warriors to overthrow the new government.

Title: The Mark of Zorro
Hint: A nobleman's son poses as a fop by day and a masked swordsman by night to free California.
Description: In 1820 Spain, the son of a California nobleman comes home to find his native land under a villainous dictatorship. On one hand, he plays the useless fop, while on the other, he is the masked avenger ___.

Title: Ghajini
Hint: A man who forgets everything every 15 minutes uses tattoos and photos to hunt his girlfriend's killer.
Description: A man suffering from anterograde amnesia as a result of a violent attack in the past sets out to avenge his girlfriend's death with the aid of photographs, notes and tattoos all over his body.

Title: Songs from the Second Floor
Hint: A string of bleak, absurd tableaux as a Swedish city grinds to a halt.
Description: A monumental traffic jam serves as the backdrop for the lives of the inhabitants of a Swedish city.

Title: Fist of Legend
Hint: A martial arts student returns to Shanghai to avenge his poisoned teacher.
Description: Chen returns to his school when he finds out that his martial arts teacher has died. When he learns that his school students are harassed by some hooligans, he gears himself up to save them.

Title: Horse Feathers
Hint: A college president hires two bootleggers to win a football game, in a comedy of anarchy.
Description: Quincy Adams Wagstaff, the new president of Huxley U, hires bumblers Baravelli and Pinky to help his school win the big football game against rival Darwin U.

Title: Stewie Griffin: The Untold Story
Hint: A talking baby with plans for world domination meets his future self.
Description: The maniacal baby of the ___ family, ___, meets his future self. In doing this he discovers that his future image is not what he has anticipated because of a near death experience.

Title: October
Hint: A Soviet docu-drama re-creating the 1917 revolution in Petrograd and the storming of the Winter Palace.
Description: Sergei M. Eisenstein's docu-drama about the 1917 ___ Revolution in Russia. Made ten years after the events and edited in Eisenstein's 'Soviet Montage' style, it re-enacts in celebratory terms several key scenes from the revolution.

Title: Iron Monkey
Hint: A Robin Hood-like vigilante doctor steals from corrupt officials in 19th-century China.
Description: In this Hong Kong variation of Robin Hood, corrupt officials of a Chinese village are robbed by a masked bandit known as "___", named after a benevolent deity. When all else fails, the Governor forces a traveling physician into finding the bandit.

Title: Omar
Hint: A young Palestinian baker is forced to become an informant after an attack on soldiers.
Description: The drama, the story of three childhood friends and a young woman who are torn apart in their fight for freedom, is billed as the first fully-financed film to come out of the Palestinian cinema industry.

Title: The Counterfeiters
Hint: A Jewish forger is forced to print fake banknotes for the Nazis in a concentration camp.
Description: The story of Jewish counterfeiter Salomon Sorowitsch, who was coerced into assisting the Nazi operation of the Sachsenhausen concentration camp during World War II.

Title: The Consequences of Love
Hint: A discreet businessman lives in a Swiss hotel and has a secret connection to the Mafia.
Description: Lugano, Switzerland. Titta Di Girolamo is a discreet and sullen man who has been living for almost a decade in a modest hotel room, a prisoner of an atrocious routine, apparently without purpose. His past is a mystery, nobody knows what he does for a living, he answers indiscreet questions evasively. What secrets does this enigmatic man hide?

Title: Custody
Hint: A divorced mother tries to protect her son from his violent, controlling father.
Description: Miriam and Antoine have recently separated. While she’s willing to permit their 17-year-old daughter Josephine to decide living arrangements for herself, Miriam is desperate to keep her youngest, 11-year-old Julien, away from his father.

Title: Seeking True Love
Hint: Two lonely strangers keep almost meeting, if fate doesn't get in the way.
Description: A narrative exploration of interpersonal relationships where protagonists navigate modern dating culture in an urban setting.

Title: Scrooge
Hint: A miserly old businessman is visited by three ghosts on Christmas Eve.
Description: Ebenezer ___ malcontentedly shuffles through life as a cruel, miserly businessman, until he is visited by three spirits on Christmas Eve who show him how his unhappy childhood and adult behavior has left him a selfish, lonely old man.

Title: Wadjda
Hint: An enterprising Saudi girl enters a Quran recitation competition to win money for a bicycle.
Description: An enterprising Saudi girl signs on for her school's Quran recitation competition as a way to raise the remaining funds she needs in order to buy the green bicycle that has captured her interest.

Title: Open Hearts
Hint: A car accident paralyzes a young man just before his wedding, and his fiancée turns to the doctor.
Description: Cecilie and Joachim are about to get married when a freak car accident leaves Joachim disabled, throwing their lives into a spin. The driver of the other car, Marie, and her family don’t get off lightly, either. Her husband Niels works in the hospital where he meets Cecilie and falls madly in love with her.

Title: The Barbarian Invasions
Hint: A dying professor gathers his old friends and his estranged son for one last round of laughter.
Description: In this belated sequel to 'The Decline of the American Empire', middle-aged Montreal college professor, Remy, learns that he is dying of liver cancer. His ex-wife, Louise, asks their estranged son, Sebastian, a successful businessman living in London, to come home.

Title: Brothers
Hint: A soldier presumed dead returns home to find his brother close to his wife.
Description: When his helicopter goes down during his fourth tour of duty in Afghanistan, Marine Sam Cahill is presumed dead. Back home, brother Tommy steps in to look over Sam’s wife, Grace, and two children. Sam’s surprise homecoming triggers domestic mayhem.

Title: Born Yesterday
Hint: A crude junk tycoon hires a tutor to polish his showgirl girlfriend, who turns out smarter than him.
Description: Uncouth, loud-mouth junkyard tycoon Harry Brock descends upon Washington D.C. to buy himself a congressman or two, bringing with him his mistress, ex-showgirl Billie Dawn.

Title: A Twelve-Year Night
Hint: Three political prisoners spend over a decade in isolation under Uruguay's dictatorship.
Description: Uruguay, 1973. Having been crushed by the military dictatorship, surviving members of the Tupamaro guerillas are imprisoned and tortured. They must find a way to endure the coming 12 years.

Title: Birds of Passage
Hint: An indigenous Colombian family gets rich in the marijuana trade and tears itself apart.
Description: During the marijuana bonanza, a violent decade that saw the origins of drug trafficking in Colombia, Rapayet and his indigenous family get involved in a war to control the business that ends up destroying their lives and their culture.

Title: Murder, My Sweet
Hint: A private eye searching for an ex-con's girlfriend falls into a web of jewels and killing.
Description: After being hired to find an ex-con's former girlfriend, Philip Marlowe is drawn into a deeply complex web of mystery and deceit.

Title: Red Cliff II
Country: China, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, United States of America
Hint: The fiery naval battle that decided the fate of ancient China reaches its climax.
Description: The battle of Red ___ continues and the alliance between Xu and East Wu is fracturing. With Cao Cao's massive forces on their doorstep, will the kingdoms of Xu and East Wu survive?

Title: King of Devil's Island
Hint: Boys at a frozen reform school off the Norwegian coast rise up against a cruel governor.
Description: Norwegian winter, 1915. On the island Bastøy, outside Oslo, a group of young boys aged 11 to 18, are held in an institution for delinquent youth, notorious for its sadistic regime. One day a new boy, Erling, arrives, determined to escape from the island. After a tragic incident, he ends up leading the boys in a violent uprising. When the boys manage to take over the island, 150 soldiers are sent in to restore order.

Title: The Distinguished Citizen
Hint: A Nobel-winning Argentine writer returns to his hometown and faces old grudges.
Description: After refusing big and prestigious awards all over the world, Mr. Mantovani, Literature Nobel Prize winner, accepts an invitation to visit his hometown in Argentina, which has been the inspiration for all of his books. It turns out that accepting this invitation is the worst idea of his life. Expect the unexpected when you have used real people as characters in your novels!

Title: Bullet in the Head
Hint: Three friends flee to war-torn Saigon after a killing and are torn apart by greed.
Description: Three childhood friends from the slums of Hong Kong flee to war-time Saigon after accidentally murdering a gang leader, but their troubles only escalate.

Title: And Now for Something Completely Different
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A greatest-hits collection of absurd British sketches, from dead parrots to lumberjacks.
Description: A collection of Monty Python's Flying Circus skits from the first two seasons of their British TV series.

Title: Blancanieves
Hint: A silent black-and-white take on a fairy tale, set in 1920s Seville with bullfighters.
Description: A black and white silent movie, based on the Snow White fairy tale, that is set in a romantic version of 1920s Seville and centered on a female bullfighter.

Title: Dasvi
Hint: A jailed, uneducated politician decides to sit his school exams behind bars.
Description: Jailed under a tough cop, an uneducated politician decides to spend his time studying for high school while his scheming wife has plans of her own.

Title: Sarah's Key
Hint: A journalist uncovers the story of a Jewish girl who hid her brother in a cupboard in 1942 Paris.
Description: On the night of 16 July 1942, ten year old ___ and her parents are being arrested and transported to the Velodrome d'Hiver in Paris where thousands of other jews are being sent to get deported. ___ however managed to lock her little brother in a closet just before the police entered their apartment.

Title: Get Real
Hint: A shy gay teen falls in love with the school's star athlete.
Description: Sensitive rural town model student Steven Carter hides his gay feelings, except with his neighbor and best friend Linda. Suddenly his desperate search for partners leads to a blind date with golden boy John Dixon, bound for an Oxbridge career.

Title: Submarino
Hint: Two brothers haunted by a childhood tragedy struggle with addiction in Copenhagen.
Description: As children, Nick and his little brother take care of their baby brother while their mother drinks herself senseless. But the baby dies, and both brothers blame themselves. Many years later, Nick is out of prison after serving time for an assault. He drinks, lives in a shelter and tries to help an old friend. When their mother dies, Nick meets his brother at the funeral.

Title: Trapped
Hint: Kidnappers grab a doctor's daughter, but the parents turn the tables.
Description: When their daughter is abducted by experienced kidnappers, the Jennings turn the tables on their seemingly fool-proof plan.

Title: Swing Time
Hint: A gambler-dancer must earn a fortune to marry his fiancée, but falls for his dance partner.
Description: Lucky is tricked into missing his own wedding to Margaret and has to make $25,000 so her father will allow him to marry her. He and business partner Pop go to New York where they run into dancing instructor Penny. She and Lucky form a successful dance partnership, but romance is blighted by his old attachment to Margaret and hers for Ricky.

Title: The Lavender Hill Mob
Hint: A meek bank clerk and a souvenir maker smuggle stolen gold as Eiffel Tower paperweights.
Description: A meek bank clerk who oversees the shipments of bullion joins with an eccentric neighbor to steal gold bars and smuggle them out of the country.

Title: Nowhere in Africa
Hint: A Jewish family flees Nazi Germany to a remote farm in Kenya, where the young daughter thrives.
Description: A Jewish woman named Jettel Redlich flees Nazi Germany with her daughter Regina, to join her husband, Walter, on a farm in Kenya. At first, Jettel refuses to adjust to her new circumstances, bringing with her a set of china dishes and an evening gown. While Regina adapts readily to this new world, forming a strong bond with her father's cook, an African named Owuor.

Title: The Desperate Hours
Hint: Three escaped convicts take a suburban family hostage in their own home.
Description: Escaped convicts terrorize a suburban family they're holding hostage.

Title: Alexander Nevsky
Hint: A Russian prince unites his people to fight invading German knights on a frozen lake.
Description: When German knights invade Russia, Prince ___ must rally his people to resist the formidable force. After the Teutonic soldiers take over an eastern Russian city, ___ stages his stand at Novgorod, where a major battle is fought on the ice of frozen Lake Chudskoe.

Title: Losers' Club
Hint: Two late-night radio hosts in 1990s Istanbul turn their heartbreak into a cult show.
Description: Kaan and Mete, co-hosts of a mid 1990s radio show called Kaybedenler Kulübü (___), struggle to deal with their daily lives after their show becomes an instant hit. Kaan meets Zeynep, the girl of his dreams, but their relationship comes under pressure as the show continues to stir controversy and attract fans from every segment of Istanbul society.

Title: The Letter
Hint: A woman shoots a man to death in Malaya, and a damning note threatens her defence.
Description: After a woman shoots a man to death, a damning ___ she wrote raises suspicions.

Title: The Concert
Hint: A disgraced Russian conductor sneaks his old orchestra to Paris by posing as the Bolshoi.
Description: A former world-famous conductor of the Bolshoï orchestra, known as "The Maëstro", Andreï Filipov had seen his career publicly broken by Leonid Brezhnev for hiring Jewish musicians and now works cleaning the ___ hall where he once directed. One day, he intercepts an official invitation from the prestigious Théâtre du Châtelet.

Title: Tokyo Sonata
Hint: A Japanese father loses his job and pretends to go to the office every day.
Description: The winds of change blow as a family grapples with unemployment, alienation, mistrust and a lack of communication. When a Japanese salaryman loses his job to outsourcing to China, it's simply the beginning of a series of shattering incidents, leading to the implosion of the family unit.

Title: The Band's Visit
Country: France, Israel, United States of America
Hint: A small Egyptian police orchestra gets lost in a sleepy Israeli town for one night.
Description: A small Egyptian police band travels to Israel to play at the inaugural ceremony of an Arab arts center, only to find themselves stuck in the wrong town.

Title: The Palm Beach Story
Hint: A New York inventor's wife leaves him to find a millionaire to fund his invention.
Description: A New York inventor, Tom Jeffers, needs cash to develop his big idea, so his adoring wife, Gerry, decides to raise it by divorcing him and marrying an eccentric Florida millionaire, J. D. Hackensacker III.

Title: Life Is a Miracle
Hint: A railway engineer in Bosnia falls for a Muslim hostage he is supposed to trade for his son.
Description: Set during the Bosnian war in the early 1990s, Luka is a mild-mannered railway clerk whose life is turned upside down, not just by the outbreak of the war, but when his wife runs off with a local musician. Then Luka's son is conscripted and eventually captured in the fighting. To recover his son, Luka is commanded to guard a pretty young Muslim nurse who will be used in a hostage swapping operation.

Title: Whisper If I Forget
Hint: An aging pop singer with dementia returns to her old home and relives her youth.
Description: An old pop singer who has Alzheimer's returns to her old house where she remembers her old days of climbing the stairs of fame and fortune while trying to deal with her older sister who holds her responsible for her ruined life.

Title: The Match Factory Girl
Hint: A dowdy worker on a production line, unloved by everyone, quietly takes poisoned revenge.
Description: Iris is a shy and dowdy young woman stuck in a dead-end job at a match ___, who dreams of finding love at the local dancehall. Finding herself pregnant after a one-night stand and abandoned by the father, Iris finally decides the time has come to get even and she begins to plot her revenge.

Title: Sidewalls
Hint: Two lonely neighbors in Buenos Aires keep missing each other until they knock through a wall.
Description: Martin is a neurotic web designer taking baby steps out of the isolation of his one-room apartment and his virtual reality. Mariana is an artist fresh out of a long relationship. They are perfect for each other, live on the same street, in opposite buildings, but they never meet. Can the movement of a modern city of three million people bring them together?

Title: Dum Laga Ke Haisha
Hint: An uneducated shopkeeper is forced to marry a heavy, educated girl and must race to carry her.
Description: A slim uneducated guy is pressured into an arranged marriage with an overweight college girl. The mismatched couple is challenged to compete in the annual wife-carrying race.

Title: Beyond the Hills
Hint: A young woman visits her friend in a remote monastery and is treated as possessed.
Description: Alina returns to Romania from Germany, hoping to bring Voichita—the only person in the world she loves and was loved by—back with her. But Voichita has found God, and God is the hardest lover of all to best.

Title: Last Life in the Universe
Hint: A suicidal Japanese librarian in Bangkok finds an unlikely bond with a messy young woman.
Description: An obsessive-compulsive Japanese librarian living in Bangkok spends most of his days contemplating suicide in his apartment. His life changes when he witnesses the death of a young girl and becomes acquainted with her elder sister.

Title: Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!
Hint: Two young people fall in love at a big family wedding, until tragedy changes everything.
Description: Prem and Nisha meet and fall in love at the wedding of their elder siblings, but their plans to be together are put in jeopardy when Nisha's sister dies, leaving behind a baby.

Title: Mondays in the Sun
Hint: Laid-off shipyard workers in a Spanish port spend their days drinking and dreaming.
Description: After the closure of their shipyard in Northern Spain, a few former workers: Santa, José, Lino, Amador, Sergei and Reina keep in touch. They meet mainly at a bar owned by their former colleague Rico. Santa is the most superficially confident and unofficial leader of the group. A court case hangs over him relating to a shipyard lamp he smashed during a protest against the closure.

Title: Sharmaji Namkeen
Hint: A retired widower in Delhi finds new purpose cooking for a gang of lively women.
Description: Late Rishi Kapoor in his swansong plays B. G. Sharma, a 58-year old middle-class widower living in West Delhi. After being laid off from the company he has worked for his entire life, ___ struggles to deal with the beast called retirement. His struggle to stay relevant in front of his two sons finally ends when he rekindles his love for cooking through a kitty party.

Title: La fille sur le pont
Hint: A knife thrower rescues a suicidal young woman and makes her his lucky target.
Description: It's night on a Paris bridge. A girl leans over Seine River with tears in her eyes and a violent yearning to drown her sorrows. Out of nowhere someone takes an interest in her. He is Gabor, a knife thrower who needs a human target for his show. The girl, Adele, has never been lucky and nowhere else to go. So she follows him. They travel along the northern bank of the Mediterranean to perform.

Bachir ___, a charismatic Algerian immigrant, steps in as the substitute teacher for the classroom of traumatized children. Description: After finally landing a teaching job, a kindhearted woman with Tourette Syndrome faces a flawed system to provide an education to her forgotten students.

Title: Survive Style 5+

Description: Five bizarre stories with no apparent connection to one another eventually become intertwined, resulting in surreal circumstances.

Title: Bang Boom Bang - Ein todsicheres Ding

Title: Srimanthudu

Description: Cal Weaver is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily. Title: John Wick: Chapter 2

Description: ___ is forced out of retirement by a former associate looking to seize control of a shadowy international assassins’ guild. Bound by a blood oath to aid him, ___ travels to Rome and does battle against some of the world’s most dangerous killers.

Title: Bram Stoker's Dracula

Description: Count ___, a 15th-century prince, is condemned to live off the blood of the living for eternity. Title: John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum

Description: Super-assassin ___ returns with a $14 million price tag on his head and an army of bounty-hunting killers on his trail. After killing a member of the shadowy international assassin’s guild, the High Table, ___ is excommunicado, but the world’s most ruthless hit men and women await his every turn.

Title: Are You There God? It's Me, Margaret.

Description: When her family moves from New York City to New Jersey, an 11-year-old girl navigates new friends, feelings, and the beginning of adolescence.

Title: A Nightmare on Elm Street

Description: Teenagers in a small town are dropping like flies, apparently in the grip of mass hysteria causing their suicides. A cop's daughter, Nancy Thompson, traces the cause to child molester Fred Krueger, who was burned alive by angry parents many years before. Krueger has now come back in the dreams of his killers' children, claiming their lives as his revenge.
