Description: Discover the game-changing partnership between a then undiscovered Michael Jordan and Nike's fledgling basketball division which revolutionized the world of sports and culture with the ___ Jordan brand.

Description: After getting a flat tire in the middle of nowhere, newly engaged couple Brad and Janet encounter the eerie mansion of the flamboyant, seductive Dr Frank-N-Furter and a variety of eccentric characters. Title: The Last Duel

On an adventure where she will find out what friendship, courage, family, and true love really means.

Title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest

Description: Captain Jack Sparrow’s got a blood debt to pay: he owes his soul to the legendary Davy Jones, ghastly Ruler of the Ocean Depths. To escape eternal servitude aboard the Flying Dutchman, ever-crafty Jack must track down the still-beating heart of Jones. Title: The Emperor's New Groove
Hint: A vain young ruler turned into a llama must team up with a kind peasant.
Description: When the self‑absorbed ___ Kuzco is accidentally transformed into a llama, he must rely on a humble villager to survive the jungle and reclaim his throne.

Title: Spider-Man: Far from Home
Hint: A teen superhero goes on a school trip to Europe and faces a new villain.
Description: Peter Parker and his friends go on a summer trip to Europe. However, they will hardly be able to rest - Peter will have to agree to help Nick Fury uncover the mystery of creatures that cause natural disasters and destruction throughout the continent.

Title: Mud
Hint: Two boys help a fugitive hiding on an island in the Mississippi.
Description: Two teenage boys find a fugitive hiding out on an island in the Mississippi River and help him reunite with his lover and escape an avenging family and their armed posse.

Title: Molly's Game
Hint: An Olympic skier runs high-stakes poker nights for celebrities.
Description: ___ Bloom, a young skier and former Olympic hopeful becomes a successful entrepreneur (and a target of an FBI investigation) when she establishes a high-stakes, international poker game.

Title: Darkest Hour
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A new prime minister faces an agonizing choice as Nazi Germany advances on Britain.
Description: In May 1940, the fate of World War II hangs on Winston Churchill, who must decide whether to negotiate with Adolf Hitler or fight on knowing that it could mean the end of the British Empire.

Title: [REC]
Hint: A TV reporter follows firefighters into an apartment building gripped by a deadly infection.
Description: A television reporter and cameraman follow emergency workers into a dark apartment building and are quickly locked inside with something terrifying.

Title: Witness
Hint: A cop hides out in an Amish community to protect a boy who witnessed a murder.
Description: While protecting an Amish boy—the sole ___ to a brutal murder—and his mother, a detective is forced to seek refuge within their community when his own life comes under threat.

Title: High Fidelity
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A record store owner revisits his top five breakups.
Description: After his long-time girlfriend dumps him, a thirty-year-old record store owner seeks to understand why he is unlucky in love while recounting his "top five breakups of all time".

Title: Minari
Hint: A Korean family moves to an Arkansas farm to chase their American dream.
Description: A Korean American family moves to an Arkansas farm in search of its own American dream. Amidst the challenges of this new life in the strange and rugged Ozarks, they discover the undeniable resilience of family and what really makes a home.

Title: The English Patient
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A burned man recounts his tragic love affair in the desert during World War II.
Description: In the 1930s, Count Almásy is a Hungarian map maker employed by the Royal Geographical Society to chart the vast expanses of the Sahara Desert along with several other prominent explorers. As World War II unfolds, Almásy enters into a world of love, betrayal, and politics.

Title: War for the Planet of the Apes
Hint: An ape leader seeks revenge against a ruthless human colonel.
Description: Caesar and his ___ are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless Colonel. After the ___ suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind.

Title: X2
Hint: Mutants unite with their enemies to stop a colonel bent on wiping them out.
Description: Professor Charles Xavier and his team of genetically gifted superheroes face a rising tide of anti-mutant sentiment led by Col. William Stryker. Storm, Wolverine and Jean Grey must join Magneto and Mystique to unhinge Stryker's scheme to exterminate all mutants.

Title: Back to the Future Part III
Hint: A teen time-traveler goes to the Old West to rescue his inventor friend.
Description: The final installment finds Marty digging the trusty DeLorean out of a mineshaft and looking for Doc in the Wild West of 1885. But when their time machine breaks down, the travelers are stranded in a land of spurs. More problems arise when Doc falls for pretty schoolteacher Clara Clayton, and Marty tangles with Buford Tannen.

Title: Begin Again
Hint: A heartbroken songwriter and a disgraced record producer make an album in New York.
Description: Gretta, a budding songwriter, finds herself alone after her boyfriend Dave ditches her. Her life gains purpose when Dan, a record label executive, notices her talent.

Title: Sully
Hint: A pilot lands a damaged airliner on the Hudson River, then faces an investigation.
Description: On 15 January 2009, the world witnessed the 'Miracle on the Hudson' when Captain '___' Sullenberger glided his disabled plane onto the Hudson River, saving the lives of all 155 souls aboard. However, even as ___ was being heralded by the public and the media for his unprecedented feat of aviation skill, an investigation was unfolding that threatened to destroy his reputation and career.

Title: Onward
Hint: Two elf brothers set out on a quest to spend one last day with their late father.
Description: In a suburban fantasy world, two teenage elf brothers embark on an extraordinary quest to discover if there is still a little magic left out there.

Title: Dracula
Hint: A London estate agent sells property to a count with a thirst for blood.
Description: A British estate agent travels to Transylvania to meet the mysterious Count ___, who is interested in leasing a London castle. After ___ enslaves the agent and drives him to insanity, the pair return to London together, where ___, a secret bloodsucker, begins preying on socialites.

Title: Body Heat
Hint: A seedy lawyer and a married woman plot to kill her husband during a Florida heatwave.
Description: During an extreme heatwave, a beautiful Florida woman and a seedy lawyer engage in an affair while plotting the murder of her rich husband.

Title: Judas and the Black Messiah
Hint: An FBI informant infiltrates a radical party to bring down its charismatic young leader.
Description: Bill O'Neal infiltrates the Black Panthers on the orders of FBI Agent Mitchell and J. Edgar Hoover. As Black Panther Chairman Fred Hampton ascends—falling for a fellow revolutionary en route—a battle wages for O’Neal’s soul.

Title: Downton Abbey
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An aristocratic Yorkshire family and their servants prepare for a royal visit to the estate.
Description: The beloved Crawleys and their intrepid staff prepare for the most important moment of their lives. A royal visit from the King and Queen of England will unleash scandal, romance and intrigue that will leave the future of ___ hanging in the balance.

Title: Downton Abbey: A New Era
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An aristocratic family travels to the south of France to uncover a mystery.
Description: The Crawley family goes on a grand journey to the south of France to uncover the mystery of the dowager countess's newly inherited villa. Meanwhile, a Hollywood director seeks to film his latest production at ___.

Title: The Mauritanian
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A detainee fights for his freedom in Guantanamo Bay with the help of a lawyer.
Description: The true story of the ___ Mohamedou Ould Slahi, who was held at the U.S military's Guantanamo Bay detention center without charges for over a decade and sought help from a defense attorney for his release.

Title: Best in Show
Hint: Dog owners compete for a prestigious prize in this mockumentary.
Description: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them.

Title: M*A*S*H
Hint: Army surgeons at a Korean War hospital use humor to cope with the horrors.
Description: One of the world's most acclaimed comedies, ___ focuses on three Korean War Army surgeons brilliantly brought to life by Donald Sutherland, Tom Skerritt and Elliott Gould. Though highly skilled and deeply dedicated, they adopt a hilarious, lunatic lifestyle as an antidote to the tragedies of their Mobile Army Surgical Hospital, and in the process infuriate Army bureaucrats.

Title: The Swimmers
Hint: Two Syrian sisters swim for their lives across the sea and dream of the Olympics.
Description: From war-torn Syria to the 2016 Rio Olympics, two young sisters embark on a risky voyage, putting their hearts and their swimming skills to heroic use.

Title: Mirage
Hint: An amnesiac accountant is hunted by killers in New York.
Description: After a blackout in his office building, accountant David Stillwell emerges outside to find out a man he did not know either jumped or was pushed out a window to his death — and that he can't remember the past two years of his life. Enlisting the help of a rookie private eye and a reluctant old flame, Stillwell uncovers the mystery detail by unexpected detail.

Title: Picnic at Hanging Rock
Hint: Schoolgirls vanish during an outing on Valentine's Day in 1900 Australia.
Description: In the early 1900s, Miranda attends a girls boarding school in Australia. One Valentine's Day, the school's typically strict headmistress treats the girls to a ___ field trip to an unusual but scenic volcanic formation called ___ Rock. Despite rules against it, Miranda and several other girls venture off.

Title: Bullitt
Hint: A tough San Francisco cop protects a witness and tears through the hills in a legendary car chase.
Description: Senator Walter Chalmers is aiming to take down mob boss Pete Ross with the help of testimony from the criminal's hothead brother Johnny, who is in protective custody in San Francisco under the watch of police lieutenant Frank ___. When a pair of mob hitmen enter the scene, ___ follows their trail through a maze of complications and double-crosses.

Title: Frances Ha
Hint: A carefree dancer in New York tries to figure out her life.
Description: An aspiring dancer moves to New York City and becomes caught up in a whirlwind of flighty fair-weather friends, diminishing fortunes and career setbacks.

Title: Green Street Hooligans
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Harvard dropout falls in with violent London football firms.
Description: After being wrongfully expelled from Harvard University, American Matt Buckner flees to his sister's home in England. Once there, he is befriended by her charming and dangerous brother-in-law, Pete Dunham, and introduced to the underworld of British football hooliganism. Matt learns to stand his ground through a friendship that develops against the backdrop of this secret and often violent world.

Title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
Hint: A young Viking chief and his winged companion search for a mythical refuge as a ruthless hunter closes in.
Description: As Hiccup fulfills his dream of creating a peaceful ___ utopia, Toothless’ discovery of an untamed, elusive mate draws the Night Fury away. When danger mounts at home and Hiccup’s reign as village chief is tested, both ___ and rider must make impossible decisions to save their kind.

Title: Welcome to the Dollhouse
Hint: A bullied seventh grader struggles to survive middle school.
Description: An unattractive 7th grader struggles to cope with suburban life as the middle child with inattentive parents and bullies at school.

Title: Thief
Hint: A professional safecracker plans one last score to settle down.
Description: Frank is an expert professional safecracker, specialized in high-profile diamond heists. He plans to use his ill-gotten income to retire from crime and build a nice life for himself complete with a home, wife and kids. To accelerate the process, he signs on with a top gangster for a big score.

Title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
Hint: The detective and his partner battle his archenemy across Europe.
Description: There is a new criminal mastermind at large (Professor Moriarty) and not only is he ___’ intellectual equal, but his capacity for evil and lack of conscience may give him an advantage over the detective.

Title: Oliver!
Hint: An orphan runs away to London and joins a gang of pickpockets.
Description: Musical adaptation of Charles Dickens' ___ Twist, a classic tale of an orphan who runs away from the workhouse and joins up with a group of boys headed by the Artful Dodger and trained to be pickpockets by master thief Fagin.

Title: Inside Llewyn Davis
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A struggling folk singer drifts through the 1960s Greenwich Village scene.
Description: In Greenwich Village in the early 1960s, gifted but volatile folk musician ___ struggles with money, relationships, and his uncertain future.

Title: Buffalo '66
Hint: A man fresh out of prison kidnaps a girl and forces her to pose as his wife for his parents.
Description: Billy is released after five years in prison. In the next moment, he kidnaps teenage student Layla and visits his parents with her, pretending she is his girlfriend and they will soon marry.

Title: Hoosiers
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A disgraced coach leads a small-town Indiana high school basketball team to glory.
Description: Failed college coach Norman Dale gets a chance at redemption when he is hired to coach a high school basketball team in a tiny Indiana town. After a teacher persuades star player Jimmy Chitwood to quit and focus on his long-neglected studies, Dale struggles to develop a winning team in the face of community criticism for his temper and his unconventional choice of assistant coach: Shooter, a notorious alcoholic.

Title: Blow Out
Hint: A sound recordist captures audio that proves a car crash was a murder.
Description: While recording sound effects for a slasher flick, Jack Terry stumbles upon a real-life horror: a car careening off a bridge and into a river. Jack jumps into the water and fishes out Sally from the car, but the other passenger is already dead — a governor intending to run for president.

Title: Forgotten
Hint: A young man suspects his kidnapped brother returned a different person.
Description: Jin-seok, 21-year-old, moves into a new house with his family. He suffers from a slight schizophrenia but he carries an ordinary life under the warm care of the family. His older brother Yu-seok is a decent college student, a mentor, and role model for Jin-seok. One night, his beloved brother is kidnapped by unidentified assailants before Jin-seok's eye.

Title: The Orphanage
Hint: A woman returns to the home where she grew up as an orphan and senses ghostly presences.
Description: A woman brings her family back to her childhood home, which used to be an ___, intent on reopening it. Before long, her son starts to communicate with a new invisible friend.

Title: Terms of Endearment
Hint: A mother and daughter share a complicated relationship over thirty years.
Description: Aurora, a finicky woman, is in search of true love while her daughter faces marital issues. Together, they help each other deal with problems and find reasons to live a joyful life.

Title: A Hidden Life
Hint: An Austrian farmer refuses to swear allegiance to the Nazis and faces execution.
Description: Austrian farmer Franz Jägerstätter faces the threat of execution for refusing to fight for the Nazis during World War II.

Title: August Rush
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, South Korea
Hint: An orphan prodigy uses music to search for the parents he never knew.
Description: Evan, a musically gifted orphan, runs away from his orphanage and searches New York City for his birth parents. On his journey, he's taken under the wing of the Wizard, a homeless man who lives in an abandoned theater. After discovering his talent, the Wizard gives Evan the name "___" and devises a plan to profit from his talent.

Title: Tootsie
Hint: An out-of-work actor disguises himself as a woman to land a soap opera role.
Description: When struggling, out of work actor Michael Dorsey secretly adopts a female alter ego—Dorothy Michaels—in order to land a part in a daytime drama, he unwittingly becomes a feminist icon and ends up in a romantic pickle.

Title: Garden State
Hint: A young actor returns home for his mother's funeral and falls for a quirky girl.
Description: Andrew returns to his hometown for his mother’s funeral, a journey that reconnects him with old friends. The trip coincides with his decision to stop taking his powerful antidepressants. A chance meeting with Sam—a girl also struggling with various maladies—opens up the possibility of rekindling emotional connections, confronting his psychologist father, and perhaps beginning a new life.

Title: The Constant Gardener
Hint: A diplomat investigates his activist wife's murder in Kenya.
Description: Justin Quayle is a low-level British diplomat who has always gone about his work very quietly, not causing any problems. But after his radical wife Tessa is killed he becomes determined to find out why, thrusting himself into the middle of a very dangerous conspiracy.

Title: Notes on a Scandal
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A lonely teacher discovers her colleague's affair with a student.
Description: A veteran high school teacher befriends a younger art teacher, who is having an affair with one of her 15-year-old students. However, her intentions with this new "friend" also go well beyond platonic friendship.

Title: Three Days of the Condor
Hint: A CIA researcher returns from lunch to find all his coworkers dead.
Description: When bookish CIA researcher Joe Turner finds all his co-workers dead, he, together with a woman he has kidnapped, must work together to outwit those responsible until he determines who he can really trust.

Title: Death in Venice
Hint: An ailing composer travels to the city of canals and becomes obsessed with a beautiful young Polish boy.
Description: Composer Gustav von Aschenbach travels to ___ for health reasons. There, he becomes obsessed with the stunning beauty of an adolescent Polish boy named Tadzio who is staying with his family at the same Grand Hôtel des Bains on the Lido as Aschenbach.

Title: The Judge
Hint: A big-city lawyer returns home to defend his estranged father, accused of murder.
Description: A successful lawyer returns to his hometown for his mother's funeral only to discover that his estranged father, the town's ___, is suspected of murder.

Title: Elizabeth
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young queen navigates plots and betrayals in Tudor England.
Description: The story of the ascension to the throne and the early reign of Queen ___ the First, the endless attempts by her council to marry her off, the Catholic hatred of her and her romance with Lord Robert Dudley.

Title: Eighth Grade
Hint: An anxious teen girl survives her last week of middle school.
Description: Thirteen-year-old Kayla endures the tidal wave of contemporary suburban adolescence as she makes her way through the last week of middle school — the end of her thus far disastrous ___ year — before she begins high school.

Title: The Cider House Rules
Hint: An orphan raised by a doctor at an orphanage sets out to see the world.
Description: Homer is an orphan who was never adopted, becoming the favorite of orphanage director Dr. Larch. Dr. Larch imparts his full medical knowledge on Homer, who becomes a skilled, albeit unlicensed, physician. But Homer yearns for a self-chosen life outside the orphanage. What will Homer learn about life and love in the ___ house? What of the destiny that Dr. Larch has planned for him?

Title: Five Easy Pieces
Hint: A drifter who gave up a promising career as a pianist returns home to his family.
Description: Robert Dupea spends his days doing various odd jobs, drinking and womanizing until an encounter with his sister makes him revisit his past.

Title: The Way Way Back
Hint: A shy teen finds friendship at a water park during a summer vacation.
Description: Shy 14-year-old Duncan goes on summer vacation with his mother, her overbearing boyfriend, and her boyfriend's daughter. Having a rough time fitting in, Duncan finds an unexpected friend in Owen, manager of the Water Wizz water park.

Title: Frequency
Hint: A father and son talk across 30 years through an old ham radio.
Description: When a rare phenomenon gives police officer John Sullivan the chance to speak to his father, 30 years in the past, he takes the opportunity to prevent his dad's tragic death. After his actions inadvertently give rise to a series of brutal murders he and his father must find a way to fix the consequences of altering time.

Title: Straw Dogs
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An American mathematician and his wife are terrorized in a quiet English village.
Description: David Sumner, a mild-mannered academic from the United States, marries Amy, an Englishwoman. In order to escape a hectic stateside lifestyle, David and his wife relocate to the small town in rural Cornwall where Amy was raised. There, David is ostracized by the brutish men of the village, including Amy's old flame, Charlie. Eventually the taunts escalate.

Title: The Mission
Country: United Kingdom, France, United States of America, Paraguay, Brazil, Colombia, Argentina
Hint: A Spanish Jesuit and a reformed slaver protect a Guaraní settlement in the South American jungle.
Description: When a Spanish Jesuit goes into the South American wilderness to build a ___ in the hope of converting the Indians of the region, a slave hunter is converted and joins his ___. When Spain sells the colony to Portugal, they are forced to defend all they have built against the Portuguese aggressors.

Title: Marathon Man
Hint: A graduate student is drawn into a plot involving a Nazi war criminal.
Description: A graduate student and obsessive runner in New York is drawn into a mysterious plot involving his brother, a member of the secretive Division.

Title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
Hint: Two con artists compete to swindle an heiress on the French Riviera.
Description: Con artist Lawrence Jamieson is a longtime resident of a luxurious coastal resort, where he enjoys the lavish fruits of his deceptions -- that is, until a competitor, Freddy Benson, shows up. When the new guy's lowbrow tactics impinge on his own sophisticated work and believing him to be the infamous conman 'The Jackal', Lawrence resolves to get rid of him.

Title: The Party
Hint: An accident-prone Indian actor wreaks havoc at a fancy Hollywood gathering.
Description: Hrundi V. Bakshi, an accident-prone actor from India, is accidentally put on the guest list for an upcoming ___ at the home of a Hollywood film producer. Unfortunately, from the moment he arrives, one thing after another goes wrong with compounding effect.

Title: To Catch a Thief
Hint: A retired cat burglar must trap a copycat on the French Riviera.
Description: When a string of jewel robberies hits the French Riviera, suspicion falls on retired thief John “The Cat” Robie. To clear his name, he sets out to trap the copycat himself—entangling a wealthy widow and her beguiling daughter in a seductive game of pursuit, deception, and desire.

Title: The Devil's Backbone
Hint: A boy arrives at an orphanage haunted by a ghost during the Spanish Civil War.
Description: Spain, 1939. In the last days of the Spanish Civil War, the young Carlos arrives at the Santa Lucía orphanage, where he will make friends and enemies as he follows the quiet footsteps of a mysterious presence eager for revenge.

Title: The Bucket List
Hint: Two terminally ill men escape a hospital to do everything they want before they die.
Description: Corporate billionaire Edward Cole and working class mechanic Carter Chambers are worlds apart. At a crossroads in their lives, they share a hospital room and discover they have two things in common: a desire to spend the time they have left doing everything they ever wanted to do and an unrealized need to come to terms with who they are.

Title: K-PAX
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A patient in a psychiatric hospital claims to be from another planet.
Description: Prot is a patient at a mental hospital who claims to be from a far away planet. His psychiatrist tries to help him, only to begin to doubt his own explanations.

Title: The Land Before Time
Hint: An orphaned young dinosaur and his friends search for a lush valley after a great earthquake.
Description: An orphaned brontosaurus named Littlefoot sets off in search of the legendary Great Valley. A land of lush vegetation where the dinosaurs can thrive and live in peace. Along the way he meets four other young dinosaurs, each one a different species, and they encounter several obstacles as they learn to work together in order to survive.

Title: The Haunting
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Four people stay in a mansion with a sinister history and malevolent spirits.
Description: Dr. John Markway recruits three strangers for a sleep-disorder study at the eerie and isolated Hill House. It soon becomes clear his real interest lies in the mansion itself and its sinister history, as they are forced to confront the nature of its horror…

Title: Black Dynamite
Hint: A 1970s action hero seeks revenge on those who killed his brother.
Description: This is the story of 1970s African-American action legend ___. The Man killed his brother, pumped heroin into local orphanages, and flooded the ghetto with adulterated malt liquor. ___ was the one hero willing to fight The Man all the way from the blood-soaked city streets to the hallowed halls of the Honky House.

Title: C'mon C'mon
Hint: A radio journalist bonds with his young nephew on a cross-country trip.
Description: Johnny and his young nephew forge a tenuous but transformational relationship when they embark on a cross-country trip to see life away from Los Angeles.

Title: Dolores Claiborne
Hint: A woman suspected of murder is visited by her estranged daughter.
Description: ___ was accused of killing her abusive husband twenty years ago, but the court's findings were inconclusive and she was allowed to walk free. Now she has been accused of killing her employer, Vera Donovan, and this time there is a witness who can place her at the scene of the crime. Things look bad for ___ when her daughter Selena, a successful Manhattan magazine writer, returns to cover the story.

Title: Entergalactic
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An artist falls for his neighbor in a dazzling animated Manhattan.
Description: Ambitious artist Jabari attempts to balance success and love when he moves into his dream Manhattan apartment and falls for his next-door neighbor.

Title: Nosferatu the Vampyre
Hint: A vampire count travels to a German town, in a remake of a silent classic.
Description: A real estate agent leaves behind his beautiful wife to go to Transylvania to visit the mysterious Count Dracula and formalize the purchase of a property in Wismar.

Title: Reign Over Me
Hint: A dentist runs into his old college roommate who lost his family on 9/11.
Description: A man who lost his family in the September 11 attack on New York City runs into his old college roommate. Rekindling the friendship is the one thing that appears able to help the man recover from his grief.

Title: Miracle
Hint: A college coach leads the US Olympic hockey team against the Soviets in 1980.
Description: When college coach Herb Brooks is hired to helm the 1980 U.S. men's Olympic hockey team, he brings a unique and brash style to the ice. After assembling a team of hot-headed college all-stars, who are humiliated in an early match, Brooks unites his squad against a common foe: the heavily-favored Soviet team.

Title: Calvary
Hint: A priest is told in confession that he will be killed in a week.
Description: After being threatened during a confession, a good-natured priest must battle the dark forces closing in around him.

Country: Germany, Hong Kong, China, France, Italy
Hint: A sci-fi writer revisits the women he loved in 1960s Hong Kong.
Description: Women enter and exit a science fiction author's life over the course of a few years after the author loses the woman he considers his one true love.

Title: The Natural
Hint: A mysterious middle-aged batter leads a losing team to victory.
Description: An unknown middle-aged batter named Roy Hobbs with a mysterious past appears out of nowhere to take a losing 1930s baseball team to the top of the league.

Title: Petite Maman
Hint: A grieving girl meets a girl her own age in the woods who seems strangely familiar.
Description: After the death of her beloved grandmother, eight-year-old Nelly meets a strangely familiar girl her own age in the woods. Instantly forming a connection with this mysterious new friend, Nelly embarks on a fantastical journey of discovery which helps her come to terms with this newfound loss.

Title: Love & Mercy
Hint: The life of the troubled genius behind a famous 1960s surf rock band.
Description: In the late 1960s, the Beach Boys' Brian Wilson stops touring, produces "Pet Sounds" and begins to lose his grip on reality. By the 1980s, under the sway of a controlling therapist, he finds a savior in Melinda Ledbetter.

Title: A Monster Calls
Hint: A boy struggling with his mother's illness is visited by a giant yew tree creature.
Description: 12-year-old Conor encounters an ancient tree monster who proceeds to help him cope with his mother's terminal illness and being bullied in school.

Title: Lean on Me
Hint: A principal cleans up a crumbling inner-city high school.
Description: When principal Joe Clark takes over decaying Eastside High School, he's faced with students wearing gang colors and graffiti-covered walls. Determined to do anything he must to turn the school around, he expels suspected drug dealers, padlocks doors and demands effort and results from students, staff and parents. Autocratic to a fault, this real-life educator put it all on the line.

Title: Mudbound
Hint: Two families, one white and one Black, struggle on a farm in post-war Mississippi.
Description: In the post–World War II South, two families are pitted against a barbaric social hierarchy and an unrelenting landscape as they simultaneously fight the battle at home and the battle abroad.

Title: McFarland, USA
Hint: A track coach leads a team of Latino runners to a championship.
Description: A track coach in a small California town transforms a team of athletes into championship contenders.

Title: High Plains Drifter
Hint: A mysterious stranger is hired to defend a corrupt mining town from outlaws, and paints it red.
Description: A gunfighting stranger comes to the small settlement of Lago. After gunning down three gunmen who tried to kill him, the townsfolk decide to hire the Stranger to hold off three outlaws who are on their way.

Title: In the Bedroom
Hint: A family is torn apart by a tragedy in a quiet Maine town.
Description: Summertime on the coast of Maine, "___" centers on the inner dynamics of a family in transition. Matt Fowler is a doctor practicing in his native Maine and is married to New York born Ruth Fowler, a music teacher. His son is involved in a love affair with a local single mother.

Title: Happening
Hint: A gifted student in 1960s France desperately seeks an illegal abortion.
Description: France, 1963. Anne is a bright young student with a promising future ahead of her. But when she falls pregnant, she sees the opportunity to finish her studies and escape the constraints of her social background disappearing. With her final exams fast approaching and her belly growing, Anne resolves to act, even if she has to confront shame and pain, even if she must risk prison to do so.

Title: A Dog's Journey
Country: China, India, United States of America
Hint: A loyal pup is reincarnated to look after his owner's granddaughter.
Description: A dog finds the meaning of his own existence through the lives of the humans he meets.

Title: Queen Margot
Hint: A French princess is married off to a Protestant king to prevent a religious war.
Description: Paris, Kingdom of France, August 18, 1572. To avoid the outbreak of a religious war, the Catholic princess Marguerite de Valois, sister of the feeble King Charles IX, marries the Huguenot King Henry III of Navarre.

Title: Howards End
Country: United Kingdom, Japan, United States of America
Hint: Two sisters' lives become entwined with a wealthy family in Edwardian England.
Description: A saga of class relations and changing times in an Edwardian England on the brink of modernity, the film centers on liberal Margaret Schlegel, who, along with her sister Helen, becomes involved with two couples: wealthy, conservative industrialist Henry Wilcox and his wife Ruth, and the downwardly mobile working-class Leonard Bast and his mistress Jackie.

Title: Bad Education
Hint: A film director receives a semi-autobiographical script from an old school friend.
Description: When an old friend brings filmmaker Enrique Goded a semi-autobiographical script chronicling their adolescence, Enrique is forced to relive his youth spent at a Catholic boarding school. Weaving through past and present, the script follows a transvestite performer who reconnects with a grade school sweetheart.

Title: Monica, O My Darling
Hint: A robotics expert gets tangled in a murder plot after a passionate affair.
Description: A slick robotics expert joins a murderous plot after a passionate affair takes a sudden turn, but nothing — not even death — is what it seems to be.

Title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham...
Hint: A man brings his disowned brother home to their proud father.
Description: Years after his father disowns his adopted brother for marrying a woman of lower social standing, a young man goes on a mission to reunite his family.

Title: Rust and Bone
Hint: A bare-knuckle fighter and a whale trainer who lost her legs find each other.
Description: Put in charge of his young son, Ali leaves Belgium for Antibes to live with his sister and her husband as a family. Ali's bond with Stephanie, a killer whale trainer, grows deeper after Stephanie suffers a horrible accident.

Title: Biutiful
Country: Mexico, Spain, United States of America
Hint: A dying father who can speak to the dead tries to protect his children.
Description: This is a story of a man in free fall. On the road to redemption, darkness lights his way. Connected with the afterlife, Uxbal is a tragic hero and father of two who's sensing the danger of death. He struggles with a tainted reality and a fate that works against him in order to forgive, for love, and forever.

Title: ...And Justice for All
Hint: A Baltimore lawyer is forced to defend a judge he despises.
Description: An ethical Baltimore defense lawyer disgusted with rampant legal corruption is forced to defend a judge he despises in a rape trial under the threat of being disbarred.

Title: Man on the Moon
Country: United States of America, Germany, Japan, United Kingdom
Hint: A brilliant prankster comedian blurs the line between performance and reality.
Description: The story of the life and career of eccentric avant-garde comedian, Andy Kaufman.

Title: Waiting for Guffman
Hint: A small-town theater troupe prepares a musical for a big Broadway critic.
Description: Aspiring director Corky St. Clair and the marginally talented amateur cast of his hokey small-town musical production go overboard when they learn that Broadway theater agent Mort ___ will be in attendance.

Title: The King and I
Hint: A British widow becomes tutor to the many children of the ruler of Siam.
Description: Widowed Welsh mother Anna Leonowens becomes a governess and English tutor to the wives and many children of the stubborn King Mongkut of Siam. Anna and the King have a clash of personalities as she works to teach the royal family about the English language, customs and etiquette, and rushes to prepare a party for a group of European diplomats who must change their opinions about the King.

Title: The Duellists
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two officers fight a series of duels over decades of Napoleonic wars.
Description: In 1800, as Napoleon Bonaparte rises to power in France, a rivalry erupts between Armand and Gabriel, two lieutenants in the French Army, over a perceived insult. For over a decade, they engage in a series of duels amidst larger conflicts, including the failed French invasion of Russia in 1812, and shifts in the political and social systems of Europe.

Title: The Greatest Game Ever Played
Hint: A young caddie challenges his idol in the US Open golf championship.
Description: A biopic of 20-year-old Francis Ouimet who defeated his golfing idol and 1900 US Open Champion, Harry Vardon.

Title: Good Night, and Good Luck.
Country: France, Japan, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A TV journalist stands against a senator's anti-communist witch hunts.
Description: The story of journalist Edward R. Murrow's stand against Senator Joseph McCarthy's anti-communist witch-hunts in the early 1950s.

Title: Rurouni Kenshin Part I: Origins
Hint: A former assassin vows never to kill again while protecting the weak.
Description: In 1868, after the Bakumatsu war ends, the ex-assassin ___ Himura traverses Japan with an inverted sword, to defend the needy without killing.

Title: The Bad Seed
Hint: A sweet little girl may be a cold-blooded killer.
Description: Air Force Colonel Kenneth Penmark and his wife, Christine, adore their daughter Rhoda, despite her secret tendency for selfishness. Christine keeps her knowledge of her daughter's darker side to herself, but when a schoolmate of Rhoda's dies mysteriously, her self-deception unravels.

Title: Trumbo
Hint: A successful Hollywood screenwriter is blacklisted during the Red Scare and writes under fake names.
Description: The career of screenwriter Dalton ___ is halted by a witch hunt in the late 1940s when he defies the anti-communist HUAC committee and is blacklisted.

Title: The Wrong Man
Hint: An innocent jazz bassist is mistaken for a robber and his life falls apart, in a true-life thriller.
Description: In 1953, an innocent man named Christopher Emmanuel "Manny" Balestrero is arrested after being mistaken for an armed robber.

Title: Frenzy
Hint: A man is suspected of being the necktie murderer terrorizing London.
Description: London is terrorized by a vicious sex killer known as The Necktie Murderer. Following the brutal slaying of his ex-wife, down-on-his-luck Richard Blaney is suspected by the police of being the killer. He goes on the run, determined to prove his innocence.

Title: From Up on Poppy Hill
Hint: Two teenagers try to save their school's old clubhouse from demolition in 1963 Yokohama.
Description: Yokohama, 1963. Japan is picking itself up from the devastation of World War II and preparing to host the 1964 Olympics—and the mood is one of both optimism and conflict as the young generation struggles to throw off the shackles of a troubled past.

Title: Akeelah and the Bee
Hint: An 11-year-old girl from South LA competes in the national spelling contest.
Description: 11-year-old ___ Anderson has a way with words. After winning her schoolwide spelling ___, she decides to enter the competition, despite her classmates' derision and the antipathy of her mother Tanya. Thanks to the efforts of her teacher Dr. Larabee, she reaches the finals. As she gets to know her fellow competitors, ___ realizes that coming first isn't everything in life.

Title: In the Loop
Hint: British and American officials stumble into a war in the Middle East.
Description: The US President and the UK Prime Minister are planning on launching a war in the Middle East, but—behind the scenes—government officials and advisers are either promoting the war or are trying to prevent it.

Title: Man Bites Dog
Hint: A film crew follows a charming serial killer and becomes complicit.
Description: The activities of rampaging, indiscriminate serial killer Ben are recorded by a willingly complicit documentary team, who eventually become his accomplices and active participants. Ben provides casual commentary on the nature of his work and arbitrary musings on topics of interest to him, such as music or the conditions of low-income housing, and even goes so far as to introduce the documentary crew to his family.

Title: Days of Being Wild
Hint: A Hong Kong playboy searches for his birth mother.
Description: Yuddy, a Hong Kong playboy known for breaking girls' hearts, tries to find solace and truth after discovering the woman who raised him isn't his mother.

Title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
Hint: An American doctor and his wife get caught in an assassination plot in Morocco.
Description: An American doctor and his wife, a former singing star, witness a murder while vacationing in Morocco, and are drawn into a twisting plot of international intrigue when their young son is kidnapped.

Title: Freddy
Hint: A shy dentist finds love, but nothing is as it seems.
Description: Introverted and awkward Dr. ___ Ginwala desperately searches for a soulmate. When he finally finds her, the relationship becomes as painful as a root canal.

Title: The Painted Veil
Hint: A British doctor fights cholera in a Chinese village with his unfaithful wife.
Description: A British medical doctor fights a cholera outbreak in a small Chinese village, while also being trapped at home in a loveless marriage to an unfaithful wife.

Title: The Cowboys
Hint: An aging rancher whose hands have deserted him hires a group of schoolboys to drive his cattle across Montana.
Description: When his cattlemen abandon him for the gold fields, rancher Wil Andersen is forced to take on a collection of young boys as his ___ in order to get his herd to market in time to avoid financial disaster. The boys learn to do a man's job under Andersen's tutelage, however, neither he nor the boys know that a gang of cattle thieves is stalking them.

Title: Lone Star
Hint: A Texas sheriff investigates a decades-old murder his legendary father may have committed.
Description: When the skeleton of his murdered predecessor is found, Sheriff Sam Deeds unearths many other long-buried secrets in his Texas border town.

Title: Felon
Hint: A family man who killed an intruder must survive prison.
Description: A family man convicted of killing an intruder must cope with life afterward in the violent penal system.

Title: The Postman Always Rings Twice
Hint: A married woman and a drifter plot to kill her husband.
Description: A married woman and a drifter fall in love, then plot to murder her husband.

Title: The Garden of Words
Hint: A schoolboy who makes shoes meets a mysterious woman in a park on rainy mornings.
Description: Takao, who is training to become a shoemaker, skipped school and is sketching shoes in a Japanese-style ___. He meets a mysterious woman, Yukino, who is older than him. Then, without arranging the times, the two start to see each other again and again, but only on rainy days. They deepen their relationship and open up to each other. But the end of the rainy season soon approaches.

Title: Pollyanna
Hint: An optimistic orphan girl wins over a gloomy town.
Description: A young girl comes to an embittered town and confronts its attitude with her determination to see the best in life.

Title: They Call Me Trinity
Hint: Two lazy, lightning-fast cowboy brothers protect a settlement of pacifist farmers from bandits.
Description: The simple story has the pair coming to the rescue of peace-loving Mormons when land-hungry Major Harriman sends his bullies to harass them into giving up their fertile valley. ___ and Bambino manage to save the Mormons and send the bad guys packing with slapstick humor instead of excessive violence, saving the day.

Title: Bullets Over Broadway
Hint: A playwright gets funding from a gangster, who demands his girlfriend gets a role.
Description: After young playwright, David Shayne obtains funding for his play from gangster Nick Valenti, Nick's girlfriend Olive miraculously lands the role of a psychiatrist—but not only is she a bimbo who could never pass for a psychiatrist—she's a dreadful actress.

Title: Together
Hint: A woman and her children move into a 1970s Swedish commune.
Description: Elisabeth leaves her abusive and drunken husband Rolf, and goes to live with her brother, Göran. The year is 1975 and Göran lives in a commune called ___. Living in this leftist commune Elisabeth learns that the world can be viewed from different perspectives.

Title: Searching for Bobby Fischer
Hint: A young chess prodigy refuses to become ruthless to win.
Description: A seven-year-old chess prodigy refuses to harden himself in order to become a champion like the famous but unlikable ___.

Title: An Affair to Remember
Hint: Two strangers fall in love on a cruise and agree to meet atop the Empire State Building.
Description: A couple falls in love and agrees to meet in six months at the Empire State Building - but will it happen?

Title: Blindspotting
Hint: An ex-con on probation witnesses a police shooting in Oakland.
Description: Collin must make it through his final three days of probation for a chance at a new beginning. He and his troublemaking childhood best friend, Miles, work as movers, and when Collin witnesses a police shooting, the two men’s friendship is tested as they grapple with identity and their changed realities in the rapidly-gentrifying neighborhood they grew up in.

Title: And Then There Were None
Hint: Ten strangers on a remote island are murdered one by one.
Description: Ten strangers are summoned to a remote island and while they are waiting for the mysterious host to appear, a recording levels serious accusations at each of the guests. Soon they start being murdered, one by one. As the survivors try to keep their wits, they reach a disturbing conclusion: one of them must be the killer.

Title: A Shot in the Dark
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A bumbling French inspector investigates a murder at a country estate and falls for the suspect.
Description: Inspector Jacques Clouseau, smitten with the accused maid Maria Gambrelli, unwittingly turns a straightforward murder investigation into a comedic series of mishaps, testing the patience of his irritable boss Charles Dreyfus as casualties mount.

Title: The Goodbye Girl
Hint: A dancer and her daughter share an apartment with an eccentric actor.
Description: After being dumped by her live-in boyfriend, an unemployed dancer and her 10-year-old daughter are reluctantly forced to live with a struggling off-Broadway actor.

Title: In the House
Hint: A student writes stories about his classmate's family, and his teacher wants more.
Description: A sixteen-year-old boy insinuates himself into the house of a fellow student from his literature class and writes about it in essays for his French teacher. Faced with this gifted and unusual pupil, the teacher rediscovers his enthusiasm for his work, but the boy’s intrusion will unleash a series of uncontrollable events.

Title: The China Syndrome
Hint: A reporter witnesses an accident at a nuclear power plant.
Description: While doing a series of reports on alternative energy sources, opportunistic reporter Kimberly Wells witnesses an accident at a nuclear power plant. Wells is determined to publicize the incident, but soon finds herself entangled in a sinister conspiracy to keep the full impact of the incident a secret.

Title: Mortal Kombat Legends: Scorpion's Revenge
Hint: A ninja warrior seeks vengeance from beyond the grave for the slaughter of his family, in a gory animated tale.
Description: After the vicious slaughter of his family by stone-cold mercenary Sub-Zero, Hanzo Hasashi is exiled to the torturous Netherrealm. There, in exchange for his servitude to the sinister Quan Chi, he’s given a chance to avenge his family – and is resurrected as ___, a lost soul bent on revenge.

Title: Cross of Iron
Hint: A cynical German sergeant clashes with an ambitious officer on the Russian front.
Description: It is 1943, and the German army—ravaged and demoralised—is hastily retreating from the Russian front. In the midst of the madness, conflict brews between the aristocratic yet ultimately pusillanimous Captain Stransky and the courageous Corporal Steiner. Stransky is the only man who believes that the Third Reich is still vastly superior to the Russian army.

Title: Ida
Hint: A young nun in 1960s Poland learns she is Jewish and sets out to find her family's fate.
Description: In 1960s Poland, young novitiate Anna is on the verge of taking her vows when she discovers a family secret dating back to the years of the German occupation.

Title: Son of Saul
Hint: A prisoner forced to work in Auschwitz tries to give a boy a proper burial.
Description: In the horror of 1944 Auschwitz, a prisoner forced to burn the corpses of his own people finds moral survival trying to save from the flames the body of a boy he takes for his son, seeking to give him a proper Jewish burial.

Title: Hombre
Hint: A white man raised by Apaches protects stagecoach passengers.
Description: John Russell, disdained by his "respectable" fellow stagecoach passengers because he was raised by Indians, becomes their only hope for survival when they are set upon by outlaws.

Title: Persian Lessons
Hint: A Jewish prisoner survives by inventing a fake language to teach an SS officer.
Description: Occupied France, 1942. Gilles is arrested by SS soldiers alongside other Jews and sent to a camp in Germany. He narrowly avoids sudden execution by swearing to the guards that he is not Jewish, but ___. This lie temporarily saves him, but Gilles gets assigned a life-or-death mission: to teach Farsi to Head of Camp Koch, who dreams of opening a restaurant in Iran once the war is over.

Title: Dear Zindagi
Hint: A budding young cinematographer struggling with relationships meets an unconventional therapist in Goa.
Description: Kaira, a young girl, faces problems in her relationships. She meets Dr Jehangir, who helps her resolve her issues with her parents and get a new perspective on life, which leads to her following her passion and an improvement in her love life.

Title: No
Country: Chile, United States of America, France
Hint: An advertising executive creates a cheerful TV campaign to defeat a Chilean dictator in a referendum.
Description: In 1988, Chilean military dictator Augusto Pinochet, due to international pressure, is forced to call a plebiscite on his presidency. The country will vote ‘Yes’ or ‘___’ to Pinochet extending his rule for another eight years. Opposition leaders for the ‘___’ vote persuade a brash young advertising executive, René Saavedra, to spearhead their campaign.

Title: The Black Stallion
Hint: A shipwrecked boy befriends an Arabian horse on a deserted island.
Description: While traveling with his father, young Alec becomes fascinated by a mysterious Arabian ___ that is brought on board and stabled in the ship he is sailing on. When it tragically sinks both he and the horse survive only to be stranded on a deserted island. He befriends it, so when finally rescued both return to his home where they soon meet Henry Dailey, a once successful trainer.

Title: Salvador
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Mexico
Hint: An American photojournalist is caught in the middle of the Salvadoran Civil War.
Description: In 1980, an American journalist covering the Salvadoran Civil War becomes entangled with both the leftist guerrilla groups and the right-wing military dictatorship while trying to rescue his girlfriend and her children.

Title: Amazing Grace
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A British MP leads the long fight to abolish the slave trade in the 18th century.
Description: The true story of William Wilberforce and his courageous quest to end the British slave trade. Along the way, Wilberforce meets intense opposition, but his minister urges him to see the cause through.

Title: Drunken Master
Hint: A young troublemaker learns kung fu from a boozy old beggar.
Description: After getting into trouble, a mischievous young man is sent to train under a brutal, but slovenly old beggar, who teaches him the secret of the ___ Fist.

Title: Doctor
Hint: An army surgeon tracks down the gang that kidnapped his fiancée's niece.
Description: An army ___ helps his love interest's family to find their kidnapped daughter.

Title: We're No Angels
Hint: Three convicts escape from prison on Devil's Island just before Christmas and help a family.
Description: Three convicts escape from prison on Devil's Island just before Christmas and arrive at a nearby French colonial town. They go to the store of the Ducotels, the only store that gives supplies on credit. They initially intend to take advantage of them but have a change of heart after they find the family is in financial troubles.

Title: Pierrot le Fou
Hint: A bored man runs away with his ex-girlfriend, chased by gangsters.
Description: ___ escapes his boring society and travels from Paris to the Mediterranean Sea with Marianne, a girl chased by hit-men from Algeria. They lead an unorthodox life, always on the run.

Title: Thesis
Hint: A film student researching violence discovers a snuff film at her university.
Description: While working on a ___ about audiovisual violence, film student Ángela finds a snuff video where a girl is tortured until death. Soon she discovers that she was a former student in her university, and that the authors of the video are not very far either.

Title: Rabbit-Proof Fence
Hint: Three Aboriginal girls walk 1,500 miles to return home.
Description: In 1931, three Aboriginal girls escape after being plucked from their homes to be trained as domestic staff, and set off on a trek across the Outback.

Title: Trust
Hint: A pregnant teen and a moody electronics repairman find an unusual romance.
Description: After being thrown away from home, pregnant high school dropout Maria meets Matthew, a highly educated and extremely moody electronics repairman. The two begin an unusual romance built on their sense of mutual admiration and ___.

Title: If....
Hint: Students at an English boarding school stage an armed rebellion.
Description: In an English boys' boarding school, social hierarchy reigns supreme and power remains in the hands of distanced and ineffectual teachers and callously vicious prefects in the Upper Sixth. Three Lower Sixth students, Wallace, Johnny and leader Mick Travis decide on a shocking course of action to redress the balance of privilege once and for all.

Title: Suburra
Hint: A gangster wants to turn Rome's waterfront into a new Las Vegas.
Description: A gangster known as "Samurai" wants to turn the waterfront of Rome into a new Las Vegas. All the local mob bosses have agreed to work for this common goal. But peace is not to last long.

Title: Gallipoli
Hint: Two Australian sprinters are sent to fight in a disastrous WWI campaign.
Description: Two Australian sprinters face the brutal realities of war when they are sent to fight in the ___ campaign in the Ottoman Empire during World War I.

Title: Saving Face
Hint: A Chinese-American surgeon hides her love life from her traditional mother.
Description: A Chinese-American lesbian and her traditionalist mother are reluctant to go public with secret loves that clash against cultural expectations.

Title: Places in the Heart
Hint: A widow struggles to save her Texas farm during the Depression.
Description: In 1935 rural Texas, recently widowed Edna Spaulding struggles to survive with two small children, a farm to run, and very little money in the bank - not to mention a deadly tornado and the unwelcome presence of the Ku Klux Klan. Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret; a blind boarder, Mr. Will; and a would-be thief, Moze, who decides to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton.

Title: Never Rarely Sometimes Always
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two teenage girls travel to New York to seek an abortion.
Description: A pair of teenage girls in rural Pennsylvania travel to New York City to seek out medical help after an unintended pregnancy.

Title: Immortal Beloved
Hint: The life of a famous composer and the mystery of his secret lover.
Description: A chronicle of the life of infamous classical composer Ludwig van Beethoven and his painful struggle with hearing loss.

Title: Vampyr
Hint: A young man fascinated by the occult arrives in a village plagued by a vampire.
Description: Allan Gray, a young man fascinated by the supernatural, goes to a small village where he feels a sinister force descending upon him. There, Allan meets an old man who asks him to protect his two daughters, for one of them has been bitten by a vampire.

Title: Curse of the Demon
Hint: An American professor arrives in London and is cursed by a cult leader.
Description: American professor John Holden arrives in London for a conference on parapsychology only to discover that the colleague he was supposed to meet was killed in a freak accident the day before. It turns out that the deceased had been investigating a cult lead by Dr. Julian Karswell. Though a skeptic, Holden is suspicious of the devil-worshiping Karswell.

Title: Yellow Submarine
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Four Liverpool musicians sail to save a colorful land from music-hating villains.
Description: The wicked Blue Meanies take over Pepperland, eliminating all color and music. As the only survivor, the Lord Admiral escapes in the ___ and journeys to Liverpool to enlist the help of the Beatles.

Title: Foreign Correspondent
Hint: An American crime reporter is sent to Europe on the eve of WWII.
Description: American crime reporter John Jones is reassigned to Europe as a ___ to cover the imminent war. When he walks into the middle of an assassination and stumbles on a spy ring, he seeks help from a beautiful politician’s daughter and an urbane English journalist to uncover the truth.

Title: Ryan's Daughter
Hint: A married schoolteacher has an affair with a British officer in 1916 Ireland.
Description: In the wake of the 1916 Easter Rising, a married schoolteacher in a small Irish village has an affair with a troubled British officer.

Title: Noises Off...
Hint: A disastrous touring production of a British farce falls apart.
Description: Hired to helm an Americanized take on a British play, director Lloyd Fellowes does his best to control an eccentric group of stage actors. With a star actress quickly passing her prime, a male lead with no confidence, and a bit actor that's rarely sober, chaos ensues in the lead up to a Broadway premiere.

Title: Macbeth
Hint: A Scottish general is driven by prophecy and ambition to murder his king.
Description: Feature film adaptation of Shakespeare's Scottish play about General ___ whose ambitious wife urges him to use wicked means in order to gain power of the throne over the sitting king, Duncan.

Title: Stranger Than Paradise
Hint: A New York hipster, his friend and his Hungarian cousin drift across America.
Description: New York layabout Willie forms an unexpected bond with his young Hungarian cousin Eva when she pays him a surprise visit. Later, Eva moves in with their aunt in Cleveland, and Willie takes his best friend Eddie to see her—a visit that culminates in a strange, eventful trip to Florida.

Title: Pillow Talk
Hint: A songwriter and an interior designer share a party line.
Description: Playboy songwriter Brad Allen's succession of romances annoys his neighbor, interior designer Jan Morrow, who shares a telephone party line with him and hears all his breezy routines. After Jan unsuccessfully lodges a complaint against him, Brad sets about to seduce her in the guise of a sincere and upstanding Texas rancher.

Title: La belle époque
Hint: A man relives the week he fell in love with his wife.
Description: Victor, a disillusioned 60-something whose marriage is on the rocks, opts to relive the week of his life when, 40 years earlier, he met his true love through a company that allows customers to return to the time period of their choosing.

Title: The Good Lie
Country: India, Kenya, United States of America
Hint: Sudanese refugees resettled in America with the help of a social worker.
Description: A young refugee of the Sudanese Civil War who wins a lottery for relocation to the United States with three other lost boys. Encountering the modern world for the first time, they develop an unlikely friendship with a brash American woman assigned to help them, but the young man struggles to adjust to this new life and his feelings of guilt about the brother he left behind.

Title: Rurôni Kenshin: Sai shûshô - The Beginning
Hint: Before he was a protector, a swordsman was a feared assassin who fell in love.
Description: Before he was a protector, ___ was a fearsome assassin known as Battosai. But when he meets gentle Tomoe Yukishiro, a beautiful young woman who carries a huge burden in her heart, his life will change forever.

Title: Bring Me the Head of Alfredo Garcia
Hint: A bartender and his girlfriend go on a road trip through Mexico to collect a bounty.
Description: An American bartender and his prostitute girlfriend go on a road trip through the Mexican underworld to collect a $1 million bounty on the head of a dead gigolo.

Title: Journal 64
Hint: A Danish cold case unit investigates mummified bodies found in an apartment.
Description: Copenhagen, 2018. A frightening discovery is made in an old apartment. The subsequent investigation of Department Q leads them to an infamous institution for girls that was suddenly closed in the early sixties.

Title: The Thief of Bagdad
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A prince and a street urchin fight an evil sorcerer in a Technicolor Arabian Nights fantasy.
Description: When Prince Ahmad is blinded and cast out of ___ by the nefarious Jaffar, he joins forces with the scrappy thief Abu to win back his royal place, as well as the heart of a beautiful princess.

Title: Radio Days
Hint: A boy in 1940s Queens grows up glued to the wireless.
Description: The Narrator tells us how the ___ influenced his childhood in the days before TV. In the New York City of the late 1930s to the New Year's Eve 1944, this coming-of-age tale mixes the narrator's experiences with contemporary anecdotes and urban legends of the ___ stars.

Title: Transamerica
Hint: A transgender woman takes a road trip with the son she never knew she had.
Description: A transgender woman takes an unexpected journey when she learns that she had a son, now a teenage runaway hustling on the streets of New York.

Title: Keith
Hint: A high school queen bee falls for a mysterious, carefree boy who has a secret.
Description: Natalie is high school royalty, but her queen bee status falls apart when she falls for the new guy at school. Although ___ ignores her at first, they soon become friends -- even though Natalie suspects that ___ has something to hide. As the free-spirited ___ shows Natalie how to embrace what life offers, they grow closer -- until a secret tests the bounds of their relationship

Title: Heaven Can Wait
Hint: A star quarterback is taken to the afterlife too early by an overeager angel and returns in a millionaire's body.
Description: Joe Pendleton is a quarterback preparing to lead his team to the superbowl when he is almost killed in an accident. An overanxious angel plucks him to ___ only to discover that he wasn't ready to die, and that his body has been cremated. A new body must be found, and that of a recently-murdered millionaire is chosen. His wife and accountant—the murderers—are confused by this development, as he buys the L.A.

Title: Island of Lost Souls
Hint: A shipwrecked man arrives where a scientist turns animals into men.
Description: An obsessed scientist conducts profane experiments in evolution, eventually establishing himself as the self-styled demigod to a race of mutated, half-human abominations.

Title: Another Year
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A happy couple's friends and family come and go over four seasons.
Description: During a year, a very content couple approaching retirement are visited by friends and family less happy with their lives.

Title: American Splendor
Hint: The life of an underground comic book writer and file clerk.
Description: An original mix of fiction and reality illuminates the life of comic book hero everyman Harvey Pekar.

Title: Tomboy
Hint: A ten-year-old girl passes as a boy in a new neighborhood.
Description: Ten-year-old Laure isn't like most girls. She prefers football to dolls and sweaters to dresses. When Laure and her family move to a new neighbourhood, local girl Lisa mistakes Laure for a boy. Indulging in this exciting new identity, Laure becomes Mickaël, and so begins a summer of long sunny afternoons, playground games and first kisses.

Title: Alice
Hint: A quiet English girl falls into a surreal version of her own world.
Description: A quiet young English girl named ___ finds herself in an alternate version of her own reality after chasing a white rabbit. She becomes surrounded by living inanimate objects and stuffed dead animals, and must find a way out of this nightmare - no matter how twisted or odd that way must be.

Title: Fort Apache
Hint: An arrogant colonel takes command of a desolate outpost and provokes a war.
Description: Owen Thursday sees his new posting to the desolate ___ as a chance to claim the military honour which he believes is rightfully his. Arrogant, obsessed with military form and ultimately self-destructive, he attempts to destroy the ___ chief Cochise after luring him across the border from Mexico, against the advice of his subordinates.

Title: All the King's Men
Hint: A man of humble beginnings rises to power by corrupt means.
Description: A man of humble beginnings and honest intentions rises to power by nefarious means. Along for the wild ride are an earnest reporter, a heretofore classy society girl, and a too-clever-for-her-own-good political flack.

Title: The American Friend
Country: France, Germany, United States of America
Hint: An art forger manipulates a terminally ill picture framer into becoming a hitman.
Description: Tom Ripley, an American who deals in forged art, is slighted at an auction in Hamburg by picture framer Jonathan Zimmerman. When Ripley is asked by gangster Raoul Minot to kill a rival, he suggests Zimmerman, and the two, exploiting Zimmerman's terminal illness, coerce him into being a hitman.

Title: A Better Tomorrow
Hint: A gangster seeks redemption while protecting his cop brother.
Description: A reforming ex-gangster tries to reconcile with his estranged policeman brother, but the ties to his former gang are difficult to break.

Title: AmeriGeddon
Hint: A globalist terrorist organization attacks the American power grid.
Description: A dire warning of a wake up call of what might be our future when a globalist terrorist organization aligned with the United Nations disables the United States power grid and institutes Martial Law. It will take a dedicated family of patriots armed with strong survival skills and the remains of the Second Amendment to save America and reclaim its freedom.

Title: Bagdad Cafe
Hint: A German woman stumbles upon a run-down motel in the Mojave desert.
Description: A German woman named Jasmin stumbles upon a dilapidated motel/diner in the middle of nowhere. Her unusual appearance and demeanor are at first suspicious to Brenda, the exasperated owner who has difficulty making ends meet. But when an unlikely magic sparks between the two women, this lonely desert outpost is transformed into a thriving and popular oasis.

Title: Cry Freedom
Hint: A South African journalist befriends a Black activist and must flee the country.
Description: A dramatic story, based on actual events, about the friendship between two men struggling against apartheid in South Africa in the 1970s. Donald Woods is a white liberal journalist in South Africa who begins to follow the activities of Stephen Biko, a courageous and outspoken black anti-apartheid activist.

Title: Everything Is Illuminated
Hint: A young Jewish American travels to Ukraine to find the woman who saved his grandfather.
Description: A young Jewish American man endeavors—with the help of eccentric, distant relatives—to find the woman who saved his grandfather during World War II—in a Ukrainian village which was ultimately razed by the Nazis.

Title: Holding the Man
Hint: Two schoolboys fall in love and stay together for fifteen years.
Description: Tim and John fell in love while teenagers at their all-boys high school. John was captain of the football team, Tim an aspiring actor playing a minor part in Romeo and Juliet. Their romance endured for 15 years in the face of everything life threw at it – the separations, the discrimination, the temptations, the jealousies and the losses – until the only problem that love can't solve tried to destroy them.

Title: Topsy-Turvy
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two Victorian composers struggle to create their next comic opera.
Description: For nearly a decade, Gilbert and Sullivan’s collaborations have delighted the English people. But in 1884, as a London heat wave cuts into the theater trade, their latest work, "Princess Ida", receives lukewarm press. In an effort to reconcile their creative differences and drawing inspiration from Japanese culture, they went on to create the hit opera "The Mikado", one of the duo's greatest successes.

Title: The Diary of Anne Frank
Hint: A Jewish girl hides with her family in an Amsterdam attic during the war.
Description: The true, harrowing story of a young Jewish girl who, with her family and their friends, is forced into hiding in an attic in Nazi-occupied Amsterdam.

Title: The Friends of Eddie Coyle
Hint: An aging hood informs on his associates to avoid prison.
Description: An aging hood is about to go back to prison. Hoping to escape his fate, he supplies information on stolen guns to the feds, while simultaneously supplying arms to his bank robbing chums.

Title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
Hint: A famous detective investigates a family curse involving a demonic beast on the Devonshire moors.
Description: When a nobleman is threatened by a family curse on his newly inherited estate, detective Sherlock Holmes is hired to investigate.

Title: City Island
Hint: A family keeps secrets from each other on a small New York waterfront.
Description: The Rizzos, a family who doesn't share their habits, aspirations, and careers with one another, find their delicate web of lies disturbed by the arrival of a young ex-con brought home by Vince, the patriarch of the family, who is a corrections officer in real life, and a hopeful actor in private.

Title: Marriage Italian Style
Hint: A businessman and a prostitute share a long relationship in Naples.
Description: During the bombing of Naples in World War II, a cynical businessman helps a naive prostitute, who spends the next two decades desperate to have him reciprocate her feelings.

Title: Ride the High Country
Hint: Two aging former lawmen transport gold from a mining camp through dangerous mountain territory.
Description: An ex-lawman is hired to transport gold from a mining community through dangerous territory. But what he doesn't realize is that his partner and old friend is plotting to double-cross him.

Title: Little Manhattan
Hint: A ten-year-old boy falls in love for the first time in New York.
Description: Ten-year-old Gabe Burton is just an average kid growing up in ___ until Rosemary Telesco walks into his karate class. But before Gabe can tell Rosemary how he feels, she reveals that she won't be going to public school any more. Gabe has a lot more to learn about life, love, and girls.

Title: Ghost in the Shell 2: Innocence
Hint: A cyborg detective and his partner investigate a series of murders committed by malfunctioning gynoid sex robots.
Description: Cyborg detective Batou is assigned to investigate a series of murders committed by gynoids—doll-like cyborgs, which all malfunctioned, killed, then self-destructed afterwards. The brains of the gynoids initialize in order to protect their manufacturer's software, but in one gynoid, which Batou himself neutralized, one file remains: a voice speaking the phrase "Help me."

Title: Masculin Féminin
Hint: A young idealist in 1960s Paris chases a pop singer and politics.
Description: Paul, a young idealist trying to figure out what he wants to do with his life, takes a job interviewing people for a marketing research firm. He moves in with aspiring pop singer Madeleine. Paul, however, is disillusioned by the growing commercialism in society, while Madeleine just wants to be successful. The story is told in a series of 15 unrelated vignettes.

Title: Knife in the Water
Hint: A married couple invite a young hitchhiker onto their sailboat.
Description: On their way to an afternoon on the lake, husband and wife Andrzej and Krystyna nearly run over a young hitchhiker. Inviting the young man onto the boat with them, Andrzej begins to subtly torment him; the hitchhiker responds by making overtures toward Krystyna. When the hitchhiker is accidentally knocked overboard, the husband's panic results in unexpected consequences.

Title: Faces
Hint: A middle-aged husband asks for a divorce, and both spouses seek comfort elsewhere.
Description: Middle-aged suburban husband Richard abruptly tells his wife, Maria, that he wants a divorce. As Richard takes up with a younger woman, Maria enjoys a night on the town with her friends and meets a younger man. As the couple and those around them confront a seemingly futile search for what they've lost -- love, excitement, passion -- this classic American independent film explores themes of aging and alienation.

Title: Smoke
Country: Germany, Japan, United States of America
Hint: A Brooklyn tobacco shop links a novelist, a runaway teen and the owner.
Description: Writer Paul Benjamin is nearly hit by a bus when he leaves Auggie Wren's ___ shop. Stranger Rashid Cole saves his life, and soon middle-aged Paul tells homeless Rashid that he wouldn't mind a short-term housemate. Still grieving over his wife's murder, Paul is moved by both Rashid's quest to reconnect with his father and Auggie's discovery that a woman who might be his daughter is about to give birth.

Title: I Killed My Mother
Hint: A teenager struggles with his love-hate relationship with the woman who raised him.
Description: Hubert, a brash 17-year-old, is confused and torn by a love-hate relationship with his mother that consumes him more and more each day. After distressing ordeals and tragic episodes, Hubert will find his mother on the banks of Saint Lawrence river, where he grew up, and where a murder will be committed: the murder of childhood.

Title: Rudderless
Hint: A grieving father discovers his late son's songs and starts a band.
Description: A grieving father in a downward spiral stumbles across a box of his recently deceased son's demo tapes and lyrics. Shocked by the discovery of this unknown talent, he forms a band in the hope of finding some catharsis.

Title: Aquarius
Hint: A retired music critic refuses to sell her apartment to developers.
Description: Clara, a vibrant former music critic and widow with flowing tresses is the only remaining apartment owner in a beautiful older building targeted for demolition by ruthless luxury high-rise developers. Clara proves to be a force to be reckoned with as she thwarts the builders plans to kick her out of the apartment.

Title: Broadway Danny Rose
Hint: A hapless talent agent gets dragged into a love triangle with the mob.
Description: A hapless talent manager named ___, by helping a client, gets dragged into a love triangle involving the mob. His story is told in flashback, an anecdote shared amongst a group of comedians over lunch at New York's Carnegie Deli.

Title: Summer Wars
Hint: A math whiz is blamed for a hack that crashes a virtual world.
Description: Teenage math whiz Kenji Koiso agrees to take a summer job at the Nagano hometown of his crush, Natsuki. When he arrives, he finds that her family have reunited to celebrate the 90th birthday of their matriarch. His job: pretend to be Natsuki's fiancé. Meanwhile, his attempt to solve a mathematical equation causes a parallel world's collision with Earth.

Title: Queen of Katwe
Hint: A young Ugandan girl from the slums becomes a chess champion.
Description: A young girl overcomes her disadvantaged upbringing in the slums of Uganda to become a Chess master.

Title: Rosetta
Hint: A young Belgian woman fights for any job to support her alcoholic mother.
Description: Young, impulsive ___ lives a hard and stressful life as she struggles to support herself and her alcoholic mother. Refusing all charity, she is desperate to maintain a dignified job.

Title: The Rider
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A rodeo star is told he can never ride again after a head injury.
Description: Once a rising star of the rodeo circuit, and a gifted horse trainer, young cowboy Brady is warned that his riding days are over after a horse crushed his skull at a rodeo. In an attempt to regain control of his own fate, Brady undertakes a search for a new identity and what it means to be a man in the heartland of the United States.

Title: The Band Wagon
Hint: A faded film star is cast in a pretentious Broadway musical.
Description: A Broadway artiste turns a faded film star's comeback vehicle into an artsy flop.

Title: This Gun for Hire
Hint: A hitman takes revenge on his employer who paid him with stolen money.
Description: Sadistic killer-for-___ Philip Raven becomes enraged when his latest job is paid off in marked bills. Vowing to track down his double-crossing boss, nightclub executive Gates, Raven sits beside Gates' lovely new employee, Ellen, on a train out of town.

Title: Two for the Road
Hint: A married couple's trips through France across twelve years.
