Description: Architect Mark Wallace and his wife, Joanna, travel to France to meet with an affluent client. While there, they reflect on their first decade of marriage -- memories of when they first met, of courtship, and of road trips through the French countryside.

Title: Maria Full of Grace
Hint: A pregnant Colombian teenager becomes a drug mule to make money, swallowing heroin pellets.
Description: A pregnant Colombian teenager becomes a drug mule to make some desperately needed money for her family.

Title: My Life Without Me
Hint: A young mother with two months to live makes a list of things to do.
Description: A fatally ill mother with only two months to live creates a list of things she wants to do before she dies without telling her family of her illness.

Title: The Dam Busters
Hint: British airmen develop a bouncing bomb to destroy German reservoirs.
Description: The story of the conception of a new British weapon for smashing the German dams in the Ruhr industrial complex and the execution of the raid by 617 Squadron 'The ___'.

Title: The Enemy Below
Hint: An American destroyer and a German U-boat duel in the Atlantic.
Description: The crew of the American destroyer escort, the USS Haynes, detects a German U-Boat—resulting in a prolonged, deadly battle of wits.

Title: Dragon Ball Z: Broly - The Legendary Super Saiyan
Hint: A mythic warrior whose uncontrollable rage dates back to birth threatens to destroy the universe.
Description: While the ___ Paragus persuades Vegeta to rule a new planet, King Kai alerts Goku of the South Galaxy's destruction by an unknown Super ___.

Title: Once Upon a Time in Mumbaai
Hint: Two gangsters from different eras, one smuggler with principles and one ruthless upstart, rule Bombay's underworld.
Description: A tale of two gangsters from the eras of past and present, whose lives enter parallel paths as they struggle to survive within Bombay's criminal underworld.

Title: Raid
Hint: A tax officer storms the mansion of a powerful politician.
Description: After receiving an anonymous tip, a tax officer leads a ___ on the mansion of the most powerful figure in Lucknow, a member of parliament who has been evading income tax for years.

Title: Written on the Wind
Hint: A geologist is caught between an oil family's drunk son and his sister.
Description: Mitch Wayne is a geologist working for the Hadleys, an oil-rich Texas family. While the patriarch, Jasper, works hard to establish the family business, his irresponsible son, Kyle, is an alcoholic playboy, and his daughter, Marylee, is the town tramp. Mitch harbors a secret love for Kyle's unsatisfied wife, Lucy -- a fact that leaves him exposed when the jealous Marylee accuses him of murder.

Title: Jezebel
Hint: A willful Southern belle wears a red dress to a ball and loses everything.
Description: In 1850s Louisiana, the willfulness of a tempestuous Southern belle threatens to destroy all who care for her.

Title: Woman at War (Kona fer í stríð)
Hint: A choir teacher secretly sabotages the power lines of an Icelandic aluminum plant.
Description: Halla declares a one-woman-war on the local aluminium industry. She is prepared to risk everything to protect the pristine Icelandic Highlands she loves… Until an orphan unexpectedly enters her life.

Title: Mesrine: Public Enemy No. 1
Hint: France's most notorious criminal becomes paranoid as the police close in.
Description: After nearly two decades of legendary criminal feats, making him France's most notorious criminal while simultaneously feeding his desire for media attention and public adoration, ___ becomes increasingly paranoid and isolated, leading to a dramatic confrontation with the law that ultimately seals his fate as the nation's most infamous public enemy.

Title: 120 BPM (Beats Per Minute)
Hint: AIDS activists in Paris fight for awareness and treatment in the early 1990s.
Description: Paris, in the early 1990s: a group of young activists is desperately tied to finding the cure against an unknown lethal disease. They target the pharmaceutical labs that are retaining potential cures, and multiply direct actions, with the hope of saving their lives as well as the ones of future generations.

Title: 84 Charing Cross Road
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A New York writer begins a long correspondence with a London bookseller.
Description: When a humorous script-reader in her New York apartment sees an ad in the Saturday Review of Literature for a bookstore in London that does mail order, she begins a very special correspondence and friendship with Frank Doel, the bookseller who works at Marks & Co., ___.

Title: The Wind Will Carry Us
Hint: A city engineer comes to a Kurdish village to film a mourning ritual.
Description: Irreverent city engineer Behzad comes to a rural Kurdish village in Iran to keep vigil for a dying relative. In the meanwhile the film follows his efforts to fit in with the local community and how he changes his own attitudes as a result.

Title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
Hint: Three friends are bound by a childhood secret involving a death.
Description: Three childhood friends, ___, Walter and Sam, share a terrible secret. Over time, the ambitious ___ and the pusillanimous Walter have married. She is a cold businesswoman; he is the district attorney: a perfect combination to dominate the corrupt city of Iverstown at will. But the unexpected return of Sam, after years of absence, deeply disturbs the life of the odd couple.

Title: Mediterraneo
Hint: Italian soldiers are stranded on a peaceful Greek island during the war.
Description: Greek Sea, World War II. An Italian ship leaves a handful of soldiers in a little island; their mission is to spot enemy ships and to hold the island in case of attack. The village of the island seems abandoned and there isn't a single enemy in sight, so the soldiers begin to relax a little. Things change when their ship is hit and destroyed by the enemy, and the soldiers find themselves abandoned there.

Title: L'Argent
Hint: A forged banknote leads an innocent man to prison and murder.
Description: A forged 500-franc note is passed from person to person and shop to shop, until it falls into the hands of a genuine innocent who doesn't see it for what it is—which will have devastating consequences on his life.

Title: The Specials
Hint: America's seventh-best superhero team bickers on a day off.
Description: America's seventh best superhero team, the ___, are a group of geeks and oddballs. Lifelong fan Nightbird joins the group just in time for the group to get a new line of action figures. But the members' extreme personalities and personal issues threaten to rip the group apart.

Title: Even the Rain
Hint: A film crew shooting in Bolivia gets caught up in the water wars.
Description: As a director and his crew shoot a controversial film about Christopher Columbus in Cochabamba, Bolivia, local people rise up against plans to privatize the water supply.

Title: Kesari
Hint: 21 Sikh soldiers fight 10,000 Afghan tribesmen to defend a fort.
Description: In 1897, an army of 21 Sikhs battles 10,000 Afghans to prevent the Saragarhi Fort from being taken down.

Title: Baghban
Hint: An elderly couple is mistreated by the children they raised.
Description: After dedicating their whole life in upbringing their children, elderly couple Raj Malhotra and Pooja gets homeless. Instead of caring, their children treat them as a burden.

Title: Shoot the Piano Player
Hint: A former classical pianist now plays in a bar and is caught up in crime.
Description: Charlie is a former classical pianist who has changed his name and now plays jazz in a grimy Paris bar. When Charlie's brothers, Richard and Chico, surface and ask for Charlie's help while on the run from gangsters they have scammed, he aids their escape. Soon Charlie and Lena, a waitress at the same bar, face trouble when the gangsters arrive, looking for his brothers.

Title: Black Orpheus
Hint: Young lovers run through Rio's favelas during Carnaval, pursued by death.
Description: Young lovers Orfeu and Eurydice run through the favelas of Rio during Carnaval, on the lam from a hitman dressed like Death and Orfeu's vengeful fiancée Mira and passing between moments of fantasy and stark reality. This impressionistic retelling of the Greek legend of ___ and Eurydice introduced bossa nova to the world with its soundtrack by young Brazilian composers Luiz Bonfá and Antonio Carlos Jobim.

Title: Badlapur
Hint: A man waits 15 years for revenge on his family's killer.
Description: After his wife and son are killed, a young man finds out the man behind the murder and fights against him, along committing some big mistakes.

Title: Life Is Sweet
Hint: A quirky London family struggles with life and their troubled daughter.
Description: Just north of London live Wendy, Andy, and their twenty-something twins, Natalie and Nicola. Wendy clerks in a shop, Andy is a cook who forever puts off home remodeling projects, Natalie is a plumber and Nicola is jobless. This film is about how they interact and play out family, conflict and love.

Title: Jaane Tu... Ya Jaane Na
Hint: Two best friends refuse to admit they are in love.
Description: Two best friends being convinced that they are not in love search for each other's love.

Title: Paradise Now
Hint: Two childhood friends are recruited for a suicide bombing in Tel Aviv.
Description: Two childhood friends are recruited for a suicide bombing in Tel Aviv.

Title: Sweet Sixteen
Hint: A Scottish teen deals drugs to buy his mother a home.
Description: Determined to have a normal family life once his mother gets out of prison, a Scottish teenager from a tough background sets out to raise the money for a home.

Title: Adam's Rib
Hint: Two married lawyers face off in court over a woman who shot her husband.
Description: A woman's attempted murder of her uncaring husband results in everyday quarrels in the lives of ___ and Amanda, a pair of happily married lawyers who end up on opposite sides of the case in court.

Title: Dark Victory
Hint: A carefree, hard-drinking socialite discovers she has a terminal brain tumour and falls for her doctor.
Description: Socialite Judith Traherne lives a lavish but emotionally empty life. Riding horses is one of her few joys, and her stable master is secretly in love with her. Told she has a brain tumor by her doctor, Frederick Steele, Judith becomes distraught. After she decides to have surgery to remove the tumor, Judith realizes she is in love with Dr.

Title: The Unknown Woman
Hint: A Ukrainian stranger insinuates herself into an Italian family.
Description: A Ukrainian woman named Irena calculatedly insinuates herself into the lives of a young, affluent Italian family. Stopping at nothing to become the couple's trusted maid and the beloved nanny to their fragile young daughter, Irena risks everything in her quest to uncover the truth about the family.

Title: Snow Cake
Hint: A traumatized man befriends an autistic woman in a snowy Canadian town.
Description: A drama focused on the friendship between a high-functioning autistic woman and a man who is traumatized after a fatal car accident.

Title: North Face
Hint: Two German climbers attempt to scale the deadly Eiger in 1936, as journalists watch from a hotel below.
Description: ___ tells the story of two German climbers Toni Kurz and Andreas Hinterstoisser and their attempt to scale the deadly ___ of the Eiger.

Title: Jhund
Hint: A retired coach turns slum kids into a football team.
Description: A retired sports teacher transforms a bunch of teenage slum goons into disciplined football players against all odds.

Title: Where Do We Go Now?
Hint: Women in a Lebanese village keep the peace between Muslims and Christians.
Description: In a remote, isolated Lebanese village surrounded by land mines, Muslims and Christians live together in peace. As civil strife starts to engulf the country around them, the women in the village try, by various means and to varying success, to keep their men in the dark by sabotaging the village radio, and then destroying the village TV.

Title: After the Storm
Hint: An unpopular writer tries to reconnect with his son during a typhoon.
Description: Ryota is an unpopular writer although he won a literary award 15 years ago. Now, Ryota works as a private detective. He is divorced from his ex-wife Kyoko and he has an 11-year-old son Shingo. His mother Yoshiko lives alone at her apartment. One day, Ryota, his ex-wife Kyoko, and son Shingo gather at Yoshiko's apartment. A typhoon passes and the family must stay there all night long.

Title: Animal Crackers
Hint: A famous explorer causes chaos at a society party in his honor.
Description: The well-known explorer and hunter Captain Spaulding has just returned from Africa, and is being welcomed home with a lavish party at the estate of influential society matron Mrs. Rittenhouse when a valuable painting goes missing.

Title: Rangeela
Hint: A spirited young woman from the Mumbai slums dreams of film stardom and is torn between two men.
Description: A poor young woman, who dreams of Bollywood fame, is caught in a love triangle between her childhood friend and a famous actor.

Title: Kaminey
Hint: Twin brothers, one with a lisp and one with a stutter, get caught up with gangsters.
Description: Two brothers, as different as chalk and cheese, find their lives intertwined when one puts himself in danger via a `get rich quick' scheme and the other finds there is a price on his head.

Title: Golmaal: Fun Unlimited
Hint: Four con men hide out in the bungalow of an old blind couple.
Description: Four runaway cons take shelter in a bungalow owned by an old blind couple.

Title: The Monster
Hint: A troubled mother and her daughter stranded on a dark country road are stalked by a creature in the woods.
Description: Stranded on a desolate road at night, a troubled mother and her daughter are stalked by a terrifying woodland creature while confronting the trauma of their fractured relationship.

Title: See You Up There
Hint: Two soldiers who survived World War I run a scam selling fake war memorials.
Description: In November 1918, a few days before the Armistice, when Lieutenant Pradelle orders a senseless attack, he causes a useless disaster; but his outrageous act also binds the lives of two soldiers who have nothing more in common than the battlefield: Édouard saves Albert, although at a high cost. They become companions in misfortune who will attempt to survive in a changing world. Pradelle, in his own way, does the same.

Title: Hunting Season
Country: Germany, Argentina, Qatar, United States of America, France
Hint: A violent teen in Patagonia meets his estranged father, a guide for rich trophy shooters.
Description: La Patagonia, southern Argentina. After his mother's death, Nahuel, a violent teenager, meets his biological father, Ernesto, a skillful ___ guide; but their reunion is harsh, since their souls are only ruled by pride and resentment.

Title: Before the Fall
Hint: A boxer is recruited to an elite Nazi school during World War II.
Description: In 1942, Friedrich Weimer's boxing skills get him an appointment to a National Political Academy (NaPolA) – high schools that produce Nazi elite. Over his father's objections, Friedrich enrolls. During his year in seventh column, Friedrich encounters hazing, cruelty, death, and the Nazi code. His friendship with Albrecht, the ascetic son of the area's governor, is central to this education.

Title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
Hint: A family's ancestral palace hides a haunted room and a disturbing legend.
Description: NRI Siddharth Chaturvedi and his wife Avni return to Siddharth's family's ancestral Varanasi palace while disregarding warnings of a curse and paranormal phenomena. Soon enough, inexplicable events begin occuring, which forces Siddharth to consult the eccentric psychiatrist Aditya Shrivastav to help solve the mystery.

Title: Tristana
Hint: An orphaned young woman is taken in by a lecherous guardian.
Description: As a young woman, ___ is orphaned and taken under the guardianship of Don Lope, a respected member of the community, who takes advantage of his innocent charge. When ___ falls in love with artist Horacio, she must learn to be more assertive in order to achieve independence from her nefarious guardian, or her blossoming relationship with Horacio is doomed.

Title: The Secret Life of Words
Hint: A solitary nurse bonds with a burned patient on an oil rig.
Description: A solitary nurse bonds with a badly burned patient who survived an accident on an oil rig.

Title: What Maisie Knew
Hint: A young girl is caught in her parents' bitter custody battle.
Description: In New York City, a young girl is caught in the middle of her parents' bitter custody battle.

Title: The Kid with a Bike
Hint: An abandoned boy searches for his father and his stolen bicycle.
Description: Abandoned by his father, a young boy is left in the hands of an unqualified childcare provider.

Title: Chachi 420
Hint: A divorcee disguises himself as an old woman to be near his daughter.
Description: In order to see his little girl more often, a divorcee disguises himself as an old lady and gets a job as his own daughter's caretaker. A Hindi remake of the 1996 Tamil film "Avvai Shanmugi," which is itself a remake of the Hollywood film "Mrs. Doubtfire."

Title: I
Hint: A bodybuilder disfigured by a virus takes revenge on those who did it.
Description: A deformed hunchback kidnaps a bride and holds her hostage while his connection to her and his targets is revealed in a series of flashbacks that unfold as he starts seeking revenge.

Title: Sweet Bean
Hint: An old woman's red paste makes a small pancake shop a hit.
Description: The master of a dorayaki pastry store hires a 76-year-old woman whose talents attract customers from all over. But she's hiding a troubling secret. Life's joys are found in the little details, and no matter what may be weighing you down, everyone loves a good pastry.

Title: The Mad Adventures of Rabbi Jacob
Hint: A bigoted Frenchman disguises himself as a Jewish holy man to escape killers.
Description: In this riot of frantic disguises and mistaken identities, Victor Pivert, a blustering, bigoted French factory owner, finds himself taken hostage by Slimane, an Arab rebel leader. The two dress up as rabbis as they try to elude not only assasins from Slimane's country, but also the police, who think Pivert is a murderer.

Title: The Robber
Hint: A champion marathoner leads a double life robbing banks.
Description: A champion marathoner leads a double life as a serial bank ___, sprinting between fixes (and away from police cavalcades) as many as three times a day.

Title: Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam
Hint: A man helps his new wife find the man she truly loves.
Description: A newly-wed man discovers that his wife is in love with another man and decides to unite them. Ignoring the ridicule he might have to face for this, he takes his wife to Italy in search of her love.

Title: You, the Living
Country: Denmark, France, Germany, Japan, Norway, Sweden
Hint: Deadpan vignettes of Swedish people's small miseries and dreams.
Description: In the Swedish city of Lethe, people from different walks of life take part in a series of short, deadpan vignettes that rush past. Some are just seconds long, none longer than a couple of minutes. A young woman remembers a fantasy honeymoon with a rock guitarist. A man awakes from a dream about bomber planes. A businessman boasts about success while being robbed by a pickpocket, and so on.

Title: Yahsi Bati
Hint: Two Ottoman agents travel to the Wild West to deliver a diamond.
Description: Aziz and Lemi must recover a diamond gifted by the Sultan of the Ottoman Empire to the U.S. President which has been stolen by bandits in the American wild west.

Title: Khakee
Hint: Police escort a terrorist to Mumbai and are attacked on the way.
Description: DCP Anant and his team get tasked with escorting an alleged terrorist to Mumbai. However, a rogue ex-police officer makes their task difficult as he tries to stop them from reaching their destination.

Title: The Firemen's Ball
Hint: A Czech town's firefighters throw a party that descends into chaos and theft.
Description: The ___ of a provincial Czechoslovakian town throw a ___ in honor of the old chief's retirement. There will be music and dancing, a beauty pageant and a raffle. The whole town will be in attendance. However, the proceedings are dogged by difficulty at every step. Workplace injuries, stolen prizes, a shortage of pretty girls... and fire.

Title: The Child
Hint: A nanny is hired to care for a girl whose mother recently died, and the dead won't rest.
Description: In early 20th century California, a young woman takes a job as a nanny to a young girl whose mother has recently died. On her way to the rural, secluded home, she meets a neighbor who warns her of the family's reputation. She soon meets the crabby, morbid Mr. Nordon, his awkward son Len, and the aloof Rosalie; who can seemingly animate objects when she is angry.

Title: Monkey Business
Hint: A research chemist accidentally creates a youth formula, and he and his wife act like teenagers.
Description: Research chemist Barnaby Fulton works on a fountain of youth pill for a chemical company. One of the labs chimps gets loose in the laboratory and mixes chemicals, but then pours the mix into the water cooler. When trying one of his own samples, washed down with water from the cooler, Fulton begins to act just like a twenty-year-old and believes his potion is working.

Title: The Princess and the Warrior
Hint: A nurse becomes obsessed with the robber who saved her life.
Description: Young nurse Sissi lives a secluded life entirely devoted to her patients at Birkenhof asylum. Her first encounter with ex-soldier and drifter Bodo has a lasting impact. He causes an accident in which he provides first aid, Sissi wonders if he may be the man of her dreams. But when she finds him weeks later she is rejected, as Bodo is stuck somewhere between a traumatic past and a criminal future.

Title: The Edukators
Hint: Three young activists break into rich people's homes to unsettle them.
Description: Three activists cobble together a kidnapping plot after they encounter a businessman in his home.

Title: Aankhen
Hint: A fired bank security chief recruits three blind men to rob his old bank.
Description: After his hatred of dishonesty costs him his job, an embittered man goes over to the dark side and plots to rob the bank he once managed.

Title: Magic Carpet Ride
Hint: A struggling comedian is taught by a car thief.
Description: A struggling, suicidal young comedian meets a car thief who is willing to teach him a few things about his profession.

Title: Dhamaal
Hint: Four friends race to find a dead gangster's hidden treasure in Goa.
Description: Four friends meet an underworld don who, on his deathbed, clues them in on hidden treasure buried in Goa. The group race towards Goa, not knowing that their plans will soon be foiled, albeit hilariously, by a police officer, who is also after the money.

Title: Bed & Board
Hint: A young married man works dyeing flowers and has an affair with a Japanese woman.
Description: Parisian everyman Antoine Doinel has married his sweetheart Christine Darbon, and the newlyweds have set up a cozy domestic life of selling flowers and giving violin lessons while Antoine fitfully works on his long-gestating novel. As Christine becomes pregnant with the couple's first child, Antoine finds himself enraptured with a young Japanese beauty.

Title: I'm Not Scared
Hint: A boy discovers a kidnapped child in a hole near his house.
Description: In a tiny community enclosed by wheat fields, the adults shelter indoors, while six children venture out on their bikes across the scorched, deserted countryside. Exploring a dilapidated and uninhabited farmhouse, nine-year-old Michele discovers a secret so momentous, so terrible, that he dares not tell anyone about it...

Title: Divines
Hint: A girl in a Paris ghetto dreams of becoming rich through drug dealing.
Description: In a ghetto where religion and drug trafficking rub shoulders, Dounia has a lust for power and success. Supported by Maimouna, her best friend, she decides to follow in the footsteps of Rebecca, a respected dealer. But her encounter with Djigui, a young, disturbingly sensual dancer, throws her off course.

Title: Peepli [Live]
Hint: A poor farmer decides to commit suicide to get his family compensation.
Description: Natha decides to commit suicide to get the farmers' compensation. However, the media and politicians learn about his intentions and descend on their village to capture the rare event.

Title: Takva
Hint: A devout man takes a job collecting rent for a religious order and is tempted.
Description: Humble and introvert Muharrem lives in a solitary and meager existence of a prayer and sexual abstinence adhering strictly to the most severe Islamic doctrines.His extraordinary devotion attracts the attention of the leader of a rich and powerful Istanbul religious group and he offers him an administrative post as a rent collector for their numerous properties.

Title: A Chinese Ghost Story
Hint: A tax collector falls for a beautiful spirit in a haunted temple.
Description: A naïve young tax collector for the imperial government winds up spending the night in a haunted temple. There he falls in love with a beautiful woman who, unfortunately, is dead. With the aid of a powerful Daoist Swordsman, he must defeat undead hordes, overcome a sinister Tree Demoness, and descend to the pits of hell, to fight for the spirit he loves.

Title: Guzaarish
Hint: A paralyzed magician petitions the court for the right to die.
Description: Ethan, a magician rendered paralyzed in an accident, sets off a furor when he makes a petition to the court to end his own life.

Title: Khuda Haafiz Chapter 2 Agni Pariksha
Hint: A father who already lost so much goes to war with a gang that kidnapped his adopted girl.
Description: Following a traumatic ___ in their lives, Sameer and Nargis try to lead a happy life by adopting Nandini, a friend's orphaned niece. But fate soon strikes back hard when Nandini goes missing.

Title: Limonata
Hint: Two mismatched half-brothers set off on a bickering road trip across Turkey.
Description: So begins an entertaining road story where we witness two brothers with different cultural backgrounds, who don't even know each other, have similarities, differences and even their fights.

Title: The Road to Guantanamo
Hint: Three British Muslim men travelling in Afghanistan are captured and held for years without charge at a US detention camp.
Description: Part drama, part documentary, The Road to Guantánamo focuses on the Tipton Three, a trio of British Muslims who were held in ___ Bay for two years until they were released without charge.

Title: Fortress of War
Hint: Soldiers and families hold a besieged border citadel against the first German assault of 1941.
Description: The film covers the heroic defence of the Brest ___, which was attacked during the first strike of German invaders on June 22 1941. The story describes the events of the first days of the defence, including the three main resistance zones, headed by the regiment commander, Pyotr Mikhailovich Gavrilov, the commissar Efim Moiseevich Fomin and the head of the 9th frontier outpost, Andrey Mitrofanovich Kizhevatov.

Title: Life in a Metro
Hint: Lonely Mumbai professionals chase love and success while the city's trains rattle past.
Description: A group of Mumbai up-and-comers search for love and struggle for success in this ensemble drama that centers on an eager young call centre executive.

Hint: Two Yankee teammates, one beloved and one booed, chase baseball's single-season home run record.
Description: In 1961, Roger Maris and Mickey Mantle played for the New York Yankees. One, Mantle, was universally loved, while the other, Maris, was universally hated. Both men started off with a bang, and both were nearing Babe Ruth's 60 home run record. Which man would reach it?

Title: Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak
Hint: Children of two feuding families fall in love and run away together.
Description: Both Dhanraj Singh and Randhir Singh are two bitter and old time enemies. They faced a disastrous situation when their children, Raj and Rashmi fall deeply in love. They openly declare their hatred for one another and will do anything in their power, even kill - but they will not accept their children's choice.

Title: Neredesin Firuze
Hint: Two bumbling Istanbul music producers search Turkey's villages for a girl singer whose voice they once heard on a tape.
Description: Hayri and Orhan are two music producers head over heels in debt. In an attempt to find the next big thing to turn the business around, they contact Ferhat, a gastarbeiter in Germany, and desperately bring him to Istanbul to sign him. As they are struggling to find the necessary funds to promote Ferhat's debut album, a mysterious rich woman named ___ shows up and starts supporting them.

Title: Telling Tales
Hint: Two very different young women are thrown together in a storytelling workshop.
Description: A structural exploration of personal narratives where subjects recount life experiences, focusing on the interplay between oral tradition and cinematic documentation.

Title: Dookudu
Hint: A tough cop stages an elaborate fake world so his father, waking from a coma, won't learn the truth.
Description: To protect his father recovering from a coma, a relentless cop must pose as the political leader his father always envisioned while hunting the men who tried to kill him.

Title: Gran Turismo
Hint: A teen video gamer gets a shot at becoming a real professional race car driver.
Description: The ultimate wish-fulfillment tale of a teenage ___ player whose gaming skills won him a series of Nissan competitions to become an actual professional racecar driver.

Title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
Country: Canada, France, United States of America
Hint: Four reptile brothers raised in the New York sewers by a rat want to be accepted as normal kids, and take on a crime syndicate.
Description: After years of being sheltered from the human world, the Turtle brothers set out to win the hearts of New Yorkers and be accepted as normal teenagers through heroic acts. Their new friend April O'Neil helps them take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them.

Title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
Hint: A charming thief and his band of misfits steal back a relic in a land of wizards and monsters.
Description: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic, but things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people.

Title: Bullet Train
Hint: Five assassins board a Japanese high-speed express and discover they are all after the same case.
Description: Unlucky assassin Ladybug is determined to do his job peacefully after one too many gigs gone off the rails. Fate, however, may have other plans, as Ladybug's latest mission puts him on a collision course with lethal adversaries from around the globe—all with connected, yet conflicting, objectives—on the world's fastest train.

Title: Tenet
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A secret agent learns to move against the flow of time to prevent World War III.
Description: Armed with only one word - ___ - and fighting for the survival of the entire world, the Protagonist journeys through a twilight world of international espionage on a mission that will unfold in something beyond real time.

Title: It
Hint: A gang of misfit kids in Maine face a shape-shifting clown who lives in the sewers.
Description: In a small town in Maine, seven children known as The Losers Club come face to face with life problems, bullies and a monster that takes the shape of a clown called Pennywise.

Title: Hereditary
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: After grandma dies, a grieving family uncovers a terrifying inheritance.
Description: Following the death of the Leigh family matriarch, Annie and her children uncover disturbing secrets about their heritage. Their daily lives are not only impacted, but they also become entangled in a chilling fate from which they cannot escape, driving them to the brink of madness.

Title: Sleepy Hollow
Hint: A squeamish constable investigates beheadings in a misty upstate village.
Description: Skeptical young detective Ichabod Crane gets transferred to the hamlet of ___, New York, where he is tasked with investigating the decapitations of three people – murders the townsfolk attribute to a legendary specter, The Headless Horseman.

Title: Poltergeist
Hint: A suburban family's little girl is snatched away by spirits through the TV set.
Description: The Freelings' suburban home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a portal to the 'other side'. With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

Title: Doctor Sleep
Hint: A grown-up boy with psychic powers protects a girl from a cult that feeds on children.
Description: Still scarred by the trauma he endured as a child at the Overlook Hotel, Dan Torrance faces the ghosts of the past when he meets Abra, a courageous teen who desperately needs his help -- and who possesses a powerful extrasensory ability called the "shine".

Title: Triangle of Sadness
Country: Denmark, France, Germany, Greece, Mexico, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Fashion models and the ultra-rich on a luxury cruise end up shipwrecked, and the pecking order flips.
Description: A celebrity model couple are invited on a luxury cruise for the uber-rich, helmed by an unhinged, alcoholic captain. What first appears Instagrammable ends catastrophically, leaving the survivors stranded on a desert island in a struggle of hierarchy.

Title: Irreversible
Hint: A woman's lover and her ex-boyfriend hunt the man who brutally assaulted her, in a story told in reverse.
Description: A woman’s lover and her ex-boyfriend take justice into their own hands after she becomes the victim of a rapist. Because some acts can’t be undone. Because man is an animal. Because the desire for vengeance is a natural impulse. Because most crimes remain unpunished.

Title: 10 Things I Hate About You
Hint: A new boy is paid to date a prickly sister so her younger sibling can go out.
Description: On the first day at his new school, Cameron instantly falls for Bianca, the gorgeous girl of his dreams. The only problem is that Bianca is forbidden to date until her ill-tempered, completely un-dateable older sister Kat goes out, too. In an attempt to solve his problem, Cameron singles out the only guy who could possibly be a match for Kat: a mysterious bad boy with a nasty reputation of his own.

Title: No Time to Die
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A retired spy is pulled back to stop a villain with a deadly nanobot weapon.
Description: Bond has left active service and is enjoying a tranquil life in Jamaica. His peace is short-lived when his old friend Felix Leiter from the CIA turns up asking for help. The mission to rescue a kidnapped scientist turns out to be far more treacherous than expected, leading Bond onto the trail of a mysterious villain armed with dangerous new technology.

Title: Elvis
Hint: A hip-shaking singer rises to fame under the thumb of a scheming manager.
Description: The life story of ___ Presley as seen through the complicated relationship with his enigmatic manager, Colonel Tom Parker.

Title: Troy
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A prince steals a queen, and a thousand ships sail to bring her back.
Description: In year 1250 B.C. during the late Bronze age, two emerging nations begin to clash. Paris, the Trojan prince, convinces Helen, Queen of Sparta, to leave her husband Menelaus, and sail with him back to ___. After Menelaus finds out that his wife was taken by the Trojans, he asks his brother Agamemnon to help him get her back. Agamemnon sees this as an opportunity for power.

Title: Layer Cake
Hint: A cocaine dealer planning to retire gets pulled into one last job in London.
Description: When a seemingly straight-forward drug deal goes awry, XXXX has to break his die-hard rules and turn up the heat, not only to outwit the old regime and come out on top, but to save his own skin...

Title: Split
Hint: A man with 23 personalities kidnaps three teenage girls.
Description: Though Kevin has evidenced 23 personalities to his trusted psychiatrist, Dr. Fletcher, there remains one still submerged who is set to materialize and dominate all the others. Compelled to abduct three teenage girls led by the willful, observant Casey, Kevin reaches a war for survival among all of those contained within him — as well as everyone around him — as the walls between his compartments shatter apart.

Title: The Place Beyond the Pines
Hint: A motorcycle stuntman robs banks, and his choices ripple down to the next generation.
Description: A motorcycle stunt rider considers committing a crime in order to provide for his wife and child, an act that puts him on a collision course with a cop-turned-politician.

Title: Starship Troopers
Hint: Young recruits join a fascist future military to fight giant alien bugs on distant planets, in a satirical war film.
Description: Set in the future, the story follows a young soldier named Johnny Rico and his exploits in the Mobile Infantry. Rico's military career progresses from recruit to non-commissioned officer and finally to officer against the backdrop of an interstellar war between mankind and an arachnoid species known as "the Bugs."

Title: A League of Their Own
Hint: Women swing bats and slide in skirts when wartime turns them into professional ballplayers.
Description: As America's stock of athletic young men is depleted during World War II, a professional all-female baseball ___ springs up in the Midwest, funded by publicity-hungry candy maker Walter Harvey. Competitive sisters Dottie Hinson and Kit Keller spar with each other, scout Ernie Capadino and grumpy has-been coach Jimmy Dugan on their way to fame.

Title: The Conjuring 2
Hint: Paranormal investigators travel to London to help a family haunted by a demonic nun.
Description: Lorraine and Ed Warren travel to north London to help a single mother raising four children alone in a house plagued by malicious spirits.

Title: Black Panther
Hint: A young king returns home to a hidden, technologically advanced African nation and faces a challenger to his throne.
Description: King T'Challa returns home to the reclusive, technologically advanced African nation of Wakanda to serve as his country's new leader. However, T'Challa soon finds that he is challenged for the throne by factions within his own country as well as without.

Title: Men in Black
Hint: Agents in dark suits police aliens living secretly on Earth.
Description: After a police chase with an otherworldly being, a New York City cop is recruited as an agent in a top-secret organization established to monitor and police alien activity on Earth: the ___. Agent K and new recruit Agent J find themselves in the middle of a deadly plot by an intergalactic terrorist who has arrived on Earth to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies.

Title: Cruella
Hint: A young fashion designer with two-tone hair becomes a villain with a love for spots.
Description: In 1970s London amidst the punk rock revolution, a young grifter named Estella is determined to make a name for herself with her designs. She befriends a pair of young thieves who appreciate her appetite for mischief, and together they are able to build a life for themselves on the London streets.

Title: American Sniper
Hint: A Texas cowboy turned Navy SEAL racks up a legendary kill count in Iraq, and pays for it at home.
Description: U.S. Navy SEAL Chris Kyle takes his sole mission—protect his comrades—to heart and becomes one of the most lethal snipers in American history. His pinpoint accuracy not only saves countless lives but also makes him a prime target of insurgents. Despite grave danger and his struggle to be a good husband and father to his family back in the States, Kyle serves four tours of duty in Iraq.

Title: Girl, Interrupted
Hint: A young woman spends two years in a psychiatric hospital in the 1960s.
Description: Set in the changing world of the late 1960s, Susanna Kaysen's prescribed "short rest" from a psychiatrist she had met only once becomes a strange, unknown journey into Alice's Wonderland, where she struggles with the thin line between normal and crazy.

Title: X-Men
Hint: Two mutants arrive at a private academy for gifted youngsters and help fight a terrorist group.
Description: Two mutants, Rogue and Wolverine, come to a private academy for their kind whose resident superhero team, the ___, must oppose a terrorist organization with similar powers.

Title: The Lincoln Lawyer
Hint: A smooth defense attorney who works from the back seat of his car takes a rich client who's lying.
Description: Mick Haller is a charismatic defense attorney who does business out of his ___ Continental sedan. Mick spends most of his time defending petty crooks and other bottom-feeders, so it comes as quite a surprise when he lands the case of a lifetime: defending a Beverly Hills playboy who is accused of attempted murder.

Title: Blue Valentine
Hint: A couple's love story is told in two timelines: the sweet start and the painful end.
Description: Dean and Cindy live a quiet life in a modest neighborhood. They appear to have the world at their feet at the outset of the relationship. However, his lack of ambition and her retreat into self-absorption cause potentially irreversible cracks in their marriage.

Title: Alita: Battle Angel
Hint: A cyborg girl with no memory discovers she was built as a legendary warrior.
Description: When ___ awakens with no memory of who she is in a future world she does not recognize, she is taken in by Ido, a compassionate doctor who realizes that somewhere in this abandoned cyborg shell is the heart and soul of a young woman with an extraordinary past.

Title: Labyrinth
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A teen wishes her baby brother away, then must rescue him from the Goblin King's maze.
Description: Frustrated with babysitting on yet another weekend night, Sarah, a teenager with an active imagination, summons the Goblins to take her baby stepbrother away. When little Toby actually disappears, Sarah must follow him into a fantastical world to rescue him from the Goblin King. Guarding his castle is the ___ itself, a twisted maze of deception, populated with outrageous characters and unknown dangers.

Title: Possession
Hint: A spy returns home to find his wife slipping into madness and something monstrous.
Description: A young woman left her family for an unspecified reason. The husband determines to find out the truth and starts following his wife. At first, he suspects that a man is involved. But gradually, he finds out more and more strange behaviors and bizarre incidents that indicate something more than a possessed love affair.

Title: Good Time
Hint: A desperate hustler races through one neon-soaked night in Queens to bail out his brother.
Description: After a botched bank robbery lands his younger brother in prison, Connie Nikas embarks on a twisted odyssey through New York City's underworld to get his brother Nick out of jail.

Title: The Shape of Water
Hint: A mute cleaning lady falls in love with an amphibian creature in a secret lab.
Description: An other-worldly story, set against the backdrop of Cold War era America circa 1962, where a mute janitor working at a lab falls in love with an amphibious man being held captive there and devises a plan to help him escape.

Title: Hercules
Genres: Animation, Family, Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy, Romance
Hint: The son of Zeus, raised as a mortal, must become a true hero to return to Olympus.
Description: Bestowed with superhuman strength, a young mortal named ___ sets out to prove himself a hero in the eyes of his father, the great god Zeus. Along with his friends Pegasus, a flying horse, and Phil, a personal trainer, ___ is tricked by the hilarious, hotheaded villain Hades, who's plotting to take over Mount Olympus!

Title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A wronged London hairdresser returns for blood, and his landlady bakes the evidence into pies.
Description: The infamous story of Benjamin Barker, a.k.a ___, who sets up a ___ shop down in London which is the basis for a sinister partnership with his fellow tenant, Mrs. Lovett. Based on the hit Broadway musical.

Title: Corpse Bride
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A nervous groom practising his wedding vows in a dark forest accidentally marries a dead woman.
Description: In a 19th-century European village, a young man about to be married is whisked away to the underworld and wed to a mysterious ___, while his real ___ waits bereft in the land of the living.

Title: True Lies
Hint: A secret agent leads a double life his wife knows nothing about.
Description: A fearless, globe-trotting, terrorist-battling secret agent has his life turned upside down when he discovers his wife might be having an affair with a used car salesman while terrorists smuggle nuclear war heads into the United States.

Title: The Karate Kid
Hint: A bullied teen learns martial arts from a wise handyman.
Description: New Jersey teen Daniel LaRusso moves to Los Angeles with his mother, and soon strikes up a relationship with Ali. He quickly finds himself the target of bullying by a group of thugs, led by Ali's ex-boyfriend Johnny, who study ___ at the Cobra Kai dojo under ruthless sensei John Kreese. Fortunately, Daniel befriends Mr. Miyagi, an unassuming repairman who just happens to be a martial arts master himself.

Title: Monster
Hint: A prostitute on the Florida highways becomes a serial killer.
Description: In 1989, prostitute Aileen Wuornos befriends and enters a relationship with a young woman named Selby. Determined to straighten out her life, Aileen's limited education lands her back on the corner. She's raped by a trick, who she kills. A string of murder and robbery follows that ultimately leads Aileen to becoming America's first female serial killer.

Title: Gremlins
Hint: A boy gets an adorable pet, but there are three rules he must never break.
Description: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

Title: The King
Hint: A wayward young prince takes the throne and is goaded into a war with France.
Description: Simba idolizes his father, ___ Mufasa, and takes to heart his own royal destiny. But not everyone in the kingdom celebrates the new cub's arrival. Scar, Mufasa's brother—and former heir to the throne—has plans of his own. The battle for Pride Rock is ravaged with betrayal, tragedy and drama, ultimately resulting in Simba's exile.

Title: She Said
Hint: Two reporters break the story of a powerful movie producer's abuse.
Description: New York Times reporters Megan Twohey and Jodi Kantor break one of the most important stories in a generation — a story that helped launch the #MeToo movement and shattered decades of silence around the subject of sexual assault in Hollywood.

Title: Dumb and Dumber
Hint: Two dim-witted friends drive across America to return a briefcase.
Description: Lloyd and Harry are two men whose stupidity is really indescribable. When Mary, a beautiful woman, loses an important suitcase with money before she leaves for Aspen, the two friends (who have found the suitcase) decide to return it to her. After some "adventures" they finally get to Aspen where, using the lost money they live it up and fight for Mary's heart.

Title: The Ballad of Buster Scruggs
Hint: Six tales of the American West, full of dark humor and violence.
Description: Vignettes weaving together the stories of six individuals in the old West at the end of the Civil War. Following the tales of a sharp-shooting songster, a wannabe bank robber, two weary traveling performers, a lone gold prospector, a woman traveling the West to an uncertain future, and a motley crew of strangers undertaking a carriage ride.

Title: 13 Hours
Hint: Contractors defend a US compound in Benghazi during a deadly attack.
Description: An American Ambassador is killed during an attack at a U.S. compound in Libya as a security team struggles to make sense out of the chaos.

Title: Rocketman
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A shy piano prodigy becomes a flamboyant rock superstar battling his demons.
Description: The story of Elton John's life, from his years as a prodigy at the Royal Academy of Music through his influential and enduring musical partnership with Bernie Taupin.

Title: Running Scared
Hint: A low-level mobster must dispose of a gun used to kill dirty cops, but it goes missing.
Description: A low-ranking thug is entrusted by his boss to dispose of a gun that killed corrupt cops, but things spiral out of control when the gun ends up in wrong hands.

Title: Excalibur
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young squire pulls a sword from a stone, becomes king and gathers his knights with a wizard's help.
Description: Arthur fulfills his fate by bringing together the Knights of the Round Table at Camelot and unifying the country. However, this flawed monarch faces greater tests ahead in pursuit of love, the Holy Grail, and his nation's survival.

Title: Nomadland
Hint: A widow in her sixties loses everything in the recession and travels the American West living in a van.
Description: A woman in her sixties embarks on a journey through the western United States after losing everything in the Great Recession, living as a van-dwelling modern-day nomad.

Title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
Hint: A peacekeeping program goes wrong, and superheroes must stop a sentient robot from destroying humanity.
Description: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous ___ emerges, it is up to The ___ to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.

Title: El Camino: A Breaking Bad Movie
Hint: A fugitive tries to escape his past after being freed from a meth-cooking gang.
Description: In the wake of his dramatic escape from captivity, Jesse Pinkman must come to terms with his past in order to forge some kind of future.

Title: Face/Off
Hint: An FBI agent and a terrorist surgically swap identities, and each must live the other's life.
Description: In order to foil a terrorist plot, an FBI agent undergoes facial transplant surgery and assumes the identity of a criminal mastermind. The plan turns sour when the criminal wakes up prematurely and seeks revenge.

Title: Ant-Man
Hint: A thief with a suit that shrinks him must pull off a heist.
Description: Armed with the astonishing ability to shrink in scale but increase in strength, master thief Scott Lang must embrace his inner-hero and help his mentor, Doctor Hank Pym, protect the secret behind his spectacular ___ suit from a new generation of towering threats. Against seemingly insurmountable obstacles, Pym and Lang must plan and pull off a heist that will save the world.

Title: Speed
Hint: A bus is rigged to explode if it slows below 50 mph.
Description: Tensions run high when a crazed bomber rigs a Los Angeles bus with a device that will kill everyone on board if the vehicle's ___ dips below fifty miles per hour.

Title: Big
Hint: A boy makes a wish and wakes up as a 30-year-old man.
Description: When a young boy makes a wish at a carnival machine to be ___—he wakes up the following morning to find that it has been granted and his body has grown older overnight. But he is still the same 13-year-old boy inside. Now he must learn how to cope with the unfamiliar world of grown-ups including getting a job and having his first romantic encounter with a woman.

Title: Belfast
Hint: A boy grows up in Northern Ireland during the Troubles of 1969.
Description: Buddy is a young boy on the cusp of adolescence, whose life is filled with familial love, childhood hijinks, and a blossoming romance. Yet, with his beloved hometown caught up in increasing turmoil, his family faces a momentous choice: hope the conflict will pass or leave everything they know behind for a new life.

Title: Tarzan
Hint: An orphaned baby raised by gorillas in the jungle meets humans for the first time, in an animated musical.
Description: ___ was a small orphan who was raised by an ape named Kala since he was a child. He believed that this was his family, but on an expedition Jane Porter is rescued by ___. He then finds out that he's human. Now ___ must make the decision as to which family he should belong to...

Title: Decision to Leave
Hint: A detective falls for the widow suspected of killing her husband.
Description: From a mountain peak in South Korea, a man plummets to his death. Did he jump, or was he pushed? When detective Hae-joon arrives on the scene, he begins to suspect the dead man’s wife Seo-rae. But as he digs deeper into the investigation, he finds himself trapped in a web of deception and desire.

Title: Identity
Hint: Ten strangers stranded at a motel during a storm are killed one by one.
Description: Complete strangers stranded at a remote desert motel during a raging storm soon find themselves the target of a deranged murderer. As their numbers thin out, the travelers begin to turn on each other, as each tries to figure out who the killer is.

Title: The NeverEnding Story
Hint: A bullied boy reads a magical book and becomes part of its adventure.
Description: While hiding from bullies in his school's attic, a young boy discovers the extraordinary land of Fantasia, through a magical book called The ___. The book tells the tale of Atreyu, a young warrior who, with the help of a luck dragon named Falkor, must save Fantasia from the destruction of The Nothing.

Title: Flight
Hint: A pilot saves a crashing plane but faces scrutiny over his drinking.
Description: Commercial airline pilot Whip Whitaker has a problem with drugs and alcohol, though so far he's managed to complete his flights safely. His luck runs out when a disastrous mechanical malfunction sends his plane hurtling toward the ground. Whip pulls off a miraculous crash-landing that results in only six lives lost.

Title: National Lampoon's Vacation
Hint: A father takes his family on a disastrous road trip to an amusement park.
Description: Clark Griswold is on a quest to take his family to the Walley World theme park for a vacation, but things don't go exactly as planned.

Title: The Accountant
Hint: A maths-savant number cruncher who launders money for dangerous criminals audits a robotics firm and becomes a target.
Description: As a math savant uncooks the books for a new client, the Treasury Department closes in on his activities and the body count starts to rise.

Title: Jerry Maguire
Hint: A sports agent with one remaining client tries to rebuild his career.
Description: ___ used to be a typical sports agent: willing to do just about anything he could to get the biggest possible contracts for his clients, plus a nice commission for himself. Then, one day, he suddenly has second thoughts about what he's really doing. When he voices these doubts, he ends up losing his job and all of his clients, save Rod Tidwell, an egomaniacal football player.

Title: Enemy of the State
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A lawyer becomes the target of a corrupt NSA official.
Description: When the videotape of the murder of a congressman unknowingly ends up in the hands of labor lawyer and dedicated family man Robert Clayton Dean, he is framed for the murder. With the help of the mysterious Brill, Dean attempts to throw the NSA off his trail and prove his innocence.

Title: Cha Cha Real Smooth
Hint: A charming young man becomes a party starter at bar mitzvahs and befriends a single mom.
Description: Fresh out of college and stuck at his New Jersey home without a clear path forward, 22-year-old Andrew begins working as a party starter for bar/bat mitzvahs—where he strikes up a unique friendship with a young mom and her teenage daughter.

Title: The Edge of Seventeen
Hint: An awkward teen's life is upended when her best friend dates her older brother.
Description: Two high school girls are best friends until one dates the other's older brother, who is totally his sister's nemesis.

Title: Suspiria
Hint: An American ballet student discovers her dance academy is run by witches.
Description: An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.

Title: Old Henry
Hint: A widowed farmer and his son take in a wounded stranger with a bag of cash, and a posse comes for him.
Description: A widowed farmer and his son warily take in a mysterious, injured man with a satchel of cash. When a posse of men claiming to be the law come for the money, the farmer must decide who to trust. Defending a siege of his homestead, the farmer reveals a talent for gun-slinging that surprises everyone calling his true identity into question.

Title: Beverly Hills Cop
Hint: A fast-talking Detroit street detective heads to a ritzy LA neighbourhood to track down his friend's killer.
Description: Fast-talking, quick-thinking Detroit street cop Axel Foley has bent more than a few rules and regs in his time, but when his best friend is murdered, he heads to sunny ___ to work the case like only he can.

Title: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A daydreaming photo manager sets out on a real-life adventure.
Description: A timid magazine photo manager who lives life vicariously through daydreams embarks on a true-life adventure when a negative goes missing.

Title: The Next Three Days
Hint: A man plans to break his wife out of prison.
Description: Life seems perfect for John Brennan until his wife, Lara, is arrested for a murder she says she didn’t commit. Three years into her sentence, John is struggling to hold his family together, raising their son and teaching at college while he pursues every means available to prove her innocence.

Title: The Ice Storm

Description: When his son dies while hiking the famed Camino de Santiago pilgrimage route in the Pyrenees, Tom flies to France to claim the remains. Looking for insights into his estranged child’s life, he decides to complete the 500-mile mountain trek to Spain.

Description: A Spanish orchestra conductor deals with the mysterious disappearance of his girlfriend.

Title: Death at a Funeral

Description: A myriad of outrageous calamities befalls an eccentric English clan with more than a few skeletons in its closets when the family's patriarch dies an unexpected death.

Description: A week in the life of ___, a poet bus driver, and his wife Laura, a very creative artist, who live in ___, New Jersey, hometown of many famous poets and artists.

Title: The Gods Must Be Crazy
Hint: A Coca-Cola bottle falls from a plane and causes chaos in a Kalahari tribe.
Description: A Coca-Cola bottle dropped from an airplane raises havoc among a normally peaceful tribe of African bushmen who believe it to be a utensil of the ___.

Title: The Walk
Hint: A Frenchman crosses a tightrope between the Twin Towers.
Description: The story of French high-wire artist Philippe Petit's attempt to cross the Twin Towers of the World Trade Center in 1974.

Title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

Description: When a huge alien probe enters the galaxy and begins to vaporize Earth's oceans, Kirk and his crew must travel back in time in order to bring back whales and save the planet.

Title: Nikita

Description: A beautiful felon, sentenced to life in prison for the murder of a policeman, is given a second chance – as a secret political assassin controlled by the government.

Title: Capote

Description: A biopic of writer Truman ___ and his assignment for The New Yorker to write the non-fiction book "In Cold Blood".

Title: Belle

Description: Dido Elizabeth Bell, the illegitimate, mixed-race daughter of a Royal Navy admiral, plays an important role in the campaign to abolish slavery in England.

Title: The Boat That Rocked
Hint: A group of rebellious DJs broadcast rock music from a pirate radio ship in the North Sea.
Description: When a group of rebellious deejays decides to defy the ban on government-censored music, they take to the seas to broadcast music and mayhem to millions of adoring fans.

Title: Murder by Death
Hint: An eccentric millionaire invites the world's five greatest detectives to dinner and a killing, in a spoof.
Description: Lionel Twain invites the world's five greatest detectives to a 'dinner and murder'. Included are a blind butler, a deaf-mute maid, screams, spinning rooms, secret passages, false identities and more plot turns and twists than are decently allowed.

Title: Thirteen Days
Hint: The White House spends a tense fortnight on the edge of nuclear war with the Soviets.
Description: The story of the Cuban Missile Crisis in 1962—the nuclear standoff with the USSR sparked by the discovery by the Americans of missile bases established on the Soviet-allied island of Cuba.

Title: Drugstore Cowboy
Hint: A gang of addicts robs pharmacies in 1971 Portland.
Description: Portland, Oregon, 1971. Bob Hughes is the charismatic leader of a peculiar quartet, formed by his wife, Dianne, and another couple, Rick and Nadine, who skillfully steal from drugstores and hospital medicine cabinets in order to appease their insatiable need for drugs. But neither fun nor luck last forever.

Title: I Stand Alone
Hint: An embittered former horse butcher wanders France, consumed by rage and hatred, in a brutal arthouse drama.
Description: After completing jail time for beating up a man who tried to seduce his mentally-handicapped teenage daughter, the Butcher wants to start life anew. He institutionalizes his daughter and moves to the Lille suburbs with his mistress, who promises him a new butcher shop. Learning that she lied, the Butcher returns to Paris to find his daughter.

Title: The Way Back
Country: United States of America, United Arab Emirates, Poland, India
Hint: Prisoners escape a Siberian gulag and walk thousands of miles to freedom.
Description: A small band of multicultural convicts stages a daring escape from a WWII-era Siberian gulag, and embarks on a treacherous journey across five countries in a desperate race for freedom and survival.

Title: Far from Heaven
Hint: A perfect 1950s housewife's world unravels when she befriends her Black gardener.
Description: In 1950s Connecticut, a housewife's life is upended by a marital crisis and mounting racial tensions in society.

Title: Matchstick Men
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A con man with OCD discovers he has a teenage daughter.
Description: A phobic con artist and his protege are on the verge of pulling off a lucrative swindle when the con artist's teenage daughter arrives unexpectedly.

Title: My Sister's Keeper
Hint: A girl sues her parents to stop being a donor for her dying older sibling.
Description: Sara and Brian live an idyllic life with their young son and daughter. But their family is rocked by sudden, heartbreaking news that forces them to make a difficult and unorthodox choice in order to save their baby girl's life. The parents' desperate decision raises both ethical and moral questions and rips away at the foundation of their relationship.

Title: Bambi
Hint: A young deer grows up in the forest and loses his mother to hunters.
Description: ___ tale unfolds from season to season as the young prince of the forest learns about life, love, and friends.

Title: The Hundred-Foot Journey
Country: India, United States of America, United Arab Emirates
Hint: An Indian family opens a restaurant across from a Michelin-starred French one.
Description: A story centered around an Indian family who moves to France and opens a restaurant across the street from a Michelin-starred French restaurant.

Title: The Fundamentals of Caring
Hint: A grieving writer becomes caregiver to a sarcastic teen with muscular dystrophy.
Description: Having suffered a tragedy, Ben becomes a caregiver to earn money. His first client, Trevor, is a hilarious 18-year-old with muscular dystrophy. One paralyzed emotionally, one paralyzed physically, Ben and Trevor hit the road on a trip into the western states. The folks they collect along the way will help them test their skills for surviving outside their calculated existence.

Title: Reds
Hint: An American journalist and his lover witness the 1917 Russian Revolution and its aftermath.
Description: An account of the revolutionary years of the legendary American journalist John Reed, who shared his adventurous professional life with his radical commitment to the socialist revolution in Russia, his dream of spreading its principles among the members of the American working class, and his troubled romantic relationship with the writer Louise Bryant.

Title: Rescue Dawn
Hint: A US fighter pilot shot down over Laos escapes from a prison camp.
Description: A US Fighter pilot's epic struggle of survival after being shot down on a mission over Laos during the Vietnam War.

Title: Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore

Description: After her husband dies, ___ and her son, Tommy, leave their small New Mexico town for California, where ___ hopes to make a new life for herself as a singer. Money problems force them to settle in Arizona instead, where ___ takes a job as waitress in a small diner.

Title: Eddie the Eagle
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: The feel-good story of Michael '___' Edwards, an unlikely but courageous British ski-jumper who never stopped believing in himself—even as an entire nation was counting him out. With the help of a rebellious and charismatic coach, ___ takes on the establishment and wins the hearts of sports fans around the world by making an improbable and historic showing at the 1988 Calgary Winter Olympics.

Title: Mr. Brooks
Hint: A respected businessman is secretly a serial killer driven by an imaginary friend.
Description: A psychological thriller about a man who is sometimes controlled by his murder-and-mayhem-loving alter ego.

Title: Lethal Weapon 2
Hint: Two mismatched LAPD detectives take on South African diplomats smuggling drugs under diplomatic immunity.
Description: Riggs and Murtaugh are on the trail of South African diplomats using their immunity to engage in criminal activities.

Title: Local Hero
Hint: An American oil man is sent to buy a Scottish village.
Description: An American oil company sends a man to Scotland to buy up an entire village where they want to build a refinery. But things don't go as expected.

Title: 20th Century Women
Hint: A single mother enlists two younger lodgers to help raise her son in 1979.
Description: In 1979 Santa Barbara, California, Dorothea Fields is a determined single mother in her mid-50s who is raising her adolescent son, Jamie, at a moment brimming with cultural change and rebellion. Dorothea enlists the help of two younger women – Abbie, a free-spirited punk artist living as a boarder in the Fields' home and Julie, a savvy and provocative teenage neighbour – to help with Jamie's upbringing.

Title: What's Love Got to Do with It
Hint: A singer escapes her abusive husband to become a rock and soul legend.
Description: Singer Tina Turner rises to stardom while mustering the courage to break free from her abusive husband Ike.

Title: The Guard
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A crass small-town Irish cop teams up with an FBI agent to bust a drug-smuggling ring.
Description: When a small-town Irish cop with a crass personality is partnered with a straight-laced FBI agent to bust an international drug-trafficking ring, they must settle their differences in order to take down a dangerous gang.

Title: Barney's Version
Country: Canada, Italy, United States of America
Hint: An impulsive TV producer recounts his life and his three marriages.
Description: The picaresque and touching story of the politically incorrect, fully lived life of the impulsive, irascible and fearlessly blunt ___ Panofsky.

Title: Betty Blue
Hint: An easy-going handyman's passionate affair with a volatile young woman descends into madness.
Description: A lackadaisical handyman and aspiring novelist tries to support his younger girlfriend as she slowly succumbs to madness.

Title: Seven Brides for Seven Brothers
Hint: Backwoods siblings kidnap wives after their eldest marries in 1850s Oregon.
Description: In 1850 Oregon, when a backwoodsman brings a wife home to his farm, his six brothers decide that they want to get married too.

Title: Clerks II
Hint: Two slackers start a new job at a fast-food restaurant.
Description: A calamity at Dante and Randall's shops sends them looking for new horizons - but they ultimately settle at Mooby's, a fictional Disney-McDonald's-style fast-food empire.

Title: Jason and the Argonauts
Hint: A hero sets out to find the Golden Fleece and battles skeletons and a giant bronze statue.
Description: ___, a fearless sailor and explorer, returns to his home land of Thessaly after a long voyage to claim his rightful throne. He learns, however, that he must first find the magical Golden Fleece. To do so, he must embark on an epic quest fraught with fantastic monsters and terrible perils.

Title: Caché
Hint: A Parisian TV host receives anonymous videotapes of his house.
Description: George, host of a television show focusing on literature, receives videos shot on the sly that feature his family, along with disturbing drawings that are difficult to interpret. He has no idea who has made and sent him the videos. Progressively, the contents of the videos become more personal, indicating that the sender has known George for a long time.

Title: The Getaway
Hint: An ex-con and his wife go on the run after a heist goes wrong.
Description: A recently released ex-convict and his loyal wife go on the run after a heist goes wrong.

Title: The Queen
Hint: The royal family struggles with how to respond to Princess Diana's death.
Description: The ___ is an intimate behind the scenes glimpse at the interaction between HM Elizabeth II and Prime Minister Tony Blair during their struggle, following the death of Diana, to reach a compromise between what was a private tragedy for the Royal family and the public's demand for an overt display of mourning.

Title: Antwone Fisher
Hint: A violent sailor finally opens up to a navy psychiatrist.
Description: A sailor prone to violent outbursts is sent to a naval psychiatrist for help. Refusing at first to open up, the young man eventually breaks down and reveals a horrific childhood. Through the guidance of his doctor, he confronts his painful past and begins a quest to find the family he never knew.

Title: Hustle & Flow
Hint: A Memphis pimp facing a midlife crisis tries to become a rapper with the help of his old friend.
Description: With help from his friends, a Memphis pimp in a mid-life crisis attempts to become a successful hip-hop emcee.

Description: Primo and Secondo, two immigrant brothers, pin their hopes on a banquet honoring Louis Prima to save their struggling restaurant.

Description: Five close friends, all of them married, share a ___ to meet their mistresses. One day they find the body of a young woman in the ___. Since there are only five keys to the ___, the five men begin to suspect each other of murder.

Title: The Captain

Description: Germany, 1945. Soldier Willi Herold, a deserter of the German army, stumbles into a uniform of a Nazi ___ abandoned during the last and desperate weeks of the Third Reich. Newly emboldened by the allure of a suit that he has stolen only to stay warm, Willi discovers that many Germans will follow the leader, whoever he is.

Title: My Name Is Nobody
Country: France, Germany, Italy, United States of America
Hint: A young gunman idolizes an aging gunfighter who just wants to retire.
Description: Jack Beauregard, an aging gunman of the Old West, only wants to retire in peace and move to Europe, but a young gunfighter known as "___" who idolizes Beauregard wants him to go out in a blaze of glory. So, he arranges for Jack to face the 150-man gang known as The Wild Bunch and earn his place in history.

Title: The Last Unicorn
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A mythical horned creature searches for others of her kind.
Description: A ___ learns from a riddle-speaking butterfly that she is supposedly the last of her kind, all the others having been herded away by the monstrous Red Bull. The ___ sets out to discover the truth behind the butterfly's words. She is eventually joined on her quest by Schmendrick, a second-rate magician, and Molly Grue, a middle-aged woman who dreamed all her life of seeing a ___.

Title: Our Friend
Hint: A man moves in with his best mate's family to help as his wife is dying.
Description: After learning that his terminally ill wife has six months to live, a man welcomes the support of his best friend who moves into their home to help out.

Title: Little Boy
Hint: An eight-year-old tries to bring his father home from World War II with faith.
Description: An eight-year-old boy is willing to do whatever it takes to end World War II so he can bring his father home. The story reveals the indescribable love a father has for his ___ and the love a son has for his father.

Title: Detroit

Description: A police raid in ___ in 1967 results in one of the largest citizens' uprisings in the history of the United States.

Title: Pusher

Description: A drug ___ grows increasingly desperate after a botched deal leaves him with a large debt to a ruthless drug lord.

Title: Eight Below
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Sled dogs left behind in Antarctica must survive the long winter alone until their guide returns.
Description: In the Antarctic, after an expedition with Dr. Davis McClaren, the sled dog trainer Jerry Shepherd has to leave the polar base with his colleagues due to the proximity of a heavy snow storm. He ties his dogs to be rescued after, but the mission is called-off and the dogs are left alone at their own fortune. For six months, Jerry tries to find a sponsor for a rescue mission.

Title: The Man in the Moon
Hint: Two sisters fall for the same boy in 1950s Louisiana.
Description: Maureen Trant and her younger sibling Dani share a strong connection, but local boy Court Foster threatens to throw their bond off balance. Dani and Court meet first and have a flirtatious rapport -- but when he meets Maureen, he falls hard and they begin a passionate affair. The new couple try to keep their love hidden from Dani, but she soon learns the truth, disavowing her sister.

Title: Mr. Holland's Opus
Hint: A frustrated composer becomes a high school music teacher for thirty years.
Description: In 1965, passionate musician Glenn ___ takes a day job as a high school music teacher, convinced it's just a small obstacle on the road to his true calling: writing a historic ___. As the decades roll by with the composition unwritten but generations of students inspired through his teaching, ___ must redefine his life's purpose.

Title: The Ultimate Gift
Hint: A rich grandson must complete tasks to receive his inheritance.
Description: When his wealthy grandfather finally dies, Jason Stevens fully expects to benefit when it comes to the reading of the will. But instead of a sizable inheritance, Jason receives a test, a series of tasks he must complete before he can get any money.

Title: Seabiscuit
Hint: An undersized racehorse lifts the spirits of a nation during the Depression.
Description: True story of the undersized Depression-era racehorse whose victories lifted not only the spirits of the team behind it but also those of their nation.

Title: Fish Tank
Hint: An angry teen in Essex has an affair with her mother's boyfriend.
Description: Fifteen-year-old Mia is in a constant state of war with her family and the world around her. When she meets her party-girl mother’s charming new boyfriend Connor, she is amazed to find he returns her attention, and believes he might help her start to make sense of her life.

Title: The Proposition
Hint: A lawman offers an outlaw a deal: kill his older brother to save his younger one.
Description: In 1880s Australia, a lawman offers renegade Charlie Burns a difficult choice. In order to save his younger brother from the gallows, Charlie must hunt down and kill his older brother, who is wanted for rape and murder. Venturing into one of the Outback's most inhospitable regions, Charlie faces a terrible moral dilemma that can end only in violence.

Title: Shallow Grave
Hint: Three roommates find a dead man and a suitcase of cash.
Description: When David, Juliet, and Alex find their new roommate dead with a large sum of money, they agree to hide the body and keep the cash. However, this newfound fortune gradually corrodes their friendship.

Title: Funny Girl
Hint: A gawky Jewish girl from the Lower East Side becomes a Broadway comedy star and falls for a gambler.
Description: The life of famed 1930s comedienne Fanny Brice, from her early days in the Jewish slums of New York, to the height of her career with the Ziegfeld Follies, as well as her marriage to the rakish gambler Nick Arnstein.

Title: I Can Only Imagine
Hint: A troubled young singer's relationship with his abusive father inspires a hugely popular Christian song.
Description: Growing up in Greenville, Texas, Bart Millard suffers physical and emotional abuse at the hands of his father, Arthur. When Arthur becomes terminally ill, he finds redemption by embracing his faith and rediscovering his love for his son. Years later, Bart's troubled childhood and mended relationship with his dad inspires him to write the hit song "___" as singer of the Christian band MercyMe.

Title: Live Flesh
Hint: A man who went to prison for a shooting seeks revenge on a cop.
Description: When Victor attempts to seduce Elena, all he gets for his trouble is a one-way, six-year ticket to prison, where he concentrates on strengthening his mind, his body... and his desire for vengeance on the man who put him there. After his release and still madly in love with her, Victor will stop at nothing to win her over even if means revenge, for Elena has married David, the cop who sent him to prison!

Title: Tess
Hint: A peasant girl is sent to claim kinship with a wealthy family.
Description: A strong-willed peasant girl is sent by her father to the estate of some local aristocrats to capitalize on a rumour that their families are from the same line. This fateful visit commences an epic narrative of sex, class, betrayal, and revenge.

Title: Nobody's Fool
Hint: A rascally man near retirement juggles a lawsuit, his son and his landlady.
