Description: A rascally nearing-retirement man juggles a workers' compensation suit while secretly working for his nemesis and flirting with his nemesis' young wife. As his estranged son returns, he faces new family responsibilities, while a banker plots to evict him from his home.

Title: The Professionals
Hint: Four mercenaries rescue a millionaire's wife from a Mexican bandit.
Description: An arrogant Texas millionaire hires four adventurers to rescue his kidnapped wife from a notorious Mexican bandit.

Title: The People vs. Larry Flynt
Hint: A pornography publisher fights a long legal battle for free speech all the way to the Supreme Court.
Description: ___ is the hedonistically obnoxious, but indomitable, publisher of Hustler magazine. The film recounts his struggle to make an honest living publishing his girlie magazine and how it changes into a battle to protect the freedom of speech for all people.

Title: The War Zone
Hint: A teenager discovers a dark secret in his family.
Description: An alienated teenager, saddened that he has moved away from London, must find a way to deal with a dark family secret.

Title: Moby Dick
Hint: A captain obsessed with a white whale leads his crew to doom.
Description: In 1841, young Ishmael signs up for service aboard the Pequod, a whaler sailing out of New Bedford. The ship is under the command of Captain Ahab, a strict disciplinarian who exhorts his men to find ___, the great white whale. Ahab lost his leg to that creature and is desperate for revenge. As the crew soon learns, he will stop at nothing to gain satisfaction.

Title: 24 Hour Party People
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A TV reporter starts a record label in Manchester.
Description: Manchester, 1976. Tony Wilson is an ambitious but frustrated local TV news reporter looking for a way to make his mark. After witnessing a life-changing concert by a band known as the Sex Pistols, he persuades his station to televise one of their performances, and soon Manchester's punk groups are clamoring for him to manage them.

Title: Ten Inch Hero
Hint: Friends work at a sandwich shop in California and search for love.
Description: Four friends search for love and happiness while working at a California sandwich shop.

Title: The Best of Enemies
Hint: A civil rights activist and a Klan leader co-chair a community meeting.
Description: Centers on the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader who reluctantly co-chaired a community summit, battling over the desegregation of schools in Durham, North Carolina during the racially-charged summer of 1971. The incredible events that unfolded would change Durham and the lives of Atwater and Ellis forever.

Title: The 12th Man
Hint: A Norwegian resistance fighter flees the Nazis through frozen mountains.
Description: After a failed anti-Nazi sabotage mission leaves his eleven comrades dead, a Norwegian resistance fighter finds himself fleeing the Gestapo through the snowbound reaches of Scandinavia.

Title: The Wanderers
Hint: Youth gangs rule the Bronx in 1963, as a group of Italian-American teens face rivals and growing up.
Description: The streets of the Bronx are owned by '60s youth gangs where the joy and pain of adolescence is lived. Philip Kaufman tells his take on the novel by Richard Price about the history of the Italian-American gang ‘The ___.’

Title: Anomalisa
Hint: A lonely man sees everyone as the same person until he meets a unique woman.
Description: An inspirational speaker becomes reinvigorated after meeting a lively woman who shakes up his mundane existence.

Title: Skyggen i mit øje
Hint: The RAF bombs Gestapo headquarters in Copenhagen and accidentally hits a school.
Description: On March 21st, 1945, the British Royal Air Force set out on a mission to bomb Gestapo's headquarters in Copenhagen. The raid had fatal consequences as some of the bombers accidentally targeted a school and more than 120 people were killed, 86 of whom were children.

Title: Point Blank
Hint: A man double-crossed in a heist seeks his money.
Description: After being double-crossed and left for dead, a mysterious man named Walker single-mindedly tries to retrieve the rather inconsequential sum of money that was stolen from him.

Title: Bacurau
Hint: A remote Brazilian town disappears from the map and is attacked by mysterious foreigners.
Description: ___, a small town in the Brazilian sertão, mourns the loss of its matriarch, Carmelita, who lived to be 94. Days later, its inhabitants notice that their community has vanished from most maps.

Title: Toni Erdmann
Hint: A father shows up unannounced to make his daughter laugh.
Description: Convinced that his daughter has forgotten how to laugh, a father shows up unannounced while she's living abroad and bombards her with outrageous jokes.

Title: Pom Poko
Hint: Shape-shifting raccoons fight to save their forest from development.
Description: The Raccoons of the Tama Hills are being forced from their homes by the rapid development of houses and shopping malls. As it becomes harder to find food and shelter, they decide to band together and fight back. The Raccoons practice and perfect the ancient art of transformation until they are even able to appear as humans in hilarious circumstances.

Title: Suspicion
Hint: A shy heiress begins to suspect her charming playboy husband is trying to kill her.
Description: A sheltered heiress falls for a charming playboy and elopes with him, but soon discovers his gambling vice and mounting debts. As his lies deepen and those around them meet mysterious ends, she begins to suspect that her husband’s affection may conceal a deadly motive—and that she could be his next victim.

Title: Red Dog
Hint: A loyal kelpie wanders the Australian outback, uniting a lonely mining town.
Description: The legendary true story of the ___ who united a disparate local community while roaming the Australian outback in search of his long lost master.

Title: Gods and Monsters
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An aging, gay horror film director forms an unlikely friendship with his straight young gardener.
Description: It's 1957, and James Whale's heyday as the director of "Frankenstein," "Bride of Frankenstein" and "The Invisible Man" is long behind him. Retired and a semi-recluse, he lives his days accompanied only by images from his past. When his dour housekeeper, Hannah, hires a handsome young gardener, the flamboyant director and simple yard man develop an unlikely friendship, which will change them forever.

Title: Bad Boy Bubby
Hint: A man locked inside by his mother for 35 years ventures out.
Description: ___ is just that: a bad boy. So bad, in fact, that his mother has kept him locked in their house for his entire thirty years, convincing him that the air outside is poisonous. After a visit from his estranged father, circumstances force ___ into the waiting world, a place which is just as unusual to him as he is to the world.

Title: Daisies
Hint: Two teenage girls go on a rampage of pranks.
Description: Two teenage girls embark on a series of destructive pranks in which they consume and destroy the world around them.

Title: Waking Ned Devine
Hint: A lottery winner dies of shock, and the village tries to claim the money.
Description: When a lottery winner dies of shock, his fellow townsfolk attempt to claim the money.

Title: Targets
Hint: An aging horror film star's farewell appearance at a drive-in crosses paths with a sniper.
Description: An aging horror-movie icon's fate intersects with that of a seemingly ordinary young man on a psychotic shooting spree around Los Angeles.

Title: A Passage to India
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An Indian doctor is falsely accused by an English woman.
Description: Cultural mistrust and false accusations doom a friendship in British colonial India between an Indian doctor, an Englishwoman engaged to marry a city magistrate, and an English educator.

Title: Lucky
Hint: A 90-year-old atheist faces mortality in a desert town.
Description: Follows the journey of a 90-year-old atheist and the quirky characters that inhabit his off-the-map desert town. He finds himself at the precipice of life, thrust into a journey of self-exploration.

Title: Deconstructing Harry
Hint: A writer's stories mirror his life and cause him trouble.
Description: Writer Harry Block draws inspiration from people he knows, and from events that happened to him, sometimes causing these people to become alienated from him as a result.

Title: Theri
Hint: A cop starts a new life as a baker after his family is killed.
Description: When an honest cop, Vijay Kumar's family is ruthlessly slaughtered by a politician and his aides, he decides to change his identity and commits his life to bring his daughter up in a serene atmosphere. But some freak events end up compromising his identity and what he does to save his daughter and avenge the death of his family unfurls as ___.

Title: The Baader Meinhof Complex
Hint: A radical German group commits terror attacks in the 1970s.
Description: When German police viciously quell a protest against the shah of Iran, popular journalist Ulrike ___ rebels against her dishonest marriage, walks away from her children and joins radical anarchist Andreas ___.

Title: You're Not You
Hint: A pianist diagnosed with ALS hires a college student as her caregiver.
Description: When an accomplished pianist is diagnosed with the devastating and incurable disease ALS, she hires a directionless young woman who becomes her full-time caregiver. Complete opposites, the strangers form a life-changing bond inspiring each other to live life to fullest, while being brought together by the most challenging of circumstances.

Title: Coming Home
Hint: A Marine officer's wife volunteers at a veterans' hospital and falls for a paralysed, anti-war veteran.
Description: In 1968 California, a Marine officer's wife falls in love with a former high school classmate who suffered a paralyzing combat injury in the war.

Title: Mona Lisa
Hint: A small-time crook becomes a chauffeur for a call girl.
Description: George is a small-time crook just out of prison who discovers his tough-guy image is out of date. Reduced to working as a minder/driver for high class call girl Simone, he has to agree when she asks him to find a young colleague from her King's Cross days. That's when George's troubles just start.

Title: Bedevilled
Hint: A woman visits a remote island and finds her friend enslaved.
Description: A disillusioned Seoul woman visits a remote island to reconnect with a childhood friend, only to find her trapped in an oppressive cycle of physical, mental, and sexual abuse. As tensions escalate, the situation spirals into a harrowing tale of survival and retribution.

Title: Starred Up
Hint: A violent teen is sent to the same prison as his father.
Description: 19-year-old Eric, arrogant and ultra-violent, is prematurely transferred to the same adult prison facility as his estranged father. As his explosive temper quickly finds him enemies in both prison authorities and fellow inmates — and his already volatile relationship with his father is pushed past breaking point — Eric is approached by a volunteer psychotherapist, who runs an anger management group for prisoners.

Title: The Girl Who Kicked the Hornet's Nest
Hint: A hacker recovering from a bullet wound must prove her innocence.
Description: After taking a bullet to the head, Salander is under close supervision in a hospital and is set to face trial for attempted murder on her eventual release. With the help of journalist Mikael Blomkvist and his researchers at Millennium magazine, Salander must prove her innocence. In doing this she plays against powerful enemies and her own past.

Title: The Killing of a Chinese Bookie
Hint: A strip club owner must kill a dangerous gambling boss to pay off his debts to the mob.
Description: Cosmo Vittelli, the proprietor of a sleazy, low-rent Hollywood cabaret, has a real affection for the women who strip in his peepshows and the staff who keep up his dingy establishment. He also has a major gambling problem that has gotten him in trouble before. When Cosmo loses big-time at an underground casino run by mobster Mort, he isn't able to pay up.

Title: Uncle Frank
Hint: A gay college professor and his niece take a road trip to his father's funeral.
Description: In 1973, when Frank Bledsoe and his 18-year-old niece Beth take a road trip from Manhattan to Creekville, South Carolina for the family patriarch's funeral, they're unexpectedly joined by Frank's lover Walid.

Title: Red Cliff
Country: China, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, United States of America
Hint: An epic battle in ancient China, as an alliance faces a massive invading navy on the Yangtze River.
Description: In 208 A.D., in the final days of the Han Dynasty, shrewd Prime Minster Cao convinced the fickle Emperor Han the only way to unite all of China was to declare war on the kingdoms of Xu in the west and East Wu in the south. Thus began a military campaign of unprecedented scale. Left with no other hope for survival, the kingdoms of Xu and East Wu formed an unlikely alliance.

Title: Angela's Ashes
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A poor Irish family struggles in Limerick in the 1930s.
Description: An Irish Catholic family returns to 1930s Limerick after a child's death in America. The unemployed I.R.A. veteran father struggles with poverty, prejudice, and alcoholism as the family endures harsh slum conditions.

Title: Ragtime
Hint: A young Black pianist becomes embroiled in the lives of an upper-class family in early 1900s New York.
Description: A young black pianist becomes embroiled in the lives of an upper-class white family set among the racial tensions, infidelity, violence, and other nostalgic events in early 1900s New York City.

Title: Blue Jay
Hint: Two former high school sweethearts reconnect after twenty years when they run into each other in a grocery store.
Description: Meeting by chance when they return to their tiny California hometown, two former high-school sweethearts reflect on their shared past.

Title: Tender Mercies
Hint: An alcoholic former country singer makes friends with a widow and her son in Texas.
Description: Alcoholic former country singer Mac Sledge makes friends with a young widow and her son. The friendship enables him to find inspiration to resume his career.

Title: Richard III
Hint: A hunchback schemes his way to the throne of a 1930s England.
Description: Having helped his brother King Edward IV take the throne of England, the jealous hunchback ___, Duke of Gloucester, plots to seize power for himself.

Title: Run Silent Run Deep
Hint: A submarine commander seeks revenge on the Japanese destroyer that sank his last boat.
Description: The captain of a submarine sunk by the Japanese during WWII is finally given a chance to skipper another sub after a year of working a desk job. His singleminded determination for revenge against the destroyer that sunk his previous vessel puts his new crew in unneccessary danger.

Title: Irma la Douce
Hint: A police officer falls in love with a Parisian prostitute.
Description: When a recently fired policeman falls in love with a French prostitute, he doesn't want her to be with other men, so he creates an alter-ego in order to become her only customer.

Title: Phoenix
Hint: A Holocaust survivor with a reconstructed face searches for her husband.
Description: In the aftermath of WWII, German-Jewish cabaret singer Nelly has to undergo facial reconstructive surgery following her survival from Auschwitz. Without recognising Nelly, her former husband Johnny asks her to help him claim his wife’s inheritance. To see if he's betrayed her, she agrees, becoming her own doppelgänger.

Title: Beau travail
Hint: A Foreign Legion officer becomes jealous of a new recruit.
Description: Foreign Legion officer Galoup recalls his once glorious life, training troops in the Gulf of Djibouti. His existence there was happy, strict and regimented, until the arrival of a promising young recruit, Sentain, plants the seeds of jealousy in Galoup's mind.

Title: Shadowlands
Hint: A writer leads a passionless life until he meets a spirited poet.
Description: C.S. Lewis, a world-renowned writer and professor, leads a passionless life until he meets spirited poet Joy Gresham.

Title: Marshall
Country: Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: A young NAACP lawyer fights a racially charged rape case in 1940s Connecticut.
Description: Thurgood ___, the first African-American Supreme Court Justice, battles through one of his career-defining cases.

Title: Murder in the First
Hint: A young public defender takes the case of an Alcatraz inmate accused of killing after years in solitary confinement.
Description: A young, inexperienced public defender is assigned to defend an inmate accused of committing murder while behind bars.

Title: Father Goose
Hint: A beachcomber spies on planes during World War II and is stuck with schoolgirls.
Description: During World War II, South Sea beachcomber Walter Eckland is persuaded to spy on planes passing over his island. He gets more than he bargained for as schoolteacher Catherine Frenau arrives on the run from the Japanese with her pupils in tow!

Title: Fat City
Hint: An aging boxer and a young fighter in California.
Description: The story of two men, a veteran boxer who is down and out, and a young man who is just starting his life and boxing career. Their fighting careers cross paths as their lives and fortunes head in opposite directions. Director John Huston tells their stories with a level, unsentimental honesty and makes it into one of his best films.

Title: The Spanish Apartment
Country: France, Spain, United States of America
Hint: A French student moves into a crowded flat in Barcelona with roommates from all over Europe.
Description: A strait-laced French student moves into an apartment in Barcelona with a cast of six other characters from all over Europe. Together, they speak the international language of love and friendship.

Title: United
Hint: A young football team is rebuilt after a deadly air disaster.
Description: ___ is based on the true story of Manchester ___ legendary "Busby Babes", the youngest side ever to win the Football League and the 1958 Munich Air Crash that claimed eight of the their number. The film draws on first-hand interviews with the survivors and their families to tell the inspirational story of a team and community overcoming terrible tragedy.

Title: Lorenzo's Oil
Hint: The parents of a boy with a degenerative disease search for a cure themselves.
Description: ___ Odone, a Virginia 5-year-old, develops a degenerative nerve disease so rare that nobody is working on a cure, so his parents decide to immerse themselves in research and tackle the problem themselves.

Title: Dirty Pretty Things
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An immigrant finds a human heart in a hotel toilet.
Description: An undocumented immigrant finds a human heart in one of the toilets of the west London hotel where he works with other undocumented immigrants.

Title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
Hint: Two very different men share a cell in a Latin American prison.
Description: The story of two radically different men thrown together in a Latin American prison cell. One is Valentin, a journalist being tortured for his political beliefs. The other is Molina, a gay window-dresser who fills their lonely nights by spinning romantic fantasies drawn from memories of old movies.

Title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
Hint: A clever farm animal goes to the city to rescue the farmer.
Description: When ___ decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets a little more action than he bargained for. A mix up with the Farmer, a caravan and a very steep hill lead them all to the Big City and it's up to ___ and the flock to return everyone safely to the green grass of home.

Title: Master
Hint: Two Black women strive to find their place at a haunted New England university.
Description: At an elite New England university built on the site of a Salem-era gallows hill, two black women strive to find their place. Navigating politics and privilege, they encounter increasingly terrifying manifestations of the school's haunted past… and present.

Title: The Long, Hot Summer
Hint: A drifter accused of barn burning arrives in a small Mississippi town.
Description: Accused barn burner and conman Ben Quick arrives in a small Mississippi town and quickly ingratiates himself with its richest family, the Varners.

Title: The Three Burials of Melquiades Estrada
Country: United States of America, France, Mexico
Hint: A rancher keeps a promise to bury his friend in Mexico.
Description: When brash Texas border officer Mike Norton wrongfully kills and buries the friend and ranch hand of Pete Perkins, the latter is reminded of a promise he made to bury his friend, ___, in his Mexican home town. He kidnaps Norton and exhumes ___ corpse, and the odd caravan sets out on horseback for Mexico.

Title: Atlantic City
Hint: A small-time gangster and a casino waitress get mixed up in a drug deal.
Description: In a corrupt city, a small-time gangster and the estranged wife of a pot dealer find themselves thrown together in an escapade of love, money, drugs and danger.

Title: A Street Cat Named Bob
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Luxembourg
Hint: A homeless busker and recovering addict in London has his life changed by a ginger stray tomcat.
Description: James Bowen, a homeless busker and recovering drug addict, has his life transformed when he meets a stray ginger cat.

Title: Monsoon Wedding
Country: France, Germany, Italy, United States of America, India
Hint: An Indian family gathers in Delhi for a chaotic arranged marriage during the rainy season.
Description: A stressed father, a bride-to-be with a secret, a smitten event planner, and relatives from around the world create much ado about the preparations for an arranged marriage in India.

Title: The Stranger
Hint: A war crimes investigator tracks a Nazi fugitive to a small Connecticut town.
Description: An investigator from the War Crimes Commission travels to Connecticut to find an infamous Nazi, who may be hiding out in a small town in the guise of a distinguished professor engaged to the Supreme Court Justice’s daughter.

Title: Interiors
Hint: An affluent New York family falls apart after the father leaves their fragile, perfectionist mother.
Description: When Eve, an interior designer, is deserted by her husband of many years, Arthur, the emotionally glacial relationships of the three grown-up daughters are laid bare. Twisted by jealousy, insecurity and resentment, Renata, a successful writer; Joey, a woman crippled by indecision; and Flyn, a budding actress; struggle to communicate for the sake of their shattered mother.

Title: Bullhead
Hint: A young cattle farmer is drawn into a criminal deal with a crooked vet.
Description: A young cattle farmer is approached by an unscrupulous veterinarian to make a shady deal with a notorious beef trader.

Title: Norma Rae
Hint: A Southern textile worker becomes a union activist and fights for better conditions in her factory.
Description: ___ is a southern textile worker employed in a factory with intolerable working conditions. This concern about the situation gives her the gumption to be the key associate to a visiting labor union organizer. Together, they undertake the difficult, and possibly dangerous, struggle to unionize her factory.

Title: Twice Born
Hint: A woman returns to Sarajevo with her son and remembers the war.
Description: Full-throttle melodrama about an ill-starred romance set against the backdrop of the siege of Sarajevo. A mother brings her teenage son to Sarajevo, where his father died in the Bosnian conflict years ago.

Title: Reprise
Hint: Two young friends in Oslo compete to become famous writers, and one has a breakdown.
Description: Fueled by literary aspirations and youthful exuberance, two competitive friends endure the pangs of love, depression, and burgeoning careers.

Title: Hope and Glory
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young boy finds wartime an exciting adventure as he grows up during the London Blitz.
Description: A middle-aged man recalls his childhood growing up in and around London during World War II.

Title: Pauline at the Beach
Hint: A teenage girl observes adults' romantic games on a seaside holiday.
Description: Marion is about to divorce from her husband and takes her 15-year-old niece, ___, on a vacation to Granville. There, she meets an old love...

Title: Grand Hotel
Hint: Guests at a posh Berlin establishment struggle through love and despair.
Description: Guests at a posh Berlin hotel struggle through worry, scandal, and heartache.

Title: Pusher II
Hint: A man released from prison tries to change his life.
Description: Tonny is released from prison - again. This time he has his mind set on changing his broken down life, but that is easier said than done.

Title: The Day of the Beast
Hint: A priest sets out to commit evil to find the Antichrist.
Description: When a rogue priest discovers the exact date the Antichrist will be born, he enlists a Death Metal record store clerk and a cheesy TV psychic for an urban spree of gore, sacrilege and twisted humor to prevent the Apocalypse.

Title: Journey to Italy
Hint: A British couple's marriage unravels on a road trip around Naples.
Description: Married for eight years with no children, Brits Katherine and Alex Joyce are driving to ___, their ultimate destination just outside of Naples to sell the villa they have just inherited from his uncle, the villa where they will be staying during their time there.

Title: Max Manus: Man of War
Hint: A Norwegian resistance fighter battles the Nazi occupation with a series of daring sabotage missions.
Description: ___ is a Norwegian 2008 biographic war film based on the real events of the life of resistance fighter ___ (1914–96), after his contribution in the Winter War against the Soviet Union. The story follows ___ through the outbreak of World War II in Norway until peacetime in 1945.

Title: Rosencrantz & Guildenstern Are Dead
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two minor characters from Hamlet try to figure out what is going on.
Description: ___, minor characters from the play 'Hamlet', find themselves on the road to Elsinore Castle at the behest of the King of Denmark. The duo encounter a band of players before arriving to find that they are needed to try to discern what troubles the prince Hamlet. Meanwhile, they ponder the meaning of their existence.

Title: Two Days, One Night
Hint: A woman has a weekend to convince her colleagues to give up their bonuses.
Description: Sandra is a young woman who has only one weekend to convince her colleagues they must give up their bonuses in order for her to keep her job — not an easy task in this economy.

Title: The Yellow Sea
Hint: A taxi driver in China takes an assassination job in South Korea to pay his debts.
Description: A Korean man in China takes an assassination job in South Korea to make money and find his missing wife. But when the job is botched, he is forced to go on the run from the police and the gangsters who paid him.

Title: Village of the Damned
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Children with glowing eyes are born in a quiet English town.
Description: In a small English village everyone suddenly falls unconscious. When they awake every woman of child bearing age is pregnant. The resulting children have the same strange blond hair, eyes and a strong connection to each other.

Title: A Woman Is a Woman
Hint: A Parisian striptease dancer longs for a baby, but her boyfriend isn't interested, so she turns to his best friend.
Description: Longing for a baby, a stripper pursues another man in order to make her boyfriend jealous.

Title: The Beast of War
Hint: A Soviet tank crew gets lost in the mountains of Afghanistan and is hunted by Pashtun fighters.
Description: During the war in Afghanistan a Soviet tank crew commanded by a tyrannical officer find themselves lost and in a struggle against a band of Mujahadeen guerrillas in the mountains.

Title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
Hint: A young man dreams of reclaiming the Victorian home built by his grandfather.
Description: Jimmie Fails dreams of reclaiming the Victorian home his grandfather built in the heart of San ___. Joined on his quest by his best friend Mont, Jimmie searches for belonging in a rapidly changing city that seems to have left them behind.

Title: Project A
Hint: A coast guard officer fights pirates in Hong Kong.
Description: In late 19th century Hong Kong, the British may rule the land, but the pirates rule the waters. Coast Guard officer Dragon Ma is determined that his beloved Coast Guard will not be made a fool of.

Title: Manhattan Murder Mystery
Hint: A couple suspects foul play when their neighbor's wife dies.
Description: A middle-aged couple suspects foul play when their neighbor's wife suddenly drops dead.

Title: Ronia: The Robber's Daughter
Hint: A bandit chief's spirited girl befriends the son of a rival clan in a magical forest full of creatures.
Description: ___ lives happily in her father's castle until she comes across a new playmate, Birk, in the nearby dark forest. The two explore the wilderness, braving dangerous Witchbirds and Rump-Gnomes. But when their families find out Birk and ___ have been playing together, they forbid them to see each other again. Indeed, their fathers are competing ___ chieftains and bitter enemies.

Title: Brigsby Bear
Hint: A man raised in isolation sets out to finish his childhood TV show.
Description: ___ Adventures is a children's TV show produced for an audience of one: James. When the show abruptly ends, James's life changes forever, and he sets out to finish the story himself.

Title: Talk to Me
Hint: A group of teens use an embalmed hand to contact spirits, and become dangerously hooked on the thrill.
Description: When a group of friends discover how to conjure spirits using an embalmed hand, they become hooked on the new thrill, until one of them goes too far and unleashes terrifying supernatural forces.

Title: Lust for Life
Hint: The life of a Dutch painter and his struggle with mental illness.
Description: An intense and imaginative artist, revered Dutch painter Vincent van Gogh possesses undeniable talent, but he is plagued by mental problems and frustrations with failure. Supported by his brother, Theo, the tormented Van Gogh eventually leaves Holland for France, where he meets volatile fellow painter Paul Gauguin and struggles to find greater inspiration.

Title: Gadar: Ek Prem Katha
Hint: A Sikh man crosses into Pakistan to bring back his wife during the partition.
Description: During the partition, Tara marries Sakina and they live a happy life. However their happiness is short-lived when Sakina's father forces her to stay in Pakistan and separates her from her family.

Title: Detour
Hint: A down-on-his-luck nightclub pianist hitchhikes to Los Angeles and gets mixed up in two deaths.
Description: The life of Al Roberts, a pianist in a New York nightclub, turns into a nightmare when he decides to hitchhike to Los Angeles to visit his girlfriend.

Title: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog
Hint: A mysterious renter is suspected of being a serial killer.
Description: London. A mysterious serial killer brutally murders young blond women by stalking them in the night ___. One foggy, sinister night, a young man who claims his name is Jonathan Drew arrives at the guest house run by the Bunting family and rents a room.

Title: Polisse
Hint: A police child protection unit investigates crimes against children in Paris.
Description: Paris, France. Fred and his colleagues, members of the BPM, the Police Child Protection Unit, dedicated to pursuing all sorts of offenses committed against the weakest, must endure the scrutiny of Melissa, a photographer commissioned to graphically document the daily routine of the team.

Title: The Man with the Golden Arm
Hint: A card dealer released from prison and off heroin struggles to stay clean in a Chicago neighbourhood.
Description: When illegal card dealer and recovering heroin addict Frankie Machine gets out of prison, he decides to straighten up. Armed with nothing but an old drum set, Frankie tries to get honest work as a drummer. But when his former employer and his old drug dealer re-enter his life, Frankie finds it hard to stay clean and eventually finds himself succumbing to his old habits.

Title: My Favorite Year
Hint: A young comedy writer is assigned to babysit a drunken movie star in 1954.
Description: Fledgling comic Benjy Stone can't believe his luck when his childhood hero, the swashbuckling matinee idol Alan Swann, gets booked to appear on the variety show he writes for. But when Swann arrives, he fails to live up to his silver screen image. Instead, he's a drunken womanizer who suffers from stage fright.

Title: Palm Trees in the Snow
Hint: A man discovers his family's past in Equatorial Guinea.
Description: Spain, 2003. An accidental discovery leads Clarence to travel from the snowy mountains of Huesca to Equatorial Guinea, to visit the land where her father Jacobo and her uncle Kilian spent most of their youth, the island of Fernando Poo.

Title: The Front Page
Hint: A hard-bitten Chicago reporter is tempted to cover one last story about an escaped murderer.
Description: Hildy Johnson is an investigative reporter looking for a bigger paycheck. When an accused murderer escapes from custody, Hildy sees an opportunity for the story of a lifetime. But when he finds the criminal, he learns that the man may not be guilty. With the help of his editor, Hildy attempts to hide the convict, uncover the conspiracy and write the scoop of his career.

Title: Summer Storm
Hint: A judge falls for a seductive woman in pre-revolutionary Russia.
Description: It's a tale of power and passions when a Russian siren, who wants the finer things in life, sinks her hooks into a judge, a decadent aristocrat and an estate superintendent, with surprising results.

Title: The Bélier Family
Hint: A hearing girl from a deaf farming family discovers a talent for singing.
Description: The whole ___ is deaf, except for sixteen year old Paula who is the important translator in her parents' day to day life especially when it comes to matters concerning the family farm. When her music teacher discovers she has a fantastic singing voice and she gets an opportunity to enter a big Radio France contest the whole family's future is set up for big changes.

Title: The Naked Spur
Hint: A bounty hunter brings a killer to justice with two untrustworthy partners.
Description: A bounty hunter trying to bring a murderer to justice is forced to accept the help of two less-than-trustworthy strangers.

Title: Jin-Roh: The Wolf Brigade
Hint: A member of a counter-terrorism unit becomes traumatized after witnessing a suicide bombing.
Description: A member of an elite paramilitary counter-terrorism unit becomes traumatized after witnessing the suicide bombing of a young girl and is forced to undergo retraining. However, unbeknownst to him, he becomes a key player in a dispute between rival police divisions, as he finds himself increasingly involved with the sister of the girl he saw die.

Title: The Collini Case
Hint: A young German lawyer defends an elderly Italian man who murdered a prominent industrialist.
Description: A young lawyer stumbles upon a vast conspiracy while investigating a brutal murder case.

Title: 42nd Street
Hint: A Broadway director needs one more hit, and a young chorus girl gets her big chance.
Description: Broadway director Julian Marsh needs just one more hit show so he can retire and recover his health. It looks like he just may pull it off until temperamental star Dorthy Brock breaks her ankle on the eve of the show's premiere and has to be replaced by her understudy Peggy.

Title: Metropolitan
Hint: A middle-class socialist student falls in with a group of preppy Manhattan debutantes during the holiday season.
Description: A radical student is adopted by a group of young New Yorkers, serves as a catalyst to alter his and their lives. Gathering in a Manhattan apartment, the group of friends meet to discuss social mobility, Fourier's socialism and play bridge in their cocoon of upper-class society - until they are joined by a man with a critical view of their way of life.

Title: Shogun Assassin
Hint: A disgraced executioner wanders with his toddler son in a wooden cart, slaying ninja sent to kill them.
Description: A ___ who grew paranoid as he became senile sent his ninjas to kill his samurai. They failed but did kill the samurai’s wife. The samurai swore to avenge the death of his wife and roams the countryside with his toddler son in search of vengeance.

Title: Tamasha
Hint: Two strangers in Corsica agree to keep their identities a secret.
Description: Meeting while on vacation, Ved and Tara sense a connection but vow to keep their real identities a secret. Years later, their paths cross again.

Title: Ponniyin Selvan: Part Two
Hint: The Chola dynasty fights to keep its empire as revenge, love and court intrigue threaten the throne.
Description: 968 AD. The Pandyan assassins gather once again to destroy the Chola dynasty. Now the mighty Chola princes must fight the Pandyas, the Rashtrakutas and other Chola enemies who have joined forces. Also, at play are the rumours of ___ death at sea, the powerful Pazhuvettarayar’s betrayal, and the tragic destiny of Aditha Karikalan, whose heart was long lost to the vengeful Nandini.

Title: Two Is a Family
Hint: A carefree man on the Riviera finds himself suddenly responsible for a baby girl.
Description: A man without attachments or responsibilities suddenly finds himself with an abandoned baby and leaves for London to try and find the mother. Eight years later after he and his daughter become inseparable Gloria's mother reappears.

Title: Holiday Inn
Hint: A crooner and a dancer compete for a woman at a lodge open only on festive days.
Description: Lovely Linda Mason has crooner Jim Hardy head over heels, but suave stepper Ted Hanover wants her for his new dance partner after fickle Lila Dixon gives him the brush. Jim's supper club, ___, is the setting for the chase by Hanover and his manager.

Title: Monsieur Ibrahim
Hint: A Jewish teenager in 1960s Paris befriends an elderly Muslim grocer who teaches him about life.
Description: Paris, 1960s. Momo, a resolute and independent Jewish teenager who lives with his father, a sullen and depressed man, in a working-class neighborhood, develops a close friendship with ___, an elderly Muslim who owns a small grocery store.

Title: Infernal Affairs II
Hint: A power struggle among the Triads before the 1997 handover.
Description: In this prequel to the original, a bloody power struggle among the Triads coincides with the 1997 handover of Hong Kong, setting up the events of the first film.

Title: On the Town
Hint: Three sailors on a 24-hour shore leave in New York search for love, in a dazzling musical.
Description: Three sailors wreak havoc as they search for love during a whirlwind 24-hour leave in New York City.

Title: Watch Out, We're Mad
Hint: Two drivers compete for a dune buggy and fight gangsters.
Description: After a tied 1st place in a local stunt race, two drivers start a contest to decide who of them will own the prize, a dune buggy. But when a mobster destroys the car, they are determined to get it back.

Title: The Spiral Staircase
Hint: A mute servant is stalked by a serial killer.
Description: On a stormy night, the mute servant to an ailing matriarch is stalked by a serial killer.

Title: Three Monkeys
Hint: A Turkish family battles to stay together amid lies, betrayal and a crime they're covering up.
Description: A family battles against the odds to stay together when small lies grow into an extravagant cover-up. In order to avoid hardship and responsibilities that would otherwise be impossible to endure, the family chooses to ignore the truth, not to see, hear or talk about it. But does playing “___” invalidate the truth of its existence?

Title: Desert Flower
Hint: A Somali nomad girl escapes a forced marriage, becomes a supermodel and campaigns against female genital mutilation.
Description: The autobiography of a Somalian nomad who was sold in marriage at 13, fled from Africa a while later to become finally an American supermodel and is now at the age of 38, the UN spokeswoman against female genital mutilation.

Title: Café de Flore
Hint: A mother in 1960s Paris and a DJ in present-day Montreal are connected.
Description: Jacqueline is a young mother living in 1960s Paris with her disabled son Laurent. Abandoned by her husband, Jacqueline sacrifices everything to care for her son and vows to give Laurent a “normal” life full of happiness. Antoine, is a successful DJ in present day Montreal who seems to have it all: a thriving career, two beautiful daughters, partner Rose, with whom he is passionately in love.

Title: Viva Zapata!
Hint: A Mexican peasant leads a revolution against a corrupt dictator in the early 20th century.
Description: The story of Mexican revolutionary Emiliano ___, who led a rebellion against the corrupt, oppressive dictatorship of president Porfirio Díaz in the early 20th century.

Title: The Man from Laramie
Hint: A stranger arrives in a New Mexico town to find the man who sold guns to the Apache.
Description: Will Lockhart arrives in Coronado, an isolated town in New Mexico, in search of someone who sells rifles to the Apache tribe, finding himself unwillingly drawn into the convoluted life of a local ranching family whose members seem to have a lot to hide.

Title: Christmas in Connecticut
Hint: A food writer pretends to be a perfect housewife.
Description: While recovering in a hospital, war hero Jefferson Jones grows familiar with the "Diary of a Housewife" column written by Elizabeth Lane. Jeff's nurse arranges with Elizabeth's publisher, Alexander Yardley, for Jeff to spend the holiday at Elizabeth's bucolic ___ farm with her husband and child.

Title: Sorry, Wrong Number
Hint: A bedridden woman overhears a murder plot on the phone.
Description: Leona Stevenson is confined to bed and uses her telephone to keep in contact with the outside world. One day she overhears a murder plot on the telephone and is desperate to find out who is the intended victim.

Title: Monsieur Hulot's Holiday
Hint: A clumsy, pipe-smoking gentleman wreaks quiet chaos on vacation at a French seaside resort.
Description: ___, Jacques Tati’s endearing clown, takes a holiday at a seaside resort, where his presence provokes one catastrophe after another. Tati’s masterpiece of gentle slapstick is a series of effortlessly well-choreographed sight gags involving dogs, boats, and firecrackers; it was the first entry in the ___ series and the film that launched its maker to international stardom.

Title: Pusher III
Hint: An aging Copenhagen drug lord tries to plan his daughter's birthday while his criminal empire unravels.
Description: Milo is aging, he is planning his daughter's 25th birthday, and his shipment of heroin turns out to be 10,000 pills of ecstasy. When Milo tries to sell the pills anyway, all Hell breaks loose and his only chance is to ask for help from his ex-henchman and old friend Radovan.

Title: My Hero Academia: Two Heroes
Hint: Two superheroes and their classmates visit a floating island for an expo and must fight off villains.
Description: All Might and Deku accept an invitation to go abroad to a floating and mobile manmade city, called 'I-Island', where they research quirks as well as hero supplemental items at the special 'I-Expo' convention that is currently being held on the island.

Title: Read My Lips
Hint: A partially deaf office secretary and an ex-con team up to rob gangsters, using her talent for lip-reading.
Description: She is almost deaf and she lip-reads. He is an ex-convict. She wants to help him. He thinks no one can help except himself.

Title: In Darkness
Hint: A Polish sewer worker hides Jews in the underground tunnels during the Holocaust.
Description: A dramatization of one man's rescue of Jewish refugees in the Nazi-occupied city of Lviv. ___ tells the true story of Leopold Soha who risks his own life to save a dozen people from certain death. Initially only interested in his own good, the thief and burglar hides Jewish refugees for 14 months in the sewers of the Nazi-occupied town of Lviv (formerly Poland).

Title: The Last Metro
Hint: An actress in occupied Paris hides her Jewish husband in the theatre's cellar.
Description: In occupied Paris, an actress wed to a Jewish theater owner must keep him hidden from the Nazis while doing both of their jobs.

Title: Graduation
Hint: A doctor bends the rules to help his daughter.
Description: After his daughter is assaulted and left with an injury that may jeopardize her opportunity to study in the UK, a Romanian doctor decides to do whatever it takes to secure her future.

Title: Trade
Hint: A cop teams up with a Mexican teen to rescue his sister from traffickers.
Description: A Texas cop, whose own daughter might have been forced into sexual slavery, joins forces with a Mexican youth to find the boy's sister, who was abducted and forced into prostitution. Meanwhile, a Polish woman who was promised a better life in America also becomes a victim.

Title: Muhammad: The Messenger of God
Hint: The childhood of Islam's prophet in the desert city of Mecca.
Description: Abousofyan tells Aboutaleb, ___ uncle, that in the upcoming morning he wants to kill the holy prophet of Islam and Muslims, who are in boycott. Aboutaleb remembers the past years when Abraha charges ahead Mecca to ruin the house of God. but by God's will his army loses out against millions of small birds sent by GOD. A month later, ___ is born.

Title: We Are the Nobles
Hint: Spoiled rich kids are forced to work by their father.
Description: Tells the "riches to rags" story of the ___, three upper-class twenty-somethings that appear to have no limits to their checkbooks, and no direction in their lives. Until one day, their father tries to teach them a lesson by staging a financial scandal that forces the whole family to escape to an old house in the poor side of town, and leads the "kids" to do what they haven't done before: get jobs.

Title: Let the Bullets Fly
Hint: An outlaw impersonates a governor to clean up a corrupt town.
Description: When circumstances force an outlaw to impersonate a county governor and clean up a corrupt town, the Robin Hood figure finds himself in a showdown with the local godfather.

Title: Hilary and Jackie
Hint: The relationship between a world-class cellist and her flute-playing sister, as illness and jealousy intrude.
Description: The tragic story of world-renowned cellist Jacqueline du Pré, as told from the point of view of her sister, flautist ___ du Pré-Finzi.

Title: In China They Eat Dogs
Hint: A Danish bank clerk gets involved with criminals after he stops a robbery.
Description: Arvid is an ordinary bank clerk who lives a rather unassuming life with his dear girlfriend. But his life is turned completely upside down when he bravely manages to avert a robbery against the bank where he works.

Title: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
Hint: A young man discovers he was swapped at birth.
Description: After growing up enduring criticism from his father, a young man finds his world shaken upon learning he was switched at birth with a millionaire's son.

Title: A Coffee in Berlin
Hint: A college dropout drifts through the German capital looking for a decent cup.
Description: Niko, a twenty-something college dropout, lives for the moment as he drifts through the streets of ___, curiously observing everyone around him and oblivious to his growing status as an outsider. Then on one fateful day, through a series of absurdly amusing encounters, everything changes.

Title: Easter Parade
Hint: A Broadway dancer whose partner leaves him bets he can turn a chorus girl into a star by spring.
Description: On the day before ___ in 1911, Don Hewes is crushed when his dancing partner (and object of affection) Nadine Hale refuses to start a new contract with him. To prove Nadine's not important to him, Don acquires innocent new protege Hannah Brown, vowing to make her a star in time for next year's ___.

Title: Psycho Raman
Hint: A cop and a serial killer get caught up in a game of cat and mouse.
Description: A corrupt cop and a serial killer obsessed with a psychopath from the '60s get caught up in a ruthless cat-and-mouse game.

Title: Labyrinth of Lies
Hint: A young prosecutor uncovers Nazi crimes in post-war Germany.
Description: A young prosecutor in postwar West Germany investigates a massive conspiracy to cover up the Nazi pasts of prominent public figures.

Title: What's in a Name?
Hint: A dinner party erupts when a man reveals what he will call his son.
Description: Vincent, a wealthy real estate agent, is invited to dinner by his sister Elizabeth and her husband Peter, both professors in Paris. Claude, a childhood friend and trombonist in a symphony orchestra, is also present. Vincent brings news from the prenatal examination of his and his wife Anna's unborn son. The name chosen by the soon-to-be parents strongly offends the others for many reasons.

Title: Elena
Hint: A former nurse married to a wealthy man schemes to secure his inheritance for her own son.
Description: After suffering from a heart attack, a wealthy elderly Russian man plans to will most of his estate to his estranged daughter, but his titular wife has other plans.

Title: My Favorite Wife
Hint: A woman returns home after being shipwrecked for seven years, just as her husband remarries.
Description: Years after she was presumed dead in a shipwreck, Ellen Arden returns home to the surprise of her husband recently remarrying. But he too gets a shock when he learns that Ellen spent her time alone on an island with another man.

Title: 72 Hoorain
Hint: Two terrorists killed in a suicide attack wait for their promised reward in the afterlife, in a dark comedy.
Description: ‘Bahattar ___’ is a dark comedy that examines the real consequences of violent extremism and urges that every human life should be treated with dignity and respect.

Title: Truman
Hint: Two old friends spend four days together, one of them dying and trying to rehome his dog.
Description: Tomás, who lives in Canada, travels to Madrid, Spain, to visit his old friend Julián. Both of them, accompanied by ___, Julián's faithful dog, will share many surprising and emotional little moments, triggered by the hard situation Julián is going through, for just a few days.

Title: A.R.O.G
Hint: A man is tricked by an alien and sent back in time.
Description: Commander Logar escapes from the planet G.O.R.A. to Earth and finds Arif. Arif gets tricked by the evil Commander Logar into thinking that his intentions have changed but Commander Logar sends Arif 1.000.000 years into the past. After finding himself in the stone age, Arif begins to help the local tribe to defend themselves against a different, much more violent tribe and tries to find a way back to his time.

Title: The Son's Room
Hint: An Italian psychoanalyst and his family grieve after their teenage boy's accidental death while diving.
Description: A psychoanalyst and his family go through profound emotional trauma when their son dies in a scuba diving accident.

Title: Once Upon a Time in China II
Hint: A martial arts master fights a fanatical anti-foreign cult in 19th-century Canton and Beijing.
Description: Wong Fei-Hung faces the White Lotus Society, a fanatical cult seeking to drive the Europeans out of China through violence, even attacking Chinese who follow Western ways. Wong must also defend revolutionary Dr. Sun Yat Sen from the military.

Title: Shock Corridor
Hint: A journalist poses as a patient in a mental hospital.
Description: With the help of his girlfriend Cathy and Dr. Fong, a psychiatrist, ambitious journalist Johnny Barrett poses as a madman in order to be admitted to a mental institution where a bloody murder has been committed.

Title: The Misfortunates
Hint: A 13-year-old Belgian boy grows up surrounded by his alcoholic father and uncles.
Description: 13-year-old Gunther Strobbe grows up surrounded by alcohol, trash and his completely useless father and uncles. Slowly but surely, he's being prepared for the same hapless life. Can he defy his destiny?

Title: The Selfish Giant
Hint: Two boys from a poor estate collect scrap metal for a local dealer.
Description: A hyperactive boy and his best friend, a slow-witted youth with an affinity for horses, start collecting scrap metal for a shady dealer.

Title: Maine Pyar Kiya
Hint: A girl falls in love with the son of a family she stays with.
Description: After Suman's father leaves her in the care of another family while he travels abroad, she falls in love with Prem. However, in order to for them to marry, Prem has to prove to Suman's father that he is not the same as his own dad.

Title: La Chèvre
Hint: An unlucky man helps search for the unlucky daughter of his boss.
Description: When the boss' unlucky daughter is missing in South America, Campana is sent to watch the boss' most unlucky employee who is sent as a private detective in hopes he can duplicate the daughter's mistakes.

Title: The Man in the White Suit
Hint: An inventor creates a fabric that never wears out.
Description: The unassuming, nebbishy inventor Sidney Stratton creates a miraculous fabric that will never be dirty or worn out. Clearly he can make a fortune selling clothes made of the material, but may cause a crisis in the process. After all, once someone buys one of his suits they won't ever have to fix them or buy another one, and the clothing industry will collapse overnight.

Title: Snake in the Eagle's Shadow
Hint: An abused orphan is taken under the wing of an old master of a rare serpent-style kung fu.
Description: Everyone abuses and humiliates a downtrodden orphan until he befriends an old man, who turns out to be the last master of the ___ fist fighting style. Jackie becomes the old man's student and finds himself in battle with the master of the ___ claw style, who has vowed to destroy the ___ fist clan.

Title: Don't Worry, I'm Fine
Hint: A 19-year-old Parisian girl searches for her missing twin brother after he disappears.
Description: A 19-year-old searches for her twin brother after he runs away from home, following a fight with their father.

Title: Bala
Hint: A young man struggles with premature balding and the insecurity it brings.
Description: A man suffering from alopecia copes with his lack of self-confidence and the societal pressure that comes with being bald.

Title: Mardaani 2
Hint: A tough female cop hunts a sadistic serial killer who targets young women in Rajasthan.
Description: Officer Shivani Shivaji Roy is stationed at Kota where she goes against a ferocious serial killer who rapes and murders women.

Title: Shanghai
Hint: An American agent arrives in Japanese-occupied China before Pearl Harbor to investigate a friend's murder.
Description: An American man returns to a corrupt, Japanese-occupied ___ four months before Pearl Harbor and discovers his friend has been killed. While he unravels the mysteries of the death, he falls in love and discovers a much larger secret that his own government is hiding.

Title: Butterflies Are Free
Hint: A blind man moves away from his overprotective mother.
Description: Striving to be independent, the blind but determined Don Baker moves away from his overprotective mother. After settling into his new San Francisco digs, Don meets kooky neighbor Jill Tanner. Don's quick wit and good looks disarm the free-spirited Jill, and before long they're more than just friends. Will Mrs. Baker's incessant meddling destroy Don and Jill's budding relationship?

Title: Taxi
Hint: A Marseille pizza boy turned cab driver helps a hapless cop catch bank robbers.
Description: In Marseilles a skilled pizza delivery boy Daniel who drives a scooter finally has his dreams come true. He gets a ___ license. Caught by the police for a huge speed infraction, he will help Emilien, a loser inspector who can't drive, on the track of German bank robbers, so he doesn't lose his license and his dream job.

Title: The Snow Walker
Hint: A bush pilot crashes in the Arctic with an Inuit woman.
Description: A bush pilot in nothern Canada who with the aid of modernity thinks he can handle it all & knows it all. After reluctantly agreeing to transport a local indian girl to a medical facility his light plane crashes & they have to survive whilst finding their way back to civilization. Along the journey the man finds a new respect for the native ways as they battle to survive the elements.

Hint: A young man takes a dead man's identity and enters an underground game.
Description: A naive young man assumes a dead man's identity and finds himself embroiled in an underground world of power, violence, and chance where men gamble behind closed doors on the lives of other men.

Title: Fullmetal Alchemist the Movie: Conqueror of Shamballa
Hint: A young transmuter is flung from his world into 1920s Germany.
Description: Munich, Germany, 1923. Two years have passed since Edward Elric was dragged from his own world to ours, leaving behind his country, his friends and his younger brother, Alphonse. Stripped of his alchemical powers, he has been all this time researching rocketry together with Alphonse Heiderich, a young man who resembles his own brother, hoping to one day find a way back home.

Title: Taxi No. 9 2 11: Nau Do Gyarah
Hint: A cabbie and a businessman cause havoc in each other's lives.
Description: A ___ driver and a businessman create havoc in each other's lives after a chance meeting.

Title: Ben X
Hint: A bullied autistic teen finds refuge in an online game.
Description: Harassed by bullies because of his mild autism, teen Ben finds refuge in an online computer game, which leads him to his virtual dream girl, Scarlite. Together, the odd couple seeks revenge against Ben's tormentors.

Title: Chinese Take-Out
Hint: A grumpy Buenos Aires hardware store owner reluctantly lets a young immigrant who doesn't speak Spanish stay with him.
Description: A comedy that chronicles a chance encounter between Robert and a Chinese named Jun who wanders lost through the city of Buenos Aires in search of his uncle after being assaulted by a taxi driver and his henchmen.

Title: Coming Soon
Hint: A group of cinema projectionists discover a cursed film that features a real lynching.
Description: Two projectionists discover a disturbing film featuring the lynching of a woman. Not only are they troubled by the content of the movie, but strange events befall them following the viewing.

Title: Gangster's Paradise: Jerusalema
Hint: A petty criminal rises to the top of the underworld.
Description: This South African movie tracks the rise of a once-petty criminal to the heights of the criminal underworld. After cutting his teeth on hijacking, before moving onto bigger game, an ambitious man hits a setback when most of his gang are shot.

Title: Mardaani
Hint: A tough female cop searches for a missing teenage girl caught up in human trafficking.
Description: A Mumbai police officer's search for a missing teenage girl leads her to the depraved world of child trafficking. What follows is a cat-and-mouse game between the officer and a ruthless mafia kingpin.

Title: The Parade
Country: Croatia, France, Macedonia, Serbia, Slovenia, United Kingdom
Hint: A gay activist recruits ex-soldiers to protect a Belgrade pride march.
Description: The ___, in a tragicomic way, tells the story about ongoing battle between two worlds in contemporary post-war Serbian society - the traditional, oppressive, homophobic majority and a liberal, modern and open-minded minority... The film, which deals with gay rights issues in Serbia, features footage of the 2010 Belgrade gay pride ___.

Title: Gunda
Hint: A mother pig and her piglets live on a farm.
Description: A glimpse into the raw and simple power of nature through encounters with farm animals: the eponymous ___, a mother pig; two cows, and a one-legged chicken.

Title: Lammbock
Hint: Friends run a cannabis business disguised as pizza delivery.
Description: Stefan and Kai run a thriving business: a home-grown cannabis trade disguised as a pizza delivery service. For now they just have to fight aphids.

Title: Rashmi Rocket
Hint: A small-town sprinter faces humiliating gender testing after she wins a major race.
Description: Born in the small-town of Kutch, ___ overcomes all societal barriers to become a national-level athlete. But her glory is hindered when she is asked to undergo a gender test.

Title: Pyaar Ka Punchnama 2
Hint: Three roommates experience surprising changes after falling in love with three women.
Description: After falling in love, three roommates experience changes in their lives.

Title: Race Gurram
Hint: Two brothers who are polar opposites clash, then unite against a corrupt politician.
Description: Ram and Lakshman, aka Lucky, are brothers who are polar opposites in nature. Their mother wishes to see them united.

Title: Ishqiya
Hint: A man and his nephew fall for a widow.
Description: While on the run from goons, a man and his nephew fall for a kidnapper's seductive widow.

Title: Mulk
Hint: A Muslim family's lives are upended when their son is accused of terrorism.
Description: The youngest son of a Muslim family settled in Benaras gets involved in terrorist activities, leading to a bomb blast massacre. His actions have an adverse effect on the family who are left to defend themselves as people who are innocent and not anti-nationals.

Title: Gold
Hint: A prospector and a geologist strike it rich in the Indonesian jungle.
Description: Kenny Wells, a modern-day prospector, hustler, and dreamer, is desperate for a lucky break. Left with few options, Wells teams up with an equally luckless geologist to execute a grandiose, last-ditch effort: to find ___ deep in the uncharted jungle of Indonesia.

Title: Yennai Arindhaal
Hint: A cop comes out of retirement to save a woman.
Description: Sathyadev, who is on a career break, is forced to put on his cop shoes ones again to save Thenmozhi, a young woman who is the target of a criminal organ harvesting group, led by a ghost from his past.

Title: The Creator
Hint: A former special forces agent is sent to destroy a weapon, which turns out to be an AI child.
Description: Amid a future war between the human race and the forces of artificial intelligence, a hardened ex-special forces agent grieving the disappearance of his wife, is recruited to hunt down and kill the ___, the elusive architect of advanced AI who has developed a mysterious weapon with the power to end the war—and mankind itself.

Title: The Equalizer
Hint: A retired black-ops operative takes on Russian gangsters to protect a young girl.
Description: McCall believes he has put his mysterious past behind him and dedicated himself to beginning a new, quiet life. But when he meets Teri, a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters, he can’t stand idly by – he has to help her.

Title: The Menu
Hint: A couple travels to an island for an exclusive dinner.
Description: A young couple travels to a remote island to eat at an exclusive restaurant where the chef has prepared a lavish ___, with some shocking surprises.

Title: Jailer
Hint: A retired prison warden must protect his family from an idol-smuggling gang.
Description: Muthuvel Pandian, a retired, stern yet compassionate ___ lives a peaceful life with his family, but trouble knocks his door when his cop son’s tryst with an antique mafia gang goes awry and forces Muthu to step back into a dark world he had voluntarily took a break from.

Title: The Lost Boys
Hint: A teenager moving to a California town is drawn into a gang of vampires.
Description: When an unsuspecting town newcomer is drawn to local blood fiends, the Frog brothers and other unlikely heroes gear up to rescue him.

Title: The Hunger Games
Hint: A teenage girl volunteers to take her sister's place in a televised fight to the death.
Description: In a dystopian society where the Capitol forces each district to send two young tributes to fight to the death in a televised spectacle, a girl volunteers to take her sister’s place, setting the stage for a struggle of survival and defiance.

Title: Kingdom of Heaven
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Germany, Spain
Hint: A blacksmith becomes a knight and defends Jerusalem during the Crusades against Saladin.
Description: After his wife dies, a blacksmith named Balian is thrust into royalty, political intrigue and bloody holy wars during the Crusades.

Title: Where the Crawdads Sing
Hint: A girl raised alone in the marshes is accused of murder.
Description: Abandoned by her family, Kya raises herself all alone in the marshes outside of her small town. When her former boyfriend is found dead, Kya is instantly branded by the local townspeople and law enforcement as the prime suspect for his murder.

Title: The Suicide Squad
Hint: A team of supervillains is sent on a doomed mission to a jungle island.
Description: Supervillains Harley Quinn, Bloodsport, Peacemaker and a collection of nutty cons at Belle Reve prison join the super-secret, super-shady Task Force X as they are dropped off at the remote, enemy-infused island of Corto Maltese.

Title: 8 Mile
Hint: A young white rapper struggles with poverty, family and rap battles in Detroit.
Description: For Jimmy Smith, Jr., life is a daily fight just to keep hope alive. Feeding his dreams in Detroit's vibrant music scene, Jimmy wages an extraordinary personal struggle to find his own voice - and earn a place in a world where rhymes rule, legends are born and every moment… is another chance.

Title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E.
Hint: A CIA agent and a KGB agent team up to stop a criminal organisation.
Description: At the height of the Cold War, a mysterious criminal organization plans to use nuclear weapons and technology to upset the fragile balance of power between the United States and Soviet Union. CIA agent Napoleon Solo and KGB agent Illya Kuryakin are forced to put aside their hostilities and work together to stop the evildoers in their tracks.

Title: Grease
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Two teenagers have a summer romance in the 1950s, then discover they're at the same school.
Description: Australian good girl Sandy and greaser Danny fell in love over the summer. But when they unexpectedly discover they're now in the same high school, will they be able to rekindle their romance despite their eccentric friends?

Title: Don't Look Up
Hint: Two astronomers try to warn humanity about a deadly comet, but no one listens.
Description: Two astronomers go on a media tour to warn humankind of a planet-killing comet hurtling toward Earth. The response from a distracted world: Meh.

Title: Cars
Hint: A hotshot race car gets stranded in a forgotten town on Route 66.
Description: Lightning McQueen, a hotshot rookie race car driven to succeed, discovers that life is about the journey, not the finish line, when he finds himself unexpectedly detoured in the sleepy Route 66 town of Radiator Springs. On route across the country to the big Piston Cup Championship in California to compete against two seasoned pros, McQueen gets to know the town's offbeat characters.

Title: Silence
Country: Mexico, Taiwan, United States of America
Hint: Two Portuguese Jesuit priests travel to 17th-century Japan to find their missing mentor.
Description: In the 17th century, two Portuguese Jesuit priests travel to Japan in an attempt to locate their mentor, who is rumored to have committed apostasy, and to propagate Catholicism.

Title: From Dusk Till Dawn
Hint: Two criminals and a family stop at a bar full of vampires.
Description: After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the Gecko brothers head south to a seedy Mexican bar to hide out in safety, unaware of its notorious clientele.

Title: The Great Gatsby
Hint: A mysterious millionaire throws lavish parties to win back a lost love on Long Island.
Description: An adaptation of F. Scott Fitzgerald's Long Island-set novel, where Midwesterner Nick Carraway is lured into the lavish world of his neighbor, Jay ___. Soon enough, however, Carraway will see through the cracks of ___ nouveau riche existence, where obsession, madness, and tragedy await.

Title: The Age of Adaline
Hint: A woman stops aging at 29 after a car accident, and spends decades guarding her secret.
Description: After 29-year-old ___ recovers from a nearly lethal accident, she inexplicably stops growing older. As the years stretch on and on, ___ keeps her secret to herself until she meets a man who changes her life.

Title: Encanto
Hint: A Colombian girl is the only one in her family without magic.
Description: The tale of an extraordinary family, the Madrigals, who live hidden in the mountains of Colombia, in a magical house, in a vibrant town, in a wondrous, charmed place called an ___. The magic of the ___ has blessed every child in the family—every child except one, Mirabel.

Title: Chicago
Hint: Two jazz-age murderesses compete for headlines and a slick lawyer's attention.
Description: Murderesses Velma Kelly and Roxie Hart find themselves on death row together and fight for the fame that will keep them from the gallows in 1920s ___.

Title: The Descent
Hint: A group of female cave explorers are trapped underground and hunted by flesh-eating creatures.
Description: After a personal tragedy, Sarah joins her friends on a caving expedition in the Appalachian Mountains. But when a rockfall traps them deep underground, their adventure turns into a nightmare. As they search for a way out, the group discovers they are not alone—lurking in the darkness are savage, cave-dwelling creatures.

Title: Clue
Hint: Guests at a dinner party try to solve a murder.
Description: ___ finds six colorful dinner guests gathered at the mansion of their host, Mr. Boddy -- who turns up dead after his secret is exposed: He was blackmailing all of them. With the killer among them, the guests and Boddy's chatty butler must suss out the culprit before the body count rises.

Title: Living
Hint: A stuffy London civil servant learns he is dying and resolves to do something meaningful.
Description: London, 1953. Mr. Williams, a veteran civil servant, is an important cog within the city's bureaucracy as it struggles to rebuild in the aftermath of World War II. Buried under paperwork at the office and lonely at home, his life has long felt empty and meaningless. Then a devastating medical diagnosis forces him to take stock, and to try and grasp some fulfilment before it passes permanently beyond reach.

Title: Insomnia
Hint: Two LA detectives investigate a murder in an Alaskan town where the sun never sets.
Description: Two Los Angeles homicide detectives are dispatched to a northern town where the sun doesn't set to investigate the methodical murder of a local teen.

Title: Five Feet Apart
Hint: Two teens with cystic fibrosis fall in love but must always stay a safe distance from each other.
Description: Seventeen-year-old Stella spends most of her time in the hospital as a cystic fibrosis patient. Her life is full of routines, boundaries and self-control — all of which get put to the test when she meets Will, an impossibly charming teen who has the same illness. There's an instant flirtation, though restrictions dictate that they must maintain a safe distance between them.

Title: Point Break
Hint: An FBI agent infiltrates a gang of surfing bank robbers.
Description: In Los Angeles, a gang of bank robbers who call themselves The Ex-Presidents commit their crimes while wearing masks of Reagan, Carter, Nixon and Johnson. Believing that the members of the gang could be surfers, the F.B.I. sends young agent Johnny Utah to the beach undercover to mix with the surfers and gather information.

Title: School of Rock
Hint: A wannabe guitar hero poses as a substitute teacher and turns his class into a band.
Description: Fired from his band and hard up for cash, guitarist and vocalist Dewey Finn finagles his way into a job as a fifth-grade substitute teacher at a private school, where he secretly begins teaching his straight-A students the finer points of rock 'n' roll and the power of sticking it to the man.

Title: American Hustle
Hint: A con man and his partner are forced to work for an FBI agent in a sting.
Description: A conman and his seductive partner are forced to work for a wild FBI agent, who pushes them into a world of Jersey power-brokers and the Mafia.

Title: The Outfit
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An English tailor in 1950s Chicago must outwit gangsters who take over his shop for the night.
Description: Leonard is an English tailor who used to craft suits on London’s world-famous Savile Row. After a personal tragedy, he’s ended up in Chicago, operating a small tailor shop in a rough part of town where he makes beautiful clothes for the only people around who can afford them: a family of vicious gangsters.

Title: Gosford Park
Hint: A murder at a country house party in 1930s England.
Description: In 1930s England, a group of pretentious rich and famous gather together for a weekend of relaxation at a hunting resort. But when a murder occurs, each one of these interesting characters becomes a suspect.

Title: The Passion of the Christ
Hint: The last twelve hours of a religious leader's life before his crucifixion.
Description: A graphic portrayal of the last twelve hours of Jesus of Nazareth's life.

Title: The Virgin Suicides
Hint: Five sisters in 1970s suburban Michigan are isolated by their strict parents after one attempts suicide.
Description: A group of male friends become obsessed with five mysterious sisters who are sheltered by their strict, religious parents.

Title: Friday
Hint: Two Los Angeles friends must pay back a drug dealer before the day ends.
Description: Craig and Smokey are two guys in Los Angeles hanging out on their porch on a ___ afternoon, smoking and drinking, looking for something to do.

Title: Meet Joe Black
Hint: Death takes a human form and visits a dying media tycoon, falling for his daughter.
Description: Bill Parrish has it all - success, wealth and power. Days before his 65th birthday, he receives a visit from a mysterious stranger, Joe Black, who soon reveals himself as Death. In exchange for extra time, Bill agrees to serve as Joe's earthly guide. But will he regret his choice when Joe unexpectedly falls in love with Bill's beautiful daughter Susan?

Title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A robot boy longs to become a real boy.
Description: David, a robotic boy—the first of his kind programmed to love—is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David.

Title: Natural Born Killers
Hint: Two victims of traumatised childhoods become lovers and murderous media celebrities on a killing spree.
Description: Two victims of traumatized childhoods become lovers and serial murderers irresponsibly glorified by the mass media.

Title: Closer
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Four people fall in and out of love and betray each other over several years in London.
Description: The relationships of two couples become complicated and deceitful when the man from one couple meets the woman of the other.

Title: Notting Hill
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A bookseller falls in love with a movie star.
Description: London bookstore owner William Thacker's quiet life turns upside down when a chance encounter with famous actress Anna Scott sparks an unlikely romance challenged by their vastly different worlds.

Title: Now You See Me
Hint: A team of magicians pull off bank heists during their performances, and the FBI is in pursuit.
Description: An FBI agent and an Interpol detective track a team of illusionists who pull off bank heists during their performances and reward their audiences with the money.

Title: Heathers
Hint: A teen and her psychopathic boyfriend kill popular students and make it look like suicide.
Description: A girl who halfheartedly tries to be part of the "in crowd" of her school meets a rebel who teaches her a more devious way to play social politics: by killing the popular kids.

Title: They Live
Hint: A drifter finds sunglasses that reveal aliens are secretly controlling humanity.
Description: A lone drifter stumbles upon a unique pair of sunglasses that reveal aliens are systematically gaining control of the Earth by masquerading as humans and lulling the public into submission.

Title: Dogtooth
Hint: Three teenagers are kept in isolation by their parents.
Description: Three teenagers are confined to an isolated country estate that could very well be on another planet. The trio spend their days listening to endless homemade tapes that teach them a whole new vocabulary. Any word that comes from beyond their family abode is instantly assigned a new meaning. Hence 'the sea' refers to a large armchair and 'zombies' are little yellow flowers.

Title: Manhunter
Hint: An FBI profiler hunts a serial killer with the help of an imprisoned cannibal.
Description: FBI Agent Will Graham, who retired after catching Hannibal Lecktor, returns to duty to engage in a risky cat-and-mouse game with Lecktor to capture a new killer.

Title: A Bug's Life
Hint: An inventive ant recruits a troupe of circus insects to save his colony from grasshoppers.
Description: On behalf of "oppressed bugs everywhere," an inventive ant named Flik hires a troupe of warrior bugs to defend his bustling colony from a horde of freeloading grasshoppers led by the evil-minded Hopper.

Title: Coherence
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Friends at a dinner party experience strange events during a comet.
Description: Four couples gather for dinner the night a mysterious and powerful comet passes overhead.

Title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
Hint: A woman wakes up in a bunker after a car crash.
Description: After a catastrophic car crash, a young woman wakes up in a survivalist's underground bunker, where he claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack that has left the outside world uninhabitable.

Title: Vice
Hint: A quiet bureaucrat becomes the most powerful number two in American history.
Description: George W. Bush picks Dick Cheney, the CEO of Halliburton Co., to be his Republican running mate in the 2000 presidential election. No stranger to politics, Cheney's impressive résumé includes stints as White House chief of staff, House Minority Whip and Defense Secretary. When Bush wins by a narrow margin, Cheney begins to use his newfound power to help reshape the country and the world.

Title: Satyaprem Ki Katha
Hint: A boy falls in love with a girl coping with a breakup.
