Description: A middle-class boy in Ahmedabad, ___ falling in one-sided love with ___, who is coping with her breakup with Tapan. Through the journey, they discover each other's life and complement in accomplishing what was left halfway.

Title: A Quiet Place Part II
Hint: A family ventures into the silent outside world, where blind creatures hunt anything that makes noise.
Description: Following the events at home, the Abbott family now face the terrors of the outside world. Forced to venture into the unknown, they realize that the creatures that hunt by sound are not the only threats that lurk beyond the sand path.

Title: The Birdcage
Hint: A gay couple fakes being straight for their son's fiancée's parents.
Description: A gay cabaret owner and his drag queen partner agree to put up a false heterosexual front so that their son can introduce them to his fiancée's conservative parents.

Title: GoldenEye
Hint: A British secret agent must stop a former ally from using a satellite weapon.
Description: When a powerful secret defense system is stolen, James Bond is assigned to stop a Russian crime syndicate from using it.

Title: Caddyshack
Hint: A caddy pursues a scholarship at an exclusive country club.
Description: At an exclusive country club, an ambitious young caddy, Danny Noonan, eagerly pursues a caddy scholarship in hopes of attending college and, in turn, avoiding a job at the lumber yard. In order to succeed, he must first win the favour of the elitist Judge Smails, and then the caddy golf tournament which Smails sponsors.

Title: Ronin
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A group of ex-special forces mercenaries are hired to steal a mysterious briefcase in France.
Description: A briefcase with undisclosed contents – sought by Irish terrorists and the Russian mob – makes its way into criminals' hands. An Irish liaison assembles a squad of mercenaries, or '___', and gives them the thorny task of recovering the case.

Title: Red Dragon
Country: Germany, Italy, United States of America
Hint: An FBI agent consults an imprisoned cannibal to catch a killer.
Description: Former FBI Agent Will Graham, who was once almost killed by the savage Hannibal 'The Cannibal' Lecter, now has no choice but to face him again, as it seems Lecter is the only one who can help Graham track down a new serial killer.

Title: Big Trouble in Little China
Hint: A truck driver gets embroiled in a supernatural battle in San Francisco's Chinatown.
Description: Truck driver Jack Burton gets embroiled in a supernatural battle when his best friend Wang Chi's green-eyed fiancée is kidnapped by henchmen of the sorcerer Lo Pan, who must marry a girl with green eyes in order to return to the human realm.

Title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A wizard arrives in New York with a case of creatures.
Description: In 1926, Newt Scamander arrives at the Magical Congress of the United States of America with a magically expanded briefcase, which houses a number of dangerous creatures and their habitats. When the creatures escape from the briefcase, it sends the American wizarding authorities after Newt, and threatens to strain even further the state of magical and non-magical relations.

Title: Murder on the Orient Express
Hint: A Belgian detective investigates a killing aboard a snowbound luxury train.
Description: Genius Belgian detective Hercule Poirot investigates the murder of an American tycoon aboard the ___ train.

Title: The Post
Hint: A newspaper publisher and her editor decide whether to publish classified documents about Vietnam.
Description: A cover-up that spanned four U.S. Presidents pushed the country's first female newspaper publisher and a hard-driving editor to join an unprecedented battle between journalist and government. Inspired by true events.

Title: I Am Legend
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A scientist is the last man in New York.
Description: Robert Neville is a scientist who was unable to stop the spread of the terrible virus that was incurable and man-made. Immune, Neville is now the last human survivor in what is left of New York City and perhaps the world. For three years, Neville has faithfully sent out daily radio messages, desperate to find any other survivors who might be out there. But he is not alone.

Title: The Road
Hint: A father and son walk through a post-apocalyptic America.
Description: A father and his son walk alone through burned America. Nothing moves in the ravaged landscape save the ash on the wind and water. It is cold enough to crack stones and, when the snow falls, it is gray. Their destination is the warmer south, although they don't know what, if anything, awaits them there.

Title: 21 Jump Street
Hint: Two inept young cops go undercover as high school students to bust a synthetic drug ring.
Description: When cops Schmidt and Jenko join the secret ___ Street unit, they use their youthful appearances to go undercover as high school students. They trade in their guns and badges for backpacks, and set out to shut down a dangerous drug ring.

Title: The Patriot
Hint: A farmer joins the American Revolution after his son is killed.
Description: After proving himself on the field of battle in the French and Indian War, Benjamin Martin wants nothing more to do with such things, preferring the simple life of a farmer. But when his son Gabriel enlists in the army to defend their new nation, America, against the British, Benjamin reluctantly returns to his old life to protect his son.

Title: The Changeling
Hint: A grieving composer moves into a Seattle mansion haunted by the ghost of a murdered child.
Description: After a tragic event happens, composer John Russell moves to Seattle to try to overcome it and build a new and peaceful life in a lonely big house that has been uninhabited for many years. But, soon after, the obscure history of such an old mansion and his own past begin to haunt him.

Title: Death on the Nile
Hint: A Belgian detective investigates a murder aboard a luxury cruise ship in Egypt.
Description: Belgian sleuth Hercule Poirot's Egyptian vacation aboard a glamorous river steamer turns into a terrifying search for a murderer when a picture-perfect couple's idyllic honeymoon is tragically cut short.

Title: The Matrix Reloaded
Hint: Rebels fight to save the last human city from an army of machines.
Description: The Resistance builds in numbers as humans are freed from the ___ and brought to the city of Zion. Neo discovers his superpowers, including the ability to see the code inside the ___. With machine sentinels digging to Zion in 72 hours, Neo, Morpheus and Trinity must find the Keymaker to ultimately reach the Source.

Title: The Founder
Hint: A milkshake-machine salesman takes over a small fast-food chain and builds an empire.
Description: The true story of how Ray Kroc, a salesman from Illinois, met Mac and Dick McDonald, who were running a burger operation in 1950s Southern California. Kroc was impressed by the brothers’ speedy system of making the food and saw franchise potential. He maneuvered himself into a position to be able to pull the company from the brothers and create a billion-dollar empire.

Title: Enter the Void
Hint: A drug dealer is killed and his spirit floats over Tokyo.
Description: This psychedelic tour of life after death is seen entirely from the point of view of Oscar, a young American drug dealer and addict living in Tokyo with his prostitute sister, Linda.

Title: Lawless
Hint: Three bootlegging brothers in 1930s Virginia face a corrupt and sadistic special deputy.
Description: In 1931, the Bondurant brothers of Franklin County, Virginia, run a multipurpose backwoods establishment that hides their true business — bootlegging. Middle brother Forrest is the brain of the operation; older Howard is the brawn, and younger Jack, the lookout.

Title: Hostiles
Hint: An Army captain reluctantly escorts a dying Cheyenne chief and his family through dangerous territory.
Description: A legendary Native American-hating Army captain nearing retirement in 1892 is given one last assignment: to escort a Cheyenne chief and his family through dangerous territory back to his Montana reservation.

Title: Wild at Heart
Hint: Two young lovers hit the road and are pursued by a hitman hired by her mother.
Description: Young lovers Sailor and Lula hit the road to start a new life together away from the wrath of Lula’s deranged, disapproving mother, who has hired a team of hitmen to cut the lovers’ surreal honeymoon short.

Title: Palmer
Hint: An ex-con returns to his hometown and befriends a boy who loves dolls and tiaras.
Description: After 12 years in prison, former high school football star Eddie ___ returns home to put his life back together—and forms an unlikely bond with Sam, an outcast boy from a troubled home. But Eddie's past threatens to ruin his new life and family.

Title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
Hint: An eccentric oceanographer seeks revenge on a jaguar shark that ate his partner.
Description: Renowned oceanographer ___ has sworn vengeance upon the rare shark that devoured a member of his crew. In addition to his regular team, he is joined on his boat by Ned, a man who believes ___ to be his father, and Jane, a journalist pregnant by a married man.

Title: Carol
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A department store clerk falls for an older, married woman in 1950s New York.
Description: In 1950s New York, a department-store clerk who dreams of a better life falls for an older, married woman.

Title: Bridge to Terabithia
Hint: Two kids create a magical kingdom in the woods.
Description: Jesse Aarons trained all summer to become the fastest runner in school. So he's very upset when newcomer Leslie Burke outruns him and everyone else. Despite this and other differences including that she's rich, he's poor, she's a city girl, and he's a country boy the two become fast friends. Together they create ___, a land of monsters, trolls, ogres, and giants where they rule as king and queen.

Title: Fences
Hint: A former Negro League baseball player turned garbage collector struggles with his family in 1950s Pittsburgh.
Description: In 1950s Pittsburgh, a frustrated African-American father struggles with the constraints of poverty, racism, and his own inner demons as he tries to raise a family.

Title: Treasure Planet
Genres: Science Fiction, Adventure, Animation, Family, Fantasy
Hint: A boy searches for pirate gold among the stars.
Description: When space galleon cabin boy Jim Hawkins discovers a map to an intergalactic "loot of a thousand worlds," a cyborg cook named John Silver teaches him to battle supernovas and space storms on their journey to find ___.

Title: Angel Heart
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A detective is hired to find a missing singer and is drawn into a satanic mystery.
Description: A down-and-out Brooklyn detective is hired to track down a singer on an odyssey that will take him through the desperate streets of Harlem, the smoke-filled jazz clubs of New Orleans, and the swamps of Louisiana and its seedy underworld of voodoo.

Title: Good Luck to You, Leo Grande
Hint: A retired widow hires a young male sex worker to finally have a good sexual experience.
Description: Nancy Stokes, a retired schoolteacher, is pretty sure she has never had good sex. Now that her husband has died, she is determined to take a tour of sexual vistas that until now she has only imagined. She even has a plan; it involves an anonymous hotel room, and a sex worker who calls himself ___.

Title: Pump Up the Volume
Hint: A lonely teen runs a pirate radio station that inspires his high school classmates to rebel.
Description: Mark Hunter, a lonely high school student, uses his shortwave radio to moonlight as the popular pirate DJ "Hard Harry." When his show gets blamed for a teen committing suicide, the students clash with high school faculty and the authorities.

Title: The Book of Life
Hint: A young bullfighter who'd rather play guitar journeys through colorful lands of the dead to win his love.
Description: The journey of Manolo, a young man who is torn between fulfilling the expectations of his family and following his heart. Before choosing which path to follow, he embarks on an incredible adventure that spans fantastical worlds where he must face his greatest fears.

Title: Monsters University
Hint: A small green eyeball-shaped student dreams of becoming a top scarer at college.
Description: A look at the relationship between Mike and Sulley during their days at ___ — when they weren't necessarily the best of friends.

Title: The Prince of Egypt
Hint: An adopted Egyptian royal discovers his Hebrew roots and leads his people out of slavery.
Description: The strong bond between two Royal Egyptian brothers is challenged when their chosen responsibilities set them at odds, with extraordinary consequences.

Title: The Age of Innocence
Hint: A Gilded-era New York lawyer engaged to a sweet society girl falls for her scandalous separated cousin.
Description: In 19th century New York high society, a young lawyer falls in love with a woman separated from her husband, while he is engaged to the woman's cousin.

Title: Unbroken
Hint: An Olympic runner survives 47 days on a raft and then a brutal Japanese prison camp.
Description: A chronicle of the life of Louis Zamperini, an Olympic runner who was taken prisoner by Japanese forces during World War II.

Title: Mean Streets
Hint: A small-time Little Italy hood tries to rise in the mob while protecting his reckless friend.
Description: A small-time hood must choose from among love, friendship and the chance to rise within the mob.

Title: Willow
Hint: An evil queen hunts a newborn princess, protected by a farmer and a swordsman.
Description: The evil Queen Bavmorda hunts the newborn princess Elora Danan, a child prophesied to bring about her downfall. When the royal infant is found by ___, a timid farmer and aspiring sorcerer, he's entrusted with delivering her from evil.

Title: Mask
Hint: A teenage boy with a severe facial deformity lives fully alongside his biker gang mother.
Description: A significantly deformed but highly intelligent teenage boy and his biker gang mother attempt to live as normal a life as possible under the circumstances.

Title: Strange Days
Hint: On the last night of 1999, an ex-cop sells illegal recordings of other people's memories.
Description: In the last days of 1999, ex-cop turned street hustler Lenny Nero receives a disc which contains the memories of the murder of a prostitute. With the help of bodyguard Mace, he starts to investigate and is pulled deeper and deeper in a whirl of murder, blackmail and intrigue.

Title: The Darjeeling Limited
Hint: Three estranged American brothers reunite on a spiritual train trip across India.
Description: Three American brothers who have not spoken to each other in a year set off on a train voyage across India with a plan to find themselves and bond with each other -- to become brothers again like they used to be. Their "spiritual quest", however, veers rapidly off-course (due to events involving over-the-counter pain killers, Indian cough syrup, and pepper spray).

Title: The Fountain
Hint: A man chases eternal life across three eras to save the woman he loves.
Description: Spanning over one thousand years, and three parallel stories, The ___ is a story of love, death, spirituality, and the fragility of our existence in this world.

Title: Only Lovers Left Alive
Hint: Two centuries-old vampire soulmates drift through Detroit and Tangier, bored with humanity.
Description: A depressed musician reunites with his lover. However, their romance, already played over several centuries, is disrupted by the arrival of her uncontrollable younger sister.

Title: Friday Night Lights
Hint: A small, turbulent Texas town obsesses over their high school football team.
Description: A small, turbulent town in Texas obsesses over their high school football team to an unhealthy degree. When the star tailback, Boobie Miles, is seriously injured during the first game of the season, all hope is lost, and the town's dormant social problems begin to flare up.

Title: Rango
Hint: A theatrical pet chameleon stumbles into a Wild West desert town and becomes its sheriff.
Description: When ___, a lost family pet, accidentally winds up in the gritty, gun-slinging Western town of Dirt, the theater-loving lizard suddenly finds himself the newly appointed sheriff. Welcomed as the last hope the town has been waiting for, ___ is forced to play his new role to the hilt and uncover the truth behind a looming water crisis—before his act catches up with him.

Title: Finding Dory
Hint: A forgetful blue tang sets off across the ocean to find her long-lost parents.
Description: ___ is reunited with her friends Nemo and Marlin in the search for answers about her past. What can she remember? Who are her parents? And where did she learn to speak Whale?

Title: The Death of Stalin
Country: Belgium, Canada, France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Soviet ministers scheme, panic and backstab after the dictator suddenly drops dead.
Description: When dictator Joseph ___ dies, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains — just who is running the government?

Title: Videodrome
Hint: A sleazy TV executive discovers a broadcast that warps reality and his body.
Description: As the president of a trashy TV channel, Max Renn is desperate for new programming to attract viewers. When he happens upon "___," a TV show dedicated to gratuitous torture and punishment, Max sees a potential hit and broadcasts the show on his channel.

Title: Till
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A grieving mother turns her son's brutal murder in Mississippi into a cry for justice.
Description: The true story of Mamie ___ Mobley's relentless pursuit of justice for her 14-year-old son, Emmett ___, who, in 1955, was lynched while visiting his cousins in Mississippi.

Title: A Room with a View
Hint: A young Englishwoman on a trip to Florence is torn between a stuffy fiancé and a free spirit.
Description: When Lucy Honeychurch and chaperon Charlotte Bartlett find themselves in Florence with rooms without views, fellow guests Mr Emerson and son George step in to remedy the situation. Meeting the Emersons could change Lucy's life forever but, once back in England, how will her experiences in Tuscany affect her marriage plans?

Title: Frailty
Hint: A man tells an FBI agent about his father, who believed he was ordered by God to kill demons.
Description: A mysterious man arrives at the offices of an FBI agent and recounts his childhood: how his religious fanatic father received visions telling him to kill people who were in fact "demons."

Title: Cold Mountain
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Romania, Italy
Hint: A wounded Confederate soldier walks home to the woman he loves in North Carolina.
Description: In this classic story of love and devotion set against the backdrop of the American Civil War, a wounded Confederate soldier named W.P. Inman deserts his unit and travels across the South, aiming to return to his young wife, Ada, who he left behind to tend their farm.

Title: The Crying Game
Hint: An IRA volunteer forms a bond with a captive soldier and then meets the soldier's lover.
Description: Irish Republican Army member Fergus forms an unexpected bond with Jody, a kidnapped British soldier in his custody, despite the warnings of fellow IRA members Jude and Maguire. Jody makes Fergus promise he'll visit his girlfriend, Dil, in London, and when Fergus flees to the city, he seeks her out. Hounded by his former IRA colleagues, he finds himself increasingly drawn to the enigmatic, and surprising, Dil.

Title: The Report
Hint: A Senate staffer digs through millions of documents to expose CIA torture.
Description: The story of Daniel Jones, lead investigator for the US Senate’s sweeping study into the CIA's Detention and Interrogation Program, which was found to be brutal, immoral and ineffective. With the truth at stake, Jones battled tirelessly to make public what many in power sought to keep hidden.

Title: The Andromeda Strain
Hint: Scientists race to contain a deadly microbe that arrived on a fallen satellite.
Description: When virtually all of the residents of Piedmont, New Mexico, are found dead after the return to Earth of a space satellite, the head of the US Air Force's Project Scoop declares an emergency. A group of eminent scientists led by Dr. Jeremy Stone scramble to a secure laboratory and try to first isolate the life form while determining why two people from Piedmont - an old alcoholic and a six-month-old baby - survived.

Title: The Parent Trap
Hint: Identical twins separated at birth meet at summer camp and plot to reunite mom and dad.
Description: Hallie Parker and Annie James are identical twins who were separated at a young age due to their parents' divorce. Unbeknownst to their parents, the girls are sent to the same summer camp, where they meet, discover the truth about their relationship, and come up with a plan to switch places in an effort to reunite their mother and father.

Title: The Full Monty
Hint: Six unemployed steelworkers in Sheffield form a male striptease act to make money.
Description: Sheffield, England. Gaz, a jobless steelworker in need of quick cash persuades his mates to bare it all in a one-night-only strip show.

Title: We Were Soldiers
Country: Germany, United States of America, United Kingdom, France
Hint: American troops fight the first major battle of the Vietnam War against overwhelming odds.
Description: The year is 1965 and America is at war with North Vietnam. Commanding the air cavalry is Lt. Col. Hal Moore (Gibson), a born leader committed to his troops. His target: the Ia Drang Valley, called "The Valley of Death." As Moore prepares for one of the most violent battles in U.S. history, he delivers a stirring promise to his soldiers and their families: "I will leave no man behind...dead or alive.

Title: The Croods
Hint: A prehistoric family must leave their cave when their world starts to crumble.
Description: The prehistoric ___ family live in a particularly dangerous moment in time. Patriarch Grug, his mate Ugga, teenage daughter Eep, son Thunk, and feisty Gran gather food by day and huddle together in a cave at night. When a more evolved caveman named Guy arrives on the scene, Grug is distrustful, but it soon becomes apparent that Guy is correct about the impending destruction of their world.

Title: Fracture
Hint: An engineer shoots his cheating wife, then outsmarts an ambitious prosecutor in court.
Description: A husband is on trial for the attempted murder of his wife, in what is seemingly an open/shut case for the ambitious district attorney trying to put him away. However, there are surprises for both around every corner, and, as a suspenseful game of cat-and-mouse is played out, each must manipulate and outwit the other.

Title: A River Runs Through It
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two brothers grow up fly-fishing in Montana with their strict Presbyterian minister father.
Description: The Maclean brothers, Paul and Norman, live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister, the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess where they've been and where they're going.

Title: RocknRolla
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A London crime boss, a crooked accountant and a crew of crooks all chase a stolen painting.
Description: When a Russian mobster sets up a real estate scam that generates millions of pounds, various members of London's criminal underworld pursue their share of the fortune. Various shady characters, including Mr One-Two, Stella the accountant, and Johnny Quid, a druggie rock-star, try to claim their slice.

Title: Somewhere in Time
Hint: A playwright wills himself back to 1912 to meet the actress in an old photograph.
Description: Young writer Richard Collier is met on the opening night of his first play by an old lady who begs him to "Come back to me". Mystified, he tries to find out about her, and learns that she is a famous stage actress from the early twentieth century. Becoming more and more obsessed with her, by self-hypnosis he manages to travel back in time—where he meets her.

Title: Columbus
Hint: An architecture scholar's son and a young librarian bond over modernist buildings.
Description: When a renowned architecture scholar falls suddenly ill during a speaking tour, his son Jin finds himself stranded in ___, Indiana - a small Midwestern city celebrated for its many significant modernist buildings. Jin strikes up a friendship with Casey, a young architecture enthusiast who works at the local library.

Title: Dr. No
Hint: A British secret agent battles a scientific genius with metal hands in Jamaica.
Description: Agent 007 battles mysterious ___, a scientific genius bent on destroying the U.S. space program. As the countdown to disaster begins, Bond must go to Jamaica, where he encounters beautiful Honey Ryder, to confront a megalomaniacal villain in his massive island headquarters.

Title: Dead Ringers
Hint: Identical twin gynecologists share everything, including women, until one falls in love.
Description: Elliot, a successful gynecologist, works at the same practice as his identical twin, Beverly. Elliot is attracted to many of his patients and has affairs with them. When he inevitably loses interest, he will give the woman over to Beverly, the meeker of the two, without the woman knowing the difference.

Title: In the Line of Fire
Hint: A veteran Secret Service agent haunted by failing to save a president in Dallas is taunted by a would-be assassin.
Description: Veteran Secret Service agent Frank Horrigan is a man haunted by his failure to save President Kennedy while serving protection detail in Dallas. Thirty years later, a man calling himself "Booth" threatens the life of the current President, forcing Horrigan to come back to protection detail to confront the ghosts from his past.

Title: The End of the Tour
Hint: A magazine reporter spends five days on the road with a brilliant, troubled novelist.
Description: The story of the five-day interview between Rolling Stone reporter David Lipsky and acclaimed novelist David Foster Wallace, which took place right after the 1996 publication of Wallace's groundbreaking epic novel, 'Infinite Jest.'

Title: Sex, Lies, and Videotape
Hint: A drifter who films women talking about intimacy upends a repressed couple's lives.
Description: Ann, a frustrated wife, enters into counseling due to a troubled marriage. Unbeknownst to her, her husband John has begun an affair with her sister. When John’s best friend Graham arrives, his penchant for interviewing women about their sex lives forever changes John and Ann’s rocky marriage.

Title: Kung Fu Panda 2
Hint: A dumpling-loving warrior faces a vain peacock with a deadly new weapon.
Description: Po is finally living the dream as the Dragon Warrior—until a shadow from his past comes roaring back. When the ruthless peacock Lord Shen unleashes a devastating new weapon used to wipe out ___ fu masters across the land, Po and the Furious Five race across China to put an end to his plans.

Title: Top Secret!
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An American rock singer gets caught up in an East German resistance plot.
Description: Popular and dashing American singer Nick Rivers travels to East Germany to perform in a music festival. When he loses his heart to the gorgeous Hillary Flammond, he finds himself caught up in an underground resistance movement. Rivers joins forces with Agent Cedric and Flammond to attempt the rescue of her father, Dr.

Title: Bitter Moon
Hint: A passenger on a cruise ship is drawn into the twisted love story of a paralyzed writer.
Description: A passenger on a cruise ship develops an irresistible infatuation with an eccentric paraplegic's wife.

Title: Re-Animator
Hint: A medical student invents a glowing serum that brings the dead back to life, badly.
Description: Conducting clandestine experiments within the morgue at Miskatonic University, scientist Herbert West reveals to a fellow graduate student his groundbreaking work concerning the re-animation of fresh corpses.

Title: Major League
Hint: A team of misfits is assembled to lose so the owner can move the club, and they start winning.
Description: When Rachel Phelps inherits the Cleveland Indians from her deceased husband, she's determined to move the team to a warmer climate—but only a losing season will make that possible, which should be easy given the misfits she's hired. Rachel is sure her dream will come true, but she underestimates their will to succeed.

Title: Swingers
Hint: A heartbroken comedian in LA is coached by his smooth friends to get back in the dating game.
Description: After 6 years together, Mike's girlfriend leaves him, so he travels to LA to be a star. Six months on, he's still not doing very well— so a few of his friends try to reconnect him to the social scene and hopefully help him forget his failed relationship.

Title: Team America: World Police
Hint: Marionette agents fight terrorists and Hollywood actors in a crude puppet satire.
Description: When North Korean ruler Kim Jong-il orchestrates a global terrorist plot, it's up to the heavily armed, highly specialized ___ unit to stop his dastardly scheme.

Title: A Dog's Purpose
Hint: A loyal pup is reborn again and again, searching for the boy he first loved.
Description: A dog goes on quest to discover his ___ in life over the course of several lifetimes with multiple owners.

Title: The Courier
Hint: A British businessman becomes an unlikely spy during the Cuban Missile Crisis.
Description: Cold War spy Greville Wynne and his Russian source try to put an end to the Cuban Missile Crisis.

Title: Ringu
Hint: A videotape kills anyone who watches it within seven days, and a reporter has just seen it.
Description: A mysterious video has been linked to a number of deaths, and when an inquisitive journalist finds the tape and views it herself, she sets in motion a chain of events that puts her own life in danger.

Title: Steve Jobs
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Three product launches show the brilliant, difficult man behind the Mac.
Description: Set backstage at three iconic product launches and ending in 1998 with the unveiling of the iMac, ___ takes us behind the scenes of the digital revolution to paint an intimate portrait of the brilliant man at its epicenter.

Title: The Rainmaker
Hint: A rookie lawyer takes on a crooked insurance giant that refused a dying boy.
Description: Fresh out of law school and desperate for work, idealistic rookie Rudy Baylor takes on a powerful insurance company accused of denying a dying boy’s claim. Teaming up with a scrappy, unlicensed paralegal, he finds himself in a David-versus-Goliath courtroom battle that tests his ethics, courage, and belief in justice.

Title: Silverado
Hint: Four unlikely heroes ride into a corrupt frontier town and clean it up.
Description: Four unwitting heroes cross paths on their journey to the sleepy town of ___. Little do they know the town where their family and friends reside has been taken over by a corrupt sheriff and a murderous posse. It's up to the sharp-shooting foursome to save the day, but first they have to break each other out of jail, and learn who their real friends are.

Title: The Bank Job
Country: Australia, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Small-time crooks are hired to rob a London vault full of royal secrets.
Description: Terry is a small-time car dealer trying to leave his shady past behind and start a family. Martine is a beautiful model from Terry's old neighbourhood who knows that Terry is no angel. When Martine proposes a foolproof plan to rob a bank, Terry recognises the danger but realises this may be the opportunity of a lifetime.

Title: The Doors
Hint: A rebellious poet singer leads a 1960s band into fame, excess and early death.
Description: The story of the famous and influential 1960s rock band and its lead singer and composer, Jim Morrison.

Title: An American Crime
Hint: A housewife keeps a teenage girl locked in her basement while the neighborhood looks away.
Description: The true story of suburban housewife Gertrude Baniszewski, who kept a teenage girl locked in the basement of her Indiana home during the 1960s.

Title: The Young Victoria
Hint: A teenage heir to the throne fights to escape her mother's control and falls in love.
Description: As the only legitimate heir of England's King William, teenage ___ gets caught up in the political machinations of her own family. ___ mother wants her to sign a regency order, while her Belgian uncle schemes to arrange a marriage between the future monarch and Prince Albert, the man who will become the love of her life.

Title: The Professor and the Madman
Country: France, Ireland, Mexico, United States of America, Iceland, Belgium
Hint: A Victorian scholar compiling a great dictionary relies on a brilliant inmate of an asylum.
Description: Professor James Murray begins work compiling words for the first edition of the Oxford English Dictionary in the mid 19th century, and receives over 10,000 entries from a patient at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum, Dr. William Minor.

Title: Two-Lane Blacktop
Hint: Two silent drag racers cross America in a primer-gray car, racing a man in a GTO.
Description: A driver and mechanic drag racing for money cross paths with a female hitchhiker and a drifter who challenges them to a cross-country race.

Title: Rise of the Guardians
Hint: Legendary holiday figures recruit a new hero, a frost spirit, to fight a nightmare-spreading villain.
Description: When an evil spirit known as Pitch lays down the gauntlet to take over the world, the immortal ___ must join forces for the first time to protect the hopes, beliefs and imagination of children all over the world.

Title: A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood
Hint: A cynical journalist is assigned to profile a gentle children's TV host.
Description: An award-winning cynical journalist, Lloyd Vogel, begrudgingly accepts an assignment to write an Esquire profile piece on the beloved television icon Fred Rogers. After his encounter with Rogers, Vogel's perspective on life is transformed.

Title: T2 Trainspotting
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Four old friends from Edinburgh reunite twenty years later.
Description: After 20 years abroad, Mark Renton returns to Scotland and reunites with his old friends Sick Boy, Spud and Begbie.

Title: Sleeping Beauty
Hint: A cursed princess pricks her finger on a spinning wheel and falls into an endless slumber.
Description: Cursed to die by the evil fairy Maleficent when she was a baby, Princess Aurora is sent into hiding under protection from three good fairies. As she grows up far away, Maleficent becomes increasingly determined to seal the princess's fate.

Title: Runaway Train
Hint: Two escaped convicts board a locomotive with no driver and no brakes in Alaska.
Description: A hardened convict and a younger prisoner escape from a brutal prison in the middle of winter only to find themselves on an out-of-control train with a female railway worker while being pursued by the vengeful head of security.

Title: August: Osage County
Hint: A dysfunctional Oklahoma family gathers in a hot farmhouse after a disappearance.
Description: An intense look at the lives of the strong-willed daughters of the Weston family, whose paths have diverged until a family crisis brings them back to the Midwest house they grew up in, and to the dysfunctional mother who raised them.

Title: An American in Paris
Hint: A Yankee painter on the Left Bank falls for a young French girl to Gershwin music.
Description: Jerry Mulligan is an exuberant American expatriate in Paris trying to make a reputation as a painter. His friend Adam is a struggling concert pianist who's a long time associate of a famous French singer, Henri Baurel. A lonely society woman, Milo Roberts, takes Jerry under her wing and supports him, but is interested in more than his art.

Title: Stuck in Love.
Hint: A divorced novelist spies on his ex-wife while his kids navigate their own love lives.
Description: An acclaimed writer, his ex-wife, and their teenaged children come to terms with the complexities of love in all its forms over the course of one tumultuous year.

Title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
Hint: A Starfleet crew is framed for the murder of a Klingon chancellor before a peace summit.
Description: After years of war, the Federation and the Klingon empire find themselves on the brink of a peace summit when a Klingon ship is nearly destroyed by an apparent attack from the Enterprise. Both worlds brace for what may be their deadliest encounter.

Title: Chasing Amy
Hint: A comic book artist falls for a woman who likes women.
Description: Holden and Banky are comic book artists. Everything is going good for them until they meet Alyssa, also a comic book artist. Holden falls for her, but his hopes are crushed when he finds out she's a lesbian.

Title: Anthropoid
Country: Czech Republic, France, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Czech soldiers parachute in to assassinate a top Nazi official in Prague.
Description: In December 1941, Czech soldiers Jozef Gabčík and Jan Kubiš parachute into their occupied homeland to assassinate Nazi officer Reinhard Heydrich.

Title: Muriel's Wedding
Hint: An awkward young woman from a dead-end Australian town dreams of walking down the aisle.
Description: Socially awkward ___ Heslop wants nothing more than to get married. Unfortunately, due to her oppressive politician father, ___ has never even been on a date.

Title: Them!
Hint: Giant mutant ants created by nuclear testing threaten the American Southwest.
Description: As a result of nuclear testing, gigantic, ferocious mutant ants appear in the American desert southwest, and a father-daughter team of entomologists join forces with the state police officer who first discovers their existence, an FBI agent and, eventually, the US Army to eradicate the menace, before it spreads across the continent — and the world.

Title: Sleep Tight
Hint: A miserable apartment building concierge torments a cheerful tenant in secret.
Description: César, an unhappy concierge, maintains a peculiar relationship with the very diverse inhabitants of the upper-class apartment building where he works in Barcelona.

Title: The Dead Zone
Hint: A schoolteacher wakes from a five-year coma with psychic powers and sees a politician's future.
Description: Johnny Smith is a schoolteacher with his whole life ahead of him but, after leaving his fiancee's home one night, is involved in a car crash which leaves him in a coma for 5 years. When he wakes, he discovers he has an ability to see into the past, present and future life of anyone with whom he comes into physical contact.

Title: The Italian Job
Hint: A crew of British crooks plan a gold heist in Turin using Mini Coopers.
Description: Charlie's got a 'job' to do. Having just left prison he finds one of his friends has attempted a high-risk job in Torino, Italy, right under the nose of the mafia. Charlie's friend doesn't get very far, so Charlie takes over the 'job'. Using three Mini Coopers, a couple of Jaguars, and a bus, he hopes to bring Torino to a standstill, steal a fortune in gold and escape in the chaos.

Title: The Light Between Oceans
Country: India, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A lighthouse keeper and his wife raise a baby that washed ashore in a rowboat.
Description: A lighthouse keeper and his wife living off the coast of Western Australia raise a baby they rescue from an adrift rowboat.

Title: Michael Clayton
Hint: A law firm fixer faces a crisis of conscience over a toxic class-action suit.
Description: A law firm brings in its "fixer" to remedy the situation after a lawyer has a breakdown while representing a chemical company that he knows is guilty in a multi-billion dollar class action suit.

Title: The Fox and the Hound
Hint: A young red cub and a hunting dog become friends, but grow up as enemies.
Description: When a feisty little ___ named Tod is adopted into a farm family, he quickly becomes friends with a fun and adorable ___ puppy named Copper. Life is full of hilarious adventures until Copper is expected to take on his role as a hunting dog -- and the object of his search is his best friend!

Title: St. Vincent
Hint: A boy befriends his grumpy, hard-drinking, gambling Vietnam veteran neighbour who babysits him.
Description: A young boy whose parents just divorced finds an unlikely friend and mentor in the misanthropic, bawdy, hedonistic, war veteran who lives next door.

Title: Quills
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The Marquis de Sade keeps writing scandalous stories from inside an asylum.
Description: In early 19th-century France, the Marquis de Sade is confined to an asylum where his forbidden writings continue to circulate beyond its walls. As the authorities tighten control, a clash unfolds between the Marquis’ unyielding imagination, the reformist ideals of the Abbé in charge, and the repressive measures of a doctor sent to silence him.

Title: Broker
Hint: Two men who steal babies from a church box go on a road trip to sell one.
Description: Sang-hyun is always struggling from debt, and Dong-soo works at a baby box facility. On a rainy night, they steal the baby Woo-sung, who was left in the baby box, to sell him at a good price. Meanwhile, detectives were watching, and they quietly track them down to capture the crucial evidence.

Title: Born on the Fourth of July
Hint: A gung-ho Marine returns from Vietnam paralyzed and becomes an anti-war activist.
Description: Paralyzed in the Vietnam war, Ron Kovic becomes an anti-war and pro-human rights political activist after feeling betrayed by the country he fought for.

Title: The Wolf Man
Hint: A man bitten by a creature on the moors transforms on full-moon nights.
Description: After his brother's death, Larry Talbot returns home to his father and the family estate. Events soon take a turn for the worse when Larry is bitten by a werewolf.

Title: Arlington Road
Hint: A widowed professor suspects his friendly new neighbors are terrorists.
Description: Bedraggled college professor Michael Faraday has been vexed — and increasingly paranoid — since his wife's accidental death in a botched FBI operation. When a seemingly all-American couple set up house next door, Michael begins to suspect there’s more to them than meets the eye.

Title: The Tale
Hint: A woman re-examines her memory of her first sexual relationship at 13.
Description: An investigation into one woman’s memory as she‘s forced to re-examine her first sexual relationship and the stories we tell ourselves in order to survive.

Title: Go
Hint: Three stories unfold after a botched drug deal on Christmas Eve.
Description: A supermarket clerk decides to step in for an absent drug dealer, setting off an explosive, comedic chain of events.

Title: An Officer and a Spy
Hint: A French counter-intelligence chief discovers that an innocent Jewish captain has been framed for treason.
Description: In 1894, French Captain Alfred Dreyfus is wrongfully convicted of treason and sentenced to life imprisonment at the Devil’s Island penal colony.

Title: Force Majeure
Hint: A father runs from an avalanche during a ski vacation, leaving his family behind.
Description: While holidaying in the French Alps, a Swedish family deals with acts of cowardliness as an avalanche breaks out.

Title: Breakfast on Pluto
Hint: A transgender orphan from a small Irish town searches London for her mother.
Description: In the 1970s, a young transgender woman called “Kitten” leaves her small Irish town for London in search of love, acceptance, and her long-lost mother.

Title: Men of Honor
Hint: The first African American Navy master diver fights racism and a brutal trainer.
Description: Against formidable odds -- and an old-school diving instructor embittered by the U.S. Navy's new, less prejudicial policies -- Carl Brashear sets his sights on becoming the Navy's first African-American master diver in this uplifting true story. Their relationship starts out on the rocks, but fate ultimately conspires to bring the men together into a setting of mutual respect, triumph and ___.

Title: The Siege of Jadotville
Hint: A small Irish UN unit holds off thousands of mercenaries in the Congo.
Description: Irish Commandant Pat Quinlan leads a stand off with troops against French and Belgian Mercenaries in the Congo during the early 1960s.

Title: Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron
Hint: A wild mustang is captured by the cavalry and refuses to be tamed.
Description: A captured mustang remains determined to return to his herd no matter what.

Title: The Butler
Hint: A White House servant serves eight presidents during the civil rights era.
Description: Cecil Gaines was a sharecropper's son who grew up in the 1920s as a domestic servant for the white family who casually destroyed his. Eventually striking out on his own, Cecil becomes a hotel valet of such efficiency and discreteness in the 1950s that he becomes a ___ in the White House itself.

Title: Broadcast News
Hint: A neurotic TV producer is caught between a brilliant reporter and a handsome anchor.
Description: A high-strung news producer finds herself in a love triangle between a talented but self-doubting reporter and a charming news anchor who embodies the growing trivialization of news that she is determined to fight against.

Title: The Ghost Writer
Hint: A ghostwriter hired to finish a former prime minister's memoir uncovers secrets.
Description: A writer stumbles upon a long-hidden secret when he agrees to help former British Prime Minister Adam Lang complete his memoirs on a remote island after the politician's assistant drowns in a mysterious accident.

Title: Vanishing Point
Hint: A car delivery driver races across the desert in a white Challenger with cops in pursuit.
Description: Kowalski works for a car delivery service, and takes delivery of a 1970 Dodge Challenger to drive from Colorado to San Francisco. Shortly after pickup, he takes a bet to get the car there in less than 15 hours.

Title: Christopher Robin
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A grown-up who left the Hundred Acre Wood behind is visited by his childhood bear.
Description: ___, the boy who had countless adventures in the Hundred Acre Wood, has grown up and lost his way. Now it’s up to his spirited and loveable stuffed animals, Winnie The Pooh, Tigger, Piglet, and the rest of the gang, to rekindle their friendship and remind him of endless days of childlike wonder and make-believe, when doing nothing was the very best something.

Title: War Horse
Hint: A young man's beloved colt is sold to the cavalry and sent to the trenches of 1914 France.
Description: On the brink of the First World War, Albert's beloved ___ Joey is sold to the Cavalry by his father. Against the backdrop of the Great War, Joey begins an odyssey full of danger, joy, and sorrow, and he transforms everyone he meets along the way. Meanwhile, Albert, unable to forget his equine friend, searches the battlefields of France to find Joey and bring him home.

Title: Speak
Hint: A freshman stops speaking after a traumatic summer party.
Description: Freshman high-school student Melinda has refused to ___ ever since she called the cops on a popular summer party. With her old friends snubbing her for being a rat, and her parents too busy to notice her troubles, she folds into herself, trying to hide her secret: that star senior Andy raped her at the party. But Melinda does manage to find solace in her art class headed by Mr. Freeman.

Title: Brick
Hint: A high school loner investigates his ex-girlfriend's death in hardboiled noir style.
Description: A teenage loner pushes his way into the underworld of a high school crime ring to investigate the disappearance of his ex-girlfriend.

Title: Rurouni Kenshin: Final Chapter Part I - The Final
Hint: The wandering swordsman faces his brother-in-law, who seeks revenge for his sister.
Description: In 1879, ___ and his allies face their strongest enemy yet: his former brother-in-law Enishi Yukishiro and his minions, who've vowed their revenge.

Title: Pay It Forward
Hint: A 12-year-old boy starts a movement of good deeds that spreads across America.
Description: Like some other kids, 12-year-old Trevor McKinney believed in the goodness of human nature. Like many other kids, he was determined to change the world for the better. Unlike most other kids, he succeeded.

Title: About Schmidt
Hint: A recently retired man drives to his daughter's wedding in a Winnebago.
Description: A recently retired man embarks on a journey to his estranged daughter's wedding, only to discover more about himself and life than he ever expected.

Title: The Way of the Dragon
Hint: A martial artist defends a Chinese restaurant in Rome from gangsters and fights in the Colosseum.
Description: After a Chinese restaurant in Rome is threatened by the mafia, who will stop at nothing to acquire the property, the owner recruits a family friend in Hong Kong, kung fu expert Tang Lung, to help them defend their business.

Title: Along With the Gods: The Two Worlds
Hint: A firefighter who died saving a child faces seven trials in the afterlife.
Description: Having died unexpectedly, firefighter Ja-hong is taken to the afterlife by 3 afterlife guardians. Only when he passes 7 trials over 49 days and proves he was innocent in human life, he’s able to reincarnate, and his 3 afterlife guardians are by his side to defend him in trial.

Title: The Hitcher
Hint: A young driver picks up a hitchhiker who turns out to be a murderous psychopath.
Description: On a stormy night, young Jim, who transports a luxury car from Chicago to California to deliver it to its owner, feeling tired and sleepy, picks up a mysterious hitchhiker, who has appeared out of nowhere, thinking that a good conversation will help him not to fall asleep. He will have enough time to deeply regret such an unmeditated decision.

Title: The Best Exotic Marigold Hotel
Hint: British retirees move to a crumbling guesthouse in India.
Description: British retirees travel to India to take up residence in what they believe is a newly restored hotel. Less luxurious than its advertisements, the ___ Hotel nevertheless slowly begins to charm in unexpected ways as the residents find new purpose in their old age.

Title: Animal Kingdom
Hint: A teenager moves in with his criminal family in Melbourne.
Description: Joshua “J” is taken in by his extended family after his mother dies of an overdose. The clan, ruled by J’s scheming grandmother, is heavily involved in criminal activities, and J is soon indoctrinated into their way of life. But J is given a chance to take another path when a cop seeks to help him.

Title: The Outlaws (Beomjoidosi)
Hint: A tough cop takes on violent Chinese gangsters in Seoul's Chinatown.
Description: In Chinatown, law and order is turned upside down when a trio of feral Chinese gangsters arrive, start terrorizing civilians, and usurping territory. The beleaguered local gangsters team up with the police, lead by the badass loose cannon Ma Seok-do, to bring them down. Based on a true story.

Title: The Misfits
Hint: A divorcée falls in with aging cowboys who capture wild mustangs.
Description: While filing for a divorce, beautiful ex-stripper Roslyn Taber ends up meeting aging cowboy-turned-gambler Gay Langland and former World War II aviator Guido Racanelli. The two men instantly become infatuated with Roslyn and, on a whim, the three decide to move into Guido's half-finished desert home together.

Title: Bad Boys
Hint: Two Miami narcotics detectives switch identities to protect a witness to a murder.
Description: Marcus Burnett is a henpecked family man. Mike Lowrey is a footloose and fancy free ladies' man. Both Miami policemen, they have 72 hours to reclaim a consignment of drugs stolen from under their station's nose. To complicate matters, in order to get the assistance of the sole witness to a murder, they have to pretend to be each other.

Title: Horror of Dracula
Hint: A vampire preys on the family of the man who tried to kill him.
Description: After Jonathan Harker attacks ___ at his castle, the vampire travels to a nearby city, where he preys on the family of Harker's fiancée. The only one who may be able to protect them is Dr. van Helsing, Harker's friend and fellow-student of vampires, who is determined to destroy ___, whatever the cost.

Title: Magnum Force
Hint: A tough San Francisco cop hunts a death squad of rogue cops.
Description: "Dirty" Harry Callahan is a San Francisco Police Inspector on the trail of a group of rogue cops who have taken justice into their own hands. When shady characters are murdered one after another in grisly fashion, only Dirty Harry can stop them.

Title: Dumbo
Hint: A baby elephant with enormous ears is mocked at the circus until he learns to fly.
Description: ___ is a baby elephant born with over-sized ears and a supreme lack of confidence. But thanks to his even more diminutive buddy Timothy the Mouse, the pint-sized pachyderm learns to surmount all obstacles.

Title: The Kerala Story
Hint: Young women lured by a new faith are trafficked across borders to serve a terrorist group.
Description: A converted Muslim woman narrates her ordeal of how she once wanted to become a nurse but was abducted from her home and manipulated by religious vanguards and turned into an ISIS terrorist and landed in Afghanistan jail.

Title: Candy
Country: France, Italy, United States of America
Hint: A naive blonde teenager wanders through a parade of absurd, lecherous men in this psychedelic satire.
Description: A high school girl encounters a variety of kookie characters and humorous sexual situations while searching for the meaning of life.

Title: The Wife
Country: Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A long-suffering spouse questions her life as she travels to Stockholm with her Nobel Prize-winning husband.
Description: A ___ questions her life choices as she travels to Stockholm with her husband, where he is slated to receive the Nobel Prize for Literature.

Title: Crazy Heart
Hint: A boozy, washed-up country singer finds a shot at redemption with a young journalist and her son.
Description: When reporter Jean Craddock interviews Bad Blake—an alcoholic, seen-better-days country music legend—they connect, and the hard-living crooner sees a possible saving grace in a life with Jean and her young son.

Title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A self-taught clerk from Madras sends dazzling formulas to Cambridge and changes mathematics.
Description: Growing up poor in Madras, India, Srinivasa Ramanujan Iyengar earns admittance to Cambridge University during WWI, where he becomes a pioneer in mathematical theories with the guidance of his professor, G.H. Hardy.

Title: Love & Basketball
Hint: Two childhood neighbors who both live for the hardwood fall in love over the years.
Description: Monica Wright and Quincy McCall grew up in the same neighborhood and have known each other since childhood. As they grow into adulthood, they fall in love, but they also share another all-consuming passion: ___. As Quincy and Monica struggle to make their relationship work, they follow separate career paths though high school and college ___ and, they hope, into stardom in big-league professional ball.

Title: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea
Hint: A ship hunting a monster is captured by a brooding captain and his futuristic submarine.
Description: A ship sent to investigate a wave of mysterious sinkings encounters the advanced submarine, the Nautilus, commanded by Captain Nemo.

Title: Django
Hint: A coffin-dragging gunslinger is embroiled in a feud between a Mexican gang and racists.
Description: A coffin-dragging gunslinger and a prostitute become embroiled in a bitter feud between a merciless masked clan and a band of Mexican revolutionaries.

Title: State of Grace
Hint: An undercover cop returns to Hell's Kitchen and is torn between his old gang and the law.
Description: Hell's Kitchen, New York. Terry Noonan returns home after a ten-year absence. He soon reconnects with Jackie, a childhood friend and member of the Irish mob, and rekindles his love affair with Jackie's sister Kathleen.

Title: Honey Boy
Hint: A child actor relives his chaotic years in a motel with his volatile ex-clown father.
Description: The story of a child star attempting to mend his relationship with his law-breaking, alcohol-abusing father over the course of a decade, loosely based on Shia LaBeouf’s life.

Title: The Mighty
Hint: A big, slow boy and his tiny, brilliant friend become modern-day knights in their neighborhood.
Description: Kevin, an intelligent guy helps out Maxwell to improve his reading skills. In return, Kevin wants Maxwell to take him out places since he is not authorized to go out. Being the social outcasts of the town, Kevin and Maxwell come to realize that they are similar to each other and accept that they are "freaks" and nothing will stop them.

Title: Angst
Hint: A freshly released killer breaks into a remote house, and the camera never leaves his side.
Description: A killer is released from prison and breaks into a remote home to kill a woman, her handicapped son and her pretty daughter.

Title: Wonder Boys
Country: Germany, Japan, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A stoned writing professor spends a wild weekend with a dead dog and a stolen jacket.
Description: Grady is a 50-ish English professor who hasn't had a thing published in years—not since he wrote his award winning 'Great American Novel' 7 years ago. This weekend proves even worse than he could imagine as he finds himself reeling from one misadventure to another in the company of a new ___ boy author.

Title: Fist of Fury
Hint: A furious martial arts student avenges his poisoned teacher in occupied Shanghai.
Description: During the Japanese occupation of Shanghai, Chen Zhen, the star pupil of a recently-deceased martial arts teacher battles a Japanese dojo which seeks the demise of his fighting school.

Title: Wish Dragon
Genres: Animation, Family, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Adventure
Country: United States of America, China, Czech Republic
Hint: A teen in Shanghai meets a sassy magic serpent who grants three wishes.
Description: Determined teen Din is longing to reconnect with his childhood best friend when he meets a ___-granting ___ who shows him the magic of possibilities.

Title: In Harm's Way
Hint: A naval officer reprimanded after Pearl Harbor is promoted to lead a task force.
Description: A Naval officer, reprimanded after Pearl Harbor, is later promoted to Rear Admiral and gets a second chance to prove himself against the Japanese.

Title: A Mighty Wind
Hint: Three eclectic, never-quite-famous folk bands reunite for a memorial concert, in a mockumentary.
Description: Three eclectic, never-quite-famous folk bands come together for the first time in decades following the death of their manager to put on an reunion concert in his honor, at the request of his son.

Title: The Witcher: Nightmare of the Wolf
Country: Poland, South Korea, United States of America
Hint: A cocky monster hunter battles creatures and corrupt mages in an animated prequel to a fantasy saga.
Description: Escaping from poverty to become a ___, Vesemir slays monsters for coin and glory, but when a new menace rises, he must face the demons of his past.

Title: Children of a Lesser God
Hint: A teacher at a school for the deaf falls for a proud young woman who refuses to speak.
Description: Starting his new job as an instructor at a New England school for the deaf, James Leeds meets Sarah Norman, a young deaf woman who works at the school as a member of the custodial staff. In spite of Sarah's withdrawn emotional state, a romance slowly develops between the pair.

Hint: A young British soldier is abandoned on the streets of Belfast during a riot and must survive the night.
Description: A young British soldier must find his way back to safety after his unit accidentally abandons him during a riot in the streets of Belfast.

Title: Ruby Sparks
Hint: A blocked novelist writes his dream woman into existence, and can change her with a keyboard.
Description: Calvin is a young novelist who achieved phenomenal success early in his career but is now struggling with his writing – as well as his romantic life. Finally, he makes a breakthrough and creates a character named ___ who inspires him. When Calvin finds ___, in the flesh, sitting on his couch about a week later, he is completely flabbergasted that his words have turned into a living, breathing person.

Title: Dope
Hint: A geeky Inglewood teen obsessed with 90s hip-hop ends up with a backpack full of drugs.
Description: Malcolm is carefully surviving life in a tough neighborhood in Los Angeles while juggling college applications, academic interviews, and the SAT. A chance invitation to an underground party leads him into an adventure that could allow him to go from being a geek, to being ___, to ultimately being himself.

Title: Cat People
Hint: A shy Serbian immigrant fears that love will turn her into a deadly panther.
Description: A Serbian émigré in Manhattan believes that, because of an ancient curse, any physical intimacy with the man she loves will turn her into a feline predator.

Title: The Hudsucker Proxy
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A naive business graduate is installed as president of a company by a scheming board.
Description: A naive business graduate is installed as president of a manufacturing company as part of a stock scam.

Title: Apollo 10½: A Space Age Childhood
Hint: A boy in 1969 Houston imagines being secretly sent to the moon by NASA.
Description: A man narrates stories of his life as a 10-year-old boy in 1969 Houston, weaving tales of nostalgia with a fantastical account of a journey to the moon.

Title: Department Q: The Keeper of Lost Causes
Hint: A grumpy detective is sent to a basement cold-case unit and reopens a missing politician case.
Description: Denmark, 2013. Police officers Carl Mørck and Hafez el-Assad, sole members of ___, which is focused on closing cold cases, investigate the disappearance of politician Merete Lynggaard, vanished when she and her brother were traveling aboard a ferry five years ago.

Title: Old Yeller
Hint: A Texas farm boy reluctantly bonds with a scruffy stray dog that protects his family while his father is away.
Description: Young Travis Coates is left to take care of the family ranch with his mother and younger brother while his father goes off on a cattle drive in the 1860s. When a yellow mongrel comes for an uninvited stay with the family, Travis reluctantly adopts the dog.

Title: Waterloo
Hint: An exiled emperor escapes and leads his army into one last, decisive battle in Belgium.
Description: After defeating France and imprisoning Napoleon on Elba, ending two decades of war, Europe is shocked to find Napoleon has escaped and has caused the French Army to defect from the King back to him. The best of the British generals, the Duke of Wellington, beat Napolean's best generals in Spain and Portugal, but now must beat Napoleon himself with an Anglo Allied army.

Title: Dolemite Is My Name
Hint: A struggling comedian creates a rhyming pimp persona and makes his own outrageous film.
Description: The story of Rudy Ray Moore, who created the iconic big screen pimp character ___ in the 1970s.

Title: Minamata
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An American war photographer documents mercury poisoning in a Japanese fishing town.
Description: War photographer W. Eugene Smith travels back to Japan where he documents the devastating effect of mercury poisoning in coastal communities.

Title: Words on Bathroom Walls
Hint: A teen with schizophrenia hides his illness from the girl he loves at a new school.
Description: Diagnosed with a mental illness halfway through his senior year of high school, a witty, introspective teen struggles to keep it a secret while falling in love with a brilliant classmate who inspires him to open his heart and not be defined by his condition.

Title: Birdy
Hint: Two friends are scarred by Vietnam, and one retreats into his obsession with flight.
Description: Two young men are seriously affected by the Vietnam War. One of them has always been obsessed with birds - but now believes he really is a bird, and has been sent to a mental hospital. Can his friend help him pull through?

Title: Hard Times
Hint: A silent drifter earns money in bare-knuckle street fights during the Depression.
Description: In the depression, Chaney, a strong silent streetfighter, joins with Speed, a promoter of no-holds-barred street boxing bouts. They go to New Orleans where Speed borrows money to set up fights for Chaney, but Speed gambles away any winnings.

Title: Fahrenheit 451
Hint: A fireman whose job is burning books secretly starts to read them.
Description: In the future, the government maintains control of public opinion by outlawing literature and maintaining a group of enforcers, known as “firemen,” to perform the necessary book burnings. Fireman Montag begins to question the morality of his vocation…

Title: Harry Brown
Hint: An elderly ex-Marine takes justice into his own hands against a violent estate gang.
Description: An elderly ex-serviceman and widower looks to avenge his best friend's murder by doling out his own form of justice.

Title: Testament of Youth
Country: Denmark, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young woman gives up Oxford to nurse wounded soldiers in the Great War.
Description: ___ is a powerful story of love, war and remembrance, based on the First World War memoir by Vera Brittain, which has become the classic testimony of that war from a woman’s point of view. A searing journey from youthful hopes and dreams to the edge of despair and back again, it’s a film about young love, the futility of war and how to make sense of the darkest times.

Title: Smoke Signals
Hint: Two young men from an Idaho reservation travel to collect the ashes of one's father.
Description: Young Native American man Thomas is a nerd in his reservation, wearing oversize glasses and telling everyone stories no-one wants to hear. His parents died in a fire in 1976, and Thomas was saved by Arnold. Arnold soon left his family, and Victor hasn't seen his father for 10 years. When Victor hears Arnold has died, Thomas offers him funding for the trip to get Arnold's remains.

Title: The Beguiled
Hint: A wounded Union soldier is taken in at a Southern girls' school, and desire turns deadly.
Description: During the Civil War, at a Southern girls’ boarding school, young women take in an injured enemy soldier. As they provide refuge and tend to his wounds, the house is taken over with sexual tension and dangerous rivalries, and taboos are broken in an unexpected turn of events.

Title: El Topo
Hint: A gunslinger in black rides through a surreal desert to defeat four masters.
Description: ___ decides to confront warrior Masters on a trans-formative desert journey he begins with his 6 year old son, who must bury his childhood totems to become a man.

Title: Secretariat
Hint: A housewife takes over her father's stables and races a champion colt into history.
Description: Housewife and mother Penny Chenery agrees to take over her ailing father's Virginia-based Meadow Stables, despite her lack of horse-racing knowledge. Against all odds, Chenery - with the help of veteran trainer Lucien Laurin - manages to navigate the male-dominated business, ultimately fostering the first Triple Crown winner in 25 years.

Title: Reversal of Fortune
Country: Japan, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A wealthy man accused of trying to kill his wife hires a law professor to win his appeal.
Description: Wealthy Sunny von Bülow lies brain-dead, husband Claus guilty of attempted murder; but he says he's innocent and hires Alan Dershowitz for his appeal.

Title: Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani
Hint: A shy, studious woman falls for a free-spirited traveller on a Himalayan trek, and they meet again years later at a wedding.
Description: On a trekking trip, an introverted Naina falls for a charming ex-classmate, whose thirst for adventure drives them apart. Years later, their paths cross again.

Title: Strictly Ballroom
Hint: An Australian dancer breaks the competition rules with his own flashy steps.
Description: Brave new steps put Scott's career in jeopardy. With a new partner and determination, can he still succeed?

Title: Conviction
Hint: A woman puts herself through law school to free her wrongfully convicted brother.
Description: When Betty Anne Waters' older brother Kenny is arrested for murder and sentenced to life in 1983, Betty Anne, a Massachusetts wife and mother of two, dedicates her life to overturning the murder ___. Convinced that her brother is innocent, Betty Anne puts herself through high school, college and, finally, law school in an 18 year quest to free Kenny.

Title: The Brave Little Toaster
Hint: Household appliances left behind in a summer cabin travel to find their young owner.
Description: A group of dated appliances, finding themselves stranded in a summer home that their family had just sold, decide to seek out their eight year old 'master'.

Title: Paris, je t'aime
Country: France, Liechtenstein, Switzerland, Germany, United States of America
Hint: Twenty short love stories, each set in a different neighborhood of the French capital.
Description: Olivier Assayas, Gus Van Sant, Wes Craven and Alfonso Cuaron are among the 20 distinguished directors who contribute to this collection of 18 stories, each exploring a different aspect of Parisian life. The colourful characters in this drama include a pair of mimes, a husband trying to choose between his wife and his lover, and a married man who turns to a prostitute for advice.

Title: The Sessions
Hint: A poet in an iron lung hires a sex surrogate to lose his virginity.
Description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself.

Title: The Woodsman
Hint: A man released after twelve years in prison struggles to resist his dark urges.
Description: After twelve years in prison, Walter returns home. His family has abandoned him, save for his brother-in-law. Few know he's a sex offender and pedophile. Walter finds an apartment and is regularly visited by his parole officer. He gets a job at a lumber mill and starts seeing a coworker.

Title: Stan & Ollie
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An aging comedy duo embarks on a final tour of British theaters.
Description: With their golden era long behind them, comedy duo ___ Laurel and Oliver Hardy embark on a variety hall tour of Britain and Ireland. Despite the pressures of a hectic schedule, and with the support of their wives Lucille and Ida – a formidable double act in their own right – the pair's love of performing, as well as for each other, endures as they secure their place in the hearts of their adoring public

Title: The Transformers: The Movie
Genres: Animation, Science Fiction, Action, Adventure, Family
Hint: Robots in disguise fight a planet-sized robot that devours worlds.
Description: The Autobots must stop a colossal planet-consuming robot who goes after the Autobot Matrix of Leadership. At the same time, they must defend themselves against an all-out attack from the Decepticons.

Title: Girl
Hint: A transgender teen dancer pushes her body to the limit at a prestigious ballet school.
Description: A promising teenage dancer enrolls at a prestigious ballet school while grappling with her gender dysphoria.

Title: Dogman
Hint: A gentle dog groomer in a rundown seaside town is bullied by a violent friend.
Description: Marcello, a small and gentle dog groomer, finds himself involved in a dangerous relationship of subjugation with Simone, a former violent boxer who terrorizes the entire neighborhood. In an effort to reaffirm his dignity, Marcello will submit to an unexpected act of vengeance.

Title: Mom
Hint: A mother seeks quiet, brutal revenge on the men who assaulted her stepdaughter.
Description: After her stepdaughter is sexually assaulted at a party, a furious mother sets out to destroy the lives of the four perpetrators who walked free.

Title: The Great Race
Genres: Comedy, Adventure, Action, Romance, Western, Family
Hint: A dashing daredevil in white and his villainous black-clad rival compete in a madcap automobile contest from New York to Paris.
Description: Professional daredevil and white-suited hero, The Great Leslie, convinces turn-of-the-century auto makers that a race from New York to Paris (westward across America, the Bering Straight and Russia) will help to promote automobile sales. Leslie's arch-rival, the mustached and black-attired Professor Fate vows to beat Leslie to the finish line in a car of Fate's own invention.

Title: The Secret Life of Bees
Hint: A girl runs away to live with three beekeeping sisters in 1960s South Carolina.
Description: Set in South Carolina in 1964, this is the tale of Lily Owens a 14 year-old girl who is haunted by the memory of her late mother. To escape her lonely life and troubled relationship with her father, Lily flees with Rosaleen, her caregiver and only friend, to a South Carolina town that holds the secret to her mother's past.

Title: Eight Men Out
Hint: Chicago ballplayers take bribes to throw the 1919 World Series.
Description: Buck Weaver and Hap Felsch are young idealistic players on the Chicago White Sox, a pennant-winning team owned by Charles Comiskey - a penny-pinching, hands-on manager who underpays his players and treats them with disdain. And when gamblers and hustlers discover that Comiskey's demoralized players are ripe for a money-making scheme, one by one the team members agree to throw the World Series.

Title: Nightwatch
Hint: A law student working nights at a morgue becomes a murder suspect.
Description: A law student takes a job as a night watchman at a morgue and begins to discover clues that implicate him as the suspect in a series of murders.

Title: Quadrophenia
Hint: A young mod in 1960s London fights rockers on the beach and loses his way.
Description: Based on the 1973 rock opera album of the same name by The Who, this is the story of 60s teenager Jimmy. At work he slaves in a dead-end job. While after, he shops for tailored suits and rides his scooter as part of the London Mod scene.

Title: Mother and Child
Hint: Three women's lives are quietly connected by an adoption decades ago.
Description: The lives of three women have a commonality: adoption. Karen is a physical therapist who regrets that, as a teenager, she gave up her daughter for adoption. Elizabeth was an adopted child and is now a successful lawyer, but her personal life lacks warmth. Lucy and her husband have failed to conceive and now hope to adopt a baby to make their family complete.

Title: Che: Part One
Country: United States of America, Spain, France
Hint: An Argentine doctor joins a band of rebels in the Cuban mountains.
Description: Ernesto Guevara, known as '___', leads a group of Cuban exiles under Fidel Castro in a revolution to overthrow Fulgencio Batista, the dictator of Cuba.

Title: Final Fantasy VII: Advent Children
Genres: Animation, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science Fiction
Hint: A former soldier must protect his ruined city from a mysterious plague and silver-haired foes.
Description: Two years have passed since the final battle with Sephiroth. Though Midgar, city of mako, city of prosperity, has been reduced to ruins, its people slowly but steadily walk the road to reconstruction. However, a mysterious illness called Geostigma torments them. With no cure in sight, it brings death to the afflicted, one after another, robbing the people of their fledgling hope.

Title: Pat Garrett & Billy the Kid
Hint: A sheriff is hired to hunt down his old outlaw friend in New Mexico.
Description: ___ is hired as a lawman on behalf of a group of wealthy New Mexico cattle barons to bring down his old friend ___ the Kid.

Title: Manderlay
Country: Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Netherlands, Sweden, United Kingdom, Italy
Hint: An idealistic woman tries to free an Alabama plantation where slavery never ended.
Description: In 1933, a young woman and her father discover an Alabama plantation whose inhabitants live as if slavery had never been abolished. Feeling a sense of duty to those behind the heavy gates, she stays to liberate the people and see them through their first harvest. With four of her father's colleagues and a lawyer, she faces the daunting task of resurrecting the place known as ___.

Title: Beasts of the Southern Wild
Hint: A six-year-old girl and her ailing father live in a flooded bayou at the edge of the world.
Description: Hushpuppy, an intrepid six-year-old girl, lives with her father, Wink, in 'the Bathtub', a ___ Delta community at the edge of the world. Wink’s tough love prepares her for the unraveling of the universe—for a time when he’s no longer there to protect her.

Title: The Madness of King George
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An aging British monarch begins showing signs of mental illness, and his scheming son sees a chance to seize power.
Description: Aging King George III of England is exhibiting signs of ___, a problem little understood in 1788. As the monarch alternates between bouts of confusion and near-violent outbursts of temper, his hapless doctors attempt the ineffectual cures of the day.

Title: Beginners
Hint: A shy graphic designer recalls how his elderly father came out as gay after his mother died.
Description: Oliver meets the irreverent and unpredictable Anna only months after his father Hal Fields has passed away. This new love floods Oliver with memories of his father, who, following the death of his wife of 44 years, came out of the closet at age 75 to live a full, energized, and wonderfully tumultuous gay life – which included a younger boyfriend.

Title: Glory Road
Hint: A coach leads the first all-Black starting lineup to a college basketball title.
Description: In 1966, Texas Western coach Don Haskins led the first all-black starting line-up for a college basketball team to the NCAA national championship.

Title: Talaash: The Answer Lies Within
Hint: A grieving cop investigating a film star's crash meets a mysterious sex worker.
