Description: A cop, investigating the mysterious death of a filmstar, meets a sex-worker, while he faces some personal problems psychologically. The mystery connects these people in a way, that ultimately changes their lives.

Title: Rescued by Ruby
Hint: A state trooper and an unruly rescue dog become an unlikely search-and-rescue team.
Description: Chasing his dream to join an elite K-9 unit, a state trooper partners with a fellow underdog: clever but naughty shelter pup ___. Based on a true story.

Title: The Physician
Hint: A boy in medieval England disguises himself as a Jew to study medicine in Persia.
Description: England, 1021: Born in a miserable mining town, Robert Cole swears to become a ___ and vanquish disease and death. His harsh path of many years, a quest for knowledge besieged by countless challenges and sacrifices, leads him to the remote Isfahan, in Persia, where he meets Ibn Sina, the greatest healer of his time.

Title: First They Killed My Father
Hint: A five-year-old girl survives the Khmer Rouge genocide in Cambodia.
Description: A 5-year-old girl embarks on a harrowing quest for survival amid the sudden rise and terrifying reign of the Khmer Rouge in Cambodia.

Title: Animal Farm
Hint: Livestock revolt against their owner, but the pigs soon act like the old master.
Description: Animals on a farm lead a revolution against the farmers to put their destiny in their own hands. However this revolution eats their own children and they cannot avoid corruption.

Title: Barbara
Hint: A Berlin doctor is banished to a country clinic and watched by the Stasi.
Description: In 1980s East Germany, Berlin doctor ___ is banished to a country medical clinic for applying for an exit visa. Deeply unhappy with her reassignment and fearful of her co-workers as possible Stasi informants, ___ stays aloof, especially from the good-natured clinic head, Andre.

Title: Eve's Bayou
Hint: A girl in 1960s Louisiana sees her charming father with another woman.
Description: Summer heats up in rural Louisiana beside Eve’s ___, 1962, as the Batiste family tries to survive the secrets they’ve kept and the betrayals they’ve endured.

Title: Julius Caesar
Hint: Roman senators plot to assassinate an ambitious ruler on the Ides of March.
Description: The growing ambition of ___ is a source of major concern to his close friend Brutus. Cassius persuades him to participate in his plot to assassinate ___ but both have sorely underestimated Mark Antony.

Title: Black Box
Hint: A father undergoes an experimental treatment to recover his memory, and finds someone else inside.
Description: After losing his wife and his memory in a car accident, a single father undergoes an experimental treatment that causes him to question who he really is.

Title: Polytechnique
Hint: A gunman targets female engineering students in 1989 Montreal.
Description: A dramatization of the Montreal Massacre of 1989 where several female engineering students were murdered by an unstable misogynist.

Title: Wristcutters: A Love Story
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A heartbroken man who took his life finds an afterlife that's just a little worse than Earth.
Description: Zia, distraught over breaking up with his girlfriend, decides to end it all. Unfortunately, he discovers that there is no real ending, only a run-down afterlife that is strikingly similar to his old one, just a bit worse. Discovering that his ex-girlfriend has also "offed" herself, he sets out on a road trip to find her.

Title: The Good, the Bad, the Weird
Hint: Three outlaws race for a treasure map across 1930s Manchuria.
Description: The story of three Korean outlaws in 1930s Manchuria and their dealings with the Japanese army and Chinese and Russian bandits. The Good (a bounty hunter), the Bad (a hitman), and the ___ (a thief) battle the army and the bandits in a race to use a treasure map to uncover the riches of legend.

Title: Cactus Flower
Hint: A dentist pretends to be married to avoid commitment, then needs a fake wife.
Description: A dentist pretends to be married to avoid commitment, but when he falls for his girlfriend and proposes, he must recruit his lovelorn nurse to pose as his wife.

Title: The Ipcress File
Hint: A bespectacled, sardonic spy investigates the kidnapping of British scientists.
Description: Sly and dry intelligence agent Harry Palmer is tasked with investigating British Intelligence security, and is soon enmeshed in a world of double-dealing, kidnap and murder when he finds a traitor operating at the heart of the secret service.

Title: El Cid
Country: Italy, Spain, United States of America
Hint: A Castilian knight battles the Moors and wins the love of his people in medieval Spain.
Description: Epic film of the legendary Spanish hero, Rodrigo Diaz ("___" to his followers), who, without compromising his strict sense of honour, still succeeds in taking the initiative and driving the Moors from Spain.

Title: Broken Embraces
Hint: A blind screenwriter recalls the tragic love affair that cost him his sight.
Description: Harry Caine, a blind writer, reaches this moment in time when he has to heal his wounds from 14 years back. He was then still known by his real name, Mateo Blanco, and directing his last movie.

Title: Arizona Dream
Hint: A dreamy young man gets caught up in his uncle's car business and loves an eccentric widow.
Description: Rebellious young Axel Blackmar gets caught up into the family car business when his cousin, Paul, coaxes him to come to ___ to attend the wedding of their Uncle Leo. As Axel makes the decision to try selling Cadillacs with his family, he meets an eccentric woman named Elaine and her equally quirky stepdaughter, Grace. Their lives become inextricably intertwined through romance, dreams – and death.

Title: The Green Butchers
Hint: Two meat-shop workers accidentally start selling human flesh, and it's a big hit.
Description: Svend and Bjarne work for a butcher in a small Danish town. Fed up with their boss' arrogance, they decide to start their own butcher shop. After dismal beginnings, an unfortunate accident happens which coincides with a large order of meat. One hasty decision leads to another and soon the business thrives.

Title: Peaceful Warrior
Hint: A cocky gymnast meets a mysterious gas station attendant who teaches him how to live.
Description: A chance encounter with a stranger changes the life of a college gymnast.

Title: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part One
Hint: A young caped vigilante hunts a killer who strikes only on holidays.
Description: Following a brutal series of murders taking place on ___, Thanksgiving, and Christmas, Gotham City's young vigilante known as the ___ sets out to pursue the mysterious serial killer alongside police officer James Gordon and district attorney Harvey Dent.

Title: Merry Christmas Mr. Lawrence
Hint: A defiant British officer clashes with a Japanese camp commander in wartime Java.
Description: Island of Java, 1942, during World War II. British Major Jack Celliers arrives at a Japanese prison camp, run by the strict Captain Yonoi. Colonel John ___, who has a profound knowledge of Japanese culture, and Sergeant Hara, brutal and simpleton, will witness the struggle of wills between two men from very different backgrounds who are tragically destined to clash.

Title: Compartment No. 6
Hint: A young Finnish archaeology student shares a train sleeper to Murmansk with a rough Russian miner.
Description: A young Finnish woman escapes an enigmatic love affair in Moscow by boarding a train to the arctic port of Murmansk. Forced to share the long ride and a tiny sleeping car with a larger than life Russian miner, the unexpected encounter leads the occupants of ___ to face major truths about human connection.

Title: The Club
Hint: Disgraced priests live hidden in a seaside house in Chile until a stranger arrives.
Description: In a secluded house in a small seaside town live four unrelated men and the woman who tends to the house and their needs. All former priests, they have been sent to this quiet exile to purge the sins of their pasts, the separation from their communities the worst form of punishment by the Church.

Title: Certified Copy
Hint: A writer and a woman in Tuscany slowly start acting like a long-married couple.
Description: In Tuscany to promote his latest book, a middle-aged English writer meets a French woman who leads him to the village of Lucignano.

Title: In the Valley of Elah
Hint: A retired military cop searches for his son who vanished after returning from Iraq.
Description: A career officer and his wife work with a police detective to uncover the truth behind their son's disappearance following his return from a tour of duty in Iraq.

Title: Mean Creek
Hint: Teenagers plan a prank on a bully during a boat trip, and it goes horribly wrong.
Description: Teenagers living in small-town Oregon take a boat trip for a birthday celebration. When they get an idea to play a ___ trick on the town bully, it suddenly goes too far. Soon they're forced to deal with the unexpected consequences of their actions.

Title: Broken
Hint: Three English families' lives intertwine on one suburban street, with tragic consequences.
Description: Three suburban English families' lives intertwine with tragic consequences.

Title: The Pink Panther Strikes Again
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A bumbling French inspector's former boss goes mad and builds a doomsday weapon to get rid of him.
Description: Charles Dreyfus, who has finally cracked over inspector Clouseau's antics, escapes from a mental institution and launches an elaborate plan to get rid of Clouseau once and for all.

Title: Drowning by Numbers
Hint: Three women with the same name drown their husbands while a coroner covers it up.
Description: Cissie Colpitts drowns her cheating husband and, in the ensuing cover-up, enlists the help of lonely coroner Henry Madgett, an old friend with a longstanding weakness for her charms.

Title: Defending Your Life
Hint: A man who just died must defend his life choices in a cosmic courtroom.
Description: Is there love after death? After he dies suddenly, the hapless advertising executive Daniel Miller finds himself in Judgment City, a gleaming way station where the newly deceased must prove they lived a life of sufficient courage to advance in their journey through the universe.

Title: Babyteeth
Hint: A terminally ill teen falls for a small-time drug dealer, horrifying her parents.
Description: A terminally ill teen upsets her parents when she falls in love with a small-time drug dealer.

Title: Memoir of a Murderer
Hint: A former serial killer with Alzheimer's suspects his daughter's boyfriend is a killer too.
Description: A former serial killer with Alzheimer's fights to protect his daughter from her mysterious boyfriend who may be a serial killer too.

Title: Scarecrow
Hint: Two drifters bum their way across America dreaming of opening a car wash.
Description: Two drifters bum around, visit earthy women and discuss opening a car wash in Pittsburgh.

Title: Petta
Hint: A hostel warden becomes the target of a politician, but he has a violent past.
Description: A hostel warden becomes the target of a dreaded politician and his gangster son, but little do they realise that it is they who should fear him.

Title: Private Life
Hint: A New York couple in their forties tries everything to have a baby.
Description: Richard and Rachel, a couple in the throes of infertility, try to maintain their marriage as they descend deeper and deeper into the insular world of assisted reproduction and domestic adoption.

Title: Ittefaq
Hint: A cop investigates a double murder with two witnesses telling two different stories.
Description: Police officer Dev investigates a double murder case that has only two witnesses - an acclaimed writer Vikram and a young homemaker Maya, who also happen to be the prime suspects in the case. He finds himself being torn between their own version's of what happened on the fateful night, and takes it upon himself to figure out the real story and capture the real murderer.

Title: Brassed Off
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A colliery brass band keeps playing as their Yorkshire mine faces closure.
Description: A Yorkshire coal mine is threatened with closure and the only hope is for the men to enter their Grimley Colliery Brass Band into a national competition. They believe they have no hope until Gloria appears carrying her Flugelhorn. At first mocked for being a woman, she soon becomes the only chance for the band to win.

Title: Operation Petticoat
Hint: A submarine commander in World War II is stuck with a crew of nurses and a pink sub.
Description: A World War II submarine commander finds himself stuck with a damaged sub, a con-man executive officer, and a group of army nurses.

Title: The Uninvited
Hint: Siblings buy a cheap cliff-top house in Cornwall that turns out to be haunted.
Description: A pair of siblings from London [Ray Milland and Ruth Hussey] purchase a surprisingly affordable, lonely cliff-top house in Cornwall, England. Only to discover that it actually carries a ghostly price, and soon they’re caught up in a bizarre romantic triangle from beyond the grave.

Title: Death and the Maiden
Hint: A former political prisoner believes her husband's dinner guest once tortured her.
Description: A political activist is convinced that her guest is a man who once tortured her for the government.

Title: Grand Prix
Country: United States of America, France, United Kingdom, Netherlands, Italy, Belgium, Monaco
Hint: Daredevil drivers compete for the Formula One championship across Europe.
Description: The most daring drivers in the world have gathered to compete for the 1966 Formula One championship. After a spectacular wreck in the first of a series of races, American wheelman Pete Aron is dropped by his sponsor. Refusing to quit, he joins a Japanese racing team.

Title: The Science of Sleep
Hint: A shy young man's vivid dreams blend with reality as he falls for his neighbor.
Description: A man entranced by his dreams and imagination is lovestruck with a French woman and feels he can show her his world.

Title: Wild Bill
Hint: The life of a legendary gunslinger who met his end at a poker table.
Description: Biopic about famous gunslinger ___ Hickock. The early career of legendary lawman is telescoped and culminates in his relocation in Deadwood and a reunion with Calamity Jane.

Title: Operation Condor
Hint: A Hong Kong treasure hunter searches the Sahara for buried Nazi gold, with three women in tow.
Description: Hired by a Spanish baron, Hong Kong treasure hunter Jackie, a.k.a. "Asian Hawk" and his entourage seek WWII Nazi gold buried in the Sahara Desert.

Title: Mongol: The Rise of Genghis Khan
Hint: A boy enslaved on the steppes grows up to become the most feared conqueror in history.
Description: The story recounts the early life of ___, a slave who went on to conquer half the world in the 11th century.

Title: Diva
Hint: A young Parisian postman secretly records an opera singer who has never allowed recordings, and gangsters chase him.
Description: Jules, a young Parisian postman, secretly records a concert performance given by the opera singer Cynthia Hawkins, whom he idolises. The following day, Jules runs into a woman who is being pursued by armed thugs. Before she is killed, the woman slips an audio cassette into his mail bag...

Title: The Spanish Prisoner
Hint: An inventor of a secret process is betrayed by everyone around him.
Description: An inventor of a secret process suddenly finds himself alone as both his friends and the corporation he works for turn against him.

Title: Bajirao Mastani
Hint: A Maratha general falls in love with a warrior princess, defying his family.
Description: Peshwa ___ married to Kashibai, falls in love with ___, a warrior princess in distress. They struggle to make their love triumph amid opposition from his conservative family.

Title: Raat Akeli Hai
Hint: A misfit cop investigates the murder of a newly married landlord in a creepy mansion.
Description: When a newly married landlord is murdered, a misfit cop’s investigation is complicated by the victim’s secretive family and his own conflicted heart.

Title: Gentleman's Agreement
Hint: A magazine writer poses as a Jew to expose anti-Semitism in polite society.
Description: A magazine writer poses as a Jew to expose anti-Semitism.

Title: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part Two
Hint: The vigilante struggles to catch a holiday-themed killer as a prosecutor turns monstrous.
Description: As Gotham City's young vigilante, the ___, struggles to pursue a brutal serial killer, district attorney Harvey Dent gets caught in a feud involving the criminal family of the Falcones.

Title: Lean on Pete
Hint: A neglected teen runs away with an aging racehorse to save it from slaughter.
Description: Charley Thompson, a teenager living with his single father, gets a summer job working for horse trainer Del Montgomery. Bonding with an aging racehorse named ___, Charley is horrified to learn he is bound for slaughter, and so he steals the horse, and the duo embark on an odyssey across the new American frontier.

Title: She Wore a Yellow Ribbon
Hint: An aging cavalry captain on the eve of retirement leads one last mission against an uprising.
Description: On the eve of retirement, Captain Nathan Brittles takes out a last patrol to stop an impending massive Indian attack. Encumbered by women who must be evacuated, Brittles finds his mission imperiled.

Title: Champions
Hint: A hotheaded coach is forced to train a team of players with intellectual disabilities.
Description: A stubborn and hotheaded minor league basketball coach is forced to train a Special Olympics team when he is sentenced to community service.

Title: Russian Ark
Hint: A ghost and a French marquis drift through the Winter Palace in one unbroken shot.
Description: A ghost and a French marquis wander through the Winter Palace in St Petersburg, encountering scenes from many different periods of its history.

Title: Mrs. Brown
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A grieving queen finds solace in her blunt Scottish servant, scandalizing the court.
Description: When Queen Victoria's husband Prince Albert dies, she finds solace in her trusted servant, Mr. John ___. But their relationship also brings scandal and turmoil to the monarchy.

Title: Avanti!
Hint: A businessman goes to Italy to bring home his father's body and finds his father's secret lover.
Description: A successful businessman travels to Italy to arrange for the return of his tycoon father's body, only to learn that dear old dad died with his longtime mistress.

Title: A Soldier's Story
Hint: A Black Army lawyer investigates the murder of a sergeant on a segregated Louisiana base.
Description: In a rural town in Louisiana, a black Master Sergeant is found shot to death just outside the local Army Base. Military lawyer, Captain Davenport—also a black man—is sent from Washington to conduct an investigation. Facing an uncooperative chain of command and fearful black troops, Davenport must battle with deceit and prejudice in order to find out exactly who really did kill the Master Sergeant.

Title: Stardust Memories
Studio: Jack Rollins & Charles H. Joffe Productions
Hint: A filmmaker at a retrospective of his work is besieged by fans, critics and flashbacks of his lovers.
Description: While attending a retrospect of his work, a filmmaker recalls his life and his loves: the inspirations for his films.

Title: A Fantastic Woman
Country: Chile, Germany, Spain, United States of America
Hint: A transgender singer is shut out by her late partner's family as she mourns him.
Description: Marina's life is thrown into turmoil following the death of her partner. Mourning the loss of the man she loved, she finds herself under intense scrutiny from those with no regard for her privacy.

Title: Marshland
Hint: Two mismatched detectives hunt a killer of young girls in the marshes of 1980 Spain.
Description: The Spanish Deep South, 1980. A series of brutal murders of adolescent girls in a remote and forgotten town bring together two disparate characters – both detectives in the homicide division – to investigate the cases.

Title: Once Upon a Time in China
Hint: A legendary martial arts healer battles foreign forces and gangsters in 19th-century Canton.
Description: In late 19th-century Canton, legendary hero Wong Fei-Hung battles foreign forces' (English, French and American) plundering of China. When Aunt Yee returns from America totally westernised, Wong assumes the role of protector. This proves difficult when his martial arts school and local militia become involved in fierce battles with foreign and local governments.

Title: Educating Rita
Hint: A working-class hairdresser enrolls in a literature course taught by a boozy professor.
Description: ___, a witty 26-year-old hairdresser, wants to 'discover' herself, so she joins the Open University where she meets the disillusioned professor of literature, Dr. Frank Bryant. His marriage has failed, his new girlfriend is having an affair with his best friend and he can't get through the day without downing a bottle or two of whisky. What Frank needs is a challenge... and along comes ___.

Title: The Apostle
Hint: A Texas preacher flees after a violent act and starts a new church in Louisiana.
Description: After his happy life spins out of control, a preacher from Texas changes his name, goes to Louisiana and starts preaching on the radio.

Title: Talk Radio
Hint: A rude late-night on-air host keeps baiting his callers until the threats turn real.
Description: A rude, contemptuous ___ show host becomes overwhelmed by the hatred that surrounds his program just before it goes national.

Title: Sweet and Lowdown
Hint: A conceited jazz guitarist idolizes a Belgian master and falls for a mute laundress.
Description: In the 1930s, jazz guitarist Emmet Ray idolizes Django Reinhardt, faces gangsters and falls in love with a mute woman.

Title: Beanpole
Hint: Two young women try to rebuild their shattered lives in postwar Leningrad.
Description: 1945, Leningrad. World War II has devastated the city, demolishing its buildings and leaving its citizens in tatters, physically and mentally. Two young women, Iya and Masha, search for meaning and hope in the struggle to rebuild their lives amongst the ruins.

Title: Le Havre
Hint: An old shoeshiner in a French port hides a young African refugee from the police.
Description: In the French harbor city of ___, an elderly shoeshiner with an ailing wife crosses paths with a young African refugee pursued by the police for deportation.

Title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Death & Rebirth
Hint: A recap of the first episodes of a mecha anime, followed by the beginning of the series' new ending.
Description: Originally a collection of clips from the ___ TV series, Death was created as a precursor to the re-worked ending of the series. ___ was intended as that re-worked ending, but after production overruns ___ became only the first half of the first part of The End of ___, with some minor differences.

Title: Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi
Hint: A shy, lonely clerk disguises himself as a flashy dancer to win his own wife's heart.
Description: A lonely 40-ish man, likely to remain a bachelor, has a chance to find the love of his life when he falls for a vivacious young woman.

Title: House of Games
Hint: A psychiatrist tries to help a gambler and is seduced by a world of smooth con artists.
Description: A psychiatrist comes to the aid of a compulsive gambler and is led by a smooth-talking grifter into the shadowy but compelling world of stings, scams, and con men.

Title: The Cincinnati Kid
Hint: A young poker player in New Orleans challenges the old master of stud.
Description: An up-and-coming poker player tries to prove himself in a high-stakes match against a long-time master of the game.

Title: La Cage aux Folles
Hint: Two gay men in St. Tropez pretend to be straight for their son's future in-laws.
Description: Two gay men living in St. Tropez have their lives turned upside down when the son of one of the men announces he is getting married. They try to conceal their lifestyle and their ownership of the drag club downstairs when the fiancée and her parents come for dinner.

Title: Calamity Jane
Hint: A rough-and-tumble sharpshooter brings a theater star back to a Dakota frontier town.
Description: Sharpshooter ___ takes it upon herself to recruit a famous actress and bring her back to the local saloon, but jealousy soon gets in the way.

Title: The Express
Hint: A Syracuse running back becomes the first African American to win college football's top prize.
Description: Follow the inspirational life of college football hero Ernie Davis, the first African-American to win the Heisman Trophy.

Title: Trinity Is Still My Name
Hint: Two lazy cowboy brothers pose as federal agents and stumble into trouble.
Description: The two brothers ___ and Bambino are exchanged by two federal agents and take advantage of the situation to steal a huge booty hidden in a monastery by a gang of outlaws.

Title: The Draughtsman's Contract
Hint: An arrogant artist is hired to draw a country house and gets far more than he bargained for.
Description: R. Neville, a brash young draftsman, is hired to make a dozen landscape illustrations at the estate of Mr Herbert and his wife Virginia. Aside from monetary compensation, the arrangement includes a sexual liaison offered to Neville by Virginia while her estranged husband is away.

Title: Shadows
Hint: A light-skinned Black woman's romance falters when her white lover meets her brother.
Description: The relationship between Lelia, a light-skinned black woman, and Tony, a white man is put in jeopardy when Tony meets Lelia’s darker-skinned jazz singer brother, Hugh, and discovers that her racial heritage is not what he thought it was.

Title: The Ballad of Cable Hogue
Hint: A prospector left to die in the desert finds water and opens a stagecoach stop.
Description: Double-crossed and left without water in the desert, ___ is saved when he finds a spring. It is in just the right spot for a much needed rest stop on the local stagecoach line, and ___ uses this to his advantage. He builds a house and makes money off the stagecoach passengers. Hildy, a prostitute from the nearest town, moves in with him.

Title: D.O.A.
Hint: A poisoned accountant has 24 hours to find out who killed him.
Description: Frank Bigelow is about to die, and he knows it. The accountant has been poisoned and has only 24 hours before the lethal concoction kills him. Determined to find out who his murderer is, Frank, with the help of his assistant and girlfriend, Paula, begins to trace back over his last steps.

Title: I Confess
Hint: A priest who hears a murderer's confession becomes the prime suspect but is bound by his vows.
Description: When a priest hears a murderer’s confession, he becomes bound by his vow of silence—even as circumstantial evidence turns suspicion toward him. Torn between faith and self-preservation, he faces public scandal and trial for a crime he cannot reveal the truth about.

Title: Modigliani
Country: France, Germany, Italy, Romania, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A tempestuous Italian painter in 1919 Paris competes with his great rival.
Description: Set in Paris in 1919, biopic centers on the life of late Italian artist Amedeo ___, focusing on his last days as well as his rivalry with Pablo Picasso. ___, a Jew, has fallen in love with Jeanne, a young and beautiful Catholic girl. The couple has an illegitimate child, and Jeanne's bigoted parents send the baby to a faraway convent to be raised by nuns.

Title: The Other Side of Hope
Hint: A Finnish restaurateur befriends a Syrian refugee in this deadpan comedy.
Description: A restaurateur befriends a Syrian refugee who has recently arrived in Finland.

Title: The Yakuza
Hint: An American businessman asks an old friend for help rescuing his daughter from gangsters in Japan.
Description: When George Tanner does business with high-ranking ___ Tono, Tono kidnaps his daughter, and George summons his old friend, private eye Harry Kilmer, to Japan to investigate.

Title: Take the Money and Run
Hint: A bumbling man tries and fails to become a notorious bank robber.
Description: Virgil Starkwell is intent on becoming a notorious bank robber. Unfortunately for Virgil and his not-so-budding career, he is completely incompetent.

Title: Flame & Citron
Country: Czech Republic, Denmark, Germany, Norway, Sweden
Hint: Two Danish resistance fighters assassinate Nazi collaborators and begin to doubt their orders.
Description: Gunman ___ and his partner ___ assassinate Nazi collaborators for the Danish resistance. Assigned targets by their Allies-connected leader, Aksel Winther, they relish the opportunity to begin targeting the Nazis themselves. When they begin to doubt the validity of their assignments, their morally complicated task becomes even more labyrinthine.

Title: Tsotsi
Hint: A young Johannesburg gang leader steals a car and finds a baby in the back seat.
Description: A young South African boy from the Johannesburg ghetto named ___, meaning Gangster, leaves home as a child to get away from his helpless parents. Now a teenage thug, ___ finds a baby in the back seat of a car he's just stolen. He decides that it is his responsibility to care for the infant and in the process learns that maybe the criminal life isn’t the best way.

Title: The Dish
Hint: A group of maverick scientists on a remote Australian sheep farm help broadcast the Moon landing.
Description: A group of maverick scientists on a remote Australian sheep farm are the globe's only hope for obtaining the epic images of man's first steps on the moon.

Title: A Better Life
Hint: An undocumented gardener in East LA tries to keep his son away from gangs.
Description: A gardener in East L.A. struggles to keep his son away from gangs and immigration agents while traveling across town to perform landscaping work for the city's wealthy landowners.

Title: Me and You and Everyone We Know
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A lonely single dad meets a quirky artist in an offbeat, tender romance.
Description: Single dad Richard meets Christine, a starving artist who moonlights as a cabbie. They awkwardly attempt to start a romance, but Richard’s divorce has left him emotionally damaged. Meanwhile, Richard’s sons—one a teenager, the other 6-years-old—take part in clumsy experiments with the opposite sex.

Title: Utøya: July 22
Hint: A teenager fights to survive a terrorist attack on a Norwegian summer camp island.
Description: A teenage girl fights for survival and to locate her young sister during the 2011 terrorist attack at a political summer camp on the Norwegian island of ___.

Title: City of Men
Hint: Two teens in Rio's favelas uncover secrets about their absent fathers.
Description: Best buddies Acerola and Laranjinha, about to turn 18, discover things about their missing fathers' pasts which will shatter their solid friendship, in the middle of a war between rival drug gangs from Rio's favelas.

Title: A Hard Day
Hint: A crooked detective tries to hide a body from a hit-and-run, and someone saw it.
Description: After trying to cover up a car accident that left a man dead, a crooked homicide detective is stalked by a mysterious man claiming to have witnessed the event.

Title: Tape
Hint: Three old high school friends confront an ugly secret in a motel room.
Description: Jon, a first-time filmmaker, finds himself in Lansing, Michigan to present his film at a local film festival. Vince, his high school friend who is now a volunteer fireman and small-time drug dealer, also visits the town to support Jon on his big day, or so it seems. After a raucous hello and much backslapping, it appears that there is an undercurrent of tension in the air.

Title: The Fortune Cookie
Hint: An injured TV cameraman is pushed by his shyster brother-in-law into a fake lawsuit.
Description: TV cameraman Harry Hinkle is injured while filming a football game. Seeing big dollar signs, his unscrupulous ambulance-chasing lawyer brother-in-law Willie Gingrich enters the picture, and convinces Harry to overstate his injuries and claim $1 million in pain and suffering. Harry's similarly-minded ex-wife suddenly reappears in an attempt to rekindle their relationship.

Title: Soul Kitchen
Hint: A Greek-German chef's scruffy Hamburg diner becomes the hottest spot in town.
Description: In Hamburg, German-Greek chef Zinos unknowingly disturbs the peace in his locals-only restaurant by hiring a more talented chef.

Title: Death Note: The Last Name
Hint: A student with a supernatural notebook that kills anyone listed in it faces off against a brilliant, eccentric detective.
Description: In the second installment of the ___ film franchise, Light Yagami meets a second Kira and faithful follower Misa Amane and her Shinigami named Rem. Light attempts to defeat L along with Teru Mikami (a Kira follower) and Kiyomi Takada (another Kira follower) but in the end will Light win? or will a Shinigami named Ryuk make all the difference in Light's victory or his ultimate death?

Title: Spare Parts
Hint: Four Hispanic high schoolers build a robot and take on MIT.
Description: With the help of their high school's newest teacher, four Hispanic students form a robotics club. Although they have no experience, the youths set their sights on a national robotics contest. With $800 and ___ scavenged from old cars, they build a robot and compete against reigning champion MIT.

Title: Berlin Calling
Hint: A touring techno DJ ends up in a psychiatric clinic on the eve of his big album.
Description: A man tours clubs around the globe with his manager and girlfriend. On the eve of their largest album release he is admitted to a psychiatric clinic after overdosing at a gig.

Title: Mr. Blandings Builds His Dream House
Hint: An advertising executive's perfect home in the country becomes a money pit.
Description: An advertising executive dreams of getting out of the city and building a perfect home in the country, only to find the transition fraught with problems.

Title: Angrezi Medium
Hint: A sweet shop owner goes to absurd lengths to send his daughter to study in London.
Description: When his daughter decides to further her studies in London, a hardworking Haryanvi businessman does everything in power to make her dreams come true.

Title: Band Baaja Baaraat
Hint: Two graduates start a wedding planning company in Delhi and fall for each other.
Description: Shruti and Bittoo decide to start a wedding planning company together after they graduate from university, but romance gets in the way of business.

Title: Little Caesar
Hint: A small-time hood shoots his way to the top of the mob, but can't stay there.
Description: A small-time hood shoots his way to the top, but how long can he stay there?

Title: Heroic Losers
Hint: A group of Argentine neighbours plan to recover their savings from a crooked banker after the 2001 crash.
Description: In a town in the Northwest of the province of Buenos Aires, a group of neighbors is organized to recover the economy of the area, but when the corralito is implemented in the country and they suffer a fraud, their hopes disappear. Now, they will unite to recover the lost money and give the blow of their lives to their greatest enemy.

Title: Lantana
Hint: A grieving woman suspects her husband of cheating as a mystery unfolds in Sydney.
Description: Plagued with grief over the murder of her daughter, Valerie Somers suspects that her husband John is cheating on her. When Valerie disappears, Detective Leon Zat attempts to solve the mystery of her absence. A complex web of love, sex and deceit emerges -- drawing in four related couples whose various partners are distrustful and suspicious about each other's involvement.

Title: It's All Gone Pete Tong
Hint: A hard-partying DJ in Ibiza goes completely deaf and must learn to mix music again.
Description: A comedy following the tragic life of the legendary Frankie Wilde. The story takes us through Frankie's life from being one of the best DJs alive, through a subsequent battle with a hearing disorder, culminating in his mysterious disappearance from the scene.

Title: Toilet: A Love Story
Hint: A bride threatens to leave her husband unless he builds proper sanitation in their home.
Description: A woman threatens to leave her husband unless he installs a ___ in their home. To win back her love and respect, he heads out on a journey to fight against the backward society.

Title: Another Woman
Studio: Jack Rollins & Charles H. Joffe Productions
Hint: A cold philosophy professor overhears therapy sessions through a wall and questions her life.
Description: Marion is a woman who has learned to shield herself from her emotions. She rents an apartment to work undisturbed on her new book, but by some acoustic anomaly she can hear all that is said in the next apartment in which a psychiatrist holds his office. When she hears a young woman tell that she finds it harder and harder to bear her life, Marion starts to reflect on her own life.

Title: Salyut-7
Hint: Two cosmonauts are sent to dock with a dead, spinning Soviet space station in 1985.
Description: USSR, June 1985. After contact with the ___ space station is lost, cosmonauts Vladimir Dzhanibekov and Viktor Savinykh dock with the empty, frozen craft, and bring her back to life. Based on actual events.

Title: Table No. 21
Hint: A couple's free trip to Fiji becomes a deadly game of truth or dare.
Description: A couple live a mediocre life and are thrilled to have won an exotic vacation to Fiji & their excitement increases when they get a chance to play "Tell all truth" game for a mind boggling prize money. The game begins and the couple discovers that the game isn't really a game, but is a game of survival.

Title: Savior
Hint: A mercenary in the Bosnian War rescues a Serbian woman and her baby.
Description: A hardened mercenary in the Foreign Legion begins to find his own humanity when confronted with atrocities during the fighting in Bosnia.

Title: Gunga Din
Hint: British soldiers in India fight a murderous cult with the help of their water carrier.
Description: British army sergeants Ballantine, Cutter and MacChesney serve in India during the 1880s, along with their native water-bearer, ___. While completing a dangerous telegraph-repair mission, they unearth evidence of the suppressed Thuggee cult. When ___ tells the sergeants about a secret temple made of gold, the fortune-hunting Cutter is captured by the Thuggees, and it's up to his friends to rescue him.

Title: Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection 'F'
Hint: An old galactic villain is revived and seeks revenge on the spiky-haired hero.
Description: One peaceful day on Earth, two remnants of Frieza's army named Sorbet and Tagoma arrive searching for the ___ Balls with the aim of reviving Frieza. They succeed, and Frieza subsequently seeks revenge on the Saiyans.

Title: The Bothersome Man
Hint: A man arrives in a strange city where everyone is relentlessly content and nothing tastes of anything.
Description: Forty-year-old Andreas arrives in a strange city with no memory of how he got there. He is presented with a job, an apartment - even a wife. But before long, Andreas notices that something is wrong. Andreas makes an attempt to escape the city, but he discovers there's no way out. Andreas meets Hugo, who has found a crack in a wall in his cellar. Beautiful music streams out from the crack.

Title: Mine vaganti
Hint: A son of a southern Italian pasta-making family plans to come out, but his brother beats him to it.
Description: Tommaso is the youngest son of the Cantones, a large, traditional southern Italian family operating a pasta-making business since the 1960s. On a trip home from Rome, where he studies literature and lives with his boyfriend, Tommaso decides to tell his parents the truth about himself. But when he is finally ready to come out in front of the entire family, his older brother Antonio ruins his plans.

Title: Amen.
Hint: An SS officer tries to alert the Pope and the world about the Holocaust.
Description: Kurt Gerstein—a member of the Institute for Hygiene of the Waffen-SS—is appalled to discover that a poison gas he helped discover is being used to kill Jews. Driven by his conscience to alert the rest of the world, Gerstein teams up with a young Jesuit priest, Riccardo Fontana, but their protestations fall on deaf ears in the Vatican.

Title: Il Divo
Hint: The career of a cold, untouchable politician who ran Italy for decades.
Description: Italy, early '90s. Calm, clever and inscrutable, politician Giulio Andreotti has been synonymous with power for decades. He has survived everything: electoral battles, terrorist massacres, loss of friends, slanderous accusations; but now certain repentant mobsters implicate him in the crimes of Cosa Nostra.

Title: Broken Blossoms
Hint: An abused waif in London's Limehouse is befriended by a gentle Chinese immigrant.
Description: A frail waif, abused by her brutal boxer father in London's seedy Limehouse District, is befriended by a sensitive Chinese immigrant with tragic consequences.

Title: Dheepan
Hint: Three strangers pose as a family to flee Sri Lanka's war and land in a violent Paris suburb.
Description: Three war-torn strangers posing as a family flee Sri Lanka’s civil war to start over in a troubled Paris suburb, but their past traumas resurface as they struggle to survive in their new environment.

Title: Te3n
Hint: A grandfather spends years searching for his missing granddaughter in Kolkata.
Description: A grandfather, police officer and a priest join hands to investigate and find a missing child.

Title: Facing Windows
Hint: A woman stuck in a gray marriage cares for an old man with no memory.
Description: Overburdened and stuck in a greying marriage, Giovanna takes to caring for a Jewish Holocaust survivor her husband brings home. As she begins to reflect on her life, she turns to the man who lives across from her.

Title: The Beat That My Heart Skipped
Hint: A ruthless real estate thug discovers a passion for piano.
Description: A ruthless real estate agent discovers a passion for piano and auditions with help from a young virtuoso, but the pressures of his corrupt career threaten to derail his musical aspirations.

Title: Of Gods and Men
Hint: French monks in Algeria are threatened by terrorists and must decide whether to stay.
Description: A group of Trappist monks reside in the monastery of Tibhirine in Algeria, where they live in harmony with the largely muslim population. When a bloody conflict between Algeria's army and Muslim Jihadi insurgents disrupts the peace, they are forced to consider fleeing the monastery and deserting the villagers they have ministered to.

Title: Starbuck
Hint: A slacker discovers his sperm donations fathered 533 children.
Description: David Wozniak is a perpetual adolescent who discovers that, as a sperm donor, he has fathered 533 children. He is advised that more than 100 of his offspring are trying to force the fertility clinic to reveal the true identity of "___," the pseudonym he used when donating his sperm. To make matters worse, his girlfriend Valérie is pregnant with his child, but doesn't feel that he is mature enough to be a father.

Title: Theeb
Country: Jordan, Qatar, Switzerland, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom
Hint: A Bedouin boy guides a British officer across the desert in 1916.
Description: Set in the Arabian Desert of 1916, the film follows ___, a young Bedouin boy, and his brother Hussein as they leave the safety of their tribe to venture on a treacherous journey at the dawn of the Great Revolt. If ___ is to survive he must quickly learn about adulthood, trust and betrayal.

Title: D-Day
Hint: Four Indian agents spend years undercover to capture the country's most wanted terrorist.
Description: Four Indian agents spend nine years under cover to track down India's most wanted criminal.

Title: The Hairdresser's Husband
Hint: A man fulfills his boyhood fantasy of marrying the woman who cuts his hair.
Description: Antoine has always been fascinated by a ___ delicate touch, the beguiling perfume, and the enticing figure of a woman with an opulent bosom. After all, he had always known he would marry one, completing his idealized love fantasy.

Title: The Memory of a Killer
Hint: An aging hitman with Alzheimer's refuses to kill a child.
Description: Vincke and Verstuyft are one of the best detective teams of the Antwerp police force. When they are confronted with the disappearance of a top official and the murder of two prostitutes, the trail leads to the almost retired assassin Angelo Ledda. Since Ledda starts showing symptoms of Alzheimer's, it's getting more and more difficult to complete his contracts.

Title: Rams
Hint: Two Icelandic brothers who haven't spoken in 40 years must save their sheep from disease.
Description: In a secluded valley in Iceland, Gummi and Kiddi live side by side, tending to their sheep. Their ancestral sheep-stock is considered one of the country’s best and the two brothers are repeatedly awarded for their prized ___ who carry an ancient lineage. Although they share the land and a way of life, Gummi and Kiddi have not spoken to each other in four decades.

Title: Common Wealth
Hint: A real estate agent finds a fortune in a dead man's apartment, and the neighbors want it.
Description: After finding an enormous amount of money hidden in a dead man's apartment, real estate agent Julia must face the wrath of the very peculiar inhabitants of the apartment building, who will stop at nothing to get their hands on the money.

Title: Asterix and Cleopatra
Hint: Two Gaulish warriors help an Egyptian queen build a palace in record time.
Description: Popular animated hero ___ and his faithful sidekick Obelix travel to ancient Egypt to help ___ build a new summer home. ___ and Julius Caesar have made a bet, with Caesar wagering the project cannot be completed in a few weeks time. With the help of a magic potion, ___ comes to the rescue of the Queen of the Nile as Caesar and an angry architect plot against them.

Title: Happy Accidents
Hint: A woman falls for a man who claims to be a time traveler from 2470.
Description: A comedy that pays tribute to the science fiction genre -- specifically, the sub-genre of time travel. But here the alternate reality is contemporary New York City where past and future experiences of trust, commitment and denial are cleverly put to the test. Just as Ruby is beginning to relish her first-ever healthy relationship, Sam begins muttering about being a time traveler from the year 2470.

Title: Johnny Stecchino
Hint: A gentle school bus driver happens to look exactly like a mafia boss.
Description: Good hearted but not very wordly-wise, Dante is happy driving the school bus for a group of mentally handicapped children, while feeling he is somehow missing out on life and love. So he is very excited when after nearly being knocked down by her car he meets Maria, who seems immediately enamoured of him. He is soon invited to her sumptuous Palermo villa, little suspecting that this is part of a plot.

Title: The Wing or The Thigh?
Hint: A famous food critic and his son go undercover to expose an industrial food tycoon.
Description: Charles Duchemin, a well-known gourmet and publisher of a famous restaurant guide, is waging a war against fast food entrepreneur Tri- catel to save the French art of cooking.

Title: Phir Hera Pheri
Hint: Three lovable con men lose their fortune in a scam and try to win it back.
Description: Raju, Shyam and Baburao are living happily after having risen from rags to riches. However, they lose it all after falling victim to a chit fund scam due to their greed for more money. Soon, they find themselves in new mess and encounter eccentric and dangerous characters in their quest for a shortcut to riches again.

Title: Human Capital
Hint: Two families are tied together after a cyclist is hit by a car near Milan.
Description: The destinies of two families are irrevocably tied together after a cyclist is hit off the road by a jeep in the night before Christmas Eve.

Title: 99 francs
Hint: A cynical Paris advertising man rebels against his job and his empty life.
Description: Paris, France, 2001. Octave Parango, a young advertiser working at the Ross & Witchcraft advertising agency, lives a suicidal existence, ruled by cynicism, irresponsibility and debauchery. The obstacles he will encounter in developing a campaign for a new yogurt brand will force him to face the meaning of his work and the way he manages his relationship with those who orbit around his egotistic lifestyle.

Title: The Gilded Cage
Hint: A Portuguese concierge couple in Paris inherit a fortune back home.
Description: In the beautiful area of ​​Paris, Maria and José Ribeiro lived for almost thirty years on the ground floor of a Haussmann building, in their dear little lodge.

Title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The Movie
Hint: A man trapped on a satellite is forced to watch terrible B-pictures and mocks them with his robot friends.
Description: In the not-too-distant future, the evil Dr. Forrester forces a temp named Mike into a series of experiments, where he's forced to watch cheesy movies so the mad scientist can monitor his mind. However, as Mike can't control where the movies begin or end, he'll try to keep his sanity with the help of his robot friends.

Title: In Your Name
Hint: A father spends decades trying to bring his daughter's killer to justice.
Description: In 1982, André Bamberski learns about the death of his 14 year-old daughter, Kalinka, while she was on vacation with her mother and stepfather in Germany. Convinced that Kalinka’s death was not an accident, Bamberski begins to investigate.

Title: L'Age d'Or
Hint: Two lovers are kept apart by church and bourgeois society in this surrealist provocation.
Description: The film consists of a series of tightly interlinked vignettes, the most sustained of which details the story of a man and a woman who are passionately in love. Their attempts to consummate their passion are constantly thwarted, by their families, by the Church and bourgeois society in general.

Title: A Better Tomorrow II
Hint: A restaurateur, a cop and an ex-con avenge a friend's daughter in Hong Kong.
Description: A restauranteur teams up with a police officer and his ex-con brother to avenge the death of a friend's daughter.

Title: Love Likes Coincidences
Hint: Two people born on the same day in the same hospital keep meeting through life.
Description: Year 1977, a September morning in Ankara... Yilmaz tries to rush his pregnant wife Neriman to the hospital and he crushes into Omer's car. This accident causes Omer's pregnant wife Inci, who was in the back seat, to have a pre-term labor. The babies are born on the same day. They see each other for the first time... This accident is the threshold of the ___ that bring Ozgur and Deniz together.

Title: The Taste of Others
Hint: A crude industrialist falls for a theater actress and tries to fit into her circle.
Description: Unpolished and ultra-pragmatic industrialist Jean-Jacques Castella reluctantly attends Racine's tragedy "Berenice" in order to see his niece play a bit part. He is taken with the play's strangely familiar-looking leading lady Clara Devaux. During the course of the show, Castella soon remembers that he once hired and then promptly fired the actress as an English language tutor.

Title: Jolly LLB 2
Hint: A small-time Lucknow lawyer takes on a staged police killing.
Description: A blunt, abrasive and yet oddly compassionate Jagdishwar Mishra aka ___, a small-time struggling lawyer who moves from Kanpur to the city of Nawabs to pursue his dream of becoming a big-time lawyer.

Title: Tere Bin Laden
Hint: A Pakistani reporter fakes a video of the world's most wanted terrorist.
Description: Ali Hassan (Ali Zafar), a reporter with a downmarket TV channel in Karachi, is keen to go to USA for a better life, but his visa has been refused six times in seven years. In desperation, he gets hold of an Osama ___ look alike and makes a fake Osama tape which he sells to the owner of his channel to raise money for a false identity, a new passport and better luck with US visa.

Title: Like Crazy
Hint: A British student overstays her visa and is banned from returning to her American love.
Description: A British college student falls for an American student, only to be separated from him when she's banned from the U.S. after overstaying her visa.

Title: Tai Chi Master
Hint: Two friends are banished from their Shaolin temple and take opposite paths.
Description: Falsely accused for cheating in a martial arts competition, two boyhood friends are banished from their Shaolin Temple and go their separate ways. As adults, they join opposing sides in a civil war. When one betrays the other, they settle their differences mano-a-mano.

Title: Dasavatharam
Hint: A scientist chases a deadly virus vial across India, with the actor playing ten roles.
Description: Bio-technologist Govind K Somaiyya sets about on a precarious journey to India to retrieve a vial containing a deadly virus and prevent it from reaching the wrong hands of an ex-CIA agent and deadly assassins.

Title: NH 10
Hint: A couple is attacked on a highway after witnessing an honor killing.
Description: Meera and Arjun are professionals living in Gurgaon. On their way to a luxurious desert holiday they stop on a Highway dhaba for dinner, where they witness a young girl being picked up by a bunch of hoodlums. Arjun chooses to step in, unmindful of the danger ahead.

Title: Batla House
Hint: An honest cop faces controversy after a deadly shootout in Delhi.
Description: Following a gunfight with suspects believed to be innocent by the media and public, an honest cop struggles to justify police actions before beginning the hunt for fugitives.

Title: Business Man
Hint: A man arrives in Mumbai with a plan to conquer the underworld.
Description: Just as the cops have declared the end of Mafia in Mumbai, a man named Surya arrives in the city with the intentions of conquering it.

Title: No One Killed Jessica
Hint: A model is shot dead in a Delhi bar, and her sister and a journalist fight for justice.
Description: The true story of model ___ Lall who was shot dead in a restaurant and the campaign to bring her killer to justice.

Title: Ghulam
Hint: A boxer from the streets of Mumbai gets involved with a gang and must stand up to them.
Description: Sidharth (Aamir Khan), is a Mumbai 'Tapori' and a boxing champion. His elder brother, Jai (Rajat Kapoor) works with Raunak Singh (Sharad Saxena), who now rules their "Basti" through terrorising its people and collecting 'Hafta' from local merchants. Sidharth idolized his father, a freedom fighter, whom he saw falling to his death as a child. This effects Sidharth through his adult life.

Title: Barbie
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A doll leaves her pink perfect world and discovers the real one.
Description: ___ and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of ___ Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.

Title: The Equalizer 3
Hint: A retired special forces officer now settled in southern Italy battles the local Mafia.
Description: Robert McCall finds himself at home in Southern Italy but he discovers his friends are under the control of local crime bosses. As events turn deadly, McCall knows what he has to do: become his friends' protector by taking on the mafia.

Title: Babylon
Hint: Excess, ambition and decadence in Hollywood as silent movies give way to sound.
Description: A tale of outsized ambition and outrageous excess, tracing the rise and fall of multiple characters in an era of unbridled decadence and depravity during Hollywood's transition from silent films to sound films in the late 1920s.

Title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
Hint: A Brooklyn plumber travels through a pipe into a magical mushroom kingdom.
Description: While working underground to fix a water main, Brooklyn plumbers—and brothers—___ and Luigi are transported down a mysterious pipe and wander into a magical new world. But when the brothers are separated, ___ embarks on an epic quest to find Luigi.

Title: Vicky Cristina Barcelona
Hint: Two American friends fall for a Spanish painter and his volatile ex-wife.
Description: Two girlfriends on a summer holiday in Spain become enamored with the same painter, unaware that his ex-wife, with whom he has a tempestuous relationship, is about to re-enter the picture.

Title: Midsommar
Hint: A grieving young woman and her friends visit a remote Swedish village for a midsummer festival run by a pagan cult.
Description: Several friends travel to Sweden to study as anthropologists a summer festival that is held every ninety years in the remote hometown of one of them. What begins as a dream vacation in a place where the sun never sets, gradually turns into a dark nightmare as the mysterious inhabitants invite them to participate in their disturbing festive activities.

Title: The Big Chill
Hint: Seven college friends reunite at a funeral and spend a weekend together.
Description: Seven old college friends gather for a weekend reunion after the funeral of one of their own.

Title: Fast Times at Ridgemont High
Hint: California teenagers navigate first jobs, crushes and a stoned surfer at the mall.
Description: Based on the real-life adventures chronicled by Cameron Crowe, Fast ___ follows a group of high school students growing up in Southern California. Stacy Hamilton and Mark Ratner are looking for love, and are helped along by their older classmates, Linda Barrett and Mike Damone. Jeff Spicoli, a perpetually stoned surfer faces-off with the resolute teacher, Mr. Hand. Hilarity and heartbreak ensue.

Title: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
Hint: A detective visits a tech billionaire's Greek island for a murder game that turns real.
Description: World-famous detective Benoit Blanc heads to Greece to peel back the layers of a mystery surrounding a tech billionaire and his eclectic crew of friends.

Title: Prey
Hint: A Comanche warrior fights to protect her tribe from a highly evolved alien hunter in 1719.
Description: When danger threatens her camp, the fierce and highly skilled Comanche warrior Naru sets out to protect her people. But the ___ she stalks turns out to be a highly evolved alien predator with a technically advanced arsenal.

Title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
Hint: A family moves to an Oklahoma farmhouse and discovers their connection to ghost hunters.
Description: When single mom Callie and her two kids Trevor and Phoebe arrive in a small Oklahoma town, they begin to discover their connection to the original ___ and the secret legacy their grandfather left behind.

Title: Mean Girls
Hint: A new student who was homeschooled in Africa infiltrates a clique of cruel popular teens.
Description: Cady Heron is a hit with The Plastics, the A-list girl clique at her new school, until she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

Title: Free Guy
Hint: A bank teller discovers he is a background character in a video game.
Description: A bank teller discovers he is actually a background player in an open-world video game, and decides to become the hero of his own story. Now, in a world where there are no limits, he is determined to be the guy who saves his world his way before it's too late.

Title: Bone Tomahawk
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A sheriff leads a rescue mission against cave-dwelling cannibals.
Description: During a shootout in a saloon, Sheriff Hunt injures a suspicious stranger. The doctor's assistant, wife of the local foreman, tends to him in prison. That night, the town is attacked and they both disappear—only the arrow of a cannibal tribe is found. Hunt and a few of his men go in search of the prisoner and the foreman's wife.

Title: The Mist
Hint: A thick fog with monsters traps people in a small-town supermarket.
Description: After a violent storm, a dense cloud of ___ envelops a small Maine town, trapping David Drayton and his five-year-old son in a local grocery store with other local residents. They soon discover that the ___ conceals deadly horrors that threaten their lives, and worse, their sanity.

Title: Sing
Hint: A koala who owns a failing theatre stages a singing competition with a cast of animals.
Description: A koala named Buster recruits his best friend to help him drum up business for his theater by hosting a singing competition.

Title: Snowpiercer
Hint: Survivors of a frozen Earth live on a train with a rigid class system.
Description: In a future where a failed global-warming experiment kills off most life on the planet, a class system evolves aboard the ___; a train that travels around the globe via a perpetual-motion engine.

Title: Pretty Woman
Hint: A businessman hires an escort to accompany him for a week in Beverly Hills.
Description: Vivian is a carefree, streetwise diamond in the rough when she meets sophisticated billionaire Edward in a chance encounter that turns into a week-long business arrangement. But Vivian's energetic spirit challenges Edward's no-nonsense approach to life, and soon they are teaching each other – and falling in love!

Title: Pitch Perfect
Hint: A college a cappella group of misfits competes for a title.
Description: College student Beca knows she does not want to be part of a clique, but that's exactly where she finds herself after arriving at her new school. Thrust in among mean gals, nice gals and just plain weird gals, Beca finds that the only thing they have in common is how well they sing together.

Title: The Dreamers
Country: France, Italy, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Three young cinephiles in Paris during the protests of 1968.
Description: When Isabelle and Theo invite Matthew to stay with them, what begins as a casual friendship ripens into a sensual voyage of discovery and desire in which nothing is off limits and everything is possible.

Title: Remember Me
Hint: A rebellious young man in New York falls for the daughter of the cop who arrested him.
Description: Still reeling from a heartbreaking family event and his parents' subsequent divorce, Tyler Hawkins discovers a fresh lease on life when he meets Ally Craig, a gregarious beauty who witnessed her mother's death. But as the couple draws closer, the fallout from their separate tragedies jeopardizes their love.

Title: The Mummy
Hint: A legionnaire and a librarian accidentally awaken an ancient Egyptian priest in Hamunaptra.
Description: Dashing legionnaire Rick O'Connell stumbles upon the hidden ruins of Hamunaptra while in the midst of a battle to claim the area in 1920s Egypt. It has been over three thousand years since former High Priest Imhotep suffered a fate worse than death as a punishment for a forbidden love—along with a curse that guarantees eternal doom upon the world if he is ever awoken.

Title: Shiva Baby
Hint: A college student runs into her sugar daddy at a Jewish mourning gathering.
Description: College student Danielle must cover her tracks when she unexpectedly runs into her sugar daddy at a ___ - with her parents, ex-girlfriend and family friends also in attendance.

Title: State of Play
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A journalist investigates the death of a congressman's mistress.
Description: When a congressional aide is killed, a Washington, D.C. journalist starts investigating the case involving the Representative, his old college friend.

Title: Blade
Hint: A half-vampire with a samurai sword hunts bloodsuckers in a war for the night.
Description: The Daywalker known as "___" - a half-vampire, half-mortal man - becomes the protector of humanity against an underground army of vampires.

Title: Dredd
Country: South Africa, United Kingdom, United States of America, India
Hint: A judge and a rookie clean up a tower block run by a drug lord.
Description: In the future, America is a dystopian wasteland. The latest scourge is Ma-Ma, a prostitute-turned-drug pusher with a dangerous new drug and aims to take over the city. The only possibility of stopping her is an elite group of urban police called Judges, who combine the duties of judge, jury and executioner to deliver a brutal brand of swift justice.

Title: Licorice Pizza
Hint: A teenage boy falls for an older woman in 1970s San Fernando Valley.
Description: The story of Gary Valentine and Alana Kane growing up, running around and going through the treacherous navigation of first love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973.

Title: The Ring
Hint: A journalist investigates a cursed videotape that kills those who watch it.
Description: Journalist Rachel Keller investigates a strange videotape that may be behind the untimely deaths of four teenagers. There is an urban legend about this tape: the viewer will die seven days after watching it. Rachel tracks down the video... and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery of the ___ in order to save herself and her son.

Title: Mrs. Doubtfire
Hint: A father disguises himself as a Scottish nanny to see his children.
Description: Loving but irresponsible dad Daniel Hillard, estranged from his exasperated spouse, is crushed by a court order allowing only weekly visits with his kids. When Daniel learns his ex needs a housekeeper, he gets the job -- disguised as a British nanny. Soon he becomes not only his children's best pal but the kind of parent he should have been from the start.

Title: The Intern
Hint: A 70-year-old widower takes an entry-level job at an online fashion startup.
Description: 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker has discovered that retirement isn't all it's cracked up to be. Seizing an opportunity to get back in the game, he becomes a senior ___ at an online fashion site, founded and run by Jules Ostin.

Title: The French Dispatch
Hint: Stories from the final issue of an American magazine based in a quirky town in France.
Description: The staff of an American magazine based in France puts out its last issue, with stories featuring an artist sentenced to life imprisonment, student riots, and a kidnapping resolved by a chef.

Title: There's Something About Mary
Hint: A man tries to win back his high school sweetheart, but many are after her.
Description: For Ted, prom night went about as bad as it’s possible for any night to go. Thirteen years later, he finally gets another chance with his old prom date, only to run up against other suitors including the sleazy detective he hired to find her.

Title: Little Shop of Horrors
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A nerdy Skid Row florist's assistant raises a plant that feeds on human blood, in a musical comedy.
Description: Seymour Krelborn is a nerdy orphan working at Mushnik's; a flower shop in urban Skid Row. He harbors a crush on fellow co-worker, Audrey Fulquard, and is berated by Mr. Mushnik daily. One day, Seymour finds a very mysterious unidentified plant which he calls Audrey II. The plant seems to have a craving for blood and soon begins to sing for it’s supper.

Title: Tropic Thunder
Hint: Actors in a war film get caught in a real war in the jungle.
Description: A group of self-absorbed actors set out to make the most expensive war film ever. After ballooning costs force the studio to cancel the movie, the frustrated director refuses to stop shooting, leading his cast into the jungles of Southeast Asia, where they encounter real bad guys.

Title: Man of Steel
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young man learns he is an alien and must face invaders from his home planet.
Description: A young boy learns that he has extraordinary powers and is not of this earth. As a young man, he journeys to discover where he came from and what he was sent here to do. But the hero in him must emerge if he is to save the world from annihilation and become the symbol of hope for all mankind.

Title: The Lobster
Country: France, Greece, Ireland, Netherlands, United Kingdom
Hint: Single people must find a partner or be turned into animals.
Description: In a dystopian near future, single people, according to the laws of The City, are taken to The Hotel, where they are obliged to find a romantic partner in forty-five days or are transformed into animals and sent off into The Woods.

Title: The Devil All the Time
Hint: Sinister characters converge in rural Ohio and West Virginia.
Description: In Knockemstiff, Ohio and its neighboring backwoods, sinister characters converge around young Arvin Russell as he fights the evil forces that threaten him and his family.

Title: Wrath of Man
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A cash truck guard is a mysterious killer seeking revenge.
Description: A cold and mysterious new security guard for a Los Angeles cash truck company surprises his co-workers when he unleashes precision skills during a heist. The crew is left wondering who he is and where he came from. Soon, the marksman's ultimate motive becomes clear as he takes dramatic and irrevocable steps to settle a score.

Title: Booksmart
Hint: Two academic overachievers realise they've missed out on fun and try to cram four years into one night.
Description: Two academic teenage superstars realize, on the eve of their high school graduation, that they should have worked less and played more. Determined to never fall short of their peers, the girls set out on a mission to cram four years of fun into one night.

Title: Coming to America
Hint: An African prince goes to Queens to find a bride.
Description: An African prince decides it’s time for him to find a princess... and his mission leads him and his most loyal friend to Queens, New York. In disguise as an impoverished immigrant, the pampered prince quickly finds himself a new job, new friends, new digs, new enemies and lots of trouble.

Title: Shooter
Hint: A former Marine sniper is framed for an assassination.
Description: A top Marine sniper, Bob Lee Swagger, leaves the military after a mission goes horribly awry and disappears, living in seclusion. He is coaxed back into service after a high-profile government official convinces him to help thwart a plot to kill the President of the United States. Ultimately double-crossed and framed for the attempt, Swagger becomes the target of a nationwide manhunt.

Title: Batman Returns
Hint: A vigilante faces a penguin-like villain and a catwoman.
Description: The monstrous Penguin, who dwells in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with corrupt mayoral candidate Max Shreck to topple the ___ once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant Selina Kyle finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she's transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy ___, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader.

Title: Mission: Impossible
Hint: A spy is framed for the murder of his team.
Description: When Ethan Hunt, the leader of a crack espionage team whose perilous operation has gone awry with no explanation, discovers that a mole has penetrated the CIA, he's surprised to learn that he's the prime suspect. To clear his name, Hunt now must ferret out the real double agent and, in the process, even the score.

Title: Von Ryan's Express
Hint: A captured American colonel leads POWs in a daring escape by hijacking a train in Italy.
Description: ___ stars Frank Sinatra as a POW colonel who leads a daring escape from WWII Italy by taking over a freight train, but he has to win over the British soldiers he finds himself commanding.

Title: Furious 7
Hint: A street racer and his crew are hunted by the vengeful brother of a man they put in a coma.
Description: Deckard Shaw seeks revenge against Dominic Toretto and his family for his comatose brother.

Title: Jumanji
Hint: A magical board game unleashes jungle animals on a small New England town.
Description: When siblings Judy and Peter discover an enchanted board game that opens the door to a magical world, they unwittingly invite Alan -- an adult who's been trapped inside the game for 26 years -- into their living room. Alan's only hope for freedom is to finish the game, which proves risky as all three find themselves running from giant rhinoceroses, evil monkeys and other terrifying creatures.

Title: American Made
Hint: A TWA pilot smuggles guns and cocaine for the CIA and the cartels in the 1980s.
Description: The true story of pilot Barry Seal, who transported contraband for the CIA and the Medellin cartel in the 1980s.

Title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
Hint: A pompous San Diego news anchor feels threatened by an ambitious female reporter.
Description: It's the 1970s and San Diego ___ is the top dog in local TV, but that's all about to change when ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone arrives as a new employee at his station.

Title: Spaceballs
Hint: A spoof of space operas where a planet's air is sold in cans.
Description: When the nefarious Dark Helmet hatches a plan to snatch Princess Vespa and steal her planet's air, space-bum-for-hire Lone Starr and his clueless sidekick fly to the rescue. Along the way, they meet Yogurt, who puts Lone Starr wise to the power of "The Schwartz." Can he master it in time to save the day?

Title: Cashback
Hint: An art student with insomnia works the night shift at a supermarket and imagines freezing time.
Description: After a painful breakup, Ben develops insomnia. To kill time, he starts working the late night shift at the local supermarket, where his artistic imagination runs wild.

Title: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
Hint: Buccaneers sail to the edge of the world to rescue their captain from the afterlife.
Description: After losing Captain Jack Sparrow to the locker of Davy Jones, Will Turner, Elizabeth Swann, and Captain Barbossa journey to the ends of the earth to rescue him. And as the East India Trading Company tightens its grip on the seas under Lord Cutler Beckett—now in control of Davy Jones—the fate of piracy hangs by a thread. Now, they must unite the pirate lords for one final stand.

Title: Queen of Hearts
Hint: A respected lawyer has a dangerous affair with her teenage stepson.
Description: Anne, a brilliant and dedicated advocacy lawyer specialising in society’s most vulnerable, children and young adults, lives what appears to be the picture-perfect life with her doctor-husband, Peter, and their twin daughters.

Title: The 40-Year-Old Virgin
Hint: A shy electronics store clerk in his forties has never slept with a woman.
Description: Andy Stitzer has a pleasant life with a nice apartment and a job stamping invoices at an electronics store. But at age ___, there's one thing Andy hasn't done, and it's really bothering his sex-obsessed male co-workers: Andy is still a ___. Determined to help Andy get laid, the guys make it their mission to de-virginize him. But it all seems hopeless until Andy meets small business owner Trish, a single mom.

Title: The Master
Hint: A troubled WWII veteran falls under the spell of a charismatic cult leader.
Description: Freddie, a volatile, heavy-drinking veteran who suffers from post-traumatic stress disorder, finds some semblance of a family when he stumbles onto the ship of Lancaster Dodd, the charismatic leader of a new "religion" he forms after World War II.

Title: Jesus Revolution
Hint: Aimless teenagers in the 1970s join a hippie religious movement in California.
Description: In the 1970s, aimless teenager Greg Laurie searches for all the right things in all the wrong places until he meets Lonnie Frisbee, a charismatic hippie/street preacher. Together with local pastor Chuck Smith, they open the doors of a languishing church to an unexpected revival.

Title: Iron Man Three
Hint: A billionaire superhero faces a terrorist after his home is destroyed.
Description: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

Title: Escape from New York
Country: United Kingdom, Germany, United States of America
Hint: A one-eyed convict must rescue the President from an island prison.
Description: In a world ravaged by crime, the entire island of Manhattan has been converted into a walled prison where brutal prisoners roam free. After the US president crash-lands inside, war hero Snake Plissken has 24 hours to bring him back.

Title: Forgetting Sarah Marshall
Hint: A musician dumped by his TV star girlfriend goes on a Hawaiian vacation, only to find her there.
Description: When actress ___ dumps aspiring musician Peter Bretter for rock star Aldous Snow, Peter's world comes crashing down. His best friend Brian suggests that Peter should get away from everything and to fly off to Hawaii to escape all his problems. After arriving in Hawaii and meeting the beautiful receptionist Rachel Jansen, Peter is shocked to see not only Aldous in Hawaii, but also ___.

Title: War Dogs
Hint: Two young men become arms dealers and land a huge Pentagon contract.
Description: Based on the true story of two young men, David Packouz and Efraim Diveroli, who won a $300 million contract from the Pentagon to arm America's allies in Afghanistan.

Title: Melancholia
Hint: A depressed bride faces the end of the world as a planet approaches.
Description: Two sisters find their already strained relationship challenged as a mysterious new planet threatens to collide with Earth.

Title: I, Robot
Country: United States of America, Germany, Canada
Hint: A technophobic detective in 2035 investigates a murder he believes was committed by an android.
Description: In 2035, where robots are commonplace and abide by the three laws of robotics, a technophobic cop investigates an apparent suicide. Suspecting that a ___ may be responsible for the death, his investigation leads him to believe that humanity may be in danger.

Title: Bad Times at the El Royale
Hint: Strangers meet at a run-down hotel on the California-Nevada border.
Description: Lake Tahoe, 1969. Seven strangers, each one with a secret to bury, meet at El ___, a decadent motel with a dark past. In the course of a fateful night, everyone will have one last shot at redemption.

Title: Sicario: Day of the Soldado
Hint: A federal agent and a hitman try to start a war between cartels.
Description: Agent Matt Graver teams up with operative Alejandro Gillick to prevent Mexican drug cartels from smuggling terrorists across the United States border.

Title: The Princess and the Frog
Hint: A hardworking waitress in New Orleans kisses an enchanted prince and turns green.
Description: A waitress, desperate to fulfill her dreams as a restaurant owner, is set on a journey to turn a ___ prince back into a human being, but she has to face the same problem after she kisses him.

Title: Real Steel
Hint: A father and son train a boxing robot in the near future.
Description: Charlie Kenton is a washed-up fighter who retired from the ring when robots took over the sport. After his robot is trashed, he reluctantly teams up with his estranged son to rebuild and train an unlikely contender.

Title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
Hint: A man rebels against a totalitarian state by falling in love.
