Description: Winston Smith is a government employee whose job involves the rewriting of history in a manner that casts his fictional country's leaders in a charitable light. His trysts with Julia provide his only measure of enjoyment, but lawmakers frown on the relationship -- and in this closely monitored society, there is no escape from Big Brother.

Title: Desperado
Hint: A guitar player with guns hidden in his case seeks revenge.
Description: El Mariachi plunges headfirst into the dark border underworld when he follows a trail of blood to the last of the infamous Mexican drug lords, Bucho, for an action-packed, bullet-riddled showdown. With the help of his friend and a beautiful bookstore owner, El Mariachi tracks Bucho, takes on his army of desperados, and leaves his own trail of blood.

Title: Four Weddings and a Funeral
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A charming, bumbling Englishman keeps meeting the same American woman at ceremonies.
Description: Over the course of five social occasions, a committed bachelor must consider the notion that he may have discovered love.

Title: Brave
Hint: A Scottish princess defies tradition and turns her mother into a bear.
Description: In the mystical Scottish Highlands, Merida is the princess of a kingdom ruled by King Fergus and Queen Elinor. An unruly daughter and an accomplished archer, Merida one day defies a sacred custom of the land and inadvertently brings turmoil to the kingdom. In an attempt to set things right, Merida seeks out an eccentric old Wise Woman and is granted an ill-fated wish.

Title: Ghost
Hint: A murdered banker's spirit stays behind to warn his lover with the help of a psychic.
Description: After a young man is murdered, his spirit stays behind to warn his lover of impending danger, with the help of a reluctant psychic.

Title: Chicken Run
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Hens plan a daring escape from a farm with the help of a rooster.
Description: The creators of Wallace & Gromit bring you an exciting and original story about a group of chickens determined to fly the coop–even if they can’t fly! It’s hardly poultry in motion when Rocky attempts to teach Ginger and her feathered friends to fly…but, with teamwork, determination and a little bit o’ cluck, the fearless flock plots one last attempt in a spectacular bid for freedom.

Title: Uncle Buck
Hint: A slovenly bachelor babysits his nephew and nieces in the suburbs.
Description: ___ Russell, a lovable but slovenly bachelor, suddenly becomes the temporary caretaker of his nephew and nieces after a family emergency. His freewheeling attitude soon causes tension with his older niece Tia, loyal girlfriend Chanice, and just about everyone else who crosses his path.

Title: Don't Breathe
Hint: Thieves break into the house of a blind veteran who is far more dangerous than they think.
Description: A group of teens break into a blind man's home thinking they'll get away with the perfect crime. They're wrong.

Title: DC League of Super-Pets
Genres: Family, Comedy, Adventure, Animation, Science Fiction
Hint: A superhero's loyal canine leads a team of shelter animals with powers.
Description: When Superman and the rest of the Justice ___ are kidnapped, Krypto the Super-Dog must convince a rag-tag shelter pack - Ace the hound, PB the potbellied pig, Merton the turtle and Chip the squirrel - to master their own newfound powers and help him rescue the superheroes.

Title: Tremors
Hint: Giant underground worms attack a small desert town, and two handymen lead the fight.
Description: Val McKee and Earl Bassett are in a fight for their lives when they discover that their desolate town has been infested with gigantic, man-eating creatures that live below the ground.

Title: The Call
Hint: An emergency dispatcher tries to save a kidnapped teenage girl phoning from the trunk of her abductor's car.
Description: Jordan Turner is an experienced 911 operator but when she makes an error in judgment and a ___ ends badly, Jordan is rattled and unsure if she can continue.

Title: Mrs. Harris Goes to Paris
Country: Belgium, Canada, France, Hungary, United Kingdom
Hint: A London cleaning lady saves up to buy a couture dress in France.
Description: A 1950s London cleaning lady falls in love with an haute couture dress by Christian Dior and decides to gamble everything for the sake of this folly.

Title: Margin Call
Hint: Investment bankers discover a financial disaster in one night.
Description: Set in the high-stakes world of the financial industry, involving the key players at an investment firm during one perilous 24-hour period in the early stages of the 2008 financial crisis. An entry-level analyst unlocks information that could prove to be the downfall of the firm.

Title: WarGames
Hint: A teenage hacker almost starts a nuclear war by playing a game.
Description: High school student David Lightman has a talent for hacking. But while trying to hack into a computer system to play unreleased video games, he unwittingly taps into the Department of Defense's war computer and initiates a confrontation of global proportions. Together with his friend and a wizardly computer genius, David must race against time to outwit his opponent and prevent a nuclear Armageddon.

Title: Deja Vu
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An ATF agent uses a time window to prevent a ferry bombing.
Description: Called in to recover evidence in the aftermath of a horrific explosion on a New Orleans ferry, Federal agent Doug Carlin gets pulled away from the scene and taken to a top-secret government lab that uses a time-shifting surveillance device to help prevent crime.

Title: Seven Psychopaths
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A screenwriter gets involved with dog kidnappers and killers.
Description: A struggling screenwriter inadvertently becomes entangled in the Los Angeles criminal underworld after his oddball friends kidnap a gangster's beloved Shih Tzu.

Title: Rumble Fish
Hint: A street thug idolises his cool, mysterious older brother in a black-and-white Tulsa.
Description: Absent-minded street thug Rusty James struggles to live up to his legendary older brother's reputation, and longs for the days of gang warfare.

Title: Enchanted
Hint: A cartoon princess is banished to modern New York and falls for a cynical divorce lawyer.
Description: The beautiful princess Giselle is banished by an evil queen from her magical, musical animated land and finds herself in the gritty reality of the streets of modern-day Manhattan. Shocked by this strange new environment that doesn't operate on a "happily ever after" basis, Giselle is now adrift in a chaotic world badly in need of enchantment.

Title: Anastasia
Hint: An amnesiac orphan joins two con men and discovers she may be the lost Russian princess.
Description: Ten years after she was separated from her family, an eighteen-year-old orphan with vague memories of the past sets out to Paris in hopes of reuniting with her grandmother. She is accompanied by two con men, who intend to pass her off as the Grand Duchess ___ to the Dowager Empress for a reward.

Title: In the Mouth of Madness
Hint: An insurance investigator searches for a missing horror novelist in a strange town.
Description: An insurance investigator visits a small town while looking into the strange disappearance of a popular horror novelist. He soon finds that the impact of the author’s books is far more than inspirational.

Title: Elf
Hint: A human raised by elves goes to New York to find his father.
Description: When young Buddy falls into Santa's gift sack on Christmas Eve, he's transported back to the North Pole and raised as a toy-making ___ by Santa's helpers. But as he grows into adulthood, he can't shake the nagging feeling that he doesn't belong. Buddy vows to visit Manhattan and find his real dad, a workaholic.

Title: Allied
Country: China, United States of America, United Kingdom, Spain
Hint: Two spies fall in love during World War II.
Description: In 1942, an intelligence officer in North Africa encounters a female French Resistance fighter on a deadly mission behind enemy lines. When they reunite in London, their relationship is tested by the pressures of war.

Title: American Underdog
Hint: A grocery stock boy becomes an NFL MVP, in an inspiring true story.
Description: The true story of Kurt Warner, who went from a stockboy at a grocery store to a two-time NFL MVP, Super Bowl champion, and Hall of Fame quarterback.

Title: Love, Rosie
Hint: Two childhood friends love each other for years but never say it.
Description: Since the moment they met at age 5, ___ and Alex have been best friends, facing the highs and lows of growing up side by side. A fleeting shared moment, one missed opportunity, and the decisions that follow send their lives in completely different directions.

Title: The Jerk
Hint: A dimwit discovers he is not Black and seeks his fortune.
Description: After discovering he's not really black like the rest of his family, likable dimwit Navin Johnson sets off on a hilarious misadventure that takes him from rags to riches and back again. The slaphappy ___ strikes it rich, but life in the fast lane isn't all it's cracked up to be and, in the end, all that really matters to Johnson is his true love.

Title: Wild
Hint: A grieving woman hikes the Pacific Crest Trail alone.
Description: A woman with a tragic past decides to start her new life by hiking for one thousand miles on the Pacific Crest Trail.

Title: Tommy Boy
Hint: Two traveling salesmen hit the road to save the family business.
Description: To save the family business, two ne’er-do-well traveling salesmen hit the road with disastrously funny consequences.

Title: The Longest Yard
Hint: A convict quarterback organizes a team of inmates against the prison guards.
Description: A football player-turned-convict organizes a team of inmates to play against a team of prison guards. His dilemma is that the warden asks him to throw the game in return for an early release, but he is also concerned about the inmates' lack of self-esteem.

Title: The Poseidon Adventure
Hint: Passengers struggle to escape an ocean liner that has flipped upside down.
Description: When their ocean liner capsizes, a group of passengers struggle to survive and escape.

Title: Live Free or Die Hard
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An old-school cop fights cyberterrorists who shut down America.
Description: John McClane is back and badder than ever, and this time he calls on the services of a young hacker in his bid to stop a ring of Internet terrorists intent on taking control of America's computer infrastructure.

Title: Shakespeare in Love
Hint: A young playwright falls in love while writing a famous tragedy.
Description: Young William ___ is forced to stage his latest comedy, 'Romeo and Ethel, the Pirate's Daughter', before it's even written. When lovely noblewoman Viola de Lesseps auditions for a role, they fall into forbidden love — and ___ play finds a new life (and title). As their relationship intensifies, the comedy soon transforms into tragedy.

Title: Don't Look Now
Hint: A grieving couple meet mysterious sisters in Venice who claim to see their dead daughter.
Description: While grieving a terrible loss, a married couple meet two mysterious sisters, one of whom gives them a message sent from the afterlife.

Title: Klute
Hint: A call girl is stalked and turns to a detective.
Description: A high-priced call girl is forced to depend on a reluctant private eye when she is stalked by a psychopath.

Title: Never Let Me Go
Hint: Clones raised at an English boarding school learn their purpose.
Description: As children, Kathy, Ruth, and Tommy spend their childhood at an idyllic and secluded English boarding school. As they grow into adults, they must come to terms with the complexity and strength of their love for one another while also preparing for the haunting reality awaiting them.

Title: Far from the Madding Crowd
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A headstrong woman attracts three very different suitors in rural England.
Description: In Victorian England, the independent and headstrong Bathsheba Everdene attracts three very different suitors: Gabriel Oak, a hardworking young sheep farmer; Frank Troy, a handsome and reckless Sergeant; and William Boldwood, a prosperous and mature bachelor.

Title: Everest
Country: Iceland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Climbers are caught in a deadly storm on the world's highest mountain.
Description: Inspired by the incredible events surrounding a treacherous attempt to reach the summit of the world's highest mountain, "___" documents the awe-inspiring journey of two different expeditions challenged beyond their limits by one of the fiercest snowstorms ever encountered by mankind.

Title: The Unforgivable
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A woman released from prison after 20 years searches for her younger sister.
Description: A woman is released from prison after serving a sentence for a violent crime and re-enters a society that refuses to forgive her past.

Title: Dressed to Kill
Hint: A prostitute witnesses a murder in an elevator and teams up with the victim's son.
Description: After witnessing a mysterious woman brutally slay a homemaker, prostitute Liz Blake finds herself trapped in a dangerous situation. While the police thinks she is the murderer, the real killer is intent on silencing her only witness.

Title: Ever After: A Cinderella Story
Hint: A spirited young woman wins a prince's heart in a grounded take on a glass-slipper tale.
Description: Danielle, a vibrant young woman, was forced into servitude after the death of her father when she was a young girl. Danielle's stepmother, Rodmilla, is a heartless woman who forces Danielle to do the cooking and cleaning, while she tries to marry off the eldest of her two daughters to the prince. But Danielle's life takes a wonderful turn when, under the guise of a visiting royal, she meets the charming Prince Henry.

Title: The Tragedy of Macbeth
Hint: A Scottish lord receives a prophecy from three witches.
Description: ___, the Thane of Glamis, receives a prophecy from a trio of witches that one day he will become King of Scotland. Consumed by ambition and spurred to action by his wife, ___ murders his king and takes the throne for himself.

Title: Moonstruck
Hint: A widow falls in love with her fiancé's brother.
Description: 37-year-old Italian-American widow Loretta Castorini believes she is unlucky in love, and so accepts a marriage proposal from her boyfriend Johnny, even though she doesn't love him. When she meets his estranged younger brother Ronny, an emotional and passionate man, she finds herself drawn to him.

Title: Side Effects
Hint: A woman's new antidepressant seems to make her commit a terrible crime.
Description: A woman turns to prescription medication as a way of handling her anxiety concerning her husband's upcoming release from prison.

Title: The Frighteners
Country: New Zealand, United States of America
Hint: A psychic con man who sees spirits battles a soul-collecting reaper.
Description: Once an architect, Frank Bannister now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. To bolster his facade, he claims his "special" gift is the result of a car accident that killed his wife. But what he does not count on is more people dying in the small town where he lives.

Title: Cube
Hint: Strangers wake up trapped in a deadly maze of rooms.
Description: A group of strangers find themselves trapped in a maze-like prison. It soon becomes clear that each of them possesses the peculiar skills necessary to escape, if they don't wind up dead first.

Title: Deepwater Horizon
Hint: An oil rig in the Gulf of Mexico explodes.
Description: A story set on the offshore drilling rig ___, which exploded during April 2010 and created the worst oil spill in U.S. history.

Title: Audition
Hint: A widower stages a fake film casting to find a new wife, and chooses the wrong one.
Description: Seven years after the death of his wife, widower Shigeharu seeks advice on how to find a new wife from a colleague. Taking advantage of their position as a film company, they stage an ___. Interviewing a series of women, Shigeharu is enchanted by the quiet Asami. But soon things take a twisted turn as Asami isn’t what she seems to be.

Title: God Bless America
Hint: A fed-up man and a teenage girl go on a killing spree against rude people.
Description: Fed up with the cruelty and stupidity of American culture, an unlikely duo goes on a killing spree, killing reality TV stars, bigots and others they find repugnant.

Title: Valkyrie
Hint: German officers plot to assassinate their Führer in 1944.
Description: Wounded in Africa during World War II, Nazi Col. Claus von Stauffenberg returns to his native Germany and joins the Resistance in a daring plan to create a shadow government and assassinate Adolf Hitler. When events unfold so that he becomes a central player, he finds himself tasked with both leading the coup and personally killing the Führer.

Title: To Leslie
Hint: A West Texas single mother who squandered her lottery winnings tries to rebuild her life.
Description: A West Texas single mother wins the lottery and squanders it just as fast, leaving behind a world of heartbreak. Years later, with her charm running out and nowhere to go, she fights to rebuild her life and find redemption.

Title: The AristoCats
Hint: Aristocratic cats are abandoned in the countryside and helped by an alley cat.
Description: When Madame Adelaide Bonfamille leaves her fortune to Duchess and her children—Bonfamille’s beloved family of cats—the butler plots to steal the money and kidnaps the legatees, leaving them out on a country road. All seems lost until the wily Thomas O’Malley Cat and his jazz-playing alley cats come to the ___’ rescue.

Title: The Glass Castle
Country: Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: A girl raised by brilliant but dysfunctional parents who roam the country.
Description: A young girl is raised in a dysfunctional family constantly on the run from the FBI. Living in poverty, she comes of age guided by her drunkard, ingenious father who distracts her with magical stories to keep her mind off the family's dire state, and her selfish, nonconformist mother who has no intention of raising a family, along with her younger brother and sister, and her other older sister.

Title: Let Me In
Country: Sweden, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A bullied boy befriends a mysterious new neighbour girl who turns out to be a vampire.
Description: A bullied young boy befriends a young female vampire who lives in secrecy with her guardian. A remake of the movie “___ The Right One In” which was an adaptation of a book.

Title: Runaway Jury
Hint: Jurors in a gun industry lawsuit are manipulated from both sides.
Description: After a workplace shooting in New Orleans, a trial against the gun manufacturer pits lawyer Wendell Rohr against shady ___ consultant Rankin Fitch, who uses illegal means to stack the ___ with people sympathetic to the defense. But when juror Nicholas Easter and his girlfriend Marlee reveal their ability to sway the ___ into delivering any verdict they want, a high-stakes cat-and-mouse game begins.

Title: Brawl in Cell Block 99
Hint: A drug courier goes to prison and is forced to commit violence.
Description: After working as a drug courier and getting into a brutal shootout with police, a former boxer finds himself at the mercy of his enemies as they force him to instigate violent acts that turn the prison he resides in into a battleground.

Title: Better Off Dead...
Hint: A teen is dumped by his girlfriend and fails at suicide.
Description: High school student Lane Meyer sinks into suicidal depression when his girlfriend dumps him for jock Roy Stalin, the high school ski racing champion. Meanwhile, he has to deal with his eccentric family, a tenacious paperboy and an obnoxious neighbor whose mother is hosting a beautiful French exchange student named Monique.

Title: Red Rocket
Hint: A washed-up porn star returns to his small Texas hometown.
Description: After hitting rock bottom in Los Angeles, former porn star Mikey Saber returns to his hometown in Texas to stay with his estranged wife and mother-in-law. Just as tensions begin to ease, he becomes infatuated with a young doughnut shop worker named Strawberry.

Title: The Danish Girl
Country: Belgium, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A painter in 1920s Copenhagen becomes one of the first people to undergo gender-affirming surgery.
Description: When Gerda Wegener asks her husband Einar to fill in as a portrait model, Einar discovers the person she's meant to be and begins living her life as Lili Elbe. Having realized her true self and with Gerda's love and support, Lili embarks on a groundbreaking journey as a transgender pioneer.

Title: Flags of Our Fathers
Hint: The soldiers who raised the flag at Iwo Jima become reluctant heroes.
Description: There were five Marines and one Navy Corpsman photographed raising the U.S. flag on Mt. Suribachi by Joe Rosenthal on February 23, 1945. This is the story of three of the six surviving servicemen - John 'Doc' Bradley, Pvt. Rene Gagnon and Pvt. Ira Hayes - who fought in the battle to take Iwo Jima from the Japanese.

Title: On the Basis of Sex
Hint: A young lawyer brings a gender discrimination case before the Supreme Court.
Description: Young lawyer Ruth Bader Ginsburg teams with her husband Marty to bring a groundbreaking case before the U.S. Court of Appeals and overturn a century of sex discrimination.

Title: We Bought a Zoo
Hint: A widower buys a run-down wildlife park and restores it with his children.
Description: Benjamin has lost his wife and, in a bid to start his life over, purchases a large house that has a ___ – welcome news for his daughter, but his son is not happy about it. The ___ is in need of renovation and Benjamin sets about the work with the head keeper and the rest of the staff, but, the ___ soon runs into financial trouble.

Title: About a Boy
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, France, Germany
Hint: A wealthy bachelor who pretends to have a son to meet single mothers befriends a lonely boy.
Description: Will Freeman is a good-looking, smooth-talking bachelor whose primary goal in life is avoiding any kind of responsibility. But when he invents an imaginary son in order to meet attractive single moms, Will gets a hilarious lesson about life from a bright, but hopelessly geeky 12-year-old named Marcus.

Title: Fighting with My Family
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A wrestling family's daughter gets a tryout with the WWE.
Description: Born into a tight-knit wrestling family, Paige and her brother Zak are ecstatic when they get the once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to try out for the WWE. But when only Paige earns a spot in the competitive training program, she must leave her loved ones behind and face this new cutthroat world alone.

Title: Monster's Ball
Hint: A prison guard falls for the widow of a man he executed.
Description: A prison guard begins a tentative romance with the unsuspecting widow of a man whose execution he presided over.

Title: The Square
Country: Denmark, France, Germany, Sweden, United States of America
Hint: A museum curator's art installation causes trouble in Stockholm.
Description: A prestigious Stockholm museum's chief art curator finds himself in times of both professional and personal crisis as he attempts to set up a controversial new exhibit.

Title: The Forgotten Battle
Hint: During WWII's fight for the Scheldt estuary, the lives of a Dutch collaborator, a British glider pilot and a resistance woman intersect.
Description: During WWII's crucial Battle of the Scheldt, the lives of a glider pilot, a Nazi soldier and a reluctant Resistance recruit tragically intersect.

Title: Phone Booth
Hint: A sleazy publicist answers a ringing payphone and is pinned there by a sniper.
Description: A slick New York publicist who picks up a ringing receiver in a ___ is told that if he hangs up, he'll be killed... and the little red light from a laser rifle sight is proof that the caller isn't kidding.

Title: The King of Staten Island
Hint: A young slacker whose firefighter father died when he was seven struggles to grow up.
Description: Scott has been a case of arrested development ever since his firefighter father died when he was seven. He's now reached his mid-20s having achieved little, chasing a dream of becoming a tattoo artist that seems far out of reach.

Title: Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero
Hint: A secret army creates two new androids to defeat the heroes, and an old enemy returns.
Description: The Red Ribbon Army, an evil organization that was once destroyed by Goku in the past, has been reformed by a group of people who have created new and mightier Androids, Gamma 1 and Gamma 2, and seek vengeance against Goku and his family.

Title: Bull Durham
Hint: A veteran catcher mentors a cocky young pitcher in the minor leagues.
Description: Veteran catcher Crash Davis is brought to the minor league ___ Bulls to help their up and coming pitching prospect, "Nuke" Laloosh. Their relationship gets off to a rocky start and is further complicated when baseball groupie Annie Savoy sets her sights on the two men.

Title: The Accused
Hint: A rape victim and a prosecutor seek justice against the men who cheered.
Description: Out drinking one night after a fight with her boyfriend, three men brutally rape Sarah Tobias in a bar while people watch and cheer. District Attorney Kathryn Murphy takes the case; however, she allows the rapists to receive a mild sentence. A distraught Sarah decides to seek punishment for the men who witnessed and encouraged the rape. To get justice, Sarah must take the stand and revisit the night of her attack.

Title: Kung Fu Panda 3
Hint: A dumpling-loving warrior finds his long-lost father and a hidden village.
Description: While Po and his father are visiting a secret ___ village, an evil spirit threatens all of China, forcing Po to form a ragtag army to fight back.

Title: Alive
Hint: Rugby players survive a plane crash in the Andes.
Description: The amazing true story of a Uruguayan rugby team's plane that crashed in the middle of the Andes mountains, and their immense will to survive and pull through ___, forced to do anything and everything they could to stay ___ on meager rations and through the freezing cold.

Title: No Way Out
Hint: A naval officer is framed for murder at the Pentagon.
Description: Navy Lt. Tom Farrell meets a young woman, Susan Atwell , and they share a passionate fling. Farrell then finds out that his superior, Defense Secretary David Brice, is also romantically involved with Atwell. When the young woman turns up dead, Farrell is put in charge of the murder investigation.

Title: Miracles from Heaven
Hint: A girl with an incurable disease is healed after falling into a tree.
Description: When Christy discovers her 10-year-old daughter Anna has a rare, incurable disease, she becomes a ferocious advocate for her daughter’s healing as she searches for a solution. After Anna has a freak accident and falls three stories, a miracle unfolds in the wake of her dramatic rescue that leaves medical specialists mystified, her family restored and their community inspired.

Title: Definitely, Maybe
Country: France, Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A father tells his daughter about his three past loves.
Description: When Will decides to tell his daughter the story of how he met her mother, he discovers that a second look at the past might also give him a second chance at the future.

Title: Payback
Hint: A thief seeks revenge on those who double-crossed him.
Description: With friends like these, who needs enemies? That's the question bad guy Porter is left asking after his wife and partner steal his heist money and leave him for dead -- or so they think. Five months and an endless reservoir of bitterness later, Porter's partners and the crooked cops on his tail learn how bad ___ can be.

Title: Catch-22
Hint: A WWII bomber pilot tries to get declared insane, but asking to be grounded proves he's sane.
Description: A WWII military pilot makes a valiant effort to be certified insane in order to be excused from flying missions. But there's a ___.

Title: Seven Years in Tibet
Hint: An arrogant Austrian mountaineer escapes a POW camp and befriends a young Dalai Lama.
Description: Austrian mountaineer Heinrich Harrer journeys to the Himalayas without his family to head an expedition in 1939. But when World War II breaks out, the arrogant Harrer falls into Allied forces' hands as a prisoner of war. He escapes with a fellow detainee and makes his way to Lhasa, ___, where he meets the 14-year-old Dalai Lama, whose friendship ultimately transforms his outlook on life.

Title: Benny & Joon
Hint: A mentally ill young woman falls for an eccentric drifter who idolizes silent film clowns.
Description: A mentally ill young woman finds her love in an eccentric man who models himself after Buster Keaton.

Title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
Hint: A showgirl and her friend sail to Paris, chased by a private detective.
Description: Lorelei Lee is a beautiful showgirl engaged to be married to the wealthy Gus Esmond, much to the disapproval of Gus' rich father, Esmond Sr., who thinks that Lorelei is just after his money. When Lorelei goes on a cruise accompanied only by her best friend, Dorothy Shaw, Esmond Sr. hires Ernie Malone, a private detective, to follow her and report any questionable behavior that would disqualify her from the marriage.

Title: Hard Eight
Hint: A stranger mentors a broke young gambler in Reno, then his past catches up with them both.
Description: A stranger mentors a young Reno gambler who weds a hooker and befriends a vulgar casino regular.

Title: Butterflies
Hint: Short experimental images of fluttering insects pinned against a blank backdrop.
Description: This cinematic production utilizes a series of character-driven vignettes to observe the complex social and romantic interactions occurring among a group of urban residents.

Title: Locke
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A construction manager drives through the night, making phone calls that unravel his whole life.
Description: Ivan ___ has worked hard to craft a good life for himself. Tonight, that life will collapse around him. On the eve of the biggest challenge of his career, Ivan receives a phone call that sets in motion a series of events that will unravel his family, job, and soul.

Title: Winter's Bone
Hint: An Ozark teenager searches meth-ridden hills for her missing father to save the family home.
Description: After discovering her father put their house up for his bail bond and then disappeared, 17-year-old Ree Dolly must confront the local criminal underworld and the harsh Ozark wilderness in order to to track down her father and save her family.

Title: Rocky Balboa
Hint: An aging boxer, long retired, steps back into the ring for one last fight.
Description: When he loses a highly publicized virtual boxing match to ex-champ ___, reigning heavyweight titleholder Mason Dixon retaliates by challenging the Italian Stallion to a 10-round exhibition bout. To the surprise of his son and friends, ___ agrees to come out of retirement and face an opponent who's faster, stronger and thirty years his junior.

Title: The Messenger
Hint: A soldier back from Iraq is assigned to deliver death notices to grieving families.
Description: Will Montgomery, a U.S. Army Staff Sergeant who has returned home from Iraq, is assigned to the Army’s Casualty Notification service. Montgomery is partnered with Captain Tony Stone, to give notice to the families of fallen soldiers. The Sergeant is drawn to Olivia Pitterson, to whom he has delivered news of her husband’s death.

Title: John Q.
Hint: A desperate father takes an emergency room hostage when his son is denied a heart transplant.
Description: John Quincy Archibald is a father and husband whose son is diagnosed with an enlarged heart and then finds out he cannot receive a transplant because HMO insurance will not cover it. Therefore, he decides to take a hospital full of patients hostage until the hospital puts his son's name on the donor's list.

Title: Die Hard 2
Hint: A New York cop at a snowbound Washington airport fights mercenaries holding planes hostage.
Description: One year after his heroics in Los Angeles, John McClane is an off-duty cop who is the wrong guy in the wrong place at the wrong time. On a snowy Christmas Eve, as he waits for his wife's plane to land at Washington Dulles International Airport, terrorists take over the air traffic control system in a plot to free a South American army general and drug smuggler being flown into the US to face drug charges.

Title: Creed II
Hint: A young heavyweight champion fights the son of the man who killed his father in the ring.
Description: Between personal obligations and training for his next big fight against an opponent with ties to his family's past, Adonis ___ is up against the challenge of his life.

Title: The Host
Hint: A mutated amphibious creature erupts from Seoul's river and snatches a young girl.
Description: A teenage girl is captured by a giant mutated squid-like creature that appears from Seoul's Han River after toxic waste was dumped in it, prompting her family into a frantic search for her.

Title: Agora
Hint: A brilliant female astronomer in Roman Alexandria fights to save knowledge as religion rises.
Description: A historical drama set in Roman Egypt, concerning philosopher Hypatia of Alexandria and her relationship with her slave Davus, who is torn between his love for her and the possibility of gaining his freedom by joining the rising tide of Christianity.

Title: Parenthood
Hint: Four siblings and their kids muddle through the chaos of raising a family.
Description: The story of the Buckman family and friends, attempting to bring up their children. They suffer/enjoy all the events that occur: estranged relatives, the 'black sheep' of the family, the eccentrics, the skeletons in the closet, and the rebellious teenagers.

Title: Out of Africa
Hint: A Danish baroness falls in love with a British big-game hunter in Kenya.
Description: Tells the life story of Danish author Karen Blixen, who at the beginning of the 20th century moved to ___ to build a new life for herself. The film is based on her 1937 autobiographical novel.

Title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
Hint: A sea sponge and a starfish journey to retrieve a stolen crown.
Description: There's trouble brewing in Bikini Bottom. Someone has stolen King Neptune's crown, and it looks like Mr. Krab, ___ boss, is the culprit. Though he's just been passed over for the promotion of his dreams, ___ stands by his boss, and along with his best pal Patrick, sets out on a treacherous mission to Shell City to reclaim the crown and save Mr. Krab's life.

Title: Defiance
Hint: Three Jewish brothers lead a band of refugees hiding in the Belarus forests during WWII.
Description: Based on a true story, during World War II, four Jewish brothers escape their Nazi-occupied homeland of West Belarus in Poland and join the Soviet partisans to combat the Nazis. The brothers begin the rescue of roughly 1,200 Jews still trapped in the ghettos of Poland.

Title: The Spectacular Now
Hint: A charming, hard-drinking high school senior falls for a quiet, bookish girl.
Description: Sutter, a popular party animal, unexpectedly meets the introverted Aimee after waking up on a stranger's lawn. As Sutter deals with the problems in his life and Aimee plans for her future beyond school, an unexpected romance blossoms between them.

Title: Blue Ruin
Hint: A homeless drifter returns to his hometown to avenge his parents' murder, badly.
Description: When the quiet life of a beach bum is upended by dreadful news, he sets off for his childhood home to carry out an act of vengeance. However, he proves an inept assassin and finds himself in a brutal fight to protect his estranged family.

Title: The Dig
Hint: As WWII looms, a widow hires an amateur archaeologist to excavate the burial mounds on her land.
Description: As WWII looms, a wealthy widow hires an amateur archaeologist to excavate the burial mounds on her estate. When they make a historic discovery, the echoes of Britain's past resonate in the face of its uncertain future‎.

Title: Elephant
Hint: An ordinary school day in Oregon slowly builds toward a massacre.
Description: Several ordinary high school students go through their daily routine as two others prepare for something more malevolent.

Title: The Ides of March
Hint: An idealistic campaign staffer learns the dirty truth of politics during a presidential primary.
Description: Dirty tricks stand to soil an ambitious young press spokesman's idealism in a cutthroat presidential campaign where 'victory' is relative.

Title: 99 Homes
Hint: An evicted construction worker goes to work for the cutthroat realtor who took his home.
Description: After his family is evicted from their home, proud and desperate construction worker Dennis Nash tries to win his home back by striking a deal with the devil and working for Rick Carver, the corrupt real estate broker who evicted him.

Title: First Reformed
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A pastor in a small church spirals into despair after counseling an environmental activist.
Description: A pastor of a small church in upstate New York starts to spiral out of control after a soul-shaking encounter with an unstable environmental activist and his pregnant wife.

Title: Day of the Dead
Hint: Soldiers and scientists in an underground bunker clash over how to handle the undead.
Description: As the world is overrun by zombies, scientists and military personnel in an underground Florida bunker must decide on how they should deal with the undead.

Title: Black Christmas
Hint: Sorority sisters are terrorized by obscene phone calls from a killer hiding in their house.
Description: As the residents of the Pi Kappa Sigma sorority house prepare for the festive season, a stranger begins to harass them with a series of obscene phone calls.

Title: The Witch: Part 1 - The Subversion
Hint: A teenage girl with lost memories enters a TV talent show and draws dangerous attention.
Description: Ja-yoon is a high school student who struggles with memory loss after she endured some unknown trauma during her childhood. While trying to uncover the truth, she is unwittingly dragged into a world of crime and finds herself on a journey that will awaken many secrets hidden deep within.

Title: Ong-Bak: The Thai Warrior
Hint: A villager travels to Bangkok to retrieve the stolen head of a sacred statue using spectacular martial arts.
Description: When the head of a statue sacred to a village is stolen, a young martial artist goes to the big city and finds himself taking on the underworld to retrieve it.

Title: Elle
Hint: A video game executive is assaulted in her home and coolly hunts down her attacker.
Description: When Michèle, the CEO of a gaming software company, is attacked in her home by an unknown assailant, she refuses to let it alter her precisely ordered life. She manages crises involving family, all the while becoming engaged in a game of cat and mouse with her stalker.

Title: The Time Traveler's Wife
Hint: A man with a genetic disorder keeps jumping through time, leaving the woman he loves waiting.
Description: Due to a genetic disorder, handsome librarian Henry DeTamble involuntarily zips through time, appearing at various moments in the life of his true love, the beautiful artist Clare Abshire.

Title: Lords of Dogtown
Hint: Three teenage surfers from Venice Beach revolutionise skateboarding in the 1970s by riding empty swimming pools.
Description: The radical true story behind three teenage surfers from Venice Beach, California, who took skateboarding to the extreme and changed the world of sports forever. Stacy Peralta, Tony Alva and Jay Adams are the Z-Boys, a bunch of nobodies until they create a new style of skateboarding that becomes a worldwide phenomenon. But when their hobby becomes a business, the success shreds their friendship.

Title: The Dark Crystal
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An elf-like orphan sets out to restore a shard to a magical gem and save his world.
Description: On another planet in the distant past, a Gelfling embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical ___ and restore order to his world, before the grotesque race of Skeksis find and use the ___ for evil.

Title: Leave No Trace
Hint: A war veteran and his daughter live off the grid in an Oregon forest until they are found.
Description: A father and daughter live a perfect but mysterious existence in Forest Park, a beautiful nature reserve near Portland, Oregon, rarely making contact with the world. But when a small mistake tips them off to authorities, they are sent on an increasingly erratic journey in search of a place to call their own.

Title: Chariots of Fire
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two British runners, one Jewish and one Christian, compete at the 1924 Olympics.
Description: In the class-obsessed and religiously divided UK of the early 1920s, two determined young runners train for the 1924 Paris Olympics. Eric Liddell, a devout Christian born to Scottish missionaries in China, sees running as part of his worship of God's glory and refuses to train or compete on the Sabbath.

Title: A Tale of Two Sisters
Hint: Two siblings return home from a mental institution to a cold stepmother and ghostly happenings.
Description: Two sisters return home after a stay in a mental institution, only to face disturbing events and a strained relationship with their stepmother. As eerie occurrences unfold, dark family secrets begin to surface, blurring the line between reality and nightmare.

Title: My Bodyguard
Hint: A bullied new kid hires the school's huge, silent loner to protect him.
Description: Clifford Peache, an easygoing teenager, is finding less than easy to fit in at his new high school, where a tough-talking bully terrorizes his classmates and extorts their lunch money. Refusing to pay up, Clifford enlist the aid of an overgrown misfit whose mere presence intimidates students and teachers alike.

Title: The Adventures of Baron Munchausen
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An 18th-century nobleman tells his outrageous tall tales to save a besieged city.
Description: An account of ___ supposed travels and fantastical experiences with his band of misfits.

Title: Three Kings
Hint: A trio of soldiers at the end of the Gulf War set out to steal Saddam's gold.
Description: A group of American soldiers stationed in Iraq at the end of the Gulf War find a map they believe will take them to a huge cache of stolen Kuwaiti gold hidden near their base, and they embark on a secret mission that's destined to change everything.

Title: The Thing from Another World
Hint: Scientists at an Arctic outpost fend off a bloodthirsty plant-based alien.
Description: Scientists and US Air Force officials fend off a blood-thirsty alien organism while investigating at a remote arctic outpost.

Title: Night Moves
Hint: A private detective is hired to find a missing teenage girl in the Florida Keys.
Description: Private detective and former football player Harry Moseby gets hired on to what seems a standard missing person case - a former Hollywood actress wants Moseby to find and return her daughter. Harry travels to Florida to find her, but he begins to see a connection between the runaway girl, the world of Hollywood stuntmen, and a suspicious mechanic when an unsolved murder comes to light.

Title: Marnie
Hint: A beautiful thief who changes identities is blackmailed into marriage by her boss.
Description: ___ is a beautiful but emotionally withdrawn thief, stealing from employers before disappearing under new identities. When her new boss, Mark Rutland, discovers her secret, his fascination turns to obsession, and he blackmails her into marriage, convinced he can cure her. But as he probes deeper into ___ fractured mind, long-buried fears and compulsions begin to surface.

Title: The Swimming Pool
Hint: A couple's lazy summer at a St. Tropez villa turns tense when an old flame visits.
Description: Set in a magnificent villa near a sun-drenched St. Tropez, lovers Jean-Paul and Marianne are spending a happy, lazy summer holiday. Their only concern is to gratify their mutual passion - until the day when Marianne invites her former lover and his beautiful teenage daughter to spend a few days with them.

Title: Thirst
Hint: A priest becomes a vampire after a medical experiment and falls for his friend's wife.
Description: A respected priest volunteers for an experimental procedure that may lead to a cure for a deadly virus. He gets infected and dies, but a blood transfusion of unknown origin brings him back to life. Now, he’s torn between faith and bloodlust, and has a newfound desire for the wife of a childhood friend.

Title: Half Nelson
Hint: An inner-city teacher hides a drug habit until one of his students finds out.
Description: Despite his dedication to the junior-high students who fill his classroom, idealistic teacher Dan Dunne leads a secret life of addiction that the majority of his students will never know. But things change when a troubled student Drey makes a startling discovery of his secret life, causing a tenuous bond between the two that could either end disastrously or provide a catalyst of hope.

Title: Diner
Hint: Five friends in 1959 Baltimore hang out at their favorite late-night eatery to avoid growing up.
Description: Set in 1959, ___ shows how five young men resist their adulthood and seek refuge in their beloved ___. The mundane, childish, and titillating details of their lives are shared. But the golden moments pass, and the men shoulder their responsibilities, leaving the ___ behind.

Title: McLintock!
Hint: A rowdy cattle baron's estranged wife returns to town, and chaos erupts.
Description: Aging rancher and self-made man, George Washington ___ is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men and nearby Native Americans. As ___ tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife—who left him two years previously—suddenly returns.

Title: The Sword in the Stone
Hint: A scrawny orphan is tutored by an eccentric wizard and pulls a legendary blade from a rock.
Description: Wart is a young boy who aspires to be a knight's squire. On a hunting trip he falls in on Merlin, a powerful but amnesiac wizard who has plans for him beyond mere squiredom. He starts by trying to give him an education, believing that once one has an education, one can go anywhere. Needless to say, it doesn't quite work out that way.

Title: The Cat Returns
Hint: A girl rescues a feline prince and is whisked away to a magical kingdom of talking felines.
Description: Young Haru rescues a cat from being run over, but soon learns it's no ordinary feline; it happens to be the Prince of the Cats.

Title: Firebird
Country: Estonia, United Kingdom, United States of America, Germany
Hint: A troubled soldier falls into a forbidden love affair with a fighter pilot during the Cold War.
Description: At the height of the Cold War, a troubled soldier forms a forbidden love triangle with a daring fighter pilot and his female comrade amid the dangerous surroundings of a Soviet Air Force Base.

Title: Time After Time
Genres: Adventure, Drama, Comedy, Science Fiction, Thriller
Hint: A science fiction writer chases Jack the Ripper through time to modern San Francisco.
Description: Writer H. G. Wells pursues Jack the Ripper to modern day San Francisco after the infamous serial killer steals his time machine to escape the 19th century.

Title: Black Mirror: Bandersnatch
Hint: A young programmer in 1984 begins to question reality, in an interactive film.
Description: In 1984, a young programmer begins to question reality as he adapts a dark fantasy novel into a video game. A mind-bending tale with multiple endings.

Title: Beautiful Girls
Hint: Old friends in a snowy Massachusetts town reunite for a high school reunion.
Description: During a snowy winter in the small fictional town of Knight's Ridge, Massachusetts, a group of lifelong buddies hang out, drink and struggle to connect with the women who affect their decisions, dreams and desires.

Title: Bad Santa
Hint: A miserable, drunken mall Saint Nick plans to rob a department store on Christmas Eve.
Description: You'd better watch out - Willie T. Soke is coming to town, and he doesn't care if you've been naughty or nice. Willie's favorite holiday tradition is to fill his sacks with loot lifted from shopping malls across the country. But this year his plot gets derailed by a wisecracking store detective, a sexy bartender, and a kid who's convinced Willie is the real ___ Claus.

Title: The World According to Garp
Hint: A struggling young writer's life is shaped by his feminist mother and a wild series of events.
Description: A struggling young writer finds his life and work dominated by his unfaithful wife and his radical feminist mother, whose best-selling manifesto turns her into a cultural icon.

Title: Sneakers
Hint: A reformed hacker and his team are blackmailed into stealing a code-breaking device.
Description: When shadowy U.S. intelligence agents blackmail a reformed computer hacker and his eccentric team of security experts into stealing a code-breaking 'black box' from a Soviet-funded genius, they uncover a bigger conspiracy. Now, he and his '___' must save themselves and the world economy by retrieving the box from their blackmailers.

Title: Timecrimes
Hint: A man accidentally travels back an hour in time and keeps making things worse.
Description: A man accidentally gets into a time machine and travels back in time nearly an hour. Finding himself will be the first of a series of disasters of unforeseeable consequences.

Title: Balto
Hint: A half-wolf sled dog leads a rescue mission to deliver medicine to Alaska.
Description: An outcast half-wolf risks his life to prevent a deadly epidemic from ravaging Nome, Alaska.

Title: Carnage
Country: France, Germany, Poland, Spain, United States of America
Hint: Two couples meet to discuss a playground fight between their sons and it turns ugly.
Description: Two pairs of parents hold a cordial meeting after their sons are involved in a fight, though as their time together progresses, increasingly childish behavior throws the discussion into chaos.

Title: Cemetery Man
Hint: An Italian graveyard caretaker must re-kill the dead who keep rising from their graves.
Description: Francesco Dellamorte is the groundskeeper at a ___ where the dead just won’t stay dead—and it’s up to him to deal with those who come back to life with a hunger for human flesh. But Dellamorte’s job soon becomes much more complicated when he falls for an enigmatic young woman whose husband has recently died.

Title: The Decameron
Hint: Bawdy tales of sex and trickery from medieval Italy.
Description: A young Sicilian is swindled twice, but ends up rich; a man poses as a deaf-mute in a convent of curious nuns; a woman must hide her lover when her husband comes home early; a scoundrel fools a priest on his deathbed; three brothers take revenge on their sister's lover; a young girl sleeps on the roof to meet her boyfriend at night; a group of painters wait for inspiration; a crafty priest attempts to seduce his…

Title: The Muppets
Hint: A devoted fan helps the felt gang reunite to save their old theatre from an oil baron.
Description: When Kermit the Frog and the ___ learn that their beloved theater is slated for demolition, a sympathetic human, Gary, and his puppet brother, Walter, swoop in to help the gang put on a show and raise the $10 million they need to save the day.

Title: Shattered Glass
Hint: A star journalist at a respected magazine is exposed for fabricating stories.
Description: Stephen ___ is a staff writer for the respected current events and policy magazine The New Republic and a freelance feature writer for publications such as Rolling Stone, Harper's and George.

Title: The Jacket
Genres: Drama, Mystery, Science Fiction, Thriller, Fantasy
Hint: A Gulf War veteran is strapped into a straitjacket and transported to the future.
Description: A military veteran goes on a journey into the future, where he can foresee his death and is left with questions that could save his life and those he loves.

Title: Swiss Family Robinson
Hint: A shipwrecked family builds a new life on a tropical island and fights off pirates.
Description: After being shipwrecked, the ___ family is marooned on an island inhabited only by an impressive array of wildlife. In true pioneer spirit, they quickly make themselves at home but soon face a danger even greater than nature: dastardly pirates.

Title: Breathe
Hint: A man paralyzed by polio defies doctors to live a full life with his wife.
Description: Based on the true story of Robin, a handsome, brilliant and adventurous man whose life takes a dramatic turn when polio leaves him paralyzed.

Title: Concussion
Hint: A forensic pathologist discovers football players are dying of brain damage.
Description: A dramatic thriller based on the incredible true David vs. Goliath story of American immigrant Dr. Bennet Omalu, the brilliant forensic neuropathologist who made the first discovery of CTE, a football-related brain trauma, in a pro player and fought for the truth to be known. Omalu's emotional quest puts him at dangerous odds with one of the most powerful institutions in the world.

Title: Queen & Slim
Hint: A couple on a first date kill a cop in self-defense and go on the run.
Description: While on a forgettable first date together in Ohio, a black man and a black woman are pulled over for a minor traffic infraction. The situation escalates, with sudden and tragic results.

Title: Parallel Mothers
Hint: Two women giving birth on the same day form a bond that leads to a startling secret.
Description: Two unmarried women who have become pregnant by accident and are about to give birth meet in a hospital room: Janis, in her late-thirties, unrepentant and happy; Ana, a teenager, remorseful and frightened.

Title: Winnie the Pooh
Hint: The honey-loving bear and his friends set off to rescue their gloomy donkey friend.
Description: During an ordinary day in Hundred Acre Wood, ___ sets out to find some honey. Misinterpreting a note from Christopher Robin, Owl convinces ___, Tigger, Rabbit, Piglet, Kanga, Roo, and Eeyore that their young friend has been captured by a creature named "Backson" and they set out to rescue him.

Title: Race
Hint: A Black sprinter wins four gold medals at the 1936 Berlin Olympics.
Description: Based on the story of Jesse Owens, the athlete whose quest to become the greatest track and field athlete in history thrusts him onto the world stage of the 1936 Olympics, where he faces off against Adolf Hitler's vision of Aryan supremacy.

Title: Blood and Black Lace
Hint: A masked killer stalks models at a Roman fashion house.
Description: Isabella, a young model, is murdered by a mysterious masked figure at a fashion house in Rome. When her diary, which details the house employees' many vices, disappears, the masked killer begins killing off all the models in and around the house to find it.

Title: Casualties of War
Hint: A soldier in Vietnam refuses to join his squad when they kidnap a Vietnamese girl.
Description: During the Vietnam War, a soldier finds himself the outsider of his own squad when they unnecessarily kidnap a female villager.

Title: The Year of Living Dangerously
Hint: An Australian reporter in Indonesia is caught up in political turmoil and a love affair.
Description: A young Australian reporter tries to navigate the political turmoil of Indonesia during the rule of President Sukarno with the help of a diminutive photographer.

Title: The Three Musketeers
Hint: A young swordsman travels to Paris and joins the king's legendary guards to stop a plot.
Description: D'Artagnan travels to Paris hoping to become a musketeer, one of the French king's elite bodyguards, only to discover that the corps has been disbanded by conniving Cardinal Richelieu, who secretly hopes to usurp the throne. Fortunately, Athos, Porthos and Aramis have refused to lay down their weapons and continue to protect their king. D'Artagnan joins with the rogues to expose Richelieu's plot against the crown.

Title: Megan Leavey
Hint: A Marine corporal forms a powerful bond with a combat dog in Iraq.
Description: The true story of Marine Corporal ___, who forms a powerful bond with an aggressive combat dog, Rex. While deployed in Iraq, the two complete more than 100 missions and save countless lives, until an IED explosion puts their faithfulness to the test.

Title: Michael Collins
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An Irish revolutionary fights for independence and is caught in a civil war.
Description: ___ plays a crucial role in the establishment of the Irish Free State in the 1920s, but becomes vilified by those hoping to create a completely independent Irish republic.

Title: The Fearless Vampire Killers
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A professor and his bumbling apprentice hunt bloodsuckers in a Transylvanian castle.
Description: A noted professor and his dim-witted apprentice fall prey to their inquiring vampires, while on the trail of the ominous damsel in distress.

Title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
Hint: A teenager checks himself into a psychiatric ward and befriends a patient.
Description: A clinically depressed teenager gets a new start after he checks himself into an adult psychiatric ward.

Title: Wag the Dog
Hint: A spin doctor and a Hollywood producer stage a fake war to distract the public.
Description: During the final weeks of a presidential race, the President is accused of sexual misconduct. To distract the public until the election, the President's adviser hires a Hollywood producer to help him stage a fake war.

Title: If Beale Street Could Talk
Hint: A young woman fights to prove her fiancé's innocence before their baby is born.
Description: After her fiance is falsely imprisoned, a pregnant African-American woman sets out to clear his name and prove his innocence.

Title: Guys and Dolls
Hint: A gambler bets he can take a missionary to Havana.
Description: In New York, a gambler is challenged to take a cold female missionary to Havana, but they fall for each other, and the bet has a hidden motive to finance a crap game.

Title: Chopper
Hint: The violent story of Australia's notorious criminal who became a bestselling author.
Description: The true and infamous story of Australia's notorious criminal Mark '___' Read and his years of crime, interest in violence, drugs and prostitutes.

Title: Human Traffic
Hint: Five friends in Cardiff live for their weekends of clubbing and drugs.
Description: For Jip, Lulu, Koop, Nina and Moff, the dead-end jobs they endure during the week just kill the time until Friday night. That's when they cut very loose and get on the rollercoaster ride that takes them right through to Monday morning.

Title: The Devil's Double
Hint: An Iraqi soldier is forced to become the lookalike stand-in for Saddam Hussein's sadistic son.
Description: A chilling vision of the House of Saddam Hussein comes to life through the eyes of the man who was forced to become the ___ of Hussein's sadistic son.

Title: Nicholas Nickleby
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young man struggles to save his family from his cruel uncle in Victorian England.
Description: ___, a young boy in search of a better life, struggles to save his family and friends from the abusive exploitation of his coldheartedly grasping uncle.

Title: The Driver
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A silent, nameless getaway wheelman is pursued by an obsessed detective in nighttime Los Angeles.
Description: The ___ specializes in driving getaway cars for robberies. His exceptional talent has prevented him from being caught yet. After another successful flight from the police a self-assured detective makes it his primary goal to catch the ___. He promises pardons to a gang if they help to convict him in a set-up robbery. The ___ seeks help from The Player to mislead the detective.

Title: Can You Ever Forgive Me?
Hint: A celebrity biographer who has fallen on hard times turns to forging letters from famous writers.
Description: When a bestselling celebrity biographer is no longer able to get published because she has fallen out of step with current tastes, she turns her art form to deception.

Title: Black Sunday
Hint: A vengeful witch returns from the dead to possess her lookalike descendant.
Description: A vengeful witch, Asa Vajda, and her fiendish servant, Igor Jauvitch, return from the grave and begin a bloody campaign to possess the body of the witch's beautiful look-alike descendant: Katia. Only a handsome doctor with the help of family members stand in her way.

Title: District B13
Hint: A cop and a free runner enter a walled-off Paris suburb to defuse a bomb.
Description: Set in the ghettos of Paris in 2010, an undercover cop and ex-thug try to infiltrate a gang in order to defuse a neutron bomb.

Title: Help!
Hint: A sinister cult pursues a rock drummer for a sacrificial ring he can't remove.
Description: An obscure Eastern cult that practices human sacrifice pursues Ringo after he unknowingly puts on a ceremonial ring (that, of course, won't come off). On top of that, a pair of mad scientists, members of Scotland Yard, and a beautiful but dead-eyed assassin all have their own plans for the Fab Four.

Title: Silkwood
Hint: A nuclear plant worker becomes a whistleblower and dies mysteriously.
Description: Like most of the people in her town, Karen ___ works at the local nuclear plant producing highly radioactive plutonium. Exposed one day to a lethal dose of radiation, Karen faces the blank walls of corporate indifference and denial. As her illness increases, her protest grows louder and she becomes an obvious danger to the powers that be.

Title: Kon-Tiki
Country: Denmark, Germany, Norway, Sweden, United Kingdom
Hint: A Norwegian explorer crosses the Pacific on a balsa raft.
Description: The true story about legendary explorer Thor Heyerdahl and his epic crossing of the Pacific on a balsa wood raft in 1947, in an effort to prove it was possible for South Americans to settle in Polynesia in pre-Columbian times.

Title: Kinky Boots
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A struggling Northampton shoe factory owner teams up with a drag queen to make footwear for drag performers.
Description: Charles Price may have grown up with his father in the family shoe business in Northampton, central England, but he never thought that he would take his father's place. Charles has a chance encounter with the flamboyant drag queen cabaret singer Lola and everything changes.

Title: I'm Your Man
Hint: A scientist is asked to live with a humanoid robot designed to be her perfect partner.
Description: Alma is a scientist coerced into participating in an extraordinary study in order to obtain research funds for her work. For three weeks, she has to live with a humanoid robot tailored to her character and needs, whose artificial intelligence is designed to be the perfect life partner for her. Enter Tom, a machine in human form in a class of its own, created solely to make her happy.

Title: Dangerous Beauty
Hint: A courtesan in 16th-century Venice is put on trial for witchcraft.
Description: Veronica is brilliant, gifted and beautiful, but the handsome aristocrat she loves, Marco Venier, cannot marry her because she is penniless and of questionable family. So Veronica's mother, Paola, teaches her to become a courtesan, one of the exotic companions favored by the richest and most powerful Venetian men. Veronica courageously uses her charms to change destiny -- and to give herself a chance at true love.

Title: Big Jake
Hint: An aging Texas cattle baron sets out to rescue his kidnapped grandson.
Description: An aging Texas cattle man who has outlived his time swings into action when outlaws kidnap his grandson.

Title: Don 2
Hint: A crime lord plans to take over the European underworld.
Description: Having conquered the Asian underworld, crime boss Don sets in motion a plan that will give him dominion over Europe.

Title: Three O'Clock High
Hint: A nerd is challenged to a fight by the school bully at the end of the day.
Description: Nerdy high schooler Jerry Mitchell is assigned to write an article for the school paper about the infamous new delinquent transfer student, Buddy Revell. When Jerry accidentally invades Buddy's personal space and touches him, Buddy challenges Jerry to an afterschool fight in the parking lot, which Jerry tries to avoid at all costs.

Title: Safe
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Los Angeles housewife develops a mysterious illness she blames on chemicals.
Description: Carol White, a Los Angeles housewife in the late 1980s, comes down with a debilitating illness with no clear diagnosis.

Title: The Railway Man
Country: Australia, France, Switzerland, Thailand, United Kingdom
Hint: A WWII veteran tortured while building the Burma death line sets out to find his captor.
Description: A victim from World War II's "Death ___" sets out to find those responsible for his torture. A true story.

Title: The Girl Who Played with Fire
Hint: A hacker investigates a sex-trafficking ring and is framed for murder.
Description: Mikael Blomkvist, publisher of Millennium magazine, has made his living exposing the crooked and corrupt practices of establishment Swedish figures. So when a young journalist approaches him with a meticulously researched thesis about sex trafficking in Sweden and those in high office who abuse underage girls, Blomkvist immediately throws himself into the investigation.

Title: The Great Mouse Detective
Hint: A rodent sleuth in Victorian London rescues a toymaker from a villainous professor rat.
Description: When the diabolical Professor Ratigan kidnaps London's master toymaker, the brilliant master of disguise Basil of Baker Street and his trusted sidekick Dawson try to elude the ultimate trap and foil the perfect crime.

Title: The Believer
Hint: A brilliant young Jewish man in New York hides his roots and becomes a violent, charismatic neo-Nazi.
Description: A hardcore US racist skinhead who, because of his intelligence, leads a gang dedicated to fighting the enemy: the supposed American-Jewish conspiracy for domination. However, he's hiding a secret: he's Jewish-born, a brilliant scholar whose questioning of the tenets of his faith has left him angry and confused, turning against those who he thinks have a tragic history of their own making.

Title: The White Tiger
Country: Singapore, United States of America, India
Hint: An ambitious Indian driver uses his cunning to escape poverty.
Description: An ambitious Indian driver uses his wit and cunning to escape from poverty and rise to the top. An epic journey based on the New York Times bestseller.

Title: Crossroads
Hint: A young blues guitarist seeks a lost song from a legendary bluesman.
Description: A wanna-be blues guitar virtuoso seeks a long-lost song by legendary musician, Robert Johnson.

Title: Broken Flowers
Hint: A man visits his ex-lovers to find out if he has a son.
Description: An introverted man receives an anonymous letter from an ex-lover informing him that he has a son who may be looking for him. A freelance sleuth neighbor motivates the man to embark on a cross-country search for his past flames, seeking answers.

Title: Kinsey
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A portrait of the researcher who uncovered the sexual behaviour of Americans.
Description: ___ is a portrait of researcher Alfred ___, driven to uncover the most private secrets of a nation. What begins for ___ as a scientific endeavor soon takes on an intensely personal relevance, ultimately becoming an unexpected journey into the mystery of human behavior.

Title: Tracks
Hint: A woman crosses the Australian desert with four camels and her dog.
Description: Accompanied only by her faithful dog and four camels, an Australian satisfies her craving for solitude by embarking on a solo trip across the desert from Alice Springs to the Indian Ocean.

Title: Nixon
Hint: The rise and fall of a paranoid US president, from his childhood to Watergate.
Description: A look at President Richard M. ___—a man carrying the fate of the world on his shoulders while battling the self-destructive demands from within—spanning his troubled boyhood in California to the shocking Watergate scandal that would end his Presidency.

Title: First Cow
Hint: A cook and a Chinese immigrant in 1820s Oregon start a business with milk secretly stolen from a rich man's animal.
Description: In the 1820s, a taciturn loner and skilled cook travels west to Oregon Territory, where he meets a Chinese immigrant also seeking his fortune. Soon the two team up on a dangerous scheme to steal milk from the wealthy landowner’s prized Jersey ___—the first, and only, in the territory.

Title: Tangerine
Hint: A trans sex worker searches Los Angeles for her cheating pimp on Christmas Eve.
Description: It's Christmas Eve in Tinseltown and Sin-Dee is back on the block. Upon hearing that her pimp boyfriend hasn't been faithful during the 28 days she was locked up, the working girl and her best friend, Alexandra, embark on a mission to get to the bottom of the scandalous rumor.

Title: Orlando
Country: United Kingdom, France, Russia, Italy, Netherlands
Hint: An English nobleman lives for 400 years and changes gender.
Description: England, 1600. Queen Elizabeth I promises ___, a young nobleman obsessed with poetry, that she will grant him land and fortune if he agrees to satisfy a very particular request.

Title: American Me
Hint: A Chicano gang leader rules over Folsom prison but can't escape his past.
Description: During his 18 years in Folsom Prison, street-gang leader Santana rules over all the drug-and-murder activities behind bars. Upon his release, Santana goes back to his old neighborhood, intending to lead a peaceful, crime-free life. But his old gang buddies force him back into his old habits.

Title: The Panic in Needle Park
Hint: A young woman falls in love with a heroin addict in New York.
Description: A stark portrayal of life among a group of heroin addicts who hang out in ___ Park in New York City. Played against this setting is a low-key love story between Bobby, a young addict and small-time hustler, and Helen, a homeless girl who finds in her relationship with Bobby the stability she craves.

Title: The Good Boss
Hint: A factory owner meddles in his employees' lives before an awards inspection.
Description: Julio Blanco is the proprietor of Básculas Blanco, a Spanish company producing industrial scales in a provincial Spanish town, which awaits the imminent visit from a committee that will decide if they merit a local Business Excellence award: everything has to be perfect when the time comes.

Title: Mosul
Hint: An Iraqi SWAT team fights ISIS to liberate their home city.
Description: When ISIS took their homes, families and city, one group of men fought to take it all back. Based on true events, this is the story of the Nineveh SWAT team, a renegade police unit who waged a guerrilla operation against ISIS in a desperate struggle to save their home city of ___.

Title: Benny's Video
Hint: A teenager obsessed with violent tapes films himself committing a murder.
Description: A 14-year-old video enthusiast obsessed with violent films decides to make one of his own and show it to his parents, with tragic results.

Title: Southern Comfort
Hint: A squad of National Guardsmen on a swamp exercise are hunted by Cajuns.
Description: A squad of National Guards on an isolated weekend exercise in the Louisiana swamp must fight for their lives when they anger local Cajuns by stealing their canoes. Without live ammunition and in a strange country, their experience begins to mirror the Vietnam experience.

Title: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
Hint: An American writer in Rome witnesses an attempted murder by a serial killer.
Description: An American writer living in Rome witnesses an attempted murder that is connected to an ongoing killing spree in the city and conducts his own investigation, despite him and his girlfriend being targeted by the killer.

Title: Valerie and Her Week of Wonders
Hint: A teenage girl in a dreamlike Czech village is threatened by vampires.
Description: ___, a Czechoslovakian teenager living with her grandmother, is blossoming into womanhood, but that transformation proves secondary to the effects she experiences when she puts on a pair of magic earrings.

Title: Cold Fish
Hint: A meek tropical aquarium store owner gets drawn into a charismatic serial killer's business.
Description: When ___ shop owner Shamoto's teenage daughter Mitsuko is caught stealing, a generous middle-aged man named Murata helps resolve the situation. The man and his wife offer to have Mitsuko work at their opposing ___ store. Shamoto soon discovers that something far more sinister lives behind Murata's friendly demeanor.

Title: 45 Years
Hint: A week before their anniversary, a husband learns the body of his old lover has been found.
Description: There is just one week until Kate Mercer's 45th wedding anniversary and the planning for the party is going well. But then a letter arrives for her husband. The body of his first love has been discovered, frozen and preserved in the icy glaciers of the Swiss Alps. By the time the party is upon them, five days later, there may not be a marriage left to celebrate.

Title: Nowhere Boy
Hint: A teenage future rock star grows up in Liverpool with his strict aunt.
Description: A rebellious teenager, future Beatle John Lennon lives with his Aunt Mimi in working-class mid-1950s Liverpool, England. Mimi's husband suddenly dies, and John spies his mother Julia at the funeral. Despite Mimi's misgivings, John intends to have a real relationship with his mother. Julia introduces him to popular music and the banjo and, though a family conflict looms, young John is inspired to form his own band.

Title: The Kings of Summer
Hint: Three teenagers run away and build a house in the woods.
Description: Three restless teenagers run away to the woods for the summer, determined to escape their parents and live by their own rules. In a hidden clearing, they build a makeshift house and attempt to create an independent life, testing their friendship, freedom, and the challenges of living off the land.

Title: Titus
Country: United Kingdom, Italy, United States of America
Hint: A Roman general returns from war and is drawn into a cycle of revenge.
Description: ___ Andronicus returns from the wars and sees his sons and daughters taken from him, one by one. Shakespeare's goriest and earliest tragedy.

Title: Whatever Works
Hint: A misanthropic physicist marries a naive runaway from Mississippi.
Description: ___ explores the relationship between a crotchety misanthrope, Boris and a naïve, impressionable young runaway from the south, Melody. When Melody's uptight parents arrive in New York to rescue her, they are quickly drawn into wildly unexpected romantic entanglements. Everyone discovers that finding love is just a combination of lucky chance and appreciating the value of "___."

Title: The Horse Soldiers
Hint: A Union cavalry unit raids deep behind Confederate lines.
Description: A Union Cavalry outfit is sent behind confederate lines in strength to destroy a rail supply center. Along with them is sent a doctor who causes instant antipathy between him and the commander. The secret plan for the mission is overheard by a southern belle who must be taken along to assure her silence.

Title: Trial by Fire
Hint: A Texas father is executed for setting the blaze that killed his daughters.
Description: The tragic and controversial story of Cameron Todd Willingham, who was executed in Texas for killing his three children after scientific evidence and expert testimony that bolstered his claims of innocence were suppressed.

Title: White Oleander
Hint: A teenager goes through foster homes after her poet mother goes to prison.
Description: A teenager journeys through a series of foster homes after her mother goes to prison for committing a crime of passion.

Title: The Seven Year Itch
Hint: A married man flirts with his blonde neighbor while his family is away for the summer.
Description: When his family goes away for summer vacation, a hitherto faithful publishing executive with an overactive imagination is tempted by an attractive new neighbor.

Title: Like Water for Chocolate
Hint: A young woman's cooking expresses her forbidden love for her sister's husband.
Description: Tita is passionately in love with Pedro, but her controlling mother forbids her from marrying him. When Pedro marries her sister, Tita throws herself into her cooking and discovers she can transfer her emotions through the food she prepares, infecting all who eat it with her intense heartbreak.

Title: Eye of the Needle
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A German spy with vital D-Day secrets is stranded on a remote Scottish island.
Description: Great Britain, 1944, during World War II. Relentlessly pursued by several MI5 agents, Henry Faber the ___, a ruthless German spy in possession of vital information about D-Day, takes refuge on Storm Island, an inhospitable, sparsely inhabited island off the coast of northern Scotland.

Title: The Whistleblower
Hint: A Nebraska cop working as a peacekeeper discovers a sex trafficking ring in post-war Bosnia.
Description: Nebraska cop Kathryn Bolkovac discovers a deadly sex trafficking ring while serving as a U.N. peacekeeper in post-war Bosnia. Risking her own life to save the lives of others, she uncovers an international conspiracy that is determined to stop her, no matter the cost.

Title: The Big Feast
Hint: Four friends gather at a villa to eat themselves to death.
Description: Four friends gather at a villa with the intention of eating themselves to death.

Title: Gloria
Hint: A tough moll protects a young boy from the mob after his family is killed.
Description: When a young boy's family is killed by the mob, their tough neighbor ___ becomes his reluctant guardian. In possession of a book that the gangsters want, the pair go on the run in New York.

Title: On the Beach
Hint: The last survivors of a nuclear war in Australia await the radiation.
Description: In 1964, atomic war wipes out humanity in the northern hemisphere; one American submarine finds temporary safe haven in Australia, where life-as-usual covers growing despair. In denial about the loss of his wife and children in the holocaust, American Captain Towers meets careworn but gorgeous Moira Davidson, who begins to fall for him.

Title: Barfly
Hint: A drunken poet and a hard-drinking woman share a dive bar in Los Angeles.
