Description: Downtrodden writer Henry and distressed goddess Wanda aren't exactly husband and wife: they're wedded to their bar stools. But, they like each other's company—and ___ captures their giddy, gin-soaked attempts to make a go of life on the skids.

Title: Female Trouble
Hint: A delinquent teen becomes a criminal celebrity after her parents deny her shoes.
Description: Teenage delinquent Dawn Davenport, incensed after her parents do not give her the cha-cha heels she wanted for Christmas, runs away from home. After an illegitimate child and hairstylist husband bring her more misery, she's enticed into a life of crime when the owners of her husband's salon promise her fame and fortune.

Title: A Love Song for Bobby Long
Hint: A young woman returns to New Orleans and finds two drunken literary men in her mother's house.
Description: A headstrong young woman returns to New Orleans after the death of her estranged mother.

Title: Venus in Fur
Hint: An actress auditions for a play and turns the tables on the director.
Description: An enigmatic actress may have a hidden agenda when she auditions for a part in a misogynistic writer's play.

Title: Goodbye Christopher Robin
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A writer creates his famous bear stories inspired by his son's toys.
Description: The behind the scenes story of the life of A.A. Milne and the creation of the Winnie the Pooh stories inspired by his son ___.

Title: Quo Vadis
Hint: A Roman commander falls for a Christian hostage under Nero.
Description: After fierce Roman commander Marcus Vinicius becomes infatuated with beautiful Christian hostage Lygia, he begins to question the tyrannical leadership of the despotic emperor Nero.

Title: Thursday
Genres: Thriller, Action, Comedy, Crime, Drama, Mystery
Hint: A former drug dealer's quiet life is disrupted by his old friend.
Description: A former Los Angeles drug dealer moves far away to Texas, making a new life for himself as a married architect in the suburbs. His old crime partner unexpectedly shows up with heroin and gangster business, attracting a slew of violent unsavory characters.

Title: The Big Red One
Hint: A veteran sergeant leads a squad through the battles of World War II.
Description: A veteran sergeant of World War I leads a squad in World War II, always in the company of the survivor Pvt. Griff, the writer Pvt. Zab, the Sicilian Pvt. Vinci and Pvt. Johnson, in Vichy French Africa, Sicily, D-Day at Omaha Beach, Belgium and France, and ending in a concentration camp in Czechoslovakia where they face the true horror of war.

Title: One False Move
Hint: Three criminals flee from Los Angeles to a small Arkansas town.
Description: Following a series of drug deals and murders, three criminals -- Fantasia, Ray Malcolm and Pluto -- travel from Los Angeles to Houston, finally arriving in a small Arkansas town to go into hiding. Two detectives from the LAPD, who are already on the case, contact the town's sheriff, Dale Dixon, to alert him of the fugitives' presence in the area.

Title: The Abominable Dr. Phibes
Hint: A disfigured doctor kills the surgeons he blames for his wife's death using biblical plagues.
Description: After a team of surgeons botches his beloved wife's operation, the distraught Dr. ___ unleashes a score of Old-Testament atrocities on his enemies.

Title: Mission Majnu
Hint: An undercover Indian spy goes to Pakistan to expose a nuclear weapons program.
Description: Set in the 1970s, an undercover Indian spy takes on a deadly mission to expose a covert nuclear weapons program in the heart of Pakistan.

Title: The Parallax View
Hint: A reporter investigates a senator's assassination and uncovers a conspiracy.
Description: An ambitious reporter gets in trouble while investigating a senator's assassination which leads to a vast conspiracy involving a multinational corporation behind every event in the world's headlines.

Title: One Night in Miami...
Hint: A young boxer, a soul singer, a football star and an activist spend one evening together in 1964.
Description: In the aftermath of Cassius Clay's defeat of Sonny Liston in 1964, the boxer meets with Malcolm X, Sam Cooke and Jim Brown to change the course of history in the segregated South.

Title: Chasing Mavericks
Hint: A young surfer trains with a mentor to ride a giant wave.
Description: Surfer Jay Moriarity sets out to ride the Northern California break known as ___.

Title: The Chase
Hint: An escaped convict's return brings out the worst in a Texas town.
Description: The escape of Bubber Reeves from prison affects the inhabitants of a small Southern town.

Title: Law of Desire
Hint: A film director's obsessive young lover becomes dangerous, in a Spanish melodrama.
Description: Pablo, a successful film director, disappointed in his relationship with his young lover, Juan, concentrates in a new project, a monologue starring his transgender sister, Tina. Antonio, an uptight young man, falls possessively in love with the director and in his passion would stop at nothing to obtain the object of his ___.

Title: Fantasia 2000
Hint: Classical music set to animation in a new sequel.
Description: Blending lively music and brilliant animation, this sequel to the original '___' restores 'The Sorcerer's Apprentice' and adds seven new shorts.

Title: One-Eyed Jacks
Hint: A bank robber seeks revenge on his partner, who became a sheriff.
Description: Running from the law after a bank robbery in Mexico, Dad Longworth finds an opportunity to take the stolen gold and leave his partner Rio to be captured. Years later, Rio escapes from the prison where he has been since, and hunts down Dad for revenge. Dad is now a respectable sheriff in California, and has been living in fear of Rio's return.

Title: Theater of Blood
Hint: A Shakespearean actor takes revenge on his critics by killing them in the style of the plays.
Description: A Shakespearean actor takes poetic revenge on the critics who denied him recognition.

Title: Brubaker
Hint: A new warden poses as an inmate to expose corruption in a prison farm.
Description: The new warden of a small prison farm in Arkansas tries to clean it up of corruption after initially posing as an inmate.

Title: The Sons of Katie Elder
Hint: Four brothers reunite after their mother's funeral to avenge their father's death.
Description: The four ___ reunite in their hometown of Clearwater, Texas for her funeral and discover that the family ranch is now in the hands of Morgan Hastings, a corrupt businessman who wants to exploit the area around the town.

Title: Nothing But the Truth
Hint: A reporter is jailed for refusing to reveal her source in a CIA leak.
Description: When reporter Rachel Armstrong writes a story that reveals the identity of a covert CIA operative, the government demands that Rachel reveal her source. She defies the special prosecutor and is thrown in jail. Meanwhile, her attorney, Albert Burnside argues her case all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court.

Title: Trees Lounge
Hint: An unemployed mechanic drinks his life away in a local bar.
Description: Tommy has lost his job, his love and his life. He lives in a small apartment above the ___, a bar which he frequents along with a few other regulars without lives. He gets a job driving an ice cream truck and ends up getting involved with the seventeen-year-old niece of his ex-girlfriend. This gets him into serious trouble with her father.

Title: Julieta
Hint: A woman recalls her estranged daughter over 30 years in a melodrama.
Description: The film spans 30 years in ___ life from a nostalgic 1985 where everything seems hopeful, to 2015 where her life appears to be beyond repair and she is on the verge of madness.

Title: The Power of One
Hint: An English orphan in South Africa learns boxing and fights apartheid.
Description: PK, an English orphan terrorized for his family's political beliefs in Africa, turns to his only friend, a kindly world-wise prisoner, Geel Piet. Geel teaches him how to box with the motto “fight with your fists and lead with your heart”. As he grows to manhood, PK uses these words to take on the system and the injustices he sees around him - and finds that one person really can make a difference.

Title: A Brilliant Young Mind
Hint: A math prodigy with autism competes in an international math olympiad.
Description: A socially awkward teenage math prodigy finds new confidence and new friendships when he lands a spot on the British squad at the International Mathematics Olympiad.

Title: In the Fade
Hint: A German woman seeks justice after her family dies in a neo-Nazi attack.
Description: Katja's life collapses after the deaths of her husband and son in a bomb attack. After a time of mourning and injustice, Katja seeks revenge.

Title: Two Hands
Hint: A young Sydney gangster loses his boss's money and must get it back.
Description: 19-year-old Jimmy is just scraping by in the red-light district of Sydney. When local crime lord Pando offers him a shot at working for his syndicate, Jimmy jumps at the chance to deliver a costly package. But, when Jimmy gets jacked by a couple of kids, he's indebted to the dangerous gangster for $10,000.

Title: 5 to 7
Hint: A young writer begins an affair with an older woman allowed only in the evenings.
Description: A young writer begins an affair with an older woman from France whose open marriage to a diplomat dictates that they can meet only between the hours of ___ p.m. to ___ p.m.

Hint: A series of incidents converge at a specific time in a small town.
Description: Tells the seemingly random yet vitally connected story of a set of incidents that all converge one evening at ___:14pm. The story follows the chain of events of five different characters and five different storylines that all converge to tell the story of murder and deceit.

Title: The Brand New Testament
Hint: God lives in Brussels as a cruel man, and his daughter rebels against him.
Description: God lives in Brussels. On Earth though, God is a coward, morally pathetic and odious to his family. His daughter, Ea, is bored at home and can't stand being locked up in a small apartment in ordinary Brussels, until the day she decides to revolt against her dad...

Title: Father of the Bride
Hint: A dad struggles to let go as his daughter plans her expensive wedding.
Description: George Banks is an ordinary, middle-class man whose 22 year-old daughter Annie has decided to marry a man from an upper-class family, but George can't think of what life would be like without his daughter. His wife tries to make him happy for Annie, but when the wedding takes place at their home and a foreign wedding planner takes over the ceremony, he becomes slightly insane.

Title: Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom
Country: France, South Africa, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The life of South Africa's first Black president, from activism to 27 years in prison to the presidency.
Description: A chronicle of Nelson ___ life journey from his childhood in a rural village through to his inauguration as the first democratically elected president of South Africa.

Title: Before Night Falls
Hint: A Cuban poet is persecuted for his homosexuality and his writing.
Description: Spanning several decades, this powerful biopic offers a glimpse into the life of famed Cuban poet and novelist Reinaldo Arenas, an artist who was vilified for his homosexuality in Fidel Castro's Cuba.

Title: Hatari!
Hint: A wildlife photographer joins hunters capturing animals in Africa.
Description: A female wildlife photographer arrives on an East African reservation where a group of men trap wild animals for zoos and circuses.

Title: Son of Frankenstein
Hint: The heir of a famous scientist revives his father's stitched-together creation.
Description: One of the sons of late Dr. Henry ___ finds his father's ghoulish creation in a coma and revives him, only to find out the monster is controlled by Ygor who is bent on revenge.

Title: Department Q: The Absent One
Hint: A detective reopens the murder of twins at a boarding school.
Description: Denmark, 2014. A former police officer asks Carl Mørck, head of ___, to find out who brutally killed his young twins in 1994. Although a local inhabitant confessed and was convicted of murder, Carl and his partner Assad soon realize that there is something in the case resolution that is terribly wrong.

Title: Sleeper
Hint: A health food store owner wakes up 200 years in the future.
Description: Miles Monroe, a clarinet-playing health food store proprietor, is revived out of cryostasis 200 years into a future world in order to help rebels fight an oppressive government regime.

Title: Gantz: O
Hint: A teen killed in a subway is resurrected to fight monsters in Osaka.
Description: After being brutally murdered in a subway station, a teen boy awakens to find himself resurrected by a strange computer named ___, and forced to fight a large force of invading aliens in Osaka.

Title: The Wings of the Dove
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A woman plots to get her fiancé to marry a dying heiress.
Description: Kate is secretly betrothed to a struggling journalist, Merton Densher. But she knows her Aunt Maude will never approve of the match, since Kate's deceased mother has lost all her money in a marriage to a degenerate opium addict. When Kate meets a terminally ill American heiress named Millie traveling through Europe, she comes up with a conniving plan to have both love and wealth.

Title: The Hater
Hint: A young man uses social media to destroy a politician.
Description: A duplicitous young man finds success in the dark world of social media smear tactics — but his virtual vitriol soon has violent real-life consequences.

Title: Turkish Delight
Hint: A sculptor has a stormy romance with a young woman.
Description: Gifted but hot-headed sculptor Eric has a stormy, erotic, and star-crossed romance with a beautiful young woman named Olga.

Title: My King
Hint: A woman recovers from an accident and recalls her tumultuous marriage.
Description: Tony is admitted to a rehabilitation center after a serious ski accident. Dependent on the medical staff and pain relievers, she takes time to look back on a turbulent relationship that she experienced with Georgio.

Title: Narc
Country: United States of America, Germany, Canada
Hint: A narcotics cop investigates the murder of an undercover officer in Detroit.
Description: Narcotics Sergeant Nick Tellis, on leave after a trauma, is called back to investigate the murder of fellow undercover operative Michael Calvess, joined by the victim's unpredictable and brutal ex-partner, Henry Oak.

Title: Pele: Birth of a Legend
Hint: The life story of a Brazilian football icon, from the slums to winning the 1958 World Cup.
Description: The life story of Brazilian football legend, ___.

Title: JCVD
Hint: An action star is caught in a post office robbery in his hometown.
Description: Between his tax problems and his legal battle with his wife for the custody of his daughter, these are hard times for the action movie star who finds that even Steven Seagal has pinched a role from him!

Title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral
Hint: A lawman and a gambling dentist team up for a famous shootout in Tombstone.
Description: Lawman Wyatt Earp and outlaw Doc Holliday form an unlikely alliance which culminates in their participation in the legendary ___.

Title: Julia
Hint: A playwright smuggles money into Nazi Germany for her friend.
Description: At the behest of an old and dear friend, playwright Lillian Hellman undertakes a dangerous mission to smuggle funds into Nazi Germany.

Title: Everybody's Fine
Hint: A widower travels across America to visit his grown children, who hide their troubles from him.
Description: Eight months after the death of his wife, Frank Goode looks forward to a reunion with his four adult children. When all of them cancel their visits at the last minute, Frank, against the advice of his doctor, sets out on a road trip to reconnect with his offspring. As he visits each one in turn, Frank finds that his children's lives are not quite as picture-perfect as they've made them out to be.

Title: The Great Muppet Caper
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Puppets go to London to investigate a jewel theft.
Description: Kermit and Fozzie are newspaper reporters sent to London to interview Lady Holiday, a wealthy fashion designer whose priceless diamond necklace is stolen. Kermit meets and falls in love with her secretary, Miss Piggy. The jewel thieves strike again, and this time frame Miss Piggy. It's up to Kermit and the rest of the Muppets to bring the real culprits to justice.

Title: The Traitor
Hint: A mafioso becomes an informant and brings down the Sicilian Mafia.
Description: Palermo, Sicily, 1980. Mafia member Tommaso Buscetta decides to move to Brazil with his family fleeing the constant war between the different clans of the criminal organization. But when, after living several misfortunes, he is forced to return to Italy, he makes a bold decision that will change his life and the destiny of Cosa Nostra forever.

Title: Trailer Park Boys: The Movie
Hint: Three Nova Scotia slackers plan one last heist after getting out of jail.
Description: The boys get arrested for robbing an ATM machine and spend 18 months in jail, upon release they decide to pull off "The Big Dirty", a plan to steal a large amount of coins because they are untraceable and quit their life of crime forever.

Title: In Order of Disappearance
Hint: A snowplow driver seeks revenge for his son's murder.
Description: Upstanding community leader Nils has just won an award for "Citizen of the Year" when he learns the news that his son has died of a heroin overdose. Suspecting foul play, Nils begins to investigate, and soon finds himself at the center of an escalating underworld gang war between Serbian drug dealers and a sociopathic criminal mastermind known only as “The Count.”

Title: The Most Dangerous Game
Hint: A famous hunter is shipwrecked on a remote island and hunted for sport by a deranged Russian count.
Description: When legendary hunter Bob Rainsford is shipwrecked on the perilous reefs surrounding a mysterious island, he finds himself the guest of the reclusive and eccentric Count Zaroff.

Title: Little White Lies
Hint: A group of friends go on a summer vacation despite a traumatic accident.
Description: Despite a traumatic event, a group of friends decide to go ahead with their annual beach vacation. Their relationships, convictions, sense of guilt and friendship are sorely tested. They are finally forced to own up to the ___ they've been telling each other.

Title: Wild Rose
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Scottish singer dreams of making it in Nashville.
Description: A young Scottish singer, ___-Lynn Harlan, dreams of making it as a country artist in Nashville after being released from prison.

Title: Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods
Hint: A god of destruction awakens and threatens to destroy Earth.
Description: After the defeat of Majin Buu, a powerful God of Destruction known as Beerus searches for the Saiyan warrior who defeated Frieza. Realizing the threat Beerus poses to Earth, the Z-fighters must stop him. Only Goku, humanity’s last hope, can ascend to the level of a legendary Super Saiyan God and save the planet, and possibly the entire universe!

Title: L.I.E.
Hint: A teenager in Long Island is befriended by a predator.
Description: With his mother dead and his father busy at work, Howie feels adrift in his New York suburb. He and his friend Gary spend their time burglarizing their neighbors' homes — until they make the mistake of robbing the house of Big John, a macho former Marine who is also an unrepentant pedophile. He propositions Howie, who declines, but the two eventually develop an unlikely and dangerous friendship.

Title: Arthur Christmas
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Santa's clumsy youngest son must deliver a forgotten gift before the children wake up.
Description: For hundreds of years, the Claus family has delegated the title "Santa" to a chosen few of its members, which can be passed down upon retirement. Each Christmas, Santa and his vast army of highly trained elves produce gifts and distribute them around the world in a one-night high-tech operation.

Title: The Savages
Hint: A sister and brother care for their dementia-stricken father.
Description: A sister and brother face the realities of familial responsibility as they begin to care for their ailing father.

Title: Forever Strong
Hint: A rebellious rugby player is sent to a juvenile facility.
Description: Hotshot rugby player Rick Penning was the star player of his Arizona high school team until a fateful brush with the law forces him to ponder the consequences of his actions in a Salt Lake City juvenile detention center.

Title: Saboteur
Hint: A factory worker is falsely accused of sabotage and flees across America.
Description: Aircraft factory worker Barry Kane flees across the United States after he is wrongly accused of starting the fire that killed his best friend.

Title: Things We Lost in the Fire
Hint: A widow invites her husband's addicted friend to live with her.
Description: A recent widow invites her husband's troubled best friend to live with her and her two children. As he gradually turns his life around, he helps the family cope and confront their loss.

Title: Kilo Two Bravo
Hint: British soldiers are trapped in a minefield in Afghanistan.
Description: British soldiers guarding the Kajaki Dam set out to rescue a three-man team after one of them loses a leg to a landmine.

Title: Belle Epoque
Hint: A deserter falls for four sisters in 1931 Spain.
Description: In 1931, a young soldier deserts from the army and falls into a country farm, where he is welcomed by the owner due to his political ideas. Manolo has four daughters, Fernando likes all of them and they like him, so he has to decide which one to love.

Title: Love in the Afternoon
Hint: A playboy becomes fascinated by the daughter of the detective who spies on him.
Description: A middle-aged playboy becomes fascinated by the daughter of a private detective who has been hired to entrap him with a client's wife.

Title: The Age of Shadows
Hint: Resistance fighters and a Japanese police officer play cat and mouse in 1920s Korea.
Description: Set in the late 1920s, The ___ follows the cat-and-mouse game that unfolds between a group of resistance fighters trying to bring in explosives from Shanghai to destroy key Japanese facilities in Seoul, and Japanese agents trying to stop them.

Title: Welcome to the Sticks
Hint: A postal manager from the south of France is transferred to the far north.
Description: Although living a comfortable life in Salon-de-Provence, a charming town in the South of France, Julie has been feeling depressed for a while. To please her, Philippe Abrams, a post office administrator, her husband, tries to obtain a transfer to a seaside town, on the French Riviera, at any cost. The trouble is that he is caught red-handed while trying to scam an inspector.

Title: Into the White
Hint: Enemy pilots shot down in Norway must survive together.
Description: During World War II, enemy fighter pilots find themselves face to face after shooting down one another's planes over a desolate landscape. In order to survive, they must set aside the rules of war.

Title: The Boston Strangler
Hint: A serial killer terrorizes a New England city in the 1960s.
Description: ___ is being terrorized by a series of seemingly random murders of women. Based on the true story, the film follows the investigators path through several leads before introducing the ___ as a character. It is seen almost exclusively from the point of view of the investigators who have very few clues to build a case upon.

Title: Adam
Hint: A pregnant stranger is taken in by a widowed baker in Casablanca.
Description: Abla runs a modest local bakery from her home in Casablanca where she lives alone with her 8-year-old daughter Warda. Their routine of housework and homework is interrupted one day by a knock on the door. It is Samia, a young woman looking for a job and a roof over her head.

Title: Under the Sand
Hint: A woman refuses to accept her husband's disappearance at the beach.
Description: When her husband goes missing at the beach, a female professor begins to mentally disintegrate as her denial of his disappearance becomes delusional.

Title: Shotgun Stories
Hint: A feud erupts between two sets of half-brothers after their father's funeral in Arkansas.
Description: ___ tracks a feud that erupts between two sets of half brothers following the death of their father. Set against the cotton fields and back roads of Southeast Arkansas, these brothers discover the lengths to which each will go to protect their family.

Title: The Admiral: Roaring Currents
Hint: A Korean naval commander defends his nation with just 13 ships against hundreds.
Description: ___ Yi Sun-sin faces a tough challenge when he is forced to defend his nation with just 13 battleships against 300 Japanese enemy ships in the Battle of Myeongryang.

Title: Heartbeats
Hint: Two best friends fall for the same young man.
Description: Francis is a young gay man, Marie is a young straight woman and the two of them are best friends -- until the day the gorgeous Nicolas walks into a Montreal coffee shop. The two friends, instantly and equally infatuated, compete for Nicolas' indeterminate affections, a conflict that climaxes when the trio visit the vacation home of Nicolas' mother.

Title: Last Night
Hint: Toronto residents await the end of the world at midnight.
Description: Various citizens of Toronto anxiously await the end of the world, which is occurring at the stroke of midnight on New Year's Day.

Title: Bella
Hint: A rising soccer star's life is derailed by a tragic accident, and he helps a pregnant waitress in New York.
Description: An international soccer star is on his way to sign a multimillion dollar contract when something happens that brings his career to an abrupt end. A beautiful waitress, struggling to make it in New York City, discovers something about herself that she's unprepared for. In one irreversible moment, their lives are turned upside down.

Title: Paddleton
Hint: Two neighbours' friendship takes on new meaning when one is diagnosed with cancer.
Description: An unlikely friendship between two neighbors becomes an unexpectedly emotional journey when the younger man is diagnosed with terminal cancer.

Title: Win Win
Hint: A struggling lawyer becomes the guardian of an elderly client.
Description: When down-on-his-luck part-time high school wrestling coach Mike agrees to become legal guardian to an elderly man, his ward's troubled grandson turns out to be a star grappler, sparking dreams of a big win -- until the boy's mother retrieves him.

Title: The Trouble with Terkel
Hint: A boy has a run of bad luck after sitting on a spider.
Description: 6th-grader ___ begins experiencing a streak of bad luck after sitting on a black spider. His teacher dies and is replaced by the strange Justin. At home, ___ Uncle Stewart erupts in sporadic fits of rage, and at school ___ is bullied by two boys after they learn that fat Doris likes him. On a school camping trip, ___ begins receiving death threats and must figure out who wants to kill him.

Title: Wendy and Lucy
Hint: A drifter loses her dog on her way to Alaska.
Description: A near-penniless drifter's journey to Alaska in search of work is interrupted when she loses her dog while attempting to shoplift food for it.

Title: Pieta
Hint: A loan shark is forced to reconsider his violent lifestyle when a woman claims to be his mother.
Description: A loan shark is forced to reconsider his violent lifestyle after the arrival of a mysterious woman claiming to be his long-lost mother.

Title: Made in Dagenham
Hint: Female workers strike for equal pay at the Ford plant.
Description: A dramatization of the 1968 strike at the Ford ___ car plant, where female workers walked out in protest against sexual discrimination.

Title: Lore
Hint: German siblings abandoned by their Nazi parents cross Germany.
Description: After being abandoned by their Nazi parents at the end of World War II, five German siblings embark on a harrowing journey across their war-torn country. Led by the eldest, 14 year-old ___, the children are forced to confront their parents’ actions and the reality of a new world.

Title: Children Who Chase Lost Voices
Hint: A girl goes on a journey to a mystical land.
Description: The film centers on Asuna, a young girl who spends her solitary days listening to the mysterious music emanating from the crystal radio she received from her late father as a memento. One day while walking home she is attacked by a fearsome monster and saved by a mysterious boy named Shun. However, Shun disappears and Asuna embarks on a journey of adventure to the land of Agartha with her teacher Mr.

Title: What Have I Done to Deserve This?
Hint: An exhausted, pill-popping Madrid housewife with a dysfunctional family takes drastic action with a ham bone.
Description: A henpecked housewife ekes out a meager existence, surrounded by a host of colorful characters: her ungrateful husband, her delinquent sons, her headstrong mother-in-law, and her sex worker neighbor, among others.

Title: Bird
Hint: A brilliant bebop saxophonist's genius is shadowed by heroin addiction in 1940s and 50s New York.
Description: Saxophone player Charlie ‘___’ Parker comes to New York in 1940 and is quickly noticed for his remarkable way of playing. He becomes a drug addict but his loving wife Chan tries to help him.

Title: My Neighbors the Yamadas
Hint: Episodes from the life of an ordinary Japanese family.
Description: The ___ are a typical middle class Japanese family in urban Tokyo and this film shows us a variety of episodes of their lives. With tales that range from the humorous to the heartbreaking, we see this family cope with life's little conflicts, problems, and joys in their own way.

Title: Venus
Hint: An aging actor becomes infatuated with a young woman.
Description: Maurice is an aging veteran actor who becomes taken with Jessie, the grandniece of his closest friend. When Maurice tries to soften the petulant and provincial young girl with the benefit of his wisdom and London culture, their give-and-take surprises both Maurice and Jessie as they discover what they don't know about themselves.

Title: May God Save Us
Hint: Two mismatched detectives hunt a serial killer of elderly women during the Pope's 2011 visit to Madrid.
Description: Madrid, summer 2011. Economic crisis. 15-M movement and 1.5 million pilgrims waiting for the Pope’s arrival live side by side in a Madrid that’s hotter and more chaotic than ever. In this context, detectives Velarde and Alfaro must find what seems to be a serial killer. Their against-the-clock hunt will make them realise something they’d never imagined: neither of them are so very different from the killer.

Title: Police Story 2
Hint: A super-cop demoted to traffic duty battles a gang of blackmailing bombers in Hong Kong.
Description: The Hong Kong super-cop must stop a group of blackmailing bombers at the same time that the villains of the first Police Story are out for revenge.

Title: Stage Beauty
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Germany
Hint: A male actor who plays women's roles is upstaged by a female dresser.
Description: Humble Maria, who outfits top London theater star Ned Kynaston, takes none of the credit for the male actor's success at playing women. And because this is the 17th century, Maria, like other females, is prohibited from pursuing her dream of acting. But when powerful people support her, King Charles II lifts the ban on female ___ performers.

Title: Kaabil
Hint: A blind man avenges his blind wife's death after the police fail them.
Description: Rohan is a kind, happy young man who has been blind since birth and works as a voice-over artist for a living. Through friends, he meets Supriya, a working woman who is also blind, but proudly independent. The two start liking each other and get married. Rohan toughest journey starts in his quest of vengeance for Supriya's indirect murderers.

Title: The Dark Valley
Hint: A mysterious rider arrives in a remote Alpine village ruled by a tyrannical family.
Description: The Alps, late 19th century. Greider, a mysterious lone rider who claims to be a photographer, arrives at an isolated lumber village, despotically ruled by a family clan, asking for winter accommodation.

Title: A Late Quartet
Hint: The cellist of a famed string ensemble is diagnosed with Parkinson's, and the group cracks.
Description: When the beloved cellist of a world-renowned string ___ is diagnosed with a life threatening illness, the group's future suddenly hangs in the balance as suppressed emotions, competing egos and uncontrollable passions threaten to derail years of friendship and collaboration.

Title: Micmacs
Hint: A man whose life was ruined by arms dealers seeks revenge with misfits.
Description: While standing in the doorway of the video shop where he works, Bazil is inadvertently shot in the head. Now homeless and jobless, he is taken in by a troupe of misfits who live in a giant mound of trash. There Bazil begins his quest for revenge against the people who produced the gun that shot him.

Title: Trash
Hint: A heroin addict searches for drugs in New York.
Description: The movie follows Joe, a heroin addict, throughout his quest to score more drugs. The episodic plot occurs over a single day and centers on Joe's problematic relationship with his on-off, sexually frustrated girlfriend.

Title: Enthiran
Hint: A scientist creates a robot that falls in love.
Description: Dr. Vaseegaran creates Chitti, a powerful robot in his own image, but it is rejected by the scientific body AIRD due to its lack of human behaviour and emotions. After a lightning strike triggers emotions in Chitti, he begins to develop human-like feelings. However, Chitti falls in love with Dr. Vaseegaran's fiancée, Sana, and turns against his creator, leading to dangerous consequences.

Title: Caramel
Hint: Five women's lives cross at a Beirut beauty salon.
Description: In a beauty salon in Beirut the lives of five women cross paths. The beauty salon is a colorful and sensual microcosm where they share and entrust their hopes, fears and expectations.

Title: In the Company of Men
Hint: Two executives plot to seduce and dump a deaf woman.
Description: Two business executives--one an avowed misogynist, the other recently emotionally wounded by his love interest--set out to exact revenge on the female gender by seeking out the most innocent, uncorrupted girl they can find and ruining her life.

Title: 9th Company
Hint: A unit of young Soviet paratroopers is sent to a remote hilltop in the final days of the Afghan war.
Description: Russian army recruits complete training and take their posting in late 1980s Afghanistan, where the insurgents are slowly gaining the upper hand.

Title: Shootout at Lokhandwala
Hint: A gunfight between police and gangsters erupts in a Mumbai apartment complex.
Description: An account of the gangster Maya Dolas and his gang which terrorized Mumbai City, and the ensuing standoff between Mumbai Police and the gang on 16 November 1991.

Title: Ruby & Quentin
Hint: An outlaw breaks out of prison with a dim-witted cellmate.
Description: After hiding his loot and getting thrown in jail, brooding outlaw ___ befriends ___, a dim-witted and garrulous giant. After ___ botches a solo escape attempt, they make a break together. Unable to shake the clumsy ___ is forced to take him along as he pursues his former partners in crime to avenge the death of the woman he loved and get to the money.

Title: Code Unknown
Hint: A series of events in Paris unfold from a minor incident.
Description: A series of events unfold like a chain reaction, all stemming from a minor event that brings the film's five characters together. Set in Paris, France, Anne is an actress whose boyfriend Georges photographs the war in Kosovo. Georges' brother, Jean, is looking for the entry ___ to Georges' apartment. These characters' lives interconnect with a Romanian immigrant and a deaf teacher.

Title: The Method
Hint: Seven candidates locked in a Madrid office compete in a ruthless, manipulative group job interview.
Description: Seven candidates to a high executive position on a multinational company show up for a selection test in a skyscraper at the financial district. Among them, the most disparate personalities: the winner, the aggressive, the insecure, the critic, the indecisive…

Title: Frozen River
Hint: A mother smuggles immigrants across an icy border in the trunk of her car.
Description: After her husband deserts her, working-class mother Ray Eddy is in great need of money to find a home. Lured by the possibility of easy cash, she joins Lila, a widowed Mohawk who earns a living by smuggling immigrants from Canada to the U.S. across the St. Lawrence.

Title: Ill Manors
Hint: Six interconnected stories of drugs, violence and survival on an east London council estate, told with rap.
Description: Ensemble film revolving around characters living in Forest Gate, London. Over the course of a few days, six inter-linking stories explore issues of drug use, prostitution and urban poverty.

Title: Priest
Hint: A young Catholic cleric struggles with his faith and his secret life in Liverpool.
Description: The deeply held religious convictions of an idealistic young ___ are challenged when he must face extraordinary events within his own congregation.

Title: Koi... Mil Gaya
Hint: A developmentally disabled young man befriends a stranded alien who gives him extraordinary powers.
Description: A developmentally disabled boy's life changes after he encounters an extraterrestrial being.

Title: Climates
Hint: A university lecturer and his younger girlfriend's relationship quietly falls apart across Turkish seasons.
Description: Isa and Bahar are two lonely figures dragged through the ever-changing climate of their inner selves in pursuit of a happiness that no longer belongs to them.

Title: A Hijacking
Hint: A Danish cargo ship is hijacked by Somali pirates, and a tense ransom negotiation drags on for months.
Description: Tensions are high after a Danish freighter is captured and held for ransom by Somali pirates, leading to weeks of high-stakes negotiations – and an escalating potential for explosive violence.

Title: Double Trouble
Hint: A singer is pursued by women and jewel thieves.
Description: When singer Guy Lambert goes on tour in Europe, he is pursued by two beautiful women, bumbling jewel thieves, and a mysterious killer.

Title: He Loves Me, He Loves Me Not
Hint: An art student is obsessively in love with a married doctor.
Description: A talented art student named Angélique is passionately in love with Dr. Loïc Le Garrec, a handsome married man whom she believes will leave his wife. When he eventually decides to stay in his marriage, it causes Angélique to spiral. However, as the story shifts from Angélique's perspective to Loïc's, the surprising truth about their relationship is revealed.

Title: Timbuktu
Hint: Jihadists seize a Malian desert city and ban music, while a herder's family tries to live quietly.
Description: Just outside of the Malian city of ___, now occupied by militant Islamic rebels who impose the Sharia on civilians and inconvenience their daily life, a cattleman kills a fisherman.

Title: We Are the Best!
Hint: Three 13-year-old girls in 1980s Stockholm start a punk band with no instruments and no skills.
Description: Three girls in 1980s Stockholm decide to form a punk band—despite not having any instruments, and being told by everyone that punk is dead.

Title: Crime Busters
Hint: Two jobless men try to rob a police station by mistake and end up recruited as cops.
Description: An attempted robbery turns to be an unexpected recruitment when two unemployed men mistakenly break into a police office instead of a store.

Title: Little Nicholas
Hint: A cheerful French schoolboy fears a new baby will replace him and schemes with his gang.
Description: Nicolas has a happy existence, parents who love him, a great group of friends with whom he has great fun, and all he wants is that nothing changes. However, one day, he overhears a conversation that leads him to believe that his life might change forever, his mother is pregnant! He panics and envisions the worst.

Title: The Butcher Boy
Hint: A troubled Irish boy with a drunk father slips into violent fantasy in the 1960s.
Description: Francie and Joe live the usual playful, fantasy filled childhoods of normal boys. However, with a violent, alcoholic father and a manic depressive, suicidal mother the pressure on Francie to grow up are immense. When Francie's world turns to madness, he tries to counter it with further insanity, with dire consequences.

Title: Metallica Through the Never
Hint: A young roadie is sent on a surreal errand across a burning city during a heavy-metal concert.
Description: Trip, a young roadie for ___, is sent on an urgent mission during the band's show. But what seems like a simple assignment turns into a surreal adventure.

Title: Klown
Hint: Two crude Danish friends take a 12-year-old on a canoe trip that is secretly a brothel tour.
Description: Frank is left with the responsibility for his nephew Bo on an already planned canoe trip. Frank's mate Casper is also coming along. Weighed down a with their obligation, Frank and Casper nevertheless look forward to ending the trip at Skanderborg Festival where there's plenty there for the guys, a spree of drinking and women. Not the best example to set for young Bo. And how do their partners see it all?

Title: Woman of the Year
Hint: Two rival newspaper writers, a sportswriter and a political columnist, marry and clash.
Description: Rival reporters Sam Craig and Tess Harding fall in love and get married, only to find their relationship strained when Sam comes to resent Tess' hectic lifestyle.

Title: Looking for Eric
Country: United Kingdom, France, Italy, Belgium, Spain
Hint: A depressed Manchester postman gets life advice from the imaginary ghost of his football idol.
Description: A man trying to put his life back on track gets some advice from an unexpected benefactor -- the ex-footballer ___ Cantona.

Title: With a Friend Like Harry...
Hint: A family on vacation meets an old schoolmate who wants to help them, whatever it takes.
Description: While fixing up their summer cottage, Michel and his family run into a man who claims to have gone to high school with Michel.

Title: Hannah Arendt
Hint: A German-Jewish philosopher reports on the trial of a Nazi war criminal in Jerusalem.
Description: A portrait of the genius that shook the world with her discovery of “the banality of evil.” After she attends the Nazi Adolf Eichmann’s trial in Jerusalem, ___ dares to write about the Holocaust in terms no one has ever heard before. Her work instantly provokes a furious scandal, and ___ stands strong as she is attacked by friends and foes alike.

Title: 36th Precinct
Hint: Two Paris cops compete for the boss's job while hunting a violent gang.
Description: In Paris, two cops are competing for the vacant job of chief of police, in the middle of the search for a gang of violent thieves. The movie is directed by Olivier Marchal, a former police officer who spent 12 years with the French police before creating this story, taken in part from real events of the 1980s.

Title: Cargo 200
Hint: A professor's car breaks down in 1984 Russia, and he stumbles into a nightmare of corruption.
Description: While returning to Leningrad from a visit to his brother, Professor Artyom's car breaks down and he finds assistance at an isolated farmhouse occupied by Alexey, his wife, a Vietnamese laborer, and a stranger who wanders around the farm. When his car is repaired, Artyom leaves, drunk on moonshine, and students Valera and Angelika arrive. After Valera gets drunk, the stranger abducts Angelika.

Title: The Connection
Hint: Addicts in a New York loft wait for their dealer while a documentary crew films them.
Description: Eight drug addicts are waiting for their ___ in a New York apartment while a two-man documentary team films the proceedings. Things go out of control as the men grow increasingly nervous and the cameraman keeps recording.

Title: Ferpect Crime
Hint: A Madrid department store playboy is blackmailed into a relationship with an unattractive coworker.
Description: A playboy has the tables turned on him when he finds himself being used as a plaything by an undesirable woman.

Title: Fanaa
Hint: A blind Kashmiri dancer falls for a charming tour guide who is secretly a terrorist.
Description: Zooni Ali Beg is a blind Kashmiri girl who travels without her parents for the first time with a dance troupe to Delhi to perform in a ceremony for independence day. On her journey, she meets Rehan Khan, a casanova and tour guide who flirts with her. Although her friends warn Zooni about him, she cannot resist falling in love with him and he takes her on a private tour of New Delhi.

Title: Time
Hint: A mother fights for two decades to free her husband from prison, in a documentary.
Description: Fox Rich, indomitable matriarch and modern-day abolitionist, strives to keep her family together while fighting for the release of her incarcerated husband. An intimate, epic, and unconventional love story, filmed over two decades.

Title: Go for It
Hint: Two drifters are mistaken for bank robbers and become special agents by accident.
Description: After Doug picks up hitchhiking Rosco with his truck, they are mistaken for two bank robbers by the traffic police. They manage to escape only to be confused for two secret agents while trying to take a flight at the airport.

Title: The Aura
Hint: An epileptic taxidermist in Argentina plans the perfect robbery during a hunting trip.
Description: A quiet, epileptic taxidermist plans the perfect crime. All he needs is the right opportunity. An accident, perhaps…

Title: Raajneeti
Hint: Two political families tear each other apart in a fierce election campaign.
Description: It is the story of a fiercely fought election campaign, where money power and corruption are the accepted norms, and where treachery and manipulation are routinely used weapons. As the personal drama of these conflict-ridden characters unfolds against this gritty backdrop, love and friendship become mere baits, and relationships get sacrificed at the altar of political alignments.

Title: The Gendarme of Saint-Tropez
Hint: An ambitious policeman is transferred to the French Riviera and struggles with nudists.
Description: The ambitious police officer Cruchot is transferred to St. ___. He's struggling with crimes such as persistent nude swimming, but even more with his teenage daughter, who's trying to impress her rich friends by telling them her father was a millionaire and owned a yacht in the harbor.

Title: Violent Cop
Hint: A ruthless detective breaks every rule while investigating a colleague's drug dealing.
Description: A detective breaks all rules of ethical conduct while investigating a colleague’s involvement in drug pushing and Yakuza activities.

Title: Wazir
Hint: A wheelchair-bound chess grandmaster and a grieving cop team up against a powerful politician.
Description: '___' is a tale of two unlikely friends, a wheelchair-bound chess grandmaster and a brave ATS officer. Brought together by grief and a strange twist of fate, the two men decide to help each other win the biggest games of their lives. But there's a mysterious, dangerous opponent lurking in the shadows, who is all set to checkmate them.

Title: Marighella
Hint: A Brazilian poet and politician leads an armed resistance against the military dictatorship.
Description: Afro-Brazilian poet and politician, the legendary Carlos ___. Driven to fight against the erosion of civil and human rights following the CIA-backed military coup of 1964 and the brutal, racist right-wing dictatorship that followed, the revolutionary leaves behind his wife and son to take up arms, becoming a notorious enemy to the power structure.

Title: Luck by Chance
Hint: A young actress moves to Mumbai and learns how fortune shapes Bollywood careers.
Description: Not wanting the same fate as befell her sisters, Sona Mishra re-locates to Mumbai to try to make a living making movies, but she soon finds that the path she has chosen is not an easy one.

Title: Gabbar Is Back
Hint: A vigilante network takes out corrupt officials across the state.
Description: A vigilante network taking out corrupt officials draws the notice of the authorities.

Title: Blackmail
Hint: A woman kills a man in self-defense and is blackmailed while her detective boyfriend investigates.
Description: London, 1929. Frank Webber, a very busy Scotland Yard detective, seems to be more interested in his work than in Alice White, his girlfriend. Feeling herself ignored, Alice agrees to go out with an elegant and well-mannered artist who invites her to visit his fancy apartment.

Title: War of the Arrows
Country: South Korea, United States of America
Hint: A master archer chases the Manchu army to rescue his kidnapped sister.
Description: After the death of their father, two siblings are raised by their father's best friend. However, when one gets kidnapped just before her wedding, the other rises against the Manchus.

Title: Sonu Ke Titu Ki Sweety
Hint: A man suspects his best friend's fiancée is a gold digger and sets out to expose her.
Description: ___ is going to marry a perfect woman named ___. ___ best-friend ___ doubts ___ character and tries to break the marriage while ___ tries to do opposite and which leads to war between Bromance and Romace.

Title: Who Finds a Friend Finds a Treasure
Hint: Two men race to find wartime gold on a small Pacific island.
Description: Alan gets a map to some war ___ which the Japanese army left behind on a small Pacific island at the end of World War II. But some gangsters try to steal the map from him and so he hides on Charlie's boat which just leaves the harbor. He manipulates the ship's compass so that Charlie is not aware that he is sailing to the ___ island.

Title: The Women on the 6th Floor
Hint: An uptight Paris stockbroker discovers the lives of the Spanish maids who live upstairs.
Description: Paris, in the early 1960s. Jean-Louis Joubert is a serious but uptight stockbroker, married to Suzanne, a starchy class-conscious woman and father of two arrogant teenage boys, currently in a boarding school. The affluent man lives a steady yet boring life.

Title: A Touch of Sin
Hint: Four people in different Chinese provinces are driven to violence.
Description: Four people in different provinces are driven to violent ends: An angry miner is enraged by corruption in his village. A migrant discovers the possibilities of owning a firearm. A receptionist is pushed beyond her limits by an abusive client. A young factory worker goes from one job to the next.

Title: The Bow
Hint: An old fisherman plans to marry the girl he has raised on his boat.
Description: On a fishing boat at sea, a 60-year old man has been raising a girl since she was a child. It is agreed that they will get married on her 17th birthday. They live a quiet and secluded life, renting the boat to day fishermen and practicing strange divination rites. Their life changes when a teenage student comes aboard.

Title: A Small September Affair
Hint: A spoiled woman's heart stops in an accident, and she falls for the man who caused it.
Description: A beautiful girl who has everything. A sudden car crash, and her heart stops for a few minutes. When she wakes up, everyone assures that everything’s alright. But she knows it isn’t. Because she cant remember her final month; a ___ of her life is missing.

Title: Khuda Haafiz
Hint: A man searches for his wife, who disappeared after taking a job in the Middle East.
Description: When the 2008 recession leaves Sameer Chaudhary and his wife Nargis jobless, they struggle to make a living and after three months, succeed when they find jobs in a Middle East country named Noman. Due to delay in arrival of documents, Sameer stays in India while Nargis heads to Noman, upon arriving where she is abducted as she pleads for help over a phone call to Sameer.

Title: Karthik Calling Karthik
Hint: A lonely loser receives mysterious phone calls from himself that change his life.
Description: A much abused loner achieves success, and even wins the heart of his gorgeous co-worker, after getting early morning mysterious phone calls from someone.

Title: Paa
Hint: A 13-year-old with progeria befriends a politician who turns out to be his father.
Description: Auro suffers from a progeria like syndrome. Mentally he is 13 but physically he looks 5 times older. In spite of his condition, Auro is a very happy boy. He lives with his mother Vidya, who is a gynaecologist. Amol is young, progressive politician. He is a man with a mission. Auro is Amol's son. ___ is a 'rare' story about a father-son, son-father relationship.

Title: Goodbye Bafana
Hint: A white South African prison guard is changed by his famous prisoner.
Description: The true story of a white South African racist whose life was profoundly altered by the black prisoner he guarded for twenty years. The prisoner's name was Nelson Mandela.

Title: Barefoot
Hint: The black sheep of a wealthy family takes a young psychiatric patient on a road trip.
Description: The "black sheep" son of a wealthy family meets a young psychiatric patient who's been raised in isolation her entire life. He takes the naive young woman home for his brother's wedding an improbable romance blooms, as she impresses everyone with her genuine, simple charms.

Title: Asterix in Britain
Hint: Two Gauls travel across the Channel to deliver a magic potion to their cousin.
Description: One little ancient British village still holds out against the Roman invaders. ___ and Obelix are invited to help. They must face fog, rain, warm beer and boiled boar with mint sauce, but they soon have Governor Encyclopaedius Britannicus's Romans declining and falling. Until a wild race for a barrel of magic potion lands them in the drink.

Title: Namastey London
Hint: A father forces his British-born daughter to marry an Indian villager.
Description: On a trip to India, Jasmeet's father forcefully marries her off to Arjun. However, when they return to London, Jasmeet announces her intention of marrying her boyfriend, Charlie Brown.

Title: Elemental
Hint: A fiery young woman and a go-with-the-flow guy discover how much they have in common.
Description: In a city where fire, water, land and air residents live together, a fiery young woman and a go-with-the-flow guy will discover something ___: how much they have in common.

Title: Bottoms
Hint: Two unpopular girls start a fight club to impress cheerleaders.
Description: Unpopular best friends PJ and Josie start a high school self-defense club to meet girls and lose their virginity. They soon find themselves in over their heads when the most popular students start beating each other up in the name of self-defense.

Title: Red, White & Royal Blue
Hint: The US president's son and a British prince fall in love after an altercation.
Description: After an altercation between Alex, the president's son, and Britain's Prince Henry at a ___ event becomes tabloid fodder, their long-running feud now threatens to drive a wedge in U.S./British relations. When the rivals are forced into a staged truce, their icy relationship begins to thaw and the friction between them sparks something deeper than they ever expected.

Title: American Pie
Hint: Four high school friends make a pact to lose their virginity before prom.
Description: At a high-school party, four friends find that losing their collective virginity isn't as easy as they had thought. But they still believe that they need to do so before college. To motivate themselves, they enter a pact to all "score" by their senior prom.

Title: Pearl
Hint: A young farm girl in 1918 Texas dreams of stardom and turns murderous.
Description: Trapped on her family’s isolated farm, ___ must tend to her ailing father under the bitter and overbearing watch of her devout mother. Lusting for a glamorous life like she’s seen in the movies, ___ ambitions, temptations, and repressions collide.

Title: Last Night in Soho
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, China
Hint: A fashion student is transported to 1960s London and finds a nightmare.
Description: A young girl, passionate about fashion design, is mysteriously able to enter the 1960s where she encounters her idol, a dazzling wannabe singer. But 1960s London is not what it seems, and time seems to be falling apart with shady consequences.

Title: Barbarian
Hint: A young woman arrives at her rental home to find it double-booked by a stranger, and a dark secret beneath.
Description: In town for a job interview, a young woman arrives at her Airbnb late at night only to find that it has been mistakenly double-booked and a strange man is already staying there. Against her better judgement, she decides to stay the night anyway.

Title: The Foreigner
Country: China, India, United Kingdom, United States of America, Switzerland
Hint: A London restaurant owner seeks revenge after his daughter dies in a terrorist bombing.
Description: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love – his teenage daughter – dies in an Irish Republican Army car bombing. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

Title: Kids
Hint: Bored New York teens spend a day skating, drinking and having unprotected sex.
Description: A group of bored, disaffected New York City teenagers spend a day skating, smoking, drinking, partying, deflowering virgins, and getting into fights.

Title: Extraction II
Hint: A battle-scarred mercenary rescues a Georgian gangster's ex-wife and children from a fortress prison.
Description: Back from the brink of death, highly skilled commando Tyler Rake takes on another dangerous mission: saving the imprisoned family of a ruthless gangster.

Title: A Good Person
Country: Canada, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A woman's life falls apart after a fatal accident, and she bonds with her late fiancé's father.
Description: Allison's life falls apart following her involvement in a fatal accident. The unlikely relationship she forms with her would-be father-in-law helps her live a life worth living.

Title: Spy
Hint: A desk-bound CIA analyst goes undercover to stop an arms dealer.
Description: A desk-bound CIA analyst volunteers to go undercover to infiltrate the world of a deadly arms dealer, and prevent diabolical global disaster.

Title: The VVitch: A New-England Folktale
Country: Brazil, Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Puritan family in 1630s colonial America is torn apart by suspicions of witchcraft and a mysterious black goat.
Description: In 1630, a farmer relocates his family to a remote plot of land on the edge of a forest where strange, unsettling things happen. With suspicion and paranoia mounting, each family member's faith, loyalty and love are tested in shocking ways.

Title: Matilda
Hint: A brilliant girl with telekinetic powers stands up to her awful parents and a monstrous principal.
Description: ___ Wormwood is an brilliant and intelligent little girl. Unfortunately, her parents, Harry and Zinnia, fail to see that fact. As time passes, she finally starts school and has a kind teacher, loyal friends, and a terrifying, sadistic headmistress. As she becomes fed up with the constant cruelty, she discovers she has a special gift that she just might be able to use to outwit the unruly adults around her.

Title: The Cabin in the Woods
Hint: College friends at a remote woodland getaway discover they are part of an elaborate ritual.
Description: Five friends set out for a weekend at a remote ___, expecting nothing more than fun and relaxation. As night falls, they discover that something far more unsettling is at work and that nothing about their getaway is what it seems.

Title: The Outsiders
Hint: Greasers from the wrong side of town fight rich kids in 1960s Oklahoma.
Description: In 1960s Tulsa, class divisions ignite a violent rivalry between the working-class Greasers and the privileged Socs. When a deadly encounter forces two Greasers, Ponyboy and Johnny, to flee, their struggle for survival and redemption exposes the fragile innocence and enduring bonds of youth on the wrong side of town.

Title: The Northman
Hint: A Viking prince seeks revenge for his father's murder in a brutal saga.
Description: Prince Amleth is on the verge of becoming a man when his father is brutally murdered by his uncle, who kidnaps the boy's mother. Two decades later, Amleth is now a Viking who's on a mission to save his mother, kill his uncle and avenge his father.

Title: Prometheus
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Explorers travel to a distant moon to find humanity's creators.
Description: A team of explorers discover a clue to the origins of mankind on Earth, leading them on a journey to the darkest corners of the universe. There, they must fight a terrifying battle to save the future of the human race.

Title: Happy Gilmore
Hint: A failed hockey player discovers he can hit a golf ball 400 yards.
Description: Failed hockey player-turned-golf whiz ___ — whose unconventional approach and antics on the green courts the ire of rival Shooter McGavin — is determined to win a PGA tournament so he can save his granny's house with the prize money. Meanwhile, an attractive tour publicist tries to soften Happy's image.

Title: We're the Millers
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A pot dealer creates a fake family to smuggle drugs across the Mexican border.
Description: A veteran pot dealer creates a fake family as part of his plan to move a huge shipment of weed into the U.S. from Mexico.

Title: Logan Lucky
Hint: Two brothers plan a heist during a NASCAR race.
Description: Trying to reverse a family curse, brothers Jimmy and Clyde ___ set out to execute an elaborate robbery during the legendary Coca-Cola 600 race at the Charlotte Motor Speedway.

Title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
Hint: A movie star plays himself and is recruited by the CIA to spy on a fan.
Description: Creatively unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, Nick Cage must accept a $1 million offer to attend the birthday of a dangerous superfan. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when Cage is recruited by a CIA operative and forced to live up to his own legend, channeling his most iconic and beloved on-screen characters in order to save himself and his loved ones.

Title: Constantine
Hint: A cynical exorcist with lung cancer tries to buy his way into Heaven.
Description: John ___ has literally been to Hell and back. When he teams up with a policewoman to solve the mysterious suicide of her twin sister, their investigation takes them through the world of demons and angels that exists beneath the landscape of contemporary Los Angeles.

Title: Napoleon Dynamite
Hint: An awkward Idaho teen helps his friend run for class president.
Description: A listless and alienated teenager decides to help his new friend win the class presidency in their small western high school, while he must deal with his bizarre family life back home.

Title: Basic Instinct
Hint: A detective investigates a seductive novelist suspected of murder in San Francisco.
Description: Catherine, a novelist with an insatiable sexual appetite, becomes a prime suspect when her boyfriend is brutally murdered -- a crime she had described in her latest story.

Title: Martyrs
Hint: A woman seeks revenge on the family she believes abused her as a child.
Description: A young woman’s quest for revenge against the people who kidnapped and tortured her as a child leads her and her best friend, also a victim of child abuse, on a terrifying journey into a living hell of depravity.

Title: Jack Reacher
Hint: A loner ex-military investigator looks into a sniper attack that killed five people in Pittsburgh.
Description: One morning in an ordinary town, five people are shot dead in a seemingly random attack. All evidence points to a single suspect: an ex-military sniper who is quickly brought into custody. The interrogation yields one written note: 'Get ___!'. ___, an enigmatic ex-Army investigator, believes the authorities have the right man but agrees to help the sniper's defense attorney.

Title: Transformers
Hint: A teenager discovers his car is an alien robot in a war for Earth.
Description: Young teenager Sam Witwicky becomes involved in the ancient struggle between two extraterrestrial factions of transforming robots – the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. Sam holds the clue to unimaginable power and the Decepticons will stop at nothing to retrieve it.

Title: Dirty Dancing
Hint: A young woman falls for a dance instructor at a summer resort.
Description: Expecting the usual tedium that accompanies a summer in the Catskills with her family, 17-year-old Frances 'Baby' Houseman is surprised to find herself stepping into the shoes of a professional hoofer—and unexpectedly falling in love.

Title: Thor
Hint: A powerful but arrogant god is cast down to Earth by his father.
Description: Against his father Odin's will, The Mighty ___ - a powerful but arrogant warrior god - recklessly reignites an ancient war. ___ is cast down to Earth and forced to live among humans as punishment. Once here, ___ learns what it takes to be a true hero when the most dangerous villain of his world sends the darkest forces of Asgard to invade Earth.

Title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Ireland
Hint: A surgeon is forced to make an unthinkable sacrifice by a strange teenage boy.
Description: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways.

Title: Independence Day
Hint: Humanity fights back against an alien invasion on the Fourth of July.
Description: Strange phenomena surface around the globe. The skies ignite. Terror races through the world's major cities. As these extraordinary events unfold, it becomes increasingly clear that a force of incredible magnitude has arrived. Its mission: total annihilation over the Fourth of July weekend. The last hope to stop the destruction is an unlikely group of people united by fate and unimaginable circumstances.

Title: Death Proof
Hint: A stuntman uses his indestructible car to murder young women.
Description: Austin's hottest DJ, Jungle Julia, sets out into the night to unwind with her two friends Shanna and Arlene. Covertly tracking their moves is Stuntman Mike, a scarred rebel leering from behind the wheel of his muscle car, revving just feet away.

Title: Stargate
Hint: A team travels through an ancient portal to a planet ruled by a god-like alien.
Description: An interstellar teleportation device, found in Egypt, leads to a planet with humans resembling ancient Egyptians who worship the god Ra.

Title: Rush Hour
Hint: A Hong Kong detective and a loudmouth LAPD cop team up to rescue a kidnapped girl.
Description: When Hong Kong Inspector Lee is summoned to Los Angeles to investigate a kidnapping, the FBI doesn't want any outside help and assigns cocky LAPD Detective James Carter to distract Lee from the case. Not content to watch the action from the sidelines, Lee and Carter form an unlikely partnership and investigate the case themselves.

Title: World War Z
Hint: A UN investigator races the globe to stop a zombie pandemic.
Description: Life for former United Nations investigator Gerry Lane and his family seems content. Suddenly, the world is plagued by a mysterious infection turning whole human populations into rampaging mindless zombies. After barely escaping the chaos, Lane is persuaded to go on a mission to investigate this disease.

Title: Passengers
Hint: Two travelers on a colony ship wake up 90 years too early.
Description: A spacecraft traveling to a distant colony planet and transporting thousands of people has a malfunction in its sleep chambers. As a result, two ___ are awakened 90 years early.

Title: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
Hint: A swinging 1960s spy is unfrozen in the 1990s to fight his nemesis.
Description: As a swinging fashion photographer by day and a groovy British superagent by night, ___ is the '60s' most shagadelic spy. But can he stop megalomaniac Dr. Evil after the bald villain freezes himself and unthaws in the '90s? With the help of sexy sidekick Vanessa Kensington, he just might.

Title: RED
Hint: A retired CIA agent reunites his old team to survive an assassination attempt.
Description: After surviving an assault from a squad of hit men, retired CIA black ops agent Frank Moses reassembles his old team for an all-out war. Frank reunites with old Joe, crazy Marvin and wily Victoria to uncover a massive conspiracy that threatens their lives. Only their expert training will allow them to survive a near-impossible mission -- breaking into CIA headquarters.

Title: Fright Night
Hint: A teen discovers his new neighbour is a vampire and recruits a TV horror host.
Description: Charley Brewster, a high school student, accidentally discovers the true and creepy nature of Jerry Dandrige, his dashing and enigmatic new neighbor; but no one seems willing to believe him.

Title: The Platform
Hint: Prisoners in a vertical prison receive food on a slab that descends level by level.
Description: A slab of food descends down a vertical facility. The residents above eat heartily, leaving those below starving and desperate. A rebellion is imminent.

Title: Wedding Crashers
Hint: Two divorce mediators sneak into receptions to pick up women.
Description: John and his buddy Jeremy are emotional criminals who know how to use a woman's hopes and dreams for their own carnal gain. Their modus operandi: crashing weddings. Normally, they meet guests who want to toast the romantic day with a random hook-up. But when John meets Claire, he discovers what true love – and heartache – feels like.

Title: Shazam!
Hint: A teen foster kid can turn into an adult superhero by saying one word.
Description: A boy is given the ability to become an adult superhero in times of need with a single magic word.

Title: Highlander
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An immortal Scottish swordsman battles others of his kind through the centuries.
Description: He fought his first battle on the Scottish Highlands in 1536. He will fight his greatest battle on the streets of New York City in 1986. His name is Connor MacLeod. He is immortal.

Title: The Fallout
Hint: High school students form an unlikely bond in the wake of a school shooting, as one struggles with trauma.
Description: In the wake of a school tragedy, Vada, Mia and Quinton form a unique and dynamic bond as they navigate the never linear, often confusing journey to heal in a world that feels forever changed.

Title: Hotel Transylvania
Hint: A famous vampire count runs a resort for monsters, and his daughter falls for a backpacking human.
Description: Welcome to ___, Dracula's lavish five-stake resort, where monsters and their families can live it up and no humans are allowed. One special weekend, Dracula has invited all his best friends to celebrate his beloved daughter Mavis's 118th birthday.

Title: Public Enemies
Hint: A charismatic Depression-era bank robber is hunted across the Midwest by an ambitious FBI agent.
Description: Depression-era bank robber John Dillinger's charm and audacity endear him to much of America's downtrodden public, but he's also a thorn in the side of J. Edgar Hoover and the fledgling FBI. Desperate to capture the elusive outlaw, Hoover makes Dillinger his first Public Enemy Number One and assigns his top agent, Melvin Purvis, the task of bringing him in dead or alive.

Title: Green Room
Hint: A broke punk band witnesses a murder backstage at a remote neo-Nazi club and is trapped inside.
Description: Members of a punk rock band and a tough young woman are forced to fight for survival after witnessing an act of violence at a skinhead bar.

Title: Roald Dahl's Matilda the Musical
Hint: A brilliant girl with a love of books stands up to her parents and a tyrannical headmistress.
Description: An extraordinary young girl discovers her superpower and summons the remarkable courage, against all odds, to help others change their stories, whilst also taking charge of her own destiny. Standing up for what's right, she's met with miraculous results.

Title: Underworld
Hint: A vampire warrior is caught in a war between vampires and werewolves.
Description: Vampires and werewolves have waged a nocturnal war against each other for centuries. But all bets are off when a female vampire warrior named Selene, who's famous for her strength and werewolf-hunting prowess, becomes smitten with a peace-loving male werewolf, Michael, who wants to end the war.

Title: Sixteen Candles
Hint: A girl's sixteenth birthday is forgotten by her family.
Description: With the occasion all but overshadowed by her sister's upcoming wedding, angst-ridden Samantha faces her 16th birthday with typical adolescent dread. Samantha pines for studly older boy Jake, but worries that her chastity will be a turnoff for the popular senior. Meanwhile, she must constantly rebuff the affections of nerdy Ted, who is unfortunately the only boy in school who seems to take an interest in her.

Title: Orphan
Hint: A grieving couple adopts a seemingly sweet 9-year-old girl who has a dark, deadly secret.
Description: After losing their baby, a married couple adopt 9-year old Esther, who may not be as innocent as she seems.

Title: Holes
Hint: A boy is sent to a desert camp where kids dig in the dirt all day.
Description: After being wrongfully convicted for stealing a pair of shoes, Stanley Yelnats is sent away to Camp Green Lake, a boys detention facility where inmates are forced to dig ___ all day in the hot desert sun as a form of character building. As he endures the brutal routine, Stanley begins to uncover a hidden truth behind the camp—one that connects to a dangerous secret and his family’s history.

Title: Greyhound
Country: Canada, China, United States of America
Hint: A Navy commander leads a convoy through U-boat-infested waters.
Description: A first-time captain leads a convoy of allied ships carrying thousands of soldiers across the treacherous waters of the "Black Pit" to the front lines of WWII. With no air cover protection for 5 days, the captain and his convoy must battle the surrounding enemy Nazi U-boats in order to give the allies a chance to win the war.

Title: Oblivion
Hint: A drone repairman on a ruined Earth discovers his memories are false.
Description: Jack Harper is one of the last few drone repairmen stationed on Earth. Part of a massive operation to extract vital resources after decades of war with a terrifying threat known as the Scavs, Jack’s mission is nearly complete. His existence is brought crashing down when he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft.

Title: The Gift
Hint: A couple's lives are disrupted by an old schoolmate who brings unwanted presents.
Description: Simon and Robyn are a young married couple whose life is going as planned until a chance run-in with Simon's high school acquaintance sends their world into a tailspin.

Title: Body of Lies
Hint: A CIA operative in Jordan hunts a terrorist mastermind while his boss pulls strings from America.
Description: The CIA’s hunt is on for the mastermind of a wave of terrorist attacks. Roger Ferris is the agency’s man on the ground, moving from place to place, scrambling to stay ahead of ever-shifting events. An eye in the sky – a satellite link – watches Ferris. At the other end of that real-time link is the CIA’s Ed Hoffman, strategizing events from thousands of miles away.

Title: Turning Red
Hint: A 13-year-old girl turns into a giant panda when she gets too excited.
Description: Thirteen-year-old Mei is experiencing the awkwardness of being a teenager with a twist – when she gets too excited, she transforms into a giant red panda.

Title: Old School
Hint: Three friends in their thirties start a wild fraternity near their old college campus.
Description: Three friends attempt to recapture their glory days by opening up a fraternity near their alma mater.

Title: Cloverfield
Hint: Friends film a monster attack on New York with a handheld camera.
Description: Five young New Yorkers throw their friend a going-away party the night that a monster the size of a skyscraper descends upon the city. Told from the point of view of their video camera, the film is a document of their attempt to survive the most surreal, horrifying event of their lives.

Title: Easy A
Hint: A clean-cut student uses a rumor to raise her social status.
Description: Olive, an average high school student, sees her below-the-radar existence turn around overnight once she decides to use the school's gossip grapevine to advance her social standing. Now her classmates are turning against her and the school board is becoming concerned, including her favorite teacher and the distracted guidance counselor.

Title: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
Hint: A retired intelligence officer is brought back to find a Soviet mole at the top of MI6.
Description: George Smiley, the aging master spy of the Cold War and once heir apparent to Control, is brought back out of retirement to flush out a top level mole within the Circus. Smiley must travel back through his life and murky workings of the Circus to unravel the net spun by his nemesis Karla 'The Sandman' of the KGB and reveal the identity of the mole before he disappears.

Title: Star Trek Beyond
Hint: The crew is stranded on a remote planet after their ship is destroyed.
Description: The USS Enterprise crew explores the furthest reaches of uncharted space, where they encounter a mysterious new enemy who puts them and everything the Federation stands for to the test.

Title: Furious 6
Hint: A team of street racers helps the police take down a mercenary.
Description: Hobbs has Dominic and Brian reassemble their crew to take down a team of mercenaries; Dominic unexpectedly gets sidetracked with facing his presumed deceased girlfriend, Letty.

Title: The Drop
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A Brooklyn bartender finds a puppy and gets caught up in a robbery.
Description: Bob Saginowski finds himself at the center of a robbery gone awry and entwined in an investigation that digs deep into the neighborhood's past where friends, families, and foes all work together to make a living - no matter the cost.

Title: Super 8
Hint: A group of friends filming a zombie movie witness a train crash.
Description: In late 1970s Ohio, a group of friends filming a homemade zombie movie witness a devastating train derailment.
