Soon after, their quiet town is gripped by unexplained disappearances, strange phenomena, and a growing sense of fear, as they uncover that something terrifying has been set loose.

Title: Wayne's World
Hint: Two metalhead slackers host a public access TV show.
Description: The adventures of two amiably aimless metal-head friends, ___ and Garth. From ___ basement, the pair broadcast a talk-show called "___" on local public access television. The show comes to the attention of a sleazy network executive who wants to produce a big-budget version of "___"—and he also wants ___ girlfriend, a rock singer named Cassandra.

Title: The Mule
Hint: An elderly horticulturist becomes a drug courier for a Mexican cartel.
Description: Earl Stone, a man in his eighties, is broke, alone, and facing foreclosure of his business when he is offered a job that simply requires him to drive. Easy enough, but, unbeknownst to Earl, he's just signed on as a drug courier for a Mexican cartel. He does so well that his cargo increases exponentially, and Earl hit the radar of hard-charging DEA agent Colin Bates.

Title: Jarhead
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young Marine in the Gulf War waits for combat that never comes.
Description: ___ is a film about a US Marine Anthony Swofford’s experience in the Gulf War. After putting up with an arduous boot camp, Swofford and his unit are sent to the Persian Gulf where they are eager to fight, but are forced to stay back from the action. Swofford struggles with the possibility of his girlfriend cheating on him, and as his mental state deteriorates, his desire to kill increases.

Title: Hard Candy
Hint: A teenage girl traps a photographer she suspects is a pedophile.
Description: Hayley’s a smart, charming teenage girl. Jeff’s a handsome, smooth fashion photographer. An Internet chat, a coffee shop meet-up, an impromptu fashion shoot back at Jeff’s place. Jeff thinks it’s his lucky night. He’s in for a surprise.

Title: The Kids Are All Right
Hint: Two children conceived by donor insemination seek out their biological father.
Description: Two women, Nic and Jules, brought a son and daughter into the world through artificial insemination. When one of their children reaches age, both kids go behind their mothers' backs to meet with the donor. Life becomes so much more interesting when the father, two mothers and children start to become attached to each other.

Title: One Day
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two people meet on the same day every year for twenty years.
Description: After spending the night together on the eve of their college graduation, Dexter and Emma are shown each year on the same date to see where they are in their lives. They are sometimes together, and sometimes not.

Title: Foxcatcher
Hint: An eccentric millionaire sponsors two Olympic wrestling brothers, with tragic consequences.
Description: The greatest Olympic Wrestling Champion brother team joins Team ___ led by multimillionaire sponsor John E. du Pont as they train for the 1988 games in Seoul - a union that leads to unlikely circumstances.

Title: Chronicle
Hint: Three teens gain telekinetic powers after discovering a mysterious object.
Description: Three high school students make an incredible discovery, leading to their developing uncanny powers beyond their understanding. As they learn to control their abilities and use them to their advantage, their lives start to spin out of control, and their darker sides begin to take over.

Title: Bronson
Hint: The story of Britain's most violent and famous prisoner, who craves celebrity behind bars.
Description: A young man who was sentenced to 7 years in prison for robbing a post office ends up spending 30 years in solitary confinement. During this time, his own personality is supplanted by his alter ego, Charles ___.

Title: Deathtrap
Hint: A playwright plots to murder a student and steal his script.
Description: A Broadway playwright puts murder in his plan to take credit for a student's script.

Title: Smokey and the Bandit
Hint: A race car driver smuggles beer and outruns a sheriff.
Description: A race car driver tries to transport an illegal beer shipment from Texas to Atlanta in under 28 hours, picking up a reluctant bride-to-be on the way.

Title: Burn After Reading
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, France
Hint: Two gym employees find a disc with secret CIA memoirs.
Description: When a disc containing memoirs of a former CIA analyst falls into the hands of gym employees, Linda and Chad, they see a chance to make enough money for Linda to have life-changing cosmetic surgery. Predictably, events whirl out of control for the duo, and those in their orbit.

Title: Pieces of a Woman
Country: Canada, Hungary, United States of America
Hint: A young mother's home birth ends in tragedy, and her life and relationships unravel.
Description: When a young mother's home birth ends in unfathomable tragedy, she begins a year-long odyssey of mourning that fractures relationships with loved ones in this deeply personal story of a woman learning to live alongside her loss.

Title: Den of Thieves
Hint: A gang plans to rob the Federal Reserve Bank in Los Angeles.
Description: A gritty crime saga which follows the lives of an elite unit of the LA County Sheriff's Dept. and the state's most successful bank robbery crew as the outlaws plan a seemingly impossible heist on the Federal Reserve Bank.

Title: Raw
Hint: A vegetarian veterinary student develops a hunger for meat.
Description: Stringent vegetarian Justine encounters a decadent, merciless, and dangerously seductive world during her first week at veterinary school. Desperate to fit in, she strays from her principles and eats ___ meat for the first time. She soon experiences terrible and unexpected consequences as her true self begins to emerge.

Title: Mighty Aphrodite
Hint: A man searches for the biological mother of his gifted son.
Description: When Lenny and his wife, Amanda, adopt a baby, Lenny realizes that his son is a genius and becomes obsessed with finding the boy's biological mother in hopes that she will be brilliant too. But when he learns that Max's mother is Linda Ash, a kindhearted prostitute and porn star, Lenny is determined to reform her immoral lifestyle. A Greek chorus chimes in to relate the plot to Greek mythology in this quirky comedy.

Title: Fallen
Hint: A detective hunts a demon that moves from body to body.
Description: Homicide detective John Hobbes witnesses the execution of serial killer Edgar Reese. Soon after the execution the killings start again, and they are very similar to Reese's style.

Genres: Action, Adventure, Animation, Science Fiction, Thriller
Hint: Sentient rag dolls fight machines in a post-apocalyptic world.
Description: When ___ first comes to life, he finds himself in a post-apocalyptic world. All humans are gone, and it is only by chance that he discovers a small community of others like him taking refuge from fearsome machines that roam the earth intent on their extinction. Despite being the neophyte of the group, ___ convinces the others that hiding will do them no good.

Title: Super Troopers
Hint: Five bored Vermont state patrolmen try to prove their worth.
Description: Five bored, occasionally high and always ineffective Vermont state ___ must prove their worth to the governor or lose their jobs. After stumbling on a drug ring, they plan to make a bust, but a rival police force is out to steal the glory.

Title: 22 Jump Street
Hint: Two cops go undercover at a college to find the supplier of a new drug.
Description: After making their way through high school (twice), big changes are in store for officers Schmidt and Jenko when they go deep undercover at a local college. But when Jenko meets a kindred spirit on the football team, and Schmidt infiltrates the bohemian art major scene, they begin to question their partnership.

Title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
Hint: A shrinking hero teams up with a partner to rescue her mother from the quantum realm.
Description: Just when his time under house arrest is about to end, Scott Lang once again puts his freedom at risk to help Hope van Dyne and Dr. Hank Pym dive into the quantum realm and try to accomplish, against time and any chance of success, a very dangerous rescue mission.

Title: Meet the Parents
Hint: A male nurse spends a disastrous weekend with his girlfriend's terrifying ex-CIA father.
Description: Greg Focker is ready to marry his girlfriend, Pam, but before he pops the question, he must win over her formidable father, humorless former CIA agent Jack Byrnes, at the wedding of Pam's sister. As Greg bends over backward to make a good impression, his visit to the Byrnes home turns into a hilarious series of disasters, and everything that can go wrong does, all under Jack's critical, hawklike gaze.

Title: Hardcore
Hint: A conservative businessman searches the porn world for his runaway daughter.
Description: A conservative Midwest businessman ventures into the sordid underworld of pornography in search of his runaway teenage daughter who’s making ___ films in the pits of Los Angeles.

Title: Demolition
Hint: A grieving investment banker begins dismantling his life, and his house, after his wife's death.
Description: An emotionally desperate investment banker finds hope through a woman he meets.

Title: My Own Private Idaho
Hint: Two street hustlers in Portland journey across the Northwest and to Italy searching for one's long-lost mother.
Description: In this loose adaptation of Shakespeare's "Henry IV," Mike Waters is a hustler afflicted with narcolepsy. Scott Favor is the rebellious son of a mayor. Together, the two travel from Portland, Oregon to ___ and finally to the coast of Italy in a quest to find Mike's estranged mother. Along the way they turn tricks for money and drugs, eventually attracting the attention of a wealthy benefactor and sexual deviant.

Title: The Adjustment Bureau
Hint: A politician discovers mysterious agents in hats who control fate are keeping him from the woman he loves.
Description: A man glimpses the future Fate has planned for him – and chooses to fight for his own destiny. Battling the powerful ___ across, under and through the streets of New York, he risks his destined greatness to be with the only woman he's ever loved.

Title: God's Crooked Lines
Hint: A private investigator fakes madness to get into an asylum and solve a murder from inside.
Description: Alice Gould, a private investigator, pretends to be mentally ill in order to enter a psychiatric hospital and gather evidence for the case she is working on: the death of a patient in unclear circumstances.

Title: Cop Land
Hint: A half-deaf small-town sheriff in New Jersey finally stands up to the corrupt city officers who live there.
Description: Freddy Heflin is the sheriff of a place everyone calls “___” — a small and seemingly peaceful town populated by the big city police officers he’s long admired. Yet something ugly is taking place behind the town’s peaceful facade.

Title: The Color of Money
Hint: An aging pool hustler takes a cocky young player on the road and teaches him to win by losing.
Description: Former pool hustler "Fast Eddie" Felson decides he wants to return to the game by taking a pupil. He meets talented but green Vincent Lauria and proposes a partnership. As they tour pool halls, Eddie teaches Vincent the tricks of scamming, but he eventually grows frustrated with Vincent's showboat antics, leading to an argument and a falling-out.

Title: Soylent Green
Hint: In an overcrowded future, a detective uncovers the secret of a food ration.
Description: In the year 2022, overcrowding, pollution, and resource depletion have reduced society’s leaders to finding food for the teeming masses. The answer is ___.

Title: Ralph Breaks the Internet
Genres: Action, Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Science Fiction
Hint: An arcade villain and his racer friend venture onto the web to find a part for her game.
Description: Video game bad guy ___ and fellow misfit Vanellope von Schweetz must risk it all by traveling to the World Wide Web in search of a replacement part to save Vanellope's video game, Sugar Rush.

Title: That Thing You Do!
Hint: A small-town Pennsylvania band scores a hit single in 1964 and rides the fame machine.
Description: A Pennsylvania band scores a hit in 1964 and rides the star-making machinery as long as it can, with lots of help from its manager. But behind the scenes, the group’s sudden fame tests their strength, their maturity and responsibility, and their ability to resist the temptations that money and notoriety always make possible.

Title: Cleopatra
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An Egyptian queen seduces two Roman rulers to hold on to her throne.
Description: Determined to hold on to the throne, ___ seduces the Roman emperor Julius Caesar. When Caesar is murdered, she redirects her attentions to his general, Marc Antony, who vows to take power—but Caesar’s successor has other plans.

Title: Planet Terror
Hint: A go-go dancer with a machine gun for a leg fights a horde of infected mutants.
Description: Two doctors find their graveyard shift inundated with townspeople ravaged by sores. Among the wounded is Cherry Darling, a dancer whose leg was ripped from her body. As the invalids quickly become enraged aggressors, Cherry and her ex-boyfriend El Wray lead a team of accidental warriors into the night.

Title: Brimstone
Country: Netherlands, United Kingdom, France, United States of America, Germany, Belgium, Sweden
Hint: A mute midwife on the American frontier is hunted by a vengeful preacher.
Description: In the menacing inferno of the old North-American West, Liz is a genuine survivor who is hunted by a vengeful preacher for a crime she didn’t commit.

Title: Pitch Black
Hint: Survivors of a spaceship crash on a desert planet must hide from creatures that hunt in the dark.
Description: When their ship crash-lands on a remote planet, the marooned passengers soon learn that escaped convict Riddick isn't the only thing they have to fear. Deadly creatures lurk in the shadows, waiting to attack in the dark, and the planet is rapidly plunging into the utter blackness of a total eclipse.

Title: The Dirt
Hint: A hair-metal band rises from the Sunset Strip to excess and superstardom.
Description: The story of Mötley Crüe and their rise from the Sunset Strip club scene of the early 1980s to superstardom.

Title: Thunderbolt and Lightfoot
Hint: A bank robber and a young drifter reunite an old gang for a daring heist.
Description: With the help of an irreverent young sidekick, a bank robber gets his old gang back together to organise a daring new heist.

Title: P.S. I Love You
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A young widow receives letters from her late husband guiding her through grief.
Description: A young widow discovers that her late husband has left her 10 messages intended to help ease her pain and start a new life.

Title: I Love You, Man
Hint: A man with no male friends goes on a series of man-dates before his wedding.
Description: Peter Klaven is a successful real estate agent who, upon getting engaged to the woman of his dreams, Zooey, discovers, to his dismay and chagrin, that he has no male friend close enough to serve as his Best Man. Peter immediately sets out to rectify the situation, embarking on a series of bizarre and awkward "man-dates."

Title: To All the Boys I've Loved Before
Hint: A shy teen's secret love letters are mailed to every boy she ever liked.
Description: Lara Jean's love life goes from imaginary to out of control when her secret letters to every boy she's ever fallen for are mysteriously mailed out.

Title: Some Kind of Wonderful
Hint: An artsy outcast dates a popular girl while his tomboy best friend secretly loves him.
Description: Keith Nelson, an artsy high school outcast, tries to land a date with popular girl Amanda Jones with some help from his tomboy best friend, Watts. However, Watts realizes she likes Keith as more than just a friend and tries to convince him to stop pursuing Amanda. Matters are further complicated when Keith's invitation draws the ire of Amanda's rich yet snobby ex-boyfriend, Hardy Jenns, who makes plans to get even.

Title: The Last Boy Scout
Hint: A washed-up private eye and a disgraced quarterback investigate a stripper's murder.
Description: Somewhere in Los Angeles, the city of broken dreams, a stripper is murdered. Now, the private detective she had hired and her ex-footballer boyfriend are going to find her murderer... if they don't kill each other first. But the more they dig, the deeper they become enmeshed in a web of extortion, blackmail and corrupt politics hidden beneath the surface of professional football.

Title: The Longest Ride
Hint: A college student's romance with a bull rider is mirrored by an old man's love story.
Description: The lives of a young couple intertwine with a much older man as he reflects back on a lost love while he's trapped in an automobile crash.

Title: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle
Hint: Two stoned friends embark on an epic quest to satisfy their burger cravings.
Description: Nerdy accountant ___ and his irrepressible friend, ___, get stoned watching television and find themselves utterly bewitched by a commercial for White ___. Convinced there must be one nearby, the two set out on a late-night odyssey that takes them deep into New Jersey.

Title: Tie Me Up! Tie Me Down!
Hint: A young man released from a mental hospital kidnaps a former porn actress to make her love him.
Description: After being released from a mental hospital, a troubled young man tracks down an actress he once had sex with and forces her into captivity, determined to make her part of his life.

Title: Filth
Country: Belgium, Germany, Sweden, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A bigoted, drug-addicted Edinburgh cop schemes and manipulates his way toward a promotion.
Description: A bigoted junkie cop suffering from borderline personality disorder and drug addiction manipulates and hallucinates his way in a bid to secure promotion.

Title: Heaven
Country: France, Germany, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A teacher takes revenge on a drug dealer and flees with a young policeman who falls for her.
Description: A woman takes the law into her own hands after police ignore her pleas to arrest the man responsible for her husband's death, and finds herself not only under arrest for murder but falling in love with an officer.

Title: The Wandering Earth II
Hint: Humans build giant engines to move the planet out of the solar system, in a prequel to a Chinese blockbuster.
Description: Humans built huge engines on the surface of the earth to find a new home. But the road to the universe is perilous. In order to save earth, young people once again have to step forward to start a race against time for life and death.

Title: Pee-wee's Big Adventure
Hint: A childlike man in a gray suit crosses America to find his stolen bicycle.
Description: The eccentric and childish ___ Herman embarks on a big adventure when his beloved bicycle is stolen. Armed with information from a fortune-teller and a relentless obsession with his prized possession, ___ encounters a host of odd characters and bizarre situations as he treks across the country to recover his bike.

Title: Buried
Country: Spain, United States of America, France, United Kingdom
Hint: A truck driver wakes up in a coffin underground in Iraq with only a phone and a lighter.
Description: As an American civilian truck driver working in Iraq, Paul Conroy's convoy is attacked by a group of Iraqi insurgents. Some time later, Paul awakes in a coffin with only a lighter, a cell phone, and his ever-growing anxiety. Faced with a dwindling oxygen supply and a dying battery, he must fight panic, despair, and delirium as he races against time to escape the claustrophobic death trap.

Title: Loving
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An interracial couple in 1958 Virginia is jailed for their marriage.
Description: In 1958, in the state of Virginia, the idea of interracial marriage was not only considered to be immoral to many, it was also illegal. When Richard and Mildred fall in love, they are aware of the eyes staring at them and the words said behind their backs. It's when they get married, however, that words and looks become actions, and the two are arrested.

Title: Breakdown
Hint: A man's wife disappears after their car breaks down in the desert.
Description: On their cross-country drive, a married couple, Jeff and Amy Taylor, experience car trouble after their SUV breaks down. Stranded in the New Mexico desert, the two catch a break when a passing truck driver offers Amy a ride to a nearby café to call for help. Meanwhile, Jeff is able to fix the car and make his way to the café, but Amy isn't there.

Title: The Upside
Hint: A wealthy quadriplegic hires an ex-con as his caretaker.
Description: Phillip is a wealthy quadriplegic who needs a caretaker to help him with his day-to-day routine in his New York penthouse. He decides to hire Dell, a struggling parolee who's trying to reconnect with his ex and his young son. Despite coming from two different worlds, an unlikely friendship starts to blossom.

Title: The Little Girl Who Lives Down the Lane
Hint: A 13-year-old girl living alone in a beach town hides a dark secret in her cellar.
Description: 13-year-old Rynn Jacobs lives in a New England beach town. Whenever the landlady inquires after Rynn's father, she claims that he's not available. But when the landlady's son, Frank, won't leave Rynn alone, she teams up with a neighbor Mario to maintain the dark family secret that she's been keeping to herself.

Title: Juice
Hint: Four Harlem friends who dabble in petty crime are torn apart when one gets a taste of power.
Description: Four Harlem friends -- Bishop, Q, Steel and Raheem -- dabble in petty crime, but they decide to go big by knocking off a convenience store. Bishop, the magnetic leader of the group, has the gun. But Q has different aspirations. He wants to be a DJ and happens to have a gig the night of the robbery. Unfortunately for him, Bishop isn't willing to take no for answer in a game where everything's for keeps.

Title: Hairspray
Hint: A plump teen dances her way onto a TV show and fights segregation in 1960s Baltimore.
Description: 'Pleasantly plump' teenager Tracy Turnblad achieves her dream of becoming a regular on the Corny Collins Dance Show. Now a teen hero, she starts using her fame to speak out for the causes she believes in, most of all integration. In doing so, she earns the wrath of the show's former star, Amber Von Tussle, as well as Amber's manipulative, pro-segregation parents.

Title: The Way We Were
Hint: A politically active Jewish woman and a carefree WASP fall in love across decades.
Description: Opposites attract when, during their college days, Katie Morosky, a politically active Jew, meets Hubbell Gardiner, a feckless WASP. Years later, in the wake of World War II, they meet once again and, despite their obvious differences, attempt to make their love for each other work.

Title: Sex and Lucía
Hint: A Madrid waitress takes refuge on a quiet Mediterranean island and pieces together her lover's past.
Description: ___ is a young waitress in Madrid who seeks refuge on a quiet, secluded Mediterranean island after the loss of her longtime boyfriend. Amidst the fresh air, dazzling sun, and glistening deep blue water, ___ begins to piece together the dark corners of her past relationship.

Title: An Officer and a Gentleman
Hint: An aloof young man aspiring to be a navy pilot clashes with a tough drill sergeant.
Description: Zack Mayo is an aloof, taciturn man who aspires to be a navy pilot. Once he arrives at training camp for his 13-week officer's course, Mayo runs afoul of abrasive, no-nonsense drill Sergeant Emil Foley. Mayo is an excellent cadet, but a little cold around the heart, so Foley rides him mercilessly, sensing that the young man would be prime officer material if he weren't so self-involved.

Title: ParaNorman
Hint: A misunderstood boy who can talk to the dead must save his town from a witch's curse.
Description: In the town of Blithe Hollow, Norman Babcock can speak to the dead, but no one other than his eccentric new friend believes his ability is real. One day, Norman's eccentric uncle tells him of a ritual he must perform to protect the town from a curse cast by a witch centuries ago.

Title: The Kingdom
Country: Germany, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A team of FBI agents travel to Saudi Arabia to investigate a terrorist bombing at a compound.
Description: A team of U.S. government agents is sent to investigate the bombing of an American facility in the Middle East.

Title: Cool Runnings
Hint: Jamaican sprinters form a bobsled team for the Winter Olympics.
Description: When a Jamaican sprinter is disqualified from the Olympic Games, he enlists the help of a dishonored coach to start the first Jamaican bobsled team.

Title: Mallrats
Hint: Two dumped friends spend the day at a suburban shopping center plotting to win back their girlfriends.
Description: Both dumped by their girlfriends, two best friends seek refuge in the local mall. Eventually, they decide to try and win back their significant others and take care of their respective nemeses.

Title: Evil Under the Sun
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Spain
Hint: A Belgian detective investigates a murder at an opulent island resort in the Adriatic.
Description: An opulent beach resort provides a scenic background to this amusing whodunit as Poirot attempts to uncover the nefarious evildoer behind the strangling of a notorious stage star.

Title: Charlie Wilson's War
Hint: A Texas congressman sets out to arm the Afghans against the Soviets.
Description: A Texas congressman sets a series of events in motion when he conspires with a CIA operative to aid Afghan mujahideen rebels fighting the Soviets.

Title: Out of Sight
Hint: A charming career bank robber and a US Marshal fall for each other after he escapes prison.
Description: Meet Jack Foley, a smooth criminal who bends the law and is determined to make one last heist. Karen Sisco is a federal marshal who chooses all the right moves … and all the wrong guys. Now they're willing to risk it all to find out if there's more between them than just the law.

Title: The Towering Inferno
Hint: A fire breaks out at the opening party of the world's tallest skyscraper.
Description: At the opening party of a colossal—but poorly constructed—skyscraper, a massive fire breaks out, threatening to destroy the tower and everyone in it.

Title: Big Eyes
Hint: A painter of big-eyed children fights her husband who claims credit for her work.
Description: In the late 1950s and early '60s, artist Walter Keane achieves unbelievable fame and success with portraits of saucer-eyed waifs. However, no one realizes that his wife, Margaret, is the real painter behind the brush. Although Margaret is horrified to learn that Walter is passing off her work as his own, she is too meek to protest too loudly.

Title: Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers
Hint: Two cartoon chipmunks reunite to save a kidnapped former castmate from a bootleg ring.
Description: Decades since their successful television series was canceled, ___ has succumbed to a life of suburban domesticity as an insurance salesman. ___, meanwhile, has had CGI surgery and works the nostalgia convention circuit, desperate to relive his glory days.

Title: Marley & Me
Hint: A newlywed couple raises a lovable but troublesome Labrador who tests their patience.
Description: A newly married couple, in the process of starting a family, learn many of life's important lessons from their trouble-loving retriever, ___. Packed with plenty of laughs to lighten the load, the film explores the highs and lows of marriage, maturity and confronting one's own mortality, as seen through the lens of family life with a dog.

Title: Boiler Room
Hint: A college dropout joins a shady brokerage firm and gets rich fast.
Description: A college dropout gets a job as a broker for a suburban investment firm and is on the fast track to success—but the job might not be as legitimate as it sounds.

Title: The Infiltrator
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A US Customs agent goes undercover to infiltrate Pablo Escobar's money laundering network.
Description: A U.S Customs official uncovers a massive money laundering scheme involving Pablo Escobar.

Title: Mansfield Park
Hint: A poor girl is sent to live with wealthy relatives at a country estate.
Description: Fanny Price is sent to live with her wealthy relatives, the Bertrams, where she is treated poorly by most except her cousin Edmund. Her life is complicated by the arrival of the worldly Mary and Henry Crawford.

Title: The Spy Who Loved Me
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A British agent teams up with a Russian agent to stop a shipping magnate planning to destroy the world.
Description: Russian and British submarines with nuclear missiles on board both vanish from sight without a trace. England and Russia both blame each other as James Bond tries to solve the riddle of the disappearing ships. But the KGB also has an agent on the case.

Title: The Bounty
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A 1789 voyage to Tahiti turns the crew against its harsh captain.
Description: An idyllic voyage to Tahiti in 1789 turns a crew aboard the H.M.S. ___ against its captain when they find a tropical paradise.

Title: A Serious Man
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, France
Hint: A Midwestern physics professor's life falls apart in 1967.
Description: It is 1967, and Larry Gopnik, a physics professor at a quiet Midwestern university, has just been informed by his wife Judith that she is leaving him. She has fallen in love with one of his more pompous acquaintances Sy Ableman.

Title: A Scanner Darkly
Hint: An undercover cop in a drug-ravaged future loses his grip on reality.
Description: An undercover cop in a not-too-distant future becomes involved with a dangerous new drug and begins to lose his own identity as a result.

Title: Tenebrae
Hint: A razor-wielding killer murders people around a horror novelist in Rome.
Description: A razor-wielding serial killer is on the loose, murdering those around Peter Neal, an American mystery author in Italy to promote his newest novel.

Title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
Country: United States of America, Germany, Hungary, United Kingdom
Hint: A red-skinned demon hero must stop an elf prince from awakening an unstoppable mechanical horde.
Description: ___, his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz, and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien, face their biggest battle when an underworld elven prince plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient force of killing machines, the all-powerful ___, to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free.

Title: The Sea Beast
Hint: A young stowaway and a legendary monster hunter set out on an unforgettable ocean journey.
Description: When a young girl stows away on the ship of a legendary sea monster hunter, they launch an epic journey into uncharted waters — and make history to boot.

Title: Enough Said
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A divorced masseuse falls for a man, then learns he is her new friend's ex-husband.
Description: Eva is a divorced soon-to-be empty-nester wondering about her next act. Then she meets Marianne, the embodiment of her perfect self. Armed with a restored outlook on being middle-aged and single, Eva decides to take a chance on her new love interest Albert — a sweet, funny and like-minded man. But things get complicated when Eva discovers that Albert is in fact the dreaded ex–husband of Marianne...

Title: A Most Violent Year
Country: United Arab Emirates, United States of America
Hint: An immigrant heating-oil businessman tries to stay honest during New York's bloodiest crime wave of 1981.
Description: A thriller set in New York City during the winter of 1981, statistically one of the most violent years in the city's history, and centered on the lives of an immigrant and his family trying to expand their business and capitalize on opportunities as the rampant violence, decay, and corruption of the day drag them in and threaten to destroy all they have built.

Title: Julie & Julia
Hint: A frustrated New York office worker cooks her way through a famous French cookbook, while its author's story unfolds.
Description: ___ Child and ___ Powell – both of whom wrote memoirs – find their lives intertwined. Though separated by time and space, both women are at loose ends... until they discover that with the right combination of passion, fearlessness and butter, anything is possible.

Title: American Honey
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A restless teen joins a crew of young drifters selling magazines across the Midwest.
Description: A restless teenager escapes her troubled home and joins a traveling crew of young drifters selling magazines across the American Midwest. Immersed in a world of reckless partying, risky hustles, and fleeting romances, she searches for freedom and belonging on the open road.

Title: Bad Lieutenant
Hint: A corrupt, drug-addicted New York detective investigates the rape of a nun and seeks redemption.
Description: While investigating a young nun's rape, a corrupt New York City police detective, with a serious drug and gambling addiction, tries to change his ways and find forgiveness.

Title: What About Bob?
Hint: A neurotic patient follows his self-absorbed psychiatrist on vacation and drives him mad.
Description: Before going on vacation, self-involved psychiatrist Dr. Leo Marvin has the misfortune of taking on a new patient: ___ Wiley. An exemplar of neediness and a compendium of phobias, ___ follows Marvin to his family's country house. Dr. Marvin tries to get him to leave; the trouble is, everyone loves ___. As his oblivious patient makes himself at home, Dr.

Title: The Pink Panther
Hint: A bumbling French inspector pursues a suave jewel thief known as the Phantom to a ski resort, unaware his wife is involved.
Description: The trademark of The Phantom, a renowned jewel thief, is a glove left at the scene of the crime. Inspector Clouseau, an expert on The Phantom's exploits, feels sure that he knows where The Phantom will strike next and leaves Paris for the Tyrolean Alps, where the famous Lugashi jewel 'The ___' is going to be. However, he does not know who The Phantom really is, or for that matter who anyone else really is...

Title: Invincible
Hint: A 30-year-old bartender tries out for the Philadelphia Eagles.
Description: Inspired by the true story of Vince Papale, a man with nothing to lose who ignored the staggering odds and made his dream come true. When the coach of Papale's beloved hometown football team hosted an unprecedented open tryout, the public consensus was that it was a waste of time – no one good enough to play professional football was going to be found this way.

Title: Maverick
Hint: A smooth-talking gambler cons his way to a poker tournament.
Description: Bret ___ is a gambler who would rather con someone than fight them, and needs an additional $3k in order to enter a winner-takes-all poker game beginning in a few days. He joins forces with a woman with a marvelous Southern accent, and the two try and enter the game.

Title: Brotherhood of the Wolf
Hint: A knight and an Iroquois warrior hunt a mysterious beast in 18th-century France.
Description: In 18th century France, the Chevalier de Fronsac and his Native American friend Mani are sent by the King to the Gevaudan province to investigate the killings of hundreds by a mysterious beast.

Title: Waitress
Hint: A diner worker stuck in a bad marriage bakes pies and falls for her doctor.
Description: A small town ___ stuck in a lousy marriage finds love when an exciting out-of-towner enters her life.

Title: Shutter
Hint: A photographer and his girlfriend flee a hit-and-run, then ghostly figures begin to appear in his photographs.
Description: When Jane and Tun run over a girl in a car accident, they speed away immediately from the crime scene. However, Tun, a photographer, soon discovers strange shadows in his photos, which unsettles them.

Title: Perfect Sense
Hint: An epidemiologist and a chef fall in love as a pandemic robs people of smell, taste and more.
Description: In Glasgow, Scotland, while a mysterious pandemic begins to spread around the world, Susan, a brilliant epidemiologist, falls in love with Michael, a skillful cook.

Title: The X-Files: Fight the Future
Hint: Two FBI agents take on a government conspiracy to hide alien colonization.
Description: Mulder and Scully, now taken off the FBI's X ___ cases, must find a way to fight the shadowy elements of the government to find out the truth about a conspiracy that might mean the alien colonization of Earth.

Title: Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer
Hint: A drifter teaches his ex-con roommate how to kill in Chicago.
Description: Arriving in Chicago, ___ moves in with ex-con acquaintance Otis and starts schooling him in the ways of the serial killer.

Title: Ichi the Killer
Hint: A sadomasochistic yakuza enforcer searches for a repressed, weeping assassin.
Description: As sadomasochistic yakuza enforcer Kakihara searches for his missing boss he comes across ___, a repressed and psychotic killer who may be able to inflict levels of pain that Kakihara has only dreamed of.

Title: Bedknobs and Broomsticks
Hint: Three evacuated children stay with an apprentice witch in World War II England.
Description: Three children evacuated from London during World War II are forced to stay with an eccentric spinster. The children's initial fears disappear when they find out she is in fact a trainee witch.

Title: An Unfinished Life
Hint: A stoic Wyoming rancher reluctantly takes in his estranged daughter-in-law and the granddaughter he never knew.
Description: Stoic and heartbroken, Einar Gilkyson quietly lives in the rugged Wyoming ranchlands alongside his only trusted friend, Mitch Bradley. One day, the woman he blames for the death of his only son arrives at his door broke, desperate, and with a granddaughter he's never known. But even as buried anger and accusations resurface, the way is opened for unexpected connection, adventure, and forgiveness.

Title: Beaches
Hint: A rich girl and a struggling entertainer share a lifelong friendship.
Description: A privileged rich debutante and a cynical struggling entertainer share a turbulent, but strong childhood friendship over the years.

Title: Kill the Irishman
Hint: An Irish-American mobster survives a bombing war in 1970s Cleveland.
Description: Over the summer of 1976, thirty-six bombs detonate in the heart of Cleveland while a turf war raged between Irish mobster Danny Greene and the Italian mafia. Based on a true story, ___ chronicles Greene's heroic rise from a tough Cleveland neighborhood to become an enforcer in the local mob.

Title: The Last Seduction
Hint: A femme fatale steals her husband's drug money and hides out in a small town.
Description: A devious femme fatale steals her husband’s drug money and hides out in a small town where she meets the perfect dupe for her next scheme.

Title: Ron's Gone Wrong
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A socially awkward boy receives a defective walking, talking digital companion robot that becomes his best friend.
Description: In a world where walking, talking, digitally connected bots have become children's best friends, an 11-year-old finds that his robot buddy doesn't quite work the same as the others do.

Title: The Boys from Brazil
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Nazi hunter discovers a sinister plot to clone the Führer in South America.
Description: Nazi hunter Ezra Lieberman discovers a sinister and bizarre plot, masterminded by Dr. Josef Mengele, to rekindle the Third Reich.

Title: We Are Marshall
Hint: A grieving West Virginia town tries to rebuild its college football team after a plane crash kills most of the squad.
Description: When a plane crash claims the lives of members of the ___ University football team and some of its fans, the team's new coach and his surviving players try to keep the football program alive.

Title: Spy Game
Country: France, Germany, Japan, United States of America
Hint: A retiring CIA officer secretly works to rescue his protégé from a Chinese prison.
Description: On the day of his retirement, a veteran CIA agent learns that his former protégé has been arrested in China, is sentenced to die the next morning in Beijing, and that the CIA is considering letting that happen to avoid an international scandal.

Title: Quatermass and the Pit
Hint: An alien spacecraft is unearthed in a London Underground station.
Description: A mysterious artifact unearthed below a London Underground station proves to have powerful psychic effects on the people around.

Title: Handsome Devil
Hint: A music-loving outcast at a rugby-mad boarding school befriends his new roommate.
Description: A music-mad 16-year-old outcast at a rugby-mad boarding school forms an unlikely friendship with his dashing new roommate.

Title: Starman
Hint: An alien takes the form of a young widow's late husband.
Description: When an alien takes the form of a young widow's husband and asks her to drive him from Wisconsin to Arizona, the government tries to stop them.

Title: Carnival of Souls
Hint: The sole survivor of a car accident takes a job as a church organist and is haunted by a ghoulish man.
Description: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted ___ on the outskirts of town.

Title: The Dressmaker
Hint: A seamstress returns to her small Australian town to take revenge.
Description: In 1950s Australia, beautiful, talented ___ Tilly returns to her tiny hometown to right wrongs from her past. As she tries to reconcile with her mother, she starts to fall in love while transforming the fashion of the town.

Title: Unthinkable
Hint: An interrogator tortures a terrorist to find three nuclear bombs.
Description: The government gets wind of a plot to destroy America involving a trio of nuclear weapons for which the whereabouts are unknown. It's up to a seasoned interrogator and an FBI agent to find out exactly where the nukes are.

Title: Fathers & Daughters
Hint: A Pulitzer-winning writer struggles to raise his daughter after a breakdown.
Description: A Pulitzer-winning writer grapples with being a widower and father after a mental breakdown, while, 27 years later, his grown daughter struggles to forge connections of her own.

Title: Grumpy Old Men
Hint: Two feuding elderly neighbors compete for a new widow.
Description: For decades, next-door neighbors and former friends John and Max have feuded, trading insults and wicked pranks. When an attractive widow moves in nearby, their bad blood erupts into a high-stakes rivalry full of naughty jokes and adolescent hijinks.

Title: Colonia
Hint: A young woman searches for her abducted boyfriend inside a Chilean cult.
Description: A young woman's desperate search for her abducted boyfriend draws her into the infamous ___ Dignidad, a sect nobody ever escaped from.

Title: Unleashed
Country: China, France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A man raised as a fighting dog is freed and learns to live.
Description: Raised as a slave, Danny is used to fighting for his survival. In fact, his "master," Bart, thinks of him as a pet and goes as far as leashing him with a collar so they can make money in fight clubs, where Danny is the main contender. When Bart's crew is in a car accident, Danny escapes and meets a blind, kindhearted piano tuner who takes him in and uses music to free the fighter's long-buried heart.

Title: House of Wax
Hint: A disfigured sculptor opens a museum whose lifelike figures are secretly made from murder victims.
Description: A sculptor opens a ___ museum to showcase the likenesses of famous historical figures, but quickly runs into trouble when his business partner demands the exhibits become more extreme in order to increase profits.

Title: Confessions of a Dangerous Mind
Genres: Comedy, Crime, Drama, Romance, Thriller, History
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A TV game show producer claims he was secretly a CIA assassin.
Description: Television made him famous, but his biggest hits happened off screen. Television producer by day, CIA assassin by night, Chuck Barris was recruited by the CIA at the height of his TV career and trained to become a covert operative. Or so Barris said.

Title: Rabbit Hole
Hint: A couple grieves after their young son dies in an accident.
Description: Life for a happy couple is turned upside down after their young son dies in an accident.

Title: Funny Face
Hint: A shy Greenwich Village bookshop clerk is discovered by a fashion photographer and whisked to Paris.
Description: A shy Greenwich Village book clerk is discovered by a fashion photographer and whisked off to Paris where she becomes a reluctant model.

Title: The Thirteenth Floor

Description: In Los Angeles, a wealthy man, known as Mr. Fuller, discovers a shocking secret about the world he lives in. Fearing for his life, he leaves a desperate message for a friend of his in the most unexpected place.

Title: Fisherman's Friends
Hint: Cornish fishermen sign a record deal for their sea shanties.
Description: Ten fishermen from Cornwall are signed by Universal Records and achieve a top ten hit with their debut album of Sea Shanties. Based on the true-life story of Cornish folk band, ___.

Title: Behind the Candelabra
Hint: A flamboyant pianist has a secret relationship with a younger man.
Description: Based on the autobiographical novel, the tempestuous 6-year relationship between Liberace and his (much younger) lover, Scott Thorson, is recounted.

Title: Thelma
Hint: A college student has seizures that reveal strange powers.
Description: A college student starts to experience extreme seizures. She soon learns that the violent episodes are a symptom of inexplicable abilities.

Title: Sid and Nancy
Hint: A punk bassist and his girlfriend spiral into heroin addiction.
Description: January 1978. After their success in England, the punk rock band Sex Pistols venture out on their tour of the southern United States. Temperamental bassist ___ Vicious is forced by his band mates to travel without his troubled girlfriend, ___ Spungen, who will meet him in New York.

Title: Soul Surfer
Hint: A teen champion of the waves loses her arm in a shark attack and fights to compete again.
Description: The true story of teen ___ Bethany Hamilton, who lost her arm in a shark attack and courageously overcame all odds to become a champion again, through her sheer determination and unwavering faith.

Title: Professor Marston & the Wonder Women
Hint: A psychologist and his two lovers create a famous female superhero.
Description: The unconventional life of Dr. William ___, the Harvard psychologist and inventor who helped invent the modern lie detector test and co-created ___ Woman in 1941.

Title: The Tribe
Hint: A deaf boy joins a violent gang at a boarding school.
Description: Deaf-mute Sergey enters a specialized boarding school for the deaf. In navigating through the school's hierarchy, he encounters a corrupt underbelly of criminality, known as The ___. By participating in several robberies, he gets propelled higher into the organization, when he meets one of the Chief’s concubines Anya, and unwittingly breaks all the unwritten rules of the group."

Title: The Merchant of Venice
Hint: A Venetian trader borrows money from a moneylender and pledges a pound of his own flesh.
Description: ___, 1596. Bassanio begs his friend Antonio, a prosperous ___, to lend him a large sum of money so that he can woo Portia, a very wealthy heiress; but Antonio has invested his fortune abroad, so they turn to Shylock, a Jewish moneylender, and ask him for a loan.

Title: Playing by Heart
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Nine interconnected people navigate love, loss and romance in Los Angeles.
Description: In a vibrant tapestry of love and longing, nine interconnected souls navigate romance and heartbreak in L.A., where passions collide and truths unfold, revealing that the heart's desires often lead us where we least expect.

Title: The Words
Hint: A writer achieves success with a novel he didn't write.
Description: The ___ follows young writer Rory Jansen who finally achieves long sought after literary success after publishing the next great American novel. There's only one catch - he didn't write it.

Title: Suite Française
Hint: A French woman falls for a German officer during the occupation.
Description: France, 1940. In the first days of occupation, beautiful Lucile Angellier is trapped in a stifled existence with her controlling mother-in-law as they both await news of her husband: a prisoner of war. Parisian refugees start to pour into their small town, soon followed by a regiment of German soldiers who take up residence in the villagers' own homes.

Title: Two Lovers
Hint: A depressed Brooklyn man is torn between his family's choice and a mysterious, troubled neighbour.
Description: A depressed man moves back in with his parents following a recent heartbreak and finds himself with two women.

Title: Little Voice
Hint: A shy girl who imitates singers is pushed into the spotlight.
Description: After the death of her father, ___ or LV becomes a virtual recluse, never going out and hardly ever saying a word. She just sits in her bedroom listening to her father's collection of old records of Shirley Bassey, Marilyn Monroe and various other famous female singers. But at night time, LV sings, imitating these great singers with surprising accuracy.

Title: Hang 'Em High
Hint: A wrongly accused cowboy survives a lynching and becomes a marshal to hunt the men who hanged him.
Description: Marshall Jed Cooper survives a hanging, vowing revenge on the lynch mob that left him dangling. To carry out his oath for vengeance, he returns to his former job as a lawman. Before long, he's caught up with the nine men on his hit list and starts dispensing his own brand of Wild West justice.

Title: An Action Hero
Hint: A movie star is accused of murder and flees to London, pursued by the victim's brother.
Description: At the age of just 30, Maanav at the peak of his acting career gets caught up in a murder accusation, which turns his own life into an eccentric action thriller as he flees the country, with a vengeful politician hot on his heels.

Title: Ip Man 4: The Finale
Hint: An aging martial arts master travels to San Francisco to find a school for his son.
Description: Following the death of his wife, Ip Man travels to San Francisco to ease tensions between the local kung fu masters and his star student, Bruce Lee, while searching for a better future for his son.

Title: Becoming Jane
Hint: A young author falls in love with an Irishman.
Description: Though young ___ Austen's financially strapped parents expect her to marry the nephew of wealthy Lady Gresham, ___ herself knows that such a union will destroy her creativity and sense of self-worth. Instead, she becomes involved with Tom Lefroy, a charming but penniless apprentice lawyer who gives her the knowledge of the heart she needs for her future career as a novelist.

Title: The One I Love
Hint: A couple on the brink of separation go on a weekend retreat and find strange doppelgangers in the guest house.
Description: Ethan and Sophie are a married couple on the brink of separation when, at the urging of their therapist, they decide to salvage their relationship by escaping to a beautiful vacation house for the weekend.

Title: The Hidden
Hint: An alien parasite jumps from body to body, turning ordinary people into thrill-seeking killers.
Description: When average, law-abiding citizens suddenly turn to a life of hedonistic behavior and violent crime, Detective Tom Beck is tasked with helping young FBI agent Lloyd Gallagher determine the cause.

Title: How the West Was Won
Hint: Three generations of one pioneer family push across the frontier through rivers, wars and railroads.
Description: The epic tale of the development of the American West from the 1830s through the Civil War to the end of the century, as seen through the eyes of one pioneer family.

Title: Official Competition
Hint: A billionaire hires an eccentric director and two rival actors to make a prestige film.
Description: When a billionaire entrepreneur impulsively decides to create an iconic movie, he demands the best. Renowned filmmaker Lola Cuevas is recruited to mastermind this ambitious endeavour. Completing the all-star team are two actors with massive talent but even bigger egos: Hollywood heartthrob Félix Rivero and radical theatre actor Iván Torres. Both are legends, but not exactly best friends.

Title: Kundun

Description: The Tibetans refer to the Dalai Lama as '___', which means 'The Presence'. He was forced to escape from his native home, Tibet, when communist China invaded and enforced an oppressive regime upon the peaceful nation. The Dalai Lama escaped to India in 1959 and has been living in exile in Dharamsala ever since.

Title: The Trouble with Harry
Hint: A corpse turns up in a quiet Vermont village, and everyone thinks they killed him.
Description: The ___ is that he’s dead. In a quiet Vermont village, a corpse creates unexpected chaos as several townspeople each believe they may be to blame.

Title: Journey to the Center of the Earth

Description: An Edinburgh professor and assorted colleagues follow an explorer's trail down an extinct Icelandic volcano to the earth's center.

Description: Set in Baroque France, a scheming widow and her lover make a bet regarding the corruption of a recently married woman. The lover, ___, bets that he can seduce her, even though she is an honorable woman. If he wins, he can have his lover to do as he will. However, in the process of seducing the married woman, ___ falls in love.

Title: The Sure Thing
Hint: A slob and an uptight Ivy Leaguer share a cross-country ride to California.
Description: Gib, a beer-guzzling slob, and Alison, an uptight Ivy-Leaguer, are an unlikely duo stuck together on a cross-country trip during Christmas break. At first they get on each other's nerves but, as time passes, they find their divergent natures complement each other. Now they need to realize what they've already found before it's too late.

Title: Alfie
