Description: A young man leads a promiscuous lifestyle until several life reversals make him rethink his purposes and goals in life.

Title: Gridiron Gang
Hint: A juvenile detention counselor turns troubled teens into a football team.
Description: Under the leadership of their counselor, teenagers at a juvenile detention center gain self-esteem by playing football together. Based on a true story.

Title: The War of the Worlds
Hint: A flaming meteor lands near a California town, and Martian machines rise from it to conquer Earth.
Description: The residents of a small town are excited when a flaming meteor lands in the hills, until they discover it is the first of many transport devices from Mars bringing an army of invaders invincible to any man-made weapon, even the atomic bomb.

Title: Abominable
Hint: A teenage girl in Shanghai helps a young yeti escape back to the Himalayas.
Description: A group of misfits encounter a young Yeti named Everest, and they set off to reunite the magical creature with his family on the mountain of his namesake.

Title: Shadow
Hint: A military commander's body double plots against a reckless king in ink-wash China.
Description: In a kingdom ruled by a young and unpredictable king, the military commander has a secret weapon: a ___, a look-alike who can fool both his enemies and the King himself. Now he must use this weapon in an intricate plan that will lead his people to victory in a war that the King does not want.

Title: Pawn Sacrifice
Hint: An American chess prodigy battles paranoia and the Soviet champion during the Cold War.
Description: During the height of the Cold War, American chess prodigy Bobby Fischer finds himself caught between two superpowers when he challenges the Soviet Empire.

Title: I Am Love
Hint: A Russian-born matriarch of a Milanese industrial family falls for her son's chef friend.
Description: Emma has left Russia to live with her husband in Italy. Now a member of a powerful industrial family, she is the respected mother of three, but feels unfulfilled. One day, Antonio, a talented chef and her son's friend, makes her senses kindle.

Title: The Zookeeper's Wife
Country: Czech Republic, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Warsaw couple hides Jews among the cages of their bombed-out animal park.
Description: The account of keepers of the Warsaw Zoo, Jan and Antonina Zabinski, who helped save hundreds of people and animals during the Nazi invasion.

Title: Hello, Dolly!
Hint: A brassy matchmaker sets her sights on a grumpy half-millionaire in turn-of-the-century New York.
Description: ___ Levi is a strong-willed matchmaker who travels to Yonkers, New York in order to see the miserly "well-known unmarried half-a-millionaire" Horace Vandergelder. In doing so, she convinces his niece, his niece's intended, and Horace's two clerks to travel to New York City.

Title: The Peanuts Movie
Hint: A lovable loser tries to impress the little red-haired girl while his beagle fights the Red Baron.
Description: Snoopy embarks upon his greatest mission as he and his team take to the skies to pursue their arch-nemesis, while his best pal Charlie Brown begins his own epic quest.

Title: American Animals
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Four young men plan to steal rare books from a Kentucky university library, in a true-crime heist.
Description: Lexington, Kentucky, 2004. Four young men attempt to execute one of the most audacious art heists in the history of the United States.

Title: The Kid Detective
Hint: A once-celebrated child sleuth, now 31 and a failure, finally takes on his first real murder case.
Description: A once-celebrated ___, now 31, continues to solve the same trivial mysteries between hangovers and bouts of self-pity. Until a naive client brings him his first 'adult' case, to find out who brutally murdered her boyfriend.

Title: The Young and Prodigious T.S. Spivet
Hint: A 10-year-old mapmaking prodigy runs away from his Montana ranch to accept a science prize.
Description: A 10-year-old child prodigy cartographer secretly leaves his family's ranch in Montana where he lives with his cowboy father and scientist mother and travels across the country on board a freight train to receive an award at the Smithsonian Institute.

Title: Son of Rambow
Country: United Kingdom, France, Germany, United States of America
Hint: Two boys in 1980s England make their own action movie with a borrowed camcorder.
Description: Will is looking for an escape from his family when he encounters Lee, the school bully. Armed with a video camera and a copy of Rambo, Lee plans to make his own action-packed video epic.

Title: Breach
Hint: A young FBI surveillance expert is assigned to watch a veteran agent suspected of spying for Russia.
Description: Eric O'Neill, a low-level surveillance expert with the FBI, believes he is accomplishing his dream of becoming a full-fledged agent, with his unexpected promotion and assignment to clerk for Robert Hanssen, a renowned senior agent with 25 years in the FBI. However, he soon learns the reason for his promotion is to gain Hanssen's trust and find proof that he is a traitor to the country.

Title: Look Who's Back
Hint: A famous dictator wakes up in modern Berlin and becomes a TV star.
Description: When Adolf Hitler reawakens at the site of his former bunker in present-day Berlin, he is mistaken for a comedian and quickly becomes a media phenomenon.

Title: Paid in Full
Hint: A dry cleaner's delivery boy rises to become a Harlem drug kingpin in the 1980s.
Description: Ace is an impressionable young man working for a dry cleaning business. His friend, drug dealer Mitch, goes to prison. In an unrelated incident, he finds some cocaine in a pants pocket. Soon, Ace finds himself dealing cocaine for Lulu. Via lucky breaks and solid interpersonal skills, Ace moves to the top of the Harlem drug world. Of course, unfaithful employees and/or rivals conspire to bring about Ace's fall.

Title: Holy Motors
Hint: A mysterious man is chauffeured around Paris in a limo, playing strange roles all day.
Description: We follow 24 hours in the life of a being moving from life to life like a cold and solitary assassin moving from hit to hit. In each of these interwoven lives, the being possesses an entirely distinct identity: sometimes a man, sometimes a woman, sometimes youthful, sometimes old. By turns murderer, beggar, company chairman, monstrous creature, worker, family man.

Title: The Protector
Hint: A young Thai fighter travels to Australia to rescue his stolen elephant.
Description: A young fighter named Kham must go to Australia to retrieve his stolen elephant. With the help of a Thai-born Australian detective, Kham must take on all comers, including a gang led by an evil woman and her two deadly bodyguards.

Title: Vampire Hunter D
Hint: A half-human drifter is hired by a farm girl to slay the count who bit her.
Description: In a far-future time ruled by the supernatural, a young girl requests the help of a ___ hunter to kill the ___ who has bitten her and thus prevent her from becoming a ___ herself.

Title: Coffee and Cigarettes
Country: United States of America, Italy, Japan
Hint: Eleven vignettes of people chatting over caffeine and smokes.
Description: An anthology of eleven vignettes featuring star-studded casts of extremely unique individuals who all share the common activities of conversing while drinking ___ and smoking ___.

Title: Exotica
Hint: A tax auditor obsessively visits a Toronto strip club to watch the same dancer each night.
Description: In the upscale Toronto strip club ___, dancer Christina is visited nightly by the obsessive Francis, a depressed tax auditor. Her ex-boyfriend, the club's MC, Eric, still jealously pines for her even as he introduces her onstage, but Eric is having his own relationship problems with the club's female owner. Thomas, a mysterious pet-shop owner, is about to become unexpectedly involved in their lives.

Title: Martin
Hint: A young man convinced he's a vampire moves in with his elderly cousin in a Pennsylvania town.
Description: A young man, convinced he's a vampire, goes to live with his elderly and hostile cousin in a small Pennsylvanian town, where he tries to suppress his bloodlust.

Title: The Little Death
Hint: Several Australian couples in suburban Sydney deal with strange and comical sexual fetishes.
Description: A comedy film that looks into the loosely connected lives of people with strange sexual fantasies.

Title: Indochine
Hint: A French plantation owner and her adopted daughter love the same naval officer in colonial Vietnam.
Description: In colonial Vietnam, dashing French naval captain Jean-Baptiste, wealthy plantation owner Éliane Devries, and her adopted Vietnamese daughter Camillevare the three points of a cross-cultural romantic triangle.

Title: The Pit and the Pendulum
Hint: A man investigates his sister's death at a Spanish castle full of torture devices.
Description: In the sixteenth century, Francis Barnard travels to Spain to clarify the strange circumstances of his sister's death after she had married the son of a cruel Spanish Inquisitor.

Title: Battle for Sevastopol
Hint: The story of the most successful female sniper in history, fighting in WWII.
Description: The story of Lyudmila Pavlichenko, the most successful female sniper in history.

Title: Miss Potter
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A beloved children's author struggles for love and independence in Edwardian England.
Description: Beatrix ___, the author of the beloved children's book "The Tale of Peter Rabbit", struggles for love, happiness and success.

Title: Padmaavat
Hint: A ruthless sultan becomes obsessed with a Rajput queen and lays siege to her fort.
Description: Rajputana, India, 13th century. The tyrannical usurper Alauddin Khilji, sultan of Delhi, becomes obsessed with Queen Padmavati, wife of King Ratan Singh of Mewar, and goes to great lengths to satisfy his greed for her.

Title: Gomorrah
Hint: Interwoven stories expose the brutal grip of the Camorra crime syndicate on Naples.
Description: An inside look at Italy's modern-day crime families, the Camorra in Naples and Caserta. Based on a book by Roberto Saviano. Power, money and blood: these are the "values" that the residents of the Province of Naples and Caserta have to face every day. They hardly ever have a choice and are forced to obey the rules of the Camorra. Only a lucky few can even think of leading a normal life.

Title: The Water Diviner
Hint: An Australian farmer travels to Turkey to find his three sons lost at Gallipoli.
Description: In 1919, Australian farmer Joshua Connor travels to Turkey to discover the fate of his three sons, reported missing in action. Holding on to hope, Joshua must travel across the war-torn landscape to find the truth and his own peace.

Title: The Christmas Chronicles
Hint: Two siblings try to film Santa on the big night and end up helping save the holiday.
Description: Siblings Kate and Teddy try to prove Santa Claus is real, but when they accidentally cause his sleigh to crash, they have to save Christmas.

Title: If Only
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A man relives the day his girlfriend died, hoping to change her fate.
Description: After his impetuous musician girlfriend, Samantha, dies in an accident shortly after they had a fight (and nearly broke up), Ian Wyndham, a grief-stricken British businessman living in London gets a chance to relive the day all over again, in the hope of changing the events that led up to her getting killed.

Title: The Grand Seduction
Hint: A dying Newfoundland harbor town schemes to convince a big-city doctor to stay.
Description: A small fishing village must procure a local doctor to secure a lucrative business contract. When unlikely candidate and big city doctor Paul Lewis lands in their lap for a trial residence, the townsfolk rally together to charm him into staying. As the doctor’s time in the village winds to a close, acting mayor Murray French has no choice but to pull out all the stops and begin The ___.

Title: Million Dollar Arm
Hint: A sports agent holds a talent contest in India to find a baseball pitcher.
Description: In a last-ditch effort to save his career, sports agent JB Bernstein dreams up a wild game plan to find Major League Baseball’s next great pitcher from a pool of cricket players in India. He soon discovers two young men who can throw a fastball but know nothing about the game of baseball. Or America.

Title: Heart and Souls
Hint: Four ghosts must use the body of a man to finish their unfinished business.
Description: A fateful night in 1959, four people die when the bus they are riding crashes. They continue as ghosts; their ___ become eternally entwined to the life of a child born at the moment of their deaths as his guardians. Baby Thomas grows up to be a businessman who has memories of his playmates, but assumes they are products of his youthful imagination.

Title: Flash of Genius
Hint: A college professor fights the auto industry over his intermittent windshield wiper invention.
Description: In this David vs. Goliath drama based on a true story, college professor Robert Kearns goes up against the giants of the auto industry when they fail to give him credit for inventing intermittent windshield wipers. Kearns doggedly pursues recognition for his invention, as well as the much-deserved financial rewards for the sake of his wife and six kids.

Title: The Quiet American
Country: France, Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America, Vietnam
Hint: A cynical British journalist in 1950s Saigon falls for a Vietnamese woman, as an idealistic US agent intervenes.
Description: Cynical British journalist Fowler falls in love with a young Vietnamese woman but is dismayed when a naïve U.S. official also begins vying for her attention. In retaliation, Fowler informs the communists that the American is selling arms to their enemy.

Title: Oklahoma!
Hint: Two cowboys compete for a farm girl in the territory around 1906, in song.
Description: In the ___ territory at the turn of the twentieth century, two young cowboys vie with a violent ranch hand and a traveling peddler for the hearts of the women they love.

Title: The Boxer
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A former IRA prisoner returns to Belfast and tries to start a boxing club.
Description: Nineteen-year-old Danny Flynn is imprisoned for his involvement with the I.R.A. in Belfast. He leaves behind his family and his sixteen-year-old girlfriend, Maggie Hamill. Fourteen years later, Danny is released from prison and returns to his old working class neighborhood to resume his life as a ___.

Title: Kabir Singh
Hint: A hot-headed surgeon self-destructs after his girlfriend is forced to marry another man.
Description: ___, a genius yet hostile medical student, falls in love with Preeti from his college. When Preeti's father spots the couple kissing, he opposes their relationship and decides to marry her off.

Title: Barefoot in the Park
Hint: A free-spirited bride and her uptight lawyer husband move into a tiny New York walk-up.
Description: In this film based on a Neil Simon play, newlyweds Corie, a free spirit, and Paul Bratter, an uptight lawyer, share a sixth-floor apartment in Greenwich Village. Soon after their marriage, Corie tries to find a companion for mother, Ethel, who is now alone, and sets up Ethel with neighbor Victor. Inappropriate behavior on a double date causes conflict, and the young couple considers divorce.

Title: Dragon: The Bruce Lee Story
Country: Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: The life and loves of the martial arts legend who conquered Hollywood.
Description: This film is a glimpse into the life, love and the unconquerable spirit of the legendary ___. From a childhood of rigorous martial arts training, ___ realizes his dream of opening his own kung-fu school in America. Before long, he is discovered by a Hollywood producer and begins a meteoric rise to fame and an all too short reign as one the most charismatic action heroes in cinema history.

Title: Extreme Job
Hint: A narcotics squad goes undercover running a chicken restaurant, which becomes a huge hit.
Description: A drug squad attempts to take down a criminal organization and they must go undercover to do so, so they begin working at a chicken restaurant, that becomes famous for its delicious chicken. Due to the unexpected popularity, the detectives find themselves in a situation they never expected.

Title: Deep Cover
Hint: A cop goes undercover as a drug dealer and finds himself liking the life.
Description: Black police officer Russell Stevens applies for a special anti-drug squad which targets the highest boss of cocaine delivery to LA—the Colombian foreign minister's nephew. Russell works his way up from the bottom undercover, until he reaches the boss.

Title: The Salton Sea
Hint: A speed-addicted trumpet player infiltrates the meth underworld to avenge his wife.
Description: After the murder of his beloved wife, a man in search of redemption is set adrift in a world where nothing is as it seems. On his journey, he befriends slacker Jimmy "The Finn", becomes involved in rescuing his neighbor Colette from her own demons, and gets entangled in a web of deceit full of unexpected twists and turns.

Title: To End All Wars
Country: United Kingdom, Thailand, United States of America
Hint: Allied soldiers held captive by the Japanese build the Burma railway.
Description: Based on a real-life story, this drama focuses on a small group of Allied soldiers in Burma who are held captive by the Japanese. Capt. Ernest Gordon, Lt. Jim Reardon and Maj. Ian Campbell are among the military officers kept imprisoned and routinely beaten and deprived of food.

Title: Gorillas in the Mist
Hint: A scientist devotes her life to protecting great apes in the Rwandan mountains.
Description: The story of Dian Fossey, a scientist who came to Africa to study the vanishing mountain ___, and later fought to protect them.

Title: Pollock
Hint: An abstract expressionist painter battles alcoholism and his own genius.
Description: In August of 1949, Life Magazine ran a banner headline that begged the question: "Jackson ___: Is he the greatest living painter in the United States?" The film is a look back into the life of an extraordinary man, a man who has fittingly been called "an artist dedicated to concealment, a celebrity who nobody knew." As he struggled with self-doubt, engaging in a lonely tug-of-war between needing to express…

Title: Red Rock West
Hint: A drifter is mistaken for a hitman in a small Wyoming town.
Description: When a promised job for Texan Michael fails to materialize in Wyoming, Mike is mistaken by Wayne to be the hitman he hired to kill his unfaithful wife, Suzanne. Mike takes full advantage of the situation, collects the money, and runs. During his getaway, things go wrong, and soon get worse when he runs into the real hitman, Lyle.

Title: Don't Torture a Duckling
Hint: A reporter investigates a series of child murders in a superstitious Southern Italian village.
Description: A reporter and a promiscuous young woman try to solve a series of child killings in a remote southern Italian town rife with superstition and a distrust of outsiders.

Title: Niagara
Hint: A honeymooning couple at the famous falls are entangled with a woman plotting to kill her husband.
Description: Rose Loomis and her older, gloomier husband, George, are vacationing at a cabin in ___ Falls, N.Y. The couple befriend Polly and Ray Cutler, who are honeymooning in the area. Polly begins to suspect that something is amiss between Rose and George, and her suspicions grow when she sees Rose in the arms of another man.

Title: Find Me Guilty
Hint: A mobster represents himself in the longest criminal trial in American history.
Description: Based on the true story of Jack DiNorscio, a mobster who defended himself in court for what would be the longest mafia trial in U.S. history.

Title: The Visitors
Hint: Two war veterans pay a visit to an old comrade who once testified against them.
Description: Bill, Martha and their little child Hal are spending a quiet winter Sunday in their cosy house when they get an unexpected visit from Mike Nickerson and Tony Rodriguez. Mike and Tony are old acquaintances of Bill; a few years back, in Vietnam, they were in the same platoon. They also became opposed parties in a court martial - for a reason that Bill never explained to Martha.

Title: Miracle Mile
Genres: Romance, Drama, Science Fiction, Thriller, Comedy, Action
Hint: A man finds a phone call warning of a nuclear attack in less than an hour, in Los Angeles.
Description: After 30 years of searching, Harry has finally met the girl of his dreams. Unfortunately, before they even have a chance to go on their first date, Harry intercepts some chilling news: WWIII has begun and nuclear missiles will destroy Los Angeles in less than an hour!

Title: The Vikings
Hint: A Viking prince and a slave unknowingly half-brothers clash over a Welsh princess.
Description: Einar, brutal son of the viking Ragnar and future heir to his throne, tangles with clever slave Eric, for the hand of a beautiful English maiden.

Title: Away We Go
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An expecting couple travels around North America to find a perfect place to raise their child.
Description: Verona and Burt have moved to Colorado to be close to Burt's parents but, with Verona expecting their first child, Burt's parents inexplicably decide to move to Belgium, now leaving them in a place they hate and without a support structure in place.

Title: The Curse of Frankenstein
Hint: A ruthless Swiss baron creates a monstrous creature from body parts, in a gory Hammer horror retelling.
Description: Baron Victor ___ has discovered life's secret and unleashed a blood-curdling chain of events resulting from his creation: a cursed creature with a horrid face — and a tendency to kill.

Title: Slacker
Hint: A day of rambling conversations among eccentric dropouts in Austin, Texas.
Description: Austin, Texas, is an Eden for the young and unambitious, from the enthusiastically eccentric to the dangerously apathetic. Here, the nobly lazy can eschew responsibility in favor of nursing their esoteric obsessions.

Title: The Old Dark House
Hint: Stranded travellers in Wales take shelter in a remote house of creepy eccentrics.
Description: In a remote region of Wales, five travelers beset by a relentless storm find shelter in an old mansion.

Title: The Return of the Pink Panther
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A bumbling French inspector is called back when a famous diamond is stolen again.
Description: The famous ___ jewel has once again been stolen and Inspector Clouseau is called in to catch the thief. The Inspector is convinced that 'The Phantom' has returned and utilises all of his resources – himself and his Asian manservant – to reveal the identity of 'The Phantom'.

Title: Curse of the Golden Flower
Studio: Beijing New Picture Film Co. Ltd.
Country: China, Hong Kong, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An emperor's family conspires against itself during a chrysanthemum festival.
Description: During China's Tang dynasty the emperor has taken the princess of a neighboring province as his wife. She has borne him two sons and raised his eldest. Now his control over his dominion is complete, including the royal family itself.

Title: Teorema
Hint: A mysterious stranger seduces every member of a wealthy Milanese family.
Description: A wealthy Italian household is turned upside down when a handsome stranger arrives, seduces every family member and then disappears. Each has an epiphany of sorts, but none can figure out who the seductive visitor was or why he came.

Title: Better Luck Tomorrow
Hint: Overachieving Asian-American teens in suburban California slide into a life of crime.
Description: A group of over-achieving Asian-American high school seniors enjoy a power trip when they dip into extra-curricular criminal activities.

Title: Rose Island
Hint: An Italian engineer declares his own micronation on a platform in the Adriatic in 1968, and Rome is furious.
Description: In 1968, engineer Giorgio Rosa established the independent state called "The Isle of Roses" off the coast of Rimini, built on a platform outside the territorial waters, with Esperanto as the official language. The Italian authorities did not take it well because the micronation was seen as an expedient to not pay taxes on the revenues obtained thanks to the arrival of numerous tourists and curious people.

Title: Kurup
Hint: A notorious fugitive fakes his own death in an insurance scam.
Description: The Film is based on the infamous 'Charlie Murder Case' in the Indian State of Kerala where the main culprit Sukumara ___ has been on the run for decades and is still not been caught. The story revolves around the perspective of Sukumara ___ and the Police officers who were investigating the case.

Title: Hondo
Hint: A dispatch rider protects a woman and her son on a ranch in Apache territory.
Description: Army despatch rider ___ Lane discovers a woman and her son living in the midst of warring Apaches, and he becomes their protector.

Title: Runway 34
Hint: A pilot makes a risky landing in bad weather and faces an inquiry.
Description: A flying prodigy, Captain Vikrant Khanna's flight takes a stirring and mysterious trajectory after take-off from an international destination. Concurrently, it follows the tenacious Narayan Vedant in his pursuit to uncover the truth.

Title: Two Mules for Sister Sara
Hint: A mercenary helps a nun who isn't what she seems during the Mexican revolution.
Description: When a wandering mercenary named Hogan rescues a nun called Sister ___ from the unwanted attentions of a band of rogues on the Mexican plains, he has no idea what he has let himself in for. Their chance encounter results in the blowing up of a train and a French garrison, as well as igniting a spark between them that survives a shocking discovery.

Title: Rio Grande
Hint: A cavalry officer defends settlers on the Texas border and reunites with his son.
Description: Lt. Col. Kirby Yorke is posted on the Texas frontier to defend settlers against depredations of marauding Apaches. Col. Yorke is under considerable stress by a serious shortage of troops of his command. Tension is added when Yorke's son (whom he hasn't seen in fifteen years), Trooper Jeff Yorke, is one of 18 recruits sent to the regiment.

Title: Miss Pettigrew Lives for a Day
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A dowdy governess spends one day as social secretary to a glamorous American singer.
Description: London, England, on the eve of World War II. Guinevere ___, a strict governess who is unable to keep a job, is fired again. Lost in the hostile city, a series of fortunate circumstances lead her to meet Delysia LaFosse, a glamorous and dazzling American jazz singer whose life is a chaos ruled by indecision, a continuous battle between love and fame.

Title: Bobby
Hint: Lives intersect at the Ambassador Hotel on the night of an assassination.
Description: In 1968 the lives of a retired doorman, hotel manager, lounge singer, busboy, beautician and others intersect in the wake of Robert F. Kennedy's assassination at the Ambassador Hotel in Los Angeles.

Title: Mohabbatein
Hint: A strict headmaster clashes with a music teacher who encourages love.
Description: At a prestigious all-male university, three friends seek love outside of the school grounds; at the same time, a newly-hired music teacher seeks to befriend and loosen up the militantly strict headmaster.

Title: Cadillac Records
Hint: The story of the Chicago record label that launched blues and rock-and-roll legends.
Description: The story of sex, violence, race and rock and roll in 1950s Chicago, and the exciting but turbulent lives of some of America's musical legends, including Muddy Waters, Leonard Chess, Little Walter, Howlin' Wolf, Etta James and Chuck Berry.

Title: Danny Collins
Hint: An aging rock star finds an undelivered letter from a legendary Liverpool songwriter and changes his life.
Description: An ageing hard-living 1970s rock star decides to change his life when he discovers a 40-year-old undelivered letter written to him by John Lennon.

Title: The Trip
Hint: A disillusioned director takes LSD and wanders through Hollywood.
Description: After his wife leaves him, a disillusioned director dives into the drug scene, trying anything his friend suggests.

Title: Angel-A
Hint: A scam artist about to jump into the Seine is saved by a mysterious woman.
Description: A beautiful and mysterious woman helps an inept scam artist get his game together... but is their meeting purely coincidence?

Title: Alphaville
Hint: A secret agent infiltrates a city controlled by a computer.
Description: Lemmy Caution is on a mission to eliminate Professor Von Braun, the creator of a malevolent computer that rules the city of ___. Befriended by the scientist’s daughter Natasha, Lemmy must unravel the mysteries of the strictly logical Alpha 60 and teach Natasha the meaning of the word “love.”

Title: Copenhagen
Hint: A young man searches for his grandfather in Denmark.
Description: After weeks of traveling through Europe, the immature William finds himself in ___, the place of his father’s birth. He befriends the youthful Effy, who works in William’s hotel as part of an internship program, and they set off to find William’s last living relative. Effy’s mix of youthful exuberance and wisdom challenges William unlike any woman ever has.

Title: Confession of Murder
Hint: A serial killer reappears after the statute of limitations expires and publishes a bestselling memoir of his crimes.
Description: A serial killer reappears 15 years after his murder spree with a book detailing his crimes. The resentful cop who failed to catch him before is assigned to protect him. The families of the victims plan revenge. And as the media circus spirals out of control, a masked man called "J" appears claiming to be the real killer.

Title: People Like Us
Hint: A man discovers he has a sister he never knew about.
Description: After flying home to L.A. for the funeral of his estranged record-producer father, a struggling man discovers that the will stipulates that he must deliver $150,000 in cash to a 30-year-old alcoholic sister he never knew existed, and her troubled 12-year-old son.

Title: Stage Fright
Hint: A struggling actress helps a friend prove his innocence in a murder.
Description: A struggling actress tries to help a friend prove his innocence when he's accused of murdering the husband of a high-society entertainer.

Title: Heavy Trip
Hint: A Finnish metal band sneaks into a Norwegian festival.
Description: Turo is stuck in a small village and the best thing in his life is being the lead vocalist for the amateur metal band Impaled Rektum. He and his bandmates have practiced for 12 years without playing a single gig. The guys get a surprise visitor from Norway -- the promoter for a huge ___ metal music festival -- and decide it's now or never.

Title: Mrs. Henderson Presents
Hint: A wealthy widow buys a London theatre and introduces nude revues during the Blitz.
Description: Recently widowed well-to-do Laura ___ purchases the Windmill Theatre in London as a post-widowhood hobby. After starting an innovative continuous variety review, which is copied by other theaters, they begin to lose money. ___ suggests they add risqué burlesque acts similar to the Moulin Rouge in Paris.

Title: High Heels
Hint: An actress returns to Madrid and her daughter's husband is murdered.
Description: After being estranged for 15 years, flamboyant actress Becky del Paramo re-enters her daughter Rebeca's life when she comes to perform a concert. Rebeca, she finds, is now married to one of Becky's ex-lovers, Manuel. The mother and daughter begin making up for lost time, when suddenly, a murder occurs...

Title: The Sapphires
Hint: Four Aboriginal girls form a soul group and perform in Vietnam.
Description: It's 1968, and four young, talented Australian Aboriginal girls learn about love, friendship, and war when they entertain the US troops in Vietnam as singing group The ___.

Title: Iris
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The lifelong romance between a novelist and her husband as she develops Alzheimer's.
Description: True story of the lifelong romance between novelist ___ Murdoch and her husband John Bayley, from their student days through her battle with Alzheimer's disease.

Title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
Hint: A sailor battles a cyclops and other monsters to save a shrunken princess.
Description: When a princess is shrunken by an evil wizard, ___ must undertake a quest to an island of monsters to cure her and prevent a war.

Title: The Lookout
Hint: A once-promising athlete with brain damage is pulled into a bank heist.
Description: Chris is a once promising high school athlete whose life is turned upside down following a tragic accident. As he tries to maintain a normal life, he takes a job as a janitor at a bank, where he ultimately finds himself caught up in a planned heist.

Title: Latter Days
Hint: A party boy tries to seduce a Mormon missionary.
Description: Christian, a hunky, 20-something, West Hollywood party boy gets more than he bargains for when he tries to seduce Aaron, a sexually confused Mormon missionary who moves into his apartment complex.

Title: Ip Man 3
Hint: A martial arts master protects a school from a property developer.
Description: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

Title: The 100 Year-Old Man Who Climbed Out the Window and Disappeared
Hint: A centenarian sneaks out of his nursing home and stumbles into a suitcase of cash and a wild adventure.
Description: After living a long and colorful life, Allan Karlsson finds himself stuck in a nursing home. On his 100th birthday, he leaps out a ___ and begins an unexpected journey.

Title: Mirai
Hint: A four-year-old meets family members from the past and future.
Description: Unhappy after his new baby sister displaces him, four-year-old Kun begins meeting people and pets from his family's history in their unique house in order to help him become the big brother he was meant to be.

Title: 8 Women
Hint: Eight women in a snowbound cottage try to solve a murder.
Description: Eight women gather to celebrate Christmas in a snowbound cottage, only to find the family patriarch dead with a knife in his back. Trapped in the house, every woman becomes a suspect, each having her own motive and secret.

Title: Badhaai Do
Hint: A gay cop and a lesbian teacher enter a sham marriage.
Description: A gay cop and a lesbian teacher enter a sham marriage to pacify their families but find that relationships — both real and fake — aren't all that easy.

Title: Dil Dhadakne Do
Country: India, Spain, Turkey, Italy, France, Tunisia
Hint: A wealthy family takes a cruise to celebrate an anniversary.
Description: On a cruise to celebrate their parents' 30th wedding anniversary, a brother and sister deal with the impact of family considerations on their romantic lives.

Title: Beavis and Butt-Head Do the Universe
Hint: Two moronic teens are sent to Space Camp and travel to 2022.
Description: In 1998, ___-Head are sentenced to Space Camp by a “creative” judge. Their obsession with a docking simulator (huh huh) leads to a trip on the Space Shuttle, with predictably disastrous results. After going through a black hole, they re-emerge in our time, where they look for love, misuse iPhones, and are hunted by the Deep State. Spoiler: They don’t score.

Title: Ferry
Hint: Before he built a drug empire, a gangster returns to his hometown in Brabant.
Description: Before he built a drug empire, ___ Bouman returns to his hometown on a revenge mission that finds his loyalty tested — and a love that alters his life.

Title: OSS 117: Cairo, Nest of Spies
Hint: A bumbling, sexist French secret agent goes undercover in 1955 Egypt to investigate a colleague's death.
Description: Set in 1955, French secret agent Hubert Bonisseur de La Bath/___ is sent to ___ to investigate the disappearance of his best friend and fellow spy Jack Jefferson, only to stumble into a web of international intrigue.

Title: Serial Bad Weddings
Hint: A French Catholic couple's daughters marry men of different religions.
Description: A catholic French couple sees their life upside down when their four daughters get married to men of different religion and origins.

Title: The End of the Affair
Hint: A novelist recalls his wartime romance with a married woman who mysteriously broke it off.
Description: On a rainy London night in 1946, novelist Maurice Bendrix has a chance meeting with Henry Miles, husband of his ex-mistress Sarah, who abruptly ended their affair two years before. Bendrix's obsession with Sarah is rekindled; he succumbs to his own jealousy and arranges to have her followed.

Title: The Stunt Man
Hint: A fugitive becomes a daredevil double on a movie set run by a manipulative director.
Description: A fugitive stumbles onto a movie set just when they need a new ___, takes the job as a way to hide out and falls for the leading lady while facing off with his manipulative director.

Title: Being Julia
Hint: A diva actress in 1930s London takes revenge on a younger rival.
Description: ___ Lambert is a true diva: beautiful, talented, weathly and famous. She has it all - including a devoted husband who has mastermined her brilliant career - but after years of shining in the spotlight she begins to suffer from a severe case of boredom and longs for something new and exciting to put the twinkle back in her eye.

Title: Infamous
Hint: A writer develops a relationship with a killer while researching his book.
Description: While researching his book In Cold Blood, writer Truman Capote develops a close relationship with convicted murderers Dick Hickock and Perry Smith.

Title: Happy-Go-Lucky
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An optimistic London schoolteacher takes driving lessons from an angry instructor.
Description: A look at a few chapters in the life of Poppy, a cheery, colorful, North London schoolteacher whose optimism tends to exasperate those around her.

Title: The Angels' Share
Hint: A young Glasgow father plans to steal rare whisky.
Description: Narrowly avoiding jail, new dad Robbie vows to turn over a new leaf. A visit to a whisky distillery inspires him and his mates to seek a way out of their hopeless lives.

Title: Thunder Road
Hint: A police officer has a breakdown after his mother's death.
Description: A police officer faces a personal meltdown following a divorce and the death of his mother.

Title: Crooklyn
Hint: A family in 1970s Brooklyn struggles through a summer.
Description: From Spike Lee comes this vibrant semi-autobiographical portrait of a school-teacher, her stubborn jazz-musician husband and their five kids living in '70s Brooklyn.

Title: Pieces of April
Hint: A rebellious young woman with a broken oven tries to cook Thanksgiving dinner for her estranged family.
Description: Quirky and rebellious ___ Burns lives with her boyfriend in a low-rent New York City apartment miles away from her emotionally distant family. But when she discovers that her mother has a fatal form of breast cancer, she invites the clan to her place for Thanksgiving.

Title: Tokyo!
Hint: Three bizarre tales set in the Japanese capital, including a sewer-dwelling madman.
Description: Three distinct tales unfold in the bustling city of ___. Merde, a bizarre sewer-dweller, emerges from a manhole and begins terrorizing pedestrians. After his arrest, he stands trial and lashes out at a hostile courtroom. A man who has resigned himself to a life of solitude reconsiders after meeting a charming pizza delivery woman.

Title: Frequently Asked Questions About Time Travel
Hint: Three pub-going nerds find a leak in the fabric of time in the men's room.
Description: Follows three social outcasts -- two geeks and a cynic -- as they attempt to navigate a time-travel conundrum in the middle of a British pub.

Title: The Odessa File
Hint: A German journalist hunts a former SS officer who ran a concentration camp.
Description: Following the suicide of an elderly Jewish man, investigative journalist Peter Miller sets out to hunt down an SS Captain and former concentration camp commander. In doing so he discovers that, despite allegations of war crimes, the former commander has become a man of importance in industry in post-war Germany, protected from prosecution by a powerful organisation of former SS members called ___.

Title: XXY
Hint: An intersex teenager in Argentina struggles with identity as her parents debate surgery.
Description: Alex, an intersexed 15-year-old, is living as a girl, but she and her family begin to wonder whether she's emotionally a boy when another teenager's sexual advances bring the issue to a head. As Alex faces a final decision regarding her gender, she meets both hostility and compassion.

Title: Going My Way
Hint: A young, unconventional priest takes over a struggling New York parish.
Description: Youthful Father Chuck O'Malley led a colorful life of sports, song, and romance before joining the Roman Catholic clergy. After being appointed to a run-down New York parish, O'Malley's worldly knowledge helps him connect with a gang of boys looking for direction, eventually winning over the aging, conventional Parish priest.

Title: Cul-de-sac
Hint: Two wounded gangsters take refuge in an isolated castle on a tidal island.
Description: On the run and in search of help, two wounded gangsters find refuge in the secluded castle of a feeble man and his wife; however, under the point of a gun, nothing is what it seems.

Title: Secret of the Wings
Hint: A fairy meets her twin sister in the winter woods.
Description: Tinkerbell wanders into the forbidden Winter woods and meets Periwinkle. Together they learn the secret of their ___ and try to unite the warm fairies and the winter fairies to help Pixie Hollow.

Title: Main Hoon Na
Hint: An army major goes undercover as a college student.
Description: An army major goes undercover as a college student. His mission is both professional and personal: to protect his general's daughter from a radical militant, and to find his estranged half-brother.

Title: Peter's Friends
Hint: A group of university pals reunite at a country estate for New Year's Eve, ten years after graduation.
Description: After inheriting a large country estate from his late father, Peter invites his friends from college: married couple Roger and Mary, the lonely Maggie, fashionable Sarah, and writer Andrew, who brings his American TV star wife, Carol. Sarah's new boyfriend, Brian, also attends. It has been 10 years since college, and they find their lives are very different.

Title: The Fountainhead
Hint: An uncompromising architect refuses to bend his designs to anyone's taste.
Description: An uncompromising, visionary architect struggles to maintain his integrity and individualism despite personal, professional and economic pressures to conform to popular standards.

Title: Robot & Frank
Hint: An aging jewel thief teams up with his mechanical caretaker to pull off one more heist.
Description: Curmudgeonly old Frank lives by himself. His routine involves daily visits to his local library, where he has a twinkle in his eye for the librarian. His grown children are concerned about their father’s well-being and buy him a caretaker ___.

Title: I'm a Cyborg, But That's OK
Hint: A young woman in a mental hospital believes she is a machine and refuses to eat.
Description: Young-goon, mentally deranged and frequently electro-charging herself with a transistor radio, has been admitted into a mental institution. Firmly believing herself to be a ___, she refuses to consume like a human being. Il-soon is another patient, who catches the eye of Young-goon and soon becomes a close friend.

Title: Vera Cruz
Hint: American mercenaries escort a countess and a fortune in gold during the Mexican revolution.
Description: After the American Civil War, mercenaries travel to Mexico to fight in their revolution for money. The former soldier and gentleman Benjamin Trane meets the gunman and killer Joe Erin and his men, and together they are hired by the Emperor Maximillian and the Marquis Henri de Labordere to escort the Countess Marie Duvarre to the harbor of ___.

Title: The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes
Hint: A bored detective takes on the case of a mysterious woman with amnesia, and finds himself in Scotland.
Description: When a bored ___ eagerly takes the case of Gabrielle Valladon following an attempt on her life, the search for her missing husband leads to Loch Ness and the legendary monster.

Title: Wheels on Meals
Hint: Two cousins running a food truck in Barcelona protect a pickpocket from kidnappers.
Description: Cousins Thomas and David, owners of a mobile restaurant, team up with their friend Moby, a bumbling private detective, to save the beautiful Sylvia, a pickpocket.

Title: Dog Pound
Hint: Three teens arrive at a brutal juvenile prison and fight to survive.
Description: Three juvenile delinquents arrive at a correctional center and are put under the care of an experienced guard.

Title: Dream Girl
Hint: A small-town man earns money by voicing a woman on a phone-chat hotline, and men fall for her.
Description: Desperate to find employment, Karam picks up a job as ‘Pooja’ at a call center for sex chats, keeping most people in his life in the dark about the nature of his work. How long can he keep it up before everyone including his girlfriend and father find out?

Title: Department Q: A Conspiracy of Faith
Hint: Two detectives find a message in a bottle written in blood by a kidnapped boy.
Description: Denmark, 2016. A blurred note is found in a bottle that has traveled across the ocean for a long time. After deciphering the cryptic note, ___ follow a sinister trail that leads them to investigate a case that occurred in 2008. At the same time, new tragic events take place that test their ___ and deepest beliefs.

Title: Sultan
Hint: An aging Haryanvi wrestler makes a comeback to win back his estranged wife.
Description: The ageing wrestler ___ Ali Khan decides to try his luck on the mat again; to do this, he wants to represent his country at the Olympic Games, but first has to overcome personal issues.

Title: Sands of Iwo Jima
Hint: A tough Marine sergeant trains his squad and leads them to an island battle in the Pacific.
Description: Haunted by personal demons, Marine Sgt. John Stryker is hated and feared by his men, who see him as a cold-hearted sadist. But when their boots hit the beaches, they begin to understand the reason for Stryker's rigid form of discipline.

Title: The Grey Zone
Hint: Jewish prisoners forced to work the crematoria plan an uprising at Auschwitz.
Description: The story of Auschwitz's twelfth Sonderkommando — one of the thirteen consecutive "Special Squads" of Jewish prisoners placed by the Nazis in the excruciating moral dilemma of assisting in the extermination of fellow Jews in exchange for a few more months of life.

Title: My Dog Skip
Hint: A shy boy in 1940s Mississippi finds courage through his loyal terrier.
Description: A shy boy is unable to make friends in Yazoo City, Mississippi in 1942, until his parents give him a terrier puppy for his ninth birthday. The dog, which he names ___, becomes well known and loved throughout the community and enriches the life of the boy, Willie, as he grows into manhood.

Title: The United States of Leland
Hint: A detached teenager murders a disabled boy, and a teacher tries to understand why.
Description: A withdrawn young man, ___ Fitzgerald is imprisoned for the murder of a mentally disabled boy, who also happened to be the brother of his girlfriend, Becky. As the community struggles to deal with the killing, Pearl Madison, a teacher at the prison, decides to write about ___ case. Meanwhile, others affected by the murder, including Becky and her sister, Julie, must contend with their own problems.

Title: Sabotage
Hint: A cinema owner secretly plants bombs in London while a detective watches him.
Description: Karl Anton Verloc and his wife own a small cinema in a quiet London suburb where they live seemingly happily. But Mrs. Verloc does not know that her husband has a secret that will affect their relationship and threaten her teenage brother's life.

Title: At the End of the Tunnel
Hint: A paraplegic engineer overhears robbers digging beneath his house toward a bank.
Description: A paraplegic computer engineer who moves in a wheelchair and works in his basement starts hearing noises and voices of bank-robbers.

Title: Ashes of Time
Hint: A heartbroken swordsman in the desert hires out killers and remembers lost loves.
Description: Ouyang Feng is a heartbroken and cynical man who spends his days in the desert, connecting expert swordsmen with those seeking revenge and willing to pay for it. Throughout five seasons in exile, Ouyang spins tales of his clients' unrequited loves and unusual acts of bravery.

Title: The Candidate
Hint: A young idealist runs for the US Senate and slowly compromises everything.
Description: Bill McKay is a ___ for the U.S. Senate from California. He has no hope of winning, so he is willing to tweak the establishment.

Title: The Bar
Hint: Strangers are trapped in a Madrid café after mysterious gunshots outside.
Description: In downtown Madrid, a series of mysterious gunshots trap a motley assortment of people in a decrepit ___.

Title: Ladies in Lavender
Hint: Two elderly sisters nurse a young Polish violinist who washes ashore.
Description: Andrea, a gifted young Polish violinist from Krakow, is bound for America when he is swept overboard by a storm. When the Widdington sisters discover the handsome stranger on the beach below their house, they nurse him back to health. However, the presence of the musically talented young man disrupts the peaceful lives of Ursula and Janet and the community in which they live.

Title: As Tears Go By
Hint: A Hong Kong gangster falls for his cousin while protecting his reckless friend.
Description: Mid-level gangster Wah falls in love with his beautiful cousin, but must also continue to protect his volatile partner-in-crime and friend, Fly.

Title: Now Is Good
Hint: A girl dying of leukemia makes a list of things to do before she dies.
Description: A girl dying of leukemia compiles a list of things she'd like to do before passing away. Topping the list is her desire to lose her virginity.

Title: Story of Ricky
Hint: A martial artist in a privatized prison fights gangs with superhuman strength.
Description: In 2001, where all correctional facilities have been privatized, martial artist ___ finds himself victim to the corrupt system, found "guilty" of the manslaughter of an infamous crime boss.

Title: Dragon
Hint: A martial arts expert tries to start a new life in a remote village.
Description: A sinful martial arts expert wants to start a new tranquil life, only to be hunted by a determined detective and his former master.

Title: White Dog
Hint: A young actress adopts a stray German shepherd, only to discover it was trained to attack Black people.
Description: Samuel Fuller’s throat-grabbing exposé on American racism was misunderstood and withheld from release when it was made in the early eighties.Today, the notorious film is lauded for its daring metaphor and gripping pulp filmmaking.

Title: A War
Hint: A Danish company commander in Afghanistan faces charges after calling in an airstrike to save his men.
Description: Company commander Claus Michael Pedersen and his men are stationed in Helmand, Afghanistan. Meanwhile back in Denmark, with a husband at ___ and three children missing their father, everyday life is a struggle for Claus' wife Maria. During a routine mission, the soldiers are caught in heavy Taliban crossfire.

Title: The Road Within
Hint: A young man with Tourette's steals a car and takes his mother's ashes to the ocean.
Description: A young man with Tourette's Syndrome embarks on a road trip with his recently-deceased mother's ashes.

Title: Priceless
Hint: A desperate man agrees to drive a truck, only to discover its cargo is women being trafficked.
Description: James, down on his luck and desperate for some quick cash, agrees to drive a small truck across country. He soon realizes that he's made a huge mistake and has inadvertently become involved in a dangerous human trafficking ring. The unlikely hero risks it all to shut down the trafficking ring and save the woman he is falling in love with.

Title: Owning Mahowny
Hint: A Canadian bank manager embezzles millions to feed his gambling addiction.
Description: Dan ___ was a rising star at the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce. At twenty-four he was assistant manager of a major branch in the heart of Toronto's financial district. To his colleagues he was a workaholic. To his customers, he was astute, decisive and helpful. To his friends, he was a quiet, but humorous man who enjoyed watching sports on television. To his girlfriend, he was shy but engaging.

Title: Bob Roberts
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A folk-singing conservative millionaire runs for the Senate in a mockumentary.
Description: Millionaire conservative ___ launches an insurgent campaign against incumbent senator Brickley Paiste, firing up crowds at his rallies by singing '60s-style acoustic folk songs with lyrics espousing far-right conservative social and economic views.

Title: Cannibal! The Musical
Hint: Prospectors in the Colorado territory get lost, sing songs and eat each other.
Description: Heading through Colorado Territory in search of gold and women, Alferd Packer and his group of bemused companions find themselves lost, starving and musically inspired by the obstacles they confront along the way, including a die-hard Confederate cyclops, a trio of surly trappers, a tribe of Japanese-speaking "Indians," and ultimately, each other.

Title: Get Low
Country: United States of America, Germany, Poland
Hint: A hermit in 1930s Tennessee throws his own funeral party while he is still alive.
Description: A movie spun out of equal parts folk tale, fable and real-life legend about the mysterious, 1930s Tennessee hermit who famously threw his own rollicking funeral party... while he was still alive.

Title: Dil To Pagal Hai
Hint: A dance troupe director falls for a new dancer while his best friend loves him.
Description: Rahul, the director of a successful dance troupe, considers Nisha his best friend, though secretly, she is madly in love with him. He then falls for Pooja, who is engaged to Ajay.

Title: Aashiqui 2
Hint: A fading singer launches a young woman's career as his own spirals out of control.
Description: A young woman meets a failing musician who launches her singing career, but their relationship is doomed when people assume he's with her for her fame and fortune.

Title: Croupier
Hint: An aspiring writer takes a job dealing cards at a London casino.
Description: Jack Manfred is an aspiring writer who to make ends meet, takes a job as a ___. Jack remains an observer, knowing that everything in life is a gamble and that gamblers are born to lose. Inevitably, he gets sucked into the world of the casino which takes its toll on his relationships and the novel he is writing.

Title: The Man Who Invented Christmas
Hint: A famous Victorian novelist struggles to write a ghostly holiday tale.
Description: In 1843, despite the fact that Dickens is a successful writer, the failure of his latest book puts his career at a crossroads, until the moment when, struggling with inspiration and confronting reality with his childhood memories, a new character is born in the depths of his troubled mind; an old, lonely, embittered man, so vivid, so human, that a whole world grows around him, a story so inspiring that changed the…

Title: Swimming with Sharks
Hint: A young assistant takes revenge on his abusive Hollywood boss.
Description: Guy is a young film executive who's willing to do whatever it takes to make it in Hollywood. He begins working for famed producer Buddy Ackerman, a domineering, manipulative, coldhearted boss. When Guy also finds out that his cynical girlfriend, Dawn, has been using sex as a career move, he reaches his limit. Guy decides to exact revenge on Buddy by kidnapping him and subjecting him to cruel and unusual punishment.

Title: I Walked with a Zombie
Hint: A nurse in the Caribbean turns to voodoo to cure her sleepwalking, soulless patient.
Description: A nurse in the Caribbean turns to voodoo in hopes of curing her patient, a mindless woman whose husband she's fallen in love with.

Title: Outsourced
Hint: A comedian's live stand-up show about jobs going overseas.
Description: Russell’s last DVD and CD, ___, was taped before a sold out audience at the Warfield Theatre in San Francisco, and gives viewers and listeners an excellent overview of Russell’s comedic genius.

Title: Hum Tum
Hint: A cartoonist and a woman keep meeting over the years and fall in love.
Description: The encounters of two people who run into each other on several occasions under circumstances ranging from friendly to hostile to loving. Along many years and countless run-ins, the two despise each other, befriend each other, and fall in love with each other—in no particular order.

Title: The Flower of My Secret
Hint: A romance author writes under a pseudonym while her marriage falls apart.
Description: Middle-aged romance author Leo writes under a pseudonym, since she despises her own work. At home, her husband, who works overseas, is distant both physically and emotionally. As she reevaluates her life and writing, Leo is led to an unexpected relationship with Ángel, a sensitive newspaper editor.

Title: Woyzeck
Hint: A poor soldier subjected to medical experiments is driven to madness and murder.
Description: Having fathered an illegitimate child with his lover, Marie, feckless soldier Franz ___ takes odd jobs around his small town to provide some extra money for them. One job is volunteering for experiments conducted by a local doctor, who puts ___ on a diet of peas.

Title: Katyn
Hint: Polish officers are massacred by the Soviets in a forest in 1940.
Description: On September 1st, 1939, Nazi Germany invades Poland, unleashing World War II. On September 17th, the Soviet Red Army crosses the border. The Polish army, unable to fight on two fronts, is defeated. Thousands of Polish men, both military and government officials, are captured by the invaders. Their fate will only be known several years later.

Title: Thappad
Hint: A woman files for divorce after her husband slaps her at a party.
Description: A young woman's life is shattered into pieces when her husband slaps her at a party, causing her to question what this relationship stands for.

Title: Two Brothers
Hint: Two tiger cubs separated as babies are reunited years later as enemies.
Description: Two tigers are separated as cubs and taken into captivity, only to be reunited years later as enemies by an explorer (Pearce) who inadvertently forces them to fight each other.

Title: One Week
Hint: Newlyweds build a kit house that falls apart in hilarious ways.
Description: Newlyweds receive a build-it-yourself house as a wedding gift—and the house can, supposedly, be built in "___". A rejected suitor secretly re-numbers packing crates, and the husband struggles to assemble the house according to this new 'arrangement' of its parts.

Title: The Young Offenders
Hint: Two Cork teenagers steal bikes and ride across Ireland to find a bale of cocaine.
Description: Two teenage boys from inner-city Cork steal bicycles and ride off on a 160km quest to find an unrecovered bale of cocaine worth 7,000,000 euros.

Title: The Warlords
Hint: A defeated general forms a blood oath with two bandits in Qing-era China.
Description: The civil war in China has ruined many lives including General Pang's. A wounded General Pang is saved by a beautiful young woman along with two other men. Together they vow to eradicate the rebels.

Title: A Cop
Hint: A Paris police chief unknowingly shares a lover with the bank robber he is chasing.
Description: A Parisian police chief has an affair, but unbeknownst to him, the boyfriend of the woman he’s having an affair with is a bank robber planning a heist.

Title: 3 Godfathers
Hint: Three outlaws on the run find a dying woman and her newborn baby in the desert.
Description: Three outlaws on the run discover a dying woman and her baby. They swear to bring the infant to safety across the desert, even at the risk of their own lives.

Title: Russian Dolls
Hint: Five friends reunite five years after their summer in Barcelona.
Description: Five years after their summer together in Barcelona, Xavier, William, Wendy, Martine and Isabelle reunite.

Title: Ash Is Purest White (Jiang hu er nü)
Hint: A dancer takes the fall for her gangster boyfriend and goes to prison.
Description: Set in China's underworld, this tale of love and betrayal follows a dancer who fired a gun to protect her mobster boyfriend during a fight. On release from prison 5 years later, she sets out to find him.

Title: The Place
Hint: Strangers sitting at a café table agree to do terrible things to get what they want.
Description: The fates of an apparently random group of strangers who each come into contact with a mysterious figure who they believe possesses the power to grant any wish, in return for which they must carry out a task he assigns them.

Title: Dhamaka
Hint: A cynical news anchor gets a call from a bomber on his radio show.
Description: When a cynical ex-TV news anchor gets an alarming call on his radio show, he sees a chance for a career comeback — but it may cost his conscience.

Title: The Lady
Hint: A pro-democracy leader is placed under house arrest in Burma.
Description: The story of Aung San Suu Kyi as she becomes the core of Burma's democracy movement, and her relationship with her husband, writer Michael Aris.

Title: They Call Me Jeeg Robot
Hint: A small-time crook in Rome gains superpowers after exposure to radioactive waste.
Description: Exposed to radioactive waste, small-time crook Enzo gains super-strength. A misanthropic, introverted brute, he uses his powers for personal gain until he meets Alessia, a mentally ill girl who believes Enzo is the hero from her favorite anime, Steel ___.

Title: Winter in Wartime
Hint: A teenage boy in occupied Holland helps a British pilot during the famine of 1944.
Description: During World War II in the freezing ___ of 1944-45 the western Netherlands are in the grip of a famine. Many people move east to provide for their families. Fourteen year old Michiel can't wait to join the Dutch resistance, to the dismay of his father, who, as mayor, works to prevent escalations in the village.

Title: Days of Glory
Hint: North African soldiers fight for France to liberate it in WWII but face discrimination in the ranks.
Description: 1943. They have never stepped foot on French soil but because France was at war, Said, Abdelkader, Messaoud and Yassir enlist in the French Army, along with 130,000 other “indigenous” soldiers, to liberate the “fatherland” from the Nazi enemy. Heroes that history has forgotten…

Title: Project A 2
Hint: A cop fights pirates and corrupt officials in early 20th-century Hong Kong.
Description: Three weeks have gone by since the alien spaceship crash landed on the Graviton City spire, and since then the aliens have been hard at work converting their ship to a pleasure district, hoping to make friends with the humans!… Not.

Title: Arif V 216
Hint: An alien returns to Earth to experience human life in 1960s Turkey.
Description: After 8 years, ___ old friend ___ from planet GORA pays a visit to Earth.Together they go on a quest where they'll be visiting 60's.

Title: Welcome
Hint: Two gangsters try to marry their sister into a respectable family.
Description: Two gangsters meet Rajiv, who belongs to a respectable family, and want to fix their sister's wedding with him. However, when Rajiv's uncle refuses to the match, a series of hilarious situations occur.

Title: Like Someone in Love
Hint: An elderly professor spends a strange day with a young escort in Tokyo.
Description: An old man and a young woman meet in Tokyo. She knows nothing about him, he thinks he knows her. He welcomes her into his home, she offers him her body. But the web that is woven between them in the space of twenty four hours bears no relation to the circumstances of their encounter.

Title: That's What I Am
Hint: A 12-year-old learns about bullying from a beloved teacher in the 1960s.
Description: A coming-of-age story that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol, a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers.

Title: Thirteen Conversations About One Thing
Hint: Interconnected stories in New York explore happiness and luck.
Description: In New York City, the lives of a lawyer, an actuary, a house-cleaner, a professor, and the people around them intersect as they ponder order and happiness in the face of life's cold unpredictability.

Title: Samaritan Girl
Hint: Two teenage girls in Seoul run a prostitution scheme, with tragic results.
Description: Jae-Young is an amateur prostitute who sleeps with men while her best friend Yeo-Jin "manages" her, fixing dates, taking care of the money, and making sure the coast is clear. When Jae-Young falls in love with one of those men, she suppresses her feelings towards him in respect of her friend who's jealous.

Title: Vikrant Rona
Hint: A mysterious inspector investigates strange disappearances in a remote village.
Description: Almost half a century ago, a remote village in the middle of a tropical rain forest starts witnessing a series of unexplainable events which they attribute to the supernatural. ___, An eccentric police officer, is assigned to solve the mystery. A mysterious game unfolds where everyone in the village is a potential victim and everyone is a suspect.

Title: The Closet
Hint: A man pretends to be gay to avoid being fired.
Description: A man spreads the rumor of his fake homosexuality with the aid of his neighbor, to prevent his imminent firing at his work.

Title: The Tiger and the Snow
Hint: An Italian poet travels to wartime Baghdad to save the woman he loves.
Description: Love and injury in time of war. Attilio de Giovanni teaches poetry in Italy. He has a romantic soul, and women love him. But he is in love with Vittoria, and the love is unrequited. Every night he dreams of marrying her, in his boxer shorts and t-shirt, as Tom Waits sings. Vittoria travels to Iraq with her friend, Fuad, a poet; they are there with the second Gulf War breaks out. Vittoria is injured.

Title: Rustom
Hint: A naval officer kills his wife's lover and stands trial.
Description: A naval officer is devastated to learn about his wife's extramarital affair with a rich businessman while he was away. He pays him a visit and shoots him to death, following which he surrenders himself but claims to be "not guilty" in the court, much to the surprise of the businessman's sister and the officers dealing with his case.

Title: The Legend Is Born: Ip Man
Hint: The early life of a legendary wing chun master in Foshan, from training to love.
Description: The remarkable true story of the early life of ___, the formidable kung fu genius who would become Bruce Lee's mentor; beginning at the start of his journey from his initial training through to the ultimate battle to become supreme master of the art of Wing Chun.

Title: Drug War
Hint: A meth kingpin is coerced into betraying his accomplices in a police sting.
Description: A drug cartel boss is arrested in a raid and coerced into betraying his former accomplices as part of an undercover operation.

Title: Eyyvah Eyvah
Hint: A young clarinetist from a Turkish village goes to Istanbul to find his father.
Description: Hüseyin is a young man who lives with his grandfather and grandmother in a village in Thracian Turkey. The two great loves of his life are his clarinet and Müjgan, a nurse. Description: Alone on a tiny deserted island, Hank has given up all hope of ever making it home again. But one day everything changes when a dead body washes ashore, and he soon realizes it may be his last opportunity to escape certain death. Armed with his new “friend” and an unusual bag of tricks, the duo go on an epic adventure to bring Hank back to the woman of his dreams.

Title: What Dreams May Come
Hint: A man travels through a painted heaven and hell to rescue his wife.
Description: Chris Nielsen dies to find himself in a heaven more amazing than he could have ever dreamed of. There is one thing missing: his wife. After he died, his wife Annie killed herself and went to hell. Chris decides to risk eternity in Hades for the small chance that he will be able to bring her back to heaven.

Title: Grandma's Boy
Hint: A 35-year-old video game tester moves in with his grandmother and her roommates.
Description: Even though he's 35, Alex acts more like he's 13, spending his days as the world's oldest video game tester and his evenings developing the next big Xbox game. But when he gets kicked out of his apartment, he's forced to move in with his grandmother.

Title: Adventures in Babysitting
Hint: A babysitter takes three kids on a wild night through downtown Chicago.
Description: When plans with her boyfriend fall through, high school senior Chris Parker ends up ___ the Anderson kids, Brad and Sara. What should be a quiet night in, however, turns into a series of ridiculous exploits, starting when they leave the house to pick up Chris' friend Brenda. Soon, Brad's buddy Daryl is involved, and the group must contend with car thieves, blues musicians and much more.

Title: Safety Not Guaranteed
Hint: Magazine journalists investigate a classified ad seeking a time-travel partner.
Description: Three magazine employees head out on an assignment to interview a guy who placed a classified ad seeking a companion for time travel.

Title: Sorry to Bother You
Hint: A telemarketer discovers a magical way to succeed and a sinister corporate plot.
Description: In an alternate present-day version of Oakland, black telemarketer Cassius Green discovers a magical key to professional success – which propels him into a macabre universe.

Title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
Hint: Two airheaded teens travel through time to pass their history report.
Description: ___ are high school buddies starting a band. They are also about to fail their history class—which means ___ would be sent to military school—but receive help from Rufus, a traveller from a future where their band is the foundation for a perfect society.

Title: Outlaw King
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Scottish nobleman crowned monarch leads a guerrilla rebellion against the English.
Description: Forced into exile by the English after being crowned King of Scotland, legendary warrior Robert the Bruce fights to reclaim the throne.

Title: Flamin' Hot
Hint: A janitor invents a spicy snack that becomes a sensation.
Description: The inspiring true story of Richard Montañez, the Frito Lay janitor who channeled his Mexican American heritage and upbringing to turn the iconic ___ Cheetos into a snack that disrupted the food industry and became a global pop culture phenomenon.

Title: Non-Stop
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An air marshal receives texts promising someone will die every 20 minutes.
Description: Bill Marks is a Federal Air Marshall for whom every day is the same until this one. On this plane ride, he starts receiving text messages from someone claiming to be on the flight and threatening to kill passengers. In a race against the clock, he must identify and stop the killer to save everyone on board.

Title: Paul
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two British nerds on a road trip pick up an alien.
Description: For the past 60 years, a space-traveling smart-ass named ___ has been locked up in a top-secret military base, advising world leaders about his kind. But when he worries he’s outlived his usefulness and the dissection table is drawing uncomfortably close, ___ escapes on the first RV that passes by his compound in Area 51.

Title: Black Snake Moan
Hint: A God-fearing bluesman chains a troubled young woman to his radiator to cure her.
Description: A God-fearing bluesman takes to a wild young woman who, as a victim of childhood sexual abuse, is looking everywhere for love, but never quite finding it.

Title: Fukrey
Hint: Four dream-chasing Delhi college friends cross paths with a dangerous female don.
Description: The paths of four dream-chasing college friends cross with an array of colourful characters, from a tough-talking Punjabi female don to a Jugaad Baaz college watchman. Mayhem ensues.

Title: Real Genius
Hint: Teenage geniuses at a college discover their laser is being used as a weapon.
Description: When teenage geniuses Mitch Taylor and Chris Knight, working on an advanced laser project, learn that the military wants to use it as a weapon, they decide to thwart the plan.

Title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
Hint: An inventor creates a machine that makes food fall from the sky.
Description: Inventor Flint Lockwood creates a machine that makes clouds rain food, enabling the down-and-out citizens of Chewandswallow to feed themselves. But when the falling food reaches gargantuan proportions, Flint must scramble to avert disaster. Can he regain control of the machine and put an end to the wild weather before the town is destroyed?

Title: Clash of the Titans
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A demigod must slay monsters to save a princess and defy the gods.
Description: To win the right to marry his love, the beautiful princess Andromeda, and fulfil his destiny, half-God-half-mortal Perseus must complete various tasks including taming Pegasus, capturing Medusa's head and battling the feared Kraken.

Title: In the Heart of the Sea
Country: Spain, United States of America, Australia
Hint: A whaling ship is sunk by a giant whale, inspiring a classic novel.
Description: In the winter of 1820, the New England whaling ship Essex is assaulted by something no one could believe—a whale of mammoth size and will, and an almost human sense of vengeance.

Title: Everybody Wants Some!!
Hint: A college freshman spends the weekend with his baseball teammates in 1980.
Description: A comedy that follows a group of friends as they navigate their way through the freedoms and responsibilities of unsupervised adulthood.

Title: Alpha Dog
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Teens kidnap the younger brother of a man who owes them money.
Description: Johnny Truelove likes to see himself as tough. He's the son of an underworld figure and a drug dealer. Johnny also likes to get tough when things don't go his way. When Jake Mazursky fails to pay up for Johnny, things get worse for the Mazursky family, as Johnny and his 'gang' kidnap Jake's 15 year old brother and hold him hostage.

Title: Overboard
Hint: A spoiled heiress with amnesia is convinced she is a carpenter's wife.
Description: Heiress Joanna Stayton hires carpenter Dean Proffitt to build a closet on her yacht—and refuses to pay him for the project when it's done. But after Joanna accidentally falls ___ and loses her memory, Dean sees an opportunity to get even.

Title: Love Story
Hint: A rich Harvard law student falls for a working-class music student.
Description: Harvard Law student Oliver Barrett IV and music student Jennifer Cavilleri share a chemistry they cannot deny - and a love they cannot ignore. Despite their opposite backgrounds, the young couple put their hearts on the line for each other. When they marry, Oliver's wealthy father threatens to disown him. Jenny tries to reconcile the Barrett men, but to no avail.

Title: Frankenweenie
Hint: A boy brings his beloved dog back to life with electricity.
Description: When a car hits young Victor's pet dog Sparky, Victor decides to bring him back to life the only way he knows how. But when the bolt-necked "monster" wreaks havoc and terror in the hearts of Victor's neighbors, he has to convince them that Sparky's still the good, loyal friend he was.

Title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
Country: Bulgaria, Canada, France, Hong Kong, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: The world's top protection agent must keep his enemy, a notorious assassin, alive to testify at The Hague.
Description: The world’s top ___ gets a new client, a ___ who must testify at the International Court of Justice. They must put their differences aside and work together to make it to the trial on time.

Title: King of New York
Hint: A drug lord returns from prison to distribute profits to the poor.
Description: A former drug lord returns from prison determined to wipe out all his competition and distribute the profits of his operations to New York's poor and lower classes in this stylish and ultra violent modern twist on Robin Hood.

Title: 48 Hrs.
Hint: A cop and a convict team up to catch two killers in 48 hours.
Description: A hard-nosed cop reluctantly teams up with a wise-cracking criminal temporarily paroled to him, in order to track down a killer.

Title: A Goofy Movie
Country: Australia, Canada, France, United States of America
Hint: A dad takes his teenage son on a road trip to reconnect.
Description: ___ teenage son Max is desperate to impress his crush and fit in at school. After well-meaning but ignorant ___ suddenly whisks him away on a cross-country road trip—messing up Max’s first date plans in the process—___ old-school parenting and Max’s desire for independence lead to a vacation of hilarious mishaps, as they both learn to see eye to eye and listen to each other.

Title: School Ties
Hint: A Jewish scholarship student hides his religion at an elite 1950s prep academy.
Description: When David Greene receives a football scholarship to a prestigious prep school in the 1950s, he feels pressure to hide the fact that he is Jewish from his classmates and teachers, fearing that they may be anti-Semitic.

Title: Dragged Across Concrete
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two suspended cops looking for quick money get involved in a robbery and a deadly confrontation.
Description: Two policemen, one an old-timer, the other his volatile younger partner, find themselves suspended when a video of their strong-arm tactics becomes the media's cause du jour. Low on cash and with no other options, these two embittered soldiers descend into the criminal underworld to gain their just due, but instead find far more than they wanted awaiting them in the shadows.

Title: Homeward Bound: The Incredible Journey
Hint: Two dogs and a cat travel across the wilderness to find their owners.
Description: Before the Seavers leave for a family vacation to San Francisco, they drop off their pets -- Chance, an adventurous American bulldog; Shadow, a wise golden retriever; and Sassy, a cautious cat -- at a friend's ranch.
