But when the animals start to worry that they've been left for good, the three embark together on a treacherous and thrilling journey to find their way back home through the California wilderness.

Title: Near Dark
Hint: A farm boy falls in with a gang of nomadic vampires.
Description: A farm boy reluctantly becomes a member of the undead when a girl he meets turns out to be part of a band of vampires who roam the highways in stolen cars.

Title: Any Given Sunday
Hint: A football coach struggles to hold his team together.
Description: A star quarterback gets knocked out of the game and an unknown third stringer is called in to replace him. The unknown gives a stunning performance and forces the aging coach to reevaluate his game plans and life. A new co-owner/president adds to the pressure of winning. The new owner must prove herself in a male dominated world.

Title: Arthur
Hint: A drunken millionaire must marry an heiress to inherit his fortune.
Description: ___ is a 30-year-old child who will inherit $750 million if he complies with his family's demands and marries the woman of their choosing.

Title: Radio
Hint: A football coach befriends a mentally disabled young man.
Description: In the racially divided town of Anderson, South Carolina in 1976, football coach Harold Jones spots a mentally disabled African-American young man nicknamed ___ near his practice field and is inspired to befriend him. Soon, ___ is Jones' loyal assistant, and he becomes a student at T.L. Hanna High School.

Title: The Croods: A New Age
Hint: A prehistoric family searches for a safer habitat and meets a more advanced family.
Description: Searching for a safer habitat, the prehistoric Crood family discovers an idyllic, walled-in paradise that meets all of its needs. Unfortunately, they must also learn to live with the Bettermans -- a family that's a couple of steps above the ___ on the evolutionary ladder.

Title: Time Bandits
Genres: Family, Fantasy, Science Fiction, Adventure, Comedy
Hint: A boy joins a group of dwarves who travel through time stealing treasure.
Description: Young history buff Kevin can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being, they've purloined a map charting all of the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon, Robin Hood and King Agamemnon before the Supreme Being catches up with them.

Title: Babe
Hint: A pig raised by sheepdogs learns to herd sheep.
Description: ___ is a little pig who doesn't quite know his place in the world. With a bunch of odd friends, like Ferdinand the duck who thinks he is a rooster and Fly the dog he calls mum, ___ realises that he has the makings to become the greatest sheep pig of all time, and Farmer Hoggett knows it. With the help of the sheep dogs, ___ learns that a pig can be anything that he wants to be.

Title: The Highwaymen
Hint: Two former Texas Rangers hunt down Bonnie and Clyde.
Description: In 1934, Frank Hamer and Manny Gault, two former Texas Rangers, are commissioned to put an end to the wave of vicious crimes perpetrated by Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow, a notorious duo of infamous robbers and cold-blooded killers who nevertheless are worshiped by the public.

Title: A Good Year
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A ruthless London banker inherits his uncle's vineyard in Provence and rediscovers his childhood.
Description: Failed London banker Max Skinner inherits his uncle's vineyard in Provence, where he spent many childhood holidays. Upon his arrival, he meets a woman from California who tells Max she is his long-lost cousin and that the property is hers.

Title: The Guardian
Hint: A high school swim champion enrols in Coast Guard rescue swimmer school.
Description: A high school swim champion with a troubled past enrolls in the U.S. Coast Guard's 'A' School, where legendary rescue swimmer Ben Randall teaches him some hard lessons about loss, love, and self-sacrifice.

Title: The Edge
Hint: A billionaire and a photographer are stranded in Alaska and hunted by a bear.
Description: The plane carrying wealthy Charles Morse crashes down in the Alaskan wilderness. Together with the two other passengers, photographer Robert and assistant Stephen, Charles devises a plan to help them reach civilization.

Title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
Hint: A crime boss teams up with a detective to catch a serial killer who attacked him.
Description: After barely surviving a brutal attack by a sadistic serial killer, crime boss Jang Dong-su is left humiliated. Determined to catch the killer known as K, he forms an uneasy alliance with Jung Tae-seok, a relentless and incorruptible detective who often disrupts his illegal business. However, while Jang Dong-su wants K dead, Jung Tae-suk is determined to bring him to justice.

Title: Play Misty for Me
Hint: A late-night DJ's fling with a fan turns into a deadly obsession.
Description: A brief fling between a late-night radio disc jockey and an obsessed female fan takes a frightening turn when another woman enters the picture.

Title: Nine to Five
Hint: Three female office workers kidnap and take revenge on their sexist, egotistical, hypocritical boss.
Description: Three female employees of a sexist, egotistical, lying, hypocritical bigot find a way to turn the tables on him.

Title: Stir of Echoes
Hint: A man sees visions of a ghost after being hypnotized.
Description: After being hypnotized by his sister-in-law, Tom Witzky begins seeing haunting visions of a girl's ghost and a mystery begins to unfold around her.

Title: The Cutting Edge
Hint: An Olympic figure skater and a hockey player become pairs partners.
Description: Two former Olympians, one a figure skater and the other a hockey player, pin their hopes of one last shot at Olympic glory on one another. That is, of course, if they can keep from killing each other in the process...

Title: Newsies
Hint: Newspaper boys go on strike against a publishing tycoon in 1899.
Description: A week in the life of the exploited, child newspaper sellers in turn-of-the-century New York. When their publisher, Joseph Pulitzer, tries to squeeze a little more profit out of their labours, they organize a strike, only to be confronted with the Pulitzer's hard-ball tactics.

Title: Thunderball
Hint: A criminal organisation steals two nuclear bombs and holds the world to ransom.
Description: A criminal organization has obtained two nuclear bombs and are asking for a 100 million pound ransom in the form of diamonds in seven days or they will use the weapons. The secret service sends James Bond to the Bahamas to once again save the world.

Title: The Half of It
Hint: A shy girl helps a jock write love letters to the girl she secretly likes.
Description: Shy, straight-A student Ellie is hired by sweet but inarticulate jock Paul, who needs help wooing the most popular girl in school. But their new and unlikely friendship gets tricky when Ellie discovers she has feelings for the same girl.

Title: The Naked Gun 2½: The Smell of Fear
Hint: A bumbling cop investigates a plot to sabotage an energy expert.
Description: Bumbling lieutenant Frank Drebin is out to foil the big boys in the energy industry, who intend to suppress technology that will put them out of business.

Title: I Don't Feel at Home in This World Anymore
Hint: A depressed woman tracks down the thieves who robbed her house.
Description: When a depressed woman is burglarized, she finds a new sense of purpose by tracking down the thieves alongside her obnoxious neighbor. But they soon find themselves dangerously out of their depth against a pack of degenerate criminals.

Title: Bottle Rocket
Hint: Three friends plan a heist and get caught up in petty crime.
Description: Upon his release from a mental hospital following a nervous breakdown, the directionless Anthony joins his friend Dignan, who seems far less sane than the former. Dignan has hatched a harebrained scheme for an as-yet-unspecified crime spree that somehow involves his former boss, the (supposedly) legendary Mr. Henry.

Title: Flight of the Navigator
Hint: A boy is abducted by a spaceship and returns eight years later without aging.
Description: 12-year-old David is accidentally knocked out in the forest near his home, but when he awakens eight years have passed. His family is overjoyed to have him back, but is just as perplexed as he is that he hasn't aged. When a NASA scientist discovers a UFO nearby, David gets the chance to unravel the mystery and recover the life he lost.

Title: River's Edge
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A teenager kills his girlfriend and shows the body to his friends.
Description: A group of high-school friends must come to terms with the fact that one of them, Samson, killed another, Jamie. Faced with the brutality of death, each must decide whether to turn their friend in to the police, or to help him escape the consequences of his dreadful deed.

Title: Naked Lunch
Hint: A bug exterminator kills his wife and enters a hallucinatory world.
Description: Blank-faced bug killer Bill Lee and his dead-eyed wife, Joan, like to get high on Bill's pest poisons while lounging with Beat poet pals. After meeting the devilish Dr. Benway, Bill gets a drug made from a centipede.

Title: Velvet Goldmine
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A journalist investigates the disappearance of a glam rock star who faked his death on stage.
Description: Almost a decade since larger-than-life glam-rock enigma Brian Slade disappeared from public eye, an investigative journalist is on assignment to uncover the truth behind his former idol.

Title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
Hint: A young maid becomes the model for a Dutch painter's masterpiece.
Description: This film, adapted from a work of fiction by author Tracy Chevalier, tells a story about the events surrounding the creation of the painting "___" by 17th century Dutch master Johannes Vermeer. A young peasant maid working in the house of painter Johannes Vermeer becomes his talented assistant and the model for one of his most famous works.

Title: Life Itself
Hint: A love story spanning decades and continents, from New York to Spain.
Description: As a young New York couple goes from college romance to marriage and the birth of their first child, the unexpected twists of their journey create reverberations that echo over continents and through lifetimes.

Title: Lucas
Hint: A brilliant but socially awkward teen falls for a new girl.
Description: A brilliant but socially inept 14-year-old experiences heartbreak for the first time when his two best friends – Cappie, an older-brother figure, and Maggie, the new girl with whom he is in love – fall for each other.

Title: Boy Erased
Country: Australia, China, United States of America
Hint: The son of a Baptist pastor is sent to a gay conversion therapy program.
Description: Jared, the son of a Baptist pastor in a small American town, is outed to his parents at age 19. Jared is faced with an ultimatum: attend a gay conversion therapy program – or be permanently exiled and shunned by his family, friends, and faith.

Title: Bicentennial Man
Hint: A robot servant spends two centuries trying to become human.
Description: Richard Martin buys a gift, a new NDR-114 robot. The product is named Andrew by the youngest of the family's children. "___" follows the life and times of Andrew, a robot purchased as a household appliance programmed to perform menial tasks. As Andrew begins to experience emotions and creative thought, the Martin family soon discovers they don't have an ordinary robot.

Title: The Rescuers
Hint: Two mice rescue a girl kidnapped by a treasure-hunting woman.
Description: Two agents of the mouse-run International Rescue Aid Society search for a little orphan girl kidnapped by sinister treasure hunters.

Title: Ladyhawke
Hint: A thief helps a knight and his love who are cursed to never be human at the same time.
Description: Captain Etienne Navarre is a man on whose shoulders lies a cruel curse. Punished for loving each other, Navarre must become a wolf by night whilst his lover, Lady Isabeau, takes the form of a hawk by day. Together, with the thief Philippe Gaston, they must try to overthrow the corrupt Bishop and in doing so break the spell.

Title: Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs
Hint: A herd of prehistoric animals discover a hidden underground world of giant reptiles.
Description: Times are changing for Manny the moody mammoth, Sid the motor mouthed sloth and Diego the crafty saber-toothed tiger. Life heats up for our heroes when they meet some new and none-too-friendly neighbors – the mighty ___.

Title: Get Shorty
Hint: A Miami mobster gets involved in the Hollywood movie business.
Description: Chili Palmer is a Miami mobster who gets sent to L.A. to collect a bad debt from Harry Zimm, a Hollywood producer who specializes in cheesy horror films. When Chili meets Harry's leading lady, the romantic sparks fly. After pitching his own life story as a movie idea, Chili learns that being a mobster and being a Hollywood producer really aren't all that different.

Title: Creature from the Black Lagoon
Hint: Scientists exploring the Amazon encounter a fearsome gill-man who becomes obsessed with a woman.
Description: When scientists exploring the Amazon River stumble on a “missing link” connecting humans and fish, they plan to capture it for later study. But the ___ has plans of his own, and has set his sights on the lead scientist's beautiful fiancée, Kay.

Title: Troop Zero
Hint: A misfit girl in 1977 Georgia forms a ragtag scout group to win a talent show and get on NASA's Golden Record.
Description: In rural 1977 Georgia, a misfit girl dreams of life in outer space. When a national competition offers her a chance at her dream, to be recorded on NASA’s Golden Record, she recruits a makeshift troupe of Birdie Scouts, forging friendships that last a lifetime and beyond.

Title: Everybody Knows
Country: Spain, France, Italy, Argentina, Germany, Denmark
Hint: A woman returns to her Spanish hometown for a wedding, and her daughter is kidnapped.
Description: Laura, a Spanish woman living in Buenos Aires, returns to her hometown outside Madrid with her Argentinian husband and children. However, the trip is upset by unexpected events that bring secrets into the open.

Title: Carnal Knowledge
Hint: Two friends navigate sex and relationships from college to middle age.
Description: Two lifelong friends navigate complex sexual encounters and emotional entanglements, wrestling with societal norms and personal desires.

Title: Repo Man
Hint: A young punk starts repossessing cars and hunts a Chevy with something deadly in its trunk.
Description: A down and out young punk gets a job working with a seasoned ___, but what awaits him in his new career is a series of outlandish adventures revolving around aliens, the CIA, and a most wanted '64 Chevy.

Title: Labor Day
Hint: A depressed mother and her son give shelter to an escaped convict over a holiday weekend.
Description: Two strangers are drawn together under incredible circumstances. What starts as an unforeseen encounter over a long holiday weekend soon becomes a second chance love story.

Title: Return to Me
Hint: A widower falls for a woman who received his late wife's heart.
Description: It took a lot of cajoling to get Bob, a recently widowed architect, to go on a blind date at a quirky Irish-Italian eatery. Once there, he's smitten instantly not with his date but with the sharp-witted waitress. Everything seems to be going great until an unbelievable truth is revealed, one that could easily break both of their hearts for good.

Title: The Night Comes for Us
Hint: A Triad enforcer spares a girl and becomes a target.
Description: After sparing a girl's life during a massacre, an elite Triad assassin is targeted by an onslaught of murderous gangsters.

Title: Stranger by the Lake
Hint: A man frequents a gay cruising beach and falls for a handsome swimmer he saw commit murder.
Description: Franck spends his summer days hopelessly searching for companionship at a popular cruising spot on the shores of a ___ in rural France. One day, he meets Michel, an attractive yet darkly mysterious man and falls blindly in love.

Title: The Duchess
Hint: An 18th-century aristocrat struggles in a loveless marriage while becoming a fashion icon.
Description: A chronicle of the life of 18th century aristocrat Georgiana, ___ of Devonshire, who was reviled for her extravagant political and personal life.

Title: Westworld
Hint: A futuristic adult amusement park's robots, including a gunslinger, begin to malfunction and kill guests.
Description: Delos is a futuristic amusement park that features themed worlds populated by human-like androids. After two patrons have a run-in with a menacing gunslinger in West World, the androids at Delos all begin to malfunction, causing havoc throughout the park.

Title: Altered States
Hint: A scientist experiments with sensory deprivation and regresses physically.
Description: A research scientist explores the boundaries and frontiers of human consciousness. Using sensory deprivation and hallucinogenic mixtures from Native American shamans, he explores these ___ of cognizance and finds that memory, time, and reality itself are states of mind.

Title: A Girl Walks Home Alone at Night
Hint: A lonely vampire stalks the streets of an Iranian ghost town.
Description: In the Iranian ghost-town Bad City, a place that reeks of death and loneliness, the townspeople are unaware they are being stalked by a lonesome vampire.

Title: Rob Roy
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Scottish highlander fights an evil English nobleman after he is cheated out of his money.
Description: In the highlands of Scotland in the 1700s, ___ tries to lead his small town to a better future, by borrowing money from the local nobility to buy cattle to herd to market. When the money is stolen, ___ is forced into a Robin Hood lifestyle to defend his family and honour.

Title: The Magic of Belle Isle
Hint: A washed-up, wheelchair-bound novelist finds inspiration in a summer lake town and the family next door.
Description: In an effort to tap into his original talent, a wheelchair-bound author moves to a rural town, where he befriends a single mother and her three kids, who help reignite his passion for writing.

Title: Private Parts
Hint: The life of a controversial radio shock jock, from his early days to fame.
Description: The life and career of shock-jock superstar Howard Stern is recounted from his humble beginnings to his view from the top. Possessing a desire to be an on-air personality since childhood, Stern meanders through the radio world, always with his supportive wife, Alison, by his side. Landing a gig in Washington, D.C., Stern meets Robin Quivers, who will become his long-time partner in crime.

Title: The Stepford Wives
Hint: A woman moves to a Connecticut town where the housewives are suspiciously perfect.
Description: Joanna Eberhart comes to the town of ___, Connecticut with her family, but soon discovers there lies a sinister truth in the all too perfect behavior of the female residents.

Title: Mr. Jones
Hint: A Welsh journalist exposes the Soviet famine in Ukraine.
Description: In 1933, Welsh journalist Gareth ___ travels to Ukraine, where he experiences the horrors of a famine. Everywhere he goes he meets henchmen of the Soviet secret service who are determined to prevent news about the catastrophe from getting out. Stalin’s forced collectivisation of agriculture has resulted in misery and ruin—the policy is tantamount to mass murder.

Title: The Sisters Brothers
Country: France, Spain, Belgium, Romania, United States of America
Hint: Two hitman siblings pursue a chemist with a gold-finding formula across the Oregon frontier.
Description: Oregon, 1851. Hermann Kermit Warm, a chemist and aspiring gold prospector, keeps a profitable secret that the Commodore wants to know, so he sends the ___, two notorious assassins, to capture him on his way to California.

Title: UHF
Hint: An eccentric daydreamer takes over a struggling low-budget TV station and makes it a hit with bizarre shows.
Description: The eccentric new manager of a ___ television channel tries to save the station from financial ruin with an odd array of programming.

Title: Up in Smoke
Hint: Two potheads in Los Angeles search for marijuana and end up in Mexico.
Description: An unemployed pot-smoking slacker and amateur drummer, Anthony Stoner ditches his strict parents and hits the road, eventually meeting kindred spirit Pedro de Pacas.

Title: The Rookie
Hint: A high school teacher becomes a major league pitcher in his thirties.
Description: Jim Morris never made it out of the minor leagues before a shoulder injury ended his pitching career twelve years ago. Now a married-with-children high-school chemistry teacher and baseball coach in Texas, Jim's team makes a deal with him: if they win the district championship, Jim will try out with a major-league organization.

Title: The Battle of Britain
Hint: The Royal Air Force fights a desperate air campaign against the Luftwaffe in the summer of 1940.
Description: In 1940, the Royal Air Force fights a desperate battle against the might of the Luftwaffe for control of the skies over ___, thus preventing an attempted Nazi invasion.

Title: At Eternity's Gate
Country: France, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States of America, Ireland
Hint: A Dutch post-impressionist painter's final years in the south of France.
Description: Famed but tormented artist Vincent van Gogh spends his final years in Arles, France, painting masterworks of the natural world that surrounds him.

Title: The Last Castle
Hint: A court-martialled general leads a prison revolt against a corrupt warden.
Description: A court-martialed general rallies together 1200 inmates to rise against the system that put him away.

Title: Scrooged
Hint: A cynical TV executive is visited by three ghosts.
Description: Frank Cross is a wildly successful television executive whose cold ambition and curmudgeonly nature has driven away the love of his life. But after firing a staff member on Christmas Eve, Frank is visited by a series of ghosts who give him a chance to re-evaluate his actions and right the wrongs of his past.

Title: The Majestic
Hint: A blacklisted writer with amnesia is mistaken for a war hero.
Description: Set in 1951, a blacklisted Hollywood writer gets into a car accident, loses his memory and settles down in a small town where he is mistaken for a long-lost son.

Title: East Is East
Hint: A strict Pakistani father struggles with his British-raised children.
Description: In 1971 Salford fish-and-chip shop owner George Khan expects his family to follow his strict Pakistani Muslim ways. But his children, with an English mother and having been born and brought up in Britain, increasingly see themselves as British and start to reject their father's rules on dress, food, religion, and living in general.

Title: Stronger
Country: Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: A man who lost his legs in the Boston Marathon bombing.
Description: A victim of the Boston Marathon bombing in 2013 helps the police track down the killers while struggling to recover from devastating trauma.

Title: Quigley Down Under
Hint: An American sharpshooter in Australia refuses to kill Aboriginal people.
Description: American Matt ___ answers Australian land baron Elliott Marston's ad for a sharpshooter to kill the dingoes on his property. But when ___ finds out that Marston's real target is the aborigines, ___ hits the road. Now, even American expatriate Crazy Cora can't keep ___ safe in his cat-and-mouse game with the homicidal Marston.

Title: Trance
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An art auctioneer with amnesia works with a hypnotherapist to find a stolen painting.
Description: A violent gang enlists the help of a hypnotherapist in an attempt to locate a painting which somehow vanished in the middle of a heist.

Title: Ravenous
Country: Czech Republic, Mexico, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An army captain at a remote 1840s outpost faces a cannibal who gains strength from eating human flesh.
Description: After arriving at his new, remote Army outpost, Capt. John Boyd and his regiment aid a wounded frontiersman who recounts a horrifying tale of a wagon train murdered by its supposed guide – a vicious U.S. Army colonel gone rogue. Fearing the worst, the regiment heads out into the wilderness to verify the gruesome claims.

Title: Bubba Ho-Tep
Hint: An elderly man who claims to be the King of Rock and Roll and a Black man who says he's a former president fight a mummy in a nursing home.
Description: The "true" story of what really became of Elvis Presley. We find Elvis as an elderly resident in an East Texas rest home, who switched identities with an Elvis impersonator years before his "death," then missed his chance to switch back. He must team up with JFK and fight an ancient Egyptian mummy for the souls of their fellow residents.

Title: Dave
Hint: A kind-hearted temp agency owner who looks like the US president is hired to impersonate him.
Description: A sweet-natured Temp Agency operator and amateur Presidential look-alike is recruited by the Secret Service to become a temporary stand-in for the President of the United States.

Title: Another Earth
Hint: A young woman's life changes when a duplicate planet appears in the sky.
Description: On the night a duplicate Earth is discovered in the solar system, the lives of a young woman and an accomplished composer become tragically connected after a fatal accident.

Title: Fletch
Hint: An investigative reporter goes undercover and uncovers a murder plot with a dying millionaire.
Description: When investigative reporter Irwin "___" Fletcher goes undercover to write a piece on the drug trade at a local beach, he's approached by wealthy businessman Alan Stanwyk, who offers him $50,000 to murder him. With sarcastic wit and a knack for disguises, ___ sets out to uncover Stanwyk's story.

Title: What We Did on Our Holiday
Hint: Three children take their dying grandfather's wishes into their own hands.
Description: Doug and Abi and their three children travel to the Scottish Highlands for Doug's father Gordie's birthday party. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability...

Title: The Thomas Crown Affair
Hint: A bored millionaire masterminds a bank robbery and falls for the insurance investigator.
Description: A debonair, adventuresome bank executive believes that he has pulled off the perfect multi-million dollar heist--until he must match wits with an insurance investigator who will do anything to get her man.

Title: Christine
Hint: A nerdy teen buys a possessed 1958 Plymouth Fury that kills his enemies.
Description: Nerdy high schooler Arnie Cunningham falls for ___, a rusty 1958 Plymouth Fury, and becomes obsessed with restoring the classic automobile to her former glory. As the car changes, so does Arnie, whose newfound confidence turns to arrogance behind the wheel of his exotic beauty. Arnie's girlfriend Leigh and best friend Dennis reach out to him, only to be met by a Fury like no other.

Title: The Meyerowitz Stories (New and Selected)
Hint: Estranged siblings gather in New York to celebrate their aging artist father.
Description: An estranged family gathers together in New York for an event celebrating the artistic work of their father.

Title: Tully
Hint: A mother of three is gifted a night nanny.
Description: Marlo, a mother of three, including a newborn, is gifted a night nanny by her brother. Hesitant at first, she quickly forms a bond with the thoughtful, surprising, and sometimes challenging nanny named ___.

Title: An American Tail
Hint: A young mouse is separated from his family on the way to America.
Description: A young mouse named Fievel and his family decide to migrate to America, a "land without cats," at the turn of the 20th century. But somehow, Fievel ends up in the New World alone and must fend off not only the felines he never thought he'd have to deal with again but also the loneliness of being away from home.

Title: Extremely Loud & Incredibly Close
Hint: A boy searches New York for the lock that fits a key left by his father.
Description: A year after his father's death, Oskar, a troubled young boy, discovers a mysterious key he believes was left for him by his father and embarks on a scavenger hunt to find the matching lock.

Title: Troll Hunter
Hint: A group of students follow a mysterious man they believe is a bear poacher and discover he hunts giant creatures.
Description: A group of students investigates a series of mysterious bear killings, but learns that there are much more dangerous things going on. They start to follow a mysterious hunter, learning that he is actually a ___.

Title: Wicker Park
Hint: A man becomes obsessed with a woman he believes left him.
Description: Matthew, a young advertising executive in Chicago, puts his life and a business trip to China on hold when he thinks he sees Lisa, the love of his life who left him without a word two years earlier, walking out of a restaurant one day.

Title: A United Kingdom
Country: Czech Republic, France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An African king marries a white Englishwoman, causing an international scandal.
Description: The inspiring true story of Seretse Khama, the King of Bechuanaland (modern Botswana), and Ruth Williams, the London office worker he married in 1948 in the face of fierce opposition from their families and the British and South African governments.

Title: Water for Elephants
Hint: A veterinary student joins a Depression-era circus and falls for the ringmaster's wife.
Description: In this captivating Depression-era melodrama, impetuous veterinary student Jacob Jankowski joins a celebrated circus as an animal caretaker but faces a wrenching dilemma when he's transfixed by angelic married performer Marlena.

Title: The Masque of the Red Death
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A European prince terrorises peasants while hosting a ball during a plague.
Description: A European prince terrorizes the local peasantry while using his castle as a refuge against the "Red Death" plague that stalks the land.

Title: The House of the Spirits
Hint: A family's fortunes rise and fall in South America.
Description: A rancher, his clairvoyant wife and their family face turbulent years in South America.

Title: He Got Game
Hint: A father in prison must convince his son to play basketball for the governor's college.
Description: A basketball player's father must try to convince him to go to a college so he can get a shorter prison sentence.

Title: Presumed Innocent
Hint: A prosecutor is accused of killing his mistress, a colleague.
Description: Rusty Sabich is a deputy prosecutor engaged in an obsessive affair with a coworker who is murdered. Soon after, he's accused of the crime. And his fight to clear his name becomes a whirlpool of lies and hidden passions.

Title: House of Usher
Hint: A man is convinced his family is cursed and plans to destroy his sister.
Description: Convinced that his family is tainted by generations of evil, Roderick ___ is hellbent on stopping his sister Madeline’s wedding to prevent the cursed ___ bloodline from expanding. When her fiancé Philip Winthrop arrives at the crumbling estate to claim his bride, Roderick goes to ruthless—even deadly—lengths to keep them apart.

Title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
Hint: An engineer designs a revolutionary car and battles Detroit.
Description: Ypsilanti, Michigan, 1945. Engineer Preston ___ dreams of designing the car of future, but his innovative envision will be repeatedly sabotaged by his own unrealistic expectations and the Detroit automobile industry tycoons.

Title: Fly Away Home
Hint: A girl and her father teach geese to migrate.
Description: Amy is only 13 years old when her mother is killed. She goes to Canada to live with her father, an eccentric inventor whom she barely knows. Amy is miserable in her new life... until she discovers a nest of goose eggs that were abandoned when a local forest was torn down. The eggs hatch and Amy becomes "Mama Goose". When winter comes, Amy and her dad must find a way to lead the birds South.

Title: Syriana
Hint: Stories of the Middle Eastern oil industry intertwine, from CIA agents to an emir.
Description: The Middle Eastern oil industry is the backdrop of this tense drama, which weaves together numerous story lines. Bennett Holiday is an American lawyer in charge of facilitating a dubious merger of oil companies, while Bryan Woodman, a Switzerland-based energy analyst, experiences both personal tragedy and opportunity during a visit with Arabian royalty.

Title: All Is Lost
Hint: An aging sailor is alone in the Indian Ocean as his yacht slowly sinks.
Description: During a solo voyage in the Indian Ocean, a veteran mariner awakes to find his vessel taking on water after a collision with a stray shipping container. With his radio and navigation equipment disabled, he sails unknowingly into a violent storm and barely escapes with his life.

Title: Charlotte's Web
Hint: An arachnid saves a pig from slaughter by spinning words into her silk.
Description: Wilbur the pig is scared of the end of the season, because he knows that come that time, he will end up on the dinner table. He hatches a plan with ___, a spider that lives in his pen, to ensure that this will never happen.

Title: Frantic
Hint: An American doctor searches Paris for his kidnapped wife.
Description: The wife of an American doctor suddenly vanishes in Paris. To find her, he navigates a puzzling web of language, locale, laissez-faire cops, triplicate-form filling bureaucrats and a defiant, mysterious waif who knows more than she tells.

Title: A Guide to Recognizing Your Saints
Hint: A writer returns to his old neighborhood in Queens.
Description: Dito Montiel, a successful author, receives a call from his long-suffering mother, asking him to return home and visit his ailing father. Dito recalls his childhood growing up in a violent neighborhood in Queens, N.Y., with friends Antonio, Giuseppe, Nerf and Mike.

Title: My Week with Marilyn
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young assistant spends seven days with a famous Hollywood star filming in England.
Description: London, 1956. Genius actor and film director Laurence Olivier is about to begin the shooting of his upcoming movie, premiered in 1957 as The Prince and the Showgirl, starring ___ Monroe. Young Colin Clark, who dreams on having a career in movie business, manages to get a job on the set as third assistant director.

Title: Dead Presidents
Hint: Vietnam veterans plan an armoured car heist in the Bronx.
Description: On the streets they call cash ___. And that's just what a Vietnam veteran is after when he returns home from the war only to find himself drawn into a life of crime. With the aid of his fellow vets he plans the ultimate heist -- a daring robbery of an armored car filled with unmarked U.S. currency!

Title: Legend of the Guardians: The Owls of Ga'Hoole
Hint: A young owl is kidnapped by an evil army and must warn the legendary protectors.
Description: When a young owl is abducted by an evil Owl army, he must escape with new-found friends and seek the legendary ___ to stop the menace.

Title: World's Greatest Dad
Hint: A father turns his son's accidental death into fame.
Description: In the wake of a freak accident, Lance suffers the worst tragedy and the greatest opportunity of his life. He is suddenly faced with the possibility of fame, fortune and popularity, if he can only live with the knowledge of how he got there.

Title: Whip It
Hint: A misfit Texas teen joins a roller derby team.
Description: In Bodeen, Texas, an indie-rock loving misfit finds a way of dealing with her small-town misery after she discovers a roller derby league in nearby Austin.

Title: At Close Range
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A teen joins his father's criminal gang in rural Pennsylvania.
Description: Brad Whitewood Jr. lives in rural Pennsylvania and has few prospects. Against his mother's wishes, he seeks out his estranged father, the head of a gang of thieves in a nearby town. Though his new girlfriend supports his criminal ambitions, Brad Jr. soon learns that his father is a dangerous man.

Title: Something Wild
Hint: A free-spirited woman kidnaps a yuppie for a weekend of adventure that turns dangerous.
Description: A free-spirited woman "kidnaps" a yuppie for a weekend of adventure. But the fun quickly takes a dangerous turn when her ex-con husband shows up.

Title: Lord of the Flies
Hint: Schoolboys stranded on an island after a plane crash descend into savagery.
Description: Following a plane crash a group of schoolboys find themselves on a deserted island. They appoint a leader and attempt to create an organized society for the sake of their survival. Democracy and order soon begin to crumble when a breakaway faction regresses to savagery with horrifying consequences.

Title: Borg vs. McEnroe
Hint: The rivalry between a cool Swede and a hot-tempered American tennis player at Wimbledon in 1980.
Description: The Swedish Björn ___ and the American John ___, the best tennis players in the world, maintain a legendary duel during the 1980 Wimbledon tournament.

Title: The Duke
Hint: A pensioner taxi driver steals Goya's portrait of Wellington from the National Gallery.
Description: In 1961, a 60-year-old taxi driver stole Goya’s portrait of the ___ of Wellington from the National Gallery in London. It was the first (and remains the only) theft in the Gallery’s history. What happened next became the stuff of legend.

Title: Shadow of the Vampire
Country: Luxembourg, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A German director makes a pact with a real bloodsucker to star in his silent horror film.
Description: Director F.W. Murnau makes a Faustian pact with a ___ to get him to star in his 1922 film "Nosferatu."

Title: Sisters
Hint: A journalist witnesses a murder through her neighbour's window, and the neighbour has a twin.
Description: Inquisitive journalist Grace Collier is horrified when she witnesses her neighbor, fashion model Danielle Breton, violently murder a man. Panicking, she calls the police. But when the detective arrives at the scene and finds nothing amiss, Grace is forced to take matters into her own hands.

Title: Set It Off
Hint: Four broke Los Angeles women turn to bank robbery to change their lives.
Description: Four inner-city Black women, determined to end their constant struggle, decide to live by one rule — get what you want or die trying. So the four women take back their lives and take out some banks in the process.

Title: Then Came You
Hint: An American hypochondriac meets a terminally ill teenager with a bucket list.
Description: An American hypochondriac who is working as a baggage handler is forced to confront his fears when a British teenager with a terminal illness enlists him to help her carry out her eccentric bucket list.

Title: Song of the South
Hint: A kindly old storyteller tells animal tales to help a lonely boy on a plantation.
Description: Uncle Remus draws upon his tales of Br'er Rabbit to help little Johnny deal with his confusion over his parents' separation as well as his new life on the plantation.

Title: Armour of God
Hint: An adventurer searches for the pieces of a legendary relic to rescue a kidnapped friend.
Description: Jackie Chan stars as Asian Hawk, an Indiana Jones-style adventurer looking to make a fortune in exotic antiquities. After Hawk discovers a mysterious sword in Africa, a band of Satan-worshipping monks kidnap his ex-girlfriend Lorelei, demanding the sword as ransom as well as other pieces of the legendary ___ - a magical outfit dating back to the Crusades.

Title: Grand Canyon
Hint: Six Los Angeles residents of different backgrounds intertwine after a car breakdown.
Description: ___ revolved around six residents from different backgrounds whose lives intertwine in modern-day Los Angeles. At the center of the film is the unlikely friendship of two men from different races and classes brought together when one finds himself in jeopardy in the other's rough neighborhood.

Title: The Grifters
Hint: A small-time con man is torn between his estranged con-artist mother and his scheming girlfriend.
Description: A small-time conman has his loyalties torn between his estranged mother and his new girlfriend, both of whom are high-stakes ___ with their own angles to play.

Title: Basquiat
Hint: The brief, brilliant life of a young New York graffiti artist turned art star.
Description: The brief life of Jean Michel ___, a world renowned New York street artist struggling with fame, drugs and his identity.

Title: Muppet Treasure Island
Hint: A boy and a gang of puppets set sail with a one-legged cook in search of buried gold.
Description: After telling the story of Flint's last journey to young Jim Hawkins, Billy Bones has a heart attack and dies just as Jim and his friends are attacked by pirates. The gang escapes into the town where they hire out a boat and crew to find the hidden ___, which was revealed by Bones before he died. On their voyage across the seas, they soon find out that not everyone on board can be trusted.

Title: Tetsuo: The Iron Man
Hint: A Tokyo businessman's body slowly turns into a mass of scrap metal.
Description: A "metal fetishist", driven mad by the maggots wriggling in the wound he's made to embed metal into his flesh, runs out into the night and is accidentally run down by a Japanese businessman and his girlfriend. The pair dispose of the corpse in hopes of quietly moving on with their lives. However, the businessman soon finds that he is now plagued by a vicious curse that transforms his flesh into ___.

Title: Kill the Messenger
Hint: A reporter exposes the CIA's link to crack cocaine and becomes the target of a smear campaign.
Description: A reporter becomes the target of a vicious smear campaign that drives him to the point of suicide after he exposes the CIA's role in arming Contra rebels in Nicaragua and importing cocaine into California. Based on the true story of journalist Gary Webb.

Title: Frank
Hint: A wannabe musician joins an eccentric band with a lead singer who wears a giant head.
Description: A young wannabe musician discovers he has bitten off more than he can chew when he joins an eccentric pop band led by the mysterious and enigmatic ___.

Title: Memphis Belle
Country: Japan, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A World War II bomber crew prepares for its final, perilous mission over Germany.
Description: The "___" is a World War II bomber, piloted by a young crew on dangerous bombing raids into Europe. The crew only have to make one more bombing raid before they have finished their duty and can go home. In the briefing before their last flight, the crew discover that the target for the day is Bremen.

Title: Supernova
Hint: Partners of 20 years travel across England in an old RV as one faces dementia.
Description: Sam and Tusker, partners of 20 years, are traveling across England in their old RV visiting friends, family and places from their past. Since Tusker was diagnosed with early-onset dementia two years ago, their time together is the most important thing they have. As the trip progresses, however, their ideas for the future clash, secrets come out, and their love for each other is tested as never before.

Title: Ma Rainey's Black Bottom
Hint: Tensions boil over at a 1927 Chicago recording session with a fiery blues queen.
Description: Tensions rise when the trailblazing Mother of the Blues and her band gather at a Chicago recording studio in 1927. Adapted from August Wilson's play.

Title: The Bob's Burgers Movie
Hint: A family burger restaurant is threatened by a giant sinkhole and a murder mystery.
Description: When a ruptured water main creates an enormous sinkhole right in front of ___, it blocks the entrance indefinitely and ruins the Belchers’ plans for a successful summer. While ___ and Linda struggle to keep the business afloat, the kids try to solve a mystery that could save their family's restaurant.

Title: Noroi: The Curse
Hint: A documentary filmmaker explores paranormal incidents tied to an ancient demon.
Description: A documentary filmmaker explores seemingly unrelated paranormal incidents connected by the legend of an ancient demon.

Title: Summer of 85
Hint: A 16-year-old boy falls in love with an older boy in a seaside town.
Description: What do you dream of when you're 16-years-old and in a seaside resort in Normandy in the 1980s? A best friend? A lifelong teen pact? Scooting off on adventures on a boat or a motorbike? Living life at breakneck speed? No. You dream of death. Because you can't get a bigger kick than dying. And that's why you save it till the very end.

Title: Blinded by the Light
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A British-Pakistani teen in 1987 is inspired by the music of Bruce Springsteen.
Description: In 1987, during the austere days of Thatcher’s Britain, a teenager learns to live life, understand his family, and find his own voice through the music of Bruce Springsteen.

Title: Coma
Hint: A doctor discovers healthy patients are being deliberately put into permanent sleep.
Description: When relatively healthy patients begin having 'complications' during simple operations and ending up in comas, a concerned doctor defies her male superiors when she suspects a secret plot.

Title: Hesher
Hint: A rebellious metalhead stranger moves into a grieving family's home uninvited.
Description: A young boy has lost his mother and is losing touch with his father and the world around him. Then he meets ___ who manages to make his life even more chaotic.

Title: Fan
Hint: A young man who looks exactly like his movie star idol becomes dangerously obsessed.
Description: A man who bears a striking resemblance to a renowned movie star becomes an obsessive ___, but when his fierce love is spurned by the star, he decides to destroy the star's life and reputation.

Title: Rolling Thunder
Hint: A Vietnam veteran returns home from a POW camp and seeks revenge on the thugs who killed his family.
Description: A Vietnam veteran, Charles Rane, returns home after years in a POW camp and is treated as a hero. He has a hard time adjusting, and things go badly. A movie about the walking dead, before that meant just flesh-eating zombies.

Title: Opera
Hint: A young soprano is stalked by a killer who forces her to watch his murders.
Description: A young ___ singer is stalked by a deranged fan bent on killing the people associated with her to claim her for himself.

Title: Calendar Girls
Hint: Members of a Yorkshire women's club pose nude for a charity fundraiser.
Description: Members of a Yorkshire branch of the Women's Institute cause controversy when they pose nude for a charity ___.

Title: Haseen Dillruba
Hint: A wife under investigation for her husband's murder reveals their passionate marriage.
Description: Under investigation as a suspect in her husband's murder, a wife reveals details of their thorny marriage that seem to only further blur the truth.

Title: The Adventures of Milo and Otis
Hint: A kitten and a pug are separated and journey across Japan to find each other.
Description: When ___ the cat and ___ the dog are separated, they each set off on an adventurous and often perilous quest across mountains, plains, and snow-covered lands to reunite with one another.

Title: Ruthless People
Hint: A man refuses to pay the ransom for his kidnapped wife, whom he wanted dead anyway.
Description: Sam Stone hates his wife Barbara so much that he wants her dead. He's ecstatic when she's taken by a duo of kidnappers who want $500,000 ransom in exchange for her life.

Title: Slow West
Hint: A Scottish teen teams up with a mysterious gunman to find the woman he loves in the frontier.
Description: In the Old West, a 17-year-old Scottish boy teams up with a mysterious gunman to find the woman with whom he is infatuated.

Title: Wilde
Hint: An Irish playwright's scandalous affair with a young lord leads to prison.
Description: Oscar ___ is a married playwright who has occasionally indulged his weakness for male suitors. After much toil, ___ debuts 'The Importance of Being Earnest' in London, and a chat at the theatre with Lord Alfred 'Bosie' Douglas leads to a full-fledged romance.

Title: Get the Gringo
Hint: An American criminal is sent to a corrupt Mexican prison run like a small town.
Description: A career criminal nabbed by Mexican authorities is placed in a tough prison where he learns to survive with the help of a 9-year-old boy.

Title: Suffragette
Hint: Working-class women in London fight for the right to vote in the early 1900s.
Description: Based on true events about the foot soldiers of the early feminist movement, women who were forced underground to pursue a dangerous game of cat and mouse with an increasingly brutal State.

Title: The Conspirator
Hint: The only woman charged in the plot to kill President Lincoln stands trial.
Description: Mary Surratt is the lone female charged as a co-___ in the assassination trial of Abraham Lincoln. As the whole nation turns against her, she is forced to rely on her reluctant lawyer to uncover the truth and save her life.

Title: Hearts in Atlantis
Hint: A boy befriends a mysterious stranger with psychic gifts who moves in upstairs.
Description: A widowed mother and her son change when a mysterious stranger enters their lives.

Title: Radio Flyer
Hint: Two brothers turn their wagon into a flying machine to escape their abusive stepfather.
Description: A father reminisces about his childhood when he and his younger brother moved to a new town with their mother, her new husband and their dog, Shane. When the younger brother is subjected to physical abuse at the hands of their brutal stepfather, Mike decides to convert their toy trolley, the "___", into a plane to fly him to safety.

Title: Tales from the Crypt
Hint: Five tourists lost in catacombs meet a sinister monk who reveals their fates.
Description: When a tourist group become lost within ancient catacombs, they meet the sinister ___ Keeper, who tells them each their fate. The enigmatic figure's macabre stories involve a wife dabbling in murder, a retired sanitation worker targeted by his suspicious neighbors, and an adulterer who may face a fitting demise if the yarns come true.

Title: The Long Riders
Hint: The origins, exploits and ultimate fate of a notorious outlaw gang of brothers.
Description: The origins, exploits and the ultimate fate of the James gang is told in a sympathetic portrayal of the bank robbers made up of brothers who begin their legendary bank raids because of revenge.

Title: The Limey
Hint: A tough English ex-con travels to Los Angeles to avenge his daughter's death.
Description: The ___ follows Wilson, a tough English ex-con who travels to Los Angeles to avenge his daughter's death. Upon arrival, Wilson goes to task battling Valentine and an army of L.A.'s toughest criminals, hoping to find clues and piece together what happened.

Title: The Fabulous Baker Boys
Hint: Two piano-playing brothers hire a sultry singer who comes between them.
Description: The lives of two struggling musicians, who happen to be brothers, inevitably change when they team up with a beautiful, up-and-coming singer.

Title: The Big Boss
Hint: A young man working at an ice factory in Thailand uncovers a drug-smuggling ring.
Description: Cheng is a young Chinese mainlander who moves in with his expatriate cousins to work at an ice factory in Thailand. He does this with a family promise never to get involved in any fights. However, when members of his family begin disappearing after meeting the management of the factory, the resulting mystery and pressures force him to break that vow and take on the villainy of the ___.

Title: Goya's Ghosts
Hint: A Spanish painter becomes involved with the Spanish Inquisition and his model's imprisonment.
Description: Painter Francisco ___ becomes involved with the Spanish Inquisition after his muse, Inés, is arrested by the church for heresy. Her family turns to him, hoping that his connection with fanatical Inquisitor Lorenzo, whom he is painting, can secure her release.

Title: The Black Cat
Hint: Honeymooners in Hungary meet a Satanist architect and a vengeful doctor.
Description: After a road accident in Hungary, the American honeymooners Joan and Peter and the enigmatic Dr. Werdegast find refuge in the house of the famed architect Hjalmar Poelzig, who shares a dark past with the doctor.

Title: The 33
Hint: Thirty-three miners are trapped underground for 69 days in Chile.
Description: Based on the true story of the collapse of a mine in San Jose, Chile—that left ___ miners isolated underground for 69 days.

Title: Suicide Kings
Hint: Rich young men kidnap a mobster to pay a ransom for a friend's sister.
Description: Carlo, a former mobster, is abducted by five privileged young men desperate to raise a $2 million ransom to save the sister of a friend. As Carlo plays mind games, however, his captors splinter -- each wondering whether one of their own had a hand in the crime.

Title: High Society
Hint: A socialite's ex-husband tries to win her back before her wedding, with Cole Porter songs.
Description: With socialite Tracy Lord about to remarry, her ex-husband - with the help of a sympathetic reporter - has 48 hours to convince her that she really still loves him.

Title: Tigerland
Hint: Recruits train for Vietnam at a brutal Louisiana camp alongside a rebellious private.
Description: A group of recruits go through Advanced Infantry Training at Fort Polk, Louisiana's infamous ___, last stop before Vietnam for tens of thousands of young men in 1971.

Title: The French Lieutenant's Woman
Hint: Two actors fall in love while filming a Victorian romance.
Description: In this story-within-a-story, Anna is an actress starring opposite Mike in a period piece about the forbidden love between their respective characters, Sarah and Charles. Both actors are involved in serious relationships, but the passionate nature of the script leads to an off-camera love affair as well.

Title: Gridlock'd
Hint: Two junkie musicians try to enroll in a detox program after a friend overdoses.
Description: After a friend overdoses, Spoon and Stretch decide to kick their drug habits and attempt to enroll in a government detox program. Their efforts are hampered by seemingly endless red tape, as they are shuffled from one office to another while being chased by drug dealers and the police.

Title: Supercop
Hint: A Hong Kong detective teams up with a mainland officer to stop a drug lord.
Description: A Hong Kong detective teams up with his female Red Chinese counterpart to stop a Chinese drug czar.

Title: Our Souls at Night
Hint: A widow and widower in a small Colorado town start sleeping side by side for company.
Description: Addie Moore and Louis Waters, a widow and widower, have lived next to each other for years. The pair have almost no relationship, but that all changes when Addie tries to make a connection with her neighbour.

Title: Saving Grace
Hint: An unexpectedly widowed English housewife grows marijuana to pay her debts.
Description: Unexpectedly widowed, prim and proper housewife ___ Trevethyn finds herself in dire financial straits when she inherits massive debts her late husband had been accruing for years. Faced with losing her house, she decides to use her talent for horticulture and hatches a plan to grow potent marijuana which can be sold at an astronomical price, thus solving her financial crisis.

Title: Jude
Hint: A stonemason aspires to be a scholar but is held back by class and scandal.
Description: In late 19th-century England, ___ aspires to be an academic, but is hobbled by his blue-collar background. Instead, he works as a stonemason and is trapped in an unloving marriage to a farmer's daughter named Arabella. But when his wife leaves him, ___ sees an opportunity to improve himself. He moves to the city and begins an affair with his married cousin, Sue, courting tragedy every step of the way.

Title: The Emerald Forest
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An engineer searches for his son who was kidnapped by an Amazonian tribe.
Description: For ten years, engineer Bill Markham has searched tirelessly for his son Tommy who disappeared from the edge of the Brazilian rainforest. Miraculously, he finds the boy living among the reclusive Amazon tribe who adopted him. And that's when Bill's adventure truly begins.

Title: The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad
Hint: Two animated tales: a reckless amphibian's motoring mania and a schoolmaster's headless horseman.
Description: The Wind in the Willows: Concise version of Kenneth Grahame's story of the same name. J. Thaddeus ___, owner of ___ Hall, is prone to fads, such as the newfangled motor car. This desire for the very latest lands him in much trouble with the wrong crowd, and it is up to his friends, Mole, Rat and Badger to save him from himself.

Title: Big Time Adolescence
Hint: A 16-year-old idolizes his older slacker friend, who leads him astray.
Description: A seemingly bright and mostly innocent 16-year-old named Mo attempts to navigate high school under the guidance of his best friend Zeke, an unmotivated-yet-charismatic college dropout. Although Zeke genuinely cares about Mo, things start to go awry as he teaches Mo nontraditional life lessons in drug dealing, partying, and dating.

Title: The Great Train Robbery
Hint: Bandits rob a locomotive and flee on horseback in one of the first westerns.
Description: After the train station clerk is assaulted and left bound and gagged, then the departing train and its passengers robbed, a posse goes in hot pursuit of the fleeing bandits.

Title: Igby Goes Down
Hint: A rebellious 17-year-old rejects his privileged family in New York.
Description: ___ Slocumb, a rebellious and sarcastic 17-year-old boy, is at war with the stifling world of old money privilege he was born into. With a schizophrenic father, a self-absorbed, distant mother, and a shark-like young Republican big brother, ___ figures there must be a better life out there -- and sets about finding it.

Title: Get on Up
Hint: The rise of a funk and soul singer from poverty to stardom.
Description: A chronicle of James Brown's rise from extreme poverty to become one of the most influential musicians in history.

Title: Zabriskie Point
Hint: A student and a young activist meet in Death Valley during the counterculture era.
Description: Anthropology student Daria, who's helping a property developer build a village in the Los Angeles desert, and dropout Mark, who's wanted by the authorities for allegedly killing a policeman during a student riot, accidentally encounter each other in Death Valley and soon begin an unrestrained romance.

Title: The Contender
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A vice presidential nominee faces a smear campaign about her past.
Description: The vice president is dead, and as the president makes his choice for a replacement, a secret contest of wills is being waged by a formidable rival. When Senator Laine Hanson is nominated as the first woman in history to hold the office, hidden agendas explode into a battle for power.

Title: Matinee
Hint: A showman introduces a small town to a unique horror movie experience.
Description: A showman introduces a small coastal town to a unique movie experience and capitalizes on the Cuban Missile crisis hysteria with a kitschy horror extravaganza combining film effects, stage props and actors in rubber suits in this salute to the B-movie.

Title: Clockers
Hint: A young drug dealer in Brooklyn is suspected of murder.
Description: Strike is a young city drug pusher under the tutelage of drug lord Rodney Little. When a night manager at a fast-food restaurant is found with four bullets in his body, Strike’s older brother turns himself in as the killer. Detective Rocco Klein doesn’t buy the story, however, setting out to find the truth, and it seems that all the fingers point toward Strike & Rodney.

Title: Charlie Bartlett
Hint: A rich teen becomes the unofficial psychiatrist to his new classmates.
Description: Awkward teenager ___ has trouble fitting in at a new high school. ___ needs some friends fast, and decides that the best way to find them is to appoint himself the resident psychiatrist. He becomes one of the most popular guys in school by doling out advice and, occasionally, medication, to the student body.

Title: Return to Paradise
Hint: Two friends must go back to Malaysia to save another from execution.
Description: Lewis, Sheriff and Tony are three friends vacationing in Malaysia. Sheriff and Tony eventually leave to pursue careers in New York, but Lewis stays behind to work with orangutans. Two years later, Sheriff and Tony learn that, because of their past actions, Lewis has been arrested for drug possession.

Title: Hector and the Search for Happiness
Country: Canada, China, Germany, South Africa, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A quirky psychiatrist travels the world searching for what makes people truly content.
Description: ___ is a quirky psychiatrist who has become increasingly tired of his humdrum life. As he tells his girlfriend, Clara, he feels like a fraud: he hasn’t really tasted life, and yet he’s offering advice to patients who are just not getting any happier. So ___ decides to break out of his deluded and routine driven life.

Title: Traitor
Hint: An FBI agent investigates a former Special Ops officer who may be a terrorist.
Description: When straight arrow FBI agent Roy Clayton heads up the investigation into a dangerous international conspiracy, all clues seem to lead back to former U.S. Special Operations officer Samir Horn.

Title: This Beautiful Fantastic
Hint: A woman must restore her neglected garden or be evicted.
Description: Set against the backdrop of a beautiful garden in the heart of London, this contemporary fairy tale revolves around the unlikely friendship between a reclusive young woman and a cantankerous old widower. Bella Brown is a beautifully quirky young woman who dreams of writing and illustrating a successful children’s book.

Title: The Stronghold
Hint: Marseille cops bust a drug network, then are accused of corruption.
Description: Tired of the small-time grind, three Marseille cops get a chance to bust a major drug network. But lines blur when a key informant makes a big ask.

Title: The Barefoot Contessa
Hint: A filmmaker discovers a shoeless Spanish dancer and turns her into a star.
Description: A washed-up filmmaker gets a second chance at stardom when he discovers stunning peasant Maria Vargas dancing in a Madrid nightclub. Goaded by his producer, the director convinces Maria to screen test for, and then star in, his next big picture. But as the producer's possessive nature and the realities of stardom weigh on Maria, she seeks a genuine lover with whom she can escape.

Title: The Cooler
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A man brings bad luck to gamblers at a Las Vegas casino.
Description: Bernie works at a Las Vegas casino, where he uses his innate ability to bring about misfortune in those around him to jinx gamblers into losing. His imposing boss, Shelly Kaplow, is happy with the arrangement. But Bernie finds unexpected happiness when he begins dating attractive waitress Natalie Belisario.

Title: Suck Me Shakespeer
Hint: A bank robber poses as a substitute teacher at a rowdy high school.
Description: Ex-con Zeki Müller goes undercover as a teacher at a below average Gymnasium to find money he'd stashed prior to incarceration.

Title: The Ref
Hint: A cat burglar takes a bickering family hostage on Christmas Eve.
Description: A cat burglar is forced to take a bickering, dysfunctional family hostage on Christmas Eve.

Title: Welcome to the Rileys
Hint: A grieving couple befriends a teenage stripper in New Orleans.
Description: Years after their teenage daughter’s death, Lois and Doug Riley, an upstanding Indiana couple, are frozen by estranging grief. Doug escapes to New Orleans on a business trip. Compelled by urgencies he doesn’t understand, he insinuates himself into the life of an underage hooker, becoming her platonic guardian.

Title: Bananas
Studio: Jack Rollins & Charles H. Joffe Productions
Hint: A bumbling New Yorker becomes the dictator of a Latin American country.
Description: When a bumbling New Yorker is dumped by his activist girlfriend, he travels to a tiny Latin American nation and becomes involved in its latest rebellion.

Title: Camp X-Ray
Hint: A young soldier forms a bond with a detainee at Guantanamo Bay.
Description: A young woman joins the military to be part of something bigger than herself and her small-town roots. Instead, she ends up as a new guard at Guantanamo Bay, where her mission is far from black and white. Surrounded by hostile jihadists and aggressive squadmates, she strikes up an unusual friendship with one of the detainees.

Title: The Last Wave
Hint: A Sydney lawyer defending Aboriginal men has visions of an apocalyptic flood.
Description: A Sydney lawyer defends five Aboriginal people in a ritualised taboo murder and in the process learns disturbing truths about himself and premonitions.

Title: Transit
Hint: A refugee in Marseille assumes a dead writer's identity to flee the Nazis.
Description: In an attempt to flee Nazi-occupied France, Georg assumes the identity of a dead author but soon finds himself stuck in Marseilles, where he falls in love with Maria, a young woman searching for her missing husband.

Title: Carry on Jatta 3
Hint: A lawyer's son falls for a girl whose brothers clash with his father.
Description: Advocate Dillon's son, Jass, is in love with Meet but her brothers get in a tussle with Adv. Dhillon. As a result, Adv. Dhillon rejects Meet's hand in marriage. Left with no option, Jass weaves a madhouse plan to propose to his friend, Goldy's wife, Diljit. Will the plan work?

Title: Absence of Malice
Hint: A reporter is duped into printing a false story that ruins an innocent liquor wholesaler.
Description: Megan Carter is a reporter duped into running an untrue story on Michael Gallagher, a suspected racketeer. He has an alibi for the time his crime was allegedly committed—but it involves an innocent party. When he tells Carter the truth and the newspaper runs it, tragedy follows, forcing Carter to face up to the responsibilities of her job when she is confronted by Gallagher.

Title: In Your Eyes
Hint: Two strangers on opposite sides of the country discover they can see and feel each other's lives.
Description: Two seemingly unconnected souls from different corners of the United States make a telepathic bond that allows them to see, hear, and feel the other's experiences, creating a connection that cannot be broken.

Title: A Cry in the Dark
Hint: A mother is accused of murdering her baby during a camping trip in Australia.
Description: Based on the true story of Lindy Chamberlain who, during a family camping trip to Ayers Rock in central Australia, claimed she witnessed a dingo take her baby daughter, Azaria, from their tent. Azaria's body was never found and, after investigations and two public inquests, she is charged with murder.

Title: Topkapi
Hint: A small-time crook is recruited for an elaborate jewel heist on a museum in Istanbul.
Description: Arthur Simon Simpson is a small-time crook biding his time in Greece. One of his potential victims turns out to be a gentleman thief planning to steal the emerald-encrusted dagger of the Mehmed II from Istanbul's ___ Museum.

Title: The Wolf's Call
Hint: A young French submariner with an extraordinary ear for sound must avert a nuclear crisis.
Description: Shown from the perspective of a young submariner with unusually sensitive hearing and uncannily precise sound recognition. The fate of many often depends on his ability, and one time, whilst highly stressed, he makes a incorrect call which put his entire crew in mortal danger.

Title: Junebug
Hint: A Chicago art dealer visits her new husband's quirky family in rural North Carolina.
Description: On the way to meet with an independent artist in the South, newlywed art dealer Madeleine is convinced by her husband, George, that they should stop to meet his family in North Carolina. Madeleine's affluent lifestyle clashes with the family, but she befriends George's wide-eyed and pregnant sister-in-law, Ashley, who is nearing her due date.

Title: Tea with Mussolini
Hint: A boy raised by eccentric English and American ladies grows up in fascist Florence.
Description: In 1930s fascist Italy, adolescent Luca just lost his mother. His father, a callous businessman, sends him to be taken care of by British expatriate Mary Wallace. Mary and her cultured friends - including artist Arabella, young widow Elsa, and archaeologist Georgie - keep a watchful eye over the boy. But the women's cultivated lives take a dramatic turn when Allied forces declare war on ___.

Title: Three... Extremes
Country: Hong Kong, Japan, Netherlands, South Korea
Hint: A trio of Asian directors deliver nightmares about dumplings, revenge and conjoined twins.
Description: Features an anthology centred on the experiences of a witch doctor, a film-maker and a disgruntled extra determined to take revenge on him, and a novelist as well as her twin sister.

Title: Without a Clue
Hint: A doctor and detective hires an actor to play the famous sleuth.
Description: Sherlock Holmes is as dashing as ever, but with a little secret: Dr. Watson is the brains behind the operation. When Reginald Kincaid, the actor he has hired to play Holmes becomes insufferable, Watson fires him and tries to go out on his own, but finds that he has done too good a job building Holmes up in the public's mind.

Title: Roger Dodger
Hint: A smooth-talking ad man teaches his teenage nephew how to pick up women in one wild night.
Description: A smooth-talking ad executive attributes his remarkable success with women to his ability to manipulate their emotions from the moment he first meets them. When his teenage nephew drops in for a visit, he soon learns that his approach isn't as foolproof as he thought when he attempts to teach the boy how to pick up women.

Title: The Emperor's Club
Hint: A principled classics teacher at an elite boarding school is tested by a rebellious senator's son.
Description: William Hundert is a passionate and principled Classics professor who finds his tightly-controlled world shaken and inexorably altered when a new student, Sedgewick Bell, walks into his classroom. What begins as a fierce battle of wills gives way to a close student-teacher relationship, but results in a life lesson for Hundert that will still haunt him a quarter of a century later.

Title: Chocolate
Hint: An autistic girl with lightning-fast martial arts skills collects debts to pay for her mother's cancer care.
Description: Zen, an autistic teenage girl with powerful martial arts skills, gets money to pay for her sick mother Zin's treatment by seeking out all the people who owe Zin money and making them pay.

Title: Agneepath
Hint: A boy who watched his father lynched returns years later as a gangster to take revenge.
Description: A young boy's father is lynched before his eyes; fifteen years later he returns home for revenge.

Title: White God
Hint: A girl's dog is abandoned in Budapest and leads an uprising of strays.
Description: 13 year old Lili fights to protect her dog Hagen, and is devastated when her father sets Hagen free on the streets. Still innocently believing love can conquer any difficulty, Lili sets out to save her dog. Failing in his desperate efforts to find his beloved owner, Hagen joins a canine revolt leading a revolution against their human abusers.

Title: Tom at the Farm
Hint: A grieving man visits his dead lover's isolated dairy and is drawn into a violent family secret.
Description: A young man travels to an isolated farm for his lover's funeral where he's quickly drawn into a twisted, sexually charged game by his lover's aggressive brother.

Title: The Wackness
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A teenage weed dealer trades pot for therapy with a burnt-out psychiatrist in 1994 New York.
Description: Set in New York City in the sweltering summer, The ___ tells the story of a troubled teenage drug dealer, who trades pot for therapy sessions with a drug-addled psychiatrist. Things get more complicated when he falls for one of his classmates, who just happens to be the doctor's daughter. This is a coming-of-age story about sex, drugs, music and what it takes to be a man.

Title: The Hitch-Hiker
Hint: Two men on a fishing trip pick up a hitchhiking killer who forces them across Mexico.
Description: Roy and Gilbert's fishing trip takes a terrifying turn when the hitchhiker they pick up turns out to be a sociopath on the run from the law. He's killed before, and he lets the two know that as soon as they're no longer useful, he'll kill again.

Title: Zero Effect
Hint: A reclusive, brilliant private investigator takes on a blackmail case in Portland.
Description: Daryl ___ is a private investigator and—along with his assistant, Steve Arlo—he solves impossible crimes and puzzles. Although Daryl's a master investigator, he doesn't know what to do with himself when he's not working; he has no social skills, writes bad music and drives Steve crazy.

Title: Infinitely Polar Bear
Hint: A bipolar father tries to raise his two daughters while their mother studies in New York.
Description: A manic-depressive mess of a father tries to win back his wife by attempting to take full responsibility of their two young, spirited daughters, who don't make the overwhelming task any easier.

Title: The Last Station
Country: Germany, Russia, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A great Russian novelist's final year is torn between his wife and his disciples.
Description: A historical drama that illustrates Russian author Leo Tolstoy's struggle to balance fame and wealth with his commitment to a life devoid of material things. The Countess Sofya, wife and muse to Leo Tolstoy, uses every trick of seduction on her husband's loyal disciple, whom she believes was the person responsible for Tolstoy signing a new will that leaves his work and property to the Russian people.

Title: Alan Partridge: Alpha Papa
Hint: A vain local DJ is caught in a hostage siege when his radio station is taken over.
Description: When famous DJ ___ radio station is taken over by a new media conglomerate, it sets in motion a chain of events which see ___ having to work with the police to defuse a potentially violent siege.

Title: The Four Musketeers: Milady's Revenge
Country: Spain, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The royal guards defend the queen from a scheming cardinal and his deadly spy.
Description: The ___ defend the queen and her dressmaker from Cardinal Richelieu and ___ de Winter.

Title: The Life and Death of Peter Sellers
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The turbulent life of the comic actor behind a bumbling French inspector.
Description: The turbulent personal and professional life of actor Peter ___ (1925-1980), from his beginnings as a comic performer on BBC Radio to his huge success as one of the greatest film comedians of all time; an obsessive artist so dedicated to his work that neglected his loved ones and sacrificed part of his own personality to convincingly create that of his many memorable characters.

Title: Hearts Beat Loud
Hint: A Brooklyn record store owner and his daughter form a band before she leaves for college.
Description: In the hip Brooklyn neighborhood of Red Hook, single dad and record store owner Frank is preparing to send his hard-working daughter Sam off to college while being forced to close his vintage shop. Hoping to stay connected through their shared musical passions, Frank urges Sam to turn their weekly jam sessions into a father-daughter live act.

Title: One True Thing
Hint: A career woman moves home to care for her dying mother and sees her parents differently.
Description: A career woman reassesses her parents' lives after she is forced to care for her cancer-stricken mother.

Title: The Resistance Banker
Hint: A Dutch financier secretly bankrolls the underground during the Nazi occupation.
Description: In the occupied Netherlands during World War II, ___ Walraven van Hall is asked to use his financial contacts to help the Dutch ___. With his brother Gijs, he comes up with a risky plan to take out huge loans and use the money to finance the ___.

Title: Kill Zone
Hint: A Hong Kong detective near retirement goes after a ruthless triad boss.
Description: Chan, an articulate senior detective nearing the end of his career, is taking care of the daughter of a witness killed by ruthless crime lord Po. Martial arts expert Ma is set to take over as head of the crime unit, replacing Chan who wants an early retirement.

Title: The Isle
Hint: A mute woman who rents floating fishing cabins forms a twisted bond with a fugitive.
Description: Mute Hee-Jin is working as a clerk in a fishing resort in the Korean wilderness; selling baits, food and occasionally her body to the fishing tourists. One day she falls in love with Hyun-Shik, who is on the run from the police, and rescues him with a fish hook when he tries to commit suicide.

Title: Things to Come
Hint: A century of war, plague and progress leads humanity toward a launch into space.
Description: The story of a century: a decades-long second World War leaves plague and anarchy, then a rational state rebuilds civilization and attempts space travel.

Title: Pardes
Hint: A wealthy Indian-American businessman sends his loyal protégé to India to find a bride for his westernised son.
Description: Kishorilal wants an Indian bride for his westernised son. He gets him engaged to Ganga, his friend's daughter, and brings her to USA. But she shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son.

Title: The Place Promised in Our Early Days
Hint: Two boys build a plane to fly to a mysterious tower in a divided Japan.
Description: In a post-war alternative timeline, Japan is divided into the North, controlled by the Union, and the South, controlled by the United States. A mysterious high tower rises within the borders of the Union. Three high school students promise to cross the border with a self-built airplane and unravel the secret of the tower.

Title: Evangelion: 3.0 You Can (Not) Redo
Hint: A young pilot awakens 14 years after a catastrophe to find the world changed.
Description: Fourteen years after Third Impact, Shinji Ikari awakens to a world he does not remember. He hasn't aged. Much of Earth is laid in ruins, NERV has been dismantled, and people who he once protected have turned against him. Befriending the enigmatic Kaworu Nagisa, Shinji continues the fight against the angels and realizes the fighting is far from over, even when it could be against his former allies.

Title: A Pigeon Sat on a Branch Reflecting on Existence
