Hint: Two dreary novelty salesmen wander through a series of absurd, darkly comic scenes.
Description: An absurdist, surrealistic and shocking pitch-black comedy, which moves freely from nightmare to fantasy to hilariously deadpan humour as it muses on man’s perpetual inhumanity to man.

Title: The Chumscrubber
Country: United States of America, Germany, Canada
Hint: Suburban teens are caught up in a kidnapping after their drug-dealing friend dies.
Description: The ___ is a dark comedy about the lives of people who live in upper-class suburbia. It all begins when Dean Stiffle finds the body of his friend, Troy. He doesn't bother telling any of the adults because he knows they won't care. Everyone in town is too self consumed to worry about anything else than themselves. And everybody is on some form of drug just to get through their days.

Title: Gozu
Hint: A yakuza's brother disappears on a road trip, and things get bizarre.
Description: Minami mistakenly kills a gangster associate of his named Brother. Almost as soon as the murder takes place, the body of the deceased man is gone, prompting Minami to conduct a search. While looking, he finds a mysterious isolated hotel where he decides to take a rest. Not only are the front desk clerks a bit strange, but even the ambiance feels unusual.

Title: The Dangerous Lives of Altar Boys
Hint: Catholic schoolkids draw an obscene comic and plot pranks against their stern nun.
Description: A group of Catholic school friends, after being caught drawing an obscene comic book, plan a heist that will outdo their previous prank and make them local legends.

Title: Hallam Foe
Hint: A strange teen who spies on people falls for a woman who looks like his dead mother.
Description: ___ talent for spying on people reveals his darkest fears-and his most peculiar desires. Driven to expose the true cause of his mother's death, he instead finds himself searching the rooftops of the city for love.

Title: The Lucky Ones
Hint: Three soldiers home on leave from Iraq take a road trip across America.
Description: The story revolves around three soldiers — Colee, T.K. and Cheaver — who return from the Iraq War after suffering injuries and learn that life has moved on without them. They end up on an unexpected road trip across the U.S.

Title: Slim Susie
Hint: A man learns his beauty-queen sister is in trouble in his hometown.
Description: When Erik, a Stockholm urbanite, learns that his beauty-queen sister, ___, is missing, he goes to their country roots to look for her. But after talking to the eccentric locals -- including a shy video store clerk and a corrupt police officer -- Erik finds a woman who is not at all like the girl he left behind. Award-winning director Ulf Malmros helms this black comedy infused with hipster flair.

Title: Asterix and Obelix: Mansion of the Gods
Hint: Romans build luxury apartments next to the stubborn Gaulish village.
Description: In order to wipe out the Gaulish village by any means necessary, Caesar plans to absorb the villagers into Roman culture by having an estate built next to the village to start a new Roman colony.

Title: Towelhead
Hint: An Arab-American girl navigates her sexual awakening and a bigoted neighbor.
Description: A young Arab-American girl struggles with her sexual obsession, a bigoted Army reservist, and her strict father during the Gulf War.

Title: Chinese Puzzle
Hint: A Frenchman follows his ex-wife and children to New York.
Description: Xavier is a 40-year-old father of two who still finds life very complicated. When the mother of his children moves to New York, he can't bear them growing up far away from him and so he decides to move there as well.

Title: Shinjuku Incident
Hint: A Chinese immigrant who enters Japan illegally rises through the violent Tokyo underworld.
Description: A simple Chinese immigrant wages a perilous war against one of the most powerful criminal organizations on the planet.

Title: Sink or Swim
Hint: A group of middle-aged men in a midlife crisis form a synchronized swimming team.
Description: 40-year-old Bertrand has been suffering from depression for the last two years and is barely able to keep his head above water. Despite the medication he gulps down all day, every day, and his wife's encouragement, he is unable to find any meaning in his life. Curiously, he will end up finding this sense of purpose at the swimming pool, by joining an all-male synchronised swimming team.

Title: Akhanda
Hint: Twin brothers separated at birth unite to fight corruption.
Description: Brothers Murali Krishna and ___ are separated at birth. They grow up to lead completely separate lives, Murali as a local hero, and ___ as a secluded Shiva devotee. But when the lives of Murali and his family are in danger, his long-lost brother finally returns.

Title: Gainsbourg: A Heroic Life
Hint: The life of a famous, provocative French singer and his alter ego.
Description: A glimpse at the life of French singer Serge ___, from growing up in 1940s Nazi-occupied Paris through his successful song-writing years in the 1960s to his death in 1991 at the age of 62.

Title: Conversations with Other Women
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two former lovers reunite at a wedding and spend the night together, shown entirely in split screen.
Description: Reunited at a wedding after many years, former lovers again feel the pull of a mutual attraction neither is willing to admit. Escaping the reception for the privacy of a hotel room, the unnamed pair explore the choices of the past that led them to the present.

Title: The Bang Bang Club
Hint: Four combat photographers capture the violence of South Africa's last days of apartheid.
Description: In the early to mid '90s, when the South African system of apartheid was in its death throes, four photographers - Greg Marinovich, Kevin Carter, Ken Oosterbroek and João Silva - bonded by their friendship and a sense of purpose, worked together to chronicle the violence and upheaval leading up to the 1994 election of Nelson Mandela as president.

Title: The Clan
Hint: A respectable Argentine family runs a kidnapping business from their home.
Description: In Argentina, between 1982 and 1985, the Puccios, a well-established family of San Isidro, an upper-class suburb of Buenos Aires, kidnap several people and hold them as hostages for a ransom.

Title: AK vs AK
Hint: A disgraced director kidnaps a movie star's daughter and films him searching for her.
Description: After a public spat with a movie star, a disgraced director retaliates by kidnapping the actor's daughter, filming the search for her in real-time.

Title: The Assassination of Richard Nixon
Country: United States of America, Australia, Mexico
Hint: A failing salesman plans to hijack a plane and crash it into the White House.
Description: It’s 1974 and Sam Bicke has lost everything. His wife leaves him with his three kids, his boss fires him, his brother turns away from him, and the bank won’t give him any money to start anew. He tries to find someone to blame for his misfortunes and comes up with the President of the United States who he plans to murder.

Title: Shubh Mangal Savdhan
Hint: A groom discovers he has erectile dysfunction before his wedding.
Description: A couple fall in love but then the groom discovers that he suffers from erectile dysfunction.

Title: Ex Drummer
Country: Belgium, France, Italy, Netherlands, United Kingdom, Netherlands Antilles
Hint: Three disabled musicians recruit a writer for their band.
Description: Three musicians form a band. But they're not just any musicians: each has a disability that makes them particularly unsuitable for their instrument. The guitarist is deaf, the singer is tone deaf, and the bassist has a stiff arm. They lack a ___, and to respect the group's uniqueness, they turn to a famous writer who has never played the drums.

Title: Jaadugar
Hint: A small-time magician must lead his local football team to win.
Description: A small-time magician with zero interest in football must lead his local team to the finals of a tournament if he wishes to marry the love of his life.

Title: Goodbye Berlin
Hint: Two teenage outsiders take a stolen car on a summer road trip across Germany.
Description: Maik, a fourteen-year-old teenager, sets out on a road trip during summertime with Tschick, a new classmate, in a stolen car. The two share life changing experiences during the eventful journey.

Title: Kaho Naa... Pyaar Hai
Hint: A woman falls for a man who looks exactly like her murdered lover.
Description: Sonia and Rohit love each other but Rohit is mysteriously killed. When Sonia moves to New Zealand, she meets Raj, Rohit's lookalike who helps her trace Rohit's killer.

Title: Patrik, Age 1.5
Hint: A gay couple expecting to adopt a toddler gets a homophobic teenager instead.
Description: Göran and Sven have been cleared for adoption and they have a possibility to adopt a swedish orphan, ___. But when ___ arrives he turns out to be someone else, not the little boy they were expecting. A comma had been misplaced, and in comes a 15-year-old homophobic with a criminal past.

Title: Little Big Soldier
Hint: A farmer forced into conscription survives a battle and captures an enemy general.
Description: The story of a farmer forced into conscription, who has been looking to get out of the army ever since. His great chance arrives when he stumbles upon a wounded general from an enemy state, and he kidnaps him, intending to claim credit for the capture, which includes five acres of land, and most importantly, honorable discharge from the army.

Title: 2 States
Hint: A Punjabi boy and a Tamil girl try to convince their families to approve their marriage.
Description: A man and a woman come from two very different cultural backgrounds, and decide that they won't get married until they convince their parents. As feared, differences between the families pose a hurdle.

Title: Chup Chup Ke
Hint: A man presumed drowned poses as a deaf-mute servant to hide from his debts.
Description: After surviving a suicide attempt in which his family and fellow villagers believe he drowned, a debt-ridden man decides to start his life afresh in another village. He pretends to be mute and starts working for a rich man where he falls in love with his mute daughter.

Title: Fantomas
Hint: A master of disguise taunts a journalist and a bumbling police inspector.
Description: Fantômas is a man of many disguises. He uses maquillage as a weapon. He can impersonate anyone using an array of masks and can create endless confusion by constantly changing his appearance.

Title: Lebanon
Hint: An Israeli tank crew's terrifying first day of the 1982 war.
Description: During the First ___ War in 1982, a lone tank and a paratroopers platoon are dispatched to search a hostile town.

Title: El Angel
Hint: A baby-faced teenager becomes Argentina's most notorious serial killer.
Description: Buenos Aires, Argentina, 1971. Carlos Robledo Puch is a 19-year-old boy with an angelic face, but a vocational thief as well, who acts ruthlessly, without remorse. When he meets Ramón, they follow together a dark path of crime and death.

Title: Bhoot Police
Hint: Two ghost-hunting con-artist brothers face a real ghost in a Himalayan village.
Description: Two brothers Vibhooti and Chiraunji have fought their share of ghosts. However, a new case in a remote village forces them to rethink their own abilities and beliefs.

Title: Fashion
Hint: A small-town girl becomes a supermodel and falls from grace.
Description: A small-town girl finally realizes her dream of becoming a famous supermodel but soon finds out that there's a price for her glamorous new life.

Title: Appleseed
Hint: A soldier is brought to a utopian city built by cyborgs and clones.
Description: In a utopian society created at the end of World War III, a female warrior who has been plucked from the badlands begins to see cracks in this new facade. And what does this community have planned for the rest of humankind?

Title: Romantics Anonymous
Hint: Two painfully shy chocolate makers fall in love in Paris.
Description: What happens when a man and a woman share a common passion? They fall in love. Hint: A poor French teenager has an affair with a wealthy older Chinese man in 1920s Vietnam.
Description: A poor French teenage girl engages in an illicit affair with a wealthy Chinese heir in 1920s Saigon. For the first time in her young life she has control, and she wields it deftly over her besotted ___ throughout a series of clandestine meetings and torrid encounters.

Title: Mank
Hint: An alcoholic screenwriter races to finish the script of the greatest film ever made.
Description: 1930s Hollywood is reevaluated through the eyes of scathing social critic and alcoholic screenwriter Herman J. Mankiewicz as he races to finish the screenplay of Citizen Kane.

Title: Can't Buy Me Love
Hint: A nerd pays a cheerleader to pretend to date him for a month.
Description: Nerdy high schooler Ronald Miller rescues cheerleader Cindy Mancini from parental punishment after she accidentally destroys her mother's designer clothes. Ronald agrees to pay for the $1,000 outfit on one condition: that she will act as though they're a couple for an entire month. As the days pass, however, Cindy grows fond of Ronald, making him popular.

Title: Superman II
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The hero gives up his powers for love just as three Kryptonian villains arrive.
Description: Three Kryptonian criminals led by General Zod team up with Lex Luthor to conquer Earth, forcing a depowered ___ to regain his strength and stop them.

Title: Unstoppable
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A veteran engineer and a young conductor race to stop an unmanned runaway train carrying toxic chemicals.
Description: When a massive, unmanned locomotive roars out of control, the threat is more ominous than just a derailment. The train is laden with toxic chemicals, and an accident would decimate human life and cause an environmental disaster.

Title: Widows
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Four women whose robber husbands died in a heist attempt a job of their own to pay a debt.
Description: A police shootout leaves four thieves dead during an explosive armed robbery attempt in Chicago. Their ___ have nothing in common except a debt left behind by their spouses' criminal activities. Hoping to forge a future on their own terms, they join forces to pull off a heist.

Title: House on Haunted Hill
Hint: An eccentric millionaire offers five strangers money to survive a night in a creepy mansion where murders occurred.
Description: Frederick Loren invites five strangers to the party of a lifetime and offers each of them $10,000 if they can stay the night in the reportedly haunted house. Armed with a gun for protection, each guest arrives in a hearse and will either leave in it much richer…Or dead.

Title: Meet the Robinsons
Genres: Animation, Comedy, Family, Science Fiction, Adventure
Hint: An orphan inventor is whisked into the future by a mysterious boy.
Description: Lewis, a brilliant young inventor, is keen on creating a time machine to find his mother, who abandoned him in an orphanage. Things take a turn when he meets Wilbur Robinson and his family.

Title: A Ghost Story
Hint: A man in a white sheet silently haunts the house he shared with his wife.
Description: Recently deceased, a white-sheeted ___ returns to his suburban home to console his bereft wife, only to find that in his spectral state he has become unstuck in time, forced to watch passively as the life he knew and the woman he loves slowly slip away.

Title: Life
Hint: Astronauts on the International Space Station discover a rapidly evolving life form from Mars.
Description: The six-member crew of the International Space Station is tasked with studying a sample from Mars that may be the first proof of extra-terrestrial ___, which proves more intelligent than ever expected.

Title: Logan's Run
Hint: In a domed future city where everyone is executed at 30, an enforcer whose job is to hunt runners becomes one himself.
Description: In the 23rd century, inhabitants of a domed city freely experience all of life's pleasures — but no one is allowed to live past 30. Citizens can try for a chance at being "renewed" in a civic ceremony on their 30th birthday. Escape is the only other option.

Title: Chappie
Country: United States of America, South Africa
Hint: A police robot is reprogrammed to think and feel, and raised by gangsters.
Description: Every child comes into the world full of promise, and none more so than ___: he is gifted, special, a prodigy. Like any child, ___ will come under the influence of his surroundings—some good, some bad—and he will rely on his heart and soul to find his way in the world and become his own man. But there's one thing that makes ___ different from any one else: he is a robot.

Title: Young Guns
Hint: A gang of youthful gunslingers deputised to avenge their mentor's death become wanted outlaws in New Mexico.
Description: A group of young gunmen, led by Billy the Kid, become deputies to avenge the murder of the rancher who became their benefactor. But when Billy takes their authority too far, they become the hunted.

Title: Bolt
Hint: A TV dog who thinks he has superpowers crosses America to find his owner.
Description: ___ is the star of the biggest show in Hollywood. The only problem is, he thinks it's real. After he's accidentally shipped to New York City and separated from Penny, his beloved co-star and owner, ___ must harness all his "super powers" to find a way home.

Title: Dog Soldiers
Country: Luxembourg, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: British troops on a training exercise in the Scottish Highlands are hunted by werewolves.
Description: A band of soldiers is dispatched to war games deep in the woods. When they stumble across a rival team slaughtered in camp, they realize they're not alone.

Title: Yes Man
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A negative, lonely bank officer signs up for a self-help programme that forces him to agree to every opportunity.
Description: Carl Allen, a guy whose life is going nowhere, signs up for a self-help program based on one simple covenant: say ___ to everything…and anything.

Title: Judy
Hint: A legendary singer, thirty years after Oz, performs in London as her health crumbles.
Description: Thirty years after starring in 'The Wizard of Oz', beloved actress and singer ___ Garland arrives in London to perform sold-out shows at the Talk of the Town nightclub. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband.

Title: The House
Hint: Three eras, three stop-motion tales of the same strange house and its occupants.
Description: Across different eras, a poor family, an anxious developer and a fed-up landlady become tied to the same mysterious ___ in this animated dark comedy.

Title: The Outpost
Hint: US troops defend an indefensible base at the bottom of an Afghan valley against hundreds of Taliban.
Description: A small unit of U.S. soldiers, alone at the remote Combat ___ Keating, located deep in the valley of three mountains in Afghanistan, battles to defend against an overwhelming force of Taliban fighters in a coordinated attack.

Title: Dan in Real Life
Hint: An advice columnist falls for a woman who turns out to be his brother's girlfriend.
Description: Advice columnist ___ Burns is an expert on relationships, but somehow struggles to succeed as a brother, a son and a single parent to three precocious daughters. Things get even more complicated when ___ finds out that the woman he falls in love with is actually his brother's new girlfriend.

Title: Heartbreak Ridge
Hint: A hard-living Marine gunnery sergeant whips a platoon of slackers into shape before the invasion of Grenada.
Description: A hard-nosed, hard-living Marine gunnery sergeant clashes with his superiors and his ex-wife as he takes command of a spoiled recon platoon with a bad attitude.

Title: The Long Kiss Goodnight
Hint: A small-town schoolteacher with amnesia discovers she was a deadly assassin.
Description: Samantha Caine is a small-town schoolteacher and mom with no memory of her life before washing up on a beach eight years ago. After a car accident and a violent home invasion trigger flashes of her past, she discovers she used to be a deadly CIA assassin. Teaming up with a wisecracking private investigator, Samantha must return to her old ways to take down the people who tried to erase her.

Title: Working Girl
Hint: A secretary from Staten Island takes over her boss's identity to pitch a big deal.
Description: When a secretary's idea is stolen by her boss, she seizes an opportunity to steal it back by pretending she has her boss' job.

Title: Adventureland
Hint: A college graduate takes a summer job at a cheesy amusement park in 1987.
Description: It's the summer of 1987, and recent college grad James Brennan can't wait to begin his long-anticipated dream trip to Europe. Unfortunately, James' plans come to a screeching halt when his parents announce that they are unable to subsidize his trip. Forced to take a job at the local amusement park, James prepares for the worst summer ever, until he finds love with a captivating co-worker named Em.

Title: Innerspace
Hint: A miniaturized test pilot is accidentally injected into a hypochondriac.
Description: Test pilot Tuck Pendleton volunteers to test a special vessel for a miniaturization experiment. Accidentally injected into a neurotic hypochondriac, Jack Putter, Tuck must convince Jack to find his ex-girlfriend, Lydia Maxwell, to help him extract Tuck and his ship and re-enlarge them before his oxygen runs out.

Title: White Men Can't Jump
Hint: Two streetball hustlers, one Black and one not, team up on the courts of Venice Beach.
Description: Two street basketball hustlers try to con each other, then team up for a bigger score.

Title: While You Were Sleeping
Hint: A lonely transit worker is mistaken for a comatose man's fiancée.
Description: A transit worker pulls commuter Peter off railway tracks after he's mugged, but—while he's in a coma—his family mistakenly thinks she's Peter's fiancée, and she doesn't correct them. Things get more complicated when she falls for his brother, who's not quite sure that she's who she claims to be.

Title: The Family Man
Hint: A selfish Wall Street executive wakes up in an alternate life as a family man.
Description: Jack's lavish, fast-paced lifestyle changes one Christmas night when he stumbles into a grocery store holdup and disarms the gunman. The next morning he wakes up in bed lying next to Kate, his college sweetheart he left in order to pursue his career, and to the horrifying discovery that his former life no longer exists.

Title: Skin
Country: Brazil, Canada, China, United States of America
Hint: A former neo-Nazi tries to leave his violent past behind.
Description: A destitute young man, raised by racist skinheads and notorious among white supremacists, turns his back on hatred and violence to transform his life, with the help of a black activist and the woman he loves.

Title: Bringing Out the Dead
Hint: A burned-out New York paramedic is haunted by the ghosts of those he couldn't save.
Description: Once called "Father Frank" for his efforts to rescue lives, Frank Pierce sees the ghosts of those he failed to save around every turn. He has tried everything he can to get fired, calling in sick, delaying taking calls where he might have to face one more victim he couldn't help, yet cannot quit the job on his own.

Title: The Last Dragon
Hint: A martial artist searches for the master who can teach him the ultimate level.
Description: A young man searches for the "master" to obtain the final level of martial arts mastery known as the glow. Along the way he must fight an evil martial arts expert and rescue a beautiful singer from an obsessed music promoter.

Title: Draft Day
Hint: A football general manager makes a series of risky trades on the biggest day of the year.
Description: At the NFL ___, general manager Sonny Weaver has the opportunity to rebuild his team when he trades for the number one pick. He must decide what he's willing to sacrifice on a life-changing day for a few hundred young men with NFL dreams.

Title: News of the World
Hint: A Civil War veteran agrees to deliver a young girl to her relatives across Texas.
Description: A Texan traveling across the wild West bringing the ___ to local townspeople, agrees to help rescue a young girl who was kidnapped.

Title: Exam
Hint: Eight candidates for a dream job must answer a question that isn't on the paper.
Description: Eight talented candidates have reached the final stage of selection to join the ranks of a mysterious and powerful corporation. Entering a windowless room, where an armed guard keeps watch, they are given 80 minutes to answer one simple question.

Title: Shin Godzilla
Hint: Japanese bureaucrats struggle to respond as a giant monster attacks Tokyo.
Description: When a massive, gilled monster emerges from the deep and tears through the city, the government scrambles to save its citizens. A rag-tag team of volunteers cuts through a web of red tape to uncover the monster's weakness and its mysterious ties to a foreign superpower. But time is not on their side - the greatest catastrophe to ever befall the world is about to evolve right before their very eyes.

Title: Stripes
Hint: A slacker joins the Army and becomes a hero by accident.
Description: Hard-luck cabbie John Winger, directionless after being fired from his job and dumped by his girlfriend, enlists in the U.S. Army with his close pal, Russell Ziskey. After his barely satisfactory performance in basic training, the irreverent Winger emerges as the figurehead for a ragtag band of misfits.

Title: eXistenZ
Hint: A game designer is trapped in her own virtual reality game.
Description: A game designer on the run from assassins must play her latest virtual reality creation with a marketing trainee to determine if the game has been damaged.

Title: Long Shot
Hint: A journalist reunites with his childhood babysitter, now running for president.
Description: Journalist Fred Flarsky reunites with his childhood crush, Charlotte Field, now one of the most influential women in the world. As she prepares to make a run for the Presidency, Charlotte hires Fred as her speechwriter — much to the dismay of her trusted advisers.

Title: Lady Macbeth
Hint: A young bride in 1865 England is suffocated by her marriage and turns to murder.
Description: Rural England, 1865. Katherine, suffocated by her loveless marriage to a bitter man and restrained by his father's tyranny, unleashes an irresistible force within her, so powerful that she will stop at nothing to get what she wants.

Title: All the Money in the World
Hint: A billionaire refuses to pay the ransom for his kidnapped grandson.
Description: The story of the kidnapping of 16-year-old John Paul Getty III and the desperate attempt by his devoted mother to convince his billionaire grandfather Jean Paul Getty to pay the ransom.

Title: The Iceman
Hint: A contract killer for the mob leads a double life as a family man.
Description: The true story of Richard Kuklinski, the notorious contract killer and family man.

Title: Selena
Hint: A Mexican-American singer rises to fame before her tragic death.
Description: In this biographical drama, ___ Quintanilla is born into a musical Mexican-American family in Texas. Her father, Abraham, realizes that his young daughter is talented and begins performing with her at small venues. She finds success and falls for her guitarist, Chris Perez, who draws the ire of her father.

Title: One Hour Photo
Hint: A lonely technician at a supermarket print counter becomes dangerously obsessed with a family whose snapshots he develops.
Description: Sy Parrish has lovingly developed photographs for the Yorkin family since their son was a baby. But as the Yorkins' lives become fuller, Sy's only seems lonelier, until he eventually convinces himself he's part of their family. When Sy's picture-perfect fantasy collides with an ugly dose of reality, a bizarre and thrilling confrontation ensues.

Title: The Score
Hint: An aging safecracker hoping to retire is persuaded into one last heist in Montreal with a cocky young partner.
Description: An aging thief hopes to retire and live off his ill-gotten wealth when a young kid convinces him into doing one last heist.

Title: Role Models
Hint: Two energy drink salesmen are forced to mentor a nerdy LARPer and a foul-mouthed kid.
Description: Two salesmen trash a company truck on an energy drink-fueled bender. Upon their arrest, the court gives them a choice: do hard time or spend 150 service hours with a mentorship program. After one day with the kids, however, jail doesn't look half bad.

Title: The Stanford Prison Experiment
Hint: College students take part in a psychology study as guards and prisoners in 1971, and it spirals out of control.
Description: In 1971, ___ Professor Philip Zimbardo conducts a controversial psychology ___ in which college students pretend to be either prisoners or guards, but the proceedings soon get out of hand. Based on a true story.

Title: The Vow
Hint: A wife loses her memory in a car crash, and her husband tries to win her back.
Description: Happy young married couple Paige and Leo are, well, happy. Then a car accident puts Paige into a life-threatening coma. Upon awakening she has lost the previous five years of memories, including those of her beloved Leo, her wedding, a confusing relationship with her parents, or the ending of her relationship with her ex-fiance.

Title: Before We Go
Hint: Two strangers stranded in New York overnight spend the night wandering the city together.
Description: A chance encounter between two strangers in Grand Central Terminal sparks a life-changing, nighttime sojourn through New York City. They grow into each other's most trusted confidants when an evening of unexpected adventure forces them to confront their fears and take control of their lives.

Title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
Hint: A spoof of musician biopics follows a rock star's wild career across five decades.
Description: Following a childhood tragedy, ___ follows a long and winding road to music stardom. ___ perseveres through changing musical styles, an addiction to nearly every drug known and bouts of uncontrollable rage.

Title: Now and Then
Hint: Four childhood friends reunite and remember their eventful summer of 1970.
Description: Waxing nostalgic about the bittersweet passage from childhood to puberty, four childhood girlfriends — Teeny, Chrissy, Samantha and Roberta — recall the magical summer of 1970. During their walk down memory lane, they reconcile experiences with boys, secrets, bullies and more.

Title: Storks
Hint: A stork delivers a baby by accident after the company switched to shipping packages.
Description: ___ deliver babies…or at least they used to. Now they deliver packages for a global internet retail giant. Junior, the company’s top delivery stork, is about to be promoted when he accidentally activates the Baby Making Machine, producing an adorable and wholly unauthorized baby girl...

Title: Tenacious D in the Pick of Destiny
Hint: Two slacker rock musicians go on a quest to steal a legendary plectrum carved from Satan's tooth that grants rock superpowers.
Description: In Venice Beach, naive Midwesterner JB bonds with local slacker KG and they form the rock band ___ D. Setting out to become the world's greatest band is no easy feat, so they set out to steal what could be the answer to their prayers... a magical guitar ___ housed in a rock-and-roll museum some 300 miles away.

Title: 22 July
Hint: A survivor and a lawyer deal with the aftermath of a far-right terror attack in Norway.
Description: On ___ 2011, neo-Nazi terrorist Anders Behring Breivik murdered 77 young people attending a Labour Party Youth Camp on Utøya Island outside of Oslo. This three-part story focuses on the survivors, the political leadership of Norway, and the lawyers involved.

Title: Inland Empire
Country: United States of America, France, Poland
Hint: An actress gets lost inside a cursed film role in this nightmare from Lynch.
Description: When actress Nikki Grace gets the lead role in a cursed film, her world becomes more and more surreal, blending realities and ideas of infidelity, reincarnation, and supernatural forces.

Title: Athena
Hint: Three brothers face off in a burning French housing project after their youngest brother's death.
Description: Hours after the tragic death of their youngest brother in unexplained circumstances, three siblings have their lives thrown into chaos.

Title: Munich: The Edge of War
Hint: A British civil servant and a German diplomat, old university friends, try to prevent catastrophe at a tense 1938 summit.
Description: At the tense 1938 ___ Conference, former friends who now work for opposing governments become reluctant spies racing to expose a Nazi secret.

Title: Madagascar 3: Europe's Most Wanted
Hint: Zoo animals on the run join a traveling circus across the continent.
Description: Animal pals Alex, Marty, Melman, and Gloria are still trying to make it back to New York's Central Park Zoo. They are forced to take a detour to ___ to find the penguins and chimps who broke the bank at a Monte Carlo casino. When French animal-control officer Capitaine Chantel DuBois picks up their scent, Alex and company are forced to hide out in a traveling circus.

Title: Brother Bear
Hint: A young Inuit hunter is turned into a grizzly and must care for an orphaned cub.
Description: When an impulsive boy named Kenai is magically transformed into a ___, he must literally walk in another's footsteps until he learns some valuable life lessons. His courageous and often zany journey introduces him to a forest full of wildlife, including the lovable ___ cub Koda, hilarious moose Rutt and Tuke, woolly mammoths and rambunctious rams.

Title: Escape from Pretoria
Country: Australia, Canada, South Africa, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two white anti-apartheid activists build wooden keys to break out of a South African prison.
Description: South Africa, 1978. Tim Jenkin and Stephen Lee, two white political activists from the African National Congress imprisoned by the apartheid regime, put a plan in motion to escape from the infamous ___ Prison.

Title: The Ghost and the Darkness
Hint: An engineer and a hunter track two man-eating lions terrorizing a railway camp.
Description: Sir Robert Beaumont is behind schedule on a railroad in Africa. Enlisting noted engineer John Henry Patterson to right the ship, Beaumont expects results. Everything seems great until the crew discovers the mutilated corpse of the project's foreman, seemingly killed by a lion. After several more attacks, Patterson calls in famed hunter Charles Remington, who has finally met his match in the bloodthirsty lions.

Title: Street Kings
Hint: A veteran LA cop is implicated in the murder of his former partner.
Description: Tom Ludlow is a disillusioned L.A. Police Officer, rarely playing by the rules and haunted by the death of his wife. When evidence implicates him in the execution of a fellow officer, he is forced to go up against the cop culture he's been a part of his entire career, ultimately leading him to question the loyalties of everyone around him.

Title: I'm Not There
Hint: Six actors portray different sides of a legendary folk singer.
Description: Six actors portray six personas of music legend Bob Dylan in scenes depicting various stages of his life, chronicling his rise from unknown folksinger to international icon and revealing how Dylan constantly reinvented himself.

Title: The Pledge
Hint: A retired police chief obsessively pursues a child killer he promised a mother he would catch.
Description: A police chief, about to retire, pledges to help a woman find her daughter's killer.

Title: To Die For
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An ambitious weather girl will do anything to be a famous news anchor, including murdering her husband.
Description: Suzanne Stone wants to be a world-famous news anchor and she is willing to do anything to get what she wants. What she lacks in intelligence, she makes up for in cold determination and diabolical wiles. As she pursues her goal with relentless focus, she is forced to destroy anything and anyone that may stand in her way, regardless of the ultimate cost or means necessary.

Title: The Imaginarium of Doctor Parnassus
Hint: The leader of a traveling show made a deal with the devil for his daughter.
Description: After a carnival troupe saves his life, a man agrees to help its immortal leader collect five souls and win a bet with the devil.

Title: Odd Thomas
Hint: A short-order cook with psychic abilities sees ghostly creatures that signal coming death.
Description: In a California desert town, a short-order cook with clairvoyant abilities encounters a mysterious man with a link to dark, threatening forces.

Title: Horton Hears a Who!
Hint: An elephant discovers a speck of dust holds an entire tiny town and vows to protect it.
Description: An imaginative elephant named ___ a faint cry for help coming from a tiny speck of dust floating through the air. ___ suspects there may be life on that speck and despite a surrounding community, who thinks he has lost his mind, he is determined to save the tiny particle.

Title: Green Zone
Country: United States of America, France, Spain, United Kingdom, Japan
Hint: An Army officer searching for weapons of mass destruction in Baghdad uncovers a cover-up.
Description: During the U.S.-led occupation of Baghdad in 2003, Chief Warrant Officer Roy Miller and his team of Army inspectors are dispatched to find weapons of mass destruction believed to be stockpiled in the Iraqi desert.

Title: Patch Adams
Hint: An unconventional doctor uses humor and clown noses to treat his patients.
Description: The true story of Dr. Hunter "___" ___, who in the 1970s found that humor is the best medicine, and was willing to do just anything to make his patients laugh—even if it meant risking his own career.

Title: An Ideal Husband
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A respected politician is blackmailed over a past scandal in Victorian London.
Description: Sir Robert Chiltern is a successful government minister, well-off and with a loving wife. All this is threatened when Mrs Cheveley appears in London with damning evidence of a past misdeed. Sir Robert turns for help to his friend Lord Goring, an apparently idle philanderer and the despair of his father. Goring knows the lady of old, and, for him, takes the whole thing pretty seriously.

Title: The American President
Hint: A widowed US commander-in-chief falls for an environmental lobbyist, causing political chaos in an election year.
Description: Widowed U.S. president Andrew Shepherd, one of the world's most powerful men, can have anything he wants -- and what he covets most is Sydney Ellen Wade, a Washington lobbyist. But Shepherd's attempts at courting her spark wild rumors and decimate his approval ratings.

Title: History of the World: Part I
Hint: A comedic tour through the ages, from the Stone Age and the Roman Empire to the Spanish Inquisition and France in 1789.
Description: An uproarious version of history that proves nothing is sacred – not even the Roman Empire, the French Revolution and the Spanish Inquisition.

Title: Freeway
Hint: A teenage girl on her way to her grandmother's is picked up by a serial killer, in a twisted fairy tale.
Description: Following the arrest of her mother, Ramona, young Vanessa Lutz decides to go in search of her estranged grandmother. On the way, she is given a ride by school counselor Bob Wolverton. During the journey, Lutz begins to realize that Bob is the notorious I-5 Killer and manages to escape by shooting him several times.

Title: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back
Hint: Two stoners travel to Hollywood to stop a movie being made about them.
Description: When ___ learn that their comic-book alter egos, Bluntman and Chronic, have been sold to Hollywood as part of a big-screen movie that leaves them out of any royalties, the pair travels to Tinseltown to sabotage the production.

Title: Four Brothers
Hint: Adopted siblings reunite in Detroit to avenge their mother's murder.
Description: Four adopted brothers return to their Detroit hometown when their mother is murdered and vow to exact revenge on the killers.

Title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
Hint: A blind man and a deaf man are wanted for a murder they half-witnessed.
Description: A murder takes place in the shop of David Lyons, a deaf man who fails to ___ the gunshot being fired. Outside, blind man Wally Karue hears the shot, but cannot see the perpetrator. Both are arrested, but escape to form an unlikely partnership. Being chased by both the law AND the original killers, can the pair work together to outwit them all?

Title: Dead Men Don't Wear Plaid
Hint: A detective investigates a death, interacting with clips from classic film noir.
Description: Juliet Forrest is convinced that the reported death of her father in a mountain car crash was no accident. Her father was a prominent cheese scientist working on a secret recipe. To prove it was murder, she enlists the services of private eye Rigby Reardon. He finds a slip of paper containing a list of people who are 'The Friends and Enemies of Carlotta'.

Title: Sunshine Cleaning
Hint: Two sisters start a crime scene cleanup business to make ends meet.
Description: A single mother and her slacker sister find an unexpected way to turn their lives around in this off-beat dramatic comedy. In order to raise the tuition to send her young son to private school the mom starts an unusual business – a biohazard removal/crime scene clean-up service.

Title: Spies in Disguise
Hint: A suave secret agent is accidentally turned into a pigeon.
Description: Super spy Lance Sterling and scientist Walter Beckett are almost exact opposites. Lance is smooth, suave and debonair. Walter is… not. But what Walter lacks in social skills he makes up for in smarts and invention, creating the awesome gadgets Lance uses on his epic missions. But when events take an unexpected turn, Walter and Lance suddenly have to rely on each other in a whole new way.

Title: Worth
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A lawyer is tasked with deciding how much each 9/11 victim's life should be valued.
Description: Kenneth Feinberg, a powerful D.C. lawyer appointed Special Master of the 9/11 Fund, fights off the cynicism, bureaucracy, and politics associated with administering government funds and, in doing so, discovers what life is ___.

Title: The Burning Plain
Hint: Intersecting stories of love and tragedy along the border in New Mexico.
Description: A trailer is ___ in the middle of a ___. The bodies of two adulterous lovers are found. Scenes from both families, before and after the dramatic events, suggest an unusual connection between them. But what is their secret?

Title: The Brood
Hint: A psychologist's radical therapy causes his patient to give birth to murderous children.
Description: A man tries to uncover an unconventional psychologist's therapy techniques on his institutionalised wife, amidst a series of brutal murders.

Title: Ice Age: The Meltdown
Hint: Prehistoric animals must escape their valley before the melting glaciers flood it.
Description: Diego, Manny and Sid return in this sequel to the hit animated movie ___. This time around, the deep freeze is over, and the ___-covered earth is starting to melt, which will destroy the trio's cherished valley. The impending disaster prompts them to reunite and warn all the other beasts about the desperate situation.

Title: The Rescuers Down Under
Hint: Two mice from a rescue society fly to Australia to save a boy and a giant eagle from a poacher.
Description: A lawless poacher wants to capture a majestic and rare golden eagle, so he kidnaps the boy who knows where to find the bird. Not to worry -- the Rescue Aid Society's top agents, heroic mice Miss Bianca and Bernard, fly to Australia to save the day. Accompanying the fearless duo are bumbling albatross Wilbur and local field operative Jake the Kangaroo Rat.

Title: You Only Live Twice
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A secret agent investigates spacecraft being hijacked in orbit, in Japan.
Description: A mysterious spacecraft captures Russian and American space capsules and brings the two superpowers to the brink of war. James Bond investigates the case in Japan and comes face to face with his archenemy Blofeld.

Title: Motherless Brooklyn
Hint: A detective with Tourette's investigates his mentor's murder in 1950s New York.
Description: New York City, 1957. Lionel Essrog, a private detective living with Tourette syndrome, tries to solve the murder of his mentor and best friend, armed only with vague clues and the strength of his obsessive mind.

Title: Mr. Peabody & Sherman
Genres: Animation, Science Fiction, Comedy, Adventure, Family
Hint: A genius dog and his adopted boy travel through time in a machine.
Description: A young boy and his dog, who happens to have a genius-level IQ, spring into action when their time-machine is stolen and moments in history begin to be changed.

Title: Martha Marcy May Marlene
Hint: A young woman escapes a cult and struggles to readjust with her sister.
Description: After several years of living with a cult, ___ finally escapes and calls her estranged sister, Lucy, for help. ___ finds herself at the quiet Connecticut home Lucy shares with her new husband, Ted, but the memories of what she experienced in the cult make peace hard to find.

Title: Detroit Rock City
Hint: Four teens try anything to get to a sold-out 1978 Kiss concert.
Description: In 1978, a Kiss concert was an epoch-making event. For the four teen fans in ___ getting tickets to the sold-out show becomes the focal point of their existence. They'll do anything for tickets -- compete in a strip club's amateur-night contest, take on religious protesters, even rob a convenience store!

Title: Three Steps Above Heaven
Hint: A rebellious biker falls for a good girl in Barcelona.
Description: Babi, a sheltered upper-class girl, and Hache, a reckless rebel obsessed with illegal motorcycle races, fall into a forbidden love that pulls them deeper into passion and risk.

Title: To the Bone
Hint: A young woman with anorexia enters an unconventional treatment program.
Description: A young woman dealing with anorexia meets an unconventional doctor who challenges her to face her condition and embrace life.

Title: El Mariachi
Hint: A travelling guitar-playing singer is mistaken for a hitman who carries weapons in his instrument case.
Description: ___ just wants to play his guitar and carry on the family tradition. Unfortunately, the town he tries to find work in has another visitor, a killer who carries his guns in a guitar case. The drug lord and his henchmen mistake ___ for the killer, Azul, and chase him around town trying to kill him and get his guitar case.

Title: Jalla! Jalla!
Hint: A park worker in Sweden loves his girlfriend but is about to be married off.
Description: Roro, a foreign worker in Swedish parks, loves his girlfriend but is about to marry another girl to prevent her from being sent back to Lebanon. Meanwhile, Roro's best friend, Måns, has serious problems getting an erection.

Title: The Skeleton Twins
Hint: Estranged siblings who both nearly died on the same day reunite and confront their painful past.
Description: Estranged ___ Maggie and Milo coincidentally cheat death on the same day, prompting them to reunite and confront the reasons their lives went so wrong. As the ___' reunion reinvigorates them, they realize the key to fixing their lives may just lie in repairing their relationship.

Title: What If
Country: Canada, Ireland, United States of America
Hint: A medical school dropout falls for a woman with a long-term boyfriend.
Description: Medical-school dropout Wallace has been repeatedly burned by bad relationships. So while everyone around him, including his roommate Allan, seems to be finding the perfect partner, Wallace decides to put his love life on hold. It is then that he meets Chantry, an animator who lives with her longtime boyfriend Ben. Wallace and Chantry form an instant connection, striking up a close friendship.

Title: Unknown
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, France, Germany
Hint: A man wakes from a coma to find someone else has taken his identity.
Description: A man awakens from a coma, only to discover that someone has taken on his identity and that no one, (not even his wife), believes him. With the help of a young woman, he sets out to prove who he is.

Title: Enemy Mine
Hint: A human pilot and an alien soldier stranded on a hostile planet must work together to survive.
Description: A soldier from Earth crashlands on an alien world after sustaining battle damage. Eventually he encounters another survivor, but from the enemy species he was fighting; they band together to survive on this hostile world. In the end the human finds himself caring for his enemy in a completely unexpected way.

Title: The First Time
Hint: Two high school students fall in love over one weekend.
Description: A spark of attraction smolders, then ignites, between two teens from different high schools who meet by chance at a party.

Title: Calibre
Hint: Two friends on a hunting trip in the Scottish Highlands have an accident that triggers a nightmare.
Description: Two lifelong friends head up to an isolated Scottish Highlands village for a weekend hunting trip that descends into a never-ending nightmare as they attempt to cover up a horrific hunting accident.

Title: Dead Calm
Hint: A couple at sea rescues a man from a sinking ship, and he turns out to be a killer.
Description: An Australian couple takes a sailing trip in the Pacific to get over the recent loss of their son. While on the open sea, they come across a sinking ship with one survivor who is not at all what he seems.

Title: Dead Again
Hint: A detective helps an amnesiac woman who may be the reincarnation of a murder victim.
Description: In 1949, composer Roman Strauss is executed for the murder of his wife. In 1990s Los Angeles, a detective comes across a mute amnesiac woman who is somehow linked to the Strauss murder.

Title: Zombie
Hint: A boat full of the walking dead drifts into New York harbor.
Description: After an abandoned boat sails into New York harbor with a ___ aboard, a reporter teams up with the daughter of the boat's missing captain to investigate the island where he was last seen conducting research—the site of an alleged ___ outbreak.

Title: The War of the Roses
Hint: A couple's divorce turns into an all-out battle over their house.
Description: Barbara and Oliver Rose live happily as a married couple. When Barbara starts to wonder what life would be like without Oliver and likes what she sees, the two begin a campaign to force each other to leave their house, with their divorce lawyer D'Amato caught in the middle.

Title: EO
Hint: A grey donkey travels across Europe, encountering good and bad people, in an experimental film.
Description: The world is a mysterious place when seen through the eyes of an animal. ___, a grey donkey with melancholic eyes, meets good and bad people on his life’s path, experiences joy and pain, endures the wheel of fortune randomly turn his luck into disaster and his despair into unexpected bliss. But not even for a moment does he lose his innocence.

Title: Joe
Hint: A wealthy ad executive and a racist factory worker go on a killing spree.
Description: After murdering his daughter's drug-dealing boyfriend, a wealthy ad executive stumbles into a bar and strikes up an uneasy alliance with ___ Curran, a drunken bigot with a bloodlust who works at a local factory.

Title: Sea of Love
Hint: A detective falls for a suspect in a lonely-hearts murder case.
Description: Seen-it-all New York detective Frank Keller is unsettled - he has done twenty years on the force and could retire, and he hasn't come to terms with his wife leaving him for a colleague. Joining up with an officer from another part of town to investigate a series of murders linked by the lonely hearts columns he finds he is getting seriously and possibly dangerously involved with Helen, one of the main suspects.

Title: Goon
Hint: A retired opera singer takes in three young singers in Chengdu.
Description: In Chengdu, China, a retired female opera singer named Master Chang takes in a trio of young tenants into her boarding home. The tenants include a rock singer and a college student who has run away from home.

Title: The Mechanic
Hint: An aging hitman trains an ambitious young apprentice, who has his own plans.
Description: Arthur Bishop is a veteran hit man who, owing to his penchant for making his targets' deaths seem like accidents, thinks himself an artist. It's made him very rich, but as he hits middle age, he's so depressed and lonely that he takes on one of his victim's sons, Steve McKenna, as his apprentice. Arthur puts him through a rigorous training period and brings him on several hits.

Title: Serial Mom
Hint: A seemingly perfect suburban homemaker is secretly a killer who murders people for small offences like wearing white after Labour Day.
Description: Beverly is the perfect happy homemaker, along with her doting husband and two children, but this nuclear family just might explode when her fascination with serial killers collides with her ever-so-proper code of ethics.

Title: Bernie
Hint: A beloved small-town mortician befriends a wealthy widow and kills her.
Description: In small-town Texas, affable and popular mortician ___ Tiede strikes up a friendship with Marjorie Nugent, a wealthy widow well known for her sour attitude. When she becomes controlling and abusive, ___ goes to great lengths to remove himself from her grasp.

Title: The Importance of Being Earnest
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two young gentlemen in 1890s England use the same fake name to woo their loves.
Description: Two young gentlemen living in 1890s England use the same pseudonym ('Ernest') on the sly, which is fine until they both fall in love with women using that name, which leads to a comedy of mistaken identities.

Title: Tristan + Isolde
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young knight and an Irish princess fall in love, but she is married to his king.
Description: An affair between the second in line to Britain's throne and the princess of the feuding Irish spells doom for the young lovers.

Title: Untamed Heart
Hint: A waitress falls for a shy busboy who believes he has a transplanted ape organ.
Description: Caroline, a young waitress who seems to have bad taste in men, is on her way home one night when thugs attempt to rape her. Adam, the mysterious busboy who works at the same diner, helps fight off the assailants, and she begins a relationship with him -- but not all their fellow Minnesotans are happy for them.

Title: Rise of the Footsoldier
Hint: A British football hooligan climbs into the world of organized crime.
Description: ___ follows the inexorable rise of Carlton Leach from one of the most feared generals of the football terraces to becoming a member of a notorious gang of criminals who rampaged their way through London and Essex in the late eighties and early nineties.

Title: Night Train to Lisbon
Hint: A Swiss teacher saves a woman on a bridge and follows a mysterious book to Portugal, unravelling the life of a resistance poet.
Description: Raimund Gregorius, having saved a beautiful Portuguese woman from leaping to her death, stumbles upon a mesmerizing book by a Portuguese author, which compels him to suddenly abandon the boring life he has led for years and to embark on an enthralling adventure.

Title: Magic
Hint: A struggling magician becomes a hit with a foul-mouthed ventriloquist act, but the vicious dummy seems to take control.
Description: A ventriloquist is at the mercy of his vicious dummy while he tries to renew a romance with his high school sweetheart.

Title: Bell, Book and Candle
Hint: A modern-day witch falls for her neighbor in New York.
Description: Gillian Holroyd, a modern-day witch, becomes smitten with her handsome upstairs neighbor, Shep Henderson. Using her magical powers, she casts a love spell on him, only to face unexpected complications when genuine feelings emerge, threatening her supernatural abilities.

Title: The Last Full Measure
Hint: A Pentagon investigator looks into why a Vietnam hero never received his Medal of Honor.
Description: The incredible true story of Vietnam War hero William H. Pitsenbarger, a U.S. Air Force Pararescuemen medic who personally saved over sixty men.

Title: Danger Close: The Battle of Long Tan
Hint: Australian troops face thousands of enemy soldiers in a rubber plantation in Vietnam.
Description: Vietnam War, 1966. Australia and New Zealand send troops to support the United States and South Vietnamese in their fight against the communist North. Soldiers are very young men, recruits and volunteers who have never been involved in a combat. On August 18th, members of Delta Company will face the true horror of a ruthless battle among the trees of a rubber plantation called Long Tân. They are barely a hundred.

Title: Elizabeth: The Golden Age
Hint: A queen faces threats from Spain and from her own heart.
Description: When Queen ___ reign is threatened by ruthless familial betrayal and Spain's invading army, she and her shrewd adviser must act to safeguard the lives of her people.

Title: Always Be My Maybe
Hint: Childhood friends reunite after 15 years in San Francisco.
Description: Reunited after 15 years, famous chef Sasha and hometown musician Marcus feel the old sparks of attraction, but struggle to adapt to each other's worlds.

Title: Man Up
Hint: A single woman is mistaken for a man's blind date and plays along.
Description: A 34 year old single woman, Nancy, hung-over again, exhausted by the endless fruitless set ups by her friends, traveling across London to toast another 10 years of her parent's successful happy magical marriage runs in with a 40 year old divorcee, Jack, who mistakes her for his 24 year old blind date.

Title: Bugsy Malone
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Rival gangsters battle with custard pies in a children's musical.
Description: New York, 1929, a war rages between two rival gangsters, Fat Sam and Dandy Dan. Dan is in possession of a new and deadly weapon, the dreaded "splurge gun". As the custard pies fly, ___, an all-round nice guy, falls for Blousey Brown, a singer at Fat Sam's speakeasy. His designs on her are disrupted by the seductive songstress Tallulah who wants ___ for herself.

Title: Bhediya
Hint: A man bitten by a wolf transforms during full moons in Arunachal Pradesh.
Description: Inspired by legendary folklore rooted in Arunachal Pradesh, ___ tells the story of Bhaskar, a man who gets bitten by a mythical wolf and begins to transform into the creature himself. As Bhaskar and his ragtag buddies try to find answers, he is worried that the monster in him will wipe out human existence in the local town.

Title: Lost and Delirious
Hint: A girl at a Canadian boarding school befriends two lovers whose relationship falls apart.
Description: After starting at an upmarket boarding school, a teenage girl forms close friendships with her two older roommates. However, when she discovers that her new friends are lovers she finds herself caught in a complicated situation.

Title: The East
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An operative infiltrates an eco-terrorist group and starts to sympathize.
Description: An operative for an elite private intelligence firm finds her priorities irrevocably changed after she is tasked with infiltrating an anarchist group known for executing covert attacks upon major corporations.

Title: Bulworth
Hint: A suicidal senator takes out a contract on his own life and starts telling the truth.
Description: A suicidally disillusioned liberal politician puts a contract out on himself and takes the opportunity to be bluntly honest with his voters by affecting the rhythms and speech of hip-hop music and culture.

Title: Harsh Times
Hint: An ex-Army Ranger slips back into crime in Los Angeles.
Description: Jim Davis is an ex-Army Ranger who finds himself slipping back into his old life of petty crime after a job offer from the LAPD evaporates. His best friend is pressured by his girlfriend Sylvia to find a job, but Jim is more interested in hanging out and making cash from small heists, while trying to get a law enforcement job so he can marry his Mexican girlfriend.

Title: Collateral Beauty
Hint: A grieving man writes letters to Love, Time and Death.
Description: Retreating from life after a tragedy, a man questions the universe by writing to Love, Time and Death. Receiving unexpected answers, he begins to see how these things interlock and how even loss can reveal moments of meaning and beauty.

Title: The Map of Tiny Perfect Things
Hint: Two teens trapped in an endless time loop hunt for the day's small flawless moments.
Description: Two teenagers trapped in an endless time loop set out to find all the ___ things that make that one day perfect.

Title: Wildlife
Hint: A teen watches his parents' marriage fall apart in 1960s Montana.
Description: 14-year-old Joe is the only child of Jeanette and Jerry — a housewife and a golf pro — in a small town in 1960s Montana. Nearby, an uncontrolled forest fire rages close to the Canadian border, and when Jerry loses his job (and his sense of purpose) he decides to join the cause of fighting the fire, leaving his wife and son to fend for themselves.

Title: Kiss Me
Hint: Two women fall in love at their parents' engagement party.
Description: After they meet at their parent's engagement party, Mia and Frida are intrigued by and attracted to one another, despite Mia's own upcoming engagement to Tim. Mia must decide whether to continue her life with Tim or to follow her heart with Frida.

Title: The Diary of a Teenage Girl
Hint: A 15-year-old in 1970s San Francisco begins an affair with her mother's boyfriend.
Description: Minnie Goetze is a 15-year-old aspiring comic-book artist, coming of age in the haze of the 1970s in San Francisco. Insatiably curious about the world around her, Minnie is a pretty typical teenage girl. Oh, except that she’s sleeping with her mother’s boyfriend.

Title: Bottle Shock
Hint: A wine expert holds a blind tasting that puts California on the map.
Description: Paris-based wine expert Steven Spurrier heads to California in search of cheap wine that he can use for a blind taste test in the French capital. Stumbling upon the Napa Valley, the stuck-up Englishman is shocked to discover a winery turning out top-notch chardonnay. Determined to make a name for himself, he sets about getting the booze back to Paris.

Title: Hitchcock
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A director struggles to make a famous horror film.
Description: Following his great success with "North by Northwest," director Alfred ___ makes a daring choice for his next project: an adaptation of Robert Bloch's novel "Psycho." When the studio refuses to back the picture, ___ decides to pay for it himself in exchange for a percentage of the profits. His wife, Alma Reville, has serious reservations about the film but supports him nonetheless.

Title: Coffy
Hint: A nurse seeks revenge on the drug dealers who hooked her younger sister.
Description: After her younger sister gets involved in drugs and is severely injured by contaminated heroin, a nurse sets out on a mission of vengeance and vigilante justice, killing drug dealers, pimps, and mobsters who cross her path.

Title: The Exception
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Germany, Belgium
Hint: A German soldier is assigned to guard the exiled Kaiser and falls for a Jewish spy.
Description: Nothing is as it seems in this riveting World War 2 thriller as a wary soldier goes to investigate a mysterious German monarch at his secluded mansion, leading him into a web of deceit and a dangerous love affair with a local Jewish woman.

Title: Young Sherlock Holmes
Hint: The detective and his partner meet as boys at a boarding school.
Description: ___ and Dr. Watson meet as boys in an English Boarding school. ___ is known for his deductive ability even as a youth, amazing his classmates with his abilities. When they discover a plot to murder a series of British business men by an Egyptian cult, they move to stop it.

Title: Nine Days
Hint: A man interviews souls for the chance to be born.
Description: A bureaucrat interviews five souls to decide which of them will be given a life on Earth. But he soon faces an existential challenge of his own.

Title: A Prayer Before Dawn
Country: Cambodia, China, France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An English boxer is incarcerated in a Thai prison and fights to survive.
Description: The amazing true story of Billy Moore, an English boxer incarcerated in Thailand’s most notorious prison. Thrown into a world of drugs and violence, he finds his best chance to escape is to fight his way out in prison Muay Thai tournaments.

Title: Devil in a Blue Dress
Hint: An unemployed WWII veteran in 1940s LA is hired to find a missing woman.
Description: In late 1940s Los Angeles, Easy Rawlins is an unemployed black World War II veteran with few job prospects. At a bar, Easy meets DeWitt Albright, a mysterious white man looking for someone to investigate the disappearance of a missing white woman named Daphne Monet, who he suspects is hiding out in one of the city's black jazz clubs.

Title: Six Degrees of Separation
Hint: A con artist poses as the son of a famous actor.
Description: The story of a young, gay, black, con artist who, posing as the son of Sidney Poitier, cunningly maneuvers his way into the lives of a white, upper-class New York family.

Title: Arctic
Hint: A man stranded in the frozen north must make a choice when a helicopter crashes.
Description: A man stranded in the ___ is finally about to receive his long awaited rescue. However, after a tragic accident, his opportunity is lost and he must then decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his camp or embark on a deadly trek through the unknown for potential salvation.

Title: Romper Stomper
Hint: Nazi skinheads in Melbourne attack Vietnamese immigrants and turn on each other.
Description: Nazi skinheads in Melbourne take out their anger on local Vietnamese, who are seen as threatening racial purity. Finally the Vietnamese have had enough and confront the skinheads in an all-out confrontation, sending the skinheads running. A woman who is prone to epileptic seizures joins the skins' merry band, and helps them on their run from justice, but is her affliction also a sign of impurity?

Title: The Boys in the Band
Hint: A birthday party for gay men in New York turns bitter.
Description: A witty, perceptive and devastating look at the personal agendas and suppressed revelations swirling among a group of gay men in Manhattan. Harold is celebrating a birthday, and his friend Michael has drafted some other friends to help commemorate the event.

Title: Fantastic Voyage
Hint: A submarine is shrunk and injected into a scientist's body.
Description: In order to save an assassinated scientist, a submarine and its crew are shrunk to microscopic size and injected into his bloodstream.

Title: Capricorn One
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: NASA fakes a Mars landing, and the astronauts are forced to flee.
Description: In order to protect the reputation of the American space program, a team of NASA administrators turn the first Mars mission into a phony Mars landing. Under threat of harm to their families the astronauts play their part in the deception on a staged set in a deserted military base. But once the real ship returns to Earth and burns up on re-entry, the astronauts become liabilities.

Title: The Boxtrolls
Hint: An orphan raised by box-wearing trolls in the sewers must save them from an exterminator.
Description: An orphaned boy raised by underground creatures called ___ comes up from the sewers and out of his box to save his family and the town from the evil exterminator, Archibald Snatcher.

Title: The Idiots
Hint: A group of people pretend to be mentally disabled.
Description: A group of people gather at a Copenhagen suburban home to break all the limitations and to bring out the 'inner idiot' in themselves.

Title: The Golden Voyage of Sinbad
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A sailor and his crew race a sorcerer for a magical tablet.
Description: ___ and his crew intercept a homunculus carrying a ___ tablet. Koura, the creator of the homunculus and practitioner of evil magic, wants the tablet back and pursues ___. Meanwhile, ___ meets the Vizier who has another part of the interlocking ___ map, and they mount a quest across the seas to solve the riddle of the map.

Title: The Alamo
Hint: A small band of Texan soldiers defend a mission against the Mexican army in 1836.
Description: The legendary true story of a small band of soldiers who sacrificed their lives in hopeless combat against a massive army in order to prevent a tyrant from smashing the new Republic of Texas.

Title: Denial
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A historian must prove the Holocaust happened in a libel case against a denier.
Description: Acclaimed writer and historian Deborah E. Lipstadt must battle for historical truth to prove the Holocaust actually occurred when David Irving, a renowned denier, sues her for libel.

Title: Swan Song
Hint: An aging hairdresser escapes his nursing home to do one last job.
Description: An aging hairdresser escapes his nursing home to embark on an odyssey across his small town to style a dead woman's hair for her funeral, rediscovering his sparkle along the way.

Title: The Prince of Tides
Hint: A troubled man talks to his sister's psychiatrist about their past.
Description: A troubled Southern man talks to his suicidal sister's psychiatrist about their family history and falls in love with her (and New York City) in the process.

Title: Mr. Holmes
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An aging detective struggles with dementia to solve one last case.
Description: In 1947, long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock ___ grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement.

Title: Kodachrome
Hint: A man drives his dying father to develop old film rolls.
Description: Matt Ryder is convinced to drive his estranged and dying father Benjamin Ryder cross country to deliver four old rolls of ___ film to the last lab in the world that can develop them before it shuts down for good. Along with Ben's nurse Zooey, the three navigate a world changing from analogue to digital while trying to put the past behind them.

Title: Poolhall Junkies
Hint: A retired pool hustler returns to the game to face his former mentor.
Description: A retired pool hustler is forced to pick up the stick again when his brother starts a game he can't finish.

Title: Victoria & Abdul
Country: India, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An aging British queen strikes up an unlikely friendship with a young Indian clerk.
Description: Queen ___ strikes up an unlikely friendship with a young Indian clerk named ___ Karim.

Title: Middle Men
Hint: An internet entrepreneur wrestles with his conscience as he builds an online porn empire.
Description: Chronicles Jack Harris, one of the pioneers of internet commerce, as he wrestles with his morals and struggles not to drown in a sea of conmen, mobsters, drug addicts, and pornstars.

Title: Florence Foster Jenkins
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A wealthy New York socialite dreams of being an opera singer, despite her terrible voice.
Description: The story of ___, a New York heiress, who dreamed of becoming an opera singer, despite having a terrible singing voice.

Title: Ms .45
Hint: A mute seamstress becomes a vigilante after two assaults.
Description: After being attacked and raped twice in one day, a timid, mute seamstress becomes a violent agent of revenge for wronged women.

Title: Rendition
Hint: An Egyptian terrorism suspect disappears on a flight from South Africa to Washington.
Description: When an Egyptian terrorism suspect "disappears" on a flight from Africa to Washington DC, his American wife and a CIA analyst find themselves caught up in a struggle to secure his release from a secret detention facility somewhere outside the US.

Title: Under the Shadow
Hint: A mother and daughter are haunted during the Iran-Iraq War.
Description: After Shideh's building is hit by a missile during the Iran-Iraq War, a superstitious neighbor suggests that the missile was cursed and might be carrying malevolent Middle-Eastern spirits. She becomes convinced a supernatural force within the building is attempting to possess her daughter Dorsa, and she has no choice but to confront these forces if she is to save her daughter and herself.

Title: Anonymous
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A conspiracy theory about who really wrote Shakespeare's plays.
Description: Set against the backdrop of the succession of Queen Elizabeth I, and the Essex Rebellion against her, the story advances the theory that it was in fact Edward De Vere, Earl of Oxford who penned Shakespeare's plays.

Title: The Football Factory
Hint: A bored young Londoner is drawn into the violence of soccer hooliganism.
Description: The ___ is more than just a study of the English obsession with football violence, it's about men looking for armies to join, wars to fight and places to belong. A forgotten culture of Anglo Saxon males fed up with being told they're not good enough and using their fists as a drug they describe as being more potent than sex and drugs put together.

Title: We Own the Night
Hint: A nightclub manager's father and brother are cops, and he must choose a side against the Russian mob.
Description: A New York nightclub manager tries to save his brother and father from Russian mafia hitmen.

Title: Year of the Dragon
Country: United States of America, Canada, Thailand
Hint: A racist cop is obsessed with a Chinese gangster.
Description: In New York, racist Capt. Stanley White becomes obsessed with destroying a Chinese-American drug ring run by Joey Tai, an up-and-coming young gangster as ambitious as he is ruthless.

Title: T-34
Hint: Russian soldiers escape a Nazi prison camp in a tank.
Description: In 1944, a courageous group of Russian soldiers managed to escape from German captivity in a half-destroyed legendary ___ tank. Those were the times of unforgettable bravery, fierce fighting, unbreakable love, and legendary miracles.

Title: Foul Play
Hint: A librarian and a cop uncover a plot to assassinate the Pope in San Francisco.
Description: A shy San Francisco librarian and a bumbling cop fall in love as they solve a crime involving albinos, dwarves, and the Catholic Church.

Title: Fellini Satyricon
Hint: A young man's surreal adventures in ancient Rome, in a bizarre, decadent epic.
Description: After his young lover, Gitone, leaves him for another man, Encolpio decides to kill himself, but a sudden earthquake destroys his home before he has a chance to do so. Now wandering around Rome in the time of Nero, Encolpio encounters one bizarre and surreal scene after another.

Title: The Life Ahead
Hint: A Holocaust survivor takes in a young Senegalese boy who robbed her.
Description: In seaside Italy, a Holocaust survivor with a daycare business takes in a 12-year-old street kid who recently robbed her.

Title: Spider
Hint: A man with schizophrenia relives his childhood in London.
Description: A mentally disturbed man takes residence in a halfway house. His mind gradually slips back into the realm created by his illness, where he replays a key part of his childhood.

Title: Red Sun
Hint: A Japanese samurai and an outlaw team up to recover a stolen sword in the Old West.
Description: In 1870, Japanese ambassador Sakaguchi and his entourage travel by train to Washington to deliver a valuable sword to the President of the United States, a gift from the Emperor of Japan. On board the same train are two robbers, Link and Gauche, ready to make their move…

Title: Jersey Boys
Hint: The rise of a 1960s doo-wop pop group from working-class Newark, and the cost of fame.
Description: A musical biopic of the Four Seasons—the rise, the tough times and personal clashes, and the ultimate triumph of a group of friends whose music became symbolic of a generation. Far from a mere tribute concert, it gets to the heart of the relationships at the centre of the group, with a special focus on frontman Frankie Valli, the small kid with the big falsetto.

Title: Slaughterhouse-Five
Hint: A World War II veteran becomes unstuck in time, bouncing between Dresden, suburbia and an alien zoo.
Description: Billy Pilgrim, a veteran of the Second World War, finds himself mysteriously detached from time, so that he is able to travel, without being able to help it, from the days of his childhood to those of his peculiar life on a distant planet called Tralfamadore, passing through his bitter experience as a prisoner of war in the German city of Dresden, over which looms the inevitable shadow of an unspeakable tragedy.

Title: Don't Worry, He Won't Get Far on Foot
Hint: A wheelchair-bound alcoholic finds sobriety and fame drawing irreverent cartoons.
Description: On the rocky path to sobriety after a life-changing accident, John Callahan discovers the healing power of art, willing his injured hands into drawing hilarious, often controversial cartoons, which bring him a new lease on life.

Title: The Wild Geese
Hint: A group of aging mercenaries are hired to rescue a deposed African leader.
Description: A British multinational company seeks to overthrow a vicious dictator in central Africa. It hires a band of (largely aged) mercenaries in London and sends them in to save the virtuous but imprisoned opposition leader who is also critically ill and due for execution.

Title: Quartet
Hint: Retired opera singers in a home for musicians are reunited for a gala concert.
Description: Cissy, Reggie, and Wilf are in a home for retired musicians. Every year, there is a concert to celebrate Composer Giuseppe Verdi's birthday and they take part. Jean, who used to be married to Reggie, arrives at the home and disrupts their equilibrium. She still acts like a diva, but she refuses to sing. Still, the show must go on, and it does.

Title: The Debt
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A former Mossad agent's past mission to capture a Nazi war criminal comes back to haunt her.
Description: Rachel Singer is a former Mossad agent who tried to capture a notorious Nazi war criminal – the Surgeon of Birkenau – in a secret Israeli mission that ended with his death on the streets of East Berlin.
