Now, 30 years later, a man claiming to be the doctor has surfaced, and Rachel must return to Eastern Europe to uncover the truth.

Title: Bugsy
Hint: A New York gangster heads to the desert and dreams of building a casino in Las Vegas.
Description: New York gangster Ben '___' Siegel takes a brief business trip to Los Angeles. A sharp-dressing womanizer with a foul temper, Siegel doesn't hesitate to kill or maim anyone crossing him. In L.A. the life, the movies, and most of all strong-willed Virginia Hill detain him while his family wait back home. Then a trip to a run-down gambling joint at a spot in the desert known as Las Vegas gives him his big idea.

Title: Bleed for This
Hint: A champion boxer breaks his neck in a car crash and fights to return to the ring.
Description: The inspirational story of World Champion Boxer Vinny Pazienza, who after a near fatal car crash, which left him not knowing if he'd ever walk again, made one of sports most incredible comebacks.

Title: Harper
Hint: A wisecracking private eye searches for a missing millionaire in Southern California.
Description: ___ is a cynical private eye in the best tradition of Bogart. He even has Bogie's Baby hiring him to find her missing husband, getting involved along the way with an assortment of unsavory characters and an illegal-alien smuggling ring.

Title: Taxidermia
Hint: Three grotesque generations: a lustful orderly, a champion speed-eater and a taxidermist.
Description: Set over three generations and beginning with a sexually frustrated orderly during WWII who relieves his tensions in the most outlandish, gross ways. The result of his liaison is a glutton who grows up to be a champion speed eater. He produces a child who becomes obsessed with taxidermy.

Title: Fair Game
Country: United States of America, United Arab Emirates
Hint: A CIA officer's cover is blown by the government after her husband criticizes the Iraq War.
Description: A devoted wife and mother leads a secret life as a CIA agent until her husband’s article exposes a scandal, putting her identity and loved ones at risk. As her world crumbles, she must navigate the fallout of her double life.

Title: Simon Birch
Hint: A tiny boy with a big faith believes God has a heroic purpose for him.
Description: ___ and Joe Wenteworth are boys who have a reputation for being oddballs. Joe never knew his father, and his mother, Rebecca, is keeping her lips sealed no matter how much he protests. ___, meanwhile, is an 11-year-old dwarf whose outsize personality belies his small stature.

Title: Beast
Country: Iceland, United States of America, Japan, South Africa
Hint: A widowed doctor and his daughters are hunted by a rogue lion in South Africa.
Description: A recently widowed man and his two teenage daughters travel to a game reserve in South Africa. However, their journey of healing soon turns into a fight for survival when a bloodthirsty lion starts to stalk them.

Title: Quick Change
Hint: A bank robber in a clown suit pulls off a heist but can't escape New York City.
Description: With the aid of his girlfriend, Phyllis Potter, and best friend, Loomis, Grimm enters a Manhattan bank dressed as a clown, creates a hostage situation and executes a flawless robbery. The only thing left for the trio to do is make their getaway out of the city and to the airport. It sounds simple enough, but it seems that fate deserts them immediately after the bank heist.

Title: Family Plot
Hint: A fake psychic and her cabbie boyfriend cross paths with a pair of kidnapping jewel thieves.
Description: Spiritualist Blanche Tyler and her cab-driving boyfriend encounter a pair of serial kidnappers while trailing a missing heir in California.

Title: Penguin Bloom
Hint: A family rescues an injured magpie that helps their paralyzed mother heal.
Description: When an unlikely ally enters the ___ family's world in the form of an injured baby magpie they name ___, the bird’s arrival makes a profound difference in the struggling family’s life.

Title: Monos
Country: Argentina, Colombia, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands, Sweden, Switzerland, Uruguay
Hint: Teenage guerrillas on a remote Colombian mountaintop watch over an American hostage and a dairy cow, until chaos erupts.
Description: On a faraway mountaintop, eight kids with guns watch over a hostage and a conscripted milk cow.

Title: Battle of the Bulge
Hint: Allied soldiers face a surprise German offensive in the winter of 1944.
Description: In the winter of 1944, the Allied Armies stand ready to invade Germany at the coming of a New Year. To prevent it, Hitler orders an all-out offensive to re-take French territory and capture the major port city of Antwerp.

Title: Beyond the Lights
Hint: A rising pop star on the verge of collapse finds love with the cop who saves her.
Description: Noni Jean is a hot new rising star. But not all is what it seems, and the pressure causes Noni to nearly fall apart - until she meets Kaz Nicol, a promising young cop and aspiring politician who's been assigned to her detail. Can Kaz's love give Noni the courage to find her own voice and break free to become the artist she was meant to be?

Title: How to Marry a Millionaire
Hint: Three Manhattan models rent a luxury apartment to trap rich husbands.
Description: Three women set out to find eligible millionaires to marry, but find true love in the process.

Title: Truth
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A TV news producer and her anchor investigate the US president's National Guard service and face a backlash.
Description: As a renowned producer and close associate of Dan Rather, Mary Mapes believes she’s broken the biggest story of the 2004 election: revelations of a sitting U.S. President’s military service. But when allegations come pouring in, sources change their stories, document authenticity is questioned, and the casualties begin to mount.

Title: One Chance
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A shy mobile phone salesman from Wales dreams of singing opera.
Description: This film follows the remarkable and inspirational true story of Paul Potts, a shy, bullied shop assistant by day and an amateur opera singer by night.

Title: Othello
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Moorish general is manipulated by his jealous ensign into doubting his wife.
Description: The evil Iago pretends to be friend of ___ in order to manipulate him to serve his own end in the film version of this Shakespeare classic.

Title: Shoot to Kill
Hint: An FBI agent teams with a mountain guide to chase a killer into the Pacific Northwest wilderness.
Description: When a cunning murderer vanishes into the rugged mountains of the Pacific Northwest, pursuing FBI agent Warren Stantin must exchange familiar city streets for unknown wilderness trails. Completely out of his element, Stantin is forced to enlist the aid of expert tracker Jonathan Knox. It's a turbulent yet vital relationship they must maintain in order to survive...

Title: Until the End of the World
Hint: A woman follows a mysterious man across the world while a nuclear satellite falls.
Description: In 1999, a woman's life is forever changed after she survives a car crash with two bank robbers, who enlist her help to take the money to a drop in Paris. On the way, she runs into another fugitive from the law — an American doctor on the run from the CIA. They want to confiscate his father's invention – a device which allows anyone to record their dreams and visions.

Title: Salmon Fishing in the Yemen
Hint: A fisheries scientist is asked to bring a favorite British game fish to the Middle Eastern desert for a sheikh.
Description: A fisheries expert is approached by a consultant to help realize a sheik's vision of bringing the sport of fly-___ to the desert and embarks on an upstream journey of faith and fish to prove the impossible possible.

Title: Puncture
Hint: A drug-addicted Houston lawyer fights a powerful medical supplies corporation over safety syringes.
Description: A lawyer who is a drug addict fights a medical-supplies corporation in court while battling his personal demons.

Title: The Mustang
Hint: A violent convict finds healing by training wild horses in a prison program.
Description: While participating in a rehabilitation program training wild mustangs, a convict at first struggles to connect with the horses and his fellow inmates, but he learns to confront his violent past as he soothes an especially feisty horse.

Title: Brittany Runs a Marathon
Hint: A hard-partying New Yorker decides to get her life together by training for a big race.
Description: Hilarious and outgoing, ___ Forgler, is everybody’s best friend ― except her own. Her partying, underemployment and toxic relationships are catching up with her. She receives a startling wake-up call when a visit to the doctor reveals how unhealthy she is. Motivated to lose weight, but too broke for a gym and too proud to ask for help, Brit is at a loss, until her neighbor pushes her to run one sweaty block.

Title: Chisum
Hint: An aging cattle baron joins forces with a young outlaw to fight a corrupt rival.
Description: Cattle baron John ___ joins forces with Billy the Kid and Pat Garrett to fight the Lincoln County Land War in the New Mexico Territory of 1878.

Title: My Life
Hint: A dying man makes a video diary for the son he may never meet.
Description: It seems that Bob Jones has everything a man could want, namely a fulfilling job and a beautiful, pregnant wife, Gail. But Bob's life is turned upside-down when he is diagnosed with cancer and given four months to live -- not even enough time to see his first child's birth. To cleanse himself of demons in his remaining days, Bob makes a video diary, hoping to pass along some wisdom to his future child.

Title: The Girl in the Fog
Hint: A detective investigates a teenage girl's disappearance in a foggy Alpine village.
Description: A gripping and chilling thriller that brings us to a hazy mountain village where an enigmatic detective is investigating the sudden disappearance of fifteen-year-old girl.

Title: My Beautiful Laundrette
Hint: A young Pakistani Briton and his punk lover turn a rundown laundromat into a success.
Description: A young Pakistani Briton manages a rundown ___ with his lover while dealing with tension in his family, the local Pakistani community, and a persistent mob of skinheads.

Title: Mammoth
Hint: A New York couple's life unravels when they leave their daughter with a Filipina nanny.
Description: When Leo travels to Thailand on business, he unwittingly sets off a chain of events that will have dramatic consequences for everyone.

Title: Their Finest
Hint: A female screenwriter works on a morale-boosting propaganda film during the Blitz.
Description: During the Blitz of World War II, a female screenwriter works on a film celebrating England's resilience as a way to buoy a weary populace's spirits. Her efforts to dramatise the true story of two sisters who undertook their own maritime mission to rescue wounded soldiers are met with mixed feelings by a dismissive all-male staff.

Title: Mr. Turner
Country: France, Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An eccentric British painter spends his last 25 years chasing light and scandal.
Description: Eccentric British painter J.M.W. ___ lives his last 25 years with gusto and secretly becomes involved with a seaside landlady, while his faithful housekeeper bears an unrequited love for him.

Title: Dead Snow 2: Red vs. Dead
Country: Iceland, Norway, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A man with a reattached zombie arm raises his own undead army to fight Nazi zombies in Norway.
Description: The gruesome Nazi Zombies are back to finish their mission, but our hero is not willing to die. He is gathering his own army to give them a final fight.

Title: Beavis and Butt-Head Do America
Hint: Two dim-witted teens search for their stolen TV and stumble into a plot involving a bioweapon.
Description: Slacker duo ___-Head wake to discover their TV has been stolen. Their search for a new one takes them on a clueless adventure across America, during which they manage to accidentally become America's most wanted.

Title: The Vanishing of Sidney Hall
Hint: A young novelist's controversial book leads to fame, tragedy and disappearance.
Description: Over the course of 12 years, and three stages of life, ___ falls in love, writes the book of a generation and then disappears without a trace.

Title: The Falcon and the Snowman
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two young Americans sell government secrets to the Soviets.
Description: The true story of a disillusioned military contractor employee and his drug pusher childhood friend who became walk-in spies for the Soviet Union.

Title: Toc Toc
Hint: Patients with OCD are stuck together in a psychologist's waiting room.
Description: A group of patients meet at a prestigious psychologist's office. Apart from the day and time of the appointment, something else unites them all: all six suffer from OCD. But the plane bringing the doctor is unexpectedly delayed, which forces them to spend an endless wait until the doctor shows up. Will they be able to keep their manias, impulses, convulsions, obsessions and rituals at bay during the wait?

Title: Thunderheart
Hint: A mixed-blood FBI agent investigates a murder on a Lakota reservation.
Description: A young mixed-blood FBI agent is assigned to work with a cynical veteran investigator on a murder on a poverty-stricken Sioux reservation.

Title: Neruda
Country: United States of America, Argentina, Chile, France, Spain
Hint: A Chilean poet and senator goes on the run from a police inspector in 1948.
Description: It’s 1948 and the Cold War has arrived in Chile. In the Congress, prominent Communist Senator and popular poet Pablo ___ accuses the government of betraying the Party and is stripped of his parliamentary immunity by President González Videla. The Chief of Investigative Police instructs inspector Óscar Peluchonneau to arrest the poet.

Title: Storytelling
Hint: Two dark tales about dysfunction set in a college and a suburban high school.
Description: College and high school serve as the backdrop for two stories about dysfunction and personal turmoil.

Title: The Muppets Take Manhattan
Hint: A group of puppets graduate college and try to get their show on Broadway.
Description: When the ___ graduate from Danhurst College, they take their song-filled senior revue to New York City, only to learn that it isn't easy to find a producer who's willing to back a show starring a frog and a pig. Of course, Kermit the Frog and Miss Piggy won't take no for an answer, launching a search for someone to take them to Broadway.

Title: Tunnel
Hint: A car salesman is trapped under a collapsed mountain road with a dying phone and two water bottles.
Description: A man is on his way home when the poorly constructed ___ he is driving through collapses, leaving him trapped leaving himself for the unexpected whilst emergency services struggle to help.

Title: The Gods Must Be Crazy II
Country: South Africa, Botswana, United States of America
Hint: A Kalahari bushman searches for his children who stowed away on a poachers' truck.
Description: Xixo is back again. This time, his children accidentally stow away on a fast-moving poachers' truck, unable to get off, and Xixo sets out to rescue them. Along the way, he encounters a couple of soldiers trying to capture each other and a pilot and passenger of a small plane, who are each having a few problems of their own.

Title: Black '47
Hint: An Irish soldier returns home during the Great Famine and takes revenge.
Description: In 1847, when Ireland is in the grip of the Great Famine that has ravaged the country for two long years, Feeney, a hardened Irish Ranger who has been fighting for the British Army abroad, returns home to reunite with his estranged family, only to discover the cruelest reality, a black land where death reigns.

Title: I Want You
Hint: A young boy and his sister are drawn into a man's obsessive pursuit of his ex-girlfriend.
Description: A young boy and his sister are drawn into one man's obsessive pursuit of his former lover.

Title: Veronica Guerin
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An Irish investigative reporter exposes Dublin's drug lords at deadly cost.
Description: In this true story, ___ is an investigative reporter for an Irish newspaper. As the drug trade begins to bleed into the mainstream, ___ decides to take on and expose those responsible. Beginning at the bottom with addicts, ___ then gets in touch with John Traynor, a paranoid informant.

Title: Hit: The First Case
Hint: A troubled detective investigates the disappearance of a young woman.
Description: Burdened by old demons, a troubled but brilliant detective sets out to solve two confounding abduction cases — one involving his own girlfriend.

Title: Dreamer
Hint: A father and daughter nurse an injured racehorse back to health.
Description: Ben Crane believes that a severely injured racehorse deserves another chance. He and his daughter Cale adopt the mare and save it from being sacrificed by the owner.

Title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
Hint: A rich duck tycoon and his nephews search for a magic genie's vessel in the desert.
Description: With his nephews and niece, everyone's favorite rich uncle, Scrooge McDuck, treks from his mansion home in Duckburg in search of the long-lost loot of the thief Collie Baba. But finding the goods isn't quite what it's "quacked" up to be! Their thrilling adventure leads to comical chaos, magical mayhem, and a lesson about what is far more valuable than money, gold and jewels.

Title: Intermission
Hint: The lives and loves of a bunch of small-time Dublin delinquents, cops and lovers interweave after a breakup.
Description: A raucous story of the interweaving lives and loves of small-town delinquents, shady cops, pretty good girls and very bad boys. With Irish guts and grit, lives collide, preconceptions shatter and romance is tested to the extreme. An ill-timed and poorly executed couple's break-up sets off a chain of events affecting everyone in town.

Title: She's Gotta Have It
Hint: A Brooklyn woman juggles three lovers who each want her to choose.
Description: The story of Nola Darling's simultaneous sexual relationships with three different men is told by her and by her partners and other friends. All three men wanted her to commit solely to them; Nola resists being "owned" by a single partner.

Title: Other People
Hint: A struggling comedy writer moves home to care for his dying mother.
Description: David, a struggling comedy writer fresh off from breaking up with his boyfriend, moves from New York City to Sacramento to help his sick mother. Living with his conservative father and much-younger sisters for the first time in ten years, he feels like a stranger in his childhood home.

Title: Clouds of Sils Maria
Country: France, Germany, Switzerland, United States of America
Hint: A veteran actress is asked to star in a revival of the play that made her famous.
Description: A veteran actress comes face-to-face with an uncomfortable reflection of herself when she agrees to take part in a revival of the play that launched her career 20 years earlier.

Title: It's Only the End of the World
Hint: A terminally ill writer returns home after 12 years to tell his family he is dying.
Description: Louis, a terminally ill writer, returns home after a long absence to tell his family that he is dying.

Title: Young and Innocent
Hint: A writer falsely accused of murder goes on the run with a police chief's daughter.
Description: When a young writer is falsely accused of murdering a famous actress, he escapes custody and joins forces with the daughter of a police constable to prove his innocence.

Title: A Perfect Day
Hint: Aid workers in the Balkans in 1995 try to remove a body from a well.
Description: Somewhere in the Balkans, 1995. A team of aid workers must solve an apparently simple problem in an almost completely pacified territory that has been devastated by a cruel war, but some of the local inhabitants, the retreating combatants, the UN forces, many cows and an absurd bureaucracy will not cease to put obstacles in their way.

Title: Dolphin Tale
Hint: A boy befriends an injured bottlenose who needs a prosthetic fin to survive.
Description: A sea of animal rescuers — and a lonely boy in need of a friend – nurse an injured ___ back to health after it loses its tail in a trap.

Title: Keeping Mum
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A pastor doesn't notice that his family's new housekeeper is murdering their problems away.
Description: A pastor preoccupied with writing the perfect sermon fails to realize that his wife is having an affair and his children are up to no good.

Title: The History Boys
Hint: An unruly class of bright Sheffield schoolboys prepare for Oxford and Cambridge entrance exams under two very different teachers.
Description: The story of an unruly class of bright, funny history students at a Yorkshire grammar school in pursuit of an undergraduate place at Oxford or Cambridge. Bounced between their maverick English master, a young and shrewd teacher hired to up their test scores, a grossly out-numbered history teacher, and a headmaster obsessed with results, the boys attempt to pass.

Title: Che: Part Two
Country: United States of America, Spain, France
Hint: A revolutionary goes to Bolivia to start a new rebellion and meets his end.
Description: Seven years after his triumph in Cuba, ___ winds up in Bolivia, where he tries to ignite the same revolutionary fires as before.

Title: Rooster Cogburn
Hint: A one-eyed marshal teams up with a spinster to hunt the outlaws who killed her father.
Description: After a band of drunken thugs overruns a small Indian Nation town, killing Reverend Goodnight and raping the women folk, Eula Goodnight enlists the aid of US Marshal ___ to hunt them down and bring her father's killers to justice.

Title: Nothing to Hide
Hint: Old friends agree to share every message on their phones during a dinner party.
Description: To spice up a dinner party, old friends agree to share every private message that pops up on their phones -- with disastrous results.

Title: The War Wagon
Hint: An ex-con seeks revenge by robbing an armoured stagecoach full of gold belonging to the man who framed him.
Description: An ex-con seeks revenge on the man who put him in prison by planning a robbery of the latter's stagecoach, which is transporting gold. He enlists the help of a partner, who could be working for his nemesis.

Title: The Upside of Anger
Hint: An abandoned wife turns to drink and a neighbor while raising four daughters.
Description: After her husband runs off with his secretary, Terry Wolfmeyer is left to fend for herself -- and her four daughters. As she hits rock bottom, Terry finds a friend and drinking buddy in next-door neighbor Denny, a former baseball player. As the two grow closer, and her daughters increasingly rely on Denny, Terry starts to have reservations about where their relationship is headed.

Title: Heaven & Earth
Hint: A Vietnamese woman endures the war and moves to America with a GI.
Description: In a small Vietnamese village torn apart by war, a young woman faces unimaginable horrors before deciding to escape to the city. There, she encounters a compassionate Marine who offers her hope and a chance at a new life, igniting the possibility of a future together.

Title: Big Bad Wolves
Hint: A vigilante cop and a grieving father kidnap a suspected child killer.
Description: The twisted paths of three very different men brutally collide due to a chain of unspeakable murders: a grieving father who has been doomed to seek vengeance and a police detective who boldly crosses the narrow boundary between law and crime meet a religion teacher suspected of being the murderer.

Title: Tetro
Country: United States of America, Argentina, Spain, Italy
Hint: A teenage boy seeks out his estranged older brother, a troubled writer, in Buenos Aires.
Description: In Buenos Aires, 17-year-old Bennie seeks out his estranged brother ___, a once-promising writer haunted by their family’s past. As Bennie uncovers ___ hidden manuscript, old secrets and rivalries resurface, forcing both men to confront the truth about their father and the tangled legacy that tore their family apart.

Title: Mary and the Witch's Flower
Hint: A clumsy girl finds a glowing bloom that grants her magical powers for one night.
Description: ___ Smith, a young girl who lives with her great-aunt in the countryside, follows a mysterious cat into the nearby forest where she finds a strange ___ and an old broom, none of which is as ordinary as it seems.

Title: Miss You Already
Hint: Two lifelong best friends' bond is tested by cancer and pregnancy.
Description: The friendship between two life-long girlfriends is put to the test when one starts a family and the other falls ill.

Title: Ink
Hint: A mercenary steals a girl's soul in her sleep, and dream warriors fight to get it back.
Description: Invisible forces exert power over us in our sleep. A mercenary named ___, on a literal nightmare mission, captures the spirit of 8-year-old Emma in the dream world. To save her, the dream-givers marshal all their resources, focusing on saving the soul of Emma's tragically broken father.

Title: Indignation
Hint: A working-class Jewish student clashes with his dean at an Ohio college in 1951.
Description: In 1951, Marcus Messner, a working-class Jewish student from New Jersey, attends a small Ohio college, where he struggles with anti-Semitism, sexual repression, and the ongoing Korean War.

Title: Steamboy
Hint: A boy inventor in 1860s Britain is caught in a battle over a steam-powered device.
Description: In 1860s Britain, a boy inventor finds himself caught in the middle of a deadly conflict over a revolutionary advance in steam power.

Title: Millions
Hint: Two grieving boys find a bag of stolen money and try to give it to the poor.
Description: Two boys, still grieving the death of their mother, find themselves the unwitting benefactors of a bag of bank robbery loot in the week before the United Kingdom switches its official currency to the Euro. What's a kid to do?

Title: Flashbacks of a Fool
Hint: A narcissistic Hollywood star returns to England for a funeral and remembers his youth.
Description: An aging Hollywood star, Joe Scott, lives a life of narcissistic hedonism, observed by his laconic personal assistant, Ophelia. The death of his childhood best friend, Boots, takes our protagonist, and the movie, into an extended flashback to a sea-side town in 1970s Britain.

Title: The Reluctant Fundamentalist
Country: Qatar, United States of America, India
Hint: A Pakistani man's American Dream is shattered after 9/11.
Description: In New York, a Pakistani native finds that his American Dream has collapsed in the wake of the 9/11 terrorist attacks.

Title: The Outrage
Hint: A con man, a preacher and a prospector discuss a rape and murder told in four versions.
Description: At a disused railway station, three men -- a con artist, a preacher, and a prospector -- discuss the recent trial and sentencing of the outlaw Juan Carrasco for the murder of a man and the rape of his wife. In their recounting, the three explore the conflicting testimonies of the parties involved in the crimes. Disconcerting new questions arise with each different version of the event.

Title: The Nativity Story
Hint: A young couple make the hard journey to Bethlehem for the birth of a child.
Description: Mary and Joseph make the hard journey to Bethlehem for a blessed event in this retelling of the ___. This meticulously researched and visually lush adaptation of the biblical tale follows the pair on their arduous path to their arrival in a small village, where they find shelter in a quiet manger and Jesus is born.

Title: Music of the Heart
Hint: A divorced woman teaches violin to children in Harlem and fights budget cuts.
Description: After Roberta Guaspari separates from her husband, she receives encouragement from her mother to take up a job of a music teacher at the Central Park East School in East Harlem.

Title: The Hunting Party
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A ruthless rancher hunts the outlaws who kidnapped his wife.
Description: A ruthless rancher, and his gang, use extremely long range rifles to kill the men who kidnapped his wife.

Title: Kafka
Hint: An insurance clerk gets caught up in an underground conspiracy in Prague.
Description: After a colleague is murdered, insurance worker ___ gets embroiled in an underground group who are attempting to thwart a secret organization that controls the major events in society.

Title: Red Road
Hint: A CCTV operator spots a man from her past on her monitor and starts to follow him.
Description: Jackie is a CCTV operator. One day, a man shows his face on her monitor, a man she hoped never to see again. Now she has no choice and is compelled to confront him.

Title: Infernal Affairs III
Hint: A corrupt cop goes to dangerous lengths to clear his name after years undercover.
Description: Triad gangster turned corrupt cop Lau Kin-ming goes to dangerous lengths to avoid detection.

Title: Ondine
Hint: A divorced Irish fisherman pulls a mysterious woman from the sea in his net.
Description: On the coast of Cork, Syracuse is a divorced fisherman who has stopped drinking. His precocious daughter Annie has failing kidneys. One day, he finds a nearly-drowned young woman in his net; she calls herself ___ and wants no one to see her. He puts her up in an isolated cottage that was his mother's. Annie discovers ___ presence and believes she is a selkie, a seal that turns human while on land.

Title: Baadshah
Hint: A small-time detective is mistaken for a government agent.
Description: A small time detective is mistaken as a CBI agent and gets embroiled in a deadly mission to save the Chief Minister from an assassination attempt.

Title: OSS 117: Lost in Rio
Hint: A bumbling, sexist French secret agent is sent to Brazil in 1967.
Description: In 1967, ___ is sent to Brazil in order to retrieve a microfilm list of French Nazi sympathizers, only to once again unknowingly set foot into a bigger international intrigue.

Title: Shaolin
Hint: A betrayed warlord seeks refuge among the kung fu monks he once mocked.
Description: China is plunged into strife as feuding warlords try to expand their power by warring over neighboring lands. Fuelled by his success on the battlefield, young and arrogant Hao Jie sneers at ___ masters when he beats one of them in a duel. But the pride comes before a fall. When his own family is wiped out by a rival warlord, Hao is forced to take refuge with the monks.

Title: Cemetery Junction
Hint: Three friends in 1970s England dream of escaping their small town.
Description: In 1970s England, three blue-collar friends spend their days joking, drinking, fighting and chasing girls. Freddie wants to leave their working-class world but cool, charismatic Bruce and lovable loser Snork are happy with life the way it is. When Freddie gets a new job as a door-to-door salesman and bumps into his old school sweetheart Julie, the gang are forced to make choices that will change their lives for ever.

Title: C'est la vie!
Hint: A wedding planner tries to keep a lavish reception from falling apart.
Description: Max is a battle-weary veteran of the wedding-planning racket. His latest — and last — gig is a hell of a fête, involving stuffy period costumes for the caterers, a vain, hyper- sensitive singer who thinks he's a Gallic James Brown, and a morose, micromanaging groom determined to make Max's night as miserable as possible.

Title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
Genres: Family, Comedy, Adventure, Animation, Science Fiction
Hint: An alien crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm and a clever flock leader helps it get home.
Description: When an alien with amazing powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, ___ goes on a mission to shepherd the intergalactic visitor home before a sinister organization can capture her.

Title: The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby: Him
Hint: A husband tries to reconnect with his wife after a tragedy, from his point of view.
Description: Told from the man's perspective, the story of a couple trying to reclaim the life and love they once knew and pick up the pieces of a past that may be too far gone.

Title: Ishq
Hint: Two rich kids fall in love with poor ones, against their fathers' wishes.
Description: The children of two wealthy businessman fall in love with someone from a poor background, much to their parents' disapprovals.

Title: Patti Cake$
Hint: An aspiring rapper from New Jersey chases her dream.
Description: Straight out of Jersey comes Patricia Dombrowski, a.k.a. Killa P, a.k.a. ___, an aspiring rapper fighting through a world of strip malls and strip clubs on an unlikely quest for glory.

Title: Torrente: El brazo tonto de la ley
Hint: A sleazy former cop busts a drug ring in Madrid.
Description: A former policeman enlists his nerdy friend to help bust drug traffickers moving heroin through a Chinese restaurant.

Title: Cookie's Fortune
Hint: An old woman's death sets off a chain of misunderstandings in a small Southern town.
Description: Conflict arises in the small town of Holly Springs when an old woman's death causes a variety of reactions among family and friends.

Title: Paris
Studio: Ce qui me meut motion pictures
Hint: A dancer with a heart condition watches life go by in the City of Light.
Description: Pierre, a professional dancer, suffers from a serious heart disease. While he is waiting for a transplant which may (or may not) save his life, he has nothing better to do than look at the people around him, from the balcony of his ___ apartment.

Title: Good Newwz
Hint: Two couples with the same surname get their IVF sperm swapped.
Description: Two couples with the same surnames pursue in-vitro fertilisation and wait for their upcoming babies. Trouble ensues when they find that the sperms of each couple have been mixed with each other.

Title: Singham
Hint: An honest small-town cop takes on a crime lord.
Description: An honest, small town cop is transferred to a big city that is controlled by a crime boss that he had once humiliated.

Title: Alone
Hint: A recently widowed woman is kidnapped and escapes into the wilderness.
Description: A recently widowed traveler is kidnapped by a cold blooded killer, only to escape into the wilderness where she is forced to battle against the elements as her pursuer closes in on her.

Title: Intacto
Genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Romance, Science Fiction, Thriller
Hint: A man who steals luck from others runs a secret casino.
Description: An enigmatic tale of four people whose lives are intertwined by destiny are subject to the laws of fate. They discover that luck is something they cannot afford to be without as they gamble with the highest stakes possible in a deadly game from which only one of them will emerge intact.

Title: Snow Angels
Hint: A small-town waitress separates from her suicidal, alcoholic husband, as a teenage romance blossoms nearby.
Description: Waitress Annie has separated from her suicidal alcoholic husband, Glenn. Glenn has become an evangelical Christian, but his erratic attempts at getting back into Annie's life have alarmed her. High school student Arthur works at Annie's restaurant, growing closer to a new kid in town, Lila, after class.

Title: Karan Arjun
Hint: Two brothers murdered by a greedy landlord are reincarnated to avenge their deaths, as their mother prayed.

Title: Love Aaj Kal

Description: Two lovers break up after they realize that their career goals are pulling them in different directions.

Description: A coming of age dramedy where infidelity, real estate, and Lyme disease have two families falling apart on Long Island in the early eighties. Scott, 15, is at the point in his life when he finds out that the most important people around him, his father, his mother, and his brother, are not exactly who he thought they were. Title: Attack

Description: Battle of the Bulge, World War II, 1944. Lieutenant Costa, an infantry company officer who must establish artillery observation posts in a strategic area, has serious doubts about Captain Cooney's leadership ability.

Description: Manu, a bodybuilder from ___, India, falls in love with Maanvi, a Zumba teacher. All seems well until a revelation causes turmoil in their love story.

Title: Interview

Guided by Special Forces officer 'Fergus', McGartland gains unparalleled insight into the organisation's dealings, providing his British handler with priceless, life-saving information. Based on a true story.

Description: Will Henry is a newly single graphic novelist balancing being a parent to his young twin daughters and teaching a classroom full of college students, all the while trying to navigate the rich complexities of new love and letting go of the woman who left him.

Title: Shinobi: Heart Under Blade

Description: Even though Gennosuke and Oboro are from rival ninja villages, they are secretly in love. At an annual conference with the Lord, it is dictated that a competition--a fight to the death--will take place between the five best ___ from each village. Gennosuke and Oboro's love is made even more impossible when they each got picked as the leader of the five to represent their respective villages.

Title: Sherni
Hint: A forest officer tracks a man-eating tigress while battling bureaucracy, hunters and politicians.
Description: A jaded forest officer leads a team of trackers and locals intending to capture an unsettled tigress while battling intense obstacles and pressures, both natural and man-made.

Title: Hasee Toh Phasee
Hint: An eccentric, pill-popping scientist crashes her sister's wedding and falls for the groom.
Description: On the eve of Nikhil and Karishma’s engagement, Karishma’s wealthy father, Devesh Solanki, expresses his disapproval, believing Nikhil to be a lackadaisical young man. With one week to prove himself worthy to marry Karishma, Nikhil and Karishma's sister, Meeta, grow closer to each other.

Title: Azumi

Description: In war-torn Japan, the Tokugawa Shogun, desperate to restore peace to his people, orders the assassination of the hostile warlords. A beautiful young woman is raised from birth with nine other orphans, to become an assassin. Her name is ___, the ultimate assassin.

Title: New York

Description: The plot follows three friends in ___ City whose lives are upended by the 9/11 attacks leading to suspicion, FBI involvement, and a story about friendship, identity, and the aftermath of terrorism.

Title: Tanu Weds Manu

Description: ___ comes to India to find a bride for himself and falls for ___ at first sight but she is a free spirited girl has no plans of marrying him.

Hint: A woman from Manipur fights poverty and prejudice to become a five-time world champion boxer.
Description: A chronicle of the life of Indian boxer '___' who went through several hardships before audaciously accomplishing her ultimate dream.

Title: Populaire
Hint: A clumsy 1950s secretary becomes a speed-typing champion under her boss's demanding coaching.
Description: An insurance agent and his new secretary become locked in the grip of romance and competition as they train together for a speed-typing contest.

Title: Asterix Versus Caesar
Hint: A Gaul falls for a newcomer to the village.
Description: Obelix falls for a new arrival in his home village in Gaul, but is heartbroken when her true love arrives to visit her. However, the lovers are kidnapped by Romans; ___ and Obelix set out to rescue them on a dangerous journey that will involve gladiators, slavers and beauracracy - and a personal encounter with the Emperor himself, Julius ___...

Title: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny
Hint: An aging archaeologist races against an ex-Nazi scientist to find a powerful device built by Archimedes.
Description: Finding himself in a new era, and approaching retirement, Indy wrestles with fitting into a world that seems to have outgrown him. But as the tentacles of an all-too-familiar evil return in the form of an old rival, Indy must don his hat and pick up his whip once more to make sure an ancient and powerful artifact doesn't fall into the wrong hands.

Title: The Flash
Hint: A speedster travels back in time to save his mother and breaks reality.
Description: When his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, Barry Allen becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned and there are no Super Heroes to turn to. In order to save the world that he is in and return to the future that he knows, Barry's only hope is to race for his life. But will making the ultimate sacrifice be enough to reset the universe?

Title: In Time
Hint: In a future where minutes are currency, a poor factory worker is suddenly given a century.
Description: In the not-too-distant future, the aging gene has been switched off. To avoid overpopulation, time has become the currency and the way people pay for luxuries and necessities. The rich can live forever, while the rest struggle to negotiate for their immortality. A poor young man who suddenly comes into a fortune of time finds himself on the run from a corrupt police force known as the "time keepers".

Title: Trick 'r Treat
Hint: Four interwoven stories set on Halloween night, watched over by a small figure in a burlap mask.
Description: Four interwoven stories that occur on Halloween: an everyday high school principal has a secret life as a serial killer; a college virgin might have just met the one guy for her; a group of teenagers pull a mean prank, and a bitter old recluse receives an uninvited guest.

Title: The Equalizer 2
Hint: The retired operative turned Lyft driver seeks justice for a murdered friend.
Description: Robert McCall, who serves an unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed, embarks on a relentless, globe-trotting quest for vengeance when his former partner is murdered.

Title: Romeo + Juliet
Hint: Star-crossed teens from rival families fall in love in a gun-filled Verona Beach.
Description: In this contemporary take on William Shakespeare's classic tragedy, the Montagues and Capulets have moved their ongoing feud to the sweltering suburb of Verona Beach, where ___ fall in love and secretly wed. Though the film is visually modern, the bard's dialogue remains.

Title: Exodus
Hint: Jewish refugees aboard a ship fight to reach Palestine in 1947.
Description: Ari Ben Canaan, a passionate member of the Jewish paramilitary group Haganah, attempts to transport 600 Jewish refugees on a dangerous voyage from Cyprus to Palestine on a ship named the ___. He faces obstruction from British forces, who will not grant the ship passage to its destination.

Title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: A young boy wins a tour through the most magnificent ___ in the world, led by the world's most unusual candy maker.

Title: The Girl Next Door

Description: In a quiet suburban town in the summer of 1958, two recently orphaned sisters are placed in the care of their mentally unstable Aunt Ruth. But Ruth's depraved sense of discipline will soon lead to unspeakable acts of abuse and torture that involve her young sons, the neighborhood children, and one 12-year-old boy whose life will be changed forever.

Title: Purple Hearts
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An aspiring musician marries a Marine for military health benefits, and they fall for each other.
Description: An aspiring musician agrees to a marriage of convenience with a soon-to-deploy Marine, but a tragedy soon turns their fake relationship all too real.

Title: Love & Other Drugs
Hint: A pharmaceutical rep selling a new blue pill falls for a woman with Parkinson's.
Description: Maggie is an alluring free spirit who won't let anyone – or anything – tie her down. But she meets her match in Jamie, whose relentless and nearly infallible charm serves him well with the ladies and the cutthroat world of pharmaceutical sales. Maggie and Jamie's evolving relationship takes them both by surprise, as they find themselves under the influence of the ultimate drug: love.

Title: Unfaithful
Country: United States of America, Switzerland, Germany

Description: A New York suburban couple's marriage goes dangerously awry when the wife indulges in an adulterous fling.

Title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle

Title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever

Description: Queen Ramonda, Shuri, M’Baku, Okoye and the Dora Milaje fight to protect their nation from intervening world powers in the wake of King T’Challa’s death. As the Wakandans strive to embrace their next chapter, the heroes must band together with the help of War Dog Nakia and Everett Ross and forge a new path for the kingdom of ___.

Title: Armageddon
Hint: A team of oil drillers is sent into space to destroy an asteroid.
Description: When an asteroid threatens to collide with Earth, NASA honcho Dan Truman determines the only way to stop it is to drill into its surface and detonate a nuclear bomb. This leads him to renowned driller Harry Stamper, who agrees to helm the dangerous space mission provided he can bring along his own hotshot crew. Among them is the cocksure A.J.

Title: Three Thousand Years of Longing
Hint: A lonely scholar releases a djinn who tells her tales of his millennia of imprisonment.
Description: A solitary scholar discovers an ancient bottle while on a trip to Istanbul and unleashes a djinn who offers her three wishes. Filled with reluctance, she is unable to come up with one, so the djinn tries to inspire her with his stories.

Title: Road House
Hint: A philosophical bouncer is hired to clean up a rowdy Missouri bar.
Description: The Double Deuce is the meanest, loudest and rowdiest bar south of the Mason-Dixon Line, and Dalton has been hired to clean it up. He might not look like much, but the Ph.D.-educated bouncer proves he's more than capable – busting the heads of troublemakers and turning the roadhouse into a jumping hot spot. But Dalton's romance with the gorgeous Dr.

Title: Eden Lake
Hint: A young couple on a romantic weekend at a remote quarry are terrorised by a gang of violent teenagers.
Description: When a young couple goes to a remote wooded ___ for a romantic getaway, their quiet weekend is shattered by an aggressive group of local kids. Rowdiness quickly turns to rage as the teens terrorize the couple in unimaginable ways, and a weekend outing becomes a bloody battle for survival.

Title: Final Destination
Hint: Teens who escape a plane explosion are hunted by death itself.
Description: After a teenager has a terrifying vision of him and his friends dying in a plane crash, he prevents the accident only to have Death hunt them down, one by one.

Title: The Proposal
Hint: A Canadian boss forces her assistant to marry her to avoid deportation.
Description: When she learns she's in danger of losing her visa status and being deported, overbearing book editor Margaret Tate forces her put-upon assistant, Andrew Paxton, to marry her.

Title: You've Got Mail
Hint: Two bookstore rivals fall in love online without knowing it.
Description: Book superstore magnate Joe Fox and independent book shop owner Kathleen Kelly fall in love in the anonymity of the Internet—both blissfully unaware that he's trying to put her out of business.

Title: Black Widow
Hint: A Russian-trained spy confronts her past and the Red Room that made her.
Description: Natasha Romanoff, also known as ___, confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises. Pursued by a force that will stop at nothing to bring her down, Natasha must deal with her history as a spy and the broken relationships left in her wake long before she became an Avenger.

Title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
Hint: Misfits from a failing gym compete in a ball-throwing tournament to save it.
Description: When megalomaniacal White Goodman, the owner of a trendy, high-end fitness center, makes a move to take over the struggling local gym run by happy-go-lucky Pete La Fleur, there's only one way for La Fleur to fight back: ___. Aided by a ___ guru and Goodman's attorney, La Fleur and his rag-tag team of underdogs launch a knock-down, drag-out battle in which the winner takes all.

Title: Police Academy
Hint: A bunch of misfits sign up for training to become cops after the rules change.
Description: New rules enforced by the Lady Mayoress mean that sex, weight, height and intelligence need no longer be a factor for joining the Police Force. This opens the floodgates for all and sundry to enter the ___, much to the chagrin of the instructors. Not everyone is there through choice, though.

Title: Redeeming Love
Country: South Africa, United States of America
Hint: A young farmer falls for a prostitute in the California Gold Rush.
Description: A young couple's relationship clashes with the harsh realities of the California Gold Rush of 1850. Angel, experiencing love for the first time and facing demons unsurmountable, runs from the new life she doesn't believe she deserves. When Michael sets out to find her, Angel discovers that she indeed has the power to choose the life she wants.

Title: Pandorum
Genres: Action, Horror, Mystery, Science Fiction, Thriller
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Astronauts wake up on a dark spaceship with no memory of their mission.
Description: Two crew members wake up on an abandoned spacecraft with no idea who they are, how long they've been asleep, or what their mission is. The two soon discover they're actually not alone – and the reality of their situation is more horrifying than they could have imagined.

Title: Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children
Hint: A boy discovers a magical house for kids with strange gifts, stuck in a time loop.
Description: A teenager finds himself transported to an island where he must help protect a group of orphans with special powers from creatures intent on destroying them.

Title: The Ninth Gate
Hint: A rare book dealer searches for copies of a book that summons the devil.
Description: A rare book dealer finds himself at the heart of a string of paranormal events when he is hired to find the last two copies of a text, The Nine Gates of the Kingdom of Shadows, capable of summoning the Devil.

Title: Blade II
Hint: A vampire hunter teams up with vampires against a new breed of monsters.
Description: ___ forms an uneasy alliance with the vampire council in order to combat the Reapers, who are feeding on vampires.

Title: Jumanji: The Next Level
