Description: As the gang return to ___ to rescue one of their own, they discover that nothing is as they expect. The players will have to brave parts unknown and unexplored in order to escape the world’s most dangerous game.

Title: Fear Street: Part Two - 1978
Hint: A summer camp is terrorized by an axe killer in the late 1970s.
Description: In ___, two rival groups at Camp Nightwing must band together to solve a terrifying mystery when horrors from their towns' history come alive.

Title: King Arthur: Legend of the Sword
Hint: A street-smart young man pulls a legendary blade from a stone and must overthrow his tyrant uncle.
Description: When the child ___ father is murdered, Vortigern, ___ uncle, seizes the crown. Robbed of his birthright and with no idea who he truly is, ___ comes up the hard way in the back alleys of the city. But once he pulls the ___ Excalibur from the stone, his life is turned upside down and he is forced to acknowledge his true legacy... whether he likes it or not.

Title: Waiting...
Hint: Young employees at a chain restaurant stave off boredom with crude games.
Description: Young employees at Shenaniganz restaurant collectively stave off boredom and adulthood with their antics.

Title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An ordinary Englishman hitchhikes through space after Earth is demolished.
Description: Mere seconds before the Earth is to be demolished by an alien construction crew, Arthur Dent is swept off the planet by his friend Ford Prefect, a researcher penning a new edition of "The ___."

Title: Empire Records
Hint: Employees of an independent record store try to save it from a chain.
Description: The employees of an independent music store learn about each other as they try to stop the store from being absorbed by a large chain.

Title: Reality
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An intelligence specialist is interrogated by the FBI about a leaked document.
Description: Augusta, Georgia, United States, June 3, 2017. After running some errands, ___ Winner returns home, where she is approached by two men.

Title: The Adam Project
Hint: A time-traveling pilot teams up with his 12-year-old self.
Description: After accidentally crash-landing in 2022, time-traveling fighter pilot ___ Reed teams up with his 12-year-old self on a mission to save the future.

Title: The Running Man
Hint: A wrongly convicted man must survive a deadly game show in a dystopian America.
Description: By 2017, the global economy has collapsed and U.S. society has become a totalitarian police state, censoring all cultural activity.

Title: Sharper
Hint: A wealthy New York family is torn apart by con artists and secrets.
Description: A small, wealthy family in New York City gets progressively torn apart by secrets, lies, and the theft that orchestrates all of it.

Title: Emma.
Hint: A wealthy young woman in Regency England meddles in her friends' love lives.
Description: In 1800s England, a well-meaning but selfish young woman meddles in the love lives of her friends.

Title: Commando
Hint: A retired special forces colonel goes on a one-man rampage to rescue his kidnapped daughter.
Description: John Matrix, the former leader of a special ___ strike force that always got the toughest jobs done, is forced back into action when his young daughter is kidnapped. To find her, Matrix has to fight his way through an array of punks, killers, one of his former commandos, and a fully equipped private army.

Title: The Old Guard
Hint: A team of immortal mercenaries who've fought for centuries are hunted by a pharmaceutical company.
Description: Four undying warriors who've secretly protected humanity for centuries become targeted for their mysterious powers just as they discover a new immortal.

Title: Midway
Country: Canada, Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: The 1942 naval battle in the Pacific, told from the perspectives of American and Japanese soldiers.
Description: The story of the Battle of ___, and the leaders and soldiers who used their instincts, fortitude and bravery to overcome massive odds.

Title: Emily the Criminal
Hint: A woman with a record joins a credit card scam in Los Angeles.
Description: Desperate for income, ___ takes a shady gig buying goods with stolen credit cards supplied by a charismatic middleman named Youcef. Seduced by the quick cash and illicit thrills, they hatch a plan to take their business to the next level.

Title: Demolition Man
Hint: A cop is frozen and thawed in a peaceful future to catch a criminal.
Description: In 1996, brash L.A. detective John Spartan and maniac killer Simon Phoenix are both sentenced to decades in a cryogenic prison as punishment for a rescue mission gone wrong. When Phoenix escapes 36 years later to wreak havoc on the future, Spartan is awakened to capture his nemesis the old-fashioned way.

Title: The A-Team
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A squad of ex-soldiers framed for a crime try to clear their names.
Description: A man who loves when a plan comes together, Col. Hannibal Smith leads a close-knit team of elite operatives and Iraq War veterans. Framed for a crime they didn't commit, Smith and his men, Capt. H.M. ‘Howling Mad’ Murdock , Sgt. Bosco ‘B.A.’ Baracus, and Lt. Templeton ‘Faceman’ Peck, break out and go rogue, using their special talents to clear their names and find the perpetrator. Hot on their trail is Capt.

Title: Robin Hood: Men in Tights
Hint: A silly parody of the outlaw of Sherwood Forest with singing merry men.
Description: ___ comes home after fighting in the Crusades to learn that the noble King Richard is in exile and that the despotic King John now rules England, with the help of the Sheriff of Rottingham. ___ assembles a band of fellow patriots to do battle with King John and the Sheriff.

Title: Good Boys
Hint: Three sixth-graders skip school and go on a wild odyssey to replace a broken drone before a kissing party.
Description: A group of young boys on the cusp of becoming teenagers embark on an epic quest to fix their broken drone before their parents get home.

Title: Benedetta
Hint: A 17th-century Italian nun with mystical visions begins a forbidden affair with a novice.
Description: A 17th-century nun becomes entangled in a forbidden lesbian affair with a novice. But it is ___ shocking religious visions that threaten to shake the Church to its core.

Title: Pretty in Pink
Hint: A poor but stylish teen falls for a rich kid while her quirky best friend pines for her.
Description: Andie is an outcast, hanging out either with her older boss, who owns the record store where she works, or her quirky high school classmate Duckie, who has a crush on her. When one of the rich and popular kids at school, Blane, asks Andie out, it seems too good to be true. As Andie starts falling for Blane, she begins to realize that dating someone from a different social sphere is not easy.

Title: Wanted
Hint: A frustrated office worker learns he is the heir to a league of curve-the-bullet assassins.
Description: Doormat Wesley Gibson is an office worker whose life is going nowhere. He meets an attractive woman named Fox and discovers that his recently murdered father - whom Wesley never knew - belonged to the Fraternity, a secret society of assassins which takes its orders from Fate itself.

Title: Kong: Skull Island
Hint: Soldiers and scientists land on an uncharted Pacific landmass ruled by a giant ape.
Description: Explore the mysterious and dangerous home of the king of the apes as a team of explorers ventures deep inside the treacherous, primordial island.

Title: Out of the Furnace
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A mill worker in Rust Belt Pennsylvania hunts the backwoods gang behind his brother's disappearance.
Description: Two brothers live in the economically-depressed Rust Belt, when a cruel twist of fate lands one in prison. His brother is then lured into one of the most violent crime rings in the Northeast.

Title: Violent Night
Hint: Mercenaries break into a rich family's compound on Christmas Eve, and Santa fights back.
Description: When a team of mercenaries breaks into a wealthy family compound on Christmas Eve, taking everyone inside hostage, the team isn’t prepared for a surprise combatant: Santa Claus is on the grounds, and he’s about to show why this Nick is no saint.

Title: Streets of Fire
Hint: A soldier of fortune rescues his ex-girlfriend, a rock singer, from a biker gang.
Description: Raven Shaddock and his gang of merciless biker friends kidnap rock singer Ellen Aim. Ellen's former lover, soldier-for-hire Tom Cody, happens to be passing through town on a visit. In an attempt to save his star act, Ellen's manager hires Tom to rescue her. Along with a former soldier, they battle through dangerous cityscapes, determined to get Ellen back.

Title: The Lost Daughter
Country: Greece, Israel, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A professor's seaside vacation turns dark when she becomes fixated on a young mother.
Description: A woman's seaside vacation takes a dark turn when her obsession with a young mother forces her to confront secrets from her past.

Title: Young & Beautiful
Hint: A 17-year-old Parisian girl secretly begins working as a high-priced escort.
Description: Isabelle, a 17-year-old student, loses her virginity during a quick holiday romance. When she returns home, she begins a secret life as a prostitute for a year.

Title: Run
Hint: A homeschooled teen in a wheelchair starts to suspect her devoted mother is hiding something.
Description: Chloe, a teenager who is confined to a wheelchair, is homeschooled by her mother, Diane. Chloe soon becomes suspicious of her mother and begins to suspect that she may be harboring a dark secret.

Title: The Guest
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A charming soldier visits the family of his dead comrade, and bodies start piling up.
Description: A soldier introduces himself to the Peterson family, claiming to be a friend of their son who died in action. After the young man is welcomed into their home, a series of accidental deaths seem to be connected to his presence.

Title: Atomic Blonde
Country: Germany, Hungary, Sweden, United States of America
Hint: An MI6 spy fights her way through Berlin as the Wall falls to recover a list of agents.
Description: An undercover MI6 agent is sent to Berlin during the Cold War to investigate the murder of a fellow agent and recover a missing list of double agents.

Title: Let Him Go
Hint: A retired sheriff and his wife set out to rescue their grandson from a dangerous Dakota family.
Description: Following the loss of their son, a retired sheriff and his wife leave their Montana ranch to rescue their young grandson from the clutches of a dangerous family living off the grid in the Dakotas.

Title: 2 Guns
Hint: A DEA agent and a Naval Intelligence officer rob a bank and discover the money belongs to the mob.
Description: A DEA agent and an undercover Naval Intelligence officer who have been tasked with investigating one another find they have been set up by the mob -- the very organization the two men believe they have been stealing money from.

Title: Return to Oz
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A girl escapes a psychiatric clinic back to a magical land, only to find its emerald capital in ruins.
Description: Dorothy, saved from a psychiatric experiment by a mysterious girl, finds herself back in the land of her dreams, and makes delightful new friends, and dangerous new enemies.

Title: Cars 3
Hint: An aging race car tries to prove he still has it against a new generation of high-tech racers.
Description: Blindsided by a new generation of blazing-fast racers, the legendary Lightning McQueen is suddenly pushed out of the sport he loves. To get back in the game, he will need the help of an eager young race technician with her own plan to win, inspiration from the late Fabulous Hudson Hornet, and a few unexpected turns.

Title: Angels & Demons
Hint: A symbologist races to stop a plot to blow up the Vatican with antimatter.
Description: Harvard symbologist Robert Langdon is recruited by the Vatican to investigate the apparent return of the Illuminati – a secret, underground organization – after four cardinals are kidnapped on the night of the papal conclave.

Title: The Devil's Rejects
Hint: A sadistic family of serial killers goes on the run from a vengeful sheriff.
Description: The murderous, backwoods Firefly family take to the road to escape the vengeful Sheriff Wydell, who is not afraid of being as ruthless as his target.

Title: The Call of the Wild
Hint: A sled dog stolen from California finds his place in the Yukon gold rush.
Description: Buck is a big-hearted dog whose blissful domestic life is turned upside down when he is suddenly uprooted from his California home and transplanted to the exotic wilds of the Yukon during the Gold Rush of the 1890s. As the newest rookie on a mail delivery dog sled team—and later its leader—Buck experiences the adventure of a lifetime, ultimately finding his true place in the world and becoming his own master.

Title: From Hell
Hint: An opium-addicted inspector hunts Jack the Ripper through Victorian Whitechapel.
Description: Frederick Abberline is an opium-huffing inspector from Scotland Yard who falls for one of Jack the Ripper's prostitute targets in this Hughes brothers adaption of a graphic novel that posits the Ripper's true identity.

Title: The Wolverine
Hint: The clawed mutant travels to Japan and faces his own mortality.
Description: ___ faces his ultimate nemesis - and tests of his physical, emotional, and mortal limits - in a life-changing voyage to modern-day Japan.

Title: Zombieland: Double Tap
Hint: The undead-killing survivors return a decade later to face evolved zombies.
Description: Columbus, Tallahassee, Wichita, and Little Rock move to the American heartland as they face off against evolved zombies, fellow survivors, and the growing pains of the snarky makeshift family.

Title: The Good Shepherd
Hint: A Yale graduate's life is consumed by building the early CIA.
Description: Edward Wilson, the only witness to his father's suicide and member of the Skull and Bones Society while a student at Yale, is a morally upright young man who values honor and discretion, qualities that help him to be recruited for a career in the newly founded OSS. His dedication to his work does not come without a price though, leading him to sacrifice his ideals and eventually his family.

Title: No Escape
Hint: An American family is caught in a violent coup in Southeast Asia.
Description: In their new overseas home, an American family soon finds themselves caught in the middle of a coup, and they frantically look for a safe escape in an environment where foreigners are being immediately executed.

Title: Escape Plan
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A security expert who designs prisons is locked inside his own creation.
Description: Ray Breslin is the world's foremost authority on structural security. After analyzing every high security prison and learning a vast array of survival skills so he can design escape-proof prisons, his skills are put to the test. He's framed and incarcerated in a master prison he designed himself. He needs to escape and find the person who put him behind bars.

Title: Rush Hour 2
Country: United States of America, Hong Kong
Hint: A Hong Kong cop and his loudmouth LA partner pursue a counterfeit ring in Hong Kong.
Description: It's vacation time for Carter as he finds himself alongside Lee in Hong Kong wishing for more excitement. While Carter wants to party and meet the ladies, Lee is out to track down a Triad gang lord who may be responsible for killing two men at the American Embassy. Things get complicated as the pair stumble onto a counterfeiting plot.

Title: Killer Joe
Hint: A cop who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill a family's mother.
Description: A cop who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister.

Title: Bumblebee
Hint: A transforming robot hides in a junkyard and befriends a teenage girl.
Description: On the run in the year 1987, ___ finds refuge in a junkyard in a small Californian beach town. Charlie, on the cusp of turning 18 and trying to find her place in the world, discovers ___, battle-scarred and broken. When Charlie revives him, she quickly learns this is no ordinary yellow VW bug.

Title: Warcraft
Hint: Orcs fleeing their dying world invade the human kingdom of Azeroth.
Description: The peaceful realm of Azeroth stands on the brink of war as its civilization faces a fearsome race of invaders: orc warriors fleeing their dying home to colonize another. As a portal opens to connect the two worlds, one army faces destruction and the other faces extinction. From opposing sides, two heroes are set on a collision course that will decide the fate of their family, their people, and their home.

Title: A Most Wanted Man
Country: Belgium, Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Chechen-Russian immigrant arrives in Hamburg and becomes the target of spies.
Description: A Chechen Muslim illegally immigrates to Hamburg and becomes a person of interest for a covert government team tracking the movements of potential terrorists.

Title: One Piece Film: Red
Hint: A pirate crew attends a concert by a world-famous singer who has a dangerous secret.
Description: A new adventure begins for Luffy and his crew when mysterious pop superstar Uta unveils her identity — and launches a misguided plan for world peace.

Title: High Tension
Hint: A young woman tries to save her friend after a killer slaughters her family.
Description: Best friends Marie and Alexia decide to spend a quiet weekend at Alexia's parents' secluded farmhouse. But on the night of their arrival, the girls' idyllic getaway turns into an endless night of horror.

Title: Pocahontas
Hint: A Native American chief's daughter falls in love with an English settler.
Description: ___, daughter of a Native American tribe chief, falls in love with an English soldier as colonists invade 17th century Virginia.

Title: Cocoon
Hint: Florida retirees swim in a pool holding alien pods and feel young again.
Description: When a group of trespassing seniors swim in a pool containing alien cocoons, they find themselves energized with youthful vigor.

Title: Backdraft
Hint: Two rival firefighter brothers hunt an arsonist setting deadly fires in Chicago.
Description: Two feuding siblings carrying on a heroic family tradition as Chicago firefighters. But when a puzzling series of arson attacks is reported, they are forced to set aside their differences to solve the mystery surrounding these crimes.

Title: The Matrix Revolutions
Hint: The final battle between humans and machines for the city of Zion.
Description: The human city of Zion defends itself against the massive invasion of the machines as Neo fights to end the war at another front while also opposing the rogue Agent Smith.

Title: American Reunion
Hint: Old high school friends get together for their class get-together in East Great Falls.
Description: The characters we met a little more than a decade ago return to East Great Falls for their high school ___. In one long-overdue weekend, they will discover what has changed, who hasn’t, and that time and distance can’t break the bonds of friendship.

Title: Heaven's Gate
Hint: A Harvard-educated marshal defends immigrants from cattle barons in Wyoming.
Description: Harvard graduate James Averill serves as the sheriff of prosperous Jackson County, Wyoming, standing at the center of a conflict between impoverished immigrants and affluent cattle farmers. Politically connected ranchers enlist mercenary Nathan Champion—who is also vying for the affections of local madam Ella Watson—to combat the immigrant uprising.

Title: Candyman
Hint: A grad student studying urban legends summons a hook-handed spirit.
Description: The ___, a murderous soul with a hook for a hand, is accidentally summoned to reality by a skeptic grad student researching the monster's myth.

Title: The Client
Hint: A street-wise kid hires a lawyer after witnessing a mob lawyer's suicide.
Description: A street-wise kid, Mark Sway, sees the suicide of Jerome Clifford, a prominent Louisiana lawyer, whose current ___ is Barry 'The Blade' Muldano, a Mafia hit-man. Before Jerome shoots himself, he tells Mark where the body of a Senator is buried. Clifford shoots himself and Mark is found at the scene, and both the FBI and the Mafia quickly realize that Mark probably knows more than he says.

Title: Drop Dead Gorgeous
Hint: A small-town Minnesota teen beauty pageant turns deadly as contestants start to die.
Description: In a small Minnesota town, the annual beauty pageant is being covered by a TV crew. Former winner Gladys Leeman wants to make sure her daughter follows in her footsteps; explosions, falling lights, and trailer fires prove that. As the Leemans are the richest family in town, the police are pretty relaxed about it all. Despite everything, main rival (but sweet) Amber Atkins won't give up without a fight.

Title: Tron
Hint: A computer programmer is sucked into a video game world.
Description: When brilliant video game maker Flynn hacks the mainframe of his ex-employer, he is beamed inside an astonishing digital world and becomes part of the very game he is designing. In his mission through cyberspace, Flynn matches wits with a maniacal Master Control Program and teams up with ___, a security measure created to bring balance to the digital environment.

Title: Mary Poppins Returns
Hint: The magical nanny with a flying umbrella comes back to help the grown-up Banks children.
Description: ___ to the Banks family and helps them evade grave dangers by taking them on magical, musical adventures.

Title: Metal Lords
Hint: Two teenage misfits want to win a battle of the bands with their thrashing band.
Description: For teenage misfits Hunter and Kevin, the path to glory is clear: Devote themselves to ___. Win Battle of the Bands. And be worshipped like gods.

Title: The Exorcism of Emily Rose
Hint: A lawyer defends a priest accused of negligence in a young woman's death after a ritual to cast out a demon.
Description: When a younger girl called ___ dies, everyone puts blame on the ___ which was performed on her by Father Moore prior to her death. The priest is arrested on suspicion of murder. The trial begins with lawyer Erin Bruner representing Moore, but it is not going to be easy, as no one wants to believe what Father Moore says is true.

Title: Stoker
Hint: After her father dies, a girl's mysterious uncle comes to live with her.
Description: After India’s father dies suddenly, her uncle Charlie, whom she never knew existed, comes to live with her and her emotionally unstable mother. Soon after his arrival, she begins to suspect that this mysterious, charming man has ulterior motives. But instead of feeling outrage or horror, the friendless girl becomes increasingly infatuated with him.

Title: James and the Giant Peach
Hint: A young orphan sails across the ocean inside an enormous fruit with insect friends.
Description: When the young orphan boy James spills a magic bag of crocodile tongues, he finds himself in possession of a ___ that flies him away to strange lands.

Title: Prince of Darkness
Hint: A priest and students discover a canister containing the essence of Satan.
Description: A priest discovers an ancient canister containing a strange liquid in an abandoned church. When a group of graduate students and scientists are tasked with studying it, they unknowingly unleash an evil force waiting to destroy all of humanity.

Title: Hot Shots!
Hint: A pilot with a troubled past is recruited for a top-secret mission in a parody of Top Gun.
Description: The gang that created Airplane! and The Naked Gun sets its sights on Top Gun in this spoof. Topper Harley is a talented but unstable fighter pilot with an axe to grind: clearing the family name. His mission is to avenge his father and save a mission sabotaged by greedy weapons manufacturers. He also gets involved in a relationship with Ramada Thompson, a woman with an unusually talented stomach. ___

Title: The Bone Collector
Hint: A paralyzed detective and a rookie cop track a serial killer.
Description: Lincoln Rhyme was the department's top homicide detective and leading expert in criminal forensics until an injury left him paralyzed, depressed, and incapable of working. But when a gruesome murder in Manhattan leaves detectives baffled, they call on Rhyme to help solve the mystery.

Title: Absolute Power
Hint: A master thief witnesses a murder involving the President.
Description: A master thief coincidentally is robbing a house where a murder—in which the President of the United States is involved—occurs in front of his eyes. He is forced to run, while holding evidence that could convict the President.

Title: Extremely Wicked, Shockingly Evil and Vile
Hint: The charming serial killer's girlfriend refuses to believe the truth.
Description: A chronicle of the crimes of Ted Bundy, from the perspective of his longtime girlfriend, Elizabeth Kloepfer, who refused to believe the truth about him for years.

Title: Ferdinand
Hint: A gentle bull is mistaken for a dangerous beast and taken to Madrid.
Description: ___, a little bull, prefers sitting quietly under a cork tree just smelling the flowers versus jumping around, snorting, and butting heads with other bulls. As ___ grows big and strong, his temperament remains mellow. But one day five men come to choose the "biggest, fastest, roughest bull" for the bullfights in Madrid— and ___ is mistakenly chosen.

Title: The Good Dinosaur
Hint: An Apatosaurus befriends a human boy on a journey home.
Description: An epic journey into the world of dinosaurs where an Apatosaurus named Arlo makes an unlikely human friend.

Title: Saint Maud
Hint: A pious young palliative nurse becomes obsessed with saving her dying patient's soul.
Description: Having recently found God, self-effacing young nurse ___ arrives at a plush home to care for Amanda, a hedonistic dancer left frail from a chronic illness. When a chance encounter with a former colleague throws up hints of a dark past, it becomes clear there is more to sweet ___ than meets the eye.

Title: The Last Letter from Your Lover
Hint: A journalist in London discovers a trove of secret love notes from the 1960s and investigates.
Description: A young journalist in London becomes obsessed with a series of letters she discovers that recounts an intense star-crossed love affair from the 1960s.

Title: Safe House
Hint: A rookie CIA agent guarding a Cape Town hideout must protect a rogue operative on the run.
Description: A dangerous CIA renegade resurfaces after a decade on the run. When the ___ he's remanded to is attacked by mercenaries, a rookie operative escapes with him. Now, the unlikely allies must stay alive long enough to uncover who wants them dead.

Title: Primer
Hint: Two engineers accidentally build a time machine in a garage.
Description: A group of fledgling inventors discover a complex method to manipulate reality. At first, they successfully game the stock market with it, but the consequences of the invention start to catch up with them.

Title: Stay
Hint: A psychiatrist tries to save a suicidal patient as reality begins to fall apart.
Description: Psychiatrist Sam Foster has a new patient, Henry Letham, who claims to be suicidal. In trying to diagnose him, Sam visits Henry's prior therapist and also finds Henry's mother -- even though Henry has said that he murdered both of his parents. As reality starts to contradict fact, Sam spirals into an unstable mental state.

Title: Four Rooms
Hint: A hotel bellhop's first night on the job on New Year's Eve.
Description: It's Ted the Bellhop's first night on the job...and the hotel's very unusual guests are about to place him in some outrageous predicaments. It seems that this evening's room service is serving up one unbelievable happening after another.

Title: Surf's Up
Hint: A young penguin surfer enters a big surfing competition, filmed in mockumentary style.
Description: With a documentary crew in tow, Cody Maverick—a young surfer from Antarctica—travels to the pacific for his first professional competition. Determined to earn respect and live up to his idol, Big Z, Cody pushes himself to the limit. But all that changes when an encounter with a laid-back local forces him to rethink his values.

Title: Conspiracy Theory
Hint: A paranoid taxi driver's wild ideas about government plots turn out to be true.
Description: A man obsessed with conspiracy theories becomes a target after one of his theories turns out to be true. Unfortunately, in order to save himself, he has to figure out which ___ it is.

Title: Super
Hint: A short-order cook becomes a superhero to rescue his wife from a drug dealer.
Description: After his wife falls under the influence of a drug dealer, an everyday guy transforms himself into Crimson Bolt, a superhero with the best intentions, though he lacks for heroic skills.

Title: Just Like Heaven
Hint: A landscape architect moves into an apartment haunted by a woman in a coma.
Description: Shortly after David Abbott moves into his new San Francisco digs, he has an unwelcome visitor on his hands: winsome Elizabeth Masterson, who asserts that the apartment is hers -- and promptly vanishes. When she starts appearing and disappearing at will, David thinks she's a ghost, while Elizabeth is convinced she's alive.

Title: Wyatt Earp
Hint: The life of a famous Old West lawman, from Kansas to his shootout in Tombstone.
Description: From Wichita to Dodge City, to the O.K. Corral in Tombstone, ___ is taught that nothing matters more than family and the law. Joined by his brothers and Doc Holliday, ___ wages war on the dreaded Clanton and McLaury gangs.

Title: Bend It Like Beckham
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An Indian girl in London defies her parents to play soccer.
Description: Jess Bhamra, the daughter of a strict Indian couple in London, is not permitted to play organized soccer, even though she is 18. When Jess is playing for fun one day, her impressive skills are seen by Jules Paxton, who then convinces Jess to play for her semi-pro team. Jess uses elaborate excuses to hide her matches from her family while also dealing with her romantic feelings for her coach, Joe.

Title: City of Angels
Hint: An angel falls in love with a surgeon and considers becoming human.
Description: When a guardian angel – who invisibly watches over the citizens of Los Angeles – becomes captivated by a strong-willed heart surgeon, he ponders trading in his pure, otherworldly existence for a mortal life with his beloved. The couple embarks on a tender but forbidden romance spanning heaven and Earth.

Title: The Best of Me
Hint: Former high school sweethearts from a small town reunite after 20 years for a friend's funeral.
Description: A pair of former high school sweethearts reunite after many years when they return to visit their small hometown.

Title: Rio Lobo
Hint: A former Union colonel hunts the traitors who sold out his gold shipment.
Description: After the Civil War, a former Union colonel searches for the two traitors whose perfidy led to the loss of a close friend.

Title: Scanners
Hint: A man with telepathic powers is trained to stop other telepaths.
Description: A scientist trains a man with an advanced telepathic ability called 'scanning' to stop a dangerous Scanner with extraordinary psychic powers from waging war against non-___.

Title: Jungle
Country: Australia, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Three backpackers get lost in the Bolivian rainforest and one is left alone to survive.
Description: In 1981, an enthusiastic young adventurer follows his dreams into the Bolivian Amazon ___ with two friends and a guide with a mysterious past. Their journey quickly turns into a terrifying ordeal as the darkest elements of human nature and the deadliest threats of the wilderness lead to an all-out fight for survival.

Title: The Last Starfighter
Hint: A video game expert is recruited to fight in an intergalactic war.
Description: Video game expert Alex Rogan finds himself transported to another planet after conquering the video game The ___, only to find out it was just a test. He was recruited to join the team of best Starfighters to defend their world from the attack.

Title: On Her Majesty's Secret Service
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The spy pursues his nemesis to the Swiss Alps and falls in love with a countess.
Description: With the help of Marc-Ange Draco, head of the Unione Corse crime syndicate, and Draco's troubled daughter Tracy, James Bond tracks his archnemesis, Ernst Stravro Blofeld, to a mountaintop retreat in the Swiss Alps, where he is training an army of beautiful, lethal women.

Title: For Your Eyes Only
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A British agent searches for a lost missile command system and avenges a murdered couple's daughter.
Description: A British spy ship has sunk and on board was a hi-tech encryption device. James Bond is sent to find the device that holds British launching instructions before the enemy Soviets get to it first.

Title: To Wong Foo, Thanks for Everything! Julie Newmar
Hint: Three drag queens are stranded in a small Midwestern town.
Description: Manhattan drag queens Vida Boheme and Noxeema Jackson impress regional judges in competition, securing berths in the Nationals in Los Angeles. When the two meet pathetic drag novice Chi-Chi Rodriguez — one of the losers that evening — the charmed Vida and Noxeema agree to take the hopeless youngster under their joined wing.

Title: Sliding Doors
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two parallel stories of a woman's life depending on whether she catches a train.
Description: Helen, a London ad executive, is fired from her job and rushes out to catch a train, but, as she runs down, her life suddenly splits off. In one version she catches the train; in the second, she misses it. Her whole life changes in that one second, and the rest of the film depicts what happens in each scenario.

Title: Slumberland
Hint: A young girl discovers a map to the dreamworld and goes looking for her late father.
Description: A young girl discovers a secret map to the dreamworld of ___, and with the help of an eccentric outlaw, she traverses dreams and flees nightmares, with the hope that she will be able to see her late father again.

Title: The Other Boleyn Girl
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two sisters compete for the love of King Henry VIII.
Description: A sumptuous and sensual tale of intrigue, romance and betrayal set against the backdrop of a defining moment in European history: two beautiful sisters, Anne and Mary ___, driven by their family's blind ambition, compete for the love of the handsome and passionate King Henry VIII.

Title: The Vast of Night
Hint: Two radio-obsessed teens in 1950s New Mexico discover a strange frequency.
Description: At the dawn of the space-race, two radio-obsessed teens discover a strange frequency over the airwaves in what becomes the most important night of their lives and in the history of their small town.

Title: You Were Never Really Here
Hint: A traumatized veteran rescues trafficked girls with a hammer.
Description: A traumatized veteran, unafraid of violence, tracks down missing girls for a living. When a job spins out of control, Joe's nightmares overtake him as a conspiracy is uncovered—leading to what may be his death trip or his awakening.

Title: Singles
Hint: Twenty-somethings in Seattle navigate love during the grunge era.
Description: A group of young adults in their twenties, who share an apartment in the city of Seattle, ponder on love and face all the challenges of adulthood.

Title: Blast from the Past
Hint: A man raised in a fallout shelter emerges into 1990s Los Angeles after 35 years.
Description: Following a bomb scare in the 1960s that locked the Webers into their bomb shelter for 35 years, Adam now ventures forth into Los Angeles to obtain food and supplies for his family, and a non-mutant wife for himself.

Title: Live and Let Die
Hint: A secret agent investigates a Harlem drug lord with voodoo ties.
Description: James Bond must investigate a mysterious murder case of a British agent in New Orleans. Soon he finds himself up against a gangster boss named Mr. Big.

Title: Hamburger Hill
Hint: American soldiers fight a brutal ten-day battle up a ridge in the A Shau Valley.
Description: The men of Bravo Company are facing a battle that's all uphill… up ___. Fourteen war-weary soldiers are battling for a mud-covered mound of earth so named because it chews up soldiers like chopped meat. They are fighting for their country, their fellow soldiers and their lives. War is hell, but this is worse. ___ tells it the way it was, the way it really was.

Title: Gangster Squad
Hint: LAPD officers wage a secret war against a mob boss.
Description: Los Angeles, 1949. Ruthless, Brooklyn-born mob king Mickey Cohen runs the show in this town, reaping the ill-gotten gains from the drugs, the guns, the prostitutes and — if he has his way — every wire bet placed west of Chicago. And he does it all with the protection of not only his own paid goons, but also the police and the politicians who are under his control.

Title: Hot Rod
Hint: A wannabe stuntman tries to raise money for his stepfather's heart surgery so he can beat him up.
Description: For ___ Kimble, performing stunts is a way of life, even though he is rather accident-prone. Poor ___ cannot even get any respect from his stepfather, Frank, who beats him up in weekly sparring matches. When Frank falls ill, ___ devises his most outrageous stunt yet to raise money for Frank's operation -- and then ___ will kick Frank's butt.

Title: The Hand That Rocks the Cradle
Hint: A vengeful nanny infiltrates a suburban family to destroy the mother she blames for her husband's suicide.
Description: A suburban family chooses seemingly sweet Peyton Flanders as their newborn's nanny. Only much later does the infant's mother, Claire Bartel, realize Peyton's true intentions -- to destroy Claire and replace her in the family. The nail-biting suspense builds quickly in this chilling psychological thriller about deception and bitter revenge.

Title: The Entity
Hint: A single mother is attacked by an invisible force.
Description: A single mom is raped by an invisible force. Her psychiatrist believes the experience stems from childhood trauma, while she knows something supernatural is at play.

Title: Over the Hedge
Hint: A raccoon convinces forest animals to raid the suburbs.
Description: A scheming raccoon fools a mismatched family of forest creatures into helping him repay a debt of food, by invading the new suburban sprawl that popped up while they were hibernating – and learns a lesson about family himself.

Title: 2010: The Year We Make Contact
Hint: A joint American-Soviet mission travels to Jupiter to find out what happened to Discovery.
Description: While planet Earth poises on the brink of nuclear self-destruction, a team of Russian and American scientists aboard the Leonov hurtles to a rendezvous with the still-orbiting Discovery spacecraft and its sole known survivor, the homicidal computer HAL.

Title: Goodnight Mommy
Hint: Twin brothers doubt that the bandaged woman is really their mother.
Description: In the heat of the summer lays a lonesome house in the countryside where nine year old twin brothers await their mother’s return. When she comes home, bandaged after cosmetic surgery, nothing is like before and the children start to doubt whether this woman is actually who she says she is.

Title: After Yang
Hint: A father tries to repair his family's robot son.
Description: When his young daughter's beloved companion — an android named ___ — malfunctions, Jake searches for a way to repair him. In the process, Jake discovers the life that has been passing in front of him, reconnecting with his wife and daughter across a distance he didn't know was there.

Title: A Private War
Hint: A fearless, eyepatch-wearing correspondent covers conflicts from Sri Lanka to Syria at great personal cost.
Description: One of the most celebrated war correspondents of our time, Marie Colvin is an utterly fearless and rebellious spirit, driven to the frontlines of conflicts across the globe to give voice to the voiceless.

Title: Marrowbone
Hint: Four siblings hide from the world in an old farmhouse.
Description: A young man and his three younger siblings are plagued by a sinister presence in the sprawling manor in which they live.

Title: The New World
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: English settlers arrive in Virginia in 1607 and a captain falls for a Native American girl.
Description: A drama about explorer John Smith and the clash between Native Americans and English settlers in the 17th century.

Title: Under the Tuscan Sun
Hint: A divorced San Francisco writer impulsively buys a villa in Tuscany and rebuilds her life.
Description: Frances Mayes, a 35-year-old professor and writer from San Francisco, decides to take a tour of Tuscany following a difficult divorce. After impulsively buying a run-down villa in the Italian countryside, she begins to piece her life back together in unexpected ways.

Title: Attack the Block
Hint: A teen gang defends their South London council estate from furry alien invaders.
Description: A South London teen gang must team up with the other residents of their housing estate to protect the neighbourhood from a terrifying alien invasion.

Title: Harriet
Hint: A woman escapes slavery and leads others to freedom.
Description: The extraordinary tale of ___ Tubman's escape from slavery and transformation into one of America's greatest heroes. Her courage, ingenuity and tenacity freed hundreds of slaves and changed the course of history.

Title: Kalifornia
Hint: A journalist duo go on a tour of serial killer murder sites with a killer.
Description: A journalist duo go on a tour of serial killer murder sites with two companions, unaware that one of them is a serial killer himself.

Title: Center Stage
Hint: A group of teens enrol at the American Ballet Academy in New York and compete for places.
Description: A group of 12 teenagers from various backgrounds enroll at the American Ballet Academy in New York to make it as ballet dancers and each one deals with the problems and stress of training and getting ahead in the world of dance.

Title: The Living Daylights
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A British secret agent helps a Soviet general defect and uncovers an arms deal.
Description: After a defecting Russian general reveals a plot to assassinate foreign spies, James Bond is assigned a secret mission to dispatch the new head of the KGB to prevent an escalation of tensions between the Soviet Union and the West.

Title: K-19: The Widowmaker
Country: Canada, Germany, Russia, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Soviet nuclear submarine malfunctions on its maiden voyage, risking a meltdown.
Description: When Russia's first nuclear submarine malfunctions on its maiden voyage, the crew must race to save the ship and prevent a nuclear disaster.

Title: Inside
Hint: A disgraced detective goes undercover in a prison to find the man responsible for a murder.
Description: Based on true events. A disgraced police detective seeking redemption goes undercover to expose a violent crime syndicate. But as he sinks deeper into the mob, the price for absolution may be higher than he can afford.

Title: THX 1138
Hint: A technician in a drug-controlled totalitarian future society rebels and tries to escape.
Description: People in the future live in a totalitarian society. A technician named ___ lives a mundane life between work and taking a controlled consumption of drugs that the government uses to make puppets out of people. As ___ is without drugs for the first time he has feelings for a woman and they start a secret relationship.

Title: The Grey
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Oil workers stranded in Alaska are hunted by wolves.
Description: Following a grueling five-week shift at an Alaskan oil refinery, workers led by sharpshooter John Ottway are flying home for a much-needed vacation. But a brutal storm causes their plane to crash in the frozen wilderness, and only eight men, including Ottway, survive.

Title: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping
Hint: A pop star's career collapses after his second album flops, in a hilarious mockumentary.
Description: When his new album fails to sell records, pop/rap superstar Conner4real goes into a major tailspin and watches his celebrity high life begin to collapse. He'll try anything to bounce back, anything except reuniting with his old rap group The Style Boyz.

Title: A Walk in the Clouds
Hint: A WWII vet pretends to be the husband of a pregnant woman.
Description: World War II vet Paul Sutton falls for a pregnant and unwed woman who persuades him -- during their first encounter -- to pose as her husband so she can face her family.

Title: The Finest Hours
Hint: The Coast Guard attempts a daring rescue of the crew of a split oil tanker in a storm.
Description: The Coast Guard makes a daring rescue attempt off the coast of Cape Cod after a pair of oil tankers are destroyed during a blizzard in 1952.

Title: Phenomena
Hint: A girl who communicates with insects investigates murders at a Swiss school.
Description: A young girl, with an amazing ability to communicate with insects, is transferred to an exclusive Swiss boarding school, where her unusual capability might help solve a string of murders.

Title: Summer of 84
Hint: Teenagers in 1984 suspect their police officer neighbour is a serial killer.
Description: After suspecting that their police officer neighbor is a serial killer, a group of teenage friends spend their summer spying on him and gathering evidence, but as they get closer to discovering the truth, things get dangerous.

Title: If I Stay
Hint: A talented cellist in a coma after a car accident decides whether to live or die.
Description: Mia Hall, a talented young cellist, thought the most difficult decision she would ever have to make would be whether to pursue her musical dreams at prestigious Juilliard or follow her heart to be with the love of her life, Adam, a rock singer/guitarist. However, a car wreck changes everything in an instant, and now Mia's life hangs in the balance.

Title: I Am Mother
Country: Australia, United States of America, Luxembourg
Hint: A robot raises a girl in a bunker after humanity's extinction.
Description: A teenage girl is raised underground by a robot "Mother", designed to repopulate the earth following an extinction event. But their unique bond is threatened when an inexplicable stranger arrives with alarming news.

Title: Hillbilly Elegy
Hint: A Yale Law student returns home to deal with his family.
Description: An urgent phone call pulls a Yale Law student back to his Ohio hometown, where he reflects on three generations of family history and his own future.

Title: The Tender Bar
Hint: A fatherless boy grows up learning about life from his uncle, a bartender with a library.
Description: JR is a fatherless boy growing up in the glow of a ___ where the bartender, his Uncle Charlie, is the sharpest and most colorful of an assortment of quirky and demonstrative father figures.

Title: Underworld: Evolution
Hint: A vampire and a hybrid face an ancient enemy.
Description: As the war between the vampires and the Lycans rages on, Selene, a former member of the Death Dealers (an elite vampire special forces unit that hunts werewolves), and Michael, the werewolf hybrid, work together in an effort to unlock the secrets of their respective bloodlines.

Title: All Dogs Go to Heaven
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A murdered casino dog sneaks back from the afterlife to seek revenge and finds an orphan girl.
Description: When a casino-owning dog named Charlie is murdered by his rival Carface, he finds himself in ___. Wanting to get back at his killer, he cons his way back to the living with the warning that doing so damns him to Hell. Once back, he teams with his old partner, Itchy, to prep his retaliation.

Title: Damage
Hint: A politician has an affair with his son's fiancée.
Description: The life of a respected British politician at the height of his career crumbles when he becomes obsessed with his son's lover.

Title: Land
Hint: A grieving woman moves to a remote cabin in the Rocky Mountains to escape her loss.
Description: Edee, in the aftermath of an unfathomable event, finds herself unable to stay connected to the world she once knew and in the face of that uncertainty, retreats to the magnificent, but unforgiving, wilds of the Rockies. After a local hunter brings her back from the brink of death, she must find a way to live again.

Title: The Man with the Golden Gun
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A British agent searches for a solar energy device and a hitman.
Description: Cool government operative James Bond searches for a stolen invention that can turn the sun's heat into a destructive weapon. He soon crosses paths with the menacing Francisco Scaramanga, a hitman so skilled he has a seven-figure working fee.

Title: Mermaids
Hint: A teenage girl in the 1960s is tired of her wacky mother moving the family around.
Description: Fifteen-year-old Charlotte Flax is tired of her wacky mom moving their family to a different town any time she feels it is necessary. When they move to a small Massachusetts town and Mrs. Flax begins dating a shopkeeper, Charlotte and her 9-year-old sister, Kate, hope that they can finally settle down.

Title: Imagine Me & You
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A bride falls in love with the florist at her own wedding.

Description: Novalee Nation is a 17-year-old Tennessee transient who has to grow up in a hurry when she's left pregnant and abandoned by her boyfriend on a roadside, and takes refuge in the friendly aisles of Wal-Mart. Description: 19-year-old Ben Burns unexpectedly returns home to his family's suburban home on Christmas Eve morning. Ben's mother, Holly, is relieved and welcoming but wary of her son staying clean. Description: The true story of Forrest Tucker, from his audacious escape from San Quentin at the age of 70 to an unprecedented string of heists that confounded authorities and enchanted the public. Wrapped up in the pursuit are a detective, who becomes captivated with Forrest’s commitment to his craft, and a woman, who loves him in spite of his chosen profession.

Title: Ghost Town
Hint: A cranky Manhattan dentist dies for seven minutes and wakes up able to see spirits who need favors.
Description: Bertram Pincus, a cranky, people-hating Manhattan dentist, develops the unwelcome ability to see dead people. Really annoying dead people. They are soon entangled in a hilarious predicament between the now and the hereafter!

Description: Befriended by aristocrat Sebastian Flyte, Oxford student Charles Ryder finds that the power and privilege experienced by the family is seductive. Title: Regarding Henry

Description: After being shot, a lawyer loses his memory and must relearn speech and mobility, but he has a loving family to support him.

Description: Martin, a mercenary, is sent from Europe by an anonymous biotech company to the Tasmanian wilderness on a hunt for the last Tasmanian tiger.

Description: As an asteroid nears Earth, a man finds himself alone after his wife leaves in a panic. He decides to take a road trip to reunite with his high school sweetheart. Accompanying him is a neighbor who inadvertently puts a wrench in his plan.

Description: Dirty Harry Callahan returns again, this time saddled with a rookie female partner. Together, they must stop a terrorist group consisting of angry Vietnam veterans.

Description: The adventure of Bella, a dog who embarks on an epic 400-mile journey home after she is separated from her beloved human.

Description: Countless wiseguy films are spoofed in this film that centers on the neuroses and angst of a powerful Mafia racketeer who suffers from panic attacks. This ruse with Olivia thrusts Antonio into the spotlight and unexpected chaos.

Description: A young woman who has been in and out from rehab for the past 10 years returns home for the weekend for her sister's wedding.

Description: Set during a sultry summer in a French suburb, Marie is desperate to join the local pool's synchronized swimming team, but is her interest solely for the sake of sport or for a chance to get close to Floriane, the bad girl of the team? Sciamma, and the two leads, capture the uncertainty of teenage sexuality with a sympathetic eye in this delicate drama of the angst of coming-of-age.

Title: The Legend of Bagger Vance

Description: World War I has left golfer Rannulph Junuh a poker-playing alcoholic, his perfect swing gone. Now, however, he needs to get it back to play in a tournament to save the financially ravaged golf course of a long-ago sweetheart. Help arrives in the form of mysterious caddy ___.

Description: Newly single, 35, and uninspired by his job, Jesse Fisher worries that his best days are behind him. But no matter how much he buries his head in a book, life keeps pulling Jesse back.
