Description: Advertising executive Nick Beame learns that his wife is sleeping with his employer. In a state of despair, he encounters a bumbling thief whose attempted carjacking goes awry when Nick takes him on an involuntary joyride. Soon the betrayed businessman and the incompetent crook strike up a partnership and develop a robbery-revenge scheme.

Title: The Last Man on Earth
Hint: The last man alive hunts vampires in a world ravaged by plague.
Description: When a disease turns all of humanity into the living dead, the ___ becomes a reluctant vampire hunter.

Title: L.A. Story
Hint: A wacky weatherman gets help from a talking freeway sign to find love.
Description: With the help of a talking freeway billboard, a "wacky weatherman" tries to win the heart of an English newspaper reporter, who is struggling to make sense of the strange world of early-90s Los Angeles.

Title: Journey to the West: Conquering the Demons
Studio: Huayi Brothers Pictures 浙江华谊兄弟影业
Hint: A demon hunter falls for a fearless woman while trying to subdue a monkey king.
Description: In a world plagued by ___ who cause great human suffering, young demon hunter Tang Sanzang must fight against monstrous ___, as well as contend with a beautiful demon hunting woman on his path to enlightenment.

Title: Goal! The Dream Begins
Country: Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young Mexican immigrant in Los Angeles gets a shot at playing for Newcastle United.
Description: Like millions of kids around the world, Santiago harbors the dream of being a professional footballer... However, living in the Barrios section of Los Angeles, he thinks it is only that—a dream. Until one day an extraordinary turn of events has him trying out for Premiership club Newcastle United.

Title: Om Shanti Om
Hint: A junior actor murdered in the 1970s is reincarnated as a star.
Description: In the early 70s, aspiring actor Om Prakash Makhija, and a famous starlet Shantipriya, are murdered. Thirty years later, his reincarnation Om Kapoor sets out to discover the mystery of their demise.

Title: Slums of Beverly Hills
Hint: A teenager in 1976 moves between cheap apartments in a posh zip code with her father.
Description: In 1976, a lower-middle-class teenager struggles to cope living with her neurotic family of nomads on the outskirts of ___.

Title: A Christmas Story Christmas
Hint: A grown man returns to his childhood home in Indiana for the holidays after his father's death.
Description: Follows Ralphie, now adult, who returns to the house on Cleveland Street to give his kids a magical Christmas like the one he had as a child, reconnecting with childhood friends, and reconciling the passing of his Old Man.

Title: Housebound
Hint: A troubled woman under house arrest suspects her childhood home is haunted.
Description: When Kylie Bucknell is sentenced to home detention, she's forced to come to terms with her unsociable behaviour, her blabbering mother and a hostile spirit who seems less than happy about the new living arrangement.

Title: Proof
Hint: A daughter of a brilliant mathematician fears she has inherited his madness.
Description: Catherine is a woman in her late twenties who is strongly devoted to her father, Robert, a brilliant and well-known mathematician whose grip on reality is beginning to slip away. As Robert descends into madness, Catherine begins to wonder if she may have inherited her father's mental illness along with his mathematical genius.

Title: Kopps
Hint: Cops in a crime-free Swedish village invent crimes to save their station.
Description: A small Swedish village, Högboträsk, is so peaceful that crime is nonexistent. The police spend their shifts drinking coffee, eating hot dogs and chasing down runaway cows. This is all well and good for the village's own police, but the police management board wants to discontinue the local police force for lack of crime.

Title: Frankie and Johnny
Hint: A cook released from prison falls for a waitress who has given up on love.
Description: When ___ is released from prison following a forgery charge, he quickly lands a job as a short-order cook at a New York diner. Following a brief fling with waitress Cora, he develops an attraction for Cora's friend and fellow waitress ___. While ___ resists ___ charms initially, she eventually relents when her best friend, Tim, persuades her to give ___ a chance.

Title: Le Mans
Hint: A racer competes in the famous 24-hour endurance race in France.
Description: Filmed during the annual 24-hour endurance race at ___, Michael Delaney is a Porsche driver haunted by the memory of an accident at the previous year's race in which a competing driver was killed. Delaney also finds himself increasingly infatuated with the man's widow.

Title: Mystery, Alaska
Hint: A tiny frozen town's pond hockey team plays the New York Rangers.
Description: In ___, life revolves around the legendary Saturday hockey game at the local pond. But everything changes when the hometown team unexpectedly gets booked in an exhibition match against the New York Rangers. When quirky small-towners, slick promoters and millionaire athletes come together.

Title: Rebel in the Rye
Hint: The life of a reclusive author whose famous novel featured a red-hunting-hat teen.
Description: The life of celebrated but reclusive author J.D. Salinger, who gained worldwide fame with the publication of his novel The Catcher in the ___.

Title: The Company Men
Hint: Corporate executives lose their jobs during a downsizing and must rebuild their lives.
Description: Bobby Walker lives the proverbial American dream: great job, beautiful family, shiny Porsche in the garage. When corporate downsizing leaves him and two co-workers jobless, the three men are forced to re-define their lives as men, husbands and fathers.

Title: The Pirates! Band of Misfits
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A pirate captain wants to win Pirate of the Year.
Description: The enthusiastic Pirate Captain, along with his rag-tag crew, sets out to beat his bitter rivals. The chaotic adventure takes them from exotic shores to Victorian London, and from a haplessly smitten scientist to a diabolical queen.

Title: Performance
Hint: A violent London gangster on the run hides out in a reclusive rock star's bohemian house.
Description: In underworld terms, Chas Devlin is a 'performer,' a gangster with a talent for violence and intimidation. Turner is a reclusive rock superstar. When Chas and Turner meet, their worlds collide—and the impact is both exotic and explosive.

Title: The Wild One
Hint: A biker gang led by a rebel in a leather jacket terrorises a small California town.
Description: The Black Rebels Motorcycle Club ride into the small California town of Wrightsville, eager to raise hell. Brooding gang leader Johnny Strabler takes a liking to Kathie, the daughter of the local lawman, as another club rolls into town.

Title: White Fang
Hint: A young prospector befriends a wolf-dog in the Yukon.
Description: Jack London's classic adventure story about the friendship developed between a Yukon gold hunter and the mixed dog-wolf he rescues from the hands of a man who mistreats him.

Title: Hysteria
Hint: Two doctors in Victorian England develop an electrical device to treat women diagnosed with nervous disorders.
Description: Two doctors in Victorian England use manual stimulation of female genitalia to cure their patients' ills, leading to the invention of the vibrator.

Title: Stir Crazy
Hint: Two jobless New Yorkers are wrongly sent to a Western prison.
Description: New Yorkers Skip Donahue and Harry Monroe have no jobs and no prospects, so they decide to flee the city and find work elsewhere, landing jobs wearing woodpecker costumes to promote the opening of a bank. When their feathery costumes are stolen and used in a bank robbery, they no longer have to worry about employment — they're sent to prison.

Title: Blade of the Immortal
Hint: An undying swordsman cursed with bloodworms helps a girl avenge her murdered parents.
Description: Manji, a highly skilled samurai, becomes cursed with immortality after a legendary battle. Haunted by the brutal murder of his sister, Manji knows that only fighting evil will regain his soul. He promises to help a young girl named Rin avenge her parents, who were killed by a group of master swordsmen led by ruthless warrior Anotsu. The mission will change Manji in ways he could never imagine.

Title: The Last Days of Disco
Hint: Young Manhattanites spend their nights at an exclusive nightclub in the early 1980s.
Description: Two young women and their friends spend spare time at an exclusive nightclub in 1980s New York.

Title: Prizzi's Honor
Hint: A Mafia hitman falls for a woman who is also a hitwoman.
Description: Charley Partanna is a hitman who works for the Prizzis, one of the richest crime families in the US. When he sees Irene Walker, it's love at first sight. But he soon finds that she, too, is a killer for hire. Charley can overlook his suspicions, but he can't turn off his heart. And the couple must remember that even if they love each other, the Prizzis love only money.

Title: Battlestar Galactica
Hint: The survivors of destroyed human colonies flee across space in search of Earth, pursued by robots.
Description: After the destruction of the Twelve Colonies of Mankind, the last major fighter carrier leads a makeshift fugitive fleet in a desperate search for the legendary planet Earth.

Title: Flawless
Hint: An ultraconservative cop takes singing lessons from a drag queen neighbor.
Description: An ultraconservative police officer suffers a debilitating stroke and is assigned to a rehabilitative program that includes singing lessons - with the drag queen next door.

Title: Postcards from the Edge
Hint: A drug-addicted actress is forced to live with her famous mother.
Description: A substance-addicted actress tries to look on the bright side even as she's forced to move back in with her mother to avoid unemployment.

Title: The Legend of Hell House
Hint: A team investigates the most haunted house in England.
Description: A team consisting of a physicist, his wife, a young female psychic, and the only survivor of the previous visit are sent to the notorious Hell House to prove or disprove survival after death. Previous visitors have either been killed or gone mad, and it is up to the team to survive a full week in isolation, and solve the mystery of the Hell House.

Title: French Connection II
Hint: A New York cop travels to Marseilles to find a drug smuggler.
Description: "Popeye" Doyle travels to Marseilles to find Alain Charnier, the drug smuggler that eluded him in New York.

Title: Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex * But Were Afraid to Ask
Hint: Seven bawdy sketches tackle questions about the birds and the bees.
Description: A collection of seven vignettes, which each address a question concerning human sexuality. From aphrodisiacs to sexual perversion to the mystery of the male orgasm, characters like a court jester, a doctor, a queen and a journalist adventure through lab experiments and game shows, all seeking answers to common questions that many would never ___.

Title: The Kindergarten Teacher
Country: Canada, Israel, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Staten Island educator becomes dangerously obsessed with a five-year-old poetry prodigy in her class.
Description: Lisa Spinelli is a Staten Island teacher who is unusually devoted to her students. When she discovers one of her five-year-olds is a prodigy, she becomes fascinated with the boy, ultimately risking her family and freedom to nurture his talent.

Title: Missing Link
Hint: An explorer searches for a mythical creature and finds a talking Sasquatch.
Description: The charismatic Sir Lionel Frost considers himself to be the world's foremost investigator of myths and monsters. Trouble is, none of his small-minded, high-society peers seems to recognize this. Hoping to finally gain acceptance from these fellow adventurers, Sir Lionel travels to the Pacific Northwest to prove the existence of a legendary creature known as the ___.

Title: The Man Without a Face
Hint: A disfigured former teacher tutors a lonely boy, and the town grows suspicious.
Description: Justin McLeod is a former teacher who lives as a recluse on the edge of town after his face is disfigured from an automobile accident ten years earlier, in which a boy was incinerated--and for which he was convicted of involuntary manslaughter. Also suspected of being a paedophile, he is befriended by Chuck, causing the town's suspicions and hostility to be ignited.

Title: Please Stand By
Hint: An autistic young woman runs away to deliver her Star Trek script.
Description: A young autistic woman runs away from her caregiver in order to boldly go and deliver her 500-page Star Trek script to a writing competition in Hollywood. On an adventure full of laughter and tears, Wendy follows the guiding spirit of Mr. Spock on her journey into the unknown.

Title: F/X
Hint: A special effects man is hired to fake a mob witness's murder.
Description: A movies special effects man is hired by a government agency to help stage the assassination of a well known gangster. When the agency double cross him, he uses his special effects to trap the gangster and the corrupt agents.

Title: Mistress America
Hint: A college freshman is swept up by her future stepsister's schemes.
Description: A college freshman cures her disappointment and loneliness by allowing herself to be pulled into the wacky schemes of her future stepsister.

Title: War and Peace
Hint: An epic Soviet adaptation of Russian aristocrats during the Napoleonic invasion.
Description: As 1809 nears its end, Natasha attends her first ball, where Andrei falls in love with her with the intent of marriage. However, as her father demands they wait, the prince travels abroad, leaving Natasha in desperate longing. But she meets Anatol Kuragin and forgets Andrei. Part two of the four-part adaptation of Leo Tolstoy's 1869 novel.

Title: Kidulthood
Hint: A day in the life of troubled teens in west London.
Description: A day in the life of a group of troubled 15-year-olds growing up in west London.

Title: The Best Man
Hint: A novelist's book reveals secrets before his friend's wedding.
Description: After writing a soon-to-be bestselling novel, writer and committed bachelor Harper attempts to hide the fact that his saucy new book is loosely based on the lives and loves of his tight-knit group of friends. Harper is set to be ___ at his friend Lance's wedding, and all his friends will be in attendance.

Title: Cold in July
Hint: A Texas man kills an intruder and is threatened by the burglar's father.
Description: While investigating noises in his house one balmy Texas night in 1989, Richard Dane puts a bullet in the brain of a low-life burglar. Although he’s hailed as a small-town hero, Dane soon finds himself fearing for his family’s safety when Freddy’s ex-con father rolls into town, hell-bent on revenge.

Title: The Soloist
Country: France, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A journalist befriends a homeless, schizophrenic cello prodigy on the streets of Los Angeles.
Description: A Los Angeles journalist befriends a homeless Juilliard-trained musician, while looking for a new article for the paper.

Title: M. Butterfly
Hint: A French diplomat falls for a Chinese opera singer.
Description: In 1960s China, French diplomat Rene Gallimard falls in love with opera singer Song Liling – but Song is not at all who Gallimard thinks.

Title: Your Sister's Sister
Hint: A grieving man stays at a friend's island cabin and finds her sibling already there.
Description: Iris invites her friend Jack to stay at her family's island getaway after the death of his brother. At their remote cabin, Jack's drunken encounter with Hannah, Iris' sister, kicks off a revealing stretch of days.

Title: A Boy Called Christmas
Hint: An ordinary boy sets out to find his father in the frozen north and becomes a legend.
Description: An ordinary young boy called Nikolas sets out on an extraordinary adventure into the snowy north in search of his father who is on a quest to discover the fabled village of the elves, Elfhelm. Taking with him a headstrong reindeer called Blitzen and a loyal pet mouse, Nikolas soon meets his destiny in this magical and endearing story that proves nothing is impossible…

Title: The Bridge at Remagen
Hint: Allied forces try to capture the last standing crossing over the Rhine before the Germans blow it up.
Description: In March of 1945, as the War in Europe is coming to a close, fighting erupts between German and American troops at the last remaining bridgehead across the Rhine.

Title: A Whisker Away
Hint: A peculiar girl transforms into a cat to get her crush's attention and risks staying one forever.
Description: A peculiar girl transforms into a cat to catch her crush's attention. But before she realizes it, the line between human and animal starts to blur.

Title: Gorky Park
Hint: A Moscow police inspector investigates three faceless bodies found frozen in the snow.
Description: Police Inspector Renko tries to solve the case of three bodies found in Moscow's ___ but finds his attempts to solve the crime impeded by his superiors. Working on his own, Renko seeks out more information and stumbles across a conspiracy involving the highest levels of the government.

Title: Coco Before Chanel
Hint: The early life of a French orphan who became a revolutionary fashion designer.
Description: Several years after leaving the orphanage, to which her father never returned for her, Gabrielle ___ finds herself working in a provincial bar. She's both a seamstress for the performers and a singer, earning the nickname ___ from the song she sings nightly with her sister. A liaison with Baron Balsan gives her an entree into French society and a chance to develop her gift for designing.

Title: Jab Tak Hai Jaan
Hint: A soldier who defuses bombs vows never to fall in love again after losing the woman he loved.
Description: Samar Anand (Shah Rukh Khan), a London-based struggling musician falls in love with Meera Thappar (Katrina Kaif). After a severe accident, a panicked Meera promises God to leave Samar if he lives. Heartbroken, Samar leaves for India to become a fearless bomb disposal expert in the army.

Title: Obsession
Hint: A businessman becomes obsessed with a woman who looks like his dead wife.
Description: A wealthy New Orleans businessman becomes obsessed with a young woman who resembles his late wife.

Title: Dumplings
Hint: A former actress buys age-defying Chinese delicacies with a gruesome secret ingredient.
Description: Aunt Mei's famous homemade ___ provide amazing age-defying qualities popular with middle-aged women. But her latest customer, a fading actress, is determined to find out what the secret ingredient is.

Title: Seems Like Old Times
Hint: A writer wrongly accused of robbery seeks help from his ex-wife, a lawyer.
Description: After being falsely accused of robbing a bank, a writer seeks the help of his lawyer ex-wife to clear his name. However, hilarity ensues when he must hide from her husband, who’s throwing a party for law enforcement officials.

Title: The Sheltering Sky
Hint: An American couple drift toward emptiness in postwar North Africa.
Description: An American couple drift toward emptiness in postwar North Africa.

Title: Dark Water
Hint: A mother and daughter move into a leaking apartment building haunted by a lost girl.
Description: A woman in the midst of an unpleasant divorce moves to an eerie apartment building with her young daughter. The ceiling of their apartment has a dark and active leak.

Title: Journey's End
Hint: British officers in a dugout await a German attack in 1918.
Description: Set in a dugout in Aisne in 1918, a group of British officers, led by the mentally disintegrating young officer Stanhope, variously await their fate.

Title: Stakeout
Hint: Two detectives stake out an escaped convict's ex-girlfriend, and one falls for her.
Description: Two detectives observe an escaped convict's ex-girlfriend, but complications set in when one of them falls for her.

Title: Easy Money
Hint: A gambler must give up his vices for a year to inherit his mother-in-law's fortune.
Description: To inherit his mother-in-law's colossal fortune, a hard living gambling addict must change his unhealthy ways before it gets the best of him.

Title: Bheed
Hint: Migrant workers are trapped at a state border during India's sudden lockdown.
Description: 8 hours, complete lockdown in the whole of India, movement shut and state borders sealed. Thousands of migrants without food, water and mode of transport were forced to return to their homes. A crisis that shook the whole nation, a time when borders of disparity divided the people and one man stood for humanity.

Title: The Sugarland Express
Hint: A couple breaks out of prison to rescue their baby from foster care and leads a police convoy.
Description: Married small-time crooks Lou-Jean and Clovis Poplin lose their baby to the state of Texas and resolve to do whatever it takes to get him back. Lou-Jean gets Clovis out of jail, and the two steal their son from his foster home, in addition to taking a highway patrolman hostage.

Title: The Accidental Tourist
Hint: A travel writer grieving his son meets an eccentric dog trainer.
Description: After the death of his son, travel writer Macon Leary seems to be sleep walking through life. Macon's wife is having similar problems. They separate, and Macon meets a strange, outgoing woman who brings him 'back down to earth', but his wife soon thinks their marriage is still worth another try.

Title: The Quiet Earth
Hint: A scientist wakes up to find that a top-secret experiment has made almost everyone on the planet vanish without a trace.
Description: After a top-secret experiment misfires, a scientist may be the only man left alive in the world.

Title: Albert Nobbs
Country: United States of America, France, Ireland, United Kingdom
Hint: A woman disguises herself as a man to work as a butler in 19th-century Dublin.
Description: ___ struggles to survive in late 19th century Ireland, where women aren't encouraged to be independent. Posing as a man, so she can work as a butler in Dublin's most posh hotel, ___ meets a handsome painter and looks to escape the lie she has been living.

Title: Witchfinder General
Hint: During the English Civil War, a sadistic lawyer tours the countryside torturing and executing suspected witches.
Description: England, 1645. The cruel civil war between Royalists and Parliamentarians that is ravaging the country causes an era of chaos and legal arbitrariness that allows unscrupulous men to profit by exploiting the absurd superstitions of the peasants; like Matthew Hopkins, a monster disguised as a man who wanders from town to town offering his services as a witch hunter.

Title: Ride with the Devil
Hint: Two friends join Confederate guerrilla fighters in the Missouri border war.
Description: Friends Jake and Jack Bull join up with Civil War guerrilla fighters, yet after the realities of war set in, they must decide what honor truly means.

Title: Mirrormask
Hint: A girl must find a magical mask in a dreamlike world drawn from her own sketches.
Description: In a fantasy world of opposing kingdoms, a 15-year old girl must find the fabled ___ in order to save the kingdom and get home.

Title: Mo' Better Blues
Hint: A self-centered jazz trumpeter juggles two women and his music.
Description: Talented but self-centered trumpeter Bleek Gilliam is obsessed with his music and indecisiveness about his girlfriends Indigo and Clarke. But when he is forced to come to the aid of his manager and childhood friend, Bleek finds his world more fragile than he ever imagined.

Title: The Disappearance of Alice Creed
Hint: Two kidnappers hold a rich man's daughter for ransom in an empty flat.
Description: A rich man's daughter is held captive in an abandoned apartment by two former convicts who abducted her and hold her ransom in exchange for her father's money.

Title: Flirting with Disaster
Hint: A new father searches for his biological parents across America.
Description: Adopted as a child, new father Mel Colpin decides he cannot name his son until he knows his birth parents, and determines to make a cross-country quest to find them. Accompanied by his wife, Nancy, and an inept yet gorgeous adoption agent, Tina, he departs on an epic road trip that quickly devolves into a farce of mistaken identities, wrong turns, and overzealous and love-struck ATF agents.

Title: The Lady in the Van
Hint: A writer lets an eccentric homeless woman park her vehicle in his driveway for fifteen years.
Description: The true story of the relationship between Alan Bennett and the singular Miss Shepherd, a woman of uncertain origins who ‘temporarily’ parked her ___ in Bennett’s London driveway and proceeded to live there for 15 years.

Title: A Monster in Paris
Hint: A shy projectionist and an inventor accidentally create a giant, flea-like creature who becomes a singing star in 1910 France.
Description: Paris, 1910. Emile, a shy movie projectionist, and Raoul, a colourful inventor, find themselves embarked on the hunt for a monster terrorizing citizens. They join forces with Lucille, the big-hearted star of the Bird of Paradise cabaret, an eccentric scientist and his irascible monkey to save the monster, who turns out to be an oversized but harmless flea, from the city's ruthlessly ambitious police chief.

Title: The Shipping News
Hint: A broken, grieving man moves with his young daughter to his ancestral home in Newfoundland and finds work at a local paper.
Description: An emotionally-beaten man with his young daughter moves to his ancestral home in Newfoundland to reclaim his life.

Title: Grandma
Hint: A misanthropic poet spends a day helping her granddaughter raise money.
Description: Self-described misanthrope Elle Reid has her protective bubble burst when her 18-year-old granddaughter, Sage, shows up needing help. The two of them go on a day-long journey that causes Elle to come to terms with her past and Sage to confront her future.

Title: Los ojos de Julia
Hint: A woman with a degenerative eye disease investigates the mysterious death of her blind twin sister.
Description: ___, a woman suffering from a degenerative sight disease, finds her blind sister Sara hung in a basement. Despite all signs pointing to suicide, ___ decides to investigate what she intuitively feels is a murder case.

Title: Merantau
Hint: A young silat fighter protects a woman from human traffickers in Jakarta.
Description: In Minangkabau, West Sumatera, Yuda a skilled practitioner of Silat Harimau is in the final preparations to begin his "___" a century's old rites-of-passage to be carried out by the community's young men that will see him leave the comforts of his idyllic farming village and make a name for himself in the bustling city of Jakarta.

Title: The Perfect Host
Hint: A fugitive talks his way into a dinner party and meets a very strange organizer.
Description: Warwick Wilson is the consummate ___. He carefully prepares for a dinner party, the table impeccably set and the duck perfectly timed for 8:30 p.m. John Taylor is a career criminal. He’s just robbed a bank and needs to get off the streets. He finds himself on Warwick’s doorstep posing as a friend of a friend, new to Los Angeles, who’s been mugged and lost his luggage.

Title: Kingsglaive: Final Fantasy XV
Hint: Royal guards defend their magical kingdom from an invading empire.
Description: The magical kingdom of Lucis is home to the world’s last remaining Crystal, and the menacing empire of Niflheim is determined to steal it. King Regis of Lucis commands an elite force of soldiers called the ___. Wielding their king’s magic, they fight to protect Lucis.

Title: Fever Pitch
Hint: A teacher's devotion to the Red Sox threatens his relationship.
Description: When Ben Wrightman, a young teacher, begins dating pretty businesswoman Lindsey Meeks, the two don't seem to have a lot of the same interests, but they fall in love, regardless. Their romance goes well until baseball season begins, and Lindsey soon realizes that Ben is completely obsessed with the Boston Red Sox.

Title: Primary Colors
Country: France, Germany, Japan, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young idealist joins a charismatic Southern governor's presidential campaign.
Description: In this adaptation of the best-selling roman à clef about Bill Clinton's 1992 run for the White House, the young and gifted Henry Burton is tapped to oversee the presidential campaign of Governor Jack Stanton.

Title: Starter for 10
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A working-class student joins his university's quiz team in 1985.
Description: In 1985, against the backdrop of Thatcherism, Brian Jackson enrolls in the University of Bristol, a scholarship boy from seaside Essex with a love of knowledge for its own sake and a childhood spent watching University Challenge, a college quiz show. At Bristol he tries out for the Challenge team and falls under the spell of Alice, a lovely blond with an extensive sexual past.

Title: Carrie Pilby
Hint: A precocious young woman in New York is given a to-do list by her therapist.
Description: Awkward, isolated and disapproving of most of the people around her, a precocious 19-year-old genius is challenged to put her convictions to the test by venturing out on to the NYC dating scene.

Title: The Robe
Hint: A Roman tribune wins Christ's garment in a dice game and is haunted by it.
Description: Drunk and disillusioned Roman, Marcellus Gallio, wins Jesus' ___ in a dice game after the crucifixion. Marcellus has never been a man of faith like his slave, Demetrius, but when Demetrius escapes with the ___, Marcellus experiences disturbing visions and feels guilty for his actions.

Title: Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives
Country: Thailand, United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, France, United States of America
Hint: A dying man spends his final days surrounded by ghosts, spirits and memories in the Thai jungle.
Description: Suffering from acute kidney failure, ___ has chosen to spend his final days surrounded by his loved ones in the countryside. Surprisingly, the ghost of his deceased wife appears to care for him, and his long lost son returns home in a non-human form. Contemplating the reasons for his illness, ___ treks through the jungle with his family to a mysterious hilltop cave—the birthplace of his first life.

Title: SubUrbia
Hint: Suburban twenty-somethings hang out in a convenience store parking lot.
Description: A group of suburban teenagers try to support each other through the difficult task of becoming adults.

Title: Palindromes
Hint: A 13-year-old girl runs away so she can have a baby.
Description: Aviva is thirteen, awkward and sensitive. Her mother Joyce is warm and loving, as is her father, Steve, a regular guy who does have a fierce temper from time to time. The film revolves around her family, friends and neighbors.

Title: Bigil
Hint: A football player turned gangster coaches a women's team.
Description: A do-gooder don wants his footballer son to uplift the life of his people by becoming a champion, but fate draws the youngster into a life of violence. Will he be able to fulfill his father’s dream when an opportunity comes his way seven years later?

Title: Frequencies
Hint: A low-born boy and a high-born girl fall for each other in a world where frequency decides fate.
Description: The story of the forbidden relationship between a 'low born' boy and a 'high born' girl in an alternate reality where every person's relationships and life worth are determined by their innate '___'.

Title: Silent Movie
Hint: A washed-up director and his two goofy friends try to get Hollywood stars to appear in a picture with no dialogue, in a modern slapstick comedy.
Description: Aspiring filmmakers Mel Funn, Marty Eggs and Dom Bell go to a financially troubled studio with an idea for a ___. In an effort to make the movie more marketable, they attempt to recruit a number of big name stars to appear, while the studio's creditors attempt to thwart them.

Title: Fido
Hint: A boy's best friend is a domesticated zombie in a 1950s-style suburb.
Description: Timmy Robinson's best friend in the whole wide world is a six-foot tall rotting zombie named ___. But when ___ eats the next-door neighbor, Mom and Dad hit the roof, and Timmy has to go to the ends of the earth to keep ___ a part of the family. A boy-and-his-dog movie for grown ups, "___" will rip your heart out.

Title: Smashed
Hint: A couple's hard-partying marriage is tested when the wife gets sober.
Description: Kate and Charlie like to have a good time. Their marriage thrives on a shared fondness for music, laughter… and getting ___. When Kate’s partying spirals into hard-core asocial behavior, compromising her job as an elementary schoolteacher, something’s got to give. But change isn’t exactly a cakewalk.

Title: The Last Supper
Hint: Liberal grad students start poisoning their conservative dinner guests in Iowa.
Description: A group of idealistic but frustrated liberals succumb to the temptation of murdering right-wing pundits for their political beliefs.

Title: A Prairie Home Companion
Hint: Backstage on the last night of a long-running live radio variety show, as a mysterious woman in white appears.
Description: A look at what goes on backstage during the last broadcast of America's most celebrated radio show, where singing cowboys Dusty and Lefty, a country music siren, and a host of others hold court.

Title: The Pirates of Somalia
Country: United States of America, South Africa
Hint: A rookie journalist travels to the Horn of Africa to embed with real hijackers.
Description: After an inspiring chance encounter with his idol, rookie journalist Jay Bahadur uproots his life and moves to ___ looking for the story of a lifetime. Hooking up with a local fixer, he attempts to get embedded with the local Somali ___, only to quickly find himself in over his head.

Title: Love Is Strange

Description: After 39 years together, Ben and George finally tie the knot, but George loses his job as a result, and the newlyweds must sell their New York apartment and live apart, relying on friends and family to make ends meet.

Title: In a World...
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A vocal coach competes with her father to voice movie trailers.
Description: An underachieving vocal coach is motivated by her father, the king of movie-trailer voice-overs, to pursue her aspirations of becoming a voice-over star. Amidst pride, sexism and family dysfunction, she sets out to change the voice of a generation.

Title: The Photographer of Mauthausen
Hint: A Spanish prisoner smuggles photos out of a Nazi camp.
Description: Spanish ___ Francesc Boix, imprisoned in the ___-Gusen concentration camp, works in the SS Photographic Service. Between 1943 and 1945, he hides, with the help of other prisoners, thousands of negatives, with the purpose of showing the freed world the atrocities committed by the Nazis, exhaustively documented. He will be a key witness during the Nuremberg Trials.

Title: The Matador
Country: Germany, Mexico, United States of America
Hint: A traveling salesman befriends a burned-out hitman in Mexico City.
Description: The life of Danny Wright, a salesman forever on the road, veers into dangerous and surreal territory when he wanders into a Mexican bar and meets a mysterious stranger, Julian, who's very likely a hit man. Their meeting sets off a chain of events that will change their lives forever, as Wright is suddenly thrust into a far-from-mundane existence that he takes to surprisingly well … once he gets acclimated to it.

Title: Ghosts of Mississippi

Description: A ___ district attorney and the widow of Medgar Evers struggle to bring a white supremacist to justice for the 1963 murder of the civil rights leader.

Title: The Paper

Description: Henry Hackett is the workaholic editor of a New York City tabloid. He loves his job, but the long hours and low pay are leading to discontent. Also, publisher Bernie White faces financial straits, and has hatchet-man Alicia Clark—Henry's nemesis—impose unpopular cutbacks.

Title: Surongo
Hint: A couple's marriage takes a turn when the husband digs to rob a jewelry shop.
Description: Moyna and Masud's marriage takes a tumultuous turn when their differing desires clash. While Masud leaves for Malaysia, Moyna seeks comfort in the arms of another man. Can they start afresh?

Title: Elegy

Description: Cultural critic David Kepesh finds his life -- which he indicates is a state of "emancipated manhood" -- thrown into tragic disarray by Consuela Castillo, a well-mannered student who awakens a sense of sexual possessiveness in her teacher.

Title: Film Stars Don't Die in Liverpool
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: ___, 1978: What starts as a vibrant affair between a legendary femme-fatale, the eccentric Academy Award-winning actress Gloria Grahame, and her young lover, British actor Peter Turner, quickly grows into a deeper relationship, with Turner being the person Gloria turns to for comfort.

Title: Faults
Hint: A deprogrammer of cult members is hired by desperate parents to rescue their daughter, and is drawn into her mind games.
Description: Claire is under the grip of a mysterious new cult called ___. Desperate to be reunited with their daughter, Claire's parents recruit one of the world's foremost experts on mind control, Ansel Roth.

Title: Atlantics
Hint: A young woman in Dakar mourns her lover who was lost at sea, until strange things happen.
Description: Arranged to marry a rich man, young Ada is crushed when her true love goes missing at sea during a migration attempt — until a miracle reunites them.

Title: 8-Bit Christmas

Description: In suburban Chicago during the late 1980s, ten-year-old Jake Doyle embarks on a herculean quest to get the latest and greatest video game system for Christmas.

Description: The story of Elliot Tiber and his family, who inadvertently played a pivotal role in making the famed ___ Music and Arts Festival into the happening that it was. When Elliot hears that a neighboring town has pulled the permit on a hippie music festival, he calls the producers thinking he could drum up some much-needed business for his parents' run-down motel.

Title: Last Love
Country: Germany, Belgium, United States of America, France

Description: A widowed professor living in Paris develops a special relationship with a younger French woman.

Title: Mili

Description: ___ Naudiyal, a nursing graduate is planning to move to Canada. She takes up a job at a food outlet for the time being but her sudden disappearance without a clue leaves her loved ones in a desperate search for her in this survival drama.

Title: The Children Act
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: In the midst of a marital crisis, a High Court judge must decide if she should order a life-saving blood transfusion for a teen with cancer despite his family's refusal to accept medical treatment for religious reasons.

Title: All the Real Girls
Hint: A small-town Romeo falls for his best friend's younger sister.
Description: In a sleepy little mill town in North Carolina, Paul is the town Romeo. But when his best friend's sister returns home from boarding school, he finds himself falling for her innocent charm. In spite of her lack of experience and the violent protests of her brother, the two find themselves in a sweet, dreamy and all-consuming love.

Title: The Jane Austen Book Club
Hint: Six Californians start a reading group devoted to one Regency novelist.
Description: Six Californians start a club to discuss the works of ___. As they delve into ___ literature, the club members find themselves dealing with life experiences that parallel the themes of the books they are reading.

Title: Cheap Thrills
Hint: A new dad meets a wealthy couple who offer money for increasingly twisted dares.
Description: Recently fired and facing eviction, a new dad has his life turned upside down when he meets a wealthy couple who offer a path to financial security... but at a price.

Title: Defendor
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A delusional man with a homemade costume becomes a superhero.
Description: A crooked cop, a mob boss and the young girl they abuse are the denizens of a city's criminal underworld. It's a world that ordinary Arthur Poppington doesn't understand and doesn't belong in, but is committed to fighting when he changes into a vigilante super-hero of his own making, ___. With no power other than courage ___ takes to the streets to protect the city's innocents.

Title: The Element of Crime
Hint: A detective under hypnosis recalls tracking a serial killer through a sepia-toned dystopian Europe.
Description: Fisher, an ex-detective, decides to take one final case when a mysterious serial killer claims the lives of several young girls. Fisher, unable to find the culprit, turns to Osbourne, a writer who was once respected for his contributions to the field of criminology.

Title: The Curse of the Jade Scorpion
Hint: An insurance investigator is hypnotised by a magician into committing jewel robberies in 1940s New York.
Description: CW Briggs is a veteran insurance investigator, with many successes. Betty Ann Fitzgerald is a new employee in the company he works for, with the task of reorganizing the office. They don't like each other - or at least that's what they think. During a night out with the rest of the office employees, they go to watch Voltan, a magician who secretly hypnotizes both of them.

Title: State and Main
Hint: A movie crew descends on a small Vermont town and causes chaos.
Description: The residents of a small Vermont town don't know what hit them when a beleaguered Hollywood film crew brings a chaotic shoot to their quaint village.

Title: Big Nothing
Hint: An unemployed teacher joins a blackmail scheme that goes wrong.
Description: A frustrated, unemployed teacher joins forces with a scammer and his girlfriend in a blackmailing scheme.

Title: Don't Think Twice
Hint: An improv group deals with crises when one member gets famous.
Description: An improv group deals with several crises, including the loss of their lease and one member hitting the big time.

Title: The Crime of Padre Amaro

Description: Sent to Mexico to help take care of aging Father Benito, young Father ___ faces a moral challenge when he meets a 16-year-old girl who he starts an affair with. Likewise, the girl's mother had been having an affair with Father Benito. Father ___ must choose between a holy or sinful life.

Title: Comet
Hint: A cynical man and a witty woman's relationship told out of order over six years.
Description: When a chance encounter brings together the cynical Dell and the quick-witted Kimberly, the stage is set for a tempestuous love affair that unfolds like a puzzle. As the film zigzags back and forth in time — from a meteor shower in LA, to an encounter in a Paris hotel room, to a fateful phone call — an unforgettable portrait of a relationship emerges.

Title: Tallulah
Hint: A drifter takes a neglected toddler from a rich, careless mother and goes on the run.
Description: Desperate to be rid of her toddler, a dissatisfied Beverly Hills housewife hires a stranger to babysit and ends up getting much more than she bargained for.

Title: Two Days in Paris
Hint: A couple's romantic trip falls apart when they meet her parents and her many ex-lovers.
Description: Marion and Jack try to rekindle their relationship with a visit to Paris, home of Marion's parents — and several of her ex-boyfriends.

Title: The Giant Mechanical Man
Hint: A silver-painted street performer and a lost zoo worker find each other.
Description: An offbeat romantic comedy about a silver-painted street performer and the soft spoken zoo worker who falls for him.

Title: Borgman
Hint: A vagrant cons his way into a rich family's home and slowly takes it over.
Description: An enigmatic vagrant cons himself into the home life of an arrogant upper-class family, turning their lives into a psychological nightmare in the process.

Description: An immature, newly unemployed comic must navigate the murky waters of adulthood after her fling with a graduate student results in an unplanned pregnancy.

Description: After her boyfriend commits suicide, a young woman attempts to use the unpublished manuscript of a novel and a sum of money he left behind to reinvent her life.

Title: Me and Orson Welles

Description: New York, 1937. A teenager hired to star in ___' production of Julius Caesar becomes attracted to a career-driven production assistant.

Title: The Air I Breathe

Description: A gambler’s bet spiraling into chaos, a gangster's prophetic visions, a pop star’s dark entanglement, a doctor’s desperate race against time to rescue his beloved... Four interconnected stories reveal life unfolding through four emotional pillars — joy, passion, grief, and love.

Title: Asterix: The Secret of the Magic Potion
Hint: An old druid sets out across Gaul to find a successor to guard his precious recipe.
Description: Following a fall during mistletoe picking, Druid Getafix decides that it is time to secure the future of the village. Accompanied by ___ and Obelix, he undertakes to travel the Gallic world in search of a talented young druid to transmit the ___.

Title: Beyond the Sea
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The life of a crooner who rose to fame despite a weak heart.
Description: Based on the life and career of legendary entertainer, Bobby Darin, the biopic moves back and forth between his childhood and adulthood, to tell the tale of his life.

Title: Girlfight
Hint: A troubled Brooklyn teenager channels her aggression into boxing.
Description: Diana Guzman, a troubled Brooklyn teenager, decides to channel her aggression by training to become a boxer, all while keeping it a secret from her father.

Title: Gangster No. 1
Hint: An old London hood learns that his former boss is about to walk free after thirty years.
Description: An old gangster is advised that Freddie Mays would leave jail after thirty years in prison. His mood changes and he recalls when he was a young punk and who joined Freddie's gang—a man he both envied and ultimately betrayed.

Title: Shadows and Fog
Hint: With a serial strangler loose in a foggy town, a timid bookkeeper is roused to join a vigilante mob.
Description: With a serial strangler on the loose, a bookkeeper wanders around town searching for the vigilante group intent on catching the killer.

Title: He Was a Quiet Man
Hint: An unhinged office worker saves a colleague instead of going on a rampage.
Description: An unhinged office worker who planned to go on a shooting spree at his workplace struggles with his newfound status as a hero after he ends up stopping a shooting spree instead.

Title: Snow Falling on Cedars
Hint: A Japanese-American fisherman is accused of murder in 1950s Washington, and a reporter who loved his wife covers the trial.
Description: In the 1950s, a Japanese-American fisherman is suspected of killing his neighbour at sea. For Ishmael, a local reporter, the trial strikes a deep emotional chord when he finds his ex-lover is linked to the case. As he investigates the killing, he uncovers some startling clues that lead him to a shocking discovery.

Title: Happythankyoumoreplease
Hint: Six New Yorkers navigate love, commitment and an unexpected foster child.
Description: Six New Yorkers navigate love, commitment, and adulthood. When struggling novelist Sam takes in an abandoned boy he meets on the subway, his life begins to intertwine with a talented singer who challenges his bachelor ways. Meanwhile, his best friend Annie battles alopecia while torn between two drastically different men, and a long-term couple faces a crossroads that could alter their future together.

Title: Saints and Soldiers
Hint: American GIs in the Battle of the Bulge struggle to survive behind enemy lines.
Description: Five American soldiers fighting in Europe during World War II struggle to return to Allied territory after being separated from U.S. forces during the historic Malmedy Massacre.

Title: Cypher
Hint: A bored accountant becomes a corporate spy and loses track of who he is.
Description: An unsuspecting, disenchanted man finds himself working as a spy in the dangerous, high-stakes world of corporate espionage. Quickly getting way over-his-head, he teams up with a mysterious femme fatale.

Title: Babysitting
Hint: A babysitter's wild night is pieced together from found footage.
Description: Looking for a baby-sitter for the night, Marc Schaudel entrusts his son Remy to the care of his employee Franck, a straight man. But the thing that Marc doesn't know, is that Franck is getting 30 years old this weekend and that his son Remy is a very capricious child. The next day, Marc and his wife Claire are awakened by a call from the police. Remy and Franck are missing, and the house is totally devastated.

Title: Flash Point
Hint: A Hong Kong detective takes on three ruthless Vietnamese brothers.
Description: Detective Sergeant Ma Jun, known for dispensing his own brand of justice during arrests, teams up with an undercover cop, Wilson, to try and bring down three merciless Vietnamese brothers running a smuggling ring in the months before mainland China's takeover of Hong Kong. Jun pursues the gang tirelessly, sometimes ignoring police protocols. A showdown is inevitable!

Title: Heartbreaker
Country: France, United States of America, Monaco
Hint: A professional seducer who breaks up couples for money is hired to stop a wedding in Monaco.
Description: Alex and his sister run a business designed to break up relationships. They are hired by a rich man to break up the wedding of his daughter. The only problem is that they only have one week to do so.

Title: Reign of the Supermen
Genres: Science Fiction, Animation, Action, Fantasy, Drama
Hint: After the death of the world's greatest hero, four new heroes appear claiming his mantle.
Description: In the wake of The Death of Superman, the world is still mourning the loss of the Man of Steel following his fatal battle with the monster Doomsday. However, no sooner as his body been laid to rest than do four new bearers of the Superman shield come forward to take on the mantle. The Last Son of Krypton, Superboy, Steel, and the Cyborg Superman all attempt to fill the vacuum left by the world's greatest champion.

Title: The Teacher
Hint: A kindly-looking schoolmistress in 1980s Bratislava uses her pupils to manipulate their parents.
Description: The principal of an elementary school calls a special parents meeting after it’s alleged that the seemingly empathetic and kindly-looking ___ Mrs. Drazděchová uses her students to manipulate their parents.

Title: Samba
Hint: A Senegalese immigrant in Paris dodges deportation and falls for an immigration worker.
Description: ___ migrated to France 10 years ago from Senegal, and has since been plugging away at various lowly jobs. Alice is a senior executive who has recently undergone a burnout. Both struggle to get out of their dead-end lives. ___ willing to do whatever it takes to get working papers, while Alice tries to get her life back on track until fate draws them together.

Title: Bon Cop Bad Cop
Hint: An English and a French detective team up when a body is found on the Ontario-Quebec border.
Description: When the body of the executive of hockey Benoit Brisset is found on the billboard of the border of Quebec and Ontario, the jurisdiction of the crime is shared between the two police forces and detectives David Bouchard from Montreal and Martin Ward from Toronto are assigned to work together. With totally different styles, attitudes and languages.

Title: Martian Child
Hint: A widowed sci-fi writer adopts a boy who claims to be from Mars.
Description: A recently-widowed science fiction writer considers whether to adopt a hyper-imaginative 6-year-old abandoned and socially-rejected boy who says he's really from Mars.

Title: Redbelt
Hint: A jiu-jitsu instructor who refuses to compete is drawn into a fixed fight.
Description: Martial artist Mike Terry lives by a strict code of no competitions, for he feels that such contests weaken fighters. After saving a famous action star from a brutal attack, Mike takes a job in the film industry. He soon finds his personal beliefs and integrity on the line as circumstances force him to participate in a prize fight.

Title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
Hint: A hot-tempered man falls for his neighbor in Goa while a rival schemes against him.
Description: Sameer, fast at losing his temper is re-located to Goa where he falls in love with Rani. But Sameer's new roommate Sunny, has some plans of his own.

Title: The Escapist
Hint: An aging prisoner plans a daring escape with a group of misfits.
Description: Frank Perry is an institutionalized convict twelve years into a life sentence without parole. When his estranged daughter falls ill, he is determined to make peace with her before it's too late. He develops an ingenious escape plan, and recruits a dysfunctional band of escapists - misfits with a mutual dislike for one other but united by their desire to escape their hell hole of an existence.

Title: The Hoax
Hint: A struggling writer convinces a publisher he has the exclusive autobiography of a famous reclusive billionaire.
Description: In what would cause a fantastic media frenzy, Clifford Irving sells his bogus biography of Howard Hughes to a premiere publishing house in the early 1970s.

Title: Tristram Shandy: A Cock and Bull Story
Hint: An actor struggles to film an unfilmable 18th-century novel.
Description: Steve Coogan, an arrogant actor with low self-esteem and a complicated love life, is playing the eponymous role in an adaptation of "The Life and Opinions of ___, Gentleman" being filmed at a stately home. He constantly spars with actor Rob Brydon, who is playing Uncle Toby and believes his role to be of equal importance to Coogan's.

Title: Yes Boss
Hint: A young man does anything his employer asks, including helping him with an affair.
Description: Rahul Joshi wants to be a successful businessman so he works hard for his boss Siddharth. One day Rahul meets Seema, an up and coming model, and he feels like he's finally met his match. Will Seema fall for Rahul?

Title: Copying Beethoven
Country: Germany, Hungary, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young music student becomes the copyist for a deaf, tormented composer as he finishes his final symphony.
Description: A fictionalised exploration of ___ life in his final days working on his Ninth Symphony. It is 1824. ___ is racing to finish his new symphony. However, it has been years since his last success and he is plagued by deafness, loneliness and personal trauma. A copyist is urgently needed to help the composer.

Title: Resurrecting the Champ

Description: Up-and-coming sports reporter rescues a homeless man ("___") only to discover that he is, in fact, a boxing legend believed to have passed away. What begins as an opportunity to resurrect ___ story and escape the shadow of his father's success becomes a personal journey as the ambitious reporter reexamines his own life and his relationship with his family.

Title: Restless
Hint: A teen who attends strangers' funerals falls for a terminally ill girl.
Description: Two outsiders, both shaped by the circumstances that have brought them together, forge a deep and lasting love.

Description: After a night of drinking, Adam Hutcherson stumbles out of the closet to his three straight buddies. A disruption to their dynamic which they now must try and overcome through alcohol, Tinder dates and forgiveness.

Title: Aqua Teen Hunger Force Colon Movie Film for Theaters

Description: Mansoor, a reserved and reticent Pithoo (porter), helps pilgrims make an arduous journey upwards to the temple town. His world turns around when he meets the beautiful and rebellious Mukku who draws him into a whirlwind of intense love.

Title: The Fury of a Patient Man
Hint: A quiet man woos a café worker, unaware he has a vengeful plan for her family.
Description: Quiet Jose woos cafe worker Ana, but she is unaware he has intentions other than the purely romantic.

Title: Sanak
Hint: A hospital in Mumbai is taken over by terrorists while a man tries to save his wife.
Description: Set in Mumbai, the story unfolds in a hospital that is under siege, where Vivaan Ahuja and his wife Anshika are trapped. Does he manage to rescue her and other hostages from the dangerous hoodlums?

Title: Catch a Fire
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An apolitical refinery worker in apartheid South Africa is radicalized after being tortured.
Description: The true story of anti-apartheid activists in South Africa, and particularly the life of Patrick Chamusso, a timid foreman at Secunda CTL, the largest synthetic fuel plant in the world. Patrick is wrongly accused, imprisoned and tortured for an attempt to bomb the plant, with the injustice transforming the apolitical worker into a radicalised insurgent, who then carries out his own successful sabotage mission.

Title: Delibal
Hint: Two young people in Istanbul fall in love while one is dying.
Description: A love story following two young people battling with their emotions and dreams, the pressures of career, family and not knowing what the future holds. Füsun is a brilliant student, destined for a successful career but can't help from falling for Baris, a musician who struggles with a psychological disorder.

Title: Sleepwalk with Me
Hint: A struggling comedian drifts through his relationship and his career while acting out his dreams at night.
Description: A burgeoning stand-up comedian struggles with the stress of a stalled career, a stale relationship, and the wild spurts of severe sleepwalking he is desperate to ignore.

Title: Der Schuh des Manitu
Hint: An Apache chief and his blood brother must clear their names in a Western parody.
Description: Abahachi, Chief of the Apache Indians, and his blood brother Ranger maintain peace and justice in the Wild West. One day, Abahachi needs to take up a credit from the Shoshone Indians to finance his tribe's new saloon. Unfortunately Santa Maria, who sold the saloon, betrays Abahachi, takes the money and leaves.

Title: Cinayet Süsü
Hint: Istanbul homicide detectives encounter a murder unlike any other.
Description: Istanbul Police Department homicide detectives encounter a murder nothing like they’ve seen before.Commissioners Emin, Salih, Asuman and deputy Alaattin begin investigating.But strange murders keep happening. They don’t have any evidence or any clues. Day by day, tempers flare and the police chiefs grow annoyed.As the murders keep piling up, the public’s interest rises.

Title: Waqt: The Race Against Time

Description: A chronic illness leaves Ishwar with only a few months to live. His son Aditya is extremely reckless. To make him realise his responsibilities, Ishwar throws his son out of the house.

Title: Chhatriwali

Description: Sanya is an unemployed chemistry genius looking for a job. However, she also wants to use her knowledge of chemistry to help young minds move beyond the taboos of sex with the right education.

Hint: A newly elected pontiff has a panic attack before he can greet the crowds.
Description: The newly elected ___ suffers a panic attack just as he is about to greet the faithful who have gathered to see him. His advisors, unable to convince him he is the right man for the job, call on a renowned therapist who also happens to be an atheist. But the ___ fear of his newfound responsibility is one he must face alone. Winner Best Film at the Italian Golden Globes.

Title: Garam Masala

Description: Photographer and serial womaniser, Mac devises a scheme to keep three airhostesses, who are unaware of each other, as his live-in partners. Everything works fine as long as they only come home every third day. But changing schedules, a jealous friend and his fiancé might just break apart his elaborately structured life of deceit.

Title: Chhalaang
Hint: A PT teacher who doesn't take his job seriously must win a contest.
Description: ___ humorously addresses the value of Sports Education in the school curriculum. It follows a hilarious, yet an inspirational journey of a typical PT Master from a semi government-funded school in Northern India, Montu, for whom it’s just a job and is forced to do what he has never done - Teach.

Title: X

Title: Asteroid City

Description: A reunion between two estranged sisters gets cut short by the rise of flesh-possessing demons, thrusting them into a primal battle for survival as they face the most nightmarish version of family imaginable.

Description: A young ___ woman falls in love with a non-___ and struggles to get her family to accept him while she comes to terms with her heritage and cultural identity.

Title: Saw II

Description: The chilling and relentless Jigsaw killer returns to terrorize the city once again. When a gruesome murder victim emerges with unmistakable traces of Jigsaw's sinister methods, Detective Eric Matthews is thrust into a high-stakes investigation. To his surprise, apprehending Jigsaw seems almost too easy, but what he doesn't realize is that being caught is merely another piece of Jigsaw's intricate puzzle.

Title: To Catch a Killer
Hint: A troubled police officer is recruited to track down a mass shooter in Baltimore.
Description: Baltimore. New Year's Eve. A talented but troubled police officer is recruited by the FBI's chief investigator to help profile and track down a mass murderer.

Title: They Cloned Tyrone

Description: A series of eerie events thrusts an unlikely trio onto the trail of a nefarious government conspiracy lurking directly beneath their neighborhood.

Description: When Scott learns that his longtime cyber-buddy from Berlin is a gorgeous young woman, he and his friends embark on a trip across Europe.

While attempting to solve this grisly mystery, the reluctant detective engages the help of one of the cadets: a strange but brilliant young fellow by the name of Edgar Allan Poe.

Title: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
Hint: A young Jedi falls for a senator while a clone army is secretly built.
Description: Following an assassination attempt on Senator Padmé Amidala, Jedi Knights Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi investigate a mysterious plot into the heart of the Separatist movement and the beginning of the Clone ___.

Title: Red Sparrow

Description: Prima ballerina Dominika Egorova faces a bleak and uncertain future after she suffers an injury that ends her career. She soon turns to ___ School, a secret intelligence service that trains exceptional young people to use their minds and bodies as weapons. Dominika emerges as the most dangerous ___ after completing the sadistic training process.

Title: Event Horizon

Description: When a willful young man tries to venture beyond his sequestered Pennsylvania hamlet, his actions set off a chain of chilling incidents that will alter the community forever.

Description: Five years after an ominous unseen presence drives most of society to suicide, a survivor and her two children make a desperate bid to reach safety.

Description: Based on the classic novel by Orson Scott Card, ___ is the story of the Earth's most gifted children training to defend their homeplanet in the space wars of the future.

Description: Scientist Bruce Banner scours the planet for an antidote to the unbridled force of rage within him: the ___. But when the military masterminds who dream of exploiting his powers force him back to civilization, he finds himself coming face to face with a new, deadly foe.

Title: 30 Days of Night

Title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors

Description: For Peter Parker, life is busy. Between taking out the bad guys as ___-Man and spending time with the person he loves, Gwen Stacy, high school graduation cannot come quickly enough. Title: The Da Vinci Code

For 2,000 years a secret society closely guards information that — should it come to light — could rock the very foundations of Christianity.

Title: The Invitation

While ___ gets accustomed to living in Warbucks' mansion, she still longs to meet her parents.

The first to discover the substance and live to tell about it, Steve and Jane witness the ___ destroying an elderly man, then it growing to a terrifying size.

Description: Adam Jones is a Chef who destroyed his career with drugs and diva behavior. He cleans up and returns to London, determined to redeem himself by spearheading a top restaurant that can gain three Michelin stars.

Description: At Adams College, the jocks rule from their house on high, the Alpha Beta fraternity. Deciding to start their own frat to protect their outcast brothers, the ___ soon find themselves in a battle royale as the Alpha Betas try to crush their new rivals.

Description: ___ is a war-weary, former military captain who's inexplicably transported to the mysterious and exotic planet of Barsoom (Mars) and reluctantly becomes embroiled in an epic conflict. It's a world on the brink of collapse, and ___ rediscovers his humanity when he realizes the survival of Barsoom and its people rests in his hands.

Title: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time

Description: A rogue prince reluctantly joins forces with a mysterious princess and together, they race against dark forces to safeguard an ancient dagger capable of releasing the ___ – gift from the gods that can reverse time and allow its possessor to rule the world.

Title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young mother discovers her mother's past on a Greek island.
Description: Five years after meeting her three fathers, Sophie Sheridan prepares to open her mother’s hotel. In 1979, young Donna Sheridan meets the men who each could be Sophie’s biological father.

Title: Me, Myself & Irene

Description: Rhode Island State Trooper Charlie Baileygates has a multiple personality disorder. One personality is crazy and aggressive, while the other is more friendly and laid back. Both of these personalities fall in love with the same woman named ___ after Charlie loses his medication.

Description: Three high school seniors throw a party to make a name for themselves. As the night progresses, things spiral out of control as word of the party spreads.

Description: Dr. Lily Houghton enlists the aid of wisecracking skipper Frank Wolff to take her down the Amazon in his dilapidated boat. Together, they search for an ancient tree that holds the power to heal – a discovery that will change the future of medicine.

Description: A young woman with a mysterious past lands in Southport, North Carolina where her bond with a widower forces her to confront the dark secret that haunts her.

Description: In Imperial Russia, ___, wife of the officer Karenin, goes to Moscow to visit her brother. On the way, she meets charming cavalry officer Vronsky, to whom she's immediately attracted. But in St. Petersburg’s high society, a relationship like this could destroy a woman’s reputation.

Description: Renowned film star Joan Crawford's abuse towards Christina, her adopted daughter, intensifies as her professional and romantic relationships turn sour.

Title: Quantum of Solace

Description: The harrowing true story of two elite US Navy fighter pilots during the Korean War. Their heroic sacrifices would ultimately make them the Navy's most celebrated wingmen.

Description: Dating coach Alex '___' Hitchens mentors a bumbling client, Albert, who hopes to win the heart of the glamorous Allegra Cole. While Albert makes progress, ___ faces his own romantic setbacks when proven techniques fail to work on Sara Melas, a tabloid reporter digging for dirt on Allegra Cole's love life.

Title: Psycho II

Description: Norman Bates is declared sane and released from the facility in which he was being held, despite the complaints of Lila Loomis, sister of his most famous victim. Is he really cured, or will he kill again?

Title: Silver Streak
Hint: A book editor witnesses a murder on a cross-country train.
Description: A somewhat daffy book editor on a rail trip from Los Angeles to Chicago thinks that he sees a murdered man thrown from the train. When he can find no one who will believe him, he starts doing some investigating of his own. But all that accomplishes is to get the killer after him.

Title: Bright Star
Hint: A young Romantic poet falls in love with his spirited neighbour in 1818 London.
Description: In 1818, high-spirited young Fanny Brawne finds herself increasingly intrigued by the handsome but aloof poet John Keats, who lives next door to her family friends the Dilkes. After reading a book of his poetry, she finds herself even more drawn to the taciturn Keats.

Title: Matador
Hint: A young man confesses to crimes he didn't commit in Madrid.
Description: A conflicted youth confesses to crimes he didn't commit while a man and woman aroused by death become obsessed with each other.

Description: Thirty years after serving together in the Vietnam War, Larry, Sal and Richard reunite for a different type of mission: to bury Doc's son, a young Marine killed in Iraq. Forgoing the burial, the trio take the casket on a bittersweet trip up the coast to New Hampshire – along the way reminiscing and coming to terms with the shared memories of a war that continues to shape their lives.

Title: The Crimson Rivers

Description: Two French policemen, one investigating a grisly murder at a remote mountain college, the other working on the desecration of a young girl's grave by skinheads, are brought together by the clues from their respective cases. Soon after they start working together, more murders are committed, and the pair begin to discover just what dark secrets are behind the killings.

Title: New Police Story
Hint: A disgraced Hong Kong cop hunts a gang that killed his unit.
Description: Sent into a drunken tailspin when his entire unit is killed by a gang of thrill-seeking punks, disgraced Hong Kong police inspector Wing needs help from his new rookie partner, with a troubled past of his own, to climb out of the bottle and track down the gang and its ruthless leader.

Title: Courageous

They know that God desires to turn the hearts of fathers to their children, but their children are beginning to drift further and further away from them.

Title: Machete
Country: United States of America, Germany, United Kingdom

Description: After being set-up and betrayed by the man who hired him to assassinate a Texas Senator, an ex-Federale launches a brutal rampage of revenge against his former boss.

Description: Bill Baker, an American oil-rig roughneck from Oklahoma, travels to Marseille to visit his estranged daughter, Allison, who is in prison for a murder she claims she did not commit. Confronted with language barriers, cultural differences, and a complicated legal system, Bill builds a new life for himself in France as he makes it his personal mission to exonerate his daughter.

Title: Operation Mincemeat

Title: Spencer

Description: During her Christmas holidays with the royal family at the Sandringham estate in Norfolk, England, Diana decides to leave her marriage to Prince Charles.

Once there, ___ faces off against Dr. Evil's army of minions to try to save the world in his own unbelievably groovy way.

Description: In 1960, a team of Israeli secret agents is deployed to find Adolf Eichmann, the infamous Nazi architect of the Holocaust, supposedly hidden in Argentina, and get him to Israel to be judged.

Title: Overlord
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Paratroopers discover Nazi experiments on the eve of D-Day.
Description: France, June 1944. On the eve of D-Day, some American paratroopers fall behind enemy lines after their aircraft crashes while on a mission to destroy a radio tower in a small village near the beaches of Normandy. After reaching their target, the surviving paratroopers realise that, in addition to fighting the Nazi troops that patrol the village, they also must fight against something else.

Title: Tears of the Sun

Description: Navy SEAL Lieutenant A.K. Waters and his elite squadron of tactical specialists are forced to choose between their duty and their humanity, between following orders by ignoring the conflict that surrounds them, or finding the courage to follow their conscience and protect a group of innocent refugees.

Title: Forever My Girl
Hint: A country singer returns home to win back his fiancée.
Description: Years after leaving his fiancée at the altar to pursue fame and fortune, country music star Liam Page returns home hoping to win her back.

Title: Whitney Houston: I Wanna Dance with Somebody
Hint: The life of a legendary pop singer with an unmatched voice.
Description: The joyous, emotional, heartbreaking celebration of the life and music of ___, the greatest female R&B pop vocalist of all time. Tracking her journey from obscurity to musical superstardom.

Title: The Polar Express
Hint: A boy boards a magical train to the North Pole.
Description: When a doubting young boy takes an extraordinary train ride to the North Pole, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery that shows him that the wonder of life never fades for those who believe.

Title: Maleficent: Mistress of Evil
Hint: A fairy queen's goddaughter is to marry a prince, but his mother has sinister plans.
Description: ___ and her goddaughter Aurora begin to question the complex family ties that bind them as they are pulled in different directions by impending nuptials, unexpected allies, and dark new forces at play.

Title: In the Realm of the Senses
Hint: A former geisha and her employer's obsessive affair spirals into erotic and deadly territory in 1930s Tokyo.
Description: A passionate telling of the story of Sada Abe, a woman whose affair with her master led to an obsessive and ultimately destructive sexual relationship.

Title: Joy Ride
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A lawyer's business trip to China becomes a raunchy road trip to find her birth mother.
Description: When Audrey's business trip to Asia goes sideways, she enlists the aid of Lolo, her irreverent, childhood best friend who also happens to be a hot mess; Kat, her college friend turned Chinese soap star; and Deadeye, Lolo's eccentric cousin.

Title: RED 2
Hint: Retired spies reunite to track down a missing portable nuclear device.
Description: Retired C.I.A. agent Frank Moses reunites his unlikely team of elite operatives for a global quest to track down a missing portable nuclear device.

Title: Cherry
Hint: A college dropout becomes an army medic, comes home with PTSD and starts robbing banks.
Description: ___ drifts from college dropout to army medic in Iraq—anchored only by his one true love, Emily. But after returning from the war with PTSD, his life spirals into drugs and crime as he struggles to find his place in the world.

Title: Kiss the Girls
Hint: A forensic psychologist searches for a serial kidnapper who collects women in North Carolina.
Description: Forensic psychologist and detective Alex Cross travels to North Carolina and teams with escaped kidnap victim Kate McTiernan to hunt down "Casanova," a serial killer who abducts strong-willed women and forces them to submit to his demands. The trail leads to Los Angeles, where the duo discovers that the psychopath may not be working alone.

Title: Nanny McPhee
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A magical, warty governess tames seven unruly children in Victorian England, one lesson at a time.
Description: Widower Cedric Brown hires ___ to care for his seven rambunctious children, who have chased away all previous nannies. Taunted by Simon and his siblings, ___ uses mystical powers to instill discipline. And when the children's great-aunt and benefactor, Lady Adelaide Stitch, threatens to separate the kids, the family pulls together under the guidance of ___.

Title: The 13th Warrior
Hint: A Muslim ambassador joins a group of Vikings to fight a mysterious enemy.
Description: A Muslim ambassador exiled from his homeland joins a group of Vikings, initially offended by their behavior but growing to respect them. As they travel together, they learn of a legendary evil closing in and must unite to confront this formidable force.

Title: The Heat
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An uptight FBI agent and a foul-mouthed Boston cop team up to take down a drug lord.
Description: Uptight and straight-laced, FBI Special Agent Sarah Ashburn is a methodical investigator with a reputation for excellence--and hyper-arrogance. Shannon Mullins, one of Boston P.D.'s "finest," is foul-mouthed and has a very short fuse, and uses her gut instinct and street smarts to catch the most elusive criminals. Neither has ever had a partner, or a friend for that matter.

Title: Inherent Vice
Hint: A stoned private eye in 1970 Los Angeles investigates his ex-girlfriend's disappearance.
Description: In Los Angeles at the turn of the 1970s, drug-fueled detective Larry "Doc" Sportello investigates the disappearance of an ex-girlfriend.

Title: Joy
Hint: A struggling single mother invents a self-wringing mop and builds a business empire.
Description: A story based on the life of a struggling Long Island single mom who became one of the country's most successful entrepreneurs.

Title: The Final Countdown
Hint: A modern aircraft carrier is swept back in time to the eve of Pearl Harbor.
Description: During routine manoeuvres near Hawaii in 1980, the aircraft-carrier USS Nimitz is caught in a strange vortex-like storm, throwing the ship back in time to 1941—mere hours before the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor.

Title: AKA
Hint: An undercover agent inside a crime syndicate is torn when he bonds with the boss's son.
Description: A steely special ops agent finds his morality put to the test when he infiltrates a crime syndicate and unexpectedly bonds with the boss' young son.

Title: The Night Porter
Hint: A concentration camp survivor reunites with her former torturer in 1957 Vienna.
Description: A concentration camp survivor discovers her former torturer and lover working as a ___ at a hotel in postwar Vienna. When the couple attempt to re-create their sadomasochistic relationship, his former SS comrades begin to stalk them.

Title: The Pelican Brief
Hint: A law student's theory about two murdered Supreme Court justices puts her in danger.
Description: A law student's theory about the recent deaths of two Supreme Court justices embroils her in a far-reaching web of murder, corruption, and greed.

Title: Borat Subsequent Moviefilm
Hint: The Kazakh journalist returns to America with his teenage daughter as a gift for a vice president.
Description: 14 years after making a film about his journey across the USA, ___ risks life and limb when he returns to the United States with his young daughter, and reveals more about the culture, the COVID-19 pandemic, and the political elections.

Title: What Lies Beneath
Hint: A scientist's wife begins to believe their house is haunted by a woman's ghost.
