Description: Norman and Claire Spencer are a seemingly happily married couple who uncover a terrible secret… a secret so disturbing it threatens to destroy them.

Title: The Chronicles of Riddick
Hint: An escaped fugitive faces an army of conquering warriors who convert or destroy entire planets.
Description: After years of outrunning ruthless bounty hunters, escaped convict ___ suddenly finds himself caught between opposing forces in a fight for the future of the human race. Now, waging incredible battles on fantastic and deadly worlds, this lone, reluctant hero will emerge as humanity's champion - and the last hope for a universe on the edge of annihilation.

Title: 8MM
Hint: A surveillance expert investigates whether a snuff film found in a dead millionaire's safe is real.
Description: A small, seemingly innocuous plastic reel of film leads surveillance specialist Tom Welles down an increasingly dark and frightening path. With the help of the streetwise Max, he relentlessly follows a bizarre trail of evidence to determine the fate of a complete stranger. As his work turns into obsession, he drifts farther and farther away from his wife, family and simple life as a small-town PI.

Title: Shattered
Country: Germany, Switzerland, United States of America
Hint: A wealthy divorcé falls for a mysterious woman who turns his smart house into a trap.
Description: Chris, a wealthy divorcee, lives in a high-tech house of his own design in Montana. His life changes when he meets Sky, a mysterious young woman who draws him out of his shell and moves in after Chris is injured.

Title: Short Circuit
Hint: A military robot is struck by lightning, comes to life and escapes, believing it's alive.
Description: After a lightning bolt zaps a robot named Number 5, the lovable machine starts to think he's human and escapes the lab. Hot on his trail is his designer, Newton, who hopes to get to Number 5 before the military does. In the meantime, a spunky animal lover mistakes the robot for an alien and takes him in, teaching her new guest about life on Earth.

Title: The Loved Ones
Hint: A girl rejected for the prom kidnaps the boy and holds her own twisted dance.
Description: When Brent turns down his classmate Lola's invitation to the prom, she concocts a wildly violent plan for revenge.

Title: Edge of Darkness
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Boston homicide detective investigates his activist daughter's murder and uncovers a conspiracy.
Description: As a seasoned homicide detective, Thomas Craven has seen the bleakest side of humanity. But nothing prepares him for the toughest investigation of his life: the search for his only daughter Emma's killer. Now, he is on a personal mission to uncover the disturbing secrets surrounding her murder, including corporate corruption, government collusion and Emma's own mysterious life.

Title: Run All Night
Hint: An aging hitman must protect his estranged son from his old boss before sunrise.
Description: Brooklyn mobster and prolific hit man Jimmy Conlon has seen better days. Longtime best friend of a mob boss, Jimmy is haunted by the sins of his past—as well as a dogged police detective who’s been one step behind Jimmy for 30 years. But when Jimmy’s estranged son becomes a target, Jimmy must make a choice between the crime family he chose and the real family he abandoned long ago.

Title: Licence to Kill
Country: Mexico, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A British agent goes rogue to avenge his friend against a drug lord.
Description: After capturing the notorious drug lord Franz Sanchez, Bond's close friend and former CIA agent Felix Leiter is left for dead and his wife is murdered. Bond goes rogue and seeks vengeance on those responsible, as he infiltrates Sanchez's organization from the inside.

Title: The Rundown
Hint: A bounty hunter is sent to the Amazon to bring back his boss's son.
Description: When Travis, the mouthy son of a criminal, disappears in the Amazon in search of a treasured artifact, his father sends in Beck, who becomes Travis's rival for the affections of Mariana, a mysterious Brazilian woman. With his steely disposition, Beck is a man of few words -- but it takes him all the discipline he can muster to work with Travis to nab a tyrant who's after the same treasure.

Title: Crocodile Dundee
Hint: A rugged Australian bushman who survived a reptile attack visits New York with a journalist.
Description: When a New York reporter plucks ___ hunter Mick ___ from the Australian Outback for a visit to the Big Apple, it's a clash of cultures and a recipe for good-natured comedy as naïve ___ negotiates the concrete jungle. He proves that his instincts are quite useful in the city and adeptly handles everything from wily muggers to high-society snoots without breaking a sweat.

Title: New Jack City
Hint: A Harlem gangster builds a crack empire while two cops try to bring him down.
Description: A gangster, Nino, is in the Cash Money Brothers, making a million dollars every week selling crack. A cop, Scotty, discovers that the only way to infiltrate the gang is to become a dealer himself.

Title: The Hunger
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An ancient vampire seeks a new companion as her current lover rapidly ages.
Description: Five-thousand-year-old vampire Miriam promises her lovers the gift of eternal life. When John, her cellist companion for centuries, discovers that he has suddenly begun growing old, he attempts to seek out the help of Dr. Sarah Roberts, a researcher on the mechanisms of aging.

Title: Heavyweights
Hint: Overweight kids at a summer camp rebel against a crazed fitness guru.
Description: Camp Hope is a summer retreat for overweight boys run by a kindly couple who make the campers feel comfortable with their extra pounds. But when tyrannical fitness guru Tony buys the camp, he puts the kids on a cruel regimen that goes too far. Sick of the endless weeks of "all work and no play," the kids stage a coup and reclaim their summer of fun.

Title: Hotel Transylvania 2
Hint: A vampire grandfather tries to awaken the monster in his half-human grandson.
Description: When the old-old-old-fashioned vampire Vlad arrives at the hotel for an impromptu family get-together, Hotel ___ is in for a collision of supernatural old-school and modern day cool.

Title: The Informer
Hint: A former IRA man betrays a friend for reward money in 1920s Dublin.
Description: Gypo Nolan is a former Irish Republican Army man who drowns his sorrows in the bottle. He's desperate to escape his bleak Dublin life and start over in America with his girlfriend. So when British authorities advertise a reward for information about his best friend, current IRA member Frankie, Gypo cooperates.

Title: Phantasm
Hint: A teenage boy battles a mysterious undertaker with flying silver spheres in his small town.
Description: A teenage boy and his friends face off against a mysterious grave robber, known only as the Tall Man, who employs a lethal arsenal of unearthly weapons.

Title: Back to School
Hint: A self-made millionaire enrolls in his son's college and parties harder than everyone.
Description: Self-made millionaire Thornton Melon decides to get a better education and enrolls at his son Jason's college. While Jason tries to fit in with his fellow students, Thornton struggles to gain his son's respect, giving way to hilarious antics.

Title: The Girl with All the Gifts
Hint: A zombie-infected girl who can think may hold the key to humanity's survival.
Description: In the future, a strange fungus has changed nearly everyone into thoughtless, flesh-eating monsters. When a scientist and a teacher find a girl who seems to be immune to the fungus, they all begin a journey to save humanity.

Title: Flushed Away
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A pampered pet rat is sent down the toilet into a bustling sewer city.
Description: London high-society mouse, Roddy is ___ down the toilet by Sid, a common sewer rat. Hang on for a madcap adventure deep in the sewer bowels of Ratropolis, where Roddy meets the resourceful Rita, the rodent-hating Toad and his faithful thugs, Spike and Whitey.

Title: Bad Boys II
Hint: Two Miami narcotics detectives take down an ecstasy kingpin.
Description: Detectives Marcus Burnett and Mike Lowrey of the Miami Narcotics Task Force are tasked with stopping the flow of the drug Ecstasy into Miami. They track the drugs to the whacked-out Cuban drug lord Johnny Tapia, who is also involved in a bloody war with Russian and Haitian mobsters.

Title: The Rules of Attraction
Hint: Spoiled students at a New England college tangle in a web of unrequited love.
Description: The incredibly spoiled and overprivileged students of Camden College are a backdrop for an unusual love triangle between a drug dealer, a virgin and a bisexual classmate.

Title: Powder
Hint: A shy albino teen with incredible mental powers is harassed by classmates.
Description: Harassed by classmates who won't accept his shocking appearance, a shy young man known as "___" struggles to fit in. But the cruel taunts stop when ___ displays a mysterious power that allows him to do incredible things. This phenomenon changes the lives of all those around him in ways they never could have imagined.

Title: Puss in Boots
Hint: A swashbuckling cat goes on an adventure to steal golden goose eggs.
Description: Long before he even met Shrek, the notorious fighter, lover and outlaw ___ becomes a hero when he sets off on an adventure with the tough and street smart Kitty Softpaws and the mastermind Humpty Dumpty to save his town. This is the true story of The Cat, The Myth, The Legend... The ___.

Title: Spirited
Hint: A ghost of Christmas Present tries to reform a ruthless media consultant.
Description: Each Christmas Eve, the Ghost of Christmas Present selects one dark soul to be reformed by a visit from three spirits. But this season, he picked the wrong Scrooge. Clint Briggs turns the tables on his ghostly host until Present finds himself reexamining his own past, present and future.

Title: Bawaal
Hint: A small-town history teacher's marriage is tested on a trip through Europe.
Description: Ajay Dixit, an ordinary history teacher in a high school, enjoys mini celebrityhood in his town courtesy of the fake image he has built. He shares a strained relationship with his newly-wed wife. Circumstances force him to take a trip to Europe for the World War II trail accompanied by his wife. Will his relationship with his wife survive this trip? Will he manage to win the war within?

Title: Heavy Metal
Genres: Animation, Science Fiction, Adventure, Fantasy, Music
Hint: A glowing green orb of evil terrorizes a young girl with tales of sci-fi and fantasy.
Description: The embodiment of ultimate evil, a glowing orb terrorizes a young girl with bizarre stories of dark fantasy, eroticism and horror.

Title: Fear Street: Part Three - 1666
Hint: A young woman relives the 17th-century witch trials that started a town's curse.
Description: In ___, a colonial town is gripped by a hysterical witch-hunt that has deadly consequences for centuries to come, and it's up to teenagers in 1994 to finally put an end to their town's curse, before it's too late.

Title: Adrift
Hint: A young couple sails into a hurricane and must survive at sea.
Description: Tami Oldham and Richard Sharp couldn't anticipate that they would be sailing directly into one of the most catastrophic hurricanes in recorded history. In the aftermath of the storm, Tami awakens to find Richard badly injured and their boat in ruins. With no hope of rescue, Tami must now find the strength and determination to save herself and the only man she has ever loved.

Title: May
Hint: A lonely veterinary assistant becomes obsessed with perfect body parts.
Description: A socially awkward veterinary assistant with a lazy eye and obsession with perfection descends into depravity after developing a crush on a boy with perfect hands.

Title: Lords of Chaos
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A teenager launches Norwegian black metal, and the scene turns violent.
Description: A teenager's quest to launch Norwegian Black Metal in Oslo in the 1990s results in a very violent outcome.

Title: Eagle Eye
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two strangers are manipulated by a mysterious woman on the phone.
Description: Jerry Shaw and Rachel Holloman are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them.

Title: Rollerball
Country: United States of America, Canada, United Kingdom
Hint: In a corporate-controlled future, an ultra-violent sport on skates is the ultimate entertainment, and its star refuses to retire.
Description: In a corporate-controlled future, an ultra-violent sport known as ___ represents the world, and one of its powerful athletes is out to defy those who want him out of the game.

Title: Summer School
Hint: A laid-back gym teacher is forced to teach remedial English to a class of misfits during the holidays.
Description: A high-school gym teacher has big plans for the summer, but is forced to cancel them to teach a "bonehead" English class for misfit goof-off students. Fortunately, his unconventional brand of teaching fun field trips begins to connect with them, and even inspires ardor in some.

Title: Going in Style
Hint: Three retired men plan a bank robbery after losing their pensions.
Description: Desperate to pay the bills and come through for their loved ones, three lifelong pals risk it all by embarking on a daring bid to knock off the very bank that absconded with their money.

Title: From Beyond
Hint: Scientists build a machine that opens a portal to monstrous creatures.
Description: The Resonator, a powerful machine that can control the sixth sense, has killed its creator and sent his associate into an insane asylum. When a psychiatrist becomes determined to continue the experiment, she unwittingly opens the door to a hostile parallel universe.

Title: Last Vegas
Hint: Four friends in their 60s throw a wild bachelor party in Sin City.
Description: Aging pals Billy, Paddy, Archie, and Sam have been best friends since childhood. When Billy finally proposes to his much-younger girlfriend, all four friends go to Las ___ to celebrate the end of Billy's longtime bachelorhood and relive their glory days. However, the four quickly realize that the intervening decades have changed Sin City and tested their friendship in ways they had not imagined.

Title: Toy Soldiers
Hint: A drug cartel takes over a boarding school for troubled rich boys.
Description: After federal agents arrest a drug czar and put him on trial, the cartel leader's vicious son storms a prep school and takes its students hostage. They rebel against the armed intruders and try to take back their academy by any means necessary.

Title: Alpha
Country: Canada, United States of America, China
Hint: A young hunter befriends a wolf during the last Ice Age.
Description: In the prehistoric past, Keda, a young and inexperienced hunter, struggles to return home after being separated from his tribe when bison hunting goes awry. On his way back he will find an unexpected ally.

Title: Malcolm & Marie
Hint: A filmmaker and his girlfriend argue all night after his movie premiere.
Description: As a filmmaker and his girlfriend return home from his movie premiere, smoldering tensions and painful revelations push them toward a romantic reckoning.

Title: Half Baked
Hint: Stoners sell stolen pot to bail out their friend.
Description: Three lovable party buds try to bail their friend out of jail. But just when the guys have mastered a plan, everything comes dangerously close to going up in smoke.

Title: Black Rain
Hint: Two New York cops get caught in a Yakuza war in Osaka.
Description: Two New York cops get involved in a gang war between members of the Yakuza, the Japanese Mafia. They arrest one of their killers and are ordered to escort him back to Japan. However, in Japan he manages to escape, and as they try to track him down, they get deeper and deeper into the Japanese Mafia scene and they have to learn that they can only win by playing the game—the Japanese way.

Title: Roxanne
Hint: A fire chief with a huge nose helps another man woo the woman he loves.
Description: In this modern take on Edmond Rostand's classic play "Cyrano de Bergerac," C. D. Bales is the witty, intelligent, and brave fire chief of a small Pacific Northwest town who, due to the size of his enormous nose, declines to pursue the girl of his dreams, lovely ___ Kowalski. Instead, when his shy underling Chris McConnell becomes smitten with ___, C.D.

Title: The Miseducation of Cameron Post
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A teen girl is sent to a gay conversion camp in 1993.
Description: Pennsylvania, 1993. After getting caught with another girl, teenager ___ Post is sent to a conversion therapy center run by the strict Dr. Lydia Marsh and her brother, Reverend Rick, whose treatment consists in repenting for feeling “same sex attraction.” ___ befriends fellow sinners Jane and Adam, thus creating a new family to deal with the surrounding intolerance.

Title: Max
Hint: A Jewish art dealer in Munich befriends a young, struggling artist who will become a dictator.
Description: In 1918, a young, disillusioned Adolf Hitler strikes up a friendship with a Jewish art dealer while weighing a life of passion for art vs. talent at politics

Title: The Eyes of Tammy Faye
Hint: The rise and fall of an evangelist couple who build a TV empire in the 1970s.
Description: From the 1960s to the 1980s, evangelist Jim Baker and his ambitious wife, ___, rose from humble beginnings to build an empire based on big-time evangelical Christianity--only for the couple to fall from grace because of some all-too-human sins.

Title: A Perfect Murder
Hint: A wealthy man plots to have his cheating wife killed by her lover.
Description: Millionaire industrialist Steven Taylor is a man who has everything but what he craves most: the love and fidelity of his wife. A hugely successful player in the New York financial world, he considers her to be his most treasured acquisition. But she needs more than simply the role of dazzling accessory.

Title: Far and Away
Hint: A free-spirited Irish woman and a tenant farmer emigrate to America and end up in the Oklahoma land rush.
Description: A young free-spirited Irish woman from an affluent Protestant family spontaneously befriends a street-smart commoner cheated by her family’s hostile land takeovers. They escape to America, ready to take advantage of the 19th century Oklahoma land rush.

Title: Midnight in the Garden of Good and Evil
Hint: A visiting New York reporter covers a murder trial among eccentrics in Savannah, Georgia.
Description: A visiting city reporter's assignment suddenly revolves around the murder trial of a local millionaire, whom he befriends.

Title: French Kiss
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A woman afraid of flying travels to France to win back her cheating fiancé, with a crook in tow.
Description: After her fiancee admits to infidelity while on a business trip in France, a woman attempts to get her lover back and marry him by traveling to Paris despite her crippling fear of flying. On the way she unwittingly smuggles something of value that has a charming crook chasing her across France as she chases after her future husband.

Title: Reality Bites
Hint: Post-college friends confront the realities of adulthood in 1990s Houston.
Description: A small circle of friends suffering from post-collegiate blues must confront the hard truth about life, love and the pursuit of gainful employment. As they struggle to map out survival guides for the future, the Gen-X quartet soon begins to realize that reality isn't all it's cracked up to be.

Title: Australia
Country: Australia, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An English aristocrat drives cattle across the northern outback with a rough stockman before WWII.
Description: Set in northern ___ before World War II, an English aristocrat who inherits a sprawling ranch reluctantly pacts with a stock-man in order to protect her new property from a takeover plot. As the pair drive 2,000 head of cattle over unforgiving landscape, they experience the bombing of Darwin by Japanese forces firsthand.

Title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
Hint: Zoo animals crash-land on the savanna and meet their long-lost families.
Description: Alex, Marty, and other zoo animals find a way to escape from ___ when the penguins reassemble a wrecked airplane. The precariously repaired craft stays airborne just long enough to make it to the African continent. There the New Yorkers encounter members of their own species for the first time. ___ proves to be a wild place, but Alex and company wonder if it is better than their Central Park home.

Title: Titan A.E.
Genres: Animation, Science Fiction, Adventure, Family, Action
Hint: A young man holds the key to saving humanity after Earth is destroyed.
Description: A young man finds out that he holds the key to restoring hope and ensuring survival for the human race, while an alien species called the Drej are bent on mankind's destruction.

Title: The Mosquito Coast
Hint: An inventor moves his family to the Central American jungle.
Description: An inventor spurns his city life and moves his family into the jungles of Central America to make a utopia.

Title: Hot Shots! Part Deux
Hint: A fighter pilot is recruited to rescue POWs in a parody of action films.
Description: Topper Harley is found to be working as an odd-job-man in a monastery. The CIA want him to lead a rescue mission into Iraq, to rescue the last rescue team, who went in to rescue the last rescue team—who went in to rescue hostages left behind after Desert Storm.

Title: Demons
Hint: Moviegoers are trapped in a Berlin theater as the audience turns into monsters.
Description: A group of people are trapped in a West Berlin movie theater infested with ravenous ___ who proceed to kill and possess the humans one-by-one, thereby multiplying their numbers.

Title: Bloody Daddy
Hint: A dirty cop steals cocaine and must save his kidnapped son.
Description: Sumair Azad, a dirty cop and his friend, Jaggi, steal Sikandar Chowdhary's cocaine bag. As a result, Sikandar kidnaps Sumair's son, but things take a turn when he loses the cocaine bag as he faces off Gurugram’s drug lords, a crime boss, murderous narcs and straight cops on one fateful night.

Title: The Great Outdoors
Hint: A man's vacation is ruined by his obnoxious brother-in-law.
Description: It's vacation time for outdoorsy Chicago man Chet Ripley, along with his wife, Connie, and their two kids, Buck and Ben. But a serene weekend of fishing at a Wisconsin lakeside cabin gets crashed by Connie's obnoxious brother-in-law, Roman Craig, his wife, Kate, and the couple's two daughters. As the excursion wears on, the Ripleys find themselves at odds with the stuffy Craig family.

Title: Copycat
Hint: A psychologist and a detective hunt a serial killer copying famous murders.
Description: An agoraphobic psychologist and a female detective must work together to take down a serial killer who copies serial killers from the past.

Title: Mr. Mom
Hint: A laid-off engineer becomes a stay-at-home dad while his wife returns to work.
Description: Jack and Caroline are a couple making a decent living when Jack suddenly loses his job. They agree that he should stay at home and look after the house while Caroline works. It's just that he's never done it before, and really doesn't have a clue...

Title: Courage Under Fire
Hint: An Army officer investigates a female helicopter pilot's Medal of Honor nomination.
Description: A US Army officer, who made a "friendly ___" mistake that was covered up, has been reassigned to a desk job. He is tasked to investigate a female chopper commander's worthiness to be awarded the Medal of Honor. At first all seems in order. But then he begins to notice inconsistencies between the testimonies of the witnesses...

Title: The Snowtown Murders
Hint: A teenager falls in with a charismatic man who leads a gang of killers in South Australia.
Description: Based on true events, 16 year-old Jamie falls in with his mother's new boyfriend and his crowd of self-appointed neighborhood watchmen, a relationship that leads to a spree of torture and murder.

Title: White Squall
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Prep school students sail on a ship caught in a storm.
Description: In 1960, a hardy group of prep school students boards an old-fashioned sailing ship. With Capt. Christopher Sheldon at the helm, the oceangoing voyage is intended to teach the boys fortitude and discipline. But the youthful crew are about to get some unexpected instruction in survival when they get caught in the clutches of a ___ storm.

Title: Promised Land
Country: United Arab Emirates, United States of America
Hint: A salesman for a natural gas company tries to buy drilling rights in a small town.
Description: A salesman for a natural gas company experiences life-changing events after arriving in a small town, where his corporation wants to tap into the available resources.

Title: All the Bright Places
Hint: Two teens with emotional scars bond while exploring Indiana.
Description: Two teens facing personal struggles form a powerful bond as they embark on a cathartic journey chronicling the wonders of Indiana.

Title: Oliver & Company
Hint: A homeless kitten joins a gang of dogs in New York.
Description: Putting its own 'twist' on the story of ___ Twist, the orange runt of a litter of kittens must fight for survival on the rough streets on New York City, finding unlikely friends in the dogs owned by a down-on-his luck man named Fagin. Soon, ___ and his new band of comrades must fight for survival when Fagin is unable to pay his debts.

Title: Kill Boksoon
Hint: A renowned Korean assassin is also a single mother, and wants to leave her job.
Description: At work, she's a renowned assassin. At home, she's a single mom to a teenage daughter. Killing? That's easy. It's parenting that's the hard part.

Title: Outland
Genres: Science Fiction, Action, Thriller, Crime, Western
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A marshal on a mining colony uncovers a drug conspiracy.
Description: On the sunless moon Io, Marshall William T. O’Niel goes toe-to-toe with the corrupt manager of a mining colony and his gang of roughnecks while investigating a rash of worker suicides.

Title: The Legend of Billie Jean
Hint: A Texas teen becomes a fugitive and a folk hero.
Description: Average Texas teen, ___ Davy, is caught up in an odd fight for justice. She is usually followed and harrased around by local boys, who, one day, decide to trash her brother's scooter for fun. The boys' father refuses to pay them back the price of the scooter. The fight for "fair is fair" takes the teens around the state and produces an unlikely hero.

Title: Raees
Hint: A bootlegger rises to power in Gujarat and clashes with an honest cop.
Description: Set in the early ’80s and ’90s in Gujarat, India, ‘___’ is a fictitious story of a crime lord named ___, who builds an entire empire from scratch, and a police officer who is determined to bring him down.

Title: Star Trek: Generations
Hint: Two Enterprise captains team up to stop a madman.
Description: Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise-D find themselves at odds with the renegade scientist Soran who is destroying entire star systems. Only one man can help Picard stop Soran's scheme...and he's been dead for seventy-eight years.

Title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Rodrick Rules
Hint: A seventh grader battles his older brother, a lazy rock drummer.
Description: ___ Greg Heffley, now in seventh grade, thinks he has it all together. He has mastered middle school and gotten rid of the Cheese Touch. However, Greg's older brother, ___, is itching to cut him down to size. He gets the perfect opportunity when their mother tries to force the boys to bond.

Title: Shoot 'Em Up
Hint: A gunman delivers a woman's baby during a shootout and protects the newborn.
Description: A man named Mr. Smith delivers a woman's baby during a shootout, and is then called upon to protect the newborn from the army of gunmen.

Title: Penguins of Madagascar
Hint: Four commando flightless birds join an undercover animal organization.
Description: Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private join forces with undercover organization The North Wind to stop the villainous Dr. Octavius Brine from destroying the world as we know it.

Title: 21 Bridges
Hint: An NYPD detective shuts down Manhattan to catch cop killers.
Description: An embattled NYPD detective, is thrust into a citywide manhunt for a pair of cop killers after uncovering a massive and unexpected conspiracy. As the night unfolds, lines become blurred on who he is pursuing, and who is in pursuit of him.

Title: Ingrid Goes West
Hint: An unstable woman moves to LA and becomes dangerously obsessed with a social media influencer.
Description: ___ becomes obsessed with a social network star named Taylor Sloane who seemingly has a perfect life. But when ___ decides to drop everything and move west to be Taylor's friend, her behaviour turns unsettling and dangerous.

Title: Shanghai Noon
Country: United States of America, Hong Kong
Hint: A Chinese imperial guard teams up with a smooth-talking cowboy outlaw.
Description: Chon Wang, a clumsy imperial guard, trails Princess Pei Pei when she's kidnapped from the Forbidden City and transported to America. Wang follows her captors to Nevada, where he teams up with an unlikely partner, outcast outlaw Roy O'Bannon, and tries to spring the princess from her imprisonment.

Title: The Beyond
Hint: A woman inherits a Louisiana hotel built over a gateway to hell.
Description: New Yorker Liza Merril inherits an old hotel in Louisiana and invests her savings to reopen the place, unaware that the hotel houses the body of a dead painter murdered decades earlier, and that the location is about to become a gateway to Hell.

Title: Dreamgirls
Hint: A trio of soul singers cross over to pop stardom in the 1960s.
Description: A trio of female soul singers cross over to the pop charts in the early 1960s, facing their own personal struggles along the way.

Title: Tommy
Hint: A deaf, dumb and blind boy becomes a pinball champion in a rock opera.
Description: After a series of traumatic childhood events, a psychosomatically deaf, dumb and blind boy becomes a master pinball player and the object of a religious cult.

Title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
Hint: The crew steals the Enterprise to rescue their captain's body.
Description: A surprise visit from ___ father provides a startling revelation: McCoy is harboring ___ living essence.

Title: Victory
Country: Italy, United Kingdom, United States of America, Hungary
Hint: POWs play a football match against the German national team in occupied Paris.
Description: A group of POWs in a German prison camp during World War II play the German National Soccer Team in this powerful film depicting the role of prisoners during wartime.

Title: Midnight Sun
Hint: A teen with a rare allergy to daylight falls in love at night.
Description: Katie, a 17-year-old, has been sheltered since childhood and confined to her house during the day by a rare disease that makes even the smallest amount of sunlight deadly. Fate intervenes when she meets Charlie and they embark on a summer romance.

Title: Epic
Hint: A teenager is shrunk and transported to a forest of tiny warriors.
Description: A teenager finds herself transported to a deep forest setting where a battle between the forces of good and the forces of evil is taking place. She bands together with a rag-tag group characters in order to save their world—and ours.

Title: Tuck Everlasting
Hint: A girl falls for a boy from a family that drank from a spring of eternal youth.
Description: Teenager Winnie Foster is growing up in a small rural town in 1914 with her loving but overprotective parents, but Winnie longs for a life of greater freedom and adventure.

Title: Fame
Hint: Students at a New York performing arts high school chase their dreams.
Description: A chronicle of the lives of several teenagers who attend a New York high school for students gifted in the performing arts.

Title: The Wedding Ringer
Hint: A groom with no friends hires a professional to pose as his best man.
Description: Doug Harris is a loveable but socially awkward groom-to-be with a problem: he has no best man. With less than two weeks to go until he marries the girl of his dreams, Doug is referred to Jimmy Callahan, owner and CEO of Best Man, Inc., a company that provides flattering best men for socially challenged guys in need.

Title: *batteries not included
Hint: Tiny alien robots help elderly tenants save their building from developers.
Description: In a soon to be demolished block of apartments, the residents resist the criminal methods used to force them to leave so a greedy tycoon can build his new skyscraper. When tiny mechanical aliens land for a recharge, they decide to stay and help out.

Title: Lethal Weapon 4
Hint: Two LAPD partners take on Chinese triads smuggling immigrants.
Description: With personal crises and age weighing in on them, LAPD officers Riggs and Murtaugh must contend with a deadly Chinese crime lord trying to get his brother out of prison.

Title: Happiest Season
Hint: A woman plans to propose to her girlfriend at her family's holiday gathering, but she's not out.
Description: A young woman's plans to propose to her girlfriend while at her family's annual holiday party are upended when she discovers her partner hasn't yet come out to her conservative parents.

Title: The Command
Hint: A Russian submarine sinks during a naval exercise, and the government refuses foreign help.
Description: Barents Sea, August 12th, 2000. During a Russian naval exercise, and after suffering a serious accident, the K-141 Kursk submarine sinks with 118 crew members on board. While the few sailors who are still alive barely manage to survive, their families push for accurate information.

Title: The Great Raid
Hint: Army Rangers launch a daring rescue of POWs from a Japanese camp in the Philippines.
Description: As World War II rages, the elite Sixth Ranger Battalion is given a mission of heroic proportions: push 30 miles behind enemy lines and liberate over 500 American prisoners of war.

Title: The Man Who Fell to Earth
Hint: An alien comes to our planet seeking water for his dying world.
Description: Thomas Jerome Newton is an alien who has come to Earth in search of water to save his home planet. Aided by lawyer Oliver Farnsworth, Thomas uses his knowledge of advanced technology to create profitable inventions. While developing a method to transport water, Thomas meets Mary-Lou, a quiet hotel clerk, and begins to fall in love with her. Just as he is ready to leave Earth, Thomas is intercepted by the U.S.

Title: Midnight Special
Hint: A father and his son with mysterious glowing powers go on the run from the government and a cult.
Description: A father and son go on the run after the dad learns his child possesses special powers.

Title: Bad Words
Hint: A 40-year-old misanthrope enters a children's spelling bee through a loophole.
Description: Forty-year-old misanthrope, Guy Trilby, enters the National Golden Quill Spelling Bee through a loophole in the rules.

Title: Judgment Night
Hint: Four friends take a shortcut and are hunted by a gang in Chicago.
Description: Four young friends, while taking a shortcut en route to a local boxing match, witness a brutal murder which leaves them running for their lives.

Title: Men, Women & Children
Hint: Teens and their parents in a Texas suburb struggle with how the internet is reshaping their relationships, sex lives and self-image.
Description: Follows the story of a group of high school teenagers and their parents as they attempt to navigate the many ways the internet has changed their relationships, their communication, their self-image, and their love lives.

Title: Sudden Impact
Hint: A rape victim becomes a serial killer, and the rogue detective tracks her.
Description: When a young rape victim takes justice into her own hands and becomes a serial killer, it's up to Dirty Harry Callahan, on suspension from the SFPD, to bring her to justice.

Title: Respect
Hint: The rise of a legendary soul singer from her father's church to superstardom.
Description: The rise of Aretha Franklin’s career from a child singing in her father’s church’s choir to her international superstardom.

Title: For Love of the Game
Hint: A baseball legend pitches the final outing of his career while remembering his love.
Description: A baseball legend almost finished with his distinguished career at the age of forty has one last chance to prove who he is, what he is capable of, and win the heart of the woman he has loved for the past four years.

Title: The Bad Lieutenant: Port of Call - New Orleans
Hint: A drug-addicted cop investigates a murder in post-Katrina Louisiana.
Description: Terrence McDonagh is a New ___ Police sergeant, who receives a medal and a promotion to ___ for heroism during Hurricane Katrina. Due to his heroic act, McDonagh injures his back and becomes addicted to prescription pain medication. He then finds himself involved with a drug dealer who is suspected of murdering a family of African immigrants.

Title: Retribution
Country: France, Germany, United States of America
Hint: A bank executive discovers a bomb under his car seat while driving his kids.
Description: When a mysterious caller plants a bomb under his car seat, a bank executive begins a high-speed chase across the city to complete a specific series of tasks — all with his kids trapped in the back seat.

Title: Fatherhood
Hint: A widowed father raises his infant daughter alone in Boston.
Description: A widowed new dad copes with doubts, fears, heartache and dirty diapers as he sets out to raise his daughter on his own. Inspired by a true story.

Title: Easy Virtue
Hint: A young Englishman marries a glamorous American racing driver and brings her home to his snobbish family.
Description: A young Englishman marries a glamorous American. When he brings her home to meet the parents, she arrives like a blast from the future - blowing their entrenched British stuffiness out the window.

Title: The Recruit
Hint: A CIA trainee is recruited for a dangerous mission inside the agency.
Description: A brilliant CIA trainee must prove his worth at the Farm, the agency's secret training grounds, where he learns to watch his back and trust no one.

Title: Café Society
Hint: A young man goes to Hollywood in the 1930s and falls in love with his uncle's mistress.
Description: The story of a young man who arrives in Hollywood during the 1930s hoping to work in the film industry, falls in love, and finds himself swept up in the vibrant ___ that defined the spirit of the age.

Title: Thoroughbreds
Hint: Two Connecticut teenage girls plot to kill a stepfather.
Description: Lily and Amanda, two high school students living in suburban Connecticut, rekindle their unlikely friendship after years of drifting apart. Together, they devise a plan to kill Lily's abusive stepfather by hiring a lowlife drug dealer.

Title: Silent Running
Hint: An ecologist maintains the last of Earth's plants in domes on a spaceship and defies orders to destroy them.
Description: After the entire flora goes extinct, ecologist Lowell maintains a greenhouse aboard a space station for the future with his android companions. However, he rebels after being ordered to destroy the greenhouse in favor of carrying cargo, a decision that puts him at odds with everyone but his mechanical companions.

Title: Airport
Hint: A terminal manager deals with a snowstorm and a bomber on a plane.
Description: An ___ manager tries to keep his terminals open during a snowstorm, while a suicide bomber plots to blow up a Boeing 707 airliner in flight.

Title: Peter Rabbit
Hint: A mischievous bunny battles a farmer for his vegetable garden.
Description: ___ feud with Mr. McGregor escalates to greater heights than ever before as they rival for the affections of the warm-hearted animal lover who lives next door.

Title: CBGB
Hint: The founding of a legendary New York punk club in a Bowery dive.
Description: A look at New York's dynamic punk rock scene through the lens of the ground-breaking Lower East Side club started by eccentric Hilly Kristal in 1973 which launched thousands of bands.

Title: Dragonslayer
Hint: A sorcerer's apprentice sets out to slay a dragon that demands virgin sacrifices.
Description: A sorcerer and his apprentice are on a mission to kill an evil dragon to save the King’s daughter from being sacrificed according to a pact that the King himself made with the dragon to protect his kingdom.

Title: The Way of the Gun
Hint: Two drifters kidnap a surrogate mother and are pursued by hired gunmen.
Description: Two criminal drifters without sympathy get more than they bargained for after kidnapping and holding for ransom the surrogate mother of a powerful and shady man.

Title: The Company of Wolves
Hint: A young girl dreams of a fairy tale world full of werewolves.
Description: An adaptation of Angela Carter's fairy tales. Young Rosaleen dreams of a village in the dark woods, where Granny tells her cautionary tales in which innocent maidens are tempted by ___ who are hairy on the inside. As Rosaleen grows into womanhood, will the ___ come for her too?

Title: Man on a Ledge
Hint: A former cop threatens to jump from a Manhattan hotel window as a diversion.
Description: An ex-cop turned con threatens to jump to his death from a Manhattan hotel rooftop. The NYPD dispatch a female police psychologist to talk him down. However, unbeknownst to the police on the scene, the suicide attempt is a cover for the biggest diamond heist ever pulled.

Title: The Red Sea Diving Resort
Hint: Mossad agents run a beach getaway in Sudan to smuggle Ethiopian refugees.
Description: Sudan, East Africa, 1980. A team of Israeli Mossad agents plans to rescue and transfer thousands of Ethiopian Jews to Israel. To do so, and to avoid raising suspicions from the inquisitive and ruthless authorities, they establish as a cover a fake ___ by the Red Sea.

Title: Yentl
Hint: A Jewish girl disguises herself as a boy to study the Talmud.
Description: In a time when girls were forbidden to study religious scriptures, a Jewish girl masquerades as a boy to enter religious training and unexpectedly finds love along the way.

Title: High Art
Hint: A magazine editor falls for a burnt-out photographer in New York.
Description: When Syd, a young editor at an influential art magazine, becomes involved with her neighbor, a drug-addicted lesbian photographer, both seek to exploit each other for their respective careers while slowly falling in love with each other.

Title: Hands of Stone
Hint: A Panamanian boxing champion and his legendary trainer take on a famous rival.
Description: The legendary Roberto Duran and his equally legendary trainer Ray Arcel change each other's lives.

Title: Ripley's Game
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Italy
Hint: An aging, urbane murderer lives in Italy and manipulates a dying framer.
Description: Tom ___ - cool, urbane, wealthy, and murderous - lives in a villa in the Veneto with Luisa, his harpsichord-playing girlfriend. A former business associate from Berlin's underworld pays a call asking ___ help in killing a rival. ___ - ever a student of human nature - initiates a game to turn a mild and innocent local picture framer into a hit man.

Title: Meet the Feebles
Hint: A puppet variety show is full of debauchery and scandal.
Description: Heidi, star of the "___ Variety Hour" discovers her lover Bletch the Walrus is cheating on her. And with all the world waiting for the show, the assorted co-stars must contend with drug addiction, extortion, robbery, disease, drug dealing, and murder.

Title: Rock 'n' Roll High School
Hint: Students who worship the Ramones take over their campus with music and explosives.
Description: A group of rock-music-loving students, with the help of the Ramones, take over their school to combat its newly installed oppressive administration.

Title: Faster, Pussycat! Kill! Kill!
Hint: Go-go dancers in a desert kidnap a girl and target an old man's fortune.
Description: A trio of thrill-seeking go-go dancers kidnap a young girl and attempt to seduce an old rancher and his two sons out of their small fortune, but their scheme doesn't play out as intended.

Title: New York, New York
Hint: A saxophonist and a singer fall in love on V-J Day.
Description: An egotistical saxophone player and a young singer meet on V-J Day and embark upon a strained and rocky romance, even as their careers begin a long uphill climb.

Title: Auto Focus
Hint: A sitcom star's life spirals into sex addiction with the help of a video technician friend.
Description: A successful TV star during the 1960s, former "Hogan's Heroes" actor Bob Crane projects a wholesome family-man image, but this front masks his persona as a sex addict who records and photographs his many encounters with women, often with the help of his seedy friend, John Henry Carpenter.

Title: The Homesman
Hint: A pioneer woman escorts three madwomen across the frontier.
Description: When three women living on the edge of the American frontier are driven mad by harsh pioneer life, the task of saving them falls to the pious, independent-minded Mary Bee Cuddy. Transporting the women by covered wagon to Iowa, she soon realizes just how daunting the journey will be, and employs a low-life drifter, George Briggs, to join her.

Title: Juliet, Naked
Hint: A woman begins an affair with her boyfriend's reclusive rock idol.
Description: Annie is stuck in a long-term relationship with Duncan – an obsessive fan of obscure rocker Tucker Crowe. When the acoustic demo of Tucker's hit record from 25 years ago surfaces, its discovery leads to a life-changing encounter with the elusive rocker himself.

Title: Arbitrage
Hint: A hedge fund magnate tries to cover up a fatal car crash.
Description: A troubled hedge fund magnate, desperate to complete the sale of his trading empire, makes an error that forces him to turn to an unlikely person for help.

Title: Brain on Fire
Hint: A young journalist is struck by a mysterious illness that mimics madness.
Description: Susannah Cahalan, an up-and-coming journalist at the New York Post becomes plagued by voices in her head and seizures, causing a rapid descent into insanity.

Title: Irrational Man
Hint: A depressed philosophy professor finds new meaning in life by planning a murder.
Description: On a small town college campus, a philosophy professor in existential crisis gives his life new purpose when he enters into a relationship with his student.

Title: The Mirror Has Two Faces
Hint: A professor marries a colleague in a platonic arrangement.
Description: Rose Morgan, who still lives with her mother, is a professor of Romantic Literature who desperately longs for passion in her life. Gregory Larkin, a mathematics professor, has been burned by passionate relationships and longs for a sexless union based on friendship and respect.

Title: Luce
Hint: A star athlete and student's idealised image is challenged by his teacher.
Description: A star athlete and top student, ___ idealized image is challenged by one of his teachers when his unsettling views on political violence come to light, putting a strain on family bonds while igniting intense debates on race and identity.

Title: Nick and Norah's Infinite Playlist
Hint: Two teens spend a night in New York searching for a secret concert.
Description: Nick cannot stop obsessing over his ex-girlfriend, Tris, until Tris' friend ___ suddenly shows interest in him at a club. Thus begins an odd night filled with ups and downs as the two keep running into Tris and her new boyfriend while searching for ___ drunken friend, Caroline, with help from Nick's band mates. As the night winds down, the two have to figure out what they want from each other.

Title: I Love You Phillip Morris
Hint: A con man falls in love with his cellmate and escapes repeatedly.
Description: Steven Russell leads a seemingly average life – an organ player in the local church, happily married to Debbie, and a member of the local police force. That is until he has a severe car accident that leads him to the ultimate epiphany: he’s gay and he’s going to live life to the fullest – even if he has to break the law to do it.

Title: These Final Hours
Hint: A man must choose how to spend his last day on Earth.
Description: What would you do on the last day on Earth? With the end of the world only hours away, the self-absorbed James heads to the ultimate party-to-end-all-parties. On his way there, he saves the life of a young girl named Rose who is searching desperately for her missing father. This simple act sets James on a path to redemption.

Title: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka
Hint: A soldier returns to the ghetto to avenge his brother's death, in a parody of blaxploitation films.
Description: Jack Spade returns from the army in his old ghetto neighbourhood when his brother, June Bug, dies. Jack declares war on Mr. Big, powerful local crimelord. His army is led by John Slade, his childhood idol who used to fight bad guys in the 70s.

Title: Strange Brew
Hint: Two dim Canadian brothers uncover a plot at a brewery.
Description: Something is rotten at the Elsinore Brewery. Bob and Doug McKenzie (as seen on SCTV) help the orphan Pam regain the brewery founded by her recently-deceased father. But to do so, they must confront the suspicious Brewmeister Smith and two teams of vicious hockey players.

Title: The Book of Henry
Hint: A boy genius leaves his mother a plan to save his abused neighbor.
Description: Susan, a single mother of two, works as a waitress in a small town. Her son, Henry, is an 11-year-old genius who not only manages the family finances but acts as emotional support for his mother and younger brother. When Henry discovers that the girl next door has a terrible secret, he implores Susan to take matters into her own hands.

Title: Super Dark Times
Hint: Two teenage best friends cover up a tragic accident, and paranoia tears them apart.
Description: Teenagers Zach and Josh have been best friends their whole lives, but when a gruesome accident leads to a cover-up, the secret drives a wedge between them and propels them down a rabbit hole of escalating paranoia and violence.

Title: Kiss of the Dragon
Hint: A Chinese cop is framed for murder in Paris.
Description: Liu Jian, an elite Chinese police officer, comes to Paris to arrest a Chinese drug lord. When Jian is betrayed by a French officer and framed for murder, he must go into hiding and find new allies.

Title: Whiskey Tango Foxtrot
Hint: A bored TV news writer becomes a correspondent covering the war in Afghanistan.
Description: Stuck in a rut, reporter Kim Baker decides to shake things up by leaving her desk job in New York and taking a dangerous assignment in Afghanistan. Far from home and completely out of her comfort zone, a culture-shocked Kim befriends an adventurous reporter Tanya Vanderpoel, a stern Colonel, and a charming photojournalist to help her navigate this crazy new world.

Title: Darlings
Hint: A woman and her mother take revenge on her abusive husband.
Description: Badru hopes her volatile husband will reform if he stops drinking. But when his rage goes too far, she and her mom boldly, albeit clumsily, seek revenge.

Title: The Hollars
Hint: An artist returns home when his mother is diagnosed with a brain tumor.
Description: Aspiring New York City artist John Hollar returns to his Middle America hometown on the eve of his mother’s brain surgery. Joined by his girlfriend Rebecca, eight months pregnant with their first child, John is forced to navigate the crazy world he left behind.

Title: Jungle Fever
Hint: A married Black architect has an affair with his Italian-American temp.
Description: A successful and married black man contemplates having an affair with a white girl from work. He's quite rightly worried that the racial difference would make an already taboo relationship even worse.

Title: Paint Your Wagon
Hint: A farmer and a prospector share a wife in a gold rush town, in song.
Description: A Michigan farmer and a prospector form a partnership in the California gold country. Their adventures include buying and sharing a wife, hijacking a stage, kidnapping six prostitutes, and turning their mining camp into a boom town. Along the way there is plenty of drinking, gambling, and singing. They even find time to do some creative gold mining.

Title: Grumpier Old Men
Hint: A family wedding reignites the ancient feud between two old next-door neighbours in Minnesota.
Description: A family wedding reignites the ancient feud between next-door neighbors and fishing buddies John and Max. Meanwhile, a sultry Italian divorcée opens a restaurant at the local bait shop, alarming the locals who worry she'll scare the fish away. But she's less interested in seafood than she is in cooking up a hot time with Max.

Title: Derailed
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two married executives having an affair are blackmailed by a violent criminal.
Description: When two married business executives having an affair are blackmailed by a violent criminal, they are forced to turn the tables on him to save their families.

Title: Vantage Point
Country: United States of America, Mexico, Spain
Hint: An attack on the US president in Spain is seen from eight different perspectives, each revealing more.
Description: During an historic counter-terrorism summit in Spain, the President of the United States is struck down by an assassin's bullet. Eight strangers have a perfect view of the kill, but what did they really see? As the minutes leading up to the fatal shot are replayed through the eyes of each eyewitness, the reality of the assassination takes shape.

Title: The One and Only Ivan
Hint: A gorilla living in a shopping mall circus starts to remember his life in the wild.
Description: A gorilla named ___ who’s living in a suburban shopping mall tries to piece together his past, with the help of other animals, as they hatch a plan to escape from captivity.

Title: Light of My Life
Hint: A father disguises his daughter as a boy to protect her after a plague wiped out most women.
Description: Parent and child journey through the outskirts of society a decade after a pandemic has wiped out half the world's population. As a father struggles to protect his child, their bond—and the character of humanity—is tested.

Title: Ice Station Zebra
Hint: A submarine is sent to the North Pole to recover a Soviet satellite.
Description: A top-secret Soviet spy satellite -- using stolen Western technology -- malfunctions and then goes into a descent that lands it near an isolated Arctic research encampment called ___, belonging to the British, which starts sending out distress signals before falling silent. The atomic submarine Tigerfish, commanded by Cmdr. James Ferraday (Rock Hudson), is dispatched to save them.

Title: The Art of Self-Defense
Hint: A timid accountant joins a karate dojo after being mugged and finds a toxic sensei.
Description: Casey is attacked at random on the street and enlists in a local dojo led by a charismatic and mysterious Sensei in an effort to learn how to defend himself. What he uncovers is a sinister world of fraternity, violence and hypermasculinity and a woman fighting for her place in it.

Title: Romeo Is Bleeding
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A corrupt cop tries to assassinate a beautiful Russian hitwoman and loses everything.
Description: A corrupt cop gets in over his head when he tries to assassinate a beautiful Russian hit-woman.

Title: Thank You for Your Service
Hint: Soldiers returning from Iraq struggle to fit back into family and civilian life.
Description: A group of U.S. soldiers returning from Iraq struggle to integrate back into family and civilian life, while living with the memory of a war that threatens to destroy them long after they've left the battlefield.

Title: Rare Exports: A Christmas Tale
Hint: Excavators in the Finnish mountains unearth the real, terrifying Santa.
Description: Young Pietari lives with his reindeer-herding father in arctic Finland. On the eve of Christmas, a nearby excavation makes a frightening discovery and an evil Santa Claus is unleashed…

Title: A Lot Like Love
Hint: Two strangers keep running into each other over seven years.
Description: On a flight from Los Angeles to New York, Oliver and Emily make a connection, only to decide that they are poorly suited to be together. Over the next seven years, however, they are reunited time and time again, they go from being acquaintances to close friends to... lovers?

Title: Plus One
Hint: Two single friends agree to be each other's date at every wedding all summer.
Description: Longtime single friends, Ben and Alice, agree to be each other's respective ___ at every wedding they're invited to, during a busy summer of wedding fever.

Title: The Aeronauts
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A daredevil balloonist and a meteorologist fly higher than anyone in 1862.
Description: In 1862, daredevil balloon pilot Amelia Wren teams up with pioneering meteorologist James Glaisher to advance human knowledge of the weather and fly higher than anyone in history. While breaking records and advancing scientific discovery, their voyage to the very edge of existence helps the unlikely pair find their place in the world they have left far below them.

Title: The Nutty Professor
Hint: A kind but obese scientist invents a formula that turns him into an obnoxious thin man.
Description: When beautiful Carla Purty joins the university faculty, genetic professor Dr. Sherman Klump grows desperate to whittle his 400-pound frame down to size and win her heart. So, with one swig of his experimental fat-reducing serum, Sherman becomes 'Buddy Love', a fast-talking, pumped-up, plumped down Don Juan.

Title: Scoop
Hint: A crime reporter is accused of a journalist's murder.
Description: Inspired by real events, this fictional dramatization gives an insider account of how the women of Newsnight secured Prince Andrew's infamous interview.

Title: Gigi
Hint: A Parisian girl is groomed to be a courtesan but wants love instead.
Description: A home, a motorcar, servants, the latest fashions: the most eligible and most finicky bachelor in Paris offers them all to ___. But she, who's gone from girlish gawkishness to cultured glamour before our eyes, yearns for that wonderful something money can't buy.

Title: All of Me
Hint: A dying millionaire's soul ends up in half of her lawyer's body.
Description: Just before stubborn millionaire Edwina Cutwater dies, she asks her uptight lawyer, Roger Cobb, to amend her will so that her soul will pass to the young, vibrant Terry Hoskins – but the spiritual transference goes awry. Edwina enters Roger's body instead, forcing him to battle Edwina for control of his own being.

Title: My Blueberry Nights
Hint: A heartbroken woman goes on a road trip across America after a breakup.
Description: Elizabeth has just been through a particularly nasty breakup, and now she's ready to leave her friends and memories behind as she chases her dreams across the country. In order to support herself on her journey, Elizabeth picks up a series of waitress jobs along the way.

Title: The Odd Life of Timothy Green
Hint: A childless couple bury their wishes in a box, and a boy appears.
Description: A childless couple bury a box in their backyard, containing all of their wishes for an infant. Soon, a child is born, though ___ is not all that he appears.

Title: The Business
Hint: A young man escapes South London to work for a drug smuggler in Spain.
Description: During the '80s, a young man named Frankie dreams of escaping London's South East region, and his mother's thug of a boyfriend gives him just the opportunity. After beating up the abusive beau, Frankie runs off to Spain, where he lands a job delivering a package to the dapper Playboy Charlie, a gangster who takes him under his wing.

Title: The Door in the Floor
Hint: A writer's young assistant becomes involved with his grieving wife.
Description: A writer's young assistant becomes both pawn and catalyst in his boss's disintegrating household.

Title: Above the Rim
Hint: A promising high school basketball star is torn between his coach and a drug dealer.
Description: Story of a promising high school basketball star and his relationships with two brothers, one a drug dealer and the other a former basketball star fallen on hard times and now employed as a security guard.

Title: Wish I Was Here
Hint: A struggling actor homeschools his kids after his father's illness.
Description: Aidan Bloom, a struggling actor, father and husband, is 35 years old and still trying to find a purpose for his life. He and his wife are barely getting by financially and Aidan passes his time by fantasizing about being the great futuristic Space-Knight he'd always dreamed he'd be as a little kid.

Title: The Greatest Show on Earth
Hint: A circus manager keeps the big top going through romance, rivalries and a train wreck.
Description: To ensure a full profitable season, circus manager Brad Braden engages The Great Sebastian, though this moves his girlfriend Holly from her hard-won center trapeze spot. Holly and Sebastian begin a dangerous one-upmanship duel in the ring, while he pursues her on the ground.

Title: The Immigrant
Hint: A Polish woman arriving in 1921 New York is tricked into prostitution by a charming man.
Description: 1921 New York. An ___ woman is tricked into a life of burlesque and vaudeville until a dazzling magician tries to save her and reunite her with her sister who is being held in the confines of Ellis Island.

Title: Shaft
Hint: A cool Black private eye is hired to find a crime lord's kidnapped daughter.
Description: Cool Black private eye John ___ is hired by a crime lord to find and retrieve his kidnapped daughter.

Title: Dark Blue
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A corrupt LAPD detective faces his sins during the Rodney King riots.
Description: Set during the Rodney King riots, a robbery homicide investigation triggers a series of events that will cause a corrupt LAPD officer to question his tactics.

Title: The Beaver
Country: United Arab Emirates, United States of America
Hint: A depressed toy executive starts communicating through a hand puppet.
Description: Suffering from a severe case of depression, toy company CEO Walter Black begins using a ___ hand puppet to help him open up to his family. With his father seemingly going insane, adolescent son Porter pushes for his parents to get a divorce.

Title: When the Game Stands Tall
Hint: A coach turns around a losing high school football program.
Description: A young coach turns a losing high school football program around to go undefeated for 12 consecutive seasons.

Title: The Villainess
Hint: A woman trained as an assassin since childhood seeks revenge.
Description: Honed from childhood into a merciless killing machine by a criminal organization, assassin Sook-hee is recruited with the promise of freedom after ten years of service. However, secrets from her past destroy everything she’s worked for and now she embarks on a roaring rampage of revenge.

Title: Pride and Glory
Hint: A family of NYPD cops uncovers corruption in their own ranks.
Description: A saga centered on the Tierneys, a multi-generational family of New York City Police officers. The family's moral codes are tested when Ray Tierney investigates a case that reveals an incendiary police corruption scandal involving his own brother-in-law. For Ray, the truth is revelatory, a Pandora's Box that threatens to upend not only the Tierney legacy but the entire NYPD.

Title: Soapdish
Hint: A soap opera star's jealous rivals plot to ruin her.
Description: Celeste Talbert is the star of the long-running soap opera "The Sun Also Sets." With the show's ratings down, Celeste's ruthlessly ambitious co-star, Montana Moorehead, and the show's arrogant producer, David Seton Barnes, plot to aggravate her into leaving the show by bringing back her old flame, Jeffrey Anderson, and hiring her beautiful young niece, Lori Craven.

Title: 16 Blocks
Country: Germany, United States of America, United Kingdom, Canada
Hint: A burnt-out cop must escort a witness a few city streets to the courthouse while dirty cops hunt them.
Description: An aging cop is assigned the ordinary task of escorting a fast-talking witness from police custody to a courthouse, but they find themselves running the gauntlet as other forces try to prevent them from getting there.

Title: Celeste & Jesse Forever
Hint: A divorcing couple tries to stay best friends, but one is not over the other.
Description: ___ met in high school and got married young. They laugh at the same jokes and finish each other’s sentences. They are forever linked in their friends’ minds as the perfect couple – she, a high-powered businesswoman and budding novelist; he, a free spirit who keeps things from getting boring. Their only problem is that they have decided to get divorced.

Title: Cracks
Country: France, Ireland, Spain, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Jealousy flares at a girls' boarding school when a new student arrives.
Description: Jealousy flares after the headmistress of an elite boarding school for girls becomes obsessed with a new student.

Title: True Crime
Hint: An alcoholic journalist tries to prove a death row inmate is innocent before his execution.
Description: Boozer, skirt chaser, careless father. You could create your own list of reporter Steve Everett's faults but there's no time. A San Quentin Death Row prisoner is slated to die at midnight – a man Everett has suddenly realized is innocent.

Title: Killer's Kiss
Hint: A washed-up boxer falls for a dancer in New York.
Description: Davey Gordon, a New York City boxer at the end of his career, falls for dancer Gloria Price. However, their budding relationship is interrupted by Gloria's violent boss, Vincent Rapallo, who has eyes for Gloria. The two decide to skip town, but before they can, Vincent and his thugs abduct Gloria, and Davey is forced to search for her among the most squalid corners of the city, with his enemy hiding in the shadows.

Title: The Dead Girl
Hint: The death of a young woman connects five women's lives.
Description: The clues to a young woman's death come together as the lives of seemingly unrelated women begin to intersect.

Title: The Balkan Line
Hint: Russian special forces seize a key airfield in Kosovo after the NATO bombing.
Description: After the NATO bombing of Yugoslavia in 1999, the Yugoslav army pulls out of Kosovo region, leaving Serbian people at the mercy of the Albanian UCK. A small band of soldiers must take over the Slatina airport, and hold it until the Russian peacekeepers arrive.

Title: Experimenter
Hint: A Yale psychologist designs a controversial obedience experiment in the 1960s.
Description: Yale University, 1961. Stanley Milgram designs a psychology experiment that still resonates to this day, in which people think they’re delivering painful electric shocks to an affable stranger strapped into a chair in another room. Despite his pleads for mercy, the majority of subjects don’t stop the experiment, administering what they think is a near-fatal electric shock, simply because they’ve been told to do so.

Title: The Weather Man
Hint: A Chicago weatherman struggles with his career and family.
Description: David Spritz, a Chicago ___, separated from his wife and children, debates whether professional and personal success are mutually exclusive.

Title: Smallfoot
Hint: A yeti discovers that humans actually exist, and his village doesn't believe him.
Description: A bright young yeti finds something he thought didn't exist—a human. News of this “___” throws the simple yeti community into an uproar over what else might be out there in the big world beyond their snowy village.

Title: The Man Who Knew Too Little
Hint: An American is mistaken for a spy in London while thinking he's in an interactive theatre game.
Description: An American gets a ticket for an audience participation game in London, then gets involved in a case of mistaken identity. As an international plot unravels around him, he thinks it's all part of the act.

Title: I Used to Be Famous
Hint: A former boy band star gets a second shot with an autistic drummer.
Description: A former boy band star unexpectedly gets a second shot at success when he forms a bond with a gifted young drummer.

Title: Bad Guy
Hint: A pimp tricks a woman he loves into prostitution.
Description: A pimp enforcer takes revenge on a woman who rejected his advances by tricking her into prostitution, but complications arise.

Title: Dracula: Prince of Darkness
Hint: Two couples on vacation are lured to a sinister castle.
Description: Whilst vacationing in the Carpathian Mountain, two couples stumble across the remains of Count ___ castle. The Count's trusted servant kills one of the men, suspending the body over the Count's ashes so that the blood drips from the corpse and saturates the blackened remains.

Title: A Civil Action
Hint: A cynical lawyer takes on a case about contaminated water.
Description: Jan Schlickmann is a cynical lawyer who goes out to 'get rid of' a case, only to find out it is potentially worth millions. The case becomes his obsession, to the extent that he is willing to give up everything—including his career and his clients' goals—in order to continue the case against all odds.

Title: Torn Curtain
Hint: An American scientist pretends to defect to East Germany to steal a formula.
Description: During the Cold War, an American scientist appears to defect to East Germany as part of a cloak and dagger mission to find the formula for a resin solution—but the plan goes awry when his fiancee, unaware of his motivation, follows him across the border.

Title: Transsiberian
Country: Belgium, Germany, Lithuania, Spain, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A train journey from China to Moscow becomes deadly for an American couple.
Description: A ___ train journey from China to Moscow becomes a thrilling chase of deception and murder when an American couple encounters a mysterious pair of fellow travelers.

Title: Doctor G
Hint: A male medical student is forced to study gynecology.
Description: Uday Gupta, a medical college student wanted to specialise in Orthopaedic, but is stuck in an all-female class of Gynaecology. Will he change his department, or will the department change him?

Title: High Anxiety
Hint: A psychiatrist with a fear of heights works at a sinister institute.
Description: A psychiatrist with intense acrophobia (fear of heights) goes to work for a mental institution run by doctors who appear to be crazier than their patients, and have secrets that they are willing to commit murder to keep.

Title: Hoffa
Hint: The life of a powerful Teamsters union boss and his mob ties.
Description: A portrait of union leader James R. ___, as seen through the eyes of his friend, Bobby Ciaro. The film follows ___ through his countless battles with the RTA and President Roosevelt.

Title: Take the Lead
Hint: A ballroom dancer teaches dance to high school detention students.
Description: A former professional dancer volunteers to teach dance in the New York public school system and, while his background first clashes with his students' tastes, together they create a completely new style of dance. Based on the story of ballroom dancer, Pierre Dulane.

Title: Next Gen
Genres: Animation, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Family, Science Fiction
Country: Canada, China, United States of America
Hint: A lonely, rebellious girl in a high-tech city befriends a top-secret combat robot with memory problems.
Description: A friendship with a top-secret robot turns a lonely girl's life into a thrilling adventure as they take on bullies, evil bots and a scheming madman.

Title: Luther
Hint: An idealistic German monk challenges the corruption of the Catholic Church and sparks the Reformation.
Description: During the early 16th century, idealistic German monk Martin ___, disgusted by the materialism in the church, begins the dialogue that will lead to the Protestant Reformation.

Title: Adulthood
Hint: A young man released from prison learns someone wants revenge.
Description: After serving six years for killing his schoolmate, a young man learns that someone is out for revenge.

Title: Oh, God!
Hint: The Almighty appears to an assistant grocery manager as a kindly old man and asks him to spread the word.
Description: When God appears to an assistant grocery manager as a good natured old man, the Almighty selects him as his messenger for the modern world.

Title: Revenge of the Pink Panther
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The bumbling French inspector fakes his own death to catch his would-be killers.
Description: Chief Inspector Jacques Clouseau is dead. At least that is what the world—and Charles Dreyfus—believe when a dead body is discovered in Clouseau's car after being shot off the road. Naturally, Clouseau knows differently and, taking advantage of not being alive, sets out to discover why an attempt was made on his life.

Title: Something New
Hint: A successful Black executive falls for a white landscaper and her world is shaken.
Description: Kenya McQueen thought she had it all: a successful career, good friends and family. There was just one thing she didn't have under control: her love life. All that changes when she meets sexy, free-spirited Brian Kelly. But when her ideal man arrives on the scene, Kenya must decide between the relationship everyone expects and the romance no one expected.

Title: One Eight Seven
Hint: A teacher in a tough Los Angeles school is threatened by a student gang.
Description: When a Brooklyn high school student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield, Garfield feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but the same student stabs Trevor soon after. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching.

Title: Seraphim Falls
Hint: A colonel pursues a former officer through the snowy mountains after the Civil War.
Description: The Civil War has ended, but Colonel Morsman Carver is on one final mission – to kill Gideon, no matter what it takes. Launched by a gunshot and propelled by rage, the relentless pursuit takes the two men through frigid snow-capped mountains and arid deserts, far from the comforts and codes of civilisation, into the bloodiest recesses of their own souls.

Title: Black Beauty
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A horse tells his life story through many owners in Victorian England.
Description: The fates of horses, and the people who own and command them, are revealed as ___ narrates the circle of his life.

Title: Happy End
Hint: A wealthy family in Calais deals with setbacks while refugees struggle nearby.
Description: A well-to-do French family living in Calais deal with a series of setbacks and crises while paying little attention to the grim conditions in the refugee camps within a few miles of their home.

Title: Animal Factory
Hint: A young man in prison for marijuana is protected by a veteran inmate.
Description: Suburbanite Ron is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison.

Title: Corrina, Corrina
Hint: A housekeeper helps a widower and his mute daughter heal in 1959.
Description: When Manny Singer's wife dies, his young daughter Molly becomes mute and withdrawn. To help cope with looking after Molly, he hires sassy housekeeper ___ Washington, who coaxes Molly out of her shell and shows father and daughter a whole new way of life. Manny and ___ friendship delights Molly and enrages the other townspeople.

Title: Arn: The Knight Templar
Country: Denmark, Finland, Norway, United Kingdom, Sweden, Germany
Hint: A Swedish nobleman's son is sent to the Holy Land to serve as a crusader warrior.
Description: ___, the son of a high-ranking Swedish nobleman is educated in a monastery and sent to the Holy Land as a ___ to do penance for a forbidden love.

Title: Ronal the Barbarian
Hint: A scrawny warrior with low self-esteem must rescue his tribe, in an adult animated parody.
Description: ___ is a young ___ with low self-esteem, the polar opposite of all the muscular barbarians in his village. He's a real wuss.

Title: River of No Return
Hint: A farmer and his son help a saloon singer on a raft down dangerous rapids.
Description: An itinerant farmer and his young son help a heart-of-gold saloon singer search for her estranged husband.

Title: Reservation Road
Hint: Two fathers' lives intersect after a hit-and-run kills one man's son.
Description: Two fathers' lives intersect when one of them is involved in a terrible and sudden hit-and-run car accident that leaves the other's son dead. In response, the two men react in unexpected ways as a reckoning looms in the near future.

Title: First Strike
Genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Crime, Drama, Thriller
Hint: A Hong Kong cop works with Interpol to track a nuclear warhead.
Description: Hong Kong cop Chan Ka-Kui returns, working with Interpol to track down and arrest an illegal weapons dealer. Chan later realizes that things are not as simple as they appear and soon finds himself to be a pawn of an organization posing as Russian intelligence.

Title: Blood: The Last Vampire
Hint: A sword-wielding schoolgirl hunts demons on an American air base in Japan.
Description: In Japan, the ___-hunter Saya, who is a powerful original, is sent by her liaison with the government, David, posed as a teenage student to the Yokota High School on the eve of Halloween to hunt down vampires. Saya asks David to give a new katana to her. Soon she saves the school nurse Makiho Amano from two vampires disguised of classmates and Makiho witnesses her fight against the powerful demon.

Title: Small Time Crooks
Hint: A crook and his wife strike it rich with a cookie business.
Description: A loser of a crook and his wife strike it rich when a botched bank job's cover business becomes a spectacular success.

Title: Confidence
Country: Canada, Germany, United States of America
Hint: A smooth con artist plans to swindle a crime boss to pay back a debt.
Description: What Jake Vig doesn't know just might get him killed. A sharp and polished grifter, Jake has just swindled thousands of dollars from the unsuspecting Lionel Dolby with the help of his crew. It becomes clear that Lionel wasn't just any mark, he was an accountant for eccentric crime boss Winston King.
