Jake and his crew will have to stay one step ahead of both the criminals and the cops to finally settle their debt.

Title: Biloxi Blues
Hint: A Jewish recruit goes through basic training in Mississippi during World War II.
Description: A Jewish teenager sets three goals: lose his virginity, become a writer, and survive World War II.

Title: The Shape of Things
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A quiet, unassuming man is changed dramatically by his new girlfriend, an art student.
Description: Quiet, unassuming Adam is changing in a major way, thanks to his new girlfriend, art student Evelyn. Adam's friends are a little freaked by the transformation.

Title: Cassandra's Dream
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two brothers with money problems agree to commit a murder for their rich uncle.
Description: The tale of two brothers with serious financial woes. When a third party proposes they turn to crime, things go bad and the two become enemies.

Title: Bamboozled
Hint: A TV writer creates a modern minstrel show that becomes a hit.
Description: Frustrated when network brass reject his sitcom idea, producer Pierre Delacroix pitches the worst idea he can think of in an attempt to get fired: a 21st century minstrel show. The network not only airs it, but it becomes a smash hit.

Title: Clay Pigeons
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A small-town man befriends a charming drifter who turns out to be a killer.
Description: ___ is a young man in a small town who witnesses his friend, Earl, kill himself because of the ongoing affair that ___ was having with the man's wife, Amanda. Feeling guilty, ___ now resists the widow when she presses him to continue with the affair. ___ unknowingly befriends a serial killer named Lester Long who murders the widow in an attempt to "help" his "fishing buddy."

Title: Guava Island
Hint: A musician wants to throw a festival on a tropical paradise, defying a ruthless businessman.
Description: Deni Maroon, a musician and dock worker is determined to pull off a music festival against the interests of the local factory owner.

Title: The Cat o' Nine Tails
Hint: A reporter and a blind puzzle-solver uncover a genetic research conspiracy.
Description: A newsman works with a blind puzzle-solver to uncover a deadly conspiracy linked to a genetic research facility.

Title: 5x2
Hint: A French couple's relationship is shown in reverse, from divorce to first meeting.
Description: As young French couple Gilles and Marion officially separate, we see, in reverse order, the milestone moments in their relationship, back to the fateful moment when they meet as acquaintances at an Italian beach resort.

Title: The Best Man Holiday
Hint: A group of college friends reunite for Christmas after 15 years, reigniting old rivalries and romances.
Description: When college friends reunite after 15 years over the Christmas holidays, they discover just how easy it is for long-forgotten rivalries and romances to be reignited.

Title: Sound of My Voice
Hint: A journalist and his girlfriend infiltrate a cult whose leader claims to be from the future.
Description: A journalist and his girlfriend get pulled in while they investigate a cult whose leader claims to be from the future.

Title: Creation
Hint: A grieving scientist struggles to write his theory of evolution.
Description: A psychological, heart-wrenching love story that provides a unique and inside look at Charles Darwin. Torn between faith and science, he struggles to finish his legendary book "On the Origin of the Species," which goes on to become the foundation for evolutionary biology.

Title: 22 Bullets
Hint: A retired mobster is shot 22 times and seeks revenge.
Description: A retired mobster goes on a revenge spree after being left for dead with ___ in his body by his former childhood friend.

Title: Suspect
Hint: A public defender takes the case of a homeless deaf veteran accused of murder, with help from a juror.
Description: When a Supreme Court judge commits suicide and his secretary is found murdered, all fingers point to Carl Anderson, a homeless veteran who's deaf and mute. But when public defender Kathleen Riley is assigned to his case, she begins to believe that Anderson may actually be innocent. Juror Eddie Sanger, a Washington lobbyist, agrees, and together the pair begins their own investigation of events.

Title: That Touch of Mink
Hint: A working woman is splashed by a millionaire's car and falls for him.
Description: Cathy Timberlake is en route to a job interview when a car transporting businessman Philip Shayne covers her in mud. He sends his assistant, Roger, to apologize, but upon meeting Cathy, Roger knows that she would be a suitable match for his boss. Despite their mutual attraction, Cathy and Philip want different things. Philip wants a fling, while Cathy wants a marriage.

Title: A Mighty Heart
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A pregnant journalist searches desperately for her husband, a reporter kidnapped in Pakistan.
Description: Based on Mariane Pearl's account of the terrifying and unforgettable story of her husband, Wall Street Journal reporter Danny Pearl's life and death.

Title: Kissing Jessica Stein
Hint: A Jewish woman in New York answers a personal ad from another woman.
Description: ___, a Jewish copy editor living and working in New York City, is plagued by failed blind dates with men, and decides to answer a newspaper's personal advertisement. The advertisement has been placed by 'lesbian-curious' Helen Cooper, a thirtysomething art gallerist.

Title: Wasabi
Hint: A French cop learns he has a daughter in Japan and must protect her.
Description: Hubert is a French policeman with very sharp methods. After being forced to take 2 months off by his boss, who doesn't share his view on working methods, he goes back to Japan, where he used to work 19 years ago, to settle the probate of his girlfriend who left him shortly after marriage without a trace.

Title: Paranoid Park
Hint: A teen skateboarder is involved in a security guard's death.
Description: A teenage skateboarder becomes suspected of being connected with a security guard who suffered a brutal death in a skate park called "___".

Title: Black or White
Hint: A grieving widower fights his granddaughter's paternal grandmother for custody in a race-charged court battle.
Description: A grieving widower is drawn into a custody battle over his granddaughter, whom he helped raise her entire life.

Title: Rocket Science
Hint: A teen with a stutter joins the debate team to win the heart of its star.
Description: Hal is a 15-year-old high-school student with a minor yet socially alienating (and painful) disability: he stutters uncontrollably. Determined to work through the problem, Hal opts for an extreme route – he joins the school debating team, which sends him on a headfirst plunge into breakneck speech competitions and offers a much-needed boost toward correcting the problem.

Title: Go Goa Gone
Hint: Friends at a beach rave in India encounter zombies.
Description: A rave party off the coast of ___ goes horrifyingly and hilariously wrong when the island is overrun with zombies.

Title: A Midsummer Night's Sex Comedy
Hint: Three couples spend a weekend in the countryside in 1906.
Description: A nutty inventor, his frustrated wife, a philosopher cousin, his much younger fiancée, a randy doctor, and a free-thinking nurse spend a summer weekend in and around a stunning - and possibly magical - country house.

Title: De-Lovely
Hint: The life of a famous songwriter and his marriage, told as a musical.
Description: From Paris to Venice to Broadway to Hollywood, the lives of Cole Porter and his wife, Linda Lee Thomas were never less than glamorous and wildly unconventional. And though Cole's thirst for life strained their marriage, Linda never stopped being his muse, inspiring some of the greatest songs of the twentieth century.

Title: The Englishman Who Went Up a Hill But Came Down a Mountain
Hint: Welsh villagers haul earth up their local peak so map-makers will officially call it a proper summit.
Description: When an English cartographer arrives in Wales to tell the residents of the Welsh village of Ffynnon Garw that their '___' is only a ___, the offended community sets out to remedy the situation.

Title: Fermat's Room
Hint: Four mathematicians are trapped in a shrinking chamber and must solve puzzles to survive.
Description: Four mathematicians are imprisoned in a shrinking room; with the walls closing in, they must try anything to escape this fatal puzzle.

Title: Freeheld
Hint: A detective fights for her pension to go to her partner.
Description: New Jersey car mechanic Stacie Andree and her police detective girlfriend Laurel Hester both battle to secure Hester's pension benefits after she was diagnosed with a terminal illness.

Title: Chaos Theory
Hint: A time management expert's orderly life is thrown into turmoil.
Description: Frank Allen, a professional speaker who lectures on time management has a perfectly ordered and scheduled life, down to the minute. When his wife sets his clock forward 10 minutes as a joke, his day is thrown off. Deciding that his strictly ordered life has done him little good, he begins to make multiple choice index cards, choosing one at random and doing what is written on the card.

Title: Le daim
Hint: A man's obsession with a deerskin jacket leads him to murder.
Description: A man's obsession with owning the designer deerskin jacket of his dreams leads him to turn his back on his humdrum life in the suburbs, blow his life savings, and even turn him to crime.

Title: Louder Than Bombs
Country: Norway, United States of America, France, Denmark
Hint: A family deals with the death of a war photographer.
Description: Three years after his wife, acclaimed photographer Isabelle Reed, dies in a car crash, Gene keeps everyday life going with his shy teenage son, Conrad. A planned exhibition of Isabelle’s photographs prompts Gene's older son, Jonah, to return to the house he grew up in - and for the first time in a very long time, the father and the two brothers are living under the same roof.

Title: Dhoom
Hint: A gang of slick motorcycle-riding thieves robs banks across Mumbai, and a cop and a mechanic chase them.
Description: A gang of bikers headed by the cool-headed and arrogant Kabir is on a robbing spree in Mumbai. ACP Jai Dixit is put in charge of the case and he recruits a bumbling bike mechanic and racer to help Jai nab them.

Title: Moonlight Mile
Hint: A young man stays with his late fiancée's parents after her death.
Description: As he copes with the death of his fiancee along with her parents, a young man must figure out what he wants out of life.

Title: The Eye
Hint: A blind violinist gets a cornea transplant and sees ghosts.
Description: A blind concert violinist gets a cornea transplant allowing her to see again. However, she gets more than she bargained for when she realizes her new ___ can see ghosts. She sets out to find the origins of the cornea and discover the fate of its former host.

Title: Factotum
Country: Norway, Germany, United States of America
Hint: A boozy, aspiring writer drifts between menial jobs, women and horse races in a grim American city.
Description: This drama centers on Hank Chinaski, the fictional alter-ego of "___" author Charles Bukowski, who wanders around Los Angeles, CA trying to live off jobs which don't interfere with his primary interest, which is writing. Along the way, he fends off the distractions offered by women, drinking and gambling.

Title: Little Man Tate
Hint: A working-class single mother struggles to raise her seven-year-old son, a sensitive child genius.
Description: Dede is a sole parent trying to bring up her son Fred. When it is discovered that Fred is a genius, she is determined to ensure that Fred has all the opportunities that he needs, and that he is not taken advantage of by people who forget that his extremely powerful intellect is harboured in the body and emotions of a child.

Title: Small Town Crime
Hint: A disgraced, alcoholic ex-cop investigates a young woman's murder to redeem himself, in a darkly funny thriller.
Description: Mike Kendall, a disgraced ex-cop, is fighting a losing battle with the bottle. When he finds a woman left for dead at the side of a road, Kendall turns private eye to track down her killers, taking one last shot at redemption.

Title: Day of the Falcon
Hint: Two warring Arab leaders face off over oil in the 1930s.
Description: On the Arabian Peninsula in the 1930s, two warring leaders come face to face. The victorious Nesib, Emir of Hobeika, lays down his peace terms to rival Amar, Sultan of Salmaah. The two men agree that neither can lay claim to the area of no man’s land between them called The Yellow Belt. In return, Nesib adopts Amar’s two boys Saleeh and Auda as a guarantee against invasion.

Title: Last Chance Harvey
Hint: A jingle writer meets a lonely woman in London.
Description: In London for his daughter's wedding, a struggling jingle-writer, ___ Shine, misses his plane to New York, and thus loses his job. While drowning his sorrows in the airport pub, ___ meets Kate, a British government worker stuck in an endless cycle of work, phone calls from her mother, and blind dates. A connection forms between the unhappy pair, who soon find themselves falling in love.

Title: Hello, My Name Is Doris
Hint: A shy sixty-something office worker pursues a much younger coworker after a self-help seminar.
Description: A self-help seminar inspires a sixty-something woman to romantically pursue her younger co-worker.

Title: Bhagam Bhag
Hint: Two bumbling theatre directors search Goa for their missing lead actress and stumble into a murder.
Description: After their lead actress quits their drama troupe; Bunty, Babla and their boss Champak search for a new heroine in London where they have just arrived, and get embroiled in a murder case involving a mysterious woman.

Title: Antim: The Final Truth
Hint: A farmer's son is forced to leave his village and becomes a gangster.
Description: A farmer's son is forced to leave the village and move to the city, where he soon becomes a dreaded gangster and crosses paths with a fearless cop determined to eliminate criminals.

Title: Rob-B-Hood
Hint: A gambler and a thief kidnap a baby for ransom.
Description: For never-do-well compulsive gambler Fong, there's only one thing more fearsome than debtors at his doorstep - having to coax a crying baby. But what if the baby becomes his golden goose to fend off his debtors? Can he overcome his phobia of diapers, milk bottles, and cloying lullabies?

Title: Five Minutes of Heaven
Hint: A killer and his victim's brother meet decades later.
Description: The story of former Ulster Volunteer Force member Alistair Little. Twenty-five years after Little killed Joe Griffin's brother, the media arrange an auspicious meeting between the two.

Title: Shrink
Hint: A celebrity psychiatrist turns to drugs after a tragedy.
Description: Unable to cope with a recent personal tragedy, LA's top celebrity ___ turns into a pothead with no concern for his appearance and a creeping sense of his inability to help his patients.

Title: What Doesn't Kill You
Hint: Two childhood friends turn to crime in South Boston.
Description: Two childhood friends from South Boston turn to crime as a way to get by, ultimately causing a strain in their personal lives and their friendship.

Title: Paper Lives
Hint: An ailing waste worker takes in a young boy in Istanbul.
Description: In the streets of Istanbul, ailing waste warehouse worker Mehmet takes a small boy under his wing and must soon confront his own traumatic childhood.

Title: Battle in Seattle
Hint: Activists protest the World Trade Organization in a Pacific Northwest city.
Description: Thousands of activists arrive in ___, Washington in masses to protest the WTO Ministerial Conference of 1999 (World Trade Organization). Although it began as a peaceful protest with a goal of stopping the WTO talks, it escalated into a full-scale riot and eventually, a State of Emergency that pitted protesters against the ___ Police Department and the National Guard.

Title: Clockwise
Hint: A painfully punctual headmaster's journey to a conference goes disastrously, hilariously wrong.
Description: School headmaster Brian Stimpson is obsessed with timeliness, order, and discipline. Brian misses his train after meticulously preparing a speech for an education conference. With no one else to turn to, he asks young former student Laura Wisely for a ride.

Title: King of California
Hint: A mentally ill father searches for treasure under a Costco.
Description: Charlie gets released from an insane asylum and moves in with Miranda, the young daughter he left behind. Charlie believes that there is treasure hidden beneath the local Costco, so he puts together a plan to unearth the loot. By convincing Miranda to quit her job at McDonald's and instead work at the wholesale store, he is able to obtain a key.

Title: The Chef
Hint: A veteran cook faces off against his restaurant group's new CEO over molecular gastronomy.
Description: A veteran ___ faces off against his restaurant group's new CEO, who wants the establishment to lose a star from its rating in order to bring in a younger ___ who specializes in molecular gastronomy.

Title: The Boss of It All
Hint: An IT company owner hires an actor to play a fake company president.
Description: The owner of an Information Technology firm wants to sell his business for profit. The trouble is that when he started his firm he invented a nonexistent company president to hide behind when unpopular steps needed to be taken. When potential purchasers insist on negotiating with the "Boss" face to face the owner has to hire a failed actor to play the part.

Title: Quo vado?
Hint: A man fights to keep his secure government job.
Description: Checco is 39 and lived his entire life with his parents. He loves his job where he does nothing the whole day, until something happens that will change his behavior and his life forever...

Title: Aitraaz
Hint: A married man is falsely accused of harassment by his ex.
Description: Raj, a married man, is falsely accused of rape by his ex-girlfriend who is also his employer's wife. He decides to sue her for sexual harassment despite societal pressures.

Title: Howl
Hint: A poem is put on trial for obscenity in 1957.
Description: It's San Francisco in 1957, and an American masterpiece is put on trial. ___, the film, recounts this dark moment using three interwoven threads: the tumultuous life events that led a young Allen Ginsberg to find his true voice as an artist, society's reaction (the obscenity trial), and mind-expanding animation that echoes the startling originality of the poem itself.

Title: Suicide Room
Hint: A teen retreats into an online chat group after humiliation.
Description: Moody, dark and handsome Dominik is terrorized at school after video footage of his drunken kiss with classmate Aleksandr goes viral. Grappling with public humiliation, Dominik seeks solace in an avatar based '___' where the pink-haired rebel Sylwia consoles him.

Title: Please Give
Hint: A Manhattan couple who resell dead people's furniture wait for their elderly neighbour to die so they can expand.
Description: In New York City, a husband and wife butt heads with the granddaughters of the elderly woman who lives in the apartment the couple owns.

Title: Sherrybaby
Hint: A former drug addict fresh out of prison tries to reconnect with her young daughter.
Description: After serving time in prison, former drug addict Sherry Swanson returns home to reclaim her young daughter from family members who have been raising the child. Sherry's family, especially her sister-in-law, doubt Sherry's ability to be a good mother, and Sherry finds her resolve to stay clean slowly weakening.

Title: Welcome to the South
Hint: A northern Italian postmaster who fakes a disability to get a transfer is sent to a small town near Naples.
Description: Alberto, post office manager of a small town in Brianza, under pressure of his wife Sylvia, is willing to do anything to get the transfer to Milan. Even pretending to be disabled to climb in the ranking. But the trick does not work and as punishment, he is transferred in a small town in Campania, which to an inhabitant of the north is equivalent to a nightmare ...

Title: The Big Kahuna
Hint: Three salesmen wait to meet a client in a hotel suite.
Description: Three salesmen working for a firm that makes industrial lubricants are waiting in the company's "hospitality suite" at a manufacturers' convention for a "___" named Dick Fuller to show up, in hopes they can persuade him to place an order that could salvage the company's flagging sales.

Title: The Trip to Italy
Hint: Two comedians take a food tour of the Mediterranean coast.
Description: Years after their successful restaurant review tour of Northern England, Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon are commissioned for a new tour in ___.

Title: Flu
Hint: A deadly strain of bird virus spreads rapidly through a Korean city, and the government seals it off.
Description: A case of the ___ quickly morphs into a pandemic. As the death toll mounts and the living panic, the government plans extreme measures to contain it.

Title: A Home at the End of the World
Hint: Two childhood friends and a free-spirited woman form an unconventional household in 1980s New York.
Description: Three friends form a bond over the year, Johnathan is gay, Clare is straight and Bobby is neither, instead he loves the people he loves. As their lives go on there is tension and tears which culminate in a strong yet fragile friendship between the three.

Title: The Dirty Picture
Hint: A village girl becomes a sensual South Indian film star in the 1980s, then falls from grace.
Description: After running away from home in search of movie stardom, a village girl rises to become a prominent sex symbol.

Title: Delicacy
Hint: A grieving Parisian widow is unexpectedly courted by a shy, awkward Swedish coworker.
Description: A French woman mourning over the death of her husband three years prior is courted by a Swedish co-worker.

Title: Renaissance
Hint: A cop searches for a missing scientist in a futuristic, stark black-and-white animated Paris.
Description: To find Ilona and unlock the secrets of her disappearance, Karas must plunge deep into the parallel worlds of corporate espionage, organized crime and genetic research - where the truth imprisons whoever finds it first and miracles can be bought but at a great price.

Title: Asterix the Gaul
Hint: A small Gaulish village resists the Romans with a magic potion.
Description: In the year 50 BC, ___ is occupied by the Romans - nearly. But the small village of ___ and his friends still resists the Roman legions with the aid of their druid's magic potion, which gives superhuman strength. Learning of this potion, a Roman centurion kidnaps the druid to get the secret formula out of him.

Title: Yashoda
Hint: A woman becomes a surrogate to save her sister.
Description: Looking to save her sister, ___, a desperate woman agrees to be a surrogate and move in to a plush facility - but nothing is as it seems. In the world outside Eva, a Hollywood starlet dies under mysterious circumstances, so do a tycoon and a super model. An unknown drug seem to hold the key to the whole mystery.

Title: Kumiko, The Treasure Hunter
Hint: A Tokyo office worker searches for buried money from a movie.
Description: Frustrated with her mundane life, a Tokyo office worker becomes obsessed with a fictional movie that she mistakes for a documentary. Fixating on a scene where stolen cash is buried in North Dakota, she travels to America to find it.

Title: Rosewater
Hint: A Canadian-Iranian journalist is detained and interrogated for months in Iran after covering the 2009 election.
Description: In 2009, Iranian Canadian journalist Maziar Bahari was covering Iran's volatile elections for Newsweek. One of the few reporters living in the country with access to US media, he made an appearance on The Daily Show with Jon Stewart, in a taped interview with comedian Jason Jones.

Title: Words and Pictures
Country: Australia, Canada, United States of America
Hint: A washed-up literature teacher and a painter who teaches art wage a war over whether language or images matter more.
Description: An art instructor and an English teacher form a rivalry that ends up with a competition at their school in which students decide whether ___ or ___ are more important.

Title: Driving Lessons
Hint: A shy teen escapes his mother by working for an actress.
Description: A shy teenage boy trying to escape the influence of his domineering mother, has his world changed when he begins to work for a retired actress.

Title: Vivah
Hint: A traditional young woman and her fiancé grow close during their engagement, before tragedy strikes.
Description: Poonam, a traditionally brought-up young woman, is to marry Prem, a groom chosen by her uncle. Poonam and Prem's faith and love are to be tested however, when an accident occurs and Poonam might be scarred for life.

Title: Güneşi Gördüm
Hint: A Kurdish family moves from their village to Istanbul.
Description: In the southeast region of Turkey, the Kurdish family of Altun lives in a small mountainside village plagued by a 25-year war that makes their daily lives a hellish struggle. As the war intensifies, the family is forced to migrate west to the city of Istanbul.

Title: The Grass Harp
Hint: A teenage boy and two elderly cousins live in a treehouse.
Description: Based on the novel by Truman Capote, this often-witty coming-of-age drama looks at a young man growing up with an unusual family in the Deep South in the 1940s. Becoming an orphan in 1935, Collin moves to his dad's cousins Verena and Dolly. Verena is a rich, bossy businesswoman. Dolly, Collin and the maid revolt, moving to a tree house.

Title: Detective Dee: The Mystery of the Phantom Flame
Studio: Huayi Brothers Pictures 浙江华谊兄弟影业
Hint: A disgraced imperial investigator is released from prison to solve mysterious spontaneous combustions in ancient China.
Description: When the future empress Wu Zetian's two courtiers die in a mysterious fire, she gets Di Renjie, a former detective and rebel, released from prison to solve the mystery of the fire.

Title: No Entry
Hint: Two friends' affairs get tangled when a faithful husband's wife suspects him of cheating.
Description: Kishan has always been faithful to his wife, Kaajal, who constantly suspects him of having affairs. Meanwhile, Kishan's friend Prem frequently cheats on his doting wife, Pooja, without getting caught, incurring the disapproval of Kishan and photographer Sunny. Tired of listening to his moralistic pals, Prem introduces Kishan to Bobby, an attractive escort.

Title: 7aum Arivu
Hint: A genetic student tries to revive an ancient warrior's skills.
Description: A genetic engineering student tries to bring back the skills of a legend of the past and use his skills to save India from a deadly virus attack by China.

Title: Eva
Hint: In 2041, a cybernetic engineer returns home to build a robot child and meets a remarkable girl.
Description: In 2041, humans live side-by-side with robots and androids. A well-known cybernetic engineer, Alex Garel, returns to his hometown to create a new model of robot child.

Title: Eyyvah Eyvah 2
Hint: A clarinetist tries to reach his fiancée in Istanbul.
Description: A clarinetist from a village in Turkey's Thracian region tries to reach his fiancé, who works as a nurse in a village near Çanakkale, to give her a ring to win back her heart.

Title: Scream VI
Hint: Survivors of the Woodsboro murders move to New York.
Description: Following the latest Ghostface killings, the four survivors leave Woodsboro behind and start a fresh chapter.

Title: Smile
Hint: A therapist is haunted by a grinning entity after a patient's death.
Description: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic incident involving a patient, Dr. Rose Cotter starts experiencing frightening occurrences that she can't explain.

Title: Gerald's Game
Hint: A woman is handcuffed to a bed after her husband dies.
Description: When her husband's sex game goes wrong, Jessie (who is handcuffed to a bed in a remote lake house) faces warped visions, dark secrets and a dire choice.

Title: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
Hint: Jedi discover a slave boy strong in the Force.
Description: Anakin Skywalker, a young slave strong with the Force, is discovered on Tatooine. Meanwhile, the evil Sith have returned, enacting their plot for revenge against the Jedi.

Title: Idiocracy
Hint: An average man wakes up in a future of idiots.
Description: To test its top-secret Human Hibernation Project, the Pentagon picks the most average European-Americans it can find - an Army private and a prostitute - and sends them to the year 2505 after a series of freak events. But when they arrive, they find a civilization so dumbed-down that they're the smartest people around.

Title: The Gray Man
Hint: A CIA operative is hunted by a former colleague.
Description: When a shadowy CIA agent uncovers damning agency secrets, he's hunted across the globe by a sociopathic rogue operative who's put a bounty on his head.

Title: Fire in the Sky
Hint: A logger disappears and claims he was abducted by aliens.
Description: After clearing brush for the government, a group of men return to town claiming their friend was abducted. Despite no apparent motive or evidence of foul play, no-one believes their story and his disappearance is treated as murder.

Title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales
Hint: A legendary drunken pirate captain is pursued by deadly ghost sailors led by an old enemy.
Description: Thrust into an all-new adventure, a down-on-his-luck Capt. Jack Sparrow feels the winds of ill-fortune blowing even more strongly when deadly ghost sailors led by his old nemesis, the evil Capt. Salazar, escape from the Devil's Triangle.

Title: It Chapter Two
Hint: The Losers Club returns to Derry to face the clown.
Description: 27 years after overcoming the malevolent supernatural entity Pennywise, the former members of the Losers' Club, who have grown up and moved away from Derry, are brought back together by a devastating phone call.

Title: Pretty Baby
Hint: A 12-year-old girl is raised in a New Orleans brothel.
Description: In 1917 New Orleans, a 12-year-old girl is raised in a brothel by her prostitute mother.

Title: The Day After Tomorrow
Hint: Climate change triggers a sudden new ice age, and a climatologist treks to a frozen New York to save his son.
Description: After paleoclimatologist Jack Hall is largely ignored by UN officials when presenting his environmental concerns about the beginning of a new Ice Age, his research proves true when a superstorm develops, setting off catastrophic natural disasters throughout the world.

Title: Plane
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A pilot lands on a war-torn island and must protect his passengers.
Description: After a heroic job of successfully landing his storm-damaged aircraft in a war zone, a fearless pilot finds himself between the agendas of multiple militias planning to take the ___ and its passengers hostage.

Title: Mamma Mia!
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A bride-to-be on a Greek island secretly invites three of her mother's ex-lovers to find her father, in a pop musical.
Description: A spirited young bride-to-be living with her single mother on a small Greek island secretly invites three of her mother's ex-boyfriends in hope of finding her biological father to walk her down the aisle.

Title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
Hint: Two iconic superheroes, the caped billionaire and the alien from Krypton, clash over the threat each poses.
Description: Fearing the actions of a god-like Super Hero left unchecked, Gotham City’s own formidable, forceful vigilante takes on Metropolis’s most revered, modern-day savior, while the world wrestles with what sort of hero it really needs. And with ___ at war with one another, a new threat quickly arises, putting mankind in greater danger than it’s ever known before.

Title: Twister
Hint: A team of storm chasers tracks deadly tornadoes across Oklahoma to test a new research device.
Description: An unprecedented series of violent tornadoes is sweeping across Oklahoma. Tornado chasers, headed by Dr. Jo Harding, attempt to release a groundbreaking device that will allow them to track them and create a more advanced warning system. They are joined by Jo's soon to be ex-husband Bill, a former tornado chaser himself, and his girlfriend Melissa.

Title: Red Eye
Hint: A hotel manager on an overnight flight discovers the charming man beside her is an assassin who needs her help.
Description: An overnight flight to Miami quickly becomes a battle for survival when Lisa realizes her seatmate plans to use her as part of a chilling assassination plot against the Deputy Secretary of Homeland Security. If she refuses to cooperate, her own father will be killed. As the miles tick by, she's in a race against time to find a way to warn the potential victims before it's too late.

Title: The Witches of Eastwick
Hint: Three bored small-town women unwittingly summon a charming devil who seduces them all.
Description: Three single women in a picturesque village have their wishes granted, at a cost, when a mysterious and flamboyant man arrives in their lives.

Title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
Hint: A brawny federal agent and a rogue British assassin team up against a cyber-enhanced villain.
Description: Ever since US Diplomatic Security Service Agent ___ and lawless outcast ___ first faced off, they just have traded smack talk and body blows. But when cyber-genetically enhanced anarchist Brixton's ruthless actions threaten the future of humanity, they join forces to defeat him.

Title: Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
Hint: Neon-noir tales of revenge, lust and a femme fatale in a corrupt, rain-soaked city.
Description: Some of ___ most hard-boiled citizens cross paths with a few of its more reviled inhabitants.

Title: Sonic the Hedgehog 2
Hint: A speedy blue alien teams up with a flying two-tailed fox to stop a mad doctor and a red echidna.
Description: After settling in Green Hills, ___ is eager to prove he has what it takes to be a true hero. His test comes when Dr. Robotnik returns, this time with a new partner, Knuckles, in search for an emerald that has the power to destroy civilizations. ___ teams up with his own sidekick, Tails, and together they embark on a globe-trotting journey to find the emerald before it falls into the wrong hands.

Title: Annabelle: Creation
Hint: An orphan girl is possessed by a demon inside a creepy porcelain doll.
Description: Several years after the tragic death of their little girl, a doll maker and his wife welcome a nun and several girls from a shuttered orphanage into their home, soon becoming the target of the doll maker's possessed ___—___.

Title: Spontaneous
Hint: High school seniors start spontaneously exploding, and two teens fall in love anyway.
Description: When students in their high school begin inexplicably exploding (literally), seniors Mara and Dylan struggle to survive in a world where each moment may be their last.

Title: The Exorcist III
Hint: A police lieutenant investigates murders that echo a serial killer executed fifteen years ago.
Description: On the fifteenth anniversary of the exorcism that claimed Father Damien Karras' life, Police Lieutenant Kinderman's world is once again shattered when a boy is found decapitated and savagely crucified.

Title: Pet Sematary
Hint: A family discovers a burial ground in the woods that brings the dead back wrong.
Description: After the Creed family's cat is accidentally killed, a friendly neighbor advises its burial in a mysterious nearby cemetery.

Title: The Blair Witch Project
Hint: Three film students vanish in the Maryland woods while making a documentary about a local legend.
Description: In October of 1994 three student filmmakers disappeared in the woods near Burkittsville, Maryland, while shooting a documentary. A year later their footage was found.

Title: Fast & Furious
Hint: Two old enemies, a fugitive street racer and an FBI agent, team up to take down a drug lord.
Description: When a crime brings them back to L.A., fugitive ex-con Dom Toretto reignites his feud with agent Brian O'Conner. But as they are forced to confront a shared enemy, Dom and Brian must give in to an uncertain new trust if they hope to outmaneuver him. And the two men will find the best way to get revenge: push the limits of what's possible behind the wheel.

Title: Antichrist
Country: Denmark, France, Germany, Italy, Poland, Sweden
Hint: A grieving couple retreat to a cabin in the woods, where grief turns into violence and horror.
Description: A grieving couple retreats to their cabin 'Eden' in the woods, hoping to repair their broken hearts and troubled marriage. But nature takes its course and things go from bad to worse.

Title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
Country: United States of America, Mexico, Netherlands Antilles
Hint: A Vietnam veteran is sent back to rescue American POWs.
Description: John ___ is released from prison by the government for a top-secret covert mission to the last place on Earth he'd want to return - the jungles of Vietnam.

Title: See How They Run
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A weary inspector and an eager constable investigate a murder at a West End theatre in 1953.
Description: In the West End of 1950s London, plans for a movie version of a smash-hit play come to an abrupt halt after a pivotal member of the crew is murdered. When world-weary Inspector Stoppard and eager rookie Constable Stalker take on the case, the two find themselves thrown into a puzzling whodunit within the glamorously sordid theater underground, investigating the mysterious homicide at their own peril.

Title: Sonic the Hedgehog
Hint: A speedy blue alien teams up with a small-town sheriff to escape a mad scientist.
Description: Powered with incredible speed, ___ embraces his new home on Earth. That is, until ___ sparks the attention of super-uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik. Now it’s super-villain vs. super-___ in an all-out race across the globe to stop Robotnik from using ___ unique power for world domination.

Title: Varsity Blues
Hint: A backup quarterback in small-town Texas takes over and clashes with his tyrannical coach.
Description: In small-town Texas, high school football is a religion, 17-year-old schoolboys carry the hopes of an entire community onto the gridiron every Friday night. When star quarterback Lance Harbor suffers an injury, the Coyotes are forced to regroup under the questionable leadership of John Moxon, a second-string quarterback with a slightly irreverent approach to the game.

Title: Don Jon
Hint: A New Jersey ladies' man addicted to porn learns about real intimacy.
Description: A New Jersey guy dedicated to his family, friends, and church, develops unrealistic expectations from watching porn and works to find happiness and intimacy with his potential true love.

Title: War of the Worlds
Hint: A dockworker flees with his kids as alien tripods rise from the ground.
Description: Ray Ferrier is a divorced dockworker and less-than-perfect father. Soon after his ex-wife and her new husband drop off his teenage son and young daughter for a rare weekend visit, a strange and powerful lightning storm touches down.

Title: The Girl on the Train
Hint: A divorced alcoholic commuter becomes entangled in a missing person case she glimpsed from her window seat.
Description: Rachel Watson, devastated by her recent divorce, spends her daily commute fantasizing about the seemingly perfect couple who live in a house that her train passes every day, until one morning she sees something shocking happen there and becomes entangled in the mystery that unfolds.

Title: Pokémon: Detective Pikachu
Hint: A young man teams up with a talking, coffee-loving pocket-monster sleuth to find his missing father.
Description: In a world where people collect pocket-size monsters (___) to do battle, a boy comes across an intelligent monster who seeks to be a detective.

Title: The Program
Hint: An Irish journalist becomes convinced a cycling champion is doping.
Description: An Irish sports journalist becomes convinced that Lance Armstrong's performances during the Tour de France victories are fueled by banned substances. With this conviction, he starts hunting for evidence that will expose Armstrong.

Title: The Last House on the Left
Hint: Escaped convicts torture two girls and seek shelter at one victim's parents' house.
Description: On the eve of her 17th birthday, Mari and friend Phyllis set off from her family home to attend a rock concert in the city. Attempting to score some drugs on the way, the pair run afoul of a group of vicious crooks, headed up by the sadistic Krug.

Title: Zoolander
Hint: A dim-witted male model is brainwashed to assassinate a prime minister.
Description: Clear the runway for Derek ___, VH1's three-time male model of the year. His face falls when hippie-chic Hansel scooters in to steal this year's award. The evil fashion guru Mugatu seizes the opportunity to turn Derek into a killing machine. It's a well-designed conspiracy and only with the help of Hansel and a few well-chosen accessories like Matilda can Derek make the world safe for male models everywhere.

Title: Ad Astra
Country: Brazil, China, United States of America
Hint: An astronaut searches the solar system for his father, whose experiments threaten Earth.
Description: The near future, a time when both hope and hardships drive humanity to look to the stars and beyond. While a mysterious phenomenon menaces to destroy life on planet Earth, astronaut Roy McBride undertakes a mission across the immensity of space and its many perils to uncover the truth about a lost expedition that decades before boldly faced emptiness and silence in search of the unknown.

Title: Under the Silver Lake
Hint: A young slacker searches for a missing neighbour in Los Angeles and uncovers a conspiracy.
Description: Young and disenchanted Sam meets a mysterious and beautiful woman who's swimming in his building's pool one night. When she suddenly vanishes the next morning, Sam embarks on a surreal quest across Los Angeles to decode the secret behind her disappearance, leading him into the murkiest depths of mystery, scandal and conspiracy.

Title: Boston Strangler
Hint: Two female reporters break the story of a serial killer terrorizing 1960s Massachusetts.
Description: Reporters Loretta McLaughlin and Jean Cole bravely pursue the story of the ___ at great personal risk, putting their own lives on the line in their quest to uncover the truth.

Title: Crimson Peak
Hint: A young American author is haunted at her new husband's crumbling English mansion.
Description: In the aftermath of a family tragedy, an aspiring author is torn between love for her childhood friend and the temptation of a mysterious outsider. Trying to escape the ghosts of her past, she is swept away to a house that breathes, bleeds… and remembers.

Title: Sex Drive
Hint: A high school senior road-trips across the country to hook up with an online girl.
Description: A high school senior drives cross-country with his best friends to hook up with a babe he met online.

Title: Night at the Museum
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A divorced dad takes a security job and discovers the exhibits come alive after dark.
Description: Chaos reigns at the natural history ___ when night watchman Larry Daley accidentally stirs up an ancient curse, awakening Attila the Hun, an army of gladiators, a Tyrannosaurus rex and other exhibits.

Title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
Hint: The rebel girl leads the final assault on the Capitol.
Description: As the war between the Capitol and the districts reaches its peak, Katniss Everdeen embarks on a perilous mission to liberate Panem and confront President Snow. Joined by a team of trusted allies, she navigates deadly traps, shifting loyalties, and the heavy cost of rebellion, determined to bring freedom to her people and end the ___ once and for all.

Title: Double Jeopardy
Hint: A woman wrongly convicted of killing her husband discovers he's alive.
Description: Libby Parsons, wrongly convicted of her husband Nick's murder, thinks he is still alive. She survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman.

Title: Silent Hill
Hint: A mother takes her daughter to a fog-shrouded ghost town that the girl keeps dreaming about.
Description: Rose, a desperate mother, takes her adopted daughter, Sharon, to the town of ___ in an attempt to cure her of her ailment. After a violent car crash, Sharon disappears, and Rose embarks on a horrific journey to get her back and begins to uncover the truth behind the apocalyptic disaster that burned the town 30 years earlier.

Title: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A wizard criminal escapes and gathers followers in Paris.
Description: Gellert ___ has escaped imprisonment and has begun gathering followers to his cause—elevating wizards above all non-magical beings. The only one capable of putting a stop to him is the wizard he once called his closest friend, Albus Dumbledore.

Title: Marie Antoinette
Country: Japan, United States of America, France
Hint: A teenage Austrian princess becomes queen of France and lives in extravagance.
Description: A retelling of the story of France’s iconic but ill-fated queen, ___ - from her betrothal and marriage to Louis XVI at fifteen to her reign as queen at nineteen and ultimately the fall of Versailles.

Title: Road Trip
Hint: College friends drive across America to retrieve a compromising videotape mailed to a girlfriend.
Description: After a student at the University of Ithaca films his one-night stand with a beautiful sorority girl, he discovers one of his friends has accidentally mailed the homemade sex tape to his girlfriend in Austin. In a frenzy, he must borrow a car and hit the road in a desperate bid to intercept the tape.

Title: Mandy
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A lumberjack seeks revenge on a cult that killed his girlfriend.
Description: The Shadow Mountains, 1983. Red and ___ lead a loving and peaceful existence; but when their pine-scented haven is savagely destroyed, Red is catapulted into a phantasmagoric journey filled with bloody vengeance and laced with fire.

Title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
Hint: A bored married couple discovers they are both secret assassins.
Description: A husband and wife struggle to keep their marriage alive until they realize they are both secretly working as assassins. Now, their respective assignments require them to kill each other.

Title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
Hint: Four best friends share a pair of magic jeans over one summer apart.
Description: Four best friends (Tibby, Lena, Carmen & Bridget) who buy a mysterious pair of ___ that fits each of them, despite their differing sizes, and makes whoever wears them feel fabulous. When faced with the prospect of spending their first summer apart, the pals decide they'll swap the ___ so that each girl in turn can enjoy the magic.

Title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
Hint: The clawed mutant's origin story and his feud with his brother.
Description: After seeking to live a normal life after 200 years, Logan sets out to avenge a death by undergoing the mutant Weapon X program and becoming ___.

Title: Homefront
Hint: A retired DEA agent protects his daughter from a vengeful meth dealer in a small town.
Description: Phil Broker, a retired DEA agent, leads a quiet life with his daughter Maddy, until a school bullying incident draws them into a conflict with Morgan “Gator” Bodine, a local crime boss.

Title: The Man in the Iron Mask
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Three aging musketeers try to replace a cruel king with his masked twin brother.
Description: Years have passed since the Three Musketeers, Aramis, Athos and Porthos, have fought together with their friend, D'Artagnan. But with the tyrannical King Louis using his power to wreak havoc in the kingdom while his twin brother, Philippe, remains imprisoned, the Musketeers reunite to abduct Louis and replace him with Philippe.

Title: Ocean's Twelve
Hint: A team of thieves pull off heists across Europe to repay a casino owner.
Description: Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history and splitting the $160 million take, each of the infamous ___ crew have tried to go straight, lay low and live a legit life... but that's proven to be a challenge. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Danny ___ return the money, plus millions more in interest.

Title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
Hint: A team travels to a second island to study dinosaurs.
Description: Four years after ___ genetically bred dinosaurs ran amok, multimillionaire John Hammond shocks chaos theorist Ian Malcolm by revealing that he has been breeding more beasties at a secret location. Malcolm, his paleontologist ladylove and a wildlife videographer join an expedition to document the lethal lizards' natural behavior in this action-packed thriller.

Title: Three Amigos!
Hint: A trio of unemployed silent film actors are mistaken for real heroes by a Mexican village.
Description: A trio of unemployed silent film actors are mistaken for real heroes by a small Mexican village in search of someone to stop a malevolent bandit.

Title: Friends with Benefits
Hint: Two pals try to add sex to their relationship without feelings.
Description: Dylan is done with relationships. Jamie decides to stop buying into the Hollywood clichés of true love. When the two become friends they decide to try something new and take advantage of their mutual attraction - but without any emotional attachment.

Title: The Perfect Storm
Hint: A swordfishing boat is caught in a massive "once in a century" weather system in the North Atlantic.
Description: In October 1991, a confluence of weather conditions combined to form a killer ___ in the North Atlantic. Caught in the ___ was the sword-fishing boat Andrea Gail.

Title: The Hangover Part II
Hint: Three friends wake up in Bangkok with no memory, after a pre-wedding night out.
Description: The ___ crew heads to Thailand for Stu's wedding. After the disaster of a bachelor party in Las Vegas last year, Stu is playing it safe with a mellow pre-wedding brunch. However, nothing goes as planned and Bangkok is the perfect setting for another adventure with the rowdy group.

Title: Blended
Hint: Two single parents get stuck on a family vacation in Africa together.
Description: Recently divorced mom Lauren and widowed dad Jim let their friends push them into a blind date, which goes disastrously wrong. Unsurprisingly, neither wants to see the other ever again. However, fate intervenes when both Jim and Lauren, unbeknownst to each other, purchase one-half of the same vacation package at a South African resort for families, during spring break.

Title: Blood & Gold
Hint: A German soldier searches for his daughter at the end of World War II.
Description: At the end of World War II, a German soldier is looking for his daughter while an SS troop is looking for a Jewish treasure.

Title: Oculus
Hint: A woman tries to prove a haunted mirror killed her parents years ago.
Description: A woman tries to exonerate her brother's murder conviction by proving that the crime was committed by a supernatural phenomenon.

Title: Halloween II
Hint: The masked killer follows his survivor to the hospital.
Description: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis, Michael Myers has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

Title: Step Up
Hint: A delinquent and a ballet dancer team up for a performance.
Description: Delinquent Tyler Gage receives the opportunity of a lifetime after vandalizing a performing arts school, gaining him the chance to earn a scholarship and dance with up-and-coming dancer Nora.

Title: Can't Hardly Wait
Hint: High school graduates party all night at a house bash, where a guy plans to confess his love.
Description: It's graduation day at Huntington Hills High, and you know what that means - time to party. And not just any party, either. This one will be a night to remember, as the nerds become studs, the jocks are humiliated, and freshman crushes blossom into grown-up romance.

Title: Triple Frontier
Hint: Former special forces operatives plan a heist in South America.
Description: Struggling to make ends meet, former special ops soldiers reunite for a high-stakes heist: stealing $75 million from a South American drug lord.

Title: Wet Hot American Summer
Hint: Camp counselors on the last day of camp in 1981 try to hook up.
Description: The setting is Camp Firewood, the year 1981. It's the last day before everyone goes back to the real world, but there's still a summer's worth of unfinished business to resolve. At the center of the action is camp director Beth, who struggles to keep order while she falls in love with the local astrophysics professor.

Title: The Rocketeer
Hint: A 1930s stunt pilot finds a prototype jetpack and must keep it from Nazis.
Description: A stunt pilot comes across a prototype jetpack that gives him the ability to fly. However, evil forces of the world also want this jetpack at any cost.

Title: Insidious: Chapter 2
Hint: A family is haunted by a spirit that follows them home.
Description: The haunted Lambert family seeks to uncover the mysterious childhood secret that has left them dangerously connected to the spirit world.

Title: The Final Girls
Hint: A grieving young woman is trapped inside her mother's horror film.
Description: A young woman grieving the loss of her mother, a famous scream queen from the 1980s, finds herself pulled into the world of her mom's most famous movie. Reunited, the women must fight off the film's maniacal killer.

Title: Mona Lisa Smile
Hint: An art history teacher challenges students at a conservative women's college.
Description: Katherine Watson is a recent UCLA graduate hired to teach art history at the prestigious all-female Wellesley College, in 1953. Determined to confront the outdated mores of society and the institution that embraces them, Katherine inspires her traditional students, including Betty and Joan, to challenge the lives they are expected to lead.

Title: The Clovehitch Killer
Hint: A teenager suspects his beloved church-going father is a notorious murderer in their small town.
Description: A picture-perfect family is torn apart after Tyler finds a cache of disturbing images in his father's possession. He begins to suspect that the man he trusts most in the world may be responsible for the murder of 13 women ten years prior.

Title: The Secret Life of Pets
Hint: A terrier's life is upended when his owner adopts a giant mutt.
Description: The quiet life of a terrier named Max is upended when his owner takes in Duke, a stray whom Max instantly dislikes.

Title: The Choice
Hint: A carefree North Carolina veterinarian falls for his new neighbour, and then a tragedy tests their love.
Description: Travis and Gabby first meet as neighbors in a small coastal town and wind up in a relationship that is tested by life's most defining events.

Title: The Night House
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A widow discovers her husband's secrets in their lake house.
Description: Reeling from the unexpected death of her husband, Beth is left alone in the lakeside home he built for her. Soon she begins to uncover her recently deceased husband's disturbing secrets.

Title: The Quick and the Dead
Hint: A female gunslinger enters a deadly fast-draw contest in a frontier town.
Description: A mysterious woman comes to compete in a ___-draw elimination tournament, in a town taken over by a notorious gunman.

Title: Confess, Fletch
Hint: A charming reporter becomes the prime suspect in a murder.
Description: The roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome ___ becomes the prime suspect in a murder case while searching for a stolen art collection. The only way to prove his innocence? Find out which of the long list of suspects is the culprit - from the eccentric art dealer and a missing playboy to a crazy neighbor and ___ Italian girlfriend. Crime, in fact, has never been this disorganized.

Title: Titane
Hint: A woman with a titanium plate in her head has a disturbing relationship with cars.
Description: A woman with a metal plate in her head from a childhood car accident embarks on a bizarre journey, bringing her into contact with a firefighter who's reunited with his missing son after 10 years.

Title: Possessor
Country: Australia, Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A corporate assassin uses brain implants to take over people's bodies.
Description: Tasya Vos, an elite corporate assassin, uses brain-implant technology to take control of other people’s bodies to terminate high profile targets. As she sinks deeper into her latest assignment, Vos becomes trapped inside a mind that threatens to obliterate her.

Title: Awake
Hint: A patient wakes up during heart surgery and overhears a murder plot.
Description: While undergoing heart surgery, a man experiences a phenomenon called ‘anesthetic awareness’, which leaves him ___ but paralyzed throughout the operation. As various obstacles present themselves, his wife must make life-altering decisions while wrestling with her own personal drama.

Title: Cry-Baby
Hint: A prim schoolgirl falls for a juvenile delinquent in 1950s Baltimore, in a musical.
Description: A prim and proper schoolgirl goes against her society grandmother's wishes when she dates a motorcycle-riding juvenile delinquent.

Title: Flash Gordon
Country: Italy, Netherlands, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A football player travels to the planet Mongo and fights a tyrant.
Description: A football player and his mates travel to the planet Mongo and find themselves fighting the tyranny of Ming the Merciless to save Earth.

Title: Gone in 60 Seconds
Hint: A former car thief must steal 50 cars in one night to save his brother.
Description: Ex-car thief Randall Raines is forced out of retirement to save his brother Kip after a boost gone wrong. With the help of allies old and new, they race to meet the demands of notorious crime boss Raymond Calitri as the police are in hot pursuit.

Title: It's Complicated
Hint: A divorced woman has an affair with her ex-husband.
Description: Ten years after their divorce, Jane and Jake Adler unite for their son's college graduation and unexpectedly end up sleeping together. But Jake is married, and Jane is embarking on a new romance with her architect. Now, she has to sort out her life—just when she thought she had it all figured out.

Title: Sister Act
Hint: A lounge singer who witnessed a murder hides from the mob in a convent and leads the choir.
Description: When lively lounge singer Deloris sees her mobster beau commit murder, she is relocated for her protection. Set up in the guise of a nun in a California convent, she proceeds to upend the quiet lives of the resident sisters.

Title: Kick-Ass 2
Country: Japan, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A teen superhero joins a team of vigilantes and faces a new villain.
Description: After ___’ insane bravery inspires a new wave of self-made masked crusaders, he joins a patrol led by the Colonel Stars and Stripes. When these amateur superheroes are hunted down by Red Mist — reborn as The Mother Fucker — only the blade-wielding Hit-Girl can prevent their annihilation.

Title: Arachnophobia
Hint: A deadly spider from South America terrorizes a small town.
Description: A large spider from the jungles of South America is accidentally transported in a crate with a dead body to America where it mates with a local spider. Soon after, the residents of a small California town disappear as the result of spider bites from the deadly spider offspring. It's up to a couple of doctors with the help of an insect exterminator to annihilate these eight legged freaks.

Title: Zack and Miri Make a Porno
Hint: Two broke roommates decide to shoot an adult film to pay the bills.
Description: Lifelong platonic friends ___ look to solve their respective cash-flow problems by making an adult film together. As the cameras roll, however, the duo begin to sense that they may have more feelings for each other than they previously thought.

Title: Minions: The Rise of Gru
Genres: Comedy, Crime, Science Fiction, Animation, Family
Hint: A young villain teams up with his yellow henchmen to join a supervillain group.
Description: A fanboy of a supervillain supergroup known as the Vicious 6, ___ hatches a plan to become evil enough to join them, with the backup of his followers, the ___.

Title: Slither
Hint: An alien parasite turns a small town's residents into zombies.
Description: A small town is taken over by an alien plague, turning residents into zombies and all forms of mutant monsters.

Title: Dog
Hint: An army ranger and a grieving Belgian Malinois go on a road trip down the coast to a funeral.
Description: An army ranger and his ___ embark on a road trip along the Pacific Coast Highway to attend a friend's funeral.

Title: Bad Boys for Life
Hint: Two Miami detectives take on a cartel seeking revenge.
Description: Marcus and Mike are forced to confront new threats, career changes, and midlife crises as they join the newly created elite team AMMO of the Miami police department to take down the ruthless Armando Armas, the vicious leader of a Miami drug cartel.

Title: Terrified
Hint: Researchers of the paranormal investigate strange events in a Buenos Aires neighborhood.
Description: Police commissioner Funes and three researchers of supernatural phenomena investigate inexplicable events that are occurring in the suburbs of Buenos Aires.

Title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
Hint: Four siblings return to the magical land to help an exiled ruler.
Description: One year after their incredible adventures in the Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe, Peter, Edmund, Lucy and Susan Pevensie return to ___ to aid a young prince whose life has been threatened by the evil King Miraz.

Title: Terminator Salvation
Hint: A rebel leader fights the machines in a post-apocalyptic future and meets a mysterious man.
Description: All grown up in post-apocalyptic 2018, John Connor must lead the resistance of humans against the increasingly dominating militaristic robots. But when Marcus Wright appears, his existence confuses the mission as Connor tries to determine whether Wright has come from the future or the past -- and whether he's friend or foe.

Title: 12 Strong
Hint: Green Berets ride on horseback against the Taliban after 9/11.
Description: A team of special forces head into Afghanistan in the aftermath of the September 11th attacks in an attempt to dismantle the Taliban.

Title: Space Jam
Genres: Family, Animation, Science Fiction, Fantasy, Comedy
Hint: A basketball legend helps cartoon characters win a game against aliens.
Description: With their freedom on the line, the Looney Tunes seek the help of NBA superstar Michael Jordan to win a basketball game against a team of moronic aliens.

Title: Last Action Hero
Hint: A boy enters the world of his favourite movie tough guy through a magic cinema ticket.
Description: After his father's death, a young boy finds solace in action movies featuring an indestructible cop. Given a magic ticket by a theater manager, he is transported into the film and teams up with the cop to stop a villain who escapes into the real world.

Title: Just One of the Guys
Hint: A high school girl disguises herself as a boy to prove her writing is good.
Description: When Terry Griffith loses her high school's writing competition, she's convinced that it's because she's a girl. So Terry decides to change high schools and pose as a boy to prove her point. Her brother, Buddy, helps her pass as a guy so well that she is soon making friends with the boys at school, including the attractive Rick, who becomes her new best friend.

Title: Olympus Has Fallen
Hint: A disgraced Secret Service agent rescues the President from terrorists.
Description: When the White House (Secret Service Code: "___") is captured by a terrorist mastermind and the President is kidnapped, disgraced former Presidential guard Mike Banning finds himself trapped within the building. As the national security team scrambles to respond, they are forced to rely on Banning's inside knowledge to help retake the White House, save the President and avert an even bigger disaster.

Title: Home
Genres: Fantasy, Comedy, Animation, Science Fiction, Family
Hint: A bumbling alien befriends a girl searching for her mother.
Description: When Earth is taken over by the overly-confident Boov, an alien race in search of a new place to call ___, all humans are promptly relocated, while all Boov get busy reorganizing the planet. But when one resourceful girl, Tip, manages to avoid capture, she finds herself the accidental accomplice of a banished Boov named Oh.

Title: The Mighty Ducks
Hint: A reckless lawyer is sentenced to coach a peewee hockey team.
Description: After reckless young lawyer Gordon Bombay gets arrested for drunk driving, he must coach a kids hockey team for his community service. Gordon has experience on the ice, but isn't eager to return to hockey, a point hit home by his tense dealings with his own former coach, Jack Reilly.

Title: Entourage
Hint: A movie star and his posse of buddies navigate Hollywood as he directs his first film.
Description: Movie star Vincent Chase, together with his boys, Eric, Turtle and Johnny, are back…and back in business with super agent-turned-studio head Ari Gold. Some of their ambitions have changed, but the bond between them remains strong as they navigate the capricious and often cutthroat world of Hollywood.

Title: Under Siege
Hint: A Navy cook with a secret past fights terrorists who have taken over a battleship.
Description: A disgruntled ex-CIA operative, his assistant and their assembled group of terrorists seize a battleship with nuclear blackmail in mind. They've planned for every contingency but ignore the ship's cook, former Navy SEAL Casey Ryback—an error that could be fatal.

Title: Cliffhanger
Country: France, Italy, United States of America, Japan
Hint: A mountain rescue climber battles thieves in the Rockies.
Description: A year after losing his friend in a tragic 4,000-foot fall, former ranger Gabe Walker and his partner, Hal, are called to return to the same peak to rescue a group of stranded climbers, only to learn the climbers are actually thieving hijackers who are looking for boxes full of money.

Title: Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga
Hint: Two Icelandic singers compete in a glittery European music competition.
Description: Two small-town singers chase their pop star dreams at a global music competition, where high stakes, scheming rivals and onstage mishaps test their bond.

Title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
Hint: Kids who move into a run-down mansion discover a hidden world of faeries.
Description: Upon moving into the run-down ___ Estate with their mother, twin brothers Jared and Simon Grace, along with their sister Mallory, find themselves pulled into an alternate world full of faeries and other creatures.

Title: Never Back Down
Hint: A troubled teen in Orlando joins an underground fight club to take on the school's bully.
Description: Jake, full of anger after his father's death, is just starting to find a place for himself at his new Orlando high school - until Ryan, head of an underground MMA fight club, picks Jake out as a prime opponent. After being trounced by Ryan in front of the entire school, Jake begins training under the firm, moral guidance of a MMA master, where he learns how to fight... and how to avoid a fight.

Title: Swordfish
Hint: A convicted hacker is recruited by a charismatic criminal for an elaborate bank heist.
Description: Rogue agent Gabriel Shear is determined to get his mitts on $9 billion stashed in a secret Drug Enforcement Administration account. He wants the cash to fight terrorism, but lacks the computer skills necessary to hack into the government mainframe. Enter Stanley Jobson, a n'er-do-well encryption expert who can log into anything.

Title: A Rainy Day in New York
Hint: A college couple's weekend in Manhattan goes awry in the rain.
Description: Two young people arrive in New York to spend a weekend, but once they arrive they're met with bad weather and a series of adventures.

Title: My Policeman
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A gay cop marries a teacher in 1950s Brighton, and the secret lasts decades.
Description: In the late 1990s, the arrival of elderly invalid Patrick into Marion and Tom’s home triggers the exploration of seismic events from 40 years previous: the passionate relationship between Tom and Patrick at a time when homosexuality was illegal.

Title: Ammonite
Hint: A paleontologist and a young woman fall in love in 1840s England.
Description: In 1840s England, palaeontologist Mary Anning and a young woman sent by her husband to convalesce by the sea develop an intense relationship. Despite the chasm between their social spheres and personalities, Mary and Charlotte discover they can each offer what the other has been searching for: the realisation that they are not alone.

Title: The Interview
Hint: Two TV journalists are recruited by the CIA to assassinate the leader of North Korea.
Description: Dave Skylark and his producer Aaron Rapaport run the celebrity tabloid show "Skylark Tonight". When they land an ___ with a surprise fan, North Korean dictator Kim Jong-un, they are recruited by the CIA to turn their trip to Pyongyang into an assassination mission.

Title: Elvira: Mistress of the Dark
Hint: A horror TV host inherits a house in a puritanical small town.
Description: Arriving in the small town of Fallwell, Massachusetts to claim her inheritance, horror hostess ___ receives a less than enthusiastic reception from the conservative locals, including her sinister uncle Vincent.

Title: Dutch
Hint: A man drives his girlfriend's snobbish son home for Thanksgiving.
Description: To get to know his girlfriend's son, a man volunteers to pick him up from a prep school... only to learn that her son's not the nicest kid.

Title: The Secret of My Success
Hint: A Kansas kid in New York poses as an executive at his uncle's company.
Description: Brantley Foster, a well-educated kid from Kansas, has always dreamed of making it big in New York, but once in New York, he learns that jobs - and girls - are hard to get. When Brantley visits his uncle, Howard Prescott, who runs a multi-million-dollar company, he is given a job in the company's mail room.

Title: Secret Window
Hint: A writer recovering from a divorce is accused of plagiarism by a menacing stranger.
Description: Mort Rainey, a writer just emerging from a painful divorce with his ex-wife, is stalked at his remote lake house by a psychotic stranger and would-be scribe who claims Rainey swiped his best story idea. But as Rainey endeavors to prove his innocence, he begins to question his own sanity.

Title: The Greatest Story Ever Told
Hint: The life of a Galilean preacher, from his birth in Bethlehem to his crucifixion and resurrection, in an all-star biblical epic.
Description: From his birth in Bethlehem to his death and eventual resurrection, the life of Jesus Christ is given the all-star treatment in this epic retelling.

Title: Host
Hint: Six friends hold a séance over a video call during lockdown.
Description: Six friends hire a medium to hold a séance via Zoom during lockdown — but they get far more than they bargained for as things quickly go wrong. When an evil spirit starts invading their homes, they begin to realise they might not survive the night.

Title: Nightbreed
Hint: A young man is drawn to a mythical place where monsters live.
Description: A troubled young man is drawn to a mythical place called Midian where a variety of friendly monsters are hiding from humanity. Meanwhile, a sadistic serial killer is looking for a patsy.

Title: Tag
Hint: Grown friends play a decades-long game of chase every May.
Description: For one month every year, five highly competitive friends hit the ground running in a no-holds-barred game of ___ they’ve been playing since the first grade. This year, the game coincides with the wedding of their only undefeated player, which should finally make him an easy target. But he knows they’re coming...and he’s ready.

Title: Air Force One
Hint: Terrorists hijack the US president's plane, and he fights back from inside the aircraft to save his family and crew.
Description: When Russian neo-nationalists hijack ___, the world's most secure and extraordinary aircraft, the President is faced with a nearly impossible decision to give in to terrorist demands or sacrifice not only the country's dignity, but the lives of his wife and daughter.

Title: His House
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A refugee couple from South Sudan is haunted in their new British home.
Description: After making a harrowing escape from war-torn South Sudan, a young refugee couple struggle to adjust to their new life in a small English town that has an unspeakable evil lurking beneath the surface.

Title: Father Stu
Hint: A boxer becomes a Catholic priest despite a crippling illness.
Description: The true-life story of boxer-turned-priest. When an injury ends his amateur boxing career, Stuart Long moves to Los Angeles to find money and fame. While scraping by as a supermarket clerk, he meets Carmen, a Sunday school teacher who seems immune to his bad-boy charm. Determined to win her over, the longtime agnostic starts going to church to impress her.

Title: Tomorrow Never Dies
Hint: A British secret agent battles a deranged media mogul who is staging international incidents to start a war for ratings.
Description: A deranged media mogul is staging international incidents to pit the world's superpowers against each other. Now James Bond must take on this evil mastermind in an adrenaline-charged battle to end his reign of terror and prevent global pandemonium.

Title: FernGully: The Last Rainforest
Hint: A tiny sprite in a magical Australian jungle shrinks a young logger to her size, and he joins her fight against a toxic pollution spirit.
Description: When a sprite named Crysta shrinks a human boy, Zak, down to her size, he vows to help the magical fairy folk stop a greedy logging company from destroying their home: the pristine ___ known as ___. Zak and his new friends fight to defend ___ from lumberjacks — and the vengeful spirit they accidentally unleash after chopping down a magic tree.

Title: Armageddon Time
Hint: A Jewish boy in 1980 Queens befriends a Black classmate.
Description: In 1980, Queens, New York, a young Jewish boy befriends a rebellious African-American classmate to the disapproval of his privileged family and begins to reckon with growing up in a world of inequality and prejudice.

Title: The Howling
Hint: A news anchor goes to a retreat full of werewolves.
Description: After a bizarre and near fatal encounter with a serial killer, a newswoman is sent to a rehabilitation center whose inhabitants may not be what they seem.

Title: The Skeleton Key
Hint: A hospice nurse uncovers hoodoo rituals in a Louisiana house.
Description: A hospice nurse working at a spooky New Orleans plantation home finds herself entangled in a mystery involving the house's dark past.

Title: Stealing Beauty
Country: Italy, United Kingdom, France, United States of America
Hint: An American teen visits a Tuscan villa to find her real father.
Description: Lucy Harmon, an American teenager is arriving in the lush Tuscan countryside to be sculpted by a family friend who lives in a beautiful villa. Lucy visited there four years earlier and exchanged a kiss with an Italian boy with whom she hopes to become reacquainted.

Title: Nerve
Country: Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: A high school student joins an online game of escalating dares.
Description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico has had it with living life on the sidelines. When pressured by friends to join the popular online game ___, Vee decides to sign up for just one dare in what seems like harmless fun.

Title: The Endless
Hint: Two brothers return to the UFO cult they fled.
Description: Two brothers return to the cult they fled from years ago to discover that the group's beliefs may be more sane than they once thought.

Title: The Crazies
Hint: The military tries to contain a virus that drives a town mad.
Description: The military attempts to contain a manmade virus causing death and permanent insanity in those infected, as it overtakes a small Pennsylvania town.

Title: Hounds of Love
Hint: A girl is abducted by a sadistic couple in Perth.
Description: When Vicki Maloney is randomly abducted from a suburban street by a disturbed couple, she soon observes the dynamic between her captors and quickly realises she must drive a wedge between them if she is to survive.

Title: Peppermint
Hint: A mother seeks revenge on the cartel that killed her family.
Description: A grieving mother transforms herself into a vigilante following the murders of her husband and daughter, eluding the authorities to deliver her own personal brand of justice.

Title: Morning Glory
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A TV producer tries to save a struggling daybreak news program.
Description: A young and devoted ___ television producer is hired as an executive producer on a long-running ___ show at a once-prominent but currently failing station in New York City. Eager to keep the show on air, she recruits a former news journalist and anchor who disapproves of co-hosting a show that does not deal with real news stories.

Title: Get Smart
Hint: A bumbling analyst gets his wish to become a field agent and teams up with a capable female spy to stop a crime syndicate.
Description: When members of the nefarious crime syndicate KAOS attack the U.S. spy agency Control and the identities of secret agents are compromised, the Chief has to promote hapless but eager analyst Maxwell ___ to field agent. He is partnered with veteran and capable Agent 99, the only spy whose cover remains intact. Can they work together to thwart the evil world-domination plans of KAOS and its crafty operative?

Title: Wonderland
Hint: The investigation of a notorious quadruple homicide in 1981 Los Angeles.
Description: On the afternoon of July 1, 1981, Los Angeles police responded to a distress call on ___ Avenue and discovered a grisly quadruple homicide.
