The police investigation that followed uncovered two versions of the events leading up to the brutal murders - both involving legendary porn actor John Holmes.

Title: Society
Hint: A Beverly Hills teen suspects his rich family belongs to a grotesque cult.
Description: Bill Whitney is worried that he is different to his sister and parents. They mix with other upper-class people while Bill is more down to earth. Even his girlfriend seems a bit odd. All is revealed when Bill returns home to find a party in full swing.

Title: Cruising
Hint: An undercover cop hunts a killer in New York's gay leather scene.
Description: When New York is caught in the grip of a sadistic serial killer who preys on patrons of the city's underground bars, rookie cop Steve Burns infiltrates the S&M subculture to try and lure him out of the shadows.

Title: Out of Time
Hint: A small-town Florida police chief races to cover up his involvement in a double murder he's investigating.
Description: Matt Lee Whitlock, respected chief of police in small Banyan Key, Florida, must solve a vicious double homicide before he himself falls under suspicion. Matt Lee has to stay a few steps ahead of his own police force and everyone he's trusted in order to find out the truth.

Title: Naked Gun 33 1/3: The Final Insult
Hint: A bumbling police lieutenant comes out of retirement to go undercover in prison and stop a bombing at the Oscars.
Description: Frank Drebin is persuaded out of retirement to go undercover in a state prison. There he has to find out what top terrorist, Rocco, has planned for when he escapes. Adding to his problems, Frank's wife, Jane, is desperate for a baby.

Title: Hoodwinked!
Hint: Police investigate a fairy tale crime from four perspectives.
Description: Little Red Riding Hood: A classic story, but there's more to every tale than meets the eye. Before you judge a book by its cover, you've got to flip through the pages. In the re-telling of this classic fable, the story begins at the end of the tale and winds its way back.

Title: Where the Buffalo Roam
Hint: A drug-fuelled gonzo journalist's chaotic adventures with his radical lawyer friend across 1970s America.
Description: Semi-biographical film based on the experiences of gonzo journalist Hunter S. Thompson.

Title: Set It Up
Hint: Two overworked assistants play matchmaker for their demanding bosses to get some free time.
Description: Two overworked and underpaid assistants come up with a plan to get their bosses off their backs by setting them up with each other.

Title: Beverly Hills Cop II
Hint: A Detroit detective returns to the posh California city to stop a gang of robbers.
Description: Axel Foley returns to the land of sunshine and palm trees to investigate the near-fatal shooting of police Captain Andrew Bogomil. With the help of Sgt. Taggart and Det. Rosewood, they soon uncover that the shooting is associated with a series of "alphabet" robberies masterminded by a heartless weapons kingpin—and the chase is on.

Title: Dangerous Minds
Hint: A former Marine teaches a class of tough inner-city students in California using poetry and karate.
Description: Former Marine Louanne Johnson lands a gig teaching in a pilot program for bright but underachieving teens at a notorious inner-city high school. After having a terrible first day, she decides she must throw decorum to the wind.

Title: Better Watch Out
Hint: A babysitter must defend a boy from home invaders.
Description: On a quiet suburban street tucked within a 'safe neighborhood', a babysitter must defend a twelve-year-old boy from strangers breaking into the house, only to discover that this is far from a normal home invasion.

Title: Loving Adults
Hint: A wife discovers her husband's affair in Copenhagen and takes drastic measures to keep the family.
Description: The thin line between love and hate turns deadly when a wife discovers her husband’s affair — and they both take extreme measures to get what they want.

Title: Octopussy
Hint: A British secret agent investigates a fellow agent's murder and uncovers a plot involving a Fabergé egg and a circus.
Description: James Bond is sent to investigate after a fellow “00” agent is found dead with a priceless Indian Fabergé egg. Bond follows the mystery and uncovers a smuggling scandal and a Russian General who wants to provoke a new World War.

Title: Ice Age: Continental Drift
Hint: A mammoth, a sloth and a saber-tooth are separated by the breaking up of a continent.
Description: Manny, Diego, and Sid embark upon another adventure after their continent is set adrift. Using an iceberg as a ship, they encounter sea creatures and battle pirates as they explore a new world.

Title: The Medium
Hint: A documentary crew follows a Thai shaman whose niece may be possessed by something far worse than a goddess.
Description: A shaman's family learn that their goddess is supposedly controlling one of them. However, their lives take a frightening turn when they realise the goddess has nothing to do with the possession.

Title: City of Lies
Hint: A disgraced LAPD detective and a journalist try to solve the murder of a famous rapper.
Description: Los Angeles Police Department detective Russell Poole has spent years trying to solve his biggest case -- the murders of The Notorious B.I.G. and Tupac Shakur -- but after two decades, the investigation remains open. Jack Jackson, a reporter desperate to save his reputation and career, is determined to find out why.

Title: Sleeping with Other People
Hint: Two serial cheaters who first slept together in college reunite years later and try to stay platonic.
Description: Can two serial cheaters get a second chance at love? After a one-night stand in college, New Yorkers Lainey and Jake meet by chance twelve years later and discover they each have the same problem: because of their monogamy-challenged ways, neither can maintain a relationship. Determined to stay friends despite their mutual attraction, they make a pact to keep it platonic, a deal that proves easier said than done.

Title: National Treasure: Book of Secrets
Hint: A relic hunter must clear his ancestor's name in Lincoln's assassination.
Description: Benjamin Franklin Gates and Abigail Chase re-team with Riley Poole and, now armed with a stack of long-lost pages from John Wilkes Booth's diary, Ben must follow a clue left there to prove his ancestor's innocence in the assassination of Abraham Lincoln.

Title: Fanboys
Hint: Fans road trip to Skywalker Ranch to steal a print of the new movie.
Description: In 1999, Star Wars fanatics take a cross-country trip to George Lucas' Skywalker Ranch so their dying friend can see a screening of The Phantom Menace before its release.

Title: Where'd You Go, Bernadette
Hint: A girl searches for her mother who disappeared before a trip to Antarctica.
Description: When architect-turned-recluse ___ Fox goes missing prior to a family trip to Antarctica, her 15-year-old daughter, Bee, goes on a quest with ___ husband to find her.

Title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
Hint: A man falls for a butcher who may be a killer.
Description: Just after a bad breakup, Charlie MacKenzie falls for lovely butcher Harriet Michaels and introduces her to his parents. But, as voracious consumers of sensational tabloids, his parents soon come to suspect that Harriet is actually a notorious serial killer -- "Mrs. X" -- wanted in connection with a string of bizarre honeymoon killings. Thinking his parents foolish, Charlie proposes to Harriet.

Title: The International
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An Interpol agent takes on a corrupt global bank that arms dictators.
Description: An interpol agent and an attorney are determined to bring one of the world's most powerful banks to justice. Uncovering money laundering, arms trading, and conspiracy to destabilize world governments, their investigation takes them from Berlin, Milan, New York and Istanbul. Finding themselves in a chase across the globe, their relentless tenacity puts their own lives at risk.

Title: Antz
Hint: A neurotic worker ant falls for a princess and accidentally becomes a hero.
Description: A neurotic worker ant in love with a rebellious princess rises to unlikely stardom when he switches places with a soldier. Signing up to march in a parade, he ends up under the command of a bloodthirsty general. But he's actually been enlisted to fight against a termite army.

Title: Don't Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in the Hood
Hint: A spoof of 1990s urban crime and coming-of-age dramas set in LA's inner city.
Description: When Ashtray moves to South ___ L.A. to live with his father (who appears to be the same age he is) and grandmother (who likes to talk tough and smoke reefer), he falls in with his gang-banging cousin Loc Dog, who along with the requisite pistols and Uzi carries a thermo-nuclear warhead for self-defense. Will Ashtray be able to keep living the straight life?

Title: Black Bear
Hint: A couple entertains a filmmaker at their lake house.
Description: At a remote lake house in the Adirondack Mountains, a couple entertains an out-of-town guest looking for inspiration in her filmmaking. The group quickly falls into a calculated game of desire, manipulation, and jealousy, unaware of how dangerously intertwined their lives will soon become.

Title: A Walk Among the Tombstones
Hint: An unlicensed private eye hunts kidnappers in New York.
Description: Private investigator Matthew Scudder is hired by a drug kingpin to find out who kidnapped and murdered his wife.

Title: Mowgli: Legend of the Jungle
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: A human child raised by wolves, must face off against a menacing tiger named Shere Khan, as well as his own origins.

Title: The Missing

Description: When rancher and single mother of two Maggie Gilkeson sees her teenage daughter, Lily, kidnapped by Apache rebels, she reluctantly accepts the help of her estranged father, Samuel, in tracking down the kidnappers. Along the way, the two must learn to reconcile the past and work together if they are going to have any hope of getting Lily back before she is taken over the border and forced to become a prostitute.

Title: The Santa Clause
Hint: A man accidentally kills Father Christmas and takes his place.
Description: On Christmas Eve, divorced dad Scott Calvin and his son discover ___ Claus has fallen off their roof. When Scott takes the reins of the magical sleigh, he finds he is now the new ___, and must convince a world of disbelievers, including himself.

Title: Underworld: Rise of the Lycans
Hint: The origin of the war between vampires and werewolves.
Description: A prequel to the first two ___ films, this fantasy explains the origins of the feud between the Vampires and the ___. Aided by his secret love, Sonja, courageous Lucian leads the ___ in battle against brutal Vampire king Viktor. Determined to break the king's enslavement of his people, Lucian faces off against the Death Dealer army in a bid for Lycan independence.

Title: Last Christmas

Description: Kate is a young woman who has a habit of making bad decisions, and her last date with disaster occurs after she accepts work as Santa's elf for a department store. However, after she meets Tom there, her life takes a new turn.

Title: Swallow
Hint: A pregnant housewife compulsively eats dangerous objects like marbles and pins.
Description: Hunter, a newly pregnant housewife, finds herself increasingly compelled to consume dangerous objects. As her husband and his family tighten their control over her life, she must confront the dark secret behind her new obsession.

Title: Higher Learning
Hint: College students face racial tension, violence and identity on a Californian campus.
Description: African-American student Malik is on a track scholarship; academics are not his strong suit, and he goes in thinking that his athletic abilities will earn him a free ride through college. Fudge, a "professional student" who has been at Columbus for six years so far, becomes friendly with Malik and challenges his views about race and politics in America.

Title: Pulse

Description: In the immense city of Tokyo, the darkness of the afterlife lures some of its inhabitants desperately trying to escape the sadness and isolation of the modern world.

Title: Oxygen

Description: A woman wakes in a cryogenic chamber with no recollection of how she got there, and must find a way out before running out of air.

Title: A Perfect Getaway

Description: For their honeymoon, newlyweds Cliff and Cydney head to the tropical islands of Hawaii. While journeying through the paradisaical countryside the couple encounters Kale and Cleo, two disgruntled hitchhikers and Nick and Gina, two wild but well-meaning spirits who help guide them through the lush jungles.

Description: The story of Richard Wershe Jr., a teenager who became an undercover informant for the police during the 1980s, and was ultimately arrested for drug trafficking and sentenced to life in prison.

Title: Due Date

Description: Peter Highman must scramble across the US in five days to be present for the birth of his first child. He gets off to a bad start when his wallet and luggage are stolen, and put on the 'no-fly' list. Peter embarks on a terrifying journey when he accepts a ride from an actor.

Title: I Want You Back
Hint: Two dumped strangers plot to win their exes again.
Description: Peter and Emma thought they were on the precipice of life’s biggest moments – marriage, kids, and houses in the suburbs – until their respective partners dumped them. Horrified to learn that the loves of their lives have already moved on, Peter and Emma hatch a hilarious plan to win back their exes with unexpected results.

Title: Life as We Know It
Hint: Two singles who hate each other become guardians of their friends' orphaned baby.
Description: After a disastrous first date for caterer Holly and network sports director Messer, all they have in common is a dislike for each other and their love for their goddaughter Sophie. But when they suddenly become all Sophie has in this world, Holly and Messer must set their differences aside. Juggling careers and social calendars, they'll have to find common ground while living under the same roof.

Title: Fire and Ice
Hint: A young warrior battles a glacier-commanding sorcerer and his mother.
Description: The villainous Nekron and his mother, Queen Juliana, plot against the human race from their frigid fortress. Creating mass destruction with huge glaciers, mother and son incur the wrath of Larn, a warrior whose entire village was destroyed by ___. When Nekron's underlings kidnap the beautiful Princess Teegra, Larn sets out to rescue her, assisted by the fierce and enigmatic Darkwolf.

Title: Oscar
Hint: A gangster promises his dying father to go straight.
Description: Angelo "Snaps" Provolone made his dying father a promise on his deathbed: he would leave the world of crime and become an honest businessman. Despite having no experience in making money in a legal fashion, Snaps sets about to keep his promise.

Title: Diamonds Are Forever

Description: ___ are stolen only to be sold again in the international market. James Bond infiltrates a smuggling mission to find out who's guilty. The mission takes him to Las Vegas where Bond meets his archenemy Blofeld.

Title: Flatliners

Description: Five medical students experiment with "near death" experiences, until the dark consequences of past tragedies begin to jeopardize their lives.

Title: Brewster's Millions

Description: Monty ___, an aging minor-league baseball player, stands to inherit $300 million if he can successfully spend $30 million in 30 days without anything to show for it, and without telling anyone what he's up to... A task that's a lot harder than it sounds!

Title: A Little Chaos

Description: A landscape gardener is hired by famous architect Le Nôtre to construct the grand gardens at the palace of Versailles. As the two work on the palace, they find themselves drawn to each other and are thrown into rivalries within the court of King Louis XIV.

Title: Roman J. Israel, Esq.

Country: United Arab Emirates, United States of America, Canada, China

Description: Hard-nosed liberal lawyer ___ J. ___ has been fighting the good fight forever while others take the credit. When his partner – the firm's frontman – has a heart attack, ___ suddenly takes on that role. He soon discovers some unsettling truths about the firm – truths that conflict with his values of helping the poor and dispossessed – and finds himself in an existential crisis that leads to extreme actions.

Title: The Secret: Dare to Dream

Description: A widow with three children hires a handyman to fix her house during a major storm. When not doing home repairs, he shares his philosophy of believing in the power of the universe to deliver what we want.

Title: The Forbidden Kingdom

Hint: A kung fu-obsessed teen travels back to ancient China.
Description: An American teenager who is obsessed with Hong Kong cinema and kung-fu classics makes an extraordinary discovery in a Chinatown pawnshop: the legendary stick weapon of the Chinese sage and warrior, the Monkey King.

Title: U.S. Marshals
Hint: A US Marshal hunts a fugitive accused of killing federal agents.
Description: U.S. Marshal Sam Gerard is accompanying a plane load of convicts from Chicago to New York. The plane crashes spectacularly, and Mark Sheridan escapes. But when Diplomatic Security Agent John Royce is assigned to help Gerard recapture Sheridan, it becomes clear that Sheridan is more than just another murderer.

Title: Pontypool
Hint: A radio DJ in a small Ontario town reports on a virus spread through the English language.
Description: When disc jockey Grant Mazzy reports to his basement radio station in the Canadian town of ___, he thinks it's just another day at work. But when he hears reports of a virus that turns people into zombies, Mazzy barricades himself in the radio booth and tries to figure out a way to warn his listeners about the virus and its unlikely mode of transmission.

Title: Last Holiday
Hint: A shy saleswoman with a terminal diagnosis spends her savings on a luxury vacation.
Description: The discovery that she has a terminal illness prompts introverted department store saleswoman Georgia Byrd to reflect on what she realizes has been an overly cautious life. With weeks to live, she withdraws her life savings, sells all her possessions and jets off to Europe where she lives it up at a posh hotel. Upbeat and passionate, Georgia charms everybody she meets, including renowned Chef Didier.

Title: The River Wild
Hint: A family whitewater rafting trip is hijacked by criminals.
Description: Gail and Tom Hartman are struggling to stay together and decide to take a white-water rafting holiday adventure in Montana for their son Roarke's 10th birthday, only to meet up with a pair of mysterious men whose desperation grows, turning their vacation into a nightmare.

Title: Mousehunt
Hint: Two brothers try to get rid of a mouse in their inherited house.
Description: Down-on-their luck brothers, Lars and Ernie Smuntz, aren't happy with the crumbling old mansion they inherit... until they discover the estate is worth millions. Before they can cash in, they have to rid the house of its single, stubborn occupant—a tiny and tenacious mouse.

Title: J. Edgar
Hint: The secretive, ruthless lawman who built the FBI and kept files on everyone.
Description: As the face of law enforcement in the United States for almost 50 years, ___ Hoover was feared and admired, reviled and revered. But behind closed doors, he held secrets that would have destroyed his image, his career, and his life.

Title: Hostage
Hint: A former LAPD negotiator must save a family taken by teens while gangsters hold his own family.
Description: When a mafia accountant is taken ___ on his beat, a police officer – wracked by guilt from a prior stint as a negotiator – must negotiate the standoff, even as his own family is held captive by the mob.

Title: 2 Days in the Valley
Hint: A pair of hitmen set off a chain reaction among strangers over 48 hours in Los Angeles' suburbs.
Description: In a sleepy bedroom community of LA's San Fernando ___, the murder of a professional athlete by two hit men sets into motion a chain of events that puts the mundane lives of a dozen residents on a collision course.

Title: The Current War
Hint: Two inventors race to decide whether America will be electrified by DC or AC power.
Description: Electricity titans Thomas Edison and George Westinghouse compete to create a sustainable system and market it to the American people.

Title: I Still Believe
Hint: A young Christian musician marries the love of his life as she battles cancer.
Description: The true-life story of Christian music star Jeremy Camp and his journey of love and loss that looks to prove there is always hope.

Title: Letters to Juliet
Hint: An American finds an old love letter in Verona and helps its writer find her lost love.
Description: An American girl on vacation in Italy finds an unanswered "letter to ___" -- one of thousands of missives left at the fictional lover's Verona courtyard, which are typically answered by the "secretaries of ___" -- and she goes on a quest to find the lovers referenced in the letter.

Title: BASEketball
Hint: Two slackers invent a sport that's a cross between basketball and baseball, and it goes pro.
Description: Two losers from Milwaukee, Coop and Remer, invent a new game combining basketball with the rules of baseball. When the game becomes a huge success, they, along with a billionaire's help, form the Professional ___ League where everyone gets the same pay and no team can change cities. When a rival owner wants to institute major rule changes, Coop and Remer's team is the only one standing in the way.

Title: Executive Decision
Hint: Commandos board a hijacked 747 in midair to stop a nerve-gas attack on Washington.
Description: Terrorists hijack a 747 inbound to Washington D.C., demanding the release of their imprisoned leader. Intelligence expert David Grant suspects another reason and he is soon the reluctant member of a special assault team that is assigned to intercept the plane and hijackers.

Title: Bridget Jones's Baby
Hint: A single Londoner in her forties is pregnant and unsure which of two men is the father.
Description: After breaking up, ___' happily-ever-after hasn't quite gone according to plan. Fortysomething and single again, she decides to focus on her job and surround herself with old friends and new. For once, ___ has everything completely under control. Then her love life takes a turn when she meets Jack.

Title: Being the Ricardos
Hint: A legendary TV couple faces a week of crises that could end their careers.
Description: Lucille Ball and Desi Arnaz face a crisis that could end their careers and another that could end their marriage.

Title: Self/less
Hint: A dying billionaire transfers his mind into a younger body and discovers whose it was.
Description: An extremely wealthy elderly man dying from cancer undergoes a radical medical procedure that transfers his consciousness to the body of a healthy young man but everything may not be as good as it seems when he starts to uncover the mystery of the body's origins and the secret organization that will kill to keep its secrets.

Title: Zola
Hint: A Detroit waitress agrees to a dancing trip to Florida that spirals into chaos.
Description: A waitress agrees to accompany an exotic dancer, her put-upon boyfriend, and her mysterious and domineering roommate on a road trip to Florida to seek their fortune at a high-end strip club.

Title: The Duke of Burgundy
Hint: Two women in a remote villa act out an elaborate dominance ritual involving insects.
Description: Day in and day out, lovers Cynthia and Evelyn enact an elaborate sadomasochistic fantasy as mistress and maid. But as their ritual of domination and submission begins to turn stale, Cynthia yearns for something more conventional, while Evelyn tries to push their taboos even further.

Title: Casanova
Hint: A notorious seducer in 18th-century Venice falls for the one woman who resists him.
Description: With a reputation for seducing members of the opposite sex, regardless of their marital status, a notorious womanizer discovers a beauty who seems impervious to his charms. However, as he continues to pursue the indifferent lady, he finds himself falling in love.

Title: Night Shift
Hint: A timid morgue attendant and his wild coworker start running a call-girl business after hours.
Description: A nebbish of a morgue attendant gets shunted back to the ___ where he is shackled with an obnoxious neophyte partner who dreams of the "one great idea" for success. His life takes a bizarre turn when a prostitute neighbor complains about the loss of her pimp. His partner, upon hearing the situation, suggests that they fill that opening themselves using the morgue at night.

Title: Internal Affairs
Hint: A young officer in the department that polices cops goes after a charismatic, corrupt LAPD officer.
Description: Keen young Raymold Avila joins the ___ Department of the Los Angeles police. He and partner Amy Wallace are soon looking closely at the activities of cop Dennis Peck whose financial holdings start to suggest something shady. Indeed Peck is involved in any number of dubious or downright criminal activities.

Title: The Runaways
Hint: Two rebellious teens form an all-girl rock band in 1970s Los Angeles.
Description: Joan Jett and Cherie Currie, two rebellious teenagers from Southern California, become the frontwomen for The ___ -- the now-legendary group that paved the way for future generations of female rockers. Under the Svengali-like influence of impresario Kim Fowley, the band becomes a huge success.

Title: The Double
Hint: A timid clerk is tormented by a confident doppelgänger who takes over his life.
Description: Igor Uspensky's popularity is growing faster than he can find time for social events, parties, photo shoots, and interacting with the public. At the same time, in one of the small beauty salons, a local masseur named Seva, who looks exactly like Uspensky, is filming a commercial. Igor finds a solution to his problem and offers Seva a partnership.

Title: Byzantium
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America, Belgium
Hint: Two centuries-old vampire women hide out in a decaying English seaside town.
Description: Residents of a coastal town learn, with deadly consequences, the secret shared by the two mysterious women who have sought refuge at a local boarding house, the ___.

Title: Space Cowboys
Hint: Four retired test pilots are sent into orbit to fix an old Soviet satellite.
Description: Frank Corvin, ‘Hawk’ Hawkins, Jerry O'Neill and ‘Tank’ Sullivan were hotdog members of Project Daedalus, the US Air Force's test program for space travel, but their hopes were dashed in 1958 with the formation of NASA and the use of trained chimps. They blackmail their way into orbit when Russia's mysterious ‘Ikon’ communications satellite's orbit begins to degrade and threatens to crash to Earth.

Title: Against the Ice
Hint: Two Danish explorers fight to survive after being left behind in Greenland in 1909.
Description: In 1909, two explorers fight to survive after they're left behind while on a Danish expedition in ___-covered Greenland.

Title: Dumplin'

Description: To prove a point about measuring up and fitting in, Texas teen Willowdean “___’” Dickson enters a local pageant run by her ex-beauty queen mom.

Title: Young Guns II
Hint: Three surviving outlaws ride with a legendary teenage gunslinger as their former friend turned sheriff hunts them.
Description: Three of the original five "young ___" — Billy the Kid, Jose Chavez y Chavez, and Doc Scurlock — return in Young ___, Part 2, which is the story of Billy the Kid and his race to safety in Old Mexico while being trailed by a group of government agents led by Pat Garrett.

Title: Cellular
Hint: A stranger receives a desperate call from a kidnapped woman on his cell phone.
Description: A young man receives an emergency phone call on his cell phone from an older woman. She claims to have been kidnapped – and the kidnappers have targeted her husband and child next.

Title: Ophelia
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A lady-in-waiting falls for a Danish prince, in a retelling of Shakespeare from her perspective.
Description: ___ comes of age as lady-in-waiting for Queen Gertrude, and her singular spirit captures Hamlet's affections. As lust and betrayal threaten the kingdom, ___ finds herself trapped between true love and controlling her own destiny.

Title: Bad Taste

Description: A team from the intergalactic fast food chain Crumb's Crunchy Delights descends on Earth, planning to make human flesh the newest ___ sensation. After they wipe out the New Zealand town Kaihoro, the country’s Astro-Investigation and Defense Service (AIaDS) is called in to deal with the problem.

Description: A mother helps her daughter work through four crucial days of recovery from substance abuse.

Title: Class of 1984

Description: Andy is a new teacher at an inner city high school that is unlike any he has seen before. There are metal detectors at the front door and the place is basically run by a tough kid named Peter Stegman. Soon, Andy and Stegman become enemies and Stegman will stop at nothing to protect his turf and drug dealing business.

Title: Inferno
Hint: A young man investigates his sister's disappearance in her satanic New York apartment building.
Description: A young man returns from Rome to his sister's satanic New York apartment house.

Title: Money Monster
Hint: A TV financial guru is taken hostage on air by a viewer who lost everything.
Description: Financial TV host Lee Gates and his producer Patty are put in an extreme situation when an irate investor takes over their studio.

Title: Music and Lyrics
Hint: A washed-up 80s pop star teams up with his plant waterer to write a hit song.
Description: A washed-up '80s pop star gets a chance at a comeback when reigning pop diva Cora Corman invites him to write & record a duet with her, but there's a problem--Alex hasn't written a song in years; he's never written ___ and he has to come up with a hit in a matter of days.

Title: Only You
Hint: A woman flies to Italy to find the man whose name a Ouija board told her.
Description: Two childhood paranormal incidents have convinced schoolteacher Faith Corvatch that her true love is a guy named 'Damon Bradley', but she has yet to meet him. Preparing to marry podiatrist Dwayne in ten days, Faith receives a phone call from Dwayne's old classmate Damon Bradley, who is on his way to Venice. She impulsively decides to fly to Italy with the hope of finally encountering the man of her dreams.

Title: Lust Stories 2
Hint: Four Indian directors explore sex, desire and love through short tales.
Description: Four eminent Indian directors explore sex, desire and love through short films in this sequel to 2018's Emmy-nominated '___ Stories'.

Title: In Her Shoes
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two very different sisters fall out and reconnect through their long-lost grandmother.
Description: Irresponsible party girl Maggie is kicked out of her father's and stepmother's home—where she lives for free—and is taken in by her hard-working sister, Philadelphia lawyer Rose. After Maggie's disruptive ways ruin her sister's love life, Rose turns her out as well.

Title: Foxy Brown
Hint: A woman goes undercover as a high-class prostitute to avenge her boyfriend.
Description: A voluptuous black woman takes a job as a high-class prostitute in order to get revenge on the mobsters who murdered her boyfriend.

Title: Purple Rain

Description: A victim of his own anger, the Kid is a Minneapolis musician on the rise with his band, the Revolution, escaping a tumultuous home life through music. While trying to avoid making the same mistakes as his truculent father, the Kid navigates the club scene and a rocky relationship with a captivating singer, Apollonia. But another musician, Morris, looks to steal the Kid's spotlight -- and his girl.

Title: Bandits

Description: After escaping from prison, Joe and Terry go on a crime spree, robbing banks through Oregon and California in order to finance their scheme for a new life south of the border. Unfortunately, things get more complicated when they meet Kate, who runs into them with her car. She joins the ___ on their cross-country spree, and eventually she steals something, too: their hearts.

Title: Space Sweepers

Description: When the crew of a space junk collector ship called The Victory discovers a humanoid robot named Dorothy that's known to be a weapon of mass destruction, they get involved in a risky business deal which puts their lives at stake.

Description: Four African-American Vietnam veterans return to Vietnam. They are in search of the remains of their fallen squad leader and the promise of buried treasure. These heroes battle forces of humanity and nature while confronted by the lasting ravages of the immorality of the Vietnam War.

Title: Batman: The Movie

Description: The Dynamic Duo faces four super-villains who plan to hold the world for ransom with the help of a secret invention that instantly dehydrates people.

Description: As the Best ___ Hotel has only a single remaining vacancy - posing a rooming predicament for two fresh arrivals - Sonny pursues his expansionist dream of opening a second hotel.

Description: On Christmas Eve, while driving to see his in-laws with his family, Frank Harrington decides to try a shortcut for the first time in 20 years. It turns out to be the biggest mistake of his life.

Title: Bean

Description: Childlike Englishman, Mr. ___, is an incompetent watchman at the Royal National Gallery. Title: House Party

Description: Young Kid has been invited to a party at his friend Play's house. But after a fight at school, Kid's father grounds him. None the less, Kid sneaks out when his father falls asleep. But Kid doesn't know that three of the thugs at school have decided to give him a lesson in behavior.

Title: Bowfinger

Description: On the verge of bankruptcy and desperate for his big break, aspiring filmmaker Bobby ___ concocts a crazy plan to make his ultimate dream movie. Rallying a ragtag team that includes a starry-eyed ingenue, a has-been diva and a film studio gofer, he sets out to shoot a blockbuster featuring the biggest star in Hollywood, Kit Ramsey -- only without letting Ramsey know he's in the picture.

Title: Magic in the Moonlight
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A master magician in the 1920s tries to expose a psychic medium on the French Riviera.
Description: Set in the 1920s French Riviera, a master magician is commissioned to try and expose a psychic as a fraud.

Title: The Big Easy
Hint: A New Orleans cop falls for an assistant DA investigating police corruption.
Description: Remy McSwain is a New Orleans police lieutenant who investigates the murder of a local mobster. His investigation leads him to suspect that fellow members of the police force may be involved.

Title: Think Like a Man
Hint: Four couples' relationships are upset when the women read a man's dating advice book.
Description: The balance of power in four couples’ relationships is upset when the women start using the advice in Steve Harvey’s book, Act Like A Lady, ___, to get more of what they want from their men. When the men realize that the women have gotten a hold of their relationship “playbook,” they decide that the best defense is a good offense and come up with a plan to use this information to their advantage.

Title: Harold & Kumar Escape from Guantanamo Bay

Description: Having satisfied their urge for White Castle, ___ jump on a plane to catch up with ___ love interest, who's headed for the Netherlands. Rob Corddry also stars in this wild comedy sequel that follows the hapless stoners' misadventures as they try to avoid being captured by the Department of Homeland Security.

Title: Hollywoodland

Description: When Hollywood superstar George Reeves dies in his home, private detective Louis Simo is hired to investigate his death and gets caught in a web of lies involving a big studio executive's wife. Based on a true story.

Title: Dead & Buried

Description: When vigilante land baron David Braxton hangs one of the best friends of cattle rustler Tom Logan, Logan's gang decides to get even by purchasing a small farm next to Braxton's ranch. Description: George, a lonely and fatalistic teen who's made it all the way to his senior year without ever having done a real day of work, is befriended by Sally, a popular but complicated girl who recognizes in him a kindred spirit.

His friends and fiancée send him four white ___ as symbols of what they view as his cowardice. To redeem his honor, he disguises himself as an Arab and secretly saves their lives.

Title: Changing Lanes

Description: Gilda Bessé shares her Paris apartment with an Irish schoolteacher, Guy Malyon, and Mia, a refugee from Spain. Although both are married and Frank has two little kids, they meet more and more often, their friendship becoming the most precious thing in their lives.

Title: Time of the Wolf
Hint: A family flees an unspecified disaster in rural France.
Description: A middle-class family flees an unspecified disaster that has struck the city and takes refuge in their country home. They think this will allow them to escape the chaos, but they soon realize that getting away won’t be so easy.

Title: The Last Circus
Hint: Two clowns fight for the love of a trapeze artist in Franco's Spain.
Description: A trapeze artist must decide between her lust for Sergio, the Happy Clown, or her affection for Javier, the Sad Clown, both of whom are deeply disturbed.

Title: Stretch
Hint: A limo driver has to pay off a debt in one wild night.
Description: A hard-luck limo driver struggling to go straight and pay off a debt to his bookie takes on a job with a crazed passenger whose sought-after ledger implicates some seriously dangerous criminals.

Title: Bulbbul
Hint: A child bride grows up to preside over a mansion haunted by mysterious deaths.
Description: A child bride grows up to be an enigmatic woman presiding over her household, harboring a painful past as supernatural murders of men plague her village.

Title: Big Miracle
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Volunteers try to save gray whales trapped under Alaskan ice.
Description: A small-town news reporter and a Greenpeace volunteer enlist the help of rival superpowers to save three majestic gray whales trapped under the ice of the Arctic Circle.

Title: Dhoom 2
Hint: Cops track an international thief who steals priceless artifacts.
Description: Jai and Ali return, this time on the trail of an international thief who steals priceless artifacts and has chosen Mumbai as his next target.

Title: Instinct
Hint: An anthropologist who lived with gorillas is examined by a psychiatrist.
Description: In a prison for the criminally insane, deranged anthropologist Ethan Powell is set to be examined by a bright young psychiatrist, Theo Caulder. Driven by ambition and a hunger for the truth, Caulder will eventually risk everything—even put his very life on the line—in a harrowing attempt to understand the bizarre actions of this madman.

Title: Hollywood Ending
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A washed-up director goes psychosomatically blind just as he gets the chance to direct a comeback film.
Description: Woody Allen stars as Val Waxman, a two-time Oscar winner turned washed-up, neurotic director in desperate need of a comeback. When it comes, Waxman finds himself backed into a corner: Work for his ex-wife Ellie or forfeit his last shot. Is Val blinded by love when he opts for the reconnect? Is love blind when it comes to Ellie's staunch support? Literally and figuratively, the proof is the picture.

Title: Chalte Chalte
Hint: A man pursues a woman and marries her, but their marriage is tested.
Description: A man pursues a woman who is already engaged and eventually gets married to her. Differences between the two lead to a bitter separation that threatens to destroy their relationship forever.

Title: A Royal Night Out
Hint: Two princesses sneak out of Buckingham Palace to celebrate VE Day in the streets of London.
Description: The re-imagining of VE Day in 1945, when Princess Elizabeth and her sister, Margaret were allowed out from Buckingham Palace for the night to join in the celebrations, and encounter romance and danger.

Title: Emperor
Hint: A US general must decide whether Japan's divine ruler should hang while searching for a lost love.
Description: As the Japanese surrender at the end of WWII, Gen. Fellers is tasked with deciding if ___ Hirohito will be hanged as a war criminal. Influencing his ruling is his quest to find Aya, an exchange student he met years earlier in the U.S.

Title: The Villain
Hint: A cowboy escorting a woman across the West is pursued by an inept outlaw, in a live-action cartoon.
Description: Handsome Stranger has agreed to escort Charming Jones to collect her inheritance from her father. But Avery Simpson wants the money and hires notorious outlaw Cactus Jack to ambush Charming. However, Cactus Jack is not very good at robbing people.

Title: Stuck
Country: Canada, Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A nurse hits a homeless man with her car and leaves him wedged in her windshield in the garage.
Description: A young woman commits a hit-and-run, then finds her fate tied to her victim.

Title: Jingle Jangle: A Christmas Journey
Hint: A toymaker's apprentice steals his inventions, and his granddaughter must help him.
Description: An imaginary world comes to life in a holiday tale of an eccentric toymaker, his adventurous granddaughter, and a magical invention that has the power to change their lives forever.

Title: The Paradine Case
Hint: A barrister falls for his client, a beautiful woman accused of poisoning her husband.
Description: In London, barrister Anthony Keane takes the case of Maddalena ___, a beautiful woman accused of poisoning her blind husband. Though happily married, Keane becomes infatuated with his enigmatic client and convinced of her innocence. His obsession clouds his judgment as he builds a defense implicating her servant, André Latour—an act that leads to devastating consequences both in court and at home.

Title: Jakob the Liar
Country: France, Hungary, United States of America, Germany
Hint: A Jewish shopkeeper in a Polish ghetto invents radio news to give his neighbors hope.
Description: In 1944 Poland, a Jewish shop keeper named ___ is summoned to ghetto headquarters after being caught out after curfew. While waiting for the German Kommondant, ___ overhears a German radio broadcast about Russian troop movements. Returned to the ghetto, the shopkeeper shares his information with a friend and then rumors fly that there is a secret radio within the ghetto.

Title: Atrangi Re
Hint: A runaway girl is forcibly married to an engaged doctor, but she loves a magician.
Description: Runaway Rinku gets forcefully married to already engaged Vishu. Both don't want this marriage and make a deal to go on their separate ways. The equation gets weirder when Rinku's lover Sajjad shows up and Vishu starts developing feelings for her.

Title: Anek
Hint: An undercover agent tries to broker peace amid insurgency in India's northeast.
Description: Amid the turmoil in northeast India, an undercover agent tasked with peace negotiations crosses paths with a tenacious boxer fighting for her dreams.

Title: Dragon Hunters
Hint: Two bumbling knights-for-hire set out with a girl to slay a world-eating beast.
Description: ___ is a fantastic tale telling the adventures of two ___: the world has become a vast conglomerate of islands of varying size and shape. This babbling universe is mainly peopled with ruthless rogues, surly peasants and illiterate, petty lords Their main concerns revolve around two fundamental rules : Eat and don't get eaten.

Title: The Good Thief
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An aging gambler on a losing streak plans to rob a Monte Carlo casino.
Description: An aging gambler on a losing streak attempts to rob a casino in Monte Carlo. But someone's already tipped off the cops before he even makes a move.

Title: Love Is All You Need
Country: Denmark, France, Italy, Japan, Sweden, Germany
Hint: A Danish hairdresser recovering from cancer meets a widower at her daughter's wedding in Italy.
Description: Ida, a Danish hairdresser who has lost her hair to cancer, returns home from the hospital one day to find her husband is cheating on her. She decides to travel to Italy on her own for her daughter's wedding, but discovers on arriving that the wedding gathering will present its own challenges.

Title: December Boys
Hint: Four teenage orphans at an Australian outback orphanage go on a holiday by the sea.
Description: For many years, four teenage orphans at an Australian outback convent have watched their younger comrades find new parents, and realize that they may never be adopted. The Reverend Mother sends the four boys away on a seaside vacation, where they meet Teresa and Fearless, a couple who would make perfect parents. The youths compete with one another to be the one Teresa and Fearless decide to adopt.

Title: 10 Items or Less
Hint: An actor researching a role spends a day with a cashier at a small-town grocery store.
Description: An actor who is considering the role of a supermarket manager arrives at a grocery store on the outskirts of Los Angeles to do some field research. He subsequently becomes stranded, without a car or cell phone, and accepts a ride home with Scarlet, a cashier who is about to interview for a new job. The actor rediscovers the essence of his craft while helping Scarlet gain the confidence she needs to change her life.

Title: Justice League vs. the Fatal Five
Hint: Superheroes face three time-traveling villains from the 31st century.
Description: The Justice ___ faces a powerful new threat — the ___ Five! Superman, Batman and Wonder Woman seek answers as the time-traveling trio of Mano, Persuader and Tharok terrorize Metropolis in search of budding Green Lantern, Jessica Cruz. With her unwilling help, they aim to free remaining ___ Five members Emerald Empress and Validus to carry out their sinister plan.

Title: Battle for Terra
Hint: A peaceful alien planet faces annihilation by humans searching for a new home.
Description: A peaceful alien planet faces annihilation, as the homeless remainder of the human race sets its eyes on ___. Mala, a rebellious Terrian teenager, will do everything she can to stop it.

Title: Spanish Affair
Hint: A man from Seville pretends to be Basque to win over a girl from the north.
Description: Rafael, a Seville citizen who has never left the ___ region of Andalucia, decides to leave his homeland to follow Amaia, a Basque girl unlike other women he has known.

Title: September
Hint: A woman recovering from a suicide attempt spends a tense weekend at her country house.
Description: After a suicide attempt, Lane has moved into her country house to recuperate. Her best friend, Stephanie, has come to join her for the summer. Lane's mother, Diane, has recently arrived with her husband Lloyd, Lane's stepfather. Lane is close to two neighbors: Peter, and Howard. Howard is in love with Lane, Lane is in love with Peter, and Peter is in love with Stephanie.

Title: Kaala
Hint: A strongman protects a Mumbai slum from a ruthless politician's land grab.
Description: Karikaalan consistently fights to keep the people of Dharavi, a slum in Mumbai, safe from the clutches of mighty politicians and the land mafia don, Hari Dhadha.

Title: Terri
Hint: A pajama-wearing teen outcast forms an unlikely friendship with his school's vice principal.
Description: ___, a pajama-clad, disaffected high school student learns how to engage the world with the help of Mr. Fitzgerald, his assistant principal.

Title: Blackthorn
Hint: An aging outlaw living under a false name in Bolivia tries to go home.
Description: In Bolivia, Butch Cassidy (now calling himself James ___) pines for one last sight of home, an adventure that aligns him with a young robber and makes the duo a target for gangs and lawmen alike.

Title: The Powerpuff Girls Movie
Country: United States of America, South Korea
Hint: Three super-powered kindergartners are blamed for wrecking their city with a game.
Description: After destroying the city of Townsville in a game of tag, a trio of superpowered little girls must redeem themselves by stopping a vengeful monkey's plot for world domination.

Title: The Deep End
Hint: A mother covers up a death she thinks her son caused, then is blackmailed.
Description: With her husband Jack perpetually away at work, Margaret Hall raises her children virtually alone. Her teenage son is testing the waters of the adult world, and early one morning she wakes to find the dead body of his gay lover on the beach of their rural lakeside home. What would you do? What is rational and what do you do to protect your child? How far do you go and when do you stop?

Title: The Unknown Girl
Hint: A young doctor searches for the identity of a woman who died after she refused to open her door.
Description: Jenny, a young doctor who feels guilty after a young woman she refused to see winds up dead a few days later, decides to find out who the girl was, after the police can't identify the young woman.

Title: Rabbit Without Ears
Hint: A tabloid reporter is sentenced to community service at a kindergarten.
Description: Rainbow press reporter Ludo is sentenced to 8 months, but is released on probation. But he has to work 300 hours for a local daycare center and meets Anna who has unfinished business with him.

Title: Triage
Hint: A war photojournalist returns from Kurdistan without his partner, and must face what happened.
Description: The wife of a photojournalist sets out to discover why he came home from a recent assignment without his colleague.

Title: Scenic Route
Hint: Two lifelong friends stranded on a desert road turn on each other.
Description: Stranded on an isolated desert road, two life-long friends fight for survival as their already strained relationship spirals into knife-wielding madness.

Title: Conquest 1453
Hint: A young sultan lays siege to Constantinople and conquers the Byzantine Empire.
Description: After the death of his father Murat II, young Mehmet II ascends to the Ottoman throne. After braving internal and external enemies, he decides to complete what he was destined to do: Conquer Constantinople.

Title: Dear Wendy
Hint: A pacifist teen forms a gun club with other misfits.
Description: In a blue-collar American town, a group of teens bands together to form the Dandies, a gang of gunslingers led by Dick Dandelion. Following a code of strict pacifism at odds with the fact that they all carry guns, the group eventually lets in Sebastian, the grandson of Dick's childhood nanny, Clarabelle, who fears the other gangs in the area.

Title: Mission Mangal
Hint: Indian scientists send a low-budget orbiter to the red planet.
Description: A team of Indian scientists at ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation) take on the extraordinary task of successfully sending a satellite into the orbit of planet Mars in a country's maiden attempt.

Title: Kolpaçino
Hint: Small-time gangsters in a poor neighborhood get caught up in rivalries.
Description: Lives of several low-level gangsters get intertwined after a game of craps in their underground casino ends in a bloody shootout.

Title: Etharkkum Thunindhavan
Hint: A lawyer turns judge, jury and executioner against a gang.
Description: A lawyer turns judge jury and executioner and goes after a gang, led by a minister's son, that threatens women with videos of them.

Title: Incir Reçeli
Hint: A desperate screenwriter is visited by the ghost of a woman who loves him.
Description: On a night of despair after being turned down continuously for the scripts he writes, Metin ends up in a bar where he meets a girl named Duygu. After spending the night together, she walks out in the morning before he wakes up and leaves only a short note. The next time they meet, Metin becomes curious about her secret and decides to follow her. What he finds out will be the beginning of an everlasting love.

Title: Viswasam
Hint: A village ruffian takes on a big shot to protect his estranged daughter.
Description: A village ruffian, who settles disputes in his native, takes on a big shot when he tries to sort out the rough patch in his marriage after several years.

Title: Mangal Pandey: The Rising
Hint: A sepoy rebels against the British East India Company in 1857.
Description: The film begins in 1857, when India was ruled by the British East India Company. ___ is a sepoy, a soldier of Indian origin, in the army of the East India Company. ___ is fighting in the Anglo-Afghan Wars and saves the life of his British commanding officer, William Gordon. Gordon is indebted to ___ and a strong friendship develops between them, transcending both rank and race.

Title: Vizontele Tuuba
Hint: A government official and his wife are posted to a remote Turkish town in the 1980s, and chaos follows.
Description: Guner Sernikli is a government official who, with his wife and their wheelchair bound daughter, has been assigned as the head librarian to this isolated province, virtually an exile since there is no library in the village. The family is warmly welcome, but these are the years of political anarchy and leftist/rightist clashes in big cities and the youth of the village inevitably follow the tides.

Title: No One Will Save You
Hint: A lonely woman fights off alien invaders in her house without saying a word.
Description: A lonely woman battles extraterrestrials who threaten her future while forcing her to face her past.

Title: No Hard Feelings
Hint: A woman is hired by parents to date their shy son before college.
Description: On the brink of losing her childhood home, Maddie discovers an intriguing job listing: wealthy helicopter parents looking for someone to “date” their introverted 19-year-old son, Percy, before he leaves for college. To her surprise, Maddie soon discovers the awkward Percy is no sure thing.

Title: The Expendables
Country: United States of America, Bulgaria, Germany
Hint: A team of mercenaries is hired to overthrow a South American dictator.
Description: Barney Ross leads a band of highly skilled mercenaries including knife enthusiast Lee Christmas, a martial arts expert Yin Yang, heavy weapons specialist Hale Caesar, demolitionist Toll Road, and a loose-cannon sniper Gunner Jensen. When the group is commissioned by the mysterious Mr.

Title: Fall
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Two friends climb a 2,000-foot TV tower and get stuck at the top.
Description: For best friends Becky and Hunter, life is all about conquering fears and pushing limits. But after they climb 2,000 feet to the top of a remote, abandoned radio tower, they find themselves stranded with no way down. Now Becky and Hunter's expert climbing skills will be put to the ultimate test as they desperately fight to survive the elements, a lack of supplies, and vertigo-inducing heights.

Title: M3GAN
Hint: A toy company roboticist builds a lifelike doll that becomes overprotective of her niece.
Description: A brilliant toy company roboticist uses artificial intelligence to develop ___, a life-like doll programmed to emotionally bond with her newly orphaned niece. But when the doll's programming works too well, she becomes overprotective of her new friend with terrifying results.

Title: Friday the 13th
Hint: Teenage counsellors reopening a cursed lakeside camp are stalked and murdered one by one by an unseen killer.
Description: Camp counselors are stalked and murdered by an unknown assailant while trying to reopen a summer camp that was the site of a child's drowning.

Title: Renfield
Hint: A legendary vampire's put-upon assistant wants out of his toxic relationship with his boss.
Description: Having grown sick and tired of his centuries as Dracula's lackey, ___ finds a new lease on life — and maybe even redemption — when he falls for feisty, perennially angry traffic cop Rebecca Quincy.

Title: Just Go with It
Hint: A plastic surgeon's assistant pretends to be his ex-wife to help him land a younger woman.
Description: While romancing Palmer, a much younger schoolteacher, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee enlists his loyal assistant Katherine to pretend to be his soon to be ex-wife, in order to cover up a careless lie. When more lies backfire, Katherine's kids become involved, and everyone heads off for a weekend in Hawaii that will change all their lives.

Title: Monsters
Hint: A journalist escorts a woman through an alien-infested zone in Mexico.
Description: Six years ago NASA discovered the possibility of alien life within our solar system. A probe was launched to collect samples, but crashed upon re-entry over Central America. Soon after, new life forms began to appear and half of Mexico was quarantined as an infected zone.

Title: The Craft
Hint: Four outcast teen girls form a coven and use their powers for revenge.
Description: A Catholic school newcomer falls in with a clique of teen witches who wield their powers against all who dare to cross them -- be they teachers, rivals or meddlesome parents.

Title: Nefarious
Hint: A psychiatrist evaluates a death row inmate who claims to be a demon.
Description: On the day of his scheduled execution, a convicted serial killer gets a psychiatric evaluation during which he claims he is a demon, and further claims that before their time is over, the psychiatrist will commit three murders of his own.

Title: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
Hint: The surviving rebels and a young scavenger face their final battle against a resurrected emperor.
Description: The surviving Resistance faces the First Order once again as the journey of Rey, Finn and Poe Dameron continues. With the power and knowledge of generations behind them, the final battle begins.

Title: Pleasure
Hint: A Swedish girl moves to Los Angeles to become an adult film star.
Description: 19 year old Linnéa leaves her small town in Sweden and heads for Los Angeles with the aim of becoming the world's next big porn star, but the road to her goal turns out to be bumpier than she imagined.

Title: She's Out of My League
Hint: An average airport security guy dates a woman who seems far too good for him.
Description: When he starts dating drop-dead gorgeous Molly, insecure airport security agent Kirk can't believe it. As his friends and family share their doubts about the relationship lasting, Kirk does everything he can to avoid losing Molly forever.

Title: Alien: Covenant
Hint: A colony ship lands on a seemingly perfect planet.
Description: The crew of the colony ship ___, bound for a remote planet on the far side of the galaxy, discovers what they think is an uncharted paradise but is actually a dark, dangerous world.

Title: Legally Blonde
Hint: A sorority girl gets into Harvard Law to win back her ex.
Description: Fashionable sorority queen Elle Woods has it all, but, she wants nothing more than to be Mrs. Warner Huntington III. But he dumps her before heading to Harvard Law School. Elle rallies all of her resources and gets into Harvard, determined to win him back. While there, she figures out that there is more to herself than just good looks.

Title: Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets
Country: France, Germany, United Arab Emirates, United States of America, Belgium, China
Hint: Two special agents in the 28th century must save a vast space station that is home to countless alien species.
Description: In the 28th century, ___ and Laureline are special operatives charged with keeping order throughout the human territories. On assignment from the Minister of Defense, the two undertake a mission to Alpha, an ever-expanding metropolis where species from across the universe have converged over centuries to share knowledge, intelligence, and cultures.

Title: The Punisher
Hint: An FBI agent becomes a vigilante after his family is murdered.
Description: When undercover FBI agent Frank Castle's wife and son are slaughtered, he becomes 'the ___' -- a ruthless vigilante willing to go to any length to avenge his family.

Title: Mars Attacks!
Hint: Martians invade Earth in a satire of 1950s sci-fi.
Description: A fleet of Martian spacecraft surrounds the world's major cities and all of humanity waits to see if the extraterrestrial visitors have, as they claim, "come in peace." U.S. President James Dale receives assurance from science professor Donald Kessler that the Martians' mission is a friendly one. But when a peaceful exchange ends in the total annihilation of the U.S.

Title: Luther: The Fallen Sun
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A disgraced detective breaks out of prison to catch a serial killer.
Description: A gruesome serial killer is terrorizing London while brilliant but disgraced detective John ___ sits behind bars. Haunted by his failure to capture the cyber psychopath who now taunts him, ___ decides to break out of prison to finish the job by any means necessary.

Title: The Princess Diaries
Hint: A shy San Francisco teen learns she is heir to a European throne.
Description: A socially awkward but very bright 15-year-old girl being raised by a single mom discovers that she is the princess of a small European country because of the recent death of her long-absent father, who, unknown to her, was the crown prince of Genovia. She must make a choice between continuing the life of a San Francisco teen or stepping up to the throne.

Title: Hell House LLC
Hint: A documentary crew investigates a haunted house attraction where 15 people died.
Description: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.

Title: The Hills Have Eyes
Hint: A family on a road trip is stalked by cannibals in the desert.
Description: Taking an ill-advised detour en-route to California, the Carter family soon run into trouble when their RV breaks down in the middle of the desert. Stranded, they find themselves at the mercy of monstrous cannibals lurking in the surrounding ___.

Title: Lucy
Hint: A woman gains superhuman powers after a drug leaks into her body.
Description: A woman, accidentally caught in a dark deal, turns the tables on her captors and transforms into a merciless warrior evolved beyond human logic.

Title: Alien³
Hint: An escape pod crashes on a prison planet with a stowaway alien.
Description: After escaping with Newt and Hicks from the alien planet, Ripley crash lands on Fiorina 161, a prison planet and host to a correctional facility. Unfortunately, although Newt and Hicks do not survive the crash, a more unwelcome visitor does. The prison does not allow weapons of any kind, and with aid being a long time away, the prisoners must simply survive in any way they can.

Title: American Pie 2
Hint: College friends rent a beach house for a wild summer.
Description: After a year apart - attending different schools, meeting different people - the guys rent a beach house and vow to make this the best summer ever. As it turns out, whether that will happen or not has a lot to do with the girls. Between the wild parties, outrageous revelations and yes, a trip to band camp, they discover that times change and people change, but in the end, it's all about sticking together.

Title: Trolls
Genres: Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Fantasy, Music
Hint: A cheerful princess and a grumpy troll rescue their friends from monsters.
Description: After the monstrous Bergens invade Troll Village, Princess Poppy, the happiest Troll ever born, and overly-cautious, curmudgeonly outcast Branch set off on a journey to rescue her friends. Their mission is full of adventure and mishaps, as this mismatched duo try to tolerate each other long enough to get the job done.

Title: Big Daddy
Hint: A lazy law school graduate adopts a kid to impress his girlfriend.
Description: A lazy law school grad adopts a kid to impress his girlfriend, but everything doesn't go as planned. Now he's forced to grow up while navigating the challenges of fatherhood.

Title: Angel Has Fallen
Hint: A Secret Service agent is framed for an attack on the President.
Description: After a treacherous attack, Secret Service agent Mike Banning is charged with attempting to assassinate President Trumbull. Chased by his own colleagues and the FBI, Banning begins a race against the clock to clear his name.

Title: The Giver
Hint: A teen discovers the dark truth beneath his colorless utopian community.
Description: In a seemingly perfect community, without war, pain, suffering, differences or choice, a young boy is chosen to learn from an elderly man about the true pain and pleasure of the "real" world.

Title: The People Under the Stairs
Hint: A boy breaks into a house owned by a cannibalistic couple with captive children.
Description: Trapped inside a fortified home owned by a mysterious couple, a young boy quickly learns the true nature of the homicidal inhabitants, and secret creatures hidden deep within the walls.

Title: The Cell
Hint: A psychologist enters the mind of a comatose serial killer to find his last victim.
Description: A psychotherapist journeys inside a comatose serial killer in the hopes of saving his latest victim.

Title: She's the Man
Hint: A girl disguises herself as her twin brother at his boarding school to play soccer.
Description: Viola Hastings is in a real jam. Complications threaten her scheme to pose as her twin brother, Sebastian, and take his place at a new boarding school. She falls in love with her handsome roommate, Duke, who loves beautiful Olivia, who has fallen for Sebastian! As if that were not enough, Viola's twin returns from London ahead of schedule but has no idea that his sister has already replaced him on campus.

Title: Tomorrowland
Hint: A teen and an inventor travel to a futuristic world hidden in another dimension.
Description: Bound by a shared destiny, a bright, optimistic teen bursting with scientific curiosity and a former boy-genius inventor jaded by disillusionment embark on a danger-filled mission to unearth the secrets of an enigmatic place somewhere in time and space that exists in their collective memory as "___."

Title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
Hint: A writer tries to make a man dump her in under two weeks for an article.
Description: It's the battle of wills, as Andie needs to prove she can dump a guy in ___ days, whereas Ben needs to prove he can win a girl in ___ days. Now, the clock is ticking—and the wildly entertaining comedy smash is off and running in this irresistible tale of sex, lies and outrageous romantic fireworks!

Title: Honey, I Shrunk the Kids
Hint: An inventor accidentally shrinks his children to the size of insects.
Description: The scientist father of a teenage girl and boy accidentally shrinks his and two other neighborhood teens to the size of insects. Now the teens must fight diminutive dangers as the father searches for them.

Title: Greenland
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A family races to a bunker as a comet fragments hit Earth.
Description: John Garrity, his estranged wife and their young son embark on a perilous journey to find sanctuary as a planet-killing comet hurtles toward Earth. Amid terrifying accounts of cities getting levelled, the Garritys experience the best and worst in humanity. As the countdown to the global apocalypse approaches zero, their incredible trek culminates in a desperate and last-minute flight to a possible safe haven.

Title: Escape Room
Hint: Six strangers compete in deadly puzzle chambers for a cash prize.
Description: Six strangers find themselves in circumstances beyond their control, and must use their wits to survive.

Title: Pitch Perfect 2
Hint: A collegiate a cappella group disgraced in front of the president competes in an international championship.
Description: The Bellas are back, and they are better than ever. After being humiliated in front of none other than the President of the United States of America, the Bellas are taken out of the Aca-Circuit. In order to clear their name, and regain their status, the Bellas take on a seemingly impossible task: winning an international competition no American team has ever won.

Title: The World Is Not Enough
Hint: A secret agent protects an oil heiress from a terrorist who can't feel pain.
Description: Greed, revenge, world dominance and high-tech terrorism – it's all in a day's work for Bond, who's on a mission to protect a beautiful oil heiress from a notorious terrorist. In a race against time that culminates in a dramatic submarine showdown, Bond works to defuse the international power struggle that has the world's oil supply hanging in the balance.

Title: Luckiest Girl Alive
Hint: A New York woman's past trauma at an elite prep school resurfaces before her wedding.
Description: A successful woman in New York City finds her life upended when she is forced to confront a dark truth that threatens to unravel her meticulously crafted life.

Title: Robots
Hint: A young robot inventor travels to the big city to meet his idol.
Description: Rodney Copperbottom is a young robot inventor who dreams of making the world a better place, until the evil Ratchet takes over Bigweld Industries. Now, Rodney's dreams – and those of his friends – are in danger of becoming obsolete.

Title: The Son
Hint: A lawyer cares for his depressed teenage boy from his first marriage.
Description: A successful lawyer, with a new wife and infant, agrees to care for his teenage ___ from a previous marriage after his ex-wife becomes concerned about the boy's wayward behavior.

Title: The Dictator
Country: United States of America, Spain, Morocco
Hint: A ruthless North African despot travels to New York for a UN summit and is stranded without his beard.
Description: The heroic story of a ___ who risks his life to ensure that democracy would never come to the country he so lovingly oppressed.

Title: Click
Hint: A man gets a universal remote that controls his life.
Description: A married workaholic, Michael Newman doesn't have time for his wife and children, not if he's to impress his ungrateful boss and earn a well-deserved promotion. So when he meets Morty, a loopy sales clerk, he gets the answer to his prayers: a magical remote that allows him to bypass life's little distractions with increasingly hysterical results.

Title: The Good Son
Hint: A boy stays with his aunt and uncle and befriends his cousin, a psychopath.
Description: A young boy stays with his aunt and uncle, and befriends his cousin who's the same age. But his cousin begins showing increasing signs of psychotic behavior.

Title: St. Elmo's Fire
Hint: Seven friends struggle with adulthood after graduating from university in Washington.
Description: Reluctant to let go of college life, a close-knit team of seven friends--irresponsible saxophone player Billy, young Republican Alec, his girlfriend Leslie, struggling journalist Kevin, drama queen Jules, lovesick waiter Kirby, and Wendy, a social worker with a heart of gold--realise the party is over.

Title: Need for Speed
Hint: A street racer seeks revenge after being framed for his friend's death.
Description: The film revolves around a local street-racer who partners with a rich and arrogant business associate, only to find himself framed by his colleague and sent to prison. After he gets out, he joins a New York-to-Los Angeles race to get revenge.

Title: Archive
Country: United Kingdom, Hungary, United States of America
Hint: An AI scientist tries to bring back his dead wife.
Description: 2038: George Almore is working on a true human-equivalent AI, and his latest prototype is almost ready. This sensitive phase is also the riskiest as he has a goal that must be hidden at all costs—being reunited with his dead wife.

Title: Bandit
Hint: A career criminal robs 59 banks under a new identity.
Description: After escaping a Michigan prison, a charming career criminal assumes a new identity in Canada and goes on to rob a record 59 banks and jewellery stores while being hunted by a rogue task force. Based on the true story of The Flying ___.

Title: Luck
Hint: The unluckiest girl in the world enters a magical realm that controls fortune.
Description: Suddenly finding herself in the never-before-seen Land of ___, the unluckiest person in the world must unite with the magical creatures there to turn her ___ around.

Title: Fractured
Hint: A man's wife and daughter disappear from a hospital.
Description: Driving cross-country, Ray and his wife and daughter stop at a highway rest area where his daughter falls and breaks her arm. After a frantic rush to the hospital and a clash with the check-in nurse, Ray is finally able to get her to a doctor. While the wife and daughter go downstairs for an MRI, Ray, exhausted, passes out in a chair in the lobby.

Title: What Women Want
Hint: A sexist advertising executive gains the ability to hear what women are thinking.
Description: Advertising executive Nick Marshall is as cocky as they come, but what happens to a chauvinistic guy when he can suddenly hear what women are thinking? Nick gets passed over for a promotion, but after an accident enables him to hear women's thoughts, he puts his newfound talent to work against Darcy, his new boss, who seems to be infatuated with him.

Title: Army of Thieves
Hint: A safecracker joins a heist across Europe during a zombie outbreak.
Description: A mysterious woman recruits bank teller Ludwig Dieter to lead a group of aspiring ___ on a top-secret heist during the early stages of the zombie apocalypse.

Title: The Money Pit
Hint: A couple buys a crumbling house that falls apart around them.
Description: After being evicted from their Manhattan apartment, a couple buy what looks like the home of their dreams—only to find themselves saddled with a bank-account-draining nightmare. Struggling to keep their relationship together as their rambling mansion falls to pieces around them, the two watch in hilarious horror as everything—including the kitchen sink—disappears into the ___.

Title: Along Came a Spider
Hint: A forensic psychologist searches for a kidnapped senator's daughter.
Description: After the harrowing death of his partner, forensic psychologist and best-selling author Alex Cross cannot forgive himself and has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal kidnaps a senator's young daughter, he is lured back into action as the kidnapper wants to deal with Alex personally.

Title: Minions
Hint: Yellow henchmen search for a new villain to serve.
Description: ___ Stuart, Kevin and Bob are recruited by Scarlet Overkill, a super-villain who, alongside her inventor husband Herb, hatches a plot to take over the world.

Title: I Care a Lot
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A legal guardian scams elderly people out of their savings.
Description: A court-appointed legal guardian defrauds her older clients and traps them under her care. But her latest mark comes with some unexpected baggage.

Title: A Cure for Wellness
Hint: An ambitious young executive is sent to retrieve his CEO from a mysterious spa in the Swiss Alps.
Description: An ambitious young executive is sent to retrieve his company's CEO from an idyllic but mysterious "___ center" at a remote location in the Swiss Alps but soon suspects that the spa's miraculous treatments are not what they seem.

Title: The Mummy Returns
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An adventurer and his family battle a revived ancient priest and a half-scorpion warrior king.
Description: Rick and Evelyn O’Connell, along with their 8-year-old son Alex, discover the key to the legendary Scorpion King’s might: the fabled Bracelet of Anubis. Unfortunately, a newly resurrected Imhotep has designs on the bracelet as well, and isn’t above kidnapping its new bearer, Alex, to gain control of Anubis’s otherworldly army.

Title: National Lampoon's Van Wilder
Hint: A party-loving student who has been in college for seven years is told to graduate.
Description: ___ has been attending college for far too many years and is scared to graduate, but ___ father eventually realizes what is going on. When he stops paying his son's tuition fees, ___ must come up with the money if he wants to stay in college, so he and his friends come up with a great fund-raising idea – throwing parties.

Title: Hidden
Hint: Kids at a camp are hunted by deformed children.
Description: Deep within a dark, twisted forest, at a faraway adventure camp, a group of young 'camp leaders' play a fast and furious game of 'hide and seek'. The atmosphere is strange and thick with tension - there is a feeling in the air that all is not well. Alliances are formed; relationships are tested, and in some cases disintegrate to the point of violence. All the while they are being watched by someone... or something.

Title: Hancock
Hint: A drunk, unpopular superhero tries to improve his image with the help of a PR man.
Description: ___ is a down-and-out superhero who's forced to employ a PR expert to help repair his image when the public grows weary of all the damage he's inflicted during his lifesaving heroics. The agent's idea of imprisoning the antihero to make the world miss him proves successful, but will ___ stick to his new sense of purpose or slip back into old habits?

Title: Hot Summer Nights
Hint: A teenager comes of age during a wild season in Cape Cod.
Description: In 1991, a sheltered teenager comes of age during a wild summer on Cape Cod, getting rich from selling pot to gangsters, falling in love for the first time, partying, and eventually realizing that he's in way over his head.

Title: Now You See Me 2
Country: Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: A team of magicians are forced into a heist by a tech prodigy.
Description: One year after outwitting the FBI and winning the public’s adulation with their mind-bending spectacles, the Four Horsemen resurface only to find themselves face to face with a new enemy who enlists them to pull off their most dangerous heist yet.

Title: Valley Girl
Hint: A girl from the San Fernando suburbs falls for a punk.
Description: Julie, a girl from the ___, meets Randy, a punk from the city. They are from different worlds and find love. Somehow they need to stay together in spite of her trendy, shallow friends.

Title: Twilight Zone: The Movie
Hint: An anthology of four supernatural tales, including a terrified passenger on a plane.
Description: An anthology film presenting remakes of three episodes from the "___" TV series—"Kick the Can", "It's a Good Life" and "Nightmare at 20,000 Feet"—and one original story, "Time Out."

Title: Predators
Hint: Mercenaries are dropped onto an alien planet and hunted.
Description: A group of cold-blooded killers find themselves trapped on an alien planet to be hunted by extraterrestrial ___.

Title: The Lorax
Hint: A boy searches for a real tree in a plastic world.
