Description: A 12-year-old boy searches for the one thing that will enable him to win the affection of the girl of his dreams. To find it he must discover the story of the ___, the grumpy yet charming creature who fights to protect his world.

Title: The First Wives Club
Hint: Three divorced women seek revenge on the ex-husbands who left them for younger women.
Description: After years of helping their hubbies climb the ladder of success, three mid-life Manhattanites have been dumped for a newer, curvier model. But the trio is determined to turn their pain into gain. They come up with a cleverly devious plan to hit their exes where it really hurts - in the wallet!

Title: No Sudden Move
Hint: Criminals are hired for a simple job in 1950s Detroit.
Description: A group of criminals are brought together under mysterious circumstances and have to work together to uncover what's really going on when their simple job goes completely sideways.

Title: The Grinch
Hint: A grumpy green creature plots to steal Christmas from a town of cheerful folk.
Description: The ___ hatches a scheme to ruin Christmas when the residents of Whoville plan their annual holiday celebration. But a certain little who might change things.

Title: The Sadness
Hint: A virus turns people into sadistic killers in Taipei.
Description: A young couple is pushed to the limits of sanity as they attempt to be reunited amid the chaos of a pandemic outbreak. The streets erupt into violence and depravity, as those infected are driven to enact the most cruel and ghastly things imaginable.

Title: Bros
Hint: Two commitment-phobic gay men in New York stumble toward love in a rom-com.
Description: Two gay men are possibly, probably, stumbling towards love. Maybe. They're both very busy.

Title: Kill List
Hint: A hitman takes a new assignment that turns sinister.
Description: Nearly a year after a botched job, a hitman takes a new assignment with the promise of a big payoff for three killings. What starts off as an easy task soon unravels, sending the killer into the heart of darkness.

Title: He's Just Not That Into You
Hint: Several people navigate the complicated rules of dating in Baltimore.
Description: Have you ever wondered why they said they would call but didn't, or why they don't want to sleep with you anymore, or why your relationship isn't going to the next level? Maybe they're just not that into you. Gigi wants a man who says he'll call her - and actually does - while Alex advises her to stop waiting by the phone.

Title: Burlesque
Hint: A small-town girl joins a cabaret club in Los Angeles.
Description: Ali leaves behind a troubled life and follows her dreams to Los Angeles, where she lands a job as a cocktail waitress at the ___ Lounge, a once-majestic theater that houses an inspired musical revue. Vowing to perform there, she makes the leap from bar to stage, helping restore the club's former glory.

Title: Solace
Hint: A psychic helps the FBI catch a serial killer.
Description: A psychic doctor, John Clancy, works with an FBI special agent in search of a serial killer.

Title: Asoka
Genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, History, Romance, War
Hint: A young Indian prince exiled from his kingdom becomes a great emperor after a bloody war.
Description: A young Prince ___ works to perfect his skills in battle and also deals with family conflict. During a struggle with one of his step-brothers, his mother urges ___ to escape to stay alive. While away, ___ meets Kaurwaki and falls in love, but must use his skills as a warrior to protect her. A dangerous and heartbreaking web of conspiracy follows, which leads ___ to embrace a Buddhist path.

Title: Hot Tub Time Machine
Hint: Friends travel back to the 1980s through a magical Jacuzzi.
Description: Four pals are stuck in a rut in adulthood: Adam has just been dumped, Lou is a hopeless party animal, Nick is a henpecked husband, and Jacob does nothing but play video games in his basement. But they get a chance to brighten their future by changing their past after a night of heavy drinking in a ski-resort hot ___ results in their waking up in 1986.

Title: 17 Again
Hint: A 37-year-old man is transformed into his teenage self.
Description: On the brink of a midlife crisis, 30-something Mike O'Donnell wishes he could have a "do-over." And that's exactly what he gets when he wakes up one morning to find he's ___ years old again. With his adult mind stuck inside the body of a teenager, Mike actually has the chance to reverse some decisions he wishes he'd never made. But maybe they weren't so bad after all.

Title: Wes Craven's New Nightmare
Hint: A horror director's franchise invades reality as an evil entity targets his cast.
Description: A demonic force has chosen Freddy Krueger as its portal to the real world. Can Heather Langenkamp play the part of Nancy one last time and trap the evil trying to enter our world?

Title: Accepted
Hint: A teen rejected from college creates a fake one to fool his parents.
Description: A high school slacker who's rejected by every school he applies to opts to create his own institution of higher learning, the South Harmon Institute of Technology, on a rundown piece of property near his hometown.

Title: Colombiana
Hint: A young woman becomes an assassin to avenge her parents.
Description: After witnessing her parents’ murder as a child in Bogota, Cataleya Restrepo grows up to be a stone-cold assassin. She works for her uncle as a hitman by day, but her personal time is spent engaging in vigilante murders that she hopes will lead her to her ultimate target: the mobster responsible for her parents' death.

Title: Be Kind Rewind
Hint: Two video store clerks accidentally erase their tapes and remake the films with homemade props.
Description: A man whose brain becomes magnetized unintentionally destroys every tape in his friend's video store. In order to satisfy the store's most loyal renter, an aging woman with signs of dementia, the two men set out to remake the lost films.

Title: Rat Race
Hint: Strangers compete in a cross-country dash to find two million dollars.
Description: In an ensemble film about easy money, greed, manipulation and bad driving, a Las Vegas casino tycoon entertains his wealthiest high rollers -- a group that will bet on anything -- by pitting six ordinary people against each other in a wild dash for $2 million jammed into a locker hundreds of miles away. The tycoon and his wealthy friends monitor each racer's every move to keep track of their favorites.

Title: Revenge
Hint: Left for dead in the desert by her lover and his hunting buddies, a young woman rises bloody and hunts them down.
Description: Jen's romantic getaway with her wealthy married boyfriend is disrupted when his friends arrive for an impromptu hunting trip. Tension mounts at the house until the situation culminates in an unexpected way.

Title: Riddick
Hint: A notorious fugitive is stranded on a hostile planet and hunted by two teams of bounty hunters.
Description: Betrayed by his own kind and left for dead on a desolate planet, ___ fights for survival against alien predators and becomes more powerful and dangerous than ever before. Soon bounty hunters from throughout the galaxy descend on ___ only to find themselves pawns in his greater scheme for revenge.

Title: Europa Report
Hint: Astronauts travel to Jupiter's moon in search of life, in a found-footage film.
Description: A crew travels to ___, Jupiter’s icy moon, to investigate signs of life in its subsurface ocean, but disaster cuts them off from Earth, leading to a tense and dangerous exploration.

Title: The Woman in Black
Hint: A young lawyer travels to a remote village and discovers a vengeful ghost.
Description: The story follows a young lawyer, Arthur Kipps, who is ordered to travel to a remote village and sort out a recently deceased client’s papers. As he works alone in the client’s isolated house, Kipps begins to uncover tragic secrets, his unease growing when he glimpses a mysterious woman dressed only in black.

Title: Gonjiam: Haunted Asylum
Hint: A web series crew visits an abandoned psychiatric hospital.
Description: The crew of a horror web series travels to an abandoned ___ for a live broadcast, but they encounter much more than expected as they move deeper inside the nightmarish old building.

Title: Pain & Gain
Hint: Miami bodybuilders kidnap a wealthy businessman to steal his fortune.
Description: Daniel Lugo, manager of the Sun Gym in 1990s Miami, decides that there is only one way to achieve his version of the American dream: extortion. To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul and Adrian as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw and convince him to sign over all his assets to them.

Title: Silver Bullet
Country: Italy, Netherlands, United States of America
Hint: A paralyzed boy discovers a werewolf in his town.
Description: The small city of Tarker's Mills is startled by a series of sadistic murders. The population fears the work of a maniac, but sightings of a mysterious, hairy creature soon spread. People lock themselves up at night, but there's one boy who's still outside…

Title: Spanglish
Hint: A Mexican housekeeper works for a dysfunctional Los Angeles family.
Description: Mexican immigrant and single mother Flor Moreno finds housekeeping work with Deborah and John Clasky, a well-off couple with two children of their own. When Flor admits she can't handle the schedule because of her daughter, Cristina, Deborah decides they should move into the Clasky home.

Title: Savages
Hint: Two pot growers face off against a Mexican drug cartel after their girlfriend is kidnapped.
Description: Pot growers Ben and Chon face off against the Mexican drug cartel who kidnapped their shared girlfriend.

Title: Little Giants
Hint: Two brothers form rival youth football teams in their small Ohio town, with an underdog squad of misfits.
Description: When Danny O'Shea's daughter is cut from the Peewee football team just for being a girl, he decides to form his own team, composed of other ragtag players who were also cut. Can his team really learn enough to beat the elite team, coached by his brother, a former pro player?

Title: The Sum of All Fears
Country: Canada, Germany, United States of America
Hint: A CIA analyst races to stop a nuclear bomb.
Description: When the president of Russia suddenly dies, a man whose politics are virtually unknown succeeds him. The change in political leaders sparks paranoia among American CIA officials, so CIA director Bill Cabot recruits a young analyst to supply insight and advice on the situation. Then the unthinkable happens: a nuclear bomb explodes in a U.S. city, and America is quick to blame the Russians.

Title: Incident in a Ghostland
Hint: Sisters return to the house where they were attacked.
Description: A mother of two inherits a home from her aunt. On the first night in the new home she is confronted with murderous intruders and fights for her daughters’ lives. Sixteen years later the daughters reunite at the house, and that is when things get strange...

Title: The Number 23
Hint: A man becomes obsessed with a book about a mysterious figure.
Description: Animal control officer Walter Sparrow becomes obsessed with a novel that he believes was written about him, as more and more similarities between himself and his literary alter ego seem to arise.

Title: Salt
Hint: A CIA agent is accused of being a Russian spy.
Description: As a CIA officer, Evelyn ___ swore an oath to duty, honor, and country. Her loyalty will be tested when a Russian defector accuses her of being a Russian sleeper spy. She goes on the run, using all her skills and years of experience as a covert operative to elude capture, protect her husband, and stay one step ahead of her colleagues at the CIA.

Title: The Hot Spot
Hint: A drifter in a small Texas town plans a bank robbery and gets involved with his boss's wife.
Description: Upon arriving to a small town, a drifter quickly gets into trouble with the local authorities — and the local women — after he robs a bank.

Title: Shortbus
Hint: New Yorkers explore sex and relationships at an underground salon.
Description: In post-9/11 New York City, an eclectic group of citizens find their lives entangled, personally, romantically, and sexually, at ___, an underground Brooklyn salon infamous for its blend of art, music, politics, and carnality.

Title: Killer Elite
Country: Australia, United States of America, United Kingdom, Morocco, France
Hint: A retired assassin is forced to kill SAS soldiers.
Description: Based on a shocking true story, ___ pits two of the world’s most elite operatives—Danny, an ex-special ops agent and Hunter, his longtime mentor—against the cunning leader of a secret military society. Covering the globe from Australia to Paris, London and the Middle East, Danny and Hunter are plunged into a highly dangerous game of cat and mouse—where the predators become the prey.

Title: Weekend at Bernie's
Hint: Two insurance employees pretend their dead boss is alive.
Description: Two young insurance corporation employees try to pretend that their murdered employer is alive by puppeteering his dead body, leading a hitman to attempt to track him down to finish him off.

Title: Turbo
Hint: A garden snail dreams of winning the Indy 500 after gaining super speed.
Description: The tale of an ordinary garden snail who dreams of winning the Indy 500.

Title: Act of Valor
Hint: Navy SEALs rescue a kidnapped CIA operative and uncover a terrorist plot.
Description: When a covert mission to rescue a kidnapped CIA operative uncovers a chilling plot, an elite, highly trained U.S. SEAL team speeds to hotspots around the globe, racing against the clock to stop a deadly terrorist attack.

Title: Deadstream
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An internet personality spends a night in a haunted house.
Description: A disgraced internet personality attempts to win back his followers by livestreaming one night alone in a haunted house. But when he accidentally unleashes a vengeful spirit, his big comeback event becomes a real-time fight for his life.

Title: The DUFF
Hint: A high school girl discovers she is the "designated ugly fat friend".
Description: Bianca's universe turns upside down when she learns that her high school refers to her as a ‘___' (Designated Ugly Fat Friend). Hoping to erase that label, she enlists the help of a charming jock and her favorite teacher. Together they'll face the school's mean girl and remind everyone that we are all someone's ___… and that's totally fine.

Title: Death Race
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Germany
Hint: A former driver is forced into a lethal prison motorsport.
Description: Terminal Island, New York: 2020. Overcrowding in the US penal system has reached a breaking point. Prisons have been turned over to a monolithic Weyland Corporation, which sees jails full of thugs as an opportunity for televised sport. Adrenalized inmates, a global audience hungry for violence and a spectacular, enclosed arena come together to form the '___', the biggest, most brutal event.

Title: Dinosaur
Hint: An orphaned iguanodon raised by lemurs joins a herd of giant reptiles on its migration after a meteor strike.
Description: An orphaned ___ raised by lemurs joins an arduous trek to a sancturary after a meteorite shower destroys his family home.

Title: The Goldfinch
Hint: A boy steals a painting after his mother dies.
Description: A boy in New York is taken in by a wealthy family after his mother is killed in a bombing at the Metropolitan Museum of Art. In a rush of panic, he steals 'The ___', a painting that eventually draws him into a world of crime.

Title: The Prophecy
Hint: An angel comes to Earth to collect a soul that will end a war in heaven.
Description: The angel Gabriel comes to Earth to collect a soul which will end the stalemated war in Heaven. However, it is hidden inside of a Native American girl and only a former priest and a schoolteacher can stop him.

Title: Chained
Hint: A serial killer raises a boy as his apprentice.
Description: A serial killer kidnaps a young boy after murdering his mother, then raises him to be his accomplice. After years in captivity, the boy must choose between escaping or following in his captor's bloody footprints.

Title: High Crimes
Hint: A lawyer discovers her husband is a marine accused of murder.
Description: A female attorney learns that her husband is really a marine officer who has been AWOL for fifteen years and accused of murdering fifteen civilians in El Salvador. Believing her husband when he tells her that he's being framed as part of a U.S. Military cover-up, the attorney defends him in a military court.

Title: Leap Year
Hint: A woman travels to Ireland to propose on February 29th.
Description: When yet another anniversary passes without a marriage proposal from her boyfriend, Anna decides to take action. Aware of a Celtic tradition that allows women to pop the question on Feb. 29, she plans to follow her lover to Dublin and ask him to marry her.

Title: Daybreakers
Hint: In 2019, vampires dominate a world running out of human blood, and a hematologist seeks a cure.
Description: In the year 2019, a plague has transformed almost every human into a vampire. Faced with a dwindling blood supply, the fractured dominant race plots their survival; meanwhile, a researcher works with a covert band of vampires on a way to save humankind.

Title: The Assistant
Hint: A day in the life of a junior employee to a powerful producer.
Description: A searing look at a day in the life of an ___ to a powerful executive. As Jane follows her daily routine, she grows increasingly aware of the insidious abuse that threatens every aspect of her position.

Title: The Ugly Truth
Hint: A romantically challenged morning show producer is coached in dating by a chauvinistic TV correspondent.
Description: A romantically challenged morning show producer is reluctantly embroiled in a series of outrageous tests by her chauvinistic correspondent to prove his theories on relationships and help her find love. His clever ploys, however, lead to an unexpected result.

Title: The Siege
Hint: Terrorists attack New York and the army declares martial law.
Description: The secret US abduction of a suspected terrorist from his Middle East homeland leads to a wave of terrorist attacks in New York. An FBI senior agent and his team attempt to locate and decommission the enemy cells, but must also deal with an Army General gone rogue and a female CIA agent of uncertain loyalties.

Title: Monsters vs. Aliens
Hint: A bride struck by a meteorite grows 50 feet tall and is recruited into a secret team of creatures to fight invaders.
Description: When Susan Murphy is unwittingly clobbered by a meteor full of outer space gunk on her wedding day, she mysteriously grows to 49-feet-11-inches. The military jumps into action and captures Susan, secreting her away to a covert government compound. She is renamed Ginormica and placed in confinement with a ragtag group of ___...

Title: The Lone Ranger
Hint: A Native American warrior and a lawman fight corruption.
Description: The Texas Rangers chase down a gang of outlaws led by Butch Cavendish, but the gang ambushes the Rangers, seemingly killing them all. One survivor is found, however, by an American Indian named Tonto, who nurses him back to health. The ___, donning a mask and riding a white stallion named Silver, teams up with Tonto to bring the unscrupulous gang and others of that ilk to justice.

Title: The Game Plan
Hint: A football star discovers he has an eight-year-old daughter, just as his team makes the playoffs.
Description: Bachelor football star Joe Kingman seems to have it all. He is wealthy and carefree, and his team is on the way to capturing a championship. Suddenly, he is tackled by some unexpected news: He has a young daughter, the result of a last fling with his ex-wife. Joe must learn to balance his personal and professional lives with the needs of his child.

Title: Kickboxer
Country: United States of America, China, Hong Kong
Hint: A martial artist trains with a master in Thailand to avenge his brother, crippled by a brutal champion.
Description: If your enemy refuses to be humbled... Destroy him. Accompanied by his brother Kurt, American kickboxing champion Eric Sloane, arrives in Thailand to defeat the Eastern warriors at their own sport. His opponent: ruthless fighter and Thai champion, Tong Po. Tong not only defeats Eric, he paralyzes him for life. Crazed with anger, Kurt vows revenge.

Title: Behind Enemy Lines
Hint: A US Navy pilot is shot down in Bosnia and hunted by Serbian forces.
Description: While flying a routine reconnaissance mission over Bosnia, fighter pilot Lt. Chris Burnett photographs something he wasn't supposed to see and gets shot down ___, where he must outrun an army led by a ruthless Serbian general.

Title: The Vault
Hint: Engineers plan to rob the Bank of Spain during the World Cup.
Description: Madrid, Spain, 2010. While the whole city follows the national team's successful participation in the World Cup, a group of daring thieves look for a way into one of the most secure and guarded places on the planet.

Title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
Hint: The crew faces a mysterious cloud heading for Earth.
Description: When an unidentified alien destroys three powerful Klingon cruisers, Captain James T. Kirk returns to the newly transformed U.S.S. Enterprise to take command.

Title: A Bigger Splash
Country: France, Italy, United States of America
Hint: A rock star's vacation is interrupted by her ex.
Description: An American couple, Paul and Marianne, spend their vacation in Italy and experience trouble when Marianne invites a former lover and his teenage daughter to visit, which leads to jealousy and dangerous sexual scenarios.

Title: The Space Between Us
Hint: A boy born on Mars travels to Earth to find his father.
Description: A young man raised by scientists on Mars returns to Earth to find his father.

Title: A Walk in the Woods
Hint: An aging travel writer hikes the Appalachian Trail with an old friend.
Description: After spending two decades in England, Bill Bryson returns to the U.S., where he decides the best way to connect with his homeland is to hike the Appalachian Trail with one of his oldest friends.

Title: Child 44
Hint: A disgraced Soviet officer investigates murders of young boys along the railway.
Description: Set in Stalin-era Soviet Union, a disgraced MGB agent is dispatched to investigate a series of child murders -- a case that begins to connect with the very top of party leadership.

Title: Explorers
Hint: Three suburban kids bolt together a homemade spacecraft from a dream and blast off to meet some very goofy aliens.
Description: Middle schooler Ben spends his free time watching sci-fi films, playing video games and reading comic books. Surprisingly, his affinity for all things fantastical yields a real result – when he has a vivid dream about technology, his prodigy best friend Wolfgang manages to create a working spacecraft. Joined by their buddy Darren, the boys take off into outer space and encounter some very odd extraterrestrial life.

Title: The Kentucky Fried Movie
Hint: A rapid-fire string of crude sketches lampoons TV ads, late-night news, disaster epics and martial arts flicks.
Description: A series of loosely connected skits that spoof news programs, commercials, porno films, kung-fu films, disaster films, blaxploitation films, spy films, mafia films, and the fear that somebody is watching you on the other side of the TV.

Title: Here Comes the Boom
Hint: A burnt-out high school biology teacher starts taking punches in mixed martial arts bouts to save the music program.
Description: A high school biology teacher moonlights as a mixed-martial arts fighter in an effort to raise money to save the school's music program.

Title: London
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: One long, coke-fuelled night at a loft party where a heartbroken guy tries to win back the girl who's leaving town.
Description: ___ is a drug laden adventure that centers on a party in a New York loft where a young man is trying to win back his ex-girlfriend.

Title: Single White Female
Hint: A New York woman's new roommate starts borrowing her clothes, her haircut and, eventually, her whole identity.
Description: Having recently split from her fiancé, Allison Jones welcomes new roommate Hedra Carlson. The young women quickly form a bond, but soon Allison begins to notice not all’s well with her new tenant.

Title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
Hint: A pet detective travels to Africa to find a sacred white bat.
Description: Summoned from an ashram in Tibet, ___ finds himself on a perilous journey into the jungles of Africa to find Shikaka, the missing sacred animal of the friendly Wachati tribe. He must accomplish this before the wedding of the Wachati's Princess to the prince of the warrior Wachootoos. If ___ fails, the result will be a vicious tribal war.

Title: Let's Be Cops
Hint: Two struggling friends dress up as police officers and become neighbourhood heroes.
Description: Best pals Ryan and Justin are stalled in their respective careers -- a fact that is painfully driven home when they go to a college reunion. Dressed as police in the mistaken belief that they were to attend a costume party, Ryan and Justin find that the uniforms earn them much respect and attention.

Title: The Company You Keep
Hint: A small-town lawyer with a radical past is unmasked by a young reporter and goes on the run to clear himself.
Description: A former Weather Underground activist goes on the run from a journalist who discovers his identity.

Title: Peggy Sue Got Married
Hint: A woman faints at her 25th class reunion and wakes up back in senior year, knowing how her marriage turns out.
Description: At her 25th high school reunion, ___ faints and awakens in 1960—back in her senior year, before her marriage and all her regrets. Given a second chance to relive her youth, she must decide whether to change the choices that shaped her life or embrace the past that made her who she is.

Title: The Lucky One
Hint: A Marine back from Iraq tracks down the stranger in a photo he believes kept him alive through the war.
Description: A Marine travels to Louisiana after serving three tours in Iraq and searches for the unknown woman he believes was his good luck charm during the war.

Title: Mr. Bean's Holiday
Country: United Kingdom, France, Germany, United States of America
Hint: A clumsy, nearly silent Englishman wins a trip to the Riviera and leaves a trail of chaos all the way to Cannes.
Description: Mr. ___ wins a trip to Cannes where he unwittingly separates a young boy from his father and must help the two reunite. On the way he discovers France, bicycling and true love, among other things.

Title: The Frozen Ground
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An Alaska state trooper teams up with a young survivor to bring down a serial killer hunting women in Anchorage.
Description: An Alaska State Trooper partners with a young woman who escaped the clutches of serial killer Robert Hansen to bring the murderer to justice. Based on actual events.

Title: The Eiger Sanction
Hint: A classical art professor doubles as an assassin on a mountain climb.
Description: A classical art professor and collector, who doubles as a professional assassin, is coerced out of retirement to avenge the murder of an old friend.

Title: Before I Fall
Hint: A popular teen relives the day of a fatal car crash again and again, trying to work out what she must change.
Description: Samantha Kingston has everything. Then, everything changes. After one fateful night, she wakes up with no future at all. Trapped into reliving the same day over and over, she begins to question just how perfect her life really was.

Title: A Dangerous Method
Hint: Two founding fathers of psychoanalysis clash over theory, ego and a brilliant, troubled female patient in Vienna.
Description: Seduced by the challenge of an impossible case, the driven Dr. Carl Jung takes the unbalanced yet beautiful Sabina Spielrein as his patient. Jung’s weapon is the ___ of his master, the renowned Sigmund Freud. Both men fall under Sabina’s spell.

Title: The Purge: Anarchy
Hint: Strangers stranded on the streets of LA try to survive the one night a year when every crime is legal.
Description: One night per year, the government sanctions a 12-hour period in which citizens can commit any crime they wish -- including murder -- without fear of punishment or imprisonment. Leo, a sergeant who lost his son, plans a vigilante mission of revenge during the mayhem.

Title: Basic
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A hurricane swallows a jungle training exercise in Panama, and a DEA investigator must untangle what happened to the soldiers.
Description: When a hurricane hits a US Army base on the edge of the Panama Canal, an elite covert operations team of US Army Rangers recruits are on a routine jungle training exercise that goes horribly awry.

Title: Happy Feet
Hint: An emperor penguin chick who can't carry a tune is born with a gift for tap dancing in Antarctica.
Description: Into the world of the Emperor Penguins, who find their soul mates through song, a penguin is born who cannot sing. But he can tap dance something fierce!

Title: Tango & Cash
Hint: Two rival LA narcotics cops, one slick and one scruffy, are framed for murder and must bust out of prison together.
Description: Ray ___ and Gabriel Cash are two successful narcotics detectives who can't stand each other. Crime lord Yves Perret, furious at the loss of income they have caused him, plots an elaborate revenge against them.

Title: Forsaken
Hint: A gunslinger turned preacher hangs up his pistols to reconcile with his father, until a ruthless gang forces his hand.
Description: John Henry returns to his hometown in hopes of repairing his relationship with his estranged father, but a local gang is terrorizing the town. John Henry is the only one who can stop them, however he has abandoned both his gun and reputation as a fearless quick-draw killer.

Title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
Hint: Mischievous furry creatures multiply and run riot inside a high-tech Manhattan skyscraper run by a media mogul.
Description: Young sweethearts Billy and Kate move to the Big Apple, land jobs in a high-tech office park and soon reunite with the friendly and lovable Gizmo. But a series of accidents creates a whole new generation of ___. The situation worsens when the devilish green creatures invade a top-secret laboratory and develop genetically altered powers, making them even harder to destroy!

Title: Faster
Hint: Freshly out of prison, a getaway driver races down a list of men who betrayed and murdered his brother.
Description: After 10 years in prison, Driver is now a free man with a single focus - hunting down the people responsible for brutally murdering his brother.

Title: DragonHeart
Hint: A disillusioned knight and the last of a wisecracking, fire-breathing species run a monster-slaying scam before joining a revolt.
Description: In an ancient time when majestic fire-breathers soared through the skies, a knight named Bowen comes face to face and heart to heart with the last dragon on Earth, Draco. Taking up arms to suppress a tyrant king, Bowen soon realizes his task will be harder than he'd imagined: If he kills the king, Draco will die as well.

Title: The General's Daughter
Hint: An Army investigator digs into the brutal murder of a high-ranking officer's child on a Georgia base and uncovers a cover-up.
Description: When the body of Army Capt. Elisabeth Campbell is found on a Georgia military base, two investigators, Warrant Officers Paul Brenner and Sara Sunhill, are ordered to solve her murder. What they uncover is anything but clear-cut. Unseemly details emerge about Campbell's life, leading to allegations of a possible military coverup of her death and the involvement of her father, Lt. Gen. Joseph Campbell.

Title: Session 9
Hint: An asbestos removal crew takes a rush job in a derelict mental hospital where old patient tapes start to haunt them.
Description: Tensions rise within an asbestos cleaning crew as they work in an abandoned mental hospital with a horrific past that seems to be coming back.

Title: Repo! The Genetic Opera
Hint: In a gothic future where organs are bought on credit, a sickly girl learns her father repossesses them for a megacorp.
Description: By the year 2056, an epidemic of organ failures has devastated the planet. The megacorporation GeneCo provides organ transplants on a payment plan — and those unable to fulfill their plans have their organs repossessed. In the midst of this, a sickly teenager discovers a shocking secret about herself, her father, and their connection to GeneCo.

Title: Rogue Agent
Hint: A charming British conman poses as an undercover spy to seduce and control his victims for years.
Description: Conman Robert Freegard poses as an undercover MI5 agent and kidnaps countless victims amidst a high-stakes manhunt, until the woman who fell for him brings him to justice.

Title: Stick It
Hint: A rebellious teen BMX rider is sentenced to an elite training academy and shakes up the judged world of competition.
Description: Haley is a naturally gifted athlete but, with her social behavior, the teen seems intent on squandering her abilities. After a final brush with the law, a judge sentences her to an elite gymnastics academy run by a legendary, hard-nosed coach. Once there, Haley's rebellious attitude wins her both friends and enemies.

Title: Wendell & Wild
Hint: Two scheming demon brothers make a deal with a punk orphan girl to escape the underworld, in stop-motion.
Description: Two scheming demons strike a deal with a punk rock-loving teen so they can leave the Underworld and live out their dreams in the Land of the Living.

Title: Darkman
Hint: A scientist left for dead by gangsters rebuilds himself in the shadows, using synthetic skin to wear his enemies' faces.
Description: Dr. Peyton Westlake is on the verge of realizing a major breakthrough in synthetic skin when his laboratory is destroyed by gangsters. Having been burned beyond recognition and forever altered by an experimental medical procedure, Westlake becomes known as ___, assuming alternate identities in his quest for revenge and a new life with a former love.

Title: The Jackal
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Japan, Finland, Russia, Canada
Hint: The FBI frees an imprisoned IRA sniper to help stop a faceless assassin hired to kill a major American target.
Description: Hired by a powerful member of the Russian mafia to avenge an FBI sting that left his brother dead, a psychopathic hitman known only as The ___ proves an elusive target for the people charged with the task of bringing him down: a deputy FBI director, a Russian MVK Major, and a jailed IRA terrorist who can recognize him.

Title: About Fate
Hint: Two strangers, each about to propose to the wrong person, collide on a snowy New Year's Eve.
Description: Two strangers believe in love but never seem to be able to find its true meaning. In a wild twist of events, fate puts each in the other's path on one stormy New Year's Eve.

Title: Baby Boy
Hint: A 20-year-old in South Central LA who still lives with his mom is forced to grow up fast.
Description: The story of Jody, a misguided, 20-year-old African-American who is really just a ___ finally forced-kicking and screaming to face the commitments of real life. Streetwise and jobless, he has not only fathered two children by two different women-Yvette and Peanut but still lives with his own mother. He can't seem to strike a balance or find direction in his chaotic life.

Title: Hardball
Hint: A gambler deep in debt agrees to coach a Little League team from a Chicago housing project for quick cash.
Description: An aimless young man who is scalping tickets, gambling and drinking, agrees to coach a Little League team from the Cabrini Green housing project in Chicago as a condition of getting a loan from a friend.

Title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
Hint: A slingshot-flung feathered crew and their green pig rivals form a truce against a threat from a frozen island.
Description: Red, Chuck, Bomb and the rest of their feathered friends are surprised when a green pig suggests that they put aside their differences and unite to fight a common threat. Aggressive ___ from an island covered in ice are planning to use an elaborate weapon to destroy the fowl and swine.

Title: Star Trek: Insurrection
Hint: A starship crew defies their own superiors to defend a peaceful planet whose radiation keeps its people young.
Description: When an alien race and factions within Starfleet attempt to take over a planet that has "regenerative" properties, it falls upon Captain Picard and the crew of the Enterprise to defend the planet's people as well as the very ideals upon which the Federation itself was founded.

Title: Bad Samaritan
Hint: A valet who burgles his customers' homes finds a woman chained up inside a rich client's house.
Description: A thief makes a disturbing discovery in the house where he breaks in. Later, when he returns to the same house with his partner in crime, things are no longer how he expected.

Title: Beat the Devil
Country: Italy, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A ragtag gang of swindlers waits out a stalled voyage to Africa, bluffing their way toward a uranium fortune.
Description: A group of con artists stake their claim on a bogus uranium mine.

Title: Fat Girl
Hint: A sullen 12-year-old watches enviously as her pretty older sister is seduced during a seaside family holiday.
Description: Anaïs is twelve and bears the weight of the world on her shoulders. She watches her older sister, Elena, whom she both loves and hates. Elena is fifteen and devilishly beautiful. Neither more futile, nor more stupid than her younger sister, she cannot understand that she is merely an object of desire. And, as such, she can only be taken. Or had. Indeed, this is the subject: a girl's loss of virginity.

Title: Hellbound: Hellraiser II
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young woman in a psychiatric hospital is dragged back into a hellish labyrinth of pain and pleasure.
Description: Now confined to a mental hospital, young Kirsty insists her supposedly dead father is actually stuck in Hell following his wife’s betrayal. Few believe the young woman’s lurid stories aside from the thrill-seeking Dr. Channard. Kirsty is undeterred and, with the help of a fellow patient, heads to Hell for a rescue.

Title: City of Ember
Hint: Two teens race to decode an old message and find a way out of an underground city whose lights are dying.
Description: For generations, the people of the ___ have flourished in an amazing world of glittering lights. But ___ once powerful generator is failing and the great lamps that illuminate the city are starting to flicker. Now, two teenagers, in a race against time, must search ___ for clues that will unlock the ancient mystery of the city's existence, before the the lights go out forever.

Title: The Messenger: The Story of Joan of Arc
Hint: A visionary teenage peasant claims to hear voices from God and leads the French army against the English.
Description: In 1429, a French teenager stood before her King with a message she claimed came from God; that she would defeat the world's greatest army and liberate her country from its political and religious turmoil. As she reclaims God's diminished kingdom, this courageous young woman has various amazing victories until her violent and untimely death.

Title: Black Sea
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Russia
Hint: A laid-off submarine captain assembles a mixed British-Russian crew to hunt for sunken Nazi gold.
Description: A rogue submarine captain pulls together a misfit crew to go after a sunken treasure rumored to be lost in the depths of the ___. As greed and desperation take control on-board their claustrophobic vessel, the increasing uncertainty of the mission causes the men to turn on each other.

Title: The Mothman Prophecies
Hint: A grieving reporter is drawn to a West Virginia town where people report a winged creature foretelling disaster.
Description: Reporter John Klein is plunged into a world of impossible terror when fate draws him to the sleepy West Virginia town of Point Pleasant, whose residents are being visited by a great winged shape that sows hideous nightmares and fevered visions.

Title: The Swan Princess
Hint: An animated royal bride-to-be is cursed by an evil sorcerer to become a white bird by day, until true love breaks the spell.
Description: The beautiful princess Odette is transformed into a ___ by an evil sorcerer's spell. Held captive at an enchanted lake, she befriends Jean-Bob the frog, Speed the turtle and Puffin the bird. Despite their struggle to keep the princess safe, these good-natured creatures can do nothing about the sorcerer's spell, which can only be broken by a vow of everlasting love.

Title: Black Death
Hint: In plague-ravaged medieval England, a young monk guides a knight to a village rumoured to be untouched by the disease.
Description: As the plague decimates medieval Europe, rumours circulate of a village immune from the plague. There is talk of a necromancer who leads the village and is able to raise the dead. A fearsome knight joined by a cohort of soldiers and a young monk are charged by the church to investigate. Their journey is filled with danger, but it's upon entering the village that their true horror begins.

Title: Horns
Hint: Accused of killing his girlfriend, a young man wakes up with devilish growths that make people confess their sins.
Description: In the aftermath of his girlfriend's mysterious death, a young man awakens to strange ___ sprouting from his temples.

Title: The Slammin' Salmon
Hint: A brutish ex-boxer turned restaurant owner demands his waiters earn him a fortune in a single shift.
Description: The brutal former heavyweight boxing champion Cleon "___'" ___ (Duncan), now owner of a Miami restaurant, institutes a competition to see which waiter can earn the most money in one night: the winner stands to gain $10,000, while the loser will endure a beating at the hands of the champ.

Title: Less Than Zero
Hint: A college freshman comes home to Beverly Hills for Christmas to find his friends lost to cocaine and debt.
Description: A college freshman returns to Los Angeles for Christmas at his ex-girlfriend's request, but discovers that his former best friend has an out-of-control drug habit.

Title: The Starling
Hint: Grieving after a loss, a woman wages a comic battle with a feisty bird nesting in her garden.
Description: A woman adjusting to life after a loss contends with a feisty bird that's taken over her garden — and a husband who's struggling to find a way forward.

Title: Tale of Tales
Hint: Three dark, lavish Italian fables, featuring a sea monster's heart, a giant pet flea and an old woman's wish to be young.
Description: The Queen of Selvascura risks everything to be a mother; the King of Roccaforte falls in love with the voice of a mysterious girl; the King of Altomonte becomes obsessed with a flea and neglects his daughter.

Title: It Could Happen to You
Hint: A cop promises a waitress half of his lottery ticket, and wins.
Description: Charlie Lang is a simple, kindhearted New York City cop. When he realizes he has no money to tip waitress Yvonne Biasi, Lang offers her half the winnings of his lottery ticket. Amazingly, the ticket happens to be a winner, in the sum of $4 million. True to his word, Lang proceeds to share the prize money with Biasi, which infuriates his greedy wife, Muriel.

Title: Compliance
Hint: A fast-food manager is manipulated by a prank caller posing as a police officer, with disturbing results.
Description: On a particularly busy day at a suburban Ohio fast food restaurant, manager Sandra receives a phone call from a police officer saying that an employee has stolen money from a customer.

Title: On the Rocks
Hint: A young New York mother suspects her husband is cheating and teams up with her playboy dad to tail him.
Description: Faced with sudden doubts about her marriage, a young New York mother teams up with her larger-than-life playboy father to tail her husband.

Title: Star Trek: Nemesis
Hint: A starship crew faces a clone of their captain who has seized power in a hostile empire.
Description: En route to the honeymoon of William Riker to Deanna Troi on her home planet of Betazed, Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise receives word from Starfleet that a coup has resulted in the installation of a new Romulan political leader, Shinzon, who claims to seek peace with the human-backed United Federation of Planets.

Title: Kill Your Darlings
Hint: A 1944 murder in New York draws together the young poets who would launch a literary revolution.
Description: A murder in 1944 draws together the great poets of the beat generation: Allen Ginsberg, Jack Kerouac and William Burroughs.

Title: Urban Cowboy
Hint: A country boy moves to the Texas city and falls for a girl at a honky-tonk bar with a mechanical bull.
Description: After moving to Pasadena, Texas, country boy Bud Davis starts hanging around a bar called Gilley's, where he falls in love with Sissy, a cowgirl who believes the sexes are equal. They eventually marry, but their relationship is turbulent due to Bud's traditional view of gender roles.

Title: Kate & Leopold
Hint: A 19th-century duke slips through a time portal into modern Manhattan and falls for a career woman.
Description: When her scientist ex-boyfriend discovers a portal to travel through time -- and brings back a 19th-century nobleman named ___ to prove it -- a skeptical ___ reluctantly takes responsibility for showing ___ the 21st century. The more time ___ spends with ___, the harder she falls for him. But if he doesn't return to his own time, his absence will forever alter history.

Title: The Mountain Between Us
Hint: Two strangers survive a small plane crash in the snowy wilderness and must trek out together with only a dog.
Description: Stranded on a ___ after a tragic plane crash, two strangers must work together to endure the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. When they realize help is not coming, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles of wilderness, pushing each other to survive and discovering their inner strength.

Title: The Omega Man
Hint: A scientist believes himself the last man alive in Los Angeles, fighting a cult of albino plague survivors.
Description: Due to an experimental vaccine, Dr. Robert Neville is the only human survivor of an apocalyptic war waged with biological weapons. Besides him, only a few hundred deformed, nocturnal people remain; sensitive to light, and homicidally psychotic.

Title: The Secret Life of Pets 2
Hint: The pampered animals of a Manhattan apartment face new challenges in the city and on a farm.
Description: Max the terrier must cope with some major life changes when his owner gets married and has a baby. When the family takes a trip to the countryside, nervous Max has numerous run-ins with canine-intolerant cows, hostile foxes and a scary turkey. Luckily for Max, he soon catches a break when he meets Rooster, a gruff farm dog who tries to cure the lovable pooch of his neuroses.

Title: Mary Shelley
Country: Ireland, Luxembourg, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A teenage girl's scandalous romance with a poet inspires her to write the most famous monster story of all time.
Description: The love affair between poet Percy ___ Wollstonecraft Godwin resulted in the creation of an immortal novel, “Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus.”

Title: Dirty Work
Hint: Two unemployed buddies start a revenge-for-hire business to raise money for a heart operation.
Description: Unemployed and recently dumped, Mitch and his buddy Sam start a revenge-for-hire business to raise the $50,000 that Sam's father needs to get a heart transplant.

Title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
Country: Italy, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Young lovers, bumbling actors and quarrelling fairies get tangled up in an enchanted forest in this starry Shakespeare romp.
Description: The lovely Hermia is to wed Demetrius, but she truly cares for Lysander. Hermia's friend, Helena, is in love with Demetrius, while other romantic entanglements abound in the woods, with married fairy rulers Titania and Oberon toying with various lovers and each other.

Title: Sputnik
Hint: A Soviet psychiatrist studies a cosmonaut who came back from space with something living inside him.
Description: At the height of the Cold War, a Soviet spacecraft crash lands after a mission gone awry, leaving the commander as its only survivor. After a renowned Russian psychologist is brought in to evaluate the commander’s mental state, it becomes clear that something dangerous may have come back to Earth with him…

Title: Pacific Heights
Hint: A San Francisco couple's dream house turns nightmare when a sinister tenant refuses to pay and won't leave.
Description: A couple works hard to renovate their dream house and become landlords to pay for it. Unfortunately one of their tenants has plans of his own.

Title: The Adventures of Ford Fairlane
Hint: A loudmouth, ladies-man private eye investigates a heavy metal star's murder in the LA music scene.
Description: To the Los Angeles elite, ___ is known as "Mr. Rock 'n' Roll Detective." This loudmouthed ladies' man serves an exclusive rock star clientele, who depend on his keen eye and smug discretion. So when a heavy-metal musician dies mid-concert, ___ is on the case before the lights come up.

Title: Phenomenon
Hint: An ordinary small-town mechanic gains genius and telekinesis after seeing a bright light in the sky.
Description: An ordinary man sees a bright light descend from the sky, and discovers he now has super-intelligence and telekinesis.

Title: Maniac
Hint: A disturbed loner stalks the New York streets at night, killing young women and collecting their scalps.
Description: A psychotic man, troubled by his childhood abuse, kills and mutilates young women and local models on the streets of New York City.

Title: Certain Women
Hint: Three women in small-town Montana quietly struggle against the limits of their lives.
Description: Three strong-willed women strive to forge their own paths amidst the wide-open plains of the American Northwest: a lawyer forced to subdue a troubled client; a wife and mother whose plans to construct her dream home reveal fissures in her marriage; and a lonely ranch hand who forms an ambiguous bond with a young law student.

Title: Inventing the Abbotts
Hint: Two working-class brothers in a 1950s Illinois town become involved with three rich sisters.
Description: In the 1950s, brothers Jacey and Doug Holt, who come from the poorer side of their sleepy Midwestern town, vie for the affections of the wealthy, lovely Abbott sisters. Lady-killer Jacey alternates between Eleanor and Alice, wanting simply to break the hearts of rich young women. But sensitive Doug has a real romance with Pamela, which Jacey and the Abbott patriarch, Lloyd, both frown upon.

Title: Mayhem
Hint: A virus sweeps through a corporate office, causing workers to act on every violent and sexual impulse.
Description: A virus spreads through an office complex causing white collar workers to act out their worst impulses.

Title: Unsane
Hint: A woman unwittingly commits herself to a mental hospital and starts to suspect her stalker works there.
Description: A woman is involuntarily committed to a mental institution where she is confronted by her greatest fear.

Title: Creep 2
Hint: A videographer answers an online ad and finds herself filming a self-proclaimed serial killer.
Description: After finding an ad online for “video work,” Sara, a video artist whose primary focus is creating intimacy with lonely men, thinks she may have found the subject of her dreams. She drives to a remote house in the forest and meets a man claiming to be a serial killer. Unable to resist the chance to create a truly shocking piece of art, she agrees to spend the day with him.

Title: Unlawful Entry
Hint: A couple calls the police after a break-in, and the friendly officer who responds becomes obsessed with the wife.
Description: Happily married Michael and Karen Carr call the police after Karen is held at knife point during a failed robbery attempt in their home. Before long, one of the responding officers, Officer Pete Davis, helps arrange the installation of a new security system, taking extra interest in the couple's case. As a result, the grateful Carrs invite him to stay for dinner and they strike up an unexpected friendship.

Title: Jamón, Jamón
Hint: A rich mother hires a hunky underwear model to seduce her son's pregnant girlfriend.
Description: José Luis has a cushy corporate job at the lingerie factory his mom owns. After he falls in love and proposes to Silvia, a beautiful laborer on the underwear assembly line, his mom enlists Raul, a potential underwear model and would-be bullfighter, to seduce Silvia.

Title: The Personal History of David Copperfield
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A colourful, comic retelling of a Victorian orphan's rise from poverty to writer.
Description: A fresh and distinctive take on Charles Dickens’ semi-autobiographical masterpiece, The ___, set in the 1840s, chronicles the life of its iconic title character as he navigates a chaotic world to find his elusive place within it.

Title: A Boy and His Dog
Hint: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a horny teen scavenger and his telepathic canine companion search for food and women.
Description: Set in the year 2024 in post-apocalyptic America, 18-year old Vic and his telepathic dog, Blood, are scavengers in the desolate wilderness ravaged by World War IV, where survivors must battle for food and shelter in the desert-like wasteland. Vic and Blood eke out a meager existence, foraging for food and fighting gangs of cutthroats.

Title: When a Stranger Calls
Hint: A teen babysitter alone in a big house is tormented by an anonymous voice on the phone asking about the children.
Description: A student babysitter has her evening disturbed when the phone rings. So begins a series of increasingly terrifying and threatening ___ that lead to a shocking revelation.

Title: Cyrano
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A poet with a tender heart helps another man woo the woman he loves, in a lush musical.
Description: A man ahead of his time, ___ de Bergerac dazzles whether with ferocious wordplay at a verbal joust or with brilliant swordplay in a duel. But, convinced that his appearance renders him unworthy of the love of a devoted friend, the luminous Roxanne, ___ has yet to declare his feelings for her—and Roxanne has fallen in love, at first sight, with Christian.

Title: When We First Met
Hint: A heartsick guy uses a magic photo booth to relive the evening he first saw his crush, trying again and again.
Description: Using a magical photo booth that sends him back in time, Noah relives the night he met Avery over and over, trying to persuade her to fall for him.

Title: Step Up Revolution
Hint: A crew of dancers stages flash mobs across Miami to protest a developer's plans to bulldoze their neighbourhood.
Description: Emily arrives in Miami with aspirations to become a professional dancer. She sparks with Sean, the leader of a dance crew whose neighborhood is threatened by Emily's father's development plans.

Title: Batman: The Killing Joke
Hint: A clown-faced villain tries to drive a police commissioner insane in this dark animated superhero story.
Description: As ___ hunts for the escaped Joker, the Clown Prince of Crime attacks the Gordon family to prove a diabolical point mirroring his own fall into madness.

Title: The Housemaid
Hint: A composer's family hires a young maid who begins a sinister, destructive affair with him in this Korean classic.
Description: A piano composer's family moves into a new house; when his pregnant wife collapses from working to support the family, he hires a ___ to help with housework.

Title: Stand Up Guys
Hint: Two aging gangsters reunite for one last night of fun before one has to kill the other.
Description: After serving 28 years in prison for accidentally killing the son of a crime boss, newly paroled gangster Val reunites with his former partners in crime, Doc and Hirsch, for a night on the town.

Title: Son of a Gun
Hint: A 19-year-old in prison is taken under the wing of a criminal mastermind.
Description: Locked up for a minor crime, 19 year old JR quickly learns the harsh realities of prison life. Protection, if you can get it, is paramount. JR soon finds himself under the watchful eye of Australia's most notorious criminal, Brendan Lynch, but protection comes at a price.

Title: Hours
Hint: A father struggles to keep his newborn alive on a ventilator in a hospital as Hurricane Katrina hits.
Description: A father struggles to keep his infant daughter alive in the wake of Hurricane Katrina.

Title: Burnt Offerings
Hint: A family spends the summer at a huge old mansion that seems to feed on its residents.
Description: A family moves into a large old mansion in the countryside which seems to have a mysterious and sinister power over its new residents.

Title: 1492: Conquest of Paradise
Hint: An explorer's epic 15th-century voyage across the Atlantic, and the brutal toll his arrival takes on the islands he claims.
Description: ___ depicts Christopher Columbus’ discovery of The New World and his effect on the indigenous people.

Title: War Room
Hint: A struggling family's marriage and finances are transformed when an elderly woman teaches them about prayer.
Description: The family-friendly movie explores the transformational role prayer plays in the lives of the Jordan family. Tony and Elizabeth Jordan, a middle-class couple who seemingly have it all – great jobs, a beautiful daughter, their dream home. But appearances can be deceiving. In reality, the Jordan’s marriage has become a war zone and their daughter is collateral damage.

Title: Spies Like Us
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Two bumbling government employees are sent as decoy agents to the Soviet Union as part of a nuclear plot.
Description: Two bumbling government employees think they are U.S. ___, only to discover that they are actually decoys for nuclear war.

Title: The Man with the Iron Heart
Country: Belgium, France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Czech resistance fighters plot to assassinate one of the most powerful Nazis in occupied Prague.
Description: With the Third Reich at its peak in 1942, the Czech resistance in London plans the most ambitious military operation of WWII – Anthropoid. Two young recruits are sent to Prague to assassinate the most ruthless Nazi leader – Reinhard Heydrich, head of the Reich Security Main Office, the Gestapo and the architect of the Final Solution.

Title: Beach Rats
Hint: An aimless Brooklyn teenager struggles with his sexuality, hanging out on the boardwalk and meeting older men online.
Description: On the outskirts of Brooklyn, Frankie, an aimless teenager, suffocates under the oppressive glare cast by his family and a toxic group of delinquent friends. Struggling with his own identity, Frankie begins to scour hookup sites for older men.

Title: How to Lose Friends & Alienate People
Hint: A clumsy British journalist joins a glossy celebrity magazine in New York and offends everyone he meets.
Description: Sidney Young is a down-on-his-luck journalist. Thanks to a stint involving a pig and a glitzy awards ceremony, Sidney turns his fortunes around, attracting the attention of Clayton Harding, editor of New York-based glossy magazine 'Sharps', and landing the holy grail of journalism jobs. The Brit jets off to the Big Apple and moves from one blunder to the next.

Title: The Serpent and the Rainbow
Country: United States of America, Haiti, Dominican Republic
Hint: An anthropologist travels to Haiti to investigate a powder said to turn people into zombies.
Description: A Harvard anthropologist is sent to Haiti to retrieve a strange powder that is said to have the power to bring human beings back from the dead. In his quest to find the miracle drug, the cynical scientist enters the rarely seen netherworld of walking zombies, blood rites and ancient curses.

Title: Injustice
Hint: After a tragedy, the world's mightiest superhero turns tyrant and seizes control of Earth in animated form.
Description: When Lois Lane is killed, an unhinged Superman decides to take control of the Earth. Determined to stop him, Batman creates a team of freedom-fighting heroes. But when superheroes go to war, can the world survive?

Title: Crazy/Beautiful
Hint: A Latino student falls hard for a troubled rich girl from a Pacific Palisades family.
Description: At Pacific Palisades High, a poor Latino falls hard for a troubled girl from the affluent neighborhood.

Title: Rules of Engagement
Hint: A Marine colonel is court-martialled after ordering his men to fire on protesters.
Description: A Marine Colonel is brought to court-martial after ordering his men to fire on demonstrators surrounding the American embassy in Yemen.

Title: Mississippi Grind
Hint: Two gamblers, a veteran and a young drifter, road trip down the river, chasing a big score.
Description: Gerry is a talented but down-on-his-luck gambler whose fortunes begin to change when he meets Curtis, a younger, highly charismatic poker player. The two strike up an immediate friendship and Gerry quickly persuades his new friend to accompany him on a road trip to a legendary high stakes poker game in New Orleans.

Title: Best of the Best
Hint: A team of American martial artists trains for a high-stakes taekwondo tournament against Korea.
Description: A team from the United States is going to compete against Korea in a Tae Kwon Do tournament. The team consists of fighters from all over the country--can they overcome their rivalry and work together to win?

Title: Brokedown Palace
Hint: Two best friends on a graduation trip to Thailand are framed for drug smuggling.
Description: Best friends Alice and Darlene take a trip to Thailand after graduating high school. In Thailand, they meet a captivating Australian man, who calls himself Nick Parks. Darlene is particularly smitten with Nick and convinces Alice to take Nick up on his offer to treat the two of them to what amounts to a day trip to Hong Kong.

Title: The Good Girl
Country: Netherlands, Germany, United States of America
Hint: A bored discount store clerk in Texas has an affair with a young stockboy who believes he's a literary hero.
Description: A discount store clerk strikes up an affair with a stock boy who considers himself the incarnation of Holden Caulfield.

Title: From Paris with Love
Hint: An ambassador's aide in the French capital teams up with a loose-cannon American agent to stop a terrorist attack.
Description: James Reese has a good job as an ambassador's aid in France, but his real passion is a side gig—working in a minor role in the CIA. He would love to be a full-fledged agent and can't believe his luck when he lands an assignment with Charlie Wax.

Title: Factory Girl
Hint: A wealthy debutante becomes the muse of the pop art scene in 1960s New York, and burns out fast.
Description: In the mid-1960s, wealthy debutant Edie Sedgwick meets artist Andy Warhol. She joins Warhol's famous ___ and becomes his muse. Although she seems to have it all, Edie cannot have the love she craves from Andy, and she has an affair with a charismatic musician, who pushes her to seek independence from the artist and the milieu.

Title: Mean Machine
Hint: A disgraced ex-England football captain is jailed and coaches the inmates in a match against the guards.
Description: Disgraced ex-England football captain, Danny '___' Meehan, is thrown in jail for assaulting two police officers. He keeps his head down and has the opportunity to forget everything and change the lives of the prisoners. When these prisoners have the chance to put one over the evil guards during a prison football match, Danny takes the lead.

Title: Cake
Hint: A woman with chronic pain becomes fascinated by a support group member's suicide and her grieving widower.
Description: After having visions of a member of her support group who killed herself, a woman who also suffers with chronic pain seeks out the widower of the suicide.

Title: Blood Father
Hint: An ex-con biker protects his estranged teenage daughter from a drug cartel.
Description: An ex-con reconnects with his estranged teenage daughter while fighting to keep her alive after she becomes a target of violent drug dealers.

Title: Tin Cup
Hint: A washed-up golf pro tries to qualify for the US Open to win the heart of his rival's girlfriend.
Description: A washed up golf pro working at a driving range tries to qualify for the US Open in order to win the heart of his succesful rival's girlfriend.

Title: Into the Night
Genres: Thriller, Comedy, Action, Crime, Drama, Romance
Hint: An insomniac engineer gets mixed up with a mysterious woman fleeing jewel smugglers in Los Angeles.
Description: Ed Okin used to have a boring life. He used to have trouble getting to sleep. Then one night, he met Diana. Now, Ed's having trouble staying alive.

Title: Brainstorm
Hint: Scientists invent a device that records and replays human experiences, including death.
Description: Two brilliant research scientists have invented a device capable of recording and playing back sensory experiences only to have devastating results when one of them records their own death.

Title: Tarantula
Hint: A giant, lab-grown spider escapes into the Arizona desert, threatening a small town.
Description: A rogue scientist near a small desert town arouses the suspicion of the town's doctor when his lab assistant is found dead from a case of acromegaly, which took only four days to develop. As the doctor investigates, aided by the scientist's new female assistant, they discover that something is devouring local cattle and humans in increasingly large quantities.

Title: Soul Men
Hint: Two former backup singers who haven't spoken in years reunite for a tribute concert to their late frontman.
Description: Two former backup soul singers, Louis and Floyd, have not spoken to each other in 20 years, and reluctantly agree to travel across the country together to a reunion concert to honor their recently-deceased lead singer. Cleo, a beautiful young woman who is believed to be Floyd's daughter, accompanies them as a new singer.

Title: The Night Before
Hint: Three childhood friends spend one last wild Christmas Eve together in New York.
Description: In New York City for their annual tradition of Christmas Eve debauchery, three lifelong best friends set out to find the Holy Grail of Christmas parties since their yearly reunion might be coming to an end.

Title: Laggies
Hint: A 28-year-old in a quarter-life crisis hides out with a teenager she meets outside a liquor store.
Description: Overeducated and underemployed, 28 year old Megan is in the throes of a quarterlife crisis. Squarely into adulthood with no career prospects, no particular motivation to think about her future and no one to relate to, Megan is comfortable lagging a few steps behind - while her friends check off milestones and celebrate their new grown-up status.

Title: Every Day
Country: Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A teen girl falls for a soul that wakes up in a different person's body each morning.
Description: 16-year old Rhiannon falls in love with a mysterious spirit named “A” that inhabits a different body ___. Feeling an unmatched connection, Rhiannon and “A” work each day to find each other, not knowing what the next day will bring.

Title: The Package
Hint: An accident on a camping trip sets off a race to save a friend's severed body part.
Description: When a group of teenagers goes on a spring break camping trip, an unfortunate accident sets off a race to save their friend’s most prized possession.

Title: Ashby
Hint: A new kid at school befriends a mysterious old man who turns out to be a retired CIA assassin.
Description: When new kid in town Ed Wallis is given an assignment to interview an older person, he turns to his mysterious neighbor, ___ Holt for help. That new connection leads to unexpected journeys for both of them, as ___ – who turns out to be a retired CIA assassin – deals with a terminal prognosis, and Ed deals with adjusting to life with his newly single mom and developing relationship with a brainy classmate, Eloise.

Title: Criminal
Country: Bulgaria, France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A dangerous convict is implanted with a dead CIA agent's memories to finish his mission.
Description: CIA Agent Bill Pope is on a mission to track down a shadowy hacker named 'The Dutchman'. When he gets mysteriously killed, an experimental procedure transfers his memories into a dangerous ex-convict. When he wakes up Pope's memories, his mission is to eliminate The Dutchman before the hacker launches ICBMs and starts World War III.

Title: Billy Madison
Hint: A spoiled heir must repeat grades 1-12 to inherit his father's hotel empire.
Description: ___ is the 27 year-old son of Bryan ___, a very rich man who has made his living in the hotel industry. ___ stands to inherit his father's empire, but only if he can make it through all 12 grades, 2 weeks per grade, to prove that he has what it takes to run the family business.

Title: Devil
Hint: Five strangers are trapped in a stalled office-tower elevator, and one of them is pure evil in disguise.
Description: A group of people are trapped in an elevator high above Philadelphia, and one of them is the ___.

Title: Vacation Friends
Hint: A straight-laced couple's wild party pals from a Mexican resort crash their wedding weekend.
Description: When a straight-laced couple that has fun with a rowdy couple on vacation in Mexico return to the States, they discover that the crazy couple they met in Mexico followed them back home and decide to play tricks on them.

Title: Knight and Day
Hint: A woman gets caught up with a charming spy on the run from his own agency.
Description: A fugitive couple goes on a glamorous and sometimes deadly adventure where nothing and no one – even themselves – are what they seem. Amid shifting alliances and unexpected betrayals, they race across the globe, with their survival ultimately hinging on the battle of truth vs. trust.

Title: Maze Runner: The Scorch Trials
Hint: Teens escape their mazelike prison and cross a scorched desert wasteland to find refuge.
Description: Thomas and his fellow Gladers face their greatest challenge yet: searching for clues about the mysterious and powerful organization known as WCKD. Their journey takes them to the ___, a desolate landscape filled with unimaginable obstacles. Teaming up with resistance fighters, the Gladers take on WCKD’s vastly superior forces and uncover its shocking plans for them all.

Title: Ella Enchanted
Hint: A girl cursed with obedience sets off on a quest to break the spell in a fairy-tale land.
Description: ___ lives in a magical world in which each child, at the moment of their birth, is given a virtuous "gift" from a fairy godmother. ___ so-called gift, however, is obedience. This birthright proves itself to be quite the curse once ___ finds herself in the hands of several unscrupulous characters whom she quite literally cannot disobey.

Title: Surrogates
Hint: People live through flawless robot stand-ins until an FBI agent must go out in his own flesh to solve a murder.
Description: Set in a futuristic world where humans live in isolation and interact through surrogate robots, a cop is forced to leave his home for the first time in years in order to investigate the murders of others' ___.

Title: Shrek Forever After
Hint: A grouchy green ogre makes a deal with a trickster to relive one day of his old life.
Description: A midlife-crisis burdened ___, longing for the days when he felt like a real ogre, makes a pact with magic deal-maker Rumpelstiltskin. But when he's duped and sent to a twisted version of Far Far Away—where Rumpelstiltskin is king, ogres are hunted, and he and Fiona have never met—he sets out to restore his world and reclaim his true love.

Title: Convoy
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Truckers linked by CB radio form a mile-long protest rolling across the Southwest to escape a corrupt sheriff.
Description: Trucker Rubber Duck and his buddies Pig Pen, Widow Woman and Spider Mike use their CB radios to warn one another of the presence of cops. But conniving Sheriff Wallace is hip to the truckers' tactics, and begins tricking the drivers through his own CB broadcasts. Facing constant harassment from the law, Rubber Duck and his pals use their radios to coordinate a vast ___ and rule the road.

Title: Triple 9
Hint: A gang of corrupt cops plans to kill a fellow officer to cover a heist.
Description: A gang of criminals and corrupt cops plan the murder of a police officer in order to pull off their biggest heist yet across town.

Title: Annette
Country: Belgium, France, Germany, Greece, Japan, Mexico, Switzerland
Hint: An edgy comedian and an opera singer have a daughter with a gift, in a dark rock musical.
Description: In present-day Los Angeles, controversial stand-up comedian Henry McHenry and internationally renowned opera singer Ann Defrasnoux form the façade of a happy couple in the spotlight. Ann gives birth to a baby girl named ___, who possesses an exceptional gift that will change all of their lives forever.

Title: Loving Pablo
Hint: A journalist's affair with the world's most feared drug lord, from his rise to his fall.
Description: The film chronicles the rise and fall of the world's most feared drug lord ___ Escobar and his volatile love affair with Colombia's most famous journalist Virginia Vallejo throughout a reign of terror that tore a country apart.

Title: A Life Less Ordinary
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Angels try to make a kidnapper and his heiress hostage fall in love.
Description: A couple of angels, O'Reilly and Jackson, are sent to Earth to make sure that their next supervised love-connection succeeds. They follow Celine, a spoiled rich girl who has just accidentally shot a suitor and, due to a misunderstanding, is kidnapped by janitor Robert. Although Celine quickly frees herself, she stays with Robert for thrills. O'Reilly and Jackson pursue, hoping to unite the prospective lovers.

Title: Mulholland Falls
Hint: A special LAPD squad investigates a young woman's death in 1950s Los Angeles.
Description: In 1950s Los Angeles, a special crime squad of the LAPD investigates the murder of a young woman.

Title: Two Night Stand
Hint: A casual hookup is stretched out when a blizzard traps two strangers in a New York apartment.
Description: After an extremely regrettable one night stand, two strangers wake up to find themselves snowed in after sleeping through a blizzard that put all of Manhattan on ice. They're now trapped together in a tiny apartment, forced to get to know each other way more than any one night stand should.

Title: Upside Down
Hint: Lovers from two worlds with opposite gravity try to reach each other.
Description: In an alternate universe where twinned worlds have opposite gravities, a young man battles interplanetary prejudice and the laws of physics in his quest to reunite with the long-lost girl of his dreams in this visually stunning romantic adventure that poses the question: what if love was stronger than gravity?

Title: Dreamscape
Hint: A young psychic enters people's dreams to cure nightmares and uncovers a plot to kill the president.
Description: In order to diagnose the psychic traumas suffered by his patients, Dr. Paul Novotny gets young Alex Gardner to enter their dreams.

Title: Tideland
Hint: A girl lives in a fantasy world after her junkie parents die on a remote prairie farm.
Description: Because of the actions of her irresponsible parents, a young girl is left alone on a decrepit country estate and survives inside her fantastic imagination.

Title: The Jazz Singer
Hint: A young Jewish man chooses Broadway over his family's cantor tradition in the first talkie.
Description: A young Jewish man is torn between tradition and individuality when his old-fashioned family objects to his career as a ___. This is the first full length feature film to use synchronized sound, and is the original film musical.

Title: Choke
Hint: A sex-addicted con man fakes choking in restaurants to pay his mother's hospital bills.
Description: A sex-addicted con-man pays for his mother's hospital bills by playing on the sympathies of those who rescue him from choking to death.

Title: Final Fantasy: The Spirits Within
Genres: Action, Adventure, Animation, Fantasy, Science Fiction
Hint: A scientist searches for alien energies to save a ravaged Earth in this photorealistic animation.
Description: Led by a strange dream, scientist Aki Ross struggles to collect the eight ___ in the hope of creating a force powerful enough to protect the planet. With the aid of the Deep Eyes Squadron and her mentor, Dr. Sid, Aki must save the Earth from its darkest hate and unleash the ___.

Title: In & Out
Hint: A Midwestern teacher is outed by a former student at the Oscars.
Description: A midwestern teacher questions his sexuality after a former student makes a comment about him at the Academy Awards.

Title: The Gauntlet
Hint: A burnt-out cop escorts a witness across Arizona while both the mob and the police try to stop them.
Description: Phoenix cop Ben Shockley is well on his way to becoming a derelict when he is assigned to transport a witness from Las Vegas. The witness turns out to be a belligerent prostitute with mob ties—and incriminating information regarding a high-ranking official.

Title: Muppets Most Wanted
Hint: The felt-and-fur gang are framed by a criminal frog lookalike during a European tour.
Description: While on a grand world tour, The ___ find themselves wrapped into an European jewel-heist caper headed by a Kermit the Frog look-alike and his dastardly sidekick.

Title: Live by Night
Hint: Boston gangsters set up shop in Florida during Prohibition and face the Klan.
Description: A group of Boston-bred gangsters set up shop in balmy Florida during the Prohibition era, facing off against the competition and the Ku Klux Klan.

Title: The Awakening
Hint: A ghost hunter investigates a haunting at a remote English boarding school after the Great War.
Description: In post–War England, a writer and sometime-ghost hunter investigates a reported haunting at a boys boarding school.

Title: The Iron Lady
Hint: A retired British prime minister reflects on her career, power and marriage.
Description: A look at the life of Margaret Thatcher, the former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, with a focus on the price she paid for power.

Title: Alice, Sweet Alice
Hint: A 12-year-old girl is suspected of murdering her sister at her First Communion.
