Description: ___ is a withdrawn 12-year-old who lives with her mother and her younger sister, Karen, who gets most of the attention from her mother, leaving ___ out of the spotlight. When Karen is found brutally murdered in a church, suspicions start to turn toward ___. But could a 12-year-old girl really be capable of such savagery?

Title: Under Suspicion
Hint: A lawyer is interrogated about a murder on the night of a San Juan festival.
Description: A lawyer is asked to come to the police station to clear up a few loose ends in his witness report of a foul murder. "This will only take ten minutes", they say, but it turns out to be one loose end after another, and the ten minutes he is away from his speech become longer and longer.

Title: Contraband
Hint: A former smuggler takes one last job to save his brother-in-law.
Description: When his brother-in-law runs afoul of a drug lord, family man Chris Farraday turns to a skill he abandoned long ago—smuggling—to repay the debt. But the job goes wrong, and Farraday finds himself wanted by cops, crooks and killers alike.

Title: Blue Thunder
Hint: A traumatised Vietnam vet flies a state-of-the-art police attack helicopter over LA and uncovers a sinister government plan.
Description: Los Angeles, California. Officer Murphy, a veteran Metropolitan Police helicopter pilot suffering from severe trauma due to his harsh experiences during the Vietnam War, and Lymangood, his resourceful new partner, are tasked with testing an advanced and heavily armed experimental chopper known as ___.

Title: Charlie St. Cloud
Hint: A small-town sailor who survived the crash that killed his little brother still meets the boy's ghost every sunset.
Description: Accomplished sailor ___ has the adoration of his mother Claire and his little brother Sam, as well as a college scholarship that will lead him far from his sleepy Pacific Northwest hometown. But his bright future is cut short when tragedy strikes and takes his dreams with it.

Title: Love in the Time of Cholera
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: In Colombia, a lovesick poet waits more than fifty years for the woman who married a doctor instead of him.
Description: In Colombia just after the Great War, an old man falls from a ladder; dying, he professes great love for his wife. After the funeral, a man calls on the widow - she dismisses him angrily. Flash back more than 50 years to the day Florentino Ariza, a telegraph boy, falls in love with Fermina Daza, the daughter of a mule trader.

Title: Remo Williams: The Adventure Begins
Hint: A tough New York cop is given a new face and trained by an elderly Korean master to become a secret assassin.
Description: Tough Brooklyn street cop Sam Makin is unwillingly recruited as an assassin for a secret United States organization known as CURE, who fake his death and give him a new identity: ___. With his appearance surgically altered, ___ is trained to be a human killing machine by his aged, derisive and impassive Korean martial arts master Chiun.

Title: Thanks for Sharing
Hint: Three people in a sex addiction recovery group try to stay on track while navigating love and temptation in New York.
Description: A romantic comedy that brings together three disparate characters who are learning to face a challenging and often confusing world as they struggle together against a common demon—sex addiction.

Title: The Last Kiss
Hint: A man about to turn 30 panics about settling down with his pregnant girlfriend and is tempted by a college student.
Description: Michael has a great job, has his 4 best friends, and is in love with a beautiful girl at 30. He loves Jenna but his life seems predictable until someone else enters his life. It seems that everybody's having relationship problems.

Title: The Souvenir
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A shy film student in 1980s London falls for a charming, secretive older man whose addiction slowly consumes them.
Description: A shy but ambitious film student falls into an intense, emotionally fraught relationship with a charismatic but untrustworthy older man.

Title: The Devil's Candy
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A struggling heavy metal painter moves his family into a rural Texas house and starts hearing satanic whispers.
Description: A struggling painter is possessed by satanic forces after he and his young family move into their dream home in rural Texas.

Title: The Man with Two Brains
Hint: A widowed brain surgeon marries a gold-digger, then falls in love with a disembodied voice kept in a jar.
Description: A brain surgeon marries a femme fatale, causing his life to turn upside down. Things go more awry when he falls in love with a talking brain.

Title: Shampoo
Hint: A womanising Beverly Hills hairdresser juggles his lovers and clients over a chaotic Election Day in 1968.
Description: On Election Day, 1968, irresponsible hairdresser and ladies' man George Roundy is too busy cutting hair and dealing with his girlfriends and mistress Felicia Karpf, whose husband Lester is having an affair with his ex-girlfriend Jackie.

Title: Chaos
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A suspended detective is forced to work with a rookie to catch a bank robber.
Description: In Seattle, detective Quentin Conners is unfairly suspended and his partner Jason York leaves the police force after a tragic shooting on Pearl Street Bridge, when the hostage and the criminal die. During a bank heist with a hostage situation, Conners is assigned in charge of the operation with the rookie Shane Dekker as his partner. The thieves, lead by Lorenz, apparently do not steal a penny from the bank.

Title: Last Man Standing
Hint: A mysterious stranger plays two rival gangs against each other in a Texas ghost town.
Description: John Smith is a mysterious stranger who is drawn into a vicious war between two Prohibition-era gangs. In a dangerous game, he switches allegiances from one to another, offering his services to the highest bidder. As the death toll mounts, Smith takes the law into his own hands in a deadly race to stay alive.

Title: Jeff, Who Lives at Home
Hint: A thirty-year-old stoner living in his mom's basement follows signs from the universe on a simple errand.
Description: Dispatched from his basement room on an errand for his mother, slacker ___ might discover his destiny (finally) when he spends the day with his brother as he tracks his possibly adulterous wife.

Title: The Inbetweeners 2
Hint: Four gawky British lads head to Australia for a gap-year holiday that goes as badly as you'd expect.
Description: Neil, Will and Simon receive an invite from Jay to join him in Australia whilst on his gap year, who promises them it’s ”the sex capital of the world”. With their lives now rather dull compared to their hedonistic school days and legendary lads holiday, it’s an offer they can’t refuse.

Title: Lock Up
Hint: A model prisoner with months left on his sentence is transferred to a brutal jail run by a vengeful warden.
Description: Frank Leone is nearing the end of his prison term for a relatively minor crime. Just before he is paroled, however, Warden Drumgoole takes charge. Drumgoole was assigned to a hell-hole prison after his administration was publicly humiliated by Leone, and has now arrived on the scene to ensure that Leone never sees the light of day.

Title: Extra Ordinary
Hint: A shy Irish driving instructor with ghost-busting gifts must stop a washed-up rock star from making a satanic pact.
Description: A driving instructor must use her other-worldly gifts to save a lonely man’s daughter from a rock star looking to use her for Satanic purposes.

Title: Severance
Hint: A team-building weekend in the Hungarian woods goes horribly wrong for a group of arms company employees.
Description: Seven employees of an international weapons manufacturer are treated to a team-building weekend at the company’s newly built luxury spa lodge. Things quickly go awry as the colleagues find their corporate weekend sabotaged by a deadly enemy.

Title: The Rover
Hint: In the Australian outback after a global collapse, a silent drifter will do anything to get back his stolen car.
Description: Ten years after a severe economic collapse in the western world, lawlessness reigns and life is cheap. Eric is a lone drifter, and his car is his only possession. When a gang steals it, Eric comes across the injured Rey, left behind by the car thieves. The pair form an unlikely and uneasy alliance.

Title: The Invisible Guardian
Hint: A Spanish detective returns to her home valley to hunt a killer leaving teenage girls' bodies on the riverbank.
Description: When the naked body of a teenage girl is found on the banks of the River Baztán, it is quickly linked to a similar murder one month before. Soon, rumours are flying in the nearby village of Elizondo. Is this the work of a ritualistic killer or is it the basajaun, the ‘___’ of Basque mythology?

Title: Love & Friendship
Hint: A beautiful, cunning widow plots to land rich husbands for herself and her daughter in Georgian England.
Description: From Jane Austen’s novella, the beautiful and cunning Lady Susan Vernon visits the estate of her in-laws to wait out colorful rumors of her dalliances and to find husbands for herself and her daughter. Two young men, handsome Reginald DeCourcy and wealthy Sir James Martin, severely complicate her plans.

Title: Dead Man Down
Hint: A mobster's right-hand man is blackmailed by a scarred neighbour who wants revenge on the gang.
Description: In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is seduced by a woman seeking retribution.

Title: The Survivalist
Hint: In a starving post-collapse world, a lone farmer's hidden forest plot is upended when two women seek shelter.
Description: In a time of starvation, a ___ lives off a small plot of land hidden deep in forest. When two women seeking food and shelter discover his farm, he finds his existence threatened.

Title: Night Watch
Hint: Supernatural beings in Moscow are divided into Light and Dark forces, and an ancient truce is about to break.
Description: Among normal humans live the "Others" possessing various supernatural powers. They are divided up into the forces of light and the forces of the dark, who signed a truce several centuries ago to end a devastating battle. Ever since, the forces of light govern the day while the night belongs to their dark opponents.

Title: Resolution
Hint: A man handcuffs his junkie friend in a remote cabin to force him to go cold turkey, but something is watching them.
Description: A man imprisons his estranged junkie friend in an isolated cabin in the boonies of San Diego to force him through a week of sobriety, but the events of that week are being mysteriously manipulated.

Title: Ghost Stories
Hint: A professor who debunks psychics takes on three unexplained cases that shake his scepticism, in British horror.
Description: Professor Philip Goodman devotes his life to exposing phony psychics and fraudulent supernatural shenanigans. His skepticism soon gets put to the test when he receives news of three chilling and inexplicable cases -- disturbing visions in an abandoned asylum, a car accident deep in the woods and the spirit of an unborn child.

Title: Big Trouble
Hint: A mysterious suitcase connects a divorced dad, an unhappy housewife, two hitmen and a pair of crooks in Miami.
Description: The story of how a mysterious suitcase brings together, and changes, the lives of a divorced dad, an unhappy housewife, two hitmen, a pair of street thugs, two love struck teens, two FBI men and a psychedelic toad. Based on Pulitzer Prize-winning humorist Dave Barry's best-selling first novel, "___."

Title: Force 10 from Navarone
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: WWII commandos head to Yugoslavia to blow up a vital bridge and hunt down a traitor in their ranks.
Description: World War II, 1943. Mallory and Miller, the heroes who destroyed the guns of ___, are sent to Yugoslavia in search of a ghost from the past.

Title: Hunter Hunter
Hint: A family living off the grid in the woods trap a wolf, only to discover something far worse hunting them.
Description: A fur trapper leaves his wife and daughter behind to kill a rogue wolf in the remote wilderness, but they soon become increasingly worried when their peaceful existence is disrupted.

Title: The Water Horse: Legend of the Deep
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Australia
Hint: A lonely Scottish boy finds a strange egg that hatches into the famous creature said to lurk in the loch.
Description: A lonely boy discovers a mysterious egg that hatches a sea creature of Scottish legend.

Title: Just Cause
Hint: A Harvard professor reopens a case of a man on death row.
Description: A Harvard professor is lured back into the courtroom after twenty-five years to take the case of a young black man condemned to death for the horrific murder of a child.

Title: Young Adam
Hint: A drifter working on a Scottish river barge has an affair with his employer's wife after finding a body.
Description: A young drifter working on a river barge disrupts his employers' lives while hiding the fact that he knows more about a dead woman found in the river than he admits.

Title: Our Idiot Brother
Hint: A sweet, naive organic farmer wreaks havoc on the lives of his three sisters after getting out of jail.
Description: Everybody has one—the sibling who is always just a little bit behind the curve when it comes to getting his life together. For sisters Liz, Miranda and Natalie, that person is their perennially upbeat brother, Ned. But as each of their lives begins to unravel, Ned's family comes to realise that Ned isn't such an ___ after all.

Title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A noble English baby raised by primates in the African jungle is brought back to his grandfather's Scottish estate.
Description: A shipping disaster in the 19th Century has stranded a man and woman in the wilds of Africa. The lady is pregnant, and gives birth to a son in their tree house. Soon after, a family of ___ stumble across the house and in the ensuing panic, both parents are killed. A female ape takes the tiny boy as a replacement for her own dead infant, and raises him as her son.

Title: Fireproof
Hint: A fire captain who puts duty first takes on a 40-day challenge to save his marriage, in a faith-based drama.
Description: A heroic fire captain values dedication and service to others above all else, but the most important partnership in his life, his marriage, is about to go up in smoke.

Title: Where the Truth Lies
Hint: An ambitious young reporter digs into why a famous 1950s comedy duo split up after a girl was found dead.
Description: An ambitious reporter probes the reasons behind the sudden split of a 1950s comedy team.

Title: I Love You to Death
Hint: A wife tries to kill her cheating husband, but he won't die.
Description: Joey Boca is the owner of a pizza parlour, and has been married to Rosalie for years. When Rosalie discovers that Joey is a womanizer and has been cheating on her for a long time, she goes to extreme lengths to punish him.

Title: The Yards
Hint: A young ex-con takes a job with his uncle in the corrupt world of New York subway contracts.
Description: In the rail ___ of Queens, contractors repair and rebuild the city's subway cars. These contracts are lucrative, so graft and corruption are rife. When Leo Handler gets out of prison, he finds his aunt married to Frank Olchin, one of the big contractors; he's battling with a minority-owned firm for contracts.

Title: Laurel Canyon
Hint: An uptight young doctor and his fiancée move into his music-producer mother's freewheeling LA home.
Description: When an uptight young man and his fiancée move into his libertine mother's house, the resulting clash of life attitudes shakes everyone up.

Title: The Interpreter
Country: France, Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A UN translator overhears an assassination plot against an African leader, and a Secret Service agent protects her.
Description: After Silvia Broome, an ___ at United Nations headquarters, overhears plans of an assassination, an American Secret Service agent is sent to investigate.

Title: Black and Blue
Hint: A rookie cop's body cam captures corrupt officers committing a murder, and she's hunted through New Orleans.
Description: Rookie cop Alicia West, an Army veteran, inadvertently captures the murder of a young drug dealer on her body cam. After realizing that the murder was committed by corrupt cops, she teams up with the one person from her community who is willing to help her as she tries to escape both the criminals out for revenge and the police who are desperate to destroy the incriminating footage.

Title: The Mortuary Collection
Hint: A sinister undertaker tells a curious young girl four macabre stories about the corpses in his care.
Description: In the phantasmagorical town of Raven's End, a misguided young girl takes refuge in a decrepit old ___. The eccentric undertaker chronicles the strange history of the town through a series of twisted tales, each more terrifying than the last, but the young girl's world is unhinged when she discovers that the final story... is her own.

Title: Not Without My Daughter
Hint: An American mother trapped in Iran by her controlling husband plots a dangerous escape with her little girl.
Description: An American woman, trapped in Islamic Iran by her brutish husband, must find a way to escape with her daughter as well.

Title: How I Live Now
Hint: An American girl in the English countryside falls in love as war breaks out.
Description: An American girl, sent to the English countryside to stay with relatives, finds love and purpose while fighting for her survival as war envelops the world around her.

Title: Ginger Snaps 2: Unleashed
Hint: A young woman fighting her werewolf infection escapes a rehab clinic, with another beast on her trail.
Description: Brigitte has escaped the confines of Bailey Downs but she's not alone. Another werewolf is tailing her closely and her sister's specter haunts her. An overdose of Monkshood - the poison that is keeping her transformation at bay - leads to her being incarcerated in a rehabilitation clinic for drug addicts where her only friend is an eccentric young girl by the name of Ghost.

Title: Chappaquiddick
Hint: A US senator's career is derailed by a 1969 car accident that kills a young woman.
Description: Ted Kennedy's life and political career become derailed in the aftermath of a fatal car accident in 1969 that claims the life of a young campaign strategist, Mary Jo Kopechne.

Title: Angel of Mine
Hint: A grieving mother becomes convinced that another family's daughter is actually her own child.
Description: A woman grieving over the death of her daughter loses grip of reality when she begins to think her girl may still be alive.

Title: New York Stories
Hint: Three Manhattan tales from three great directors: a painter's obsession, a rich little girl, and a man haunted by his mother.
Description: Three tales of love, ambition, and neurosis unfold in the city that never sleeps. In "Life Lessons" (Martin Scorsese), a tormented painter channels heartbreak into his art. In "Life Without Zoë" (Francis Ford Coppola), a precocious 12-year-old navigates privilege and loneliness in a Manhattan hotel. And in "Oedipus Wrecks" (Woody Allen), a man’s domineering mother literally becomes a looming presence over New York.

Title: White Bird in a Blizzard
Hint: In 1988, a teenage girl's life is thrown into chaos when her mother vanishes without a trace.
Description: In 1988, a teenage girl's life is thrown into chaos when her mother disappears.

Title: Alps
Country: Canada, France, Greece, United States of America
Hint: A secret group stands in for dead people to help their grieving families, until one member gets too involved.
Description: A nurse, a paramedic, a gymnast and her coach offer a service for hire wherein they stand in for dead people by appointment, hired by relatives, friends or colleagues of the deceased, to assist with the grieving process.

Title: The Joneses
Hint: A seemingly perfect family moves into a wealthy suburb, but they're secretly stealth marketers selling a lifestyle.
Description: A seemingly perfect family moves into a suburban neighborhood, but when it comes to the truth as to why they're living there, they don't exactly come clean with their neighbors.

Title: Enigma
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America, Netherlands
Hint: Codebreakers at Bletchley Park race to crack a German cipher machine as a colleague disappears.
Description: The story of the WWII project to crack the code behind the ___ machine, used by the Germans to encrypt messages sent to their submarines.

Title: Youth in Revolt
Hint: A nerdy teen creates a bad-boy alter ego to win the girl of his dreams.
Description: As a fan of Albert Camus and Jean-Luc Godard, teenage Nick Twisp is definitely out of his element when his mother and her boyfriend move the family to a trailer park. When a pretty neighbor named Sheeni plays records by French crooners, it's love at first sight for frustrated and inexperienced Nick. Learning that she is dating someone, Nick launches a hilarious quest to find his way into Sheeni's heart -- and bed.

Title: The Willoughbys
Hint: Four neglected children send their selfish parents on a perilous vacation so they can raise themselves.
Description: When the four Willoughby children are abandoned by their selfish parents, they must learn how to adapt their Old-Fashioned values to the contemporary world in order to create something new: The Modern Family.

Title: Blood Work
Hint: A retired FBI profiler with a heart transplant hunts the killer of his donor.
Description: Still recovering from a heart transplant, a retired FBI profiler returns to service when his own blood analysis offers clues to the identity of a serial killer.

Title: Wheelman
Hint: A getaway driver realises he's been double-crossed on a bank job and must race to find out who betrayed him.
Description: A getaway driver for a bank robbery realizes he has been double crossed and races to find out who betrayed him.

Title: The Opposite of Sex
Hint: A manipulative 16-year-old visits her gay half-brother and seduces his boyfriend, wreaking havoc on everyone.
Description: A 16-year-old girl visits her gay half-brother and ends up seducing his boyfriend, thus wreaking havoc on all of their lives.

Title: In the Land of Women
Hint: A heartbroken writer moves to Michigan to care for his grandmother and befriends a mother and her daughters.
Description: After a bad breakup with his girlfriend leaves him heartbroken, Carter Webb moves to Michigan to take care of his ailing grandmother. Once there, he gets mixed up in the lives of the mother and daughters who live across the street.

Title: Don't Let Go
Hint: A detective receives phone calls from his recently murdered niece and tries to change her fate.
Description: A detective suffering from a personal loss receives a call from his recently deceased niece. Being able to communicate across time, the two work together to try and stop the crime before it occurs.

Title: The Occupant
Hint: An unemployed executive becomes obsessed with the family now living in his former luxury apartment.
Description: An unemployed executive is forced to sell his apartment. When he discovers that he still has the keys, he becomes obsessed with the family that now lives there and decides to recover the life he has lost, at any price.

Title: Grudge Match
Hint: Two aging boxing rivals come out of retirement for one final bout, thirty years after their last fight.
Description: A pair of aging boxing rivals are coaxed out of retirement to fight one final bout -- 30 years after their last match.

Title: The Addiction
Hint: A philosophy student in New York is bitten by a vampire and struggles to control her new hunger.
Description: A vampiric doctoral student tries to follow the philosophy of a nocturnal comrade and control her thirst for blood.

Title: Charlotte Gray
Hint: A Scottish woman joins the French Resistance during WWII to find her missing lover.
Description: This is a drama set in Nazi-occupied France at the height of World War II. ___ tells the compelling story of a young Scottish woman working with the French Resistance in the hope of rescuing her lover, a missing RAF pilot. Based on the best-selling novel by Sebastian Faulks.

Title: Lust Stories
Hint: An anthology of four tales exploring desire and modern relationships from the perspective of Indian women.
Description: An anthology of four stories that sheds light on modern relationships from the viewpoint of the Indian woman.

Title: Kajillionaire
Hint: Two con artists have trained their only daughter to swindle and steal, until a stranger joins their schemes.
Description: Two con artists have spent 26 years training their only daughter to swindle, scam and steal at every turn. During a desperate and hastily conceived heist, they charm a stranger into joining them, only to have their entire world turned upside down.

Title: Dirty Girl
Hint: A promiscuous teenager and her gay friend run away to find her father.
Description: Accompanied by her closeted gay buddy, a promiscuous teenager sets out to find her long-absent father.

Title: Blow the Man Down
Hint: After their mother's funeral, two sisters in a Maine fishing town cover up a crime and uncover a dark secret.
Description: While grieving for the loss of their mother, the Connolly sisters suddenly find they have a crime to cover up, leading them deep into the underbelly of their salty Maine fishing village.

Title: Parkland
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The chaotic events at a Dallas hospital on the day a US president was assassinated in 1963.
Description: November 22nd, 1963 was a day that changed the world forever — when young American President John F. Kennedy was assassinated in Dallas, Texas. This film follows, almost in real time, a handful of individuals forced to make split-second decisions after an event that would change their lives and forever alter the world’s landscape.

Title: Big Business
Hint: Two sets of identical twins mixed up at birth meet for the first time in New York as corporate rivals.
Description: In the 1940s in the small town of Jupiter Hollow, two sets of identical twins are born in the same hospital on the same night. One set to a poor local family and the other to a rich family just passing through. The dizzy nurse on duty accidentally mixes the twins unbeknown to the parents. Our story flashes forward to the 1980s where the mismatched sets of twins are about to cross paths.

Title: The Congress
Country: Belgium, France, Germany, Israel, Luxembourg, Poland
Hint: An aging actress sells her digital likeness to a studio and enters an animated hallucinogenic world.
Description: An aging, out-of-work actress accepts one last job, though the consequences of her decision affect her in ways she didn't consider.

Title: Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram-Leela
Hint: Two lovers from rival clans in Gujarat fall in love, in a vibrant musical retelling of a Shakespeare tragedy.
Description: Ran and ___ are passionately in love with each other. The only problem is that their respective clans have been enemies for 500 years.

Title: Everything Must Go
Hint: An alcoholic, after losing his wife and job, holds a yard sale of his belongings on his front lawn.
Description: When an alcoholic relapses, causing him to lose his wife and his job, he holds a yard sale on his front lawn in an attempt to start over. A new neighbor might be the key to his return to form.

Title: Phantasm II
Hint: A young man teams up with his old friend to hunt a sinister undertaker with killer flying spheres.
Description: Mike, after his release from a psychiatric hospital, teams up with his old pal Reggie to hunt down the Tall Man, who is at it again. A mysterious, beautiful girl has also become part of Mike's dreams, and they must find her before the Tall Man does.

Title: Coogan's Bluff
Hint: An Arizona deputy sheriff goes to New York to extradite a prisoner and must track him down when he escapes.
Description: ___, an Arizona deputy sheriff goes to New York to pick up a prisoner. While escorting the prisoner to the airport, he escapes and ___ heads into the city to recapture him.

Title: The Other Sister
Hint: A mentally challenged young woman proves herself capable when she moves out and falls in love.
Description: A mentally challenged girl proves herself to be every bit as capable as her "perfect" sister when she moves into an apartment and begins going to college.

Title: Ned Kelly
Country: Australia, France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An Irish-Australian outlaw and his gang become folk heroes as they fight corrupt police in the outback.
Description: After getting threatened by ___ friends and family, Constable Fitzpatrick places the blame on ___ and exaggerates what happened. With the biggest ever award available, ___ and his gang set into the wild, to remain hidden from everyone who seeks them. Even if it means having his family arrested, the members of the ___ Gang stay hidden and plan a way to get their names cleared.

Title: Stake Land
Hint: A teenage boy and a vampire hunter journey through a post-apocalyptic America overrun by bloodsuckers.
Description: Martin was a normal teenage boy before the country collapsed in an empty pit of economic and political disaster. A vampire epidemic has swept across what is left of the nation's abandoned towns and cities, and it's up to Mister, a rogue vampire hunter, to get Martin safely north to Canada, the continent's New Eden.

Title: Extraordinary Measures
Hint: A father teams up with a maverick scientist to find a cure for his children's rare disease.
Description: Working-class father John Crowley is finally on the fast track to corporate success when his two young children are diagnosed with Pompe disease—a condition that prevents the body from breaking down sugar. With the support of his wife, John ditches his career and teams with unconventional specialist, Dr. Robert Stonehill to found a bio-tech company and develop a cure in time to save the lives of his children. As Dr.

Title: Nativity!
Hint: A primary school teacher in Coventry falsely boasts that Hollywood is coming to film his school's play.
Description: Paul, charged with directing his school's ___ play, falsely boasts that his ex-girlfriend plans to turn the production into a film.

Title: The High Note
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A superstar singer and her ambitious assistant shake up the LA music scene with a big decision.
Description: Set in the dazzling world of the LA music scene comes the story of Grace Davis, a superstar whose talent, and ego, have reached unbelievable heights. Maggie is Grace’s overworked personal assistant who’s stuck running errands, but still aspires to her childhood dream of becoming a music producer.

Title: Next Door
Hint: A Berlin movie star's day is ruined when a neighbour confronts him with hidden truths in a bar.
Description: Berlin, the Prenzlauer Berg district. Daniel is a movie star accustomed to success. His loft apartment is stylish and so is his wife, and the nanny has the children under control. Everything is ready for him to jet off to an audition in London where a role in an American superhero film awaits.

Title: Top Five
Hint: A comedian trying to become a serious actor spends a day with a journalist revisiting his past.
Description: Though he began in stand-up comedy, Andre Allen hit the big-time as the star of a trilogy of action-comedies about a talking bear but now he wants to be taken seriously. His passion project about the Haitian Revolution, a movie called Uprize, was panned by the NY Times film critic.

Title: Keeping the Faith
Hint: A rabbi and a priest, best friends since childhood, fall for the same girl.
Description: Best friends since they were kids, Rabbi Jacob Schram and Father Brian Finn are dynamic and popular young men living and working on New York's Upper West Side. When Anna Reilly, once their childhood friend and now grown into a beautiful corporate executive, suddenly returns to the city, she reenters Jake and Brian's lives and hearts with a vengeance. Sparks fly and an unusual and complicated love triangle ensues.

Title: Pretty Persuasion
Hint: A teen girl incites chaos among friends and the media when she accuses her drama teacher of sexual harassment.
Description: A 15-year-old girl incites chaos among her friends and a media frenzy when she accuses her drama teacher of sexual harassment.

Title: Message from the King
Country: Belgium, Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A South African man infiltrates the seedy underbelly of Los Angeles to avenge his sister's murder.
Description: On a relentless quest to avenge his sister's murder, a man from Cape Town infiltrates a sprawling network of lowlifes and elites in Los Angeles.

Title: A Good Woman
Country: Italy, Luxembourg, Spain, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A divorcee with a scandalous past travels to the Italian Riviera and stirs up rumours among high society.
Description: Fleeing 1930s New York and leaving behind a chequered past, the giltzy divorcee Mrs Stella Erlynne travels to Italy's sun-dappled Amalfi coast. Mrs Erlynne's appearance causes a stir amongst the visiting aristocracy. Based on the Oscar Wilde play "Lady Windemere's Fan."

Title: Switchback
Hint: An FBI agent hunts the serial killer who kidnapped his son, following two suspects through the snowy Rockies.
Description: After FBI agent Frank Lacrosse believes his son was kidnapped by a notorious serial killer, he travels to Amarillo, Texas, where he believes the murderer is in hiding. Although officially taken off the case because of its personal significance to him, Frank continues to pursue the killer, causing concern for local sheriff Buck Olmstead.

Title: Lonely Hearts
Hint: Two detectives track a murderous couple who preyed on widows through personal ads in the late 1940s.
Description: In the late 1940s, a murderous couple known as the 'The ___ Killers' kills close to a dozen people. Two detectives try to nab the duo who find their targets via the personals in the paper.

Title: Mark Felt: The Man Who Brought Down the White House
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An FBI associate director becomes the anonymous source behind the Watergate scandal.
Description: The story of ___, who under the name "Deep Throat" helped journalists Bob Woodward and Carl Bernstein uncover the Watergate scandal in 1974.

Title: Ain't Them Bodies Saints
Hint: An outlaw escapes from prison in 1970s Texas and sets out to reunite with his wife and the daughter he's never met.
Description: Bob Muldoon and Ruth Guthrie, an impassioned young outlaw couple on an extended crime spree, are finally apprehended by lawmen after a shootout in the Texas hills. Although Ruth wounds a local officer, Bob takes the blame. But four years later, Bob escapes from prison and sets out to find Ruth and their daughter, born during his incarceration.

Title: Joe Kidd
Hint: A gunman is hired by a land baron to hunt Mexican farmers.
Description: A band of Mexicans find their U. S. land claims denied and all the records destroyed in a courthouse fire. Their leader, Louis Chama, encourages them to use force to regain their land. A wealthy landowner wanting the same decides to hire a gang of killers with ___ to track Chama.

Title: Stop-Loss
Hint: A decorated soldier returns from Iraq, only to be ordered back to duty under a controversial policy.
Description: A veteran soldier returns from his completed tour of duty in Iraq, only to find his life turned upside down when he is arbitrarily ordered to return to field duty by the Army.

Title: Fierce Creatures
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A new manager tries to save a struggling British zoo by featuring only dangerous animals.
Description: Ex-policeman Rollo Lee is sent to run Marwood Zoo, the newly acquired business of a New Zealand tycoon. In order to meet high profit targets and keep the zoo open, Rollo enforces a new '___' policy, whereby only the most impressive and dangerous animals are allowed to remain in the zoo. However, the keepers are less enthusiastic about complying with these demands.

Title: Good Kill
Hint: A drone pilot grows disillusioned with killing from afar in Las Vegas and longs to fly real planes.
Description: In the shadowy world of drone warfare, combat unfolds like a video game–only with real lives at stake. After six tours of duty, Air Force pilot Tom Egan now fights the Taliban from an air-conditioned bunker in the Nevada desert.

Title: Errementari
Hint: In a remote Basque village, a mysterious blacksmith is rumoured to have made a pact with the devil.
Description: Basque Country, Spain, 1843. A police constable arrives at a small village in Álava to investigate a mysterious blacksmith who lives alone deep in the woods.

Title: Dostana
Hint: Two straight guys pretend to be a gay couple to secure a posh Miami apartment and fall for their roommate.
Description: Two straight guys pretend to be a gay couple to secure a posh Miami apartment, but fall for their gorgeous roommate. Hilarity ensues as they strive to convince everyone of the ruse while secretly trying to win her heart.

Title: Red Joan
Hint: An elderly British woman is arrested for passing nuclear secrets to the Soviet Union decades ago.
Description: London, England, May 2000. The peaceful life of elderly ___ Stanley is suddenly disrupted when she is arrested by the British Intelligence Service and accused of providing information to communist Russia during the forties.

Title: Resident Evil: Damnation
Hint: A US agent sneaks into a war-torn Eastern European country to investigate rumours of biological weapons.
Description: U.S. federal agent Leon S. Kennedy sneaks into the "East Slavic Republic" to verify rumors that Bio-Organic Weapons (BOWs) are being used in the country's civil war, which the U.S. and Russia are making preparations to jointly intervene in. Right after his infiltration, the U.S. government orders him to leave immediately.

Title: Killing Zoe
Hint: An American safe-cracker arrives in Paris and gets mixed up in a drug-fuelled bank heist gone wrong.
Description: Zed is an American vault-cracker who travels to Paris to meet up with his old friend Eric. Eric and his gang have planned to raid the only bank in the city which is open on Bastille day. After offering his services, Zed soon finds himself trapped in a situation beyond his control when heroin abuse, poor planning and a call-girl named ___ all conspire to turn the robbery into a very bloody siege.

Title: Mr. Destiny
Hint: An unhappy man is shown what his life would be like if he'd made a different choice.
Description: Larry Burrows is unhappy and feels powerless over his life. He believes his entire life could have turned out differently had he not missed that shot in a baseball game when was a kid. One night he meets this mysterious man, who could change his fate by offering him that alternative life he always dreamed of.

Title: Tom Jones
Hint: A bawdy, charming foundling romps through 18th-century England in pursuit of love and adventure.
Description: Tom loves Sophie and Sophie loves Tom. But Tom and Sophie are of differering classes. Can they find a way through the mayhem to be true to love?

Title: Rogue Trader
Hint: A young futures dealer's reckless gambles in Singapore bring down Britain's oldest merchant bank in the 1990s.
Description: ___ tells the true story of Nick Leeson, an employee of Barings Bank who--after a successful trading run--ends up accumulating $1.4 billion in losses hidden in account #88888.

Title: Beyond Borders
Country: Canada, Germany, United States of America
Hint: An American woman in London falls for a doctor working in war zones.
Description: Sarah Jordan, an American living in London in 1984, is married to the son of a wealthy British industrialist. She encounters Nick Callahan, a renegade doctor, whose impassioned plea for help to support his relief efforts in war-torn Africa moves her deeply. As a result, Sarah embarks upon a journey of discovery that leads to danger, heartbreak and romance in the far corners of the world.

Title: Shining Through
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A New York secretary becomes a spy in Nazi Germany during World War II.
Description: Spirited New Yorker Linda Voss goes to work for international lawyer and secret Office of Strategic Services operative Ed Leland just before World War II. As they fall in love, the United States enters the fight against Hitler, and Linda volunteers to work for Ed spying undercover behind Nazi lines.

Title: Irreplaceable You
Hint: A woman diagnosed with terminal cancer tries to find a new girlfriend for her fiancé before she dies.
Description: A stunning cancer diagnosis spurs Abbie to seek a future girlfriend for fiancé and childhood sweetheart Sam, who's clueless when it comes to dating.

Title: Paheli
Hint: A ghost falls in love with a merchant's wife and takes his form while he's away on business.
Description: Kishanlal marries the beautiful Lachchi, but the day after the wedding, he leaves on business for five years. When Kishanlal reappears only a few days later, Lachchi is delighted, but this new Kishanlal is in fact a spirit who has taken the form of Lachchi's husband, after having seen her by chance and fallen in love with her. Four years later, the real Kishanlal returns and the townsfolk must determine who is who.

Title: Elvis & Nixon
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Canada
Hint: The bizarre real-life meeting between a rock-and-roll icon and a US president in the White House.
Description: In 1970, a few days before Christmas, ___ Presley showed up on the White House lawn seeking to be deputized into the Bureau of Narcotics and Dangerous Drugs by the President himself.

Title: Twin Dragons
Hint: Identical brothers separated at birth, one a streetwise mechanic and the other a concert pianist, get mixed up in Hong Kong.
Description: Identical twins are separated at birth, one becoming a streetwise mechanic, and the other an acclaimed classical concert conductor. Finally meeting in adulthood, they're mistaken for the other and entangled in each other's worlds.

Title: Crying Freeman
Country: Canada, France, Japan, United States of America
Hint: A tormented assassin who cries after every kill falls for the artist who witnessed his crime.
Description: A lethal assassin for a secret Chinese organisation, who sheds tears of regret each time he kills, is seen swiftly and mercilessly executing three Yakuza gangsters by a beautiful artist. She is captivated by the grace of his kill and later falls in love with him. An intense power struggle for the leadership of the Yakuza Clans ensues as they seek vengeance for the death of their leader.

Title: Down in the Valley
Hint: A teenage girl falls for a charismatic older drifter who dresses and acts like a cowboy in suburban Los Angeles.
Description: On a trip to the beach, a teenage girl named Tobe meets a charismatic stranger named Harlan, who dresses like a cowboy and claims to be a former ranch hand. The pair feel an instant attraction and begin a relationship, but her father, a lawman, is suspicious of her lover.

Title: Kid Cannabis
Hint: An 18-year-old dropout and his friend start trafficking weed across the Canadian border.
Description: An eighteen year old high school drop out and his twenty-seven year old friend start trafficking marijuana across the border of Canada in order to make money and their lives are changed forever.

Title: Leaves of Grass
Hint: An Ivy League philosophy professor returns home where his pot-growing twin has a plan to take down a drug lord.
Description: An Ivy League professor returns home, where his pot-growing twin brother has concocted a plan to take down a local drug lord.

Title: Human Nature
Hint: Scientists try to civilise a man raised in the wild as if he were an ape.
Description: Obsessive scientist Nathan and his lover, the naturalist Lila, discover Puff: a man born and raised in the wild. As Nathan trains the wild man in the civilized ways of the world, Lila fights to preserve the man’s natural state. In the power struggle that ensues, an unusual love triangle emerges.

Title: Witching and Bitching
Hint: A gang of gold thieves on the run land in a coven of witches preparing for an ancient ritual.
Description: A gang of gold thieves land in a coven of witches who are preparing for an ancient ritual... and in need of a sacrifice.

Title: Foolproof
Hint: Three friends who plan imaginary heists for fun are blackmailed into actually committing one.
Description: Kevin, Sam and Rob have an unusual hobby: planning ___ heists, without intending to actually perform them. The game goes wrong when their latest plan is stolen and carried out. Things get even worse when a mysterious man approaches them with an offer: plan a heist for him, or go to jail. As the clock ticks, they find that the risk might be higher than just their freedom.

Title: Ideal Home
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A bickering gay couple's lives are upended when a previously unknown grandson shows up on their doorstep.
Description: A couple is going through marital troubles made worse when a previously unknown grandson shows up.

Title: New Kids Turbo
Hint: Five unemployed friends from a Dutch village refuse to pay for anything during the economic crisis, sparking a war.
Description: Five friends from 'Maaskantje' are getting fired because of the economic crisis. They decide that they won't pay for anything anymore.

Title: The Ottoman Lieutenant
Hint: An American nurse falls for a Turkish officer in Anatolia during WWI.
Description: Lillie, a determined American woman, ventures overseas to join Dr. Jude at a remote medical mission in the ___ Empire (now Turkey). However, Lillie soon finds herself at odds with Jude and the mission’s founder, Woodruff, when she falls for the titular military man, Ismail, just as the war is about to erupt.

Title: Fireflies in the Garden
Hint: A family torn apart by tragedy reunites, revealing the complexities of love and commitment.
Description: The semi-autobiographical story centers on the complexities of love and commitment in a family torn apart when faced with an unexpected tragedy.

Title: Resident Evil: Degeneration
Hint: Two agents battle a rogue warrior seeking revenge after unleashing a zombie virus at an airport.
Description: Leon S. Kennedy and Claire Redfield must battle a rogue warrior seeking revenge after unleashing the deadly G-Virus, whilst a mutated monster goes on a rampage.

Title: Kung Fu Jungle
Hint: A jailed martial arts instructor helps police catch a serial killer targeting the masters of Hong Kong's fighting styles.
Description: A martial arts instructor working at a police academy gets imprisoned after killing a man by accident. But when a vicious killer starts targeting martial arts masters, the instructor offers to help the police in return for his freedom.

Title: Day Watch
Hint: A man serving in the war between Light and Dark obtains a magical chalk that can rewrite fate.
Description: A man who serves in the war between the forces of Light and Dark comes into possession of a device that can restore life to Moscow, which was nearly destroyed by an apocalyptic event.

Title: Evening
Hint: A dying woman recalls a weekend from her youth and a lost love at a friend's wedding.
Description: As Constance (Natasha Richardson) and Nina (Toni Collette) gather at the deathbed of their mother, Ann (Vanessa Redgrave), they learn for the first time that their mother lived an entire other lifetime during one ___ 50 years ago. In vivid flashbacks, the young Ann (Claire Daines) spends one night with a man named Harris (Patrick Wilson), who was the love of her life.

Title: CJ7
Genres: Comedy, Drama, Family, Fantasy, Science Fiction
Hint: A poor construction worker mistakes an orb he finds in a junkyard for a toy, but it's an alien pet.
Description: A poor construction worker, who struggles to keep his son in private school, mistakes an orb he finds in a junkjard for a toy which proves to be much, much more once the young boy starts to play with it.

Title: Underdogs
Hint: An animated foosball player sees his tiny players come to life to help him defeat a bully.
Description: All seems well for Amadeo, a shy but talented foosball player who's in love with the free-spirited Laura. Trouble strikes when Grosso, the world's best soccer player, returns home with plans to destroy the village and turn it into a new sports stadium.

Title: Jagga Jasoos
Hint: A gifted teenage detective searches for his missing father with his assistant, in a musical adventure.
Description: A gifted teenage detective searches for his missing father with his ladylove assistant.

Title: Billu
Hint: A poor village barber's claim that he knows a famous film star changes everything for him.
Description: When a famous Bollywood actor visits a small village for a film's shoot, a poor hairdresser's claim that they were once childhood friends soon makes him the centre of attention.

Title: Harlock: Space Pirate
Hint: An outlaw captain and his crew battle invaders who want to conquer Earth in a lavish CGI anime adventure.
Description: ___ Captain ___ and his fearless crew face off against the space invaders who seek to conquer the planet Earth.

Title: The Odd Couple II
Hint: Two cantankerous friends road-trip together to their children's wedding in California.
Description: Brucey, the son of Oscar, calls his father to invite him to his wedding to Felix's daughter next Sunday in California. Oscar and Felix meet again at Los Angeles International Airport and rent a car in order to go to San Malina for the wedding.

Title: Krrish
Hint: A young man with superpowers inherited from his father becomes a masked superhero in Singapore.

Description: After a powerful billionaire is murdered, his secret adoptive son must race to prove his legitimacy, find his father's killers and stop them from taking over his financial empire.

Description: Working in a ferry as a waiter, Ayzek, having a defect with his front teeth, dreams to get his front teeth fixed and to marry his girlfriend, Songül. Title: Bhoothnath

Title: Vidocq
Genres: Fantasy, Action, Thriller, Crime, Science Fiction, Mystery

Title: Avalon

Description: In a future world, young people are increasingly becoming addicted to an illegal (and potentially deadly) battle simulation game called ___. When Ash, a star player, hears of rumors that a more advanced level of the game exists somewhere, she gives up her loner ways and joins a gang of explorers. Title: Being Flynn

Description: Working in a Boston homeless shelter, Nick ___ re-encounters his father, a con man and self-proclaimed poet. Sensing trouble in his own life, Nick wrestles with the notion of reaching out yet again to his dad.

Title: Cold Souls

Description: Paul is agonising over his interpretation of 'Uncle Vanya' and, paralysed by anxiety, stumbles upon a solution via a New Yorker article about a high-tech company promising to alleviate suffering by extracting ___. He enlists their services—only to discover that his soul is the shape and size of a chickpea.

Title: Juan of the Dead

Panic seizes all until ___ comes to the rescue: he discovers he can kill the undead destroying his brain, and decides to start a small business under the slogan "We kill your loved ones."

Title: The Great Buck Howard

Description: When a law school dropout answers an advertisement to be a personal assistant he unknowingly signs on to work for a belligerent has-been magician struggling to resurrect his career. This leads to a journey across the country staging the comeback of a lifetime.

Title: You Kill Me

Title: Returner

Description: A young woman from the future forces a local gunman to help her stop an impending alien invasion which will wipe out the human race.

Title: Extracted

Description: Thomas Jacobs invents a way to watch people's memories from the inside. Going against his morals, he accepts an offer to enter a heroin addict's memories to literally see if he committed a crime. However,a malfunction causes his consciousness to become trapped inside the criminal's mind. He remains a prisoner in the addict's memories for more than four years until he discovers the possibility of escape.

Title: Miles Ahead

Description: An exploration of the life and music of ___ Davis.

Title: Henry Poole Is Here

Description: Henry ___ abandons his fiancée and family business to spend what he believes are his remaining days alone. The discovery of a 'miracle' by a nosy neighbor ruptures his solitude and restores his faith in life.

Title: Nothing to Declare

Description: During the elimination of the Belgian/French border in the 90s, a Belgian customs officer is forced to team up with one of his French counterparts.

Description: Four couples meet for Sunday brunch only to discover they are stuck in a house together as the world may be about to end.

Description: In 1977 France, tightfisted factory owner Robert Pujol is so shocked when his workers strike for higher wages that he suffers a heart attack. His acquiescent wife, Suzanne, whose father had founded the factory, takes over management duties during Robert's convalescence.

Title: Manikarnika: The Queen of Jhansi

Description: Story of Rani Lakshmibai, one of the leading figures of the Indian Rebellion of 1857 and her resistance to the British Rule.

Description: Four friends become stranded in Eastern Europe and have to become hit men, prostitutes, corrupt cops, smugglers and more to make it home.

Description: When his love interest doesn't show up for a meeting, a man and his friends go to Goa in order to find her, where they discover she loves someone else.

Title: Don't Worry Darling

Description: Alice and Jack are lucky to be living in the idealized community of Victory, the experimental company town housing the men who work for the top-secret Victory Project and their families. Title: Strays

Description: When Reggie is abandoned on the mean city streets by his lowlife owner, Doug, Reggie is certain that his beloved owner would never leave him on purpose. But once Reggie falls in with Bug, a fast-talking, foul-mouthed stray who loves his freedom and believes that owners are for suckers, Reggie finally realizes he was in a toxic relationship and begins to see Doug for the heartless sleazeball that he is.

Title: The Little Things

Description: Deputy Sheriff Joe "Deke" Deacon joins forces with Sgt. Jim Baxter to search for a serial killer who's terrorizing Los Angeles. As they track the culprit, Baxter is unaware that the investigation is dredging up echoes of Deke's past, uncovering disturbing secrets that could threaten more than his case.

Title: Practical Magic

Description: Sally and Gillian Owens, born into a magical family, have mostly avoided witchcraft themselves. But when Gillian's vicious boyfriend, Jimmy Angelov, dies unexpectedly, the Owens sisters give themselves a crash course in hard magic. With policeman Gary Hallet growing suspicious, the girls struggle to resurrect Angelov -- and unwittingly inject his corpse with an evil spirit that threatens to end their family line.

Title: Operation Fortune: Ruse de Guerre

Title: The King's Man

Description: As a collection of history's worst tyrants and criminal masterminds gather to plot a war to wipe out millions, one man must race against time to stop them.

Title: Girl in the Basement

Description: Sara is a teen girl who is looking forward to her 18th birthday to move away from her controlling father Don. But before she could even blow out the candles, Don imprisons her in the ___ of their home.

Title: Under the Skin

Description: A seductive stranger prowls the streets of Glasgow in search of prey: unsuspecting men who fall under her spell.

Description: The ___ are a team of ancient aliens who have been living on Earth in secret for thousands of years. When an unexpected tragedy forces them out of the shadows, they are forced to reunite against mankind’s most ancient enemy, the Deviants.

Title: Waterworld

Description: In a futuristic world where the polar ice caps have melted and made Earth a liquid planet, a beautiful barmaid rescues a mutant seafarer from a floating island prison. They escape, along with her young charge, Enola, and sail off aboard his ship. But the trio soon becomes the target of a menacing pirate who covets the map to 'Dryland'—which is tattooed on Enola's back.

Title: Tomb Raider

Description: Lara Croft, the fiercely independent daughter of a missing adventurer, must push herself beyond her limits when she finds herself on the island where her father disappeared.

Description: A young street-smart, Nathan Drake and his wisecracking partner Victor “Sully” Sullivan embark on a dangerous pursuit of “the greatest treasure never found” while also tracking clues that may lead to Nathan’s long-lost brother.

Title: The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It
Hint: Paranormal investigators help a man accused of murder who claims he was possessed.
Description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren encounter what would become one of the most sensational cases from their files. The fight for the soul of a young boy takes them beyond anything they'd ever seen before, to mark the first time in U.S. history that a murder suspect would claim demonic possession as a defense.

Title: Godzilla vs. Kong

Description: In a time when monsters walk the Earth, humanity’s fight for its future sets ___ on a collision course that will see the two most powerful forces of nature on the planet collide in a spectacular battle for the ages.

Title: Ocean's Eight

Description: Debbie ___, a criminal mastermind, gathers a crew of female thieves to pull off the heist of the century at New York's annual Met Gala.

Title: The Many Saints of Newark

Description: Young Anthony Soprano is growing up in one of the most tumultuous eras in ___, N.J., history, becoming a man just as rival gangsters start to rise up and challenge the all-powerful DiMeo crime family. Caught up in the changing times is the uncle he idolizes, Dickie Moltisanti, whose influence over his nephew will help shape the impressionable teenager into the all-powerful mob boss, Tony Soprano.

Title: The Ritual
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: A group of college friends reunite for a trip to the forest, but encounter a menacing presence in the woods that's stalking them.

Title: Spider-Man 3

Description: The seemingly invincible ___-Man goes up against an all-new crop of villains—including the shape-shifting Sandman. While ___-Man’s superpowers are altered by an alien organism, his alter ego, Peter Parker, deals with nemesis Eddie Brock and also gets caught up in a love triangle.

Description: Lifelong friends Dave and Mitch are envious of the other's life. Mitch thinks Dave has it all: a beautiful, loving family and a high-paying job at a prestigious law firm. One fateful drunken night, they both admit that they wish they had the other’s life while peeing in a fountain when lightning strikes.

Title: The Babysitter

Description: When Cole stays up past his bedtime, he discovers that his hot ___ is part of a Satanic cult that will stop at nothing to keep him quiet.

Title: Miss Congeniality

Description: When the local FBI office receives a letter from a terrorist known only as 'The Citizen', it's quickly determined that he's planning his next act at the ___ America beauty pageant. Because tough-as-nails Gracie Hart is the only female Agent at the office, she's chosen to go undercover as the contestant from New Jersey.

Title: Watcher

Title: Red Notice

Description: An Interpol-issued ___ is a global alert to hunt and capture the world's most wanted. But when a daring heist brings together the FBI's top profiler and two rival criminals, there's no telling what will happen.

Title: Before I Go to Sleep
Country: France, Sweden, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A woman who wakes every morning with no memory must piece together her life from a hidden video diary.
Description: A woman wakes up every day, remembering nothing as a result of a traumatic accident in her past. One day, new terrifying truths emerge that force her to question everyone around her.

Title: Prospect
Country: Canada, United States of America, United Kingdom

Description: A teenage girl and her father travel to a remote alien moon, aiming to strike it rich. They've secured a contract to harvest a large deposit of the elusive gems hidden in the depths of the moon's toxic forest. But there are others roving the wilderness and the job quickly devolves into a fight to survive.

Title: 13 Going on 30
Hint: A 13-year-old girl wishes on magic dust and wakes up as a successful 30-year-old magazine editor.
Description: After total humiliation at her thirteenth birthday party, Jenna Rink wants to just hide until she's thirty. Thanks to some magic wishing dust, Jenna's prayer has been answered. With a knockout body, a fabulous wardrobe, an athlete boyfriend, a dream job, and superstar friends, this can't be a better life. But soon Jenna realizes that adult life isn’t as easy as she hoped for.

Title: Goosebumps

Description: When a retiring assassin realizes that he is the target of a hit, he winds up back in the game going head to head with a gang of younger, ruthless killers.

Title: King Arthur
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Roman officer and his knights fight the Saxon invaders in a gritty historical take on the legend.
Description: The story of the Arthurian legend, based on the 'Sarmatian hypothesis' which contends that the legend has a historical nucleus in the Sarmatian heavy cavalry troops stationed in Britain, and that the Roman-British military commander, Lucius Artorius Castus is the historical person behind the legend.

Title: Creep
Hint: A videographer answers an online ad and meets a strange man who wants a film made for his unborn son.
Description: Looking for work, Aaron comes across a cryptic online ad: "$1,000 for the day. Filming service. Discretion is appreciated." He drives to a cabin in a remote mountain town where he meets Josef, his cinematic subject for the day. Josef is sincere and the project seems heartfelt, so Aaron begins to film.

Title: Sky High
Hint: The powerless son of the world's greatest superhero couple enrols at a floating academy for gifted teens.
Description: Set in a world where superheroes are commonly known and accepted, young Will Stronghold, the son of the Commander and Jetstream, tries to find a balance between being a normal teenager and an extraordinary being.

Title: Do Revenge
Hint: A dethroned queen bee and an unassuming new student secretly swap targets to get payback on each other's tormentors.
Description: A dethroned queen bee at a posh private high school strikes a secret deal with an unassuming new student to enact revenge on one another’s enemies.

Title: Lake Mungo

Description: After 16-year-old Alice Palmer drowns at a local dam, her family experiences a series of strange, inexplicable events centered in and around their home. Unsettled, the Palmers seek the help of a psychic and parapsychologist, who discovers that Alice led a secret, double life. At ___, Alice's secret past emerges.

Title: Paranormal Activity

Description: After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic but is certainly the most active in the middle of the night.

Title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas

Description: Capitol Policeman John Cale has just been denied his dream job with the Secret Service protecting President James Sawyer. Not wanting to let down his little girl with the news, he takes her on a tour of the White House, when the complex is overtaken by a heavily armed paramilitary group.

Title: Lights Out

Description: Rebecca must unlock the terror behind her little brother's experiences that once tested her sanity, bringing her face to face with a supernatural spirit attached to their mother.

Description: The year is 2029. John Connor, leader of the resistance continues the war against the machines. Title: Chloe

Description: Catherine and David Stewart are a well-to-do couple living in a posh area of Toronto, but all is not well in paradise. Catherine suspects that David is cheating on her, so she hires an escort named ___ to meet David and see if he gives in to temptation — but events spin out of control when ___ spills the details of her torrid encounters.

Description: A crew of savvy former strip club employees band together to turn the tables on their Wall Street clients.

Title: The Bodyguard

Description: A former Secret Service agent grudgingly takes an assignment to protect a pop idol who's threatened by a crazed fan. But before long, all that tension sparks fireworks of another sort, and the love-averse tough guy is torn between duty and romance.

Description: An Icelandic couple live with their herd of sheep on a beautiful but remote farm. When they discover a mysterious newborn on their land, they decide to keep it and raise it as their own. This unexpected development and the prospects of a new family brings them much joy before ultimately destroying them.

Title: The Deep End of the Ocean

Description: A three-year-old boy disappears during his mother's high school reunion. Nine years later, by chance, he turns up in the town in which the family has just relocated.

Title: Date Night

Title: Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines

Title: The BFG

Description: An orphan little girl befriends a benevolent giant who takes her to Giant Country, where they attempt to stop the man-eating giants that are invading the human world.

Description: An ordinary guy suddenly finds himself forced to fight a gladiator-like battle for a dark website that streams the violence for viewers. In order to survive and rescue his kidnapped ex-girlfriend, he must battle Nix, a heavily armed and much more experienced fighter.

Description: Michael Mason is an American pickpocket living in Paris who finds himself hunted by the CIA when he steals a bag that contains more than just a wallet. Title: Dark Skies
Hint: An ordinary suburban family is targeted by terrifying alien beings.
Description: From the producers of Paranormal Activity, Insidious, and Sinister comes ___: a supernatural thriller that follows a young family living in the suburbs. As husband and wife Daniel and Lacey Barret witness an escalating series of disturbing events involving their family, their safe and peaceful home quickly unravels.

Title: Transporter 2
Hint: A former special forces driver must rescue a kidnapped boy in Miami.
Description: Professional driver, and former Special Forces officer, Frank Martin is living in Miami, where he is temporarily filling in for a friend as the chauffeur for a government narcotics control policy director and his family. The young boy in the family is targeted for kidnapping, and Frank immediately becomes involved in protecting the child and exposing the kidnappers.

Title: Get Him to the Greek
Hint: A record company intern must escort an out-of-control British rock star to his comeback gig in Los Angeles.
Description: Pinnacle records has the perfect plan to get their sinking company back on track: a comeback concert in LA featuring Aldous Snow, a fading rockstar who has dropped off the radar in recent years. Record company intern Aaron Green is faced with the monumental task of bringing his idol, out of control rock star Aldous Snow, back to LA for his comeback show.

Title: The Boss Baby
Hint: A seven-year-old is jealous of his new infant brother, a briefcase-carrying corporate spy in a suit.
Description: A story about how a new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative 7 year old named Tim.

Title: Mary Queen of Scots
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young widowed royal returns to her Scottish homeland and challenges her Protestant cousin who rules England.
Description: In 1561, ___ Stuart, widow of the King of France, returns to Scotland, reclaims her rightful throne and menaces the future of Queen Elizabeth I as ruler of England, because she has a legitimate claim to the English throne. Betrayals, rebellions, conspiracies and their own life choices imperil both Queens. They experience the bitter cost of power, until their tragic fate is finally fulfilled.

Title: Hail, Caesar!
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A 1950s Hollywood fixer must deal with a kidnapped movie star and a host of other studio problems.
Description: When a Hollywood star mysteriously disappears in the middle of filming, the studio sends their fixer to get him back.

Title: Jack the Giant Slayer
Hint: A young farmhand climbs a beanstalk to rescue a princess from a race of towering monsters in the sky.
Description: The story of an ancient war that is reignited when a young farmhand unwittingly opens a gateway between our world and a fearsome race of giants. Unleashed on the Earth for the first time in centuries, the giants strive to reclaim the land they once lost, forcing the young man, Jack into the battle of his life to stop them.

Title: Flightplan
Hint: A grieving aircraft engineer's daughter disappears in mid-flight, but no one believes the girl was ever on board.
Description: Flying at 40,000 feet in a state-of-the art aircraft that she helped design, Kyle Pratt's 6-year-old daughter Julia vanishes without a trace. Or did she? No one on the plane believes Julia was ever onboard. And now Kyle, desperate and alone, can only count on her own wits to unravel the mystery and save her daughter.

Title: Beowulf
Hint: A Norse warrior slays a monster and must face its seductive mother, in motion-capture animation.
Description: A 6th-century Scandinavian warrior named ___ embarks on a mission to slay the man-like ogre, Grendel.

Title: Red Dawn
Hint: A group of teenagers band together to defend their small town when the Soviets invade America.
Description: It is the ___ of World War III. In mid-western America, a group of teenagers band together to defend their town—and their country—from invading Soviet forces.

Title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two siblings and their cousin are drawn into a magical world on a ship.
Description: This time around Edmund and Lucy Pevensie, along with their pesky cousin Eustace Scrubb find themselves swallowed into a painting and on to a fantastic Narnian ship headed for the very edges of the world.

Title: Central Intelligence
Hint: A one-time bullied geek grows up to be a CIA agent and reunites with his old high school hero.
Description: Calvin Joyner, a mild-mannered accountant whose high school glory days are long behind him, reconnects with an awkward pal from high school through Facebook. After meeting up, Calvin’s mundane life takes an unexpectedly thrilling turn when he's thrust into the world of international espionage.

Title: Blades of Glory
Hint: Two rival figure skaters banned for life team up to become the first male pair in the sport.
Description: When a much-publicized ice-skating scandal strips them of their gold medals, two world-class athletes skirt their way back onto the ice via a loophole that allows them to compete together as a pairs team.

Title: Funny People
Hint: A famous stand-up comedian is diagnosed with a terminal illness and takes a young comic under his wing.
Description: Famous and wealthy funnyman George Simmons doesn't give much thought to how he treats people until a doctor delivers stunning health news, forcing George to reevaluate his priorities with a little help from aspiring stand-up comic Ira.

Title: Neighbors
Hint: A couple with a newborn baby wage war against the fraternity that moves in next door.
Description: A couple with a newborn baby face unexpected difficulties after they are forced to live next to a fraternity house.

Title: My Best Friend's Wedding
Hint: A food critic tries to sabotage her closest pal's nuptials after realising she's in love with him.
Description: When she receives word that her longtime platonic pal Michael O'Neal is getting married to debutante Kimberly Wallace, food critic Julianne Potter realizes her true feelings for Michael -- and sets out to sabotage the wedding.

Title: Predator 2
Hint: An alien trophy hunter stalks the streets of a sweltering Los Angeles amid a gang war.
Description: A police chief in the war-torn streets of Los Angeles discovers that an extraterrestrial creature is hunting down residents - and that he is the next target.

Title: Shivers
Hint: The residents of a suburban apartment building are infected by parasites that turn them into sex-crazed maniacs.
Description: The residents of a suburban high-rise apartment building are infected by parasites that turn them into mindless nymphomaniac fiends.

Title: Meet the Fockers
Hint: An uptight ex-CIA father of the bride is introduced to his son-in-law's free-spirited, hippie parents.
Description: Hard-to-crack ex-CIA man Jack Byrnes and his wife Dina head for the warmer climes of Florida to meet the parents of their son-in-law-to-be, Greg Focker. Unlike their happily matched offspring, the future in-laws find themselves in a situation of opposites that definitely do not attract.

Title: Clerks III
Hint: A convenience store clerk decides to make a movie about his life.
Description: After narrowly surviving a massive heart attack, Randal enlists his old friend Dante to help him make a movie immortalizing their youthful days at the little convenience store that started it all.

Title: The Family
Hint: A Mafia family is relocated to a sleepy town in Normandy in witness protection, and can't fit in.
Description: After ratting out his Mafia cohorts, Giovanni Manzoni and his ___ enter the Witness Protection Program and relocate to a sleepy town in France. Despite the best efforts of their handler to keep them in line, Giovanni (now called Fred Blake), his wife and children can't help but resort to doing things the "___" way. However, their dependence on such old habits places everyone in danger from vengeful mobsters.

Title: The Angry Birds Movie
Hint: A team of flightless, short-tempered feathered misfits sets out to uncover why green pigs have come to their island.
Description: An island populated entirely by happy, flightless ___ or almost entirely. In this paradise, Red, a bird with a temper problem, speedy Chuck, and the volatile Bomb have always been outsiders. But when the island is visited by mysterious green piggies, it’s up to these unlikely outcasts to figure out what the pigs are up to.

Title: Sleeping with the Enemy
Hint: A young woman fakes her own death to escape her abusive husband, but he tracks her down.
Description: A young woman fakes her own death in an attempt to escape her nightmarish marriage, but discovers it is impossible to elude her controlling husband.

Title: Oz the Great and Powerful
Hint: A small-time circus magician is swept by a tornado into a magical land, where witches want him to be king.
Description: Oscar Diggs, a small-time circus illusionist and con-artist, is whisked from Kansas to the Land of Oz where the inhabitants assume he's the great wizard of prophecy, there to save Oz from the clutches of evil.

Title: Spectral
Hint: An engineer and an elite team of soldiers battle ghostly, invisible entities in war-torn Eastern Europe.
Description: A special-ops team is dispatched to fight supernatural beings that have taken over a European city.

Title: The Last Stand
Hint: A small-town border sheriff and his deputies make a final defence against an escaped drug cartel leader racing to Mexico.
Description: Ray Owens is sheriff of the quiet US border town of Sommerton Junction after leaving the LAPD following a bungled operation. Following his escape from the FBI, a notorious drug baron, his gang, and a hostage are heading toward Sommerton Junction where the police are preparing to make a ___ to intercept them before they cross the border.

Title: A View to a Kill
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A British agent investigates a microchip tycoon's plan to flood Silicon Valley.
Description: A newly-developed microchip designed by Zorin Industries for the British Government that can survive the electromagnetic radiation caused by a nuclear explosion has landed in the hands of the KGB. James Bond must find out how and why.

Title: Once Upon a Time in Mexico
Hint: A legendary guitar-playing gunslinger is recruited by a corrupt CIA agent to stop a coup.
Description: A corrupt CIA agent Sands hires hitman El Mariachi to assassinate a Mexican general hired by a drug kingpin attempting a coup d'état of the President of Mexico.

Title: Bachelor Party
Hint: A groom-to-be's wild friends throw him an outrageous stag do the night before his wedding.
Description: On the eve of his wedding to his longtime girlfriend, unassuming nice guy Rick is dragged out for a night of debauchery by his friends.

Title: Wolf
Hint: An aging publisher bitten by a canine beast in Vermont gains new youthful vigor and fights to keep his job.
Description: An aging publisher becomes a demon ___ and, with this newfound youthful vigor, fights to keep his job.

Title: The Burning
Hint: A caretaker burned in a summer camp prank returns years later with garden shears for revenge.
Description: A caretaker at a summer camp is burned when a prank goes tragically wrong. After several years of intensive treatment at hospital, he is released back into society, albeit missing some social skills. What follows is a bloody killing spree with the caretaker making his way back to his old stomping ground to confront one of the youths that accidentally burned him.

Title: Run Hide Fight
Hint: A 17-year-old girl uses her wits and hunting skills to strike back when shooters take over her high school.
Description: A 17-year-old girl uses her wits, survival skills, and compassion to fight for her life, and those of her fellow classmates, against a group of live-streaming school shooters.

Title: Bright
Hint: A human cop and an orc cop find a powerful magic wand in an alternate Los Angeles.
Description: In an alternate present-day where magical creatures live among us, two L.A. cops become embroiled in a prophesied turf battle.

Title: Walking Tall
Hint: A former wrestler becomes a Tennessee sheriff and fights corruption in his county with a big stick.
Description: Ex-wrestler and Tennessee Sheriff Buford Pusser walks ___ and carries a big stick as he tussles with county-wide corruption and moonshining thugs.

Title: American Wedding
Hint: A nerdy young man and his friends prepare for his nuptials, bachelor party and all, in the third raunchy reunion.
