Description: With high school a distant memory, Jim and Michelle are getting married — and in a hurry, since Jim's grandmother is sick and wants to see him walk down the aisle — prompting Stifler to throw the ultimate bachelor party. And Jim's dad is reliable as ever, doling out advice no one wants to hear.

Title: The Commuter
Country: United States of America, France, Spain
Hint: An insurance salesman on his daily commute is caught up in a criminal conspiracy aboard a train.
Description: A businessman, on his daily commute home, gets unwittingly caught up in a criminal conspiracy that threatens not only his life but the lives of those around him.

Title: Take Me Home Tonight
Hint: A recent MIT grad attends a wild 1980s party to impress his high school crush.
Description: Recent MIT grad Matt Franklin should be well on his way to a successful career at a Fortune 500 company, but instead he rebels against maturity by taking a job at a video store. Matt rethinks his position when his unrequited high-school crush, Tori, walks in and invites him to an end-of-summer party. With the help of his twin sister and his best friend, Matt hatches a plan to change the course of his life.

Title: The House of the Devil
Hint: A college student takes a babysitting job in a creepy old mansion during a lunar eclipse.
Description: A young college student who’s struggling financially takes a strange babysitting job which coincides with a full lunar eclipse. She slowly realizes her clients harbor a terrifying secret, putting her life in mortal danger.

Title: #Alive
Hint: A young gamer is trapped alone in his apartment while a zombie virus spreads through Seoul.
Description: As a grisly virus rampages a city, a lone man stays locked inside his apartment, digitally cut off from seeking help and desperate to find a way out.

Title: My Spy
Hint: A hardened CIA operative is blackmailed by a precocious 9-year-old girl he's spying on.
Description: A hardened CIA operative finds himself at the mercy of a precocious 9-year-old girl, having been sent undercover to surveil her family.

Title: The American
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An assassin hiding out in a remote Italian town forms friendships with a priest and a prostitute.
Description: Dispatched to a small Italian town to await further orders, assassin Jack embarks on a double life that may be more relaxing than is good for him.

Title: Night of the Comet
Studio: Thomas Coleman and Michael Rosenblatt Productions
Hint: After a passing space rock wipes out most of life on Earth, two Valley Girls fight off cannibal zombies.
Description: After a ___ wipes out most of life on Earth, two Valley Girls find themselves fighting against cannibal zombies and a sinister group of scientists.

Title: Wizards
Hint: An evil mutant wizard uses Nazi propaganda films to conquer the world, in a fantasy animation.
Description: After the death of his mother, evil mutant wizard Blackwolf discovers long-lost military technologies. Full of ego and ambition, Blackwolf claims his mother's throne, assembles an army, and sets out to brainwash and conquer Earth.

Title: Horrible Bosses 2
Hint: Three disgruntled employees plot to kidnap the son of the investor who cheated them.
Description: Dale, Kurt and Nick decide to start their own business but things don't go as planned because of a slick investor, prompting the trio to pull off a harebrained and misguided kidnapping scheme.

Title: The Loft
Hint: Five married friends share a secret apartment for their affairs, until a woman is found dead there.
Description: For five men, the opportunity to share a penthouse in the city -- in which to carry on extramarital affairs -- is a dream come true, until the dead body of an unknown woman turns up. Realizing that her killer must be one of their group, the men are gripped by paranoia as each one suspects another.

Title: Rock Star
Hint: A tribute band singer becomes the lead singer of his favourite heavy metal group.
Description: A wannabe ___ who fronts a Pennsylvania-based tribute band is devastated when his bandmates kick him out of the group he founded. Things begin to look up for Izzy when he is asked to join Steel Dragon, the heavy metal rockers he had been imitating for so long. This film is loosely based on the true story of the band Judas Priest.

Title: Rio 2
Hint: A family of rare macaws leaves the city to explore the Amazon jungle.
Description: It's a jungle out there for Blu, Jewel and their three kids after they're hurtled from ___ de Janeiro to the wilds of the Amazon. As Blu tries to fit in, he goes beak-to-beak with the vengeful Nigel, and meets the most fearsome adversary of all: his father-in-law.

Title: Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation
Hint: A family of monsters takes a holiday on a cruise ship captained by a secret monster hunter.
Description: Dracula, Mavis, Johnny and the rest of the Drac Pack take a vacation on a luxury Monster Cruise Ship, where Dracula falls in love with the ship’s captain, Ericka, who’s secretly a descendant of Abraham Van Helsing, the notorious monster slayer.

Title: Barb and Star Go to Vista Del Mar
Hint: Two middle-aged best friends leave their small Midwestern town for a Florida resort and stumble onto a villain's plot.
Description: The story of best friends ___ and Star, who leave their small midwestern town for the first time to go on vacation in ___, Florida, where they soon find themselves tangled up in adventure, love, and a villain’s evil plot to kill everyone in town.

Title: Feel the Beat
Hint: A failed Broadway dancer returns home and reluctantly trains a misfit group of young dancers for a competition.
Description: After failing to make it on Broadway, April returns to her hometown and reluctantly begins training a misfit group of young dancers for a competition.

Title: Crooked House
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A private investigator helps a former flame solve the murder of her wealthy grandfather in his sprawling mansion.
Description: A private investigator helps a former flame solve the murder of her wealthy grandfather, who lived in a sprawling estate surrounded by his idiosyncratic family.

Title: Doc Hollywood
Hint: A hotshot young plastic surgeon heading to Beverly Hills crashes his car in a small Southern town and is sentenced to work at the local clinic.
Description: After leaving Washington D.C. hospital, plastic surgeon Ben Stone heads for California, where a lucrative practice in Beverly Hills awaits. After a car accident, he's sentenced to perform as the community's general practitioner.

Title: Irresistible
Hint: A Democratic strategist runs a retired Marine colonel's campaign for mayor of a small Wisconsin town, sparking a political circus.
Description: A Democratic political consultant helps a retired Marine colonel run for mayor in a small, conservative Wisconsin town.

Title: The Family Stone
Hint: An uptight businesswoman accompanies her boyfriend to his eccentric family's annual holiday gathering.
Description: An uptight, conservative businesswoman accompanies her boyfriend to his eccentric and outgoing family's annual Christmas celebration and finds that she's a fish out of water in their free-spirited way of life.

Title: True Story
Hint: A disgraced New York Times reporter discovers an accused killer has been using his name as an alias.
Description: A drama centered on the relationship between journalist Michael Finkel and Christian Longo, an FBI Most Wanted List murderer who for years lived outside the U.S. under Finkel's name.

Title: Summer Rental
Hint: An overworked air traffic controller takes his family to the beach, but things go wrong from day one.
Description: Jack Chester, an overworked air traffic controller, takes his family on vacation to the beach. Things immediately start to go wrong for the Chesters, and steadily get worse. Jack ends up in a feud with a local yachtsman, and has to race him to regain his pride and family's respect.

Title: Entrapment
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An insurance investigator and a master thief team up to steal a priceless Chinese mask, then plot a bigger heist.
Description: Two thieves, who travel in elegant circles, try to outsmart each other and, in the process, end up falling in love.

Title: Don't Say a Word
Hint: A psychiatrist's daughter is kidnapped, and the abductors demand he extract a number from a disturbed patient.
Description: When the daughter of a psychiatrist is kidnapped, he is horrified to discover that the abductors' demand is that he break through to a young woman, suffering from PTSD, who knows a secret six digit code number.

Title: Sand Castle
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: During the occupation of Iraq, a squad of US soldiers try to repair a village's water supply.
Description: Set during the occupation of Iraq, a squad of U.S. soldiers try to protect a small village.

Title: All Good Things
Hint: The true story of a New York real estate heir suspected of murdering his wife who vanished.
Description: Newly-discovered facts, court records and speculation are used to elaborate the true love story and murder mystery of the most notorious unsolved murder case in New York history.

Title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
Hint: An inventor's machine has created food-animal hybrids, and he must return to his island to stop them.
Description: After the disastrous food storm in the first film, Flint and his friends are forced to leave the town. Flint accepts the invitation from his idol Chester V to join The Live Corp Company, which has been tasked to clean the island, and where the best inventors in the world create technologies for the betterment of mankind.

Title: Henry & June
Hint: An American writer, his wife and a French diarist begin a passionate love triangle in 1930s Paris.
Description: While traveling in Paris, author Henry Miller and his wife, ___, meet Anais Nin, and sexual sparks fly as Nin starts an affair with the openly bisexual ___. When ___ is forced to return to the U.S., she gives Nin her blessing to sleep with her husband. Then, when ___ returns to France, an unexpected, and sometimes contentious, threesome forms.

Title: Major Payne
Hint: A tough-as-nails Marine is discharged and becomes commander of a ragtag junior ROTC unit.
Description: Major Benson Winifred ___ is being discharged from the Marines. ___ is a killin' machine, but the wars of the world are no longer fought on the battlefield. A career Marine, he has no idea what to do as a civilian, so his commander finds him a job - commanding officer of a local school's JROTC program, a bunch of ragtag losers with no hope.

Title: License to Drive
Hint: A teenager who failed his driving test takes his grandfather's car out for a wild night anyway.
Description: Teenager Les Anderson thinks his life can't get any worse after he flunks his driver's exam, but he's wrong. Even though he didn't receive his ___, Les refuses to break his date with the cool Mercedes Lane, and he decides to lift his family's prize luxury car for the occasion.

Title: The Aftermath
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Germany
Hint: A British colonel and his wife move into a German widower's house in post-war Hamburg.
Description: In the ___ of World War II, a British colonel and his wife are assigned to live in Hamburg during the post-war reconstruction, but tensions arise with the German widower who lives with them.

Title: Centurion
Hint: A Roman soldier and his fellow survivors fight behind enemy lines after their legion is decimated in Scotland.
Description: Britain, A.D. 117. Quintus Dias, the sole survivor of a Pictish raid on a Roman frontier fort, marches north with General Virilus' legendary Ninth Legion, under orders to wipe the Picts from the face of the Earth and destroy their leader, Gorlacon.

Title: Cargo
Hint: An infected father in the Australian outback has 48 hours to find a home for his baby during a pandemic.
Description: After being infected in the wake of a violent pandemic and with only 48 hours to live, a father struggles to find a new home for his baby daughter.

Title: Ninja Assassin
Country: United States of America, France, Germany
Hint: A young killer turns on the secret Japanese clan that raised him and hunts down his former masters.
Description: ___ follows Raizo, one of the deadliest assassins in the world. Taken from the streets as a child, he was transformed into a trained killer by the Ozunu Clan, a secret society whose very existence is considered a myth. But haunted by the merciless execution of his friend by the Clan, Raizo breaks free from them and vanishes. Now he waits, preparing to exact his revenge.

Title: Love Hard
Hint: An LA writer unlucky in love flies to the East Coast to surprise her online match at Christmas, only to find she's been catfished.
Description: An LA girl, unlucky in love, falls for an East Coast guy on a dating app and decides to surprise him for Christmas, only to discover that she's been catfished. But the object of her affection actually lives in the same town, and the guy who duped her offers to set them up if she pretends to be his own girlfriend for the holidays.

Title: The Shack
Country: Canada, Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: A grieving father receives a mysterious invitation to an abandoned hut where he meets God.
Description: A grieving man receives a mysterious, personal invitation to meet with God at a place called 'The ___'.

Title: Revolver
Hint: A con man released from prison seeks revenge on a casino boss but is drawn into a mysterious game.
Description: Hotshot gambler Jake Green is long on bravado and seriously short of common sense. Rarely is he allowed in any casino because he's a bona fide winner and, in fact, has taken so much money over the years that he's the sole client of his accountant elder brother, Billy. Invited to a private game, Jake is in fear of losing his life.

Title: The Rebound
Hint: A 40-year-old mother of two finds love with her 24-year-old babysitter.
Description: Upon discovering her husband's infidelity, Sandy leaves the suburbs and moves into the city. There, she befriends Aram, a guy whose wife only married him so she could get a green card. Sandy hires Aram to be her nanny, and it isn't long until Aram and Sandy find out they get along wonderfully and start to date. But is their relationship real or is it, in fact, just a ___ for both of them?

Title: Queenpins
Hint: Two bored suburban women run a multimillion-dollar counterfeit coupon scam.
Description: Bored and frustrated suburban homemaker Connie and her best pal JoJo, a vlogger with dreams, turn a hobby into a multi-million-dollar counterfeit coupon caper.

Title: Look Both Ways
Hint: A woman's life splits into parallel realities on the night she takes a pregnancy test.
Description: On the night of her college graduation, Natalie's life splits into parallel realities after she takes a pregnancy test. What will life and love bring?

Title: Free Fire
Hint: A gun deal between two gangs in a Boston warehouse turns into a chaotic shoot-out.
Description: Set in Boston in 1978, a meeting in a deserted warehouse between two gangs turns into a shoot-out and a game of survival.

Title: The Black Cauldron
Hint: An assistant pig-keeper with dreams of heroism must stop an evil king from finding a magic pot that raises an undead army.
Description: Taran is an assistant pigkeeper with boyish dreams of becoming a great warrior. However, he has to put the daydreaming aside when his charge, an oracular pig named Hen Wen, is kidnapped by an evil lord known as the Horned King. The villain hopes Hen will show him the way to The ___, which has the power to create a giant army of unstoppable soldiers.

Title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
Hint: A boy's summer plans are ruined when his dad tries to get him to do outdoor activities.
Description: It's summertime, and Greg Heffley is looking forward to playing video games and spending time with his friends. However, Greg's dad has other plans: He's decided that some father-son bonding time is in order. Desperate to prevent his dad from ruining summer vacation, Greg pretends he has a job at a ritzy country club.

Title: No Reservations
Hint: A master chef must take care of her niece and deal with a new free-spirited sous-chef.
Description: Master chef Kate Armstrong runs her life and her kitchen with intimidating intensity. However, a recipe for disaster may be in the works when she becomes the guardian of her young niece while crossing forks with the brash sous-chef who just joined her staff. Though romance blooms in the face of rivalry, Kate needs to look outside the kitchen to find true happiness.

Title: This Means War
Hint: Two CIA agents and best friends compete for the affections of the same woman.
Description: Two top CIA operatives wage an epic battle against one another after they discover they are dating the same woman.

Title: Dear John
Hint: A soldier falls for a college student during his two-week leave and they exchange love letters.
Description: While Sergeant John Tyree is home on two weeks leave from Germany, he meets Savannah after he dives into the ocean to retrieve Savannah's purse that had fallen off a pier. John eventually falls in love with Savannah, who promises to write to him until he returns from overseas.

Title: The Invention of Lying
Hint: In a world where no one can lie, a loser discovers he can, and uses it to his advantage.
Description: Set in a world where the concept of ___ doesn't exist, a loser changes his lot when he invents ___ and uses it to get ahead.

Title: Blue Streak
Hint: A jewel thief poses as a cop to retrieve a diamond he hid in a police station while it was under construction.
Description: Miles Logan is a jewel thief who just hit the big time by stealing a huge diamond. However, after two years in jail, he comes to find out that he hid the diamond in a police building that was being built at the time of the robbery. In an attempt to regain his diamond, he poses as an LAPD detective.

Title: The Only Living Boy in New York
Hint: A young man learns his father is having an affair and tries to stop it, but falls for the mistress himself.
Description: When a young man learns that his overbearing father is having an affair, he tries to stop it, only to be seduced by the older woman as well.

Title: Kimi
Hint: An agoraphobic tech worker hears a violent crime on a voice-assistant recording and must leave her apartment.
Description: A tech worker with agoraphobia discovers recorded evidence of a violent crime but is met with resistance when she tries to report it. Seeking justice, she must do the thing she fears the most: leave her apartment.

Title: The Laundromat
Hint: A widow swindled out of insurance money investigates two lawyers who run a shady Panamanian law firm.
Description: When a widow gets swindled out of insurance money, her search for answers leads to two cunning lawyers in Panama who hide cash for the superrich.

Title: Every Which Way But Loose
Hint: An easy-going trucker and bare-knuckle brawler travels across the West with his pet orangutan to chase a country singer.
Description: Philo Beddoe is your regular, easygoing, truck-driving guy. He's also the best bar-room brawler west of the Rockies. And he lives with a 165-pound orangutan named Clyde. Like other guys, Philo finally falls in love - with a flighty singer who leads him on a screwball chase across the American Southwest. Nothing's in the way except a motorcycle gang, some cops, and legendary brawler Tank Murdock.

Title: The Sentinel
Hint: A suicidal model moves into a Brooklyn brownstone and discovers it's a gateway to hell.
Description: As a young girl, Alison Parker attempted suicide after being traumatized by her father's sexual exploits. Now an elite fashion model, she moves to a Brooklyn Heights apartment building where she encounters a number of bizarre, eccentric tenants and attempts to uncover the building's sinister secret.

Title: American Gigolo
Hint: A high-priced male escort in Los Angeles is framed for murder.
Description: Julian makes a lucrative living as an escort to older women in the Los Angeles area. He begins a relationship with Michelle, a local politician's wife, without expecting any pay. One of his clients is murdered and Detective Sunday begins pumping him for details on his different clients, something he is reluctant to do considering the nature of his work. Julian begins to suspect he's being framed.

Title: Johnny English Reborn
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A bumbling British secret agent trains with monks in Tibet and returns to stop an assassination of the Chinese premier.
Description: The most prominent heads of state in the world begin gathering for a conference that could have a major impact on global politics. When MI-7 receives word that the Chinese premier has become the target of some high-powered killers, it falls on ___ English to save the day.

Title: Austenland
Hint: A woman obsessed with a period drama travels to a Regency-era theme park in search of the perfect gentleman.
Description: Obsessed with the BBC production of "Pride and Prejudice", a woman travels to a Jane Austen theme park in search for her perfect gentleman.

Title: Intolerable Cruelty
Hint: A divorce lawyer falls for a gold-digging client in a romantic comedy from two famous filmmaking brothers.
Description: A revenge-seeking gold digger marries a womanizing Beverly Hills lawyer with the intention of making a killing in the divorce.

Title: Berlin Syndrome
Hint: An Australian photojournalist's holiday fling in Germany turns into imprisonment by her lover.
Description: A passionate holiday romance leads to an obsessive relationship when an Australian photojournalist wakes one morning in an abandoned ___ apartment and is unable to leave.

Title: Bus Stop
Hint: A naive cowboy falls for a nightclub singer at a Phoenix rodeo and tries to drag her back to Montana.
Description: Cowboys Beauregard Decker and Virgil Blessing attend a rodeo in Phoenix, where Decker falls in love with beautiful cafe singer Cherie. He wants to take Cherie back to his native Montana and marry her, but she dreams of traveling to Hollywood and becoming famous.

Title: The Principal
Hint: A teacher takes charge of a violent inner-city high school and fights the gang that runs it.
Description: Burglary. Drugs. Assault. Rape. The students at Brandel High are more than new ___ Rick Latimer bargained for. Gangs fight to control the school using knives - even guns - when they have to. When Latimer and the head of security try to clean up the school and stop the narcotics trade, they run up against a teenage mafia.

Title: Womb
Hint: A woman's consuming love forces her to bear the clone of her dead lover.
Description: A woman's consuming love forces her to bear the clone of her dead beloved. From his infancy to manhood, she faces the unavoidable complexities of her controversial decision.

Title: Angus, Thongs and Perfect Snogging
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A 14-year-old British girl tries to snag a boyfriend while surviving her family and friends.
Description: Georgia Nicolson is fourteen, lives with nosey parents who don't understand her, an annoying three year old sister and has to wear a beret to school. She would, however, rather be blonde, have a smaller nose and a boyfriend. Revolving around her hilarious journal entries, prepare to be engulfed in the world of the soaring joys and bottomless angst of being a teenager.

Title: Mr. Right
Hint: A girl falls for the perfect guy, who turns out to be a hitman on the run from his former employers.
Description: A girl falls for the "perfect" guy, who happens to have a very fatal flaw: he's a hitman on the run from the crime cartels who employ him.

Title: Tales from Earthsea
Hint: A young prince and a wizard investigate why dragons have appeared and magic is fading across an archipelago.
Description: Something bizarre has come over the land. The kingdom is deteriorating. People are beginning to act strange... What's even more strange is that people are beginning to see dragons, which shouldn't enter the world of humans. Due to all these bizarre events, Ged, a wandering wizard, is investigating the cause. During his journey, he meets Prince Arren, a young distraught teenage boy.

Title: Young Adult
Hint: A divorced writer returns to her Minnesota hometown to reconnect with her married high school sweetheart.
Description: A divorced writer from the Midwest returns to her hometown to reconnect with an old flame, who's now married with a family.

Title: Newness
Hint: In Los Angeles, two millennials navigating an app-driven hookup culture begin an open relationship.
Description: In contemporary Los Angeles, two millennials navigating a social media–driven hookup culture begin a relationship that pushes both emotional and physical boundaries.

Title: Fast Food Nation
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A fictional look at the health issues and social consequences of America's love of burgers.
Description: A dramatised examination of the health issues and social consequences of America's love affair with fast ___.

Title: Deathgasm
Hint: Two teenage metalheads unwittingly summon an ancient demon by playing cursed sheet music.
Description: Two teenage boys unwittingly summon an ancient evil entity known as The Blind One by delving into black magic while trying to escape their mundane lives.

Title: One Crazy Summer
Hint: An aspiring teen cartoonist and his friends help a singer save her family property on Nantucket.
Description: An aspiring teenage cartoonist and his friends come to the aid of a singer trying to save her family property from developers.

Title: Rabid
Hint: After experimental plastic surgery, a young woman develops a taste for blood and spreads a rabies-like plague.
Description: A young woman develops a taste for human blood after experimental plastic surgery, and her victims turn into bloodthirsty zombies, leading into a city-wide epidemic.

Title: Osmosis Jones
Genres: Action, Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Science Fiction
Hint: A white blood cell cop with a cold pill partner must stop a deadly virus from destroying a human body.
Description: A white blood cell policeman, with the help of a cold pill, must stop a deadly virus from destroying the human they live in, Frank.

Title: Threesome
Hint: Two mismatched college guys get stuck sharing a dorm with a girl, sparking a messy love triangle.
Description: At a sizable public college, high-minded student Eddy is forced to room with the slovenly Stuart, but the pair strike up a surprising friendship. When attractive co-ed Alex is assigned to live with the two male students because of her gender-neutral name, a roundabout love triangle ensues. Eddy secretly yearns for Stuart, who wants Alex, but she prefers Eddy.

Title: Throw Momma from the Train
Hint: A wannabe novelist with an overbearing mother persuades his writing teacher they should swap murders.
Description: Larry Donner, an author with a cruel ex-wife, teaches a writing workshop in which one of his students, Owen, is fed up with his domineering mother. When Owen watches a Hitchcock classic that seems to mirror his own life, he decides to put the movie's plot into action and offers to kill Larry's ex-wife, if Larry promises to murder his mom.

Title: Hoodlum
Hint: In 1930s Harlem, an ex-con takes on a ruthless gangster trying to muscle in on the numbers racket.
Description: In 1934, the second most lucrative business in New York City was running 'the numbers'. When Madam Queen—the powerful woman who runs the scam in Harlem—is arrested, Ellsworth 'Bumpy' Johnson takes over the business and must resist an invasion from a merciless mobster.

Title: Unlocked
Hint: A woman's life is turned upside down when a dangerous man finds her lost smartphone and uses it to stalk her.
Description: A woman's life is turned upside-down when a dangerous man gets a hold of her lost cell phone and uses it to track her every move.

Title: Baby Boom
Hint: A high-flying New York career woman inherits a toddler from a distant relative and moves to rural Vermont.
Description: J.C. Wiatt is a talented and ambitious New York City career woman who is married to her job and working towards partner at her firm. She has a live-in relationship with Steven, a successful investment broker who, along with J.C., agreed children aren't part of the plan. J.C.'s life takes an unexpected turn when a distant relative dies and the will appoints her the caretaker of their baby girl, Elizabeth.

Title: Project Almanac
Hint: A group of teens discover plans for a time machine in a basement and use it for their own gain.
Description: A group of teens discover secret plans of a time machine, and construct one. However, things start to get out of control.

Title: Delivery Man
Country: United States of America, India, Canada
Hint: A middle-aged slacker discovers that his sperm donations fathered 533 children, many of whom want to meet him.
Description: An affable underachiever finds out he's fathered 533 children through anonymous donations to a fertility clinic 20 years ago. Now he must decide whether or not to come forward when 142 of them file a lawsuit to reveal his identity.

Title: It Boy
Hint: A shy 35-year-old architect falls for a much younger man who pretends to be older, in French romantic comedy.
Description: 38-year-old Alice has everything to become the next editor-in-chief of Rebelle magazine except for her uptight image. But when the young and charming Balthazar, barely 20, crosses Alice's path, she realizes that he holds the key to her promotion.

Title: Aniara
Hint: A colossal passenger ship heading to Mars is knocked off course and drifts endlessly through the void.
Description: A ship carrying settlers to a new home on Mars after Earth is rendered uninhabitable is knocked off-course, causing the passengers to consider their place in the universe.

Title: Paycheck
Genres: Action, Adventure, Mystery, Science Fiction, Thriller
Hint: A reverse engineer whose memory is wiped after each job finds an envelope of clues instead of his payment.
Description: Michael Jennings is a genius who's hired – and paid handsomely – by high-tech firms to work on highly sensitive projects, after which his short-term memory is erased so he's incapable of breaching security. But at the end of a three-year job, he's told he isn't getting a ___ and instead receives a mysterious envelope.

Title: Forever Young
Genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Drama, Science Fiction, Romance
Hint: A 1939 test pilot volunteers to be cryogenically frozen and wakes up 50 years later.
Description: A 1939 test pilot asks his best friend to use him as a guinea pig for a cryogenics experiment. Daniel McCormick wants to be frozen for a year so that he doesn't have to watch his love lying in a coma. The next thing Daniel knows is that he's been awoken in 1992.

Title: The Dead Pool
Hint: A hard-nosed San Francisco cop investigates a list of celebrities who are being killed one by one.
Description: Dirty Harry Callahan returns for his final film adventure. Together with his partner Al Quan, he must investigate the systematic murder of prominent figures. By the time Harry learns that the murders are part of a sick game to predict such deaths, it may be too late.

Title: Underworld: Awakening
Hint: A vampire warrior awakens after 12 years to find humans have discovered her kind and are wiping them out.
Description: Having escaped years of imprisonment, vampire warrioress Selene finds herself in a changed world where humans have discovered the existence of both Vampire and Lycan clans and are conducting an all-out war to eradicate both immortal species. Now Selene must battle the humans and a frightening new breed of super Lycans to ensure the death dealers' survival.

Title: While We're Young
Hint: A middle-aged documentary filmmaker and his wife have their stale lives shaken up by a hip twentysomething couple.
Description: An uptight documentary filmmaker and his wife find their lives loosened up a bit after befriending a free-spirited younger couple.

Title: Screamers
Country: Canada, Japan, United States of America
Hint: On a distant mining planet, soldiers face self-replicating killer robots that have begun to evolve.
Description: SIRIUS 6B, Year 2078. On a distant mining planet ravaged by a decade of war, scientists have created the perfect weapon: a blade-wielding, self-replicating race of killing devices known as ___ designed for one purpose only -- to hunt down and destroy all enemy life forms.

Title: Elizabethtown
Hint: A shoe designer who has just lost his company a fortune travels to Kentucky for his father's funeral.
Description: Drew Baylor is fired after causing his shoe company to lose hundreds of millions of dollars. To make matters worse, he's also dumped by his girlfriend. On the verge of ending it all, Drew gets a new lease on life when he returns to his family's small Kentucky hometown after his father dies. Along the way, he meets a flight attendant with whom he falls in love.

Title: Barbershop
Hint: A day in the life of a struggling barber shop on Chicago's South Side.
Description: A day in the life of a ___ on the south side of Chicago. Calvin, who inherited the struggling business from his deceased father, views the shop as nothing but a burden and waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy and struggles with the notion that he just sold it out.

Title: Because of Winn-Dixie
Hint: A lonely girl in a small Florida town adopts a stray dog who helps her make friends.
Description: A girl, abandoned by her mother when she was three, moves to a small town in Florida with her father. There, she adopts an orphaned dog she names ___. The bond between the girl and her special companion brings together the people in a small Florida town and heals her own troubled relationship with her father.

Title: Evita
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The rise of an actress who became first lady of Argentina, told in a sung-through musical.
Description: The hit musical based on the life of ___ Duarte, an Argentinian actress who eventually became the wife of Argentinian president Juan Perón, and the most beloved and hated woman in Argentina.

Title: Dead Snow
Hint: Medical students on a ski trip in Norway discover that Nazi zombies are guarding stolen gold.
Description: Eight medical students on a ski trip to Norway discover that Hitler's horrors live on when they come face to face with a battalion of zombie Nazi soldiers intent on devouring anyone unfortunate enough to wander into the remote mountains where they were once sent to die.

Title: Risen
Hint: A Roman officer investigates the disappearance of a crucified man's body from a sealed tomb.
Description: Clavius, a powerful Roman military tribune, and his aide, Lucius, are tasked with solving the mystery of what happened to Jesus in the weeks following the crucifixion, in order to disprove the rumors of a ___ Messiah and prevent an uprising in Jerusalem.

Title: The Fury
Hint: A CIA agent searches for his psychic son, who has been kidnapped by a government agency.
Description: When a devious plot separates CIA agent Peter Sandza from his son, Robin, the distraught father manages to see through the ruse. Taken because of his psychic abilities, Robin is being held by Ben Childress, who is studying people with supernatural powers in hopes of developing their talents as weapons. Soon Peter pairs up with Gillian, a teen who has telekinesis, to find and rescue Robin.

Title: W.
Hint: The life of the 43rd US president, from wild young man to the Iraq War.
Description: The story of the eventful life of George ___ Bush—his struggles and triumphs, how he found both his wife and his faith—and the critical days leading up to his decision to invade Iraq.

Title: Mindhunters
Country: Finland, Netherlands, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: FBI profiling trainees are trapped on an island and realise one of them is a serial killer.
Description: Trainees in the FBI's psychological profiling program must put their training into practice when they discover a killer in their midst. Based very loosely on Agatha Christie's And Then There Were None.

Title: Radioactive
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, France
Hint: The life of a Nobel Prize-winning scientist and her extraordinary discoveries in radiation.
Description: The story of Nobel Prize winner Maria Skłodowska-Curie and her extraordinary scientific discoveries—through the prism of her marriage to husband Pierre—and the seismic and transformative effects their discovery of radium had on the 20th century.

Title: Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
Hint: Two time-travelling slackers are killed by evil robot doubles and must challenge Death to get back.
Description: Amiable slackers ___ are once again roped into a fantastical adventure when De Nomolos, a villain from the future, sends evil robot duplicates of the two lads to terminate and replace them. The robot doubles actually succeed in killing ___, but the two are determined to escape the afterlife, challenging the Grim Reaper to a series of games in order to return to the land of the living.

Title: Cat's Eye
Hint: Three creepy horror-master tales connected by a wandering stray tabby, including a troll that steals a girl's breath.
Description: Three short stories linked by a stray cat that roams from one tale to the next, in this creepy triptych that begins as Dick tries to quit smoking by any means necessary. Next, we meet Johnny, an adulterous man who's forced by his lover's husband onto a building's hazardous ledge. Finally, Amanda is threatened by an evil gnome who throws suspicion on the family cat.

Title: Radius
Hint: A man wakes from a car crash with no memory and finds that anyone who comes near him drops dead.
Description: Liam wakes from a car crash with no memory of who he is. As he makes his way into town to look for help, he finds only dead bodies, all with strange pale eyes. Liam's first assessment is that a virus is present in the air, but he soon discovers the horrible truth: anyone who comes within a 50-foot ___ of him dies instantly.

Title: About Last Night
Hint: A Chicago couple try to make a casual affair into a real relationship despite their meddling friends.
Description: A man and woman meet and try to have a romantic affair, despite their personal problems and the interference of their disapproving friends.

Title: The November Man
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An ex-CIA operative is brought back for a personal mission and finds himself hunted by his former protégé.
Description: An ex-CIA operative is brought back in on a very personal mission and finds himself pitted against his former pupil in a deadly game involving high level CIA officials and the Russian president-elect.

Title: Everything, Everything
Hint: A teen who can't leave her house due to a rare illness falls for the boy next door.
Description: A teenager who's lived a sheltered life because she's allergic to everything, falls for the boy who moves in next door.

Title: Breakthrough
Hint: A mother's faith is tested when her son falls through the ice of a frozen lake and is trapped underwater.
Description: Tragedy strikes when a woman named Joyce's son falls through the ice on a frozen lake and is trapped underwater for over 15 minutes. After being rushed to the hospital, the 14-year-old boy continues to fight for his life as Joyce, her husband and their pastor stay by his bedside and pray for a miracle.

Title: Over the Moon
Hint: A grieving girl builds a rocket to prove the existence of a legendary lunar goddess, in an animated musical.
Description: Fueled by memories of her mother, resourceful Fei Fei builds a rocket to the ___ on a mission to prove the existence of a legendary ___ goddess.

Title: Wedding Season
Hint: Two Indian-Americans pressured by their parents to marry fake a relationship to survive a summer of family nuptials.
Description: Pressured by their immigrant parents to find spouses, two Indian-Americans pretend to date in order to survive a summer of weddings – but find themselves falling for each other as they struggle to balance who they are with who their parents want them to be.

Title: Alien Nation
Hint: An LA cop is partnered with an extraterrestrial immigrant from a new refugee population to solve his partner's murder.
Description: A few years from now, Earth will have the first contact with an alien civilization. These aliens, known as Newcomers, slowly begin to be integrated into human society after years of quarantine.

Title: Very Bad Things
Hint: A bachelor party in Vegas goes horribly wrong when a stripper is accidentally killed.
Description: Kyle Fisher has one last night to celebrate life as a single man before marrying Laura, so he sets out to Vegas with four of his best buddies. But a drug and alcohol filled night on the town with a stripper who goes all the way, turns into a cold night in the desert with shovels when the stripper goes all the way into a body bag after dying in their bathroom.

Title: Escape to Witch Mountain
Hint: Two orphans with special powers are pursued by a millionaire who wants to exploit their abilities.
Description: Tia and Tony are two orphaned youngsters with extraordinary powers. Lucas Deranian poses as their uncle in order to get the kids into the clutches of Deranian's megalomaniacal boss, evil millionaire Aristotle Bolt, who wants to exploit them. Jason, a cynical widower, helps Tia and Tony ___, while at the same time Tia and Tony help Jason escape the pain of the loss of his wife.

Title: Nighthawks
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, France
Hint: Two New York cops track an international terrorist who is planning an attack in the city.
Description: When one of Europe's most lethal terrorists shows up in New York, an elite undercover cop is assigned to take him down by any means necessary.

Title: Somewhere
Country: France, Italy, Japan, United States of America
Hint: A burnt-out Hollywood star holed up in a famous hotel re-examines his life when his daughter visits.
Description: After withdrawing to the Chateau Marmont, a passionless Hollywood actor reexamines his life when his eleven-year-old daughter surprises him with a visit.

Title: The Man Who Killed Don Quixote
Country: Belgium, France, Portugal, Spain, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A cynical commercials director returns to the Spanish village where he made his student film and finds an old man who believes he's a knight.
Description: Toby, a cynical film director finds himself trapped in the outrageous delusions of an old Spanish shoe-maker who believes himself to be Don ___. In the course of their comic and increasingly surreal adventures, Toby is forced to confront the tragic repercussions of a film he made in his idealistic youth.

Title: Uncommon Valor
Hint: A retired colonel reunites a team of Vietnam veterans to rescue his son, who is held as a POW in Laos.
Description: A group of Vietnam War veterans re-unite to rescue one of their own left behind and taken prisoner by the Vietnamese.

Title: Misbehaviour
Hint: A group of women from the women's liberation movement disrupt the 1970 Miss World competition in London.
Description: A group of women involved in the Women's Liberation Movement hatched a plan to invade the stage and disrupt the live broadcast at the 1970 Miss World competition in London, resulting in overnight fame for the newly-formed organization. When the show resumed, the results caused an uproar and turned the Western ideal of beauty on its head.

Title: To All the Boys: Always and Forever
Hint: A teen couple faces their senior year and the challenge of choosing colleges in the final romantic chapter.
Description: Senior year of high school takes center stage as Lara Jean returns from a family trip to Korea and considers her college plans — with and without Peter.

Title: Proof of Life
Country: United States of America, Ecuador, United Kingdom, Poland
Hint: A professional hostage negotiator is hired to free an American engineer kidnapped by rebels in South America.
Description: When Peter Bowman, an American engineer working in a South American country, is captured by anti-government forces, the rebels learn his identity and demand $5 million for his safe return. However, his US employer is on the verge of insolvency and will not provide the ransom.

Title: Assassins
Hint: A veteran hitman who wants to retire is hunted by an ambitious young assassin.
Description: Assassin Robert Rath arrives at a funeral to kill a prominent mobster, only to witness a rival hired gun complete the job for him -- with grisly results. Horrified by the murder of innocent bystanders, Rath decides to take one last job and then return to civilian life.

Title: He Never Died
Hint: A mysterious, solitary man with strange habits and a taste for blood finds his past catching up with him.
Description: Jack is a solitary man with a mysterious past. His strange habits will soon become stranger when his past catches up with him.

Title: Chemical Hearts
Hint: A hopelessly romantic high school senior falls for a mysterious new classmate with a tragic past.
Description: When a hopelessly romantic high school senior falls for a mysterious new classmate, it sets them both on an unexpected journey that teaches them about love, loss, and most importantly themselves.

Title: Lone Wolf McQuade
Hint: A renegade Texas Ranger wages a one-man war against an arms smuggler.
Description: The archetypical renegade Texas Ranger wages war against a drug kingpin with automatic weapons, his wits and martial arts after a gun battle leaves his partner dead. All of this inevitably culminates in a martial arts showdown between the drug lord and the ranger, and involving the woman they both love.

Title: Repo Men
Country: Canada, United States of America, United Kingdom, Japan
Hint: In the future, a man who repossesses artificial organs is fitted with a heart he can't pay for.
Description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims.

Title: John Dies at the End
Hint: A new drug sends users across time and dimensions, but they come back changed, in a bizarre horror comedy.
Description: A new drug promises out-of-body experiences, but users are coming back changed forever, and an otherworldly invasion of Earth is underway.

Title: Celebrity
Hint: A divorced writer and his ex-wife navigate the world of fame and fortune in New York, in black and white.
Description: The career and personal life of writer Lee are at a standstill, so he divorces his bashful wife, Robin, and dives into a new job as an entertainment journalist. His assignments take him to the swankiest corners of Manhattan, but as he jumps from one lavish party to another and engages in numerous empty romances, he starts to doubt the worth of his work.

Title: The Nest
Country: Canada, Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An ambitious entrepreneur moves his American family to a crumbling English manor in the 1980s.
Description: Rory is an ambitious entrepreneur who brings his American wife and kids to his native country, England, to explore new business opportunities. After abandoning the sanctuary of their safe American suburban surroundings, the family is plunged into the despair of an archaic '80s Britain and their unaffordable new life in an English manor house threatens to destroy the family.

Title: Jennifer 8
Hint: A big-city cop moves to a small town and investigates a serial killer targeting blind women.
Description: John Berlin, a big-city cop from LA moves to a small-town police force and immediately finds himself investigating a murder. Using theories rejected by his colleagues, Berlin meets a young blind woman named Helena, whom he is attracted to. Meanwhile, a serial killer is on the loose—and only John knows it.

Title: 13 Sins
Hint: A meek salesman drowning in debt receives a call offering him money to complete 13 increasingly sinister tasks.
Description: Drowning in debt as he's about to get married, a bright but meek salesman receives a mysterious phone call informing him that he's on a hidden-camera game show where he must execute ___ tasks to receive a multi-million dollar cash prize.

Title: Country Strong
Hint: A rising young singer-songwriter gets involved with a fallen, emotionally unstable Nashville star on her comeback tour.
Description: Soon after the rising young singer-songwriter Beau Williams gets involved with a fallen, emotionally unstable country star Kelly Canter, the pair embark on a career resurrection tour helmed by her husband/manager James and featuring a beauty queen-turned-singer Chiles Stanton. Between concerts, romantic entanglements and old demons threaten to derail them all.

Title: To Rome with Love
Hint: Four stories unfold in the Italian capital, from a retired opera director to a couple on their honeymoon.
Description: Four tales unfold in the Eternal City: While vacationing in ___, architect John encounters a young man whose romantic woes remind him of a painful incident from his own youth; retired opera director Jerry discovers a mortician with an amazing voice, and he seizes the opportunity to rejuvenate his own flagging career; a young couple have separate romantic interludes; a spotlight shines on an ordinary man.

Title: Blind Fury
Hint: A sightless Vietnam vet trained as a swordsman comes to America to help rescue his army buddy's son.
Description: A ___ Vietnam vet, trained as a swordfighter, comes to America and helps to rescue the son of a fellow soldier.

Title: Death to Smoochy
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A corrupt children's TV host is fired and plots revenge on his squeaky-clean replacement, a purple rhino.
Description: Tells the story of Rainbow Randolph, the corrupt, costumed star of a popular children's TV show, who is fired over a bribery scandal and replaced by squeaky-clean ___, a puffy fuchsia rhinoceros.

Title: Psycho Goreman
Hint: Two siblings resurrect an ancient alien overlord and use a magic amulet to make him do their bidding.
Description: Siblings Mimi and Luke unwittingly resurrect an ancient alien overlord. Using a magical amulet, they force the monster to obey their childish whims, and accidentally attract a rogues’ gallery of intergalactic assassins to small-town suburbia.

Title: Wimbledon
Hint: A fading British tennis player falls for a rising American star during his last tournament at a famous grass-court championship.
Description: Britain’s Peter Colt has never quite lived up to his dreams of tennis stardom. Once ranked as high as number 11 in the world, the journeyman veteran has watched his number slip to 119 as his confidence on the court slowly ebbs away. Now, on the eve of his leaving the world of professional tennis, he’s granted a wild card, allowing him to play his final ___ tournament…make that his final tournament ever.

Title: Formula 51
Hint: An American master chemist plans to score big on a drug deal in Liverpool, but it all goes wrong.
Description: An American master chemist plans to score big on a once in a lifetime drug deal. All does not go as planned and he is soon entangled in a web of deceit.

Country: Austria, Germany, United States of America
Hint: A soft-spoken American co-pilot struggles to save passengers when terrorists try to hijack a flight from Berlin.
Description: When terrorists try to seize control of a Berlin-Paris flight, a soft-spoken young American co-pilot struggles to save the lives of the passengers and crew while forging a surprising connection with one of the hijackers.

Title: Loving Annabelle
Hint: A rebellious new student at a Catholic girls' school falls for her poetry teacher.
Description: ___ is the wise-beyond-her-years newcomer to an exclusive Catholic girls school. Having been expelled from her first two schools she's bound to stir some trouble. Sparks fly though when sexual chemistry appears between her and the Head of her dorm and English teacher, Simone Bradley. ___ pursues her relentlessly and until the end the older woman manages to avoid the law.

Title: Wolfen
Hint: A New York cop investigates grisly deaths that seem to be the work of supernatural wolves.
Description: A New York City cop and an expert criminologist trying to solve a series of grisly deaths in which the victims have seemingly been maimed by feral animals discover a sinister connection between the crimes and an old legend.

Title: Pecker
Hint: A Baltimore teen photographer becomes an art-world sensation, to the horror of his neighbourhood.
Description: A Baltimore teenager who picks up a second-hand camera starts snapping his way to stardom, soon turning into a nationwide sensation, with a fateful choice between his life and his art.

Title: Down with Love
Country: United States of America, Germany, Switzerland
Hint: In 1962 New York, love blossoms between a playboy journalist and a feminist advice author.
Description: In 1962 New York City, love blossoms between a playboy journalist and a feminist advice author.

Title: Escape from the Planet of the Apes
Hint: Three talking chimpanzees travel back in time to 1970s Los Angeles.
Description: The world is shocked by the appearance of three talking chimpanzees, who arrived mysteriously in a spacecraft. Intrigued by their intelligence, humans use them for research - until the ___ attempt to escape.

Title: The Baytown Outlaws
Hint: Three redneck brothers agree to help a woman rescue her godson from a gang leader.
Description: When three redneck brothers agree to help a woman save her son from an abusive father, they become targets on the run from an odd cast of characters.

Title: The New York Ripper
Hint: A Manhattan police detective and a psychoanalyst track a vicious slasher who taunts them with a duck-like voice.
Description: A burned-out New York police detective teams up with a college psychoanalyst to track down a vicious serial killer randomly stalking and killing various young women around the city.

Title: The Extraordinary Adventures of Adèle Blanc-Sec
Hint: A famous novelist goes on an adventure in 1910s Paris, involving a pterodactyl and Egyptian mummies.
Description: An adventure set in the early part of the 20th century, focused on a popular novelist and her dealings with would-be suitors, the cops, monsters, and other distractions.

Title: Going the Distance
Hint: A couple try to keep their romance alive when one moves to San Francisco and the other stays in New York.
Description: Erin and Garrett are very much in love. When Erin moves to San Francisco to finish her journalism degree and Garrett stays behind in New York to work in the music industry, they gamely keep the romance alive with webcams and frequent-flyer miles. But just when it seems the lovers will soon be reunited, they each score a big break that could separate them for good.

Title: The Limehouse Golem
Hint: A series of murders in Victorian London is blamed on a legendary creature.
Description: A series of murders has shaken the community to the point where people believe that only a legendary creature from dark times – the mythical ___ – must be responsible.

Title: Nick of Time
Hint: An ordinary man is forced to assassinate a politician to save his kidnapped daughter, with only 90 minutes.
Description: An ordinary man is suddenly forced into a plot to kill a politician in exchange for his kidnapped daughter's freedom.

Title: Breathe In
Hint: A foreign exchange student challenges the dynamics of her host family and has an affair with the father.
Description: When a foreign exchange student arrives in a small upstate New York town, she challenges the dynamics of her host family's relationships and alters their lives forever.

Title: Alex Strangelove
Hint: A high school senior is about to lose his virginity to his girlfriend but realises he might be gay.
Description: Alex Truelove is on a quest to lose his virginity, an event eagerly awaited by his patient girlfriend and cheered on with welcome advice by his rowdy friends. But Alex, a super gregarious dude, is oddly unmotivated. A magical house party throws Alex into the presence of Elliot, a hunky college guy, who pegs Alex as gay and flirts hard.

Title: Bad Influence
Hint: A young executive's life is turned upside down by a mysterious stranger who leads him into a dark world.
Description: Wimpy young executive Michael is about to get pulverized by a jealous boyfriend in a bar when a handsome, mysterious stranger steps in—and then disappears. Later that night, Michael runs into a stranger on a pier, who wheedles his way into Michael's life and turns it upside down.

Title: Gung Ho
Hint: An auto worker acts as a liaison when a Japanese company takes over his Pennsylvania factory.
Description: When a western Pennsylvania auto plant is acquired by a Japanese company, brokering auto worker Hunt Stevenson faces the tricky challenge of mediating the assimilation of two clashing corporate cultures. At one end is the Japanese plant manager and the sycophant who is angling for his position. At the other, a number of disgruntled long-time union members struggle with the new exigencies of Japanese quality control.

Title: Little Monsters
Hint: A young boy befriends the monster under his bed and is drawn into a world of mischief.
Description: A young boy is scared of the monster under his bed. He asks his 6th grade brother to swap rooms for the night as a bet that the monster really exists. Soon the brother becomes friends with the monster and discovers a whole new world of fun and games under his bed where pulling pranks on kids and other ___ is the main attraction.

Title: On Chesil Beach
Hint: In 1962 England, a young couple's honeymoon night collides with their sexual anxieties.
Description: In 1962 England, a young couple finds their idyllic romance colliding with issues of sexual freedom and societal pressure, leading to an awkward and fateful wedding night.

Title: Shimmer Lake
Hint: A small-town sheriff's investigation of a bank robbery is told in reverse, day by day.
Description: Shot in reverse day-by-day through a week—a local sheriff embarks on a quest to unlock the mystery of three small-town criminals and a bank heist gone wrong.

Title: How to Make an American Quilt
Hint: A graduate student spends a summer with her grandmother's quilting circle and hears their love stories.
Description: Soon-to-be-wed graduate student Finn Dodd develops cold feet when she suspects her fiancé is cheating on her. In order to clear her head, Finn visits her grandmother, Hy, and great aunt, Glady Joe Cleary, in Grasse, Calif.

Title: The Frisco Kid
Hint: A Polish rabbi crossing the American West to his new congregation is befriended by an outlaw.
Description: Rabbi Avram arrives in Philadelphia from Poland en route to San Francisco where he will be a congregation's new rabbi. An innocent and inexperienced traveller, he is tricked by con men to pay for the trip to go west, then they leave him and his belongings scattered along a deserted road. He is befriended by a stranger, Tommy, who is a bank robber and have many adventures during their journey.

Title: Hope Springs
Hint: After thirty years of marriage, a middle-aged couple attends an intense week-long counselling session.
Description: After thirty years of marriage, a middle-aged couple attends an intense, week-long counseling session to work on their relationship.

Title: Hart's War
Hint: An American POW lieutenant defends a black airman accused of murder in a German prison camp.
Description: When Col. William McNamara is stripped of his freedom in a German POW camp, he's determined to keep on fighting even from behind enemy lines. Enlisting the help of a young lieutenant in a brilliant plot against his captors, McNamara risks everything on a mission to free his men and change the outcome of the war.

Title: Third Person
Country: Belgium, Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Three interconnected love stories set in Paris, Rome and New York.
Description: An acclaimed novelist struggles to write an analysis of love in one of three stories, each set in a different city, that detail the beginning, middle and end of a relationship.

Title: Tightrope
Hint: A New Orleans detective investigating a serial killer has dark sexual tastes that mirror the killer's.
Description: Wes Block is a detective who's put on the case of a serial killer whose victims are young and pretty women. The murders are getting personal when the killer chooses victims who are acquaintances of Block. Even his daughters are threatened.

Title: Plunkett & Macleane
Hint: An aristocrat and a commoner team up as highwaymen in 18th-century London.
Description: Will ___ and Captain James ___, two men from different ends of the social spectrum in 18th-century England, enter a gentlemen's agreement: They decide to rid the aristocrats of their belongings. With ___ criminal know-how and ___ social connections, they team up to be soon known as "The Gentlemen Highwaymen".

Title: Just Before I Go
Hint: A man who has nothing to live for returns to his hometown to confront his high school bully before ending it all.
Description: Ted Morgan has been treading water for most of his life. After his wife leaves him, Ted realizes he has nothing left to live for. Summoning the courage for one last act, Ted decides to go home and face the people he feels are responsible for creating the shell of a person he has become. But life is tricky.

Title: Fur: An Imaginary Portrait of Diane Arbus
Hint: A 1950s housewife and photographer falls for a mysterious neighbour covered in hair.
Description: In 1958 New York ___ is a housewife and mother who works as an assistant to her husband, a photographer employed by her wealthy parents. Respectable though her life is, she cannot help but feel uncomfortable in her privileged world. One night, a new neighbor catches ___ eye, and the enigmatic man inspires her to set forth on the path to discovering her own artistry.

Title: Gloria Bell
Hint: A free-spirited divorcée in LA spends her nights dancing and falls for a man who can't let go of his family.
Description: ___ is a free-spirited divorcée who spends her days at a straight-laced office job and her nights on the dance floor, joyfully letting loose at clubs around Los Angeles. After meeting Arnold on a night out, she finds herself thrust into an unexpected new romance, filled with both the joys of budding love and the complications of dating, identity, and family.

Title: Blue Chips
Hint: A college basketball coach under pressure to win breaks the rules to recruit top players.
Description: Pete Bell, a college basketball coach is under a lot of pressure. His team isn't winning and he cannot attract new players. The stars of the future are secretly being paid by boosters. This practice is forbidden in the college game, but Pete is desperate and has pressures from all around.

Title: ARQ
Hint: Two old friends in a dystopian future are trapped in a time loop involving a perpetual energy device.
Description: Two old friends living in a dystopic future become trapped in a mysterious time loop — one that may have something to do with an ongoing battle between an omnipotent corporation and a ragtag band of rebels.

Title: The United States vs. Billie Holiday
Hint: A jazz singer's career is overshadowed by the government's war on drugs targeting her in the 1940s.
Description: ___ Holiday spent much of her career being adored by fans. In the 1940s, the government targeted Holiday in a growing effort to racialize the war on drugs, ultimately aiming to stop her from singing her controversial ballad, "Strange Fruit."

Title: Green Card
Hint: A Frenchman and an American woman enter a marriage of convenience so he can stay in the US.
Description: Urban horticulturalist Brontë Mitchell has her eye on a gorgeous apartment, but the building's board will rent it only to a married couple. Georges Fauré, a waiter from France whose visa is expiring, needs to marry an American woman to stay in the country.

Title: The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby: Them
Hint: A New York couple's relationship is tested after the loss of their child, told from his perspective.
Description: A New York couple's relationship is tested after the loss of their child. This film is the wide-released combination of the original two :him and :her volumes that premiered at the Cannes Film Festival.

Title: The Brass Teapot
Hint: A couple discovers a magical kitchen pot makes them money whenever they hurt themselves.
Description: When a couple discovers that a ___ makes them money whenever they hurt themselves, they must come to terms with how far they are willing to go.

Title: Sylvia
Hint: The tumultuous relationship between two famous poets, a British man and an American woman.
Description: Story of the relationship between the poets Ted Hughes and ___ Plath.

Title: Lost Bullet
Hint: A small-time delinquent turned police mechanic is framed for murder and must find the evidence.
Description: A small time delinquent, turned police mechanic for a go fast task force, is forced to defend his innocence when his mentor is killed by dirty cops.

Title: The Tigger Movie
Hint: An energetic bouncing tiger searches for his family in the Hundred Acre Wood.
Description: Winnie the Pooh, Piglet, Owl, Kanga, Roo, and Rabbit are preparing a suitable winter home for Eeyore, the perennially dejected donkey, but ___ continual bouncing interrupts their efforts.

Title: Noelle
Hint: Santa's daughter sets off on a mission to find her brother after he gets cold feet.
Description: Kris Kringle's daughter, ___, sets off on a mission to find and bring back her brother, after he gets cold feet when it's his turn to take over as Santa.

Title: City Hunter
Hint: A lecherous private eye ends up on a cruise ship taken over by terrorists.
Description: A self-indulgent private investigator winds up on a cruise ship full of rich patrons, gorgeous women, murderous terrorists, and scarce food.

Title: Charlie Countryman
Hint: A young American falls hard for a Romanian cellist whose father has died, and whose ex is a gangster.
Description: A young American falls hard for a Romanian cellist whose father has recently died -- and whose violent past could bring about his own demise.

Title: Great Balls of Fire!
Hint: The wild life of a rock-and-roll legend in the 1950s, and his scandalous marriage to his teenage cousin.
Description: The story of Jerry Lee Lewis, arguably the greatest and certainly one of the wildest musicians of the 1950s. His arrogance, remarkable talent, and unconventional lifestyle often brought him into conflict with others in the industry, and even earned him the scorn and condemnation of the public.

Title: The Ramen Girl
Hint: An American woman stranded in Tokyo after a breakup becomes the apprentice of a gruff noodle-soup master.
Description: An American woman is stranded in Tokyo after breaking up with her boyfriend. Searching for direction in life, she trains to be a ___ chef under a tyrannical Japanese master.

Title: Anything Else
Hint: An aspiring writer in New York falls in love at first sight with a free-spirited young woman.
Description: Jerry Falk, an aspiring writer in New York, falls in love at first sight with a free-spirited young woman named Amanda. He has heard the phrase that life is like "___," but soon he finds that life with the unpredictable Amanda isn't like ___ at all.

Title: Only the Lonely
Hint: A Chicago cop who still lives with his overbearing mother falls for a shy undertaker's daughter.
Description: Danny Muldoon, a Chicago policeman, still lives with his overbearing mother Rose. He meets and falls in love with Theresa Luna, whose father owns the local funeral parlour. Naturally, his mother objects to the relationship, and Danny and Theresa must either overcome her objections or give up the romance.

Title: Rapid Fire
Hint: A college student witnesses a murder and is pursued by smugglers, mobsters and crooked federal agents.
Description: College student Jake Lo is pursued by smugglers, mobsters and crooked federal agents after he witnesses a murder by a Mafia kingpin.

Title: The Private Lives of Pippa Lee
Hint: A woman forced into a retirement community engages in a secret affair with a younger man.
Description: After her much older husband forces a move to a suburban retirement community, ___ engages in a period of reflection and finds herself heading toward a quiet nervous breakdown.

Title: The Truth About Cats & Dogs
Hint: A successful vet and radio host persuades her model neighbour to pretend to be her for a caller who's fallen for her voice.
Description: A successful veterinarian and radio show host with low self-esteem asks her model friend to impersonate her when a handsome man wants to see her.

Title: The Hard Way
Hint: A Hollywood action star tags along with a tough New York cop to research a role.
Description: Seeking to raise his credibility as an actor and to land a role as a tough cop on a new show, Hollywood action star Nick Lang works a deal with New York City Police Capt. Brix, who by chance is one of his fans. Nick will be paired with detective Lt. John Moss and learn how to act like a real cop. But when Nick drives John crazy with questions and imitating him, he gets in the way of John's pursuit of a serial killer.

Title: Trespass
Hint: Two firemen hunt for stolen gold in an abandoned factory and get caught in a gang war.
Description: Two Arkansas firemen, Vince and Don, get hold of a map that leads to a cache of stolen gold in an abandoned factory in East St. Louis. What they don't know is that the factory is on the turf of a local gang, who come by to execute one of their enemies. Vince sees the shooting, the gang spots Vince, and extended mayhem ensues.

Title: Surveillance
Hint: Two FBI agents interview witnesses of a series of murders on a remote highway.
Description: An FBI agent tracks a serial killer with the help of three of his would-be victims - all of whom have wildly different stories to tell.

Title: The Assassin
Hint: A woman trained as a killer by a nun in 9th-century China is ordered to kill the man she was once promised to.
Description: 9th century China. Ten year old general’s daughter Nie Yinniang is abducted by a nun who initiates her into the martial arts, transforming her into an exceptional ___ charged with eliminating cruel and corrupt local governors.

Title: For Your Consideration
Hint: The cast and crew of an indie film go crazy when Oscar buzz surrounds their movie.
Description: The possibility of Oscar gold holds the cast and crew of an independent film in its grip after the performance of its virtually unknown, veteran star generates awards buzz.

Title: The Other Woman
Hint: A woman discovers her boyfriend is married and teams up with his wife and another mistress to get revenge.
Description: After discovering her boyfriend is married, Carly soon meets the wife he's been cheating on. And when yet another affair is discovered, all three women team up to plot mutual revenge on the three-timing SOB.

Title: The Three Caballeros
Hint: A duck receives a box of gifts and goes on a musical journey through Latin America.
Description: For Donald's birthday he receives a box with three gifts inside. The gifts, a movie projector, a pop-up book, and a pinata, each take Donald on wild adventures through Mexico and South America.

Title: Greedy
Hint: Scheming relatives compete for the fortune of their wealthy, manipulative uncle, who has a young new companion.
Description: Meet the McTeagues. They've come to stake a claim in their wealthy uncle's will… only he's not dead yet!

Title: Bleach
Hint: A high school student who can see ghosts gains the powers of a soul reaper to fight evil spirits.
Description: High school student Ichigo Kurosaki lives an ordinary life, besides being able to see ghosts and the blurry memories of his mother's death under strange circumstances when he was a kid. His peaceful world suddenly breaks as he meets Rukia Kuchiki, a God of Death.

Title: Made
Hint: Two aspiring boxers and lifelong friends get involved in a money-laundering scheme in New York.
Description: Two aspiring boxers and lifelong friends get involved in a money-laundering scheme through a low-level organized crime group.

Title: This Christmas
Hint: A family reunion for the holidays turns chaotic as siblings come home with secrets.
Description: This year Christmas with the Whitfields promises to be one they will never forget. All the siblings have come home for the first time in years and they've brought plenty of baggage with them. As the Christmas tree is trimmed and the lights are hung, secrets are revealed and family bonds are tested. As their lives converge, they join together and help each other discover the true meaning of family.

Title: Headshot
Hint: A young man with no memory washes ashore and is pursued by a ruthless drug lord in Indonesia.
Description: A young man washes ashore, his memory gone - but his past comes back to haunt him after he is nursed back to health and his killing ability is needed when he takes on a powerful drug lord.

Title: Smilla's Sense of Snow
Hint: A woman investigates the death of a young boy who falls from the roof of her Copenhagen apartment.
Description: ___ Jaspersen attempts to understand the death of a small boy who falls from the roof of her apartment building. Suspecting wrongdoing, ___ uncovers a trail of clues leading towards a secretive corporation that has made several mysterious expeditions to Greenland.

Title: The Conspiracy
Hint: A documentary about paranoid theorists takes a horrific turn when one subject vanishes and the filmmakers infiltrate a secret society.
Description: A documentary about ___ theories takes a horrific turn after the filmmakers uncover an ancient and dangerous secret society.

Title: Jamaica Inn
Hint: In 19th-century Cornwall, a young woman discovers her uncle runs a gang of shipwreckers.
Description: In early 19th-century Cornwall, young Mary Yellan travels to live with her aunt and uncle at the remote ___, where she discovers the ___ is a front for a violent gang of wreckers who lure ships to their doom along the coast. As she becomes entangled in their crimes, Mary must fight to survive and uncover the truth behind the terror that haunts the moors.

Title: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
Country: Spain, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two married couples in London find only trouble and heartache as their complicated lives unfold.
Description: Two married couples find only trouble and heartache as their complicated lives unfold. After 40 years of marriage, Alfie leaves his wife to pursue what he thinks is happiness with a call girl. His wife, Helena, reeling from abandonment, decides to follow the advice of a psychic.

Title: Special Forces
Hint: A war correspondent is kidnapped by the Taliban and an elite French commando unit is sent to rescue her.
Description: Afghanistan. War correspondent Elsa Casanova is taken hostage by the Taliban. Faced with her imminent execution, a ___ unit is dispatched to free her.

Title: Wakefield
Hint: A man's nervous breakdown leads him to leave his wife and live in their garage attic for months.
Description: A man's nervous breakdown causes him to leave his wife and live in his attic for several months.

Title: Cedar Rapids
Hint: A naive insurance salesman from a small town travels to a big-city convention to save his company.
Description: A naive Midwesterner insurance salesman travels to a big-city convention in an effort to save the jobs of his co-workers.

Title: A Long Way Down
Hint: Four strangers meet on a London rooftop on New Year's Eve, each intending to end their life.
Description: Four lost souls—a disgraced TV presenter, a foul-mouthed teen, an isolated single mother, and a failed musician—decide to end their lives on the same night, New Year's Eve.

Title: Red Corner
Hint: An American lawyer on business in China is framed for murder and fights the legal system.
Description: An American attorney on business in China, ends up wrongfully on trial for murder and his only key to innocence is a female defense lawyer from the country.

Title: Norwegian Wood
Hint: A man recalls his life in 1960s Tokyo, torn between two very different women after his friend's suicide.
Description: Toru recalls his life in the 1960s, when his friend Kizuki killed himself and he grew close to Naoko, Kizuki's girlfriend, and another woman, the outgoing, lively Midori.

Title: Shopgirl
Hint: A shy department store glove clerk is courted by a wealthy older man and a slacker musician.
Description: Mirabelle is a disenchanted salesgirl and aspiring artist who sells gloves and accessories at a department store. She has two men in her life: wealthy divorcée Ray Porter and struggling musician Jeremy. Mirabelle falls in love with the glamorous Ray, and her life takes a magical turn, but eventually she realizes that she must empower herself and make a choice between them.

Title: The Art of the Steal
Hint: A documentary about the decades-long battle over a famous collection of Impressionist paintings in Philadelphia.
Description: A gripping tale of intrigue and mystery in the art world, this film traces the history of a collection of Post-Impressionist paintings - worth billions - which became the subject of a power struggle after the death of its owner, Dr. Albert Barnes.

Title: Art School Confidential
Hint: A shy young illustrator pursues his obsession at a pretentious college while a strangler stalks the campus.
Description: Starting from childhood attempts at illustration, the protagonist pursues his true obsession to art school. But as he learns how the art world really works, he finds that he must adapt his vision to the reality that confronts him.

Title: Solitary Man
Hint: A car tycoon watches his life hit the skids because of his business and romantic indiscretions.
Description: A car magnate watches his personal and professional life hit the skids because of his business and romantic indiscretions.

Title: Grabbers
Genres: Science Fiction, Comedy, Thriller, Horror, Mystery
Hint: Tentacled alien monsters invade a small Irish island, and the locals discover that alcohol is their only defence.
Description: Something sinister has come to the shores of Erin Island, unbeknownst to the quaint population of this sleepy fishing village resting somewhere off Ireland’s coast. First, some fishermen go missing. Then there is the rash of whale carcasses suddenly washing up on the beach.

Title: David Brent: Life on the Road
Hint: An office manager-turned-rock-star tries to make it as a musician on a disastrous UK tour.
Description: A camera crew catches up with ___, the former star of the fictional British series, "The Office" as he now fancies himself a rockstar on the road.

Title: The Good Neighbor
