Hint: A man covers up a deadly hit-and-run with his neighbour's help, but guilt sets in.
Description: A nightmarish evening unfolds for neighbors David and Robert when they accidentally hit a woman on her bike and flee the scene. While David is increasingly plagued by feelings of guilt, Robert shows no remorse and becomes overbearing and possessive.

Title: The Rewrite
Hint: An Oscar-winning screenwriter in a slump teaches a college writing class in Binghamton.
Description: An Oscar-winning writer in a slump leaves Hollywood to teach screenwriting at a college on the East Coast, where he falls for a single mom taking classes there.

Title: Flypaper
Hint: A man caught in the middle of two simultaneous bank robberies tries to protect the teller he loves.
Description: A man caught in the middle of two simultaneous robberies at a bank desperately tries to protect the teller with whom he's secretly in love.

Title: Mad City
Hint: A museum guard who loses his job tries to get it back at gunpoint, while a TV reporter exploits him.
Description: A misguided museum guard who loses his job and then tries to get it back at gunpoint is thrown into the fierce world of ratings-driven TV gone ___.

Title: The Red Baron
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A German WWI fighter ace becomes a war hero and falls for a nurse.
Description: Richthofen goes off to war like thousands of other men. As fighter pilots, they become cult heroes for the soldiers on the battlefields. Marked by sportsmanlike conduct, technical exactitude and knightly propriety, they have their own code of honour. Before long he begins to understand that his hero status is deceptive. His love for Kate, a nurse, opens his eyes to the brutality of war.

Title: The Battery
Hint: Two baseball players try to survive a zombie plague in rural New England.
Description: In rural Connecticut, baseball players Ben and Mickey are trying to survive a zombie plague. They are forced to form a ___: a catcher and a pitcher who work together to outwit the batter, the one who hits the ball. And the batter in this case just happens to be a zombie. Tough Ben and gentle Mickey frequently disagree on the best way to go about the situation.

Title: Shade
Hint: Con artists try to swindle a legendary card mechanic in a high-stakes poker game.
Description: Tiffany, Charlie and Vernon are con artists looking to up the ante from their typical scams. They figure a good way of doing this is taking down Dean "The Dean" Stevens, a well-known cardsharp, in a rigged game. However, they first need enough money to enter a game with Stevens, so they decide to strike a deal with fellow crook Larry Jennings to scam a local gangster -- which turns out to be a bad idea.

Title: The Crossing Guard
Hint: A grieving father plans to kill the drunk driver who killed his daughter when he's released.
Description: Unable to move on from the loss of his daughter, Freddy, now a shell of the person he was before, swears to kill the man responsible for her death.

Title: The 9th Life of Louis Drax
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A psychologist working with a boy who survived a near-fatal fall investigates a series of strange accidents.
Description: A psychologist who begins working with a young boy who has suffered a near-fatal fall finds himself drawn into a mystery that tests the boundaries of fantasy and reality.

Title: Cop Car
Hint: Two runaway boys find an abandoned sheriff's cruiser and take it for a joyride, and its crooked owner comes after them.
Description: Two kids find themselves in the centre of a deadly game of cat and mouse after taking a sheriff's cruiser for a joy ride.

Title: Prince Avalanche
Hint: Two road workers spend the summer of 1988 painting lines on a fire-ravaged Texas highway.
Description: Two highway road workers spend the summer of 1988 away from their city lives. The isolated landscape becomes a place of misadventure as the men find themselves at odds with each other and the women they left behind.

Title: The Astronaut Farmer
Hint: A Texas rancher builds a rocket in his barn to fulfil his dream of going to space.
Description: Texan Charles ___ left the Air Force as a young man to save the family ranch when his dad died. Like most American ranchers, he owes his bank. Unlike most, he's an astrophysicist with a rocket in his barn - one he's built and wants to take into space. It's his dream. The FBI puts him under surveillance when he tries to buy rocket fuel, and the FAA stalls him when he files a flight plan – but Charles is undeterred.

Title: Nurse Betty
Hint: A small-town waitress in shock after witnessing her husband's murder believes a soap opera is real.
Description: What happens when a person decides that life is merely a state of mind? If you're ___, a small-town waitress and soap opera fan from Fair Oaks, Kansas, you refuse to believe that you can't be with the love of your life just because he doesn't really exist. After all, life is no excuse for not living.

Title: The Pretty One
Hint: After her twin sister dies in a car accident, a young woman decides to take her place.
Description: When her idolized twin sister Audrey dies in a car accident, Laurel decides to take her place. But, as she eases into the life she has always wanted, she must decide between continuing the lie or revealing herself.

Title: Enduring Love
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two strangers become dangerously linked after witnessing a deadly hot-air balloon accident.
Description: Two strangers become dangerously close after witnessing a deadly accident. On a beautiful cloudless day a young couple celebrate their reunion with a picnic. Joe has planned a postcard-perfect afternoon in the English countryside with his partner, Claire. But as Joe and Claire prepare to open a bottle of champagne, their idyll comes to an abrupt end. A hot air balloon drifts into the field, obviously in trouble.

Title: Rob the Mob
Hint: A Queens couple in love start holding up Mafia social clubs, in a true story.
Description: The true-life story of a crazy-in-love Queens couple who robbed a series of mafia social clubs and got away with it… for a while… until they stumble upon a score bigger than they ever planned and become targets of both the mob and the FBI.

Title: Major Grom: Plague Doctor
Hint: An honest St. Petersburg police officer tracks a masked vigilante killing corrupt businessmen.
Description: In present day St. Petersburg, police major Igor ___, an honest and skilled cop with unconventional methods, pursues a vigilante murderer in the mask of a ___.

Title: Cyrus
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A divorced man finally meets the woman of his dreams, but her adult son is weirdly jealous.
Description: With John's social life at a standstill and his ex-wife about to get remarried, a down on his luck divorcée finally meets the woman of his dreams, only to discover she has another man in her life - her son. Before long, the two are locked in a battle of wits for the woman they both love-and it appears only one man can be left standing when it's over.

Title: Mindhorn
Hint: A washed-up actor known for playing a TV detective is asked by police to help catch a killer.
Description: A washed up actor best known for playing the title character in the 1980s detective show "___" must work with the police when a serial killer says that he will only speak with Detective ___, whom he believes to be real.

Title: The Big White
Country: Canada, Germany, New Zealand, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A travel agent in debt tries to cash in on his brother's life insurance using a frozen corpse.
Description: To remedy his financial problems, a travel agent has his eye on a frozen corpse, which just happens to be sought after by two hitmen.

Title: Daydream Nation
Hint: A teenager forced to move to a dull town has affairs with a teacher and a stoner classmate.
Description: Forced to move to a boring backwater town, a teenager embarks on affairs with a teacher and a stoner classmate.

Title: Versus
Hint: Gangsters, a woman and an escaped convict meet in a forest where the dead come back to life.
Description: A group of ruthless gangsters, an unknown woman and an escaped convict have met, in The Forest of Resurrection, the 444th portal to the other side. Their troubles start when those once killed and buried in the forest come back from the dead.

Title: I Am Not an Easy Man
Hint: A chauvinist man wakes up in a world where gender roles are reversed.
Description: The chauvinist Damien wakes up in a world where women and men have their roles reversed in society, and everything is dominated by women.

Title: Veronika Decides to Die
Hint: A young woman wakes in a mysterious asylum after a suicide attempt and is told she has days to live.
Description: After a frantic suicide attempt, ___ awakens inside a mysterious mental asylum. Under the supervision of an unorthodox psychiatrist who specializes in controversial treatment, ___ learns that she has only weeks to live.

Title: Hamlet 2
Hint: A failed actor turned drama teacher stages a musical sequel to a Shakespeare tragedy.
Description: Failed actor-turned-worse-high-school-drama-teacher Dana Marschz rallies his Tucson students as he conceives and stages a politically incorrect musical sequel to Shakespeare's ___.

Title: Ararat
Hint: A young man recounts how his life changed during the making of a film about the Armenian genocide.
Description: Interrogated by a customs officer, a young man recounts how his life was changed during the making of a film about the Armenian genocide.

Title: Welcome to Collinwood
Hint: Five hapless lowlifes try to rob a pawnbroker's safe in Cleveland, but are plagued by bad luck.
Description: Five hapless inner-city low-lifes attempt to burgle a pawnbroker's safe, but end up being plagued by bad luck.

Title: Bandslam
Hint: A nerdy new kid in town helps assemble a ragtag rock group to compete in a high-stakes battle of the bands.
Description: A new kid in town assembles a fledgling rock band — together, they achieve their dreams and compete against the best in the biggest event of the year, a battle of the bands.

Title: Ju-On: The Grudge 2
Hint: A TV crew shoots a paranormal reality show in a cursed Tokyo house and unleashes a vengeful ghost.
Description: When the cast and crew of a paranormal TV reality program decide to shoot in the house of the original Saeki hauntings, a series of strange events unfold at the location.

Title: Ordinary Decent Criminal
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, Ireland, United States of America
Hint: A flamboyant Dublin crook with two wives taunts the police with an audacious art heist.
Description: Michael Lynch is a notorious criminal with two wives and a flair for showmanship. He's also a huge embarrassment to the local police, who are determined to bring him down once and for all.

Title: The Meddler
Hint: A meddling widow moves to Los Angeles to be closer to her screenwriter daughter and won't stop texting her.
Description: With a new iPhone, an apartment near the Grove, and a comfortable bank account left to her by her beloved late husband, Marnie Minervini has happily relocated from New Jersey to Los Angeles to be near her daughter Lori, a successful (but still single) screenwriter, and smother her with motherly love.

Title: The Life Before Her Eyes
Hint: A woman relives the high school shooting that changed her life 15 years earlier.
Description: As the 15th anniversary of a fatal high school shooting approaches, former pupil Diana McFee is haunted by memories of the tragedy. After losing her best friend Maureen in the attack, Diana has been profoundly affected by the incident - her seemingly perfect life shaped by the events of that day.

Title: Southside with You
Hint: A future US president and his future wife spend a long summer day together on their first date in 1989 Chicago.
Description: Chronicles a single day in the summer of 1989 when the future president of the United States, Barack Obama, wooed his future First Lady on an epic first date across Chicago's South Side.

Title: Happy, Texas
Hint: Two escaped convicts roll into a tiny Lone Star town, where they're mistaken for a gay couple running a kids' beauty pageant.
Description: Two escaped convicts roll into the village of ___, where they're mistaken for a gay couple who work as beauty pageant consultants. They go along with it to duck the police, but the local sheriff has a secret of his own.

Title: Cocktail
Hint: A cocky young bartender learns the tricks of the trade from a cynical mentor and finds love in Jamaica.
Description: After being discharged from the Army, Brian Flanagan moves back to Queens and takes a job in a bar run by Doug Coughlin, who teaches Brian the fine art of bar-tending. Brian quickly becomes a patron favorite with his flashy drink-mixing style, and Brian adopts his mentor's cynical philosophy on life and goes for the money.

Title: Luka Chuppi
Hint: A television reporter in a small Indian town and his headstrong girlfriend decide to move in together before marriage.
Description: The story of a television reporter in Mathura who falls in love with a headstrong woman.

Title: Gulabo Sitabo
Hint: A greedy old landlord and a crafty tenant feud over a crumbling mansion in Lucknow, in a social satire.
Description: Set in present-day Lucknow, ___ is a social satire about two impossibly peculiar human beings, Mirza Chunnan Nawab, who stays in a dilapidated mansion and one of the tenants, Bankey Rastogi.

Title: Kokowääh
Hint: A German playboy discovers he has an eight-year-old daughter from a one-night stand.
Description: Henry is a playboy who has no idea that he is the father of a beautiful, cute girl out of a One-night-Stand. Her mother left the daughter in front of Henry door after her husband realized after 8 years of marriage that he is not the father so their relationship now is breaking up...

Title: Spyder
Hint: A surveillance expert comes across a serial killer who murders for pleasure in Hyderabad.
Description: A surveillance expert who wants to help people comes across a foe who is the very definition of evil. Can he stop the man before he destroys everything?

Title: Thalaivaa
Hint: A mafia don's son, who wants nothing to do with his father's life, is forced to take over the family business.
Description: A mafia don sends his son out of the country because he doesn't want even a shadow of his life falling on him. Destiny wills otherwise. The son makes an innocuous trip to Mumbai to visit his dad. And ends up filling his father's large shoes.

Title: Dügün Dernek 2: Sünnet
Hint: A screwball crew of friends land in hot water when a grandson's circumcision ceremony goes awry.
Description: Ismail and his old screwball crew land themselves in hot water when his grandson's circumcision evolves into a buzz-making citywide event.

Title: Blue Beetle
Hint: A recent college grad is chosen by an ancient alien scarab that bonds with him and gives him an armoured suit.
Description: Recent college grad Jaime Reyes returns home full of aspirations for his future, only to find that home is not quite as he left it. As he searches to find his purpose in the world, fate intervenes when Jaime unexpectedly finds himself in possession of an ancient relic of alien biotechnology: the Scarab.

Title: Haunted Mansion
Hint: A single mother and her son enlist a motley crew of spiritual experts to rid their New Orleans home of ghosts.
Description: A woman and her son enlist a motley crew of so-called spiritual experts to help rid their home of supernatural squatters.

Title: My Fault
Hint: A rebellious teen moves into a mansion with her stepbrother and the two fall into a forbidden romance.
Description: Noah must leave her city, boyfriend, and friends to move into William Leister's mansion, the flashy and wealthy husband of her mother Rafaela. As a proud and independent 17 year old, Noah resists living in a mansion surrounded by luxury. However, it is there where she meets Nick, her new stepbrother, and the clash of their strong personalities becomes evident from the very beginning.

Title: Saw III
Hint: A sadistic serial killer's apprentice puts a doctor and a grieving father through brutal games.
Description: Jigsaw has disappeared. Along with his new apprentice Amanda, the puppet-master behind the cruel, intricate games that have terrified a community and baffled police has once again eluded capture and vanished. While city detectives scramble to locate him, Doctor Lynn Denlon and Jeff Reinhart are unaware that they are about to become the latest pawns on his vicious chessboard.

Title: The Toxic Avenger
Hint: A scrawny, bullied janitor falls into a vat of radioactive sludge and becomes a hideous, mop-wielding hero.
Description: A gang of thugs devise a cruel hoax that goes horribly wrong as Melvin, a nerdy emaciated janitor at the local health club, is cast through a third story window into a vat of hazardous ___ waste.

Title: Thor: Love and Thunder
Hint: A Norse god's attempt at retirement is interrupted by a galactic killer out to exterminate every deity.
Description: After his retirement is interrupted by Gorr the God Butcher, a galactic killer who seeks the extinction of the gods, ___ Odinson enlists the help of King Valkyrie, Korg, and ex-girlfriend Jane Foster, who now wields Mjolnir as the Mighty ___. Together they embark upon a harrowing cosmic adventure to uncover the mystery of the God Butcher’s vengeance and stop him before it’s too late.

Title: Bodies Bodies Bodies
Hint: A group of rich twentysomethings play a murder party game in an isolated mansion, and it turns deadly.
Description: In an isolated family mansion, a group of rich 20-somethings decides to play ___, a game where one of them is secretly a "killer" while the rest tries to "escape". Things take a turn for the worse when real ___ start turning up, setting off a paranoid and dangerous chain of events.

Title: This Is 40
Hint: A married couple approaching a milestone birthday deal with their kids, parents and money problems.
Description: Pete and Debbie are both about to turn ___, their kids hate each other, both of their businesses are failing, they're on the verge of losing their house, and their relationship is threatening to fall apart.

Title: I Spit on Your Grave
Hint: A young writer is brutally assaulted at a backwoods cabin and takes violent revenge on her attackers.
Description: A young, beautiful career woman rents a backwoods cabin to write her first novel. Attacked by a group of local lowlifes and left for dead, she devises a horrific plan to inflict revenge.

Title: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A wizard professor sends a team to stop a dark wizard from seizing control of the magical world.
Description: Professor Albus ___ knows the powerful, dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald is moving to seize control of the wizarding world. Unable to stop him alone, he entrusts magizoologist Newt Scamander to lead an intrepid team of wizards and witches. They soon encounter an array of old and new ___ as they clash with Grindelwald's growing legion of followers.

Title: Birth
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A grieving widow is about to remarry when a 10-year-old boy claims to be her dead husband reincarnated.
Description: It took Anna 10 years to recover from the death of her husband, Sean, but now she's on the verge of marrying her boyfriend, Joseph, and finally moving on. However, on the night of her engagement party, a young boy named Sean turns up, saying he is her dead husband reincarnated.

Title: As Above, So Below
Hint: A team of explorers venture into the catacombs under Paris and uncover dark secrets.
Description: When a team of explorers venture into the catacombs that lie beneath the streets of Paris, they uncover the dark secret that lies within this city of the dead.

Title: Scream 4
Hint: A best-selling author returns to her hometown and the masked killer from her past returns too.
Description: Fifteen years after the original Woodsboro murders, Sidney Prescott returns home to promote her new book about surviving trauma, only for a new Ghostface killer to emerge, targeting a new group of teens.

Title: Malignant
Hint: A woman is haunted by visions of grisly murders, and discovers they're connected to her childhood imaginary friend.
Description: Madison is paralyzed by shocking visions of grisly murders, and her torment worsens as she discovers that these waking dreams are in fact terrifying realities with a mysterious tie to her past.

Title: The Visit
Hint: A brother and sister spend a week at their grandparents' remote farm and discover something is very wrong.
Description: A brother and sister are sent to their grandparents' remote Pennsylvania farm for a week, where they discover that the elderly couple is involved in something deeply disturbing.

Title: The Empty Man
Country: South Africa, United States of America
Hint: An ex-cop searching for a missing girl uncovers a secret group trying to summon a supernatural entity.
Description: On the trail of a missing girl, an ex-cop comes across a secretive group attempting to summon a terrifying supernatural entity.

Title: The Cannonball Run
Country: United States of America, Hong Kong
Hint: An outlandish cross-country race brings together a ragtag group of drivers in disguises and gadget-filled cars.
Description: A cross-country road race is based on an actual event, the ___ Baker Sea to Shining Sea Memorial Trophy Dash, organized by Brock Yates to protest the 55 mph speed limit then in effect in the U.S. The ___ was named for Erwin G. "___" Baker, who in the roaring 20's rode his motorcycle across the country.

Title: Pearl Harbor
Hint: Two best friends, both pilots, love the same woman before and after the 1941 Japanese attack in Hawaii.
Description: The lifelong friendship between Rafe McCawley and Danny Walker is put to the ultimate test when the two ace fighter pilots become entangled in a love triangle with beautiful Naval nurse Evelyn Johnson. But the rivalry between the friends-turned-foes is immediately put on hold when they find themselves at the center of Japan's devastating attack on ___ on Dec. 7, 1941.

Title: The Legend of Tarzan
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A jungle-raised English lord returns to the Congo to investigate a mining camp.
Description: ___, having acclimated to life in London, is called back to his former home in the jungle to investigate the activities at a mining encampment.

Title: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
Country: Canada, Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: In 1968, a group of teens find a haunted book whose tales write themselves and then come true.
Description: Mill Valley, Pennsylvania, Halloween night, 1968. After playing a joke on a school bully, Stella and her friends decide to sneak into a supposedly haunted house that once belonged to the powerful Bellows family, unleashing dark forces that they will be unable to control.

Title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
Hint: An aging archaeologist races against Soviet agents to find a mysterious artefact.
Description: Set during the Cold War, the Soviets—led by sword-wielding Irina Spalko—are in search of a ___ which has supernatural powers related to a mystical Lost City of Gold. Indy is coerced to head to Peru at the behest of a young man whose friend—and Indy's colleague—Professor Oxley has been captured for his knowledge of the ___ whereabouts.

Title: Sweet Home Alabama
Hint: A New York fashion designer must go back down South to get a divorce from her childhood sweetheart.
Description: New York fashion designer, Melanie Carmichael suddenly finds herself engaged to the city's most eligible bachelor. But her past holds many secrets—including Jake, the redneck husband she married in high school, who refuses to divorce her. Bound and determined to end their contentious relationship once and for all, Melanie sneaks back home to ___ to confront her past.

Title: Jeepers Creepers
Hint: Two siblings driving home from college are stalked by a winged creature that eats human body parts.
Description: On a desolate country highway, two homeward-bound teens are nearly run off the road by a maniac in a beat-up truck, and later spot him shoving what appears to be a body down a sewer pipe.

Title: Killer Klowns from Outer Space
Hint: Aliens disguised as circus entertainers crash-land in a small town to harvest its residents in cotton candy.
Description: Aliens disguised as clowns crash land on Earth in a rural town to capture unsuspecting victims in cotton candy cocoons for later consumption.

Title: Mama
Hint: Two orphaned girls who survived alone in the woods for years are adopted by their uncle, but something followed them.
Description: Guillermo del Toro presents ___, a supernatural thriller that tells the haunting tale of two little girls who disappeared into the woods the day that their parents were killed. When they are rescued years later and begin a new life, they find that someone or something still wants to come tuck them in at night.

Title: The Losers
Hint: A double-crossed special forces team seeks revenge on the CIA operative who betrayed them.
Description: On a mission deep in the Bolivian jungle, a team of elite commandos finds itself on the receiving end of a lethal betrayal. Now presumed dead, the men join forces with a mysterious operative named Aisha to hunt down their enemy and even the score.

Title: Terminator: Dark Fate
Hint: A cyborg and an augmented soldier must protect a young woman from a new, deadly liquid-metal assassin.
Description: Decades after Sarah Connor prevented Judgment Day, a lethal new ___ is sent to eliminate the future leader of the resistance. In a fight to save mankind, battle-hardened Sarah Connor teams up with an unexpected ally and an enhanced super soldier to stop the deadliest ___ yet.

Title: Fear Street: Part One - 1994
Hint: In the mid-90s, a group of teenagers discover the terrifying, centuries-old curse on their unlucky town.
Description: After a series of brutal slayings, a teen and her friends take on an evil force that's plagued their notorious town for centuries.

Title: Men in Black II
Hint: Two secret agents must stop an alien disguised as a lingerie model from destroying the world.
Description: Kay and Jay reunite to provide our best, last and only line of defense against a sinister seductress who levels the toughest challenge yet to the MIB's untarnished mission statement – protecting Earth from the scum of the universe. It's been four years since the alien-seeking agents averted an intergalactic disaster of epic proportions.

Title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A scrawny middle schooler records his attempts to become popular in his journal.
Description: Greg Heffley is headed for big things, but first he has to survive the scariest, most humiliating experience of any kid’s life – middle school! That won’t be easy, considering he’s surrounded by hairy-freckled morons, wedgie-loving bullies and a moldy slice of cheese with nuclear cooties!

Title: No Strings Attached
Hint: Two friends try to keep their relationship purely physical, but feelings start to get in the way.
Description: Emma is a busy doctor who sets up a seemingly perfect arrangement when she offers her best friend Adam a relationship with one rule: ___. But when a fling becomes a thing, can sex friends stay best friends?

Title: The Hating Game
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two executive assistants who despise each other compete for the same promotion and fall in love.
Description: Resolving to achieve professional success without compromising her ethics, Lucy embarks on a ruthless game of one-upmanship against cold and efficient nemesis Joshua, a rivalry that is complicated by her growing attraction to him.

Title: Cold Pursuit
Country: France, Norway, United States of America
Hint: A snowplough driver seeks revenge against the drug dealers who killed his son.
Description: The quiet family life of Nels Coxman, a snowplow driver, is upended after his son's murder. Nels begins a vengeful hunt for Viking, the drug lord he holds responsible for the killing, eliminating Viking's associates one by one. As Nels draws closer to Viking, his actions bring even more unexpected and violent consequences, as he proves that revenge is all in the execution.

Title: The Card Counter
Country: Sweden, United Kingdom, United States of America, China
Hint: A gambler and former interrogator is haunted by his past at Abu Ghraib.
Description: William Tell just wants to play cards. His spartan existence on the casino trail is shattered when he is approached by Cirk, a vulnerable and angry young man seeking help to execute his plan for revenge on a military colonel. Tell sees a chance at redemption through his relationship with Cirk.

Title: Sleepaway Camp
Hint: A painfully shy girl sent to a lakeside summer retreat is suspected when campers start dying gruesomely.
Description: Years after a terrible boating accident, Angela is sent to Camp Arawak where a series of bizarre and violent "accidents" begin to claim the lives of various campers.

Title: Kate
Hint: A poisoned assassin has 24 hours to take revenge on the Japanese gangsters who killed her.
Description: A ruthless criminal operative has less than 24 hours to exact revenge on her enemies and in the process forms an unexpected bond with the daughter of one of her past victims.

Title: Alien: Resurrection
Hint: A cloned soldier and a crew of space smugglers battle acid-blooded creatures on a military research ship.
Description: Two hundred years after Lt. Ripley died, a group of scientists clone her, hoping to breed the ultimate weapon. But the new Ripley is full of surprises … as are the new aliens. Ripley must team with a band of smugglers to keep the creatures from reaching Earth.

Title: Porky's
Hint: In 1950s Florida, a group of horny high school boys plot revenge on a strip club owner.
Description: In 1954 Florida, a group of high school boys head to a strip club in the Everglades in an attempt to lose their collective virginity. When the club's owner and his sheriff brother swindle them out of their money and embarrass them, the boys plan revenge.

Title: Final Destination 2
Hint: A young woman has a premonition of a deadly highway pileup, and death starts hunting the survivors.
Description: When Kimberly has a violent premonition of a highway pileup she blocks the freeway, keeping a few others meant to die, safe...Or are they? The survivors mysteriously start dying and it's up to Kimberly to stop it before she's next.

Title: Dick Tracy
Hint: A comic strip detective's life is complicated when a femme fatale makes advances towards him.
Description: The comic strip detective finds his life vastly complicated when Breathless Mahoney makes advances towards him while he is trying to battle Big Boy Caprice's united mob.

Title: Rush Hour 3
Country: United States of America, Germany, France
Hint: Two mismatched cops travel to Paris to take on the Chinese Triads.
Description: After a botched assassination attempt, the mismatched duo finds themselves in Paris, struggling to retrieve a precious list of names, as the murderous crime syndicate's henchmen try their best to stop them. Once more, Lee and Carter must fight their way through dangerous gangsters; however, this time, the past has come back to haunt Lee. Will the boys get the job done once and for all?

Title: 300: Rise of an Empire
Hint: A Greek general leads his navy against a massive Persian force led by a vengeful commander.
Description: Greek general Themistocles attempts to unite all of Greece by leading the charge that will change the course of the war. Themistocles faces the massive invading Persian forces led by mortal-turned-god, Xerxes and Artemesia, the vengeful commander of the Persian navy.

Title: Hackers
Hint: A teenage computer whiz joins a group of young cyberpunks who uncover a corporate embezzlement scheme.
Description: Along with his new friends, a teenager who was arrested by the US Secret Service and banned from using a computer for writing a computer virus discovers a plot by a nefarious hacker, but they must use their computer skills to find the evidence while being pursued by the Secret Service and the evil computer genius behind the virus.

Title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
Hint: Giant robots discover an alien spacecraft hidden on the lunar surface since the 1960s space race.
Description: The Autobots continue to work for NEST, now no longer in secret. But after discovering a strange artifact during a mission in Chernobyl, it becomes apparent to Optimus Prime that the United States government has been less than forthright with them.

Title: Knowing
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Australia
Hint: A teacher opens a time capsule and finds a list of numbers that predicts disasters.
Description: A teacher opens a time capsule that has been dug up at his son's elementary school; in it are some chilling predictions -- some that have already occurred and others that are about to -- that lead him to believe his family plays a role in the events that are about to unfold.

Title: Emancipation
Hint: A runaway enslaved man escapes through the Louisiana swamps to find his family.
Description: Inspired by the gripping true story of a man who would do anything for his family—and for freedom. When Peter, an enslaved man, risks his life to escape and return to his family, he embarks on a perilous journey of love and endurance.

Title: The Brady Bunch Movie
Hint: The original 1970s TV family is placed in the 1990s, where they're more out of touch than ever.
Description: The original '70s TV family is now placed in the 1990s, where they're even more square and out of place than ever.

Title: Deep Impact
Hint: A comet is on a collision course with Earth, and a reporter uncovers the government's secret plans.
Description: A seven-mile-wide space rock is hurtling toward Earth, threatening to obliterate the planet. Now, it's up to the president of the United States to save the world. He appoints a tough-as-nails veteran astronaut to lead a joint American-Russian crew into space to destroy the comet before ___. Meanwhile, an enterprising reporter uses her smarts to uncover the scoop of the century.

Title: 47 Ronin
Country: Japan, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A half-breed outcast joins a band of masterless samurai seeking vengeance for their lord in a fantasy Japan.
Description: Kai—an outcast—joins Oishi, the leader of ___ outcast samurai. Together they seek vengeance upon the treacherous overlord who killed their master and banished their kind. To restore honour to their homeland, the warriors embark upon a quest that challenges them with a series of trials that would destroy ordinary warriors.

Title: Dark Shadows
Hint: A vampire is freed from his tomb in 1972 and returns to his dysfunctional descendants.
Description: Vampire Barnabas Collins is inadvertently freed from his tomb and emerges into the very changed world of 1972. He returns to Collinwood Manor to find that his once-grand estate and family have fallen into ruin.

Title: Cars 2
Hint: A racing car and a tow truck get caught up in international espionage during a world tour.
Description: Star race car Lightning McQueen and his pal Mater head overseas to compete in the World Grand Prix race. But the road to the championship becomes rocky as Mater gets caught up in an intriguing adventure of his own: international espionage.

Title: American Mary
Hint: A struggling medical student is drawn into the shady world of underground body modification surgery.
Description: A young medical student struggling to pay tuition is drawn into the shady world of underground body-modification.

Title: Case 39
Hint: A social worker fights to save a girl from her abusive parents, but discovers something sinister about the child.
Description: In her many years as a social worker, Emily Jenkins believes she has seen it all, until she meets 10-year-old Lilith and the girl's cruel parents. Emily's worst fears are confirmed when the parents try to harm the child, and so Emily assumes custody of Lilith while she looks for a foster family.

Title: Reign of Fire
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: In post-apocalyptic England, survivors battle airborne, flame-breathing beasts that have burned the world to ashes.
Description: In post-apocalyptic England, an American volunteer and a British survivor team up to fight off a brood of ___-breathing dragons seeking to return to global dominance after centuries of rest underground. The Brit -- leading a clan of survivors to hunt down the King of the Dragons -- has much at stake: His mother was killed by a dragon, but his love is still alive.

Title: Austin Powers in Goldmember
Hint: A swinging British spy must travel back to 1975 to stop a villain with a golden obsession.
Description: The world's most shagadelic spy continues his fight against Dr. Evil. This time, the diabolical doctor and his clone, Mini-Me, team up with a new foe—'70s kingpin ___. While pursuing the team of villains to stop them from world domination, ___ gets help from his dad and an old girlfriend.

Title: Despicable Me 3
Hint: A former supervillain and his wife must stop a 1980s child star turned criminal.
Description: Gru and his wife Lucy must stop former '80s child star Balthazar Bratt from achieving world domination.

Title: Idle Hands
Hint: A lazy teenager's hand becomes possessed and starts killing people, and he must stop it with his zombie friends.
Description: Anton is a cheerful but exceedingly non-ambitious 17-year-old stoner who lives to stay buzzed, watch TV, and moon over Molly, the beautiful girl who lives next door. However, it turns out that the old cliché about ___ being the devil's playground has a kernel of truth after all.

Title: Johnny English Strikes Again
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A bumbling British secret agent is brought out of retirement after a cyber attack.
Description: Disaster strikes when a criminal mastermind reveals the identities of all active undercover agents in Britain. The secret service can now rely on only one man - ___ English. Currently teaching at a minor prep school, ___ springs back into action to find the mysterious hacker.

Title: The Five-Year Engagement
Hint: A couple's walk down the aisle keeps getting postponed when career moves and family drama get in the way.
Description: Exactly one year after Tom meets Violet, he surprises her with a wedding ring. By all accounts, Tom and Violet are destined for their happily ever after. However, this engaged couple just keep getting tripped up on the long walk down the aisle.

Title: Dracula Untold
Hint: A prince of Transylvania becomes a vampire to protect his family from a Turkish invasion.
Description: Vlad Tepes is a great hero, but when he learns the Sultan is preparing for battle and needs to form an army of 1,000 boys, he vows to find a way to protect his family. Vlad turns to dark forces in order to get the power to destroy his enemies and agrees to go from hero to monster as he's turned into the mythological vampire, ___.

Title: Wolf Creek
Hint: Three backpackers stranded in the Australian outback are kidnapped by a serial killer.
Description: Three backpackers stranded in the Australian outback are plunged inside a hellish nightmare of insufferable torture by a sadistic psychopathic local.

Title: In the Shadow of the Moon
Hint: A Philadelphia cop becomes obsessed with a serial killer who returns every nine years.
Description: In 1988, Philadelphia police officer Thomas "Locke" Lockhart, hungry to become a detective, begins tracking a serial killer whose crimes defy scientific explanation. When the killer mysteriously resurfaces nine years later, Locke's obsession with finding the truth threatens to destroy his career, his family, and possibly his sanity.

Title: Parker
Hint: A professional thief is double-crossed by his crew and left for dead, and plans his revenge.
Description: A thief with a unique code of professional ethics is double-crossed by his crew and left for dead. Assuming a new disguise and forming an unlikely alliance with a woman on the inside, he looks to hijack the score of the crew's latest heist.

Title: The Adventures of Buckaroo Banzai Across the 8th Dimension
Hint: A neurosurgeon, rock star and physicist battles evil aliens from another plane of existence with his band.
Description: Adventurer/surgeon/rock musician ___ and his band of men, the Hong Kong Cavaliers, take on evil alien invaders from the ___.

Title: Hitman
Country: France, United States of America, United Kingdom, Turkey
Hint: A genetically engineered assassin known by a barcode tattoo is caught in a political conspiracy.
Description: A genetically engineered assassin with deadly aim, known only as "Agent 47" eliminates strategic targets for a top-secret organization. But when he's double-crossed, the hunter becomes the prey as 47 finds himself in a life-or-death game of international intrigue.

Title: The Love Witch
Hint: A modern-day sorceress in a retro Technicolor world uses spells to make men fall for her, with deadly consequences.
Description: A modern-day ___ uses spells and magic to get men to fall in love with her, with deadly consequences.

Title: Kindergarten Cop
Hint: A tough detective goes undercover teaching five-year-olds to catch a drug dealer's ex-wife and son.
Description: Hard-edged cop John Kimble gets more than he bargained for when he goes undercover as a ___ teacher to get the goods on a brutal drug lord while at the same time protecting the man's young son. Pitted against a class of boisterous moppets whose antics try his patience and test his mettle, Kimble may have met his match … in more ways than one.

Title: It Comes at Night
Hint: A family hiding in the woods from a deadly contagion is visited by another family seeking refuge.
Description: Secure within a desolate home as an unnatural threat terrorizes the world, a man has established a tenuous domestic order with his wife and son, but this will soon be put to test when a desperate young family arrives seeking refuge.

Title: Bad Moms
Hint: Three overworked and underappreciated mothers rebel against the pressures of perfect parenting.
Description: When three overworked and under-appreciated ___ are pushed beyond their limits, they ditch their conventional responsibilities for a jolt of long overdue freedom, fun, and comedic self-indulgence.

Title: Deliver Us from Evil
Hint: A New York cop teams up with a priest to investigate a series of demonic possessions.
Description: When a frightening wave of violence sweeps through New York City, troubled cop Sarchie fails to find a rational explanation for the bizarre crimes. However, his eyes are opened to a frightening alternate reality when renegade Jesuit priest Mendoza convinces him that demonic possession may be to blame for the gruesome murders. Together, they wage a valiant supernatural struggle to rid the city of an otherworldly evil.

Title: Maze Runner: The Death Cure
Hint: A young man leads a group of escapees on a final mission into the last city to rescue a friend.
Description: Thomas leads his group of escaped Gladers on their final and most dangerous mission yet. To save their friends, they must break into the legendary Last City, a WCKD-controlled labyrinth that may turn out to be the deadliest ___ of all. Anyone who makes it out alive will get answers to the questions the Gladers have been asking since they first arrived in the ___.

Title: Incantation
Hint: A woman who broke a religious taboo years ago must protect her daughter from a curse in Taiwanese found-footage horror.
Description: Inspired by the true story of a family who believed they were possessed by spirits. This film follows a woman who must protect her child from a curse.

Title: Lovelace
Hint: The story of a 1970s porn star used and abused by her coercive husband.
Description: Story of Linda ___, who is used and abused by the porn industry at the behest of her coercive husband, before taking control of her life.

Hint: A Nebraska farmer kills his wife with the help of their son and is haunted by her ghost.
Description: A simple yet proud rancher conspires to murder his wife for financial gain, convincing his teenage son to participate.

Title: Anger Management
Hint: A meek businessman is ordered to attend therapy sessions with an unhinged counsellor after an incident on a plane.
Description: After a small misunderstanding aboard an airplane escalates out of control, timid businessman Dave Buznik is ordered by the court to undergo ___ therapy at the hands of specialist Dr. Buddy Rydell. But when Buddy steps up his aggressive treatment by moving in, Dave goes from mild to wild as the unorthodox treatment wreaks havoc with his life.

Title: Ouija: Origin of Evil
Hint: In 1967, a widowed mother and her daughters add a new stunt to their séance business.
Description: In 1967 Los Angeles, a widowed mother and her two daughters add a new stunt to bolster their séance scam business and unwittingly invite authentic evil into their home. When the youngest daughter is overtaken by the merciless spirit, this small family confronts unthinkable fears to save her and send her possessor back to the other side.

Title: Flashdance
Hint: A young welder dreams of becoming a ballet dancer and works as a nightclub dancer.
Description: Alex Owens, a young woman juggling between two odd jobs, aspires to become a successful ballet dancer. Nick, who is her boss and lover, supports and encourages her to fulfil her dream.

Title: Just Friends
Hint: A once-overweight high school nerd returns home as a ladies' man and tries to win over his crush.
Description: While visiting his hometown during Christmas, a man comes face-to-face with his old high school crush whom he was best friends with – a woman whose rejection of him turned him into a ferocious womanizer.

Title: Save the Last Dance
Hint: After her mother's death, a ballet student moves to Chicago, where a classmate teaches her hip-hop.
Description: After the death of her mother, Sara moves to the South Side of Chicago to live with her father and gets transferred to a majority-black school. Her life takes a turn for the better when befriends Chenille and her brother Derek, who helps her with her dancing skills.

Title: Copshop
Hint: A con artist and an assassin are both locked up in a small-town police station.
Description: On the run from a lethal assassin, a wily con artist devises a scheme to hide out inside a small-town police station. However, when the hit man turns up at the precinct, an unsuspecting rookie cop finds herself caught in the crosshairs.

Title: Colossal
Country: Canada, South Korea, Spain, United States of America
Hint: A woman discovers she is mentally linked to a giant monster attacking Seoul.
Description: A woman discovers that severe catastrophic events are somehow connected to the mental breakdown from which she's suffering.

Title: The Arrival
Hint: An astrophysicist discovers evidence of an alien invasion hidden in Mexico and is hunted for knowing too much.
Description: Zane Ziminski is an astrophysicist who receives a message that seems to have extraterrestrial origins. Eerily soon after his discovery, Zane is fired. He then embarks on a search to determine the origins of the transmission that leads him into a Hitchcockian labyrinth of paranoia and intrigue.

Title: Color Out of Space
Country: United States of America, Portugal, Malaysia
Hint: A family in rural New England is infected by a mysterious coloured light from a meteorite.
Description: The Gardner family moves to a remote farmstead in rural New England to escape the hustle of the 21st century. They are busy adapting to their new life when a meteorite crashes into their front yard, melts into the earth, and infects both the land and the properties of space-time with a strange, otherworldly colour.

Title: Piggy
Hint: A bullied overweight teen sees hope when her tormentors are abducted by a mysterious stranger.
Description: A bullied overweight teenager sees a glimpse of hope when her tormentors are brutally abducted by a mesmerizing stranger.

Title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
Hint: A young woman with a rare ability and her allies fight against a ruthless leader in a dystopian Chicago.
Description: Beatrice Prior must confront her inner demons and continue her fight against a powerful alliance which threatens to tear her society apart.

Title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
Hint: A wasteland drifter becomes a pawn in a decadent outpost's gladiator arena.
Description: ___ becomes a pawn in a decadent oasis of a technological society, and when exiled, becomes the deliverer of a colony of children.

Title: Death Race 2000
Hint: In a dystopian future, drivers in a cross-country auto contest score points for running down pedestrians.
Description: In a boorish future, the government sponsors a popular, but bloody, cross-country race in which points are scored by mowing down pedestrians. Five teams, each comprised of a male and female, compete using cars equipped with deadly weapons. Frankenstein, the mysterious returning champion, has become America's hero, but this time he has a passenger from the underground resistance.

Title: The Amityville Horror
Hint: A family moves into a beautiful Long Island house where a mass murder took place, and terror ensues.
Description: George Lutz, his wife Kathy, and their three children have just moved into a beautiful, and improbably cheap, Victorian mansion nestled in the sleepy coastal town of ___, Long Island. However, their dream home is concealing a horrific past and soon each member of the Lutz family is plagued with increasingly strange and violent visions and impulses.

Title: Happy Death Day 2U
Hint: A college student is trapped in a time loop again, this time in a parallel dimension.
Description: Collegian Tree Gelbman wakes up in horror to learn that she's stuck in a parallel universe. Her boyfriend Carter is now with someone else, and her friends and fellow students seem to be completely different versions of themselves. When Tree discovers that Carter's roommate has been altering time, she finds herself once again the target of a masked killer.

Title: Adoration
Hint: A high school student weaves his family history into a news story involving terrorism.
Description: For his French-class assignment, a high school student weaves his family history in a news story involving terrorism, and goes on to invite an Internet audience in on the resulting controversy.

Title: Night at the Museum: Secret of the Tomb
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A watchman and his living exhibits travel to London to save the magic Egyptian tablet that brings them to life after dark.
Description: When the magic powers of The Tablet of Ahkmenrah begin to die out, Larry Daley spans the globe, uniting favorite and new characters while embarking on an epic quest to save the magic before it is gone forever.

Title: American Assassin
Country: Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: A young man whose fiancée is killed in a terrorist attack is recruited by the CIA.
Description: Following the murder of his fiancée, Mitch Rapp trains under the instruction of Cold War veteran Stan Hurley. The pair then is enlisted to investigate a wave of apparently random attacks on military and civilian targets.

Title: Meatballs
Hint: A summer camp counsellor takes a shy kid under his wing at a budget summer camp.
Description: Tripper is the head counselor at a budget summer camp called Camp Northstar. In truth, he's young at heart and only marginally more mature than the campers themselves. Tripper befriends Rudy, a loner camper who has trouble fitting in. As Tripper inspires his young charges to defeat rival Camp Mohawk in the annual Olympiad competition, Rudy plays matchmaker between Tripper and Roxanne, a female counselor at Northstar.

Title: Verónica
Hint: A teenage girl and her friends use a Ouija board during a solar eclipse in Madrid.
Description: In 1991 Madrid, after holding a séance at school, a teen girl minding her younger siblings at home suspects an evil force has entered their apartment.

Title: Alice Through the Looking Glass
Hint: A young woman returns to a magical world via a mirror and travels back in time to save her friend's family.
Description: ___ Kingsleigh returns to Underland and faces a new adventure in saving the Mad Hatter.

Title: TMNT
Country: Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: Four crime-fighting turtles have grown apart and must reunite to stop an ancient curse.
Description: After the defeat of their old arch nemesis, The Shredder, the Turtles have grown apart as a family. Struggling to keep them together, their rat sensei, Splinter, becomes worried when strange things begin to brew in New York City.

Title: Time Trap
Hint: A group of students become trapped inside a mysterious cave where time passes differently.
Description: A group of students become trapped inside a mysterious cave where they discover time passes differently underground than on the surface.

Title: Pumpkinhead
Hint: A grieving father seeks the help of a witch to summon a vengeful demon to kill the teens who killed his son.
Description: When a group of teenagers inadvertently kill his only son, Ed Harley seeks the powers of a backwoods witch to bring the child back to life.

Title: Fear
Hint: A teenage girl falls for a charming young man who turns out to be a psychopath.
Description: Nicole Walker always dreamed of being swept away by someone special — someone strong, sexy and sensitive who would care for her more than anything else in the world. David is all that and more: a modern-day knight who charms and seduces her, body and soul. But her perfect boyfriend is not all he seems to be. His sweet facade masks a savage, dark side that will soon transform Nicole's dream into a nightmare.

Title: Small Soldiers
Genres: Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Science Fiction, Action
Hint: A toy company's new action figures are equipped with military-grade microchips and go to war.
Description: When missile technology is used to enhance toy action figures, the toys soon begin to take their battle programming too seriously.

Title: The Cursed
Hint: In the late 19th century, a land baron slaughters a Roma clan, unleashing a curse on his family.
Description: In the late 19th century, a brutal land baron slaughters a Roma clan, unleashing a curse on his family and village. In the days that follow, the townspeople are plagued by nightmares, the baron's son goes missing, and a boy is found murdered.

Title: Synchronic
Hint: Two paramedics investigate deaths linked to a new designer drug that sends users back in time.
Description: Two New Orleans paramedics' lives are ripped apart after encountering a series of horrific deaths linked to a designer drug with bizarre, otherworldly effects.

Title: I Came By
Hint: A rebellious graffiti artist who targets wealthy homes discovers a respected judge has a dark secret.
Description: A rebellious young graffiti artist, who targets the homes of the wealthy elite, discovers a shocking secret that leads him on a journey endangering himself and those closest to him.

Title: Zathura: A Space Adventure
Hint: Two brothers discover a mysterious board game that launches their house into the cosmos.
Description: After their father is called into work, two young boys, Walter and Danny, are left in the care of their teenage sister, Lisa, and told they must stay inside. Walter and Danny, who anticipate a boring day, are shocked when they begin playing ___, a space-themed board game, which they realize has mystical powers when their house is shot into space. With the help of an astronaut, the boys attempt to return home.

Title: Wall Street: Money Never Sleeps
Hint: A disgraced financier released from prison warns of an economic crisis and teams up with his daughter's fiancé.
Description: As the global economy teeters on the brink of disaster, a young ___ trader partners with disgraced former ___ corporate raider Gordon Gekko on a two tiered mission: To alert the financial community to the coming doom, and to find out who was responsible for the death of the young trader's mentor.

Title: The Hole
Hint: Four teenagers at a British private school explore a sealed underground bunker, but only one emerges.
Description: Four teenagers at a British private school secretly uncover and explore the depths of a sealed underground ___ created decades ago as a possible bomb shelter.

Title: Transcendence
Hint: A dying scientist uploads his consciousness to a computer and becomes all-powerful.
Description: Two leading computer scientists work toward their goal of Technological Singularity, as a radical anti-technology organization fights to prevent them from creating a world where computers can transcend the abilities of the human brain.

Title: Dorian Gray
Hint: A young aristocrat whose portrait ages while he stays young descends into hedonism.
Description: Seduced into the decadent world of Lord Henry Wotton, handsome young aristocrat ___ becomes obsessed with maintaining his youthful appearance, and commissions a special portrait that will weather the winds of time while he remains forever young. When ___ obsession spirals out of control, his desperate attempts to safeguard his secret turn his once-privileged life into a living hell.

Title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
Hint: A young CIA analyst uncovers a Russian plot to crash the US economy.
Description: ___, as a young covert CIA analyst, uncovers a Russian plot to crash the U.S. economy with a terrorist attack.

Title: 3 Days to Kill
Hint: A dying CIA agent tries to reconnect with his daughter while taking on one last mission.
Description: A dangerous international spy is determined to give up his high stakes life to finally build a closer relationship with his estranged wife and daughter. But first, he must complete one last mission - even if it means juggling the two toughest assignments yet: hunting down the world's most ruthless terrorist and looking after his teenage daughter for the first time in ten years, while his wife is out of town.

Title: Trainwreck
Hint: A commitment-phobic magazine writer falls for a sports doctor.
Description: Ever since her father drilled into her head that monogamy isn't realistic, magazine writer Amy has made promiscuity her credo. As much as she enjoys an uninhibited life free of commitment, Amy is really in a rut. While writing a profile about charming and successful sports doctor Aaron Conners, she finds herself actually falling in love for the first time -- and what's more, Aaron seems to really like her too.

Title: The Brothers Grimsby
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A top MI6 agent is reunited with his idiot football hooligan brother.
Description: Wrongfully accused and on the run, a top MI6 assassin joins forces with his long-lost, football hooligan brother to save the world from a sinister plot.

Title: Moonraker
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A British secret agent investigates a hijacked space shuttle and a billionaire's plan to wipe out humanity.
Description: After Drax Industries' ___ space shuttle is hijacked, secret agent James Bond is assigned to investigate, traveling to California to meet the company's owner, the mysterious Hugo Drax. With the help of scientist Dr. Holly Goodhead, Bond soon uncovers Drax's nefarious plans for humanity, all the while fending off an old nemesis, Jaws, and venturing to Venice, Rio, the Amazon...and even outer space.

Title: Stigmata
Hint: An atheist hairdresser begins having violent experiences that mimic the wounds of Christ.
Description: A young woman with no strong religious beliefs, Frankie Paige begins having strange and violent experiences, showing signs of the wounds that Jesus received when crucified. When the Vatican gets word of Frankie's situation, a high-ranking cardinal requests that the Rev. Andrew Kiernan investigate her case.

Title: Two for the Money
Hint: A former college athlete joins forces with a sports consultant to handicap football games for high-rollers.
Description: A former college athlete joins forces with a sports consultant to handicap football games for high-rolling gamblers.

Title: Girls Trip
Hint: Four lifelong friends travel to New Orleans for the Essence Festival and rediscover their wild sides.
Description: Four girlfriends take a trip to New Orleans for an annual festival and, along the way, rediscover their wild sides and strengthen the bonds of sisterhood.

Title: Baby's Day Out
Hint: A wealthy infant is kidnapped but crawls away from his bumbling captors on an adventure through Chicago.
Description: Baby Bink couldn't ask for more: he has adoring (if somewhat sickly-sweet) parents, lives in a huge mansion, and he's just about to appear in the social pages of the paper. Unfortunately, not everyone in the world is as nice as Baby Bink's parents—especially the three enterprising kidnappers who pretend to be photographers from the newspaper.

Title: A Night at the Roxbury
Hint: Two dim-witted brothers who still live at home dream of getting into an exclusive nightclub in Los Angeles.
Description: Despite being well into adulthood, brothers Doug and Steve Butabi still live at home and work in the flower shop owned by their dad. They exist only to hit on women at discos, though they're routinely unsuccessful until a chance run-in with Richard Grieco gets them inside the swank ___ club. Mistaken for high rollers, they meet their dream women, Vivica and Cambi, and resolve to open a club of their own.

Title: Blockers
Hint: Three parents try to stop their daughters from losing their virginity on prom night.
Description: When three parents discover that each of their daughters have a pact to lose their virginity at prom, they launch a covert one-night operation to stop the teens from sealing the deal.

Title: The Eagle
Hint: In 140 AD, a Roman officer travels to the Scottish highlands to recover his father's lost legion's emblem.
Description: In 140 AD, twenty years after the unexplained disappearance of the entire Ninth Legion in the mountains of Scotland, young centurion Marcus Aquila arrives from Rome to solve the mystery and restore the reputation of his father, the commander of the Ninth.

Title: Out Cold
Hint: A carefree snowboarder fights to save his beloved Alaskan ski resort from a greedy developer.
Description: Rick Rambis and his friends are having the time of their lives on Bull Mountain—until the legendary Papa Muntz' son decides to sell the mountain to a sleazy land developer, have the staff fired and turn Bull Mountain into 'Yuppieville'.

Title: Accident Man
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A hitman who makes murders look like mishaps seeks revenge when his ex is killed by his own crew.
Description: Mike Fallon, the ___, is a stone cold killer. When a loved one is murdered by his own crew, Fallon is forced to avenge the one person who actually meant something to him.

Title: Before I Wake
Hint: A young couple adopts an orphan whose dreams and nightmares manifest physically as he sleeps.
Description: An orphaned child's dreams—and nightmares—manifest physically as he sleeps.

Title: Captain Underpants: The First Epic Movie
Genres: Family, Comedy, Animation, Science Fiction, Action
Hint: Two mischievous kids hypnotise their mean principal into thinking he's a superhero.
Description: Based on the bestselling book series, this outrageous comedy tells the story of George and Harold, two overly imaginative pranksters who hypnotize their principal into thinking he’s an enthusiastic, yet dimwitted, superhero named ___.

Title: Spenser Confidential
Hint: An ex-cop teams up with his roommate to investigate the murders of two Boston police officers.
Description: ___, a former Boston patrolman who just got out from prison, teams up with Hawk, an aspiring fighter, to unravel the truth behind the death of two police officers.

Title: Killing Them Softly
Hint: A professional enforcer investigates a heist that took place during a mob-protected poker game.
Description: Jackie Cogan is an enforcer hired to restore order after three dumb guys rob a Mob protected card game, causing the local criminal economy to collapse.

Title: Vacancy
Hint: A couple stranded at a motel discover they're being filmed for snuff films.
Description: A young married couple becomes stranded at an isolated motel and find hidden video cameras in their room. They realize that unless they escape, they'll be the next victims of a snuff film.

Title: Uptown Girls
Hint: A spoiled socialite is forced to get a job as a nanny for a precocious, uptight young girl.
Description: Molly Gunn, the freewheeling daughter of a deceased rock legend, is forced to get a job when her manager steals her money. As nanny to Ray - the precocious, oft-ignored daughter of a music executive - she learns what it means to be an adult while teaching Ray how to be a child.

Title: Hard Target
Hint: A woman searches for her missing father in New Orleans with a homeless drifter.
Description: When a woman's father goes missing, she enlists a local to aid in her search. The pair soon discover that her father has died at the hands of a wealthy sportsman who hunts homeless men as a form of recreation.

Title: Why Him?
Hint: A dad forms a bitter rivalry with his daughter's young, rich boyfriend.
Description: A dad forms a bitter rivalry with his daughter's young rich boyfriend.

Title: Taken 2
Country: France, Turkey, United States of America
Hint: A retired CIA agent and his wife are kidnapped while vacationing in Istanbul by the father of a man he killed.
Description: In Istanbul, retired CIA operative Bryan Mills and his wife are taken hostage by the father of a kidnapper Mills killed while rescuing his daughter.

Title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants 2
Hint: Four friends continue their journey toward adulthood during a summer apart.
Description: Four young women continue the journey toward adulthood that began with "The ___ of the Traveling ___." Now three years later, these lifelong friends embark on separate paths for their first year of college and the summer beyond, but remain in touch by sharing their experiences with each other.

Title: Step Up 2: The Streets
Hint: A rebellious street dancer enrols at the prestigious Maryland School of the Arts.
Description: When rebellious street dancer Andie West lands at the elite Maryland School of the Arts, she finds herself fighting to fit in while also trying to hold onto her old life. When she joins forces with the school's hottest dancer, Chase Collins, to form a crew of fellow outcasts to compete in Baltimore's underground dance battle The ___.

Title: Endless Love
Hint: A teenage love affair is thwarted by her father, and the boy's obsession turns destructive.
Description: As their romance unfolds, Jade and David's growing love for one another becomes the scorn of Jade's father. However, when Jade's grades begin to drop, her father forbids the young couple from seeing each other for 30 days. Driven insane with frustration and desire, David attempts to reverse the decision, with catastrophic results.

Title: Johnny English
Hint: A bumbling British spy must stop a plot to steal the Crown Jewels.
Description: A lowly pencil pusher working for MI7, ___ is suddenly promoted to super spy after Agent One is assassinated and every other agent is blown up at his funeral. When a billionaire entrepreneur sponsors the exhibition of the Crown Jewels—and the valuable gems disappear on the opening night and on English's watch—the newly-designated agent must jump into action to find the thief and recover the missing gems.

Title: The Devil's Own
Hint: An IRA assassin hides out in New York with a cop's family.
Description: Frankie McGuire, one of the IRA's deadliest assassins, draws an American family into the crossfire of terrorism. But when he is sent to the U.S. to buy weapons, Frankie is housed with the family of Tom O'Meara, a New York cop who knows nothing about Frankie's real identity. Their surprising friendship, and Tom's growing suspicions, forces Frankie to choose between the promise of peace or a lifetime of murder.

Title: London Boulevard
Hint: A parolee falls for a reclusive movie star while trying to evade a ruthless gangster.
Description: A parolee falls for a reclusive movie star while trying to evade a ruthless gangster.

Title: Wayne's World 2
Hint: Two metalheads put on a rock festival in their hometown after a vision from a dead rock star.
Description: A message from Jim Morrison in a dream prompts cable access TV stars ___ and Garth to put on a rock concert, "Waynestock," with Aerosmith as headliners. But amid the preparations, ___ frets that a record producer is putting the moves on his girlfriend, Cassandra, while Garth handles the advances of mega-babe Honey Hornée.

Title: Hatching
Hint: A Finnish girl desperate to please her mother finds a strange egg that hatches into a creature.
Description: 12 year old Tinja is desperate to please her mother, a woman obsessed with presenting the image of a perfect family. One night, Tinja finds a strange egg. What hatches is beyond belief.

Title: Frankenhooker
Hint: A medical school dropout loses his fiancée in a tragic lawnmower accident and rebuilds her.
Description: A medical school dropout loses his fiancée in a tragic lawnmower incident and decides to bring her back to life. Unfortunately, he was only able to save her head, so he goes to the red light district in the city and lures prostitutes into a hotel room so he can collect body parts to reassemble her.

Title: The Perfection
Hint: A troubled music prodigy seeks out the new star pupil of her former school, with shocking consequences.
Description: When troubled musical prodigy Charlotte seeks out Elizabeth, the new star pupil of her former school, the encounter sends both musicians down a sinister path with shocking consequences.

Title: Feast
Hint: A motley crew of strangers are trapped in an isolated bar and must fight off a horde of monsters.
Description: When a motley crew of strangers find themselves trapped in an isolated tavern, they must band together in a battle for survival against a family of flesh-hungry creatures.

Title: Taking Lives
Hint: An FBI profiler helps Canadian police catch a serial killer who assumes the identities of his victims.
Description: Recruited to assist Montreal police in their desperate search for a serial killer who assumes the identities of his victims, FBI profiler Illeana Scott knows it's only a matter of time before the killer strikes again. Her most promising lead is a museum employee who might be the killer's only eyewitness.

Title: Ali G Indahouse
Country: France, Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A clueless hip-hop wannabe becomes a pawn in a political plot in Britain.
Description: ___ G unwittingly becomes a pawn in the evil Chancellor's plot to overthrow the Prime Minister of Great Britain. However, instead of bringing the Prime Minister down, ___ is embraced by the nation as the voice of youth and 'realness', making the Prime Minister and his government more popular than ever.

Title: The Beastmaster
Hint: A warrior who can communicate with animals seeks revenge on the evil priest who killed his family.
Description: Dar, the son of a king, is hunted by a priest after his birth and grows up in another family. When he becomes a grown man, his new father is murdered by savages and he discovers that he has the ability to communicate with animals, which leads him on a quest for revenge against his father's killers.

Title: Next
Hint: A Las Vegas magician who can see minutes into the future is pursued by the FBI to stop a nuclear attack.
Description: Las Vegas showroom magician Cris Johnson has a secret which torments him: he can see a few minutes into the future.

Title: Outlander
Hint: An alien warrior crash-lands in Viking-era Norway with a deadly monster and helps the Vikings fight it.
Description: During the reign of the Vikings, a man from another world crash-lands on Earth, bringing with him an alien predator. The man must fuse his advanced technology with the weaponry of the vikings to fight the monster.

Title: Married to the Mob
Hint: A widow tries to escape her late husband's gangster family, while an FBI agent falls for her.
Description: Angela de Marco is fed up with her gangster husband's line of work and wants no part of the crime world. When her husband is killed for having an affair with the mistress of mob boss Tony "The Tiger" Russo, Angela and her son depart for New York City to make a fresh start. Unfortunately, Tony has set his sights upon Angela -- and so has an undercover FBI agent looking to use her to bust Tony.

Title: Takers
Hint: A seasoned team of bank robbers plan one last heist, but a determined detective is on their trail.
Description: A seasoned team of bank robbers, including Gordon Jennings, John Rahway, A.J., and brothers Jake and Jesse Attica successfully complete their latest heist and lead a life of luxury while planning their next job. When Ghost, a former member of their team, is released from prison he convinces the group to strike an armored car carrying $20 million.

Title: Stuber
Hint: A cop recovering from eye surgery recruits a ride-share driver to help him catch a heroin dealer.
Description: After crashing his car, a cop who's recovering from eye surgery recruits an Uber driver to help him catch a heroin dealer. The mismatched pair soon find themselves in for a wild day of stakeouts and shootouts as they encounter the city's seedy side.

Title: Lionheart
Hint: A Foreign Legion deserter becomes a street fighter in Los Angeles to help his brother's family.
Description: Lyon Gaultier is a deserter in the Foreign Legion arriving in the USA entirely hard up. He finds his brother between life and death and his sister-in-law without the money needed to heal her husband and to maintain her child. To earn the money needed, Gaultier decides to take part in some very dangerous clandestine fights.

Title: Tower Heist
Hint: A group of employees plot revenge on the Wall Street businessman who stole their pensions.
Description: A luxury condo manager leads a staff of workers to seek payback on the Wall Street swindler who defrauded them. With only days until the billionaire gets away with the perfect crime, the unlikely crew of amateur thieves enlists the help of petty crook Slide to steal the $20 million they’re sure is hidden in the penthouse.

Title: Beerfest
Hint: Two German-American brothers discover a secret beer-drinking competition during a trip to Germany.
Description: During a trip to Germany to scatter their grandfather's ashes, German-American brothers Todd and Jan discover ___, the secret Olympics of downing stout, and want to enter the contest to defend their family's beer-guzzling honor. Their Old Country cousins sneer at the Yanks' chances, prompting the siblings to return to America to prepare for a showdown the following year.

Title: The Deep
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two vacationers discover a shipwreck full of treasure and drugs in Bermuda.
Description: A pair of young vacationers are involved in a dangerous conflict with treasure hunters when they discover a way into a deadly wreck in Bermuda waters.

Title: Airheads
Hint: Three struggling rock musicians take over a radio station with water pistols to get their demo played.
Description: The Lone Rangers have heavy-metal dreams and a single demo tape they can't get anyone to play. The solution: Hijack an FM rock radio station and hold the deejays hostage until they agree to broadcast the band's tape.

Title: Turner & Hooch
Hint: A fussy detective is stuck with a slobbering dog who is the only witness to a murder.
Description: Detective Scott ___ has three days left in the local police department before he moves to a bigger city to get some 'real' cases—not just misdemeanors. When Amos Reed is murdered, Scott sets himself on the case, but the closest thing to a witness to the murder is Reed's dog, ___, which Scott has to take care of—to avoid ___ being 'put to sleep'.

Title: Angels in the Outfield
Hint: A foster boy prays for his last-place baseball team to win, and heavenly helpers start showing up during games.
Description: Roger is a foster child whose irresponsible father promises to get his act together when Roger's favourite baseball team, the California ___, wins the pennant. The problem is that the ___ are in last place, so Roger prays for help to turn the team around. Sure enough, his prayers are answered in the form of angel Al.

Title: Dark Places
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A woman who survived the massacre of her family as a child reexamines the case when amateur sleuths question her testimony.
Description: A woman who survived the brutal killing of her family as a child is forced to confront the events of that day.

Title: How High
Hint: Two stoners smoke weed grown from a dead friend's ashes, ace their exams and get into Harvard.
Description: Jamal and Silas, two ordinary guys who smoke something magical, pass their college entrance exams with flying colors and end up at Harvard. Ivy League ways are strange but Silas and Jamal take it in a stride -- until their supply of supernatural smoke runs dry. That's when they have to start living by their wits and rely on their natural resources to make the grade.

Title: The Rocker
Hint: A drummer dumped by his band before they hit it big gets a second shot with his nephew's teen group.
Description: In the 1980s, a drummer is abandoned by his band just before they become rock superstars. Twenty years later, the drummer sees his second chance at stardom arise when he is asked to perform with his teenage nephew's high school rock band.

Title: Fritz the Cat
Hint: An X-rated animated satire about a hedonistic college feline drifting through 1960s New York counterculture.
Description: In late 1960s New York City, fed up with monotonous college life and police repression, free-spirited ___, an impenitent seducer and unrestrained party-animal, decides to explore the world. And just like that, as he flees NYC, heading to San Francisco, ___ embarks on an endless adventure of illumination.

Title: Sydney White
Hint: A college freshman is kicked out of her late mother's sorority and moves in with seven dorky outcasts.
Description: College freshman ___ arrives at Southern Atlantic University, determined to pledge her late mother's sorority. Unfortunately, she finds that the sisterhood has changed since her parent's day. Banished to a condemned house, ___ joins forces with seven outcasts to take over the student government and win equal rights for nerd and noted alike.

Title: Destroyer
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A burnt-out LA detective confronts the gang leader from an undercover operation that went disastrously wrong years earlier.
