Description: When Erin Bell was a young cop, she was given an undercover assignment that ended badly and destroyed her life. Years later, she must face her demons in order to make peace with her past.

Title: Resident Evil: Extinction
Country: Canada, France, Germany, United States of America
Hint: A superhuman survivor joins a convoy crossing the zombie-ravaged Nevada desert to find a safe haven.
Description: Years after the Racoon City catastrophe, survivors travel across the Nevada desert, hoping to make it to Alaska. Alice joins the caravan and their fight against hordes of zombies and the evil Umbrella Corp.

Title: Daddy's Home
Hint: A mild-mannered stepdad competes with his wife's cool, motorcycle-riding ex for the kids' affection.
Description: The story of a mild-mannered radio executive who strives to become the best stepdad ever to his wife's two children, but complications ensue when their freewheeling, freeloading real father arrives, forcing stepdad to compete for the affection of the kids.

Title: The Outsider
Hint: A former American GI joins a yakuza clan after his release from prison in post-war Osaka.
Description: A former American G.I. joins a yakuza family after his release from prison in post-World War II Osaka.

Title: Land of the Dead
Country: Canada, United States of America, France
Hint: Zombies have taken over the world, and the living hide in a walled city ruled by a ruthless tycoon.
Description: The living dead have taken over the world, and the remaining humans live in a walled city to protect themselves as they cope with the situation.

Title: Redemption
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A homeless ex-special forces soldier hiding in London assumes another man's identity and becomes an enforcer.
Description: Homeless and on the run from a military court martial, a damaged ex-special forces soldier navigating London's criminal underworld seizes an opportunity to assume another man's identity, transforming into an avenging angel in the process.

Title: Femme Fatale
Hint: A jewel thief who betrayed her partners assumes another woman's identity and marries a diplomat.
Description: A $10-million diamond rip-off, a stolen identity, a new life married to a diplomat. Laure Ash has risked big, won big. But then a tabloid shutterbug snaps her picture in Paris, and suddenly, enemies from Laure's secret past know who and where she is. And they all want their share of the diamond heist. Or her life. Or both.

Title: Message in a Bottle
Hint: A woman finds a romantic letter washed ashore and tracks down the author, a widowed shipbuilder.
Description: A woman finds a romantic letter in a ___ washed ashore and tracks down the author, a widowed shipbuilder whose wife died tragically early. As a deep and mutual attraction blossoms, the man struggles to make peace with his past so that he can move on and find happiness.

Title: We Are Your Friends
Hint: A young DJ in the San Fernando Valley tries to make it big while falling for his mentor's girlfriend.
Description: Young Cole Carter dreams of hitting the big time as a Hollywood disc jockey, spending his days and nights hanging with buddies and working on the one track that will set the world on fire. Opportunity comes knocking when he meets James Reed, a charismatic DJ who takes the 23-year-old under his wing.

Title: My Bloody Valentine
Hint: Twenty years after a mining tragedy, a killer in a miner's mask returns to a small town for a holiday dance.
Description: Twenty years after a ___ Day tragedy claimed the lives of five miners, Harry Warden returns for a vengeful massacre among teen sweethearts gearing up for another party.

Title: Keanu
Hint: Two cousins pose as drug dealers to retrieve a stolen kitten from a street gang.
Description: Friends hatch a plot to retrieve a stolen cat by posing as drug dealers for a street gang.

Title: The Nanny Diaries
Hint: A college graduate goes to work as a live-in childminder for a rich, dysfunctional Upper East Side family.
Description: A college graduate goes to work as a ___ for a rich New York family. Ensconced in their home, she has to juggle their dysfunction, a new romance, and the spoiled brat in her charge.

Title: Last Knights
Country: Czech Republic, Japan, South Korea, United States of America
Hint: A band of loyal warriors seeks revenge after their lord is executed by a corrupt minister.
Description: When an evil emperor executes their leader, his band of ___ – bound by duty and honour – embarks on a journey of vengeance that will not come to an end until they've destroyed their mortal foe.

Title: The Silencing
Hint: A reformed hunter and the local sheriff set out to track a killer who has kidnapped a young girl.
Description: A reformed hunter becomes involved in a deadly game of cat and mouse when he and the local sheriff set out to track a vicious killer who may have kidnapped his daughter years ago.

Title: The Whole Truth
Hint: A defence attorney works to get his teenage client acquitted of murdering his wealthy father.
Description: A defense attorney works to get his teenage client acquitted of murdering his wealthy father.

Title: National Lampoon's European Vacation
Hint: A bumbling American family wins a trip across Europe on a game show and wreaks havoc everywhere.
Description: The Griswolds win a vacation to Europe on a game show, and so pack their bags for the continent. They do their best to catch the flavor of Europe, but they just don't know how to be be good tourists. Besides, they have trouble taking holidays in countries where they CAN speak the language.

Title: Rising Sun
Hint: A detective investigates a murder at a Japanese corporation in Los Angeles.
Description: When a prostitute is found dead in a Los Angeles skyscraper occupied by a large Japanese corporation, detectives John Connor and Web Smith are called in to investigate. Although Connor has previous experience working in Japan, cultural differences make their progress difficult until a security disc showing the murder turns up.

Title: Lost Girls
Hint: A mother searches for her missing daughter on Long Island, uncovering a series of murdered sex workers.
Description: When Mari Gilbert's daughter disappears, police inaction drives her own investigation into the gated Long Island community where Shannan was last seen. Her search brings attention to over a dozen murdered prostitutes.

Title: Rogue
Country: South Africa, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A mercenary team rescues hostages from an African militia, only to be hunted by a lioness.
Description: Battle-hardened O’Hara leads a lively mercenary team of soldiers on a daring mission: rescue hostages from their captors in remote Africa. But as the mission goes awry and the team is stranded, O’Hara’s squad must face a bloody, brutal encounter with a gang of rebels.

Title: Deadfall
Hint: A con man accidentally kills his father during a sting and gets mixed up with his uncle's criminal world.
Description: After he accidentally kills his father Mike during a sting, Joe tries to carry out Mike's dying wish by recovering valuables that Mike's twin brother Lou stole from him years earlier. But Uncle Lou is also a confidence artist, and Joe is soon drawn into his increasingly dangerous schemes.

Title: Tulip Fever
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An artist falls for a married woman he is commissioned to paint in 17th-century Amsterdam during a flower-bulb craze.
Description: An artist falls for a married young woman while he's commissioned to paint her portrait. The two invest in the risky ___ market in hopes to build a future together.

Title: Necessary Roughness
Hint: A Texas college football team disqualified for cheating has to rebuild with a 34-year-old freshman quarterback.
Description: When the Texas State University Fightin' Armadillos football team is disqualified for cheating and poor grades, the University is forced to pick from a team that actually goes to school. Will they even win a single game?

Title: A Dark Song
Hint: A determined young woman and a damaged occultist perform a dangerous months-long ritual in a remote Welsh house.
Description: A determined young woman and a damaged occultist risk their lives and souls to perform a dangerous ritual that will grant them what they want.

Title: The Saint
Genres: Thriller, Action, Romance, Science Fiction, Adventure
Hint: A master thief of a thousand disguises is hired to steal the secret formula for cold fusion.
Description: Simon Templar (The ___), is a thief for hire, whose latest job to steal the secret process for cold fusion puts him at odds with a traitor bent on toppling the Russian government, as well as the woman who holds its secret.

Title: Eye for an Eye
Hint: A grieving mother takes justice into her own hands when the courts fail to convict her daughter's killer.
Description: Grieving mother Karen McCann takes justice into her own hands when the courts in Los Angeles fail to convict Robert Doob, the monster who raped and murdered her 17-year-old daughter.

Title: Youngblood
Hint: A skilled young hockey prospect is pressured to prove he can fight as well as score.
Description: A skilled young hockey prospect hoping to attract the attention of professional scouts is pressured to show that he can fight if challenged during his stay in a Canadian minor hockey town. His on-ice activities are complicated by his relationship with the coach's daughter.

Title: Red Lights
Hint: Two investigators of paranormal hoaxes look into a legendary psychic who has made a sudden return.
Description: Two investigators of paranormal hoaxes, the veteran Dr. Margaret Matheson and her young assistant, Tom Buckley, study the most varied metaphysical phenomena with the aim of proving their fraudulent origins. Simon Silver, a legendary blind psychic, reappears after an enigmatic absence of 30 years to become the greatest international challenge to both orthodox science and professional sceptics.

Title: Paper Towns
Hint: A teenager searches for his mysterious neighbour who vanishes after a night of pranks.
Description: Quentin Jacobsen has spent a lifetime loving the magnificently adventurous Margo Roth Spiegelman from afar. So when she cracks open a window and climbs back into his life dressed like a ninja and summoning him for an ingenious campaign of revenge, he follows. After their all-nighter ends and a new day breaks, Quentin arrives at school to discover that Margo, always an enigma, has now become a mystery.

Title: Heartbreakers
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A mother-daughter con team seduce and swindle rich men, and target a wealthy tobacco tycoon.
Description: Max and Page are a brilliant mother/daughter con team who have their grift down to a fine science. Max targets wealthy, willing men and marries them. Page then seduces them, and Max catches her husband in the act. Then it's off to palimony city and the next easy mark.

Title: Dark Star
Hint: A group of bored scientists on a mission to destroy unstable planets argue with a talking bomb.
Description: A group of scientists are sent on a mission to destroy unstable planets. Twenty years into their mission, they have to battle their alien mascot as well as a "sensitive" and intelligent bombing device that starts to question the meaning of its existence.

Title: Peacock
Hint: A minor train accident in rural Nebraska unveils a mystery involving a reclusive bank clerk with a secret.
Description: A minor train accident in rural Nebraska gradually unveils a mystery involving the town's reclusive bank clerk.

Title: Needful Things
Hint: A mysterious shop opens in a small town, selling each customer their deepest desire, at a devilish price.
Description: A mysterious new shop opens in a small town which always seems to stock the deepest desires of each shopper, with a price far heavier than expected.

Title: The Boondock Saints II: All Saints Day
Hint: Two vigilante brothers return to Boston from Ireland to avenge a priest's murder.
Description: Skillfully framed by an unknown enemy for the murder of a priest, wanted vigilante MacManus brothers Murphy and Connor must come out of hiding on a sheep farm in Ireland to fight for justice in Boston.

Title: Life in a Year
Hint: A 17-year-old learns his girlfriend is dying and they decide to live a lifetime in one year.
Description: A 17 year old finds out that his girlfriend is dying, so he sets out to give her an entire life, in the last year she has left.

Title: Fun with Dick and Jane
Hint: A couple turns to armed robbery after the husband loses his job in a corporate collapse.
Description: After ___ Harper loses his job at Globodyne in an Enron-esque collapse, he and his wife, ___, turn to crime in order to handle the massive debt they now face. Two intelligent people, ___ actually get pretty good at robbing people and even enjoy it -- but they have second thoughts when they're reminded that crime can hurt innocent people.

Title: Dagon
Hint: A man is shipwrecked in a Spanish fishing village where people worship a sea god.
Description: A boating accident off the coast of Spain sends Paul and his girlfriend Barbara to the decrepit fishing village of Imboca. As night falls, people start to disappear and things not quite human start to appear. Paul is pursued by the entire town. Running for his life, he uncovers Imboca's secret..they worship ___, a monstrous god of the sea...and ___ unholy offspring are on the loose...

Title: Kung Pow: Enter the Fist
Hint: A martial arts spoof that takes an old 1970s chop-socky film and digitally inserts a goofy new hero.
Description: A movie within a movie, created to spoof the martial arts genre. Writer/director Steve Oedekerk uses contemporary characters and splices them into a 1970s ___-fu film, weaving the new and old together. As the main character, The Chosen One, Oedekerk sets off to avenge the deaths of his parents at the hands of ___-fu legend Master Pain. Along the way he encounters some strange characters.

Title: Lakeview Terrace
Hint: A young interracial couple are terrorised by their neighbour, a racist LAPD officer.
Description: A young interracial couple has just moved into their California dream home when they become the target of their next-door neighbor, who disapproves of their relationship. A tightly wound LAPD officer has appointed himself the watchdog of the neighborhood. His nightly foot patrols and overly watchful eyes bring comfort to some, but he becomes increasingly aggressive to the newlyweds.

Title: Krampus
Hint: A boy's family is attacked by a demonic creature after he loses his Christmas spirit.
Description: When his dysfunctional family clashes over the holidays, young Max is disillusioned and turns his back on Christmas. Little does he know, this lack of festive spirit has unleashed the wrath of ___: a demonic force of ancient evil intent on punishing non-believers.

Title: Bride & Prejudice
Country: Belgium, France, India, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Bollywood-style adaptation of a classic English romance, in which an Indian woman falls for an arrogant American.
Description: Mrs. Bakshi is eager to find suitors for her four unmarried daughters when a family friend introduces them to handsome American Will Darcy. A Bollywood-style modern adaptation of Jane Austen's classic novel.

Title: Eraser
Hint: A US Marshal in witness protection protects a woman who blew the whistle on illegal weapons dealing.
Description: A Witness Protection specialist becomes suspicious of his co-workers when dealing with a case involving high-tech weapons.

Title: Orange County
Hint: A surfer from Southern California dreams of going to Stanford, but his school sends the wrong transcript.
Description: Shaun Brumder is a local surfer kid from ___ who dreams of going to Stanford to become a writer and to get away from his dysfunctional family household. Except Shaun runs into one complication after another, starting when his application is rejected after his dim-witted guidance counselor sends in the wrong form.

Title: Untraceable
Hint: An FBI agent tracks a killer who murders people live on the internet, faster the more people watch.
Description: Special Agent Jennifer Marsh works in an elite division of the FBI dedicated to fighting cybercrime. She thinks she has seen it all, until a particularly sadistic criminal arises on the Internet. This tech-savvy killer posts live feeds of his crimes on his website; the more hits the site gets, the faster the victim dies. Marsh and her team must find the elusive killer before time runs out.

Title: Frontier(s)
Hint: A gang of young thieves flee Paris and hole up in a remote inn run by neo-Nazi cannibals.
Description: A gang of young thieves flee Paris during the violent aftermath of a political election, only to hole up at an Inn run by neo-Nazis.

Title: The Little Shop of Horrors
Hint: A clumsy florist's assistant grows a strange, talking plant that feeds on human blood.
Description: Seymour works in a skid row florist shop and is in love with his beautiful co-worker, Audrey. He creates a new plant that not only talks but cannot survive without human flesh and blood.

Title: Villains
Hint: A couple on the run break into a house where they find a girl chained in the basement.
Description: When their car breaks down, a couple on the run headed southbound for a fresh start in the Sunshine State break into a nearby house looking for a new set of wheels. What they find instead is a dark secret, and a sweet-as-pie pair of homeowners who will do anything to keep it from getting out.

Title: Double Lover
Hint: A fragile young woman falls for her psychoanalyst, then discovers he has an identical twin.
Description: Chloé, a fragile young woman, falls in love with her psychoanalyst, Paul. A few months later she moves in with him, but soon discovers that her lover is concealing a part of his identity.

Title: Palo Alto
Hint: Bored, privileged teens in a California town rebel with drugs and sex in this indie drama.
Description: A lack of parental guidance encourages teens in an affluent California town to rebel with substance abuse and casual sex.

Title: The Men Who Stare at Goats
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A reporter learns of a secret US Army unit trying to harness psychic powers.
Description: A reporter in Iraq might just have the story of a lifetime when he meets Lyn Cassady, a guy who claims to be a former member of the U.S. Army's New Earth Army, a unit that employs paranormal powers in their missions.

Title: MI-5
Hint: A disgraced MI5 agent is framed and must clear his name while stopping a terrorist attack in London.
Description: During a handover to the head of counter-terrorism of MI5, Harry Pearce, a terrorist escapes custody. When Harry disappears soon after, his protégé is tasked with finding out what happened as an impending attack on London looms, and eventually uncovers a deadly conspiracy.

Title: Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back
Hint: A powerful genetically engineered creature lures trainers to an island to battle with clones.
Description: Determined to prove its superiority, a bio-engineered ___ called ___ lures Ash, Pikachu and others into a Pokemon match like none before.

Title: Party Monster
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Netherlands
Hint: The rise and fall of a New York club kid whose life of excess ends in murder.
Description: The New York club scene of the 80s and 90s was a world like no other. Into this candy-colored, mirror ball playground stepped Michael Alig, a wannabe from nowhere special. Under the watchful eye of veteran club kid James St. James, Alig quickly rose to the top... and there was no place to go but down.

Title: Billy Lynn's Long Halftime Walk
Country: China, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A 19-year-old soldier is brought home for a victory tour that ends with a surreal Thanksgiving football spectacle.
Description: 19-year-old ___ is brought home for a victory tour after a harrowing Iraq battle. Through flashbacks the film shows what really happened to his squad – contrasting the realities of war with America's perceptions.

Title: Damien: Omen II
Hint: A boy discovers he is the Antichrist at a military academy while his uncle runs a powerful company.
Description: Since the sudden and suspicious deaths of his parents, young ___ has been in the charge of his wealthy aunt and uncle and enrolled in a military school. Widely feared to be the Antichrist, he relentlessly plots to seize control of his uncle's business empire — and the world.

Title: Black Sheep
Hint: A politician's team tries to keep his embarrassing brother away from the press.
Description: When dignified Albert Donnelly runs for Governor, his team moves to keep his slow-witted and klutzy younger brother, Mike, out of the eye of the media. To baby-sit Mike, the campaign assigns sarcastic Steve, who gets the experience of a lifetime when he tries to take Mike out of town during the election.

Title: Basket Case
Hint: A young man carries a wicker hamper containing his deformed, formerly conjoined twin, who seeks bloody revenge.
Description: A young man carrying a big ___ that contains his extremely deformed, formerly conjoined twin brother seeks vengeance on the doctors who separated them against their will.

Title: The Discovery
Genres: Drama, Romance, Science Fiction, Thriller, Mystery
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: After a scientist proves the afterlife exists, millions commit suicide to get there.
Description: In the near future, due to a breakthrough scientific ___ by Dr. Thomas Harbor, there is now definitive proof of an afterlife. While countless people have chosen suicide to reset their existence, others try to decide what it all means. Among them is Dr. Harbor's son Will, who has arrived at his father's isolated compound with a mysterious young woman named Isla.

Title: The Libertine
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The 17th-century poet who famously drank and debauched his way to an early grave.
Description: The story of John Wilmot, a.k.a. the Earl of Rochester, a 17th century poet who famously drank and debauched his way to an early grave, only to earn posthumous critical acclaim for his life's work.

Title: New York, I Love You
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A collection of love stories in a city that never sleeps, from many international directors.
Description: ___ delves into the intimate lives of New Yorkers as they grapple with, delight in and search for love. Journey from the Diamond District in the heart of Manhattan, through Chinatown and the Upper East Side, towards the Village, into Tribeca, and Brooklyn as lovers of all ages try to find romance in the Big Apple.

Title: Blown Away
Hint: A Boston bomb squad officer is taunted by a mad bomber from his Irish past.
Description: ___ tells the story of Jimmy Dove, who works for the Boston bomb squad. Shortly after Dove leaves the force, his partner is killed by a bomb that Dove thinks might have been made by someone he knows.

Title: The Foot Fist Way
Hint: An inept taekwondo instructor struggles with marital troubles and his obsession with his martial arts idol.
Description: An inept taekwondo instructor struggles with marital troubles and an unhealthy obsession with fellow taekwondo enthusiast Chuck "The Truck" Williams.

Title: Money Talks
Hint: A small-time huckster wanted by police and criminals makes a deal with a TV newsman for protection.
Description: Sought by police and criminals, a small-time huckster makes a deal with a TV newsman for protection.

Title: My Friend Dahmer
Hint: The teenage years of a future serial killer, seen through the eyes of a high school classmate.
Description: Jeffrey ___ struggles with a difficult family life as a young boy. During his teenage years he slowly transforms, edging closer to the serial killer he was to become.

Title: A Chorus Line
Hint: A group of dancers audition for a new Broadway musical production.
Description: A group of dancers congregate on the stage of a Broadway theatre to audition for a new musical production directed by Zach. After the initial eliminations, seventeen hopefuls remain, among them Cassie, who once had a tempestuous romantic relationship with Zach.

Title: My Blue Heaven
Hint: An uptight FBI agent is assigned to protect a Mafia informant in a quiet suburb.
Description: FBI agent Barney Coopersmith is assigned to protect former Mafia figure turned informant Vincent Antonelli. In the witness protection program one is supposed to keep a low profile, but that is something that Antonelli has trouble doing. Coopersmith certainly has his hands full keeping Antonelli away from the Mafia hitmen who want to stop him testifying, not to mention the nightclubs...

Title: The Two Faces of January
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: In 1962 Greece, a con artist, his wife, and a dangerous stranger are caught up in a murder.
Description: 1962. A con artist, his wife, and a dangerous stranger are caught up in the murder of a private detective and are forced to try and escape Athens.

Title: Shanghai Knights
Country: Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: An Old West sheriff and his partner travel to London to avenge a father's murder.
Description: When a Chinese rebel murders Chon's estranged father and escapes to England, Chon and Roy make their way to London with revenge on their minds.

Title: Shall We Dance
Hint: A ballet dancer falls for a tap-dancing star and pretends they're secretly married.
Description: Ballet star Petrov arranges to cross the Atlantic aboard the same ship as the dancer and musical star he's fallen for but barely knows. By the time the ocean liner reaches New York, a little white lie has churned through the rumour mill and turned into a hot gossip item—that the two celebrities are secretly married.

Title: Maps to the Stars
Country: Canada, United States of America, France, Germany
Hint: Members of a dysfunctional Hollywood family chase fame, while their past haunts them.
Description: Driven by an intense need for fame and validation, members of a dysfunctional Hollywood family chase celebrity, one another, and the relentless ghosts of their pasts. Their fragile ecosystem is disrupted by the arrival of Agatha, the scarred and estranged pyromaniac daughter.

Title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
Country: Canada, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Two high school rivals magically swap bodies at a natural history museum.
Description: A visit to a natural history museum proves catastrophic for two high school rivals, an overachiever and a jock, when an ancient Aztec statue casts a spell that causes them to switch bodies and see exactly what it's like to walk in the other's shoes.

Title: Step Up 3D
Hint: A group of street dancers in New York compete in a battle.
Description: A tight-knit group of New York City street dancers, including Luke and Natalie, team up with NYU freshman Moose, and find themselves pitted against the world's best hip-hop dancers in a high-stakes showdown that will change their lives forever.

Title: Crisis
Hint: Three stories about the opioid epidemic collide: a trafficker, an architect mourning her son, and a whistleblowing professor.
Description: Three stories about the world of opioids collide: a drug trafficker arranges a multi-cartel Fentanyl smuggling operation between Canada and the U.S., an architect recovering from an OxyContin addiction tracks down the truth behind her son's involvement with narcotics, and a university professor battles unexpected revelations about his research employer, a drug company with deep government influence bringing a new…

Title: Jersey Girl
Hint: A widowed music publicist must give up the Manhattan high life to raise his daughter in a small suburban town.
Description: Ollie Trinke is a young, suave music publicist who seems to have it all, with a new wife and a baby on the way. But life deals him a bum hand when he's suddenly faced with single fatherhood, a defunct career and having to move in with his father. To bounce back, it takes a new love and the courage instilled in him by his daughter.

Title: Quest for Camelot
Hint: A brave girl dreams of following her late father as a knight of the Round Table.
Description: During the times of King Arthur, Kayley is a brave girl who dreams of following her late father as a Knight of the Round Table. The evil Ruber wants to invade ___ and take the throne of King Arthur, and Kayley has to stop him.

Title: Belly
Hint: Two ruthless New York criminals start to drift apart as one seeks a new life.
Description: Tommy Bundy and Sincere are best friends as well as infamous and ruthless criminals and shot-callers in the hood. Respected by many but feared by all. As the police are closing in on them and new players are looking for a come up, will their reign last?

Title: D.A.R.Y.L.
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A 10-year-old boy is secretly a military android who starts to develop human emotions.
Description: Daryl is a normal 10-year-old boy in many ways. However, unbeknown to his foster parents and friends, Daryl is actually a government-created robot with superhuman reflexes and mental abilities. Even his name has a hidden meaning -- it's actually an acronym for Data Analyzing Robot Youth Life-form.

Title: YPF
Hint: On one night, five couples have separate sexual adventures in a raunchy comedy.
Description: On a Tuesday night, five couples have separate sexual adventures. Matt and Kris, friends for years, want to have an only-once, no-strings good time. Abby and Andrew, married, celebrate his birthday, but it's marred by angst and miscommunication. Mia and Eric are exes, making sure they are over each other. Jaime and Ken work together and this is a first date. Inez and Gord invite his roommate, Dave, to join them.

Title: Welcome to Marwen
Country: Canada, Japan, United States of America
Hint: A man who lost his memory after a brutal attack creates a miniature world populated by dolls.
Description: When a devastating attack shatters Mark Hogancamp and wipes away all memories, no one expected recovery. Putting together pieces from his old and new life, Mark meticulously creates a wondrous town named ___ where he can heal and be heroic. As he builds an astonishing art installation — a testament to the most powerful women he knows — through his fantasy world, he draws strength to triumph in the real one.

Title: Gods and Generals
Hint: A deeply religious Confederate general's life and campaigns during the Civil War.
Description: Follows the personal and professional life of Thomas 'Stonewall' Jackson, a brilliant if eccentric Confederate general, from the outbreak of the American Civil War until its halfway point.

Title: Private Benjamin
Hint: A sheltered young woman joins the US Army on a whim and finds herself in a difficult situation.
Description: A sheltered young high society woman joins the US Army on a whim and finds herself in a more difficult situation than she ever expected.

Title: Thumbelina
Hint: A tiny girl born of a flower dreams of finding love with a fairy prince.
Description: Born of a flower and growing to only a couple of inches tall, poor ___ is worried she'll never meet someone her own size, until she happens to catch the eye of Prince Cornelius of the Fairies. Just as soon as she finds love, however, it's torn away when she's kidnapped by Ms. Toad. Now ___ has to escape Ms. Toad's grasp and search for Prince Cornelius.

Title: The Human Stain
Country: France, Germany, United States of America
Hint: A professor accused of racism hides a secret about his own past.
Description: Coleman Silk is a worldly and admired professor who loses his job after unwittingly making a racial slur. To clear his name, Silk writes a book about the events with his friend and colleague Nathan Zuckerman, who in the process discovers a dark secret Silk has hidden his whole life.

Title: The Big Year
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Three bird-watchers spend a year competing to see the most species in North America.
Description: Three fanatical bird-watchers spend an entire year competing to spot the highest number of species as El Nino sends an extraordinary variety of rare breeds flying up into the U.S., but they quickly discover that there are more important things than coming out on top of the competition.

Title: The Catcher Was a Spy
Hint: A former big-league ballplayer works undercover during WWII to stop Germany building an atomic bomb.
Description: Former major league baseball player Moe Berg lives a double life working for the Office of Strategic Services in World War II Europe.

Title: National Lampoon's Loaded Weapon 1
Hint: Two cops investigate a murder involving cookies laced with cocaine, in a spoof of buddy-cop movies.
Description: An LA detective is murdered because she has microfilm with the recipe to make cocaine cookies. Two cops partner to find and stop the fiends before they can dope the nation by distributing their wares via the 'Wilderness Girls' cookie drive.

Title: City of the Living Dead
Hint: A priest's suicide opens the gates of hell in a small town.
Description: A psychic seemingly dies of fright during a séance where she sees a vision of a Dunwich priest hanging himself in a church cemetery. New York City reporter Peter Bell investigates and learns that the priest's suicide has somehow opened a portal to Hell that must be sealed by All Saints Day, or else the dead will overtake humanity.

Title: Astro Boy
Country: Japan, United States of America, Hong Kong
Hint: A robot boy built by a grieving scientist sets out on a journey to find his place.
Description: Set in the futuristic Metro City, ___ (Atom) is a young robot with incredible powers created by a brilliant scientist in the image of the son he had lost. Unable to fulfill his creator's expectations, ___ embarks on a journey in search of acceptance, experiencing betrayal and a netherworld of robot gladiators, before returning to save Metro City and reconcile with the father who rejected him.

Title: The Wolf of Snow Hollow
Hint: A small mountain town is terrorised by a werewolf, with a stressed sheriff leading the hunt.
Description: Terror grips a small mountain town as bodies are discovered after each full moon. Losing sleep, raising a teenage daughter, and caring for his ailing father, officer Marshall struggles to remind himself there's no such thing as werewolves.

Title: Mr. Magorium's Wonder Emporium
Hint: A magical toy store is under threat when its eccentric owner decides to retire.
Description: Molly Mahoney is the awkward and insecure manager of ___—the strangest, most fantastic and most wonderful toy store in the world. After Mr. ___ bequeaths the store to her, a dark and ominous change begins to take over the once-remarkable ___.

Title: Ricochet
Hint: An attorney is terrorised by the criminal he put away years ago when he was a cop.
Description: An attorney is terrorized by the criminal he put away years ago when he was a cop.

Title: Greenberg
Hint: A failed musician returns to Los Angeles to house-sit for his brother and falls for his assistant.
Description: Roger ___, a failed musician now making a living as a carpenter in New York, returns to Los Angeles to house-sit for his brother. He's stranded there—since he doesn't drive—until his brother's assistant, Florence, comes to his rescue. She's as much a lost soul as he is, and the pair form a significant connection—giving Roger a much-needed reason to be happy.

Title: Galveston
Hint: A hitman on the run with a young woman tries to find safety along the Texas Gulf Coast.
Description: After a violent encounter, Roy finds Rocky and sees something in her eyes that prompts a fateful decision. He takes her with him as he flees to ___, an action as ill-advised as it is inescapable.

Title: Alexander and the Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Day
Hint: A boy's day starts with gum in his hair, and soon everything goes wrong for him and his entire family.
Description: ___ day begins with gum stuck in his hair, followed by more calamities. Though he finds little sympathy from his family and begins to wonder if bad things only happen to him, his mom, dad, brother, and sister all find themselves living through their own terrible, ___, no good, very bad day.

Title: Amazon Women on the Moon
Hint: A series of sketches parodying late-night TV, including a 1950s sci-fi movie.
Description: Centered on a television station which features a 1950s-style sci-fi movie interspersed with a series of wild commercials, wacky shorts and weird specials, this lampoon of contemporary life and pop culture skewers some of the silliest spectacles ever created in the name of entertainment.

Title: Prozac Nation
Hint: A gifted young writer at Harvard spirals into depression and self-destruction in the late 1980s.
Description: When talented young writer Elizabeth Wurtzel earns a scholarship to Harvard, she sees it as her chance to escape the pressures of her working-class background and concentrate on her true talent. But what starts out so promising leads to self-destructive behavior and paralyzing depression that reflects an entire generation's struggle to navigate the effects of divorce, drugs, sex, and high expectations.

Title: Wonder Wheel
Hint: Four characters' lives intertwine at a Coney Island amusement park in the 1950s.
Description: The story of four characters whose lives intertwine amid the hustle and bustle of the Coney Island amusement park in the 1950s: Ginny, an emotionally volatile former actress now working as a waitress in a clam house; Humpty, Ginny’s rough-hewn carousel operator husband; Mickey, a handsome young lifeguard who dreams of becoming a playwright; and Carolina, Humpty’s long-estranged daughter, who is now hiding out from…

Title: Dick
Hint: Two dim-witted high school girls become the president's secret dog walkers and accidentally take him down.
Description: Two high school girls wander off during a class trip to the White House and meet President Richard Nixon. They become the official dog walkers for Nixon's dog Checkers, and become his secret advisors during the Watergate scandal.

Title: Work It
Hint: A brilliant but clumsy high school senior forms a dance crew to get into her late father's university.
Description: A brilliant but clumsy high school senior vows to get into her late father's alma mater by transforming herself and a misfit squad into dance champions.

Title: One Wild Moment
Hint: Two old friends spend a summer in Corsica with their teenage daughters, and one has an affair.
Description: Antoine and Laurent, old friends, spend their vacation in Corsica with their respective daughters: seventeen-year-old Louna and eighteen-year-old Marie. One evening at the beach, Louna seduces Laurent. Louna is in love, but for Laurent it was nothing more than a momentary distraction. Without revealing her lover's name, Louna confides in her father, who tries by any means to discover who his daughter's lover is.

Title: Warlock
Hint: A 17th-century witch hunter pursues an evil sorcerer to modern-day Los Angeles.
Description: In 17th century New England, witch hunter Giles Redferne captures an evil ___, but the conjurer eludes death with supernatural help. Flung into the future, the ___ winds up in the 1980s and plans to bring about the end of the world. Redferne follows the enchanter into the modern era and continues his mission, but runs into trouble in such unfamiliar surroundings.

Title: Prime
Hint: A Manhattan career woman is wooed by a young painter, who is the son of her therapist.
Description: A career driven professional from Manhattan is wooed by a young painter, who also happens to be the son of her psychoanalyst.

Title: 6 Days
Hint: Six terrorists seize the Iranian Embassy in London, and an SAS team prepares to storm it.
Description: London, England, April 1980. Six terrorists assault the Embassy of Iran and take hostages. For six days, tense negotiations are held while the authorities decide whether a military squad should intervene.

Title: The Nines
Hint: A troubled actor, a TV show runner and a video game designer find their lives intertwining.
Description: A troubled actor, a television show runner, and an acclaimed videogame designer find their lives intertwining in mysterious and unsettling ways.

Title: Lions for Lambs
Hint: Three stories about the war in Afghanistan unfold simultaneously: a senator, a journalist and two soldiers.
Description: Three stories told simultaneously in ninety minutes of real time: a Republican Senator who's a presidential hopeful gives an hour-long interview to a skeptical television reporter, detailing a strategy for victory in Afghanistan; two special forces ambushed on an Afghani ridge await rescue as Taliban forces close in; a poli-sci professor at a California college invites a student to re-engage.

Title: Romance & Cigarettes
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A married ironworker in Queens falls for a younger woman, in a musical comedy.
Description: Ironworker Nick lives with his wife, Kitty, and three daughters. When he meets a significantly younger woman, Tula, he starts an affair with her, much to the chagrin of his wife, and his life is thrown into upheaval. Kitty kicks Nick out of the house, and he is forced to make some difficult decisions.

Title: Wonderstruck
Hint: The story of a young boy in the Midwest told simultaneously with a tale about a young girl in New York.
Description: The story of a young boy in the Midwest is told simultaneously with a tale about a young girl in New York from fifty years ago as they both seek the same mysterious connection.

Title: Una
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Canada
Hint: A young woman confronts the older man who sexually abused her when she was 13.
Description: When a young woman unexpectedly arrives at an older man's workplace, looking for answers, the secrets of the past threaten to unravel his new life.

Title: Peter Rabbit 2: The Runaway
Hint: A mischievous bunny runs away and joins a gang of animal criminals in the city.
Description: Peter ___ runs away from his human family when he learns they are going to portray him in a bad light in their book. Soon, he crosses paths with an older ___ who ropes him into a heist.

Title: Our Kind of Traitor
Hint: An Oxford academic and his girlfriend become involved with a Russian money launderer.
Description: A young Oxford academic and his attorney girlfriend holiday in Morocco. They bump into a Russian millionaire who owns a peninsula and a diamond watch. He wants a game of tennis. What else he wants propels the lovers on a tortuous journey to the City of London and its unholy alliance with Britain's intelligence establishment, to Paris and the Alps.

Title: Surviving the Game
Hint: A homeless man is hired as a survival guide for a group of wealthy businessmen, but he's their prey.
Description: A homeless man is hired as a survival guide for a group of wealthy businessmen on a hunting trip in the mountains, unaware that they are killers who hunt humans for sport, and that he is their new prey.

Title: I'm Still Here
Studio: They Are Going To Kill Us Productions
Hint: A famous actor announces his retirement to become a rapper in a hoax documentary.
Description: ___ is a portrayal of a tumultuous year in the life of actor Joaquin Phoenix. With remarkable access, the film follows the Oscar-nominee as he announces his retirement from a successful film career in the fall of 2008 and sets off to reinvent himself as a hip-hop musician.

Title: Funny Farm
Hint: A city sportswriter and his wife move to a country town that turns out to be crazy.
Description: Sportswriter Andy Farmer moves with his schoolteacher wife Elizabeth to the country in order to write a novel in relative seclusion. Of course, seclusion is the last thing the Farmers find in the small, eccentric town, where disaster awaits them at every turn.

Title: In Fabric
Hint: A cursed red dress at a department store brings misfortune to its owners.
Description: A haunting ghost story set against the backdrop of a busy winter sales period in a department store, following the life of a cursed dress as it passes from person to person, with devastating consequences.

Title: The Hummingbird Project
Hint: Two traders try to build a fibre-optic cable from Kansas to New Jersey to make millions.
Description: A pair of high-frequency traders go up against their old boss in an effort to make millions in a fiber-optic cable deal.

Title: Tiny Furniture
Hint: A film school graduate returns to New York to live with her artist mother and sister.
Description: After graduating from film school, Aura returns to New York to live with her photographer mother, Siri, and her sister, Nadine, who has just finished high school. Aura is directionless and wonders where to go next in her career and her life. She takes a job in a restaurant and tries unsuccessfully to develop relationships with men, including Keith, a chef where she works, and cult Internet star Jed.

Title: Tales from the Darkside: The Movie
Hint: A boy tells three horror stories to distract a witch who plans to cook him.
Description: A young boy tells three stories of horror to distract a witch who plans to eat him.

Title: Innocent Blood
Hint: A vampire with a taste for bad guys accidentally creates a mobster vampire in Pittsburgh.
Description: Marie is a vampire with a thirst for bad guys. When she fails to properly dispose of one of her victims, a violent mob boss, she bites off more than she can chew and faces a new, immortal danger.

Title: Chalet Girl
Hint: A girl working at an exclusive Alpine ski resort learns to snowboard and enters a competition.
Description: While working a job at an exclusive ski resort to support her Dad, Kim learns to snowboard and is so good at it that she enters a competition with a huge cash prize. She has to dig deep to overcome her fears, but her life gets more complicated through her spoken-for boss, Jonny.

Title: The Deep Blue Sea
Hint: The wife of a British judge is caught in a self-destructive affair with an RAF pilot.
Description: The wife of a British Judge is caught in a self-destructive love affair with a Royal Air Force pilot.

Title: Tamara Drewe
Hint: A young newspaper writer returns to her English countryside hometown, causing chaos among the locals.
Description: A young newspaper writer returns to her hometown in the English countryside, where her childhood home is being prepped for sale.

Title: Renaissance Man
Hint: An unemployed advertising man is hired to teach a group of underachieving army recruits.
Description: An advertising man is slowly sliding downhill. When he is fired from his job in Detroit, he signs up for unemployment. One day they find him a job: teaching thinking skills to Army recruits. He arrives on base to find that there is no structure set up for the class.

Title: After the Sunset
Hint: An FBI agent is suspicious of two retired master thieves in the Bahamas.
Description: An FBI agent is suspicious of two master thieves, quietly enjoying their retirement near what may - or may not - be the biggest score of their careers.

Title: W.E.
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A woman becomes obsessed with the love story of a king who gave up his throne for an American divorcée.
Description: In 1998, an auction of the estate of the Duke and Duchess of Windsor causes great excitement. For one woman, Wally Winthrop, it has much more meaning. Wally becomes obsessed by their historic love story. As she learns more about the sacrifices involved, Wally gains her own courage to find happiness.

Title: Stay Tuned
Hint: A couch potato and his wife are sucked into a hellish cable TV world.
Description: Salesman Roy Knable spends all his free time watching television, to the exasperation of his wife, Helen. One day, TV salesman Spike convinces Roy to buy a satellite dish offering 666 channels. The new addition to Roy's home entertainment system sucks him and Helen into Hellvision, a realm run by Spike, who is an emissary of Satan.

Title: The Eyes of My Mother
Hint: A lonely young woman is consumed by her darkest desires after tragedy strikes her rural family.
Description: A young, lonely woman is consumed by her deepest and darkest desires after tragedy strikes her quiet country life.

Title: The Fifth Estate
Hint: A dramatised look at the founding of a website that leaked classified government secrets.
Description: A look at the relationship between WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange and his early supporter and eventual colleague Daniel Domscheit-Berg, and how the website's growth and influence led to an irreparable rift between the two friends.

Title: The Portrait of a Lady
Country: Italy, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A free-spirited American heiress in Europe is manipulated by a scheming expatriate.
Description: Ms. Isabel Archer isn't afraid to challenge societal norms. Impressed by her free spirit, her kindhearted cousin writes her into his fatally ill father's will. Suddenly rich and independent, Isabelle ventures into the world, along the way befriending a cynical intellectual and romancing an art enthusiast.

Title: Twilight
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A teenage girl falls for a mysterious classmate who is actually a vampire.
Description: When Bella Swan moves to a small town in the Pacific Northwest, she falls in love with Edward Cullen, a mysterious classmate who reveals himself to be a 108-year-old vampire. Despite Edward's repeated cautions, Bella can't stay away from him, a fatal move that endangers her own life.

Title: Bruised
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A disgraced MMA fighter is pulled back into the ring after her son reappears.
Description: Jackie Justice is a mixed martial arts fighter who leaves the sport in disgrace. Down on her luck and simmering with rage and regret years after the fight, she's coaxed into a brutal underground fight by her manager and boyfriend Desi and grabs the attention of a fight league promoter who promises Jackie a life back in the Octagon.

Title: Mr. Nice Guy
Hint: A Chinese chef gets mixed up with drug dealers and a reporter in Melbourne.
Description: A Chinese chef accidentally gets involved with a news reporter who filmed a drug bust that went awry and is now being chased by gangs who are trying to get the video tape.

Title: Maggie's Plan
Hint: A woman's scheme to have a baby on her own is derailed when she falls for a married professor.
Description: ___ to have a baby on her own with a sperm donor is derailed when she falls in love with John, an older married professor, destroying his volatile marriage to the brilliant and impossible Georgette. But three years later, married to John with one daughter, ___ is out of love and in a quandary: what do you do when you suspect your man and his ex-wife are actually perfect for each other?

Title: Jabberwocky
Hint: A young cooper sets off to kill a monster in medieval England.
Description: After the death of his father, young Dennis Cooper goes to town where he has to pass several adventures. The town and the whole kingdom is threatened by a terrible monster called '___'. Will Dennis make his fortune? Is anyone brave enough to defeat the monster?

Title: Down and Out in Beverly Hills
Hint: A wealthy family's lives are changed when they rescue a suicidal homeless man.
Description: ___ couple Barbara and Dave Whiteman find their lives altered by the arrival of a vagrant who tries to drown himself in their swimming pool.

Title: Afflicted
Hint: Two friends touring Europe take a dark turn when one contracts a mysterious illness.
Description: Two friends' tour of Europe takes a dark turn when one of them contracts a mysterious illness. They race to find out what it is and how to cure it before the sickness consumes him completely.

Title: The Quake
Hint: A geologist races to save his family when a devastating earthquake strikes Oslo.
Description: A geologist races against time to save his estranged wife and two children when a devastating earthquake strikes Oslo, Norway.

Title: Sergio
Country: Albania, Jordan, Thailand, United States of America
Hint: A top UN diplomat is trapped under the rubble of a bombing in Baghdad.
Description: A sweeping drama set in the chaotic aftermath of the US invasion of Iraq, where the life of top UN diplomat Brazilian Sérgio Vieira de Mello hangs in the balance during the most treacherous mission of his career.

Title: HouseSitter
Hint: A con artist moves into an architect's empty house, posing as his wife.
Description: Con artist Gwen moves into Newton's empty home without his knowledge and begins setting up house, posing as his new wife.

Title: A Lonely Place to Die
Hint: Five mountaineers find a girl buried in the Scottish Highlands and are hunted by her kidnappers.
Description: A group of five mountaineers are hiking and climbing in the Scottish Highlands when they discover a young Serbian girl buried in a small chamber in the wilderness. They become caught up in a terrifying game of cat and mouse with the kidnappers as they try to get the girl to safety.

Title: Dhokha: Round D Corner
Hint: A delusional housewife is taken hostage by a terrorist, but who's the real villain?
Description: When a delusional housewife with a personality disorder is taken hostage by a terrorist on the loose and a husband accused of cheating on his wife have their own versions of reality, how do we know who's saying the truth?

Title: Cecil B. Demented
Hint: A deranged director and his gang of cinema terrorists kidnap a Hollywood star to make an underground film.
Description: A young lunatic director and his devoted cult of cinema terrorists kidnap a Hollywood movie goddess and force her to star in their radical underground movie.

Title: Below Zero
Hint: A prisoner transport is attacked and the cop in charge must deal with the freezing cold.
Description: When a prisoner transfer van is attacked, the cop in charge must fight those inside and outside while dealing with a silent foe: the icy temperatures.

Title: The Coldest Game
Hint: An alcoholic mathematician is recruited to play chess against a Soviet champion.
Description: Warsaw, Poland, during the Cuban Missile Crisis, 1962. Josh Mansky, a troubled math genius and former US chess champion, is recruited to hold a dangerous public match against the Soviet champion, while playing the deadly game of espionage hidden in the darkest shadows of a hostile territory.

Title: The Warrior's Way
Country: India, New Zealand, South Korea, United States of America
Hint: A legendary swordsman from the East hides in a small town in the American West with a baby.
Description: A warrior-assassin is forced to hide in a small town in the American Badlands after refusing a mission.

Title: For Love or Money
Hint: A New York concierge wants to start his own hotel but falls for his wealthy investor's mistress.
Description: New York concierge Doug Ireland wants to go into business for himself and refurbish a hotel on Roosevelt Island, N.Y., but he needs an investor. With a few weeks left before his option on the site runs out, Doug agrees to help wealthy Christian Hanover conceal his affair with salesgirl Andy Hart from his wife.

Title: Rampage
Hint: A primatologist and a giant albino gorilla race to stop mutated animals from destroying Chicago.
Description: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, the extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla who has been in his care since birth. But a rogue genetic experiment gone awry mutates this gentle ape into a raging creature of enormous size. To make matters worse, it’s soon discovered there are other similarly altered animals.

Title: Mother's Day
Hint: Three girls on a camping trip are kidnapped by two backwoods brothers who torture them to please their mom.
Description: Three girls discover that two men are willing to do anything to impress Mother and what impresses Mother is watching her sons commit acts of rape and murder. Now these women are prisoners and lowered to pawns in the game of checkers between two dim wits and their Maniac Mommy and the question becomes, can any of them escape, alive?

Title: Single All the Way
Hint: A perpetually unattached man brings his best friend home for the holidays, pretending they're a couple.
Description: Desperate to avoid his family’s judgment about his perpetual single status, Peter convinces his best friend Nick to join him for the holidays and pretend that they’re now in a relationship. But when Peter’s mother sets him up on a blind date with her handsome trainer James, the plan goes awry.

Title: Monkey Shines
Hint: A quadriplegic man is given a trained helper primate who becomes murderously jealous.
Description: A quadriplegic man is given a trained ___ help him with every day activities, until the little ___ begins to develop feelings, and rage, against its new master and those who get too close to him.

Title: Fading Gigolo
Hint: A florist becomes a professional ladies' man, with his bookseller friend as his manager.
Description: Fioravante decides to become a professional Don Juan as a way of making money to help his cash-strapped friend, Murray. With Murray acting as his "manager", the duo quickly finds themselves caught up in the crosscurrents of love and money.

Title: Assassination of a High School President
Hint: A student reporter investigates stolen SAT papers and uncovers a far-reaching conspiracy among his classmates.
Description: After the theft of copies of SAT exams from a principal's office, teenage reporter Bobby Funke sets out to unmask the thief.

Title: Ong Bak 2: The Beginning
Hint: A young nobleman whose family was murdered is trained in martial arts and seeks revenge.
Description: Tien, the son of Lord Sihadecho — a murdered nobleman — is taken under the wing of Chernang, a renowned warrior and leader of the Pha Beek Krut.

Title: White Zombie
Hint: A Haitian plantation owner asks a sinister voodoo master to turn a young bride into his mindless, obedient slave.
Description: A wealthy landowner living in Haiti convinces a sorcerer to lure the woman he has fallen for away from her fiancé. The madman later betrays their agreement by keeping the woman for himself…as a ___.

Title: Vanity Fair
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A clever, ambitious orphan schemes her way up through the ranks of 19th-century English high society.
Description: In early 19th century England, orphaned Becky Sharp defies her poverty-stricken background and ascends the social ladder alongside her best friend.

Title: Butter
Hint: An adopted girl discovers a gift for dairy sculpture and takes on an ambitious politician's wife at the Iowa state fair.
Description: An adopted girl discovers her talent for ___ carving and finds herself pitted against an ambitious local woman in their Iowa town's annual contest.

Title: Man of the Year
Hint: A comedian TV host runs for president and wins due to a computer glitch.
Description: The irreverent host of a political satire talk show decides to run for president and expose corruption in Washington. His stunt goes further than he expects when he actually wins the election, but a software engineer suspects that a computer glitch is responsible for his surprising victory.

Title: Powder Blue
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Four desperate souls on the gritty streets of LA collide on Christmas Eve, including a stripper and a dying man.
Description: On the gritty streets of LA, the destinies of four people desperate for connection and redemption are about to collide.

Title: A Very Harold & Kumar Christmas
Hint: Two stoner buddies accidentally torch a prized holiday tree and race through New York on the 24th to replace it, in 3D.
Description: Six years have elapsed since Guantanamo Bay, leaving ___ estranged from one another with very different families, friends and lives. But when ___ arrives on ___ doorstep during the holiday season with a mysterious package in hand, he inadvertently burns down ___ father-in-law's beloved Christmas tree.

Title: Mad Dog and Glory
Hint: A shy police photographer saves a mobster's life and is given a young woman for a week as a thank-you.
Description: Wayne Dobie is a shy cop whose low-key demeanor has earned him the affectionate nickname "___ Dog." After ___ Dog saves the life of Frank Milo, a crime boss and aspiring stand-up comedian, he's offered the company of an attractive young waitress named ___ for a week. At first both are uneasy about the arrangement, but they eventually fall in love.

Title: A Field in England
Hint: Deserters in the 17th-century civil war encounter a sinister alchemist in a meadow.
Description: During the Civil War in 17th-Century England, a small group of deserters flee from a raging battle through an overgrown ___. They are captured by an alchemist, who forces the group to aid him in his search to find a hidden treasure that he believes is buried in the ___.

Title: Sommersby
Hint: A Civil War soldier returns home to his wife after years away, but she starts to suspect he is an impostor.
Description: Set in the South just after the US Civil War, Laurel ___ is just managing to work the farm without her husband, believed killed in battle. By all accounts, Jack ___ was not a pleasant man, thus when he suddenly returns, Laurel has mixed emotions. It appears that Jack has changed a great deal, leading some people to believe that this is not actually Jack but an imposter.

Title: Guarding Tess
Hint: A Secret Service agent is stuck protecting a cantankerous former First Lady in her small Ohio town.
Description: Doug is a Secret Service Agent who has just completed his stint in charge protecting ___ Carlisle—the widow of a former U.S. President, and a close personal friend of the current President. He finds that she has requested that he not be rotated but instead return to be her permanent detail.

Title: City Hall
Hint: A boy's accidental shooting in New York leads a deputy mayor to an investigation of corruption.
Description: The accidental shooting of a boy in New York City leads to an investigation by the Deputy Mayor, and unexpectedly far-reaching consequences.

Title: Three Fugitives
Hint: A reformed bank robber is taken hostage by a bumbling first-time thief and his mute daughter.
Description: On his first day after being released from jail for 14 armed bank robberies, Lucas finds himself caught up in someone else's robbery. Perry has decided to hold up the local bank to raise money so that he can keep his daughter, Meg, and get her the treatment she needs. Dugan, a detective, assumes Lucas helped plan the robbery, and hence Lucas, Perry and Meg become ___.

Title: Topaz
Hint: A CIA agent and a French agent investigate a Soviet spy ring.
Description: Copenhagen, Denmark, 1962. When a high-ranking Soviet official decides to change sides, a French intelligence agent is caught up in a cold, silent and bloody spy war in which his own family will play a decisive role.

Title: Santa Claus: The Movie
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Netherlands
Hint: A woodcutter becomes the legendary toy-giving saint at the North Pole, while a greedy toymaker tries to cash in.
Description: In ancient times, a man named ___, who delivers toys in his small village, fulfils his destiny to become ___ after meeting an expert toy-making elf, Patch, in the North Pole. In the present day, ___ has become overwhelmed by his workload, and the disgruntled Patch flees the workshop to New York City.

Title: Manhattan Night
Hint: A big-city tabloid writer is drawn into a cold-case murder by a seductive widow.
Description: Porter Wren is a ___ tabloid writer with an appetite for scandal. On the beat he sells murder, tragedy, and anything that passes for the truth. At home, he is a dedicated husband and father.

Title: UFO
Hint: A college math whiz investigates an unexplained sighting over a Cincinnati airport.
Description: A college student, who sees a ___, uses his exceptional math skills to investigate the sighting with his friends while the FBI follows closely behind.

Title: Cold Prey
Hint: Five snowboarders shelter in an abandoned mountain lodge after an injury, and a killer is waiting.
Description: When one of them breaks a leg, five friends snowboarding in the Norwegian mountains take shelter in an abandoned ski lodge and soon realize they’re not alone.

Title: CB4
Hint: A mockumentary about the rise of a hardcore gangsta rap group that is not as tough as it seems.
Description: A "rockumentary", covering the rise to fame of MC Gusto, Stab Master Arson, and Dead Mike: members of the rap group "___". We soon learn that these three are not what they seem and don't appear to know as much about rap music as they claim... but a lack of musical ability in an artist never hurts sales, does it? You've just got to play the part of a rap star...

Title: The Onion Movie
Hint: A satirical newscaster reports on fake news stories in a sketch comedy from the famous parody paper.
Description: Venerable newscaster Norm Archer reports the latest news in politics, health, culture and entertainment - such as an automotive recall of decapitation-inducing "Neckbelts" and a study finding that "depression hits losers hardest". This compilation of bogus news stories, celebrity profiles, movie trailers and skits come courtesy of the ace satirists at The ___.

Title: Bride of Re-Animator
Hint: Two mad doctors continue their gruesome experiments reanimating the dead, and try to build a perfect woman.
Description: Unperturbed by the disastrous outcome of his previous meddling with the dead, Dr. West continues his research into the phenomenon of re-animation; only this time, he plans to create life – starting with the heart of his young protégé Dan's dearly deceased Meg Halsey.

Title: Resident Evil: Vendetta
Genres: Action, Animation, Adventure, Science Fiction, Horror
Hint: A captain and an agent battle a terrorist unleashing a deadly new virus in New York, in animated form.
Description: When a fearless enemy out for revenge unleashes a brutal and deadly new virus, BSAA captain Chris Redfield enlists the help of Agent Leon S. Kennedy and Professor Rebecca Chambers to bring down the death merchant and save New York City.

Title: I.Q.
Hint: The world's most famous physicist helps a mechanic win his niece's heart by pretending he's a genius.
Description: Albert Einstein helps a young man who's in love with Einstein's niece to catch her attention by pretending temporarily to be a great physicist.

Title: One Night at McCool's
Hint: Three men in love with the same femme fatale recount how she turned their lives upside down.
Description: On an ordinary night, in an ordinary part of town, a beautiful young woman walks into a bar. Her name is Jewel, and before long she is chatting to bartender Randy. The pair leave together, but he ends up getting into a tussle with her criminal boyfriend, who she then shoots dead, later persuading Randy to take the rap for her.

Title: Dear White People
Hint: A culture war erupts at an Ivy League college when a campus humour magazine throws a racist party.
Description: A campus culture war between Blacks and whites at a predominantly white Ivy League college comes to a head when the staff of a satirical magazine stages an offensive Halloween party.

Title: A Little Bit of Heaven
Hint: A guarded woman finds out she's dying of cancer but falls for her doctor.
Description: A guarded woman finds out she's dying of cancer but, when she meets her match, the threat of falling in love is scarier than death.

Title: Anywhere But Here
Hint: A teenage girl is dragged from Wisconsin to Beverly Hills by her flighty mother, who wants to make her a star.
Description: Single mother Adele August is bad with money, and even worse when it comes to making decisions. Her straight-laced daughter, Ann, is a successful high school student with Ivy League aspirations. When Adele decides to pack up and move the two of them from the Midwest to Beverly Hills, Calif., to pursue her dreams of Hollywood success, Ann grows frustrated with her mother's irresponsible and impulsive ways.

Title: Holiday in the Wild
Hint: A newly divorced woman goes on a solo honeymoon to Zambia and ends up working at an elephant orphanage.
Description: When her husband abruptly ends their marriage, empty nester Kate embarks on a solo second honeymoon in Africa, finding purpose and potential romance.

Title: OtherLife
Hint: An inventor of a drug that creates virtual memories finds herself trapped in a nightmarish prison of her own creation.
Description: Ren Amari is the driven inventor of a revolutionary new drug. ___ expands the brain's sense of time and creates virtual reality directly in the user's mind. With ___, mere seconds in real life feel like hours or days of exciting adventures. As Ren and her colleagues race around the clock to launch ___, the government muscles in to use the drugs as a radical solution to prison overcrowding.

Title: Sweet Virginia
Hint: A former rodeo star now managing a motel befriends the man responsible for a triple murder.
Description: A former rodeo star, now a motel manager, meets a young man who is responsible for the violence that suddenly has seized his small town.

Title: The Last Mimzy
Hint: Two siblings develop special talents after finding a mysterious box of toys from the future.
Description: Two siblings begin to develop special talents after they find a mysterious box of toys, and soon their parents and even their teacher are drawn into a strange new world – and find a task ahead of them that is far more important than any of them could imagine.

Title: Open Grave
Hint: A man wakes without memory in a pit full of bodies and must figure out if his rescuers are friend or foe.
Description: A man awakes -- without memory -- in a pit full of bodies and must figure out if the people who rescued him are the killers, or if he is the murderer.

Title: I Am Not a Serial Killer
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A troubled teen with homicidal tendencies hunts a supernatural murderer in his small Midwestern town.
Description: In a small Midwestern town, a troubled teen with homicidal tendencies must hunt down and destroy a supernatural killer while keeping his own inner demons at bay.

Description: Queen Poppy and Branch make a surprising discovery — there are other Troll worlds beyond their own, and their distinct differences create big clashes between these various tribes. Every Wednesday afternoon, a woman comes to his house for graphic, almost wordless, sex. One day, Jay follows her and learns about her. This eventually disrupts their relationship.

Description: ___ to discover his 5-year absence has allowed Lex Luthor to walk free, and that those he was closest to felt abandoned and have moved on. Luthor plots his ultimate revenge that could see millions killed and change the face of the planet forever, as well as ridding himself of the Man of Steel.

Description: The world’s most lethal odd couple – ___ Michael Bryce and ___ Darius Kincaid – are back on another life-threatening mission. Still unlicensed and under scrutiny, Bryce is forced into action by Darius's even more volatile wife, the infamous international con artist Sonia Kincaid.

Description: Sixteen-year-old Poppy has everything her unlimited credit cards can buy, and a spoiled attitude to match. After a final thoughtless prank, her exasperated father ships her off to boarding school in England. There, Poppy meets her match in a stern headmistress and a class full of girls who will not tolerate her selfishness.

David Duchovny, Orlando Jones, Seann William Scott, and Julianne Moore are the only people standing between the aliens and world domination... which could be bad news for the Earth.

Description: She's a magazine writer who gives up her career for love and family. He's a playboy newspaper columnist who can't quite give up his old tricks. And if that combination doesn't give a relationship ___, nothing will.

Title: The Golden Compass
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: In a parallel universe, after overhearing a shocking secret, precocious orphan Lyra Belacqua trades her carefree existence roaming the halls of Jordan College for an otherworldly adventure in the far North, unaware that it's part of her destiny.

Description: After finding out about her fiancé's cheating ways, a pop superstar impulsively marries a total stranger. They must soon decide if two people from such different worlds can find true love.

Title: Bedazzled
Hint: A hapless short-order cook sells his soul to the devil in exchange for seven wishes.
Description: A hapless loser sells his soul to the Devil in exchange for seven wishes, but has trouble winning over the girl of his dreams.

Description: An American soldier who had been killed during the Vietnam War is revived 25 years later by the military as a semi-android, UniSols, a high-tech soldier of the future. After the failure of the initiative to erase all the soldier's memories, he begins to experience flashbacks that are forcing him to recall his past.

Title: What Happens in Vegas
Hint: Two strangers wake up married after a bender in Sin City and win a jackpot they must stay married to keep.
Description: During a wild vacation in Las ___, career woman Joy McNally and playboy Jack Fuller come to the sober realization that they have married each other after a night of drunken abandon. They are then compelled, for legal reasons, to live life as a couple for a limited period of time. At stake is a large amount of money.

Description: A group of friends reunite ten years after their high-school graduation.

Description: The church enlists a team of vampire-hunters to hunt down and destroy a group of ___ searching for an ancient relic that will allow them to exist in sunlight.

Description: A Hollywood songwriter goes through a mid-life crisis and becomes infatuated with a sexy blonde newlywed.

Description: A group of eighty American workers are locked in their office and ordered by an unknown voice to participate in a twisted game.

Title: Resurrection

Description: A woman's carefully constructed life is upended when an unwelcome shadow from her past returns, forcing her to confront the monster she's evaded for two decades.

Title: Lyle, Lyle, Crocodile
Hint: A family moves to New York and finds a singing reptile living in their attic.
Description: When the Primm family moves to New York City, their young son Josh struggles to adapt to his new school and new friends. All of that changes when he discovers ___ — a singing ___ who loves baths, caviar and great music — living in the attic of his new home. But when ___ existence is threatened by evil neighbor Mr.

Title: Devil's Knot

Description: The savage murders of three young children sparks a controversial trial of three teenagers accused of killing the kids as part of a satanic ritual.

Title: The Cable Guy
Hint: A lonely, unhinged installer gives a customer free premium channels, then refuses to leave his life.
Description: When recently single Steven moves into his new apartment, ___ Chip comes to hook him up—and doesn't let go. Initially, Chip is just overzealous in his desire to be Steven's pal, but when Steven tries to end the 'friendship', Chip shows his dark side. He begins stalking Steven, who's left to fend for himself because no one else can believe Chip's capable of such behaviour.

Title: Three Men and a Baby
Hint: A trio of swinging New York bachelors are left to care for an infant who turns up on their doorstep.
Description: Three bachelors find themselves forced to take care of a baby left by one of the guy's girlfriends.

Title: Harlem Nights
Hint: In 1930s uptown New York, the owner of an illegal casino plots to outfox a gangster and a crooked cop.
Description: 'Sugar' Ray is the owner of an illegal casino and must contend with the pressure of vicious gangsters and corrupt police who want to see him go out of business. In the world of organised crime and police corruption in the 1920s, any dastardly trick is fair.

Title: Rookie of the Year

Description: 12-year-old Henry Rowengartner, whose late father was a minor league baseball player, grew up dreaming of playing baseball, despite his physical shortcomings. After Henry's arm is broken while trying to catch a baseball at school, the tendon in that arm heals too tightly, allowing Henry to throw pitches that are as fast as 103 mph.

Title: Level 16
Hint: Teenage girls at a sealed academy are trained in obedience and cleanliness, until two of them uncover the truth.
Description: The teenage girls of Vestalis Academy are meticulously trained in the art of being “clean girls,” practicing the virtues of perfect femininity. But what exactly are they being trained for? Vivien intends to find out.

Title: Grave Encounters

Description: A crew from a paranormal reality television show lock themselves in a haunted psychiatric hospital. They search for evidence of paranormal activity as they shoot what ends up becoming their final episode.

Title: The Rum Diary
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Puerto Rico
