Description: It's the lawless future, and renegade biker ___ and his surly cowboy buddy, ___, learn that a corrupt bank is about to foreclose on their friend's bar to further an expanding empire. ___ decide to help by robbing the crooked bank. But when they accidentally filch a drug shipment, they find themselves on the run from criminal financiers and the mob in this rugged action adventure.

Title: Harry and the Hendersons
Hint: A family hits a bigfoot with their car and takes the gentle creature home.
Description: Returning from a hunting trip in the forest, the Henderson family's car hits an animal in the road. At first they fear it was a man, but when they examine the "body" they find it's a "bigfoot". They think it's dead so they decide to take it home (there could be some money in this). As you guessed, it isn't dead. Far from being the ferocious monster they fear "Harry" to be, he's a friendly giant.

Title: Snake Eyes
Hint: A corrupt Atlantic City cop at a boxing match witnesses a political assassination and uncovers a conspiracy.
Description: All bets are off when shady homicide cop Rick Santoro witnesses a murder during a boxing match. Determined to solve the crime, he quickly learns that his search for answers will only uncover yet more questions in an ever-widening web of conspiracy, intrigue, and danger.

Title: The Collection
Hint: A man who escaped a sadistic killer is forced to lead a rescue team back to the killer's lair.
Description: Arkin escapes with his life from the vicious grips of "The Collector" during an entrapment party where he adds beautiful Elena to his "___." Instead of recovering from the trauma, Arkin is suddenly abducted from the hospital by mercenaries hired by Elena's wealthy father. Arkin is blackmailed to team up with the mercenaries and track down The Collector's booby trapped warehouse and save Elena.

Title: The Wedding Date
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A single woman hires a charming male escort to pose as her boyfriend at her sister's nuptials in London.
Description: With the wedding of her younger sister fast approaching, Kat Ellis faces the undesirable prospect of traveling alone to London for the ceremony. While this is bad enough, Jeffrey, the man who left her as they moved closer to marriage, happens to be the groom's best man.

Title: Red Heat
Hint: A tough Soviet cop is forced to team up with a cocky Chicago detective to catch a Georgian drug lord.
Description: A tough Russian policeman is forced to partner up with a cocky Chicago police detective when he is sent to Chicago to apprehend a Georgian drug lord who killed his partner and fled the country.

Title: Mercury Rising
Hint: A renegade FBI agent protects a young autistic boy who has cracked a top-secret government code.
Description: Renegade FBI agent Art Jeffries protects a nine-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new "unbreakable" code.

Title: The House with a Clock in Its Walls
Hint: An orphaned boy moves in with his warlock uncle and discovers a sinister secret in the house.
Description: When ten-year-old Lewis is suddenly orphaned, he is sent to live with his Uncle Jonathan in a creaky (and creepy) old mansion with a mysterious ticking noise that emanates from the ___. Upon discovering that his uncle is a warlock, Lewis begins learning magic, but when he rebelliously resurrects an evil warlock he must find the secret of the house and save the world from destruction.

Title: The Doom Generation
Hint: Two troubled teens pick up a young drifter and embark on a violent road trip.
Description: Jordan White and Amy Blue, two troubled teens, pick up an adolescent drifter, Xavier Red. Together, the threesome embarks on a sex- and violence-filled journey through a United States of psychos and quickie marts.

Title: All the Old Knives
Hint: Two CIA agents and former lovers meet over dinner to discuss a deadly hostage crisis years earlier.
Description: When the CIA discovers one of its agents leaked information that cost more than 100 people their lives, veteran operative Henry Pelham is assigned to root out the mole with his former lover and colleague Celia Harrison.

Title: Someone Great
Hint: A music journalist's boyfriend breaks up with her, so she has one last epic night in New York with her best friends.
Description: An aspiring music journalist lands her dream job and is about to move to San Francisco when her boyfriend of nine years decides to call it quits. To nurse her broken heart, she and her two best friends spend one outrageous last adventure in New York City.

Title: Nanny McPhee Returns
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, France
Hint: A magical, stern caretaker arrives to help a harried young mother on a farm while her husband is at war.
Description: ___ appears at the door of a harried young mother who is trying to run the family farm while her husband is away at war. But once she’s arrived, ___ discovers that the children are fighting a war of their own against two spoiled city cousins who have just moved in.

Title: The Noel Diary
Hint: A novelist cleaning out his childhood home meets a woman searching for her birth mother.
Description: Cleaning out his childhood home at Christmas, a novelist meets a woman searching for her birth mother. Will an old ___ unlock their pasts — and hearts?

Title: The Pagemaster
Hint: A timid boy takes shelter in a library and is transformed into a cartoon, journeying through classic novels.
Description: Rich knows a lot about accidents. So much so, he is scared to do anything that might endanger him, like riding his bike, or climbing into his treehouse. While in an old library, he is mystically transported into the unknown world of books, and he has to try and get home again.

Title: The Promise
Hint: A love triangle between a medical student, an American journalist and a dance teacher during the Armenian genocide.
Description: Set during the last days of the Ottoman Empire, a love triangle develops between Mikael, a brilliant medical student, the beautiful and sophisticated artist Ana, and Chris, a renowned American journalist based in Paris.

Title: Romeo Must Die
Hint: A former cop seeks revenge for his brother's death in a war between Chinese and African-American gangs.
Description: Two warring gang families (one African-American, the other Chinese) maneuver for bragging rights to the Oakland, California docks. Hang Sing and Trish O'Day uncover a trail of deceit that leaves most of the warring factions dead... or worse!

Title: Sky Captain and the World of Tomorrow
Country: Italy, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A reporter and a daredevil pilot investigate giant robots attacking New York in a retro 1930s adventure.
Description: When gigantic robots attack New York City, "___ Captain" uses his private air force to fight them off. His ex-girlfriend, reporter Polly Perkins, has been investigating the recent disappearance of prominent scientists. Suspecting a link between the global robot attacks and missing men, ___ Captain and Polly decide to work together. They fly to the Himalayas in pursuit of the mysterious Dr.

Title: Ride Along
Hint: A fast-talking security guard joins his girlfriend's cop brother on a 24-hour patrol of Atlanta.
Description: For the past two years, high-school security guard Ben has been trying to show decorated APD detective James that he's more than just a video-game junkie who's unworthy of James' sister, Angela. When Ben finally gets accepted into the academy, he thinks he's earned the seasoned policeman's respect and asks for his blessing to marry Angela.

Title: That Awkward Moment
Hint: Three friends make a pact to stay single, but each falls in love.
Description: Best pals Jason and Daniel indulge in casual flings and revel in their carefree, unattached lives. After learning that the marriage of their friend Mikey is over, they gladly welcome him back into their circle. The three young men make a pact to have fun and avoid commitment. However, when all three find themselves involved in serious relationships, they must keep their romances secret from one another.

Title: Open Season
Hint: A pampered domesticated bear teams up with a hyper mule deer to survive in the wild when hunters arrive.
Description: Boog, a domesticated 900lb. Grizzly bear finds himself stranded in the woods 3 days before ___. Forced to rely on Elliot, a fast-talking mule deer, the two form an unlikely friendship and must quickly rally other forest animals if they are to form a rag-tag army against the hunters.

Title: Two Weeks Notice
Hint: A lawyer quits her job working for a billionaire who relies on her for everything.
Description: Dedicated environmental lawyer Lucy Kelson goes to work for billionaire George Wade as part of a deal to preserve a community center. Indecisive and weak-willed George grows dependent on Lucy's guidance on everything from legal matters to clothing. Exasperated, Lucy gives ___ and picks Harvard graduate June Carter as her replacement.

Title: Inkheart
Hint: A man with the power to bring books to life by reading aloud must save his daughter from a villain.
Description: The adventures of a father and his young daughter, in their search for a long lost book that will help reunite a missing, close relative.

Title: Eyes of Laura Mars
Hint: A fashion photographer develops the ability to see a serial killer's crimes as they happen.
Description: A famous fashion photographer develops a disturbing ability to see through the eyes of a serial killer.

Title: Yes, God, Yes
Hint: A Catholic teen in the early 2000s discovers masturbation and goes on a religious retreat.
Description: Alice, a young innocent Catholic girl, is tempted into masturbating after an AOL chat suddenly turns sexual, however is conflicted as the act would be considered a sin.

Title: Wolf Creek 2
Hint: Backpackers in the Australian outback are terrorised by the return of a notorious serial killer.
Description: Lured by the promise of an Australian holiday, backpackers Rutger, Katarina and Paul visit the notorious ___ Crater. Their dream Outback adventure soon becomes a horrific reality when they encounter the site's most infamous local, the last man any traveller to the region ever wants to meet—Mick Taylor. As the backpackers flee, Mick pursues them on an epic white knuckled rampage across hostile wasteland.

Title: The Philadelphia Experiment
Hint: A secret US Navy test in 1943 sends two sailors forward through time to 1984.
Description: Based on an "actual event" that took place in 1943. About a US Navy Destroyer Escort that disappeared from the ___ Naval Shipyard, and sent two men 40 years into the future to 1984.

Title: The Bronze
Hint: A foul-mouthed former Olympic gymnast clinging to her small-town fame must coach a young rival.
Description: In 2004, Hope Ann Greggory became an American hero after winning the ___ medal for the women's gymnastics team. Today, she's still living in her small hometown, washed-up and embittered. Stuck in the past, Hope must reassess her life when a promising young gymnast threatens her local celebrity status.

Title: Blitz
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A nine-year-old boy in WWII London escapes his evacuation train and tries to get home to his mother during the bombing.
Description: In World War II London, nine-year-old George is evacuated to the countryside by his mother, Rita, to escape the bombings. Defiant and determined to return to his family, George embarks on an epic, perilous journey back home as Rita searches for him.

Title: Code 8
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: In a city where people with special powers are oppressed, a construction worker turns to crime.
Description: In Lincoln City, some inhabitants have extraordinary abilities. Most live below the poverty line, under the close surveillance of a heavily militarized police force. Connor, a construction worker with powers, involves with a criminal gang to help his ailing mother. (Based on the short film “___,” 2016.)

Title: The Campaign
Hint: Two candidates for a congressional seat in North Carolina wage a dirty, escalating election war.
Description: Two rival politicians compete to win an election to represent their small North Carolina congressional district in the United States House of Representatives.

Title: Don't Listen
Hint: A man renovating a new home hears a ghostly plea for help after his son goes missing.
Description: After a tragic turn of events at the new home he's fixing up, Daniel hears a ghostly plea for help, spurring him to seek out a famous paranormal expert.

Title: Little Big League
Hint: A 12-year-old inherits a professional baseball team and becomes its manager.
Description: When the owner of the Minnesota Twins passes away, he bequeaths the team to his preteen grandson. The newly minted head honcho quickly appoints himself manager, causing unrest in an organization that struggles to take orders from a 12-year-old.

Title: Orgazmo
Hint: A devout Mormon in LA becomes a porn actor and plays a superhero with a ray gun.
Description: A devout Mormon living in L.A. becomes a pornographic actor after his martial arts moves impress a big-time director.

Title: Down Periscope
Hint: An unorthodox Navy officer is given command of a rusty, outdated diesel submarine.
Description: Maverick Navy Lieutenant Commander Tom Dodge will never be a textbook officer, but he's a brilliant seaman who's always wanted to command a nuclear submarine — he's been given one last chance to clean up his record. Unfortunately, Admiral Graham, his nemesis, would rather sink the fleet than give Dodge his own boat.

Title: Below
Hint: A WWII US submarine rescues survivors of a British hospital ship, and supernatural events begin.
Description: In the dark silence of the sea during World War II, the submarine USS Tiger Shark prowls on what should be a routine rescue mission. But for the shell-shocked crew, trapped together in the sub's narrow corridors and constricted spaces, this is about to become a journey into the sensory delusions, mental deceptions and runaway fears that lurk just ___ the surface of the ocean.

Title: Tourist Trap
Hint: Young travellers whose car breaks down are terrorised by a telekinetic man with a museum of mannequins.
Description: After their car breaks down, a group of young travelers find themselves stranded at a roadside museum run by the enigmatic Mr. Slausen and populated by his collection of life-like wax mannequins.

Title: Erik the Viking
Hint: A peaceful Norse warrior sets out on a voyage to the edge of the world to end the age of war, in a Python-style comedy.
Description: ___ gathers warriors from his village and sets out on a dangerous journey to Valhalla, to ask the gods to end the Age of Ragnorok and allow his people to see sunlight again. A Pythonesque satire of ___ life.

Title: The Wizard
Hint: A boy and his brother run away to a video game championship in California, as their father chases them.
Description: A boy and his brother run away from home and hitch cross-country, with help from a girl they meet, to compete in the ultimate video-game championship.

Title: April Fool's Day
Hint: A group of college friends gather on an isolated island for a weekend of pranks, but someone is killing them.
Description: On ___ weekend, a group of college friends gather together at a secluded island mansion to celebrate their final year of school, where they soon become prey for an unseen murderer.

Title: The Mexican
Hint: A hapless bagman is sent to Mexico to retrieve a cursed antique pistol while his girlfriend is kidnapped.
Description: Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the ___"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border.

Title: An Awkward Sexual Adventure
Hint: An accountant teams up with a stripper to become a better lover.
Description: A hyper-repressed and schlubby accountant (Jonas Chernick) strikes a deal with a worldly but disorganized stripper (Emily Hampshire): he'll help her with her crushing debt if she helps him become a better lover.

Title: Windtalkers
Hint: A Marine is assigned to protect a Navajo code talker during WWII, with orders to kill him if captured.
Description: Joe Enders is a gung-ho Marine assigned to protect a "windtalker" - one of several Navajo Indians who were used to relay messages during World War II because their spoken language was indecipherable to Japanese code breakers.

Title: Chasing Liberty
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The US president's daughter escapes her security detail during a trip to Europe and falls for a man who's secretly an agent.
Description: The President's daughter, unable to experience life like a normal 18 year-old, escapes from her entourage of Secret Service agents while traveling in Europe. She falls in love with a handsome British stranger, who also happens to be working undercover for her father.

Title: Showdown in Little Tokyo
Hint: A cop raised in Japan and his partner take on the yakuza in Los Angeles.
Description: An American with a Japanese upbringing, Chris Kenner is a police officer assigned to the Little ___ section of Los Angeles. Kenner is partnered with Johnny Murata, a Japanese-American who isn't in touch with his roots. Despite their differences, both men excel at martial arts, and utilize their formidable skills when they go up against Yoshida, a vicious yakuza drug dealer with ties to Kenner's past.

Title: American Ultra
Hint: A stoner convenience store clerk is actually a sleeper agent targeted for extermination.
Description: Mike is an unmotivated stoner whose small-town life with his live-in girlfriend, Phoebe, is suddenly turned upside down. Unbeknownst to him, Mike is actually a highly trained, lethal sleeper agent. In the blink of an eye, as his secret past comes back to haunt him, Mike is thrust into the middle of a deadly government operation and is forced to summon his inner action-hero in order to survive.

Title: Winter's Tale
Hint: A burglar falls for an heiress who dies in his arms, and he has the power to save her.
Description: A burglar falls for an heiress as she dies in his arms. When he learns that he has the gift of reincarnation, he sets out to save her.

Title: Vampire's Kiss
Hint: A publishing executive believes he's been bitten by a bloodsucker and begins a wild descent into madness.
Description: A publishing executive is visited and bitten by a ___ and starts exhibiting erratic behavior. He pushes his secretary to extremes as he tries to come to terms with his affliction.

Title: The Kid Who Would Be King
Hint: A schoolboy finds a legendary sword and must defeat an evil sorceress.
Description: Old-school magic meets the modern world when young Alex stumbles upon the mythical sword Excalibur. He soon unites his friends and enemies, and they become knights who join forces with the legendary wizard Merlin. Together, they must save mankind from the wicked enchantress Morgana and her army of supernatural warriors.

Title: Red State
Hint: A group of teens answer an online sex invitation and are captured by an extremist church.
Description: Set in Middle America, a group of teens receive an online invitation for sex, though they soon encounter Christian fundamentalists with a much more sinister agenda.

Title: The Replacement Killers
Hint: An assassin refuses to kill a child and teams up with a forger to escape his crime boss.
Description: Hired assassin John Lee is asked by Chinatown crime boss Terence Wei to murder the young son of policeman Stan Zedkov. Lee has the boy in his sights, but his conscience gets the better of him, and he spares the child's life.

Title: Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius
Genres: Family, Comedy, Adventure, Animation, Science Fiction
Hint: A brainy boy inventor saves his parents and the town's adults from egg-shaped alien abductors.
Description: ___ is a ___ and way ahead of his friends, but when it comes to being cool, he's a little behind. All until one day when his parents, and parents all over Earth are kidnapped by aliens, it's up to him to lead all the children of the world to rescue their parents.

Title: The Killer Inside Me
Country: Canada, Sweden, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A small-town Texas deputy sheriff is secretly a psychopath with a violent streak.
Description: Deputy Sheriff Lou Ford is a pillar of the community in his small west Texas town, patient and apparently thoughtful. Some people think he is a little slow and maybe boring, but that is the worst they say about him. But then nobody knows about what Lou calls his "sickness": He is a brilliant, but disturbed sociopathic sadist.

Title: A Good Old Fashioned Orgy
Hint: A group of friends throw one last outrageous party at a beach house before it's sold.
Description: A group of 30-year-olds who have been friends since high school attempt to throw an end-of-summer ___.

Title: Airplane II: The Sequel
Hint: A faulty computer causes a passenger space shuttle to head straight for the sun.
Description: A faulty computer causes a passenger space shuttle to head straight for the sun, and man-with-a-past Ted Striker must save the day and get the shuttle back on track – again – all the while trying to patch up his relationship with Elaine.

Title: Drinking Buddies
Hint: Two coworkers at a Chicago brewery are perfect for each other, but they're both in relationships.
Description: Weekend trips, office parties, late night conversations, ___ on the job, marriage pressure, biological clocks, holding eye contact a second too long… you know what makes the line between “friends” and “more than friends” really blurry? Beer.

Title: Point of No Return
Hint: A drug-addicted killer is given a second chance as a government assassin.
Description: Hardened criminal Maggie Hayward's consistent violence, even in police custody, ends in the execution chamber. However, top-secret US government agent 'Bob' arranges a staged death, so Maggie can be elaborately trained as a phantom killer and subdued into obedience.

Title: Shirley
Hint: A famous horror writer finds inspiration for her next book when she takes in a young couple.
Description: A famous horror writer finds inspiration for her next book after she and her husband take in a young couple.

Title: Ironclad
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: In 1215, a band of knights defend Rochester Castle against King John's army.
Description: In the year 1215, the rebel barons of England have forced their despised King John to put his royal seal on the Magna Carta, a seminal document that upheld the rights of free men. Yet within months of pledging himself to the great charter, the King reneged on his word and assembled a mercenary army on the south coast of England with the intention of bringing the barons and the country back under his tyrannical rule.

Title: Personal Shopper
Hint: A young American in Paris works as a celebrity assistant and waits for a sign from her dead twin.
Description: Maureen, mid-20s, is a ___ for a media celebrity. The job pays for her stay in Paris, a city she refuses to leave until she makes contact with her twin brother who previously died there. Her life becomes more complicated when a mysterious person contacts her via text message.

Title: Hit and Run
Hint: A former getaway driver jeopardises his identity to drive his fiancée to LA.
Description: When former getaway driver Charlie Bronson jeopardises his Witness Protection Plan identity in order to help his girlfriend get to Los Angeles, the feds and Charlie's former gang chase them on the road.

Title: In a Valley of Violence
Hint: A drifter and his dog arrive in a small town where he seeks revenge on those who wronged him.
Description: The story of a drifter named Paul who arrives in a small town seeking revenge on the thugs who murdered his friend. Sisters Mary Anne and Ellen, who run the town's hotel, help Paul in his quest for vengeance.

Title: The Edge of Love
Hint: A Welsh poet and his wife become involved with his childhood sweetheart and her soldier husband during WWII.
Description: When the Welsh poet Dylan Thomas and his flirtatious wife Caitlin sweep into war-torn London, the last thing they expect is to bump into Dylan's childhood sweetheart Vera. Despite her joy at seeing Dylan after so many years, Vera is swept off her feet by a dashing officer, William Killick, and finds herself torn between the open adoration of her new found beau and the wily charms of the exotic Welshman.

Title: Between Two Ferns: The Movie
Hint: An awkward talk show host goes on a road trip to complete a series of celebrity interviews.
Description: Galifianakis dreamed of becoming a star. But when Will Ferrell discovered his public access TV show, '___' and uploaded it to Funny or Die, Zach became a viral laughing stock. Now Zach and his crew are taking a road trip to complete a series of high-profile celebrity interviews and restore his reputation.

Title: Waxwork
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A group of college students are invited to a wax museum where the exhibits come to life.
Description: Wealthy slacker college student Mark, his new girlfriend Sarah, and their friends are invited to a special showing at a mysterious wax museum which displays 18 of the most evil men of all time. After his ex-girlfriend and another friend disappear, Mark becomes suspicious.

Title: Rememory
Hint: The widow of a professor finds one of his inventions, a device that records memories, and investigates his death.
Description: The widow of a wise professor stumbles upon one of his inventions that's able to record and play a person's memory.

Title: A Hologram for the King
Country: Germany, United States of America, France, Mexico, Switzerland
Hint: A struggling American businessman travels to Saudi Arabia to sell a 3D teleconferencing system to the monarch.
Description: Alan Clay, a struggling American businessman, travels to Saudi Arabia to sell a new technology to the King, only to be challenged by endless Middle Eastern bureaucracy, a perpetually absent monarch, and a suspicious growth on his back.

Title: Let Them All Talk
Hint: A celebrated author takes a transatlantic cruise with her old friends.
Description: A celebrated author takes a journey with some old friends to have some fun and heal old wounds. Her nephew comes along to wrangle the ladies and finds himself involved with a young literary agent.

Title: 30 Minutes or Less
Hint: Two fledgling criminals strap a bomb to a pizza delivery guy and force him to rob a bank.
Description: Two fledgling criminals kidnap a pizza delivery guy, strap a bomb to his chest, and advise him that he has mere hours to rob a bank or else...

Title: Dark Angel
Hint: A Houston vice cop teams up with an FBI agent to stop an alien drug dealer.
Description: Jack Caine is a Houston vice cop who's forgotten the rule book. His self-appointed mission is to stop the drugs trade and the number one supplier Victor Manning. While involved in an undercover operation to entrap Victor Manning, his partner is killed, and a sinister newcomer enters the scene...

Title: The Russia House
Country: United States of America, Soviet Union
Hint: A British publisher of Russian literature is recruited by MI6 to investigate a Soviet manuscript.
Description: Barley Scott Blair, a Lisbon-based editor of Russian literature who unexpectedly begins working for British intelligence, is commissioned to investigate the purposes of Dante, a dissident scientist trapped in the decaying Soviet Union that is crumbling under the new open-minded policies.

Title: Intruder
Hint: The overnight crew of a supermarket is stalked and slashed by a mysterious killer.
Description: The overnight stock crew of a local supermarket find themselves being stalked and slashed by a mysterious maniac.

Title: Coriolanus
Hint: An arrogant Roman general, banished by his people, allies with his sworn enemy for revenge.
Description: Caius Martius, aka ___, is an arrogant and fearsome general who has built a career on protecting Rome from its enemies. Pushed by his ambitious mother to seek the position of consul, ___ is at odds with the masses and unpopular with certain colleagues. When a riot results in his expulsion from Rome, ___ seeks out his sworn enemy, Tullus Aufidius. Together, the pair vow to destroy the great city.

Title: Splinter
Hint: A couple taken hostage at a gas station are attacked by a parasitic creature.
Description: When their plans for a nature trip go awry, Polly and boyfriend Seth decide to check into a motel. On their way, they're carjacked and kidnapped by low-rent crooks Dennis and Lacey, who take the victims and their SUV to a nearby gas station. Along the way, they encounter an increasingly terrifying horde of parasites, and if any of them intend to survive, they'll have to outsmart the deadly organisms.

Title: The Quiet
Hint: A deaf teenage girl moves in with her godparents, whose family is hiding a dark secret.
Description: After her widowed father dies, deaf teenager Dot moves in with her godparents, Olivia and Paul Deer. The Deers' daughter, Nina, is openly hostile to Dot, but that does not prevent her from telling her secrets to her silent stepsister, including the fact that she wants to kill her lecherous father.

Title: Stockholm
Hint: A bank robber takes hostages in a 1973 heist, and they begin to sympathise with him.
Description: Based on the extraordinary true story of the city's 1973 bank heist and hostage crisis. The events grasped the world’s attention when the hostages bonded with their captors and turned against the authorities, giving rise to the psychological phenomenon known as “___ Syndrome.”

Title: The Tale of Despereaux
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A tiny, brave mouse with big ears sets out to rescue a princess.
Description: Once upon a time... in the far away kingdom of Dor... lived a brave and virtuous mouse with comically oversized ears who dreamt of becoming a knight. Banished from his home for having such lofty ambitions, ___ sets off on an amazing adventure with his good-hearted rat friend Roscuro, who leads him, at long last, on a very noble quest to rescue an endangered princess and save an entire kingdom from darkness.

Title: The Sea of Trees
Hint: An American man goes to a Japanese forest to end his life and meets a lost Japanese man.
Description: In Japan's Aokigahara Forest, a troubled teacher meets a mysterious lost stranger who takes him on a life-changing journey of love and redemption.

Title: The Sacrament
Hint: Two journalists document their friend's journey to reunite with his sister at a remote religious commune.
Description: Two journalists set out to document their friend's journey to reunite with his estranged sister. They track her to an undisclosed location where they are welcomed into the remote world of "Eden Parish," a self-sustained rural utopia composed of nearly two hundred members and overseen by a mysterious leader known only as "Father." It quickly becomes evident to the newcomers that this paradise may not be as it seems.

Title: Finding 'Ohana
Hint: Two Brooklyn siblings visit their grandfather in Oahu and go on a treasure hunt.
Description: Two Brooklyn siblings' summer in a rural Oahu town takes an exciting turn when a journal pointing to long-lost treasure sets them on an adventure, leading them to reconnect with their Hawaiian heritage.

Title: Multiplicity
Hint: A construction worker overwhelmed by work and family has himself cloned.
Description: Construction worker Doug Kinney finds that the pressures of his working life, combined with his duties to his wife Laura and daughter Jennifer leaves him with little time for himself. However, he is approached by geneticist Dr. Owen Leeds, who offers Doug a rather unusual solution to his problems: cloning.

Title: The Two Jakes
Hint: A private investigator is hired by a real estate developer in 1948 Los Angeles.
Description: Real estate developer Jake Berman hires private investigator and war veteran Jake Gittes for some run-of-the-mill matrimonial work. After Berman shoots his wife's lover, who happens to be his business partner, Gittes is drawn into a web of conspiracy and deceit involving the oil reserves beneath Los Angeles.

Title: Sniper
Hint: A veteran Marine marksman and a rookie are sent into the Panamanian jungle to assassinate a rebel leader.
Description: Tough guy Thomas Beckett is a US Marine working in the Panamanian jungle. His job is to seek out rebels and remove them using his ___ skills. Beckett is notorious for losing his partners on such missions. This time he's accompanied by crack marksman Richard Miller.

Title: Out for Justice
Hint: A Brooklyn detective rampages through the neighbourhood hunting the psychotic mobster who killed his partner.
Description: Gino Felino is an NYPD detective from Brooklyn who knows everyone and everything in his neighborhood. Killing his partner was someone's big mistake... because he's now ___.

Title: The Final Cut
Hint: In a world with memory implants, a man who edits people's lives for funerals finds a dangerous secret.
Description: Set in a world with memory implants, Alan Hakman is a 'cutter'—someone with the power of final edit over people's recorded histories—but his latest assignment puts him in great danger.

Title: I Kill Giants
Country: Belgium, United Kingdom, United States of America, Ireland
Hint: A girl who claims she hunts monsters with a magic hammer struggles to face her family's tragedy.
Description: Sophia, a new high school student, tries to make friends with Barbara, who tells her that “she kills ___,” protecting this way her hometown and its inhabitants, who do not understand her strange behavior.

Title: The Seasoning House
Hint: A deaf orphan girl in a Balkan brothel seeks revenge.
Description: The ___ - where young girls are prostituted to the military. An orphaned deaf mute is enslaved to care for them. She moves between the walls and crawlspaces, planning her escape. Planning her ingenious and brutal revenge.

Title: The Decoy Bride
Hint: A local woman is hired as a stand-in to fool paparazzi at a Hollywood actress's wedding on a Scottish island.
Description: A local woman is hired to draw paparazzi away from a Hollywood actress who has come to Scotland to get married.

Title: The Car
Hint: A small Utah town is terrorised by a driverless black coupe.
Description: The Utah community of Santa Ynez is being terrorized by a mysterious black coupe that appears out of nowhere and begins running people down. After the ___ kills off the town sheriff, Captain Wade Parent is determined to stop the murderous driver.

Title: Hobo with a Shotgun
Hint: A vigilante homeless man arrives in a city and starts fighting back against crime.
Description: A vigilante homeless man pulls into a new city and finds himself trapped in urban chaos, a city where crime rules and where the city's crime boss reigns. Seeing an urban landscape filled with armed robbers, corrupt cops, abused prostitutes and even a pedophile Santa, the ___ goes about bringing justice to the city the best way he knows how - with a 20-gauge ___.

Title: ATL
Hint: Four friends in Atlanta face turning points in their lives as they prepare for life after high school, and a roller rink.
Description: As four friends prepare for life after high school, different challenges bring about turning points in each of their lives. The dramas unfold and resolve at their local rollerskating rink, Cascade.

Title: Extract
Hint: A factory owner's life falls apart after a series of accidents and a con artist.
Description: The owner of a factory that produces flavor extracts, Joel Reynold seems to have it all, but really doesn't. What's missing is sexual attention from his wife, Suzie. Joel hatches a convoluted plan to get Suzie to cheat on him, thereby clearing the way for Joel to have an affair with Cindy, an employee.

Title: The House by the Cemetery
Hint: A family moves into a house in New England, and the previous owner is still in the basement.
Description: After a doctor kills his mistress and himself while researching the mysterious previous owner of his Boston home, his colleague, Dr. Norman Boyle, takes over his studies and moves his family into the Boston mansion. Soon after, Boyle's young son Bob becomes plagued by visions of a young girl, who warns him of the danger within the house.

Title: Little Buddha
Hint: Tibetan monks believe a boy in Seattle may be the reincarnation of their teacher.
Description: After the death of Lama Dorje, Tibetan Buddhist monks find three children — one American and two Nepalese — who may be the rebirth of their great teacher.

Title: The Tailor of Panama
Hint: A British spy banished to Central America recruits a clothier with a dubious past as an informant, and the lies spiral.
Description: A British spy is banished to ___ after having an affair with an ambassador's mistress. Once there he makes connection with a local ___ with a nefarious past and connections to all of the top political and gangster figures in ___. The ___ also has a wife, who works for the Panamanian president and a huge debt. The mission is to learn what the President intends to do with the Canal.

Title: Snow White: A Tale of Terror
Hint: A dark, gothic fable in which a girl's grieving stepmother uses a magic mirror and wants her dead.
Description: When young Lili's mother dies in childbirth, her father remarries Lady Claudia, a woman ruled by an evil mirror with the power to make her queen of all living things. After escaping an attempt on her life, Lili finds herself lost in a dark forest, where living happily ever after seems unlikely.

Title: Undisputed
Country: United States of America, Germany, Japan
Hint: A prison boxing champion faces a former heavyweight champ who has been sent to the same prison.
Description: Monroe Hutchens is the heavyweight champion of Sweetwater, a maximum security prison. He was convicted to a life sentence due to a passionate crime. Iceman Chambers is the heavyweight champion, who lost his title due to a rape conviction to ten years in Sweetwater. When these two giants collide in the same prison, they fight against each other disputing who is the real champion.

Title: Moonwalker
Hint: A fantasy film inspired by a pop superstar's music, with a robot transformation and a drug lord.
Description: This fantastical movie inspired by the music of Michael Jackson features imaginative interpretations of hit tracks from the iconic 1987 album “Bad”.

Title: Captain Alatriste
Hint: A brave soldier fights in 17th-century Spain and gets caught up in court intrigue.
Description: In 17th century Spain Diego ___, a brave and heroic soldier, is fighting in his King's army in the Flandes region. His best mate, Balboa, falls in a trap and, near to death, asks Diego to look after his son and teach him to be a soldier.

Title: Running with Scissors
Hint: A young boy is sent to live with his mother's eccentric psychiatrist.
Description: Young Augusten Burroughs absorbs experiences that could make for a shocking memoir: the son of an alcoholic father and an unstable mother, he's handed off to his mother's therapist, Dr. Finch, and spends his adolescent years as a member of Finch's bizarre extended family.

Title: Chennai Express
Hint: A man travels to Tamil Nadu to scatter his grandfather's ashes and gets entangled with a gangster's daughter.
Description: Rahul embarks on a journey to a small town in Tamil Nadu to fulfill the last wish of his grandfather: to have his ashes immersed in the Holy water of Rameshwaram. En route, he meets a woman hailing from a unique family down South. As they find love through this journey in the exuberant lands of South India, an unanticipated drive awaits them.

Title: House of the Sun
Hint: An ex-cop trying to stay clean is pulled back into the criminal underworld to save his brother.
Description: An analytical examination of interpersonal relationships and inherited property constraints set against the backdrop of mid-twentieth-century societal shifts.

Title: The Front Runner
Hint: A promising presidential candidate's campaign is derailed by an affair in 1987.
Description: Gary Hart, former Senator of Colorado, becomes the ___ for the Democratic presidential nomination in 1987. Hart's intelligence, charisma and idealism makes him popular with young voters, leaving him with a seemingly clear path to the White House.

Title: Broken City
Hint: A former cop turned private eye is hired by the mayor to investigate his wife.
Description: In a ___ rife with injustice, ex-cop Billy Taggart seeks redemption and revenge after being double-crossed and then framed by its most powerful figure, the mayor. Billy's relentless pursuit of justice, matched only by his streetwise toughness, makes him an unstoppable force - and the mayor's worst nightmare.

Title: Adult World
Hint: A naive college graduate who believes she's destined to be a famous poet takes a job at a sex shop.
Description: Amy, a naive college graduate who believes she's destined to be a great poet, begrudgingly accepts a job at a sex shop while she pursues a mentorship with reclusive writer Rat Billings.

Title: Divine Secrets of the Ya-Ya Sisterhood
Hint: A woman's estranged daughter learns about her mother's past through her eccentric friends in Louisiana.
Description: In a sleepy Louisiana parish, a group of lifelong friends stage a rather unorthodox intervention to help a young playwright unravel the truth about her complicated mother and let go of her painful past.

Title: O
Hint: A Black basketball star at an elite boarding school is manipulated by a jealous teammate.
Description: Even though he's the only black student at the elite Palmetto Grove Academy, star basketball player Odin James has the adoration of all, including the team's coach and the Dean's beautiful daughter Desi.

Title: Any Which Way You Can
Hint: A bare-knuckle brawler and his orangutan friend are drawn into a big-money fight.
Description: Philo takes part in a bare knuckle fight – as he does – to make more money than he can earn from his car repair business. He decides to retire, but when the Mafia come along and arrange another fight, he's pushed into it. A motorcycle gang and an orangutan called Clyde all add to the 'fun'.

Title: S1m0ne
Hint: A struggling film producer creates a virtual actress who becomes a star.
Description: The career of a disillusioned producer, who is desperate for a hit, is endangered when his star walks off the film set. Forced to think fast, the producer decides to digitally create an actress "Simone" to sub for the star — the first totally believable synthetic actress.

Title: City by the Sea
Hint: A New York detective investigates a murder that leads to his estranged son.
Description: Vincent LaMarca is a dedicated and well-respected New York City police detective who has gone to great lengths to distance himself from his past, but then makes the terrible discovery that his own son has fallen into a life of crime.

Title: Jug Jugg Jeeyo
Hint: A couple heading for divorce attend a family wedding where his father also announces he wants a divorce.
Description: A marriage. A re-marriage. A pending divorce. It's been five years since Kukoo and Nainaa got married after knowing each other practically all their lives, and now they need to break it to their family that they want a divorce. Kukoo's parents, Bheem and Geeta, a couple that everyone looks up to, have no plans of making Kukoo and Naina's lives easier.

Title: The Oxford Murders
Hint: An American graduate student and a logician professor at an English university work to solve a series of killings.
Description: At ___ University, a professor and a grad student work together to try and stop a potential series of murders seemingly linked by mathematical symbols.

Title: The Invisible
Hint: A teenager left in limbo after an attack tries to help his friends find his body.
Description: After an attack leaves him in limbo -- ___ to the living and also near death -- a teenager discovers the only person who might be able help him is his attacker.

Title: Guest House Paradiso
Hint: Two incompetent men run the worst hotel in the UK, next to a nuclear power plant.
Description: Richie and Eddie are in charge of the worst hotel in the UK, ___, neighbouring a nuclear power plant. The illegal immigrant chef has fled and all the guests have gone. But when a famous Italian filmstar, Gina Carbonara, who is in hiding from a fiance she doesn't want to marry, arrives at the hotel, things get very interesting!

Title: Willard
Hint: A social misfit uses his pet rats to take revenge on his cruel boss.
Description: A social misfit, ___ is made fun of by his co-workers, and squeezed out of the company started by his deceased father by his boss. His only friends are a couple of rats he raised at home, Ben and Socrates. However, when one of them is killed at work, he goes on a rampage using his rats to attack those who have been tormenting him.

Title: Raising Cain
Hint: A child psychologist with multiple personalities kidnaps children for an experiment.
Description: Child psychologist Carter Nix is a loving and caring family man, but under this appearance lies a dark and troubled past. Grappling with the consequences of this past on his own psyche and the influence of his returning father and violent brother ___, Carter becomes involved in a series of murders and kidnappings.

Title: Antitrust
Hint: A computer programmer at a hot Portland firm discovers his boss is stealing ideas.
Description: A computer programmer's dream job at a hot Portland-based firm turns nightmarish when he discovers his boss has a secret and ruthless means of dispatching anti-trust problems.

Title: Dragonfly
Hint: A grieving doctor believes his late wife is trying to contact him through his patients.
Description: A grieving doctor is being contacted by his late wife through his patient's near death experiences.

Title: Good Kids
Hint: Four high school nerds look to reinvent themselves during one wild summer after graduation.
Description: Four high school students look to redefine themselves after graduation.

Title: In the Electric Mist
Hint: A Louisiana detective tracks a serial killer while being visited by the ghost of a Confederate general.
Description: Lt. Dave Robicheaux, a detective in New Iberia, Louisiana, is trying to link the murder of a local hooker to New Orleans mobster Julie (Baby Feet) Balboni, who is co-producer of a Civil War film.

Title: 15 Minutes
Hint: Two Eastern European criminals film their murders and sell the footage to tabloid TV.
Description: When Eastern European criminals Oleg and Emil come to New York City to pick up their share of a heist score, Oleg steals a video camera and starts filming their activities, both legal and illegal.

Title: Duplicity
Hint: Two romantically involved spies team up to manipulate a corporate battle.
Description: Two romantically involved government operatives Claire Stenwick and Ray Koval team up to manipulate a race between opposing corporations to corner the market on a medical innovation that will reap huge profits and allow them to lead an extravagant lifestyle together.

Title: Wilderness
Hint: Juvenile delinquents sent to a remote British island are hunted by a killer.
Description: Juvenile delinquents are sent to a small British island after a fellow prisoner's death, where they must fight for survival.

Title: Otherhood
Hint: Three mothers feeling forgotten drive to New York to reconnect with their grown sons.
Description: Feeling forgotten on Mother's Day, three best friends leave the suburbs and drive to New York City to surprise their adult sons.

Title: In Hell
Hint: A man must survive a Russian prison where inmates fight to the death for the warden's amusement.
Description: A man must survive a prison where hardened criminals battle to the death for the warden's entertainment.

Title: Seeking Justice
Hint: After his wife is assaulted, a teacher enlists a vigilante group that demands a favour in return.
Description: After his wife is assaulted, a husband enlists the services of a vigilante group to help him settle the score.

Title: Tomorrow, When the War Began
Hint: A group of Australian teens return from a camping trip to find their country invaded.
Description: Ellie Linton, a teen from an Australian coastal town, leads her friends on an excursion to a camp deep in the woods, dubbed "Hell." Upon their return, the youths find that their town has been overrun by an enemy army, and their friends and family have been imprisoned.

Title: Gringo
Hint: An American businessman finds himself in Mexico on the run from cartels and his bosses.
Description: An American businessman with a stake in a pharmaceutical company that's about to go public finds his life is thrown into turmoil by an incident in Mexico.

Title: Gentlemen Broncos
Hint: A teenager discovers his fantasy story idea has been stolen by his idol.
Description: A teenager attends a fantasy writers' convention where he discovers his idea has been stolen by an established novelist.

Title: Johnny Handsome
Hint: A disfigured career criminal is given a new face and tries to go straight.
Description: A career criminal who has been deformed since birth is given a new face by a kindly doctor and paroled from prison. It appears that he has gone straight, but he is really planning his revenge on the man who killed his mentor and sent him to prison.

Title: Desperate Measures
Hint: A cop searches for a bone marrow donor for his son, and the only match is a psychopath.
Description: San Francisco police officer Frank Connor is in a frantic search for a compatible bone marrow donor for his gravely ill son. There's only one catch the potential donor is convicted multiple murderer Peter McCabe who sees a trip to the hospital as the perfect opportunity to get what he wants most: freedom.

Title: Conquest of the Planet of the Apes
Hint: Enslaved primates in a future dystopia rise up in revolt, led by a rare talking chimpanzee.
Description: In a futuristic world that has embraced ape slavery, a chimpanzee named Caesar resurfaces after almost twenty years of hiding from the authorities, and prepares for a revolt against humanity.

Title: Doctor Dolittle
Hint: A San Francisco physician discovers he can talk to animals and is soon overwhelmed by patients with paws and claws.
Description: A successful physician and devoted family man, John ___ seems to have the world by the tail, until a long suppressed talent he possessed as a child, the ability to communicate with animals is suddenly reawakened with a vengeance! Now every creature within squawking distance wants the good doctor's advice, unleashing an outrageous chain of events that turns his world upside down!

Title: Fletch Lives
Hint: A reporter goes to Louisiana to claim an inheritance and gets mixed up in a murder.
Description: ___ is a fish out of water in small-town Louisiana, where he's checking out a tumbledown mansion he's inherited. When a woman he flirts with turns up dead, he becomes a suspect and must find the killer and clear his name.

Title: Someone to Watch Over Me
Hint: A working-class New York detective assigned to protect a wealthy murder witness falls for her.
Description: Claire Gregory, an upper class New York personality, witnesses a murder in a luxurious nightclub. Detective Mike Keegan, recently promoted, is assigned to protect her.

Title: Cleaner
Hint: A former cop who cleans up crime scenes realises he's been tricked into covering up a murder.
Description: Single father and former cop Tom Cutler has an unusual occupation: he cleans up death scenes. But when he's called in to sterilize a wealthy suburban residence after a brutal shooting, Cutler is shocked to learn he may have unknowingly erased crucial evidence, entangling himself in a dirty criminal cover-up.

Title: American Pastoral
Country: Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: In postwar America, a man watches his seemingly perfect life fall apart when his daughter becomes a radical.
Description: Set in postwar America, a man watches his seemingly perfect life fall apart as his daughter's new political affiliation threatens to destroy their family.

Title: The Invisible Woman
Hint: In 1857, a famous Victorian novelist has a secret affair with a young actress.
Description: In 1857, at the height of his fame and fortune, novelist and social critic Charles Dickens meets and falls in love with teenage stage actress Nelly Ternan. As she becomes the focus of his heart and mind, as well as his muse, painful secrecy is the price both must pay.

Title: Edtv
Hint: A video store clerk agrees to have his life filmed 24/7 for a TV show.
Description: Video store clerk Ed agrees to have his life filmed by a camera crew for a tv network.

Title: What's New Pussycat
Hint: A Parisian fashion editor and womaniser seeks help from a lunatic psychiatrist to stay faithful to his fiancée.
Description: A playboy who refuses to give up his hedonistic lifestyle to settle down and marry his true love seeks help from a demented psychoanalyst who is having romantic problems of his own.

Title: Friends with Kids
Hint: Two longtime platonic best pals decide to have a baby together while dating other people.
Description: In the wake of their friends' marriages and eventual offspring, longtime pals Julie and Jason decide to have a child together without becoming a couple. By becoming "time-share" parents, they reason, they can experience the joys of parenthood without significantly curbing their personal freedom.

Title: Love and Other Disasters
Hint: A flighty London fashion assistant tries to set up her gay friend while ignoring her own love life.
Description: Flighty Emily "Jacks" Jackson works for the British edition of Vogue magazine. Rather than pursue a relationship, Jacks regularly hooks up with her devoted ex-boyfriend, James Wildstone, and lives with Peter Simon, a gay screenwriter.

Title: Early Man
Hint: A plucky caveman and his pet boar unite their Stone Age tribe to beat Bronze Age invaders at football.
Description: Dug, along with his sidekick Hognob, unite a cavemen tribe to save their hidden valley from being spoiled and, all together as a team, to face the menace of a mysterious and mighty enemy, on the turf of an ancient and sacred sport.

Title: The Sweeney
Hint: A rule-breaking London Flying Squad detective chases a gang of armed robbers through the city.
Description: Jack Regan, a hardened cop who doesn’t play by the rules, is confronted with a criminal from his past. With sidekick George Carter they are put on the case of a jewellery store heist that ends in a killing. But is that killing really an execution in disguise? With pressure from his boss and the fact that Regan is having an affair with that boss’s wife, it’s not going to be easy for him to stay out of trouble.

Title: Employee of the Month
Hint: Two big-box store slackers compete for the top worker award to win over the hot new cashier.
Description: When he hears that the new female ___ digs ambitious men who are the store ___, a slacker gets his act together but finds himself in competition with his rival, an ambitious co-worker.

Title: The Brave
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A down-on-his-luck Native American man agrees to appear in a snuff film for money.
Description: A down-on-his-luck American Indian recently released from jail is offered the chance to "star" as the victim of a snuff film, the resulting pay of which could greatly help his poverty stricken family.

Title: Rugrats in Paris: The Movie
Hint: A group of rambunctious babies travel to France and get loose in a theme park.
Description: A group of rambunctious toddlers travel a trip to Paris. As they journey from the Eiffel Tower to Notre Dame, they learn new lessons about trust, loyalty and love.

Title: Chéri
Hint: In Belle Époque Paris, an aging courtesan has a love affair with a much younger man.
Description: The son of a courtesan retreats into a fantasy world after being forced to end his relationship with the older woman who educated him in the ways of love.

Hint: A scientist and his android rebuild a robot to battle a vengeful bird-like spirit attacking cell phones in Chennai.
Description: An ornithologist who commits suicide returns as a fifth force to wreak vengeance on mankind for harming birds with mobile phone radiation. The only thing standing in his way is ___, the upgraded version of Chitti, the robot.

Title: Godmothered
Hint: An inexperienced fairy godmother tries to prove fairy tales still matter by helping a widowed mom in Boston.
Description: A young and unskilled fairy godmother that ventures out on her own to prove her worth by tracking down a young girl whose request for help was ignored. What she discovers is that the girl has now become a grown woman in need of something very different than a "prince charming."

Title: Knockaround Guys
Hint: Four sons of New York mobsters try to retrieve a bag of cash lost in a small Montana town.
Description: Four sons of well-known New York mobsters must retrieve a bag of cash from a small Montana town ruled by a corrupt sheriff.

Title: Bunraku
Hint: A drifter, a bartender and a samurai seek revenge on a ruthless lumber baron in a world with no guns.
Description: In a world with no guns, a mysterious drifter, a bartender and a young samurai plot revenge against a ruthless leader and his army of thugs, headed by nine diverse and deadly assassins.

Title: Addicted to Love
Hint: A jilted astronomer and a woman whose boyfriend left her spy on their exes in a New York apartment.
Description: Good-natured astronomer Sam is devastated when the love of his life leaves him for a suave Frenchman. He therefore does what every other normal dumpee would do — go to New York and set up home in the abandoned building opposite his ex-girlfriend's apartment, wait until she decides to leave her current lover, and then win her back.

Title: Calvaire
Hint: A travelling entertainer's van breaks down and he's taken prisoner by a deranged innkeeper.
Description: A few days before Christmas, traveling entertainer Marc Stevens is stuck at nightfall in a remote wood in the swampy Hautes Fagnes region of Liège when his van breaks down. An odd chap who's looking for a lost dog then leads Marc to a shuttered inn.

Title: The Lovebirds
Hint: A couple on the verge of breaking up are framed for murder and must clear their names in one night.
Description: A couple experiences a defining moment in their relationship when they are unintentionally embroiled in a murder mystery. As their journey to clear their names takes them from one extreme – and hilarious - circumstance to the next, they must figure out how they, and their relationship, can survive the night.

Title: Like Father
Hint: A workaholic left at the altar goes on her honeymoon cruise with the dad who abandoned her as a child.
Description: When a workaholic young executive is left at the altar, she ends up on her Caribbean honeymoon cruise with the last person she ever expected: her estranged and equally workaholic father. The two depart as strangers, but over the course of a few hilarious adventures, a couple of umbrella-clad cocktails and a whole lot of soul-searching, they return with a renewed appreciation for family and life.

Title: Pokémon the Movie 2000
Genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Animation, Science Fiction, Family
Hint: A collector captures legendary bird monsters, throwing the world's weather into chaos.
Description: When Lawrence III's scheme to capture the Legendary ___ Lugia upsets the balance of nature, it is up to Ash Ketchum and his friends to save the world.

Country: Austria, Brazil, France, United Kingdom, Canada, United States of America
Hint: A series of interconnected stories of love and infidelity unfolds across cities in Europe and America.
Description: A disparate group of characters unknowingly bond by the sexual choices they make. Consumed by loneliness, a British businessman ponders a rendezvous with a prostitute. The businessman's wife prepares to call it quits with her younger lover. A Brazilian student breaks up with her boyfriend in London. A recovering alcoholic travels to Phoenix in search of his missing daughter.

Title: The Newton Boys
Hint: The story of four brothers from Texas who became the most successful bank robbers in American history.
Description: The story of the ___ gang, the most successful bank robbers in history, owing to their good planning and minimal violence.

Title: The Cottage
Hint: Two bungling brothers kidnap a gangster's stepdaughter and hide out in a remote farmhouse with a killer.
Description: In a remote part of the countryside, a bungled kidnapping turns into a living nightmare for four central characters when they cross paths with a psychopathic farmer and all hell breaks loose.

Title: Our Brand Is Crisis
Hint: A veteran American political consultant is hired to help re-elect a controversial president in Bolivia.
Description: A battle-hardened American political consultant is sent to help re-elect a controversial president in Bolivia, where she must compete with a long-term rival working for another candidate.

Title: The Overnight
Hint: A couple new to Los Angeles are invited to a playdate that turns into a sexually charged evening.
Description: Alex, Emily, and their son, RJ, are new to Los Angeles. A chance meeting at the park introduces them to the mysterious Kurt, Charlotte, and Max. A family “playdate” becomes increasingly interesting as the night goes on.

Title: Burke and Hare
Hint: Two 19th-century Edinburgh opportunists become serial killers to supply bodies for an anatomy school.
Description: Two 19th-century opportunists become serial killers so that they can maintain their profitable business supplying cadavers to an anatomist.

Title: Murder at 1600
Hint: A secretary is found dead in the White House, and a DC homicide detective uncovers a conspiracy.
Description: A secretary is found dead in a White House bathroom during an international crisis, and Detective Harlan Regis is in charge of the investigation. Despite resistance from the Secret Service, Regis partners with agent Nina Chance. As political tensions rise, they learn that the crime could be part of an elaborate cover-up.

Title: Ninja: Shadow of a Tear
Hint: A martial artist hunts down the killers of his pregnant wife in Thailand and Myanmar.
Description: Fight everyone and trust no one: it's the code of survival practiced by martial-arts master Casey Bowman after his life of domestic bliss is shattered by a savage act of violence. Vowing revenge, the fearless American stealthily tracks the killer from Osaka to Bangkok to Rangoon with the help of a wise and crafty sensei.

Title: The Princess Switch
Hint: A Chicago baker swaps places with a lookalike duchess just before Christmas.
Description: When a down-to-earth Chicago baker and a soon-to-be princess discover they look like twins, they hatch a Christmastime plan to trade places.

Title: Miami Bici
Hint: Two Romanian pals arrive in South Florida trying to get rich quick and get mixed up with the city's underworld.
Description: ___ is the story of Ion and Ilie, two young people from a small dark city in Romania who go to ___ in the middle of winter, to live both the "American Dream" and the Romanian dream of "getting rich quick". Once there, they find themselves in the middle of the Machiavellian plan of Mișu, a Romanian of the lowest species, established in Florida.

Title: Black Butterfly
Country: United States of America, Italy, Spain
Hint: A struggling screenwriter takes in a drifter who begins to help him write, with sinister consequences.
Description: Paul is a down-on-his-luck screenwriter who picks up a drifter and offers him a place to stay. However, when the deranged stranger takes Paul hostage and forces him to write, their unhinged relationship brings buried secrets to light.

Title: Leap of Faith
Hint: A fraudulent preacher's travelling revival show breaks down in a drought-stricken Kansas town.
Description: Jonas Nightengale is a fraudulent Christian ___ healer who makes a living travelling around America holding revival meetings and conducting 'miracles' with the help of his friend and manager, Jane, and their entourage.

Title: Up Close & Personal
Hint: An ambitious young woman pursues her dream of being a network newscaster with the help of a veteran journalist.
Description: Tally Atwater has a dream: to be a prime-time network newscaster. She pursues this dream with nothing but ambition, raw talent and a homemade demo tape. Warren Justice is a brilliant, hard edged, veteran newsman. He sees Tally has talent and becomes her mentor. Tally’s career takes a meteoric rise and she and Warren fall in love. The romance that results is as intense and revealing as television news itself.

Title: My Name Is Bruce
Hint: A B-movie actor is mistaken for his character and asked to fight a real demon.
Description: B-movie Legend ___ Campbell is mistaken for his character Ash from the Evil Dead trilogy and forced to fight a real monster in a small town in Oregon.

Title: Desierto
Country: Mexico, France, United States of America
Hint: A group of Mexican migrants crossing into the US are hunted by a rifle-toting vigilante and his dog.
Description: A group of Mexican emigrants attempts to cross the Mexican-US border. What begins as a hopeful journey becomes a harrowing, bloody and primal fight for survival when a deranged, rifle-toting vigilante and his loyal Belgian Malinois dog chase the group of unarmed men and women through the treacherous borderland.

Title: According to Greta
Hint: A teenage girl dumped on her grandparents for the summer rebels against everyone.
Description: Dumped on her grandparents for the summer by her indifferent mother, acerbic and self-destructive teenager ___ disrupts the elderly couple's staid life on the Jersey Shore. Eventually, a romance helps ___ face down her demons.

Title: Impostor
Hint: A weapons designer is accused of being an alien replicant carrying a bomb.
Description: A top-secret government weapons designer is arrested by a clandestine government organization on suspicion of being a clone created by the hostile alien race wanting to take over Earth.

Title: Badrinath Ki Dulhania
Hint: A conventional small-town man falls for an independent woman who wants to be an air hostess.
Description: ___ is a story of ___ Bansal from Jhansi and Vaidehi Trivedi from Kota and what happens when the two of them meet. Even though they both belong to small towns, their mindset about gender roles in society and about life in general are diametrically opposite. This leads to a clash of ideologies, despite both of them recognising the goodness in each other.

Title: The Man Who Cried
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young refugee travels from Russia to America in search of her father, via Paris.
Description: A young refugee travels from Russia to America in search of her lost father and falls in love with a gypsy horseman.

Title: God's Pocket
Hint: A boozy lowlife tries to bury the truth about his stepson's death in a working-class Philadelphia neighbourhood.
Description: A boozy lowlife tries to bury the truth about his crazy stepson's suspicious death, but a nosy newspaper columnist and the young man's mother complicate matters.

Title: Welcome to the Punch
Country: Canada, India, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A London detective is forced to work with the criminal who shot him.
Description: When notorious criminal Jacob Sternwood is forced to return to London, it gives detective Max Lewinsky one last chance to take down the man he's always been after.

Title: Dom Hemingway
Hint: A boisterous safecracker released from prison after 12 years goes to collect what he's owed.
Description: After spending 12 years in prison for keeping his mouth shut, notorious safe-cracker ___ is back on the streets of London looking to collect what he's owed.

Title: Miracle at St. Anna
Hint: Four Black American soldiers are trapped behind enemy lines in a Tuscan village during WWII.
Description: ___ chronicles the story of four American soldiers who are members of the all-black 92nd "Buffalo Soldier" Division stationed in Tuscany, Italy during World War II.

Title: Bronco Billy
Hint: An idealistic modern-day cowboy struggles to keep his Wild West travelling show afloat.
Description: An idealistic, modern-day cowboy struggles to keep his Wild West show afloat in the face of hard luck and waning interest.

Title: Youth Without Youth
Country: United States of America, Romania, France, Italy, Germany, Bulgaria
Hint: A professor is struck by lightning and grows younger, with new powers.
Description: Professor of language and philosophy Dominic Matei is struck by lightning and ages backwards from 70 to 40 in a week, attracting the world and the Nazis. While on the run, the professor meets a young woman who has her own experience with a lightning storm. Not only does Dominic find love again, but her new abilities hold the key to his research.

Title: Assassination Games
Country: United States of America, Hong Kong, Romania
Hint: Two hitmen join forces against a Romanian crime boss and his crooked Interpol allies.
Description: Brazil is a contract killer, willing to take any job if the price is right. Flint left the assassin game when a ruthless drug dealer’s brutal attack left his wife in a coma. When a contract is put out on the same coldblooded drug dealer, both Brazil and Flint want him dead – one for the money, the other for revenge.

Title: The Ones Below
Hint: A young pregnant couple befriend the new couple downstairs, until a tragic accident turns them into enemies.
Description: A young affluent couple expecting their first child hits it off with the new couple that moves in downstairs, until a dinner party between them ends in a shocking accident.

Title: The Corruptor
Hint: A rookie New York cop is partnered with a corrupt veteran in Chinatown.
Description: Danny is a young cop partnered with Nick, a seasoned but ethically tainted veteran. As the two try to stop a gang war in Chinatown, Danny relies on Nick but grows increasingly uncomfortable with the way Nick gets things done.

Title: Code 46
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: The Blind Man has been hiding out for several years in an isolated cabin and has taken in and raised a young girl orphaned from a devastating house fire. Title: Censor

Description: A screener at the British Board of Film Classification (BBFC), who has earned an unsavory reputation for being the strictest ___ of violent films, begins to spiral out of control after viewing a low-budget horror with similarities to the disappearance of her sister.

Title: Sahara
Country: Germany, Morocco, Spain, United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: Seasoned adventurer and treasure hunter Dirk Pitt, a former Navy SEAL, sets out for the African desert with his wisecracking buddy Al in search of a confederate ironclad battleship rumored to have vanished long ago, the main draw being the treasure supposedly hidden within the lost vessel. Title: Kama Sutra: A Tale of Love

Description: Tara and Maya are inseparable, with the same tastes, habits, and hobbies. Years later, the two have matured but have maintained their friendship. Tara marries local prince Raj Singh, who succeeds the throne as the sole heir. After the marriage, Raj seeks another female to satisfy his sexual desires, with his sights settling on Maya, putting a perhaps unforgivable strain on a longtime friendship.

Title: The Signal

Description: On a road trip, Nic and two friends are drawn to an isolated area by a computer genius. When everything suddenly goes dark, Nic regains consciousness – only to find himself in a waking nightmare.

Title: The Handmaid's Tale

Description: In a dystopian, polluted right-wing religious tyranny, a young woman is put in sexual slavery on account of her now rare fertility.

Title: Relic

Description: When elderly mother Edna inexplicably vanishes, her daughter rushes to the family's decaying home, finding clues of her increasing dementia scattered around the house in her absence.

Title: G.I. Jane
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: In response to political pressure from Senator Lillian DeHaven, the U.S. Navy begins a program that would allow for the eventual integration of women into its combat services. The program begins with a single trial candidate, Lieutenant Jordan O'Neil, who is chosen specifically for her femininity.

Title: Pieces

Description: A frustrated Boston detective searches for the maniac responsible for mutilating a number of university coeds.

Title: The Room

Description: Johnny is a successful banker with great respect for and dedication to the people in his life, especially his future wife Lisa. The happy-go-lucky guy sees his world being torn apart when his friends begin to betray him one-by-one.

Title: Honest Thief
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: A bank robber tries to turn himself in because he's falling in love and wants to live an ___ life...but when he realizes the Feds are more corrupt than him, he must fight back to clear his name.

Title: The Shadow

Description: Based on the 1930s comic strip, The ___ is put up against his archenemy Shiwan Khan, who plans to take over the world by holding a city to ransom using an atom bomb. Using his powers of invisibility and "the power to cloud men's minds", The ___ comes blazing to the rescue with explosive results.

Title: Project Power
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Canada, France

Description: An ex-soldier, a teen and a cop collide in New Orleans as they hunt for the source behind a dangerous new pill that grants users temporary superpowers.

Title: The Net

Description: Angela Bennett is a freelance computer systems analyst who tracks down software viruses. At night she hooks up to the internet and chats to others 'surfing the ___'. While de-bugging a new high-tech game for a cyber friend, she comes across a top secret program and becomes the target of a mysterious organization who will stop at nothing to erase her identity and her existence, in order to protect the project.

Title: The Gambler
Hint: A New York English professor's secret gambling addiction gets him in deep debt to the mob.
Description: New York City English professor Axel Freed outwardly seems like an upstanding citizen. But privately Freed is in the clutches of a severe gambling addiction that threatens to destroy him.

Title: The Gate
Hint: Three children accidentally release a horde of tiny demons from a hole in their backyard.
Description: Three young children accidentally release a horde of nasty, pint-sized demons from a hole in a suburban backyard. What follows is a classic battle between good and evil as the three kids struggle to overcome a nightmarish hell that is literally taking over the Earth.

Title: Along Came Polly
Hint: A risk-averse insurance agent falls for a free-spirited former classmate after his honeymoon disaster.
Description: Reuben Feffer is a guy who's spent his entire life playing it safe. ___ Prince is irresistible as a free-spirit who lives for the thrill of the moment. When these two comically mismatched souls collide, Reuben's world is turned upside down, as he makes an uproarious attempt to change his life from middle-of-the-road to totally-out-there.

Title: Jexi
Country: Canada, United States of America, South Korea
Hint: A man's smartphone comes with an AI that becomes obsessed with him.
Description: Phil's new phone comes with an unexpected feature, ___...an A.I. determined to keep him all to herself in a comedy about what can happen when you love your phone more than all else.

Title: Walk of Shame

Description: A reporter's dream of becoming a news anchor is compromised after a one-night stand leaves her stranded in downtown L.A. without a phone, car, ID or money - and only 8 hours to make it to the most important job interview of her life.

Title: My Son
Country: Germany, France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A father searches for his missing boy in the Scottish Highlands, in a largely improvised thriller.
Description: When a man's only son goes missing, he travels to the town where his ex-wife lives in search of answers. [To play a man whose life is clouded by mystery, McAvoy will not be given a script of dialogue.]

Title: Creepshow 2
Hint: Three macabre tales from a boy's horror comic book, including a raft on a lake with a hungry slick.
Description: Three macabre tales from the latest issue of a boy's favorite comic book, dealing with a vengeful wooden Native American, a monstrous blob in a lake, and an undying hitchhiker.

Title: All the Right Moves

Description: Sensitive study of a headstrong high school football star who dreams of getting out of his small Western Pennsylvania steel town with a football scholarship. His equally ambitious coach aims at a college position, resulting in a clash which could crush the player's dreams.

Title: The Purge: Election Year
Country: France, Japan, United States of America
Hint: A senator running for president is targeted on the annual night of legal crime.
Description: Two years after choosing not to kill the man who killed his son, former police sergeant Leo Barnes has become head of security for Senator Charlene Roan, the front runner in the next Presidential ___ due to her vow to eliminate the ___. On the night of what should be the final ___, a betrayal from within the government forces Barnes and Roan out onto the street where they must fight to survive the night.

Title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
Hint: Six young ninjas defend their island city from a warlord, who happens to be one boy's father.
Description: Six young ninjas are tasked with defending their island home of ___. By night, they’re gifted warriors using their skill and awesome fleet of vehicles to fight villains and monsters. By day, they’re ordinary teens struggling against their greatest enemy....high school.

Title: Nights in Rodanthe
Hint: A woman spends a weekend at an inn on the North Carolina coast and falls for a doctor.
Description: Adrienne is trying to decide whether to stay in her unhappy marriage or not, and her life changes when Paul, a doctor who is travelling to reconcile with his estranged son, checks into an inn where she is staying.

Title: The Rite
