Description: Seminary student Michael Kovak reluctantly attends exorcism school at the Vatican. While he’s in Rome, Michael meets an unorthodox priest who introduces him to the darker side of his faith, uncovering the devil’s reach even to one of the holiest places on Earth.

Title: Free Willy
Hint: A troubled boy befriends a captive orca and helps him escape.
Description: When maladjusted orphan Jesse vandalizes a theme park, he is placed with foster parents and must work at the park to make amends. There he meets ___, a young Orca whale who has been separated from his family. Sensing kinship, they form a bond and, with the help of kindly whale trainer Rae Lindley, develop a routine of tricks.

Title: CHIPS
Hint: Two California motorcycle highway patrol officers, one an undercover FBI agent, investigate a heist involving corrupt cops.
Description: The adventures of two California Highway Patrol motorcycle officers as they make their rounds on the freeways of Los Angeles.

Title: Class

Description: Naive Midwestern prep student Jonathan bonds with his more worldly roommate, Skip, who takes the small-town boy under his wing. At Skip's urging, the inexperienced Jonathan is emboldened to seek out older women in the cocktail lounges of nearby Chicago, where he meets and beds the alluring Ellen, who unfortunately turns out to be Skip's mother.

Title: First Knight

Description: The timeless tale of King Arthur and the legend of Camelot are retold in this passionate period drama. Arthur is reluctant to hand the crown to Lancelot, and Guinevere is torn between her loyalty to her husband and her growing love for his rival. But Lancelot must balance his loyalty to the throne with the rewards of true love.

Title: She's the One
Hint: Two working-class brothers in New York deal with their love lives and their father.
Description: Mickey, a free-spirited New York cabbie, and Francis, a materialistic Wall Street stockbroker, are extremely competitive and confused about women as a result of their father's influence. They disagree on everything, but they have one thing in common: Mickey's ex-fiance Heather is Francis's secret love. Although both brothers are already married, Heather triggers their longtime sibling rivalry.

Title: Brainscan
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: A lonely teenage horror-movie fan discovers a mysterious computer game that uses hypnosis to custom-tailor the game into the most terrifying experience imaginable. When he emerges from the hypnotic trance he is horrified to find evidence that the brutal murder depicted in the game actually happened -- and he's the killer.

Title: Horse Girl
Hint: A socially awkward woman with a love of equestrian arts and crafts believes she is being abducted by aliens.
Description: A socially awkward woman with a fondness for arts and crafts, horses, and supernatural crime shows finds her increasingly lucid dreams trickling into her waking life.

Title: V/H/S/2
Country: United States of America, Canada, Indonesia
Hint: A team of investigators searching for a missing student find more found-footage horror tapes.
Description: Inside a darkened house looms a column of TVs littered with VHS tapes, a pagan shrine to forgotten analog gods. The screens crackle and pop endlessly with monochrome vistas of static white noise permeating the brain and fogging concentration. But you must fight the urge to relax: this is no mere movie night. Those obsolete spools contain more than just magnetic tape. They are imprinted with the very soul of evil.

Title: The Hunted
Hint: In the wilderness of British Columbia, a retired tracker hunts the deadly special forces soldier he once trained, who has gone rogue.
Description: In the wilderness of British Columbia, two hunters are tracked and viciously murdered by Aaron Hallam. A former Special Operations instructor is approached and asked to apprehend Hallam—his former student—who has 'gone rogue' after suffering severe battle stress from his time in Kosovo.

Title: Unfriended: Dark Web
Hint: A man finds hidden files on a stolen laptop and becomes the target of a sinister online group.
Description: ​When a 20-something finds a cache of hidden files on his new laptop, he and his friends are unwittingly thrust into the depths of the ___. They soon discover someone has been watching their every move and will go to unimaginable lengths to protect the ___.

Title: Daddy's Home 2
Hint: Two dads who have finally learned to co-parent must deal with their own fathers at Christmas.
Description: Father and stepfather Dusty and Brad join forces to make Christmastime perfect for the children. Their newfound partnership soon gets put to the test when Dusty's old-school, macho dad and Brad's gentle father arrive to turn the holiday upside down. After a sudden change in plans, the four men decide to take the kids to a luxury resort for a fun-filled getaway that turns into a hilarious and chaotic adventure.

Title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
Hint: An undersea porous fry cook and his friends travel to the surface world to find a stolen recipe.
Description: Evil pirate Burger Beard is in search of the final page of a magical book that makes any evil plan he writes in it come true, but the final page happens to be the Krabby Patty secret formula. When Burger Beard endangers Bikini Bottom, ___, Patrick, Mr.

Description: A pregnant New York social worker begins to develop romantic feelings for her gay best friend, and decides she'd rather raise her child with him, much to the dismay of her overbearing boyfriend.

Title: Bholaa
Hint: An ex-convict on his way to meet his daughter helps police fight drug lords.
Description: An ex-convict must undertake a perilous, violent journey in order to meet his daughter after ten years of imprisonment.

Title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason

Description: ___ is still dating her new love, barrister Mark Darcy, for a perfect six weeks. However, while on assignment in Thailand with her disreputable ex, Daniel Cleaver, claiming to be reformed, ___ questions if she has everything she's ever dreamed of having.

Title: Wrongfully Accused

Description: Ryan Harrison, a violin god, superstar and sex symbol does not want to cheat on sexy Lauren Goodhue's husband with her. Mr. Goodhue is found murdered and Ryan suddenly finds himself being the main suspect. After being sentenced to death he manages to flee while being transferred to his execution site.

Title: Super Troopers 2
Hint: A group of Vermont highway cops are sent to a disputed Canadian border town after it becomes part of the US.
Description: When an international border dispute arises between the U.S. and Canada, the Super ___- Mac, Thorny, Foster, Rabbit and Farva, are called in to set up a new Highway Patrol station in the disputed area.

Title: Valhalla Rising
Hint: A mute warrior of supernatural strength escapes captivity and joins a crusade in Scandinavia, 1000 AD.
Description: Scandinavia, 1,000 AD. For years, One Eye, a mute warrior of supernatural strength, has been held prisoner by the Norse chieftain Barde. Aided by Are, a boy slave, One Eye slays his captor and together he and Are escape, beginning a journey into the heart of darkness.

Title: Assassination Nation
Hint: Four high school girls are targeted by their town after a massive data leak of secrets.
Description: After an anonymous hacker begins leaking the private data of thousands living in a small American town, the townspeople spiral into madness, with four high school seniors at the center of the maelstrom.

Title: Smurfs: The Lost Village

Hint: Small blue creatures search for a hidden settlement in the forbidden forest.
Description: In this fully animated, all-new take on the ___, a mysterious map sets Smurfette and her friends Brainy, Clumsy and Hefty on an exciting race through the Forbidden Forest leading to the discovery of the biggest secret in Smurf history.

Hint: Four African-American women in Phoenix lean on each other through their relationship troubles.
Description: Cheated on, mistreated and stepped on, the women are holding their breath, ___ for the elusive "good man" to break a string of less-than-stellar lovers. Friends and confidants Vannah, Bernie, Glo and Robin talk it all out, determined to find a better way to breathe.

Title: Hope Floats
Hint: A woman humiliated on live TV returns to her small Texas hometown with her daughter.
Description: Birdee Pruitt has been humiliated on live television by her best friend, Connie, who's been sleeping with Birdee's husband, Bill. Birdee tries starting over with her daughter, Bernice, by returning to her small Texas hometown, but she's faced with petty old acquaintances who are thrilled to see Birdee unhappy -- except for her friend Justin. As he helps Birdee get back on her feet, love begins to blossom.

Title: War Machine
Hint: A gung-ho four-star general is sent to win the unwinnable conflict in Afghanistan, in a biting satire.
Description: A rock star general bent on winning the “impossible” war in Afghanistan takes us inside the complex machinery of modern war. Inspired by the true story of General Stanley McChrystal.

Title: Happy Birthday to Me
Hint: Members of an elite clique at a private school are murdered one by one as a troubled girl's 18th approaches.
Description: Virginia is proud that she belongs to a clique. The best students at a private school. But before her 18th birthday, a gruesome set of murders take place and her friends are the ones who are falling prey. Could it be her? She suffers from blackouts due to a freak accident one year earlier. We soon learn the truth behind her accident and what is going on.

Title: Automata
Hint: An insurance investigator discovers that robots are secretly modifying themselves in a dying future world.
Description: Jacq Vaucan, an insurance agent of ROC robotics corporation, routinely investigates the case of manipulating a robot. What he discovers will have profound consequences for the future of humanity.

Title: We're Back! A Dinosaur's Story
Hint: A time-travelling alien feeds prehistoric reptiles a cereal that makes them smart and brings them to modern New York.
Description: Captain New Eyes travels back in time and feeds dinosaurs his Brain Grain cereal, which makes them intelligent and non-violent. They agree to go to the "Middle Future" in order to grant the wishes of children in New York City. They are to meet Dr. Bleeb of the Museum of Natural History, but get sidetracked with their new children friends and run into the Captain's evil brother, Professor Screweyes.

Title: True History of the Kelly Gang
Hint: A young Australian bushranger rises from poverty to lead a notorious band of outlaws against English rule.
Description: Set against the badlands of Australia where the English rule with a bloody fist and the Irish endure, Ned ___ discovers he comes from a line of Irish rebels — an uncompromising army of cross dressing bandits immortalised for terrorising their oppressors back in Ireland.

Title: Beneath the Planet of the Apes
Hint: An astronaut searches for his missing colleague in a future world ruled by primates and telepathic mutants.
Description: The sole survivor of an interplanetary rescue mission lands on the planet of the ___, and uncovers a horrible secret ___ the surface.

Description: A young man who arrives at a remote island finds himself trapped in a battle for his life.

Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America

Title: Lockout

Description: Set in the near future, ___ follows a falsely convicted ex-government agent , whose one chance at obtaining freedom lies in the dangerous mission of rescuing the President's daughter from rioting convicts at an outer space maximum security prison.

Title: On the Road
Country: Brazil, France, United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: Sal Paradise is a young writer whose life is shaken and ultimately redefined by the arrival of Dean Moriarty, a free-spirited, fearless, fast talking Westerner and his girl, Marylou. Traveling cross-country, Sal and Dean venture out on a personal quest for freedom from the conformity and conservatism engulfing them in search of the unknown, themselves, and the pursuit of “it” -- the pure essence of experience.

Title: Soldier
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A veteran fighter is replaced by genetically engineered troops and dumped on a waste planet.
Description: Sergeant Todd is a veteran ___ for an elite group of the armed forces. After being defeated by a new breed of genetically engineered soldiers, he is dumped on a waste planet and left for dead. He soon interacts with a group of crash survivors who lead out a peaceful existence. The peace is broken as the new soldiers land on the planet to eliminate the colony, which Sergeant Todd must defend.

Title: Come True
Hint: A runaway teen with recurring nightmares joins a university sleep study that is far more sinister.
Description: Looking for an escape from her recurring nightmares, 18-year-old Sarah submits to a university sleep study, but soon realizes she's become the conduit to a frightening new discovery.

Title: The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas
Hint: A Lone Star sheriff tries to save a beloved brothel from a moralistic TV crusader, in a country musical.
Description: When a Conservative TV crusader threatens to shut down beloved brothel The Chicken Ranch, proprietress Miss Mona Stangley and her girls won't go down without a fight.

Title: Destination Wedding

Description: Frank and Lindsay—two emotionally-broken strangers—meet on the way to a ___. Over the course of the weekend and against all odds, they find themselves drawn together even though they are initially repulsed by one another.

Title: The Woman
Hint: A lawyer captures a feral woman in the woods and tries to civilise her, with brutal consequences.
Description: A lawyer puts his family in jeopardy when he captures the last member of a violent clan and tries to forcibly tame her.

Title: Dream House

Description: Publisher Will Atenton quits a lucrative job in New York to relocate his wife, Libby, and their daughters to a quaint town in New England. However, as they settle into their home the Atentons discover that a woman and her children were murdered there, and the surviving husband is the town's prime suspect.

Title: Z for Zachariah
Country: Iceland, New Zealand, Switzerland, United States of America
Hint: After a nuclear war, a young woman who believes she's the last person alive meets two strangers.
Description: In the wake of a nuclear war, a young woman survives on her own, fearing she may actually be the proverbial last woman on earth, until she discovers the most astonishing sight of her life: another human being. A distraught scientist, he’s nearly been driven mad by radiation exposure and his desperate search for others. A fragile, imperative strand of trust connects them.

Title: Baby Mama
Hint: A single businesswoman who can't conceive hires a loud, working-class surrogate who moves in with her.
Description: A successful, single businesswoman who dreams of having a baby discovers she is infertile and hires a working class woman to be her unlikely surrogate.

Title: The Lazarus Project
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A man who returns to crime wakes up in a psychiatric hospital with no explanation of how he got there.
Description: After Ben Garvey foolishly turned back to crime, he thought his life was over when he was sentenced to death by lethal injection. But his death sentence isn't quite what it seems, as Ben regains consciousness near an eerie psychiatric ward, where he's told he's been hired as the groundskeeper.

Title: The Last Song
Hint: A rebellious teen spends the summer with her estranged dad on a Georgia beach and falls in love.
Description: A drama centered on a rebellious girl who is sent to a Southern beach town for the summer to stay with her father. Through their mutual love of music, the estranged duo learn to reconnect.

Title: Backcountry

Description: A couple on a deep-wilderness hike become hopelessly lost within an aggressive black bear's territory.

Title: Lord of Illusions

Description: During a routine case in L.A., NY private investigator Harry D'Amour stumbles over members of a fanatic cult who are preparing for the resurrection of their leader Nix, a powerful magician who was killed 13 years earlier.

Title: Carriers
Genres: Action, Drama, Horror, Science Fiction, Thriller

Description: A deadly virus has spread across the globe. Contagion is everywhere, no one is safe, and no one can be trusted. Four friends race through the back roads of the American West on their way to a secluded utopian beach in the Gulf of Mexico where they could peacefully wait out the pandemic. Their plans take a grim turn when their car breaks down on an isolated road starting a chain of events that will seal their fates.

Title: I Could Never Be Your Woman

Description: A mother falls for a younger man while her daughter falls in love for the first time.

Title: The Indian in the Cupboard

Description: A nine-year-old boy gets a plastic Indian and a ___ for his birthday and finds himself involved in adventure when the Indian comes to life and befriends him.

Description: When Environmental Protection Agency inspector Steve Malone travels to a remote military base in order to check for toxic materials, he brings his family along for the ride. After arriving at the base, his teenage daughter Marti befriends Jean Platt, daughter of the base's commander, General Platt.

Title: Above the Law
Country: United States of America, Hong Kong
Hint: An ex-CIA agent and aikido master uncovers a conspiracy involving drug dealers and the CIA.
Description: Nico Toscani is an Italian immigrant, American patriot, ex-CIA agent, aikido specialist and unorthodox Chicago policeman. He is as committed to his job as he is to his personalized brand of justice—expert and thorough bone-crushing.

Title: Starry Eyes
Hint: A hopeful young starlet makes a deal with a sinister production company to land a role.
Description: A hopeful young starlet uncovers the ominous origins of the Hollywood elite and enters into a deadly agreement in exchange for fame and fortune.

Title: The Zero Theorem
Country: France, Romania, United Kingdom, United States of America

Description: A computer hacker's goal to discover the reason for human existence continually finds his work interrupted thanks to the Management; this time, they send a teenager and lusty love interest to distract him.

Title: The Peacemaker
Hint: A nuclear scientist and an army officer track stolen nuclear warheads across Europe.
Description: When a train carrying atomic warheads mysteriously crashes in the former Soviet Union, a nuclear specialist discovers the accident is really part of a plot to cover up the theft of the weapons. Assigned to help her recover the missing bombs is a crack Special Forces Colonel.

Title: Jobs

Description: The story of Steve ___' ascension from college dropout into one of the most revered creative entrepreneurs of the 20th century.

Title: Maniac Cop

Description: A killer dressed in a police uniform begins murdering innocent people on the streets of New York City.

Title: A Man Apart

Description: When Vetter's wife is killed in a botched hit organized by Diablo, he seeks revenge against those responsible. But in the process, Vetter and Hicks have to fight their way up the chain to get to Diablo but it's easier said than done when all Vetter can focus on is revenge.

Title: Death Wish II
Hint: A vigilante architect sets out to find the punks who murdered his housekeeper and daughter in LA.
Description: Paul Kersey is again a vigilante trying to find five punks who murdered his housekeeper and daughter in Los Angeles.

Title: Mr. Popper's Penguins
Hint: A businessman inherits six Antarctic birds and his slick New York life is turned upside down.
Description: Tom ___ is a successful businessman who’s clueless when it comes to the really important things in life...until he inherits six “adorable” ___, each with its own unique personality. Soon Tom’s rambunctious roommates turn his swank New York apartment into a snowy winter wonderland — and the rest of his world upside-down.

Title: Motel Hell
Hint: A farmer and his sister run a roadside inn where they capture travellers and turn them into smoked meats.
Description: Farmer Vincent Smith and his sister Ida run a ___ attached to a farm where they capture unsuspecting travelers, bury them alive, fatten them up and then harvest their bodies as ingredients for his famous brand of "smoked meats."

Title: Raising Helen
Hint: A glamorous New York fashion assistant is forced to raise her late sister's three children.
Description: ___ Harris has a glamorous, big-city life working for one of New York's hottest modeling agencies. But suddenly her free-spirited life gets turned upside down when she must chose between the life she's always loved, and the new loves of her life!

Title: Equals

Description: A futuristic love story set in a world where emotions have been eradicated.

Title: Man of Tai Chi

Description: In Beijing, a young martial artist's skill places him in position to experience opportunities and sacrifices.

Title: Boxcar Bertha
Hint: A transient woman during the Depression falls in with a union organiser and becomes a robber.
Description: "___" ___ Thompson, a transient woman in Arkansas during the violence-filled Depression of the early '30s, meets up with rabble-rousing union man "Big" Bill Shelly and the two team up to fight the corrupt railroad establishment.

Title: Come to Daddy
Country: Ireland, Canada, New Zealand, United States of America
Hint: A pretentious young man travels to his estranged father's coastal cabin and finds a nightmare.
Description: After receiving a cryptic letter from his estranged father, Norval travels to his dad’s oceanfront home for what he hopes will be a positive experience. If only he’d known the dark truth about his old man beforehand.

Title: The Code
Hint: A thief and a veteran detective team up to steal Russian Fabergé eggs.
Description: For 60 years, the group of detectives known as "Detective Office 5" has raised the bar for detective work. The agents of Detective Office 5 are a group of stellar detectives lead by the genius ___ breaker Detective 507.

Title: The Escort
Hint: A sex-addicted journalist teams up with a high-class call girl to write a story.
Description: Desperate for a good story, a sex-addicted journalist throws himself into the world of high-class escorts when he starts following a Stanford-educated prostitute.

Title: Flower
Hint: A rebellious 17-year-old girl tries to expose her new stepbrother's abuser.
Description: Rebellious, quick-witted Erica Vandross is a 17-year-old firecracker living with her single mom, Laurie, and her mom's new boyfriend, Bob, in L.A.'s San Fernando Valley. When Bob's mentally unbalanced son, Luke, arrives from rehab to live with the family, Erica finds her domestic and personal life overwhelmed.

Title: 6 Souls
Hint: A forensic psychiatrist discovers that her patient's personalities are murder victims.
Description: A female forensic psychiatrist discovers that all of one of her patient's multiple personalities are murder victims. She will have to find out what's happening before her time is finished.

Title: The Condemned
Hint: Ten death-row inmates are forced to fight to the death on a remote island for an online show.
Description: Jack Conrad is awaiting the death penalty in a corrupt Central American prison. He is "purchased" by a wealthy television producer and taken to a desolate island where he must fight to the death against nine other ___ killers from all corners of the world, with freedom going to the sole survivor.

Title: Ice Princess
Hint: A brainy high school student gives up her academic future to pursue her dream of figure skating.
Description: With the help of her coach, her mom, and the boy who drives the Zamboni, nothing can stop Casey Carlyle from realizing her dream to be a champion figure skater.

Title: Nim's Island
Hint: A girl living on a remote tropical isle with her scientist father asks a reclusive adventure author for help.
Description: A young girl inhabits an isolated island with her scientist father and communicates with a reclusive author of the novel she's reading.

Title: Split Second
Genres: Science Fiction, Action, Crime, Thriller, Horror
Hint: In a flooded future London, a detective hunts a serial killer that devours hearts.
Description: In a flooded future London, Detective Harley Stone hunts a serial killer who murdered his partner and has haunted him ever since — but he soon discovers what he is hunting might not be human.

Title: Memoirs of an Invisible Man
Hint: A stock analyst turned transparent after a freak accident is hunted by a CIA agent.
Description: After a freak accident, an ___ yuppie runs for his life from a treacherous CIA official while trying to cope with his new life.

Title: Parental Guidance
Hint: Two grandparents look after their three grandkids when the helicopter parents go on a trip.
Description: Artie and Diane agree to look after their three grandkids when their type-A helicopter parents need to leave town for work. Problems arise when the kids' 21st-century behavior collides with Artie and Diane's old-school methods.

Title: The Riot Club
Hint: Two first-year students at Oxford join an elite secret society of rich young men.
Description: Two first-year students at Oxford University join a secret society and learn that their reputations can be made or destroyed over the course of one evening.

Title: Asterix and Obelix vs. Caesar
Hint: Two plucky Gaulish warriors fight the Roman emperor's plot to conquer their village.
Description: Set in 50 B.C., ___ are living in a small but well-protected village in Gaul, where a magic potion concocted by Druids turns the townsfolk into mighty soldiers. When Roman troops carve a path through Gaul to reach the English Channel, ___ and his aide de camp Detritus discover the secret elixir and capture the Druid leader who knows its formula, and ___ are sent off to rescue them.

Title: The Night Flier
Hint: A cynical tabloid journalist chases a vampire who flies a private plane between small airports.
Description: For cynical tabloid journo Richard Dees, facts are always stranger than fiction. Every headline is a dead-line. Serial killers, UFO abductions, tales of molestation, mayhem and murder. To some the tales are mere sleazy fantasy – but his faithful readers believe. And now there's a new story: The ___.

Title: Rock-A-Doodle
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A rooster who believes his crowing raises the sun leaves his farm for the city.
Description: Chanticleer is a foolhardy farm rooster who believes his crows can actually make the sun come up and shine. When the sun rises one morning without Chanticleer's crow, he leaves the farm in disgrace and runs off to become a rock 'n' roll singer. But in his absence, a sinister, sunshine-hating owl prepares to take over.

Title: Deception
Hint: A corporate auditor is introduced to a sex club by a charismatic lawyer.
Description: As a corporate auditor who works in a number of different offices, Jonathan McQuarry wanders without an anchor among New York's power brokers. A chance meeting with charismatic lawyer Wyatt Bose leads to Jonathan's introduction to The List, an underground sex club. Jonathan begins an affair with a woman known only as S, who introduces Jonathan to a world of treachery and murder.

Title: The Night Eats the World
Hint: A man wakes up after a party in a Paris apartment to find the city overrun by zombies.
Description: After waking up to find himself all alone in an apartment where a massive party was being held the night before, Sam is immediately forced to face a terrifying reality: the living dead have invaded the streets of Paris.

Title: Margot at the Wedding
Hint: A sharp-tongued writer and her son visit her sister, who is about to marry a slacker.
Description: ___ Zeller is a short story writer with a sharp wit and an even sharper tongue. On the eve of her estranged sister Pauline's wedding to unemployed musician/artist/depressive Malcolm at the family seaside home, ___ shows up unexpectedly to rekindle the sisterly bond and offer her own brand of support. What ensues is a nakedly honest and subversively funny look at family dynamics.

Title: Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna
Hint: Two unhappily married people in New York start an affair.
Description: Dev and Maya are both married to different people. Settled into a life of domestic ritual, and convinced that they are happy in their respective relationships, they still yearn for something deeper and more meaningful, which is precisely what they find in each other.

Title: To All the Boys: P.S. I Still Love You
Hint: A high school girl's relationship is tested when another boy from her past reappears.
Description: Lara Jean and Peter have just taken their romance from pretend to officially real when another recipient of one of her love letters enters the picture.

Title: Ask Me Anything
Hint: A wild teen takes a year off before college and gets involved with older men.
Description: Beautiful, wild, funny, and lost, Katie Kampenfelt takes a year off before college to find herself, all the while chronicling her adventures in an anonymous blog into which she pours her innermost secrets. Eventually, Katie's fearless narrative begins to crack, and dark pieces of her past emerge.

Title: Tequila Sunrise
Hint: Two best friends, a drug dealer and a cop, fall for the same restaurant owner.
Description: In a seaside California town, best friends Mac and Nick are on opposite sides of the law. Mac is a former drug dealer trying to clean up his act, while Nick is a high-profile detective trying to take down a Mexican drug lord named Carlos.

Title: Someone Like You
Hint: A talk show producer is dumped by her boyfriend and develops a theory about men.
Description: Jane Goodale has everything going for her. She's a producer on a popular daytime talk show, and is in a hot romance with the show's dashing executive producer Ray. But when the relationship goes terribly awry, Jane begins an extensive study of the male animal, including her womanizing roommate Eddie.

Title: Planet 51
Genres: Animation, Family, Comedy, Science Fiction, Adventure
Hint: An astronaut lands on a world of little green aliens who are terrified of invaders from space.
Description: When Earth astronaut Capt. Chuck Baker arrives on ___ -- a world reminiscent of American suburbia circa 1950 -- he tries to avoid capture, recover his spaceship and make it home safely, all with the help of an empathetic little green being.

Title: Bird on a Wire
Hint: An FBI informant is recognised by an old flame and must go on the run.
Description: An FBI informant has kept his new identity secret for 15 years. Now an old flame has recognised him, and the bad guys are back for revenge.

Title: Medicine Man
Hint: An eccentric scientist in the Amazon has found a cure for cancer.
Description: An eccentric scientist in the Amazon jungle rejects his research assistant for being a woman, but as bulldozers threaten their work on a potential cancer cure, they learn to collaborate and begin to fall in love.

Title: The Christmas Chronicles: Part Two
Hint: A girl spends the holidays with her mother's new boyfriend and his son, and is drawn into an adventure.
Description: Kate Pierce is reluctantly spending Christmas with her mom’s new boyfriend and his son Jack. But when the North Pole and Christmas are threatened to be destroyed, Kate and Jack are unexpectedly pulled into a new adventure with Santa Claus.

Title: Wildcats
Hint: A high school track coach takes over an inner-city football team.
Description: High school track coach Molly McGrath knows just as much about football as anyone else on the planet. When a football coach's position becomes vacant, she applies for the job, despite snickers from fellow staff members and her former husband.

Title: How to Be a Latin Lover
Hint: An aging gigolo gets dumped by his sugar mama and must move in with his sister.
Description: An aging ___ lover gets dumped by his sugar mama and must fend for himself in a harsh world.

Title: Tragedy Girls
Hint: Two death-obsessed teenage best friends start a killing spree to gain followers for their true-crime blog.
Description: McKayla and Sadie, two death-obsessed teenage girls, use their online show about real-life tragedies to send their small Midwestern town into a frenzy and cement their legacy as modern horror legends.

Title: The Big Hit
Country: United States of America, Canada, France
Hint: A hitman is always being scammed by his colleagues in the business.
Description: Affable hit man Melvin Smiley is constantly being scammed by his cutthroat colleagues in the life-ending business. So, when he and his fellow assassins kidnap the daughter of an electronics mogul, it's naturally Melvin who takes the fall when their prime score turns sour. That's because the girl is the goddaughter of the gang's ruthless crime boss.

Title: Ricki and the Flash
Hint: An aging rock musician playing in a bar band tries to reconnect with her estranged family after her daughter's divorce.
Description: Meryl Streep stars as ___ Rendazzo, a guitar heroine who made a world of mistakes as she followed her dreams of rock-and-roll stardom. Returning home, ___ gets a shot at redemption and a chance to make things right as she faces the music with her family.

Title: The Dark Half
Hint: A writer's pseudonym comes to life and begins killing people.
Description: Following the public's realization that Thad Beaumont and George Stark are one and the same, the former stages a mock funeral, only for a series of gruesome murders to begin occurring as in his books.

Title: Leatherheads
Hint: A football player in the 1920s recruits a war hero to save his team.
Description: A light hearted comedy about the beginnings of Professional American Football. When a decorated war hero and college all star is tempted into playing professional football. Everyone see the chance to make some big money, but when a reporter digs up some dirt on the war hero... everyone could lose out.

Title: K-9
Hint: An extravagant cop teams up with a German shepherd to catch a drug dealer.
Description: The extravagant cop Michael Dooley needs some help to fight a drug dealer who has tried to kill him. A "friend" gives him a dog named Jerry Lee (Officer Lewis), who has been trained to smell drugs. With his help, Dooley sets out to put his enemy behind the bars, but Jerry Lee has a personality of his own and works only when he wants to.

Title: Erased
Hint: A struggling comic-book artist with a time-travel ability is sent back to his childhood to prevent a murder.
Description: Struggling manga author Satoru Fujinuma is beset by his fear to express himself. However, he has a supernatural ability of being forced to prevent deaths and catastrophes by being sent back in time before the incident occurred, repeating time until the accident is prevented. One day, he gets involved in an accident that has him framed as a murderer.

Title: Cheech and Chong's Next Movie
Hint: Two perennially stoned buddies tear through Los Angeles causing chaos.
Description: Perennially stoned ___ tear through the city of Los Angeles, causing trouble wherever they go. After ___ loses his job, the two pot enthusiasts head to the welfare offices where ___ girlfriend, Donna, works. Instead of collecting unemployment, they find themselves thrown back on the streets, searching for a way to earn new income.

Title: The Secret of Moonacre
Country: Australia, France, Hungary, United States of America
Hint: A girl moves to a mysterious manor after her father dies and discovers a family curse.
Description: When 13 year old Maria Merryweather's father dies, leaving her orphaned and homeless, she is forced to leave her luxurious London life to go and live with Sir Benjamin, an eccentric uncle she didn't know she had, at the mysterious ___ Manor.

Title: Chinese Zodiac
Hint: An adventurer leads a team to recover twelve lost bronze animal heads looted from a Beijing palace.
Description: Asian Hawk leads a mercenary team to recover several lost artifacts from the Old Summer Palace, the bronze heads of the twelve ___ animals which were sacked by the French and British armies from the imperial Summer Palace in Beijing in 1860. Assisted by a Chinese student and a Parisian woman, Hawk stops at nothing to accomplish the mission.

Title: Dead Man on Campus
Hint: Two college roommates try to find a fellow student who will commit suicide so they can get straight A's.
Description: Two college roommates venture out to identify a fellow student, who is most likely to commit suicide as it will help them pass the semester.

Title: Arkansas
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two low-level drug dealers in the American South work for a kingpin they've never met.
Description: Kyle and Swin live by the orders of an ___-based drug kingpin named Frog, whom they've never met. But when a deal goes horribly wrong, the consequences are deadly.

Title: Varisu
Hint: A billionaire's prodigal son takes over the family business, and conflicts with his brothers.
Description: Vijay, The prodigal son of business tycoon Rajendran agrees to take over the reins of the business, much to the chagrin of his brothers. But can Vijay prove himself to be a worthy ___ and also reunite his now-broken family?

Title: Pushing Tin
Hint: Two air traffic controllers compete to outdo each other at work.
Description: Two air traffic controllers who thrive on living dangerously compete to outdo each other on several levels.

Title: The Story of Us
Hint: A long-married couple grows apart over 15 years and remembers better days.
Description: After 15 years of marriage, Katie and her husband, Ben, have grown apart. While they keep up the facade of having a contented marriage, mostly to not worry their children, they aren't happy together and argue frequently. While the kids are away at camp, Katie and Ben decide to separate and try to reassess their relationship to see if they should stay together or split up for good.

Title: The Machine
Hint: An engineer builds a female android for the Ministry of Defence.
Description: Already deep into a second Cold War, Britain’s Ministry of Defense seeks a game-changing weapon. Programmer Vincent McCarthy unwittingly provides an answer in The ___, a super-strong human cyborg. When a programming bug causes the prototype to decimate his lab, McCarthy takes his obsessive efforts underground, far away from inquisitive eyes.

Title: The Caller
Hint: A divorcee is tormented by sinister phone calls from a woman claiming to be in the past.
Description: Troubled divorcee Mary Kee is tormented by a series of sinister phone calls from a mysterious woman. When the stranger reveals she's calling from the past, Mary tries to break off contact. But the ___ doesn't like being ignored, and looks for revenge in a unique and terrifying way...

Title: Dying Young
Hint: A working-class woman falls for the wealthy patient she nurses through leukaemia in a seaside house.
Description: After she discovers that her boyfriend has betrayed her, Hilary O'Neil is looking for a new start and a new job. She begins to work as a private nurse for a young man suffering from blood cancer. Slowly, they fall in love, but they always know their love cannot last because he is destined to die.

Title: The Den
Hint: A woman studying webcam chat users witnesses a murder.
Description: A young woman studying the habits of webcam chat users from the apparent safety of her apartment witnesses a brutal murder online and is quickly immersed in a nightmare in which she and her loved ones are targeted for the same grisly fate as the first victim.

Title: Blood and Wine
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A failed husband and father commits a heist with a safecracker.
Description: A man who has failed as a father and husband commits a heist to make money for his fledging business, but things become complicated when his wife interferes.

Title: Gerry
Country: Argentina, Switzerland, United States of America
Hint: Two friends become lost in the desert after taking a wrong turn.
Description: Two friends named ___ become lost in the desert after taking a wrong turn. Their attempts to find their way home only lead them into further trouble.

Title: Killshot
Hint: A couple who witnessed a murder are placed in witness protection, and a hitman and his partner follow them.
Description: Beautiful Carmen Colson and her ironworker husband Wayne are placed in the Federal Witness Protection program after witnessing an "incident". Thinking they are at last safe, they are targeted by an experienced hit man and a psychopathic young upstart killer.

Title: Bordertown
Hint: An American reporter investigates a series of murders of female factory workers in Juárez.
Description: American corporations are using the North American Free Trade Agreement by opening large maquiladoras right across the United States–Mexico border. The maquiladoras hire mostly Mexican women to work long hours for little money in order to produce mass quantity products. Lauren Adrian, an impassioned American news reporter for the Chicago Sentinel wants to be assigned to the Iraq front-lines to cover the war.

Title: Churchill
Hint: A ticking-clock thriller following a British prime minister in the 24 hours before D-Day.
Description: A ticking-clock thriller following Winston ___ in the 24 hours before D-Day.

Title: The Tournament
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Bahrain
Hint: Every seven years, a town hosts a secret battle royale between the world's deadliest assassins.
Description: Every seven years, in an unsuspecting town, The ___ takes place. A battle royale between 30 of the world's deadliest assassins. The last man standing receives the $10,000,000 cash prize and the title of World's No. 1 Assassin, which itself carries the legendary million dollar-a-bullet price tag.

Title: Birthday Girl
Hint: A banker orders a Russian bride online, but she turns out to be a con artist.
Description: John is a mild-mannered banker who has never been lucky in love. Fed up with waiting for the right girl to come along, John takes a chance on a Russian mail-order bride arranged via the Internet, where he is introduced to Nadia. John's fondness for Nadia grows... until the sudden arrival of Nadia's gregarious cousins makes John realize that he's in over his head.

Title: Three to Tango
Hint: An architect pretends to be gay to win a design contract and falls for the client's girlfriend.
Description: Oscar and Peter land a career-making opportunity when a Chicago tycoon chooses them to compete for the design of a cultural center. The tycoon mistakenly believes that Oscar is gay and has him spy on his mistress Amy. Oscar goes along with it and ends up falling in love with Amy.

Title: At First Sight
Hint: A man who lost his vision as a child has an operation to see again.
Description: A blind man has an operation to regain his ___ at the urging of his girlfriend and must deal with the changes to his life.

Title: Earthquake Bird
Hint: A translator in 1980s Tokyo is a suspect in her friend's disappearance.
Description: Tokyo, Japan, 1989. Lucy Fly, a foreigner who works as a translator, begins a passionate relationship with Teiji, a mysterious man obsessed with photography.

Title: Anna and the Apocalypse
Hint: An undead outbreak threatens a small Scottish town at Christmas, in a high-school musical.
Description: A zombie ___ threatens the sleepy town of Little Haven—at Christmas—forcing ___ and her friends to fight, slash, and sing their way to survival. In a desperate race to reach their loved ones, they soon learn that no one is safe in this new world, and with civilization falling apart around them, the only people they can truly rely on are each other.

Title: Violet & Daisy
Hint: Two teenage assassins accept what they think will be an easy job.
Description: Two teenage assassins accept what they think will be a quick-and-easy job, until an unexpected target throws them off their plan.

Title: I Sell the Dead
Hint: Two body snatchers in 18th-century England start trading in corpses and undead creatures.
Description: 18th century justice catches up with a pair of grave robbers. With only a few hours to go before his date with the guillotine, Arthur Blake tells his life story to Father Francis Duffy. Before long, Arthur spills the beans on how he got started in the grim corpse peddling business with seasoned ghoul Willie Grimes.

Title: Senseless
Hint: A broke college student volunteers for an experimental drug that enhances his senses, with dangerous side effects.
Description: A student gets his senses enhanced by an experimental drug. But abuse is not an option.

Title: 6 Bullets
Hint: An ex-mercenary searches for a missing girl in Moldova, kidnapped by traffickers.
Description: An ex-mercenary known for finding missing children is hired by a mixed martial arts fighter whose daughter has been kidnapped.

Title: The Good German
Hint: An American journalist in post-war Berlin investigates a murder involving his old lover.
Description: An American journalist arrives in Berlin just after the end of World War Two. He becomes involved in a murder mystery surrounding a dead GI who washes up at a lakeside mansion during the Potsdam negotiations between the Allied powers. Soon his investigation connects with his search for his married pre-war German lover.

Title: The Chamber
Hint: A young lawyer represents his estranged grandfather, a Klansman on death row for a bombing.
Description: Idealistic young attorney Adam Hall takes on the death row clemency case of his racist grandfather, Sam Cayhall, a former Ku Klux Klan member he has never met.

Title: The Polka King
Hint: A beloved Pennsylvania accordion bandleader runs a Ponzi scheme on his loyal fans.
Description: Local Pennsylvania ___ legend Jan Lewan develops a plan to get rich that shocks his fans and lands him in jail.

Title: The Maiden Heist
Hint: Three museum security guards devise a plan to steal back the artworks they love.
Description: A comedy centered on three museum security guards who devise a plan to steal back the artworks to which they have become attached after they are transferred to another museum.

Title: Assault on Wall Street
Hint: An average New Yorker loses everything in the financial crisis and seeks revenge.
Description: Jim is an average New Yorker living a peaceful life with a well paying job and a loving family. Suddenly, everything changes when the economy crashes causing Jim to lose everything. Filled with anger and rage, Jim snaps and goes to extreme lengths to seek revenge for the life taken from him.

Title: Phantasm III: Lord of the Dead
Hint: A sinister mortician returns to terrorise a man and his friend.
Description: The Tall Man, that imposing menace from Morningside Mortuary, is back and once again haunting the thoughts of the now-adult Mike and his friend, ex-Ice Cream vendor Reggie. The two continue their hunt for the mysterious figure and in his path of destruction encounter a variety of dangerous situations, friends and enemies.

Title: Ladies vs. Ricky Bahl
Hint: A charming con man is conned by four women he swindled.
Description: A smooth and charming conman, ___, cons girls for a living but finally meets his match is this fun-filled "ROM-CON."

Title: Blind Dating
Hint: A sightless young man who refuses to let his impairment hold him back searches for love.
Description: Danny is a ___ man who does not let his impairment get in the way of living his life to the fullest, except when it comes to love. Danny's brother sets him up on a series of ___ dates, but all of them go disastrously wrong. Just when Danny is about to give up, he meets Leeza, a nurse who works for Danny's doctor. There is just one catch: Leeza, who is from India, is promised to another man.

Title: Doghouse
Hint: Men on a weekend in a remote village find the women have become zombies.
Description: A group of men, heading to a remote village to help one of their friends get over his divorce, soon discover that all the women have been infected with a virus that makes them man-hating cannibals.

Title: Fragile
Hint: A nurse takes a job at a children's hospital haunted by a ghost.
Description: Haunted by memories of a patient's death, a nurse takes a job at an antiquated hospital for children. Soon she learns that the kids fear a ghost that prowls the floors and will not allow anyone to leave. Amy tries to protect them and convince the other staffers of the evil that lurks there.

Title: Anatomy
Hint: A medical student at a German university discovers a secret society.
Description: Medical student Paula wins a place at an exclusive Heidelberg medical school. When the body of a young man she met on the train turns up on her dissection table, she begins to investigate the mysterious circumstances surrounding his death.

Title: Gorgeous
Hint: A girl from a Taiwan fishing village goes to Hong Kong looking for the man who sent a message in a bottle.
Description: When Ah Bu, a girl from a small fishing town in Taiwan, finds a glass bottle with a romantic message, she travels to Hong Kong to find her prince charming. As it turns out, her prince charming, Albert, happens to be gay. But all is not lost when Ah Bu meets the dashing Chi Wu. Meanwhile, Ah Bu's boyfriend from Taiwan comes looking for her, as the action and romance follow Ah Bu back to Taiwan.

Title: For a Good Time, Call...
Hint: Two college frenemies start a phone sex line in their New York apartment.
Description: College "frenemies" Lauren and Katie move in together after losing a relationship and rent control, respectively. Sharing Katie's late grandmother's apartment in New York City, the girls bicker with each other until one fateful night, when Katie's noisy bedroom activities make Lauren barge in and discover a dirty little secret.

Title: Half Light
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A crime novelist moves to a Scottish village after her son's death and is haunted by him.
Description: Rachel Carson, a best-selling crime novelist, is devastated and filled with guilt over the accidental death of her son. Hoping that a change of scenery will help alleviate her suffering, she leaves her home in the city and moves into a vacant country house owned by a friend and begins a relationship with charming local Angus.

Title: Legal Eagles
Hint: A district attorney becomes involved with a defence attorney and her eccentric client.
Description: District Attorney Tom Logan is set for higher office, at least until he becomes involved with defence lawyer Laura Kelly and her unpredictable client Chelsea Deardon. It seems the least of Chelsea's crimes is the theft of a very valuable painting, but as the women persuade Logan to investigate further and to cut some official corners, a much more sinister scenario starts to emerge.

Title: Right at Your Door
Hint: A dirty bomb goes off in Los Angeles, trapping a man outside his home.
Description: A dirty bomb goes off in Los Angeles, jamming freeways and spreading a toxic cloud.

Title: Black Mask
Hint: A super-soldier tries to live a quiet life as a librarian but must fight his former comrades.
Description: Super-soldier recruit Tsui Chik is forced to escape with his comrades after the project is canceled. Months later, he's trying to have a quiet life as a librarian with his best friend, Inspector Shek Wai-Ho. However, a string of vicious gangland murders begins that has all the markings of Tsui's former compatriots who seem to have turned to crime.

Title: Jayeshbhai Jordaar
Hint: A meek man defies his patriarchal family to protect his unborn daughter from sex-selective abortion.
Description: A non-confrontational Jayesh decides to defy his patriarchal family and flee with his pregnant wife Mudra to save their unborn daughter from foeticide. A screwball, hilarious chase begins as Jayesh's father assembles all his might to nab them. Will this unlikely hero manage to create a safe and equal haven for his daughter?

Title: Mr. Baseball
Hint: A washed-up American slugger is traded to a team in Japan and struggles to adapt.
Description: Jack Elliot, a one-time MVP for the New York Yankees is now on the down side of his ___ career. With a falling batting average, does he have one good year left and can the manager of the Chunichi Dragons, a Japanese Central ___ league find it in him?

Title: Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania
Hint: A girl about to marry falls for a playboy in Delhi.
Description: A girl from Ambala, Kavya Pratap Singh, is about to be married. When she visits Delhi to shop for her 'dhai lakh ka Ghagra'(wedding dress worth Rs. 2.5 Lakh), she meets ___, a carefree Delhiite, and falls in love with him.

Title: Beatriz at Dinner
Hint: A Mexican holistic healer is stranded at a wealthy client's party with a ruthless billionaire.
Description: ___, an immigrant from a poor town in Mexico, has drawn on her innate kindness to build a career as a health practitioner. Doug Strutt is a cutthroat, self-satisfied billionaire. When these two opposites meet at a ___ party, their worlds collide, and neither will ever be the same.

Title: Heyy Babyy
Hint: Three womanisers find a baby on their doorstep and must learn to raise her in Mumbai.
Description: Three womanisers find a baby left at their doorstep. Chaos ensues as they try to contact their former girlfriends to determine who is the father amongst them.

Title: Franklyn
Hint: Four lost souls in London and a futuristic city are drawn together.
Description: Set between the parallel worlds of contemporary London and the futuristic faith dominated metropolis of Meanwhile City, ___ weaves a tale of four souls, whose lives are intertwined by fate, romance and tragedy. As these worlds collide, a single bullet determines the destiny of these four characters.

Title: Parallels
Hint: An MMA fighter must confront his sister and his past in an adventure through parallel worlds.
Description: An underground MMA fighter must confront his sister and his past in an adventure through parallel universes

Title: The Money Trap
Hint: A cop teams up with a doctor's wife to steal from a drug dealer.
Description: When half a million dollars disappears from a doctor office's safe, the cops assigned to the burglary case, Joe and Pete, decide to find the money and keep it for themselves.

Title: Mine 9
Hint: Nine Appalachian coal miners struggle to survive after an explosion traps them two miles underground.
Description: Two miles into the earth, nine Appalachian miners struggle to survive after a methane explosion leaves them with one hour of oxygen.

Title: Asterix and the Vikings
Hint: Two Gaulish heroes must turn a chief's lazy nephew into a man in a Viking land.
Description: ___ and Obelix have been given a tough mission: Transform the chief's lazy nephew Justforkix into a warrior. When the ___ abduct him and bring him back to their homeland, ___ and Obelix must travel to Norway to rescue Justforkix.

Title: Kick
Hint: An adrenaline junkie becomes a Robin Hood-style thief who steals from the rich to help sick children.
Description: An adrenaline junkie walks away from a whirlwind romance and embraces a new life as a thief, though he soon finds himself pursued by veteran police officer and engaged in a turf war with a local gangster.

Title: The I Inside
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A man awakens in hospital with amnesia and finds himself jumping between two different years.
Description: When Simon awakens in the hospital after surviving a near-fatal accident, amnesia has erased the last two years from his memory. He learns that his brother was killed, he has married a woman he doesn't remember and he's haunted by strange visions of the woman he loved.

Title: Stuck Apart
Hint: A Turkish man in a midlife crisis seeks solace from his mundane life.
Description: Entrenched in a midlife crisis, Aziz seeks solace from his mundane job, lonesome friends and rowdy family while pretending to have his act together.

Title: Kites
Hint: A wounded man searches for his sweetheart in the Mexican desert.
Description: A wounded man searches for his sweetheart in the Mexican desert while on the run from the police, bounty hunters, and others.

Title: 2 Days in New York
Country: Belgium, France, Germany, United States of America
Hint: A French woman's family visits her and her new boyfriend in Manhattan.
Description: Marion and Mingus both come from failed relationships but, by bringing their children together, they've managed to form a small yet happy family. Tensions in their household soon begin to spike when Marion's jovial father shows up on their doorstep with his randy daughter and her peculiar boyfriend in tow.

Title: Casshern
Hint: A soldier returns from the dead to fight in a war between man and machine.
Description: Fifty years of war between the Great Eastern Federation and Europa - now merged as Eurasia - have taken their toll on planet Earth. As a result of the use of biological, chemical and nuclear weapons, much of Earth has become uninhabitable and people have become prey to new diseases.

Title: MSG: The Messenger of God
Hint: A spiritual leader fights drug dealers in Punjab in a self-made action film.
Description: Guru ji (Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh) is a spiritual leader who has a huge follower base. He has accepted the challenge of eradicating social evils including drugs and gender-related issues that have been prevailing in the society. Those with vested interests and apathetic towards the welfare of the society are now disturbed as there’s someone who has taken control of the situation. They conspire to kill him.

Title: The Nun II
Hint: A sister investigates the murder of a priest in 1956 France and faces the demonic force again.
Description: In 1956 France, a priest is violently murdered, and Sister Irene begins to investigate. She once again comes face-to-face with a powerful evil.

Title: Cocaine Bear
Hint: A huge black predator goes on a murderous rampage in a Georgia forest after ingesting a stash of drugs dropped from a plane.
Description: Inspired by a true story, an oddball group of cops, criminals, tourists and teens converge in a Georgia forest where a 500-pound black ___ goes on a murderous rampage after unintentionally ingesting ___.

Title: Cobweb
Hint: An 8-year-old boy hears tapping in the walls of his house, and his parents seem to be hiding something.
Description: Eight year old Peter is plagued by a mysterious, constant tapping from inside his bedroom wall—one that his parents insist is all in his imagination. As Peter's fear intensifies, he believes that his parents could be hiding a terrible, dangerous secret and questions their trustworthiness.

Title: The Boogeyman
Hint: Two grieving sisters find a sinister presence haunting their family.
Description: Still reeling from the tragic death of their mother, a teenage girl and her younger sister find themselves plagued by a sadistic presence in their house and struggle to get their grieving father to pay attention before it’s too late.

Title: Saw IV
Hint: A sadistic serial killer's twisted games target a police officer.
Description: Despite Jigsaw's death, and in order to save the lives of two of his colleagues, Lieutenant Rigg is forced to take part in a new game, which promises to test him to the limit.

Title: Suicide Squad
Hint: A secret government agency recruits imprisoned supervillains for a deadly, deniable mission.
Description: From DC Comics comes the ___, an antihero team of incarcerated supervillains who act as deniable assets for the United States government, undertaking high-risk black ops missions in exchange for commuted prison sentences.

Title: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief
Hint: A teenager discovers he's a demigod son of the sea god, accused of stealing a weapon.
Description: Accident prone teenager, ___ discovers he's actually a demi-God, the son of Poseidon, and he is needed when Zeus' ___ is stolen. ___ must master his new found skills in order to prevent a war between the Gods that could devastate the entire world.

Title: Till Death
Hint: A woman wakes up handcuffed to her dead husband and must survive two killers.
Description: After a romantic evening at their secluded lake house, a woman wakes up handcuffed to her dead husband. Trapped and isolated in the dead of winter, she must fight off hired killers to escape her late spouse's twisted plan.

Title: The Ruins
Hint: A group of American tourists in Mexico find an ancient ruin with a deadly plant.
Description: Americans Amy, Stacy, Jeff and Eric look for fun during a sunny holiday in Mexico, but they get much more than that after visiting an archaeological dig in the jungle.

Title: She's All That
Hint: A popular high school student bets he can turn a nerdy girl into prom queen.
Description: High school hotshot Zach Siler is the envy of his peers. But his popularity declines sharply when his cheerleader girlfriend, Taylor, leaves him for sleazy reality-television star Brock Hudson. Desperate to revive his fading reputation, Siler agrees to a seemingly impossible challenge. He has six weeks to gain the trust of nerdy outcast Laney Boggs -- and help her to become the school's next prom queen.

Title: The School for Good and Evil
Hint: Two best friends are sent to an enchanted academy where one trains as a hero and the other as a villain.
Description: Best friends Sophie and Agatha navigate an enchanted school for young heroes and villains — and find themselves on opposing sides of the battle between good and evil.

Title: Vivarium
Country: Belgium, Denmark, Ireland, United States of America
Hint: A young couple are trapped in a suburban maze of identical houses and forced to raise a strange child.
Description: A young woman and her fiancé are in search of the perfect starter home. After following a mysterious real estate agent to a new housing development, the couple finds themselves trapped in a maze of identical houses and forced to raise an otherworldly child.

Title: Pathaan
Hint: An exiled soldier returns to stop a rogue agent planning a deadly attack.
Description: A soldier caught by enemies and presumed dead comes back to complete his mission, accompanied by old companions and foes.

Title: Clifford the Big Red Dog
Hint: A girl's small crimson puppy magically grows into a giant hound in New York.
Description: As Emily struggles to fit in at home and at school, she discovers a small red puppy who is destined to become her best friend. When ___ magically undergoes one heck of a growth spurt, becomes a gigantic dog and attracts the attention of a genetics company, Emily and her Uncle Casey have to fight the forces of greed as they go on the run across New York City.

Title: Underwater
Hint: A crew of deep-sea researchers must survive after an earthquake devastates their ocean-floor station.
Description: After an earthquake destroys their ___ station, six researchers must navigate two miles along the dangerous, unknown depths of the ocean floor to make it to safety in a race against time.

Title: Hostel
Country: United States of America, Czech Republic
Hint: Three backpackers in Slovakia are lured to a cheap lodging where rich clients pay to torture travellers.
Description: Three backpackers head to a Slovakian city that promises to meet their hedonistic expectations, with no idea of the hell that awaits them.

Title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
Hint: A journalist and his alien symbiote face a serial killer who becomes a new monster.
Description: After finding a host body in investigative reporter Eddie Brock, the alien symbiote must face a new enemy, ___, the alter ego of serial killer Cletus Kasady.

Title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
Hint: A former cop and his friend go undercover for the US Customs Service.
Description: It's a major double-cross when former police officer Brian O'Conner teams up with his ex-con buddy Roman Pearce to transport a shipment of "dirty" money for shady Miami-based import-export dealer Carter Verone. But the guys are actually working with undercover agent Monica Fuentes to bring Verone down.

Title: The Fourth Kind
Hint: A psychologist records patients claiming alien abductions in Alaska, in a supposedly true story.
Description: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler, a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

Title: The Great Wall
Hint: European mercenaries discover a horde of monsters attacking China's most famous ancient barrier.
Description: European mercenaries searching for black powder become embroiled in the defense of the ___ of China against a horde of monstrous creatures.

Title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
Genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Family, Science Fiction
Country: United States of America, China, Hong Kong
Hint: Four turtle brothers face a new threat from a mad scientist in New York.
Description: After supervillain Shredder escapes custody, he joins forces with mad scientist Baxter Stockman and two dimwitted henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, to unleash a diabolical plan to take over the world. As the ___ prepare to take on Shredder and his new crew, they find themselves facing an even greater evil with similar intentions: the notorious Krang.

Title: The Kissing Booth
Hint: A high school girl falls for her best friend's older brother.
Description: When teenager Elle's first kiss leads to a forbidden romance with the hottest boy in high school, she risks her relationship with her best friend.

Title: Annabelle Comes Home
Hint: A cursed doll terrorises the daughter of paranormal investigators.
Description: Determined to keep ___ from wreaking more havoc, demonologists Ed and Lorraine Warren bring the possessed doll to the locked artifacts room in their home, placing her “safely” behind sacred glass and enlisting a priest’s holy blessing.

Title: A Cinderella Story
Hint: A modern-day girl is bullied by her stepmother and stepsisters and meets her prince online.
Description: Routinely exploited by her wicked stepmother, the downtrodden Samantha Montgomery is excited about the prospect of meeting her Internet beau at the school's Halloween dance.

Title: Mannequin
Hint: A department store window dresser falls for a store dummy that comes to life.
Description: Jonathan Switcher, an unemployed artist, finds a job as an assistant window dresser for a department store. When Jonathan happens upon a beautiful ___ he previously designed, she springs to life and introduces herself as Emmy, an Egyptian under an ancient spell.

Title: Species
Hint: A team of scientists hunt an alien-human hybrid who wants to mate.
Description: In 1993, the Search for Extra Terrestrial Intelligence Project receives a transmission detailing an alien DNA structure, along with instructions on how to splice it with human DNA. The result is Sil, a sensual but deadly creature who can change from a beautiful woman to an armour-plated killing machine in the blink of an eye.

Title: Deep Blue Sea
Hint: Scientists searching for an Alzheimer's cure are trapped in an underwater lab with genetically enhanced sharks.
Description: Researchers on the undersea lab Aquatica have genetically altered the brains of captive sharks to develop a cure for Alzheimer's disease. But there's an unexpected side effect: the sharks got smarter, faster, and more dangerous. After a big storm damages their remote research facility, they must fight for their lives.

Title: Into the Woods
Hint: A childless baker and his wife set off into an enchanted forest to break a witch's curse, crossing paths with fairy-tale characters in a musical.
Description: In a ___ filled with magic and fairy tale characters, a baker and his wife set out to end the curse put on them by their neighbor, a spiteful witch.

Title: Against All Odds
Hint: A cut football player is hired to find a mob boss's girlfriend in Mexico.
Description: Having been cut from his professional football team, down-and-out athlete Terry Brogan is in desperate need of money. Crooked nightclub owner and bookie Jake Wise offers Terry a hefty sum to go to Mexico and find his girlfriend, Jessie Wyler. Terry cannot turn the offer down. When Terry locates Jessie, the two fall in love. Terry reports that he failed to find her, but Jake sends someone else.

Title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
Hint: A college student finds himself at the centre of a war between alien robots again as an ancient enemy returns to Earth.
Description: Sam Witwicky leaves the Autobots behind for a normal life. But when his mind is filled with cryptic symbols, the Decepticons target him and he is dragged back into the ___' war.

Title: After.Life
Hint: After a car crash, a woman wakes on a mortuary slab while an enigmatic undertaker insists she's dead.
Description: Following a terrible car crash, a woman awakes to find an enigmatic mortician preparing her for burial.

Title: Cheaper by the Dozen
Hint: A football coach and his writer wife juggle the chaos of raising twelve kids when they move to Illinois.
Description: The Baker brood moves to Chicago after patriarch Tom gets a job coaching football at Northwestern University, forcing his writer wife, Kate, and the couple's 12 children to make a major adjustment. The transition works well until work demands pull the parents away from home, leaving the kids bored -- and increasingly mischievous.

Title: The Last Witch Hunter
Country: Canada, Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: An immortal warrior who has hunted witches for 800 years must stop a plague-spreading queen from returning in modern New York.
Description: The modern world holds many secrets, but by far the most astounding is that witches still live among us; vicious supernatural creatures intent on unleashing the Black Death upon the world and putting an end to the human race once and for all.

Title: Punisher: War Zone
Country: Canada, Germany, United States of America
Hint: A ruthless skull-wearing vigilante wages his one-man crusade on the New York mob and creates a disfigured new enemy.
Description: Waging his one-man war on the world of organized crime, ruthless vigilante-hero Frank Castle sets his sights on overeager mob boss Billy Russoti. After Russoti is left horribly disfigured by Castle, he sets out for vengeance under his new alias: Jigsaw.

Title: 9½ Weeks
Hint: A New York art gallery assistant enters an erotic, controlling affair with a mysterious Wall Street broker.
Description: An erotic story about a woman, the assistant of an art gallery, who gets involved in an impersonal affair with a man. She barely knows about his life, only about the sex games they play, so the relationship begins to get complicated.

Title: Power Rangers
Country: United States of America, Hong Kong
Hint: Five misfit teens discover glowing alien coins that give them superhuman abilities and must stop an ancient sorceress.
Description: Five ordinary teens must become something extraordinary when they learn that their small town of Angel Grove — and the world — is on the verge of being obliterated by an alien threat. Chosen by destiny, our heroes quickly discover they are the only ones who can save the planet. But to do so, they will have to overcome their real-life issues and before it’s too late, band together as the ___.

Title: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
Hint: Jedi knights and an apprentice must rescue a crime lord's kidnapped son in a computer-animated space adventure.
Description: As the ___ sweep through the galaxy, Anakin Skywalker and his new Padawan learner Ahsoka Tano plunge into a dangerous mission to rescue the kidnapped son of crime lord Jabba the Hutt.

Title: The Grudge
Hint: An American nurse in Tokyo is exposed to a curse that spreads to everyone who enters a certain house.
Description: An American nurse living and working in Tokyo is exposed to a mysterious supernatural curse, one that locks a person in a powerful rage before claiming their life and spreading to another victim.

Title: Medieval
Country: Czech Republic, United States of America
Hint: A 15th-century Czech warlord, never defeated in battle, leads his people against the might of the Holy Roman Empire.
Description: The story of fifteenth century Czech icon and warlord, Jan Zizka, who defeated armies of the Teutonic Order and the Holy Roman Empire.

Title: Jurassic Park III
Hint: A paleontologist is tricked into joining a rescue mission to an island overrun with cloned dinosaurs.
Description: In need of funds for research, Dr. Alan Grant accepts a large sum of money to accompany Paul and Amanda Kirby on an aerial tour of the infamous Isla Sorna. It isn't long before all hell breaks loose and the stranded wayfarers must fight for survival as a host of new -- and even more deadly -- dinosaurs try to make snacks of them.

Title: Night Hunter
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Minnesota cop crosses paths with a tireless vigilante as they hunt a serial predator of young women.
Description: A Minnesota police officer crosses paths with a committed and tireless vigilante as he follows the trail of a ruthless predator responsible for several abductions and murders.

Title: Orphan: First Kill
Hint: A disturbed Estonian woman escapes an asylum and poses as an American family's long-missing daughter.
Description: After escaping from an Estonian psychiatric facility, Leena Klammer travels to America by impersonating Esther, the missing daughter of a wealthy family. But when her mask starts to slip, she is put against a mother who will protect her family from the murderous “child” at any cost.

Title: Dirty Grandpa
Hint: An uptight lawyer about to marry is tricked into driving his foul-mouthed grandfather to Daytona Beach for spring break.
Description: Jason Kelly is one week away from marrying his boss's uber-controlling daughter, putting him on the fast track for a partnership at the law firm. However, when the straight-laced Jason is tricked into driving his foul-mouthed grandfather, Dick, to Daytona for spring break, his pending nuptials are suddenly in jeopardy.

Title: Nacho Libre
Hint: A cook at a Mexican orphanage moonlights as a masked wrestler to raise money for the kids.
Description: Ignacio, a disrespected cook at a Mexican monastery, can barely afford to feed the orphans who live there. Inspired by a local wrestling hero, he decides to moonlight as the not-so-famous Luchador "___" to earn money for the monastery -- not to mention the admiration of beautiful nun Sister Encarnación.

Title: The Wraith
Hint: A mysterious black supercar driven by a helmeted stranger takes revenge on a gang of street racers in an Arizona town.
Description: Packard Walsh and his motorized gang control and terrorize an Arizona desert town where they force drivers to drag-race so they can 'win' their vehicles. After Walsh beats the decent teenager Jamie Hankins to death after finding him with his girlfriend, a mysterious power creates Jake Kesey, an extremely cool motor-biker who has a car which is invincible.

Title: Six Days Seven Nights
Hint: A New York magazine editor and a grumpy cargo pilot crash-land on a deserted South Pacific island.
Description: In the South Pacific, in Polynesia, on the island of Makatea, Quinn Harris, a taciturn pilot, leads a quiet life, content to earn a living by transporting goods in his De Havilland Beaver. His life is exactly as he wants it to be—until he meets Robin Monroe, a sophisticated and determined woman, the assistant editor of a New York magazine, on vacation for a week with her boyfriend, Frank Martin.

Title: Rock of Ages
Hint: A small-town girl and a city boy chase their dreams on the 1987 Sunset Strip, in a hair-metal musical.
Description: A small town girl and a city boy meet on the Sunset Strip, while pursuing their Hollywood dreams.

Title: Child's Play 2
Hint: A killer doll possessed by a serial killer's soul is rebuilt and hunts the boy he wants to inhabit.
Description: Chucky is reconstructed by a toy factory to dispel the negative publicity surrounding the doll, and tracks young Andy Barclay to a foster home where the chase begins again.

Title: Drop Dead Fred
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An unhappy housewife is visited by her anarchic imaginary friend from childhood.
Description: An unhappy housewife gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, ___.

Title: The Brothers Grimm
Hint: Two con-artist siblings who collect folk tales in 19th-century Germany are forced to investigate a real enchanted forest.
Description: Folklore collectors and con artists, Jake and Will ___, travel from village to village pretending to protect townsfolk from enchanted creatures and performing exorcisms. However, they are put to the test when they encounter a real magical curse in a haunted forest with real magical beings, requiring genuine courage.

Title: Final Destination 5
Hint: A group of coworkers survive a bridge collapse, but death hunts them in the order they were meant to die.
Description: Death is just as omnipresent as ever, and is unleashed after one man’s premonition saves a group of coworkers from a terrifying suspension bridge collapse. But this group of unsuspecting souls was never supposed to survive, and, in a terrifying race against time, the ill-fated group frantically tries to discover a way to escape Death’s sinister agenda.

Title: Reminiscence
Hint: A scientist who lets people relive their memories becomes obsessed with finding a missing woman.
Description: Nicolas Bannister, a rugged and solitary veteran living in a near-future Miami flooded by rising seas, is an expert in a dangerous occupation: he offers clients the chance to relive any memory they desire. His life changes when he meets a mysterious young woman named Mae. What begins as a simple matter of lost and found becomes a passionate love affair.

Title: Hall Pass
Hint: Two married men are given a week off from marriage to do whatever they want.
Description: When best buds Rick and Fred begin to show signs of restlessness at home, their wives take a bold approach to revitalize their marriages, they grant the guys a '___'—one week of freedom to do whatever they want. At first, it seems like a dream come true, but they quickly discover that their expectations of the single life—and themselves—are completely and hilariously out of sync with reality.

Title: Antlers
Hint: A small-town Oregon teacher discovers a young student is hiding a dangerous supernatural creature.
Description: A small-town Oregon teacher and her brother, the local sheriff, discover a young student is harbouring a dangerous secret that could have frightening consequences.

Title: I Now Pronounce You Chuck & Larry
Hint: Two straight Brooklyn firefighters pretend to be a gay couple to get domestic partner benefits.
Description: Firefighters ___ Ford and ___ Valentine are guy's guys, loyal to the core—which is why when widower ___ asks ___ to pose as his lover so that he can get domestic partner benefits for his kids, his buddy agrees.
