However, things get dicey when a bureaucrat comes calling, and the boys are forced to present a picture of domestic bliss.

Title: The Wandering Earth
Hint: As the sun dies, humanity builds giant engines to propel the planet out of the solar system.
Description: When the Sun begins to expand in such a way that it will inevitably engulf and destroy the Earth in a hundred years, united mankind finds a way to avoid extinction by propelling the planet out of the Solar System using gigantic engines, moving it to a new home located four light years away, an epic journey that will last thousands of years.

Title: Premonition
Hint: A grieving widow wakes each day to find her husband alive or dead, as the days of the week jumble.
Description: A depressed housewife who learns her husband was killed in a car accident the day previously, awakens the next morning to find him alive and well at home, and then awakens the day after to a world in which he is still dead.

Title: Bill & Ted Face the Music
Hint: Two middle-aged rockers must write a song to save the world, with the help of their daughters.
Description: Yet to fulfill their rock and roll destiny, the stakes are higher than ever for the now middle-aged ___ who set out on a new adventure when a visitor from the future warns them that only their song can save life as we know it.

Title: Earthquake
Hint: Interconnected people struggle to survive when a massive tremor destroys Los Angeles.
Description: Various interconnected people struggle to survive when an ___ of unimaginable magnitude hits Los Angeles, California.

Title: Vertical Limit
Hint: A climber leads a rescue team up K2 to save his sister trapped in a crevasse.
Description: Trapped near the summit of K2, the world's second-highest mountain, Annie Garrett radios to base camp for help. Brother Peter hears Annie's message and assembles a team to save her and her group before they succumb to K2's unforgiving elements. But, as Annie lays injured in an icy cavern, the rescuers face several terrifying events that could end the rescue attempt -- and their lives.

Title: The Legend of Zorro
Hint: A masked swordsman and his wife clash over his heroics as California prepares to become a state.
Description: Despite trying to keep his swashbuckling to a minimum, a threat to California's pending statehood causes the adventure-loving Don Alejandro de la Vega and his wife, Elena, to take action.

Title: London Has Fallen
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Bulgaria, India
Hint: A secret service agent protects the US president in the UK after terrorists target world leaders.
Description: In London for the Prime Minister's funeral, Mike Banning discovers a plot to assassinate all the attending world leaders.

Title: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter
Hint: A future American president secretly hunts bloodsuckers with an axe to avenge his mother's death.
Description: President ___ mother is killed by a supernatural creature, which fuels his passion to crush vampires and their slave-owning helpers.

Title: The One
Hint: A sheriff's deputy fights an evil version of himself from another universe who has killed his other selves.
Description: A sheriff's deputy fights an alternate universe version of himself who grows stronger with each alternate self he kills.

Title: The Possession
Hint: A young girl buys an antique box at a yard sale, unaware that it contains a malevolent spirit.
Description: A young girl buys an antique box at a yard sale, unaware that inside the collectible lives a malicious ancient spirit. The girl's father teams with his ex-wife to find a way to end the curse upon their child.

Title: The Black Hole
Hint: A spaceship crew discovers a long-lost research vessel hovering at the edge of a cosmic void, captained by a mad scientist.
Description: The explorer craft USS Palomino is returning to Earth after a fruitless 18-month search for extra-terrestrial life when the crew comes upon a supposedly lost ship, the USS Cygnus, hovering near a ___. The ship is controlled by Dr.

Title: Into the Blue
Hint: Four divers in the Bahamas discover a shipwreck full of gold and a crashed drug plane.
Description: When they take some friends on an extreme sport adventure, the last thing Jared and Sam expect to see below the shark-infested waters is a legendary pirate ship rumored to contain millions of dollars in gold. But their good fortune is short-lived, as a ruthless gang of criminals gets word of what they have uncovered.

Title: The Borrowers
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A family of four-inch-tall people secretly living in a house fight to save it from an evil lawyer.
Description: The four-inch-tall Clock family secretly share a house with the normal-sized Lender family, "borrowing" such items as thread, safety pins, batteries and scraps of food. However, their peaceful co-existence is disturbed when evil lawyer Ocious P. Potter steals the will granting title to the house, which he plans to demolish in order to build apartments.

Title: The Void
Hint: A small-town cop and others are trapped in a hospital surrounded by hooded cultists and monsters.
Description: In the middle of a routine patrol, officer Daniel Carter happens upon a blood-soaked figure limping down a deserted stretch of road. He rushes the young man to a nearby rural hospital staffed by a skeleton crew, only to discover that patients and personnel are transforming into something inhuman.

Title: Timecop
Country: United States of America, Japan, Canada
Hint: A futuristic cop who regulates time travel fights a corrupt senator trying to change history.
Description: In 2004, an officer for a security agency that regulates time travel must fend for his life against a shady politician who has a tie to his past.

Title: Conan the Destroyer
Hint: A barbarian warrior is hired by an evil queen to escort a princess on a quest for a magical horn.
Description: ___ is commissioned by the evil queen Taramis to safely escort a teen princess and her powerful bodyguard to a far away castle to retrieve the magic Horn of Dagoth. Unknown to ___, the queen plans to sacrifice the princess when she returns and inherit her kingdom after the bodyguard kills ___.

Title: The Stuff
Hint: A delicious, addictive yogurt-like dessert turns out to be a living organism that takes over its eaters.
Description: Amalgamated Dairies hires David Rutherford, an FBI man turned industrial saboteur, to investigate a popular new product called “the ___,” a new dessert product that is blowing ice cream sales out of the water. Nobody knows how it’s made or what’s in it, but people are lining up to buy it. It's got a delicious flavor to die for!

Title: Gone
Hint: A woman who escaped a kidnapping believes the same man has taken her sister.
Description: Jill Conway is trying to rebuild her life after escaping a terrifying kidnapping. Though she is having a difficult time, she takes small steps toward normalcy by starting a new job and inviting her sister, Molly, to move in with her. Returning home from work one morning, Jill discovers that Molly has vanished, and she is certain that the same man who previously abducted her has returned for revenge.

Title: Street Trash
Hint: A group of hobos melt into multicoloured goo after drinking cheap, 60-year-old liquor.
Description: A group of hobos begin melting into multicolored piles of goo after drinking sixty-year-old liquor. At the same time, the psychotic Vietnam War vet who rules the hobo camp snaps and begins killing at random. Two brothers set out to stop the liquor and the killer.

Title: Drumline
Hint: A talented street drummer from Harlem enrols at a Southern university with a competitive marching band.
Description: A talented street drummer from Harlem enrolls in a Southern university, expecting to lead its marching band's ___ to victory. He initially flounders in his new world, before realizing that it takes more than talent to reach the top.

Title: Look Who's Talking
Hint: A single mother falls for a cab driver, as her baby son comments on everything in a wisecracking voice.
Description: After a single, career-minded woman is left on her own to give birth to the child of a married man, she finds a new romantic chance in a cab driver. Meanwhile, the point-of-view of the newborn baby is narrated through voice-over.

Title: Iron Sky
Hint: In 2018, Nazis who fled to the dark side of the moon in 1945 return to invade Earth.
Description: In the last moments of World War II, a secret Nazi space program evaded destruction by fleeing to the Dark Side of the Moon. During 70 years of utter secrecy, the Nazis construct a gigantic space fortress with a massive armada of flying saucers.

Title: The Funhouse
Hint: Four teens spend the night in a carnival dark ride and are hunted by a deformed killer.
Description: Rebellious teen Amy defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz, and their friends Liz and Richie. Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy "___" horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask.

Title: The Blackcoat's Daughter
Hint: Two young women left alone at a remote Catholic boarding school over winter break are haunted by an evil presence.
Description: Two young women at a prestigious prep school are assailed by an evil, invisible power when they're stranded over winter break.

Title: Daylight
Hint: An explosion traps commuters in a New York tunnel, and an ex-emergency chief must lead them out.
Description: A group of armed robbers fleeing the police head for the New Jersey Tunnel and run right into trucks transporting toxic waste. The spectacular explosion that follows results in both ends of the tunnel collapsing and the handful of people who survived the explosion are now in peril. Kit Latura is the only man with the skill and knowledge to lead the band of survivors out of the tunnel before the structure collapses.

Title: All Eyez on Me
Hint: The rise to superstardom of a legendary West Coast rapper.
Description: ___ chronicles the life and legacy of Tupac Shakur, including his rise to superstardom as a hip-hop artist, actor, poet and activist, as well as his imprisonment and prolific, controversial time at Death Row Records. Against insurmountable odds, Tupac rose to become a cultural icon whose career and persona both continue to grow long after his passing.

Title: It Takes Two
Hint: Two identical nine-year-olds, an orphan and a rich girl, meet at summer camp and switch places.
Description: Identical 9-year-olds from very different backgrounds: orphaned Amanda and wealthy Alyssa meet at summer camp and decide to switch places -- and play matchmaker between Alyssa's dad, Roger, and the kind social worker who cares for Amanda.

Title: Quarantine
Hint: A TV reporter and her cameraman are trapped inside a building quarantined after an outbreak.
Description: A television reporter and her cameraman are trapped inside a building quarantined by the CDC after the outbreak of a mysterious virus which turns humans into bloodthirsty killers.

Title: The Boss Baby: Family Business
Hint: Two grown-up brothers are turned back into kids and go undercover at a school for gifted children.
Description: The Templeton brothers — Tim and his ___ little bro Ted — have become adults and drifted away from each other. But a new ___ with a cutting-edge approach and a can-do attitude is about to bring them together again … and inspire a new ___.

Title: Sirens
Hint: An Anglican clergyman and his wife visit a bohemian artist in 1930s Australia and are tempted by his models.
Description: In 1930s Australia, Anglican clergyman Anthony Campion and his prim wife, Estella, are asked to visit noted painter Norman Lindsay, whose planned contribution to an international art exhibit is considered blasphemous. While Campion and Lindsay debate, Estella finds herself drawn to the three beautiful models sitting for the painter's current work, freethinking Sheela, sensual Pru and virginal Giddy.

Title: Georgia Rule
Hint: A rebellious teen is sent to spend the summer with her strict grandmother in Idaho.
Description: Rebellious, uncontrollable teenager, Rachel is hauled off by her dysfunctional mother to spend the summer with her estranged grandmother, ___. Her journey will lead all three women to revelations of buried family secrets and an understanding that - regardless what happens - the ties that bind can never be broken.

Title: Doomsday
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America, South Africa
Hint: A lethal virus forces Britain to wall off Scotland, and decades later a team goes in to find a cure.
Description: The lethal Reaper virus spreads throughout Britain—infecting millions and killing hundreds of thousands. Authorities brutally and successfully quarantine the country but, three decades later, the virus resurfaces in a major city. An elite group of specialists is urgently dispatched into the still-quarantined country to retrieve a cure by any means necessary.

Title: The Prom
Hint: Fading Broadway stars travel to Indiana to help a lesbian teen take her girlfriend to the school dance.
Description: After the PTA of a conservative high school in Indiana bans same-sex couples from attending the annual ___, a gang of flamboyant Broadway stars try to boost their image by showing up to support two lesbian students.

Title: Fortress
Hint: In the future, a couple who broke a one-child law is sent to a high-tech underground prison.
Description: In the future, the inmates of a private underground prison are computer-controlled with cameras, dream readers, and devices that can cause pain or death. John and his illegally pregnant wife Karen are locked inside "The ___" but are determined to escape before the birth of their baby.

Title: Hide and Seek
Hint: A widowed psychologist's young daughter has an imaginary friend who might be real.
Description: David Callaway tries to piece together his life in the wake of his wife's suicide and has been left to raise his nine-year-old daughter, Emily on his own.

Title: Piranha
Hint: Flesh-eating fish are accidentally released into the rivers of a summer resort.
Description: When flesh-eating piranhas are accidentally released into a summer resort's rivers, the guests become their next meal.

Title: Vegas Vacation
Hint: A bumbling suburban family hits the Nevada strip for a getaway that goes wrong at every casino.
Description: The Griswold family hits the road again for a typically ill-fated vacation, this time to the glitzy mecca of slots and showgirls—Las ___.

Title: Keeping Up with the Joneses
Hint: A suburban couple becomes embroiled in espionage when they discover their new neighbours are spies.
Description: An ordinary suburban couple finds it’s not easy ___ – their impossibly gorgeous and ultra-sophisticated new neighbors – especially when they discover that Mr. and Mrs. “Jones” are covert operatives.

Title: Waiting for the Barbarians
Hint: A colonial magistrate at a remote frontier outpost questions the brutality of a visiting colonel.
Description: At an isolated frontier outpost, a colonial magistrate suffers a crisis of conscience when an army colonel arrives looking to interrogate the locals about an impending uprising, using cruel tactics that horrify the magistrate.

Title: Catch and Release
Hint: A grieving fiancée learns to love again with the help of her late love's three best friends.
Description: For a grieving fiancée, learning to love again requires the help of her late love's three best friends.

Title: The Invasion
Hint: A Washington psychiatrist discovers an alien epidemic that takes over people while they sleep.
Description: Washington, D.C. psychologist Carol Bennell and her colleague Dr. Ben Driscoll are the only two people on Earth who are aware of an epidemic running rampant through the city. They discover an alien virus aboard a crashed space shuttle that transforms anyone who comes into contact with it into unfeeling drones while they sleep.

Title: Cam
Hint: A camgirl finds her online identity has been stolen by a doppelgänger.
Description: A young camgirl discovers that she’s inexplicably been replaced on her site with an exact replica of herself.

Title: Son in Law
Hint: A college surfer spends Thanksgiving with his friend's family on their South Dakota farm.
Description: Country girl Rebecca has spent most of her life on a farm in South Dakota, and, when she goes away to college in Los Angeles, Rebecca immediately feels out of place in the daunting urban setting. She is befriended by a savvy party animal named Crawl, who convinces the ambivalent Rebecca to stay in the city.

Title: Dinner for Schmucks
Hint: An ambitious executive must find the most idiotic person to bring to his boss's monthly party for losers.
Description: Rising executive Tim Conrad works for a boss who hosts a monthly ___ in which the guest who brings the biggest buffoon gets a career-boost. Tim plans on not attending until he meets Barry, a man who builds dioramas using stuffed mice. Barry's blundering but good intentions send Tim's life into a downward spiral, threatening a major business deal and possibly scuttling Tim's engagement to his fiancee.

Title: Fright Night Part 2
Hint: A college student is visited by a vampire seeking revenge for her brother's death.
Description: After three years of therapy Charley Brewster, now a college student, is convinced that Jerry Dandridge was a serial killer posing as a vampire. But when Regine, a mysterious actress and her entourage move into Peter Vincent's apartment block, the nightmare starts again - and this time it's personal!

Hint: A young New Jersey man becomes a bartender at New York's most famous disco in the 1970s.
Description: When the mastermind behind New York's infamous Studio ___ disco plucks young Shane from the sea of faces clamoring to get inside his club, he not only gets his foot in the door, but lands a coveted job behind the bar — and a front-row ticket to the most legendary party on the planet!

Title: My Life in Ruins
Hint: A Greek tour guide tries to get her mojo back by guiding a group of misfit tourists.
Description: A Greek tour guide named Georgia attempts to recapture her kefi (Greek for mojo) by guiding a ragtag group of tourists around Greece and showing them the beauty of her native land. Along the way, she manages to open their eyes to the wonders of an exotic foreign land while beginning to see the world through a new set of eyes in the process.

Title: Game of Death
Country: United States of America, Hong Kong
Hint: A martial arts movie star fakes his own funeral to hunt down the syndicate trying to kill him.
Description: A martial arts movie star must fake his death to find the people who are trying to kill him.

Title: Beyond the Black Rainbow
Hint: In 1983, a young mute woman with psychic abilities is held captive in a mysterious research facility.
Description: In 1983, a young mute woman with psychic abilities is held captive within the Arboria Institute, a secluded futuristic facility overseen by a sinister doctor with an unraveling mind and a growing obsession with her.

Title: Step Up All In
Hint: Dancers from previous films reunite in Las Vegas for a dance competition.
Description: All-stars from previous installments convene in glittering Las Vegas, battling for a victory that could define their dreams and their careers.

Title: She's Having a Baby
Hint: Young newlyweds struggle with married life in the suburbs.
Description: Jake and Kristy Briggs are newlyweds. Being young, they are perhaps a bit unprepared for the full reality of marriage and all that it (and their parents) expect from them. Do they want babies? Their parents certainly want them to. Is married life all that there is? Things certainly aren't helped by Jake's friend Davis, who always seems to turn up just in time to put a spanner in the works.

Title: The Golden Child
Hint: A social worker who specialises in missing children is chosen to rescue a mystical Tibetan boy.
Description: After a Tibetan boy, the mystical ___, is kidnapped by the evil Sardo Numspa, humankind's fate hangs in the balance. On the other side of the world in Los Angeles, the priestess Kee Nang seeks the Chosen One, who will save the boy from death.

Title: Brüno
Hint: A flamboyant Austrian fashion reporter tries to become famous in America.
Description: Flamboyantly gay Austrian television reporter Bruno stirs up trouble with unsuspecting guests and large crowds through brutally frank interviews and painfully hilarious public displays of homosexuality.

Title: Gnomeo & Juliet
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Canada
Hint: Two rival families of garden ornaments fall in love, in an animated Shakespeare adaptation.
Description: A version of Shakespeare's play, set in the world of warring indoor and outdoor gnomes. Garden gnomes ___ have as many obstacles to overcome as their quasi namesakes when they are caught up in a feud between neighbors. But with plastic pink flamingos and lawnmower races in the mix, can this young couple find lasting happiness?

Title: Joe Versus the Volcano
Hint: A hypochondriac told he has six months to live agrees to jump into a lava-filled crater on a tropical island.
Description: Hypochondriac Joe Banks finds out he has six months to live, quits his dead end job, musters the courage to ask his co-worker out on a date, and is then hired to jump into a ___ by a mysterious visitor.

Title: Domino
Hint: A British model's daughter abandons her career to become a bounty hunter.
Description: The story of the life of ___ Harvey, who abandoned her career as a Ford model to become a bounty hunter.

Title: Victor Frankenstein
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A young assistant to an eccentric scientist witnesses his obsessive attempt to create life.
Description: Eccentric scientist ___ Von ___ creates a grotesque creature in an unorthodox scientific experiment.

Title: Spree
Hint: A desperate rideshare driver livestreams a killing rampage to finally go viral.
Description: Desperate for an online following, a rideshare driver has figured out a deadly plan to go viral and he will stop at nothing to get his five minutes of fame.

Title: Grind
Hint: Four skaters follow their idol on his summer tour to get sponsored.
Description: Four skaters follow their idol on his summer tour in an attempt to get noticed, get sponsored, and become stars themselves.

Title: P2
Hint: A businesswoman is locked in a parking garage on Christmas Eve with a deranged security guard.
Description: A businesswoman finds herself locked with a unhinged security guard in a parking garage after getting stuck working late on Christmas Eve.

Title: The 6th Day
Hint: A pilot returns home to find a clone of himself has replaced him.
Description: A world of the very near future in which cattle, fish, and even the family pet can be cloned. But cloning humans is illegal - that is until family man Adam Gibson comes home from work one day to find a clone has replaced him.

Title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
Hint: Two teen best friends defy their strict parents to win a spot on a Chicago TV dance show.
Description: Janey is new in town. She soon meets Lynne, a classmate who shares her passion for the local show 'Dance TV'. When a competition is announced to find new Dance TV performers, Janey and Lynne are determined to audition. The only problem is that Janey's father doesn't approve of that kind of thing.

Title: Office Christmas Party
Hint: A branch manager throws a wild holiday bash to save his tech company branch from being shut down.
Description: When Carol Vanstone, CEO of the technology company Zenotek, expresses her intention to close the Chicago branch, run by her brother Clay, he and his co-workers organize a Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and save their jobs. But the party gets out of control…

Title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run
Country: United States of America, France, Canada
Hint: A porous yellow fry cook and his starfish pal go on a quest to rescue their kidnapped pet snail.
Description: When his best friend Gary is suddenly snatched away, ___ takes Patrick on a madcap mission far beyond Bikini Bottom to save their pink-shelled pal.

Title: The Woman in Red
Hint: A happily married man becomes infatuated with a beautiful woman he sees in a parking garage.
Description: When a happily married family man, who would never consider an affair, meets a beautiful ___, he is totally infatuated and desperate to make her acquaintance. However, as he tries out various schemes to sneak out to meet her, he realizes that adultery is not quite as easy as it looks.

Title: Let's Go to Prison
Hint: A career criminal plots revenge on the son of the judge who locked him up by getting himself sent back inside with him.
Description: When a career criminal's plan for revenge is thwarted by unlikely circumstances, he puts his intended victim's son in his place by putting him in prison...and then joining him.

Title: Pawn Shop Chronicles
Hint: The stories of a missing wife, a couple of meth heads and a rock-and-roll impersonator converge at a rural Southern pawnbroker's.
Description: The stories of a missing wife, a couple of meth heads and an Elvis impersonator are connected by the items found in a small town's ___ shop.

Title: Firefox
Hint: An American pilot is sent to the USSR to steal a revolutionary new fighter jet.
Description: The Soviets have developed a revolutionary new jet fighter, called '___'. Worried that the jet will be used as a first-strike weapon—as there are rumours that it is undetectable by radar—the British send ex-Vietnam War pilot, Mitchell Gant on a covert mission into the Soviet Union to steal the ___.

Title: The Fan
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An unhinged knife salesman stalks a baseball star he believes has disrespected the team.
Description: When the San Francisco Giants pay center-fielder, Bobby Rayburn $40 million to lead their team to the World Series, no one is happier or more supportive than #1 ___, Gil Renard. When Rayburn becomes mired in the worst slump of his career, the obsessed Renard decides to stop at nothing to help his idol regain his former glory—not even murder.

Title: Dirty Dancing: Havana Nights
Hint: An American teenage girl in pre-revolution Cuba falls for a waiter who teaches her to dance.
Description: In pre-revolution Cuba, Katey Miller is about to defy everyone's expectations. Instead of a parent-approved suitor, Katey is drawn to the sexy waiter, Javier, who spends his ___ in ___ nightclubs. As she secretly learns to dance with Javier, she learns the meanings of love, sensuality and independence.

Title: Marked for Death
Hint: A retired DEA agent takes on a Jamaican drug gang in his hometown.
Description: Just retired from the Drug Enforcement Agency, John Hatcher returns to his hometown and quickly discovers that drugs have infiltrated his old neighborhood. Determined to drive the dealers out, Hatcher crosses paths with a ferocious Jamaican drug lord who vows that Hatcher and his family are now ___.

Title: Playing It Cool
Hint: A man who doesn't believe in love falls for an engaged woman.
Description: A young man meets and instantly falls in love with an engaged woman.

Title: Jane Got a Gun
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A woman asks her ex-lover to help defend her farm from her husband's old gang.
Description: After her outlaw husband returns home shot with eight bullets and barely alive, ___ reluctantly reaches out to an ex-lover who she hasn't seen in over ten years to help her defend her farm when the time comes that her husband's gang eventually tracks him down to finish the job.

Title: American Outlaws
Hint: A gang of Missouri bandits fights a corrupt railroad baron in a revisionist Western.
Description: When a Midwest town learns that a corrupt railroad baron has captured the deeds to their homesteads without their knowledge, a group of young ranchers join forces to take back what is rightfully theirs. They will become the object of the biggest manhunt in the history of the Old West and, as their fame grows, so will the legend of their leader, a young outlaw by the name of Jesse James.

Title: Mary Magdalene
Country: Australia, Italy, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: In the first century, a free-spirited woman flees an arranged marriage to follow a new religious movement.
Description: In the first century, free-spirited ___ flees the marriage her family has arranged for her, finding refuge and a sense of purpose in a radical new movement led by the charismatic, rabble-rousing preacher named Jesus.

Title: Nancy Drew
Hint: A teen detective heads to Hollywood to investigate the unsolved murder of a movie star.
Description: Intrepid teenage private eye ___ heads to Tinseltown with her father to investigate the unsolved murder of a movie star in this old-fashioned whodunit based on Carolyn Keene's popular series of books for young adults. But can the small-town girl cut through the Hollywood hype to solve the case?

Title: The X-Files: I Want to Believe
Hint: Two former FBI agents return to investigate the disappearance of an agent and a psychic priest.
Description: Mulder and Scully are called back to duty by the FBI when a former priest claims to be receiving psychic visions pertaining to a kidnapped agent.

Title: Passenger 57
Hint: An airline security specialist must stop a hijacking by a terrorist.
Description: Airline security specialist John Cutter, finally returning to the job after his wife's death, finds himself stuck on a flight being hijacked by notorious terrorist Charles Rane. Unfortunately for the terrorists, they're also stuck with him.

Title: Red Tails
Country: United States of America, Czech Republic, Italy, Slovenia
Hint: The first African-American pilots to fly in a combat squadron during WWII.
Description: The story of the Tuskegee Airmen, the first African-American pilots to fly in a combat squadron during World War II.

Title: Captain Corelli's Mandolin
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An Italian officer falls for a fisherman's fiancée on a Greek island during WWII.
Description: When a fisherman leaves to fight with the Greek army during World War II, his fiancée falls in love with the local Italian commander.

Title: Fatman
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Canada
Hint: A rowdy, unorthodox Santa fights to save his business while a hitman hired by a child hunts him.
Description: A rowdy, unorthodox Santa Claus is fighting to save his declining business. Meanwhile, Billy, a neglected and precocious 12 year old, hires a hit man to kill Santa after receiving a lump of coal in his stocking.

Title: The Incredible Burt Wonderstone
Hint: A pair of Vegas magicians face a rival street magician.
Description: After breaking up with his longtime stage partner, a famous but jaded Vegas magician fights for relevance when a new, "hip" street magician appears on the scene.

Title: Braven
Hint: A logger defends his family from a group of dangerous drug runners.
Description: A logger defends his family from a group of dangerous drug runners.

Title: Hard Rain
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Denmark, France, Japan, Germany
Hint: An armoured car guard tries to elude thieves while a flood ravages a small town.
Description: An armored car driver tries to elude a gang of thieves while a flood ravages the countryside.

Title: Harriet the Spy
Hint: A sixth-grade girl who wants to be a writer spies on her friends and neighbours.
Description: ___ may only be in the sixth grade, but she's already found her calling: to be a spy. In a private journal she takes everywhere, ___ records suspicious activity and keeps a running list of observations on virtually everyone she knows. It seems harmless enough until, one day, someone finds the journal and exposes ___ critical thoughts about her classmates.

Title: Hardware
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A robot reassembles itself in a post-apocalyptic apartment and goes on a rampage.
Description: Mark 13 is a government-built killing machine programmed with artificial intelligence, able to repair and recharge itself from any energy source. Through a series of coincidences, the cyborg's head ends up in the home of a sculptress as a bizarre Christmas present from her boyfriend.

Title: Return of the Living Dead III
Hint: A young man revives his girlfriend after a motorcycle accident and she becomes a zombie.
Description: Having recently witnessed the horrific results of a top secret project to bring the dead back to life, a distraught teenager performs the operation on his girlfriend after she's killed in a motorcycle accident.

Title: Wasp Network
Hint: A group of Cuban spies infiltrate anti-Castro groups in Miami.
Description: Havana, Cuba, 1990. René González, an airplane pilot, unexpectedly flees the country, leaving behind his wife Olga and his daughter Irma, and begins a new life in Miami, where he becomes a member of an anti-Castro organization.

Title: Curly Sue
Hint: A drifter and his little girl con a rich lawyer.
Description: Bill is a penniless drifter who scams strangers out of just enough money to feed himself and his partner in crime, an orphan girl known as ___. Bill and ___ target Grey, a yuppie lawyer, but their con takes an unexpected turn when the successful woman begins to like the ramshackle duo. But there's one problem—Grey's jealous, conniving boyfriend, Walker.

Title: Undercover Brother
Hint: A secret agent fights against a white conspiracy in a blaxploitation spoof.
Description: An Afro-American organization, the B.R.O.T.H.E.R.H.O.O.D., is in permanent fight against a white organization "The Man" defending the values of the black people in North America. When the Afro-American candidate Gen. Warren Boutwell behaves strangely in his presidential campaign, ___ is hired to work undercover for "The Man" and find what happened with the potential candidate.

Title: Men at Work
Hint: Two garbage men find a politician's body in a trash can and stumble onto a conspiracy.
Description: Two garbage men find the body of a city councilman in a trash can on their route. With help from a supervisor, the duo must solve the case and find the man's killer while hiding the body from the cops.

Title: The Captive
Hint: Eight years after their daughter's abduction, a couple find clues that she is still alive.
Description: Eight years after their daughter Cassandra's abduction tore them apart, an estranged couple discover disturbing clues that indicate that she is still alive.

Title: The Prowler
Hint: A cop's affair with a married woman leads to murder.
Description: Los Angeles, California. A cop who, unhappy with his job, blames others for his work problems, is assigned to investigate the case of a ___ who stalks the home of a married woman.

Title: Southbound
Hint: Five stories set on a desolate desert highway, where travellers face their nightmares.
Description: The film contains five stories set on desolate stretches of a desert highway. Two men on the run from their past, a band on its way to a gig, a man struggling to get home, a brother in search of his long-lost sister and a family on vacation are forced to confront their worst fears and darkest secrets in these interwoven tales.

Title: Why Did I Get Married?
Hint: Four couples who were college friends take a getaway to reassess their relationships.
Description: Eight married college friends plus one other non-friend (all of whom have achieved middle to upper class economic status) go to Colorado for their annual week-long reunion, but the mood shifts when one couple's infidelity comes to light. As secrets are revealed, each couple begins to question their own relationship.

Title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
Hint: A Chicago hair salon crew fights back against rising gang violence in their neighbourhood.
Description: To survive harsh economic times, Calvin and Angie have merged the ___ and beauty salon into one business. The days of male bonding are gone as Eddie and the crew must now contend with sassy female co-workers and spirited clientele. As the battle of the sexes rages on, a different kind of conflict has taken over Chicago. Crime and gangs are on the rise, leaving Calvin worried about the fate of his son.

Title: Planes: Fire & Rescue
Hint: A famous racer joins a firefighting team when his engine is damaged.
Description: When world-famous air racer Dusty learns that his engine is damaged and he may never race again, he must shift gears and is launched into the world of aerial firefighting. Dusty joins forces with veteran ___ and rescue helicopter Blade Ranger and his team, a bunch of all-terrain vehicles known as The Smokejumpers.

Title: Jumpin' Jack Flash
Hint: A bank computer operator receives a coded message from a British spy in trouble.
Description: Terry works for a bank, and uses computers to communicate with clients all over the world. One day, she gets a strange coded message from an unknown source. After decoding the message, Terry becomes embroiled in an espionage ring. People are killed, and Terry is chased. Throughout, she remains in contact with this mysterious person, who needs Terry's help save his life.

Title: Ride Along 2
Hint: A security guard turned rookie cop heads to Miami with his brother-in-law to take down a drug lord.
Description: As his wedding day approaches, Ben heads to Miami with his soon-to-be brother-in-law James to bring down a drug dealer who's supplying the dealers of Atlanta with product.

Title: True Memoirs of an International Assassin
Hint: A writer's thriller novel is marketed as non-fiction, and he's kidnapped in Venezuela as a real hitman.
Description: After a publisher changes a writer's debut novel about a deadly assassin from fiction to nonfiction, the author finds himself thrust into the world of his lead character, and must take on the role of his character for his own survival.

Title: Isn't It Romantic
Hint: An Australian architect in New York gets hit on the head and wakes up inside a cheesy rom-com.
Description: For a long time, Natalie, an Australian architect living in New York City, had always believed that what she had seen in rom-coms is all fantasy. But after thwarting a mugger at a subway station only to be knocked out while fleeing, Natalie wakes up and discovers that her life has suddenly become her worst nightmare—a romantic comedy—and she is the leading lady.

Title: Holy Smoke
Hint: A young woman under the influence of a guru is deprogrammed by an American expert.
Description: While on a journey of discovery in exotic India, beautiful young Ruth Barron falls under the influence of a charismatic religious guru. Her desperate parents then hire PJ Waters, a macho cult de-programmer who confronts Ruth in a remote desert hideaway. But PJ quickly learns that he's met his match in the sexy, intelligent and iron-willed Ruth.

Title: Igor
Hint: A hunchbacked assistant to an evil scientist aspires to be a mad scientist himself.
Description: A cliché hunchbacked evil scientist's assistant aspires to become a scientist himself, much to the displeasure of the rest of the evil science community.

Title: The Tall Man
Country: Canada, France, United States of America
Hint: A mother searches for her child, who has been taken by a mysterious figure in a dying mining town.
Description: When her child goes missing, a mother looks to unravel the legend of the ___, an entity who allegedly abducts children.

Title: Guess Who
Hint: An African-American woman's father doesn't approve of her white fiancé.
Description: When a young African-American woman brings her fiancé home to meet her parents, she's neglected to mention one tiny detail – he's white.

Title: 3000 Miles to Graceland
Hint: Two ex-cons rob a Las Vegas casino during a rock-and-roll impersonator convention.
Description: It was an ingenious enough plan: rob the Riviera Casino's count room during an Elvis impersonator convention. But Thomas Murphy decided to keep all the money for himself and shot all his partners, including recently-freed ex-con Michael Zane. With $3.2 million at stake, the Marshals Service closing in, Michael must track down Murphy.

Title: Tiger Zinda Hai
Hint: An Indian agent leads a mission to rescue nurses held hostage by terrorists in Iraq.
Description: When a group of Indian and Pakistani nurses are held hostage in Iraq by a terrorist organization, a renowned Indian secret agent is drawn out of hiding to rescue them.

Title: Rust Creek
Hint: A college senior takes a wrong turn and is hunted by thugs in the Kentucky woods.
Description: When an overachieving college senior makes a wrong turn, her road trip becomes a life-changing fight for survival in rural Kentucky.

Title: Dragon Blade
Hint: A Han commander in ancient China teams up with a Roman general to protect the Silk Road.
Description: Huo An, the commander of the Protection Squad of the Western Regions, was framed by evil forces and becomes enslaved. On the other hand, a Roman general escapes to China after rescuing the Prince. The heroic duo meet in the Western Desert and a thrilling story unfolds.

Title: Very Good Girls
Hint: Two inseparable New York teens make a pact to lose their virginity during the summer, then fall for the same guy.
Description: Two New York City girls make a pact to lose their virginity during their first summer out of high school. When they both fall for the same street artist, the friends find their connection tested for the first time.

Title: Another 48 Hrs.
Hint: A cop and a criminal team up again to stop a drug kingpin.
Description: For the past four years, San Francisco cop Jack Cates has been after an unidentified drug kingpin who calls himself the Ice Man. Jack finds a picture that proves that the Ice Man has put a price on the head of Reggie Hammond, who is scheduled to be released from prison on the next day.

Title: Encounter
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Marine rescues his sons from an alien infection.
Description: A decorated Marine goes on a rescue mission to save his two young sons from an unhuman threat. As their journey takes them in increasingly dangerous directions, the boys will need to leave their childhoods behind.

Title: Mad Money
Hint: Three female employees of the Federal Reserve plot to steal old banknotes set to be destroyed.
Description: Three female employees of the Federal Reserve plot to steal money that is about to be destroyed.

Title: Kidnap
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A mother chases her son's kidnappers in her minivan.
Description: A mother (in her Minivan) stops at nothing to recover her kidnapped son.

Title: The Presidio
Hint: A civilian detective investigates a murder on a military base with his old commander.
Description: Jay Austin is now a civilian police detective. Colonel Caldwell was his commanding officer years before when he left the military police over a disagreement over the handling of a drunk driver. Now a series of murders that cross jurisdictions force them to work together again. That Austin is now dating Caldwell's daughter is not helping their relationship.

Title: This Island Earth
Hint: Aliens disguised as humans recruit our planet's top scientists to help save their own dying world.
Description: Aliens have landed and are hiding on Earth, but need Earth’s scientists to help them fight an inter-planetary war.

Title: The Road to Wellville
Hint: An unhappy couple visit an eccentric health spa run by a cereal pioneer.
Description: An unhappy young couple visit the infamous Kellogg spa in Battle Creek, Michigan while a young hustler tries get into the breakfast-cereal business and compete against John Kellogg's corn flakes.

Title: Mortal
Country: United Kingdom, Norway, United States of America
Hint: A young boy in Norway must discover the origins of his extraordinary powers.
Description: A young boy must discover the origins of his extraordinary powers before he is captured by authorities hell-bent on condemning him for an accidental murder.

Title: 88 Minutes
Country: United States of America, Germany, Canada
Hint: A forensic psychiatrist receives a call saying he has less than an hour and a half to live.
Description: Famed forensic psychiatrist Dr. Jack Gramm enjoys a reputation as one of the most sought-after profilers around. His expert testimony has resulted in the conviction of many criminals, including serial killer Jon Forster.

Title: We Are What We Are
Hint: A reclusive family's secret cannibal customs are threatened by a flood.
Description: The Parkers, reclusive people who cling to ancient customs, find their secret lives threatened when a torrential downpour and the death of the family matriarch forces daughters Iris and Rose to assume special responsibilities.

Title: Homeward Bound II: Lost in San Francisco
Hint: Two dogs and a cat escape at an airport and must find their way home through a big California city.
Description: When the pets accidentally get separated from their vacationing owners, Chance, Shadow, and Sassy navigate the mean streets of San ___, trying to find their home across the Golden Gate Bridge. But the road is blocked by a series of hazards, both man and beast.

Title: A Fall from Grace
Hint: A law-abiding woman is indicted for murdering her husband.
Description: When a law-abiding woman gets indicted for murdering her husband, her lawyer soon realizes that a larger conspiracy may be at work.

Title: Who's Harry Crumb?
Hint: A bumbling, inept private investigator is hired to find a kidnapped heiress and botches every clue.
Description: Harry ___ is a bumbling and inept private investigator who is hired to solve the kidnapping of a young heiress which he's not expected to solve because his employer is the mastermind behind the kidnapping.

Title: Freaks of Nature
Hint: In a small town, humans, vampires and zombies live in peace, until an alien invasion.
Description: In the town of Dillford, humans, vampires and zombies were all living in peace - until the alien apocalypse arrived. Now three teenagers-one human, one vampire, and one zombie-have to team up to figure out how to get rid of the visitors.

Title: Final Analysis
Hint: A psychiatrist falls for the sister of his patient.
Description: A psychiatrist becomes romantically involved with the sister of one of his patients, but the influence of her controlling gangster husband threatens to destroy them both.

Title: Sanctum
Hint: An underwater cave diving team is trapped by a storm and must find another way out.
Description: Master diver Frank McGuire has explored the South Pacific's Esa-ala Caves for months. But when his exit is cut off in a flash flood, Frank's team—including 17-year-old son Josh and financier Carl Hurley are forced to radically alter plans. With dwindling supplies, the crew must navigate an underwater labyrinth to make it out.

Title: Sex and Death 101
Hint: A man receives an email with a list of every woman he will ever sleep with.
Description: A guy's life is turned around by an email, which includes the names of everyone he's had sex with and ever will have sex with. His situation gets worse when he encounters a femme fatale who targets men guilty of sex crime.

Title: Pathology
Hint: A top medical student joins an elite group of forensic doctors who play a deadly game of perfect murders.
Description: Medical student Ted Grey graduates at the top of his class and quickly joins an elite ___ program, whose top students invite him into their circle. There he uncovers a gruesome secret: They play a game in which one tries to commit the perfect, undetectable murder, then the others compete to determine the victim's cause of death.

Title: 7 Days in Entebbe
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Four hijackers take over a plane, and Israeli commandos launch a rescue.
Description: In 1976, four hijackers take over an Air France airplane en route from Tel Aviv to Paris and force it to land in ___, Uganda. With 248 passengers on board, one of the most daring rescue missions ever is set in motion.

Title: Duplex
Hint: A couple's dream house comes with a nightmare elderly tenant upstairs.
Description: When a young couple buys their dream home, they have no idea what the sweet little old lady upstairs is going to put them through!

Title: The Rugrats Movie
Hint: Toddlers get lost in the woods while trying to return a new baby.
Description: The Pickles family welcome a new arrival, Dil, whose constant crying and need for attention quickly exhaust the other toddlers. Seeking to return the "broken" baby to the hospital, the gang embarks on a journey in a Reptar Wagon that inadvertently veers off course, leaving them stranded in a vast, dangerous forest.

Title: Tokyo Gore Police
Hint: A cop in a futuristic Japanese capital battles mutants who turn their wounds into weapons.
Description: In a futuristic ___ where police have been privatized and bitter self-mutilation is so casual that advertising is often specially geared to the 'cutter' demographic, Ruka is on a mission to avenge her father's assassination. Ruka is a cop from a squad whose goal is to destroy homicidal mutant humans known as 'engineers', that possess the ability to transform any injury to a weapon in and of itself.

Title: Phantom
Hint: A Soviet submarine captain must stop rogue KGB agents.
Description: The haunted Captain of a Soviet submarine holds the fate of the world in his hands. Forced to leave his family behind, he is charged with leading a covert mission cloaked in mystery.

Title: The Prodigy
Hint: A mother concerned about her son's disturbing behaviour thinks he is possessed.
Description: A mother concerned about her young son's disturbing behavior thinks something supernatural may be affecting him.

Title: Must Love Dogs
Hint: A newly divorced woman rediscovers romance through online dating.
Description: Sarah Nolan is a newly divorced woman cautiously rediscovering romance with the enthusiastic but often misguided help of her well-meaning family. As she braves a series of hilarious disastrous mismatches and first dates, Sarah begins to trust her own instincts again and learns that, no matter what, it's never a good idea to give up on love.

Title: Man Down
Hint: A Marine returns home from Afghanistan to find America devastated.
Description: When a U.S. Marine returns home from Afghanistan, he finds that the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, he searches desperately for the whereabouts of his estranged son and wife.

Title: Kuffs
Hint: A slacker takes over his brother's police district after his murder.
Description: George ___ didn't finish high-school, just lost his job, and his college-age girlfriend is pregnant. To top it off, George's brother Brad is killed and George inherits Brad's "patrol special" privatized police district and all the problems that come with it.

Title: Canadian Bacon
Hint: A US president tries to boost his popularity by starting a cold war with Canada.
Description: The U.S. President, low in the opinion polls, gets talked into raising his popularity by trying to start a cold war with Canada.

Title: Henry's Crime
Hint: An aimless man is sent to prison for a bank robbery he didn't commit, then decides to do it for real.
Description: An aimless man is sent to prison for a crime he did not commit, an ex-con targets the same bank he was sent away for robbing.

Title: iBoy
Hint: A teenager wakes from a coma to discover he can control electronics.
Description: After an accident, Tom wakes from a coma to discover that fragments of his smart phone have been embedded in his head, and worse, that returning to normal teenage life is impossible because he has developed a strange set of super powers.

Title: Robinson Crusoe
Hint: A man is shipwrecked on a deserted island and befriends a native.
Description: ___ flees Britain on a ship after killing his friend over the love of Mary. A fierce ocean storm wrecks his ship and leaves him stranded by himself on an uncharted island. Left to fend for himself, ___ seeks out a tentative survival on the island, until he meets Friday, a tribesman whom he saves from being sacrificed.

Title: Gossip
Hint: Three college students spread a false rumour that spirals out of control.
Description: For a class project, three college students decide to invent an unfounded rumor about the most popular girl on campus. But as the rumor spreads, it begins to spiral out of control.

Title: Analyze That
Hint: A mob boss is released from prison and needs his therapist's help.
Description: The mafia's Paul Vitti is back in prison and will need some serious counseling when he gets out. Naturally, he returns to his analyst Dr. Ben Sobel for help and finds that Sobel needs some serious help himself as he has inherited the family practice, as well as an excess stock of stress.

Title: Blind Date
Hint: A workaholic bachelor's set-up evening with a beautiful woman goes haywire when she gets drunk.
Description: When bachelor Walter Davis is set up with his sister-in-law's pretty cousin, Nadia Gates, a seemingly average ___ turns into a chaotic night on the town. Walter's brother, Ted, tells him not to let Nadia drink alcohol, but he dismisses the warning and her behaviour gets increasingly wild. Walter and Nadia's numerous incidents are made even worse as her former lover David relentlessly follows them around town.

Title: Then She Found Me
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A New York schoolteacher is approached by her birth mother.
Description: A New York schoolteacher experiences a midlife crisis when, in quick succession, her husband leaves, her adoptive mother dies, and her biological mother, an eccentric talk show host, materializes and turns her life upside down as she begins a courtship with the father of one of her students.

Title: Kiss of Death
Hint: An ex-con trying to go straight must face a crazed criminal.
Description: An ex-con trying to go straight must face a crazed criminal out for revenge.

Title: Demons 2
Hint: Tenants are trapped in a high-rise infested with bloodthirsty creatures that burst out of a TV.
Description: A group of tenants and visitors are trapped in a 10-story high-rise apartment building infested with ___ who proceed to hunt the dwindling humans down.

Title: Wiener-Dog
Hint: A dachshund passes from owner to owner, each with their own sad story.
Description: A dachshund passes from oddball owner to oddball owner, whose radically dysfunctional lives are all impacted by the pooch.

Title: 200 Cigarettes
Hint: Twentysomethings try to cope with relationships on New Year's Eve 1981.
Description: In 1981 New York City, a collection of twentysomethings try to cope with relationships, loneliness, desire and their individual neuroses on New Years Eve.

Title: Vice Versa
Hint: A workaholic father and his young son magically swap bodies thanks to a mysterious skull.
Description: A mysterious oriental skull transforms a father into his son, and ___.

Title: Batman and Harley Quinn
Hint: A superhero duo team up with a villainess to stop a plan to turn humans into plants.
Description: ___ and Nightwing are forced to team with the Joker's sometimes-girlfriend ___ to stop a global threat brought about by Poison Ivy and Jason Woodrue, the Floronic Man.

Title: The Children
Hint: A Christmas vacation turns into a terrifying fight for survival when the kids turn murderous.
Description: A relaxing Christmas vacation turns into a terrifying fight for survival as the ___ begin to turn on their parents.

Title: Special Correspondents
Hint: A radio journalist and his technician fake reports from a war zone in Ecuador.
Description: A radio journalist and his technician get in over their heads when they hatch a scheme to fake their own kidnapping during a rebel uprising in South America and hide out in New York instead.

Title: Chi-Raq
Hint: A modern-day adaptation of an ancient Greek comedy about women on a sex strike to stop gang violence in Chicago.
Description: A modern day adaptation of the ancient Greek play Lysistrata by Aristophanes, set against the backdrop of gang violence in Chicago.

Title: G.B.F.
Hint: A gay student becomes the most popular accessory for three popular girls.
Description: The bitter fight for supremacy between the three most popular girls at North Gateway High takes an unexpected turn when their classmate, Tanner, is outed and becomes the school’s first openly gay student. The trio races to bag the big trend in fashion accessories, the Gay Best Friend, while Tanner must decide whether his skyrocketing popularity is more important than the friendships he is leaving behind.

Title: Reno 911!: Miami
Hint: A bumbling squad of Nevada sheriff's deputies heads to a Florida cop convention and must save the day.
Description: A rag-tag team of ___ cops are called in to save the day after a terrorist attack disrupts a national police convention in ___ Beach during spring break. Based on the Comedy Central series.

Title: Honeymoon in Vegas
Hint: A commitment-shy private eye loses his fiancée in a poker game to a smooth gambler for a weekend.
Description: On her deathbed, a mother makes her son promise never to get married, which scars him with psychological blocks to a commitment with his girlfriend. They finally decide to tie the knot in ___, but a wealthy gambler arranges for the man to lose $65K in a poker game and offers to clear the debt for a weekend with his fiancée.

Title: Backtrack
Hint: A troubled psychotherapist realises all his patients are ghosts and returns to his hometown to uncover a buried secret.
Description: Troubled psychotherapist Peter Bowers is suffering from nightmares and eerie visions. When he uncovers a horrifying secret that all of his patients share, he is put on a course that takes him back to the small hometown he fled years ago. There he confronts his demons and unravels a mystery 20 years in the making.

Title: Just Wright
Hint: A physical therapist falls for the NBA star she's helping recover from a career-threatening injury.
Description: Physical therapist Leslie ___ lands the dream job of working with basketball superstar Scott McKnight, helping him recover from a career-threatening injury. All goes well and soon Leslie finds herself falling in love with him.

Title: Welcome to Me
Hint: A woman with borderline personality disorder wins the lottery and buys her own daytime talk show.
Description: A year in the life of Alice Klieg, a woman with Borderline personality disorder who wins the Mega Millions lottery, quits her meds and buys her own talk show.

Title: Billy Bathgate
Hint: In 1935, a street kid from the Bronx becomes the protégé of a notorious gangster and falls for his girlfriend.
Description: In the year 1935, a teen named ___ finds first love while becoming the protégé of fledgling gangster Dutch Schultz.

Title: The Distinguished Gentleman
Hint: A Florida con man uses the death of a congressman with the same name to get elected.
Description: A Florida con man uses the recent death of the long time Congressman from his district, who he just happens to share a last name with, to get elected to his version of paradise, the U.S. Congress, where the money flows from lobbyists.

Title: Mickey Blue Eyes
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A British auctioneer in New York proposes to his girlfriend, only to discover her family is in the Mafia.
Description: An English auctioneer proposes to the daughter of a mafia kingpin, only to realize that certain "favors" would be asked of him.

Title: School for Scoundrels
Hint: A hapless clerk enrols in a college that teaches the art of one-upmanship to win the girl he loves.
Description: Hapless Henry Palfrey is patronised by his self-important chief clerk at work, ignored by restaurant waiters, conned by shady second-hand car salesmen, and, worst of all, endlessly wrong-footed by unspeakably rotten cad Raymond Delauney who has set his cap at April, new love of Palfrey's life. In desperation Henry enrolls at the College of Lifemanship to learn how to best such bounders and win the girl.

Title: F/X2
Hint: A movie effects wizard turned toymaker is drawn into a police sting that ends in murder and stolen gold.
Description: F/X man Rollie Tyler is now a toymaker. Mike, the ex-husband of his girlfriend Kim, is a cop. He asks Rollie to help catch a killer. The operation goes well until some unknown man kills both the killer and Mike. Mike's boss, Silak says it was the killer who killed Mike but Rollie knows it wasn't.

Title: Cockneys vs Zombies
Hint: A group of East Enders arm themselves to rescue their grandad's retirement home from the undead.
Description: A group of ___ arm themselves to rescue their elderly relative and his retirement home friends who are trapped and fighting off a zombie attack during a zombie apocalypse in the East End of London.

Title: Trapped in Paradise
Hint: Three brothers rob a bank in a friendly Pennsylvania town on Christmas Eve and get stuck there.
Description: Residents of a friendly Pennsylvania town foil three brothers' plan to rob a bank on Christmas Eve.

Title: Love Hostel
Hint: A young couple who married against their families' wishes are hunted by a ruthless hitman in rural India.
Description: Set against the pulsating backdrop of rustic North India, ___ traces the volatile journey of star-crossed lovers, being hunted by a ruthless mercenary on the orders of the area's MLA, who also happens to be the girl's grandmother.

Title: Deathwatch
Hint: A British infantry company in WWI takes a German trench where something supernatural is lurking.
Description: In the brutal trench fighting of the First World War, a British Infantry Company is separated from their regiment after a fierce battle. Attempting to return to their lines, the British soldiers discover what appears to be a bombed out German trench, abandoned except for a few dazed German soldiers.

Title: The Machine Girl
Genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Crime, Horror, Thriller
Hint: A Japanese schoolgirl whose arm was cut off by yakuza replaces it with a gatling gun for bloody revenge.
Description: The life of a young, Japanese schoolgirl is destroyed when her family is killed by a Ninja-Yakuza family. Her hand cut off, she replaces it with various machines-of-death, and seeks revenge.

Title: Grand Piano
Country: Spain, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A pianist with stage fright receives a threat during a concert that he will be killed if he plays a wrong note.
Description: Tom Selznick, the most talented pianist of his generation, stopped performing in public because of his stage fright. Years after a catastrophic performance, he reappears in public in a long awaited concert in Chicago. Just moments after starting his performance in the packed theater, in front of an expectant audience, Tom finds a threatening message written on the score: 'Play one wrong note and you die'.

Title: The Ring Two
Hint: A single mother and her son move to Oregon, but the vengeful spirit from a cursed videotape follows them.
Description: After the ordeal with Samara, Rachel and Aiden move to a rural town. But soon Rachel learns about the death of a girl in a similar fashion. To save Aiden, she must dig into Samara's past even further.

Title: Life Stinks
Hint: A billionaire bets that he can survive for 30 days as a homeless man on the streets of Los Angeles.
Description: Affluent and arrogant businessman Goddard Bolt, feuding with rival Vance Crasswell over a land deal, makes a bet with Crasswell that he has the wits and street smarts to live penniless and anonymous on the rough streets of Los Angeles for thirty days. But Bolt has a rude awakening when the reality of homelessness hits him.

Title: The Horde
Hint: Crooked cops raid a crumbling Paris tower block to avenge a colleague and face a swarm of the undead.
Description: A bunch of crooked cops raid a ruined building in an impoverished suburb of Paris to avenge the death of one of them, but the building becomes a deathly trap when the living, turned into the undead by a mysterious plague, begin to devour the world.

Title: Crimson Rivers 2: Angels of the Apocalypse
Hint: A French detective investigates a series of killings linked to a monastery and a hidden treasure.
Description: No one is safe when seemingly random killings emerge as a deadly pattern intended to usher in the end of the world. A murder victim with the same DNA as Christ. A serial killer mimicking the deaths of the 12 Apostles.

Title: Haunter
Hint: A teenage girl stuck in a time loop realises she's a ghost and must save another family from a killer.
Description: A teenager is stuck in a time loop that is not quite the same each time. She must uncover the truth but her actions have consequences for herself and others.

Title: Police Story: Lockdown
Hint: A Beijing detective is taken hostage in a nightclub by a man seeking to free a prisoner, in a tense siege.
Description: A man looking for the release of a long-time prisoner takes a police officer, his daughter, and a group of strangers hostage.

Title: Hyde Park on Hudson
Hint: A US president's affair with his distant cousin, during a visit by the British king and queen.
Description: The story of the love affair between FDR and his distant cousin Margaret Stuckley, centered around the weekend in 1939 when the King and Queen of the United Kingdom visited upstate New York.

Title: Lucky You
Hint: A professional poker player whose luck at the table fails in love meets a singer in Las Vegas.
Description: A professional poker player whose astounding luck at the table fails to translate into his lonesome love life attempts to win the World Series of Poker while simultaneously earning the affections of a beautiful Las Vegas singer.

Title: The Night Listener
Hint: A radio show host befriends a young fan, then begins to question whether the boy is real.
Description: In the midst of his crumbling relationship, a radio show host begins speaking to his biggest fan—a young boy—via the telephone. But when questions about the boy's identity come up, the host's life is thrown into chaos.

Title: Immortal
Hint: In a futuristic New York occupied by ancient Egyptian gods, a winged deity seeks a woman to bear his child.
Description: In the distant future, Earth is occupied by ancient gods and genetically altered humans. When a god is sentenced to death he seeks a new human host and a woman to bear his child.

Title: The Babe
Hint: The life of a legendary home-run slugger, from his days in a Baltimore orphanage to New York stardom.
Description: A chronicle of ___ Ruth's phenomenal story--from his hard knock beginnings at a Baltimore orphanage, to his meteoric rise to baseball superstardom and his poignant retirement from the game. His amazing career included seven American League pennants, four World Series championships, two tempestuous marriages and a wild lifestyle that earned him numerous suspensions.

Title: Waiting for Forever
Hint: A lovesick drifter follows his childhood sweetheart to their hometown, where her life is falling apart.
Description: A Hollywood-set romantic tale of a guy who is content to live his life without a job yet with the love of his life, a young actress.

Title: Thalaivi
Hint: The biopic of a film star turned chief minister of Tamil Nadu.
Description: The biopic charts the life of actor-turned-chief minister J. Jayalalitha and the relationship paving her rapid yet complicated path to power, who served five terms as the Chief Minister for the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.

Title: The Darwin Awards
Hint: An insurance investigator and a fainting criminologist investigate deaths caused by sheer stupidity.
Description: After botching the capture of a notorious serial killer, idiosyncratic detective Michael Burrows loses his job with the San Francisco Police. He becomes an investigator for an insurance company and joins forces with a cynical field agent to probe suspicious and unusual deaths.

Title: Khatta Meetha
Hint: A struggling contractor fights corrupt officials and his own family in a comedy of greed.
Description: Sachin Tichkule, a struggling contractor whose failure in making peace with the corrupt bureaucracy in town as well as strained relation with his ex-girlfriend and his family leads to misadventures that deprive him of his closest relations. However, as he begins to mend his ways, justice comes knocking on his door.

Title: Suck Me Shakespeer 2
Hint: A rowdy teacher accompanies a class trip to Thailand to recover some diamonds.
Description: A rowdy teacher accompanies a class trip to Thailand to recover some diamonds accidentally sent there and restore the school's reputation.

Title: Heartless
Hint: A young man with a facial birthmark makes a deal with a devil to be free of his deformity.
Description: Jamie Morgan is a troubled young man with a facial birthmark, which has left him isolated and fearful, hiding from the world outside. He lives in the East End, notorious for its violent hooded gangs. But, one night, after the murder of his mother, Jamie discovers the terrifying truth.

Title: Columbus Circle
Hint: An agoraphobic heiress who hasn't left her apartment in two decades is drawn into a murder plot.
Description: An heiress who's been shut inside her apartment building for nearly two decades is forced to confront her fears after one of her neighbors is killed and a detective arrives to begin the investigation.

Title: New Kids Nitro
Hint: Five lowlifes from a Dutch village fight a neighbouring town and battle a zombie outbreak.
Description: Gerrie, Richard, Rikkert, Robbie and Barry from Maaskantje are in a big fight with the village of Schijndel. When a zombie kills someone from Brabant, things get out of hand.

Title: Fast X
Hint: A street racer and his family face a vengeful son of a drug lord they killed.
Description: Over many missions and against impossible odds, Dom Toretto and his family have outsmarted, out-nerved and outdriven every foe in their path. Now, they confront the most lethal opponent they've ever faced: A terrifying threat emerging from the shadows of the past who's fueled by blood revenge, and who is determined to shatter this family and destroy everything—and everyone—that Dom loves, forever.

Title: Downsizing
Hint: A man decides to shrink himself to five inches tall to live better in a miniature community.
Description: A kindly occupational therapist undergoes a new procedure to be shrunken to four inches tall so that he and his wife can help save the planet and afford a nice lifestyle at the same time.

Title: Ghosted
Hint: A man falls for a woman he meets at a farmers market, only to find she's a secret agent.
Description: Salt-of-the-earth Cole falls head over heels for enigmatic Sadie—but then makes the shocking discovery that she's a secret agent. Before they can decide on a second date, Cole and Sadie are swept away on an international adventure to save the world.

Title: Old
Hint: A group of families on a tropical holiday discover a secluded beach that makes them age rapidly.
Description: A group of families on a tropical holiday discover that the secluded beach where they are staying is somehow causing them to age rapidly – reducing their entire lives into a single day.

Title: Saw V
Hint: A detective investigates the sadistic serial killer's apprentice while a new group plays a deadly game.
Description: Following Jigsaw's grisly demise, Detective Mark Hoffman is commended as a hero, but Agent Strahm is suspicious, and delves into Hoffman's past. Meanwhile, another group of people are put through a series of gruesome tests.

Title: Salò, or the 120 Days of Sodom
Hint: Four fascist libertines round up teenagers and subject them to torture, in a notorious art film.
Description: Four corrupted fascist libertines round up 9 teenage boys and girls and subject them to ___ days of sadistic physical, mental and sexual torture.

Title: The Blue Lagoon
Hint: Two children and a ship's cook survive a shipwreck on a tropical island and grow up alone.
Description: Two small children and a ship's cook survive a shipwreck and find safety on an idyllic tropical island. Soon, however, the cook dies and the young boy and girl are left on their own. Days become years and Emmeline and Richard make a home for themselves surrounded by exotic creatures and nature's beauty. But will they ever see civilization again?

Title: Cannibal Holocaust
Hint: A professor returns from the Amazon with the footage of a lost documentary crew.
Description: A New York University professor returns from a rescue mission to the Amazon rainforest with the footage shot by a lost team of documentarians who were making a film about the area's local ___ tribes.

Title: Crimes of the Future
Country: Canada, Greece, United Kingdom, France, United States of America
Hint: A performance artist who grows new organs has them removed in front of an audience.
Description: With his partner Caprice, celebrity performance artist Saul Tenser publicly showcases the metamorphosis of his organs in avant-garde performances. An investigator from the National Organ Registry obsessively tracks their movements, which is when a mysterious group is revealed... Their mission — to use Tenser's notoriety to shed light on the next phase of human evolution.

Title: Hollow Man
Hint: A scientist becomes invisible and begins to lose his sanity, terrorising his colleagues.
Description: Cocky researcher Sebastian Caine is working on a project to make living creatures invisible. Determined to achieve the ultimate breakthrough, Caine pushes his team to move to the next phase — using himself as the subject. The test is a success, but when the process can't be reversed and Caine seems doomed to future without flesh, he starts to turn increasingly dangerous.

Title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
Hint: Four teenagers who covered up an accident are stalked by a killer with a hook a year later.
Description: After an accident on a winding road, four teens make the fatal mistake of dumping their victim's body into the sea. Exactly one year later, the deadly secret resurfaces as they're stalked by a hook-handed figure.

Title: Blade: Trinity
Hint: A vampire hunter teams up with a group of human vampire killers to fight the first vampire.
Description: For years, ___ has fought against the vampires in the cover of the night. But now, after falling into the crosshairs of the FBI, he is forced out into the daylight, where he is driven to join forces with a clan of human vampire hunters he never knew existed—The Nightstalkers.

Title: Army of the Dead
Hint: A group of mercenaries plan a heist in a zombie-infested Las Vegas.
Description: Following a zombie outbreak in Las Vegas, a group of mercenaries take the ultimate gamble: venturing into the quarantine zone to pull off the greatest heist ever attempted.

Hint: A geophysicist warns that the world will end in a series of cataclysms.
Description: Dr. Adrian Helmsley, part of a worldwide geophysical team investigating the effect on the earth of radiation from unprecedented solar storms, learns that the earth's core is heating up. He warns U.S. President Thomas Wilson that the crust of the earth is becoming unstable and that without proper preparations for saving a fraction of the world's population, the entire race is doomed.

Title: Barbarella
Hint: A sexy space adventurer is tasked with finding a missing scientist in the far future.
Description: In the far future, a highly sexual woman is tasked with finding and stopping the evil Durand-Durand. Along the way she encounters various unusual people.

Title: Persuasion
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: In early 19th-century England, a woman is reunited with the naval officer she rejected eight years earlier.
Description: In early 19th-century England, dire financial straits reacquaint the aristocratic Anne Elliot with her wealthy ex-fiance Frederick Wentworth. The two must choose between either putting the past behind them or listening to their hearts.

Title: The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones
Country: Canada, Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A teenager discovers she's a descendant of a line of angel-human hybrids who fight demons.
Description: In New York City, Clary Fray, a seemingly ordinary teenager, learns that she is descended from a line of Shadowhunters — half-angel warriors who protect humanity from evil forces. After her mother disappears, Clary joins forces with a group of Shadowhunters and enters Downworld, an alternate realm filled with demons, vampires, and a host of other creatures.

Title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Beginning
Hint: The origins of a cannibalistic Southern family and their skin-masked son, in a gory prequel.
Description: Chrissie and her friends set out on a road trip for a final fling before one is shipped off to Vietnam. Along the way, bikers harass the foursome and cause an accident that throws Chrissie from the vehicle. The lawman who arrives on the scene kills one of the bikers and brings Chrissie's friends to the Hewitt homestead, where young Leatherface is learning the tools of terror.

Title: Battleship
Hint: A fleet of ships is forced to do battle with an alien armada off the coast of Hawaii.
Description: When mankind beams a radio signal into space, a reply comes from ‘Planet G’, in the form of several alien crafts that splash down in the waters off Hawaii. Lieutenant Alex Hopper is a weapons officer assigned to the USS John Paul Jones, part of an international naval coalition which becomes the world's last hope for survival as they engage the hostile alien force of unimaginable strength.

Title: xXx
Hint: An extreme sports athlete is recruited by the NSA to infiltrate a group of Russian anarchists.
Description: Xander Cage is your standard adrenaline junkie with no fear and a lousy attitude. When the US Government "recruits" him to go on a mission, he's not exactly thrilled. His mission: to gather information on an organization that may just be planning the destruction of the world, led by the nihilistic Yorgi.

Title: Career Opportunities
Hint: A janitor gets locked in a department store overnight with a rich girl and two robbers.
Description: Josie, the daughter of the town's wealthiest businessman, faces problems at home and wishes to leave town but is disoriented. Her decision is finalized after she falls asleep in a Target dressing room. She awakens to find herself locked in the store overnight with the janitor, Jim, the town "no hoper" and liar.

Title: Final Destination 3
Hint: A high school student has a premonition of a roller coaster accident, and death hunts the survivors.
Description: High school senior Wendy's premonition of a deadly rollercoaster ride saves her life and a lucky few, but not from death itself — which seeks out those who escaped their fate.

Title: Jaws 2
Hint: A police chief must protect a beach town from a second giant shark.
Description: Police chief Brody must protect the citizens of Amity after a second monstrous shark begins terrorizing the waters.

Title: The Babysitter: Killer Queen
Hint: A teen who survived a satanic cult is hunted again two years later.
