Description: Two years after defeating a satanic cult led by his ___ Bee, Cole's trying to forget his past and focus on surviving high school. But when old enemies unexpectedly return, Cole will once again have to outsmart the forces of evil.

Title: Troll
Hint: A sinister fairy-tale creature takes over a San Francisco apartment building and turns residents into woodland beasts.
Description: When a family moves into a San Francisco apartment, an opportunistic ___ decides to make his move and take possession of little Wendy, thereby paving the way for new ___ recruits, the first in his army that will take eventual control of the planet. We soon discover Torok is the ex-husband of Eunice St. Clair, a resident in the building who was married to Torok.

Title: Splice
Country: Canada, France, Germany, United States of America
Hint: Two genetic engineers create a hybrid human-animal creature that grows into a dangerous adult.
Description: Elsa and Clive, two young rebellious scientists, defy legal and ethical boundaries and forge ahead with a dangerous experiment: splicing together human and animal DNA to create a new organism. Named "Dren", the creature rapidly develops from a deformed female infant into a beautiful but dangerous winged human-chimera, who forges a bond with both of her creators - only to have that bond turn deadly.

Title: The Contractor
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A discharged special forces sergeant joins a private military outfit and is betrayed on his first mission.
Description: After being involuntarily discharged from the U.S. Special Forces, James Harper decides to support his family by joining a private contracting organization alongside his best friend and under the command of a fellow veteran. Overseas on a covert mission, Harper must evade those trying to kill him while making his way back home.

Title: The Gunman
Country: France, Spain, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A former special forces assassin is hunted after a mission in the Congo.
Description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why.

Title: The Princess Diaries 2: Royal Engagement
Hint: A young queen-to-be must marry within 30 days or lose her throne.
Description: Mia Thermopolis is now a college graduate and on her way to Genovia to take up her duties as princess. Accompanied by her friend Lilly, Mia continues her 'princess lessons', like riding horses side-saddle and archery. But her already complicated life is turned upside down once again when she learns that she is to take the crown as queen earlier than expected, all while she meets a mysteriously charming young man.

Title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
Hint: Twenty years after the original murders, a mother hides at a private school as her brother finds her.
Description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former baby sitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts.

Title: Pitch Perfect 3
Hint: The Bellas reunite for one last performance at a USO tour in Europe.
Description: After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart and discovering there aren't job prospects for making music with your mouth. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, this group of awesome nerds will come together to make some music, and some questionable decisions, one last time.

Title: Wild Hogs
Hint: Four suburban friends set out on a motorcycle road trip and cross paths with a biker gang.
Description: Restless and ready for an adventure, four suburban bikers leave the safety of their subdivision and head out on the open road. But complications ensue when they cross paths with an intimidating band of New Mexico bikers known as the Del Fuegos.

Title: The Hangover Part III
Hint: Three friends must rescue their fourth from a gangster who wants his gold back.
Description: This time, there's no wedding. No bachelor party. What could go wrong, right? But when the Wolfpack hits the road, all bets are off.

Title: High Life
Country: France, Germany, Poland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A father and daughter are the last survivors of a dangerous deep-space mission.
Description: Monte and his daughter are the last survivors of a damned and dangerous mission to deep space. The crew—death-row inmates led by a doctor with sinister motives—has vanished. As the mystery of what happened onboard the ship is unraveled, father and daughter must rely on each other to survive as they hurtle toward the oblivion of a black hole.

Title: V/H/S
Hint: A gang of thieves breaks into a house and finds a dead man and a stack of found-footage horror tapes.
Description: When a group of misfits is hired by an unknown third party to burglarize a desolate house and acquire one rare VHS tape, they discover more found footage than they had bargained for.

Title: Noah
Hint: A man who has visions of a great flood builds an ark to save the animals.
Description: A man who suffers visions of an apocalyptic deluge takes measures to protect his family from the coming flood.

Title: Something Borrowed
Hint: A single attorney sleeps with her best friend's fiancé after her 30th birthday party.
Description: Though Rachel is a successful attorney and a loyal, generous friend, she is still single. After one drink too many at her 30th-birthday celebration, Rachel unexpectedly falls into bed with her longtime crush, Dex -- who happens to be engaged to her best friend, Darcy.

Title: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
Hint: A masked killer escapes a sanitarium on October 31st and comes back to his hometown to hunt his young niece.
Description: Ten years after his original massacre, the invalid Michael ___ awakens on ___ Eve and returns to Haddonfield to kill his seven-year-old niece.

Title: RoboCop 2
Hint: A cyborg cop battles a powerful new drug dealer who becomes a robot in Detroit.
Description: After a successful deployment of the ___ Law Enforcement unit, OCP sees its goal of urban pacification come closer and closer, but as this develops, a new narcotic known as "Nuke" invades the streets led by God-delirious leader Cane. As this menace grows, it may prove to be too much for Murphy to handle.

Title: Eat Pray Love
Hint: A divorced writer travels to Italy, India and Bali to find herself.
Description: A married woman realizes how unhappy her marriage really is, and that her life needs to go in a different direction. After a painful divorce, she takes off on a round-the-world journey to "find herself".

Title: Mr. Deeds
Hint: A small-town pizza shop owner inherits a media empire.
Description: When Longfellow ___, a small-town pizzeria owner and poet, inherits $40 billion from his deceased uncle, he quickly begins rolling in a different kind of dough. Moving to the big city, ___ finds himself besieged by opportunists all gunning for their piece of the pie. Babe, a television tabloid reporter, poses as an innocent small-town girl to do an exposé on ___.

Title: Ken Park
Country: United States of America, France, Netherlands
Hint: A group of troubled teens in a California suburb grapple with their parents.
Description: Teen skater ___ (nicknamed Krap Nek; his name spelled and pronounced backward) kills himself at a Visalia skate park; his death bookends the lives of four other young people who knew him: Shawn, the most conventional; Tate brims with psychotic rage; Claude is habitually harassed by his brutish father and coddled, rather uncomfortably, by his enormously pregnant mother; and Peaches looks after her devoutly…

Title: The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen
Hint: A team of famous literary heroes join forces to stop a villain in Victorian England.
Description: To prevent a world war from breaking out, famous characters from Victorian literature band together to do battle against a cunning villain.

Title: Rambo III
Hint: A Vietnam vet goes to Afghanistan to rescue his mentor from the Soviets.
Description: Combat has taken its toll on ___, but he's finally begun to find inner peace in a monastery. When ___ friend and mentor Col. Trautman asks for his help on a top secret mission to Afghanistan, ___ declines but must reconsider when Trautman is captured.

Title: Over the Top
Hint: A truck driver tries to win his son back and enters an arm-wrestling championship.
Description: Lincoln Hawk a hard-luck big-rig trucker takes us under the glaring Las Vegas lights for all the boisterous action of the World Armwrestling Championship. Relying on wits and willpower, Hawk tries to rebuild his life by capturing the first-place prize money, and the love of the son he abandoned years earlier into the keeping of his rich, ruthless father-in-law.

Title: Extinction
Hint: A man has recurring nightmares of an alien invasion, which turns out to be real.
Description: A chief mechanic at a factory, haunted by apocalyptic nightmares, becomes a hero when Earth is invaded by a mysterious army bent on destruction.

Title: Encino Man
Hint: Two high school misfits discover a caveman frozen in ice in a backyard and pass him off as an exchange student.
Description: High school misfits Stoney and Dave discover a long-frozen primeval man buried in their backyard. But the thawed-out Link—as the boys have named him—quickly becomes a wild card in the teens' already zany Southern California lives. After a shave and some new clothes, Link's presence at school makes the daily drudgery a lot more interesting.

Title: Look Away
Hint: A shy, alienated teenage girl's reflection becomes a sinister alter ego that takes over her life.
Description: A timid and socially alienated 17-year-old high school student's life is turned upside down when she switches places with her sinister mirror image.

Title: Cobra
Hint: A tough-on-crime street cop protects a witness from a serial killer cult.
Description: A tough-on-crime street cop must protect the only surviving witness to a strange murderous cult with far reaching plans.

Title: Pride and Prejudice and Zombies
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: In 19th-century England, five sisters trained in martial arts fight the undead while finding husbands.
Description: A zombie outbreak has fallen upon the land in this reimagining of Jane Austen's classic tale of the tangled relationships between lovers from different social classes in 19th century England. Feisty heroine Elizabeth Bennet is a master of martial arts and weaponry and the handsome Mr. Darcy is a fierce zombie killer, yet the epitome of upper class ___.

Title: The Ringer
Hint: A man in debt pretends to be mentally disabled to fix the Special Olympics.
Description: Pressured by a greedy uncle and a pile of debt, lovable loser Steve Barker resorts to an unthinkable, contemptible, just-crazy-enough-to-work scheme. He pretends to be mentally challenged to rig the upcoming Special Olympics and bring home the gold. But when Steve's fellow competitors get wise to the con, they inspire him to rise to the greatest challenge of all: becoming a better person.

Title: Nine
Hint: A famous Italian filmmaker struggles to make his latest film, in a musical.
Description: Arrogant, self-centered movie director Guido Contini finds himself struggling to find meaning, purpose, and a script for his latest film endeavor. With only a week left before shooting begins, he desperately searches for answers and inspiration from his wife, his mistress, his muse, and his mother.

Title: Skyscraper
Hint: A security expert must rescue his family trapped in a burning tower in Hong Kong.
Description: Framed and on the run, a former FBI agent must save his family from a blazing fire in the world's tallest building.

Title: The Break-Up
Hint: A bickering couple who split up refuse to move out of the Chicago condo they share, leading to petty warfare.
Description: Pushed to the breaking-up point after their latest 'why can't you do this one little thing for me?' argument, Brooke calls it quits with her boyfriend Gary. What follows is a hilarious series of remedies, war tactics, overtures and undermining tricks – all encouraged by the former couple's friends and confidantes …and the occasional total stranger!

Title: Last Looks
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A disgraced ex-cop is drawn back to investigate a TV star accused of murder.
Description: A disgraced ex-cop seeks solace by moving to the woods, but his quiet life comes to an end when a private eye recruits him to investigate the murder of an eccentric TV star's wife.

Title: Zardoz
Hint: In the far future, a savage killer finds a way into a community of bored immortals.
Description: In the far future, a savage trained only to kill finds a way into the community of bored immortals that alone preserves humanity's achievements.

Title: End of Days
Hint: A suicidal ex-cop must protect a young woman from Satan on New Year's Eve 1999.
Description: Cynical bodyguard Jericho is hired by a man possessed by Satan, who is in search of his bride. When Jericho realizes what is happening, he must do everything he can to save the woman and the world.

Title: What a Girl Wants
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: An American teenager travels to London to meet her father, a British politician.
Description: American Daphne Reynolds heads to Europe in search of the father she's never met. But instead of finding a British version of her boho mother, she learns the love of her mom's life is an uptight politician. The only problem now is that her long-lost father is engaged to a fiercely territorial social climber with a daughter who makes Daphne's life miserable.

Title: Without Remorse
Hint: An elite Navy SEAL uncovers an international conspiracy while seeking justice for his wife's murder.
Description: An elite Navy SEAL uncovers an international conspiracy while seeking justice for the murder of his pregnant wife.

Title: The Man from Toronto
Hint: A bumbling entrepreneur is mistaken for the world's deadliest assassin.
Description: A case of mistaken identity forces a bumbling entrepreneur to team up with a notorious assassin known as The ___ in hopes of staying alive.

Title: The Crush
Hint: A precocious, obsessive 14-year-old girl becomes dangerously infatuated with a young journalist renting her parents' guesthouse.
Description: A precocious and obsessive teenager develops a ___ on a naive writer with harrowing consequences.

Title: The Little Hours
Hint: In 1347 Italy, a young servant hides out in a convent of unruly nuns.
Description: Garfagnana, Italy, 1347. The handsome servant Masseto, fleeing from his vindictive master, takes shelter in a nunnery where three young nuns, Sister Alessandra, Sister Ginevra and Sister Fernanda, try unsuccessfully to find out what their purpose in life is, a conundrum that each of them faces in different ways.

Title: Eli
Hint: A boy with a rare disease is taken to a clinic that's actually haunted.
Description: A boy named ___ with a rare autoimmune disorder is confined to a special experimental clinic for his treatment. He soon begins experiencing supernatural forces, turning the supposedly safe facility into a haunted prison for him and his fellow patients.

Title: Monte Carlo
Hint: A girl on a trip to Paris is mistaken for a British heiress.
Description: Three young women vacationing in Paris find themselves whisked away to ___ after one of the girls is mistaken for a British heiress.

Title: Gothika
Hint: A psychiatrist wakes up as a patient in her own asylum, accused of murder.
Description: After a car crash, criminal psychologist Dr. Miranda Grey regains consciousness only to find that she's a patient in the same mental institution that currently employs her. She's been accused of murdering her husband Dr. Douglas Grey — but she has no memory of committing the crime. As she tries to regain her memory and convince her co-worker, Dr.

Title: St. Trinian's
Hint: The unruly schoolgirls of a girls' school are more interested in men and mischief.
Description: The unruly schoolgirls of St ___ are more interested in men and mischief than homework and hockey. But greater trouble than ever beckons when the arrival at the school of Princess Fatima of Makyad coincides with the return of recently expelled Arabella Fritton, who has the kidnap of a prize racehorse on her mind.

Title: The Wolfman
Hint: An actor returns to his ancestral home in England and is bitten by a beast.
Description: Lawrence Talbot, an American man on a visit to Victorian London to make amends with his estranged father, gets bitten by a werewolf and, after a moonlight transformation, leaves him with a savage hunger for flesh.

Title: The Prince and Me
Country: United States of America, Czech Republic
Hint: A pre-med student in Wisconsin falls in love with a Danish royal who is posing as an exchange student.
Description: A fairy tale love-story about pre-med student Paige who falls in love with a Danish Prince "Eddie" who refused to follow the traditions of his parents and has come to the US to quench his thirst for rebellion.

Title: Drive Me Crazy
Hint: Two teenage neighbours pretend to date to make their exes jealous.
Description: Nicole and Chase live next door to each other but are worlds apart. However, they plot a scheme to date each other in order to attract the interest and jealousy of their respective romantic prey. But in the mist of planning a gala centennial celebration, Nicole and Chase find that the one they always wanted was closer than they ever thought.

Title: Masterminds
Hint: An armoured car driver is manipulated into robbing his employer.
Description: A night guard at an armored car company in the Southern U.S. organizes one of the biggest bank heists in American history.

Title: Dracula: Dead and Loving It
Hint: A lawyer travels to Transylvania to meet a vampire, in a spoof.
Description: When a lawyer shows up at the vampire's doorstep, he falls prey to his charms and joins him in his search for fresh blood. Enter Professor Van Helsing, who may be the only one able to vanquish the Count.

Title: The Haunting in Connecticut
Hint: A family moves to a New England house to be near their son's cancer treatment, and learns it was a funeral home.
Description: When the Campbell family moves to upstate ___, they soon learn that their charming Victorian home has a disturbing history: not only was the house a transformed funeral parlor where inconceivable acts occurred, but the owner's clairvoyant son Jonah served as a demonic messenger, providing a gateway for spiritual entities to crossover.

Title: The Heartbreak Kid
Hint: A newlywed falls for a beautiful blonde on his Miami honeymoon and abandons his bride.
Description: Three days into his Miami honeymoon with needy and unsophisticated Lila, Lenny meets tall, blonde Kelly. This confirms his fear that he has made a serious mistake and he decides he wants to be with Kelly instead.

Title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
Hint: A celebrity photographer is visited by the spirits of his ex-lovers at his brother's wedding.
Description: Celebrity photographer Connor Mead lives life in the fast lane, committed to lifelong bachelorhood and simultaneous relationships with multiple women. On the eve of his younger brother Paul's wedding, Connor's mockery of love proves a real buzz-kill for everyone - including his childhood crush, Jenny, the one woman who always seemed immune to his considerable charms.

Title: The To Do List
Hint: A high school valedictorian makes a checklist of sexual experiences to complete before college.
Description: Feeling pressured to become more sexually experienced before she goes to college, Brandy Klark makes a ___ of things to accomplish before hitting campus in the fall.

Title: Traffik
Hint: A couple's romantic weekend in the mountains turns deadly when they're accosted by a biker gang.
Description: A couple off for a romantic weekend in the mountains are accosted by a biker gang. Alone in the mountains, Brea and John must defend themselves against the gang, who will stop at nothing to protect their secrets.

Title: Home Again
Hint: A single mom in Los Angeles lets three young filmmakers move into her guest house.
Description: Life for a single mom in Los Angeles takes an unexpected turn when she allows three young guys to move in with her.

Title: Without a Paddle
Hint: Three friends reunite for a canoe trip in search of a legendary skyjacker's lost loot and get hopelessly lost.
Description: Three friends, whose lives have been drifting apart, reunite for the funeral of a fourth childhood friend. When looking through their childhood belongings, they discover a trunk which contained details on a quest their friend was attempting. It revealed that he was hot on the trail of the $200,000 that went missing with airplane hijacker D.B. Cooper in 1971.

Title: Thinner
Hint: An obese lawyer starts losing weight uncontrollably after an old Romani man curses him.
Description: An obese lawyer finds himself growing "___" when an old Romani man places a hex on him. Now the lawyer must call upon his friends in organized crime to help him persuade the old man to lift the curse. Time is running out for the desperate lawyer as he draws closer to his own death, and grows ever ___.

Title: Lake Placid
Genres: Horror, Comedy, Action, Science Fiction, Thriller
Hint: A giant crocodile terrorises a small body of water in rural Maine, baffling a game warden and a palaeontologist.
Description: When a man is eaten alive by an unknown creature, the local Game Warden teams up with a paleontologist from New York to find the beast. Add to the mix an eccentric philanthropist with a penchant for "Crocs", and here we go! This quiet, remote ___ is suddenly the focus of an intense search for a crocodile with a taste for live animals...and people!

Title: Haywire
Country: United States of America, Ireland, Spain
Hint: A black ops soldier seeks payback after she is betrayed.
Description: A black ops soldier seeks payback after she is betrayed and left for dead.

Title: Saving Silverman
Hint: Two buddies kidnap their best friend's fiancée to save him from marriage.
Description: A pair of buddies conspire to save their best friend from marrying the wrong woman, a cold-hearted beauty who snatches him from them and breaks up their Neil Diamond cover band.

Title: Good Burger
Hint: Two teens at a fast-food joint try to save it from a giant rival chain with a secret sauce.
Description: Two L.A. teens with summer jobs at ___ try to save their small restaurant when a corporate giant ___ franchise moves in across the street.

Title: Blame It on Rio
Hint: A man has an affair with his best friend's teenage daughter on holiday in Brazil.
Description: Matthew Hollis is man on holiday in ___ with his best friend. Both men have teenage daughters with them. When Matthew falls for his best friend's amorous daughter named Jennifer, they embark on a secret, if slightly one-sided relationship. Jennifer's father is furious when he finds out about the 'older man' in his daughter's life, and sets out to hunt him down with the aid of Matthew!

Title: Last Shift
Hint: A rookie cop works the final night at a closing police station, haunted by a murderous cult.
Description: Rookie police officer Jessica Loren has been assigned the ___ at a closing police station and must wait for a hazmat crew to collect biomedical evidence. Ordered not to leave the station under any circumstances, Jessica comes to learn that it's more than just an outdated station, it's home to the ultimate embodiment of evil and his devoted bloodthirsty followers.

Title: The Wretched
Hint: A teenage boy encounters a witch that is possessing a neighbour.
Description: A rebellious teenage boy, struggling with his parents' imminent divorce, encounters a terrifying evil after his next-door neighbor becomes possessed by an ancient witch that feasts on children.

Title: Jack
Hint: A boy ages four times faster than normal and enters fifth grade.
Description: Born with a rare condition that makes him age four times faster than normal, ten-year-old ___ Powell looks like a forty-year-old man. After years of homeschooling, he enters public school for the first time, eager to make friends and live like any other kid—only to discover that growing up too fast means learning some of life’s hardest lessons early.

Title: The People We Hate at the Wedding
Hint: Two estranged siblings and their half-sister reluctantly attend a family celebration in England.
Description: A dysfunctional family that can't seem to get along and get it together reluctantly reunites for a family wedding. As their many skeletons are wrenched from the closet, it turns out to be just what this singular family needs to reconnect.

Title: The Lie
Hint: A father and daughter cover up a crime after she murders her best friend.
Description: A father and daughter are on their way to dance camp when they spot the girl's best friend on the side of the road. When they stop to offer the friend a ride, their good intentions soon result in terrible consequences.

Title: Morgan
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A corporate risk consultant evaluates a lab-created artificial human.
Description: A corporate risk-management consultant must determine whether or not to terminate an artificial being's life that was made in a laboratory environment.

Title: Semi-Pro
Hint: The owner and star of a basketball team in Flint tries to make the NBA.
Description: Jackie Moon is the owner, promoter, coach, and star player of the Flint Michigan Tropics of the American Basketball Association (ABA), the worst team in the league. In 1976 before the ABA collapses, the NBA plans to merge with the best teams of the ABA at the end of the season. Only the top four teams will make the move and the worst teams will fold.

Title: The Relic
Country: Germany, Japan, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A homicide detective and a biologist hunt a giant creature loose in a Chicago museum.
Description: A homicide detective teams up with an evolutionary biologist to hunt a giant creature that is killing people in a Chicago museum.

Title: The New Guy
Hint: A nerdy high school senior gets himself expelled to reinvent himself at a new school.
Description: Nerdy high school senior Dizzy Harrison has finally gotten lucky -- after purposely getting expelled, he takes lessons in 'badass cool' from a convict and enrolls at a new school. But can he keep up the ruse?

Title: Dual
Country: Canada, Finland, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A terminally ill woman's clone must fight her in a duel to the death.
Description: A terminally ill woman opts for a cloning procedure to ease her loss on her friends and family. When she makes a miraculous recovery, her attempts to have her clone decommissioned fail and lead to a court-mandated duel to the death.

Title: Black Water
Hint: Three people stranded in a mangrove swamp in Australia are hunted by a crocodile.
Description: Based on true events, Grace, her boyfriend Adam, and her younger sister, Lee, are on holiday in Northern Australia when they decide to take a tour down a river. As they drift into a swamp, their boat suddenly capsizes, and the three tourists realize they are being watched through the ___.

Hint: In the days after Pearl Harbor, panic grips California.
Description: In the days after the attack on Pearl Harbor, panic grips California, where a military officer leads a mob chasing a Japanese sub.

Title: Blue Steel
Hint: A rookie cop is stalked by a psychopath who stole a gun from a robbery scene.
Description: Rookie cop Megan Turner orders a burglar to drop his gun. He whirls to shoot. Too late. Turner fires, killing him instantly. When someone lifts the assailant's gun from the crime scene, the police hold Turner accountable for killing an unarmed man. That same someone carves Turner's name into the bullets and uses them in a series of murders.

Title: Spread
Hint: A gigolo in Los Angeles must contend with the prospect that he has found true love.
Description: A gigolo must contend with the prospect that he has found true love.

Title: The Green Hornet
Hint: A newspaper heir becomes a masked crime fighter with his martial arts sidekick.
Description: Britt Reid, the heir to the largest newspaper fortune in Los Angeles, is a spoiled playboy who has been, thus far, happy to lead an aimless life. After his father dies, Britt meets Kato, a resourceful company employee. Realizing that they have the talent and resources to make something of their lives, Britt and Kato join forces as costumed crime-fighters to bring down the city's most-powerful criminal, Chudnofsky.

Title: Looney Tunes: Back in Action
Hint: A cartoon duck is fired from Warner Bros. and teams up with a security guard.
Description: Fed up with all the attention going to Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck quits Hollywood, teams up with recently-fired stuntman Damien Drake Jr. and embarks on a round-the-world adventure, along with Bugs and The VP of Warner Bros. Their mission? Find Damien's father, and the missing blue diamond... and stay one step ahead of The Acme Corp., who wants the diamond for their own purposes.

Title: The Cobbler
Hint: A lonely shoe repairman discovers a magical stitching machine that lets him become his customers.
Description: Max Simkin repairs shoes in the same New York shop that has been in his family for generations. Disenchanted with the grind of daily life, Max stumbles upon a magical heirloom that allows him to step into the lives of his customers and see the world in a new way. Sometimes walking in another man's shoes is the only way one can discover who they really are.

Title: Wishmaster
Hint: A genie released from an ancient prison tries to capture the soul of the woman who freed him.
Description: The Djinn, having been released from his ancient prison, seeks to capture the soul of the woman who discovered him, thereby opening a portal and freeing his fellow Djinn to take over the earth.

Title: Miss Bala
Hint: A young woman's dream of becoming a beauty queen is hijacked by a drug cartel.
Description: The story of a young woman clinging on to her dream to become a beauty contest queen in a Mexico dominated by organized crime.

Title: Made of Honor
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A playboy realises he loves his best friend when she becomes engaged to another man.
Description: Tom and Hannah have been platonic friends for 10 years. He's a serial dater, while she wants marriage but hasn't found Mr. Right. Just as Tom is starting to think that he is relationship material after all, Hannah gets engaged. When she asks Tom to be her 'maid' of ___, he reluctantly agrees just so he can attempt to stop the wedding and woo her.

Title: Nightbooks
Hint: A boy obsessed with scary stories is trapped by a witch in her magical apartment.
Description: Alex, a boy obsessed with scary stories, is trapped by a witch in her modern, magical New York City apartment. His original hair-raising tales are the only thing keeping him safe as he desperately tries to find a way out of this twisted place.

Title: The Forgotten
Hint: A grieving mother is told her son never existed.
Description: Telly Paretta is a grieving mother struggling to cope with the loss of her 9-year-old son. She is stunned when her psychiatrist reveals that she has created nine years of memories about a son she never had. But when she remembers a man who had a similar experience, Telly embarks on a search to prove her son's existence, and her sanity.

Title: Resident Evil: Afterlife
Country: Canada, United States of America, Germany, France
Hint: A superhuman warrior searches for survivors in Los Angeles during a zombie apocalypse.
Description: In a world ravaged by a virus infection, turning its victims into the Undead, Alice continues on her journey to find survivors and lead them to safety. Her deadly battle with the Umbrella Corporation reaches new heights, but Alice gets some unexpected help from an old friend.

Title: Into the Storm
Hint: A small town is hit by a series of tornadoes, and a team of chasers follows the twisters.
Description: As a new day begins in the town of Silverton, its residents have little reason to believe it will be anything other than ordinary. Mother Nature, however has other plans. In the span of just a few hours, an unprecedented onslaught of powerful tornadoes ravages Silverton.

Title: 100 Girls
Hint: A college freshman meets his dream girl in a dorm elevator during a blackout, and tries to find her.
Description: Matthew, a college freshman, meets his dream girl in a dorm elevator during a blackout. He never sees her face, but instantly falls in love. In the morning, the power is restored, but the "dream girl" has vanished. All Matthew knows is that she lives in an all-girls dorm. He sets out on a semester-long journey to find his mystery girl among a hundred female suspects. Could it be Wendy? Dora? Arlene? Patty? Cynthia?

Title: Confessions of a Shopaholic
Hint: A spendaholic journalist gets a job at a financial magazine and becomes a popular columnist while hiding her debts.
Description: In the glamorous world of New York City, Rebecca Bloomwood is a fun-loving girl who is really good at shopping – a little too good, perhaps. She dreams of working for her favorite fashion magazine, but can't quite get her foot in the door – until ironically, she snags a job as an advice columnist for a financial magazine published by the same company.

Title: Troop Beverly Hills
Hint: A divorcing Rodeo Drive housewife leads a group of rich scout girls into the wild to earn their badges.
Description: A ___ housewife in the middle of a divorce tries to find focus in her life by taking over her daughter's Wilderness Girls ___.

Title: Tau
Hint: A woman held captive in a smart house befriends the AI.
Description: Held captive in a futuristic smart house, a woman hopes to escape by befriending the A.I. program that controls the house.

Title: Cirque du Freak: The Vampire's Assistant
Hint: A teenager becomes the apprentice of a bloodsucker at a carnival of oddities.
Description: When Darren Shan is taken to a circus that's chock-full of sideshow oddities, he meets a ___ and receives a life-changing bite on the neck.

Title: Mine
Country: Italy, Spain, United States of America
Hint: A soldier steps on a landmine and must wait for rescue in the desert.
Description: After a failed assassination attempt, a soldier finds himself stranded in the desert. Exposed to the elements, he must survive the dangers of the desert and battle the psychological and physical toll of the treacherous conditions.

Title: Switch
Hint: A sexist man is reincarnated as a woman to teach him a lesson.
Description: Steve Brooks, a sexist womanizer, is killed by a group of his angry former lovers. In heaven, he makes a bargain with God for redemption and agrees to return to Earth. Once there, he must have a sincere relationship with a female and make her fall in love with him. If not, Steve's soul will become the property of the devil. But the devil hedges his bet, and Steve is reincarnated as a woman named Amanda Brooks.

Title: Wind Chill
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two college students share a ride home for the holidays and break down on a haunted road.
Description: Two college students share a ride home for the holidays. When they break down on a deserted stretch of road, they're preyed upon by the ghosts of people who have died there.

Title: Second Act
Hint: A big-box store assistant manager fakes her résumé to land a corporate job.
Description: Value Shop assistant manager Maya Vargas wants only one thing for her 43rd birthday -- a promotion. While her résumé may not scream upper management, her track record certainly does; she is an innovator who listens to her customers and delivers results.

Title: Rampart
Hint: A corrupt LAPD officer in the 1990s spirals out of control.
Description: The story follows veteran police officer Dave Brown, the last of the renegade cops, as he struggles to take care of his family, and fights for his own survival.

Title: Antebellum
Hint: A successful author finds herself trapped in a horrifying reality of a Civil War-era plantation.
Description: Successful author Veronica finds herself trapped in a horrifying reality and must uncover the mind-bending mystery before it's too late.

Title: The Lady of Heaven
Hint: A boy in Iraq hears the story of the daughter of the Prophet.
Description: Two stories separated by 1400 years. After losing his mother in the midst of a war-torn country, an Iraqi child learns the importance and power of patience by discovering the historical story of ___ Fatima and her suffering.

Title: Paranormal Activity 3
Hint: Two sisters in the 1980s encounter an invisible entity that resides in their house.
Description: In 1988, young sisters Katie and Kristi befriend an invisible entity who resides in their home.

Title: Captain Ron
Hint: A mild-mannered man hires a roguish skipper to sail his inherited yacht through the Caribbean.
Description: When mild-mannered Martin Harvey finds out that he has inherited a vintage yacht, he decides to take his family on a Caribbean vacation to retrieve the vessel. Upon arriving on a small island and realizing that the ship is in rough shape, Martin and his family end up with more than they bargained for as the roguish ___ signs on to sail the boat to Miami.

Title: Runaway
Hint: A police officer who specialises in malfunctioning robots tracks a killer who reprograms them.
Description: In the near future, a police officer specializes in malfunctioning robots. When a robot turns out to have been programmed to kill, he begins to uncover a homicidal plot to create killer robots... and his son becomes a target.

Title: 21 & Over
Hint: Two friends take their best friend out for his 21st birthday the night before a med school interview.
Description: Brilliant student Jeff Chang has the most important interview of his life tomorrow. But today is still his birthday, what starts off as a casual celebration with friends evolves into a night of debauchery that risks to derail his life plan.

Title: All the Pretty Horses
Hint: A young Texan travels to Mexico and falls in love with a rancher's daughter.
Description: The year is 1949. A young Texan named John Grady finds himself without a home after his mother sells the ranch where he has spent his entire life. Lured south of the border by the romance of cowboy life and the promise of a fresh start, Cole and his pal embark on an adventure that will test their resilience, define their maturity, and change their lives forever.

Title: The Divide
Country: Canada, Germany, United States of America
Hint: Survivors of a nuclear attack are trapped in a basement.
Description: Survivors of a nuclear attack are grouped together for days in the basement of their apartment building, where fear and dwindling supplies wear away at their dynamic.

Title: The Tunnel
Hint: An investigation into a government cover-up leads to abandoned train passages under Sydney.
Description: An investigation into a government cover-up leads to a network of abandoned train tunnels deep beneath the heart of Sydney. As a journalist and her crew hunt for the story it quickly becomes clear the story is hunting them.

Title: Shut In
Country: Canada, France, United States of America
Hint: A widowed child psychologist lives in an isolated house in the snow.
Description: A widowed child psychologist lives in an isolated existence in rural New England. When caught in a deadly winter storm, she must find a way to rescue a young boy before he disappears forever.

Title: And So It Goes
Hint: A self-centred realtor must take care of his granddaughter.
Description: Nobody likes self-centered realtor Oren Little, and he prefers it that way. He's deliberately mean to anyone who crosses his path and wants nothing more than to sell one final house and retire. His life turns upside-down when his estranged son drops off a granddaughter he never knew existed.

Title: Friday After Next
Hint: Two cousins move into their own apartment and get jobs as security guards.
Description: Craig and his cousin Day-Day have finally moved out of their parents' houses and into their own crib, working nights at a local mall as security guards. When their house is robbed on Christmas Eve they set out to track down the culprit.

Title: Raise Your Voice
Hint: A small-town singer goes to a performing arts school in LA.
Description: A coming-of-age story centered around a small-town singer brokenhearted by the death of her brother in a car crash, who had secretly submitted her for a summer session at a performing arts academy in Los Angeles. In the academy, she experiences a whole new way of life in the big city, far from the small town lifestyle she's used to.

Title: Suburbicon
Hint: A seemingly perfect 1950s suburban town is rocked by a home invasion.
Description: In the quiet family town of ___ during the 1950s, the best and worst of humanity is hilariously reflected through the deeds of seemingly ordinary people. When a home invasion turns deadly, a picture-perfect family turns to blackmail, revenge and murder.

Title: Into the Forest
Hint: Two sisters living in a remote woodland house must fend for themselves after a continent-wide power outage.
Description: In the not too distant future, two young women who live in a remote ancient forest discover the world around them is on the brink of an apocalypse. Informed only by rumor, they fight intruders, disease, loneliness & starvation.

Title: My Best Friend's Girl
Hint: A lovesick guy hires his obnoxious, womanising roommate to take his ex on a terrible date, but it backfires.
Description: Lovestruck Dustin is dating Alexis, his ideal girlfriend, but when she dumps him for coming on too strong, Dustin takes drastic measures to win her back. He asks his best friend Tank to take her on the worst rebound date imaginable - his side job - so that she will come running back to him, and Tank reluctantly agrees.

Title: Striking Distance
Hint: A Pittsburgh river patrol cop hunts a serial killer he suspects is a fellow officer.
Description: Coming from a police family, Tom Hardy ends up fighting his uncle after the murder of his father. Tom believes the killer is another cop, and goes on the record with his allegations. Demoted to water-way duty Tom, along with new partner Jo Christman, navigate the three rivers looking for clues and discovering bodies. This time the victims are women Tom knows, he must find the killer to prove his innocence.

Title: Young Ones
Country: South Africa, United States of America, Ireland
Hint: In a drought-stricken future, a farmer fights to protect his land and family from a ruthless teenage rival.
Description: In a future where water is scarce, a farmer defends his land and hopes to rejuvenate his parched soil. However, his daughter's boyfriend schemes to steal the land for himself.

Title: I Still See You
Hint: Ten years after an apocalyptic event left the world haunted by echoes of the dead, a teen is targeted by a sinister spirit.
Description: Ten years after an apocalyptic event left the world haunted by ghosts, Veronica 'Ronnie' Calder receives a threatening message from beyond the grave. Joining forces with a mysterious classmate, Kirk, Ronnie descends into a shadow world that blurs the bounds of the living and the dead—and begins a desperate race against time to stop a cunning killer.

Title: Open Water
Hint: Two scuba divers are accidentally left behind miles out at sea by their tour boat as sharks circle.
Description: Two divers are left out at sea without a boat. There’s nothing but water for miles, unless they look at what’s underneath them...

Title: Baskin
Hint: A squad of Turkish cops go through a trapdoor into a nightmarish realm of hell.
Description: A squad of unsuspecting cops go through a trapdoor to Hell when they stumble upon a Black Mass in an abandoned building.

Title: Hard to Kill
Hint: A cop who survives an assassination attempt wakes from a coma seeking revenge.
Description: Mason Storm, a 'go it alone' cop, is gunned down at home. The intruders kill his wife, and think they've killed both Mason and his son too. Mason is secretly taken to a hospital where he spends several years in a coma. His son meanwhile is growing up thinking his father is dead. When Mason wakes up, everyone is in danger - himself, his son, his best friend, his nurse - but most of all those who arranged for his death

Title: The Glass House
Hint: Two orphaned siblings are taken in by a wealthy couple who may be after their inheritance.
Description: When Ruby and Rhett's parents are killed in a car accident, their carefree teenage lives are suddenly shattered. Moving to an incredible house in Malibu with the Glasses', old friends of the family, seems to be the beginning of a new life for them.

Title: Reindeer Games
Hint: An ex-con assumes his dead cellmate's identity to get the girl, but is forced into a casino heist.
Description: After assuming his dead cellmate's identity to get with his girlfriend, an ex-con finds himself the reluctant participant in a casino heist.

Title: Absentia
Hint: A woman whose husband has been missing for seven years starts seeing him again, near a sinister tunnel.
Description: Tricia's husband has been missing for seven years. Her younger sister Callie comes to live with her as the pressure mounts to finally declare him 'dead in ___'. Tricia is reluctant, always holding out hope, but Callie is practical and wants her to move on. As Tricia sifts through the wreckage and tries to move on with her life, Callie finds herself drawn to an ominous tunnel near the house.

Title: Pyewacket
Hint: An angry teenage girl summons a witch in the woods to kill her mother, then regrets it.
Description: A frustrated, angry teenage girl awakens something in the woods when she naively performs an occult ritual to invoke a witch to kill her mother.

Title: A Thousand Words
Hint: A fast-talking literary agent discovers a magical tree will die, and so will he, with every syllable he speaks.
Description: Jack McCall is a fast-talking literary agent, who can close any deal, any time, any way. He has set his sights on New Age guru Dr. Sinja for his own selfish purposes. But Dr. Sinja is on to him, and Jack’s life comes unglued after a magical Bodhi tree mysteriously appears in his backyard.

Title: Stuck on You
Hint: Conjoined twins move from Martha's Vineyard to Hollywood so one of them can become an actor.
Description: In Martha's Vineyard, Mass., conjoined twins Walt and Bob Tenor make the best of their handicap by being the fastest grill cooks in town. While outgoing Walt hopes to one day become a famous actor, shy Bob prefers to stay out of the spotlight. When a fading Hollywood actress, Cher, decides to get her show "Honey and the Beaze" cancelled, she hires Walt -- and his brotherly appendage -- as her costars.

Title: Table 19
Hint: A group of misfit wedding guests are seated at the furthest spot from the bride and bond over their failures.
Description: Eloise, having been relieved of maid of honor duties after being unceremoniously dumped by the best man via text, decides to attend the wedding anyway – only to find herself seated with five fellow-unwanted guests at the dreaded ___.

Title: Heaven Is for Real
Hint: A small-town pastor's young son claims to have visited the afterlife during emergency surgery.
Description: After their young son, Colton, undergoes emergency surgery, small-town parents Todd and Sonja Burpo are overjoyed at the child's miraculous recovery. However, the Burpos are unprepared for what happens next... Colton says that during his surgery he went to ___ and back, and tells his parents things that he couldn't possibly know.

Title: Bulletproof
Hint: An undercover cop and a car thief who became best friends must survive a trip across the country together.
Description: An undercover police officer named Rock Keats befriends a drug dealer and car thief named Archie Moses in a bid to catch the villainous drug lord Frank Coltan. But the only problem is that Keats is a cop, his real name is Jack Carter, and he is working undercover with the LAPD to bust Moses and Colton at a sting operation the LAPD has set up.

Title: Death Wish 3
Hint: A vigilante architect returns to New York to fight a street gang terrorising a neighbourhood.
Description: Architect/vigilante Paul Kersey arrives back in New York City and is forcibly recruited by a crooked police chief to fight street crime caused by a large gang terrorizing the neighborhoods.

Title: A Very Brady Sequel
Hint: A man claiming to be the mother's long-lost first husband shows up to steal a priceless horse statue.
Description: A man claiming to be Carol ___ long-lost first husband, Roy Martin, shows up at the suburban ___ residence one evening. An impostor, the man is actually determined to steal the Bradys' familiar horse statue, a $20-million ancient Asian artifact.

Title: Wetlands
Hint: A rebellious German teenager with a strange approach to hygiene tries to reunite her divorced parents.
Description: Helen is a nonconformist teenage girl who maintains a conflictual relationship with her parents. Hanging out most of her time with her friend Corinna, with whom she breaks one social taboo after another, she uses sex as a way to rebel and break the conventional bourgeois ethic. After an intimate shaving accident, Helen ends up in the hospital where it doesn’t take long before she makes waves.

Title: The Perfect Date
Hint: A high school student creates an app to be hired as a stand-in boyfriend.
Description: No beau? No problem! To earn money for college, a high schooler creates a dating app that lets him act as a stand-in boyfriend.

Title: Ae Dil Hai Mushkil
Hint: A young man falls for a woman who sees him only as a friend, in a heartbreaking Bollywood romance.
Description: Ayan falls in love with his soulmate, Alizeh, but she doesn’t reciprocate the feeling. Later, a relationship with Saba helps him realize Alizeh’s value in his life, irrespective of their relationship status.

Title: Happy Feet Two
Hint: A penguin and his son who can't dance must help their colony when they are trapped by a glacier.
Description: Mumble the penguin has a problem: his son Erik, who is reluctant to dance, encounters the Mighty Sven — a penguin who can fly! Things get worse for Mumble when the world is shaken by powerful forces, causing him to bring together the penguin nations and their allies to set things right.

Title: Cry Wolf
Hint: A group of students start a prank email about a serial killer, only to have it come to life.
Description: After a local woman is murdered, a group of teenage liars create a warning e-mail of a serial killer named “The ___”, coming on the next full moon. The teens describe each death method The ___ uses, but when the described victims actually do start turning up dead, suddenly no one knows where the lies end and the truth begins.

Title: Cradle 2 the Grave
Hint: A gang leader and a Taiwanese intelligence agent team up to rescue his daughter from an arms dealer.
Description: Gang leader Tony pulls off a major diamond heist with his crew, but cop-turned-criminal Ling knows who has the loot and responds by kidnapping Tony's daughter and holding her for ransom. Unfortunately, Tony's lost the diamonds as well. As he frantically searches for his daughter and the jewels, Tony pairs with a high-kicking government agent who once worked with Ling and seeks revenge on him.

Title: The Toy
Hint: A bratty rich kid picks an unemployed reporter working as a janitor as his new plaything at his father's department store.
Description: On one of his bratty son Eric's annual visits, the plutocrat U.S. Bates takes him to his department store and offers him anything in it as a gift. Eric chooses a black janitor who has made him laugh with his antics. At first the man suffers many indignities as Eric's "___", but gradually teaches the lonely boy what it is like to have and to be a friend.

Title: To the Wonder
Hint: A man is torn between a European woman he brought to Oklahoma and an old flame.
Description: Neil is torn between two loves: Marina, the European woman who comes to the United States to be with him, and Jane, the old flame from his hometown he reconnects with. Neil’s doubts about his life and loves are reflected in the crisis of faith experienced by Father Quintana, who only sees pain and the loss of hope in the world.

Title: For Richer or Poorer
Hint: A wealthy, quarrelling Manhattan couple on the run from the IRS hide out with an Amish family.
Description: Brad Sexton and his wife, Caroline, are wealthy New Yorkers with both marital and financial problems. The latter issue becomes a pressing matter when they discover that their accountant has embezzled millions and pinned the blame on them. Forced to go on the lam, Brad and Caroline end up in an Amish area of Pennsylvania and decide to pose as members of the religious group to evade the IRS.

Title: 1BR
Hint: A young woman moves into an idyllic LA apartment complex that turns out to be a cult.
Description: When Sarah lucks into a sweet one-bedroom at Asilo Del Mar Apartments in Los Angeles, she thinks she's hit the jackpot. It's got plenty of space, friendly tenants, group BBQs and even a cute neighbour next door. All is not what it seems: loud noises start keeping her awake at night; her cat is missing; everyone seems to be a little too helpful and friendly, except for the weirdo, Lester.

Title: The Ant Bully
Hint: A boy who floods an anthill is shrunk to their size and must learn their ways.
Description: Fed up with being targeted by the neighborhood ___, 10-year-old Lucas Nickle vents his frustrations on the anthill in his front yard ... until the insects shrink him to the size of a bug with a magic elixir. Convicted of "crimes against the colony," Lucas can only regain his freedom by living with the ants and learning their ways.

Title: Silent Night, Deadly Night
Hint: A boy who witnessed his parents' murder by a man in a red suit grows up to be a killer.
Description: After a man dressed as Santa Claus brutally murders Billy Chapman's parents, little Billy then endures the cruelty of a sadistic nun at his orphanage. Years later, when adult Billy has to fill in for an absent in-store Santa, his childhood trauma brings him to the breaking point.

Title: Mary Reilly
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A housemaid falls in love with a doctor and his darkly mysterious alter ego in Victorian London.
Description: A housemaid falls in love with Dr. Jekyll and his darkly mysterious counterpart, Mr. Hyde.

Title: Kin
Hint: A young boy finds an otherworldly weapon, which he uses to save his older adoptive brother.
Description: A young boy finds a powerful otherworldly weapon, which he uses to save his older adoptive brother from a crew of thugs. Before long, the two of them are also pursued by federal agents and mysterious mercenaries aiming to reclaim their asset.

Title: Sea Fever
Genres: Thriller, Horror, Drama, Science Fiction, Mystery
Hint: The crew of a West of Ireland trawler are marooned with a deadly parasite.
Description: The crew of a West of Ireland trawler—marooned at sea—struggle for their lives against a growing parasite in their water supply.

Title: Murder Party
Hint: A lonely man invited to a costume bash on October 31st is captured by pretentious artists planning a killing.
Description: A random invitation to a Halloween party leads a man into the hands of a rogue collective sparking a bloodbath of mishap, mayhem and hilarity.

Title: Sudden Death
Hint: A former firefighter must save the vice president from terrorists at a Stanley Cup game.
Description: When a man's daughter is suddenly taken during a championship hockey game – with the captors demanding a billion dollars by game's end – he frantically sets a plan in motion to rescue her and abort an impending explosion before the final buzzer.

Title: Let It Snow
Hint: A snowstorm on Christmas Eve brings together a group of teens in a small town.
Description: In a small town on Christmas Eve, a snowstorm brings together a group of young people. They soon find their friendships and love lives colliding, and come Christmas morning, nothing will be the same.

Title: Vox Lux
Hint: A teenage school shooting survivor becomes a pop star, and her life is shaped by violence.
Description: In 1999, teenage sisters Celeste and Eleanor survive a seismic, violent tragedy. The sisters compose and perform a song about their experience, making something lovely and cathartic out of catastrophe — while also catapulting Celeste to stardom.

Title: Goon: Last of the Enforcers
Hint: A hockey enforcer is injured during a pro lockout and must choose between family and the game.
Description: During a pro lockout, Doug "The Thug" Glatt is injured and must choose whether to defend his team against a dangerous new enemy, or be there for his wife as she prepares to give birth to his daughter.

Title: Terror Train
Hint: A masked killer targets college students on a costume party aboard a locomotive.
Description: A masked killer targets six college kids responsible for a prank gone wrong three years earlier and who are currently throwing a large New Year's Eve costume party aboard a moving train.

Title: Air America
Hint: Two pilots fly for a CIA-run airline in Laos during the Vietnam War, and uncover a drug-smuggling scheme.
Description: ___ was the CIA's private airline operating in Laos during the Vietnam War, running anything and everything from soldiers to foodstuffs for local villagers. After losing his pilot's license, Billy Covington is recruited, and ends up in the middle of a bunch of lunatic pilots, gun-running by his friend Gene Ryack, and opium smuggling by his own superiors.

Title: Uncle Drew
Hint: An older basketball player recruits his old team to win a tournament.
Description: ___ recruits a squad of older basketball players to return to the court to compete in a tournament.

Title: Next of Kin
Hint: After inheriting a retirement home, a woman witnesses strange events.
Description: After Linda inherits a retirement home, she witnesses a series of strange events which seem connected to a dark and unspeakable evil.

Title: Wonder Park
Hint: A girl discovers that the magical amusement land from her imagination has come to life and is in danger.
Description: A young girl named June with a big imagination makes an incredible discovery -- the amusement park of her dreams has come to life. Filled with the world's wildest rides operated by fun-loving animals, the excitement never ends. But when trouble hits, June and her misfit team of furry friends begin an unforgettable journey to save the park.

Title: Firewall
Hint: A bank security expert is forced to rob his own bank by criminals who kidnapped his family.
Description: State-of-the-art security system creator Jack Stanfield has cemented his reputation as a man who's thought of everything. But when a criminal finds a way into his personal life, everything Jack holds dear is suddenly at stake.

Title: The Reef
Hint: A great white shark hunts the crew of a capsized sailboat off the coast of Queensland.
Description: A great white shark hunts the crew of a capsized sailboat along the Great Barrier ___.

Title: Beowulf & Grendel
Country: Australia, Canada, Iceland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Norse warrior battles a murderous troll in a blood-soaked tale.
Description: The blood-soaked tale of a Norse warrior's battle against the great and murderous troll, ___. Heads will roll. Out of allegiance to the King Hrothgar, the much respected Lord of the Danes, ___ leads a troop of warriors across the sea to rid a village of the marauding monster.

Title: The Forger
Hint: A former child art prodigy and petty thief arranges to get out of prison.
Description: A former child art prodigy and second generation petty thief arranges to buy his way out of prison to spend time with his ailing son, only to be forced to alter his plans and commit one more job for the man who financed his release.

Title: Final Score
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An ex-soldier is trapped in a stadium seized by terrorists during a football match.
Description: When a stadium is seized by a group of heavily armed criminals during a major sporting event, an ex-soldier must use all his military skills to save both the daughter of a fallen comrade and the huge crowd unaware of the danger.

Title: Annapolis
Hint: A working-class young man from a shipbuilding family enrols at the US Naval Academy and becomes a boxer.
Description: Jake Huard, from a shipbuilders family, promised his dying mother he'ld make it to Anapolis Naval Academy. Thanks to tenaciously bugging a Congressman, he's selected despite dubious grades. Once inside, Jake soon proves sub-standard academically.

Title: Sierra Burgess Is a Loser
Hint: A high school girl catfishes a jock, with the help of a popular cheerleader.
Description: A case of mistaken identity results in unexpected romance when the most popular girl in high school and the biggest ___ must come together to win over their crushes.

Title: Laws of Attraction
Country: Germany, Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two New York divorce lawyers fall in love while on opposing sides of a case.
Description: Amidst a sea of litigation, two New York City divorce lawyers find love.

Title: Airport '77
Hint: A hijacked airliner crashes in the Bermuda Triangle and sinks to the bottom of the sea.
Description: Flight 23 has crashed in the Bermuda Triangle after a hijacking gone wrong. Now the surviving passengers must brave panic, slow leaks, oxygen depletion, and more while attempting a daring plan, all while 200 feet underwater.

Title: Babe: Pig in the City
Hint: A sheep-herding piglet and his farmer's wife travel to a big city, where they get lost in a hotel full of animals.
Description: ___, fresh from his victory in the sheepherding contest, returns to Farmer Hoggett's farm, but after Farmer Hoggett is injured and unable to work, ___ has to go to the big city to save the farm.

Title: Escape from Planet Earth
Genres: Animation, Comedy, Adventure, Family, Science Fiction
Hint: A heroic blue alien astronaut gets caught in a trap when he responds to an SOS from a notoriously dangerous world.
Description: Astronaut Scorch Supernova finds himself caught in a trap when he responds to an SOS from a notoriously dangerous alien planet.

Title: Beyond a Reasonable Doubt
Hint: A newspaper publisher sets up his writer to be accused of a murder to prove a point.
Description: A newspaper publisher, wanting to prove a point about the insufficiency of circumstantial evidence, talks his possible son-in-law Tom into a hoax in an attempt to expose ineptitude of the city's hard-line district attorney. The plan is to have Tom plant clues leading to his arrest for killing a female nightclub dancer. Once Tom is found guilty, he is to reveal the setup and humiliate the DA.

Title: Peter Pan 2: Return to Never Land
Country: Australia, Canada, United States of America
Hint: A boy who refuses to grow up whisks a girl who no longer believes in magic to his island during the WWII Blitz.
Description: In 1940, the world is besieged by World War II. Wendy, all grown up, has two children; including Jane, who does not believe Wendy's stories about Peter ___.

Title: Smiley Face
Hint: A stoned actress tries to get through her chaotic day after eating her roommate's pot cupcakes.
Description: Jane, a struggling but perpetually stoned actress, has a busy day ahead. She has several important tasks on her list, including buying more marijuana. Even though she already has a good start on the day's planned drug use, she eats her roommate's pot-laced cupcakes and embarks on a series of misadventures all over Los Angeles.

Title: Afterlife of the Party
Hint: A woman who dies during her birthday week is given a second chance to make amends.
Description: A social butterfly who dies during her birthday week is given a second chance to right her wrongs on Earth.

Hint: Four friends in London get caught up in a diamond robbery over three days.
Description: Jo is chained down in a dead end supermarket job while all her friends are all out on their own separate adventures. But a chance encounter with some diamond thieves sends their separate worlds on a collision course with not only each other, but fate itself.

Title: Love the Coopers
Hint: Four generations of a dysfunctional family come together for Christmas.
Description: When four generations of the Cooper clan come together for their annual Christmas Eve celebration, a series of unexpected visitors and unlikely events turn the night upside down, leading them all toward a surprising rediscovery of family bonds and the spirit of the holiday.

Title: Silk
Hint: A French silkworm trader falls for a mysterious woman in Japan in the 19th century.
Description: French silkworm trader Hervé is married to the beautiful Hélène. When an outbreak of disease ravages European silkworms, Hervé must travel to Japan to retrieve healthy eggs. After a long journey, Hervé finally arrives at a village where he can buy them. He becomes infatuated with a young concubine and goes to great lengths to see her again.

Title: A California Christmas
Hint: A wealthy charmer poses as a ranch hand to get a farmer to sell her land.
Description: With his carefree lifestyle on the line, a wealthy charmer poses as a ranch hand to get a hardworking farmer to sell her family’s land before Christmas.

Title: Life of Crime
Hint: Two common criminals kidnap a rich man's wife, but he doesn't want her back.
Description: Two common criminals get more than they bargained for after kidnapping the wife of a corrupt real-estate developer who shows no interest in paying the $1 million dollar ransom for her safe return.

Title: Outpost
Hint: Mercenaries hired by a businessman find a Nazi bunker with undead soldiers.
Description: In a seedy bar in a town ravaged by war, scientist and businessman Hunt hires mercenary and former Royal Marine D.C. to assemble a crack team of ex-soldiers to protect him on a dangerous journey into no-man's land. Their mission is to scope out an old military bunker in Eastern Europe. It should be easy – 48 hours at the most. Lots of cash for little risk. Or so he says...

Title: All About the Benjamins
Hint: A bounty hunter and a con artist team up to recover stolen diamonds in Miami.
Description: Bounty hunter Bucum Jackson teams with the small-time con artist, Reggie Wright, that he is pursuing, in an attempt to locate a missing stash of diamonds and a lottery ticket worth millions of dollars. Bucum and Reggie find themselves in a race to the finish as they embark on an unlikely partnership that should -- when all is said and done -- prove beneficial to them both.

Title: The Seventh Sign
Hint: A pregnant woman suspects her boarder is a messenger of the apocalypse.
Description: Abby is a pregnant woman with a curious new boarder in the apartment over her garage. Turns out he's heaven-sent and is speeding along the Apocalypse by bloodying rivers, egging on plagues and following scripture word for word.

Title: Ginger Snaps Back: The Beginning
Hint: Two sisters in 19th-century Canada encounter werewolves at a remote fort under siege.
Description: Set in 19th Century Canada, Brigitte and her sister ___ take refuge in a Traders' Fort which later becomes under siege by some savage werewolves. But when one of the girls is bitten, they have no one to turn to but themselves.

Title: Amelia
Hint: The life of a legendary aviator who disappeared on a round-the-world flight.
Description: A look at the life of legendary American pilot ___ Earhart, who disappeared while flying over the Pacific Ocean in 1937 in an attempt to make a flight around the world.

Title: War on Everyone
Hint: Two corrupt cops in New Mexico blackmail every criminal they encounter.

Description: After the death of her husband, a mother takes her kids off to live with their grandparents in a huge, decrepit old mansion. Description: Jimmy is a young man who was born without an immune system and has lived his life within a plastic ___ in his bedroom... who pines for the sweet caresses of girl-next-door Chloe. But when Chloe decides to marry her high school boyfriend, Jimmy – ___ suit and all – treks cross-country to stop her.

Description: After years of performing “exorcisms” and taking believers’ money, Reverend Marcus travels to rural Louisiana with a film crew so he can dispel what he believes is the myth of demonic possession.

Description: Big money artists and mega-collectors pay a high price when art collides with commerce. After a series of paintings by an unknown artist are discovered, a supernatural force enacts revenge on those who have allowed their greed to get in the way of art.

Description: Eddie Hawkins, called ___ has just been released from ten years of prison and is planning to spend the rest of his life honestly. But then the crazy Mayflower couple blackmail him to steal some of the works of Leonardo da Vinci. If he refuses, they threaten to kill his friend Tommy.

Title: A Classic Horror Story

Description: Five people travelling by camper crash into a tree. When they recover, the road they were driving on has been replaced by an impenetrable forest and a wooden house.

Description: Challenges of impending parenthood turn the lives of five couples upside down.

Title: Planes

Description: Dusty is a cropdusting plane who dreams of competing in a famous aerial race. The problem? He is hopelessly afraid of heights. With the support of his mentor Skipper and a host of new friends, Dusty sets off to make his dreams come true.

Description: Nothing gets between Anne Marie and her board. Having transplanted herself to Hawaii with no one's blessing but her own, Anne Marie finds all she needs in the adrenaline-charged surf scene - until pro quarterback Matt Tollman comes along...

Title: Humanoids from the Deep

Description: After suffering a personal tragedy, and desperate for justice, Jacob Kanon, a veteran New York City police detective, embarks on the search for a twisted killer who is leaving a bloody trail of elaborate murders across Europe.

Title: Enough

Description: Working-class waitress Slim thought she was entering a life of domestic bliss when she married Mitch, the man of her dreams. After the arrival of their first child, her picture perfect life is shattered when she discovers Mitch's hidden possessive dark side, a controlling and abusive alter ego that can turn trust, love and tranquility into terror. Terrified for her child's safety, Slim flees with her daughter.

Title: The Marksman

Description: Jim Hanson’s quiet life is suddenly disturbed by two people crossing the US/Mexico border – a woman and her young son – desperate to flee a Mexican cartel. He embraces his role as Miguel’s protector and will stop at nothing to get him to safety, as they go on the run from the relentless assassins.

Description: A cunning and resourceful housewife vows revenge on her husband when he begins an affair with a wealthy romance novelist.

Description: Dealing with a sociopathic school bully, three high school freshmen hire a low-budget bodyguard to protect them, not realizing he is just a homeless beggar and petty thief looking for some easy cash.

Description: An American tourist in Greece finds himself on the run after a tragic accident plunges him into a political conspiracy that makes him a target for assassination.

Description: A story about a seemingly unlikely couple who cross paths under life-threatening circumstances as though they are destined not only to meet but to save each other's lives. Not once, but twice.

Description: A beautiful, strong-willed young royal refuses to wed the cruel sociopath to whom she is betrothed and is kidnapped and locked in a remote tower of her father’s castle. With her scorned, vindictive suitor intent on taking her father’s throne, the ___ must protect her family and save the kingdom.

Title: Devil's Pass
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Russia

Description: In February of 1959, nine Russian hikers ventured into a remote area of the Ural Mountains. Two weeks later, all of them were found dead. What happened is a mystery that has baffled investigators and researchers for decades. It has become known as the Dyatlov ___ Incident.

Title: Diary of a Mad Black Woman
Hint: A woman is thrown out by her husband and moves in with her grandmother.
Description: Charles, an attorney, and Helen, his devoted wife, seem to have everything – money, a beautiful mansion – the American Dream. However, as Helen prepares to celebrate their 18th wedding anniversary, her life takes an unexpected twist when she comes home to find her clothes packed up in a U-Haul van parked in the driveway. Charles is divorcing her and kicks her out.

Title: Afternoon Delight
Hint: A stay-at-home mom tries to spice up her marriage by taking in a young stripper.
Description: Rachel is a quick-witted and lovable stay-at-home mom, frustrated with the responsibilities of her son's preschool, a lacklustre sex life and a career that's gone kaput. One night, intent on spicing up their marriage, she visits an LA strip club with her husband, where she meets McKenna, a stripper she adopts as her live-in nanny.

Title: Wild Mountain Thyme
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A headstrong farmer in Ireland pines for her neighbour, who believes he's a honeybee.
Description: Headstrong farmer Rosemary Muldoon has her heart set on winning her neighbour Anthony Reilly's love. The problem is, Anthony seems to have inherited a family curse, and remains oblivious to his beautiful admirer. Stung by his father's plans to sell the family farm to his American nephew, Anthony is jolted into pursuing his dreams.

Title: Jingle All the Way
Hint: A father desperately searches for the year's hottest toy on Christmas Eve.
Description: Howard Langston, a salesman for a mattress company, is constantly kept busy at his job, disappointing his son. After he misses his son's karate exposition, Howard vows to make it up to him by buying an action figure of his son's favorite television hero for Christmas. Unfortunately for Howard, it is Christmas Eve, and every store is sold out of Turbo Man.

Title: The War with Grandpa
Hint: A boy declares all-out prank warfare on his grandfather to get his bedroom back.
Description: Peter is thrilled that his ___ is coming to live with his family. That is, until ___ moves into Peter's room, forcing him upstairs into the creepy attic. And though he loves his ___, he wants his room back - so he has no choice but to declare war.

Title: Almost Heroes

Description: Two hapless explorers lead an ill-fated 1804 expedition through the Pacific Northwest in a hopeless, doomed effort to reach the Pacific Ocean before Lewis and Clark.

Title: Diary of a Nymphomaniac

Description: A chronicle of the life of a middle-class French girl's sexual adventures, her then fall into prostitution, and her ultimate redemption.

Title: Meet Cute
Hint: A woman travels back in time to perfect her relationship with a man she just met.
Description: A wildly inventive deconstruction of the romantic comedy built around the question: What would you do if you could travel to your loved ones’ past, heal their traumas, fix their problems, and change them into the perfect partner?

Title: The Hallow
Hint: A family in rural Ireland face the ancient evil of the forest.
Description: Deep within the darkness of secluded forest land in rural Ireland dwells an ancient evil. Feared by the nearby superstitious villagers as cursed creatures who prey upon the lost, their secrets have been kept from civilization and remain on their hallowed ground.

Title: High Spirits
Country: Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An American tourist falls for a ghost in an Irish castle.
Description: When a hotelier attempts to fill the chronic vacancies at his castle by launching an advertising campaign that falsely portrays the property as haunted, two actual ghosts show up and end up falling for two guests.

Title: Premature
Hint: A young woman falls for a mysterious man in Harlem before leaving for college.
Description: The summer before she leaves for college, Ayanna meets handsome and mysterious outsider Isaiah; her entire world is turned upside down as she navigates the demanding terrain of young love against a changing Harlem landscape.

Title: Crocodile Dundee II
Hint: An Australian outback expert protects his New York love from drug lords.
Description: Australian outback expert protects his New York love from gangsters who've followed her down under.

Title: Money Train
