Description: When a vengeful New York transit cop decides to steal a trainload of subway fares, his foster brother—a fellow cop—tries to protect him.

Title: The Sleepover
Hint: Two siblings discover their mom is a former thief in witness protection.
Description: Two siblings who discover their seemingly normal mom is a former thief in witness protection. Mom is forced to pull one last job, and the kids team up to rescue her over the course of an action-packed night.

Title: Security
Hint: An ex-special forces veteran takes a job as a mall guard and must defend a girl from a gang of mercenaries.
Description: An ex-special services veteran, down on his luck and desperate for work, takes a job as a ___ guard at a run-down mall in a rough area of town. On his first night on the job, he opens the door to a distraught and desperate young girl who has fled the hijacking of a Police motorcade that was transporting her to testify as a witness in a trial.

Title: The Keep
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A German army garrison guarding a Romanian castle unleashes an ancient evil.
Description: Set during World War II, a German army garrison is sent to guard a mountain pass in a village in Romania's Carpathian mountains and sets up barracks in an ancient stone fortress. Two of the soldiers unwittingly release a mysterious entity that kills or corrupts those within its influence, drawing the attention of a Gestapo commander, a Jewish scholar, and a mysterious traveller.

Title: Mighty Joe Young
Hint: A woman protects a giant gorilla from poachers and brings him to Los Angeles.
Description: As a child living in Africa, Jill Young saw her mother killed while protecting wild gorillas from poachers led by Andrei Strasser. Now an adult, Jill cares for an orphaned gorilla named Joe -- who, due to a genetic anomaly, is 15 feet tall. When Gregg O'Hara arrives from California and sees the animal, he convinces Jill that Joe would be safest at his wildlife refuge.

Title: Perfect Stranger
Hint: A journalist goes undercover to investigate a businessman she suspects of killing her friend.
Description: A journalist goes undercover to ferret out businessman Harrison Hill as her best friend's killer. Posing as one of his temps, she enters into a game of online cat-and-mouse.

Title: Antiviral

Description: Syd March is employed at a clinic that sells injections of live viruses harvested from sick celebrities to obsessed fans. When he becomes infected with the disease that kills super sensation Hannah Geist, Syd becomes a target for collectors and rabid fans. He must unravel the mystery surrounding her death before he suffers the same fate.

Title: Strange Magic

Description: A love potion works its devious charms on fairies, elves and the swamp-dwelling Bog King as they all try to possess the potion for themselves.

Title: Queen of the Desert
Hint: The life of a British explorer and archaeologist who helped shape the modern Middle East.
Description: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attaché for the British Empire in the Near and Middle East at the dawn of the twentieth century. Her knowledge of the tribal leaders is used by the British to establish the Kingdoms of Iraq, Jordan and Saudi Arabia.

Title: Pet

Description: A man bumps into an old crush and becomes obsessed. After several failed attempts at winning her over, he kidnaps her and holds her captive underneath the animal shelter where he works.

Title: Nocturne
Hint: A timid music student at an elite arts academy discovers a notebook that gives her talent.
Description: Inside the halls of an elite arts academy, a timid music student begins to outshine her more accomplished and outgoing twin sister when she discovers a mysterious notebook belonging to a recently deceased classmate.

Title: The Santa Clause 2
Hint: The big guy in red must find a wife before his time at the North Pole runs out.
Description: Better watch out! The big guy in red is coming to town once again. This time, Scott Calvin -- also known as ___ Claus -- finds out there's an obscure ___ in his contract requiring him to take on a wife. He has to leave the North Pole to fulfill his obligations, or else he'll be forced to give up his Yuletide gig.

Title: Four Christmases
Hint: A couple has to visit each of their divorced parents on December 25th.
Description: Brad and Kate have made something of an art form out of avoiding their families during the holidays, but this year their foolproof plan is about go bust -- big time. Stuck at the city airport after all departing flights are canceled, the couple is embarrassed to see their ruse exposed to the world by an overzealous television reporter.

Country: Australia, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An air traffic controller sees the same sequence of events every day at 2:22.
Description: Two planes almost collide after a blinding flash of light paralyzes air traffic controller Dylan Branson for a few seconds. Suspended from his job, Dylan starts to notice an ominous pattern of sounds and events that repeats itself in exactly the same manner every day, ending precisely at ___ p.m.

Title: SpaceCamp
Hint: A group of teens at a summer camp are accidentally launched into space.
Description: Andie Bergstrom, an astronaut eagerly awaiting her first trip to space, runs a summer camp for teenagers with her NASA-employed husband, Zach. One night during an engine test, Andie and four teenage campers are accidentally shot into space. Together, the group -- which includes Kathryn, a pilot-in-training, and Tish, a ditz with a perfect memory -- must work together to operate the spacecraft and return home.

Title: The Bay
Hint: A deadly parasite spreads through a Maryland town on the Fourth of July.
Description: Two million fish washed ashore. One thousand blackbirds dropped from the sky. On July 4, 2009 a deadly menace swept through the quaint seaside town of Claridge, Maryland, but the harrowing story of what happened that Independence Day has never been told—until now. The authorities believed they had buried the truth about the tragedy that claimed over 700 human lives.

Title: Return of the Living Dead II
Hint: Kids discover a drum of toxic gas that brings corpses back to life.
Description: A group of kids discover one of the drums containing a rotting corpse and release the 2-4-5 Trioxin gas into the air, causing the dead to once again rise from the grave and seek out brains.

Title: Aftermath
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A fatal plane crash changes the lives of two men forever.
Description: A fatal plane crash changes the lives of Roman and Jake forever. Roman loses his wife and daughter in the accident, while Jake loses his mind—as he happens to be the air traffic controller who failed to avert the nightmare. Rage and revenge engulfs Roman and Jake finds himself swamped with guilt and regret.

Title: Spinning Man
Hint: A professor becomes a suspect when a student goes missing, and his memory seems unreliable.
Description: Evan Birch is a family man and esteemed professor at a distinguished university. When a female student goes missing, police Detective Malloy has reason to be suspicious when crucial evidence makes Evan the prime suspect in her disappearance.

Title: Get Over It
Hint: A popular basketball player gets dumped and joins a school play to win her back.
Description: When Berke Landers, a popular high school basketball star, gets dumped by his life-long girlfriend, Allison, he soon begins to lose it. But with the help of his best friend Felix's sister Kelly, he follows his ex into the school's spring musical.

Title: Savage Grace
Country: United States of America, Spain, France
Hint: A wealthy socialite's relationship with her son ends in murder.
Description: This examination of a famous scandal from the 1970s explores the relationship between Barbara Baekeland and her only son, Antony. Barbara, a lonely social climber unhappily married to the wealthy but remote plastics heir Brooks Baekeland, dotes on Antony, who is homosexual. As Barbara tries to "cure" Antony of his sexuality -- sometimes by seducing him herself -- the groundwork is laid for a murderous tragedy.

Title: The Goods: Live Hard, Sell Hard
Hint: A legendary used-car salesman is hired to save a dealership over the Fourth of July weekend.
Description: Don Ready is many things, but he is best-known as an extraordinary salesman. When a car dealership in Temecula teeters on the brink of bankruptcy, he and his ragtag team dive in to save the day. But what Ready doesn't count on is falling in love and finding his soul.

Title: Office Uprising
Hint: An arms manufacturer's employees turn into zombies after drinking a new energy drink.
Description: The compound of an arms manufacturer turns into a zombie nightmare when its workers are given the wrong formula.

Title: Red Planet
Hint: Astronauts on a mission to Mars are stranded with a malfunctioning robot.
Description: Astronauts search for solutions to save a dying Earth by searching on Mars, only to have the mission go terribly awry.

Title: Sugar & Spice
Hint: A cheerleading squad decides to rob a bank to help their pregnant captain.
Description: When Jack and Diane find themselves in an unexpected adult situation, the A-Squad comes to their rescue. In order to help their friend Diane, the A-Squad goes where no cheerleader has gone before: taking on a little after-school project known as bank robbery. But the A-Squad does things their way -- with ___ -- forever changing their friendship, their future and the nation's notion of teen spirit.

Title: Orca
Hint: A killer whale hunts the reckless captain who killed his mate.
Description: After witnessing the killing of his mate and offspring at the hands of a reckless Irish captain, a vengeful killer whale rampages through the fisherman's Newfoundland harbor. Under pressure from the villagers, the captain, a female marine biologist, and an Indigenous tribalist venture after the great beast, who will meet them on its own turf.

Title: Nowhere to Run
Hint: An escaped convict protects a widow and her children from ruthless developers.
Description: Escaped convict Sam Gillen single-handedly takes on ruthless developers who are determined to evict a widow with two young children.

Title: Kill Command
Hint: A team of soldiers on a training island find the AI-controlled robots they're fighting have learned too much.
Description: Set in a near future, technology-reliant society that pits man against killing machines. Against this backdrop an elite army unit is helicoptered to a remote, off-the-grid island training facility.

Title: The Comeback Trail
Hint: Two movie producers owing money to the mob plan to kill an aging actor for insurance.
Description: Two movie producers who owe money to the mob set up their aging movie star for an insurance scam to try and save themselves. But they wind up getting more than they ever imagined.

Title: Lost River
Hint: A single mother is drawn into a macabre underworld while her son discovers a secret underwater town.
Description: Billy, a single mother of two, is led into a macabre underworld while her teenage son, Bones, discovers a secret road leading to an underwater town. Both Billy and Bones must dive deep into the mystery if their family is to survive.

Title: The Vanished
Hint: A family vacation at a lakeside campground turns terrifying when the young daughter disappears.
Description: A family vacation takes a terrifying turn when parents Paul and Wendy discover their young daughter has ___ without a trace. Stopping at nothing to find her, the search for the truth leads to a shocking revelation.

Title: Little Evil
Hint: A newlywed man discovers his stepson might be the Antichrist.
Description: Gary, who has just married Samantha, the woman of his dreams, discovers that her six-year-old son may be the Antichrist.

Title: Intruders
Country: United States of America, Spain, United Kingdom
Hint: Two children in different countries are haunted by a faceless figure.
Description: Though no one can see him, Hollow Face lurks in the corners, desperately desiring love but only knowing how to spread fear and hate. He creeps into the life of John Farrow after Farrow’s beloved 12-year-old daughter Mia is assaulted in their home. The line between the real and the imaginary blurs as fissures start to open within the family unit. It seems that no security measure can keep Hollow Face out.

Title: Honeymoon
Hint: A newlywed bride sleepwalks into the woods surrounding a secluded cabin.
Description: On her ___, a young bride sleepwalks into the woods surrounding a secluded cabin. When she returns, she looks the same—but something about her is terrifyingly different.

Title: Michael
Hint: Tabloid reporters investigate a man who claims to be an archangel.
Description: Tabloid reporters are sent by their editor to investigate after the paper recieves a letter from a woman claiming an angel is living with her.

Title: Acts of Vengeance
Hint: A fast-talking lawyer takes a vow of silence until he finds his wife and daughter's killer.
Description: A fast-talking lawyer transforms his body and takes a vow of silence, not to be broken until he finds out who killed his wife and daughter and has his revenge.

Title: Short Circuit 2
Hint: A robot moves to the city to help his friend with a toy factory.
Description: Robot Johnny 5 moves to the city to help his friend Ben Jahrvi with his toy manufacturing enterprise, only to be manipulated by criminals who want to use him for their own nefarious purposes.

Title: Death Warrant
Hint: A Canadian cop investigates the murders of prisoners in a jail.
Description: Canadian policeman Louis Burke is assigned in a jail to investigate the murders of prisoners and jailors. While there, Louis, using his outstanding martial arts skills, is able to save his life and make himself respected in this violent world.

Title: Bandidas
Hint: Two women become bank robbers to fight a ruthless robber baron in Mexico.
Description: When a ruthless robber baron takes away everything they cherish, a rough-and-tumble, idealistic peasant and a sophisticated heiress embark on a quest for justice, vengeance…and a few good heists.

Title: The Perfect Score
Hint: Six high school seniors break into a testing centre to steal the SAT answers.
Description: Six high school seniors decide to break into the Princeton Testing Center so they can steal the answers to their upcoming SAT tests and all get perfect scores.

Title: The Paramedic
Hint: An ambulance worker left in a wheelchair develops a deadly obsession with the girlfriend who left him.
Description: Unable to face his new reality in a wheelchair, Ángel develops a deadly obsession with the woman who left him and unleashes a sinister revenge plot.

Title: Life or Something Like It
Hint: A reporter is told by a psychic that she will die in a week.
Description: A reporter Lanie Kerrigan interviews a psychic homeless man for a fluff piece about a football game's score. Instead he tells her that her life has no meaning and is going to end in just a few days, which sparks her to action, trying to change the pattern of her life...

Title: America's Sweethearts
Hint: A publicist must keep a feuding Hollywood couple together for the press junket of their last film.
Description: In the midst of a nasty public breakup of married movie stars, a studio publicist scrambles to put a cap on the escalating situation as the couple's latest film has found it's only print kidnapped by the director.

Title: The Man Who Killed Hitler and Then the Bigfoot
Genres: Drama, Adventure, Fantasy, Science Fiction, War
Hint: An old American veteran who secretly assassinated the Nazi leader is recruited to hunt a legendary forest creature.
Description: Decades after serving in WWII and assassinating Adolf ___, a legendary American war veteran must now hunt down the fabled ___.

Title: The Juror
Hint: A single mother on jury duty is intimidated by a mobster's hitman to win an acquittal.
Description: Struggling single mother Annie Laird impulsively agrees to serve on a jury, hoping for a little excitement in her humdrum life. But she gets far more than she bargained for when she's forced to sacrifice the truth to save her son from the mob's seductive, psychotic enforcer.

Title: The English Teacher
Hint: A small-town Pennsylvania literature instructor stages her former student's dark play, with disastrous results.
Description: Small-town Pennsylvania schoolteacher Linda Sinclair balances her staid home life with an incredible passion for her subject. Then a former star pupil reenters her life after failing as a playwright in New York City.

Title: The Nut Job
Country: Canada, South Korea, United States of America
Hint: A curmudgeonly squirrel is banished from his park and plans a heist on a store full of snacks.
Description: Surly, a curmudgeon, independent squirrel is banished from his park and forced to survive in the city. Lucky for him, he stumbles on the one thing that may be able to save his life, and the rest of park community, as they gear up for winter - Maury's ___ Store.

Title: The Flock
Country: Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: A public safety agent near retirement searches for a missing girl he believes is with a sex offender.
Description: Erroll Babbage has spent his career tracking sex offenders and his unorthodox methods are nearly as brutal as the criminals he monitors. When he links one of his deranged parolees to the disappearance of a local girl, he and his new partner must scour the S&M underground to find her before it's too late.

Title: Rules Don't Apply
Hint: An aspiring actress and her driver fall in love while working for an eccentric billionaire.
Description: The unconventional love story of an aspiring actress, her ambitious driver, and their eccentric boss, the legendary billionaire Howard Hughes.

Title: Gambit
Hint: An art curator seeks revenge on his boss by conning him into buying a fake painting.
Description: An art curator decides to seek revenge on his abusive boss by conning him into buying a fake Monet, but his plan requires the help of an eccentric and unpredictable Texas rodeo queen.

Title: Last Days
Hint: A notorious grunge musician spirals into loneliness and isolation in the final hours of his life.
Description: The life and struggles of a notorious rock musician seeping into a pit of loneliness whose everyday life involves friends and family seeking financial aid and favors, inspired by rock music legend Kurt Cobain and his final hours.

Title: Something to Talk About
Hint: A woman managing her father's stables discovers her husband is cheating.
Description: Grace King Bichon, who is managing her father's riding-stable, discovers that her husband Eddie is deceiving her with another woman. After confronting him in the middle of the night on the streets of their small home town, she decides to stay at her sister Emma Rae's house for a while to make up her mind. Breaking out of her everyday life, she starts to question the authority of everyone.

Title: Drowning Mona
Hint: A sheriff investigates the murder of a hated woman in a small town.
Description: A Sheriff investigating the murder of an upstate New York woman learns that her extremely hateful ways gave the whole town a motive to be rid of her.

Title: New in Town
Hint: An ambitious Miami executive is sent to Minnesota to restructure a plant.
Description: Lucy Hill is an ambitious up-and-coming executive living in Miami. She loves her shoes, her cars, and climbing the corporate ladder. When she is offered a temporary assignment — in the middle of nowhere — to restructure a manufacturing plant, she jumps at the opportunity, knowing that a big promotion is close at hand.

Title: How to Talk to Girls at Parties
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: In 1970s London, a punk teenager falls in love with an alien.
Description: In 1970s London, a teenage outsider named Enn falls in love with a rebellious alien girl named Zan, who has come to Earth for a party. Together, they navigate the complexities of intergalactic culture and the trials of first love.

Title: Love Potion No. 9
Hint: A nerdy chemist gets a magic elixir from a fortune teller that makes him irresistible to women.
Description: Unlucky in love, chemist Paul Matthews visits gypsy Madame Rosa for help. Quickly realizing he is a hopeless nerd, she gifts him with Love ___ No. 8, which makes anyone who wears it irresistible to the opposite sex for four hours. Paul and animal psychologist coworker Diane Farrow decide to test it on themselves.

Title: In the Blood
Hint: A woman searches for her husband who goes missing during their Caribbean vacation.
Description: When her husband goes missing during their Caribbean vacation, a woman sets off on her own to take down the men she thinks are responsible.

Title: Kevin & Perry Go Large
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two hopeless teenage friends go to Ibiza to become DJs.
Description: When stubborn, spotty ___ and his equally hopeless best friend ___ go on holiday to the party island Ibiza, they see it as their big chance to become superstar club DJs and, more importantly, to lose their virginities. But they aren't prepared for the interference of top DJ Eyeball Paul, not to mention the embarrassment factor of ___ long-suffering parents.

Title: Some Kind of Beautiful
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A professor has a baby with his young girlfriend.
Description: By day, Richard Haig is a successful and well-respected English professor at renowned Trinity College in Cambridge. By night, Richard indulges his own romantic fantasies with a steady stream of beautiful undergraduates. But Richard has grown tired of the game and is looking for something more meaningful and lasting.

Title: An American Pickle
Hint: An immigrant worker at a brine factory is preserved for 100 years and wakes up in modern Brooklyn.
Description: An immigrant worker at a ___ factory is accidentally preserved for 100 years and wakes up in modern day Brooklyn. He learns his only surviving relative is his great grandson, a computer coder who he can’t connect with.

Title: Admission
Hint: A Princeton gatekeeper of applications meets a gifted boy who might be the son she gave up.
Description: Straitlaced Princeton University admissions officer Portia Nathan is caught off-guard when she makes a recruiting visit to an alternative high school overseen by her former classmate, the freewheeling John Pressman. Pressman has surmised that Jeremiah, his gifted yet very unconventional student, might well be the son that Portia secretly gave up for adoption many years ago.

Title: Airport 1975
Hint: A flight attendant must fly a damaged airliner after a mid-air collision kills the pilots.
Description: When an in-flight collision incapacitates the pilots of an airplane bound for Los Angeles, stewardess Nancy Pryor is forced to take over the controls. From the ground, her boyfriend Alan Murdock, a retired test pilot, tries to talk her through piloting and landing the 747 aircraft. Worse yet, the anxious passengers — among which are a noisy nun and a cranky man — are aggravating the already tense atmosphere.

Title: We Are Still Here
Hint: A grieving couple move into a haunted New England house after their son's death.
Description: After the death of their college age son, Anne and Paul Sacchetti relocate to the snowswept New England hamlet of Aylesbury, a sleepy village where all is most certainly not as it seems. When strange sounds and eerie feelings convince Anne that her son's spirit is still with them, they invite an eccentric, New Age couple to help them get to the bottom of the mystery.

Title: Futureworld
Hint: Two journalists investigate a new amusement park with robots.
Description: Two years after the Westworld tragedy in the Delos amusement park, the corporate owners have reopened the park following over $1 billion in safety and other improvements. For publicity purposes, reporters Chuck Browning and Tracy Ballard are invited to review the park. Just prior to arriving, however, Browning is given a clue by a dying man that something is amiss.

Title: Vampires vs. the Bronx
Hint: Three kids from a gentrifying New York neighbourhood discover bloodsuckers are taking over their bodega block.
Description: Three gutsy kids from a rapidly gentrifying ___ neighborhood stumble upon a sinister plot to suck all the life from their beloved community.

Title: I Think We're Alone Now
Hint: After a catastrophe destroys most of humanity, a recluse's peace is shattered by a young woman.
Description: After a catastrophe destroys most of humanity, recluse Del lives in his small, empty town, content with the utopia he has methodically created for himself, until an interloper, young Grace, disrupts his solitude.

Title: The Angriest Man in Brooklyn
Hint: A man is told he has 90 minutes to live.
Description: After learning that a brain aneurysm will kill him in about 90 minutes, a perpetually unhappy man struggles to come to terms with his fate and make amends with everyone he has ever hurt.

Title: Blue Mountain State: The Rise of Thadland
Hint: A college football star throws a massive party at his new mansion.
Description: With ___ football star Thad Castle recently signing a multi-million dollar NFL contract, his teammates and college life seem like a distant memory. However, when a new school dean threatens to clean up the BMS image by auctioning off the infamous Goat House, Alex, Sammy and the boys must find a way to convince him to get involved.

Title: Armed and Dangerous
Hint: A framed cop joins a security firm and uncovers corruption.
Description: After policeman Frank Dooley is framed for theft and loses his job on the force, he joins a security guard agency and teams up with inept former defense lawyer Norman Kane. When the two botch a job guarding a local warehouse, they begin to uncover corruption within the company and their union.

Title: Girl Most Likely
Hint: A failed New York playwright fakes a suicide and is sent back to live with her mother.
Description: A failed New York playwright stages a suicide in an attempt to win back her ex, only to wind up in the custody of her gambling-addict mother.

Title: Echelon Conspiracy
Hint: A young American engineer receives mysterious cell phone messages.
Description: Mysterious cell phone messages promise a young American engineer untold wealth - then make him the target of a deadly international plot. Dangerous security operatives chase the engineer across the globe, while a powerful government official pursues a mysterious agenda that threatens the stability of the entire world.

Title: Kaboom
Hint: A college student has a series of bizarre experiences after eating a hallucinogenic cookie.
Description: Smith, a typical young college student who likes partying and engaging in acts of random sex and debauchery, has been having some interesting dreams revolving around two gorgeous women -- and is shocked when he meets the dream girls in real life. Lorelei looks just like his fantasy brunette, while a mysterious red-haired girl being chased by assassins draws him into an international conspiracy.

Title: The In-Laws
Hint: A dentist meets his daughter's future father-in-law, a CIA agent.
Description: In preparation for his daughter's wedding, dentist Sheldon Kornpett meets Vince Ricardo, the groom's father. Vince, a manic fellow who claims to be a government agent, then proceeds to drag Sheldon into a series of chases and misadventures from New York to Central America.

Title: Cadillac Man
Hint: A fast-talking car salesman with two days to sell twelve cars ends up taken hostage on his showroom floor.
Description: Joe's a car salesman with a problem—he has two days to sell 12 cars or he loses his job. This would be a difficult task at the best of times but Joe has to contend with his girlfriends (he's two-timing), a missing teenage daughter and an ex-wife.

Title: Playing for Keeps
Hint: A washed-up soccer star coaching his son's team is pursued by the players' flirtatious mothers.
Description: A former sports star who's fallen on hard times starts coaching his son's soccer team in an attempt to get his life together.

Title: Armored
Hint: Security guards plan to steal millions from their own armoured truck, but a rookie objects.
Description: A crew of officers at an ___ transport security firm risk their lives when they embark on the ultimate heist against their own company. Armed with a seemingly fool-proof plan, the men plan on making off with a fortune with harm to none. But when an unexpected witness interferes, the plan quickly unravels and all bets are off.

Title: The Preacher's Wife
Hint: An angel arrives to help a struggling pastor save his church, but falls for the pastor's gospel-singing spouse.
Description: Good-natured Reverend Henry Biggs finds that his marriage to choir mistress Julia is flagging, due to his constant absence caring for the deprived neighborhood they live in. On top of all this, his church is coming under threat from property developer Joe Hamilton. In desperation, Biggs prays to God for help – which arrives in the form of an angel named Dudley.

Title: The Possession of Michael King
Hint: A sceptic asks occultists to summon evil spirits to prove they don't exist, and becomes possessed.
Description: Michael King asks occultists to summon all evil spirits to prove his point that they do not exist. But something goes wrong and he becomes a danger to everyone.

Title: Son of God
Hint: The life of a Galilean preacher, from his miracles to his crucifixion, adapted from a TV miniseries about the Bible.
Description: In the Holy Land, the Roman occupation has produced a cauldron of oppression, anxiety and excessive taxes levied upon the Jewish people. Fearing the wrath of Roman governor Pontius Pilate , Jewish high priest Caiaphas tries to keep control of his people. That control is threatened when Jesus arrives in Jerusalem, performing miracles and spreading messages of love and hope.

Title: Ernest Saves Christmas
Hint: Santa is looking for his successor in Orlando, and a goofy cab driver helps him.
Description: When Santa Claus decides to retire and pass on his magic bag of Christmas surprises to a new Saint Nick, he enlists the aid of a hilarious assortment of characters. A perky teen runaway and hapless taxi driver ___ P. Worrell must convince a skeptical kiddie-show host to take over the post of Father Christmas.

Title: Jumping the Broom
Hint: Two very different African-American families clash over a wedding weekend on Martha's Vineyard.
Description: Two very different families converge on Martha's Vineyard one weekend for a wedding.

Title: The Million Dollar Hotel
Hint: A federal agent investigates a death at a seedy LA flophouse full of eccentric residents, where a simple young man is in love.
Description: A federal agent searches for a potential killer among the bizarre residents of a dilapidated Los Angeles hotel.

Title: Just Visiting
Hint: A 12th-century French knight and his servant are accidentally sent forward in time to modern Chicago.
Description: A knight and his valet are plagued by a witch, and to repair the damage they make use of the services of a wizard. However, something goes wrong and they are transported from the 12th century to the year 2000. There the knight meets some of his family and slowly learns what this new century is like. However, he still needs to get back to the 12th century to deal with the witch, so he starts looking for a wizard.

Title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business
Hint: A Chicago barber crew fights to save their shop and neighbourhood from a slick developer and gentrification.
Description: The continuing adventures of the barbers at Calvin's ___. Gina, a stylist at the beauty shop next door, is now trying to cut in on his business. Calvin is again struggling to keep his father's shop and traditions alive--this time against urban developers looking to replace mom & pop establishments with name-brand chains.

Title: The Pact
Hint: After their mother's death, two sisters return to their childhood home and discover a dark presence.
Description: After their mother passes away, sisters Nicole and Annie reluctantly return to their childhood home to pay their last respects. While staying overnight in the house, the sisters sense a mysterious presence in their midst: noises startling them in the night, objects moving about, a fallen picture of an unknown woman posed next to their mother.

Title: Stitches
Hint: A clumsy children's entertainer killed at a birthday party rises from the grave to take revenge.
Description: The clumsy and unfunny clown Richard "___" Grindle entertains at the 10th birthday party of little Tom, but the boy and his friends play a prank with ___, tying his shoelaces. ___ slips, falls and dies. Six years later, Tom gives a birthday party for his friends at home, but ___ revives to haunt the teenagers and revenge his death.

Title: The Banger Sisters
Hint: Two former rock-and-roll groupies reunite after twenty years, and one has become a respectable suburban mother.
Description: In the late '60s, the self-proclaimed belles of the rock 'n' roll ball, rocked the worlds of every music legend whose pants they could take off -- and they have the pictures to prove it. But it's been more than two decades since the ___ earned their nickname -- or even laid eyes on each other. Their reunion is the collision of two women's worlds; one who's living in the past, and one who's hiding from it.

Title: The Gingerbread Man
Hint: A Savannah defence attorney gets involved with a seductive waitress and her deranged father.
Description: A successful Savannah defense attorney gets romantically involved with a sexy, mysterious waitress troubled by psychopaths and dark family secrets.

Title: The Man with One Red Shoe
Hint: A violinist is mistaken for a spy by the CIA when he arrives at an airport wearing mismatched footwear.
Description: A man is mistaken as a spy by the CIA when he arrives at the airport with one red ___.

Title: Family Business
Hint: A career criminal, his straight-laced son and his grandson team up for a heist.
Description: Jessie is an aging career criminal who has been in more jails, fights, schemes, and lineups than just about anyone else. His son Vito, while currently on the straight and narrow, has had a fairly shady past and is indeed no stranger to illegal activity. They both have great hope for Adam, Vito's son and Jessie's grandson, who is bright, good-looking, and without a criminal past.

Title: Earth to Echo
Hint: A group of best friends discover a small alien robot and help him find his way home.
Description: After a construction project begins digging in their neighbourhood, best friends Tuck, Munch and Alex inexplicably begin to receive strange, encoded messages on their cell phones. Convinced something bigger is going on, they go to their parents and the authorities.

Title: The Art of War
Hint: A UN agent framed for murder must clear his name by uncovering a conspiracy.
Description: Neil Shaw is both agent and weapon - a critical line of defense for the Secretary General of the United Nations. He does not even officially exist. As an international security expert, he must uncover an international plot in which ruthless terrorists threatened to bring down the United Nations on the eve of an historic summit with China. A mysterious chain of events leads to the murder of the Chinese U.N.

Title: Collide
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An American backpacker in Germany gets involved with drug smugglers and must outrun them on the Autobahn.
Description: An American backpacker gets involved with a ring of drug smugglers as their driver, and winds up on the run from his employers across Cologne’s autobahns.

Title: The Love Punch
Hint: A divorced couple team up to steal a diamond from a crooked businessman.
Description: Retirement at last! Middle-aged and divorced, company owner Richard Jones is looking forward to a worry-free existence as he arrives at his office on his last day of work. Much to his dismay, he discovers that the management buyout of his company was fraudulent. The company is now bankrupt and the employee pension fund — including his own — has been embezzled.

Title: King Kong vs. Godzilla
Hint: Two legendary monsters, a giant ape and a radioactive lizard, clash in Japan.
Description: The advertising director of Pacific Pharmaceuticals, frustrated with the low ratings of their sponsored TV program, seeks a more sensationalist approach. He orders his staff to Faro Island to capture King ___ for exploitation. As ___ re-emerges, a media frenzy generates with Pacific looking to capitalize off of the ultimate battle.

Title: Paparazzi
Hint: A rising Hollywood actor takes personal revenge against the photographers who caused his family's accident.
Description: A rising Hollywood actor decides to take personal revenge against a group of four persistent photographers to make them pay for almost causing a personal tragedy involving his wife and son.

Title: A Single Shot
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Canada
Hint: A hunter accidentally kills a girl and finds a bag of cash, sparking a deadly game of cat and mouse.
Description: The tragic death of a beautiful young girl starts a tense and atmospheric game of cat and mouse between hunter John Moon and the hardened backwater criminals out for his blood.

Title: The Domestics
Hint: A married couple must fight to return home in a lawless post-apocalyptic Midwest.
Description: A young husband and wife must fight to return home in a post-apocalyptic mid-western landscape ravaged by gangs.

Title: Selfiee
Hint: A traffic officer's meeting with his superstar idol turns into a bitter feud.
Description: RTO officer Om Prakash strikes a golden opportunity to meet his icon, Vijay Kumar. Bhut when his love gets spurned by the superstar, a clash of egos ensues.

Title: Reasonable Doubt
Country: United States of America, Germany, Canada
Hint: An up-and-coming DA commits a hit-and-run and then has to prosecute the man accused of the crime.
Description: When up-and-coming District Attorney Mitch Brockden commits a fatal hit-and-run, he feels compelled to throw the case against the accused criminal who was found with the body and blamed for the crime. Following the trial, Mitch's worst fears come true when he realizes that he acquitted a guilty man, and he soon finds himself on the hunt for the killer before more victims pile up.

Title: Cuttputlli
Hint: A rookie cop in a small town hunts a serial killer targeting teenage girls.
Description: When a small town gets plunged into the nightmare of serial killings, rookie cop Arjan embarks on a chase for the truth and unravels a gruesome conspiracy.

Title: Think Like a Man Too
Hint: All the couples are back for a wedding in Las Vegas, but their plans go wrong.
Description: All the couples are back for a wedding in Las Vegas, but plans for a romantic weekend go awry when their various misadventures get them into some compromising situations that threaten to derail the big event.

Title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2
Hint: Two strangers cross paths at an abandoned mansion haunted by an evil spirit.
Description: When strangers Reet and Ruhan cross paths, their journey leads to an abandoned mansion and a dreaded spirit who has been trapped for eighteen years.

Title: Desi Boyz
Hint: Two cash-strapped Indian men in London become male escorts during an economic downturn.
Description: When two cash-strapped UK-based Indians become male escorts amid an economic downturn, money flows right in but everything else in their lives starts falling apart.

Title: Pimp
Hint: A struggling female hustler in the Bronx runs a stable of sex workers and fights to survive with her girlfriend.
Description: An urban love story set on the hard streets of the Bronx. A struggling female ___, named Wednesday, grows up learning the game from her dad. Once he's gone she's left to look out for her prostitute mother and girlfriend Nikki.

Title: Christmas Inheritance
Hint: A socialite must visit her father's small hometown to deliver an envelope to inherit his company.
Description: To inherit her father's company, socialite Ellen must first visit his small hometown, where she learns the value of hard work and helping others.

Title: Faces in the Crowd
Country: Canada, France, United States of America
Hint: A woman who survives a serial killer's attack is left with face blindness.
Description: Anna is living with "face-blindness" after surviving a serial killer's attack. As she lives with her condition, one in which facial features change each time she loses sight of them, the killer closes in.

Title: Samrat Prithviraj
Hint: A legendary Hindu warrior king fights the invader Muhammad of Ghor, in an Indian historical epic.
Description: The true story of legendary Hindu warrior king "___ Chauhan" including his early military successes, love story with Sanyogita & clashes with Muhammad of Ghor, a ruler of the Ghurid dynasty who led the foundation of Muslim rule in the Indian subcontinent.

Title: Bait
Hint: A Cornish fisherman without a boat battles with tourists and gentrification in his village.
Description: Martin Ward is a cove fisherman, without a boat. His brother Steven has repurposed their father’s vessel as a tourist tripper, driving a wedge between the brothers. With their childhood home now a getaway for London money, Martin is displaced to the estate above the picturesque harbour.

Title: The Muse
Hint: A washed-up Hollywood screenwriter enlists a demanding, mysterious goddess of inspiration to revive his career.
Description: With his career on the skids, a Hollywood screenwriter enlists the aid of a modern-day ___, who proves to test his patience.

Title: White Noise 2: The Light
Hint: A man whose family was saved from death discovers he can see people who are about to die.
Description: A man's family brought back from the verge of death, he then discovers he can identify people who are about to die.

Title: Kurtlar Vadisi: Irak
Hint: A Turkish special operations team goes to Iraq to take revenge for a humiliation.

Description: A group of young backpackers' vacation turns sour when a bus accident leaves them marooned in a remote Brazilian rural area that holds an ominous secret.

Title: Phantoms
Hint: Two sisters return to their Colorado town to find the residents have vanished.
Description: In the peaceful Colorado town of Snowfield, something evil has wiped out the community. And now, it's up to a group of people to stop it, or at least get out of Snowfield alive.

Title: Æon Flux
Hint: Four hundred years in the future, a rebel assassin is sent to kill the leader of humanity's last city.
Description: 400 years into the future, disease has wiped out the majority of the world's population, except one walled city, Bregna, ruled by a congress of scientists. When ___, the top operative in the underground 'Monican' rebellion, is sent on a mission to kill a government leader, she uncovers a world of secrets.

Title: Northmen: A Viking Saga
Country: Germany, South Africa, Switzerland, United Kingdom
Hint: A band of Norse raiders shipwrecked in Scotland must cross enemy lines with a kidnapped princess.
Description: A band of Vikings cross enemy lines and a panicked race begins. The losers will pay with their lives.

Title: Barely Lethal
Hint: A 16-year-old assassin fakes her death to go to high school.
Description: A 16-year-old international assassin yearning for a "normal" adolescence fakes her own death and enrolls as a senior in a suburban high school. She quickly learns that being popular can be more painful than getting water-boarded.

Title: Psycho III
Hint: A suicidal nun who resembles a former victim comes to the motel.
Description: When Maureen Coyle, a suicidal nun who resembles Norman's former victim, Marion Crane, arrives at the motel, all bets are off and "Mother" is less than happy.

Title: The Colony
Hint: In the next ice age, a group of survivors fight cannibals.
Description: Forced underground by the next ice age, a struggling outpost of survivors must fight to preserve humanity against a threat even more savage than nature.

Title: Outside the Wire
Hint: A drone pilot is sent into a war zone with an android officer.
Description: In the near future, a drone pilot is sent into a deadly militarized zone and must work with an android officer to locate a doomsday device.

Title: Like Mike
Hint: An orphan finds a pair of sneakers that give him basketball skills.
Description: Calvin and his friends, who all live in an orphanage, find old shoes with the faded letters MJ connected to a powerline. One stormy night, they go to get the shoes when Calvin and the shoes are struck by lightning. Calvin now has unbelievable basketball powers and has the chance to play for the NBA.

Title: Vampire Academy
Hint: A half-human guardian protects her royal best friend at a secret boarding school for bloodsuckers.
Description: Rose, a rebellious half-___/half-human guardian-in-training and her best friend, Lissa -- a mortal, royal ___ Princess - have been on the run when they are captured and returned to St. Vladamirs ___, the very place where they believe their lives may be in most jeopardy.

Title: The Smurfs
Hint: Little blue creatures are chased into New York by an evil wizard.
Description: When the evil wizard Gargamel chases the tiny blue ___ out of their village, they tumble from their magical world and into ours -- in fact, smack dab in the middle of Central Park. Just three apples high and stuck in the Big Apple, the ___ must find a way to get back to their village before Gargamel tracks them down.

Title: What Men Want
Hint: A female sports agent gains the ability to hear men's thoughts.
Description: Magically able to hear what men are thinking, a sports agent uses her newfound ability to turn the tables on her overbearing male colleagues.

Title: Aliens in the Attic
Genres: Adventure, Comedy, Family, Fantasy, Science Fiction
Hint: A group of kids must protect their vacation home from invading extraterrestrials hiding upstairs.
Description: A group of kids must protect their vacation home from invading ___.

Title: The Hustle
Hint: Two female con artists team up to swindle rich men.
Description: Two female scam artists, one low rent and the other high class, compete to swindle a naïve tech prodigy out of his fortune. A remake of the 1988 comedy "Dirty Rotten Scoundrels."

Title: Curve
Hint: A woman is trapped on a curved concrete surface above a deadly drop.
Description: Clinging to a smooth, curved surface high above a sentient abyss, a woman tries to cover the few feet back to safety without losing purchase and falling to her death.

Title: I Am Wrath
Hint: A man seeks justice after corrupt cops fail to catch his wife's killer.
Description: A man is out for justice after a group of corrupt police officers are unable to catch his wife's killer.

Title: Problem Child
Hint: A couple adopts a seven-year-old boy who turns out to be a little devil.
Description: Ben Healy and his social climbing wife Flo adopt fun-loving seven year old Junior. But they soon discover he's a little monster as he turns a camping trip, a birthday party and even a baseball game into comic nightmares.

Title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
Hint: An inner-city drug dealer turns to hip-hop after being shot nine times.
Description: A tale of an inner city drug dealer who turns away from crime to pursue his passion, rap music.

Title: Killing Me Softly
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A woman grows suspicious of her controlling new husband.
Description: A woman grows suspicious of her controlling husband after she discovers secrets about the women in his past.

Title: Replicas
Country: Canada, China, Puerto Rico, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A scientist clones his family after a car accident kills them.
Description: A scientist becomes obsessed with returning his family to normalcy after a terrible accident.

Title: Bulletproof Monk
Hint: An immortal Tibetan kung fu master protects an ancient scroll with the help of a street thief.
Description: A mysterious and immortal Tibetan kung fu master, who has spent the last 60 years traveling around the world protecting the ancient Scroll of the Ultimate, mentors a selfish street kid in the ancient intricacies of kung fu.

Title: Richie Rich
Hint: The richest kid in the world must save his parents from a corporate villain.
Description: Billionaire heir ___ has it all, including Reggie Jackson as a batting coach and Claudia Schiffer as a personal trainer -- but no playmates. What's more, scoundrel Laurence Van Dough is scheming to take over the family empire. Uh-oh! Enter faithful butler Cadbury to save the day.

Title: Serena
Hint: A timber baron and his wife build an empire in 1920s North Carolina.
Description: North Carolina mountains at the end of the 1920s – George and ___ Pemberton, love-struck newly-weds, begin to build a timber empire. ___ soon proves herself to be equal to any man: overseeing loggers, hunting rattle-snakes, even saving a man’s life in the wilderness. With power and influence now in their hands, the Pembertons refuse to let anyone stand in the way of their inflated love and ambitions.

Title: Jessabelle
Hint: A woman recuperating at her father's home discovers videotapes from her mother.
Description: A young woman recuperating at her father's run-down home after a tragic accident soon encounters a terrifying presence with a connection to her long-deceased mother.

Title: The Addams Family 2
Hint: A family of ghouls goes on a road trip across America.
Description: The ___ get tangled up in more wacky adventures and find themselves involved in hilarious run-ins with all sorts of unsuspecting characters.

Title: Hop
Hint: The teenage son of the springtime rabbit wants to be a drummer in Hollywood.
Description: E.B., the Easter Bunny's teenage son, heads to Hollywood, determined to become a drummer in a rock 'n' roll band. In L.A., he's taken in by Fred after the out-of-work slacker hits E.B. with his car.

Title: Bliss
Hint: A divorced, recently fired man meets a woman who convinces him that their world is a computer simulation.
Description: A mind-bending love story following Greg who, after recently being divorced and then fired, meets the mysterious Isabel, a woman living on the streets and convinced that the polluted, broken world around them is just a computer simulation. Doubtful at first, Greg eventually discovers there may be some truth to Isabel’s wild conspiracy.

Title: Overdrive
Country: Belgium, France, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Two brother car thieves in the South of France must steal a gangster's prized vintage car to save their lives.
Description: Master car thieves square off against French gangsters in the South of France with money, women and lives all on the line.

Title: Game Over, Man!
Hint: Three slacker hotel housekeepers must save a rapper's penthouse party from terrorists, using their gamer skills.
Description: Three friends are on the verge of getting their video game financed when their benefactor is taken hostage by terrorists.

Title: The Last Legion
Country: Bulgaria, France, Italy, Slovakia, Tunisia, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: As Rome falls, the boy emperor flees to Britain with his protector and a band of soldiers.
Description: As the Roman empire crumbles, young Romulus Augustus flees the city and embarks on a perilous voyage to Britain to track down a ___ of supporters.

Title: Love in the Villa
Hint: A young teacher's dream holiday in Verona is ruined when she has to share her rental with a British wine snob.
Description: A young woman takes a trip to romantic Verona, Italy, after a breakup, only to find that the ___ she reserved was double-booked, and she'll have to share her vacation with a cynical British man.

Title: The Spy Next Door
Hint: A retired CIA agent must babysit his girlfriend's three kids while Russian terrorists hunt them.
Description: Former CIA spy Bob Ho takes on his toughest assignment to date: looking after his girlfriend's three kids, who haven't exactly warmed to their mom's beau. And when one of the youngsters accidentally downloads a top-secret formula, Bob's longtime nemesis, a Russian terrorist, pays a visit to the family.

Title: American Ninja
Hint: An orphaned drifter with martial arts skills joins the US Army in the Philippines and battles a black-clad assassin army.
Description: Joe Armstrong, an orphaned drifter with little respect for much other than martial arts, finds himself on an American Army base in the Philippines after a judge gives him a choice of enlistment or prison. On one of his first missions driving a convoy, his platoon is attacked by a group of rebels who try to steal the weapons the platoon is transporting and kidnap the base colonel's daughter.

Title: Home on the Range
Hint: A trio of dairy cows sets out to catch a cattle rustler and save their farm, in a Disney musical.
Description: When a greedy outlaw schemes to take possession of the "Patch Of Heaven" dairy farm, three determined cows, a karate-kicking stallion and a colorful corral of critters join forces to save their home. The stakes are sky-high as this unlikely animal alliance risk their hides and match wits with a mysterious band of bad guys.

Title: Bordello of Blood
Hint: A private eye investigates a missing man and finds a brothel run by vampire prostitutes.
Description: Private eye Rafe Guttman is hired by repressed, born-again Katherine to find her missing bad-boy brother. The trail leads him to a whorehouse run by a thousand-year-old vampire and secretly backed by Katherine's boss, televangelist Jimmy Current.

Title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
Hint: Two rival cadet schools compete to avoid closure when the governor cuts law enforcement funding.
Description: When police funding is cut, the Governor announces he must close one of the academies. To make it fair, the two police academies must compete against each other to stay in operation. Mauser persuades two officers in Lassard's ___ to better his odds, but things don't quite turn out as expected...

Title: The Perfect Man
Hint: A teenage girl creates a fake secret admirer to cheer up her serial-dating mother.
Description: Holly is tired of moving every time her mom Jean breaks up with yet another second-rate guy. To distract her mother from her latest bad choice, Holly conceives the perfect plan for the ___, an imaginary secret admirer who will romance Jean and boost her self-esteem.

Title: Battle for the Planet of the Apes
Hint: A peaceful society of evolved primates is threatened by mutated humans in the final instalment of the saga.
Description: The fifth and final episode in the Planet of the ___ series. After the collapse of human civilization, a community of intelligent ___ led by Caesar lives in harmony with a group of humans. Gorilla General Aldo tries to cause an ape civil war and a community of human mutants who live beneath a destroyed city try to conquer those whom they perceive as enemies. All leading to the finale.

Title: Pathfinder
Hint: A Viking boy left behind is raised by Native Americans and defends them against his own people.
Description: A Viking boy is left behind after his clan battles a Native American tribe. Raised within the tribe, he ultimately becomes their savior in a fight against the Norsemen.

Title: Man of the House
Hint: A Texas Ranger goes undercover as a cheerleading coach to protect five college girls who witnessed a murder.
Description: Texas Ranger Roland Sharp is assigned to protect the only witnesses to the murder of a key figure in the prosecution of a drug kingpin -- a group of University of Texas cheerleaders. Sharp must now go undercover as an assistant cheerleading coach and move in with the young women.

Title: Follow Me
Hint: A social media star travels with friends to Moscow to record an escape room, which turns deadly.
Description: A social media personality travels with his friends to Moscow to capture new content for his successful vlog. Always pushing the limits and catering to a growing audience, they enter a cold world of mystery, excess, and danger. When the lines between real life and social media are blurred, the group must fight to escape, and survive.

Title: House II: The Second Story
Hint: A young man moves into his family's ancestral home and resurrects his zombie great-great-grandfather.
Description: Jesse moves into an old family property where his parents were mysteriously murdered years before. He soon finds himself with unexpected guests in the form of his mummified great-great grandfather, a mystical crystal skull, and a zombie cowboy.

Title: The Man with the Iron Fists
Country: China, Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: In feudal China, a blacksmith forges deadly weapons for warring clans and becomes a reluctant hero.
Description: In feudal China, a blacksmith who makes weapons for a small village is put in the position where he must defend himself and his fellow villagers.

Title: The Boss
Hint: A disgraced business titan comes out of prison and starts a brownie empire with a troop of girl scouts.
Description: A titan of industry is sent to prison after she's caught for insider trading. When she emerges ready to rebrand herself as America's latest sweetheart, not everyone she screwed over is so quick to forgive and forget.

Title: All I See Is You
Hint: A blind woman regains her sight after surgery and discovers disturbing details about her marriage.
Description: After a successful experimental surgery restores her eyesight, a young woman sees her marriage spiral in a disturbing direction.

Title: The Tuxedo
Hint: A New York cab driver becomes a spy when he wears a high-tech formal suit.
Description: Cabbie-turned-chauffeur Jimmy Tong learns there is really only one rule when you work for playboy millionaire Clark Devlin : Never touch Devlin's prized ___. But when Devlin is temporarily put out of commission in an explosive accident, Jimmy puts on the tux and soon discovers that this extraordinary suit may be more black belt than black tie.

Title: What's the Worst That Could Happen?
Hint: A thief and a billionaire battle over a stolen lucky ring.
Description: Thief Kevin Caffery attempts to rob from the home of rich businessman Max Fairbanks. But Fairbanks catches him and steals his cherished ring that his girlfriend gave him. Caffery is then bent on revenge and getting his ring back with the help of his partners.

Title: The Dentist
Hint: A successful oral surgeon suffers a mental breakdown and begins torturing the people in his chair.
Description: Dr. Alan Feinstone has everything: a beautiful wife and a successful career in dentistry. However, when he discovers his wife's affair, he realizes that behind every clean, white surface lies the stench of decay.

Title: My Stepmother Is an Alien
Hint: An extraterrestrial comes to Earth to save her planet and falls for a scientist with a teenage daughter.
Description: Trying to rescue her home planet from destruction, a gorgeous extraterrestrial named Celeste arrives on Earth and begins her scientific research. She woos quirky scientist Dr. Steve Mills, a widower with a young daughter. Before long, Celeste finds herself in love with Steve and her new life on Earth, where she experiences true intimacy for the first time.

Title: Jack Frost
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A father who died in a car accident returns as a snowman to reconnect with his son.
Description: A father who can't keep his promises dies in a car accident. One year later, he returns as a snowman, who has one final chance to put things right with his son before he is gone forever.

Title: Big Game
Country: Finland, Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: The US president's plane is shot down, leaving him in a Finnish forest with a 13-year-old hunter.
Description: Air Force One is shot down by terrorists, leaving the President of the United States stranded in the wilderness of Finland. 13-year-old Oskari is on a hunting mission to prove his maturity to his kinsfolk by tracking down a deer, but instead discovers the President in an escape pod. With the terrorists closing in to capture their prize, the unlikely duo team up to escape their hunters.

Title: Freejack
Hint: Time-travelling bounty hunters snatch a race car driver from the past to provide a body for a rich man.
Description: Time-traveling bounty hunters find a doomed race-car driver in the past and bring him to 2009 New York, where his mind will be replaced with that of a terminally ill billionaire.

Title: Cocoon: The Return
Hint: The rejuvenated elderly friends who left with aliens come back to Earth to visit their families for a short time.
Description: The reinvigorated elderly group that left Earth comes back to visit their relatives. Will they all decide to go back to the planet where no one grows old, or will they be tempted to remain on Earth?

Title: Christmas with the Kranks
Hint: A couple decide to skip the holidays and take a cruise, until their daughter announces she's coming home.
Description: When their only daughter Blair leaves the family nest, Luther and Nora Krank decide to book an island cruise to beat the yuletide blues and just skip the holidays.

Title: Stomp the Yard
Hint: A troubled street dancer from LA enrols at a historically Black college and joins a fraternity's step team.
Description: After the death of his younger brother, a troubled 19-year-old street dancer from Los Angeles is able to bypass juvenile hall by enrolling in the historically black, Truth University in Atlanta, Georgia.

Title: Tom and Jerry: The Movie
Hint: A classic cartoon cat and mouse team up to help an orphan girl escape her evil aunt.
Description: The popular cartoon cat and mouse are thrown into a feature film. The story has the twosome trying to help an orphan girl who is being berated and exploited by a greedy guardian.

Title: Bullet Head
Hint: Three career criminals are trapped in a warehouse with the cops and a vicious fighting dog.
Description: A group of career criminals finds itself trapped in a warehouse with the law – and an Attack Dog named DeNiro closing in.

Title: Fun Size
Hint: A teen's Halloween is ruined when she must babysit her brother, who disappears into the night.
Description: Wren's Halloween plans go awry when she's made to babysit her brother, who disappears into a sea of trick-or-treaters. Accompanied by her best friend and two nerdy classmates, Wren needs to find her brother before her mom finds out.

Title: Boys and Girls
Hint: Two college students who can't stand each other become best friends, and maybe more.
Description: Ryan and Jennifer are opposites who definitely do not attract. At least that's what they always believed. When they met as twelve-year-olds, they disliked one another. When they met again as teenagers, they loathed each other. But when they meet in college, the uptight Ryan and the free-spirited Jennifer find that their differences bind them together and a rare friendship develops.

Title: Meander
Hint: A woman wakes up in a tube with a countdown bracelet on her arm and must crawl through deadly traps.
Description: After getting a car ride from an unknown man, Lisa wakes up in a tube. On her arm is strapped a bracelet with a countdown. She quickly understands that every 8 minutes, fire burns an occupied section. She has no choice but to crawl into safe sections to survive. To know why she’s there and how to get out, Lisa will have to face the memories of her dead daughter…

Title: The Glimmer Man
Hint: A former government operative partners with an LA cop to hunt a serial killer.
Description: A former government operative renowned for his stealth, Jack Cole is now a Los Angeles police detective. When a series of horrible murders occurs in the metro area, Cole is assigned to the case, along with tough-talking fellow cop Jim Campbell. Although the two men clash, they gradually become effective partners as they uncover a conspiracy linked to the killings, which also involves terrorism and organized crime.

Title: Hatchet II
Hint: A survivor escapes a swamp-dwelling killer and returns with a team of hunters for revenge.
Description: Picking up right where the original ended, Marybeth escapes the clutches of the swamp-dwelling killer Victor Crowley. After learning the truth about her family’s connection to the ___-wielding madman, Marybeth returns to the Louisiana swamps along with an army of hunters to recover the bodies of her family and exact the bloodiest revenge against the bayou butcher.

Title: Burying the Ex
Hint: A horror fan's dead, controlling girlfriend comes back from the grave just as he meets someone new.
Description: Before horror enthusiast Max can break things off with his girlfriend Evelyn she dies in a bus accident. In time, Max meets another woman only to have Evelyn resurface as a zombie ready to resume their relationship.

Title: The Longest Week
Hint: A spoiled young Manhattan heir is left homeless and falls for his best friend's girlfriend.
Description: Left broke and homeless by his wealthy parents' divorce, a young man moves in with an old friend and finally meets the woman of his dreams -- only to discover she's already dating his friend.

Title: The Thinning
Hint: In a dystopian future, high school students who fail a standardised test are executed.
Description: In a post-apocalyptic future where population control is dictated by a high-school aptitude test, two students discover the test is smoke and mirrors hiding a larger conspiracy.

Title: Invasion U.S.A.
Hint: A one-man army fights a Soviet-backed guerrilla assault on Florida.
Description: A one-man army comes to the rescue of the United States when a spy attempts an ___.

Title: Sorority Boys
Hint: Three college guys disguise themselves as women to infiltrate a campus girls' house.
Description: After being falsely accused of stealing the budget for their annual cocktail cruise, three very different fraternity brothers are kicked out of their dorm. In order to clear their name and to secure their future careers, the three dress up in drag and pledge the ___ next door where they learn a few valuable - and hilarious - lessons about themselves and the female species.

Title: Head Over Heels
Hint: A single woman thinks she witnesses her new neighbour murdering someone.
Description: Ordinary single girl Amanda Pierce unexpectedly finds herself sharing an awesome Manhattan apartment with four sexy supermodels. Determined to bring Amanda into their world, the models give her the ultimate makeover. The plan works fabulously as Amanda connects with next door charmer Jim Winston.

Title: Darkness
Hint: A teenage girl moves into a remote Spanish house and discovers a secret ritual.
Description: A teenage girl moves into a remote country home with her family, only to discover that the gloomy old house has a horrifying past that threatens to destroy them.

Title: Unfinished Business
Hint: A small-company owner and his two odd associates travel to Europe to close the deal that will save them.
Description: A hard-working small business owner and his two associates travel to Europe to close the most important deal of their lives. But what began as a routine business trip goes off the rails in every imaginable – and unimaginable – way, including unplanned stops at a massive sex fetish event and a global economic summit.

Title: The Rhythm Section
Country: Spain, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A woman sets out to find the people responsible for the plane crash that killed her family.
Description: When she discovers the plane crash that claimed the lives of her family was no accident, Stephanie Patrick enters the dark, complex world of international espionage seeking vengeance. With nothing left to lose, Stephanie transforms from victim to assassin and discovers that neither revenge nor the truth are what they appear.

Title: The Trust
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two Las Vegas cops investigating a drug case discover a mysterious vault and plan a heist.
Description: A pair of cops investigating a drug invasion stumble upon a mysterious bank vault.

Title: The Astronaut's Wife
Hint: A space shuttle pilot comes home from a mission, and his spouse suspects something alien has replaced him.
Description: When ___ Spencer Armacost returns to Earth after a mission that nearly cost him his life, he decides to take a desk job in order to see his beautiful wife, Jillian, more often. Gradually, Jillian notices that Spencer's personality seems to have changed, but her concerns fade when she discovers that she's pregnant. As Jillian grows closer to becoming a mother, her suspicions about Spencer return.

Title: Death Wish 4: The Crackdown
Hint: A vigilante architect targets the drug dealers responsible for his girlfriend's daughter's overdose.
Description: After the death of his girlfriend's daughter from a drug overdose, Paul Kersey takes on the local drug cartel.

Title: Stone
Hint: A parole officer is manipulated by an arsonist's seductive wife.
Description: Parole officer Jack Mabry has only a few weeks left before retirement and wishes to finish out the cases he's been assigned. One such case is that of Gerald '___' Creeson, a convicted arsonist who is up for parole. Jack is initially reluctant to indulge ___ in the coarse banter he wishes to pursue and feels little sympathy for the prisoner's pleads for an early release.

Title: Bel Ami
Hint: In 1890s Paris, a penniless ex-soldier rises to power by seducing influential women.
Description: Georges Duroy travels through 1890s Paris, from cockroach ridden garrets to opulent salons, using his wits and powers of seduction to rise from poverty to wealth, from a prostitute’s embrace to passionate trysts with wealthy beauties, in a world where politics and media jostle for influence, where sex is power and celebrity an obsession.

Title: Mars Needs Moms
Hint: A boy stows away on a spaceship when Martians abduct his mother.
Description: When Martians suddenly abduct his mom, mischievous Milo rushes to the rescue and discovers why all ___ are so special.

Title: Mixed Nuts
Hint: The volunteers of a crisis hotline deal with crazy callers on Christmas Eve.
Description: The events of a crisis hotline business on one crazy night during the Christmas holidays.

Title: Missing in Action
Hint: An American colonel returns to Vietnam to rescue soldiers still held captive.
Description: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris. Following a daring escape from a Vietnamese POW camp, Special Forces Colonel James Braddock (Norris) is on a mission to locate and save remaining MIAs.

Title: I Spy
Hint: A secret agent and a boxing champ team up to recover a stolen stealth fighter in Budapest.
Description: When the Switchblade, the most sophisticated prototype stealth fighter created yet, is stolen from the U.S. government, one of the United States' top spies, Alex Scott, is called to action. What he doesn't expect is to get teamed up with a cocky civilian, World Class Boxing Champion Kelly Robinson, on a dangerous top secret espionage mission.

Title: Absolutely Fabulous: The Movie
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two hard-partying British PR women are on the run after accidentally knocking a supermodel into the Thames.
Description: Edina and Patsy are still oozing glitz and glamour, living the high life they're accustomed to; shopping, drinking and clubbing around London's trendiest hotspots. Blamed for a major incident at an uber fashionable launch party, they become entangled in a media storm and are relentlessly pursued by the paparazzi.

Title: Bad Ass
Hint: A Vietnam veteran becomes a vigilante after he is assaulted on a bus.
Description: Decorated Vietnam hero, Frank Vega returns home only to get shunned by society leaving him without a job or his high school sweetheart. It's not until forty years later when an incident on a commuter bus makes him a local hero where he's suddenly celebrated once again. But his good fortune suddenly turns for the worse when his best friend is murdered and the police aren't doing anything about it.

Title: Dhoom 3
Hint: A circus magician robs a Chicago bank to avenge his father's death.
Description: To avenge his father's death, a circus entertainer trained in magic and acrobatics robs banks to take down a corrupt bank owner. Two cops from Mumbai are assigned to the case.

Title: Prom
Hint: Several couples and students prepare for the biggest night of the school year, each with their own dramas.
Description: At “___,” every couple has a story and no two are exactly alike. As the big dance approaches for Nova Prescott, it’s a battle of wills as she finds herself drawn to the guy who gets in the way of her perfect ___. Fellow seniors Mei and Tyler harbor secrets, while others face all the insecurity and anticipation that surrounds one of high school’s most seminal events.

Title: Banshee Chapter
Hint: A woman investigating her friend's disappearance discovers a secret government drug experiment.
Description: On the trail of a missing friend who had been experimenting with mind-altering drugs, a young journalist - aided by a rogue counter-culture writer, finds herself drawn into the dangerous world of top-secret government chemical research and the mystery of a disturbing radio signal of unknown origin.

Title: Killing Season
Country: Belgium, United States of America, Bulgaria
Hint: Two veterans of the Bosnian War, one American and one Serbian, clash in the Appalachian mountains.
Description: Two veterans of the Bosnian War, one American, one Serbian, clash in the remote Smoky Mountain wilderness.

Title: Down to Earth
Hint: A struggling comic dies too soon and returns in the body of a rich old white man.
Description: Struggling comic Lance Barton knows what it's like to die on stage. But when his life takes an unexpected turn - straight to heaven - Lance is sure there's been a mistake. Miraculously, he's right! An angel tells Lance he was taken prematurely but assures him he can be returned to Earth - in the aged body of a ruthless white billionaire.

Title: Feeling Minnesota
Hint: A man falls in love with his brother's wife, an ex-stripper, on their wedding day.
Description: Sam Clayton's marriage to ex-stripper Freddie comes about when she's strong-armed into the match by Red, a club proprietor who once did her a favor. But Freddie falls in love with Jjaks, Sam's brother, and the pair tries to escape the situation together. It isn't long before both Sam and Red catch up with them, resulting in threats against the two of them -- although tension also starts to build between Sam and Red.

Title: The Ex
Hint: An underachiever's wife's ex-boyfriend is his new boss, in a smug comedy.
Description: When his lawyer wife, Sofia, becomes pregnant, chronic underachiever Tom Reilly must take a job at his father-in-law's advertising firm. Tom has to adjust to the demands of a very high-powered job, and he finds himself in an increasingly hostile office rivalry with Chip, Sofia's paraplegic former lover.

Title: Nine Dead
Hint: A group of strangers are kidnapped and chained in a room, and one is killed every ten minutes until they find the link.
Description: Communication is the key to the survival for ___ strangers who have been kidnapped by a masked gunman and told that one of them will die every ten minutes until they discover how they are all connected. Who of the ___ lives and who dies?

Title: King Ralph
Hint: A down-on-his-luck Las Vegas lounge singer inherits the British throne after the royal family is electrocuted.
Description: As the only relative in line to ascend the Royal throne, a down-on-his-luck American slob must learn the ways of the English.

Title: Surviving Christmas
Hint: A lonely rich executive pays a family to let him spend the holidays with them.
Description: A wealthy executive, Drew Latham (Ben Affleck) has no close relationships and becomes nostalgic for his childhood home as Christmas approaches. When he visits the house and finds another family living there, he offers the residents, Tom Valco (James Gandolfini) and his wife, Christine (Catherine O'Hara), a large sum of money to pretend they are his parents.

Title: 100 Feet
Hint: A woman under house arrest after killing her abusive husband is haunted by his ghost.
Description: After Marnie Watson kills her abusive husband in self-defense, she is condemned to house arrest... only to discover that the house is possessed by the enraged and violent spirit of her dead husband.

Title: The Broken
