Description: After their airplane crashes behind enemy lines, four soldiers must survive and try to find a way back to their battalion. However, when they come across a local peasant girl the horrors of war quickly become apparent.

Title: Hollywood Homicide
Hint: Two mismatched LAPD detectives, one a part-time realtor and one a yoga teacher, investigate the murder of a rap group.
Description: Joe Gavilan and his new partner K. C. Calden, are detectives on the beat in Tinseltown. Neither one of them really wants to be a cop, Gavilan moonlights as a real estate broker, and Calden is an aspiring actor moonlighting as a yoga instructor. When the two are assigned a big case they must work out whether they want to solve the case or follow their hearts.

Title: The Dark
Hint: A murderous undead girl haunts a remote stretch of woods, until she finds a kidnapped boy and forms an unlikely bond.
Description: A murderous, flesh-eating undead young girl haunting the remote stretch of woods where she was murdered decades earlier discovers a kidnapped and abused boy hiding in the trunk of one of her victim’s cars. Her decision to let the boy live throws her solitary existence into upheaval.

Title: The Final
Hint: A group of high school outcasts lure their tormentors to a party and take a terrifying, sadistic revenge.
Description: A group of high school outcasts get revenge on the students that torment them.

Title: Vamps
Hint: Two glamorous young vampires live the good New York nightlife, until one falls for a mortal.
Description: The modern-day story focuses on two beautiful young vampires who are living the good nightlife in New York until love enters the picture and each has to make a choice that will jeopardize their immortality.

Title: Astérix and Obélix: God Save Britannia
Hint: Two Gaulish heroes help Britain fight off the Roman invasion led by the dictator's legions.
Description: Asterix crosses the channel to help second-cousin Anticlimax face down Julius Caesar and invading Romans.

Title: Pootie Tang
Hint: A street-slang-talking folk hero with a magical belt fights an evil corporation in a TV sketch spinoff.
Description: ___, the musician/actor/folk hero of the ghetto, is chronicled from his early childhood to his battles against the evil Corporate America, who try to steal his magic belt and make him sell out by endorsing addictive products to his people. ___ must learn to find himself and defeat the evil corporation for all the young Black children of America, supatime.

Title: Tomcats
Hint: A group of college buddies bet that the last one to stay unmarried will collect a huge cash fund.
Description: College buddies chip in and promise that the group's last unmarried man will collect a cash pot. Seven years later, the kitty is worth $500,000 -- money Michael needs to pay a gambling debt. Problem is, the only other single guy is a hopeless womanizer!

Title: Flipper
Hint: A boy sent to stay with his uncle in the Florida Keys befriends a playful bottlenose dolphin.
Description: Sandy Ricks is sent by his mom to Coral Key, a rustic island in the Florida keys, to spend the summer with his uncle Porter Ricks. Sandy dislikes everything about his new environment until a new friend comes into his life, a dolphin named ___, that brings uncle and nephew together and leads Sandy on the summer adventure of a lifetime.

Title: The Haunting in Connecticut 2: Ghosts of Georgia
Hint: A young family moves into a historic Southern house and discovers the spirits of slaves hiding there.
Description: A young family moves into a historic home in ___, only to learn they are not the house's only inhabitants. Soon they find themselves in the presence of a secret rising from underground and threatening to bring down anyone in its path.

Title: Edison
Hint: A young journalist uncovers police corruption and a secret elite squad in a troubled city.
Description: In the troubled city of ___, a young journalist, his jaded editor, and an honest investigator from the district attorney's office join forces to gather evidence against corrupt members of an elite police unit.

Title: The Other Side of the Door
Hint: A grieving mother performs a ritual to see her dead son, breaking a sacred rule.
Description: Grieving over the loss of her son, a mother struggles with her feelings for her daughter and her husband. She seeks out a ritual that allows her say goodbye to her dead child, opening the veil between the world of the dead and the living. Her daughter becomes the focus of terror. She must now protect against the evil that was once her beloved son.

Title: Fullmetal Alchemist
Hint: Two brothers who practise a forbidden transmutation science search for a mythical stone after a ritual costs them their bodies.
Description: Two ___ brothers go on a quest for the Philosopher's Stone after an attempt to revive their dead mother goes horribly wrong.

Title: The Jungle Book 2
Hint: A boy raised by wolves misses his animal friends and runs away from the man-village to see them.
Description: Mowgli has been living in the man-village with his little stepbrother Ranjan and his best friend Shanti. But the man-cub still has that ___ rhythm in his heart, and he misses his old buddies Baloo and Bagheera. When Mowgli wanders back to the wild for some swingin' fun, he soon finds the man-eating tiger Shere Khan is lurking in the shadows and planning his revenge.

Title: The Dilemma
Hint: A man discovers his best friend's wife is having an affair just before they close a big car deal.
Description: Longtime friends Ronny and Nick are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out.

Title: Eye See You
Hint: A disgraced FBI agent with a drinking problem joins other troubled cops at a remote rehab centre.
Description: A disgraced FBI agent with a drinking problem joins nine other troubled law enforcement officers at an isolated detox clinic in the wilds of Wyoming. But the therapeutic sanctuary becomes a nightmarish hellhole when a major snowstorm cuts off the clinic from the outside world and enables a killer on the inside to get busy.

Title: Ready to Rumble
Hint: Two slacker wrestling fans try to help their fallen idol get back in the ring.
Description: Two slacker wrestling fans are devastated by the ousting of their favorite character by an unscrupulous promoter.

Title: Dunston Checks In
Hint: A hotel manager's sons find an orangutan jewel thief living secretly in the hotel.
Description: Hotel manager Robert Grant is forced by his boss to postpone his family vacation when a hotel critic ___ in. Trouble is, the critic is really a villainous jewel thief with an orangutan assistant named ___. When ___ gets loose and tries to escape a life of crime -- aided by Robert's sons -- havoc, hijinks and lots of laughs abound!

Title: Moms' Night Out
Hint: A group of mothers plan an evening off from the kids that turns into a chaotic, comedic disaster.
Description: Yearning for an evening without their kids, some friends plan a night out. But to do this, their husbands need to watch the kids. What can go wrong?

Title: Blood Creek
Hint: A man and his brother seeking revenge become trapped in a Nazi occult experiment.
Description: A man and his brother on a mission of revenge become trapped in a harrowing occult experiment dating back to the Third Reich.

Title: [REC] 4: Apocalypse
Hint: A TV reporter who survived a quarantine outbreak wakes up on a ship with infected passengers.
Description: Ángela Vidal, the young television reporter who entered the building with the firemen, manages to make it out alive. But what the soldiers don't know is that she carries the seed of the strange infection. She is to be taken to a provisional quarantine facility, a high-security installation where she will have to stay in isolation for several days.

Title: Slackers
Hint: Three college layabouts who cheat their way through school are blackmailed by a creepy classmate.
Description: Dave, Sam and Jeff are about to graduate from Holden University with honors in lying, cheating and scheming. The three roommates have proudly scammed their way through the last four years of college and now, during final exams, these big-men-on-campus are about to be busted by the most unlikely dude in school.

Title: A Good Marriage
Hint: A wife discovers her husband of 25 years is a notorious serial killer.
Description: After 25 years of a ___, what will Darcy do once she discovers her husband's sinister secret?

Title: Demonic
Hint: A young woman unleashes demons when she tries to reconnect with her mother through a virtual reality simulation.
Description: A young woman unleashes terrifying demons when supernatural forces at the root of a decades-old rift between mother and daughter are ruthlessly revealed.

Title: Radhe Shyam
Hint: A palmist who believes love isn't written in his hand falls for a doctor in 1970s Europe.
Description: Vikramaditya, a world-renowned palmist, believes love does not exist in his stars, until he meets Prerana. But when destiny tries to pull them apart, will love prevail?

Title: Visions
Hint: A pregnant woman who moves to a vineyard experiences horrifying hallucinations of an intruder.
Description: After moving to a vineyard with her family, a pregnant woman experiences horrifying ___.

Title: Nine Lives
Hint: A stuffy businessman finds himself trapped inside the body of his family's pet.
Description: A stuffy businessman finds himself trapped inside the body of his family's cat.

Title: The New Daughter
Hint: A writer moves his family to a rural house, and his young girl becomes obsessed with a mysterious burial mound.
Description: John James is a writer; his wife has left him. He moves with his two middle-school children to an isolated house off a dirt road in South Carolina. The property has an Indian burial mound, which fascinates his daughter, Louisa, who's entering puberty.

Title: Bangkok Dangerous
Hint: A hitman in Thailand breaks his rules when he falls for a deaf pharmacist.
Description: When carrying out a hit, assassin Joe always makes use of the knowledge of the local population. On arriving in ___, Joe meets street kid Kong and he becomes his primary aide. But when Kong is nearly killed, he asks Joe to train him up in the deadly arts and unwittingly becomes a target of a band of killers.

Title: Little Black Book
Hint: A young woman snoops through her boyfriend's personal planner to learn about his past girlfriends.
Description: Determined to learn about her boyfriend's past relationships, Stacy -- who works for a talk show -- becomes a bona fide snoop. With her colleague, Barb, Stacy gets the names of Derek's ex-lovers and interviews them, supposedly for an upcoming show. But what she learns only adds to her confusion, and her plans begin to unravel when she befriends one of the women.

Title: Raksha Bandhan
Hint: A man must find suitable grooms for his four sisters before he can marry.
Description: Lala Kedarnath is blessed with 4 sisters. But his only worry is to find suitable grooms for each of them, as only then can he marry his childhood love. To what lengths will he go to succeed?

Title: Blood and Chocolate
Country: Romania, Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A teenage werewolf is torn between honouring her family's secret and her love for a human.
Description: A young teenage werewolf is torn between honoring her family's secret and her love for a man.

Title: House of 9
Hint: Nine strangers wake up in a locked house, and they're told only one will leave alive.
Description: Nine strangers wake up in a house with no recollection how they got there and no way out. The voice on the PA introduces them to a grisly game they must play. The prize is $5 million and their life.

Title: Welcome to Mooseport
Hint: A retired US president runs for mayor of a small Maine town.
Description: A US president who has retired after two terms in office returns to his hometown of ___, Maine and decides to run for Mayor against another local candidate.

Title: Into the Grizzly Maze
Hint: Two estranged brothers reunite in the Alaskan wild and are hunted by a rogue man-eating bear.
Description: Two estranged brothers reunite at their childhood home in the Alaskan wild. They set out on a two-day hike and are stalked by an unrelenting ___ bear.

Title: Pink Cadillac
Hint: A skip tracer helps a woman whose baby has been kidnapped by a gang of white supremacists.
Description: A skip tracer helps out a bail-jumper after her child is kidnapped by a group of ethno-nationalist thugs, of which her husband is a member, going by the name of Birthright. The baby is taken as leverage because, although initially oblivious, she has their money!

Title: Unaccompanied Minors
Hint: Five kids snowed in at an airport on Christmas Eve learn some lessons.
Description: Five disparate kids snowed in at the airport on Christmas Eve learn some lessons about friendship when they launch a bid to get back to their families and outsmart a disgruntled airport official who wants to keep them grounded.

Title: Blackway
Hint: A young woman in her small hometown is harassed by a local thug, and turns to a logger for help.
Description: A young woman newly returned to her hometown becomes the subject of harassment by a man named ___, an ex-cop turned violent crime lord who operates with impunity in this small community on the edge of the wilderness.

Title: The Brothers Solomon
Hint: Two well-meaning but socially inept siblings try to get their dying father a grandchild.
Description: A pair of well-meaning, but socially inept brothers try to find their perfect mates in order to provide their dying father with a grandchild.

Title: Krrish 3
Hint: A superhero and his scientist father team up to save the world from a telekinetic villain.
Description: ___ and his father must team up to save the world from a psychokinetic evil man named Kaal and his army of mutants.

Title: Wrecked
Hint: A man wakes in a car wreck at the bottom of a steep cliff with no memory of how he got there.
Description: A man awakens in a car wreck at the bottom of a steep cliff. He can't remember who he is or how he got there, but a report over the radio fills in some of the blanks, as it describes a violent bank robbery and names a perpetrator who happens to be sitting dead in the back seat.

Title: Tim and Eric's Billion Dollar Movie
Hint: Two guys blow a fortune on a disastrous film and must run a failing shopping mall to pay it back.
Description: Two guys get a ___ dollars to make a movie, only to watch their dream run off course.

Title: Ram Setu
Hint: An atheist archaeologist races against time to prove the existence of a mythical bridge between India and Sri Lanka.
Description: An atheist archaeologist turned believer must race against time to prove the true existence of the legendary ___ before evil forces destroy the pillar of India’s heritage.

Title: Infini
Hint: A search and rescue team are teleported to a distant mining colony to save a soldier.
Description: A search and rescue team are transported through deep space to a distant mining colony to save the sole survivor of a biological outbreak. During their mission, they find a lethal weapon which is set to arrive on Earth within the hour.

Title: Housefull 2
Hint: Four men fool their prospective father-in-law to get married.
Description: A comedy of errors wherein four men help each other to fool their prospective father-in-laws creating a cascade of confusion and mayhem.

Title: Woman on Top
Hint: A Brazilian chef with severe motion sickness becomes a TV star in San Francisco.
Description: Set to the intoxicating rhythms of Brazil, "___" is a spicy, sexy comedy about the magic of food, love and music. Meet Isabella, a sultry enchantress born with the special gift of melting the palates and hearts of men everywhere.

Title: Phone Bhoot
Hint: Two horror fans start a ghost-hunting business and make a deal with a spirit.
Description: Two crazy, jobless, horror-film addicts Major and Gullu, under immense family pressure to find work, hit upon the idea to float a unique ghost-capturing service when they meet a spirit, Ragini, who makes their business a success but in return asks them for a favour which they are compelled to honour.

Title: Zookeeper
Hint: A lovable animal caretaker gets dating advice from the talking animals in his care.
Description: Kindhearted Griffin Keyes is one of the best-loved caretakers at the Franklin Park Zoo, but he's more comfortable with the animals than with females of his own species as proven by his failed marriage proposal to the self-absorbed Stephanie several years ago.

Title: Teen Wolf: The Movie
Hint: An ancient evil emerges in a California town, and a group of werewolves must stop it.
Description: The wolves are howling once again, as a terrifying ancient evil emerges in Beacon Hills. Scott McCall, no longer a teenager yet still an Alpha, must gather new allies and reunite trusted friends to fight back against this powerful and deadly enemy.

Title: Pacific Rim: Uprising
Hint: A new generation of pilots must stop rogue giant robots and a kaiju attack.
Description: It has been ten years since The Battle of the Breach and the oceans are still, but restless. Vindicated by the victory at the Breach, the Jaeger program has evolved into the most powerful global defense force in human history. The PPDC now calls upon the best and brightest to rise up and become the next generation of heroes when the Kaiju threat returns.

Title: The Dark Tower
Hint: A gunslinger and a boy hunt a man in black who wants to destroy the universe.
Description: A boy haunted by visions of a parallel world aids its disillusioned guardian in preventing the destruction of the nexus of universes known as the ___.

Title: Bad Teacher
Hint: A gold-digging, lazy and foul-mouthed middle school educator tries to land a rich colleague.
Description: A lazy, incompetent middle school teacher who hates her job and her students is forced to return to her job to make enough money for a boob job after her rich fiancé dumps her.

Title: Alexander
Genres: War, History, Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance
Country: France, Germany, Netherlands, United Kingdom, United States of America, Italy
Hint: The life of the Macedonian king who conquered much of the known world.
Description: ___, the King of Macedonia, leads his legions against the giant Persian Empire. After defeating the Persians, he leads his army across the then known world, venturing farther than any westerner had ever gone, all the way to India.

Title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre 2
Hint: A radio host is victimised by a family of power-tool-wielding cannibals, and a vengeful ranger hunts them.
Description: A radio host is victimised by the notorious cannibal family while a former Texas Marshal hunts them.

Title: Knight of Cups
Hint: A Hollywood screenwriter wanders through the empty excess of LA, searching for meaning.
Description: Rick is a screenwriter living in Los Angeles. While successful in his career, his life feels empty. Haunted and confused, he finds temporary solace in the decadent Hollywood excess that defines his existence. Women provide a distraction to his daily pain, and every encounter brings him closer to finding his place in the world.

Title: Bride of Chucky
Hint: A killer doll is revived by his ex-girlfriend and they take a road trip to recover a magical amulet.
Description: For ten years, the tortured soul of serial killer Charles Lee Ray has been imprisoned inside a child's doll. ___ is reborn when his old flame, Tiffany, rescues his battered doll parts from a police impound. But ___ wants his new playmate cut down to size, so he transforms his blushing ___ into a stunning little terror. ___ and Tiffany can't wait to start their own homicidal honeymoon.

Title: Assassin's Creed
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A man discovers he's a descendant of a secret brotherhood of killers from the Spanish Inquisition.
Description: Through a technology that unlocks the genetic memories of his ancestor in 15th century Spain, Callum Lynch discovers he is a descendant of an ancient line of Assassins and amasses lethal skills to take on the oppressive Templar Order.

Title: Inheritance
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A wealthy patriarch's daughter discovers he left her a key to a secret bunker.
Description: The patriarch of a wealthy and powerful family suddenly passes away, leaving his wife and daughter with a shocking secret ___ that threatens to unravel and destroy their lives.

Title: Disenchanted
Hint: A married fairy-tale princess moves to the suburbs and wishes for a fairy-tale life.
Description: Disillusioned with life in the city, feeling out of place in suburbia, and frustrated that her happily ever after hasn’t been so easy to find, Giselle turns to the magic of Andalasia for help.

Title: Disturbing Behavior
Country: Australia, United States of America, Canada
Hint: A teen newcomer discovers the popular kids are being brainwashed into perfect students.
Description: Steve Clark is a newcomer in the town of Cradle Bay, and he quickly realizes that there's something odd about his high school classmates. The clique known as the "Blue Ribbons" are the eerie embodiment of academic excellence and clean living. But, like the rest of the town, they're a little too perfect.

Title: Ma
Hint: A lonely middle-aged woman befriends some teens and lets them party in her basement.
Description: Sue Ann is a loner who keeps to herself in her quiet Ohio town. One day, she is asked by Maggie, a new teenager in town, to buy some booze for her and her friends, and Sue Ann sees the chance to make some unsuspecting, if younger, friends of her own.

Title: Judge Dredd
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Netherlands
Hint: A futuristic street cop who serves as jury and executioner is framed for murder and must fight his evil clone.
Description: In a dystopian future, ___, the most famous ___ (a cop with instant field judiciary powers) is convicted for a crime he did not commit while his murderous counterpart escapes.

Title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 4: The Dream Master
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A teen girl absorbs the powers of her friends after a sleep-stalking killer with a bladed glove murders them.
Description: Freddy Krueger returns once again to terrorize the dreams of the remaining Dream Warriors, as well as those of a young woman who may be able to defeat him for good.

Title: Dolittle
Hint: A doctor who can talk to animals goes on a voyage to find a cure for the queen.
Description: After losing his wife seven years earlier, the eccentric Dr. John ___, famed doctor and veterinarian of Queen Victoria’s England, hermits himself away behind the high walls of ___ Manor with only his menagerie of exotic animals for company.

Title: Wild Card
Hint: A Las Vegas bodyguard with a gambling problem seeks revenge on a mobster.
Description: When a Las Vegas bodyguard with lethal skills and a gambling problem gets in trouble with the mob, he has one last play… and it's all or nothing.

Title: Good Luck Chuck
Hint: A man is cursed so that every woman he sleeps with meets the love of her life with the next guy.
Description: Cursed since childhood, dentist Charlie Logan cannot find the right woman. Even worse, he learns that each of his ex-girlfriends finds true love with the man she meets after her relationship with him ends. Hearing of Charlie's reputation as a good-luck charm, women from all over line up for a quick tryst.

Title: The Babysitters
Hint: A teen babysitter starts a prostitution ring for married men.
Description: Seventeen-year-old Shirley is a good student who works as a babysitter in order to make money for college. One night Michael, a father Shirley works for, confesses he's unhappy with married life. Shirley has a crush on Michael, and seizes this moment to kiss him. Michael is so happy he presents Shirley with a big tip, which gives her an idea.

Title: Machete Kills
Hint: A former federal agent is recruited by the US president to stop a madman.
Description: Ex-Federale agent ___ is recruited by the President of the United States for a mission which would be impossible for any mortal man – he must take down a madman revolutionary and an eccentric billionaire arms dealer who has hatched a plan to spread war and anarchy across the planet.

Title: The Ice Road
Hint: A group of truck drivers must cross frozen lakes in Canada to rescue trapped miners.
Description: After a remote diamond mine collapses in far northern Canada, an ___ driver must lead an impossible rescue mission over a frozen ocean to save the trapped miners.

Title: Wanderlust
Hint: A Manhattan couple join a hippie commune after losing their jobs.
Description: Rattled by sudden unemployment, a Manhattan couple surveys alternative living options, ultimately deciding to experiment with living on a rural commune where free love rules.

Title: The Slumber Party Massacre
Hint: A killer with a power drill attacks a high school girls' sleepover.
Description: Trish invites her high school basketball teammates over for a night they'll never forget when an unexpected guest crashes the party: an escaped psychopath with a portable power drill.

Title: Goosebumps 2: Haunted Halloween
Hint: Two boys find a book that unleashes a monster ventriloquist doll on October 31st.
Description: Be careful what you wish for. With their after school junk business, best friends Sonny and Sam hope to find treasure in other people’s trash. But when cleaning out the old Stine house, they open a locked book that frees a supernatural nightmare – Slappy!

Title: Dennis the Menace
Hint: A mischievous five-year-old drives his grumpy neighbour crazy and catches a burglar.
Description: Mr. Wilson's ever-present annoyance comes in the form of one mischievous kid named ___. But he'll need ___ tricks to uncover a collection of gold coins that go missing when a shady drifter named Switchblade Sam comes to town.

Title: The Black Dahlia
Country: United States of America, France, Germany
Hint: Two cops investigate the murder of a young actress in 1940s Los Angeles.
Description: In 1940s Los Angeles, two former boxers-turned-cops must grapple with corruption, narcissism, stag films and family madness as they pursue the killer of an aspiring young actress.

Title: Johnny Mnemonic
Hint: A data courier carries a huge secret in his brain implant.
Description: In a dystopian 2021, ___ is a data trafficker who has an implant that allows him to securely store data too sensitive for regular computer networks. On one delivery run, he accepts a package that not only exceeds the implant's safety limits—and will kill him if the data is not removed in time—but also contains information far more important and valuable than he had ever imagined.

Title: The Bling Ring
Hint: A group of fame-obsessed teens rob celebrities' homes in LA.
Description: Lured by stardom, a crew of aimless teens breaks into celebrity homes for a string of high-profile robberies and fame by appropriation.

Title: Jeepers Creepers 2
Hint: A school basketball team's bus is stranded and attacked by a winged monster.
Description: When their bus is crippled on the side of a deserted road, a team of high school athletes discover an opponent they cannot defeat – and may not survive.

Title: The Pacifier
Hint: A Navy SEAL is assigned to protect a family of five unruly kids.
Description: Navy SEAL Shane Wolfe is handed a new assignment: Protect the five Plummer kids from enemies of their recently deceased father -- a government scientist whose top-secret experiment remains hidden in the kids' house.

Title: Magic Mike XXL
Hint: A group of retired male strippers take a road trip to a convention.
Description: Three years after Mike bowed out of the stripper life at the top of his game, he and the remaining Kings of Tampa hit the road to Myrtle Beach to put on one last blow-out performance.

Title: The Hole in the Ground
Hint: A single mother suspects her son has been replaced by a sinister doppelgänger.
Description: Trying to escape her broken past, Sarah O’Neill is building a new life on the fringes of a backwood rural town with her young son Chris.

Title: Because I Said So
Hint: A meddlesome mother sets up dates for her youngest daughter.
Description: In an effort to prevent family history from repeating itself, meddlesome mom Daphne Wilder attempts to set up her youngest daughter, Milly, with Mr. Right. Meanwhile, her other daughters try to keep their mom's good intentions under control.

Title: Mirror Mirror
Hint: An evil queen tries to marry a prince and her stepdaughter fights back.
Description: After she spends all her money, an evil enchantress queen schemes to marry a handsome, wealthy prince. There's just one problem - he's in love with a beautiful princess, Snow White. Now, joined by seven rebellious dwarves, Snow White launches an epic battle of good vs. evil...

Title: 47 Meters Down
Country: Dominican Republic, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Two sisters on holiday in Mexico are trapped in a shark cage at the bottom of the ocean.
Description: Two sisters on Mexican vacation are trapped in a shark observation cage at the bottom of the ocean, with oxygen running low and great whites circling nearby, they have less than an hour of air left to figure out how to get to the surface.

Title: Josie and the Pussycats
Hint: A small-town girl band becomes famous, but their record label is using subliminal messages.
Description: ___, Melody and Val are three small-town girl musicians determined to take their rock band out of their garage and straight to the top, while remaining true to their look, style and sound. They get a record deal which brings fame and fortune but soon realize they are pawns of two people who want to control the youth of America. They must clear their names, even if it means losing fame and fortune.

Title: Hatchet
Hint: A group of tourists on a New Orleans swamp tour are stalked by a deformed killer.
Description: When a group of tourists on a New Orleans haunted swamp tour find themselves stranded in the wilderness, their evening of fun and spooks turns into a horrific nightmare.

Title: Curse of Chucky
Hint: A killer doll terrorises a paraplegic woman and her family.
Description: After her mother's mysterious death, Nica begins to suspect that the talking, red-haired doll her visiting niece has been playing with may be the key to the mounting bloodshed and chaos.

Title: Night School
Hint: A dropout tries to get his diploma at evening classes taught by a tough no-nonsense instructor.
Description: Teddy Walker is a successful salesman whose life takes an unexpected turn when he accidentally blows up his place of employment. Forced to attend ___ to get his GED, Teddy soon finds himself dealing with a group of misfit students, his former high school nemesis and a feisty teacher who doesn't think he's too bright.

Title: Stowaway
Hint: A three-person crew on a mission to Mars finds an unexpected passenger and doesn't have enough oxygen.
Description: A three-person crew on a mission to Mars faces an impossible choice when an unplanned passenger jeopardizes the lives of everyone on board.

Title: Unfriended
Hint: A group of friends on a video chat are haunted by a classmate who killed herself.
Description: While video chatting one night, six high school friends receive a Skype message from a classmate who killed herself exactly one year ago. At first they think it's a prank, but when the girl starts revealing the friends' darkest secrets, they realize they are dealing with something out of this world.

Title: Ice Age: Collision Course
Genres: Adventure, Animation, Family, Comedy, Science Fiction
Hint: A prehistoric squirrel's pursuit of an acorn sends an asteroid towards Earth, and the herd must stop it.
Description: Set after the events of Continental Drift, Scrat's epic pursuit of his elusive acorn catapults him outside of Earth, where he accidentally sets off a series of cosmic events that transform and threaten the planet.

Title: Mom and Dad
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A mass hysteria causes parents to try to kill their children.
Description: In a suburban community, moms and dads, one after the other, mysteriously feel the irresistible impulse to attack and kill their own offspring.

Title: Song to Song
Hint: Two intertwined love triangles play out in the Austin, Texas music scene.
Description: In this modern love story set against the Austin, Texas music scene, two entangled couples — struggling songwriters Faye and BV, and music mogul Cook and the waitress whom he ensnares — chase success through a rock ‘n’ roll landscape of seduction and betrayal.

Title: The Night Clerk
Hint: A hotel worker with Asperger's secretly records guests and witnesses a murder on a hidden camera.
Description: Hotel ___ Bart Bromley is a highly intelligent young man on the Autism spectrum. When a woman is murdered during his shift, Bart becomes the prime suspect. As the police investigation closes in, Bart makes a personal connection with a beautiful guest named Andrea, but soon realises he must stop the real murderer before she becomes the next victim.

Title: Jolt
Country: Bulgaria, France, United States of America
Hint: A bouncer with anger issues uses electric shocks to control her rage and seeks revenge.
Description: A bouncer with an anger management problem goes on a furious and resentful rampage after the murder of a friend.

Title: Double Impact
Hint: Two twins separated at birth reunite to take revenge on their parents' killers.
Description: Jean Claude Van Damme plays a dual role as Alex and Chad, twins separated at the death of their parents. Chad is raised by a family retainer in Paris, Alex becomes a petty crook in Hong Kong. Seeing a picture of Alex, Chad rejoins him and convinces him that his rival in Hong Kong is also the man who killed their parents. Alex is suspicious of Chad, especially when it comes to his girlfriend.

Title: Chain Reaction
Hint: A student machinist and a physicist are framed after a clean energy breakthrough.
Description: At the University of Chicago, a research team that includes brilliant student machinist Eddie Kasalivich experiences a breakthrough: a stable form of fusion that may lead to a waste-free energy source. However, a private company wants to exploit the technology, so Kasalivich and physicist Dr. Lily Sinclair are framed for murder, and the fusion device is stolen.

Title: The Specialist
Hint: A bomb expert helps a woman get revenge on the mobsters who killed her parents.
Description: May Munro is a woman obsessed with getting revenge on the people who murdered her parents when she was still a girl. She hires Ray Quick, a retired explosives expert, to kill her parents' killers. When Ned Trent, embittered ex-partner of Quick's, is assigned to protect one of Quick's potential victims, a deadly game of cat and mouse ensues.

Title: Dumb and Dumber To
Hint: Two idiots travel across America to find one of them a long-lost daughter.
Description: 20 years since their first adventure, Lloyd and Harry go on a road trip to find Harry's newly discovered daughter, who was given up for adoption.

Title: Amityville II: The Possession
Hint: A family moves into a haunted house where the oldest son is possessed.
Description: Anthony and Dolores Montelli, along with their four children, move into their dream house in ___ and are immediately plagued by a string of paranormal experiences. When the abusive Anthony wrongly places the blame on the children, Dolores recruits a local Catholic priest to exorcise the house.

Title: Scoob!
Hint: A group of teens and their talking dog solve a mystery in an animated adventure.
Description: In Scooby-Doo’s greatest adventure yet, see the never-before told story of how lifelong friends Scooby and Shaggy first met and how they joined forces with young detectives Fred, Velma, and Daphne to form the famous Mystery Inc. Now, with hundreds of cases solved, Scooby and the gang face their biggest, toughest mystery ever: an evil plot to unleash the ghost dog Cerberus upon the world.

Title: 40 Days and 40 Nights
Country: United States of America, France, United Kingdom
Hint: A man gives up sex for Lent, just as he meets the woman of his dreams.
Description: Matt Sullivan's last big relationship ended in disaster and ever since his heart's been aching and his commitment's been lacking. Then came Lent, that time of year when everybody gives something up. That's when Matt decides to go where no man's gone before and make a vow: No sex. Whatsoever. For ___ straight days. At first he has everything under control.

Title: The Town That Dreaded Sundown
Hint: A hooded killer terrorises a small Texas community in 1946.
Description: When two young lovers are savagely beaten and tortured on a back country road in Texarkana, local police are baffled and must find "the Phantom Killer" before he can kill again.

Title: I Feel Pretty
Hint: An insecure woman wakes up from a head injury believing she's beautiful.
Description: A head injury causes a woman to develop an extraordinary amount of confidence and believe she's drop dead gorgeous.

Title: Poltergeist II: The Other Side
Hint: A family moves in with their grandmother to escape the evil spirits.
Description: The Freeling family move in with Diane's mother in an effort to escape the trauma and aftermath of Carol Anne's abduction by the Beast. But the Beast is not to be put off so easily and appears in a ghostly apparition as the Reverend Kane, a religious zealot responsible for the deaths of his many followers. His goal is simple - he wants the angelic Carol Anne.

Title: Timeline
Country: Italy, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A group of archaeology students travel back to 14th-century France to rescue their professor.
Description: A group of archaeological students become trapped in the past when they go there to retrieve their professor. The group must survive in 14th century France long enough to be rescued.

Title: R.I.P.D.
Hint: A slain cop joins a team of undead police officers who hunt monsters disguised as humans.
Description: A recently slain cop joins a team of undead police officers working for the Rest in Peace Department and tries to find the man who murdered him.

Title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A team of superheroes face a gleaming alien herald on a board who is preparing Earth for destruction.
Description: The ___ return to the big screen as a new and all powerful enemy threatens the Earth. The seemingly unstoppable '___', but all is not what it seems and there are old and new enemies that pose a greater threat than the intrepid superheroes realize.

Title: Runaway Bride
Hint: A woman who left three grooms at the altar falls for a reporter.
Description: Having already left three grooms at the altar, Maggie Carpenter is branded "the ___" by jaded New York journalist Ike Graham. But, after his facts are called into question, Ike races to Maggie's hometown to save his reputation and report on her upcoming fourth trip down the aisle – during which he's convinced she'll run again.

Title: After the Dark
Hint: A philosophy teacher challenges his students to a thought experiment about the end of the world.
Description: At an international school in Jakarta, a philosophy teacher challenges his class of twenty graduating seniors to choose which ten of them would take shelter underground and reboot the human race in the event of a nuclear apocalypse.

Title: National Security
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A police academy reject and a disgraced cop team up as warehouse guards to bust a smuggling ring.
Description: Earl Montgomery, a bombastic police academy reject, and Hank Rafferty, a disgraced, mild-mannered cop, can't seem to escape each other. They met on opposite sides of the law during a routine traffic stop that escalated out of control; now as lowly security guards they're thrown together to bust a smuggling operation.

Title: Failure to Launch
Hint: A 35-year-old man still living with his parents is set up with a woman hired to get him out of the house.
Description: At 35, Tripp has an interesting job, a hip car, a passion for sailing, an active dating life, and a great house - trouble is, he still lives with his parents, Al and Sue, who are not happy about it. Al and Sue are fascinated when friends whose adult son has recently moved away from home reveal they hired an expert to help.

Title: Hold the Dark
Country: Switzerland, United States of America, Canada
Hint: A naturalist in the grim Alaskan winter hunts wolves blamed for killing a local boy.
Description: In the grim Alaskan winter, a naturalist hunts for wolves blamed for killing a local boy, but he soon finds himself swept into a chilling mystery.

Title: No Retreat, No Surrender
Country: Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: A young martial artist battles a Russian fighter with the help of a famous martial artist's spirit.
Description: The mob is trying to strongarm local martial arts schools, forcing young Jason Stillwell and his family to move after his father is injured defending their dojo. With his father now rejecting violence, Jason is forced to train on his own to protect himself and his best friend from the members of a rival karate school.

Title: A Bad Moms Christmas
Hint: Three overworked mothers rebel against their own demanding mothers during the holidays.
Description: Amy, Kiki and Carla – three under-appreciated and over-burdened women – rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for mothers: Christmas. And if creating a more perfect holiday for their families wasn’t hard enough, they have to do all of that while hosting and entertaining their own mothers.

Title: Be Cool
Hint: A mobster turned movie producer tries his hand at the music industry.
Description: Disenchanted with the movie industry, Chili Palmer tries the music industry, meeting and romancing a widow of a music executive along the way.

Title: The Nutcracker and the Four Realms
Hint: A young girl searching for a key discovers a magical world divided into lands of sweets, flowers and snow, ruled by a tyrant.
Description: When Clara’s mother leaves her a mysterious gift, she embarks on a journey to four secret ___—where she discovers her greatest strength could change the world.

Title: Autumn in New York
Hint: A playboy restaurateur falls for a young woman with a fatal illness.
Description: Will Keane, a Manhattan restaurateur, is content with his playboy lifestyle until he meets Charlotte Fielding, a free-spirited young woman. Together the pair pursue a passionate affair that forces them both to reevaluate what they want out of life, even as fate threatens to steal away their future.

Title: Daddy Day Care
Hint: Two fathers who lose their jobs open a daycare centre.
Description: Two men get laid off and have to become stay-at-home dads when they can't find jobs, which inspires them to open their own day-care center.

Title: Raw Deal
Hint: A former FBI agent goes undercover to bring down the Chicago mob.
Description: Mark Kaminsky is kicked out of the FBI for his rough treatment of a suspect. He winds up as the sheriff of a small town in North Carolina. FBI Chief Harry Shannon, whose son has been killed by a mobster named Patrovina, enlists Kaminsky in a personal vendetta with a promise of reinstatement into the FBI if Patrovina is taken down. To accomplish this, he must go undercover and join Patrovina's gang.

Title: RV
Country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A family takes a cross-country trip in a huge rented motorhome to save the dad's job.
Description: Climbing aboard their mammoth recreational vehicle for a cross-country road trip to the Colorado Rockies, the Munro family – led by dysfunctional patriarch, Bob – prepares for the adventure of a lifetime. But spending two weeks together in one seriously small space has a way of cramping their style.

Title: Chopping Mall
Hint: Security robots in a shopping centre go haywire and start killing a group of teens.
Description: High-tech robots equipped with state-of-the-art security devices have been recruited as the new mechanical "night watchmen" for the Park Plaza ___. When a jolting bolt of lightning short-circuits the main computer control, the robots turn into "killbots" on the loose after unsuspecting shoppers!

Title: Barnyard
Hint: A carefree cow must step up when his father dies.
Description: Otis is a mischievous, carefree Holstein cow who lives on a farm where, unbeknownst to humans, the animals are anthropomorphic. He prefers having fun with his best friends: Pip the mouse, Freddy the ferret, Peck the rooster, and Pig the pig - rather than following strict rules and accepting responsibility. This annoys his stern adoptive father Ben, the leader of the farm's community.

Title: Bringing Down the House
Hint: An uptight lawyer meets an escaped convict online, who moves into his home.
Description: Uptight lawyer Peter Sanderson wants to dive back into dating after his divorce and has a hard time meeting the right women. He tries online dating and lucks out when he starts chatting with a fellow lawyer. The two agree to meet in the flesh, but the woman he meets — an escaped African-American convict named Charlene — is not what he expected.

Title: The Box
Hint: A couple are offered a mysterious device that will make them rich if they push a button, but a stranger will die.
Description: Norma and Arthur Lewis, a suburban couple with a young child, receive a simple wooden ___ as a gift, which bears fatal and irrevocable consequences. A mysterious stranger delivers the message that the ___ promises to bestow upon its owner $1 million with the press of a button. However pressing this button will simultaneously cause the death of another human being somewhere in the world; someone they don't know.

Title: Survivor
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A Foreign Service officer in London is framed for a terrorist attack.
Description: A Foreign Service Officer in London tries to prevent a terrorist attack set to hit New York, but is forced to go on the run when she is framed for crimes she did not commit.

Title: Triple Threat
Country: United States of America, China, Thailand, United Kingdom
Hint: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter.
Description: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A small band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

Title: Jay and Silent Bob Reboot
Hint: Two stoners travel across America to stop a Hollywood remake of a movie about them.
Description: ___ embark on a cross-country mission to stop Hollywood from rebooting a film based on their comic book characters Bluntman and Chronic.

Title: Laal Singh Chaddha
Hint: A simple-hearted man's life story unfolds through key events in India's history, in a remake of a famous American film.
Description: Events in India's history — from the Emergency and the famous Cricket World Cup win to the Punjab riots , unfold from the perspective of an innocent Sikh man ___, a person with a low IQ but high optimism. ___ is able to achieve everything under the sun but his childhood love continues to elude him.

Title: Billionaire Boys Club
Hint: A group of wealthy young men in Los Angeles in the 1980s establish a get-rich-quick Ponzi scheme.
Description: A group of wealthy boys in Los Angeles during the early 1980s establishes a get rich quick scam that turns deadly.

Title: Fist Fight
Hint: A teacher gets a colleague fired and is challenged to an after-school brawl.
Description: When one school teacher gets the other fired, he is challenged to an after-school fight.

Title: Wedding Daze
Hint: A man proposes to a stranger after his girlfriend dies.
Description: After losing the woman of his dreams, Anderson is convinced he'll never fall in love again. But at the urging of his best friend, he spontaneously proposes to a dissatisfied waitress named Katie and an innocent dare evolves into the kind of love that both have been looking for all along.

Title: Attraction
Hint: An alien ship crash-lands in a Russian city, and a teenage girl falls for an alien.
Description: After an alien ship crash lands in a Russian city, many who see the inside and the occupants start to question their own existence while others demand the aliens leave Earth.

Title: C.H.U.D.
Hint: A rash of bizarre murders in New York points to deformed underground creatures.
Description: A rash of bizarre murders in New York City seems to point to a group of grotesquely deformed vagrants living in the sewers. A courageous policeman, a photojournalist and his girlfriend, and a nutty bum, who seems to know a lot about the creatures, band together to try and determine what the creatures are and how to stop them.

Title: Win a Date with Tad Hamilton!
Hint: A small-town grocery clerk enters a contest and gets an evening with a Hollywood heartthrob, who then follows her home.
Description: A small-town girl wins a ___ with a Hollywood star through a contest. When the ___ goes better than expected, a love triangle forms between the girl, the celebrity, and the girl's best friend.

Title: Life of the Party
Hint: A housewife whose husband dumps her goes back to college with her daughter.
Description: When her husband suddenly dumps her, longtime dedicated housewife Deanna turns regret into re-set by going back to college... landing in the same class and school as her daughter, who's not entirely sold on the idea.

Title: Life After Beth
Hint: A grieving young man's dead girlfriend comes back as a zombie.
Description: Zach is devastated by the unexpected death of his girlfriend, ___. When she mysteriously returns, he gets a second chance at love. Soon his whole world turns upside down...

Title: The Woods
Hint: In 1965 New England, a troubled girl experiences mysterious happenings at a boarding school.
Description: In 1965 New England, a troubled girl encounters mysterious happenings in the ___ surrounding an isolated girls school that she was sent to by her estranged parents.

Title: The Ice Pirates
Hint: Space buccaneers steal frozen water in a future where it is the most precious resource.
Description: In the not too distant future, where by far the most precious commodity in the galaxy is water. The last surviving water planet was somehow removed to the unreachable centre of the galaxy at the end of the galactic trade wars. The galaxy is ruled by an evil emperor presiding over a trade oligarchy that controls all mining and sale of ___ from asteroids and comets.

Title: No Good Deed
Hint: A devoted wife and mother lets a charming stranger into her house.
Description: Terri is a devoted wife and mother of two, living an ideal suburban life in Atlanta when Colin, a charming but dangerous escaped convict, shows up at her door claiming car trouble. Terri offers her phone to help him but soon learns that ___ goes unpunished as she finds herself fighting for survival when he invades her home and terrorizes her family.

Title: The Lifeguard
Hint: A New York reporter returns to her hometown and takes a job guarding the local pool.
Description: Leigh, feeling unfulfilled, quits her reporter job in New York and returns to the place she last felt happy: her childhood home in Connecticut. She takes a job as a ___, regresses into adolescent behavior, and begins a dangerous relationship with a troubled teenager, leading to consequences for everyone involved.

Title: The Intruder
Hint: A young married couple buys a house from a man who can't let go.
Description: A psychological thriller about a young married couple who buys a beautiful Napa Valley house on several acres of land only to find that the man they bought it from refuses to let go of the property.

Title: Ghosts of War
Hint: WWII soldiers ordered to hold a French chateau encounter a supernatural enemy.
Description: A group of World War II American soldiers encounter a supernatural enemy as they occupy a French castle previously under Nazi control.

Title: The Sitter
Hint: A suspended college student babysits three kids on a wild night in New York.
Description: Noah, is not your typical entertain-the-kids-no-matter-how-boring-it-is kind of ___. He's reluctant to take a sitting gig; he'd rather, well, be doing anything else, especially if it involves slacking. When Noah is watching the neighbor's kid he gets a booty call from his girlfriend in the city.

Title: Milk Money
Hint: Three boys pool their savings to pay a prostitute to show them her body.
Description: Three young boys pool their money and pay V, a kindhearted prostitute, to strip for them. Afterward, she drives them home to the suburbs -- but then her car breaks down. It's just as well, though, because a mobster named Waltzer is after her, and V realizes the suburbs are the perfect place to hide.

Title: Altered
Hint: Four men who were abducted by aliens years ago capture one, and seek revenge.
Description: Fifteen years ago, five men were abducted by aliens. Only four returned. Now, these same four men have managed to capture one of the creatures who killed their friend and ruined their lives.

Title: The Bonfire of the Vanities
Hint: A Wall Street hotshot's mistress runs over a black teen.
Description: After his mistress runs over a black teen, a Wall Street hotshot sees his life unravel in the spotlight; A down-and-out reporter breaks the story and opportunists clamber to use it to their advantage.

Title: Club Dread
Hint: A serial killer stalks a hedonistic party resort on a Caribbean island.
Description: When a serial killer interrupts the fun at the swanky Coconut Pete's Coconut Beach Resort -- a hedonistic island paradise for swingers --- it's up to the club's staff to stop the violence ... or at least hide it!

Title: Paranoia
Hint: An entry-level employee is blackmailed into corporate espionage between tech giants.
Description: An entry-level employee at a powerful corporation finds himself occupying a corner office, but at a dangerous price—he must spy on his boss's old mentor to secure for him a multi-billion dollar advantage.

Title: The Delta Force
Hint: An elite counter-terrorist team rescues hostages on a hijacked plane.
Description: A 707 aircraft jetliner, en route from Athens to Rome and then to New York City, is hijacked by Lebanese terrorists, who demand that the pilot take them to Beirut. What the terrorists don't realize is that an elite team of commandos have been called in to eliminate all terrorists on the jetliner.

Title: They Came Together
Hint: A small business owner is about to lose her shop to a corporate developer, in a parody of romcoms.
Description: A small business owner is about to lose her shop to a major corporate development.

Title: Detention
Hint: A killer stalks the students at a high school in Grizzly Lake.
Description: As a killer named Cinderhella stalks the student body at the high school in Grizzly Lake, a group of co-eds band together to survive while they're all serving ___.

Title: New Year's Eve
Hint: The lives of several couples and singles in New York intertwine on December 31st.
Description: The lives of several couples and singles in New York intertwine over the course of ___.

Title: Beauty Shop
Hint: A hairdresser relocates to Atlanta and opens her own salon.
Description: Far from Chicago, hairdresser Gina Norris has relocated to Atlanta with her daughter and has quickly established herself as a rare talent in her profession. But after repeatedly butting heads with her shady, over-the-top boss, Jorge, Norris sets out to create her own salon -- even snagging a few of Jorge's employees and clients. Now, Jorge will do anything to shut her down.

Title: Clean
Hint: A garbage man tries to live quietly but is drawn into violence.
Description: Tormented by a past life, garbage man ___ attempts a life of quiet redemption. But when his good intentions mark him a target of a local crime boss, ___ is forced to reconcile with the violence of his past.

Title: Exit Wounds
Hint: A maverick cop is transferred to Detroit's worst precinct.
Description: Maverick cop Orin Boyd always brings down the domestic terrorists he tracks, but he ruffles feathers with his unorthodox techniques -- and soon finds himself reassigned to the toughest district in Detroit. When he discovers a group of detectives secretly operating a drug ring, Boyd joins forces with an unlikely ally -- gangster Latrell Walker -- to bring down the rotten cops.

Title: Regression
Country: Canada, Spain, United States of America
Hint: A detective investigates a case of satanic ritual abuse in 1990 Minnesota.
Description: Minnesota, 1990. Detective Bruce Kenner investigates the case of young Angela, who accuses her father, John Gray, of an unspeakable crime. When John unexpectedly and without recollection admits guilt, renowned psychologist Dr. Raines is brought in to help him relive his memories and what they discover unmasks a horrifying nationwide mystery.

Title: Boomerang
Hint: An advertising executive who woos women meets his match in his new boss.
Description: Marcus is a successful advertising executive who woos and beds women almost at will. After a company merger he finds that his new boss, the ravishing Jacqueline, is treating him in exactly the same way. Completely traumatised by this, his work goes badly downhill.

Title: The Big Wedding
Hint: A long-divorced couple must pretend to still be married for their adopted son's strict Catholic birth mother.
Description: To the amusement of their adult children and friends, long-divorced couple Don and Ellie Griffin are forced to play the happy couple for the sake of their adopted son's wedding after his ultra conservative Catholic biological mother unexpectedly decides to fly halfway across the world to attend.

Title: MacGruber
Hint: An inept ex-special operative is called back to stop his old enemy, who has stolen a nuclear warhead.
Description: Ex-special operative ___ is called back into action to take down his archenemy, Dieter Von Cunth, who's in possession of a nuclear warhead and bent on destroying Washington, DC.

Title: Maggie
Country: Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A father protects his teenage daughter as she slowly turns into a flesh-eating zombie in rural America.
Description: There's a deadly zombie epidemic threatening humanity, but Wade, a small-town farmer and family man, refuses to accept defeat even when his daughter ___ becomes infected. As ___ condition worsens and the authorities seek to eradicate those with the virus, Wade is pushed to the limits in an effort to protect her. Joely Richardson co-stars in this post-apocalyptic thriller.

Title: Brick Mansions
Country: Canada, France, United States of America
Hint: An undercover cop and an ex-con infiltrate a walled-off, crime-ridden Detroit housing project.
Description: In a dystopian Detroit, grand houses that once housed the wealthy are now homes of the city's most-dangerous criminals. Surrounding the area is a giant wall to keep the rest of Detroit safe. For undercover cop Damien Collier, every day is a battle against corruption as he struggles to bring his father's killer, Tremaine, to justice.

Title: Begotten
Hint: A god disembowels himself and Mother Earth emerges, in a nightmarish, experimental black-and-white silent film.
Description: ___ is the creation myth brought to life, the story of no less than the violent death of God and the (re)birth of nature on a barren earth.

Title: The Quest
Hint: A pickpocket in 1920s New York ends up on a lost island competing in a secret martial arts tournament.
Description: Ghang-gheng, the ancient winner-take-all competition in which the deadliest fighters from around the world employ the most spectacular feats of martial arts skills ever displayed in order to win the prized Golden Dragon. But fighting prowess alone will not be enough for Chris to triumph over such daunting foes.

Title: Skiptrace
Country: China, Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: A Hong Kong detective teams up with an American gambler to take down a notorious crime boss across China and Russia.
Description: A detective from Hong Kong teams up with an American gambler to battle against a notorious Chinese criminal.

Title: Domestic Disturbance
Hint: A divorced father suspects his ex-wife's charming new husband is a dangerous criminal.
Description: Frank Morrison is a divorced father with a 12-year-old son, Danny. His ex-wife Susan and son Danny now live with Rick Barnes, Susan's new husband. Danny, who has a reputation for telling lies, accuses his stepfather of committing a murder. Initially, no one believes his accusations, but then Frank becomes convinced and is the only one who believes him.

Title: The Pink Panther 2
Hint: A bumbling French inspector joins an international dream team of detectives to catch a jewel thief.
Description: When legendary treasures from around the world are stolen, including the priceless ___ Diamond, Chief Inspector Dreyfus is forced to assign Inspector Clouseau to a team of international detectives and experts charged with catching the thief and retrieving the stolen artifacts.

Title: The Skulls
Hint: A working-class student at an Ivy League college joins a powerful secret society and uncovers a murder.
Description: A senior at an Ivy League college, who depends on scholarships and working on the side, gets accepted into the secret society The ___. He hopes it betters chances at Harvard but The ___ is not what he thought and comes at a price.

Title: Love Wedding Repeat
Hint: A man tries to make his sister's nuptials go smoothly, in alternate versions of the same day.
Description: While trying to make his sister's wedding day go smoothly, Jack finds himself juggling an angry ex-girlfriend, an uninvited guest with a secret, a misplaced sleep sedative, and the girl that got away in alternate versions of the same day.

Title: Atlas Shrugged: Part I
Hint: A railroad executive struggles to keep her business afloat in a dystopian America where innovators are disappearing.
Description: A powerful railroad executive, Dagny Taggart, struggles to keep her business alive while society is crumbling around her. Based on the 1957 novel by Ayn Rand.

Title: Major League II
Hint: A baseball team that went from worst to first struggles to repeat as success goes to their heads.
Description: After losing in the ALCS the year before, the Cleveland Indians are determined to make it into the World Series this time! However, they first have to contend with Rachel Phelps again when she buys back the team.

Title: Fire with Fire
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A firefighter who witnessed a murder in Long Beach enters witness protection, then decides to take revenge.
Description: A fireman takes an unexpected course of action when a man whom he's been ordered to testify against—after being held up at a local convenience store—threatens him.

Title: Runner Runner
Hint: A Princeton student who goes bust playing online poker travels to Costa Rica to confront the site's owner.
Description: When a poor college student who cracks an online poker game goes bust, he arranges a face-to-face with the man he thinks cheated him, a sly offshore entrepreneur.

Title: Beyond the Reach
Hint: A corporate shark and his young desert guide play a deadly game of survival in the Mojave.
Description: A high-rolling corporate shark and his impoverished young guide play the most dangerous game during a hunting trip in the Mojave Desert.

Title: Bad Company
Country: United States of America, Czech Republic
Hint: A street hustler is recruited by the CIA to impersonate his dead twin brother in a nuclear arms deal.
Description: When a Harvard-educated CIA agent is killed during an operation, the secret agency recruits his twin brother.

Title: Dahmer
Hint: The story of one of America's most notorious serial killers and cannibals in Milwaukee.
Description: On February 15, 1992 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, Jeffrey ___, one of the world's most infamous serial killers, was convicted of 15 counts of murder and sentenced to 937 years in federal prison. This movie is based on events from his life.

Title: Falling Inn Love
Hint: A San Francisco executive wins a rundown New Zealand guesthouse in an online contest and sets out to fix it.
Description: When a San Francisco exec wins a New Zealand ___, she ditches city life to remodel and flip the rustic property with help from a handsome contractor.

Title: Chapter 27
Hint: A man stalks a famous rock star in New York in the days leading up to his assassination.
Description: A film about Mark David Chapman in the days leading up to the infamous murder of Beatle John Lennon.

Title: Ek Tha Tiger
Hint: An Indian spy falls for a Pakistani agent while on a mission in Dublin.
Description: A top Indian agent is sent to observe the actions of a scientist but the mission complicates when he falls in love with the scientist's Pakistani caretaker.

Title: You, Me and Dupree
Hint: A newly married couple's lives are disrupted when the husband's jobless best friend moves in.
Description: After standing in as best man for his longtime friend Carl Petersen, Randy ___ loses his job, becomes a barfly and attaches himself to the newlywed couple almost permanently -- as their houseguest. But the longer ___ camps out on their couch, the closer he gets to Carl's bride, Molly, leaving the frustrated groom wondering when his pal will be moving out.

Title: Bad Santa 2
Country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A drunk, foul-mouthed safe-cracker in a red suit teams up with his angry partner for a holiday charity heist.
Description: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Soke teams up with his angry little sidekick, Marcus, to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. Along for the ride is chubby and cheery Thurman Merman, a 250-pound ray of sunshine who brings out Willie's sliver of humanity.

Title: 12 Rounds
Hint: A New Orleans cop must complete 12 dangerous tasks to save his kidnapped girlfriend.
Description: When New Orleans Police Detective Danny Fisher stops a brilliant thief from getting away with a multimillion-dollar heist, the thief's girlfriend is accidentally killed. After escaping from prison, the criminal mastermind enacts his revenge, taunting Danny with ___ of near-impossible puzzles and tasks that he must somehow complete to save the life of the woman he loves.

Title: Jenny's Wedding
Hint: A woman's conservative family is thrown into chaos when she reveals she's marrying a woman.
Description: ___ Farrell is getting married. But how will her straight-laced family react when they find out that the woman they thought was their daughter’s roommate is actually her fiancée? As the old-fashioned Farrells attempt to come to terms with the prospect of a surprise daughter-in-law, they face a difficult choice: either adapt with the times or risk being left behind.

Title: The Reaping
Hint: A former missionary turned sceptic investigates biblical plagues in a small Louisiana town.
Description: Katherine Morrissey, a former Christian missionary, lost her faith after the tragic deaths of her family. Now she applies her expertise to debunking religious phenomena. When a series of biblical plagues overrun a small town, Katherine arrives to prove that a supernatural force is not behind the occurrences, but soon finds that science cannot explain what is happening.

Title: Drop Zone
Hint: A US marshal must stop a gang of skydiving terrorists who stage a prison break from an airliner.
Description: A daring prison break from an airliner at 30,000 feet leaves U.S. Marshal Pete Nessip mourning a brother and gunning for revenge. After being ordered to turn in his badge, he seeks out Jessie Crossman, a noted skydiver, and offers to sponsor her crew for the annual Independence Day parachuting show in Washington, D.C., if she trains him.

Title: The Kitchen
