When he discovers that she is actually a character from a bedtime story who is trying to make the journey back to her home, he works with his tenants to protect his new friend from the creatures that are determined to keep her in our world.

Title: Babylon A.D.
Country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A mercenary escorts a young woman with a secret across a post-apocalyptic world.
Description: A veteran-turned-mercenary is hired to take a young woman with a secret from post-apocalyptic Eastern Europe to New York City.

Title: Whatever It Takes
Hint: A nerdy teen helps his friend win his crush.
Description: A nerdy teen, Ryan Woodman is smitten with the popular and gorgeous Ashley Grant, who apparently has no interest in him. Meanwhile, dim star athlete Chris Campbell has his eye on Ryan's brainy and beautiful friend, Maggie Carter. The two agree to help each other in their romantic quests, but, as they come closer to their goals, both Ryan and Chris suspect that they might be pursuing the wrong girls.

Title: Senior Year
Hint: A woman wakes up from a 20-year coma and returns to high school.
Description: A 37-year-old woman wakes up from a 22-year coma, and returns to the high school where she was once a popular cheerleader to finish her ___ and become prom queen.

Title: Volcano
Hint: Molten lava erupts in the middle of Los Angeles, and an emergency chief must save the city.
Description: An earthquake shatters a peaceful Los Angeles morning and opens a fissure deep into the earth, causing lava to start bubbling up. As a ___ begins forming in the La Brea Tar Pits, the director of the city's emergency management service, working with a geologist, must then use every resource in the city to try and stop the ___ from consuming LA.

Title: Sleepaway Camp II: Unhappy Campers
Hint: A killer escapes from a mental hospital and becomes a counsellor at a summer retreat.
Description: Angela Baker escapes from a mental hospital and surfaces at a summer camp as a counselor who lectures her teenage charges on proper moral behavior. Those teens who break her strict rules -- from the camp chatterbox or a sex-obsessed girl to the boys who are peeping Toms -- are murdered by the impostor in various gruesome ways. As more ___ go missing, intrepid counselor Molly begins to piece together the truth.

Title: Virtuosity
Hint: A virtual reality serial killer escapes into the real world.
Description: The Law Enforcement Technology Advancement Centre (LETAC) has developed SID version 6.7: a Sadistic, Intelligent, and Dangerous virtual reality entity which is synthesized from the personalities of more than 150 serial killers, and only one man can stop him.

Title: Just Married
Hint: A newlywed couple's honeymoon in Europe goes horribly wrong.
Description: Although Tom Leezak and Sarah McNerney come from different worlds, they are both unexpectedly swept off their feet after their first meeting. They quickly fall in love and plan to get married, despite opposition from Sarah's uptight, rich family. After their wedding, the happy couple sets off - with the highest of hopes and ideals about love and marriage - on what they expect will be the perfect honeymoon in Italy.

Title: Seventh Son
Country: China, Canada, United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: A witch hunter trains an apprentice to battle an evil queen.
Description: John Gregory, who is a ___ of a ___ and also the local spook, has protected the country from witches, boggarts, ghouls and all manner of things that go bump in the night. However John is not young anymore, and has been seeking an apprentice to carry on his trade. Most have failed to survive. The last hope is a young farmer's son named Thomas Ward.

Title: Peninsula
Hint: A soldier returns to a zombie-ravaged South Korea to retrieve a truck of cash.
Description: A soldier and his team battle hordes of post-apocalyptic zombies in the wastelands of the Korean ___.

Title: Beverly Hills Cop III
Hint: A Detroit detective goes to an amusement park to investigate a counterfeiting ring.
Description: When his boss is killed, Detroit cop Axel Foley finds evidence that the murderer had ties to a California amusement park called Wonder World. Returning to sunny ___ once more, Foley reunites with Detective Billy Rosewood to solve the case. Along with Billy's new partner, Detective Jon Flint, they discover that Wonder World is being used as a front for a massive counterfeiting ring.

Title: V/H/S/94
Hint: A SWAT team discovers a mysterious tape collection in a drug den.
Description: After the discovery of a mysterious VHS tape, a brutish police SWAT team launches a high-intensity raid on a remote warehouse, only to discover a sinister cult compound whose collection of pre-recorded material uncovers a nightmarish conspiracy.

Title: Little Fockers
Hint: A man must prove himself to his father-in-law to be the head of the family.
Description: It has taken 10 years, two ___ with wife Pam and countless hurdles for Greg to finally get in with his tightly wound father-in-law, Jack. After the cash-strapped dad takes a job moonlighting for a drug company, Jack's suspicions about his favorite male nurse come roaring back.

Title: Gretel & Hansel
Hint: Two siblings encounter a witch in the woods during a famine.
Description: A long time ago in a distant fairy tale countryside, a young girl leads her little brother into a dark wood in desperate search of food and work, only to stumble upon a nexus of terrifying evil.

Title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
Hint: A popular girl is invited to a party where a killer stalks the guests.
Description: Beautiful ___ isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man, the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and ___ close pal, Emmet, keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for ___. Then two of the students are murdered.

Title: Don't Be Afraid of the Dark
Country: Australia, Mexico, United States of America
Hint: A young girl in a mansion discovers creatures that want to take her.
Description: A young girl sent to live with her father and his new girlfriend discovers creatures in her new home who want to claim her as one of their own.

Title: Under Siege 2: Dark Territory
Hint: A former Navy SEAL battles terrorists on a hijacked train.
Description: A passenger train has been hijacked by an electronics expert and turned into an untraceable command center for a weapons satellite. He has planned to blow up Washington DC and only one man can stop him, former Navy SEAL Casey Ryback.

Title: Sweet Girl
Hint: A man vows to bring justice to those responsible for his wife's death.
Description: A man vows to bring justice to those responsible for his wife's death while protecting the only family he has left, his daughter.

Title: Mortdecai
Hint: An eccentric British art dealer searches for a stolen painting that contains a secret.
Description: An art dealer, Charles ___, searches for a stolen painting rumored to contain a secret code that gains access to hidden Nazi gold.

Title: The Beach Bum
Country: France, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A rebellious stoner poet lives life by his own rules.
Description: An irreverent comedy about the misadventures of Moondog, a rebellious stoner and lovable rogue who lives large.

Title: Big Fat Liar
Hint: A teen whose story is stolen by a Hollywood producer seeks revenge.
Description: After one of his class papers is stolen and turned into a movie, a young student and his best friend exact a hilarious, slapstick revenge on the Hollywood hot shot who has taken credit!

Title: The Bounty Hunter
Hint: A tracker of bail jumpers is hired to bring in his ex-wife.
Description: Milo Boyd, a down-on-his-luck ___, thinks he's seeing an upswing in fortune when he gets a call to bring in his bail-jumping ex-wife, a reporter named Nicole. Milo considers the job an easy payday, but Nicole quickly escapes to chase a lead on a murder case. The former spouses play an escalating game of one-upmanship, until they suddenly find themselves on the run for their lives.

Title: The Lizzie McGuire Movie
Hint: A girl takes a trip to Rome and is mistaken for a pop star.
Description: ___ has graduated from middle school and takes a trip to Rome, Italy with her class. And what was supposed to be only a normal trip, becomes a teenager's dream come true.

Title: Hellraiser III: Hell on Earth
Hint: A demonic villain is unleashed in New York and creates a new army of followers.
Description: Pinhead is set loose on the sinful streets of New York City to create chaos with a fresh cadre of Cenobitic kin.

Title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider - The Cradle of Life
Country: Germany, Hong Kong, Japan, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: An archaeologist searches for Pandora's box before a scientist finds it.
Description: Off the coast of the volcanic island of Santorini, the intrepid archaeologist ___ makes the unexpected discovery of a pulsating golden orb able to guide its holder to the mythical Pandora's Box. As the legendary artifact contains ancient mysteries of unfathomable power - said to contain one of the deadliest plagues on Earth, ___ is tasked by MI6 to make sure it doesn't fall into the wrong hands.

Title: Critters 2: The Main Course
Hint: Three alien bounty hunters return to a small town to fight space creatures.
Description: Three bounty hunters from space fly back to the town of Grovers Bend, hoping to save local residents from a new batch of Critter eggs.

Title: Ladybugs
Hint: A businessman coaches his company's losing all-girl soccer team and disguises a boy as a girl.
Description: To climb the corporate ladder to success, a businessman agrees to coach his company's all-girl soccer team with the help of his secret weapon: his fiancee's son.

Title: Yours, Mine & Ours
Hint: A widower with ten children marries a widow with eight.
Description: When a widower with ten children marries a widow with eight, can the twenty of them ever come together as one big happy family?

Title: The Last Summer
Hint: A group of friends navigate love and life before college.
Description: Standing on the precipice of adulthood, a group of friends navigate new relationships, while reexamining others, during their final summer before college.

Title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
Hint: A renegade Vulcan hijacks the starship to find God.
Description: A renegade Vulcan with a startling secret hijacks the U.S.S. Enterprise in order to find a mythical planet.

Title: Hick
Hint: A pistol-packing teen meets an unstable rebel and a drifter.
Description: A pistol-packing teen meets an unstable rebel and a cocaine-snorting drifter as she hitchhikes her way out West.

Title: Hell Fest
Hint: On October 31st at a travelling horror theme park, a masked killer starts slaying visitors while everyone thinks it's part of the show.
Description: On Halloween night at a horror theme park, a costumed killer begins slaying innocent patrons who believe that it's all part of the festivities.

Title: Beastly
Hint: A shallow, arrogant teen is cursed by a witch to become hideous and has a year to find true love.
Description: A modern-day take on the "Beauty and the Beast" tale where a New York teen is transformed into a hideous monster in order to find true love.

Title: High-Rise
Hint: Life inside a luxury tower block in 1970s London descends into class warfare and savage chaos.
Description: Life for the residents of a tower block begins to run out of control.

Title: My Father the Hero
Hint: A teenage girl on vacation in the Bahamas pretends her divorced dad is her lover.
Description: A teenage girl on vacation in the Bahamas with her divorced father tries to impress a potential boyfriend by saying that her father is actually her lover. Remake of the 1991 French film Mon père, ce héros.

Title: When in Rome
Hint: A New Yorker steals coins from a fountain in Italy and is pursued by a gaggle of lovesick suitors.
Description: Disillusioned with romance, Beth, an ambitious New Yorker, travels to ___ for her sister's wedding, where she plucks magic coins from a special fountain of love. The coins attract unwanted attention from an assortment of odd yet ardent suitors: a sausage merchant, a street magician, an artist, and a male model.

Title: Horsemen
Hint: A grieving detective discovers his own son may be connected to a series of apocalyptic murders.
Description: A recently widowed detective still grieving over his wife's death discovers a shocking connection between himself and the suspects in a serial killing spree linked to the Four ___ of the Apocalypse.

Title: Deadgirl
Hint: Two high school misfits find a naked, undead woman chained in an abandoned asylum and keep her secret.
Description: When high school misfits Rickie and JT decide to ditch school and find themselves lost in the crumbling facility of a nearby abandoned hospital, they come face-to-face with a gruesome discovery: a body of a woman stripped naked, chained to a table and covered in plastic and soon realize she is anything but dead.

Title: Collateral Damage
Hint: A firefighter takes revenge on the terrorist who killed his wife and child in a bombing.
Description: Firefighter Gordon Brewer is plunged into the complex and dangerous world of international terrorism after he loses his wife and child in a bombing credited to Claudio 'The Wolf' Perrini.

Title: Three Men and a Little Lady
Hint: A trio of doting bachelors try to stop the woman they love from marrying a slimy Englishman and taking her daughter away.
Description: Sylvia's work increasingly takes her away from the three men who help bring up Mary, her daughter. When she decides to move to England and take Mary with her, the three men are heartbroken at losing the two most important women in their lives.

Title: Shocker
Hint: A serial killer is executed and becomes pure electricity, hunting a college football player.
Description: About to be electrocuted for a catalog of heinous crimes, the unrepentant Horace Pinker transforms into a terrifying energy source. Only young athlete Jonathan Parker, with an uncanny connection to him through bizarre dreams, can fight the powerful demon.

Title: The Innkeepers
Hint: During the final days of a haunted New England hotel, two employees try to prove the ghost stories are real.
Description: During the final days at the Yankee Pedlar Inn, two employees determined to reveal the hotel's haunted past begin to experience disturbing events as old guests check in for a stay.

Title: The Big Green
Hint: A British teacher in a depressed Texas town builds a soccer team from local misfit kids.
Description: In a depressed Texas town, British foreign exchange teacher Anna attempts to inject some life into her hopeless kids by introducing them to soccer. They're terrible at first, but Anna and her football-hero assistant whip them into shape. As they work overtime, the pair help kids build their self-esteem and also get involved in solving family squabbles.

Title: The Happytime Murders
Hint: In a world where humans and felt characters coexist, a disgraced puppet detective investigates the killings of former TV stars.
Description: In a world where humans coexist with puppets—who are seen as lesser citizens—cast members of a beloved 1990s children's television series begin getting murdered one by one. Puppet Phil Philips, an ex-LAPD detective-turned-private eye, takes on the case at the request of his old boss in order to assist his former partner, Detective Connie Edwards.

Title: Wine Country
Hint: A group of old friends turn 50 on a boozy weekend in Napa Valley that brings their tensions to the surface.
Description: A group of friends head to the land of oaky Chardonnays and big, bold Cabernet Sauvignons for one member of the squad’s 50th birthday party.

Title: The Girlfriend Experience
Hint: An expensive Manhattan call girl's life is shaken during the 2008 financial crisis.
Description: Chelsea is an in-demand call girl whose $2,000 an hour price tag allows her to live in New York's lap of luxury. Besides her beauty and sexual skill, Chelsea offers her clients companionship and conversation, or, as she dubs it, "the ___." With her successful business and a devoted, live-in boyfriend, Chelsea thinks she has it made... until a new client rocks her world.

Title: Iron Eagle
Country: Canada, Israel, United States of America
Hint: A teenager steals an F-16 with the help of a retired colonel to rescue his father from a Middle Eastern country.
Description: When Doug's father, an Air Force Pilot, is shot down by MiGs belonging to a radical Middle Eastern state, no one seems able to get him out. Doug finds Chappy, an Air Force Colonel who is intrigued by the idea of sending in two fighters piloted by himself and Doug to rescue Doug's father after bombing the MiG base.

Title: Invaders from Mars
Hint: A boy tries to stop aliens who have taken over his town and are brainwashing his parents.
Description: A boy tries to stop aliens that have taken over his town and are brainwashing its inhabitants.

Title: D3: The Mighty Ducks
Hint: A youth hockey team is offered scholarships at a prep school but struggles with a new coach.
Description: The ___ are offered scholarships at Eden Hall Academy but struggle with their new coach's methods and come under pressure from the board to retain their scholarships before their big game against the Varsity team.

Title: Cherry 2000
Hint: A businessman hires a tough female tracker to find a replacement for his broken android wife.
Description: When successful businessman Sam Treadwell finds that his android wife, ___ model ___ has blown a fuse, he hires sexy renegade tracker E. Johnson to find her exact duplicate. But as their journey to replace his perfect mate leads them into the treacherous and lawless region of 'The Zone', Treadwell learns the hard way that the perfect woman is made not of computer chips and diodes.

Title: Beverly Hills Ninja
Hint: An orphaned American raised by Japanese warriors travels to a ritzy LA neighbourhood on a bumbling mission.
Description: Haru, an orphaned American who washes ashore in Japan and is mistaken for the great White ___ of legend. Raised among the finest Ninjas, Haru grows strong and big - very big. With the grace of all Three Stooges rolled into one body, Haru is an embarrassment to his clan. But when a beautiful blonde pleads for his help, Haru is given one dangerous, disastrously funny chance to prove himself.

Title: The Final Conflict
Hint: The adult Antichrist becomes the US ambassador to Britain and hunts the newborn Christ.
Description: Damien Thorn has helped rescue the world from a recession, appearing to be a benign corporate benefactor. When he then becomes U.S. Ambassador to the United Kingdom, Damien fulfills a terrifying biblical prophecy. He also faces his own potential demise as an astronomical event brings about the second coming of Christ.

Title: Monster-in-Law
Hint: A woman's dream man's controlling mother will do anything to stop their marriage.
Description: Office temp Charlotte Cantilini thinks she's found Mr. Right when she starts dating gorgeous surgeon Dr. Kevin Fields. But there's a problem standing in the way of everlasting bliss: Kevin's overbearing and controlling mother, Viola. Fearing she'll lose her son's affections forever, Viola decides to break up the happy couple by becoming the world's worst mother-in-law.

Title: Volunteers
Hint: A womanising Yale graduate joins the Peace Corps in Thailand to escape his gambling debt.
Description: After graduating from Yale in 1962, womanizing Lawrence flees a gambling debt that his rich dad won't pay and takes his roomie's place as a Peace Corps Volunteer in the Thai Golden Triangle with two other PCVs. Will he survive two years?

Title: Forces of Nature
Hint: A blurb writer travelling to his wedding gets stranded with a free-spirited woman.
Description: Ben Holmes, a professional book-jacket blurbologist, is trying to get to Savannah for his wedding. He just barely catches the last plane, but a seagull flies into the engine as the plane is taking off. All later flights are cancelled because of an approaching hurricane, so he is forced to hitch a ride in a Geo Metro with an attractive but eccentric woman named Sara.

Title: Whiteout
Hint: A US Marshal in Antarctica investigates the continent's first murder before winter.
Description: The only U.S. Marshal assigned to Antarctica, Carrie Stetko will soon leave the harsh environment behind for good – in three days, the sun will set and the Amundsen-Scott Research Station will shut down for the long winter. When a body is discovered out on the open ice, Carrie's investigation into the continent's first homicide plunges her deep into a mystery that may cost her her own life.

Title: Little
Hint: A tyrannical tech mogul is magically turned back into her 13-year-old self.
Description: Jordan Sanders, a take-no-prisoners tech mogul, wakes up one morning in the body of her 13-year-old self right before a do-or-die presentation. Her beleaguered assistant April is the only one in on the secret.

Title: High School High
Hint: A teacher from a posh prep academy transfers to a rough inner-city campus, in a spoof of inspirational teacher films.
Description: Richard Clark has just left the well-known Wellington Academy to teach at Marion Barry High School. Now, he will try to inspire the D-average students into making good grades and try to woo a fellow teacher.

Title: Cop Out
Hint: Two veteran NYPD partners chase a stolen vintage baseball card and get tangled up with a Mexican drug lord.
Description: Detectives Jimmy and Paul, despite nine years as partners, can still sometimes seem like polar opposites—especially when Paul's unpredictable antics get them suspended without pay. Already strapped for cash and trying to pay for his daughter's wedding, Jimmy decides to sell a rare baseball card that's worth tens of thousands.

Title: The Last Days on Mars
Country: Belgium, Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A crew on the final day of the first manned mission to the red planet discovers a deadly organism.
Description: On the last day of the first manned mission to ___, a crew member of Tantalus Base believes he has made an astounding discovery – fossilized evidence of bacterial life. Unwilling to let the relief crew claim all the glory, he disobeys orders to pack up and goes out on an unauthorized expedition to collect further samples.

Title: Tom and Huck
Hint: A mischievous Missouri boy and his friend witness a graveyard murder and must decide whether to testify.
Description: A mischievous young boy, Tom Sawyer, witnesses a murder by the deadly Injun Joe. Tom becomes friends with Huckleberry Finn, a boy with no future and no family. Tom has to choose between honoring a friendship or honoring an oath because the town alcoholic is accused of the murder. ___ go through several adventures trying to retrieve evidence.

Title: My Little Eye
Country: Canada, France, United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: Five young people agree to live in a remote house for six months on a web broadcast for a million dollars.
Description: Five young people apply to live in an isolated house together for six months whilst their every move is filmed by numerous cameras.

Title: Stuart Little 2
Hint: A talking mouse and his cat friend help a bird escape a falcon.
Description: ___, an adorable white mouse, still lives happily with his adoptive family, the Littles, on the east side of Manhattan's Central Park. More crazy mouse adventures are in store as ___, his human brother, George, and their mischievous cat, Snowbell, set out to rescue a friend.

Title: Marauders
Hint: A suicidal FBI agent hunts a group of elite bank robbers and uncovers a conspiracy.
Description: An untraceable group of elite bank robbers is chased by a suicidal FBI agent who uncovers a deeper purpose behind the robbery-homicides.

Title: Action Jackson
Hint: A tough Detroit cop seeks vengeance on a powerful auto magnate.
Description: Vengeance drives a tough Detroit cop to stay on the trail of a power hungry auto magnate who's systematically eliminating his competition.

Title: Gabriel
Hint: An archangel fights to bring light to a purgatory city of darkness.
Description: ___ tells the story of an archangel who fights to bring light back to purgatory - a place where darkness rules - and save the souls of the city's inhabitants.

Title: Momentum
Country: South Africa, United States of America
Hint: An infiltration expert reveals her identity during a heist and is hunted by a killer.
Description: When Alex, an infiltration expert with a secret past, accidentally reveals her identity during what should have been a routine heist, she quickly finds herself mixed up in a government conspiracy and entangled in a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with a master assassin and his team of killers. Armed with her own set of lethal skills, Alex looks to exact revenge for her murdered friends while uncovering the truth.

Title: Navy SEALs
Hint: A team of elite naval commandos discovers terrorists have stolen Stinger missiles in the Middle East.
Description: During a rescue mission, a team of ___ discovers that a terrorist group has access to deadly, US-built Stinger missiles and must set out to locate and destroy them before they can be used.

Title: The Shrine
Hint: Young journalists investigate a missing backpacker and a cult in rural Poland that practises human sacrifice.
Description: A group of young journalists investigate a cult said to practice human sacrifice, but their ambitious ways may lead them to becoming the cult's next victims.

Title: Hotel for Dogs
Hint: Two foster kids secretly turn an abandoned building into a high-tech home for stray pets.
Description: Placed in a foster home that doesn't allow pets, 16-year-old Andi and her younger brother, Bruce, turn an abandoned hotel into a home for their dog. Soon other strays arrive, and the hotel becomes a haven for every orphaned canine in town. But the kids have to do some quick thinking to keep the cops off their tails.

Title: Kuttey
Hint: One rainy night outside Mumbai, several crooks try to rob the same van full of cash.
Description: A van carrying crores of cash. One rainy night in the outskirts of Mumbai. Unaware of each other, three stray gangs cross paths on the hunt. Unfortunately, all of them have the same plan. Bullets... Blood... Betrayal... It’s every man for himself... All the dogs after one bone. Will these dogs bite the bone, or will they lose to greed?

Title: Welcome Home, Roscoe Jenkins
Hint: A celebrity talk show host returns to his Southern family for his parents' anniversary.
Description: When a celebrated TV show host returns to his hometown in the South, his family is there to remind him that going home is no vacation!

Title: The Accidental Husband
Hint: A radio host is accidentally married to a fireman whose fiancée she broke up.
Description: Emma, a radio host, is about to be married to Richard, her perfect match. But right before her wedding, she learns she's already married to Patrick, a charming but irresponsible fireman. Furthermore, Patrick has a secret: he has arranged this little trick because Emma advised Patrick's ex-fiancée to end their relationship.

Title: Dickie Roberts: Former Child Star
Hint: A washed-up 1970s TV kid actor hires a family to relive the childhood he never had.
Description: TV child star of the '70s, ___ is now 35 and parking cars. Craving to regain the spotlight, he auditions for a role of a normal guy, but the director quickly sees he is anything but normal. Desperate to win the part, ___ hires a family to help him replay his childhood and assume the identity of an average, everyday loser.

Title: Picture Perfect
Hint: An advertising executive invents a fake fiancé to get a promotion.
Description: A young advertising executive's life becomes increasingly complicated when, in order to impress her boss, she pretends to be engaged to a man she has just met.

Title: A Castle for Christmas
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A bestselling author tries to buy a Highlands fortress from its grumpy owner during the holidays.
Description: To escape a scandal, a bestselling author journeys to Scotland, where she falls in love with a ___ -- and faces off with the grumpy duke who owns it.

Title: Diary of the Dead
Hint: A group of film students encounter real zombies while making a horror movie.
Description: A group of young filmmakers encounter real zombies while filming a horror movie of their own.

Title: Cube²: Hypercube
Hint: Strangers are trapped in a cube where time and space are warped.
Description: Eight strangers awaken with no memory, in a puzzling cube-shaped room where the laws of physics do not always apply.

Title: Home Sweet Hell
Hint: A man's wife becomes a killer when his mistress threatens to expose their affair.
Description: Don Champagne seems to have it all, but when his wife, Mona, learns of his affair with a pretty new salesgirl, she will stop at nothing to maintain their storybook life.

Title: Unplanned
Hint: A Planned Parenthood clinic director changes her mind about abortion.
Description: As one of the youngest Planned Parenthood clinic directors in the nation, Abby Johnson was involved in upwards of 22,000 abortions and counseled countless women on their reproductive choices. Her passion surrounding a woman's right to choose led her to become a spokesperson for Planned Parenthood, fighting to enact legislation for the cause she so deeply believed in.

Title: American Renegades
Country: Germany, Belgium, France, United States of America
Hint: A squad of Navy SEALs discover a hidden Nazi treasure in Bosnia.
Description: In the midst of the Balkan wars, a squad of Navy SEALs attempts to unravel a long-forgotten mystery after discovering an enormous treasure trove hidden at the bottom of a lake in Serbia.

Title: Valiant
Country: United Kingdom, United States of America
Hint: A small woodland pigeon joins the Royal Homing Pigeon Service in WWII.
Description: Set in 1944, ___ is a woodland pigeon who wants to become a great hero someday. When he hears they are hiring recruits for the Royal Homing Pigeon Service, he immediately sets out for London. On the way, he meets a smelly but friendly pigeon named Bugsy, who joins him, mainly to get away from clients he cheated in a game of find-the pebble, and helps him sign up for the war.

Title: Stolen
Hint: A master thief released from prison must rescue his daughter from his old partner.
Description: Master thief Will Montgomery is just released from the State penitentiary after serving a 10 year sentence, is contacted by Vincent, his ex comrade in crime, who is holding Will’s teenage daughter ransom in a hijacked taxi cab. Vincent will only surrender her when Will reveals the whereabouts of the 20 million dollars he contrived to conceal from their last robbery.

Title: Mafia!
Hint: A mob boss looks back on his life, in a spoof of gangster films.
Description: After growing up poor in Salmonella, Vincenzo Cortino installs himself as the preeminent, if bumbling, Mafia don of the New World. But now he must pass on power to one of his two sons: either level-headed veteran Anthony or vituperative loose cannon Joey.

Title: Head of State
Hint: An alderman is chosen as a presidential candidate after the candidate dies.
Description: When a presidential candidate dies unexpectedly in the middle of the campaign, the Democratic party unexpectedly picks a Washington, D.C. alderman as his replacement.

Title: Nine Months
Hint: A commitment-phobe realises he must grow up when his girlfriend becomes pregnant.
Description: When he finds out his longtime girlfriend is pregnant, a commitment-phobe realizes he might have to change his lifestyle for better or much, much worse.

Title: Open Season 2
Hint: A bear and his deer friend must rescue his dachshund from a circus.
Description: After falling head over hooves in love with Giselle, Elliot's road to the altar takes a slight detour when Mr. Weenie is kidnapped by a group of pampered pets determined to return him to his owners.

Title: Maximum Risk
Hint: An investigator looks into the death of his identical twin brother.
Description: Alain Moreau's investigation into the death of his identical twin brother leads him from the beauty of the south of France to the mean streets of New York City and into the arms of his brother's beautiful girlfriend. Pursued by ruthless Russian mobsters and renegade FBI agents, the duo race against time to solve his brother's murder and expose an international conspiracy.

Title: I.T.
Country: France, Ireland, United States of America
Hint: A successful businessman's family is terrorised by a young IT consultant.
Description: Mike Regan is a successful, self-made man who has it all: a gorgeous wife, a beautiful teenage daughter and a sleek, state-of-the-art “smart home”. But he soon finds himself in a deadly, high-stakes game of cat-and-mouse when his ___ consultant, Ed, starts using his skills to stalk Mike’s daughter and endanger his family, his business, and his life.

Title: Father Figures
Hint: Two brothers go on a road trip to find their real biological dad.
Description: Upon learning that their mother has been lying to them for years about their allegedly deceased father, two fraternal twin brothers hit the road in order to find him.

Title: Ratchet & Clank
Country: Canada, Hong Kong, United States of America
Hint: A mechanic and his robot friend join a team of galactic heroes.
Description: When the galaxy comes under the threat of a nefarious space captain, a mechanic and his newfound robot ally join an elite squad of combatants to save the universe.

Title: The Whole Ten Yards

Description: The parents of a soon-to-be married couple make the final preparations for the wedding ceremony.

Title: 12 Feet Deep

Description: Two sisters are trapped under the fiberglass cover of an Olympic sized public pool and must brave the cold and each other to survive the harrowing night.

Title: Apollo 18
Country: Canada, Russia, United States of America

Description: Officially, ___ 17 was the last manned mission to the moon. But a year later in 1973, three American astronauts were sent on a secret mission to the moon funded by the US Department of Defense. What you are about to see is the actual footage which the astronauts captured on that mission. While NASA denies its authenticity, others say it's the real reason we've never gone back to the moon.

Title: Inconceivable
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom

Description: A mother looks to escape her abusive past by moving to a new town where she befriends another mother, who grows suspicious of her.

Title: The Wild

Description: After a shipwreck, an intelligent robot called Roz is stranded on an uninhabited island. To survive the harsh environment, Roz bonds with the island's animals and cares for an orphaned baby goose.

Description: Medical researcher Frank, his fiancee Zoe and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her.

Title: We Summon the Darkness
Country: United States of America, United Kingdom
Hint: Three best friends at a heavy metal show in 1988 cross paths with sadistic killers, during a satanic panic.
Description: Three best friends attending a heavy-metal show cross paths with sadistic killers after they travel to a secluded country home for an after party.

Description: Four former harlots try to leave the wild west (Colorado, to be exact) and head north to make a better life for themselves. Unfortunately someone from Cody's past won't let it happen that easily.

Title: Ready to Wear

Description: During Paris Fashion Week, models, designers and industry hot shots gather to work, mingle, argue and try to seduce one another.

Title: King Solomon's Mines

Description: Fortune hunter Allan Quatermain teams up with a resourceful woman to help her find her missing husband lost in the wilds of 1900s Africa while being pursued by hostile tribes and a rival German explorer.

Title: Rim of the World

Description: Stranded at a summer camp when aliens attack the planet, four teens with nothing in common embark on a perilous mission to save the world.

Description: A panicked young woman and her two best friends fly to Mexico to delete a ranting email she sent to her new boyfriend. On arrival, they run into her former beau, who soon gets caught up in their frantic scheme.

Title: Exists

Description: A group of friends venture into the remote Texas woods for a party weekend and find themselves stalked by Bigfoot.

Title: Sandy Wexler

Description: When a hapless but dedicated talent manager signs his first client who actually has talent, his career finally starts to take off.

Description: Orphan Mary Katherine Gallagher, an ugly duckling at St. Monica High School, has a dream: to be kissed soulfully. She decides she can realize this dream if she becomes a ___, so her prayers, her fantasies and her conversations with her only friend focus on achieving super-stardom.

Title: Simply Irresistible
Hint: A struggling chef discovers her cooking can magically cause emotions in those who eat it.
Description: After her mother's death, mediocre chef Amanda Shelton is having trouble attracting customers to her family's restaurant. While shopping for ingredients, she is given a magical crab by mysterious Gene O'Reilly. Afterward, Amanda's dishes suddenly become excellent, inducing strong emotional reactions in everyone who eats them. Tom Bartlett, who is preparing to open his own eatery, tries her cooking and falls in love.

Title: Hangman
Hint: A detective teams up with a profiler to catch a killer who leaves letters from a children's word game on his victims.
Description: A homicide detective teams up with a criminal profiler to catch a serial killer whose crimes are inspired by the children's game, ___.

Title: My Super Ex-Girlfriend
Hint: A man dumps his neurotic superhero lover, who uses her powers to make his life a living hell.
Description: When New York architect Matt Saunders dumps his new girlfriend Jenny Johnson—a smart, sexy, and reluctant superhero known as G-Girl—she uses her powers to make his life a living hell.

Title: Clockstoppers
Hint: A teenager discovers a watch that stops time and is hunted by a corrupt tech tycoon.
Description: Until now, Zak Gibbs' greatest challenge has been to find a way to buy a car. But when he discovers an odd wristwatch amidst his father's various inventions and slips it on -- something very strange happens. The world around him seems to come to a stop, everything and everybody frozen in time.

Title: Paradise Hills
Hint: A young woman is sent to a luxurious island reform school for young women and learns its sinister secret.
Description: A young woman is sent to ___ to be reformed, only to learn that the high-class facility's beautiful facade hides a sinister secret.

Title: The Royal Treatment

Description: Isabella runs her own salon and isn’t afraid to speak her mind, while Prince Thomas runs his own country and is about to marry for duty rather than love. When Izzy and her fellow stylists get the opportunity of a lifetime to do the hair for the ___ wedding, she and Prince Thomas learn that taking control of their own destiny requires following their hearts.

Title: Friend Request
Hint: A popular college student accepts an online connection from a lonely classmate and is haunted by her through social media.
Description: Enjoying college life as a popular student, Laura shares everything with her more than 800 friends on Facebook. But one day, after accepting a ___ from a social outcast named Marina, Laura’s life is cursed...

Description: A criminal waits in a seedy motel for his boss after killing several men to steal a ___.

Description: Garden ___ Gnomeo & Juliet recruit renown detective ___ to investigate the mysterious disappearance of other garden ornaments.

Title: Silent House

Description: Sarah returns with her father and uncle to fix up the family's longtime summerhouse after it was violated by squatters in the off-season. As they work in the dark, Sarah begins to hear sounds from within the walls of the boarded-up building. Although she barely remembers the place, Sarah senses the past may still haunt the home.

Title: Asterix at the Olympic Games

Description: Astérix and Obélix have to win the ___ in order to help their friend Alafolix marry Princess Irina. Brutus uses every trick in the book to have his own team win the game, and get rid of his father Julius Caesar in the process.

Title: Snow Dogs

Description: When a Miami dentist inherits a team of sled ___, he's got to learn the trade or lose his pack to a crusty mountain man.

Description: In the aftermath of a nuclear disaster, a starving family finds hope in a charismatic hotel owner. Lured by the prospect of a free dinner, they discover that the evening's entertainment blurs the lines between performance and reality.

Title: Open Water 2: Adrift

Description: A weekend cruise on a luxurious party yacht goes horribly wrong for a group of old high-school friends when they get stuck in the water many miles from shore and a happy reunion turns into a fight for survival.

Title: The Medallion

Description: A Hong Kong detective suffers a fatal accident involving a mysterious ___ and is transformed into an immortal warrior with superhuman powers.

Description: She could do the responsible thing. Or she could go to ___ with her best friends to chase down a hot DJ. Easy choice.

Description: Annie, a young schoolteacher struggling to solve the brutal murder of her father, unwittingly summons the "___" to New Orleans, where she learns the secret of his power, and discovers the link that connects them.

Title: The Super

Description: A man becomes the superintendent of a large New York City apartment building where people mysteriously go missing.

Title: Strange Wilderness

Description: With the ratings dropping for a wilderness-themed TV show, two animal fans go to the Andes in search of Bigfoot.

Title: License to Wed

Description: Newly engaged, Ben and Sadie can't wait to start their life together and live happily ever after. However Sadie's family church's Reverend Frank won't bless their union until they pass his patented, "foolproof" marriage prep course consisting of outrageous classes, outlandish homework assignments and some outright invasion of privacy.

Title: Rapture-Palooza

Description: Two teens battle their way through a religious apocalypse on a mission to defeat the Antichrist.

Title: Catch That Kid

Description: A determined twelve-year-old mountain climber takes drastic action to save her injured father by planning a high-stakes bank heist, using her skills and teamwork to navigate the challenge.
